reviews.author: Aubrey M
reviews.title: Perfect family getaway!
reviews.text: Perfect family getaway!  Beautiful beach, wonderful service, and delicious food! Mario our concierge attended to our every need, and we couldn’t have asked for more. For our first trip to Mexico, the Paradisus far exceeded our expectations.

reviews.author: N H
reviews.title: Exceptional Service, Amazing and Caring Employees what more could you ask for!
reviews.text:
I had an amazing stay at Paradisus Cancun from February 17 to February 22, and what truly made it special was the incredible staff who went above and beyond to make me feel at home.

First, I have to give a huge thank you to my wonderful concierge team, Rossana & Galdino. They were always available, making sure I had everything I needed and offering great recommendations throughout my stay. Their kindness and attention to detail made such a difference—I felt genuinely cared for. Thank you also for decorating my room and my sister room. I was touched! :) 

Dining at Blue Agave & Cielo was a highlight, thanks to Jorge, who provided excellent service every time. He was attentive, friendly, and made sure every meal was enjoyable. A special shoutout to Mario, the supervisor at Blue Agave, who was always present and ensuring everything ran smoothly. His dedication to the restaurant and its guests was clear, and it truly elevated the dining experience.

Another part of my daily routine that I loved was stopping by the Nespresso Coffee Corner, where Richar & Alex made my iced coffee just the way I liked it—morning and evening. They were always welcoming, remembered my order, and made the experience feel personal and special.

The service at Paradisus Cancun was exceptional, and the staff made my stay truly unforgettable. I can’t wait to return and experience it all over again! Highly recommend! - Room 3126

reviews.author: Jennifer K
reviews.title: Massage with Teresita at the YHI Spa
reviews.text: My 75 minute Elemental massage with Teresita was absolutely spectacular. She applied the perfect amount of pressure and found all the spots that needed relief. I highly recommend her and this service. A every relaxing addition to our vacation.

reviews.author: Sara M
reviews.title: Wonderful stay at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay at Paradisus Cancun and chose the all-inclusive option. Obviously the location is idyllic, but beyond that, the service, food, amenities, and overall ambiance was exceptional. We stayed in the Melia members area, which was quiet and removed from the main hustle and bustle of the hotel. The members area also has its own espresso bar, manned by Luz, one of the nicest, friendliest people we met during our stay. The spa was wonderful and the escape rooms were very fun (extra charges for both of those). Highly recommend this resort if you’re traveling to Cancun!

reviews.author: Mark M
reviews.title: Relaxing time at Paradisus.
reviews.text: Overall experience was good. Rooms are a bit dated, but our concierge, Rodolfo, was outstanding in helping resolve issues and navigate the resort. Meals were pretty good, especially at Capella, and Jesus was outstanding as our wait staff. Made the evening for us. We would definitely do this again, but do your homework before hand, as all the activities and benefits of your stay are not made as clear to you up front as they could be.

reviews.author: EloP2000
reviews.title: Family Holidays
reviews.text:
We found it an unforgettable experience.  And amazing service.  Highlighting the attention of Baltazar, who attended us throughout our stay, in the Piletas part. 
As well as the attention of Daniel our Concierge, who were always attentive to our needs.  
The cleanliness of the rooms was excellent.  
The drinks were Premium and the food Excellent quality. 
100% recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: d0cpag
reviews.title: Carole and Michel
reviews.text:
Everything perfect except lack of chairs on the beach opposite adult side, too many BaliBed
Very fast repair service (toilet, safe)

reviews.author: timevans289
reviews.title: Exceeded Expectations
reviews.text: Loved the pyramid rain forest type of feel in many areas of the resort.Every meal and snacks were delicious!!! Loved the free cabanas that we were allowed to use at the Reserve.

reviews.author: Sheba Y
reviews.title: HEAVEN ON EARTH!!!! MUST GO
reviews.text:
We had an incredible experience, as always! We visited for our friend's bachelorette trip and stayed in the Reserve section, where the service exceeded all expectations. Cristian, our concierge, was amazing—he made everything incredibly smooth and stress-free, explaining everything clearly and with such warmth. The food and service here are top-notch, and it's clear they go above and beyond to care for each guest. We especially enjoyed breakfast at Sante at the Reserve every morning, with its stunning views and delicious chilaquiles. A big thank you to Miguel and Valeria at the pool, as well as Luis and Alejandro at the pool bar, for making our days so special. Ricardo at Ginger Bar was fantastic. RICARDO RICARDO !!!!!

Everyone made our stay unforgettable and we will be back for the grand reopening next year !!!!

reviews.author: M S
reviews.title: Awesome Weekend
reviews.text: Paradisus is a beautiful resort with awesome service. We stayed on the adults only side for a friends birthday and it was truly excellent. The staff was incredible. Waitress Valeria and all the staff at Sante were so immensely kind. They made great recommendations for dining. Destination concierge Christian really made it special. He made sure to let me know all the great things that were included like the day beds, hydrotherapy and sunset cruise. He helped our group of 10 to make reservations and even decorated the dinner table my friends birthday. Christian really went above and beyond and am so grateful for his commitment to making our trip memorable.

reviews.author: Pat K
reviews.title: Great Resort!!!
reviews.text: We had a great trip! This was our second time to the resort and we couldn’t have been happier! The reserve is fantastic! Enrique really took care of us!  The ocean is a bit rough however the reserve pool is heated and our drinks never got empty! Cesar was fantastic!

reviews.author: FellowTraveler56355
reviews.title: Fun times at Paradisus
reviews.text: Amazing! Had the most amazing time in Paradisus Cancun.  The ocean views were dreamy.  The entertainment staff was on point.  Latin night was so much fun!!! Had a blast dancing every night. On our last day Uriel and Bryan made our day with our honeydew melon gifts.  They were so sweet and attentive. Will definitely be back!!!

reviews.author: Naldo Turl
reviews.title: We love Melia
reviews.text:
We love it!
They always take care of us with the most affection in the world! 

Today we had dinner at the Capella, and they made a birthday surprise for my husband! Always caring! 

Rogelio attended us with a lot of affection and attention to everything! Congratulations on your work!

reviews.author: Kelly G
reviews.title: Not All Inclusive
reviews.text:
Lets start by saying I posted a review while still at the resort and they got upset at me.... Quite unprofessional.  Now that I am gone, and they cannot retaliate, I will give a legit review. One thing I noticed, look how many good reviews are 1 to 2 reviews... these are likely employees/ownership. I have many reviews and I am real and I give it straight. 

Ok here we go.

1. We paid for All Inclusive. This is NOT. Half of the resort was off limits. There is a heated nice pool and about 1/3 of the property we were not allowed to access because our all inclusive was not really all inclusive......This is false advertising straight up. 

2. The restaurants.. So "all inclusive" includes free food/drinks. However the way Paradisus solves this is so bad. Basically every included restaurant (except the buffet) requires a reservation at least 1 full day in advance. So 1st day, you will not be able to eat at any restaurants. The way to make reservations is also really horrible. There is ONE! lady at a desk from 10am to 2pm. And she is the ONLY way to reserve any restaurants. So yes there will be HUGE line waiting for this ONE lady to make reservations for the ENTIRE hotel. It took me 1.5 hours in line to make a reservation. This is when I also found out some restaurants I cannot eat at with our "all inclusive" pass. So that was really lame. However, I will say this. All the restaurants give you the same food as the buffet. Same Exact Food, most likely sitting out all day. There are pieces of rice on dessert. Pretty gross actually. I was sad to not be able to eat at the steak restaurant, but I imagine its just as bad as all the other ones. Yes at these restaurants they all have additional items you can pay for for extra, However All included should be all included. 

3. My "all inclusive" was supposed to come with a concierge. I saw our concierge the first day then no time after. So another scam. 

4. Resort, looks lovely. However many places are off limits. So all the nice pictures you see most likely are off limits. This is the entire 1st floor, either the restaurants or spa nice areas.

5. When you walk out the back door to the beach there is another bar and cabanas on the beach,.... nice right?? ... No, this they call a completely seperate company (its really all the same). The chairs provided by the resort will all be reserved with someones stuff by 7am. Every one, every day. I heard people reserve at 3am for the next day. The ONLY places available were these cabanas... They charge 250USD! to "rent" a cabana for the day, yes that is $5,116.870 pesos!. Yes you can order the same crappy food from the resort and pay much more here. This is ridiculous and probably pissed me off the most on this trip. You own the chairs, let your customers who already paid you use the chairs!!! Total SCAM.

6. The good was the beach. They are so lucky to have this beach. They have not yet figured out a way to pay per wave, or per sun, but I assure you they are working on it.

Overall very unhappy with Paradisus by Melia. The main thing is they know this, they want your money and will do anything to get it all. I will next time go to a place that respects their customers. Melia does NOT>

Regards

reviews.author: Jay L
reviews.title: Terrible experience
reviews.text:
Our experience at the Paradisus resort was nothing short of a nightmare, and I would strongly advise against staying here if you are looking for a relaxing and enjoyable vacation.

From the moment we arrived late at night, our stay was riddled with issues. We were given a room facing the street, directly across from a nightclub that blasted deafening music until 4 a.m., making it nearly impossible for my family, including young children, to get any sleep. The noise was unbearable, and it felt like we were inside the nightclub itself. Exhausted and frustrated, I approached the front desk the next morning, only to be told that no other rooms were available. A staff member assured me he would speak to a supervisor about moving us, but the next day, the answer was the same—no availability. I asked again on the third day, and once again, I was told no rooms were open. It became blatantly clear that the staff had no intention of accommodating us, despite the severe noise disturbance and the fact that our family’s comfort was severely compromised.

The incompetence and lack of professionalism extended beyond the front desk. The resort’s restaurants were poorly managed and disorganized. We had a dinner reservation at 6 p.m. and arrived 15 minutes early. Shockingly, the host informed us that we could not be seated until exactly 6 p.m., despite the restaurant being completely empty. This rigid and nonsensical policy left us standing around unnecessarily and showed a complete lack of customer care and flexibility.

Our health and safety were also jeopardized during this stay. On the last day, my children fell ill with a virus and fever, raising serious concerns about the resort’s hygiene and sanitation practices. To make matters worse, my wife had a drink at one of the bars that caused her lips to swell up, leading us to question the safety and quality of their food and beverages. These alarming incidents left us worried and upset, casting serious doubt on whether proper cleaning protocols were being followed, especially in dining areas.

The negative experience didn’t end there. Our checkout process was downright rude and impersonal. We checked out at 6 a.m. with no other guests present at the front desk, yet the staff member did not greet us or even ask about our stay. Instead, he coldly informed me of a charge, processed the payment, and hurriedly dismissed us without so much as a thank you or farewell. This shocking level of indifference and discourtesy was incredibly off-putting and completely unprofessional.

While the resort grounds were well-maintained and the food was decent, the rooms were outdated and in poor condition. Our sink was leaking, and the bathroom had a musty, moldy odor that was both unpleasant and concerning. It was clear that the rooms were not being properly maintained or cleaned. Additionally, the pool and beach lounge chairs were constantly occupied by guests who left their belongings unattended for hours, preventing other families from finding seating. The staff did absolutely nothing to manage this issue, leading to frustration and inconvenience.

Overall, while the resort may look appealing at first glance, the shocking lack of customer service, unbearable noise levels, outdated and poorly maintained rooms, serious sanitation concerns, disorganized staff, and health risks made our stay a complete disaster. I would never recommend Paradisus resort to anyone, and I will certainly not be returning. This was by far one of the worst vacation experiences we have ever had. Save yourself the frustration, discomfort, and potential health risks—choose another destination for your vacation.

reviews.author: Julia D
reviews.title: Concierge
reviews.text: The hotel and experience was just okay. However, our concierge Enrique was WONDERFUL. He helped us through every single detail and was incredibly attentive. He is by far the best we have ever worked with and we were so grateful to him. If you’re going to stay at this hotel, definitely utilize the concierge service and request Enrique!

reviews.author: Lisa A
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancún
reviews.text: To start, Christian, our concierge, took amazing care of us.  He was our “go to” for everything. He set up all of our dinner reservations, whether it was at the resort or somewhere else. The resort is so beautiful that’s why we went back there.  The spa was fabulous and even had a cold plunge 😬!!! My husband and I will definitely go back again.

reviews.author: deewaldron
reviews.title: NEVER A DISAPPOINTMENT!!!
reviews.text: Wonderful girls trip!!  I took a friend with me on a trip to Paradisus.  I have been several times but she has never been.  It was a relaxing and fun trip.  Food was very good, service excellent.  If I had one complaint, it was that the resort is not handicapped accessible.  Lots of stairs with NO RAILINGS.  Hopefully this will be corrected with the planned full renovation.  A SPECIAL COMPLIMENT to RODOLFO , our concierge who was efficient and had everything done which we requested and always stopped by to insure that we didn’t need anything.  We have had good concierges and bad ones as we travel alot and he was one of the best!!!  DAVID at the Adult pool area in the Reserve section was also wonderful with a warm welcome and great service!   Looking forward to our next trip.  No disappointment here!!!!

reviews.author: Phoebe F
reviews.title: Pleasant Stay with Minor Flaws
reviews.text: The stay was quite enjoyable overall. The staff were friendly and helpful, making us feel welcome. The amenities were decent, though some areas could use a little updating. The location was great, close to the beach and local attractions. A solid choice for a relaxing getaway!

reviews.author: Mr G
reviews.title: Waiting for our future return to Paradise at Melia Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: My wife and I have stayed at Melia Paradisus Cancun twice a year for the past 15 years. Each and every time has been a memorable experience. It has become our second home and the staff treat us like family. We are sad to report that they will be closing in mid 2025 for renovations. There has been many changes over the years and hope when they reopen they bring back the current staff who have provided exceptional service for so many years now. Both Galdino and Diego should be in top management positions as they are both an asset to the Melia brand. They are hard workers and have always gone above and beyond to make everyone happy. We will eagerly await the reopen so we can return to Paradise and once again join our second family. Thank you for the many wonderful years!

reviews.author: Rachael B
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun - Amazing Spot: A Deep Dive Review From Normal People
reviews.text:
To start this review, I feel like there needs to be context in who you're hearing the review from. We're two late twenties/ early thirties couple, whom are pretty simple to please... that being said, we feel we can still spot value or add a critique where needed. When I booked Paradisus Cancun, I became very hesitant after reading TripAdvisor reviews. There was concerns over the hotel shutting down in May 2025 to August 2025 for renovations and therefore issues in staff etc. I got so wrapped up in these reviews, (like others I assume,) and contemplated changing resorts... Thank god I didn't!! It was an amazing resort. 

We booked 'The Reserves,' - Ocean Front Room... This meant we had access to 'The Sante,' Exclusive to Reserve guests, a evening at Sals Steak house, a Hydrotherapy Spa treatment, a adults only pool, and access to a secondary coffee bar. The Reserves guests provided a concierge (highly recommend - family concierge is available for the non adults-only side,) two days with a Bali Bed (Underappreciated this at first,) and a evening lagoon tour through Aqua World. 

The property is set up by "pyramids." Upon arrival, you're in the main Pyramid- being Pyramid 3. Everything is accessible on the main floor or second floor. There is elevators to accommodate persons whom have a hard time with stairs, however there's still a lot of walking if that's a concern for you. (I say that as imagining my father with a bad knee coming here.) The restaurants in Pyramid 3 are as follows: 

Main Floor: Blue Agave (specialty is tacos, we loved it here,) Malva (buffet- what you would expect in a buffet,) Sals Steak House (unreal!), Coffee bar (iced lattes are to die for,) Access to the beach/ pool.

Mid/Second Floor: Lemon Fish (best sushi I've ever had! We went back a second time! The tart tar is out of this world.) Ginger Bar (the evening bar- we never really made it past 10/11pm to give a proper review.) 

As we arrived, we were escorted immediately to the left where Reserve Guests check in. On the right is where Non-Reserve Guests check in, (assuming there's separate lines for Concierge versus Non-Concierge guests.) We then walked to Pyramid 5 where The Reserve guests stay. Pyramids 1 & 2 and 4 are Non-Reserve guests or guests with children. 

Between Pyramids 3 and 4 is 'Flora,' located on the main floor. It was described to us as a 'healthy,' spot but still had good food in our opinions! Its attached directly Behind the Malva buffet for reference of its location.

Furthermore, located on the main floor of Pyramid 4 is also the spa, as well as the fitness center. As a fitness person, the gym has more than enough to cater to any kind of workout... if that's your thing on vacay! The Hydrotherapy spa was also great! 

Between Pyramid 4 and 5... the floors change... (This is confusing to type, but you will understand when you get there, so I'm going to be very brief on this...) Floor 1 in Pyramid 4 Becomes Floor 2 in Pyramid 5. 

Upon entering Pyramid 5... You'll see the Reserves area... Its bluntly noted with "The Reserves - Adults Only," signs. There's an area for check in that you're escorted to. Here is where you'll meet your concierge and plan your week. While I know you want to boogie to the beach and grab a drink - ITS WORTH IT!

Take the time to consider your week...You've paid xxx amount of dollars, don't be silly. All your A' La Cartes are booked at this time, your Bali Bed day (9PM -5/6PM or whenever you leave) , Your Spa session (1 hour,) Your lagoon boat tour etc. They take consideration to days you want to book a excursion. This ensures your A' La Carte reservation time is reasonable to make based on arrival times. Your concierge will offer a tour, we took it and it allowed what we read to come to life. It was maybe 20 minutes and they understand when you're 'done.' There was no pressures of timeshares or any unnecessary 'pushing,' whatsoever as I had read online. 

I found it useful to create a note on my IPhone and add each reservation time based on the date for easy reference. Our Concierge was great for being patient and allowing us time to discuss our options/ move things around. This note was referenced A LOT throughout the trip. 

Once you've concluded your tour/bookings, your concierge is reachable through 'WhatsApp.' They'll message you daily to provide a spreadsheet of daily activities at both The Reserve and Main Pools, nightly entertainment, Restaurant times/services etc. I will say that our concierge was mixed in replying quickly, while otherwise not replying for 5-6 hours. Once again, were not picky people and I wouldn't fault the hotel for it - I get it, I'm human too. However, if you have a higher standard for that sort of thing.. There you go. We were able to ask questions, change restaurants (Lemon Fish!!,) and even access medical care... 

Medical: Our concierge helped me located a pharmacy/ Walk In doctor. ("Farmacias Del Ahorro," located 300M Directly across the street, open 24hrs.) where I received a injection of antibiotics/ medical needs unexpectedly.  It was a life saver... The doctors office is on the left hand side of the pharmacy. We were in and out within 20 minutes. Its 200US to have access to care on resort property, here however the doctor asks, 'What do you value this as?" AKA, Whatever you think is reasonable. We gave him 70US cash, credit cards accepted within the pharmacy (we have AMEX.) 

Rooms: We personally loved the rooms. Youtube is great for reference. The glass between both the shower/bath area into the room is a romantic feature/novelty. The rooms were air conditioned, but I was jealous of a guy I saw that brought a personal fan... We still slept okay, however woke up sweating/ warm periodically. Mind you.. that could also be attributed to the booze and 30 degree weather lol.
Room Service: We found this to be a game changer.. The Reserve cafe/ bar menu is accessible via room service. SO, we would regularly order breakfast and coffee to the room. Our go to was avocado toasts (2 in each order,) with a plate of fruit, coffee (they bring a heated jug with creamer/sugar,) and biscuits - included croissants or other pastries. We found it allowed us to enjoy the balcony/ view a bit more. This also allowed time to... CLAIM YOUR POOL CHAIRS!!! 

Pool: As I did read in previous reviews... and can agree with as a non-picky guest... this was huge. There aren't enough pool chairs - both as a Reserve guest, or with access to the other pool areas. We would wake up between 7AM-8AM to leave a towel and personal item (books) to claim a spot. People are respectful to not take them... however don't be that person that claims a chair and doesn't use it and or comes at 3PM. People do take notice of it due to the limited amount of chairs. This negative critique is corrected though when you consider your two bali bed days, alongside likely a day or two of excursions when you're not there. Its not to say they don't become available during the day, however its like seagulls when one opens up.

Food/ Drinks: I can honestly say our drink menu included : Mango Tangos, Miami Vice, Sol's, Mojitos (Blue Agave makes a mean one,) and Margaritas (spicy.) There wasn't any sort of menus to get ideas from, so we eventually just kept asking for "anything with vodka/tequila etc," and had surprise drinks. The food was great all around! EVERY, and I mean EVERY single place, would ask if you had any allergy concerns- it was really great!  

We ate our body weight in Guac with their additional sauces (very spicy.) As Reserve Guests, you really get to indulge on Bali Bed Days. "The Sante," (Reserve Guest only,) restaurant is located at The Reserve pool. Everyone online went crazy for it- and I would too for the lunch. You can order as much food as you want to your Bali Bed throughout the day. Every restaurant uses QR code menus through the Melia App/portal. The Bali Beds specifically have these codes on them for 'Bali Bed Service.' Included burgers, wings (unreal), frenchfries, quesadillas, and of course.. Guac/Salsa chips. We had went here for a quick dinner on our check in day and weren't really thrilled though, but to each their own. 

A La Cartes: Lemon Fish is hands down the best for sushi - I thought I hated raw fish sushi and was pleasantly humbled.  Blue Agave was great for tacos, we came here several times. You essentially pick as many tacos as you want to choose from. There's approximately 7/8 if I recall correctly. Vegan options as well if that's your choice. Capella was a bit of a let down, this included Italian food (Lasagna gnocchi etc).. but again, you're in Mexico. Connolis were a saving grace.. very yummy!  Capella was accessible outside of the pool next to the reserves area. This is immediately left of Pyramid 3 beach access area. All of the outdoor nightly entertainment occurs here.  Capella seating is also used during breakfast for Malva Buffet (as its located behind it.) - You might now realize that Capella, Malva and Flora all stack behind one and other. Again, this is for reference to understand the layout - back to the food!

Sals Steak House was killer!! While they do cater to the public as well, I didn't notice any difference in service.  There are options to purchase more exclusive cuts of meat not included in your package (Tomahawk steaks, New York etc,) however we had Striploin and a unique cut that were DELICIOUS. I partially joked that it was better than the Keg.... truthfully. The last A La Carte that has gone unmentioned is located in front of Pyramid 1 area. I cant remember its name, and that goes for its food as well. Lastly, there's a pizza/ ice cream shop located in front of Pyramid 1/2 and the Kids Area of the main pool.  Good ice cream, always a line with obvious reason based on its location lol. 

Pools: There are 3 pools. The Main Pool, accessible to everyone is located in front of pyramids 1/2. Its accessible through those pyramids, and or turning right when exiting Pyramid 3's entry/exit area.  Pyramid 3 (again being the main access point,) is central for access to the pool, beach, and your restaurants/ cafe area. The Main pool was more lively, swim up bar, a lot of people. There was occasional entertainment/ music but it was hit and miss. All pools are lined with the Bali beds. When you do have your Bali bed day- if you want a ocean front one, make sure you ask in advance... All Bali Beds are randomly assigned by room, there's no 'first come, first pick concept.' We tipped 20US for the next Bali Bed day to get one for my boyfriends birthday.  

The Second pool, (Access to Cappella/Night Entertainment) is located turning left from the Pyramid 3 entry/exit area. Its accessible by all guests and simply just a 'quiet,' pool. There's a bar located beside the pool, people still played music etc. We kept chairs here or at the Reserve pool and would bounce back and forth to the Main Pool based on our social energy lol. All pools are lined with showers to try and get the sand off if you venture to the beach.

The Reserve pool was a quiet pool depending on the day of the week. They have some activities at the Reserve Bar/ Sante, but its not as lively as the Main Pool. We would play music from a Bluetooth speaker on days there was none etc. If you're looking for party pools - this isn't it. The Reserve pool area had a hidden gem that we wished we found sooner. To the right of the bar area is a stair set that leads to a second tier of pool chairs viewing the ocean. There's a couple umbrellas. LOVED having a chair here. The pool guys attended to both Bali beds and poolside chairs to provide drinks, order food etc. They were very attentive! The Reserve pool access the beach, with a bathroom/ shower area as well. 

The beach is also accessible via Pyramid 3 entry/exit area with a bathroom area and Aqua World vendor located here. Its entirely stairs here FYI. 

Bars: The only unmentioned bar and hidden gem is the beach bar! Its located between Pyramid 3 entry/exit area and The Secondary Pool. Turn left from Pyramid 3 and there'll be a bamboo arched stairwell on your right.. this leads to a beach bar with Muskoka Chairs and covered patio seats lined along the ocean front. This is also where the picturesque bar swings are located. 

Beach: The waves were pretty rough during our stay, there was designated areas to swim due to the riptides. The beach itself was impeccable though. We walked roughly 1km in either direction and came to the conclusion that Paradisus had the best maintenance for seaweed etc. Maybe we lucked out, but between rock fronts etc... its a great spot. All Bali Beach beds were of extra charge (150US.) The sand will reach every part of you the moment the waves crash against you! Trust me, it didn't make sense. 

Excursions: Aqua World is located directly across the street, next to the Pharmacy. Its extremely safe to walk between the two. Some drivers are considerate to tourists and stop for you (80km/hr road,) while other days we played Frogger and ran. We booked our excursions at the Secondary Pool. 400 US for three excursions for 2 people. We chose: Catamaran Isla Mujeres, the Jungle Tour, and Parasailing. To each their own here.  

Catamaran Isla Mujeres: You'll board a two Tier Catamaran (all seating no netting,) and have three stops. It's all inclusive food and lunch. It was a great time! You'll stop at the first destination being a reef with the option to snorkel.. There's multiple tour companies here with guides keeping the group together. It was maybe 30 minutes or so... You can stay on the boat if you want as well. The next stop is for food and to enjoy a hour or so lunch on the beach. Don't buy from any vendors here- its overpriced. The last stop is at Isla Mujeres. You have two hours to venture with three options- rent a golf cart (90US + Bring your license), walk around, or rent a taxi (100US). We wished we had brought more cash, and a credit card for the golf cart.) 
We rented a golf cart with a couple we met on the boat... we got lost, but ended up finding a random resort with a beach bar. A lot of ocean front resorts didn't look like much until you enter the property. We walked down jungle pathways until finding these hidden gems of luxury pool/ breach fronts. Others walked the street in the 'downtown,' port area for trying food or buying novelties. Up to you- your vacay!

Jungle Tour: You'll drive a speed boat out into the ocean (its choppy, but you can make of that what you want. The boats can zip, but are easy to drive/maneuver.) All boats are tied together by the guides, and then you go snorkel! This snorkeling is more private. There's a bit more freedom, however the guide does show you the best path to go through as their is coral. Flippers, goggles etc are all provided.   This was a half day excursion. We really enjoyed it! You get to venture, leave the property, but still take advantage of the all inclusive you paid for with minimal travel time. (Again- across the street.) 

Parasailing: We had to wait for the right day (weather,) to be able to go. My partner loved it, while I found a new fear of heights. The boat takes you out and essentially you sit back into a deep chair... with.. no... harness.. seatbelt.. nothing... and go up in the air for 10-20 minutes. I found it to be a bit scary but that's why you signed the liability sheets. My spouse loved it, I can simply check it off the bucket list now. 

Spa: We initially missed our original appointment... our concierge helped us rebook the same day! I was separated from my boyfriend and brought to a females sauna/ steam rooms for a period of time. The attendants then escort you to a variety of showers, and eventually a cold plunge/ rather large hot tub/ spa pool. (I'm sure there's proper terminology for all of this, but like I said - we're not fancy people, and we felt pampered!) After spending about 20 minutes in the spa pool, we exited to lay down chairs where they draped a hot cloth on our face and gave us head / neck massages. We had the areas to ourselves when using them... I'm not sure if that was by luck, or if they book it to ensure this. If you're sensitive to smells - there's a lot of aromas in the sitting areas (we loved it.) 

The Hotel Itself: GORGEOUS. 10/10 absolutely stunning greenery inside. Its a sensory overload! The staff do a very good job keeping the grounds clean and overall just beautiful to look at! All the vines, fountains, and many details really make the place feel luxury. 

All in all, we would recommend this place to come back to! I'll be curious to see the renovations come August 2025!

reviews.author: Barb L
reviews.title: Amazing, spoiled by our Concierge
reviews.text: 100% Reccomend!! I arrived first for a family trip ( Turned out to be an Engagement) My concierge Enrique was amazing he met me at Reserve side reception explained everything about the resort. Once the other family members arrived Enrique took over their concierge needs also, He made sure we had reservations and Bali Beds and when he found out about my sons engagement he assisted in a beach proposal ( beautiful) decorated their room twice and took care of everything. He kept us informed of daily activities and made sure he checked with us every morning to check any new needs/ wants !!! This man needs a raise he was incredible. David at the pool was amazing he always was happy and singing and smiling and I don't think he ever stopped moving!  He remembered who I was by name anytime i saw him, I asked him how he could remember so many people he said it was a gift!! Yes it is David it's a gift . Our nightly bartender Julio ( think i might have that wrong) again memorized our preferences always had a smile and seemed so happy to be at work !! Take the Catamarsn sunset cruise it's a blast and make sure you book your restaurants early but if you miss out the buffet is great and it's also 24 hour room service . Again 100% recommend !!

reviews.author: Dreamer25744541003
reviews.title: Enrique with butler service is awesome
reviews.text: Enrique was awesome! We were celebrating my son’s 14th birthday and he made his day special by decorating the room. Any issues we had he was prompt! I stayed here years ago and had an amazing experience as VIP adults only. Food this time was mid but the views are breathtaking!

reviews.author: Bailey P
reviews.title: Great couple trip
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful and has so much to offer. We stayed on the adults only side and enjoyed the poolside Bali beds, there are no palapas on the adults only beach as the tide took them out. LEMON FISH and the SAL Steakhouse restaurant were our favourite, the buffet is pretty bland. Nice beach with beautiful sand and hardly any seaweed. Walking distance to Aquaworld and restaurants off the resort.

reviews.author: Vijiti
reviews.title: AMAZING TIME! Loved it and will be back
reviews.text:
The resort is beautiful and we had a wonderful time! We were two families of 4 (kids aged 2, 7, 10 and 10). A few highlights:

* Lobby is stunning - the integration of greenery, water features, light and use of spaces creates an inviting and beautiful ambience that automatically relaxes you

* Food is good - great options - we really liked the Blue Agave Mexican, Outdoor Seafood Restaurant, Breakfast buffet, Lemon Fish and the ice-cream gelato bar

* Beach is beautiful - soft sand, lots of good space for kids to play and water clarity/calmness depended on weather (clear on sunny days but rough on rain/windy days). Walking around to the other resorts - our hotel portion is very nice! 

* Fun kids club! Although the kids club is not big or very modern compared to some other resorts, the ladies who run it do a fantastic job of creating activities and events that the kids absolutely loved! They wanted to go every day and even want to come back for it!

* We did not have the upgrade to family/club class but still enjoyed the whole experience and didn’t feel like we missed out!

* Great service and special thanks to the following people who made our stay absolutely wonderful! Thank you Gerry for helping book all our meals - that really saved us so much time and made our stay so easy! Thank you to all the Kidsdom team who made the kids want to go back every day - specifically: Irlanda, Alexia, Joanna and Monse. Thank you to Marco, Perla (Nespresso cafe), Michelle, Gerrardo, Manuel and Alejandro for the great service. You all made our stay amazing! 

* Few areas of improvement although I believe they are renovating very soon so most will be addressed:
1) Rooms are dated but to be honest it didn’t bother us as we were out most of the day. I think this will be upgraded in their upcoming renovations
2) Pools are beautiful but only 1 is heated which makes it hard for young kids to use the other ones. Again I think this will be upgraded in their upcoming renovations
3) Beach chairs are limited so you need to get up early or stay up late at night and put some things to save chairs (ex. Sunblock/book). We didn't mind this as we were up till 11pm anyways and secured them then

* For the price and the quality - we really enjoyed this resort experience and would happily do it again!

reviews.author: Trek67209400467
reviews.title: A little disappointed after 10 years.
reviews.text: We own a unit in this resort and have visited 10 times in the past.  We were a bit disappointed this year because of changes we did not know about.  There were no pool beds available the first day and we were told we could only get one for the following days but there were 6 of us.  That made our first day there very trying.  It turned out that we were able to get 3 beds on the following day.  The communication was very unclear.  We thoroughly enjoyed the remainder of the trip.  Another disappointment was that there were no available reservations in the restaurants on the property for any of the days we were there so we had to go off site or eat at the buffet.

reviews.author: Luis M
reviews.title: Our paradise in Mexico
reviews.text: The pool staff Mr. Cornelio Granados, attended us very excellently, meeting all our demands.  Like our concierge Mrs. Jennifer who served us very well, Mr. Fabio of Circle who advised us very warmly to change our membership and a special recognition for the somelier Mr. Iran for his extraordinary ability and predisposition to make us spend unforgettable evenings, Mr. Rodrigo and all the caregivers in pools and restaurants were of excellent efficiency, for us it will be a pleasure to return when they reopen.

reviews.author: tracyc22025
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun Review
reviews.text: An excellent resort!  The all-inclusive option worked well for us and the buffets always served great food and beverages.  In addition, the variety of on-site restaurants were many and they were all delicious.  We watched 3 of the 7 nightly shows and the acrobatics were fantastic.

reviews.author: Dennis B
reviews.title: Beautiful  but needs updating - closing end of May for major renovation
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful and the staff is very friendly. Unfortunately, the grounds are not very accessible for individuals with mobility issues. Restrooms  near the beach require descending and ascending stairs with limited hand rails. We are Circle members so we had a concierge to handle dinner, Bali bed, and other reservations.  There are only about 3 Concirge for all members, so they are not always available. As Members we are not interested  in upgrading our benefits. Our Concierge kept pressuring us to attend one to find out new benefits. We finally conceded with the promise of a free massage. Presentation was only 40 minutes, but to get the new benefits, we would need to shell out $26k. No thanks. Once we attended, our Concirge became almost invisible.  Hopefully, after the renovation  they will be hiring more staff. Current  staff have no idea what will happen to them when the resort shuts down at the end of May

reviews.author: Deborah J
reviews.title: Cielio’s
reviews.text: Ate at Cielio’s today. Food was great. Had the yogurt with berries and oats, fresh fruit, and the ham and cheese omelette. Also the coffee and green juice.  Jorge was exceptional. Phenomenal service by Carlos and Jorge. Everything was 5 star. Loved the food.

reviews.author: Hannah F
reviews.title: A team member who won't be forgotten!
reviews.text: Although I've rated the resort a 4 out of 5 for reasons like room cleanliness and difficulty of getting restaurant reservations, I do want to mention one incredible team member, Mariana at the breakfast buffet, who went absolutely above and beyond to make our family feel special. We were celebrating a 65th birthday and she took the time to create us custom decorated coffees, a handwritten sign, a birthday cake, and all of this was just during breakfast! She was truly special and deserves a lot of praise. Thank you Mariana!

reviews.author: Nafia K
reviews.title: Wonderful stay would love to go back
reviews.text: We had an amazing stay at paradisus cancun!! Veronica, manager relations of Meliá, made our stay special and memorable. She fixed any issues she had, was sympathetic, personable and extremely kind! We had the best time doing a couples massage and hydrotherapy at the spa. Boris is the manager at Lemon fish and he also made our experience one of a kind with the service he gave us. He was just like a friend to us, always helped us out with reservations and introduced us to the head chef who is incredible there. The decor of this restaurant is stunning and so too is the food. We had the most phenomenal dessert there made specially that evening and we really have to thank Boris for his fantastic personality, we really hope to meet him again!! Fanny at the Flora restaurant is extremely kind and warm, she also helped us out with reservations here at this healthy restaurant. We loved the food and decor at flora - the tomato soup and salmon were excellent and the environment is truly enchanting. The Nespresso bar was another favourite of ours, we visited this as many times a day as we could because the coffee is incredible here and the service is extremely fast and nice. There is a reason the queue is always so long for the Nespresso bar (since it’s so delicious including all the fresh desserts they have - we are not even dessert people but we could not resist), and yet you’re never left waiting very long at all! The pools are so much fun here  and if you can get a Bali bed (we had one with a view of the beach), you will have the most relaxing and comfortable day. Even sitting on the beach chairs was wonderful - no seaweed in the water but the sea was rough! You have to go early in the day to get seats. The aquamarina restaurant is by the pool and it has the best shrimp tacos, nice dinner options too. The pizza bar and ice cream bar are also wonderful as pool-side snacks. We also loved the pool-side bar for fresh lemonade and mojitos! We had one bad waiter at the blue agave restaurant near Malva as he was quite rude but then all the other waiters and chefs were wonderful at breakfast and dinner. Malva is the buffet restaurant and the food is sub-standard (breakfast, lunch dinner) but it is reliable. I would recommend you to try the restaurants when you can because the food is almost always better. We also had a bad experience with one waiter at Capella as we were sat at our table late (we had to wait a while) and then nobody came to take our order or serve us water for half an hour afterwards. The food was pretty good but it did take a while to come. Overall, this resort is lively and beautiful. Highly recommend this resort for the most memorable, magical stay!!!

reviews.author: Ali H
reviews.title: Lack Luster Resort
reviews.text:
I had high hopes for our trip, but unfortunately, it fell far short of expectations. The biggest disappointment? The food. Buffets were repetitive, bland, and often lukewarm. The à la carte restaurants weren’t much better—long wait times for mediocre dishes that lacked any real flavor. But the worst part was the bakery. Stale pastries, dry cakes, and artificial-tasting desserts made it clear that little effort was put into quality.

As for the hotel itself, it’s in desperate need of an update. The rooms felt worn out, with dated decor, musty smells, and furniture that had clearly seen better days.

The only reason this isn’t a 1-star review is that the beach was beautiful, and the staff were friendly. But for the price, I expected way more. I wouldn’t stay here again.

reviews.author: Julia Yu
reviews.title: Bad service and Food
reviews.text: The rooms and construction of the hotel are fine. The only thing is the customer service, it seems like they're not willing to service my family. (Not sure why) Especially the restaurants, I cannot make reservation online but had to book it in person at a certain time period. Which I think it was stupid because by the time I got to book it was already all full. My mother got really upset because we been eating buffet for the past 2 days already when we are staying here for 6 nights. Honestly buffet was not good too, when we finally ate at blueagave, aquamarina, the food is not good. For the service it was awful, we waited 5 minutes until they came to ask for our drinks. This trip at the paradisus was not exceptional, my last trip at the other hotel was MUCH BETTER than this hotel. My mom was mad half of the time because of this customer service and food quality plus unavailability of restaurants. This will not be my returning hotel.

reviews.author: laurahunt115
reviews.title: Loved this all inclusive experience!
reviews.text:
We had an overall great stay at Paradisus Cancun. We stayed in the adults only reserve section and made sure to take full advantage of the all inclusive benefits. We ate so much food and enjoyed poolside service with a drink in our hands at almost all times, mainly thanks to Yamil and Oscar.

Our concierge, Enrique, was attentive, accommodating, and always available. He did his very best to get the reservations at the restaurants and times we requested and sent us our daily activities each morning. He also booked us a poolside cabana for our last two days and made sure to get us the sunset cruise on Saturday.

Three issues we ran into:

1. Our original room was incorrect. They had my wife and I in a room with a double bed that was not an ocean view. Nevertheless, they made up for it by switching our room the next morning that matched our intended reservation.

2. When we arrived to the hotel, we were fortunate that Enrique had booked dinner reservations for us but a lot of days and times were already booked. I am not sure how this happens when booking the restaurants ourselves prior to arrival is not an option.

3. Our pickup at the airport was not readily available which meant we had to wait for about an hour to get a ride to the hotel, through their transportation provider, Otium.

Still yet, the people, the service from the staff, and the hotel itself made it a very nice stay. We would definitely come back to Paradisus in the future!

reviews.author: Ben T
reviews.title: Great resort with a couple things to note
reviews.text: Beautiful resort, excellent food, very friendly staff. Only one buffet though, so the breakfast lineup was also quite long - it's a huge resort, so lots of people. Coffee not the best either, they use Nespresso pods, but that's minor. Chairs go super fast too, they need to fix that. Getting up at 545am to reserve chairs wasnt fun. But we had a great time, miss it already. Rodolfo was our Concierge rep, and he was 5/5 stars!!

reviews.author: Judy C
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun absolutely wonderful
reviews.text:
1st time in Mexico for my husband and I. Had an amazing 2 week holiday at Paradisus Cancun. Such a unique architectural design and all the greenery.
All the restaurants were fabulous. Service was phenomenal all around. 
I would recommend to anyone, especially after the reno coming up.
We stayed in a king bed room in pyramid 2.
I would like to give special mention to a number of staff members....
- Gonzaldo at the customer service desk who spent tremendous time with me as I was registering,  due to a personal mishap arriving in Mexico. He sent wine and chocolate covered strawberries twice. (I did get him a Big Mac meal from McDonald's across the road, just because).
- Samantha, the food and beverage supervisor, that has proven herself in the 3 short weeks that she has held the position. She also had a gift sent to the room.
- Martin Ku, Manuel and Alfredo, all from Malva buffet, who were all exceptional,  and treated my husband and I like royalty. Martin even gave us a dessert with a sparkler and a sign saying "Have A Safe Flight Home" at our final dinner last Sunday.
- Jose, Francesco, and Laura from poolside, all were absolutely wonderful. 
I wish each of them a world of success.
Thank you all, Judy

reviews.author: Michael C
reviews.title: Dated Infrastructure but Great Service with Select Staff
reviews.text:
Rooms are dated in the first pyramid. We had to complain due to mold and the degradation of the room, for example the fan was swinging off the ceiling as many mounts were off the roof and the towel rack was not screwed into the wall. Pyramid 1 was also the farthest away and took 10-15min walk with our baby.
They addressed our concerns by moving us into pyramid 3 and it was much better. The room was updated and the convenience of its location was central to the whole resort including all the restaurants. It was a much desired change.
Service has been great. We were disappointed at first being left without service at one of the restaurants but the next night, Armando at Blue Agave turned out whole mood around. He was very helpful, very entertaining, and his service was excellent.
The restaurants are much better than the buffet. Reservation based.
Location is good with the beach. Convenient from the airport with the shuttle. Only 20 minutes. It is definitely one of those places where you have to get up in the morning to occupy spaces for the pool and the beach.
The rooms need to be updated but the staff here are very accommodating to your concerns and in the end, know how to make things right.
EDIT: I would also like to highlight that Rommel with guest services and Ignacio at Sal Steak House helped to provide an exceptional customer service experience for myself and my family. Thank you to you both for creating exceptional experiences.

reviews.author: Micheline L
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel with great staff
reviews.text: We had a really good time at the hotel. The reserve was definitely worth the money and I’m really glad that we got Enrique as our concierge. He went above and beyond to help us enjoy our stay, even though there were not a lot of time slots for dinner or cabana bed reservations. We were only offered late dinner time slots which had us missing the night time entertainment. The resort is beautiful and the staff is excellent, so it made up for the late dinners. I enjoyed all of the cocktails and our cabana waitress Valentina was also very sweet and always on top of things. My husband and I received a really great couples massage that had us relaxed for the remainder of our trip. I highly recommend getting a massage at the spa. Not sure if we will stay here again, (this is our second time), but we really enjoyed our 4 night stay overall.

reviews.author: Mona M
reviews.title: Amazing vacation!
reviews.text: We just spent an amazing week at the reserve side which was well worth the upgrade since it included the Bali beds, sunset cruise, spa experience and Sal and Sante restaurants.  The staff that made our stay extra great were Julio, Miguel, Oscar, Caesar, Valeria, David and Daniel.  Will be back for sure!

reviews.author: Nicci S
reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text:
We just arrived home from a family vacation at Paradisus Cancun. We travelled as a group of 8 with two kids ages 8 and 12. Overall we had a fantastic vacation with some phenomenal weather.

I would give the food about a 7 out of 10. The buffet was a little disappointing but had some good selections. I was hoping there would be some more options for picky children at the buffet. The restaurants were all pretty good. We especially liked Aqua Marina. The reservation process was a little frustrating as we had to wait in line beginning at 10am and could only book up to 3 days in advance. And often we couldn't get into the restaurants we wanted to. But we were able to get in somewhere every night around the times we had hoped for. 

Carlos at the pool bar was fantastic and made several drinks fun for my non alcoholic self and for my kids. Chocolate Milk was the crowd favorite. Water bottles were very limited around the resort but they did have filtered water throughout.

We LOVED the Nespresso bar, and having it open 24hours was especially beneficial for early morning chair retrieval (Ill elaborate). Alex was our favorite who was super chatty and was always engaging my kids in conversation. They had little sandwiches and snacks at Coffee Corner all throughout the day, which was good for a mid afternoon snack. My kids loved the banana bread.

The beach area was amazing with some fun waves that provided endless entertainment for the kids. I was  able to get chairs down at the beach everyday that provided some relief from the sun with some shade. Again, waves were pretty aggressive so we had a constant eye on kids while in the water.

Rooms :( We found the rooms to be pretty disappointing. Although we later learned that this hotel is shutting down in a couple months for a complete renovation. The rooms were dated and definitely needed to be fixed up. The beds were only double and weren't very comfortable. So 4 people in a room wasn't ideal. We had called several times to have our snacks and fridge restocked, in which they never came! Also from Thursday to Sunday, there was obnoxious music from the club across the street that went until 4 or 5am each night.  I would suggest ocean facing to avoid this.  We were in Pyramid 4 facing the front of the resort. It was SO loud.

Chairs (insert angry face). Reserving our chairs in the morning was painfully frustrating. This resort did not have enough chairs to accommodate the people staying. People were obviously going down in the middle of the night to place towels and personal belongings to save their seats. I am a very early riser and was down anywhere from 4am to 530am and most days the seats we wanted were not available. Not to mention people just removing our towels and items as they pleased.

Oscar was very helpful upon check in and answered all the questions we had. He did have us sit through a presentation for Melia, but provided Escape Room tickets for my kids and a beautiful beach bag for my mother in law and I.

Outside of a few minor things we had a great time. Staff was friendly and attentive and the ocean and pool were great for relaxing and for the kids to swim and play. I'd be curious to see the resort once renovations are complete!

reviews.author: Trish Q
reviews.title: Great vacation to relax and unwind
reviews.text: Resort is well maintained and clean. The food from the buffet is yummy and has healthy options. Staff and servers are very accommodating and friendly. Get family concierge if there isnt much price difference and maximize the benefits. Christian was a wonderful assistant. Would recommend.

reviews.author: Jennifer W
reviews.title: Dinner at Capella Restaurant
reviews.text:
We ordered salads and calamari to start. We all enjoyed these. The salads had anchovy dressing but we did not get a strong taste of anchovies which was pleasant.  The bread served with the meal was soft with garlic butter and Parmesan cheese and was delicious. 
For main entrees, two of us ordered Chicken Parmesan with a side of pasta with white sauce; another ordered the Fresh Catch of the day with vegetables. It was sea bass and he was very pleased with the taste of it. The other dish was pasta with a white sauce and bacon. She enjoyed it also. 
Desserts were Tiramisu and Parmesan Cheesecake with a balsamic reduction. Everyone was very impressed and pleased with their choices. 
Our waiter was Claudio and he made recommendations and was prompt and very courteous and friendly.

reviews.author: Tucker B
reviews.title: Enrique’s amazing service
reviews.text:
My stay at Paradisus was absolutely incredible, and I can’t say enough about the outstanding service I received—especially from my concierge, Enrique. From the moment we arrived, he went above and beyond to make our trip seamless and unforgettable.
Enrique took care of everything, from booking all of our dinner reservations, to arranging the best excursions. He made sure every detail was handled with care, allowing me to relax and truly enjoy my vacation! When we come back we will hope to get Enrique as our concierge again!

reviews.author: Catharine M
reviews.title: Pros and Cons
reviews.text:
The hotel resort and amenities are beautiful. The pools were clean and wonderful, as well as my room. I upgraded to The Reserve (adults only) and was assigned a concierge, Manuel, who was wonderful and helped me book dinner reservations, the spa, etc. The drinks were great and the service was overall good, but here are some complaints I had: 

1. I found the food to overall be terrible. I had some good meals - sea bass, tilapia, and other fish, but everything else was barely edible, and it upset my stomach (and I have a strong stomach!)   Lemon Fish and Aqua Marina were good, but I didn't like any of the other restaurants. Sal Steakhouse I found to be very overrated and the service was not good (maybe because I was just one person?) Malva, the buffet, had good salad and fruit, but that was about it. Everything else was not good, and also not very warm. 

2. I found it frustrating that dinner reservations had to be made, and they were not easy (thank goodness for Manuel!)  Several nights the restaurants were booked until 8:30 or 9pm and I don't like to eat that late, so I was irritated that I was at an all-inclusive and my dinner times and locations were very limited. 

3.  The pools were lovely, but it would have been nice to have a swim-up bar at the adults-only pool and not just the family pool. 

4. It would have been nice to have bars where you could actually sit at the bar - better for socializing. But this resort did not have that so you just ordered your drink and left. 

I have stayed at only two other all-inclusive resorts in my life (all in Mexico) so I am not an expert, but the food was the worst I've ever had. However, the drinks were good and the grounds were lovely - the hotel, facilities, pool, all very nice. So it just depends on what is important to you.

reviews.author: Juan Pablo S
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text:
The truth is that I had a reservation and had paid for another hotel and last minute I changed to this one. I had certain fears about the comments that some were very bad, but the truth is that I got an excellent surprise in the 10 nights I was. Vamor on the part:
1.- Far for me Cancun beach with that calypso color is to another level. Besides unlike the neighbouring hotels this one has a beach (the others no longer have a beach)
2.- We were in tower 1 (I believe) 1319. Very quiet with a jacuzzi on the terrace excellent.
3.- It's all close. Unlike other giant resorts. Everything was close by within minutes walking.
4.- The service in the pool and / or the beach where they brought you not only drinks but also food was excellent. In fact a few days we went to lunch at the Buffet. There were some very good drinks. While I wasn't "reserve" which seems to be special I never noticed the difference and you could take Chivas, JAck Daniel and even Ferne for the Argentines.
5,. The very friendly staff. especially highlighted the Kidclub as Esme, Monse, Irla Joana, Yammi and the cheerleader I think was called Natalia. My daughters had a great time there.
6.- They never bothered me about the timeshare issue. They called me a couple of times and I said no and that'd be it.
7.- The food surprised me. It is a resort but the buffet in my opinion is superior to others I have been to (Iberostar Tucan, Grand Bavaro Beach Punta Cana, Grand Park Royal, Hard Rock, Catalonia). Very good quality buffet food and breakfast too.  The pastries surprised me.
8.- The restaurants I did not find more fun but there was always possibility to book.
9.- The only one but was that I did not receive good attention when trying to make use of the free transfer from the airport. Although I admit that I did not read the fine print that said that you had to send an email 72 hours in advance, when ordering it two days in advance I was referred to an external operator, who never answered the phone, I lost a lot of time, and after many complaints and bad attention from the hotel (the operator never conesto) told me that I should have sent a thousand before. They could have told me from the start and not wasted hours on that. 
10.- Unfortunately, like every resort, I had to get up at 7:00 am to go and book restrooms.  However, I noticed once that I went earlier 6:45 which hotel staff booked for guests, putting towels and/or items.
11..- I would return to the hotel anyway.

reviews.author: Gabriela D
reviews.title: Dream holidays
reviews.text:
If you are traveling to Cancun, this is the Resort where you should stay.

Facilities are amazing, from the main pyramid hall (3), Lemon Fish restaurant, "The Reserve" area, gym, SPA, views from the room... EVERYTHING!

I want to thank the entire team of Paradisus Cancun for this unforgettable vacation. I want to mention especially Alicia, manager of The Reserve and who made sure that our stay was dreamy in addition to Astrid, Gex Manager for being aware of us.

Miguel and César from the pool bar in the adult area, Jesus from the restaurant Lemon Fish, "the bullfighter" from the restaurant Aguamarina and Claudio from the Restaurant Capella. For the service, the pampering and the sympathy with which they treated us.

Last but not least, our Concierge Mario. Without him, our vacation wouldn't have been the same. He organized our entire stay flawlessly and made sure we were enjoying our vacation 100%. Thank you so much Mario.

The hotel is a fantasy, but what makes it unique is its staff.

Thanks for these fantastic 11 days, we are looking forward to coming back!

reviews.author: Mike R
reviews.title: Great experience!
reviews.text:
Paradisus is a wonderful resort. Service at its finest. Rave to all the staff. 

Stayed in the "Reserve" adults only area. The atmosphere is good.  Nice and quiet if you want to lay and read a book, also lots of room it you want throw a ball in the pool. Service is great.  Oscar and Ceasar by the pool won't let your drink get empty. You can order food right to your Bali bed via QR code which your concierge will book for you during your stay.

Shout out to our Concierge Enrique! Very inviting upon arrival. Was always able to accommodate any requests. He updated us every day of the happenings around the resort via WhatsApp. Was always in touch. Set us up with a great Valentines suprise during our stay.

Ocean was quite rough during our stay. If you aren't sturdy on your feet, might not be the best beach resort for you. Not many beach chairs available either.

Food was fantastic. The buffet had many dishes to choose from breakfast, lunch and dinner. All fresh and tasty. At peak times there was a line up to get in. Be patient and you will enjoy it. 

A la carte's were all top notch. Get on your concierge to book for you upon arrival. They fill up fast. Best experience was at Lemon Fish with Miguel and Jorge. Those are two hard working guys that love to have fun. Recommend highly.

Did the spa water circuit. It was nice. Sauna, steam room  water treatment, cold plung and wonderful jet pool to cure the achy body. Conquered the escape room. Super fun with our group. A bit pricey for the experience tho. Nightlife was alright. Shows were done at 10pm. Bar in the reseve stops serving at 10:30pm. Rest of the resort stops at 11pm. Daily stocked fridge in your room.

Rooms were alright. A bit of aging showing. They are getting a renovation come spring this year. Still clean, daily service and clean linens. A/C was sup par. A bit warm to sleep. If you choose the lagoon view, the club at night is a bit noisy. Just bass from 11am till 4am. Kept me up a night or two. 

All in all a wonderful stay for our group of 6. We all enjoyed ourselves.

reviews.author: Nabeal H
reviews.title: Kanna beach club
reviews.text:
My wife and I spent half a day at Kanna Beach Club and had a fantastic experience. 
We paid $100 each for a cabana by the beach, which included food and drinks and access to the pool.
Our server, Oscar, was amazing, so friendly, spoke excellent English, and provided top-notch service. 
We couldn't use all of our credit, so he even brought us a bottle of red wine. 
We would definitely return if we're ever in Cancun again!

reviews.author: Heidi C
reviews.title: Great time
reviews.text: My husband and I visited Paradisus, Cancun for our 10 year wedding anniversary. We had a great time, the beach at this property was amazing. Our concierge, Rodolfo was top notch, taking our experience to the next level by arranging our dinner reservations and Bali bed bookings.

reviews.author: Yevgeniy O
reviews.text: Wonderful friendly atmosphere with concierge Cristian, he very help us for everything. Also SUPPER professional help us on Reserve bar on the breakfast or any time waitress Lorena and waiter Javier. Five star service . THANK YOU. God bless.

reviews.author: Jesenia Q
reviews.title: Amazing, once again!
reviews.text: During our most recent visit to this incredible resort, we were once again blown away by the exceptional service provided by the staff. We’d like to give a special shout-out to the Reserve Sante and pool team for their outstanding hospitality. Apologies if we’ve missed anyone, but we want to express our deepest thanks to Luis, Victor, Oscarito, Miguel, Cesar, David and our concierge Charly,for making our stay so memorable. Your efforts truly made a difference. We can’t wait to return after the renovations in 2026, and we sincerely hope the company continues to retain these amazing team members. Thank you again for everything!

reviews.author: slsinil
reviews.title: Oh what a wonderful week!
reviews.text:
We can’t say enough about the superb service from all the staff at Paradisus. It was genuine,courteous,kind and never ending. What hard working people!  To name a few - Cornelia and Hiram were great every day with setup at pool/cabana.  Laura was tireless waiting and serving drinks and food.  And Timoteo and Angel served the guys at the swim-up bar whatever their requests.  All these people were so professional.   Everyday our concierge Carlos checked on our group and fulfilled requests.
Our rooms were in an area apparently up for renovation.   They were very nice but I would say due for some repair/upgrade. You could see some wear and tear.  Cleaning crew did a great job, rooms always taken care of.

reviews.author: Nancy L
reviews.title: Run away
reviews.text: This is my worst hotel experience in Mexico. I paid for a 5*, rather a 3*. The hotel will close for major renovation, that’s all. There are palapas for 1/4 of the rooms, you have to get up at 5am to reserve places, not really room for adults only and many children, the staff has been cut, the workers are out of breath... poor staff... despite everything he keeps smiling. We line up in the morning for lunch. Food ok no more...go elsewhere

reviews.author: Camila M
reviews.title: Family holidays
reviews.text:
My experience in Kanna was excellent from the service, live music, food, super clean place. And especially the support of Oscar always attended to us 100. We appreciate everything, we hope to be back soon ☀️🏝 
Amazing place to recommend without a doubt.

reviews.author: Journey03859916016
reviews.title: Returned visit was excellent!
reviews.text:
Returned to play on the beautiful beach that Paradisus offers.  Like last year, great wave action, warm water, awesome experience.  This year stayed at the reserve, which I will recommend,  adults only.  Food hit and miss. Agua Marina was excellent,  the Italian place very average.  We "upgraded " our experience at Flora one night and had a fantastic dinner, well worth it. I think it ran 100 US for two double lobster tail dinners. Service excellent,  very clean, very nicely appointed room. Sunset cruise was a really fun excursion,  that was thrown in.

The property felt pretty busy, but that's not a dis.  I think they handled it well. You gotta get your spot, pool or beach, early, like 6-7AM. 

We compare this with our stays at iberostar grande and secrets akumal, all three excellent,  but if you go for a beach, Paradisus wins hands down

reviews.author: Marcia P
reviews.title: Good stay and will be back
reviews.text:
We stayed at the La Reserva
Pros - the best hardworking staff and always with a smile, pool concierges David and Victor; personal Concierge Galdino Chavez; wait staff - Oscar, Lorena, Gabby
Restaurants for dinner reservations in order of ranking best experience to think twice: Sal, Lemon Fish, aqua marina, Sante, Flora, Cielo
Cons: being accessibility challenged - more lighting, too many stairs, distance to main food from La Reserva too long on inside but shorter distance using outside path, more pool seating required

reviews.author: Momrob3x
reviews.title: Fun times and great service
reviews.text:
We stayed in the Club Melia and Rodolfo  took wonderful care of us. The pool staff is good but Roberto was the best and so attentive. The wait staff was very good. Bernice in the Blue Agave which was a great change from the buffet for breakfast .Anabel in Flora was super as was Martin, shade, armed.
Housekeeping and maintenance staff were always working to make the environment perfect.

reviews.author: Pablo H
reviews.title: Experience of 10
reviews.text:
The hotel is super well equipped. We took the reserv area, we had an adults only pool. I'm missing some music to liven up the atmosphere in this pool. Another thing we would have liked is to have a smoking area in this pool as we had to go around the whole pool and go to the children's area to be able to smoke. The staff was very friendly and the workers impeccable. Especially Jose May who was our concierge (impeccable treatment and very pending our stay) In Irina pool, cesar and juan Manuel.  Special appointment to Julio from the reception bar of the level reserv (his smile and desire to work so we would love to be there).
If you want to enjoy the Caribbean this is your hotel.

reviews.author: Adolfo C
reviews.title: A boat aground in the sand
reviews.text:
I have travelled several times to Cancun
We were at the Oasis, Iberostar etc
We chose the Paradisus for good reviews. And we found an “offer” of $400 a night for 2. We like the Caribbean Sea. If you want to get an umbrella near the beach and enjoy the Caribbean Sea: do not come to this hotel. You'd better hire a little hotel downtown and buy an umbrella and go to the beach. It's not possible here. You're on a boat running aground in the sand and you can't touch the sea.
That is, you should add to your budget a bottle of blocker 50 per day, because if you want to go to the beach you should be in the sun without exception. Bah, there is actually a choice: you get up at 4:00 am and you are going to throw a couple of towels on 2 restrooms every day of your stay!!!

reviews.author: Bk2219
reviews.title: Paradisus is Paradise
reviews.text:
Stayed in Pyramid 5, The Reserve Adults only. We were barely done with the check in process when our Concierge, Christian, was already in contact with us and introducing himself. He was SPECTACULAR! He checked in with us daily, assisted with some minor inconveniences that occurred allowing us to enjoy our vacation, and not worry about the small stuff. Oscar, was superb at the Pool and Sante. Genuinely a nice person, and a very hard worker. He took great care of everyone at the pool. Special shout out to David and Victor. Not only for their attentiveness for the guests, but for their care and compassion towards Daisy, the VERY FRIENDLY cat. "She is part of the team" as Victor said. 

Our room was clean and comfortable. The property itself was also very clean. The remainder of the staff we interacted with were all friendly. 

We ate at Malva ( The Buffet), Sal Steak Cave and Cappella ( Italian) the food was very good. Santa, in the Reserve, was our favorite. Lunch and Dinners there were amazing, specifically the Aguachile (Lunch) and Beef Ossobucco (dinner) 

We hope to return after the renovations are completed. Very pretty property.

reviews.author: Alexis T
reviews.title: Great Girls Trip
reviews.text: Paradisus is an amazing resort with friends, family, or as a couple! Came for a bachelorette - I had the best time. The food is amazing for an all inclusive and the drinks actually have alcohol. The resort is also beautiful. Definitely worth the price.

reviews.author: Vinay V
reviews.title: Paradise indeed!
reviews.text: Excellent place for family fun! Was crowded the week of winter break but that’s to be expected. Perfect weather and great staff and amenities!

reviews.author: jcolby8597
reviews.title: Cancun 2/2025
reviews.text: Overall great hotel. We stayed in the reserve section. Room was clean and beautiful. Concierge Antonio was awesome and took care of all of our needs . Food overall was good. Hot or miss with the service . Disappointed in the pool service at the reserve . No alcohol in drinks and our servers basically ignored us

reviews.author: Ric S
reviews.title: Great lack of beach chairs and swimming pool!
reviews.text:
There is a great lack of chairs at the beach and pool to the point of creating conflicts between holidaymakers. There are only half the required chairs in place. Probably to force people to pay for beach beds way too expensive.
I'm not going back because of this.

Otherwise the restaurants are very good and the employees are attentive. 9-hole golf is good for getting your mind off things. There are shows in the evening but still a lack of chairs to watch them.

Conclusion everything is fine except the lack of chairs which is unacceptable for the price of the hotel.

reviews.author: shart144
reviews.title: Great Trip!
reviews.text: Amazing experience. Beautiful rooms on the reserve adults side (beds were pretty firm but otherwise great), food was varied and fresh, and service was incredible. Specifically Valeria and Carlos! Thank you all for an amazing time.

reviews.author: André B
reviews.title: Among the best in Mexico
reviews.text: Paradise Cancun is very clean (although some refreshments are required). All employees are smiling, kind and helpful and never fail to greet you with a well-smelling Holà or Buenos dias. Reserve for adults only is highly recommended: bar and restaurant services by the hottest pool, Atrium area and Health restaurant are dedicated to it, suite-style rooms are large, balconies are large and private, sunset cruise on the lagoon is very pleasant, including drinking and eating, all in a party atmosphere with music and a saxophonist/singer. This package also includes an essential and easily accessible concierge service. Christian’s services to coordinate all bookings have been exceptional. In addition to checking in on us every day and keeping us on top of the daily schedule of activities, he proceeded with all our reservations for restaurants, cruise, spa, poolside beds with great attention, speed and sound advice. The restaurants Sal Steak Cave and Lemon Fish are particularly recommended, the service and meals are worthy of the 5-star restaurants, and offer a Chilean wine called very respectable house. The complex does not offer a large-scale performance venue, but the daily performances in various locations have allowed us to witness memorable performances by a Mexican guitarist, acrobats, dancers and troupe. We highly recommend Paradise Cancun.

reviews.author: Sherpa54781027085
reviews.title: I'll be back.
reviews.text: I think they can improve the facilities. The location and unbeatable scenery, just like the beach the sea and the sand! The abundant and varied food, as well as the restaurants that can be accessed. The beach service very good ,fast the.staff very attentive.

reviews.author: Curiosity07123696505
reviews.title: A Renewing Experience
reviews.text: A great hotel of great quality and excellent location, thank you , congratulations and gratitude with the hotel staff especially with my concierge Tony for his kindness and professionalisms, we will see you again waiting in your new face remodeled Pardisus by Meliá

reviews.author: Magdalena F
reviews.title: Excellent Hotel
reviews.text:
Excellent hotel and very helpful staff. Very friendly the Guest Service guys, especially Stephanie.
Very good spin classes from Uriel and the kids club for the kids had them very entertaining.
If it would improve the issue of control of the pools both on the beach and in the pool. Many people booked from very early and by 9 am there was no longer availability. Out of that all amazing!

reviews.author: Wendy Szmid
reviews.title: Super friendly staff! Super delicious food!
reviews.text:
The friendliness of the staff is unmatched. We don't feel like leaving the hotel! Everything we need is here. The food is very good from the buffet to the special restaurants.
I highlight Cornelio's attention in the pool, always attentive to help the tourist!

reviews.author: Asia T
reviews.title: Looking forward to coming back!
reviews.text:
The hotel fantastic, but its staff the best.
It is located very centrally, just 15 minutes by bus from the shopping and party area. If you don’t want to leave the resort you don’t have to because it has multiple entertainment options.
I want to highlight in particular the work of the whole team of The reserve, especially José our concierge always attentive and willing to help. Also Miguel of the restaurant Lemon and Fish, a 10. Finally we would like to thank the super work that manager Alicia always pays attention to every detail making you feel at home!
We will definitely repeat!

reviews.author: Javier T
reviews.title: Unbeatable experience.
