reviews.text: The hotel is simply a paradise, from setting foot in the lobby to any corner of it. But certainly the people who work there, make the experience unforgettable. In every restaurant, pool, bar... special mention for Alice and our concierge José, who have made us spend a wonderful holiday helping us at all times. Two people we'll always take in our hearts. Thank you also to Miguel de Lemon Fish, who gave us exquisite treatment and advice. We will repeat without hesitation.

reviews.author: Departure52091126922
reviews.title: Paradisus is paradise!
reviews.text:
We spent a week on our honeymoon at Paradisus Cancun, with the adults only reserve upgrade.  It truly makes you feel like a celebrity! We couldn't believe the quality of service given to us. We had our own personal concierge, Enrique, who took care of us, and even prepared a honeymoon surprise for us in our room! He is so friendly and funny. As soon as we checked in, Enrique sat down with us and explained how everything worked, made reservations for every night's dinners, and sent us every day's activity list. If we had questions, we just Whatsapped him, and he got right back to us.  What an amazing person, and a great way to feel taken care of! 
The resort is incredible already, with 12 restaurants and so many pools.  But then you add the reserve package and you also get your own personal pool, personal bar and restaurant, away from the families having with with their kids.  We had this whole section nearly to ourselves.  You can float in the pool and a server will ask you if you wanted another drink. Sure! Why not. 
We ate at different restaurants every day, never once going to the buffet.  
The price is very affordable and we felt like we ate and drink more than we paid for the package each day. 
Victor at the cabanas is so cool and hooked us up with the cabana with the best view for our last day, Luis behind the bar is very funny..
Each time we walked by a staff member across the entire resort, they would smile and say something to make you feel good. I could praise each individual staff member at this resort. 
I would definitely go again.  It was better than anywhere else we've been.
Thank you for everything

reviews.author: John L
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: The resort was beautiful. The majority of the restaurants were great. The rooms were comfortable and clean. The ocean view was amazing. Our concierge Enrique was so good to us and made us feel very special. Victor and David at the poolside were also very good to us. All the staff throughout the resort was very helpful and polite.  We had an amazing and memorable vacation at Paradisus Cancun

reviews.author: Corinne G
reviews.title: Paradise Found - a fantastic retreat for couples and families
reviews.text:
Our experience at this resort was truly wonderful. From the moment we stepped into the nature-inspired lobby, we felt an instant sense of relaxation. The atmosphere is incredibly peaceful, with lush greenery surrounding us and sweet, soothing aromas filling the air.

We stayed on the Reserve side, and if you’re not traveling with kids, it’s absolutely worth the upgrade. The package includes a dedicated concierge, a hydrotherapy session, a sunset cruise, and a complimentary token for one of the resort’s best restaurants—Sal. Our concierge, Manuel, was exceptional. He was attentive, quick to respond, and made sure we were well taken care of throughout our stay.

The café in the Reserve lobby was perfect for snacks and beverages between meals, with great service and you could grab extra bottled water whenever needed. The Reserve pool was a peaceful retreat for adults, offering plenty of space so it never felt overcrowded. Victor was amazing, ensuring we had everything we needed for a relaxing day by the pool. Be sure to say hi to Daisy, the resort cat, who lounges around the Reserve side and is clearly adored by the staff.

The food overall was fantastic, and we had no issues with sickness. While the buffet was what you’d expect, most of the restaurants were excellent. Our favorites were Sante, Flora, Lemon Fish, and Sal. Capella, on the other hand, was underwhelming—the food was mediocre, and the service didn’t quite meet the standard of the other restaurants. They use bagged ice, so there was no concern about getting sick from cocktails.

Our room was clean, spacious, and featured a beautiful rainhead shower. We had a lagoon sunset view, which was beautiful to watch every evening. The only downside was the stiff bed and pillows. Additionally, while not the hotel’s fault, the lagoon side faces a nightclub across the street that plays loud music until 3 AM from Thursday to Sunday.

The resort offers plenty of daily activities, including yoga, aqua Zumba, salsa lessons, evening shows, and live music. It strikes a great balance between catering to families and couples. Unlike many other Cancun resorts, this isn’t a party destination—it’s peaceful and quiet at night, which was exactly what we were looking for.

Overall, this is a fantastic resort where anyone can have a lovely vacation. We’d absolutely love to return!

reviews.author: Maria R
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancún is a beautiful hotel in front of the beach with five pyramids and several good restaurants.
reviews.text:
All restaurants were excellent except for Flora that served us raw and cold octopus. 
Besides, the best plates required an extra charge. If you’re advertising an All Inclusive, it should be ALL.
There were several employees that went out of their way to help us. Ex: Charly Encinas. 
He was always available to make sure our stay was going smoothly. 
Ramiro and Johnny were very good waiters for breakfast.

reviews.author: Vleria
reviews.title: Don't spend money at this hotel
reviews.text:
A disaster
Food in horrible restaurants and nothing adapted for children
Since we arrived we have come to the buffet. All with poor disposition. Zero desire to help

At the buffet there are no fries the most basic things in the world

Pay Family Concierge to fart because it doesn't make any difference!!!!!! Family Concierge breakfast is a disaster

Everything would absolutely never return to Paradisus Cancun
I have been to Paradisus Playa del Carmen and nothing to see!!!!

The only good thing is the Kids and the beach but you have to go book 6.30 in the morning or you don't get place
I won't come back because of bad care everywhere

reviews.author: Dalectro
reviews.title: Very bad
reviews.text: This is my 28th time in Cancun, been to Melias before, great service and quality so I have always wanted to visit this property. There were absolutely no chairs after 8AM (except if you want to rent a bed for $250) People were laying down on the cement, grass and sand all day long.Precensed a couple of verbal fights over "chairs" with children present. VIP had absolutely no benefits at this property (only check in) Requested early arrival late departure, not available. After waiting 2 hrs for my room, I got a freshly painted room triggering my wife's asthma. The food was very, very bad. Poorly managed property,very overcrowded with just one buffet operating for breakfast and lunch (15-20 minute line forms outside. The staff did its best with what they had but absolutely not a 5-star resort, for the money you can do way better elsewhere. Sour taste and a bad experience overall. First time we have encountered these conditions after vacationing in Mexico for the past 20 years. Melia broke our hearts this time. Advise anyone looking at this property, please and save them the hassle. All guests we interacted with shared the same sentiments.

reviews.author: Martin B
reviews.title: Excellent Resort
reviews.text:
We did the Reserve side and believe it was well worth it.
From check in to check out everything was great.
Resort was clean as well as ocean view room.
Oscar at Sente for breakfast was a great way to start the day, his smile and kindness made it a great experience.
David and Victor at the reserve pool went above and beyond to make sure our day went well, from extra towels to Bali beds .
Restaurants had enough selection to satisfy most peoples choices.
Sal and Lemon Fish being our favourites.
We found staff professional and courteous .
The only disappoint to our fantastic week was the our Concierge that was assigned to help us. No contact was made to us unless we contacted him.
Others did not have the same problem.

reviews.author: Matt C
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun - A Wonderful and Memorable Experience
reviews.text:
We liked the theme and building layout—it feels more like a resort with a relaxing green atmosphere both inside and outside. That said, the entire building welcome a full renovation, which is scheduled for later this year. They’ve been patching things up, but that simply isn’t enough. I’m looking forward to seeing a completely refreshed look, inside and out, that meets guests’ expectations.

We visited during their winter, and the indoor temperature was just right for us. Some reviews mentioned certain areas being too warm and humid, but we didn’t experience that. However, we can’t speak to how it feels during the summer.

We enjoy pickleball, and with the game's growing popularity, we suggested that they add at least one or two pickleball courts—especially since neighboring resorts already have them. That said, we were still able to do pickleball drills almost every day, and the tennis court served our purpose.

The staff were mostly friendly and helpful with smiles, and they didn’t push for tips, though they were certainly welcomed! They do try to sell activities and excursions, but a simple “no, thank you” is enough, and they’ll leave you alone if you’re not interested. Even the beach towel attendants promote activities, but again, a polite refusal is all it takes. Some guests might find this intrusive, but we were fine with it—they were friendly and respectful. Restaurant staff were also mostly warm and welcoming, though a few seemed exhausted at times.

One area that could use improvement is food handling. Based on our observations, there were several instances where standards could have been higher, especially when compared to cruise ships or North American standards. We were cautious when selecting food and drinks to avoid any issues, as one should always be when visiting Cancun. We had no incidents at Paradisus.

Our stay at the resort was truly exceptional, thanks to Irma from guess relation. From the moment we arrived, she went above and beyond to ensure everything was smooth and enjoyable.

At check-in, we were taken to the front desk on the other side of the lobby by a staff member, but we felt completely lost. Our room wasn’t what we had booked, and the front desk didn’t provide any hotel information—such as the WiFi password, how to access activities via their app, and more. Thankfully, Irma stepped in, promptly arranging a room change and making sure we felt welcomed and taken care of.

Even though she had only been at the resort for about four months, Irma was incredibly knowledgeable about its facilities and systems. She spoke excellent English and was always ready with helpful information. Throughout our stay, she kept in touch with us via WhatsApp, assisting with dinner reservations and ensuring we had everything we needed. She even checked in after our Uber rides back to the resort to make sure we arrived safely.

Her kindness extended beyond logistics—she often stopped by to chat with us by the pool, making us feel truly at home. Irma’s warmth, attentiveness, and dedication turned what could have been a frustrating start into a wonderful and memorable experience. Irma was undoubtedly a valuable asset to Paradisus.

Thank you, Irma, for everything!

reviews.author: iRamblr
reviews.title: Highly recommend!
reviews.text: It’s my second time at Paradisus Cancun. This time I brought the family, so we have little kids and grandparents. Everyone had a great time. The resort is beautiful inside and out. Maids did fantastic jobs! Our rooms were clean and comfortable each day. All the staff are courteous and friendly. Room service waiters were so helpful, came back and brought us water bottles when I told him we had ran out. Buffet waiters at Malva were especially nice. I couldn’t remember all the names unfortunately, but Pasquale, Roberto and Claudio were just 3 out of many wonderful waiters. They made sure our big group got everything we wanted. Pools and activities were a lot of fun. Definitely recommend this resort!

reviews.author: lverdouw
reviews.title: Highly recommend The Reserve Couples Only
reviews.text: First off, you need to meet David the Pool Concierge at The Reserve (highly recommend). He is amazing with customer service and getting the perfect pool side or ocean front seating. I seriously cannot say enough good things about him. We loved The Reserve. Concierge to make all your dinner reservations, our trip came with a sunset cruise, aqua therapy session, and surf & turf feast, all booked by Manuel. He was amazing. The food so far (two days in) has just been mediocre, but everything else has made up for it. Our room is nice and clean and spacious and conveniently situated with the pool and beach. We love the common space for The Reserve, tranquil and soothing, I get my morning latte there and we spend our evenings peacefully there. They will be doing a hard remodel starting June 2025, lasting at least a year (they will be closed during this time). We will be one of the first to book when they reopen. Cannot wait to see how this fabulous vacation can get any better.

reviews.author: Lisa S
reviews.title: Great staff!
reviews.text: Staff was fantastic! Enjoyed every one of them! Upgraded to the reserve side and we thoroughly enjoyed the Bali beds and the heated pool. The sunset cruise was an added bonus! The ocean was the most beautiful color blue I have ever seen, although it was a little rough. It did not keep me from getting in.Food was not great.

reviews.author: Wynnona Nicole B
reviews.title: The service made our experience
reviews.text:
My husband and I celebrated our 13th year anniversary at Paradisus Cancun. We had a great time, wishing we can stay longer! 

The resort is beautiful but what made our trip was the service we received!

First our signature concierge Christian H. Made our trip so seamless! We did not lift a finger! He organized all our restaurant reservations, to anything we needed in the room, to surprising us with chocolate strawberries and bottle of rose as a gift. He made sure he let us know about the activities available everyday and he respond super fast! I can’t ask for a better concierge!!! 

We also enjoyed our stay at Kanna beach club to the point that we came back 2 times! Oscar and Carlos were amazing host!! They made sure they gave us the VIP treatment the whole time. We had so much fun. Kanna was our fav activity throughout the resort! 

We would definitely come back again!

reviews.author: manonimo.gl
reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: Excellent service in the hotel paradisus cancun, especially in the mallow restaurant where Manuel and Alfredo attended us, very attentive to all our needs and pleasant treatment, even gave us a taste of tequila and shared a little of their culture with us. Excellent place to eat.

reviews.author: jdobs
reviews.title: Cant wait to come back!
reviews.text: My husband and I had a wonderful time at Paradisus!!! Mario our concierge was attentive and made sure we had all our dinner reservations and we were enjoying our stay-  the whole staff was attentive, friendly and courteous- food was one of the best for an all- inclusive- we were pleasantly surprised!!! Cant say enough of our bartenders in the adult reserve- Ceasar and Javier , thank you, you are the best!!!!

reviews.author: Linda V
reviews.title: “We’ll Be Back” to the Paradisus
reviews.text: The ‘room with a view’ was amazing!  The staff was so friendly and attentive. They quickly became ‘friends’ that you said ‘Hola’ to in passing and hoped their day was going good too. Our concierge Enrique was top notch and made our stay memorable.  Bartender Luis at The Reserve Pool Bar was a blast and made our daily ‘mini beers’ a staple to start the day off right!  Our pool guys , Victor and David , were the best! Especially when dealing with an injury one of our group had,  and they made hanging out at the pool, a blast! We can’t thank Yolanda at check-in, Gabriella and Lorena at the Reserve Atrium Cafe, and the boys at Sante, a huge thanks for making our stay an absolute pleasure. Too many to mention but definitely a reason to go back to The Paradisus Cancun!  Muchas Gracias 🫶🏻

reviews.author: Adriana B
reviews.title: Classic and iconic paradisus
reviews.text:
The best beach in Cancun
Incredible views of the sea in cousy spaces to appreciate and taste a drink
Very good quality of food and drink
Excellent Nespresso coffee
Quality and varied buffet 
Strategic location 
Lobby in harmony with nature

reviews.author: Nestor R
reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text: Excellent hotel, excellent food, very rich super friendly staff, very nice beach, all restaurants to our liking, only missing maas camastros because by 8 am they were all separated, from there on out everything excellent

reviews.author: traylenee
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: The entire staff was very friendly and welcoming. There are a variety of places for meals. The resort was clean and smelled amazing! The entertainment ended at 11:00 pm but their location isn’t far from the strip (you’ll need a taxi) if you want to experience the nightlife. Overall, we had a great time and I would return.

reviews.author: Areen A
reviews.title: Amazing service
reviews.text: The service and hospitality at this hotel were outstanding! The staff was incredibly friendly, attentive, and made every moment feel special. The rooms were comfortable and well maintained. Highly recommended! Rommel was amazing. His professionalism was very welcoming and appreciated.

reviews.author: Jeanette A
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun: Where Guests Are Treated Like Family
reviews.text:
Even though six years had passed since our last visit, walking into Paradisus Cancun still felt like coming home! While some areas have been refreshed with upgraded décor, the resort maintains its signature charm, and most importantly, the incredible attention to guests remains unchanged.

From the moment we arrived, the service was nothing short of exceptional. Enrique, our concierge, took care of all our reservations and even went the extra mile by sending us the daily activity list—on his days off! At Sante, we were warmly welcomed by Cesar and Valentina, who recognized us after all these years and made our breakfasts and lunches extra special with their thoughtful service.

Poolside relaxation was effortless, thanks to David and Victor, who made sure we had everything we needed while enjoying our Bali Beds and soaking up the sun. Dining-wise, every restaurant impressed us, but our standout favorites were Sal Steak House, where Roger helped us pick the perfect steaks, and Sante, the Reserve-side pool restaurant, which offers an unbeatable beach view.

Evenings were made extra special by Julius at the Reserve Atrium Bar, who provided fantastic service with the biggest smile—we practically had him all to ourselves! And on our final day, Javier at Sante went above and beyond, crafting a customized lunch with lobster, steak, and a bottle of champagne—a truly unforgettable send-off.

The staff at Paradisus Cancun consistently go above and beyond to ensure every visit is magical. We’re already missing everyone and can’t wait to return!

reviews.author: Shaina J
reviews.title: Book your stay
reviews.text: Do not hesitate to book this amazing place!  Just spent a week. Tower 1. Room 1201. 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom. Ocean view.  Beautiful, clean room.  It was amazing. Food was great. Easy to book unlimited supper reservations outside Cielo. Beach was the nicest in the strip. Some are so narrow with minimal chairs. This one was gorgeous. Kids swam a bit south of the Paradisus beach where it was more shallow and loved wave riding. The staff go out of their way to ensure you are happy and are enjoying yourself. Nester with pool activities ensured we were having a great time and made my girls’ trip by giving them a braid. Pool service was  5 🌟 with staff serving drinks and food all day. Coffee bar in tower 1 and tower 3 was delicious with great service. Location was great. 20 minutes from airport. Took the public transit bus to the market by Coco Bongo. Aqua World is directly across the street for easy access to tours if you’re interested. Wake up early and leave a personal item and towel on a chair or you will have trouble getting and keeping pool and beach chairs. Once we learned this, we had zero trouble with chairs. Looking forward to another trip. Enjoy!

reviews.author: Taylor A
reviews.title: Jose Garcia! 🎉
reviews.text: Jose Garcia was the nicest server at Capella restaurant! So welcoming and friendly,  he even taught us some Spanish.  It was  a wonderful experience, we felt like we were at home with Familia! We will for sure be back! Uno mass me amigo, gracias!

reviews.author: Rob R
reviews.title: Meliá is my favorite resort in Mexico!
reviews.text: Fantastic resort. The staff were amazing and my concierge Chris was very helpful with making my arrangements while on property. The restaurants were fantastic, especially the Lemon Fish. The pools were clean and the views were great. We used the Otium tours to plan our excursions and I recommend them too.

reviews.author: Jen S
reviews.title: Christian is worth every penny
reviews.text: We had a great stay in the 5th building.   Our personal concierge Christan made things exceptional.   He helped with all reservations and took care of a few minor things in our room.  He was absolutely wonderful and on top of everything day or night.

reviews.author: James_wu
reviews.title: Great location, amazing hotel, inconsistent food and service and some questionable guest rooms
reviews.text:
We chose this hotel for our winter escape based on the 4 diamond and 5 star rating found online.

In my opinion (our 13th hotel stay in Cancun) this property currently should avoid advertising these ratings. After renovations, absolutely. This will be a fantastic hotel when the rooms, public spaces and restaurants are cohesively designed. The main spaces currently are already great and intriguing. It’s the rooms and hallways that are desperately in need for upgrades.

We had a terrible check in experience and our original room (Jr suite beach view) was  nasty. Mold in the shower and ceiling, missing balcony latch, furnishings that were falling apart and missing toilet fixtures like water stopper etc. At least the beds were clean and comfortable.

Our complaints about our room was turned over to Guest Services. Rommel was our contact. We were very upset and he listened and offered solutions and relocated us.

Being in the hospitality industry myself, Rommel handled the situation very well and our sincerest thanks to him for making the rest of our vacation comfortable.

The hotel itself, is actually quite amazing. We have stayed in newer hotels and they definitely don’t build resorts like this anymore. The buildings are a maze and it’s fun discovering different hidden gems throughout. The grounds are expansive and beachfront is very nice.

Negatives -
1. Never enough loungers - about 40% of the space is taken up by cabanas that are rented for a charge. By 10am, all loungers are spoken for. People leave their towels for the entire day so most of the time, there are rows of empty loungers with towels and personal effects. There has to be a better way to handle this.
2. Service - very inconsistent especially at Malva (buffet). There are days we get excellent service and some days, we would be ignored for the entire visit. Same applies to the pool side service as well. 
3. Food - main buffet is mediocre at best. It would be great to see more Mexican flavours. Lemon Fish is highly rated online but it’s just ok. The design of the restaurant however is quite unique and pleasant. Sante and Capella were just ok. 
4. The guest rooms and hallways are desperate in need of renovations. 

Positives -
1. The hotel is actually charming, intriguing and interesting. Needs some TLC and this will be a fantastic hotel. Quick example - paint the wedding gazebo versus having the structure rusting away. 
2. Restaurants - Flora, Sal, Cielo, Agave - the service and food were outstanding. Thank you. The Mexican menu at Cielo was incredible - Xcaret Arts could copy some of these menu items.
3. I highly recommend paying extra to stay at the Reserve section for adults only. The rooms are more updated and there is a dedicated pool with dedicated loungers and cabanas. The Reserve atrium restaurant has a good bar, coffee, snacks, breakfast and lunch.

Recap - overall we had a good vacation despite the negative start. There are some amazing team members that worked hard to make our vacation comfortable. Thanks to Rommel, Victor and David at Reserve pool.

reviews.author: Carol M
reviews.title: Another trip to Paradise in Cancun!
reviews.text:
We love Paradisus but most of all we love the staff! They have become like family to us over the many years we have been vacationing here. Some new but by the time we leave our family here has grown. I will name some and hope I have not forgotten any!

Rodolfo (Rudy) as our concierge took care of everything from reservations to noises in the room! He checked in with us every day at least twice! 
Cornelius and Hiram at the pool were always greeting us warmly and ensuring our large group had a good spot to be together.
Accentia, Lara,Jose, Leticia, Flor kept our glasses and bellies full at the pool. 
Blue Agave and Aqua Marina staff were excellent! I am not remembering all the names Roberto for sure but so many more.
Most of all my morning started with coffee from building 3 and building 1. Always greeted with a smile and kind words to start my day. I wish I could pack them up and bring them home with me!

reviews.author: Quim M
reviews.title: Highly recommended
reviews.text:
Location and facilities 9.5, perhaps lack a little renovation.   Restoration and staff, a 10. The great variety of the restaurant, with different types of international cuisine, makes it sensational. 
The staff attentive and friendly ; special mention to the professionalism and attention of Concierge Manuel.

They made us feel at home and we can't wait to come back. Five stars without a doubt!

reviews.author: Patricio F
reviews.title: Excellent experience and price
reviews.text: Fantastic experience! I went with my wife and mother-in-law and from the moment we arrived, everything was perfect. The hotel is beautiful and the staff is incredibly attentive and friendly. I want to highlight the animation team, especially the Valentina aquagym, which was very fun and refreshing. In addition, the attention of the garzones made him more welcoming, in particular Michelle in "Malva", Ernesto in "Lemon Fish", Alfredo in "Cielo", Claudio in "Cappella", Cinthia in "Flora", Juan in "Agua Marina" and, finally Arnulfo, Rigoberto, Francisco and Iran in "Sante". They made us feel special and made sure our stay was unforgettable. We'll definitely be back soon. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: brendaknipe2025
reviews.title: January 2025 Vacation
reviews.text: This resort was by far the best resort we have been to & this was our 6th time in Cancun.  The food, service, drinks, wait staff, etc, was top notch!  The only downfall was that the beach was not level and was difficult to walk in some areas.

reviews.author: Elia C
reviews.title: A great experience
reviews.text: Our stay at the hotel was great! The room with sea view was spectacular. It has different restaurant options, all of which we tried very good. All very friendly and attentive staff, especially Alicia and Emma. I'd come back!

reviews.author: MARIELA M
reviews.title: Excellent holiday dreamed of a whole year and made true!!!
reviews.text: We started our holiday in January and ending on February 5 , I want to thank all the staff in general for the good vibe , the warmth and sympathy they have with the people and I want to highlight a very special person who made us feel very comfortable and happy Rodolfo was the one who did not lose details of each day of our stay , always attentive and very cordial in good humor and resolving small details like doing the cheking and ordering us dinners and many more things , Thank you Rodolfo for making our holidays excellent!! Familia Moreno Urtubey

reviews.author: Kathleen B
reviews.title: Well, need renovation
reviews.text:
We stayed at the hotel for 1 week. We were generally satisfied. Good food, a la carte restaurants also (3.5-4 stars).
The hotel is old and the rooms need renovation. However, always very clean.
The bed was not very comfortable. The mattress yes, but as soon as anyone moves, this one makes like a boat. as for the sofa bed, the horror! very uncomfortable.
The service was very good. 5 stars for the sports bar where the cocktails were perfect! 
5 stars also for the gelato bar near the pool, kids and adults love it!
The negatives, sun loungers at the beach and pool were in very insufficient quantity and sometimes broken. And what about Bali style beds at 250$USD/day, it's insulting (even if there is lobster and sparkling included) it's far too much. I would have preferred a weekly package to rent these beds at a reasonable price without the food and sparkling.

reviews.author: luisedoaguirre
reviews.title: Very pleasant experience
reviews.text:
The pillows are kind of hard. The hotel facilities merit the remodeling they are announcing, the rooms are old and not everything works well.
The overall concept of the hotel is very good for us and the restaurants very good, high standard food.

reviews.author: Jacquie D
reviews.title: Fun!
reviews.text: The hotel is big but not too big. It’s perfect for families. Lots of activities for the kids. My daughter loved the Disney show.  She didn’t want to stay alone at the kids club but she participated in their family activities and a few other games. The kids club is nice though! The staff is friendly and the ladies were all so sweet with the kids. The coffee shop is great! The buffet has a decent selection of food but they need more kid friendly choices daily. Otherwise, no issues! Hotel is also very clean. We will be back.

reviews.author: Olivia B
reviews.title: Second visit just as great
reviews.text: Our second time staying here last year and this year loved it both times all the staff everywhere was great. Spent alot of time in the buffet and the coffee bar which was my kids fave place to go. The kids club was amazing my kids had a great time and loved going they are great with the kids alot of fun activities they especially liked the pinata activity outside and hot potato game. The only thing I would change is the pool loungers and beach loungers situation there needs to be more and a better system in place alot of fights over it unfortgently our family was screamed at in the buffet in front of a bunch of people it was terrible over chairs they were left unoccupied for over an hour at the kids pool the people beside them in both spots said Noone had been there for over in hr and we were there 40 mins the man was very aggressive he came at us in the buffet screaming in our face the resort took the incident seriously we dealt with the incident with guest services with Jonathan and Orlanzo and we are thankful for that and felt safe after they resolved it, We will deff come back very relaxing clean and very family oriented resort.

reviews.author: Johanny
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun is great!
reviews.text: Great resort! If you want to be in the middle of everything tower 2 or 3 …. For vip reserve tower 5! Excellent service in all towers! The beach is clean and all the pools are nice. Buffet was good for breakfast and lunch, but make reservations for restaurants. Favorites were #1 Sal Steak and #2 Lemon Fish.

reviews.author: Andrea T
reviews.title: Kanna excellent place
reviews.text: Kanna is an amazing place to spend the day, the beach beautiful and all the staff with the best willingness to help you and have a very good time. Everyone is very friendly and friendly but especially Oscar and Jose treated us great, they are the best:)

reviews.author: Armando A
reviews.title: I noticed a capital improvement in the rooms. Modifications and adjustments that made our stay pleasant
reviews.text: Rest, attention and first class food. Very nice facilities. The name Paradisus fully assimilates the concept of a paradise place. There's no place I can focus so many things at once. Really enjoyable all the experience lived.

reviews.author: Carmina M
reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: Very good service from valentine of the animation team, good disposition and very friendly, hero of our experience something very entertaining, excellent professional, it is nice to find professionals of that level, very friendly and good attitude

reviews.author: gaby
reviews.title: All wonderful!
reviews.text: Excellent service! Our Concierge Jennifer super well, very loving and excellent disposition., Valentina from the entertainment team too, super fun and friendly! Bernardo, from the waiter service of Malva we took care of very very well!!!!! Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Jeromy B
reviews.title: A perfect name, truly paradise!!
reviews.text: My second time at Paradisus. It once again did not fail to disappoint. At every turn you feel like royalty and that all your needs will be met with a glad heart. All the staff are just incredibly helpful and positive. They learn your names and preferences so quickly. I even met someone who knew my name who I hadn’t even met yet. There are too many great people here to list them all but some special mentions for me were my concierge Enrique who checked in frequently and made sure I had everything I need I knew about all the perks available to me, Victor down at the cabanas made sure we always had our favorite spot and made sure everyone took great care of us, whatever we needed. Cesar and Gemma at the Santé were so friendly and went out of their way to get us things that weren’t even readily available so that we enjoyed our meal to the maximum level. Valentina, Oscar, Cynthia and Uriel were so fun and engaging and encouraged us to participate in the many activities going on. They just made us feel like family. I never want to leave

reviews.author: Jonathan r
reviews.title: A different level of experience
reviews.text: Excellent food, the dishes we tasted excellent. Attention 10 out of 10; cinthya very attentive and super friendly. A quiet, relaxed atmosphere, very good music... super recommended, you can not miss this experience when you visit Paradisus Cancun

reviews.author: lfwent
reviews.title: Close to airport so great for quick getaway
reviews.text: Beautiful updated resort with great service! Had updated premium ocean view room with large balcony. Extremely quiet and comfortable. Service was good throughout the resort, enjoyed dinner at Lemon Fish in a unique setting. Lots of dining choices! Also used the circuit in the spa. Enjoyed our stay more than another high end resort  Cancun that we have at multiple times

reviews.author: Jackeline722
reviews.title: We enjoyed our stay but some things to improve
reviews.text:
In general we enjoyed our stay at Paradisus Cancun; pros: Beautiful atmosphere, comfortable and clean room, one of the best beaches in that area, good food and the service in general was good! Francisco was wonderful bringing drinks and snacks to the beach! Gaby , Abraham, Katrina at Ginger bar were amazing hosts, Uriel the entertainment guy is also wonderful! (Maluma Baby! :-))All of them helped me to celebrate my husband’s 50’s birthday! We had a great time with them during all our stay! At Malva restaurant make sure you look for Armando, Candelario and Manuel when you seat outside! They are very special people and treat you as family! We didn’t have any issues getting reservations for the restaurants and the shows at 9 pm were good! 
Cons: Check in was very slow, we had to wait for our room more than an hour ( around 4 pm) , all the bars close at 11pm , extra charges in the restaurant for some drinks and food, make sure all your choices are included when are ordering! In our third day a big company arrived for a convention (250-300 people) so breakfast around 9 am and lunch around 1 pm was a nightmare, because all the group showed up at the same time for breakfast and lunch ! A line to get a table and a line to get food! You shouldn’t be dealing with all that stress while in vacation! We ended up waking up earlier to beat the crowds but that’s not right! We saw families standing there waiting for seat! After the convention left everything was perfect but we had to deal with that for 3-4 days.

reviews.author: Ruben
reviews.title: One-a-lifetime Experience in Cancun
reviews.text: One of the best experiences I’ve ever had. From the staff to the activities, this resort exceeded my expectations. One of the staff members, Christian, was so helpful and knowledgeable. He was very responsive and courteous. I’ve stayed at a few resorts and hotels in Cancun, but this was the best. Highly recommend if you’re looking for memorable experience in Cancun.

reviews.author: carmen m
reviews.title: Beach club in ZH, make a reservation
reviews.text:
Oscar was our waiter and the service was very good. I arrived here because of the post I test and approve, I didn't like it at all when we arrived, security lacks a lot of customer support, they told me they couldn't receive me without reservation, which I understand, I asked him if he had the number to contact me with the front and he told me he didn't have it, to Google, and then another security helped me enter, once inside, they took 40 min to attend us.
Maybe the difference in arrival is if you make a reservation, but hopefully at least make it more bearable.
The food is good, the service very good and the beach is super clean and blue.

reviews.author: gusg4502

reviews.text:
Very professional and pleasant service from the hotel reception to reach the Kanna beach club. Friendly welcomed by Mr Alberto Valencia he accompanied us by the sea to choose a bed <>. On site you have the opportunity to order high quality seafood dishes or your alcoholic beverages (or non-alcoholic) of your choice. All-inclusive recipe for stay and drinks: check their website for more details. Our waiter José Escalante offered us a first-class service, always with a real smile and the will to highlight the joy of living of guests during a good gourmet tasting by the sea. 
Our highest feelings of thanks. We expect to be back soon!

reviews.author: Inma Inma
reviews.title: A hit.
reviews.text:
We spent a few days in this wonderful hotel. Our reservation was in the area adults only. From our arrival to the last moment we have felt at home and we want to thank Emmanuel Salias in particular who was attentive the whole time and made our stay unforgettable. 
The views of the room, a luxury. Shows, activities (mention Nestor) and food also denote that they think about every detail.
We hope to come back.

reviews.author: Carolina S
reviews.title: Couple trip
reviews.text:
I give it 5 stars because everything was so father! Very clean everything, delicious food, all very attentive and good people. The view of our room to the sea was the best!
The only thing I didn't like was CIRCLE. I don't like them trying to sell so aggressively. If they're told no, it's no. We said no to a lady and we went somewhere else to focus and she went to follow us to where we were. We stay and pay in an all-inclusive to relax and enjoy, not waste so much time saying no. It was the only complaint we had. Outside of that everything was spectacular!

reviews.author: Rogério P
reviews.title: Never-before-seen attention in resorts
reviews.text:
At Paradisus, I have had one of the best attentions I have ever had in my entire life as a resort frequentist, nothing conventional, everything super personalized. 
Special recognition to Gabriela, Diego and Lorraine. Go to Pyramid 5, super exclusive and with first-rate services. 

Gabi and Diego, I'm coming back to see you soon. You made my stay a very pleasant and happy time. 

For the Paradisus management, watch out for these jewels, they make a difference to frequenters.

reviews.author: Nina C
reviews.title: Family trip
reviews.text: At the restaurant of gastronomic experience we were very well served. Lorena, Gabriela and Diego were very attentive every day. The service was impeccable. The food is delicious and the options are excellent. The hotel itself is very nice and relaxing, all restaurants have excellent food. The service and services of the staff are phenomenal.

reviews.author: Brad k
reviews.title: Excellent comfy resort! Highly recommend!
reviews.text:
Excellent resort! Plenty of food options, great rooms, and excellent hotel service! I stayed in tower 5, the adults only section, and enjoyed all inclusive amenities. Our room service was also top notch. Christian was our contact for hotel amenities and checked in with me daily, offering the best service and providing details on the activities for the each day. We had coffee delivered and he also brought a bottle of wine, catering to our every need.

The pool and cabanas were very comfy and definitely not too packed. Plenty of room to relax. I think the pool food options were a bit limited, but the drinks were great!

reviews.author: Quest39710840341
reviews.title: Outdated Resort
reviews.text: Resort is closing in May 2025 for full renovations. You can tell the rooms are barely maintained in anticipation for the renovations.

reviews.author: Jenny
reviews.title: First but hopefully not last visit...
reviews.text: Despite the rainy beginning, our overall experience went smoothly.  The staff was attentive, and the activities were truly inspirational for an all-inclusive.  Specifically, the Enrichment events held on the Reserve by Nestor were the highlights of our stay.  The food service department captained by Gabriela were consistently beyond expectation and delightful.  As far as the main dining options (outside of the Reserve) Malva's serving staff, especially Armando truly made this an unforgettable trip.  We look forward to returning after the renovations which I hope will include updated accessibility for visitors who have disabilities specifically - more wheelchair accessible areas and improved way-finding signage.  We spent a significant amount of time trying to locate places rather than enjoying them.  Pool and beach were lovely.

reviews.author: Jlb03003
reviews.title: Perfect Getaway, But Please Bring Back Kanna Night!
reviews.text:
We had an incredible stay at Paradisius Cancun! The resort is beautiful, with stunning beaches, great food, and top-notch service. Our favorite spot was definitely the Kanna Beach Bar – the perfect place for a relaxing nightcap by the ocean. The cocktails were fantastic, and the atmosphere was so laid-back and serene.

Only downside? The bar closed too early! It’s such a great spot to unwind after a day of fun, and we would have loved to enjoy it a little longer into the evening. If they extended the hours  a bit, it would be the perfect end to a perfect day.  Having this an an adult only escape at night would be perfect as many of us staying on the Reserve side would love an adults only escape at night.

It seems as though they are pushing the nightcap into the Ginger Bar. We went in the spring as well and Kanna was open later with a live local dj and it was the perfect vibe, it felt like we were in Ibiza, the highlight of our trip.

Overall, an unforgettable trip – highly recommend, just hope they consider keeping Kanna Beach Bar open later!

reviews.author: AER
reviews.title: The Reserve Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Our stay was very good, especially by our concierge Enrique who served us very well, very helpful and attentive! The room that left a bit to be desired by the question of the bathroom, the rest was all perfect! Meet the expectations!

reviews.author: BoardingPass316815
reviews.title: Wonderful week away escaping the polar vortex!
reviews.text:
Had a fantastic stay at Paradisus Cancun! The food, staff, and location were all wonderful, making for a truly enjoyable trip. I’m sad to hear they’ll be closing for renovations in May—I know I won’t be able to afford this place once it reopens!

We decided to upgrade to The Reserve upon arrival, and it was absolutely worth it. The adults-only side offers a more exclusive experience, including a dedicated concierge to help plan your stay. Enrique, our concierge, was amazing—he took care of all our dinner reservations, helped connect us with a rep to book our tour to Chichen Itza, and even arranged a complimentary catamaran sunset cruise and free hydrotherapy at the spa.

Overall, it was a perfect mix of fun, rest, and relaxation. I would definitely come back!

reviews.author: GrandTour774878
reviews.title: Wonderful place
reviews.text:
The service was outstanding.. They kept our rooms clean. They provided whatever we requested. The food was good and had many choices. The entertainment was pretty good considering where it had to be done. 
I would like to go again sometime. The weather wasn't the best, but that's are fault for picking the time.

reviews.author: hodan13
reviews.title: Disappointed customer
reviews.text: For a supposedly a five star resort, the jacuzzi had a leak & a bad pump. Mini fridge was wobbly bcuz it had one broken leg. Noisy party goers outside of our room. Guest attendants couldn’t help with me and other guest issues. Some of the restaurants were under staff, had longer wait to be seated.

reviews.author: Tan k
reviews.title: Great experience great food
reviews.text: The food was really delicious. Cinthia made the experience even better. She was so friendly and attentive to us. We felt so welcome and had a great experience. The food came really quickly and it was well prepared and looked fantastic. We would definitely recommend. It also so healthy which is what you need on an all inclusive holiday sometimes.

reviews.author: Jocelyn R
reviews.title: Limited Mobility Review
reviews.text:
Hello Everyone, 
My wife and I travelled to Paradisus Cancun for 5 nights. My wife uses a $10,000 manual custom wheelchair. We booked our trip with a travel agent, and we requested an accessibility room. In a call to the resort one week before departure, we explained that we would need a barrier-free bathroom and shower. We were assured that would happen. This was our first vacation in over 10+ years since my wife lost use of her lower half. 
When we arrived, the hotel had a LARGE curb to enter after offloading from the bus. 
The hotel issues us our FIRST room. While it may be rated accessible, it is not. In the Bathroom, you can not even access the toilet due to a sliding door and a commode; the shower has a lip of 2 inches, and in the bedroom, my wife could not even wheel over to the bed and turn her chair around. 
We were unpacking when we heard a LOUD PLOP and found the ceiling in the sink. We called the front desk and were informed that we would need to change rooms, but there were no other accessible rooms. My wife and I were trying to have a good vacation and work well together, so we said anything is better than no room. She can access the bathroom or bed without help due to the turn radius. 
Off to room two; this is where things are funny. The second room, which was the same grade as the room, had a better bathroom. While she could not take her chair into the shower, she could access the toilet on her own. Best of all, she could reach the bed and turn around alone. 

The resort is NOT accessible. The ramps to the pools are ski slopes that are beyond slick. I speak Spanish, and my wife does not; witnessing the unkind remarks spoken behind my wife's back was more than I could handle. The restaurants are less than accommodating. The Mexican restaurant had a very large glass door that the staff did not open, requiring my wife to struggle to open, and Asian fusion required 2-6 steps to enter each of the huts. 
The buffet was frustrating to navigate when you were on your own. She would try and wheel with her plate on her lap. The staff were less than helpful. There is zero ramp to the beach. 

Sent bombs. The hotel has sent sprayers every 20 feet, spraying out smells so strong you taste it. If you have asthma, good luck. 

The coffee vendor was the one spot of joy for my wife. The morning guy would see my wife and come down to her (4 steps down) and ask her what she wanted and bring it to her.

reviews.author: Verde A
reviews.title: Paradisus cancun
reviews.text: Irina from the children's pool, very attentive, friendly and helpful, regardless of whether we were nationals or foreigners, she took care of us equally, thank you Irina, the good quality food and drinks, the ice cream girl was also very professional and the chivas from the children's club very nice.

reviews.author: Mcfanelli
reviews.title: Fabulous Vacation
reviews.text: We stayed in the Master Reserve ocean view suite.  Violeta was our concierge.  We couldn't have asked for anyone better.  She made our dinner reservations, checked with us every day even on her day off.  Everything about our trip was perfect.

reviews.author: Mávil Méndez C
reviews.title: The best experience
reviews.text: Everything was beautiful, we arrived and in our room they let us be inside the facilities, eat, pool and everything, everything was very delicious, food and drinks, especially Salvador and Karina at Kanna, they get you everything to drink at ease and have a good time good

reviews.author: Juan Antonio N
reviews.title: The best open bar in Paradisus Cancun at night
reviews.text: Karina and kanna night's savior are in full force! We returned to the same bar 3 times!! We talked very comfortably with them, they listened to us, they gave their opinion with complete confidence and that's how we like it, then you can tell when it's a false talk and this one wasn't! Thank you!!

reviews.author: Alex L
reviews.title: Unforgetable experience
reviews.text: The best service they can give is at the Kanna bar at night. Salvador and Karina are very good people and they are great at what they do. For me, it has been the best experience I have had since the pandemic in all-inclusive hotels. Nice to meet you

reviews.author: Fearless03831540054
reviews.title: Experience in
reviews.text: Karina and Salvador from Kanna night, very good service and a very good attitude when serving us, I would definitely return to the place and they would serve us in the same way, they made us feel at home and very happy with the service of the place, thank you very much

reviews.author: Anonimus
reviews.title: If you are looking for a five star hotel, don't come here.
reviews.text:
If you are looking for a real 5 star hotel, this is not the place for you. It might have been 5 stars 15 years ago, but now it can be rated 3 stars.
The buildings, rooms, common areas, restaurants, pools are very out dated and the all property need a big renovation. They are trying to fix things and painting some surfaces but this only makes everything more out dated. The furnitures in the restaurants are worn out, the chairs are dirty, the kinderdome need a big cleaning, because the toys and tools are very dirty. We visited there two times, but never again..

Lot of guest complaning, that there are not enough sunbeds around the pools, and less umbrellas, only every 8-10th sunbesd comes with unbrella, so you can burn to red in the sun, or you are forced to rent a balinese bed for $250 a day if you need any shades.
It is unacceptable in a 5-star hotel where you pay USD 400-700 per night that you have to spread your towel on the concrete by the pool because there are not enough beds. Families have to sit on their towells by the pool or on the beach in the sand, because there are not enough palapas on the beach too, but there are lot of balinese beds for extra cost of course..
It is outrageous in a 5-star hotel, that you have to reserve a sunbed early morning, between 6-7am in the darkness, because if you arrive later, no chance to have any bed.
The staff and service are good, excep the staff at the check-in. They are very rude and dismissive.
We booked two Nikte rooms, and we got a Nikte room, while the other room was a  lower category older and smaller. When we complained, the manager was upset and wanted to convince us that both rooms were Nikte category. Even though we showed them their website, it was clear that based on the photos, the other room was not a Nikté. It took 2 days to change the room to a Nikté category, but they refuse to refund the difference for two nights between the Nikté and lower category room. Lot of people complain about the quality of the rooms, and the staff don't do nothing.

The hotel hosts a lot of weddings and conferences, so the only heated pool and the area around, are closed several times a week at 2 p.m., to pepare for the event, so the guests have to leave and and there is no chance to find other sunbed on the beach or by the other pool.

The food is average or below. They are not nicely presented and at the pool, the food is served on aluminum trays, usually cold

In conclusion, the beach is beautiful, with white sands, but if you are looking for a five star hotel, don't come here. If only the all inclusive plan and the lots of tequila is the most important, then this is your place, but if the 5 stars quality is, a good food, look for another hotel. If this hotel is a 5 stars, I think the JW  Marriott 8 stars next door. The Paradisus Cancun was a big disappointment for us

reviews.author: Daydream33320940542
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: I was worried from all the negative reviews and we travel a lot but I was impressed!  We stayed in the Reserve and the food was AWESOME top notch, beverages were premium brands and the hotel itself is beautiful!!  We will absolutely be back!  They could use more night life for the adults but I Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Hotelskywalker
reviews.title: Viva Mexico & Viva Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
We were really pleased with our stay in this hotel. The staff was professional, courteous and always smiling. Our room was clean, spacious and cozy. The bed and pillows were really comfortable.
The breakfast is our highlight here - it was superb! We were greeted each morning by Orlando, Daniela, Luis and the top staff.
Overall, I would say that this is a very nice hotel. The customer service from the front desk, F&B, and the housekeeping was indeed good. Great team!
10/10 MELIA
Dreaming to come back soon.

reviews.author: Shannon C
reviews.title: Love this resort
reviews.text: Definitely would return to this resort!  In the main restaurant Armando, Ignacio and Richer were amazing.  Recognized us whenever we went in and took great care of us . The Nespresso bar started our day out perfectly with the help of Alejandro & Fernando.   Loved how many options were in the gym as well . The buffet food always changed up which was nice and the Italian restaurant did not disappoint

reviews.author: Kayla W
reviews.title: Cafe
reviews.text: Great coffee, great service, great pastries. All around and excellent experience! Would highly recommend. And very conveniently located. We had it almost every day. Right close to the beach. Very friendly staff and lots of options for the menu.

reviews.author: 936sean
reviews.title: Pool side bar us great but thats it.
reviews.text: The staff at the pool swim up bar is fantastic.  The rest of the staff is friendly and good.  The management team is poor.  Very day there was food and dity plates left outside of rooms for up to 18 hours.  Tables were not well cleaned in the restaurants.  Just bad management.

reviews.author: Ramon D
reviews.title: Business trip
reviews.text: Excellent service and recommendations, the explanation of each of the dishes and Omar's attention were of a very good level. The presentation and flavor of the dishes were as expected, the attention definitely invites us to return, congratulations

reviews.author: Sherry C
reviews.title: Lemon Fish restaurant was amazing.
reviews.text: We love Miguel. He was a vibe!!! He really took care if us during my birthday dinner. A lot of good mood. Knew what we wanted and kept the drinks coming at all times. My friend's and I all really enjoyed our time with Miguel taking care of us. Couldn't recommend it more

reviews.author: Native New Yorker
reviews.title: Good but not GREAT ...
reviews.text:
We are regular travelers to Mexico and switch up resorts every few trips.  Our most recent favorite for the last several trips has been the Paradisus Cancun.  

The Resort is very clean, food is good - meaning typical resort fare but plenty of variety to choose from and many restaurants to choose from as well.  Staff is always great and deserving of every tip they receive.  (TIP: Take plenty of singles for tipping the waitstaff and bartenders - they work hard and always have a great attitude.)

Last week, we were in Tower 3 (with Reserve privileges).  Meaning, we like the Reserve perks but don't like how far away Tower 5 is so we tend to not stay in the adults only Tower 5.  While we liked that our room in Tower 3 was close to everything like the restaurants, gift shop, etc., it is CLEARLY showing signs of wear and tear.  There was a ceiling leak outside our door along the corridor that staff was soaking up with a stack of towels for several days.  It was just a matter of time before slipped on the wet marble floor and hurt themselves.  

Inside our room, the sink had several LARGE chipped-off patches that looked terrible.  There was no walk-in shower but rather an old-school bathtub with shower curtain  (circa the '90's) that also had several chipped off areas.  The bathroom lighting was VERY dim - my husband wasn't bothered much by it but it made my usual 5-minute morning make-up routine challenging to say the least.  Oddly, the light was much brighter in the separate toilet area but dimmer near the sink/mirror.  They had a magnifying make-up mirror attached to the wall BUT it wasn't very useful because the overall lighting was so dim PLUS the mirror's light was blinding - rendering it useless.  We usually stay in Tower 4 and never had this issue in that Tower. 
   
Our biggest pet peeve is how they have cut back on perks for Reserve bookings.  In the past, a free dinner at SAL Steakhouse was always included.  (SAL is normally an additional charge.)  Upon check-in, for some odd reason, we were told that the 'policy changed on Jan. 1' and the dinner was no longer included.  I booked our trip before Jan. 1 and had to speak to a manager and make a fuss to get them to agree to honor our original booking. 
  
It was also nearly impossible to get a pool cabana - we asked the day we arrived but only managed to get a spot for one day.  The other days, we spent our days under the palapas on the beach and you had to go down at the crack of DAWN  to get one of those.  They have over 600 rooms but seem to only have palapa beach seating for about 30 guests.  Many were laying out on their towels under the blazing sun with zero shade at all.  At a resort this size, make it make sense.  They DO have cabanas on the beach - which mostly remained empty since they charge around $250 per day to rent them. I guess they'd rather lose money than lower the beach cabana prices and get them rented out each day.  Doesn't seem like a sound business plan to me but okay.  We also noticed less waitstaff coming down onto the beach to take orders.  In past years, we rarely had to go in search of drinks (esp. on the Reserve side) but we rarely had anyone come and take our order last week.  And it wasn't just us - several other Reserve couples relaxing under nearby palapas also commented on the lack of waitstaff attention.  Not sure what that was about. 
  
Another issue is how they are starting to push a concierge on you when you don't really need one.  We are very low-maintenance travelers and honestly just don't require concierge services.  We've done all the tours and excursions on previous visits and mostly like to relax on the beach.  I wanted to make a simple reservation at SAL and was told that I have to do that through my concierge.  I used to be able to simply call and make a reservation but now it can ONLY be done through the concierge.

Basically, they are forcing you to use concierge services for the simplest of tasks and it feels a bit like a money-grab because if you use the services, most decent people will want to tip the concierge so you feel a bit strong-armed into tipping them. We made it clear that we did not need concierge services but they assigned one to us ANYWAY.  Our concierge was very friendly and we gave him a tip but other than booking that one SAL dinner reservation, we didn't really require concierge services. 
 
Also, the front desk is NOT forthcoming about informing guests of all the perks you are entitled to through the Reserve.  Why does the concierge not tell guests about these perks?  We found out that we were entitled to a hydro-therapy session at the spa when we just happened to be chatting with another couple!!  No one had said a word to us about this - not the frontdesk staff and not our concierge.  (TIP: If you book a Reserve room, be sure you specifically ask them what perks you're entitled to because they probably won't mention it otherwise.)
 
All in all, the Paradisus is still very nice but their age is REALLY starting to show and for the money they charge, upkeep should be on the top of their list.  Side note, last year during another visit to Paradisus, it rained and water started quickly seeping in under the sliding doors of our Balcony.  It was far too much to soak up with towels and it began forming a large pool on one side of our suite in Tower 4.  Three hours after we called to report the flood, a staff member showed up with a mop/bucket and a bunch of towels to try to get the water up.  Turns out, it took him three hours to get to us because he was busy getting water out of several other rooms.  

As resorts go, Paradisus is still a good option (thus the 4 stars) but not GREAT considering the prices they charge.  We will be trying another resort when we return to Cancun in a few months.

reviews.author: Wander639768
reviews.title: Mother/Daughter Trip
reviews.text: Overall our experience was great! Other than a shortage of towels at the pool and a pesky leak in our bathroom, the resort is beautiful. The food in the restaurants is delicious too. There activities are ok.

reviews.author: kirstynstroinski2024
reviews.title: Annual Paradisus Vacation
reviews.text: For the last two decades we have been visiting different Paradisus properties.  We love the atmosphere and the staff.  Our favorite staff members on this most recent trip was Lili, our Reserve Concierge.   Joel in Sante and the Reserve Pool.  And Gabby in the Atrium and Reserve Pool.  When we arrived the hotel capacity was not super high, so we did not have issue with pool chairs/bali beds.  About 3 days in the hotel capacity was at 96% and although service remained high, the ability to enjoy the pool and beach was less than desirable.  There was a lack of seating/beach chairs at all pool and beach locations.  Since the outdoor space is one of the main reasons guests travel to sunny beach locations, ensuring the ability to relax by the pool and beach should be a high priority.  Without suitable places for all guests, the overall experience is tainted.  I still give this property high praise because the staff was incredible in spite of the large occupancy rate.

reviews.author: Vanildo N
reviews.title: PARADISUS CANCUN FROM LUXURY TO TRASH
reviews.text: After 8 months since we made our reservation, we had a NEGATIVE experience with this project. When we arrived at the Hotel, we checked in, paid and waited for the rooms to be released. We were offered apartments 3010 and 3009, which are on the 3rd lower floor, facing a garden, contrary to what my reservation said that the units were facing the Nichupte Lagoon. We went to request a room change but the information was that the Hotel was fully booked and it would not be possible. We asked to speak to a Manager, (ROSANA ZANINOR) and she said she was there to serve those who PAY MORE! I got the money back that I had already paid and after going back and forth, they decided to return the money, and we went to another Hotel where we were VERY WELL RECEIVED. The Paradisus is no longer the same, and in fact it is not, as demonstrated by Ms. Rosana, who HAS ABSOLUTELY NO PROFILE AS AN ADMINISTRATOR, who will certainly come up with a standard response. I WOULD LIKE, FINALLY, FOR THIS EVALUATION TO BE SENT TO PALMAS DE MAYORCA, WHERE THE MANAGEMENT OF THE PROJECT IN QUESTION IS LOCATED.

reviews.author: Nika P
reviews.title: AVOID if you are a vegetarian
reviews.text:
If you are a strict VEGETARIAN I would AVOID this hotel. We found a huge lack of service for a 5* rated hotel. In the buffet, vegetarian food was often mixed with the meat, often touching one another, spoon contamination between meat and vegetarian dishes and a lot of the veggie hot food had hidden animal fats. We raised our concerns with the Manager of the hotel who said she would make contact with the head chef and we would hear from them soon in order to make the necessary food arrangements. We didn't receive any communication. As a pregnant lady on holiday with my 2 year old son and husband, this was a far from relaxing holiday as food was always an issue at every meal time. 

When we booked the hotel we made a reservation for a travel cot and king size bed. We walked into our room after a long journey to Cancun to find two twin beds and no cot. After informing concierge we were told the beds and cots are never guaranteed even though that is what we paid for. We found concierge to be very rude and lack sympathy.  It put us in a very difficult position not having a cot for our son. 

We were really looking for a relaxing holiday before the birth of our 2nd child so it is a real shame that we had such a terrible experience. If you do ever visit this hotel, make sure you arrive at the restaurant at 6pm on the dot to receive a table otherwise you could risk waiting 1-2 hours for a table, not ideal for a family. 

On a positive note, the beach was beautiful and clean, and my son really enjoyed the evening entertainment in the hotel :)

reviews.author: chetndeb2021
reviews.title: Club Melia Paradisus Cancún
reviews.text: Had a great time at this resort. Room had an ocean view which was spectacular. There were many choices for restaurants and also room service. Loved the food presentation at Malva! They were pros at displaying the food— and there were so many choices. Our favorite restaurant was Agua Marina, a seafood restaurant. From the hostess to the servers, waiters, and chef the experience was phenomenal. This was a well run restaurant (Thanks Rafael Chavez). We also loved the trio they had playing on Tuesday and Friday of trumpet, guitar, and bongos. The music was great.

reviews.author: Darrick R
reviews.title: Winter Get-away from Northern Midwestern Cold
reviews.text:
We booked a winter get-away and the Cancun weather was PERFECT.....around 80 degrees and low humidity.   Our room was nice, a comfy bed and pillows with a large bathroom and very large walk-in shower, marble floors and curtains to shield out the light to sleep in during the mornings early mornings.  The food was excellent...with something for everyone (Japanese, Mexican, Italian, seafood and buffet-style restaurants all on-sight).  A few smaller food stops were surrounding the pools.  The beach was VERY clean and white, matching the turquoise waters, found in your dreams.
      I want to give a special shout-out to our favorite nighttime bartender, Karina Salvador from the Kanna Bar.  We hung out with her EVERY evening till bedtime.  We hope to see her again...."wooop wooooop"!!
      The overall resort was VERY clean, smelling of lavender, like a full day-spa, the moment you walk in.  The staff was always helpful....even when I lost my prescription glasses and they were found and turned back over to me the very next afternoon.  
         The ONLY hiccup we had was that we booked a room with an ocean view, in which we were given a room with two twin beds....not a way for a couple to fully enjoy a "couples trip".  Fortunately, they had one room available with the last King Size bed and the ocean view.  Sadly, the view was about 50% obstructed by an industrial roof top air conditioner above the lower floor buffet, causing our room to continuously smell like "fry oil" from your local fast food joint.  Since we didn't spend "much" time in our room, we just chalked it up to a mild inconvenience....keeping this from a 5-star evaluation.
       This being said.....we loved the stay and location overall and will be back.

reviews.author: terriduarte9633
reviews.title: Great trip
reviews.text:
I'd recommend the Melia Paradisus to anyone. Great food and staff. 
They could use some better signage on the walls to help direct people to the rooms. Get up early if you want a beach chair though. People are cutthroat reserving chairs on the beach.

reviews.author: Kristi C
reviews.title: Overall, a really great vacation!!!
reviews.text:
We just got back from our stay at Paradisus Cancun. The location is amazing. Didn’t take too long to get there from the airport and it’s right across the street from Aquaworld if you’re interested in doing any excursions, you are literally right there!!
The beach is white sand and the ocean water is so warm and clear! The waves were fun to play in as well. 
The resort itself is close to the beach and pools so you never feel like you’re too far away from anything. The only negative thing is that people would reserve their pool chairs by putting towels or things on them even if they weren’t actually there. If you come down to the pool at 8am, you will not be able to find an open chair, which is pretty frustrating when there is literally no one down there. You could reserve a day bed, but for $250 USD a day, we through that was just a little too much more than we wanted to spend to be pool side. Even the ocean side chairs were “saved” as well. So, unless you want to get up at 6am when it’s still dark to reserve your chair, you might be out of luck. We did that one day and there were still only a few chairs left. Wish there was a better system in place for that. 
The restaurants were hit and miss as far as food goes, but that’s pretty subjective depending on what you like to eat. Our favourite restaurants were Flora, Lemon Fish and Agua Marina. We didn’t stay in the Reserve side, but if you do, you will have access to a couple more restaurants free of charge. The service in the whole resort is absolutely amazing!
Our favourite server though was Juan at Agua Marina. He was super attentive and just so much fun! He made our dining experience that much better!   If you love the Beatles, he may even duet with you! ;)
The rooms were clean and comfy, but a little outdated. We would have loved to sit out on the balcony together as a couple, but there was only one chair. In the mini bar, they had some soda, water and beer. It was a little disappointing that the only alcohol they offered in the room was beer. I’m not a beer drinker and one night, we started our evening a little bit later and wanted a nightcap, but were told the resort stopped serving at 11pm due to liquor laws. Would have been nice to have had something in the room that we could have had. 
Overall, we were really happy with our stay. They had lots of different activities and entertainment and we had a great time!

reviews.author: Waboolio
reviews.title: Juan of the best trips ever!
reviews.text:
Location: 
Beautiful location one of the best spots in Cancun. Beach was perfect very clean no weeds or rocks, fun to play in the waves.
Room:
 Beds were comfy, room was kept clean I believe they all have balconies with lots of space. 
Pool: 
Great pools very clean, many are connected and can walk in the pool to the swim bar. 
Bars: 
Best was Ginger bar for karaoke and the beach bar with the swings. Really good service, bartenders are well trained and the booze selection is really really good. 
Restaurant/Food: 
Best food is probably the Lemonfish restaurant. Decent Sushi there.

Best server was Juan at Agua Marina. Dude is a legend. I can't recommend enough. A man of many talents and a genuinely great guy. He made our trip extra memorable. Thanks Juan!

reviews.author: Anne Q
reviews.title: Good time
reviews.text:
Iran was our concierge,  she was awesome!  Very welcoming,  attended to our needs on the reserve side of the resort.  Booze always in the fridge!

Cleaning of the room did not go unoticed!  Thank you!

Cesar, Oscar, Gabriella and Alehandro were great bartenders!  Great personal touch to their drinks and fun to talk with!

Thank you to all the staff that make the resort great!

reviews.author: Sightseer35842099089
reviews.title: Rocio is the BEST concierge!!!!
reviews.text:
We spent 7 days at this property and our concierge Rocio was amazing!!!!
YES!!!! AMAZING!!!! 

She made our trip so easy and helped us all week long with celebrating my sister's 60th birthday and my husband and I celebrated our 24th Anniversary.  She was a joy to be around and became a friend. :) We loved having Rocio be a part of our families week stay.  There were 11 adults and one 7 year year old in our group.

Martin, one of the restaurant managers was awesome!!! He was there every day and so nice.  At the Sante restaurant the crab cakes were wonderful.  The Sea Bass was also so fresh & fluffy.  We truly enjoyed our week.  

We also had a 75 minute couples massage and my massage therapist Liliana was fantastic!!!! Very relaxing and she was a sweetheart.  

This property was very enjoyable.  It is a large property and we stayed on the Reserve - Adults only side but we figured out the property by day 5. :)

reviews.author: Jill M
reviews.title: Winter Getaway
reviews.text: Beautiful resort, excellent service and a shout out to our concierge, Lili and pool/restaurant servers; Gabby and Joel.  The only issue we encountered was the lack of pool/beach chairs and the need to continually get up earlier and earlier to grab them-even in the "Reserve" area.  Takes away the "relaxation" for a vacation.

reviews.author: Flavia M
reviews.title: The dream hotel
reviews.text: I booked in the adults-only area which has a high price but is worth it if you want to feel very comfortable and calm! The concierge Andrés was very very attentive. I did all the activities and I took away a lot of memories and dancing was also very fun. The entertainment guys were the ones who made the most fun. Then the food was very good in general. The sea water in that part of Cancun is wonderful, there is no sargassum. Very nice room with sea view. I recommend to people who are used to having dinner late not to get complacent because time passes and you don't get anything done. The people are all very kind!!!

reviews.author: juancho992024
reviews.title: February = High season = Bad idea for a vacation
reviews.text: The air conditioning in the room sounded horrible. In the bathroom, there are no robes or laundry bags. The pool chairs, completely separated without being occupied by anyone since 7 in the morning. There are only two bathrooms for women in the pool area, so there are endless lines, plus they are very far from the pools. We arrived at 5pm, hungry and tired and there was no restaurant available. One more comment... The reception area is very small for the size of the hotel, in addition to the fact that the facilities already look very old (nothing to do with the photo gallery on the website

reviews.author: FellowTraveler178947
reviews.title: Good hotel with a great beach
reviews.text: The rooms were dated and could use some refresh. There were entertainments and activities to do throughout the day. Every worker there was very friendly, accommodating, and helpful. Special thanks to our concierge, Daniela, who listened to our concerns and went up and beyond to make things right. She also helps us made last minute reservations and check in on us daily to make sure we are doing good.

reviews.author: Sharda R
reviews.title: Terrible service for a 5 star !!
reviews.text:
This resort is worst than a dumpster fire. At checkin the young lady who’s checking us in was on the phone the entire time which took over half hour ; my room number was in 3000 which I assume was on the 3 rd floor. On the way bell hop is explaining all the restaurants are in the lower level where I’ll be staying at first I did  not understood him so I asked him to repeat himself. Which he reiterated I’ll be in the basement; I stopped him and asks him to take me  back to the checkin since I paid for a king junior suite with a lagoon view.  The audacity of this check in attendant without asking or discussing where she was putting me to stay. When I got back to checkin another young lady was there; claimed she couldn’t give the room I booked. After going back and forth she became extremely rude referring to me as LADY keeping on telling me she cannot accommodate me meanwhile acting as if she’s doing me a favor by giving me any room.
Finally I asked for a manager she found a king junior suite lagoon view in the 3rd pyramid. On the way to the room elevator has no light, hallways are dimly lit  and felt quite unsafe. The new room was the biggest disappointment its stunk of cleaning solution, beyond outdated and old, outlets did not work and the balcony was disgustingly dirty. Spoke to the manager again at 7.00 pm we were finally accommodated in the first pyramid with double beds with a promise of a king room the next day. This room was an upgrade from the last one.  We went to get dinner at 8.00 pm none of the restaurants were accepting more guest for the evening so we dined at the subpar buffet.  During the evening the power went off we called the front desk we we were told we did not know how to use the light switches and someone would be up shortly to show up NO ONE EVER came or checked on us.  We were told the new room would be ready at 3.30 pm the next day; leave your bags in the old room and it will be moved. Our bags were never moved we had to do it our selves.  
At beach on a daily basis not enough chairs and umbrellas unless you were willing to fork out $220.00 per day. I will never go back to this resort neither will I ever recommend anyone to stay there. I absolutely hate this resort it’s my 8-9 time to Cancun and last last  stay at the paradisus Cancún.

reviews.author: Mel P
reviews.title: Best Vacay Ever
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun completely stands up to its name!  The hotel is beautiful, the atriums are lust with plants and trees making you feel like you are strolling through the rainforest!  What makes this resort stand above all others is its staff!!! Customer service like I have never experienced!  Moises at the reserve pool took exceptional care of us and always kept us laughing!
