Oscar made sure we had chairs on the beach…even our last day!  Caesar introduced us to Mango Tangos on our day we had a pool cabana!  Luis (the pool bar tender) made us the best drinks and surprised us the last day with a drink in a cantaloupe made like the cutest penguin!!!  I can’t forget the spa days with Lorena and William—best massage ever!!!  My friend has been 5 times and although this was my first—I will most defiantly be back!!!

reviews.author: lucicasi
reviews.title: While entertainment department was great, the service was definitely lacking and rooms were not up to par.
reviews.text: Rooms smelled of mold and we had water issues outside our room that caused several people in our party to slip and fall and no one really did much about it after bringing it to managements attention. Our larger party was not accommodated at Capella, which originally we were fine with to splitting up however then they would seat other large parties. Staff was selective in who they would accommodate and who they wouldn't. The gift shops were vastly overpriced and everything was an upsell so definitely be cautious and ake sure to bring the lotions, sunscreens, aloe, kids floaties, etc that you need if you come here otherwise they take advantage and charge 10x more.

reviews.author: Sükrü K
reviews.title: Everything was great at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Really good service and hospitality at the hotel and all the facilities. The adult side was great and peaceful. Everything was good. Especially the treatment we had from Karina and Salvador from the Kanna night bar! Nice peoptle that make your night good! Thank you very much and greetings from Holland/Turkey

reviews.author: Zach H
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: We loved Miguel he was a very fun server and made our dinner experience so entertaining. Would absolutely recommend him for future customers! He does this hilarious shot for desert where he pours tequila directly in your mouth. He made the mood a 10/10!

reviews.author: Yanireth A
reviews.title: Phenomenal experience in Mixture class, Ginger Bar
reviews.text:
The hotel is spectacular!!!!, but I am left with the affectionate attention, love and even family. In fact, it is the first time in my entire life that in a Mixology class they allow me to enter and learn how to make a Cocktail, I learned how to make the Catrina, my new favorite "construct." Thank you very much Alberto's, Gaby and Laura...all this at Ginger Bar
The experience was great! I'm going to my country happy!

reviews.author: Christine and O... T
reviews.title: Beautiful Beach, Great Food, Nice Vacation.
reviews.text:
First I want to say we had a wonderful time at this resort.  We were there for 2 weeks in January 2024. 

The rooms were very outdated and dark, but were very clean.  We enjoyed using the deck, but could have used a small table for our drinks.  It was tricky to find plug ins to plug in our phones and tablets for charging.  Internet would go out in our room alot, but surprisingly it was good at the beach.  

The beach here was very beautiful, 10/10 for beauty.  The beach chairs did not adjust so it was hard on the back.  We were able to find rocks that we jammed in the back so that we could sit upright.  The beach beds were always empty and extra charge.  They could have kept a few of them open for guests or put more beach chairs in this area.  You do need to get up early to save a chair, but we found people just took the towels off of the chairs and used them.  

The buffet was excellent for breakfast.  However, we did go a couple of suppers and it was disappointing at night.
The a la carte restaurants were spectacular, Flora, Yellow Fish, Cappella and Agua Marina Restaurant were one we went to more than once.  We did not get the  reserve club, so we cannot comment on the reserve only restaurants.

The entertainment was pretty good, we did enjoy the rock concert outside  and the Jaguar show inside.  But they do not have a theater for shows, so if it is raining they use a place outside of the bar, and it would be loud for people in tower 3 specially for people with kids.  We were in tower 4 and it was nice and quiet.

We did go to the spin class 3 times.  The first time was Sante, he did a little bit of instruction, but now much.  It was ok.  The second time we had a woman that had never instructed a class before and I just did my own thing, it kind of sucked.  Then we had Vanessa for the 3rd class,  she was a lot better, but we decided to walk the beach instead, as we do not have a beach at home and better spin classes at home.

We just want to acknowledge some of the outstanding staff that went above and beyond.  Firstly, Gaudencio, our server on the beach was so friendly, and very hard-working.  He would be ready with our drinks even before we asked.

We liked eating at the Flora side for our breakfast buffet and the following servers always were very attentive and friendly:  Richer Armando Javier, Eduard and Ramiro.  

We definitely recommend this hotel and would probably come back.  We hope that they consider renovating the rooms, it would make this hotel a 10/10.

reviews.author: Latrail31
reviews.title: I WILL NOT BE BACK!!!!
reviews.text: Second time visiting Cancun, different resort, same experiences...feeling ignored and overlooked simply because of the color of my skin is NOT COOL...ESPECIALLY when I tip each and every staff member that assists me.  Not to mention, I only enjoyed the buffet food for the most part (SMH)..oh and the wings from the beach bar ...everything  else including drinks...SUBPAR!!!

reviews.author: Little Travelling Missus
reviews.title: Can’t wait to return
reviews.text:
We’re Melia members so we can go to any of their properties but we keep choosing Paradisus Cancún because of the incredible staff!  
Honourable mentions:  Concierge Karen went above and beyond!   The activities staff Ariel and Luis were incredible and made you feel welcome.  The outdoor serving staff were quick and you didn’t have to wait long for a drink.  Carlos was our guy on the pool side bar and he was an absolute pro.
   Inside the buffet there was a wonderful  guy who serenaded our family every day.  But we can’t remember his name.  The entire buffet staff and all the restaurant staff are top notch.  Jorge in Lemonfish was fantastic.  Abraham at the main bar was a vibe.  Josue and Allan were faces we remember from last year and we were so happy to see them again.
     The location is perfect, the beach is pristine.  The grounds have tons of pool space and deck chairs/ cabanas.  The building is open so feels very safe and located close to excusrions (Victor and Diego are great at the Aquaworld booths we highly recommend their excursions).  The Paradisus is also only 20 mins from the airport.   
    Every night they had something fun for the whole family.  The silent disco was our favourite.  
    The food was great we loved all the restaurants and the buffet.  They also serve poolside lunch and other quick options poolside so it was so convenient when travelling with a big family and picky eaters.  
     We noticed mostly family couple and groups.   Not alot of young partiers in main area.  But we heard come March- April it’s more of a party vibe.
    We can’t wait to return.  It’s a great place that you will even recognize guests who keep returning because it is a stand out among the gorgeous Cancun resorts.
    Next time I might just bring the husband and try the reserve side.  We paid a fee for the day for the pool but would love to stay a week on that side of the resort. 
      You will not want to leave.

reviews.author: Exploration795347
reviews.title: Perfect meal at Sante
reviews.text: Monserrat, natanael, and Arnulfo in the Sante Grand Reserve were PHENOMENAL. They immediately got us a bottle of champagne to celebrate our honeymoon, were incredibly attentive, and even brought us a dessert platter catered specifically to us. The team here went above and beyond and I will be coming back to eat with Natanel and Co every night I am here.

reviews.author: Samantha G
reviews.title: Sante Restaurant is a must!!!
reviews.text: Came to Paradisus to celebrate our honeymoon and had the pleasure of eating at Sante restaurant with the service of Natanael Monserrat Arnulfo . We were made to feel like VIPs and plan to eat here again tomorrow. The food was outstanding and service was INCREDIBLE. Sante with Natanel and Arnulfo was the highlight of our trip.

reviews.author: markembrey8681
reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.text: Perfect beach location. Every restaurant was excellent. The Furnished hotel staff I have personally encountered. I would highly recommend to any either going solo or with friends or family. Easy access to all of the excursions Cancun has to offer

reviews.author: AmandaCris1981
reviews.title: Beautiful resort but food allergies are tough!
reviews.text: My young children, parents husband I just got back. The resort itself is lovely. It's older and it shows in the rooms a bit but they were clean and adequate. We had ocean view Nikte in building 3 and it was a great spotl. It was a bit loud when there was entertainment at night but they shut it down by 10 and it was very worth the convenience of getting to everthing easily. The full beds are a problem if you are sharing a room with your family. The beds are small! I'm glad though we didn't opt for the king/sofa bed as the sofa bed in our room seemed very old and kinda gross when I took the cushions off. We had no problems getting into any restaurant at 6. Flora was by far our favorite. Tere (assuming she is the manager) and Alex (our waiter) were just memorable. We enjoyed the other restaurants though and I can't say service was bad anywhere. The chair game is real! Get up at 7 if you want your choice of chairs at the pools. We were also there at a very busy time so that could have played into it. The staff is wonderful! They really go over and above to try and accommodate. I selected this hotel because I have a child that has Celiac Disease and they assured me it was safe. It wasn't, she was not well for most of the stay but she's a rockstar and pushed through. I did meet with a manager and also chef, they were super accommodating and did everything they could to help. Fransisco at the buffet also did his absolute best to help us. They tried their hardest to have food at every meal that worked for her. They accomplished that for her main meals but there was nothing extra that she could have. The only frozen treat she could have was lychee sorbet, not a single ice cream was gluten free. There were a few random desserts but no cookies or muffins anything pretty and junk -food ish that you eat while you're on vacation. Cross contamination is terrible at the buffet. We've been to other all inclusives that didn't feel like this though. This one felt a bit more chaotic and also didn't seem to have enough serving pieces. Again, we were there at a very busy time so that could have played into it. Everyone was absolutely doing their best to keep up. I know this review is in no particular order but to sum it all up. Their employees are amazing, the grounds are lovely but if you have a kid with an allergy or you have an allergy, I would probably do a bit more research and think twice about going there. We won't be returning any time soon, it was to stressful worrying about food at every meal and we have been to other resorts that didn't feel this way.

reviews.author: Vi T
reviews.title: Paradise in Cancun
reviews.text:
We came during February and there was no seaweed in the beaches. They provided towels for us and free Wi-Fi even on the beach. Though the wifi was out for one day of our trip. Some cabanas were $150 but we ended up laying on the beach and sun tanning instead and it was fine.

The customer service was exemplary. I couldn't believe it when I experienced the phenomenal customer service from Abraham and Nurby from Ginger 1 bar. We came to the Ginger 1 bar, but apparently the Mezcal tasting was the day before and we were too late, but Abraham gave us the tasting and history lesson anyway with additional tequila. He gave us an amazing history lesson on tequila and Mezcal while giving us drinks while impressively serving other guests. He also let us in on a tip that opening time at LemonFish (6pm) always has a long line, so he recommended for us to try the Mediterranean restaurant Sante by the ocean first, in which he mentioned many people do not know it's open to the public after 6 PM. Earlier than that is for the reserve guests only. We had a nice meal while the sun set. This is just one example of the great service provided at Paradisus in Cancun. I've never had a better experience at a hotel bar. 

One tip for eating is to put your name on the waitlist early at the restaurants because they fill up. For the other restaurants, we came at closing time for the buffet/food bazaar and it was cold. The blue agave restaurant, which was Mexican food, was fire. These two restaurants were not too busy for us. The hotel had tables set up located on the second floor for information about excursions and events going on. They mentioned there was a pirate ship dinner event & a two for one on Tuesday for $85 aside from that they advised us we can go on the bus to the clubs @8 (We like to party). on the way to the airport we noticed there is a Cancún Mayan museum right next to the hotel. 

There were a few bugs in the room, but it wasn't inconvenient enough to report to guest services. Guest services was very helpful throughout our trip as well. They will do their best to solve any issues or questions you have.

Download the Melia app and go to the Hotel Information page. It will have all the restaurants+menus and activities on there.

reviews.author: Phillip G
reviews.title: Beautiful grounds, but the chairs!
reviews.text:
Currently staying here so maybe my rating will change, but there are definitely pros and cons.

The grounds are beautiful. I’ll give them that. Everything is well maintained and the ambiance at the restaurants is top notch. The food at the restaurants is good. As far as the rooms go, the bed is comfortable and the layout of the room overall is nice.

There are definitely some negatives though. To start, the rooms do not have a coffee maker. This seems like it should be a standard amenity. We asked three different people to send one to the room and got three different answers. The chairs at the pool and beach are constantly taken. Seems like people get up at 630 am to reserve their spot. I wouldn’t mind if people were in the pools, but that’s not the case. The pools are empty. Where are the people??? You shouldn’t be able to throw your stuff on a chair and leave for hours. There should be a policy update. Either that or please add more chairs. 

Overall, I would rate this hotel 3 stars right now. It could be 5 stars, but there are some things that need to changed in order for that to happen.

reviews.author: Gabriel
reviews.title: Excellent experience at Paradisus
reviews.text: Everything excellent. The hotel staff makes the difference. Always ready, warm and efficient in their work. The attention in Malva by Armando, Ignacio and Bernardo was of a high level. On the beach Javier makes the stay more pleasant with his good humor and his willingness to make the guest feel good. With respect to meals and services, there is no choice but excellence. Bravo Paradisus!! It is the second time we come and we will continue doing so. Its high standard is maintained

reviews.author: DAVID P
reviews.title: Close but no cigar
reviews.text: We booked an ocean front room in the reserve and spent almost 1,000 more vs a standard room, we were on the ground floor with no option to go to a higher floor. Planters @ the railing made it difficult to see anything but a small “slice of the ocean.  We were told only room available when we inquired about a higher floor.  We felt like we were in the basement.  We booked early and saved some money but felt trike “second class’ guests.  I am VERY confident the hotel was not sold out as we rally saw people in halls and common areas.  I should have insisted on being moved.

reviews.author: Jean G
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun is indeed a paradise!
reviews.text:
We spent 7 days at Paradisus Cancun on the President’s weekend. When I first entered the resort, I was mesmerized on the way the resort was designed. I felt like I was in Bali. It was very serene, relaxing, spa like atmosphere, everywhere I go. The resort was huge and even when there were many people during President’s Day weekend in Feb 2024, there were still lots of space for everyone to go. It didn’t feel crowded. There were couches everywhere to lounge around. The pool was huge and the beach - oh the beach so so nice. The color of it is like the blue gatorade I can’t stop looking at it. Although some days the waves were rough, we still went into the beach and swam and I’m not an expert swimmer.

The staff were very nice specially Gerardo, Martin, and Enrique at the Malva treated us like family whenever we come in for breakfast. They often checked on us and got us any drinks we wanted. Most importantly they do it with a smile. Most staff work hard, always on their feet walking back and forth but still do their job with a smile.

My favorite restaurants were definitely the Lemon Fish, Agua Marina and Blue agave. All such good food. No reservations but first come first serve. They open at 6pm and I suggest come right before they open or a little before if you don’t want to wait. 

We had a wonderful time in Paradisus Cancun and we can’t wait to make it a yearly vacation.

reviews.author: GrandTour29272562748
reviews.title: Terrible Experience
reviews.text: I had terrible experience going here. I have travelled with my wife and 5 month old baby on our 5th anniversary. We have booked Nikte package and a room with King bed and crib for the baby. We got assigned a room with two separate single beds and no crib. I made multiple trips to the reception to get our room changed and get a crib in our room . I never got help and folks at reception were rude.

reviews.author: Alisha K
reviews.title: Relaxing and enjoying!
reviews.text: The staff and amenities are amazing! My favorite waiter is Martin! The food is outstanding! The pool and beach are very serene! The spa was very relaxing and Liliana was an amazing massage therapist! I highly recommend her! The views are incredible

reviews.author: France
reviews.title: Our 2nd home in Mexico
reviews.text: Always a beautiful hotel with a magnificent, splendid view, there are no words to describe this view!! EXCEPTIONAL service from Pascual, Alberto and Ariadna at the MALVA restaurant!! Always a pleasure to see them again year after year as if we were members of the family.

reviews.author: Rafael L
reviews.title: Ginger Bar the best!!
reviews.text: The best service at the ginger bar, I recommend visiting the bar in the afternoons, Abraham will always have a drink to surprise you, the hotel is very nice and the food in the restaurants tastes good. 100% recommended ginger in the afternoon. Thank you very much Abraham.

reviews.author: Mejia
reviews.title: First visit to Cancun!
reviews.text: My wife and I went with a group of friends. We had a good time , because of the outstanding customer service we returned to Cancun. The room was good, ocean view with a jacuzi in the balcony. The food was okay, not impressed. The drinks fabulous!

reviews.author: Fernando B
reviews.title: Paradisis Cancun Mexican Restaurant.
reviews.text:
We had an excellent experience. We learned details of Mexican cuisine thanks to the explanations of César Hernández who treated us very kindly.
We ate a mix of typical Mexican tacos and we loved the Gringa, which is a tortilla with meat and cheese.

reviews.author: Erin H
reviews.title: All-around wonderful! I wanna go back right now
reviews.text:
We traveled in a group of couples and spent 5 days here last week. 

We stayed in a lagoon view room, which was nice. Nothing special, but clean and the view  was nice enough. Another couple in our group had a cockroach in their room. We were in tower 4, floor 4. It was quiet. 

The food is pretty good. We’ve been to another resort in the area and liked it more. Most of the couples in our group were happy with the food. Definitely check out Flora and Yellow Fish for great food and ambiance all-around. Others are good too. We didn’t particularly like Capella (Italian) but they did make a dish for me with gluten-free noodles. We didn’t eat at Cielo but some in our group did and they said definitely order family-style there. Can’t go wrong with the buffet. Coffee is a nespresso machine run by a super sweet guy (can’t remember his name. Darn). I was able to get almond milk.

Drinks are weak at the pool but as-expected at the restaurants. Shoutout to the staff at the Ginger Bar, especially Abraham. He is a skilled bartender and very fun and personable. 

Loved the live entertainment most nights. Loved the “warm pool” as we called it.. the larger pool  had music playing but was cold and barely anyone went in. 

Wished the activities were better. Nobody really participated. We’ve enjoyed a more robust experience with partaking in fitness and fun at other resorts. We were happy to just chill and read and swim and drink though. We went to the gym for exercise - gym is basic but nice. 

Also enjoyed not having to walk very far to get around. 

We didn’t do the reserve adults-only but I don’t think it would have been worth it. There was not much distance from the regular pool- so you’d still be able to hear screaming children. It was a bother to us at times, but again, don’t think reserve would have made a difference.

We would go back, especially with our family. Good for all ages here.

reviews.author: Ricardo Dioney R
reviews.title: It was amazing!
reviews.text: We chose Paradisus Cancún for our honeymoon and it was the best decision we could make, the attention of all the staff is excellent, especially that of Eduardo who was always attentive to us in the reservation, the food in their different restaurants is delicious , the rooms are very comfortable and the facilities are incredible, we will surely return.

reviews.author: Gabriel B
reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text: In general, excellent facilities, service and food, highlighting the attention of the concierge Lalo and Lily, we thank them for all their attention, Abraham from the bar for his excellent cocktails, we had a great time. Just as a suggestion for improvement and where I see an opportunity is in the quality of the pillows, beds and sofa beds, for our tastes we might find them a little hard, another situation was at the Blue Agave restaurant, a waiter was a little out of his mind who He was not giving the appropriate treatment but his supervisor immediately intervened and solved the problem. In short, I recommend it to spend a good vacation.

reviews.author: Sergio A
reviews.title: THANKS FOR EVERYTHING CÉSAR (Mexican restaurant)
reviews.text: At the Mexican restaurant, César, the best, shined, it is the best thing that has happened to me since I arrived here, he has 10/10 hospitality, I of you will give him tips and not only that, but also a raise or better yet Let the manager do it, why? Because today's manager, the one with a white shirt, on February 17, 2024, behaved very badly, disastrous in my opinion, very poor customer service, the customer is always right and César made me understand it, but this lady He refused our pleasure and did nothing but harm to our entire group and worse, to my mental health and the rest of the group that accompanied us. On the other hand, Felipe, the Cuban, is not only one of the best chefs who has served me, but one of the people with the biggest hearts I have ever met, a great friend to remember.

reviews.author: Joseph R
reviews.title: Bar Time at Sante
reviews.text: Sofinia was the best bartender we had at the resort. He provided us extensive bar expertise at Sante while playing cards woth our friends. Attention to detail was his strong point and listened to our drink orders. He went above and beyond on all things.

reviews.author: Oscar C
reviews.title: Restaurant Cielito Lindo
reviews.text: Osvaldo Avendaño, the best waiter who served us at Paradisus Cancún during our two weeks at the hotel. Cielito Lindo is the hotel's Mexican restaurant and Osvaldo was very friendly, he advised us on the menu and was always attentive to any request.

reviews.author: Wanderer64356742129
reviews.title: Cielito Lindo Review
reviews.text: The food was incredible, the music was very mexican but it was really enjoyable. The attention and service was really good and fast. it had a great variety of foods, the Sopes, the Catch of the day and the Boñuelos were spectacular. Our waiter was Osvaldo Avendaño and his service was one of the best I have received in years.

reviews.author: Baylee N
reviews.title: Abraham the best bartender!
reviews.text: Abraham at the ginger bar was the most wonderful bartender!!! He continuously went out of his way to give us the most memorable experience. He always had the best attitude and was so fun!!!! He’s our favorite bartender!  We can’t wait to come back to Paradisus !!

reviews.author: Shelby B
reviews.title: Great for families, not so much couples
reviews.text: Overall a great resort!! Rodrigo by the pool made our day, EVERYDAY! Freida in the spa gives a GREAT massage. The food quality has slipped a bit, and there are less amenities than previous years (no robes in the room, beach cabanas are an extra charge, etc).

reviews.author: Travis E
reviews.title: Rodrigo-king of the poolside
reviews.text: The hotel and service were amazing as always. Especially our poolside server Rodrigo, we never had to ask for anything. It’s like he could read our minds! Great service like Rodrigo provides are what make this place so special. Thank you!!!

reviews.author: Jean-pierre
reviews.title: Hotel Paradisus Cancun, paradise in the sun!
reviews.text:
We went to the Paradisus Cancun hotel for my party and we had Georges, assigned to The Reserve, who guided us with our questions. He was attentive throughout our trip. The food is excellent in all the restaurants and the choice is very varied. Fairly strong waves and red flag during the 8 days of our stay.
Quiet hotel in the adult section, heated pool and Cabana available by reserving ours the same morning. Really enchanted with this destination..

reviews.author: Marcia M
reviews.title: Great vacation with kids, thanks to Kidsdom!
reviews.text:
Overall, we had amazing experience!
We tried to upgrade to Nikte but it was unavailable and it turned out to be good anyway.

We have twins, who are 5 years old. They loved the Kidsdom! Everyday they had a different schedule which includes arts and crafts, fun time at the pool (including a fantastic pool party with foam, music and unicorns dancing outside), and activities such as scavenger hunts and movie night. The staff are super friendly and nice. The Kidsdom helped my husband and I have some couple time, go to restaurants, the beach and relax.

There is a heated pool which is deep and my kids were able to enjoy it with their floats. 
The beach is beautiful and the water had a good temperature. The only down side is there are strong waves, so my kids didn’t go in the water but enjoyed the sand.

The restaurants are good and our favorite is Flora, which just opened around 3 months ago.

My room had a noisy AC; every time it turned on it made a huge noise. Luckily I had brought my earplugs so it didn’t disturb me.

Overall we had a great experience, due to the great location and amenities, and super friendly staff.

reviews.author: Alexandre J
reviews.title: Excellent! One of the best places to go on vacation!
reviews.text: Wonderful hotel with an amazing team! We would like to thank many persons. Malva restaurant team: Ramiro, Alfredo, Ricardo, Ignácio. Nespresso team: Alejandro. Kidsdom team: Xiomara, Scheila, Itsy, Ivy e Monse. Concierge team: Liz. We appreciate their kind attention!

reviews.author: Coastal652057
reviews.title: Investigating flavors at Flora Restaurant at the Melia Paradisus Cancún. It was an experience to enjoy the menu
reviews.text:
Investigating flavors at Flora Restaurant at the Melia Paradisus Cancún. It was a
 experience being able to enjoy the menu offered by Flora's chef, where he combines flavors and colors of healthy foods. Thanks to Chinita our waitress for her attention.

reviews.author: Sanam K
reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: Carlos and fransisco were amazing at Malva restaurant. They always helped us for everything with the amazing behaviour and kindness. The only thing that i loved it was the malva restaurant and these 2 person. They helped me to feed and warm up my baby food whenever i went there and i asked. Thank you Carlos for being nice and good a hust for my family .

reviews.author: mareaps
reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.text:
Seaview!
And to top it all off, when I requested the respective change at the suggestion of Viajes Palacio who was my travel agent, they offered it to me the next day with a delivery time of 4 pm when the normal time would be at 3 pm, in short, a TERRIBLE EXPERIENCE IN A HOTEL FROM A PRESIIGIOUS CHAIN AND SUPPOSEDLY OF WORLD QUALITY AND BY THE WAY, NOTHING CHEAP

reviews.author: MARIA J
reviews.title: Marvelous
reviews.text: Without a doubt a wonderful hotel, we were in royal service and it was a dream, I would return again, I was very sad not to be able to take advantage of everything that the hotel offers because I did many excursions, but I will return to rest and thus take advantage of everything

reviews.author: Bajouni
reviews.title: Solid 4 star
reviews.text:
This is a pretty solid 4 star resort.  The amenities offer good access to the beach with adequate seating / lounging.  There are also multiple pools on site with adequate seating / lounging.  Food options are average in quality and extent of choices.  The staff are very attentive and welcoming.  
This is my second time staying at this resort, and I’d stay here again.

reviews.author: jacob d
reviews.title: Very nice and great food and service
reviews.text: The restaurant flora hand wonderful soups and healthy foods. I ordered the tuna tartar as well as the octopus both were delicious, I ended up ordering 3 tuna tartars. My girlfriend loved her food as well. Our servers were wonderful too cinthia and Annabel were very fast and responsive with our orders and requests, for a table of 9 were were all overly satisfied with the service and food here. Highly recommend flora while staying at paradisus

reviews.author: Companion18768339744
reviews.title: Excellent Service and thanks
reviews.text: Excellent service. A special thank you to Vanessa from the Gym Center, Aztia (our concierge) and Bernardo our waiter who provided us with exceptional service, super attentive and helpful and made us have the best vacation! Greetings from Argentina to them!

reviews.author: ClauZ
reviews.title: NOT SUITABLE FOR FAMILIES WITH TEENS OR FOR DEMANDING GUESTS
reviews.text:
The GOOD: The facilities.
The food, in general, except Mexican food that is nothing like the native one. Restaurant Lemon Fish and Nespresso point
The BAD: Excessive restrictions for those under 18 years of age - they are not allowed to participate in many activities or stay in a beach bar or a bar with a pool, not even accompanied by their parents (I am referring to a 13-year-old teenager).
Almost zero entertainment - some live musical acts (with poor quality sound) and a few beach/pool/indoor activities with little attendance. No nightly shows or entertainment equipment like in other hotels.
The cocktail bar: with the exception of the drinks prepared by Orlando at the pool bar, the drinks are horrible and served in plastic glasses. They denied me a glass of tequila (national drink that is supposed to be included in the Nikte plan)
The attention: in general it is bad, and not because of the bad predisposition of the staff, but rather as a policy of the hotel: good manners are tip-dependent.
Bad management in restaurants: even if the restaurant is empty, they do not allow you to sit wherever you like. You no longer have to reserve dinner in restaurants in advance, but since they are always full, you inevitably end up on a waiting list that is arbitrarily managed.
the beach: although it is not the hotel's fault, it should be noted that the beach has sectors with significant unevenness and stones that make it very difficult to navigate
the Mexican restaurant: very small, not suitable for claustrophobics. The greasy and unpleasant food, very different from the native ones I have tried in CDMX.
In short, I do not recommend it to go as a family with teenagers or children or for demanding guests.

reviews.author: fer c
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text:
The hotel is very nice but it does not have swimming pools with water games for children
At the Malva restaurant you have variety and good food, but what stands out most about the place and the hotel is the quality service provided by some of the employees who still preserve the spirit and vocation of customer service.
These hosts named Arilano, Francisco, Rafael, Jani and Cedequias, we thank them because they really made us feel like a guest.
 They are to stand out for their friendly attitude with which they interact in each contact.
Thanks again to them

reviews.author: Pedro Paulo A
reviews.title: Excellent stay at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: We stayed in the top block, everything was wonderful especially the quality of the food and coffee served, polite staff, we were very well supported by our concierge who booked the special restaurants and everything we needed during our 15 day stay

reviews.author: cmikkelman
reviews.title: Worst dining experience ever
reviews.text: The room was great as was most of the staff . However the experience of service at every restaurant except the steak cave was horrible. The servers never made you feel welcome and never really provided decent service. I don’t know if it was because I was a solo diner but I always felt unwelcome and uncomfortable. Actually the worst dining service I have ever had and I am a restaurant owner myself so I know a little about dining service. Very disappointed to say the least.

reviews.author: Siqueiros102
reviews.title: Bad mouth taste
reviews.text:
It's not the first time I've gone, it lost that exclusive touch, I highly recommended it to my partner and it was a great owe.
I feel that the hotel is a little neglected even though they have done renovations, it smelled a lot of fresh paint near my room and there is a lack of more personal details that make you feel at home.

reviews.author: Shockerx3k
reviews.title: Racism is subtle but evident
reviews.text:
If you are black do not come here.  You will be treated as a second-class guest.   Racism is subtle.   Like placing in poor seating locations or putting in a basement suite.    Today I had to seat myself for breakfast and the waiter only arrived as I almost finished my meal.  I've observed Asian and Caucasian guests receive superior service which I found amusing as I usually always tip and they usually have not by my observations.    The only exception is the OUTSTANDING SERVICE I received at the moet bar by the beach.   Everywhere else it was subpar and racism was evident.    I sincerely regret booking this vacation and will not be returning.   The food is also not very good.  
I have found racism to rampant in Mexico.in general for African Americans, especially in Cancun.   The last time I was here via cruise ship I received similar treatment.    If you are African American i encourage you to spend you money elsewhere.

reviews.author: Jorge R
reviews.title: Lemon Fish - Omar
reviews.text: Excellent service at Lemon Fish by Omar, highly recommended! Very delicious food, Peruvian Asian fusion. One of many options for dinner. Excellent attention from the manager. Tuesday, February 13. Come, you won't regret it!

reviews.author: Antoniorodriguez92
reviews.title: lemon fish
reviews.text: The best restaurant in the hotel without a doubt. Japanese/Peruvian fusion. Highlight the sushis and nigiris, they are a delight. The staff was also very good, professional and attentive. Especially Jorge who was our waiter the last night and Boris (manager) who gave us a great welcome both days.

reviews.author: johnlstone
reviews.title: Another outstanding visit!  Look forward to the next stay!
reviews.text: Another wonderful visit to Paradisus Cancun!  We were fortunate to have Galdi serve as our butler (again), and he went above and beyond to make sure we felt comfortable during our stay.  The attention to detail is why we enjoy visiting this resort.  Nicole at the adult pool area greeted us with a smile each day and selected the perfect cabana so we could enjoy both the pool and the beach.  Diego reminded us if there was anything we needed, just let him know.  Thank you Diego.  Joel, Valeria, Moises and the other Sante team members made us feel special.  They frequently would say to us, welcome home.  Julio in Pyramid Number 5 would serve excellent cocktails for us in the evening. The Reserve area of this resort never feels crowded, and the atmosphere is relaxing.  The housekeeping was excellent in keeping our room spotless and refilling the snacks and drinks.  Thank you Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: Clullo
reviews.title: So disappointing.
reviews.text: This is was our 2nd time staying at la paridisus, our 1st was in 2020 and it was a wonderful experience, this time, everything from the room to the food and service has completely gone downhill. Upon chechin we were given a room that was infested with bugs and the front door was so warped that the door wouldn't lock without slamming it hard. The maids left the door unlocked twice while we were out an that was after we brought the problem to managements attention and requested that they ensure they do whats necessary to ensure our door is locked while we were away. Thankfully none of our belongings went missing. For safety and health reasons, I requested a different room and was denied by the manager. These inconveniences wasted our entire 1st day then, we were subjected to having to deal with both problems our entire stay. Unacceptable. So disappointed.

reviews.author: Jeanne D
reviews.title: Thank you Melia Paradisius!
reviews.text: Service is amazing, special mention for Luis, bar tender, Rene capitan, Luis Concierge,  Alberto and Oxte. They are so kind. Food is insane. Beaches are the most beautiful I’ve ever seen! Thank you very much for everything, we’ll come back for sure!

reviews.author: Leila Papaux
reviews.title: Paradise Kanna
reviews.text:
The service is amazing, the people so nice. A real touch of paradise in our daily life!!
Special appreciation for Luis, Rene Capitán, Luis, Alberto, Oxte
They are always there for us and make sure we have a good time.

reviews.author: Adventure20238052718
reviews.title: My Favorite Hotel!
reviews.text: I have always felt very comfortable in this wonderful hotel! I have been visiting Cancun for several years and the Paradisus always makes me want to return! The food is very delicious and the facilities are very comfortable! It's worth every peso invested! The waiters at Cielo restaurant are very friendly and attentive and the food is very delicious! I wish they could include a melted cheese!

reviews.author: Robin H
reviews.title: Great vacation at Club Melia Paradisus
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Club Melia Paradisus in Cancun again this year (Jan 27-Feb 3).  It was a great vacation.  It did not disappoint.  The resort is showing some wear and tear.  Our rooms were in the Club Melia building (1316 and 1317).  Outside our rooms, there was severe condensation coming from the vents in the ceiling which required a huge laundry cart and multiple pads to absorb the water.  It truly was a safety hazard due to water on the tile flooring.  Other than that, we had no other issues.

Our rooms were very clean and the beds were super comfortable.  Bathrooms were fine but the faucets (sink and shower head) could use a good descaling.  Housekeeping was terrific and kept us fully stocked with towels.

The food was excellent at Lemon Fish and Capella and we ate at those two restaurants most of the time.  The food at Sante and Agua Marina restaurants was also very good.  We had lunch daily at Agua Marina and breakfast daily at Malva.
Malva was the least impressive because other than the omelet station, the hot items were just repurposed leftover food from the night before.  

I would like to give a heads up and big thank you to the following people who went out of their way to make our stay really enjoyable.  

Agua Marina lunch - Carlos and Antonio
Agua Marina dinner - Antonio
Lemon Fish dinner - Jorge, Daniel and Iran 
Sante - Roberto, manager, Monserrat, hostess, and Axel, server
Capella dinner - Jose and Jesus, servers, and Karely, hostess
Ginger Bar - Luz  
Malva - Candelario and Fernando 

I wish I had the name of the server on the beach in front of the Agua Marina restaurant to give him props, but I don't.  He remembered our drinks daily without even having to ask.

All in all, it was a fantastic trip and I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Denisse Avitia
reviews.title: AMAZING beach and excellent service
reviews.text: I traveled with my husband and my one and a half year old baby. I have to give special recognition to the staff at the Malva restaurant, Alfredo, Rigoberto and Richard who treated us incredibly throughout our stay. The hotel is located in the area with the best beach in Cancun, and in addition to being able to enjoy the wonder of Gaudencio Beach and the wait staff on the beach, they made the trip unforgettable.

reviews.author: Steeve Grondin
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text:
We stayed at Paradisius Cancun in the adult section "the reserve" from January 22 to 29, 2024. We received unparalleled service from the moment we arrived until our departure. Smiling, attentive staff who are always available to make our stay as pleasant as possible. Starting with our concierge, Galdino, who was able to meet our needs from our first day. He even came to greet us by the pool and make sure we had a good time. Very nice clean hotel, well appointed and well maintained. Very good choice of restaurants. Our favorites are the Sal steak house and lunch on the Malva terrace with the servers Ivonn and Rigoberto who were particularly attentive and remarkably professional. Without forgetting the little attentions of our servers Gabriela and Luis at the bar of the Sante restaurant, always dedicated and smiling. We had a pleasant stay and we will keep excellent memories of it.

Sandra and Steve

reviews.author: Mark L
reviews.title: Great time at Paradisus Cancún
reviews.text: We spent a week at Paradisus Cancun for a business conference. The facility is great, the pool and beach are amazing. The food was fantastic with lots of options. The staff were very friendly and attentive. Gaudencio working on the beach was fantastic. Very attentive and friendly, it was a pleasure seeing him on the beach each day!

reviews.author: Sherry5160
reviews.title: The Reserve – Adults Only – Pyramid 5 (P5) - Lagoon View Junior Suite - We loved it!
reviews.text:
The highest-end package. P5 is the far-left one when facing the ocean. It has a private concierge person assigned you, a private atrium/ lounge with a bar & a self-serve charcuterie & dessert counter. Every night we’d get a plate of bonbons & drinks from delightful Julio on our way up to our room. P5 has a private pool – the only one heated; & a private pool restaurant overlooking the ocean – Sante. Shoutout to Victor at the towel hut and Moises providing pool guests with food, drinks & laughs.

Stunning suite - bed & pillows perfect; construction from 7am to 9pm & a nightclub booming til 4:30am was trying. Housekeeping: annoying. Fresh coffee cups, but forgot the coffee?! We'd leave at 9am with Please Tidy sign; come back at 4pm for our nap; change the sign to Do Not Disturb; 5-min later the phone rings, "Can we clean your room?" Grrr. 

Best shows: The Summers; The Rock Concert; Guerrero Jaguar. Best restaurant: AquaMarina. Malva buffet - excellent; but a convention during Week 2 created line ups. Many great meals, just one or two misses.

The AquaWorld excursions (offered in the pool area) are good prices & convenient – just across the street. Get your souvenirs there & toiletries at the pharmacy next door.

reviews.author: Rory
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Best restaurant is Sante. Arnulfo and Nathanael served us and were great. Offered us their recommendations and brought surprise drinks and food. Will not be disappointed. Try a variety of things on the menu. We had the beef, sea bass and canaloni - all were great.

reviews.author: Carlos Artur C
reviews.title: PARADISUS CANCUN
reviews.text: From the reception to the structure and service of some, dear ERNESTO from Fish Lemon. Very attentive to requests and our satisfaction, Thank you ERNESTO, beautiful beach and exceptional structure, they just need to update the room facilities

reviews.author: David
reviews.title: I will be back
reviews.text: The hotel is spectacular, very good treatment in general from all the staff, good restaurants and services, perhaps the buffet food could improve a little, but otherwise I have no complaints, the best thing about the hotel is the beach area, it is spectacular, with the KANNA bar, where I tried the best cocktails in the entire hotel, and the best treatment with Salvador and Gabriela, incredible treatment, always very attentive, very good cocktails and very good music in the bar at night, thank you very much I will definitely return.

reviews.author: krzystekmom
reviews.title: Wonderful Vacation
reviews.text:
We’ve been vacationing in Cancun for many years now and have stayed at various resorts, but always return to this resort. 
We love the location on the beach, we love the location on the strip and we always feel welcomed!  We even got to know some of the staff throughout the years and always enjoy seeing them!  We’ve had many wonderful meals with Armando, in Malva, both at the buffet and when he was working as a waiter in the evening restaurants. 
The food was amazing and we really enjoyed Flora!  We went there twice during our stay!  The chef, Ramon, even came out to say hello and say thank you for dining twice with him!  
We really enjoyed Malva, the buffet, with its selection and quality of food. We enjoyed the salads and the fresh steamed vegetables. So fresh and delicious! Plus, there was a large selection of different types of food. Something for everyone!!!
The room was nice and very clean!  In saying that, it’s an older hotel and although the room was updated, the bathroom mirror had worn spots on it and the toilet handle and garbage pail were rusty. We enjoyed the balcony and the ocean view!  It was wonderful watching the sun rise!!!
The Nespresso bar is a must!  They make the best coffees!
We stayed at the Nikte level and enjoyed a destination experience to a cenote. It included a yoga class and a Mayan ceremony. The cenote wasn’t that clear, blue color of the other cenotes we’ve been to, but they had a zip line and that was a lot of fun!  Plus, it wasn’t as cold as other cenotes we’ve been to. That was a really nice plus to our stay!
It was a wonderful vacation and came home feeling relaxed and refreshed, although wishing we had one more day in Cancun!!

reviews.author: Shachar Nachmias
reviews.title: Wow
reviews.text: The hotel was clean and the staff members were kind and excellent. Our concierge Eduardo was very tentative to all of our needs and a great help. There were many food options as well which is always a plus at an all inclusive resort. We will be back

reviews.author: Agus B
reviews.title: lemon fish
reviews.text: Very good attention and service from Jorge who was very good and attentive to us. The food cooked by chefs Karen and Marcos was excellent, it was very delicious and well cooked. The restaurant is very good, it is a beautiful and well decorated place to share a good dinner

reviews.author: Colin B
reviews.title: Great time at the Paradisus!
reviews.text: We love coming to the Paradisus. We always stay in the reserve (adult only area). We were here two years ago and things have changed for the better. Post covid, things have returned to normal and have been improved upon. Options for food inside the reserve have expanded and no need for reservations when dining at restaurants. The staff is as friendly as ever. Want to give a shout out to Cesar, Luis, Gabriel, Oscar, Axel and Sofonia at the Reserve Pool and Sante Bar. They were friendly attentive and accommodating. What more could you want on vacation?!?!

reviews.author: Fernando M
reviews.title: I would not return to this hotel on my next visit to Cancun
reviews.text:
The hotel and its facilities are very good. The food and quality of it EXCELLENT.
Criticism, the WORST drinks. Terrible quality for this category of hotel, Margarita from a can, plastic cups.
Little maintenance of the bathrooms. We had several problems in different rooms
They do not replenish the snacks and coffee in the rooms some days

reviews.author: Antonio
reviews.title: Wonderful Dinner at Santé
reviews.text: A wonderful experience. Gerardo's cooking, Montserrat's welcome and the care and professionalism of Natanael and Arnulfo made our dinner at Santé one of the best moments of our vacation. We chose the Sea Bass and the spaghetti with squid ink

reviews.author: Kelsey M
reviews.title: Rodrigo at the pool, Gaby at the Ginger Bar, Alejandro at the coffee bar, and Jorge at the main bar were our favorite!
reviews.text:
We had an incredible stay at the Paradisus Cancun, thanks to the amazing service we had throughout our stay.

Gaby, at the Ginger Bar, was the friendliest face to see, and she made specialty drinks for us all week. She created drinks based on our tastes, remembered our preferences, and served a very welcoming, enjoyable experience along with the drinks. She is so great with people, and she works so hard to make the experience one of a kind. 

Alejandro at the Nespresso Coffee Bar was the first to help us each day, with a huge smile on his face, jokes and greetings, and incredibly prompt and personalized service. I drank twice as much coffee on vacation because I wanted to go back and see him again! 

Rodrigo was a phenomenal waiter by the pool. He took care of us all week, remembered what we liked, recommended new things, brought us extra surprises with our orders… he was so attentive and kind. We had great conversations with Rodrigo, and his sense of humor was the best part! He kept us well entertained and kept our drinks full. He has an incredible work ethic and heart! 

Thanks to these three, we will be back next year!!!

reviews.author: chareleneserrano
reviews.title: Feedback
reviews.text: rooms in tower 1 need to be updated it looks outdated. Accessibility to restaurants & coffee are only in tower 3 which if you stay at any other tower you have to walk to the main tower to get food or coffee. Yes you can order room service but after the second one you pay 6 dollars.

reviews.author: Jesus P
reviews.title: Arrived single and left a happily engaged man.
reviews.text:
We had previously stayed at Paradisus in Playa del Carmen and so we decided to try out the Cancun resort as well. All the staff was great, as usual. Very attentive and willing to go the extra mile to help with whatever is within their reach.

We had a positive experience during our check-in process as well as during our stay checking out the various restaurants and bars inside the resort.

The main highlight from our trip was my proposal to my now fiancée. I proposed during the Xoximilco tour (separate from the hotel), but we wanted to take pictures by the beach the next day when the sun was out. Here I would like to highlight two people specifically: Corona and Dania from the Ginger Bar. We had a nice champagne bottle that we wanted to include in our pictures and requested a bucket with ice. Boy, did they deliver. We asked for a simple bucket and instead received one with beautiful tulips and decorated glasses that Dania prepared on the spot as nice surprise for us. It made our experience more memorable :-)
Corona was also a great host during the mezcal tasting. I recommend everyone to try out their drinks!

Hoping this is helpful if you are on the fence about whether to stay at Paradisus, best of luck and happy travels.

reviews.author: Keith J
reviews.title: Top notch!
reviews.text:
Amazing vacation spent at the Paradisus Cancun.
We arrived late on Jan 23 and stayed until Feb. 6th.
Check-in was easy. Only a few minutes at the front desk. We were introduced to our Concierge Able who sat down with us and he explained the perks and benefits of the Hotel, grounds and restaurants. 
We were on the "Reserve" side of the Hotel. ( highly recommended)
The Reserve option gives you added benefits such as a private pool area, reservations for private Bali beds , poolside bar and food service and 1 complimentary massage!

Our room was everything we could ask for.... it was a good size room with soaker tub and glassed in shower.
We were on the Lagoon side of the hotel which gives you an expansive view of the Hotel zone and far away vista's.
We did have some " noise" issues ( not the Hotels fault)   there was plenty of construction noise from the neighboring property and across the street was a nightclub that gave off a muffled 🔊 bass boom boom almost all night long.

This Hotel has at least 11 or 12 restaurants,  bars and other food options including Malva the all day Buffet.
You can even get Hamburgers or Hotdogs from a VW bus parked poolside.
We went on several Excursions while staying at Paradisus including two Cenotes, horseback riding and Snorkeling. 
This is the place to come if you want to Unwind and decompress. The Hotel itself has a very intricate Architecture that will amaze you with stunning Atriums and glass topped Pyramids with tropical plants and trees everywhere. 

A special shout out to a few outstanding Employees!
Moises our poolside attendant... who was always working his Butt off with a smile and kind words for everyone 😊 
Victor and Nicole: our poolside towel hut experts who always ran an effective system to ensure Guests were seated at the pool.
Julio... Bartender at the Reserve side Indoor Pyramid who always ensured our Vodka needs were fulfilled 😀
All the staff at the Hotel were very attentive and friendly. 
We will definitely come and stay at Paradisus again!

reviews.author: storming18
reviews.title: Fantastic hotel make shure you book sea side
reviews.text:
Just got back from Paradisus Cancun and the resort was fantastic. Only little problem is if you book the reserve lagune side the hotel has a very loud naibor across the street. We ended up changing room as it was impossible to sleep until 4 am as the disco does blast. Stelian our concierge arranged to move us to the sea side wich fixed the noise problem.
The beach at the hotel is great and they have palapas to give you shade. There is directly in front of the hotel a part where you can advance in the water quite far and play in the waves which was awsome.
The restaurant are quite good. Sal the stake house is fantastic. Sante is excellent for breakfast and lunch but we did not try it for diner. It is well sutuated just by the beach.
All the personnel are very freindly. 
We will definetly go back.

reviews.author: Carolina G
reviews.title: Don't go with children
reviews.text:
Don't go with children. Although it is allowed, the hotel is not prepared and the staff not only does not facilitate the stay but is annoyed that they are there. While we were at breakfast, they took away the sugar packets that my daughter was playing with because it bothered them. They do not allow you to remove food from the buffet to take it to another place unless it is in your own food container.
The sofa bed is unpresentable for a hotel of this category.
Although the restaurants say they are open until 11 p.m., at 9:45 they no longer let us enter one of them and on another occasion they brought us appetizers, main course and dessert all together because the kitchen closes at 10 p.m.
Access is on a first-come, first-served basis and reservations are not accepted. So you have to decide at the moment if there is no place after waiting in line.
Every night there is a music show in a part of the hotel that is heard very loudly in the rooms, not even allowing you to hear the TV. Lasts until 11pm.
There is a heated pool but sometimes it is reserved for private events so you are not allowed access.
Little variety of food at the buffet and poor service at the stations that prepare food.
The beach is good, the room and the view are very good too.
We expected more from this hotel for the price of the stay. We prefer other chains.

reviews.author: dolcesollove
reviews.title: Not bad but not so great
reviews.text: If you are looking for a hotel with bang for the buck, this place might be the one. The location is great and the beach and hotel are beautiful. But there are too much option for extra cost and for all-inclusive, service and everything I don't know what exactly but something lacks little bit.

reviews.author: Maria Camila G
reviews.title: An incredible place
reviews.text: Delicious food and excellent service, highly recommended. A wide variety of food with incredible flavors, and best of all the service from those who work here, very friendly. The experience has been wonderful, we absolutely love every dish

reviews.author: Saúl F
reviews.text: Many congratulations for your hospitality and especially for your bartenders, we met Abraham from ginger bar 1, who gave us an incredible experience with his attitude and his delicious cocktails. He gave us a great night. We will definitely return to paradisus cancun.

reviews.author: Karen P
reviews.title: Excellent attention
reviews.text: Everything was very good, especially Abraham from Ginger bar 1, in addition to his cheerful attitude that made us have a great time, he prepared us delicious drinks that improved our experience in the place. Congratulations for having staff like him.

reviews.author: ajay v
reviews.title: Amazing Service Staff
reviews.text:
The service was great. The staff was eager 
To make your experience the best.  They also help you celebrate your special occasion what are right maybe and go above and beyond.  Moises and Kenia at Cielo Restaurant were Great incredible at making our experience memorable.

reviews.author: Dreamer40940942273
reviews.title: The resort was very nice, relaxing and the service was great. Would recommend to others!
reviews.text:
The service was excellent at the Paradisus Cancun on the adults only side. Our server by the pool Gabriella was excellent and our concierge Rocío was absolutely amazing!!! We were with a large group and she was so accommodating and helped with everything we asked! She even went the extra mile to decorate our friend’s room for her birthday.  

Isabella and Gemma were also excellent in the spa!!

The resort was very nice and clean and service was fast! The food was hit or miss but bc it was AI you can just order something else.

reviews.author: demcodever
reviews.title: The food included in the package leaves a lot to be desired and the service even more so. The paid food is 10!!!
reviews.text: Guest service and waiting time in the all-inclusive restaurants should improve, possibly better organize waiting times through reservations, the attitude of the staff that receives in the restaurants is terrible

reviews.author: ammielmartinezcanil
reviews.title: Excellent Hotel.
reviews.text:
Emblematic hotel in Cancun. With facilities and services for the whole family.
We spent 12 nights and the attention was very good. Perhaps there are some hotel facilities that need to be improved in terms of maintenance. They are minimal.

reviews.author: Claire K
reviews.title: Amazing Experience!
reviews.text: We absolutely loved our time at this resort. The food was delicious and the service was incredible. Our favorite spot was the Kanna Beach Bar with Karina and Salvator. They were amazing, remembered our drink orders, and brought the fun every night! The only negative is that they don't take reservations, so on Thursday-Saturday nights it was difficult to find a dinner spot without a long wait. We stayed on the Reserve side and it was absolutely worth the money. It gives you access to a heated pool which is a necessity on a windy day. We will definitely be returning!

reviews.author: ralphbarnes
reviews.title: Paradisus is paradise!
reviews.text: If you are looking for relaxed luxury in an all inclusive resort, the Reserve area of Paradisus Cancun will be hard to beat. The resort has the capacity to absorb crowds and not feel crowded. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: José P
reviews.title: Holidays in Paradisus
reviews.text:
At the Flora restaurant, Fanny welcomed us very attentively, always with a smile and a very good attitude, and at the table we were served by Ana who guided us at all times to choose from the menu and made our dinner a spectacular moment.
Not to mention Moisés in the beach area who is very attentive and helpful
 thank you so much

reviews.author: Ric J
reviews.title: Carders served it up big!
reviews.text: The pillows are the fluffiest I’ve ever felt! Caesar was great he suggested some great menu items. Unfortunately the didn’t have Caesar salad or Caesar to drink. The tacos were great and the drinks were flowing all night long. I worth paying for the meal at an all inclusive resort.

reviews.author: zach o
reviews.title: Pardisus Is A Great Hotel - If You Have Kids, I Recommend The "Kidsdom" Daycare
reviews.text:
Last week was the second time I have been to Mexico, but the first time with my family. Wow, what a difference there was between my first experience (different hotel, was still a good time, just me and my wife) and this trip to Paradisus. 

Paradisus is an excellent hotel. The design is beautiful (pyramid style). It's in a great location in Cancun. Beautiful beaches (some of the best I have seen). Friendly staff. Delicious food and nice restaurants - which is particularly impressive considering this was all inclusive. 

With all that being said, I need to give a special shout out to the entire "Kidsdom" staff. "Kidsdom" is the daycare that they have at Pardisus for kids to hang out at and do activities throughout the day. Monse, Itza, Bruno, Rubi, Sheila, Ivonne, Ivana (apologies if I spelled any names wrong or missed anyone) were all amazing. My daughter had so much fun at the daycare that she kept begging me to go back each day and stay longer whenever I told her we had to go. The staff were all friendly, kind and patient. They made sure the kids had fun and even did things like make pottery, treasure hunt, swim events and more. I could also tell they put a focus on safety - making sure we always signed in and out, kept the door closed at the appropriate times and kept the kids together whenever they went outside. No joke - "Kidsdom" might be a primary reason for me to return to the Paradisus hotel, because I know my children will have a blast and be safe. 

P.S. Arin Lopez with BD experience is excellent and I highly recommend her for any transporation or excursion needs, and Fernanan who works with Optium International was very nice and I would recommend working with her for a trip to Coco Bongo.

reviews.author: JI J
reviews.title: To mauve with the perfect Armando Arturo!
reviews.text: A mauve experience with the assistance of Armando Rafael Arturo! Perfect and still here for us and our daughter to attend:) the food is very nice and varied for everyone. Vegetarian meat, fish, salad and desserts! wonderful thank you very much armando

reviews.author: Monica
reviews.title: Fantastic team at the Sante and Pool area for adults only 🤞🏼
reviews.text: Absolutely great team at the Sante and Pool area for adults only!! For us the best food in the whole area and the best service, very friendly and funny - just exzellente !! To mention are Miguel, Oscar, Victor, Valeria, Gaby, Nicole - sorry if we missed some!! The whole crew just great job, thank you! 👏🏼👏🏼👏🏼

reviews.author: Scenic731814
reviews.title: The good and not so good
reviews.text:
The best are the people. Malva attended by Ivonne in the morning and Francisco captain.
The worst was the sweet bread, French bread and mini pancakes from the buffet. Very bad dough, nice presentation, not much flavor.
The rest is very good, lots of variety.

reviews.author: Mathieu A
reviews.title: Fantastic Service and Experience
reviews.text:
We stayed in the adults-only Reserve section of the Paradisus Cancun for a week in mid-January 2024. It was our first time in Mexico and we loved our stay for a multitude of reasons.

PROS
- We received amazing service; we did tip generously, and the staff appreciated it and remembered us. Special thanks to our concierge Josemay, Andrea at the Reserve front desk, Victor and Nicole at the pool area, Gabi and Oscar at Sante, Luis at the pool bar, Abraham at the Lemon Fish and the staff at the Lounge in the Reserve pyramid.
- The facilities were clean and relaxing. We loved the vegetation inside the pyramids!
- The restaurants we tried were all at least good, and in some cases, fantastic. We had some of the best sushi we've ever had at the Lemon Fish; the Flora was a surprise with delicious, beautiful, and healthy dishes; and the Sal Steak House was a tour de force. (We had access to Sal as part of the Reserve, otherwise you must pay for it, and prices are expensive.)
- The Reserve's pool area isn't large but it was quiet and well-maintained. We loved the Sante beachside restaurant and ate there whenever we could due to the superb view of the ocean.
- The beach was clean with next to no algae or trash, fine sand, and plenty of lounge chairs. The weather was perfect all week except for Wednesday, where it was overcast and rained slightly.

CONS
- Not sure what the experience is outside of the Reserve, but when we visited the general pool area a couple of times, we found it noisy and even saw children eating in the pool. The beach seemed fine.
- While the hotel was renovated not too long ago, some the amenities could use a refresh. In particular, after the one rainy day we had, water leaked through the ceiling in a couple of places in our pyramid. I hope the Paradisus will receive the attention and renovations it needs to remain a premier destination.

Overall, a great experience that we would love to repeat.

reviews.author: Matt M
reviews.title: Amazing massage from Guadalupe!
reviews.text:
The spa was very relaxing, and Guadalupe gave a wonderful deep tissue massage!  The water experience was a little cold for my taste...maybe 4 degrees warmer would be perfect!  But everyone should get the massage!

(200 characters is too many for a requirement on comments.  I'm writing this because they won't let me comment with less than 200 characters)

reviews.author: MexicoLove123
reviews.title: An incredible vacation!
reviews.text:
The Paradisus Cancun exceeded my expectations! Let me break this down…

Lobby: check in was a bit slow. However, the lobby pyramid is breathtaking! The plants, the lights, it all makes for a memorable experience! 

Pool: there are 2 pools. The pool with the swim up bar is not heated but still a very reasonable and refreshing temperature. The water is clean! The other pool is heated. Half is for everyone and the other half is for reserve guests only. It is separated by an infinity edge and a glass door so only adults can access. 

Beach: I’m gonna go ahead and say it’s the best beach in the Caribbean. Clear blue waters, white sands. I’ll be dreaming about it until my next visit! 

Rooms: we didn’t have a great view but it was a very spacious room. I didn’t find it dated. They were nice. We did hear bass from the bar across the street nightly. This is something to consider if you’re in building 4 lagoon view. 

Food: we loved the food. We tried every à la carte. The Lemon Fish (Japanese) and Capella (Italian) were the best. Make sure to try to mussels at Capella. They also have Flora (artisan), blue agave (Mexican), aqua marina (international). The buffet food does get repetitive. They also have a pizza counter and ice cream parlour by the pool. The servers are always serving burgers/nachos/hot dogs/wings/pizza/cesar salad. 

Service: amazing service. We rarely had to get up to grab our own drink or lunch. Special shout out to Roberto, Guadencio, and Alejandro. They always went out of their way to make sure we were taken care of. 

Kids: lots of activities for the kids from the kids club including; Bubble pool party, jet ski racing, dream catcher making, painting, magicians, science labs etc. 

Downfalls: Perhaps the biggest downfall is having to wake up early to reserve chairs. We’re up by 6am regardless but it would have been nice to stay in bed a bit longer. The problem stems from not having towel cards. Guests are free to take as many towels as they want. This is a great feature but I also think it leads to guests reserving a lot of chairs at multiple areas. 

Overall this was a great vacation and I wouldn’t hesitate to return! I miss this place already. Enjoy your vacation!

reviews.author: Suryavarman
reviews.title: HORRIBLE! Please AVOID
reviews.text:
This hotel is one of the worst I have been to. I spend close to 50 days in a year vactaioning and I am a Top Contributor on Tripadvisor.

We made the terrible mistake of booking this hotel for 5 nights during the Christmas period and they literlly ruined everything about Christmas!

Rooms: 
- The hotel needs to refurbish every room. Hands down. We were multiple families and none of our rooms were good. And we paid $6400 for these horrible rooms.
- Broken doors, broken beds, shady curtains. I have seen hotels where flush does not work, and this hotel had that too. But to top it, it had a 24x7 leaking shower cable and they will not fix it. So we had a room with dripping water sound all the time.
- The ac vents were open and disgusting because they never cleaned.
- In our room we were a party of 2 adults and 2 kids and when we asked to change the room because of the problems, they offered us a king bed suggesting that 2 of us sleep on the floor.
- There was a locker in all the rooms but all of them were broken which meant we were unsure if our immigration docs will last.
- People would come randomly into the room as if its their room in the name of room service. But there was no service.
- To get water into the room, we had to make multiple phone calls.
- To get the bell boy to come to the room, we had to wait over 45 mins.
- We booked the room through jetblue travel and the hotel had the audacity to say that they have politics with jetblue so they cannot service as per what was agreed. We paid for a romantic couples dinner which we never got.

Food:
- Another horror story.
- This so called all inclusive restaurant has 5-6 restaurants. 
- The food has fancy names but the portions are the sizes of peanuts.
- Every restaurant had 40-50 mins wait. 
- Servers dont even look at you.
- If you are lucky that they saw ou and you ask the servers to get you same thing or anything for that matter, they throw tantrums. One server even said "how many time will you order the same"... 
- The only place where you can get food faster is the buffet. You get to wait for less time. Its not no-wait.
- The buffet food is basically whatever people do not eat in other restaruants deep fried.

Staff:
- I seriously want to know if this hotel pays the staff any salaries.
- The whole idea of going to an all-inclusive is to not carry wallets or any accessories and enjoy the surroundings. Here you got to carry your money.
- People only work if you tip them. And nothing comes for $1. 
- The guy at the pool bar asked me to pay for a can of pepsi.
- The breakfast buffet omlet lady only looks at you if you wave a $ bill at her. Otherwise no food for you.
- In the 5 days we were there, I spent close to $400 in tips.

Grounds:
- The hotel is small.
- Its only one building.
- The other building is a time share.
- In total its like 1.5 acres.
- I heard the private cab driver say that Moonpalace is a much nicer hotel with 20 acres of property, and nobody comes to paradisus because of how horrible it is.
- The beach is full of shell dust and even the cabanas on the beach are not free. I dont know whats included in the all-inclusive.
- Drinks in this all inclusive is 10% drink and 90% water. 

Spa:

- Sadly we ended up using the spa too and it was just more grimy rooms with super old equipment that were ready to fall apart.

Charges:
- Remmeber I said that the hotel has 5-6 restaurants. of the 5-6 retsaurants, 2 are not free. So how is this an all-inclusive restaurant?
- Charges for cabanas, charges for drinks, charges for everything expect the water fruit ice cream at the beginning.

Every employee at the hotel tries to run away from having to do their job. They just point you to the next person and walk away. They do not clean the rooms. They do not refill water or the bar in the room and when asked, they act as if they are doing us a favor.

This hotel has a time share and they treat everyone as if they are some beggars. 

If you want to pay top dollar and make your self feel like a beggar begging for food, this is the hotel for you.

This is as bad as it gets.

Even writing this review makes me feel so terrible that I had to put myself through this ordeal during Christmas.

Nobody even smiles at this hotel. Everyone is busy trying to make a quic buck in tips.

reviews.author: Mike H
reviews.title: Great Birthday
reviews.text: My wife and i visited the Paradisus to celebrate her 60th birthday. This trip was amazing. The food was above average, the drinks were great! No tap beer cans and bottles! Our concierge Violeta was exceptional! She decorated our room in my wifes birthday and gave us Champagne and Cake. I f you want serenity i recommend the retreat area. The only bad thing i have to say in that we went to Sal steak restaurant on her birthday and if you order a steak off menu the prices were ridiculous. $155 dollars for a ribeye is above what you would pay in Manhattans premier steak houses. But we will definitely be returning!!

reviews.author: Passport05672387795
reviews.title: Amazing service
reviews.text: This service was great! Esmaralda was awesome! I will definitely visit again! She was very hospitable and the service was great. I felt at home when she was here and the food and drinks were everything that I could ever imagine. She was very polite and I will definitely come back.

reviews.author: Maika P
reviews.title: Enjoyed our stay, highly recommend!
reviews.text:
Absolutely loved our stay at the Paradisus Cancun resort! We booked this trip for our an anniversary trip. Once we arrived, we were greeted immediately and our luggage was taken to our room for us. We were assigned a concierge person and they helped us throughout our stay. Thank you Alexis! You were amazing. We booked dining reservations through her for our entire stay and she helped us book excursions as well. She provided many options and we chose the one that worked for us. 

The room was very nice! We booked a luxury suite ocean view and the view was indeed amazing. We spent a lot of time on the balcony admiring the views. 

The food was great! I would say that the buffet was a hit or miss depending on when you get there for the freshness of the food. My favorite buffet time was breakfast! The food was coming out constantly fresh. 

If you're pool side, the chairs can fill up quickly. But many people were leaving their towels on their chairs even if they were leaving. Just ask around if folks are using their chairs or not. There are servers that you can order food and drinks from. 

Overall, I think enjoyed my stay at a Paradisus Cancun and would come back!

reviews.author: Roxana B
reviews.title: BEST photographer at resort!
reviews.text: We had an amazing time especially during our photoshoot with Outdoorsphoto company within the resort. Our photographer was Eugene, he was excellent, gifted artist, and great to work with. We absolutely loved all the photos he took and bought many of them. He is a great addition to the resort.

reviews.author: rebeccawhitfield12
reviews.title: Appalling customer service and horrible food
reviews.text: Worst resort I’ve ever been to. Ricardo from OTIUM desk and our concierge Frida were both extremely rude and unhelpful. Ricardo got in my face at one point and made me feel uncomfortable and unsafe. All the food was really bad and you could tell it was very cheap. I paid for the reserve but nobody told me what was and wasn’t included. Overall I feel taken advantage of by this place and will never return. I’ll make sure to tell my friends to never stay at this resort. I also never heard back from anyone when I tried to escalate things. And I’m sure I never will!

reviews.author: eruelas
reviews.title: Awesome vacation at Paradisus Cancún
reviews.text:
Great vacation in Paradisus Cancún. Hotel is very nice, beautiful beach, friendly staff and food. Especially breakfast with Atalanio, he always made us feel great and right at home. 
Rooms can use a little upgrade, and nightly entertainment would be great.

reviews.author: tazzzella
reviews.title: Amazing loved everything.
reviews.text: First my favorite place to vacation is Cancun Mexico.  I've been to 25 countries and Cancun is my favorite. The otium transfer co took care of us from airport to hotel and back again. This hotel was perfect. All the workers are so friendly and helpful. Our concierge Theresa was so professional I wish I could remember all the workers names from the check in desk the help desk and all the men and women who took such great care of us at the restaurants, coffee bar and pool area. I drank so many virgin mojitos. The room was perfect, the bed so comfy, my husband asked for extra pillows which they provided. The food was delicious. The beach was so much fun and beautiful. Loved the warm or cold pool. And lastly, I played three rounds of golf and my husband played 5 you have to pay to rent clubs, no green fees. we even played a round of tennis, with the help of Christian. Also make reservations when you check in for the restaurants.  We ate at Lemon Fish, Aqua Marina, and Ceilo. We will be staying at this hotel yearly. I always tell my coworkers Cancun is better than Hawaii.

reviews.author: Sarah Melanie
reviews.title: Best all inclusive we've ever stay at
reviews.text:
We came for a music festival and we weren't sure what to expect but once we arrived we were blown away by this resort. 
When you first walk in the lobby area is so beautiful, the natural light shining down and all the plants hanging from the balconies is like something I've never seen before. We were escorted by a bellhop to our room and he so informational and answered all our questions during the walk. We stayed in the Reserve, which is further from the center of the resort, but well worth it. With Reserve you have access to a concierge, who by the way came and knocked on our door and introduced himself when we didn't contact him after our first night.
