You also have 24 hour bar, coffee station, and small bites station in reserve away from the rest of the resort. The dining area surrounding that is quiet and serene. The room itself was beautiful, clean and comfortable. We were able to have our mini bar filled with only waters because thats all we wanted in the room. One day we overslept and missed housekeeping but were able to have them come back and quickly give us service. 
The restaurants were amazing for it being all inclusive. Other resorts we've stayed at the food was frankly not appetizing, but this resort nothing really disappointed. Our favorite was Lemonfish and I highly recommend you eat here while visiting. Even the buffet had amazing food and even some more traditional Mexican dishes. Breakfast always had these stews that reminded me of my mother in laws cooking. (If you're need of tortillas just ask your server!) 
The pool was amazing as well, we spent our days at the cabanas. The pool staff was friendly and always so attentive to our needs. 
Overall this resort was amazing from the views, to the staff, to the food, to the accommodations.  We will for sure be back!

reviews.author: Chip M
reviews.title: Just got back - was a great 10 days
reviews.text:
We just got home from a 10 day trip here with two other couples.  While we were "reserve", we were not in the Reserve building which was troublesome to start, but our rooms were all on the same floor and just doors away from each other in the most central of locations (Building 3).  Close to EVERYTHING.   We did not see what the "reserve" rooms in building 5 looked like, but our rooms were adequate, but the bathrooms were a little on the small side.  But the ocean view was amazing.
As with any vacation, everything was not "perfect".  However, our concierge (listed as butler on the website) Diego was amazing!!  He set up a what's app group chat for us to contact him and, as we told him, he "got things done".  He got some minor issues with our rooms fixed quickly, made all our restaurant, spa, and bali bed reservations.  He checked in with us everyday, and made it a point to find us by the pool to see if we needed anything.  
Overall the service was great.  Everyone was very helpful and if we needed anything, someone was there.   
Specifically, the Reserve pool concierges Nicole and Jennifer were amazing and so friendly with anything we needed in terms of our bali beds on a daily basis.  The Reserve bartender Miguel was also great.  Our servers out by the pool (Flor, Joel, Valeria, Yamil, Reuben) were great too, always checking in to see if we needed any food or drink.   
The food throughout the resort, from poolside, reserve restaurant (Sante), to the buffet and the numerous restaurants was amazing!!! As a group, we ate in every restaurant and there was NOT a meal that wasn't superb.  I personally feel the two best restaurants were Sals Steakhouse and the Lion Fish.  But all were great.  And the service in each of the restaurants was top notch. 
Now for the CONS..   The hotel Definitely is in dire need of some upgrades and is showing its age in lots of places.  But that was mostly cosmetic stuff.   
Also, the Aqua sports salespeople were VERY aggressive/pushy (friendly - but aggressive) and you had to tell them know numerous times a day.  They should really just be in their booth and if someone WANTS to do something they are very easy to find.  
Another issue was that as an ALL INCLUSIVE, there were many menu items in most of the restaurants that entailed an extra charge.  I think that defeats what "all inclusive" is.. 
All that said, we, as a group had a great vacation and highly recommend the property.

reviews.author: dnlmom
reviews.title: Most recent visit disappointing
reviews.text: We have been going to the Paradisus Cancun for a number of years.  Some things remain lovely (most particularly certain staff members and the food) but overall, the quality is diminished.   The entertainment is few and far between and what they have is horrible!  Saturday nights performance in the lobby was ear piercing, teeth clenching loud and horrible.   We couldn't wait to get inside the restaurant where we couldn't hear it anymore.  Pool is loud in the afternoons and the constant booming of the base makes us retreat to our rooms early with a headache.  Bri g back quality entertainment like the three tenors!  Water drips from  a moldy ceiling in the Sports Bar.  Maintenance needs more attention.

reviews.author: Rachael M
reviews.title: Best Resort Service and Food I’ve Ever Had (older building)
reviews.text:
Short review: The hotel is dated but the amazing staff and delicious restaurants deliver the 5 star experience way beyond my expectations. The beach is stunning and we had a great trip! 

My family and I are frequent travelers and have never had such a great service experience as we did at Paradisus Cancún. Although the hotel is older, the staff is beyond any expectation we had. I highly recommend booking into the reserve area. 

Once we arrived our concierge Diego handled everything we needed. We arrived tired and drunk and woke up the next day with all of our reservations handled and made for the week! Diego made sure we had private cabana/Bali beds by the pool, reservations for dinner at the restaurants we requested, and was a constant fount of knowledge and expertise for the area. He gave us his personal number to contact him via WhatsApp anytime we needed anything! This vacation wouldn’t have been nearly as wonderful without his help. Not to mention he is so nice to talk to and get to know! 

In addition, the reserve pool was a great place to have lunch (at the Santé restaurant), swim, and relax. Moises always greeted us with the happiest smile, fun jokes, and fantastic service. He brought us tons of drinks, of course, but also went to other bars and restaurants to get things we wanted. 

My favorite part of every night was seeing Julio at the reserve bar. He remembered our favorite drinks and I will sincerely miss seeing him! What a genuine and lovely person!!

The hotel is older, and not as nice as the other Meliá resorts I have stayed in, however we spent very little time in our room. The bathrooms were updated and had an amazing rain shower and a huge tub with a view of the ocean. The service and tasty restaurants infinitely make up for the older building. The beach is 5 star beautiful ocean and beach!! 

The spa had facilities I have never seen at other resorts, sauna, steam room, cold showers, hot showers, cold plunge pool, hydro pool, and multiple massage areas. My massage was of normal quality but the spa facilities made it an experience to remember. 

The golf course leaves much to be desired, however it was free so we don’t have many complaints. 

Overall I would definitely return to this resort. Diego changed our life and we will never forget all the work he put in to make our stay fabulous. Thank you Paradisus, Moises, Julio, and Diego.

reviews.author: leftyjenks
reviews.title: The best stap
reviews.text:
Timorese and Gaby where Fantastic they made most tasteful drinks.Their personalities were great, they were so funny. They gave us the best advice on tours in Cancun. Which saved us money as well. We found out how to go on the bus to downtown and to the ferry.
It was a blast, we can wait to come back again.

reviews.author: mumbojojo
reviews.title: Our amazin  vacations
reviews.text: Everyone was helpful and friendly! Loved every minute! I recommend Gaby and  Timote by the pool bar. Their drinks are the best! Thanks for making our stay the best. We hope to return and see these guys!

reviews.author: Joan Laura
reviews.title: My third visit to the Reserve  in 6 months.
reviews.text: This hotel is my home away from home.  I have been going to Paradisus for many years.  I have been staying in Adult Reserve for the last few years and I highly recommend it.  Be sure to stay in Tower 5.  In addition to a beautiful pool and beach area with the most comfortable Bali beds, they also have a private atrium to have a snack and drinks and to get your morning coffee.  You will have the services of 2 pool concierge, Jennifer and Nicole, who are excellent! in addition the staff is the best starting with Diego the manager and Moises, Val and Caesar. The hotel is beautiful and there are several restaurants to choose from.  I highly recommend Lemon Fish, Capella, and Aqua Marina.  Be sure to visit Aqua Marina for lunch if you love seafood.  The lunch menu is different than the dinner menu and not only delicious, but also presented beautifully.  What will keep you coming back however is the staff who are absolutely wonderful.  They also have a beach bar there - Kanna- which is very nice.  Geovany and Karina, the bartender and hostess are fabulous! The Ginger bar also has great service with Randy, Carlos and Gaby.  While at Lemon Fish stop at their small bar to try a tropical cocktail.  David, the bartender is a Sommelier and all the waiters are terrific.  Hugo is there and makes certain it is great experience.  In the main area is the swim up bar.  Be sure to visit and ask for Victor C. You will also have the services of a personal concierge.  I have had Aaron for several years and he takes care of arranging everything for me. I highly recommend him.  All in all, you will have a vacation to remember.

reviews.author: Anita B
reviews.title: Really enjoyable stay with super kind staff
reviews.text: The Paradisus was super nice. It was clean and nice pool and beach. The staff were all SO kind ! We made friends with our waiter Atilano who greeted us with a big smile each morning. Most of the restaurants were amazing food. Rooms were spacious and clean

reviews.author: SP-VD-GK
reviews.title: Excellent Customer Service (Not a fan of the rooms as they are outdated)
reviews.text:
Travelled Feb 2023 with my husband, 4 year old and 13 month old. Also accompanied by friends with a 12 month old.

1) Check-in was decent. They have a nice array of drinks, popsicles for the kids on arrival. The check-in desk clark NOT friendly at all. Andrea appeared disgruntled and not wanting to help. She could see I had two young kids and didn't seem interested in accommodating any requests (such as a crib) and room request. What I did LIKE was the room key was essentially your wrist band. So you could wear it at all times, never lose it, and it swiped you into your room very easily

2) Room was in the Main Tower (3) with Lagoon View.  Room was my LEAST favorite of the whole trip. Clean but outdated, particularly the bathroom. Bathtub had rainshower and hand held - water pressure and temperature was great but it was hard to bath the kids in it. The mattresses were great! The plugs were so loose that it would easily fall out. Small fridge was always wet at the bottom and leaky. Also music would blare so loud into your room at 9pm when kids are trying to sleep. That bothered me a lot.

3) The beach is just beautiful and stunning. Cabanas are $50 to rent for day (bit disappointed in the extra cost). The service on the beach is great. Nachos and salsa/guac were delicious! Ordered a virgin pina colada daily.

4) Amayrani from Malva Restaurant was a God Send. Helped me coordinate meal delivery to room 2x/day for my 13 mo old with shreeded salmon/chicken and fresh tasty veggie puree mash. I also secured a carton of Almond Milk for allergies. The food at the resort is excellent! The service in all the restaurants were amazing. So patient despite young kids and food options were lovely overall. Morning breakfast with omelettes were great and could not get enough of fresh papaya. 

5) Spa treatments (I had detox facial and the hanakasumi) are lovely but the sauna/steam room/hydrotherapy are VERY outdated. 

6) We used the hotel photographers (Outdoors Photo) for a family shoot on the beach. Diego and Oscar were excellent. Photos stunning and we even got an album! We took photos at 445pm prior to sun set and it was just perfect. 

7) I loved Lemon Fish and Cielo restaurants! Michelle our concierge did help us book restaurant each night. With 7 of us, it was very very helpful to have her do this for us so thank you!

I have to say the service at this resort is TOP NOTCH but the hotel rooms are not my favourite (at least the unrenovated rooms). I did not get to see the newer ones. I would go back if the hotel rooms were ALL renovated! I am grateful for a wonderful trip with my family and thank you to Paradisus for taking care of us :)

reviews.author: lgswny
reviews.title: New management- could be better
reviews.text:
This is our second time at the resort- and we’re club kris members. The hotel has changed management and it shows.. i wasnt very impressed. 

The staff however was exceptional.
Ada at the pool was the best! All of the service staff is kind and extremely helpful.

reviews.author: Coastal802088
reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: Activity staff superb especially axcel, Tabatha. Out of there way to accommodate and get people involved. Extremely friendly and good English. Also Wendy in ginger 2 bar exceptional . You are lucky to have such a dynamic person. Also Antonio waiter in Agua marina resturant so professional and super friendly .went back to eat there again because of him and reasturant manager honono and bus boy Armando. Opps got these 2 mixed up both great personalities. All these yrs as time share owners and first time in tower one loved it. One complaint need a better 2nd bed couch too low and not good mattress...love paradesius

reviews.author: Eric L
reviews.title: Phenomenal vacation/ work trip
reviews.text: Atilano Eligio Herardo Manuel was the best service in town. Never had to wait and always was attending whatever we needed did a phenomenal job will come back. We never thought we would enjoy our first time like we did.

reviews.author: Jane L
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, AWESOME views, great food and friendly great service.
reviews.text: Loved the location of our room. We had a nice atrium area where we could sit relax and play cards & games.Would be nice if there was some water, coffee and light snacks there as there were a few years ago.Bar service,pool servers were very on top of our needs. They do a great job. I have no complaints about service it was very top notch and friendly. The only disappointment was the inconsistency of the renting the beds poolside. They say you can’t rent til 10:00 daily and we’d be there after 9:00 asking and they say our preferred spots were already taken. So either they get good tips from people that they are saved everyday to the same people not sure. You can tell the same people had the same bed but we tried to get one earlier cause we saw this pattern. VERY INCONSISTENT and not fair to pick some guests over others.

reviews.author: danielwaldron44
reviews.title: Best dining experience
reviews.text: Jorge (food service) and Dabi (drink service) were the best we had the resort. The food and drink options we had were fantastic. Two of the nicest, friendliest, and attentive servers I have had in life.

reviews.author: katie s
reviews.title: amazing service at Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Jorge, the waiter from Lemon Fish, was amazing. So personable, offered the best food options, constantly checked on us and made sure we had a great experience. Dabi, the bartender, was very wonderful as well.

reviews.author: Kelly W
reviews.title: Theft from room safe
reviews.text:
Use caution , we are sol melia vacation club members for nearly 20 years , never before had an issue but this trip on our second day and employee hot our safe forever $400 cash .
Hotel has refuses to do anything and dragged their feet while we were at the resort. 
In 20nyears of world travel we have never made any theft claims .

reviews.author: Traveler17092523102
reviews.title: Be Warned -Worst Experience Ever!
reviews.text:
Before arrival, Otium could have been more courteous as I was trying to arrange the offered transportation to the hotel. Unfortunately, they kept hanging up the phone. 
I arrived at Paradisus and waited 30+ minutes to be checked in and rushed through. When I asked for details on the resort, I was told to read the card. 

The room view I purchased differed from what I received, and they could not accommodate it. In my room, the toilet ran nonstop, the power went out every morning, and the outlets stopped working, causing the refrigerator to leak. Imagine maintenance coming to your room every day. 

Housekeeping took items from my room, walked in on me naked without knocking, and just stood there taking a mental picture. 

I could not reserve half the restaurants because they were closed for the week. Moreover, finding a spot on the beach was challenging due to people holding places with towels. 

On the last day, I woke up late. My alarm did not sound because the power went out again! I called guest services, but they never came. I barely made my flight. 

I exercised much patience and consideration, but this prompted me to reach out to the guest services manager (ZANNINO, ROSANNA). She rushed through my concerns and promised to make things right and email me. 

I did not expect to be emailing for two months for what she offered. She never made things right or kept her promises and became verbally abusive, yelling at me over the phone. Because of this, I opted not to return.

reviews.author: Valerie R
reviews.title: Best Cancun resort
reviews.text: We loved this resort. The service was wonderful and the ocean was perfectly clear. The restaurants are actually incredible too. Surprising for an all inclusive! The heated pool was also clutch for the less hot days.

reviews.author: Cat G
reviews.title: I Wish They Would They Would Have Told Us
reviews.text:
I would like to start by saying that I do not know the finances behind this trip as another guest on our party payed for the whole trip. Our rating is based solely on the resort itself and not our whole experience. Our review is about the hotel atmosphere, the rooms, the food, and the service, as well as the impact on the other days. 

Day 1: Arrival Day/Check-In
This was the first time we said to each other as a party, "I wish they would have told us," and wasn't the first time we would say this during the trip. When we checked in we first learned that when you book the room, you do not get a choice in the room that you get. They assign you your room and bed type and for most of our party that ended up being doubles even though most of the party were couples and had requesting kings. Only half of our 10 person party got the rooms they wanted. On all of the rooms we were miss booked and they tried playing us in lower tier rooms while still charging us for the deluxe rooms and reserve access. We had all paid for the junior deluxe suites with reserve access and had to bring over the leader of our party to make sure they reinstated our reserve access, which took a lot of arguing. That was the first red flag of our stay. After an entire half an hour of checking in we finally went upstairs to our room with our bellhop and walk in on man in his bathrobe. They had booked us in an occupied room. Luckily my brothers room was a few doors down and when we called and let them know they said we had to go back downstairs and check in again. When we did and they did was laugh at the situation and no one apologized. We went up to our room which was adjacent to the last one and the door would work. The battery of the door was broken. Again we had to call down and it took 20 minutes for security to come and let us in our room. An entire hour just to check in. At this point we had to rush and go to our dinner appointment. But still no apologies and no one ever checked in on us for the remainder of the trip. 

Agua Marina: this dining experience was not only annoying but overall disappointing. In all restaurants in the hotel your menu is the use of a QR code which not only works only half of the time but is also incorrect. Missing descriptions, missing menu items, incorrect description, or just does not open. Getting physical menus took arguing and they would only give 1 for the party of 10 people. Our server was inattentive, did not refill drinks after dinner and never came back to order desserts. I personally did not like my entree could not finish it and was left dissatisfied on my first day.

Day 2: Resort Day
In our first day my partner and I were told if we wanted to get a better room in the reserve area we would have to check on our second day. When we asked about a king bed we were told we would have to check out at 11 and then recheck in at 3pm to see if they was an available king sized room. That would be extremely inconvenient. At the same time we told them our bathroom door would not open and that our AC was not working. It was 80 degrees in our room the whole entire trip. They attempted to fix it twice and once again, never checked in with us.

Malva pt. 1: We decided to sleep in and went down for a later breakfast. Ended up going to Malva and I made a charcuterie plate with a fresh made omelet. We had the green juice for breakfast. I wish they would better labeled the items in the buffet as we didn't know half of what we ate was. Especially the cheeses. The textures were different than what I'm used to and I was surprised that it wasn't cold. Although besides my omelet, the food wasn't hot either.

We booked 5 cabanas in the reserve area for our first day. When we got there discovered they had only booked us for 4 cabanas and had given the other away. They tried moving the other group but we stopped them as that seemed rude to the couple who booked and was incorrectly placed. We had Yamil as a server and ended up being one of the best servers the entire trip. Anytime we walked by he would great us. He recommended their signature cocktail the Mangolele (mango lay lay) which I drank too much of. We had the aguachile and two of the surf and turf platters. I still think it was a wast of $150 for the 2 surf and turf platters and the only think I enjoyed on them was the fried fish. We were very surprised that we came to the Caribbean and they didn't even serve Caribbean lobster for that price. 

We then went to book our spa days for later in the week and learned the second time of "I wish they would have told us" they there was an entire reserve area for us. A bar, a snack bar, a breakfast buffet. 

Malva: this is the main buffet. Highly avoid. I can go into each dining experience. But I'll just say simply, AVOID the cheese and only eat simple proteins. I still have no idea what that "lamb" was supposed to be but it was wrong and gross. At this point in time I am not feeling good at all and consistently had to excuse myself from the part and started having diarrhea. Eventually my partner is having the same experience. 

Day 3: Isla Mujeres
We woke up the next day and almost cancelled our entire day. Both of us feel absolutely disgusting and are still very sick. We were reassured that we would have an easy day. We did not and had to leave the island early. Thankfully our taxi driver was very kind and helpful and drove us to a pharmacy to get Treda. YOU WILL NEED THIS. This saved us. After some rest we felt a lot better and went to our next reservation. The rest of our group stayed at Isla Mujeres instead. At Isla mujeres we found out that another couple had cheese and was not feeling well. Together we decided to avoid the cheese.

Cielo: this was by far my favorite experience although there was a few dishes that didn't excite us we were able to overlook that because of Melvin our amazing server who single handedly helped us feel better about our trip. The chef even came out and took a photo with us and gave us delicious Mexican snacks. I loved almost everything we had except for the elote, because of the cheese, which still did not taste right. Melvin asked if we could review their restaurant and gave us a QR code that linked to Tripadvisor. I was a bit upset because that made me realize as I went through the reviews that they were highly reviewing individual experiences and not the hotel as a whole. Cielo for me gets a separate rating from the hotel with 5/5 stars and would go back just for those desserts. Especially that delicious corn cake!

Day 4: Chichen-Itza
The day starts our by finding our my brother's ordered room service and also have diarrhea. At this point 3 out of the 5 rooms have now had food poisoning from the cheese at the hotel. This was so unfortunate as one of my brothers had a horrible day and missed half of the activities due to being sick. We also ended up missing our dinner reservation to Lemonfish which is unfortunate. My mom got a hold of our concierge and they booked us for a reservation at 9pm at Lunch Box as it was the only place that would take us for dinner. 

Lemonfish: However our other guests that did not go to the ruins with us went and said it's delicious. We called many times trying to make a reservation for another day and were told they do not accept walk-ins and had no reservations available. 

The Lunch Box: first when we get there we find out the concierge messed up the reservation AGAIN and they did not have is on their list. They fixed it and threw some tables together for us but blamed us for the mistake and we're so bitter for the rest of the dinner. Our server was rude and inattentive, we could hear the server and manager talking bad about us behind us. They did not want to provide paper Manus and we were upset when we returned several dishes because they were not as described on the menu. Got made at us because we didn't want to order all the appetizers. Our food came out barely warm. The "wagyu" patty was just a frozen patty you get at McDonald's. 

We ended up being hungry later and ordering room service. I definitely didn't get the wings and got two cheeseburgers... With no cheese. It took about an hour to get it sadly and once again I don't know why they can't make hot food. 

Day 5: Resort Day
At this point I'm time the 4th couple in our family now has food poisoning and we are beginning to learn that there is a lot we don't know about the hotel and what is provided for us. We called again about our AC and were told that if they could fix it they wod move us. After everything we had been though we were not up for moving our rooms 2 days before we were to leave. Again no follow up about the AC and still 80 degrees at 8am.

We went to the spa which was actually amazing. They didn't tell us we needed a bathing suit so I didn't get to enjoy the other parts of the spa, the massage withu partner was nice and we ended up going to the reserve snack area for breakfast. I'm happy we did because this was the first breakfast I didn't feel like I had to worry about

I did the escape room with my mom and she told me that she was now on her 3rd concierge and they kept messing up her reservation. She said we had a reservation for Sal which we were all excited for. You can only go one time included but honestly with the reservation system I can't see how you would be able to go again anyways. 

We went back to the cabanas but we were only able to get 2 out of the 5 cabanas we were promised. You can only reserve cabanas 2 days of your stay but we had difficulty with that. 

Blue Agave: this ended up being my favorite lunch spot. Being able to order individual tacos. I love al pastor and they do it right here. Caramelized with lovely grilled pineapple. Some delicious fresh pineapple. Marco was great and I ended up tipping him $20 just because he was extremely engaging and very helpful and kind. We told the rest of our party about it and they all went on their own time and had a similar experience. 

Sal: Some of our party did not remember the reservation time for Sal. So I called down when they opened and they said our reservation was for 7. We all had thought it was 7:30. My mom calls down and they tell her it's 7:30. The manager ended up being wrong and on their own reservation list it said 7:30 even though he argued with us when we arrived. This was my second favorite meal but everyone else's first favorite meal. From start to finish you cannot go wrong at sal. It is not worth paying extra for the up charged meats or wine. The house wines and free reserve meals are fine but they will try and upsell you proteins by showing you this display of meat until you ask them about how much they are giving you and find out you get 1/4 of the size for about $80 starting point. 

Day 6: Xcaret
We spent the entire day at Xcaret and this solidified that the bad food and rooms was only at this hotel. The food at Xcaret was amazing and so was our experience. We also learned they have resorts on property and if we ever come back to Cancun will stay there and never again with Paradisus or Melia properties.

Day 7: Resort Day
Today the executive chef was here. This was the only day we felt comfortable eating at Malva. However to not risk it we are very simple.proteins, cured meats and simple carbs. Apparently we weren't the only group getting sick as when our fourth couple went in to the shop to buy food poisoning medication they had sold out. 

Cabana day was nice and we ended up having 3 cabanas which was nice. We got Blue agave again and enjoyed some coconut water and fresh coconut. We saw Yamil and by this point knew what we could and could eat at the resort. Try the aguachile in the cabanas.

At this point my mom's concierge called her again and delighted her by saying she got her dinner reservations to Capella. Everyone told her to try Capella at the hotel. However our reservationa were at 6. The last couple who got sick ended up leaving early. This was unrelated as far as they told us so there were only 8 of us. 

Blue Agave: we went here again for lunch with my mom and brother and once again had a wonderful time. I took a risk and tried the lengua, which is something I usually only have at places I really trust and was amazingly surprised they they took care of it. Once again Marco was amazing and also had David with him who was also great. 

Capella: this placed actually pissed me off. So much hype for this place. Again to fight for the menus for our table, our server is bitter and rude. Do not get the artichoke appetizer. It was gross and had the consistency of cat food. The cacio a Pepe salad is just a Caesar with an insulting lack of dressing, when we asked for extra dressing they brought us sour ranch, further confirming our suspicions of the dairy in this hotel. The carpaccio has no acid to cook the beef and we had to ask for limes. Our entrees surprised everyone. Mushroom risotto... With no mushrooms. Pizza with string cheese consistency and no sauce, my pasta didn't have anything I ordered in it. And I told them I could not have dairy and they put cheese on my pasta anyways. The sp called "best" restaurant ended up being the worse. This ended up being the only place we did not tip. 

Room service: we ate half of our food at sal and were left starving by 10. we decided to get room service again. The burger again since it's safe at the "pretzel" dog they didn't have the other night. Again over an hour to get the food. It wasn't till I called at midnight that said its an hour deliver time for food. And hour for a hot dog? Supposedly it was supposed to come on a pretzel bun, sauerkraut and spicy mustard with potato wedges. I got sweetustard, hoagie roll, no sauerkraut and 4 wedge cut potatoes that were inedible since they were still raw? I ate the sausage itself and finalized out last night with further disappointment. 

Day 8: Departure Day
Overall saying in building 3 was loud ALL night every night. They consistently doing maintenance in the middle of the night and we woke up multiple times to the smell of paint thinner and listening to cleaning machines. Those that were in building 4 had a way better experience. 

5/16 of our meals consumed on property did we consider good or edible.

The check out experience was as bad as everyone mentioned. We put a card on file at check in and were told "as soon as you use the card you have to add it again," what does that even mean? We have to add the card to file every time we use the card on file? What a poor excuse. They said that we had to have the servers apply the discounts at each service we used, we never even saw a single check at any establishment. So our party paid several hundred more for no reason. 

We will never stay at a Melia property again and we will never return to Paradisus. If we ever return to Cancun we will stay at a Xcaret property.

reviews.author: Kimb2330
reviews.title: Amazing, can’t wait to return ❤️
reviews.text: This was my 15th time to Cancun and my 12th time to the Paradisus Cancun. This was the first time we booked The Reserve. It was an amazing experience. The waiters and pool staff were excellent! The food and drinks were extremely good. Best of all our concierge Violeta was amazing. She was so attentive to our needs. Always a text away. We never had to so much as lift a finger. She made the reservations for absolutely everything! All meals, anything we wanted to do off sight, any problems we had with our room, right down to one of the elevators in the hotel. She also made our reservation from the hotel back to the airport.  I love this resort and give it 5 stars. I give Violeta our concierge 10 stars! Thank you so much for a spectacular week in paradise 🎂

reviews.author: Travel607400
reviews.title: Perfect long weekend getaway
reviews.text: We had a fantastic time at this all inclusive resort! The food was excellent and the staff could not have been nicer and more accommodating to our group. Oscar, Joel, and all the staff at Sante pool bar and restaurant took amazing care of us- bringing waters, drinks, and food all day! Romero at the Lunch Box always made sure we had what we needed during breakfast. The views were incredible and the resort provided fun music, dancing, and activities every evening. We had truly delicious food at all the restaurants we visited. We definitely will be back!

reviews.author: corporatetripper
reviews.title: Great place to relax
reviews.text: Though not for those who are on a tight budget, it is a great place to relax and do nothing but experience the scenery and food. The view from even the second floor was beautiful and the lagoon side is still great for sunset views.

reviews.author: Deisch
reviews.title: Amazing service
reviews.text:
Every morning we made sure to sit us in the section with Atilano, Armando and Gerardo. These three gentlemen were very attentive to whatever it was we needed. We have been here in the past and remember Atilano from the last time we were here. He is the absolute best!

Thanks for helping us feel like we were truly on vacation and taken care of.

See you next time!!

reviews.author: Kishore30083518
reviews.title: Over rated. Prepare for some surprises.
reviews.text:
1. The rooms weren’t comfortable. 
2. One restaurant per night to reserve and they had no availability for one of the day.
3. Ground level servicing employees were good and helpful.
4. Front desk was too slow and service desk didn’t address

reviews.author: Steve
reviews.title: Bali beds for the win
reviews.text:
Relaxing time staying at the reserve.  This is a larger property than I prefer to stay at, but honestly it never felt that big while exploring the property and enjoying some great food and drink. 
My man Cesar at the reserve made the trip! David at lemon fresh made some very creative cocktails and was a wealth of knowledge on wines.

reviews.author: Joe and Becky L
reviews.title: Amazing Trip!
reviews.text:
We absolutely loved this resort!  Entertainment every night and excellent customer service.  The staff did a very good job keeping such a big resort so clean.  Everyone was extremely helpful and personable.   

We would like to recognize Rodrigo, Arnulfo, Pascual, and Martin in the buffet restaurant that went above and beyond for us.  All of them always made sure we were taken care of.  They made sure our wine glasses were always filled.  They appreciated us on our last day and made it very special for us.

We would also like to appreciate Adriana in the buffet restaurant for taking care of us.  As well as Alejandro in the Nespresso Cafe.  He always had an excellent attitude and smile.  He talked to every customer and made sure we were all taken care of.

Axcel was very friendly and always approached us to make sure we were having a good time and if we needed anything.

The dancers were phenomenal and worked and mingled with the audience.  They made every night and theme something we looked forward to nightly.

We loved our room and felt very comfortable in it.  The housekeeping service did a great job cleaning it.

As you can tell from our review, we were completely happy and satisfied with how nice the resort and staff are there.  We will be back!

reviews.author: Hilda O
reviews.title: Excellent attention!
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful and customer service is amazing. At the buffet Janeth, Ramiro, Rey and Arturo were very attentive.  Timoteo was the best bartender! He made us delicious palomas. We had a great time, Thank you all!

reviews.author: Katelyn L
reviews.title: WENDY!!!!
reviews.text: We recently stayed at the Paradisus in Cancun and had the absolute pleasure of meeting Wendy in the Sports Bar attached to the lounge on the first floor. She totally made our trip, and all 20 of us agreed that she was fantastic and we would love for her to be recognized. Thank you Wendy for such a great few nights in paradise! Get this girl a raise!

reviews.author: Nikki D
reviews.title: Wonderful, relaxing vacation!
reviews.text: Amazing resort, the staff was wonderful and always willing to help. It wasn’t overly crowded and the week we went it seemed low key, which is what we were looking for. There is nightly entertainment at about 8:00 and we enjoyed those shows but it wasn’t a party resort and that was good. Some of our favorite servers, bar tenders and workers were Ignacio, Martin, Balta, Leo and Victor. We can’t thank these men enough for making our vacation amazing!

reviews.author: michaelO5652IB
reviews.title: Not even close to luxury
reviews.text: Room service is terrible - items on the menu are often "not available", no alcohol can be delivered to the room (what!?), mini bar is awful, rooms are outdated, AC never stops running, are among the worst things with this hotel. We've stayed at some of the other 5 start hotels on the strip, and this more in line with a budget hotel (3 star). Don't waste your money.

reviews.author: Robin H
reviews.title: Great relaxing week
reviews.text: We just returned from a week at the Club Melia Paradisus.  It was a great week and the resort was very nice. Our rooms were great.  The bed was so comfortable, and the bathroom was well appointed.  The food was pretty good for an all-inclusive.  Breakfast and lunch at Malva (buffet) daily was better than you might expect.  There was a large variety of breads which were good and a donut wall with freshly made donuts that my husband really enjoyed.  Our server, Ramiro Edier, and Armando at Malva were terrific!  They  had champagne and Bloody Caesars ready for us when we sat down and then remembered our drinks at lunch as well.  We had some awesome servers at all the restaurants and bars we went to.  Antonio at Aqua Marine, Luis and Fernando at Capella, and Cecelia and Luz at Ginger Bar.  What we found unacceptable is how hard all the service people work to make our experiences pleasant  and the very few people who tipped these wonderful workers.  They all work so hard to please us. I wish I had the names of the other servers as well, but unfortunately, I don't.  The young man at the coffee bar, our housekeeper (room 1216), and the beach servers outside Aqua Marine restaurant were also wonderful.  One young man on the beach actually brought us fresh towels while we went to lunch!  The service was terrific!  We would definitely consider staying here again.   All in all it was a great week!

reviews.author: Armin L
reviews.title: No good communication and just overcharging
reviews.text: I should say it was a great experience staying with them and specially their kids club service for the young kids, but the last day on the check out time was an awful note in my trip. It started when the receptionist informed me about the $120 USD standing in my room ,which was billed from few nights ago during the dinner time. The key point, which I brought it up to the attention of receptionist was, me and wife during that night asked for the wine, and waiter offered us lots of different bottles, which we asked for the one that is included to our room deal. Three times asked from the same waiter and confirmed with another different waiter was our approach. The interesting point was the time that when he(waiter) was talking to us regarding the food, notified us on some food are not included in our room deal, so it doesn't mean that he didn't understand us.

reviews.author: Kendo C
reviews.title: 5 stars????!!
reviews.text:
Seriously what kind a of a resort is this?! I had a
fun time 🌞
 
Thank you much Gauducio, Armando and Manuel! - from cancun Malva
  
Guarducio and Manuel handled themselves and provided are family the last days of dining in for breakfast. They were very fast and efficient at providing us drinks and service. Really appreciate it.  

Armando however provided such professionalism and friendly service my kids and family enjoyed dining outside! Whenever we need something Armando would just tend to us by himself and  we were really impressed. With a family of 5, it tends to be busy, but Armando was always very tentative.  
 
Thank you for an amazing experience! My family will be missing your hospitality and presence. Thank you! 

 From the Martins

reviews.author: armin2572023
reviews.title: Bad customer service and information exchanging
reviews.text: We loved the entire experience until the last day before the check out, which was told for additional $120 USD charge on our room due to one the night's dinner charges. As I told to the receptionist, me and wife asked at least three times from the waiter regarding the wine, which was offered by the waiter if it is included in our room deal or not, he clearly said it is. We even asked another waiter to confirm it and he also agreed on it. It is getting interesting, when our waiter told us regarding some food that aren't included in our room deal. 10 Minutes before been picked up, I was informed with that charge and they even tried to reach out to the restaurant, but clearly no answer from no one. As I mentioned, we were happy with our experience until the last minute, which it just gave us unpleasant customer service right before leaving.

reviews.author: Loay A
reviews.title: Malva restaurant
reviews.text: My name is Loay Alfasih I stayed at paradisus melia and attended Malva Pm restaurant the staff were Beyond expectations  the staff Francicco Tetto is polite, helpful and very hospitality also I met Rodrigo Gorocica was very welcoming and helpful and polite I met Oscar the chef his food was amazing and he came out to introduce himself because I was very happy with the taste of the food also I was very empressed with Quillermo and Amulfo they are on top of everything as far as waiting on the table very polite respectful and very helpful I am so amazed with all the crews they are top notch I will recommend all my friends and family to come to this venue my son Ali Alfasih and his wife are coming to visit here on Mar 1st 2023 because of what I told him about this venue. I will come and visit again.

reviews.author: CathereneCalzo
reviews.title: PARADISUS CANCUN
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay here at Paradisus Cancun. The staff here are amazing! They were very friendly and attentive. Every morning our family would look forward to breakfast at Malva. We always had Antilono, Fernando, and Gerardo. They took the time to get to know our family and the kids loved them. We celebrated our sons birthday and they put a big smile on his face! Thank you again Paradisus family for giving us one of the best experiences and memories we will cherish for a lifetime. 

-Martin Family-

reviews.author: Brad M
reviews.title: Service at Cancun -  BE WARNED
reviews.text:
BE WARNED! Your in for excellent service 🌞
 
Had an excellent time with my family here! Our server Atilano, Gerardo, and Fernando did a fantastic job. 
 
We celebrated my sons 4th Birthday and also had consecutive service for breakfast from both of them. From coffee being filled, juices, and to our morning mimosas, they made sure our party was topped up. 
  
As for food, they made sure if needed anything else from the buffet such as toast being done (as I was busy tending to my kiddos), extra bacon/sausages  to needing extra fruit. They did a superb job. 
 
Overall, thank you so much Atilano, Gerardo, and Fernando for your excellent hospitality, we really appreciate your effort and time!

reviews.author: Izaias N
reviews.title: We will try to come back
reviews.text: Really nice Hotel and the Staff was amazing the food was incredible, pool was great, rooms clean and modern as well really had a good experience here. This is a hotel that has a romantic vibe to it we have stayed in many other hotels in cancun this is definitely one of the best ones

reviews.author: Alex E
reviews.title: Almost didn’t leave
reviews.text: Loved our stay here. The service and food were incredible and the property is beautiful. We upgraded to the reserve suite with an ocean view half way through our stay and it was well worth it. Special thanks to DeeDee for making us feel welcome right away and Corinna from the Kanna bar on the beach. Loved going there almost every night.

reviews.author: Paige W
reviews.title: Loved it
reviews.text: The service at this resort is absolutely amazing. All of the workers are friendly and professional. Carina at the Kanna Bar and DeDe at the pool are exceptional and made us feel more than welcome. The food is also very good. We upgraded to the Reserve during the last half of our stay and it was well worth it.

reviews.author: John H
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Wow! A delicious meal. Novices with Japanese food. Thanks to Daniel, our waiter for his patience and explanation of what each dish was. The food was excellent and by far the best in the hotel. Daniel’s service couldn’t have been any better. Will definitely book again before going home. Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Ji Hoon S
reviews.title: Nice hotel, great service
reviews.text: The hotel was nice and service throughout was very good. In particular, the servers at Malva (Arturo, Ramiro, Edier, and Alberto) provided excellent service and were very friendly with us. The pool was kept very clean and at the perfect temperature. We had an extremely relaxing time.

reviews.author: Spat3873737383
reviews.title: Great Looking Resort, Rooms Need Help
reviews.text: Great main area with the natural look but the rooms and services via operator need a lot of help to become modern. The staff at the pools and restaurants were fantastic but the maids were not. Not a very toddler friendly resort even though it is advertised to be kid friendly.

reviews.author: Sue F
reviews.title: Beautiful AI resort
reviews.text:
We’d like to acknowledge the great work done by the following staff: 
1) Check-in at Pyramid 1 (Club Melia): Arturo & Ulises were wonderful & efficient & kind. They handled any issues we had with grace & professionalism. 

2) AguaMarina restaurant: Francisco was terrific & explained all menu items & worked with our diets. His helpers Armando, Cristel & Jesus (over the week) also were very good. Food was tasty, more seafood than fish selections. 
3) Malva Buffet: Guillermo Española (Maître D) was superb & super- friendly & knows how to run a restaurant. His employees all were wonderful especially: Martin Ku (great waiter & fun personality & very efficient), David Gentreras (great waiter), Rodrigo Gorocka (also marvelous waiter), Arnulfo (also marvelous waiter), Orlando (great & friendly waiter) & helper Rafael; also Francisco & Arturo & Andy & Janette & Alberto were also helpful & efficient. Food was amazing & hot & plentiful & beautifully presented. Baked goods were terrific, as were all the salads. Lots of vegan etc options. 
4) La Capella: Omar (waiter) did a great job handling a lot of tables. Food was gourmet Italian but we were able to get some basic menu items too which was good. 
5) Lemonfish: Ernesto (waiter) was very good & let us know spicy vs non-spicy dishes. Again, a lot of sushi & gourmet seafood, but short-ribs & some fish offerings were very good. 
6) Lunchbox: Nataniel (waiter) was very good. Gourmet burgers & food, but some basic dishes were available like brisket & chicken. 
7) Espresso bar: all servers there were great, & coffee & pastry selections were plentiful. Nice fancy espresso machines. Alcoholic coffee also available. 
8) Dancers/ entertainment at Ginger Bar: the 4 professional dancers (2 male, 2 female) were astonishingly good & talented & a joy to watch. They performed ballet, aerial acrobatics, traditional folk dances, lasso tricks, many kinds of dance, & even got the audience up to dance almost nightly too. A lot of fun & energy. The “Jersey Boys” singers were also terrific, as were the guest traditional Mexican dance troupe & lead singer & lasso performer- all breathtaking. The Dominican night band was also entertaining & fun. 
9) The beach bar waitstaff did a nice job running between the beach loungers & up the stairs to the bar to keep our drinks filled or food ordered. 
If eating at the beach, watch the seagulls so they don’t steal the food! And the pelicans were a joy to watch day after day, as were the parasailing balloons. 
10) Our concierge Agustin helped us find our way around on our 1st day too. 

The partial kitchen in our room was very handy with the filled beverage fridge. Housekeeping did a nice job too. The room had some water dripping from the upper air conditioning unit so we just put a towel on the tile floor to absorb it. Had some hot water shower issues which we reported & hopefully are fixed by now! 

The resort is gorgeous & we had no need to leave it at all during our stay. The swimming pools were beautiful & plenty of pool & beach loungers & towels available. The pizza cafe & burger bar & cold custard stand were also nice as we could stay outside all day & snacks were available, as well as the swim-up bar. 
DJ at main pool was entertaining. 

All in all, a wonderful vacation. And we also were very heavy tippers, which helped our experience a lot. Employees do respond well to great tips! And it’s worth it.

reviews.author: FC
reviews.title: Resort Is a Letdown Since It Didn't Live Up to Our Expectations.
reviews.text:
We stayed at Paradisus Cancun for seven nights from January 30, 2023. This was our 5th trip to Cancun but first to Paradisus Cancun. I have conflicted views about this resort because it has several redeeming qualities but also a lot of flaws. Two of us were vegan.

Pros:

Communication:
The staff (Cristian Morales) is prompt in communicating via WhatsApp which is a great method of contacting guest services.

Check-In:
Once you enter the main lobby you will be greeted by an impressive atrium-style lobby and bar. The sheer size of pyramid 3 will hit you once you see the main atrium. There is lovely vegetation draped from the ceilings and it gives off some lovely tropical vibes, however, if you prefer open concept and airy environment, then this is not the resort for you.

Restaurants:
Given the scale of the resort, you would think the Paradisus would have a vast food selection, and it does, with 5 ala carte restaurants. The food was quite good for an all-inclusive, however, you could taste and feel the mass-produced part of their culinary offering at times. They should also offer a variety of more vegan-friendly alternatives. There are no vegan desserts here; every dessert contains eggs and cow milk.
Malva buffet restaurant (is small compared to other resorts) offers a respectable small selection; however, it is consistent day in and day out. There is no vegan cheese available for vegans; imagine a pizza without cheese.

Staff:
There was an exceptional staff member in guest services, Cristian Morales! This young man deserves a promotion! He went above and beyond to correct the wrongs we were experiencing.
We had the worst room experience, and after a two day battle with back and forth with check-in and guest services, one room had an excessive amount of AC and no water in the shower for two days. They have available rooms, but they won't upgrade you until you pay more $$$ for a better room. The bare minimum they should do before assigning a room is to ensure everything is in working order.
After the room saga was settled, Cristian arranged to have champagne and chocolate covered strawberry delivered to our rooms. This is one of the many things he did to salvage our experience (Cristian … Thank you so much, and we hope your mother is doing well. You won’t be forgotten.
Also, a special thanks to the following members of staff who went above and beyond to improve our stay:
•	Chef of Capella restaurant, Arturo – He personally came to greet us and made sure we had the chance to sample some of his vegan dishes. Although vegan cheese would be ideal to have on a pizza.
•	Manager of Capella restaurant, Carlos Chay – In addition to introducing Chef Arturo, he went above and above to ensure that our requirements were satisfied.
•	Manager of Lunch Box restaurant, Rafael – Rafael is beyond amazing and great; he deserves a promotion or some sort of acknowledgment. During our dinner at Lunch Box, he brought a cake as a simple gesture of gratitude.
•	Chef of Lunch Box restaurant, Christopher – Rafael introduced Chef Christopher who made dishes that were not on the menu. Chef Christopher – thank you for making the delicious vegan dishes for our group.
•	Manager and Chef of Aqua Marina – Thank you for accommodating our vegan dietary and making us a delicious vegan shawarma.
•	Barista of Nepresso, Edier – He went above and beyond to prepare lattes every evening and Edier is extremely humble and polite. He should be acknowledged by Paradissus.
•	Staff of Guest Services, Rommel Cruz – It was a pleasure to see how he was always willing to help and was very knowledgeable about the resort and gave us tips and tricks of travelling outside the resort. He is a true professional.

Cons
Hotel:
The hotel requires a MAJOR INDOOR construction or renovation; the entire pyramids 3 and 4 are falling apart. The railings in the corridor on the seventh level are disintegrating. I unintentionally walked in a pool of water in the corridor of Pyramid 4 due to the passageway had constant leakage from overnight rain.

Rooms:
Our junior suite rooms which overlooked the lagoon, were seriously outdated like from the 80’s and in need of major renovation. Our rooms (4410 and 3629) had unclean mirrors, peeling bathtubs, faulty air conditioning, counter edges that were falling off, water dripping from our balcony and into our suite and no hot water for two days. Prior to leaving for the beach, we contacted the front desk, sadly no one arrived to mend repairs until the next day. The decor was all over the place and didn’t flow together. It looked like it was designed for a 4-year-old with cheap Ikea furniture.

Staff:
The first individual I had an issue with works at Nepresso, he wears glasses and retainers, and is the worst employee they could have, extremely rude. One evening after dinner, I went and requested for a soymilk latte, but this person lied and said they don’t’ carry soymilk. When I asked him how it was possible that you no longer carry soymilk after our group had it for the past four days, he responded saying he would go get some from the restaurant.
The second individual is Stephanie at Guest Services who thinks she knows everything and lied about our inquiry. When we inquired about playing tennis, she informed us that the tennis courts would be closed for two days due to ongoing maintenance work, and there would be a fee after 6 p.m.
No work was being done, according to our inspection. We are shocked to see her handing out tennis balls to six Spanish-speaking guest and they were heading to the court to play the same evening. Once more, Cristian Morales stepped in to take care of the situation, he informed us that no work is being done on the court, as he resolved the issue.

Charges:
Although this resort is advertised as all inclusive, there are a TONS of extra hidden fees from resort costs, cabanas, drinks, dining establishments, room service, etc. We anticipated that there would be extra fees for deluxe amenities, however, we have never seen so many fees for what we view as “standard”; at other all-inclusive resorts, especially in comparison to our previous visits to the Bahia Principe Luxury, Royalton Hotels, Sandos, Riu Group of Hotels, Karisma Hotels & Resorts which is genuinely a 4.5-star hotel.

Fresh Juice:
We got fresh juices with our choice of vegetables and fruits the first two days at breakfast. The staff member informed the guests at breakfast on the third day that no fresh juice will be made since Ginger Bar and Malva Restaurant share the same blender. Until the manager informed us that they do share machines with other restaurants, we were laughing and thought it was a joke and in realty it was the truth. And because they use a blender rather than a juicer, the juice is very pulpy.

Overall, we had a great time here. We made an effort to ignore the drawbacks and focus only on the fantastic setting and exceptional service, however we will not be returning to this hotel. Rooms 3629 and 4410

reviews.author: Mary Jo B
reviews.title: Poor customer service. Great staff
reviews.text:
We want to express our disappointment with the manner in which our room flooding experience was handled.

On Friday, February 3, 2023, we woke up to flooding in our room, number 3347. The water covered a large area from the sliding glass door,soaking the rug, and reaching to the side of the bed. I got out of bed and my feet were in water. The water also came under the sofa.

We called for maintenance to come to the room. They did come quickly.  We left the room, and stayed out until about 3 pm.

When we returned to the room, it was again flooded with the same amount of water. This time, we went to the "front desk" at the "check" in area. Maintenance again mopped up the water. 

We left the room for about 2 hours, and came back to a flooded room. Again, we went to the "front desk" and reported the problem.

We were really inconvenienced, not having full and safe access to our room.
When we talked with Customer Service, Rosanna Zannino, she challenged that we had any issues with the room. While we understand Melia may have guests that are "difficult", we are good and respectful guests, having stayed at Melia properties for many years.We did ask for some credit for 1 night of charges.

We would have expected more respect from "Customer Service". It was a very unpleasant experience ending our vacation. We may not stay with Melia in the future. This review will also be posted in Trip Advisor

reviews.author: Nancy P
reviews.title: Had a wonderful time!
reviews.text: Just returned from a wonderful time at Paradisus Cancun.  Resort was beautiful and we loved our ocean view room.  We stayed in Pyramid three as part of the Reserve Program and the spot was perfect.  Close to all the restaurants, pools and the beach.  Can get a little loud in Pyramid three as this is where you will find the entertainment in the evenings but by 9:30 -10 pm it’s fine and we had no issues sleeping after fun filled days by the pool.  Service was wonderful especially Cesar at the reserve pool, Wendy at the sports bar, and the hilarious Manny at the Lunch Box.  Our concierge George was the absolute best!  Always checking in on us to make sure we had everything we may need and help us with reservations and give us advice on excursions.  Alberto at check in was also very helpful with some changes we requested and did his very best to accommodate us.  Overall at great time and a lovely place to stay.

reviews.author: Michelle T
reviews.title: Great Staff
reviews.text: While at the resort I can’t say enough how great Acel and Galdi were. Acel was very entertaining and helpful and Galdi was great and assisted with reservations and anything we needed. Great staff!!!!!

reviews.author: Jordi28
reviews.title: Rafael from lemon fish was superb
reviews.text: Excellent sushi, and the chefs special dessert was the stuff of dreams. Rafael is an amazing waiter also! He knew everything about the food and was passionate about it too. This is the 3rd time I’ve eaten here in the last 7 days

reviews.author: Bruno Š
reviews.title: Review
reviews.text: We were in food bazar Nespresso in the hotel Paradisus. The food bazar Nespresso was near to the restaurant Malva. Our waiter in Nespresso was Alejandro. He was nice, friendly and perfect. Thanks for these types of people!

reviews.author: Rockgirlca1
reviews.title: Alejandro -Baristta
reviews.text:
Alejandro the best , pleasant happy to serve us latte’s , expresso’s each morning . Always greeted you with a smile . Very efficient in managing the barista bar !

We love him he makes us laugh, and that is a great thing in first thing in the morning

reviews.author: Britney
reviews.title: Amazing service, pools, and food - totally recommend
reviews.text:
We're a couple in our early 30s from Canada who went to Paradisus Cancun for 6 days in Feb 2023. We had an amazing experience and would absolutely recommend this resort. Given it's an all-inclusive, I didn't have high expectations for the food but it was AMAZING. The Japanese restaurant, Lemon Fish, had incredible sushi, ceviche and tuna tacos. I did not expect to have such great sushi in Mexico. Huge selection at the breakfast buffet every morning. The only restaurant I wouldn't recommend is Italian - I'm not picky at all about pizza, but it was terrible (though our appetizers were good!) 

We stayed at The Reserve, which ended up being $700CAD more for 2 of us over 6 days, and it was absolutely worth it. Exclusive bar and buffet (cheese, meats, etc. all afternoon), one included meal at Sal (amazing steakhouse), and adults-only pool where we spent all our time. With The Reserve you also have two days of cabanas booked in advance, but on the days you aren't booked for one you just ask at 11am if there are any no-shows (there always were) and take whatever is available. 

Drinks were great (and abundant) and service/staff were fantastic. Our room was massive with a full bathtub and living room, which we weren't expecting at all. We also returned to our room to find a bottle of sparkling wine had been left for us, which was such a nice touch! 

We golfed, which we only recommend if you're not a serious golfer and are just looking for a light, fun activity. It was an easy, short 9-hole course and the grass wasn't well-kept. We rented clubs and they didn't have full sets, so we didn't have proper clubs. We still had a ton of fun and it was beautiful, but temper your expectations before you golf and skip it if you take the sport seriously. 

My biggest complaint is that the fitness centre and spa were below what I expected. I didn't end up using the spa, just checked out the hydrotherapy, and it was very small and not as nice as I thought it would be. Admittedly it was a rainy day so it was busier than it would normally be, so it may be nicer when it's quiet. The fitness centre was very dated and below ground, so no windows - sufficient for a quick workout but not a place you want to spend much time (which you shouldn't be on vacation anyway!!!)

Despite these small criticisms, I still recommend the resort and would definitely go back! Food, drink, service, pools, beach and rooms were all fantastic and that's what is most important. Also if you're considering the Reserve and aren't sure - BOOK IT. Absolutely worth it.

reviews.author: The Audacious Traveler
reviews.title: Paradise in a Resort!
reviews.text: Traveled to Cancun for 4 days and 3 nights. (Sun-Wed)  It was myself and my best friend.  I looked profusely for the perfect hotel for my 46th birthday.  After reading reviews on TripAdvisor, I narrowed it down to about 5 and then prayed and chose the Paradisus. Let me say that it was the best choice!  They treated us like celebrities from start to finish.  Their staff was friendly and accommodating, and our concierge, George was amazing!  We did not leave the resort!  We were going to go to Tulum but it rained that day so we just enjoyed the resort and all of its amenities.  Although we stayed in the junior nikte suite, we were able to partake in activities at the Reserve, the all-adult side.  Every bit of this resort was thought out perfectly.   The variety of restaurants exceeded my expectations.  It's all-inclusive so we made our way to most of the restaurants.  The food was 3.5/5...however, nothing a little salt and pepper couldn't help. Many prior reviews raved about Lemon Fish but I thought it was ok...great ambiance though. The Agua Marina Restaurant was amazing!  They even had some entertainers to come out and dance one night.  I mentioned my birthday when we first arrived and by the end of the meal, they were bringing out a brownie topped with sparklers and singing happy birthday.  My trip was amazing! No complaints! Overall 5/5

reviews.author: Trish
reviews.title: Fantastic customer service
reviews.text: 13 friends and I went to Paradisus Cancun in early February 2023.  Despite not so nice weather (it rained 3 of 4 days), our service at the resort helped to make our stay fun and memorable. One notable person was Wendy. She went out of her way to make us special drinks, to help with hangovers and to be friendly. We also had a great time each night at the "swing" bar. I would recommend this resort, expecially the Reserve side. The extra service and amenities were worth it.

reviews.author: Rick P
reviews.title: Great week getaway for couples.
reviews.text: We had a wonderful 8 day vacation. The food was awesome and the staff were excellent. Nicole and Jennifer at the Reserve pool were fantastic. Our Concierge, Galdino was very helpful. The facilities were great and the beach was amazing. The Bali beds were a great feature by the pools and on the  beach. All restaurants were fantastic and not one bad meal in 8 days. Evening entertainment was fun. The golf was good but could use work on the greens and tee boxes. Lots of fun for a Par 3 course.  I would highly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: debrabaybehh
reviews.title: Amazing Service. Wonderful staff
reviews.text: The staff was incredible. Every single person was accommodating and friendly. Made us feel very welcome. Like celebrities. Our concierge, Andres, was phenomenal!! Would absolutely recommend. We had an amazing time. The food variety was great to experience. Lots of places to dine while there. We enjoyed our time. Definitely one to remember

reviews.author: Ainatay2aina
reviews.title: Roach infestation
reviews.text: 1st night… I had a roach crawl up my leg in our bathroom. Next morning… woke up to 8 roaches in our room. They were in our bed, closet, dresser, and floor. They moved us to a 2nd room that had roaches as well. We open the refrigerator and found one crawling along the side. Moved us a 3rd time. This time there were no roaches inside the room but were outside on our balcony wall. The whole situation was poorly handled. I was promised a refund which I never received and as of today they still did not send me proof that they are going to refund me. Jan 30th to Feb 1st. Room 5419, 5009, and 4206. Beautiful resort but infested with roaches. I will NEVER come back.

reviews.author: Amalia
reviews.title: Most enjoyable and relaxing vacation!
reviews.text: I loved the ocean view along with the pool side view from our newly renovated bright room.  The bedding was heavenly as was the cleanliness.  Guest services made our stay better than expected.  Rosanna made sure all our meals for dinner were set and she took care of all our needs.  I loved that we could enjoy our meals with ocean view.  All the staff were friendly and eager to make our stay enjoyable.  The sushi restaurant, Lemon Fish was my favourite place for dinner.  I’m looking forward to coming back with my family as soon as possible.  Thank you to everyone at Paradisus Cancun!🥰

reviews.author: Bingitt
reviews.title: Excellent atmosphere and superb service!
reviews.text: Everything about this place is fabulous! The rooms are comfortable, the pools are great, the food selection is wide, the overall feel and vibe is great and the happiness is contagious! There are programs and entertainment every night. They have in house companies to provide you with tours, rides, there’s a great spa, there’s stuff for kids and adults. Everything you can think of! And the staff! The staff goes above and beyond to make the stay perfect! A special shout out to Martin Ku and David Contreras at the Malva International Food Bazar- thanks for the great service and the excellent drinks! You guys are the definition of happy, helpful and perfect service!

reviews.author: Sherpa23193738876
reviews.title: Hotel with Inefficient management
reviews.text: Terrible hotel with inefficient management. So many bosses starring at their computer terminal with out being accountable for anything. We (9 of us) booked 4 rooms paid extra money for their Reserva category with benefits for premium drinks and restaurant. Everything in the hotel, drinks and food even with that category shows up as extra. Once they run out of drinks they do not even replace it. The quality and choices of food was limited and not that great. Poor maintenance, floors with puddles of water, roof in the corridors leaking. My daughter fell hit her head and injured her knee and finger. No compensation from the hotel. She wasted all her vacation in pain. I have stayed in a lot of Meliá hotels. This is by far is the worst one. I will not recommend this hotel to anyone.

reviews.author: Martin M
reviews.title: Do not stay here.
reviews.text:
Not even close to other properties in Cancun at this price point.
The upgrade to the Reserve is basically an upgrade to a normal room just about anywhere in Cancun.
Please note this is my 20th visit. 
Other recent properties were 
Secrets Cancun
Hyatt Ziva Cancun
RIU multiple
Gran Caribe Real
Princess resorts etc 
The food and service is average.
Entertainment at this resort is basically non existent.
No animation staff
No music 
Activities non existent 
Water sports non existent 
Service at restaurants/ buffet average at best
No pride in what they do here 
Unwelcoming atmosphere
Do yourself a favour 
Save your money look for anything but.
The upgrade is $100 USD per night - this basically gets you a normal room that’s semi recently renovated - again this is likely 90% of resorts in Cancun
No bath / jacuzzi in the room 
Just standard shower etc 
2 cabana days per week are included with your upgrade .
A concierge that books your restaurant - you can do this yourself.
Mexican restaurant- uninspiring 
Fish restaurant- same 
Buffet average - a grilling station that is never on etc ..
This is basically a hotel with a room and average restaurants at best . It ends there.  The interior is unique and beautiful- but so are the others.
Room 5403 
Presently still here

reviews.author: Sara
reviews.title: Too spread out & needs updating but great location
reviews.text:
We had our 2nd annual sisters trip here in Feb 2023. There were 4 of us. 
I do not like the reserve check in process. You leave your luggage at the main lobby door and walk 2 buildings away for reserve check in where they do not immediately serve you a drink! No champagne!! Why?!? We had to wait for our bags to be sent to reserve desk so we cud change! We had already explained to bellman we needed our bags with us, but they wasted our time anyways and took them from us! The reserve desk staff did not follow thru when we asked to have the water checked in one of our rooms-it was cold showers for TWO days!  Our saving grace was Galdino our butler! He was amazing, anything we needed he made it happen to the best of his abilities!! He made sure our sisters birthday was celebrated at the pool!! 
Pool staff & waiters are amazing! Shout out to Cesar, Moises, Joel & Jennifer and many more! 
The activities staff was great too! 
Gym needs a larger space, better equipment, water bottles & air circulation.

reviews.author: Explorer35341427839
reviews.title: Cappello amazing Italian food and setup
reviews.text: Amazing resort and services.  We found a bit limited options on menu for food in all inclusive restaurants as we are vegetarian.  However,  the chefs made customized dishes . The Italian restaurant Cappella has delicious food to offer. Both, the host Gerardo and the chef Arturo were great.

reviews.author: Ashalzzz
reviews.title: Lemon Fish 🙌🏾
reviews.text: Our waiter Jorge was amazing at Lemon Fish!! He was very attentive, informative, and overall the best. His service was fantastic! He explained everything on the menu and made sure our table was well taken care of. The food was great, the ambiance was very beautiful, and the service was top tier.

reviews.author: Moez J
reviews.title: Fantastic food, amazing experience.
reviews.text: Rafael at lemon fish was fantastic! Can’t wait to come back! We loved every minute of our experience at lemon fish. Rafael brought us new dishes and desserts, many of which we haven’t even tried before

reviews.author: Razeena T
reviews.title: Rafael from Lemon Fish
reviews.text: He was amazing and he even gave us a cake for our birthday that we were celebrating. Great service and amazing recommendations for food. Would definitely come here again for our trip in Cancun. Amazing.

reviews.author: Roohi H
reviews.title: Rafael from Lemonfish
reviews.text: Rafael was AMAZING! The food was also amazing. We tried almost everything - and everything was a hit! I was really amazed with the service and the ambiance. Highly recommend to eat here and make sure to make reservations

reviews.author: SATrvler
reviews.title: Rafael from Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Excellent meal and service at Lemon Fish Asian restaurant.  Rafael provided wonderful service!  Location is also ver beatiful!  Nice stream runs through restaurant.  Sake not extra!  Sushi was also excellent.  Everthing was well presented.

reviews.author: ducman24
reviews.title: Second visit again with excellent service
reviews.text: This is our second visit here we were here last year and it is a very nice resort. Beautiful Beach area and a wonderful pool. we are just getting settled in now, but want to make a particular compliment to the two gentlemen that checked us in. Apparently there was difficulty with our reservation.  Both Orlando and most importantly Ulysses the night manager went above and beyond to smooth our reservation process. Ulysses, the night manager. Worked so hard to find us the right room repeatedly going up and checking rooms for us to make sure that we would  be happy with our room. His professionalism and dedication to making our room satisfactory was a pleasure to see. Thank you so much Ulysses and Orlando both of you for handling our situation so we did not have come down the following day to straighten out the issue. I can't say enough about these two. It would have been very easy to give us a room and let us go. Ulysses said it was important for us to be happy with our room. as for the resort it is an absolute joy. And she will do it for the review at the end of our stay but just wanted to take a moment to compliment the two gentlemen who went above and beyond

reviews.author: Deborah O
reviews.title: Second great  experience in Paradise!
reviews.text: We are back! We came here exactly this time last year in 2022 and here we are again! My boyfriend took me on this lovely vacation for a week this time, last year we were here for two weeks. It’s a lovely resort we do the all inclusive and they have fantastic restaurants. Make sure you make reservations on the first floor with the concierge to make sure you get seated each night, especially love lemon grass this sushi restaurant! The check in was fantastic and we had two people help us that were extraordinary! Ulysses helped us find exactly the room we wanted with the ocean view on the fourth floor with the spectacular view. He made the check in effortless and was very professional and accommodating. The other person that helped us was Orlando who was also very helpful. Kudos to both of them and we will definitely be back again! I highly recommend the resort, and if you do come make sure you visit all the restaurants from the sushi to Italian to Mexican to buffet.

reviews.author: ddswong
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: This was our 13th stay here and we absolutely love it. The service is great, the food is fantastic and we find every vacation at the Paradisus Cancun better than the previous one. We hope to return here again with more family members .

reviews.author: Prerana P
reviews.title: In real sense a Paradise at Paradisus
reviews.text:
We had a great stay at Paradisus! Best part was the service, at the  restaurants or kids club it was beyond amazing. I’ll like to mention Atilano, ignacionand Janeth specially who took really good care of us. 

Rooms are spacious, all inclusive part was the best ! Pur concierge Jennifer helped us arranging reservations and trips as well !!

Its location is breathtaking! And the pools are never crowded!! 

We absolutely loved it and would come back again !!

reviews.author: Verobarreraramirez
reviews.title: Comments for families
reviews.text: We have been several times in this hotel and now that our kids are 2 and 4 YO, we have used the kidsdome (activities for the kiddos) daily and they are super fun. Thanks for the support with the kids, they are happy and enjoying the vacations even more!

reviews.author: John
reviews.title: Lemonfish  …. great meal and experience.
reviews.text: Best sushi by far, excellent service and great modern vibes.  Rafael and Alejandro are amazing waiters.  They went over and above to make our experience an unforgettable one. They suggested an assortment of sushi for us to try and every bite was beyond delicious.  Thank you so much.

reviews.author: Eglover68
reviews.title: Won't be back.....
reviews.text: While this resort has amazing room views & some nice amenities (spa, multiple restaurant choices, etc) the hotel seems to be struggling with maintenance issues and an overall lack of staff training and consistency in service. I arrived with a large group of 6 well-travelled couples who are very familiar with all-inclusive resorts. For most places, this would've been an excellent opportunity to go out on a limb and wow us with service...not at Paradisus. Our size made it very difficult to obtain dinner reservations....even though most of the restaurants were almost empty when we managed to book. Concierge was virtually non-existent. Spa scheduling was limited to only 2 at a time. No turn down service even though the porter told us housekeeping would come by twice a day. A few of us (including me) experienced flooding in our rooms from mysterious causes to which the solution was to move out of the room - no bonus consolation offered.
