I also had a power outtage on one side of my room which I didn't pay too much attention to, but later reported. There was leaking from the rafters outside of our room as well which caused a safety hazard (my husband almost slipped multiple times). Our best foodie experience overall was at Lemon Fish. Capella's was nice, but service was average as the waiter seemed somewhat annoyed the whole time we were there. I personally was very irritated by the hard-sell tactics of resort management who invaded our pool time several times to upsell Melia. I understand they work on commission, but the insistence in having me attend a 1 hour sales session even after I expressed my displeasure was ridiculous. Improve your product before you try to sell me on it. I think this place had once been marvelous, but a lack of attention is certainly creeping it's way in. Needless to say, we won't be back.

reviews.author: LH
reviews.title: Good stay and great buffet!
reviews.text:
We enjoyed our time at this hotel, except that they couldn't give us connecting rooms as requested months in advance. My parents had to stay in a different tower and logistically that was hard, since there is a lot of walking among the buildings.

Our concierge Ruth was great, very helpful and efficient. Only thing is we didn't like that she and her boss found us one afternoon on the beach to try to convince us for about an hour to attend a 45min talk about Melia resorts. We felt that they invaded our space and vacation.

There were plenty of food options, but to be honest, none great quality, and in some, we payed additional for a specialty item that was ok. We did enjoy Malva buffet, and the waiters, especially in the morning were really attentive. We particularly recommend Orlando, he was very service oriented and always welcomed us with a small and fast, efficient service. Wonderful guy!

We had the Reserve, and honestly it felt unfair that even oceanside beds were at an extra cost, $250 (Dec 2022).

Overall a good stay, but probably next time we won't do an all-inclusive and will choose a different place.

reviews.author: Kevin L
reviews.title: Lemon Fish Rafael
reviews.text: Lemon Fish restaurant is a must have when you stay at Paradisus Cancún Resort. Food is very good, nice ambience and we got an excellent service from Rafael, he went out of his way to provide us a dish which is not on the menu. I would come back for Tuna Taco.

reviews.author: Susan P
reviews.title: Great time in Cancun!
reviews.text: Spent a week at Pardisus Cancun via RCI exchange program.  Property is beautiful, well cared for, maintenance, landscaping and caretaking constantly occurring.  Room was clean and comfortable, enjoyed being in Pyramid two which was  a bit further away from all activity, late night DJ in Pyramid three.   Lots of restaurants choices, you need to make reservations unless you are going to buffet.  Concierge, Michelle  initially greeted us  and was great for approx 48 hours, after we turned down the time share seminar a couple times, no more concierge.  Ada and Gaby on beach service duty were phenomenal, have mind reading ability at when you are due for your next cocktail or a bite to eat.  Anna, Ohhhh Anna;  massage therapist in the spa! You MUST see her  for a Balinese massage, its life changing. I wish I could have brought her home with me.  Highly recommend the hydro therapy prior to the massage.  We enjoyed grabbing a cup of coffee every morning, watching the sunrise and enjoying a long walk on the beach every day and then spending the rest of the day in a lounge chair or playing in the waves. Only left the resort once for a cooking class.  We would definitely return, and I consider other Paradisus resort locations.

reviews.author: Jasdeep S
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text: Axcel and Maribel was amazing.  Very entertaining and we had lots of fun.  The resort overall is good.   Food is okay, the drink are good.  The service is good, they take care of you.  The view of the ocean and the beach is really good from the resort.

reviews.author: Kristen M
reviews.title: Great time at Paradisus!!
reviews.text: Maribel and Axcel were great for activities — really fun with painting the animals. Wendy was the best bartender, so friendly and accommodating at Ginger bar. Also Flora was my favorite waitress at the beach. She was super attentive and lovely

reviews.author: Mary Latham
reviews.title: Painting animals
reviews.text: Great experience with Axcel and Maribel painting! Wendy wonderful waitress at Ginger Bar!!! Very friendly people and great time at a very beautiful beach - would highly recommend a visit to this beautiful island. Flora also lovely at the beach!!

reviews.author: Kimberly S
reviews.title: Another wonderful stay at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Another perfect vacation at our favorite place to stay. Thank you to our favorite staff members who we can’t wait to see again- Raul at the entrance- Valeria, Luis, and Miguel in the Reserve. Another perfect vacation

reviews.author: priinv
reviews.title: great stay
reviews.text: very clean and friendly resort, excellant service. building is a bit oldin need of some work but never turned us off. resturants were above average and buffet has a large selection although at times food sew cooler then should be.

reviews.author: Taylor D
reviews.title: Cappella Restaurant
reviews.text:
Javier Jimenez’s customer service was extraordinary and sincere at Cappella restaurant at Paradisus Resort in Cancun. The manager Carlos Chays was
very personable and his staff was extremely courteous which led to an amazing experience. The food was one of the best we have ever had. I would recommend these two at Paradisus Cancun to anyone contemplating visiting this resort!

reviews.author: MFPUB
reviews.title: Service in pool
reviews.text: The trip was amazing because of yesenia sitting here always on point over the top service wonderful fast and very accommodating There was no one better than her and willing to come back keep the service up

reviews.author: Magnolia Barney
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
Our Butler Aaron Ruiz, was excellent. He took care of us and went above and beyond to provide excellent service to us during our stay @ Paradisus in Cancun. He listen attentively to our needs and delivers all requests on time. 
Thank you Aaron for everything you did for us!

reviews.author: Karen G
reviews.title: Malva Buffet
reviews.text: Our experience at this hotel has been one of the best ones We have had to date at an all inclusive. From the staff to the food and everything in-between. Our servers Samuel and Daniel were so attentive. We will be back here with the entire family next year. Thank you Paradisus and make sure you keep up the good work 👍🏻

reviews.author: Sarah H
reviews.title: Restaurant service
reviews.text:
Alfredo Miron, Eduardo, David, Alex are excellent service - very friendly and helpful.

Hopefully their hard work will be recognised and they can get to travel as they dream 😁👍🏻

Thank you for all your help and learning what a shandy is!!

reviews.author: Loriann H
reviews.title: Restaurant capella
reviews.text: We ate at Cappellas  several times. Food was amazing. Servers  Fernando cumplido, Luis Ayala and Carlos Chay the manager, were attentive and helpful guiding us to amazing dishes. Highly recommend this Paradisus Hotel and the restaurant

reviews.author: victor R
reviews.title: A+
reviews.text: Carlos gave us the best customer service. He was on top of making sure our food was delivered fast and hot. On top of that he always had a smile on his face. I would definitely return just because of the service he gave me and my wife. Way to go carlos!!!

reviews.author: Carol G
reviews.title: Wedding
reviews.text: Samuel Sosa was very attentive & professional. He took care of us always. Made sure we were satisfied with food & drinks. He went above & beyond for us! He made us feel welcomed to Cancun. A great asset to Paradisus Resort. Thank you again for your service Samuel Sosa.

reviews.author: Laurie C
reviews.title: Wonderful time!
reviews.text: Wonderful trip.  Alfredo, Orlando B and Orlando K and Atilano gave us impeccable service in the restaurant and it was a pleasure.  The pool staff at the Reserve was also wonderful, especially Julio.  Victor was our butler and he made all of our reservations and answered all questions.  The silent disco was a blast.  We had a wonderful time.

reviews.author: Mallory F
reviews.title: Awesome experience!
reviews.text: Jorge Ramos provided excellent service! He made sure to cater to all of our needs! We had gone fishing today and caught tuna that Chef Mario y Toño prepared for us. All of the food was amazing as well as our experience!

reviews.author: Orville B
reviews.title: Friendly Staff

He checked on us each day to see if there was anything we needed.  Nice variety of food and restaurants.   Loved having breakfast at Sante outside overlooking the ocean.

reviews.author: 662micaelc

reviews.text:
Atilano and hes crew of server gave a service as good as we receive back home would recommend!! Everybody is smiling and courteous, you are really taking care of!
You feel like your are important to everybody

reviews.author: Jessica R
reviews.title: Lemon Fish Restaurant
reviews.text: Cristian Sanchez fue tan amable con nostros! Lo mejor! 🙌🏻🍾👍🏻🎉 wonderful experience! Will come back again! Highly recommend the delicious food! Amazing service and great customer service! Thank you!

reviews.author: Touktam B
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text:
Axcel and Agustin were the perfect friendly instructor for aqua exercise 
Margarita and everyone in club Melia were friendly 
Room service and cleaning was amazing 
Desert menu was missing my favourite desert cream caramel

reviews.author: Rayan S
reviews.title: Axcel
reviews.text: Had a great trip with my family for 6 days. Lemon fish had the best meat in the resort and an amazing atmosphere. The ginger bar had great music on club nights and their bartenders knew how to make any drink you could ask for. One of the highlights of the trip was Axcel who was the activity coordinator who would set up volleyball and water polo games daily. He had an amazing welcoming personality and knows how to speak 6 different languages.

reviews.author: Torrie M
reviews.title: Fabulous Hotel
reviews.text: This hotel is absolutely fabulous!! We had a wonderful stay from start to finish. It is very clean and beautiful.  Before the trip, Daniel reached out via email to make sure that we had everything we needed. We had fresh chocolate-covered strawberries and champagne. He was truly OUSTANDING. When we arrived, Ruth was our concierge and made sure we had dinner reservations. She was responsive and helpful. All of the restaurant wait staff were spectacular and the food was delicious!! Give everyone a raise, we can't wait to come back!

reviews.author: Pipule71
reviews.title: Excellent service at Paradisus Cancún.
reviews.text:
This group of professionals made our daily visits to the buffet area a great experience. Fantastic service! They took great care of us!  Muchas gracias!

Atilano
Orlando
Alfredo
Armando

reviews.author: dave g
reviews.title: Another successful visit….
reviews.text:
Full disclosure…we are frequent visitors to all the Paradisus resorts.  This was our 4th time at the Cancun location.  8th time at a Paradisus resort. It once again lived up to my expectations.  Guest Service Manager Rosanna Zannino, and her team provided outstanding customer service.  The best part is that it was absolutely genuine and not done with hopes of a tip.  They were awesome.  
The resort is super clean, food really good, easy to get yo from airport.   
Although very nice, the non-Reserve areas, are closer to ordinary.  Still wonderful however The Reserve is quieter,  has a warmer pool plus offers more amenities.

reviews.author: Emily S
reviews.title: Vacation to Paradisus resort in Cancun
reviews.text:
Beautiful hotel, excellent service, staff is friendly and accommodating. We especially enjoyed the lounge and wait staff: Luz is wonderful! Fun, friendly and a hard worker! Giovanni, Karina and Salvador also were excellent staff!
The views of the ocean were beautiful. We reserved an ocean view room. I will note that it is the hotter side of the hotel, our air conditioner had a hard time keeping up so was usually at 74-75 in the room.
House keeping and room service were spot on, reliable and friendly.
The main buffet had a wide variety of fresh and very good food, the wait staff were also excellent.
There are other restaurants to reserve and try in the evening, they were also good.

reviews.author: AnnaMaria
reviews.title: Amazing trip for a family of 7- RESERVE 5 STAR service, TY Aaron!
reviews.text: Just returned from an amazing trip, we couldn't have asked for a better location, weather and staff.  All around amazing service but our concierge, Aaron, made this trip remarkable!  He was knowledgeable, polite, professional and on point.  Reservations for dinner were taken care of every night, arranged  car service, our spa appointments, daily pool side/ beach front lounge bed reservations and was available 24/7.  He even contacted us on his day off and made changes to accommodate sudden change in our schedule.  Check out was a breeze and transport to and from airport was taken care before we even asked! This level of service made us feel at ease and incredibly relaxed!  Highly recommend this hotel, it was all around luxurious.  From an all inclusive aspect, kind attentive staff, SUPER CLEAN and beautiful rooms, beautiful beach, and every amenity available for a large family.  We felt safe to let our 5 kids wander (ages 11-19).  The pros at the pool side Aqua World kiosk arranged our excursions and were total gentlemen- Julio was a big hit with my kids and by the end of our trip we were sad to say goodbye!   From start to finish, our trip was a success- Thanks to a superior staff and beautiful hotel!  The RESRVE was definitely the way to go.  Aaron, you are first-rate,  Paradisus is lucky to have you!

reviews.author: Lee O
reviews.title: Jorge Ramos.   Miguel  Villegas
reviews.text: The food was delicious, but the service was impeccable. Highly qualified staff and knowledgeable. Welcoming and happy to assist in any way. We were able to clearly understand what menu options and understanding the menu.

reviews.author: Brittney W
reviews.title: Fabiola is the best!!! 5 STARS!
reviews.text: Fabiola is the BEST!! She was so nice and helped me leave a birthday surprise for a friend who was going to stay at the hotel a few days later!! Excellent customer service she went above and beyond!!!!!

reviews.author: Mike W
reviews.title: Truly paradise
reviews.text: Have spent a week here and wow what an amazing place with amazing staff. Pascual, Fernando,Antonio, and Orlando at malva are absolutely amazing taking care of guests from refilling drinks to getting items for you. Axel was awesome with the pool activities especially playing water polo with guests, there are so many more staff that are very attentive at lemon fish, lunch box, the swim up bar,And Enso that I could not possibly name them all.. thank you for a fantastic experience

reviews.author: Global670904
reviews.title: An amazing hotel with an amazing host
reviews.text: Amazing hotel with the best Host we got shoutout to Aaron ruiz, best host i have ever met. He was so happy to to work and help us get reservations, gave us a full tour of the hotel and made sure everything was perfect. Thank you so much Aaron! I couldn’t ask for a better host.

reviews.author: Marisa C
reviews.title: Amazing experience!
reviews.text: The Paradisus Cancun has been nothing but exceptional this trip! I’ll first start off by saying the service has been incredible. Our Butler tended to our needs and made all reservations so simple! The spa is amazing! My massage by Liliana Marquez was so phenomenal that I had to make another one with her again before we left! She tended to my request and made me feel so relaxed and so comfortable! My husband had Anna Angeles and he said she was also incredible! The food was delicious and there were enough restaurants to choose from that we didn’t have to eat one place twice! We will be returning as soon as possible!

reviews.author: Joan M
reviews.title: Returing to Paradisus is like going home!
reviews.text: I have been to Paradisus Cancun 6 times during the pandemic and never contracted covid.  They have good safety measures in place and all staff wear masks.  They have some new bars/restaurants.  One is the Lemon Fish (formerly Bana) and they have redone this whole area and it is very niceand the sushi is delicious!  Also Ginger Sports bar which is beautifully updated and has pool table, etc and usually a DJ or live music.  If you have never been to Paradisus you will love it.  Such a beautiful place and the staff is positively the most warm and welcoming people whose main focus is to make sure you have the best experience. Rooms are updated and very spacious. Beds are very comfortable.  I have been staying the Adult Reserve for the past several years and it is worth the experience.  Bali beds, butler service, private restaurant for lunch and dinner.  The staff is like family to me - Val, Moises, Carlos, Josue, Julio and the pool concierge, Max  just to name a few.  And the chef, Alex Simbron is the best!  Kanna beach bar is great and Victor will take very good care of you!  There is entertainment nightly in the Ginger Bar which is spacious and recently redecorated.  This hotel is a short 20 minutes from the airport.  You will not be disappointed!  Special thanks to Rosanna, guest services manager, and my wonderful butler, Aaron, for again making it a perfect visit!

reviews.author: John A
reviews.title: Awesome resort! We will be going back!
reviews.text:
We really enjoyed our stay. We have stayed at other resorts in Cancun and this one was by far the best. The resort is beautiful and well maintained. The rooms are clean and plenty spacious. However, the best part of this resort was the service! Every person working were super polite and they were eager to assist with anything we asked of them. There are too many restaurants to name here, but we found ALL of the food was excellent! 

We paid for the "Reserve" upgrade and it was well worth the money. The upgrade provides you access to an adults only pool and bar area, a concierge who will make all your dinner reservations, and access to all the premium liquor they have on site. 

The service at this resort was far better than any resort we have stayed out in Cancun. A special shout out to the following:

Aaron our concierge. He was available everyday to help with anything we asked of him.

Caesar and Oscar our servers in the pool area. These guys bust their butts bringing you food and drinks right to you. No need to get up to go to the bar for a drink or going somewhere to grab a snack. They bring it right to you. The guys were over-the top when it comes to excellent service!

Wendy our server in the Sports Bar. She is super nice, provided great service and she was very helpful providing information our local shopping areas in town.

Hints:
1) Bring small denomination bills for tips. Even though it is an all inclusive resort the servers work for tips and they deserve to compensated for their hard work (just my opinion).  There are 2 ATMS on site. The one that dispenses USD only had $50's and they charge you a lot for the transaction fee.

2) Down load and install Whatsapp prior to traveling. You can use it to make calls and send messages using the resort WiFi. It is also used for contacting your concierge.

3) Take plenty of sun tan lotion. If you run out they charge you $45 USD in the gift store.

4) If you prefer to drink out of a straw bring it with you. The hotel is Eco friendly and they don't offer straws with their drinks.

Again- can't tell you how much we enjoyed this place. We WILL be going back!

reviews.author: WAwineDoug
reviews.title: Jorge y Miguel excelente
reviews.text:
Jorge provided amazing service and chef Villegas really did a good job. I’ve had my share of all inclusive experiences and without upcharge we were quite pleased with everything we experienced. 

Thanks Jorge!

reviews.author: Leah A
reviews.title: Amazing experience!!!!!
reviews.text: We had an absolutely amazing experience. Food, hospitality, drinks, and evening was all amazing.  I hate that trip advisor makes me spend more characters, but Lemon Fish is incredible! Everything we could imagine

reviews.author: Zach A

Favorites were the mussels and the octopus salad and ALL the deserts. 

Definitely a place to he sure to eat during your stay at Paradisus.

reviews.author: Jacob D
reviews.title: Alejandro and Atilano gave the best service all week!
reviews.text: Amazing service from the staff at breakfast by Alejandro and atilano they gave us everything we needed and continuously checked on us and remembered our names. They went above and beyond. Super impressed by the staff at Paradisus. Definitely would recommend

reviews.author: Rachael R
reviews.title: Themelis
reviews.text: Flor by the pool was the best! She was always around to help us out and was attentive to help us whenere she can. She always had waters for us when we got to the pool each morning, and we love having her around

reviews.author: Jaime M
reviews.title: Do Not Stay - No A/C, Terrible Concierge, Food Poisoning
reviews.text:
We just returned a day early from our family vacation. I will say that a major reason we decided to return early was due to the terrible experience at this resort. I have screen shots of all of the messages between the hotel concierge and our family. It breaks my heart that we want to take our kids somewhere fun and warm and leave so disappointed.

1. The Melia App is terrible, you are unable to use many of the functions. The first being online checkin. We were not able to check in online and I was told from the front desk via email "this feature may not work and we cannot do anything about it, you will need to check in when you arrive". This is find, but our flight was getting in late and we wanted to make restaurant reservations and work with our concierge to ensure our arrival went smoothly. 

2. Check-in takes a long time. We checked in around 6:00pm and it took about 30 minutes. The part that took a long time was another employee would jump in and use the same computer as the gentlemen that was checking us in. Then finding a concierge to take us to our room took time. We had concierge service because we upgraded to the "Reserve" which included this service for approximately $150 USD more a day. 

3. We were assigned room 5212, do not stay in this room. The AC was not working. At first I thought it would take some time, so we set the thermostat at 70 degrees and left for dinner and a small tour of the resort. We arrived back a few hours later and the temperature had not changed. It was 74.5 degrees in our room and humid. I mentioned this to Janick, our concierge/butler and he said it should be working.

4. We did not have restaurant reservations, so we had dinner at the buffet. The food was ok. The wait staff at ALL of the dining areas are amazing and I hope their hard work is recognized.

5. We requested through our concierge distilled water for my husband's CPAP. The hotel responded like they had never had that request. I cannot imagine that no one has ever needed distilled water for a CPAP? I was told we could walk to the convenient store and see if they have any, but that is where the assistance stopped.

6. I then requested to change rooms or have the AC fixed, we could not get comfortable. Our concierge left for the evening and at 11:10pm a maintenance person came to look. This person spoke little English and I spoke little Spanish, so we had to use google translate. He stated he could not fix the issue and we would have to wait until the morning to get it fixed or be moved to a new room. We slept very little that first night, it was like sleeping in a humid jungle.

7. In the morning, I immediately sent a message to our concierge, and email to the website email address, and went down to the check in to explain we have to change rooms, this is not acceptable. Please be advise, we upgraded to the "Reserve Level" and did not find the value in this at all. After all of these contacts and following up from 7:30am to 2:00pm, we finally were given a new room. We were essentially without a room for most of the second day. The only room they were able to offer us was a King room with a roll away bed. We are a family of 4, so we now had to have one child on a roll away bed and the other on a couch. Again, unacceptable, but were were desperate for a room with working air conditioning. 

8. The service on the beach is hit or miss. We had no service one day and then great service one day. They also ran out of towels on one of the days, so we had no beach towels. I cannot even imagine being a beach resort and running out of towels half way through the day. Our concierge told us he was going to find towels and send them to us, we waited 4 hours and he never sent towels, we could not find him or get a hold of him that afternoon. Just MIA and gave us no other point of contact.

9. On Sunday, we went to a local church for mass. I knew we would need to check in at the main pool for our reserved Bali bed between 9-11am. I asked our concierge to inform the pool concierge that we will be there, but may be late due to mass and taking the bus. Our concierge, Janick, responded back that he informed the pool and to go as soon as possible. We arrived to checkin for our Bali Bed at 11:09am and were told they gave our spot away and there is nothing available for the day. The pool concierge tried to upsell us to Bali Bed for $220 USD per day since we no longer had a reservation. I showed them the message from our concierge and they said there is nothing they can do. When I let Janick know what happened, he again went MIA and never responded and never fixed the issue.

10. Just to top off our terrible experience, we ordered room service through Janick, our concierge, on our departure day so the kids could eat prior to flying out. Janick confirmed our order and said it would take 35-40 minutes. We waited an hour and followed up, Janick said he would check, but never responded back. 90 minutes later, still no room service, still no response from Janick after multiple messages. As you probably can conclude, we had to leave without eating before our departure. In hindsight maybe this was ok because my son started vomiting after we checked in to our flight. He had food poisoning from the meat on the lunch buffet. He was so sick during our flight, God bless the flight attendants on Sun Country he took care of us and helped as much as they could. We concluded that was the only thing he ate that no one else did. Thank you Paradisus Cancun for topping off taking our money for a terrible experience with food poisoning. I would not expect anything less at this point.

Any communication to get resolution for this issue was met with "I need to check and will get back to you", but then no one follows up. I also wrote a review during our trip and posted on TripAdvisor and was asked by the hotel guest experience manager to remove the post if we wanted to be compensated for our experience. I removed the post, but of course, no compensation was given. I believe they do this to all of the negative reviews and most people comply and delete their true reviews. I just hope that you, as a traveler, know there are many options in Cancun and I would highly encourage you to find a resort that you will not be disappointed and is responsive if there is an issue with your stay.

Positives:
The front line employees are friendly
The beach is as described and ocean is beautiful
The bracelets for room entry are a great idea because no one wants to carry around a room key
Cece at the Reserve reception desk is amazing

reviews.author: Joe N
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text:
The hotel was great and Fabiola answered every request and question. It was a pleasure having her around when needed. Always smiling, she loves her job and she does what it takes for a great service.
Thank you and I will definitely go back

reviews.author: Ashley B
reviews.title: Kanna Beach Club
reviews.text: Salvador and Karina have this great bar spot down. We came here probably 3-4 times during our stay and it was definitely a mainstay of our trip. Great people and great service coupled with amazing views. Thanks!

reviews.author: jmb55
reviews.title: WONDERFUL STAFF AND SERVICE AT PARADISUS CANCUN
reviews.text:
The only reason I rated the resort as VERY GOOD was due to the Covid-related restrictions that limited the evening entertainment.  There was always music but no shows, etc.

BUTLER:  We upgraded to The Reserve which assigns us a Butler & gives us access to The Reserve (adult only) pool.  Our Butler, Djordje, was phenomenal to say the least.  He made all our dinner reservations, reserved our pool beds/huts, promptly responded to all of our requests & found us daily to visit personally with us.  Great personality with great energy!

RESERVE POOL STAFF:
     Max, the Bali Bed attendant, was also amazing.  Always in a good mood & able to assist promptly. He ran his butt off to accommodate all the guests.  Loved him!
     The bartenders were attentive & pleasant.  Willing to take the time to help us decide what our next cocktail should be & serving it with kindness!
     The pool/Sante waiters ran their butts off and were still able to greet us with smiles & great service.  I can't remember all their names, but the few I do remember were Eddie, Moses & Jose.

THE BUFFET:
     Again, wonderful staff.  Attentive, kind and prompt.

RESTAURANTS:
     Enzo was our favorite.  We were greeted by Denise & our waiter was Darwin.  We ate there 3 evenings, indulging in the steak dinner-tender & tasty.  Twice we paid a little extra to add lobster tails-delicious for sure!!
     The Lunch Box was our next favorite.  Again, unfailing attention by all staff.  Sea bass was excellent.

CHECK IN / CHECK OUT
     No glitches & wonderful staff.

reviews.author: rizzor
reviews.title: Great place to stay everything is  nice
reviews.text:
Bottom line I plan on going back and bringing my kids and grand kids. We never left the hotel we stayed for 5 nights and it was great. Hotel was Covid friendly they were on top of masks and sanitizing. I was reminded once about not having a mask. 

Check In:
Had no issues took about 15 minutes. bags arrive in our room 10 minutes after we got there. Was assigned a concierge who took care of everything we needed throughout our stay. We used the whatsapp app which was nice was able to get things done without having to look for him. He took care of all my dinner reservation.

The staff:
Everyone was extremely friendly and helpful when you needed anything. The concierge we had was awesome he took care of us twice with a cabana at the pool overlooking the ocean and a (free) lobster lunch absolutely no complaints about the staff

The Room:
The room was clean and nice. The deco wouldn't have been my selection but had no effect on my stay. Was always clean when we returned. We had a junior suite with ocean view and it was spacious.

Hotel:
The hotel was spacious the atrium was really nice with live plants wide open. They had 3 pools (one was for adults at an additional charge didn't bother) The main pool was large with swim up bar and the other we used often  was heated. The lounge chairs around the pool some you couldn't adjust some you could. Both pools we used were great towels were plentiful. They also had coffee bar which we used everyday. The typical hotel store with everything

Restaurants:
The buffet was nice we ate mostly breakfast there however we did lunch and dinner. It was good, the choices we plentiful. We had dinner at Lemon Fish in the atrium area was really good. Capella Italian restaurant was also good. Taco place the portion were tiny however you could order more then one. Enso we ate lunch which was awesome, the dinner the food was good but again the portions were tiny.  I guess the mortal to the story is to order more than one meal which you can

Bars / Entertainment:
There was a sports bar and a bar overlooking the beach (I wanted to go to) we did not use either. With all the drinks we had in and around the pool why bother to go to the bar. We saw two shows they were ok for the price was right FREE

reviews.author: Martin
reviews.title: We have spent two weeks in Mexico - from Mexico City, Acapulco, Oaxaca, Merida, Palenque till Cancún …. Hotel Paradise 👍
reviews.text:
Nice and very kind service, especially in Malva restaurant - we had a nice and grat time, service of waiter Alfredo Mirón was excellent!. 
He was very attentive during our whole stay (4 nights).

Unfortunatelly … Hotel is VERY VERY noisy place, especiall during late night, when we wanna to go to sleep… Noosy music from Bars and restaurants, drunk guests … Not good …

reviews.author: Dayana F
reviews.title: Best vacation ever
reviews.text: I will definitely be coming back to this place! The service, experience, the views, everything was absolutely breathtaking and amazing! I love how welcoming the staff is. And especially love the fact, if you do not want to step out for a day In the resort, every night and day there’s a different activity to do and something new to try.

reviews.author: Manu C
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancún café
reviews.text:
Great service! All guys are amazing with a great service and good actitud. The food is good! Different types of food. The coffee is good 👍🏼 😎 
Gracias Edier Cab y Manuel Delezma por el servicio y su atención!

reviews.author: Reuben D
reviews.title: Love it here!
reviews.text: Amazing beach, food and Axcel was pretty cool with his cars tricks! We love coming here and can't wait to come back every year. Our kids love the activities and getting away from the cold a s snow on Minnesota makes it all worth it. Can't wait to come back next year.

reviews.author: John Y
reviews.title: Family vacation in Cancun
reviews.text:
The facilities are nice and the included restaurants are all ok. The best restaurant on the property is SAL (a steakhouse) but it is not included in your “all inclusive rate”. 
Many of the staff are excellent in that they try to make you feel at home and bring the drinks/food very quickly. In particular Diego (in charge of food and beverage), Melissa (Ginger Bar), Miguel (in the Reserve bar area), Yessina (in the beach area), Djordje, and Maximilliano (Reserve Pool area) are outstanding. If we go back it will be because of these hardworking, great attitude individuals.
Unfortunately the management of the hotel is lacking as their only motivation is to try and charge the guests as much as they can outside of what is “included”. Everywhere you go the staff are obligated to push items which are not included. Be careful as the extras can become very expensive.

reviews.author: AlexandAshtravels
reviews.title: Breath taking hotel !
reviews.text: I’m so happy that I chose this hotel. It was everything thing I imagined and more!! You feel like you are in a beautiful romantic jungle with all the amazing greenery and decor! It’s a huge property that gives you access to so much activity’s and amenities! You will not regret choosing this hotel for a fun exciting romantic getaway! I also want to give a huge shout out to the amazing staff and most of all Violeta who helped us she was amazing she really went above and beyond to make sure our stay was comfortable and easy thank you for your amazing hospitality you made our stay even better!!

reviews.author: R.Craft
reviews.title: Disappointed In Paradise
reviews.text: I have stayed at this resort several times, and had reservations for June 22, 2022 which I canceled.  My husband and I stayed in October 2021 and I was very disappointed.  The main reason I stay in the reserve section is for the private beach for adults only. After the hurricane the private beach was destroyed.  The beach available for the entire resort was over crowded.  To get a cabana so we could be out of the sun I had to wait in line around one and half hours every day to get the best selection.  No on wants to pay for a service that is advertised but they don't receive.  And speaking to management is non existent.  I should  been informed of the condition of the private beach (which is advertised as part of the reserve amenities)  After this experience I canceled my June trip.

reviews.author: Gerald H
reviews.title: Staff are very friendly and helpful
reviews.text:
All staff have been excellent during our five-week visit to Paridisus Cancun.  We have been coming here for several years and we plan to come back again in future years.

Special mention to Vanessa,who works in the gym/exercise room.  I exercise every morning and Vanessa always seems to be working hard to keep the equipment room clean and tidy. She always has a smile and a kind word when I see her.

On a few occasions, when I came by the reception desk while she was busy with the equipment, I did not get a bottle of water. Vanessa always made sure to bring me water while I was exercising.

My wife will be mentioning other staff members in other reviews.  

Thank you to everyone who has helped us to relax during our vacation at Paradisus Cancun..

reviews.author: Jon S
reviews.title: Yesenia Sergio on the beach
reviews.text: Yesenia was very responsive to our family needs with food & drinks constantly supplied. She remembered that I drink iced tea and kept me well supplied. Yesenia was so helpful the first day, we continued to get the beach umbrellas that she cover's for the rest of the time we were there. We tipped generously each day as she is worth the tip.

reviews.author: Timothy R Andrews
reviews.title: Thai Massage
reviews.text:
At first glance I winced at the price of the massage- but what I can tell you is that it was worth every penny and more!

Gemma was a delight and delivered one of the best Thai massages I have ever had.

It’s not often you encounter a masseur/masseuse who has such belief and passion in their trade but you could feel it through every pressure point, rub and stretch.

I always think that, unless you’re going for professional injury reasons, a massage should be a spiritual experience.

This was and I’ve booked again.

Recommend, recommend, recommend!

reviews.author: samantha s
reviews.title: Servicing
reviews.text: The service is amazing and the people are very kind, helpful, and attentive. Thank you to Yesenia and Sergio for helping my family and I by bringing us excellent service on the beach. They made our beach days much more enjoyable!!

reviews.author: Firdavs S
reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text: Great service and hospitality. Buffet people are very polite and kids friendly. Ricardo from hotel service was very helpful at all times. Room service did a great job with routine cleaning everyday. Everything cleaned and disinfected everyday.

reviews.author: Jose Armenta
reviews.title: Bad service, and they still owe me a refund.
reviews.text:
I visited Jan 16th  for a week with my family. Before we went on the trip one of the adults on our booking wasn’t able to make it due to covid. We asked for a refund and we have been getting the runaround ever since. The hotel was a ghost town when we went and even still the service was bad, our “consierge” took hours to reply. And on the day we arrived the hotel had no power. We arrived at 6pm and didn’t get into our room until 10pm due to the power issues. The front desk staff overall was very unfriendly, and not pleasant at all. I would go somewhere else. 
THE ROOMS ARE OLD AND DO NOT LOOK LIKE THE PHOTOS 

Also PLEASE GIVE ME MY REFUND THAT IM OWED

reviews.author: CesarC
reviews.title: Staying at The Reserve
reviews.text: Have stayed here a few times. It never disappoints. Staying at The Reserve this week. Service great, as usual. The hotel isn’t super packed, which is nice, and they’ve made some improvements to the property. Shout out to Antonio, at the Reception desk in Pyramid 5 in The Reserve — he has been Uber kind and very welcoming!

reviews.author: Noreen K
reviews.title: YHI Spa
reviews.text: Decided something different.  OMG Oriental Sensations with Gemma (sp of the name) she was simply brilliant.  so professional and I mean i felt amazing after.  I get a lot of massages but I have to say this experience i had to share.  the whole spa was simply amazing.  going again.

reviews.author: Navi D
reviews.title: Needs huge improvements
reviews.text: We came for a couple night stay and our shower was leaking all over the floor, the water was leaking from the room above us into our washroom, and our balcony door handle was broken on the outside.  Although my wife had stayed here previously, what we experienced on this trip definitely was not what she recalled from before.  In addition, we had called down to arrange pick up of room service dishes and towels; however, even after 4 hours this was not done.  Furthermore, when requesting our room bar drinks, even that wasn’t fulfilled.  Very disappointed as we have the hotel ample opportunity to correct this.

reviews.author: Lisset Munoz
reviews.title: Dinner at Lemon Fish
reviews.text:
Alejandro Camelo, our server for the evening, was exceptional and payed attention to detail. He provided us a very nice eating experience. I would highly recommend anyone to have him as a server. 

To add, the food was delicious!

reviews.author: Roy A
reviews.title: Amazing view and hospitality
reviews.text: The hotel was beautiful beyond words, filled with nature, the staffs were amazing. Guendoline Flores and Violeta were beyond amazing, very kind and very helpful. Always there’s when we needed them or had any questions. We definitely will be coming back to Paradisus Cancun

reviews.author: Lovejit S
reviews.title: Stayed for 6 days
reviews.text: I and my wife stayed here for 6 days and we didn't even feel the need to step out of the hotel they have so many activities going on all the time that you won't get bored. Their activities organizer Agustin is an incredible person who would locate us for the activities and encourage on participation. One favorite was the Arobics class where 2 trainers taught me how to climb rope and we did alot of stretching.  This is the hotel I am coming back as it seems to be the best

reviews.author: olaa311
reviews.title: had a great time
reviews.text: Janick was our butler. He was awesome, respond quickly to questions and our needs. We stayed in the reserved rooms which was nice. Room service was available and prompt for the most part. The resort is neat and clean

reviews.author: Armin D S
reviews.title: False advertising
reviews.text: This was a total rip off and a fraud. The listing is promoted as "all inclusive" but it's not. You will be asked to pay for a variety of basics when you have already paid a very premium price, including dinner bills, and subbed charges. False advertising and mis-selling by the hotel and the travel platform expedia.  Nowhere in the listing it was mentioned there will be exceptions or extra charges, nor was it communicated when we checked in even though we asked. Hotel manager tried to make ammends with a bottle of sparkling wine since we were there for my girlfriend's birthday - but we were still charged for a petty dinner bill. Will not go back again, and will never trust expedia or any hotel in Cancun with all inclusive promotion.

reviews.author: gilberto a
reviews.title: One of the best experience in hoteleria
reviews.text:
Recommend this hotel 100 % the  facilities  the staff the best , Engel our assigned concierge were excellent we did not have to worry about anything , the coffee guys alejandro Diaz and Edie Cab excellent baristas always with a smile  great guys , the tacos it was a great experience ,also the food at Capella we love it there , nice artist in the restaurants  ,  also the waitress in the central bar the dancing queen is  very nice 

Love this hotel , and can no wait to come back ,

Pool excellent , beach superb, the room and staff super great

reviews.author: PacmanSanDiego
reviews.title: Do Not Think Twice
reviews.text:
Literally blown away! We have a medical company and we came here for our 10 year anniversary. I was so nervous because usually the service, food options and alcohol quality can differ so much from resort to resort in Cancun. 

However Paradisus Cancun blew it out of the water for our company trip, I can’t think of a single complaint. If you are considering all-inclusive for a company trip or a family reunion, look no further. 

Also so many people I could shout out but our group host Nataly was amazing. I would hire her to work for our customer service department if I could. Nataly, thank you so much for making our trip, our company event and even the beach party. This hotel is lucky to have you.

reviews.author: Jim W
reviews.title: The Perfect Stay!!
reviews.text: This was the 3rd time we've stayed at this resort and we fell in love with this place while at a conference here in 2017. We returned in 2018 with our daughter, my son in law and our 3 year old granddaughter. This years stay was one of the best yet. One of the the many things we love about this resort is that it is located right on the water. You literally go from your room down to the restaurant level then out to the pools and donw

reviews.author: Yanett O
reviews.title: Very attentive and amazing atmosphere !
reviews.text:
I stayed here for 5 days and it was amazing !  The staff very attentive and very welcoming. The guys behind the bar at the pool were always friendly and would try to please us in every possible way. 

The animation team was great as well, they encourage people to do activities and aerobics at the pool ! I can’t remember the name of the person who was in charge of the animation but he was awesome and funny and charismatic! 

This hotel is a must go. The food is delicious, and the drinks as well. A BONUS: THE HOTEL HAS THE CUTEST CAT! I think it’s beyond amazing that the hotel allows this. The cat stole my heart! ❤️ 

One thing to know: They don’t have too many shows or activities at night in the hotel. So if you are looking for a night life, you would have to get out of the hotel.  

Some nights they have a DJ a for 2-3 hours early night, but you are not allowed to request music or listen to anything else but “merengue, salsa or bachatta” which was kind of a turn off because no one wants to listen to those three genres the whole time. 

Overall, I think the hotel is great, relaxing and warm!

reviews.author: Richard M
reviews.title: The most excellent dining service
reviews.text: What a pleasure having the service provided  by Atilano, GavDencio,Armendo, and Joni. Made each day special. What a special resort. The goal of all staff are to make your visit memorable. Great resort.

reviews.author: Rachel W
reviews.title: Agustin (Activities)
reviews.text: Agustin was so great. All of the activities were awesome!! Thank you for everything this week! Always so much to do when we come to Cancun!! Always so much fun with him!! Can’t wait to come back!!!!!!

reviews.author: Geoff B
reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: Working with Fabiola at guest services was a pleasure. She was very helpful and knew exactly what I needed! She was very attentive and mindful of my vacation time and got me on my way very quickly!!!!

reviews.author: alexlorena
reviews.title: Perfect location, friendly staff, effortless relaxation!
reviews.text:
My first time visiting any resort and it won’t be my last after the wonderful experience that I had at Paradisus Cancun. 

Shout out to the amazing staff who were hospitable, entertaining, and some of the hardest working people that I’ve ever met. 

Edier and Alejandro served up some delicious coffee and remembered our orders each time we stopped by. 

Saúl led some motivating fitness classes of all different types and made an effort to invite us and inform us whenever we crossed paths. 

Melissa provided us with excellent drink service while we enjoyed some live music by an incredibly talented trio of entertainers at the Ginger Bar. 

Ángeles gave a relaxing massage and body scrub at the Yhi Spa, which has all the perks you could hope for in your spa experience. 

And our friend Elliot at the pool took time to have great conversations with us about Mexico’s culture and offered some fantastic recommendations for places to visit. 

Our rooms were kept immaculate by the house keeping staff and I was impressed by the grounds staff constant maintenance throughout the resort to keep it presentable and functional for it’s guests. 

Overall, Paradisus checked all the boxes that I was hoping for during my vacation and I am so incredibly grateful for the experience.

reviews.author: Calum T
reviews.title: Mr Calum tempest
reviews.text: I would definitely stay here again!! The hotel is amazing and so is the staff, staff are very friendly and always there with food and drinks especially Samuel (sammy) who’s always bringing drinks and food around the people with out even asking him. Best bar man in Cancun!! Would highly recommend staying here and I’m sure I’ll be back one day

reviews.author: kristabrooke1
reviews.title: Beautiful Meliá
reviews.text: Just leaving here wow what a place all the staff amazing especially Samuel sosa at the pool went over and above the hotel is great one of the best will definitely be back love it here the rooms are clean and comfortable beach bar beautiful love love it

reviews.author: Excursion635709
reviews.title: Excellent service oriented resort, with or without kids 😊😎
reviews.text:
This resort is geared towards service and making sure you have everything you need. A great all inclusive resort.
Tonight was the best experience of all. I had a package delivered that was essential for work. The bell hop David Hilario was so very kind and helpful and then I went to guest services and Wen Wagner went out of her way to get the package. They went searching at 9:00pm!!!!   To my enormous relief, Wen came back with my package after going out of her way, she had to get into the package area that was closed and then find it and she ran with purpose!  Icing on the cake of a fantastic work (and a little vacation) Thank you so much to Paradisus Cancun for your commitment to taking care of your guests.  Wen Wagner and David Hilario, I am grateful for you both.  
Thank you!

reviews.author: BoardingPass562625
reviews.title: Precious Moments has excellent customer service!
reviews.text: Guendoline Flores Navarro with the Precious Moments  department really helped to arrange and surprise my wife for Valentine’s Day. She helped to surprise my wife with sunflowers, champagne, and a massage. Guendoline was very responsive, creative, and she followed through with everything we had discussed in a timely fashion. I would highly recommend working with her!

reviews.author: Michael F
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun - Worth the Money!
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun was a lot of fun. We stayed in the unrenovated area, so the room decor was old, but we didn’t spend much time there anyway. We enjoyed the food options, and everyone worked with gluten and soy allergies. The only complaint was that the restaurants were not running full hours due to it being low season.  All of the staff  we dealt with were friendly, especially Samuel Sosa at the pool bar, and Moises at Cielo.

reviews.author: Julie P
reviews.title: Amazing service because of the wonderful people! We’ve been to this property 3 times in the past 10 months.
reviews.text: This property is beautiful and the staff is amazing. Situated on the perfect beach in the hotel zone, the water is clear and there is no sargasso. We’ve visited this property 3 times in 10 months and are already planning our summer return. People who exceeded our very high expectations: Gabriella- manager of Cielo, Iran, and his entire group of associates at Lemon Fish, Diego, Moises, Valeria, Yamil, Joel at Sante’, our excellent concierge Janick and the amazing Maximilian at the Reserve pool. These wonderful people made our stay as perfect as it could have possibly been.  We look forward to seeing you again soon!

reviews.author: Juliana G
reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: For the most part the experience could have been better. If you speak spanish, they don’t treat you well. I do have to say that Eduardo, Martin and Ian were excellent. They made the whole experience a lot better. If we only had them taking care of us, I would have given the Hotel 5 stars.

reviews.author: angel
reviews.title: Excellent hotel
reviews.text: i would like to thank once again the team of workers at the Paradisus Cancún hotel, especially Daniela Zae from reception for his special attention and cordiality, I recommend 100% the amazing hotel paradisus Cancún. from utah EE UU. Angel & Lili

reviews.author: Sia A
reviews.title: Husband's AMAZING birthday at Paradisus!!!
reviews.text: Every text I sent while on our trip started with OMG.  The hotel, our view, the service ....all breathtaking.  Eddie and Didi were our servers for breakfast and they were superb.  The star of the show during our stay was our concierge Veronica!!!! What a wonderful human being.  So accommodating, so pleasant, so warm.  She was accessible and always there with answers.  Not only that but she was proactive.  She is top notch. Paradisus is lucky to have her.  The hotel is absolutely beautiful and the views are one of a kind.  We will definitely return.

reviews.author: Vova M
reviews.title: Breakfast
reviews.text: Amazing service! Gacdencio, Jony, Gerardo, atiluno, Alejandro in the buffet were very nice. Huge variety of food - all delicious. The staff were exceptional. Charlie at the Ginger bar was our favorite! We are hoping to come back soon!!!!!

reviews.author: Roupen B
reviews.title: Wedding Party trip
reviews.text: We had an amazing time on our visit to Cancun! Many of the staff at Paradisus did a fantastic job at helping us relax and enjoy every possible luxury.  We especially appreciated Juan, our personal concierge, who went above and beyond to make recommendations and provide service throughout our entire stay for a most enjoyable trip.  The pool concierge, Max, was very attentive and always happy.  Our waiters at the reserve, Yamil and Rubin, were professional, creative and made it fun. Everyone went above and beyond to give us a luxurious, relaxing and wonderful stay.

reviews.author: Victoria
reviews.title: Worst family "vacation", not worth it!
reviews.text: Our family of 3 (husband, wife and 6 yr old daughter) from NYC, booked via Expedia to stay at Paradisus in Cancun for a week (about $2,900+), we paid extra to be apart of the "reserve" club which at first we were sold on all of the "extra" amenities and spaces and thought it might be worth the extra $$. Now, when we arrived, it was another story. Everything was disorganized and unaccommodating! Dinner reservations must be made ahead of time, there will be no more spaces available last minute (ironically, you can only make reservations the day before which is really annoying). We were sold on the idea of a butler doing everything for us, what in the world did they do? They made dinner reservations for us via an app we could do. They were not allowed to reserve any beds by the pool for us. Are you kidding me? The butlers did minimum and sometimes unfriendly, we are generous tippers and honestly felt it was not worth it at all. We had to wake up early and stand on line to get a bali bed by the pools, and I recall multiple guests fighting over this issue. If you were just a minute after 10am and end up at the end of the line, you may lose your chance of getting a bed even though you arrived on time and waited on the line under the sun. EVERYTHING WAS A HEADACHE!!! It was NOT a vacation for us, instead everything was so complicated and time consuming. We wanted to relax, not have to deal with all of this extra drama and this place simply wasn't it. The "reserve" was a joke, they placed us in a room right above the entertainment area (DJ's, events, lobby etc). We didn't even get to stay in the quieter pyramid 5, we didn't mind the loud music until we tried to sleep at night and it was like sleeping above a club. The food was disgusting, what is the point of having so many restaurants but the only one that is really decent is Mole?? Everything was either limited or reserved or require further purchase, what is the point of paying extra for the "reserve" and there still are limitation (WTH)? Honestly, the only good part about the experience was that my daughter loved the Kids Club and enjoyed a lot of the activities. Overall, we will not be returning ever again.

reviews.author: Ang U
reviews.title: Outstanding Service & Posh Resort
reviews.text: Malva had the widest selection of breakfast and impeccable service. Awesome gym & spa access with sauna. The pools were relaxing & the staff was enthusiastic, friendly, and attentive. They remembered us all weekend & provided great service. Rodriguez, Samuel, Leo, Alex, Luis and the activities staff created a great atmosphere! Muchas gracias

reviews.author: Aaron W
reviews.title: Great trip at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Had a wonderful trip overall. Galbi our concierge was fantastic, Max with the Bali beds, Luis was an awesome bartender and teacher,  Atilano, Arturo, Teresa, and Alexis gave us fantastic breakfast service! Great trip overall, 10/10 can’t wait to come back.

reviews.author: Bonzarelli50
reviews.title: A definite destination in Cancun.
reviews.text:
2nd time there, wonderful rooms, wonderful Reserve section for pool.. the restaurants had changed all their menus, not really for the better.
The resort was spotless. Masks as required. Staff amazingly accommodating..
Our concierge Violetta is so very wonderful. Always there when u need her, checking in with us on her days off, making sure we had everything we wanted.We had Violetta inApril when we were there. No one like her . Paradisus is so very lucky to have her. 
Made dinner reservations for us everyday we wanted them. Even made outside restaurant reservations at our request
Max & Lucas at the Reserve pool made sure our balley beds were made up when needed. Max even helped me schedule a tattoo that I requested be done in Cancun.
David was helpful in booking massages. 
The other pool staff for drinks were terrific.
There really are not enough words to describe how wonderful the staff there is. They only want to make your stay the best it can be.

reviews.author: Julie V
reviews.title: Service
reviews.text: Didier & Eddie in the buffet were excellent! Very friendly and helpful with our whole family. My little nephew Jesse became fast buddies with Didier and every morning he looked forward to seeing them at breakfast to recap his previous day of activities. Their service was fantastic!

reviews.author: Nick
reviews.title: Amazing Resort
reviews.text:
Having booked Paradisus on the recommendation of a friend, I became quite nervous when I started reading all of the negative reviews regarding checkin, dinner reservations and the overall quality of the food. Those negative reviews couldn’t be further from the truth. 
Checkin took my girlfriend and I ten minutes to complete; the hotel had a room for us even though we checked in 2 hours early. We had an ocean view, which in my opinion is the way to go. The room had a cosmetic issue or 2 but we had no problems like water not running or ceiling leaking which other reviews suggested. 
Dinner reservations are easy to make, I was reading reviews with people saying they had to call some number first thing in the morning and they had no luck. The dinner reservation table is on the ground floor, in front of Ciello and Blue Agave. The front desk told us that information when we checked in. The restaurants are really quite good, Ciello being our personal favorite but every place is delicious. The menus are a bit seafood oriented, but you’re in Mexico. 
The staff are all amazing, regardless of whether you tip them or not. But please, tip the staff whenever you can. Those people work really hard and a few dollars can really go a long way to improve your experience. A $5 tip at the pool bar had the bartender sending drinks over as soon as our glass was empty; what more can you ask for?
I also read people complain their room wasn’t cleaned until 4 pm and the mini fridge wasn’t ever stocked beyond the first day, that wasn’t our experience— room cleaned before noon and fridge was stocked every day.
 
Getting Covid tested took 5 minutes, not sure why some are saying it was chaotic and took forever. 

Now for the Cons—
The hotel lobby bar Ginger plays music until about midnight- 2 am, which can be a huge disruption to people trying to sleep. The other issue I had with Paradisus is them send a pre-checkin form; asking questions including bed preference or if we were celebrating anything. None of the information we provided on that form was used, which we were willing to overlook, but why bother having it then? 
There also aren’t a ton of chairs and umbrellas by the pool and on the beach, with people throwing their towels on chairs early and the morning and coming back hours later, but that’s true of any resort. 

An overall great hotel, definitely the nicest looking of any of the hotels in the hotel zone. I understand everyone’s experience is different, but we have no legit complaints. Also if you do any of the Aquaworld excursions (which is located directly across the street from the hotel) the jungle cruise is the best one— you drive your own speed boat to and from a snorkeling spot.

reviews.author: Diana Holzhausen
reviews.title: Awesome week at Paradisus!
reviews.text: We stayed in the reserve and could not have been more pleased with the service, the friendliness of the staff, and the whole overall hotel.  The most outstanding, professional, helpful and knowledgeable person who really made our trip was our concierge, DjORDjE TOPALOVIC.  He is perfect at his job at even the smallest details!  We definitely would go back!

reviews.author: Ava Clenney
reviews.title: Guest services.
reviews.text:
Rosanna and When Warner went beyond what was expected in handling our issues and questions making our vacation most enjoyable. We will return because of them. 
Flor and Gabby were our our beach services help and we’re fantastic

reviews.author: Elizabeth N
reviews.title: Exceptional Service & Great Amenities
reviews.text: The room is a great size and all aspects were very clean. The restaurants had a great variety of food options at a high quality. While all of the service we received was exceptional, we did have some staff that went above and beyond in their relations. Eliot, Luis, and Saul were great activities directors and made a point to create personal relationships. Atilano and Didiero were very personable and attentive in the restaurant. Overall, we were extremely impressed with the quality of all aspects of the resort. We will be back for another vacation!

reviews.author: TDJernberg
reviews.title: Family Christmas 2021
reviews.text: All of the staff made us feel special and were amazing. There was everything available that our family enjoyed, weight room, reserve accommodations, cabanas, photos, the beach was beautiful,  and the meals were all good. Our favorite restaurant was Sante, thank you to  Diego, Valeria, Yamir, Moises, Julio, the chef Asterio  and Benjamin who kept a drink in our hands.

reviews.author: Resort817432
reviews.title: Malva at paradisus
reviews.text: Alejandro is the absolute best!! He served us at malva and helped us more than anybody has! We have loved our experience here overall! Angel at the concierge started our trip off incredible at has made a point to chat and check in throughout trip!

reviews.author: Shvetabhasin
reviews.title: 40th birthday celebration
reviews.text: Guendoline at Paradisus Cancun from Premium moments , arranged the most gorgeous beach side dinner for my friends and family . The setting and the decor with Tippis and string lighting was simply gorgeous . The 4 course meal customized for my guests was thoroughly enjoyed

reviews.author: Sergio D
reviews.title: Paradisus Malva Restaurant
reviews.text:
Eddie’s customer service is beyond 5 star service. Every morning that he has waited on us has been nothing short of exceptional. He’s very friendly, very professional and extremely funny. Please make sure you tip this wonderful man who is so deserving of every tip we have left him. We will be returning next year and look forward to seeing this amazing man. 

- Sergio Duarte

reviews.author: Ariel P
reviews.title: Amazing & relaxing time at Paradisus
reviews.text: I was in Paradisus Cancun For 5 nights with family and friends. Our stay was a stellar experience. The delicious drinks kept flowing and the restaurants were very delicious, clean and the staffing super friendly. Our favorite restaurant was Lemon Fish. We had the best waiter, Cristian Sanchez, who treat us so wonderful and took care of us. He showed us all the food options and made our stay special that we came back a second time. We also rented a cabana for the day. Rene took wonderful care of us there and Coco’s beach club. The hotel is aesthetically pleasing and makes you feel like Royal. The staff was amazing. Muchas gracias Cristian por haber hecho la cenas muy special para nosotros! Fue un verdadero placer!  -Ariel

reviews.author: Bibiana P
reviews.title: Best Vacation Ever!
reviews.text: I had an amazing vacation at Paradisus. My room was clean and cozy. The food at all the restaurants was beyond my expectations. The hotel is beautiful inside. My favorite restaurant was Lemon Fish. The food is amazing. Also, the customer service was the best. Everyone was friendly and very helpful whenever we needed it something. If you ever vacation at Paradisus and dine at Lemon Fish ask for Christian Sanchez… he is absolutely the best in customer service. Also, Veronica was amazing at helping us plan day to day activities and restaurant reservations.

reviews.author: Mario G
reviews.title: AMAZING EXPERIENCE!!!
reviews.text: The service is awesome!! Special thanks to Renee at the beach club and Christian Sanchez at Lemon Fish. So attentive and keep us smiling! The views and the beach are stunning. This is my second time here and I’ll definitely be returning!! The food is unforgettable and the staff are awesome!

reviews.author: Shannon G
reviews.title: Wonderful week on the ocean!
reviews.text:
The property is very well taken care of. The ocean view reserve room was amazing!
Enjoyed the week and can’t wait to go back! Max at the pool did an amazing job making sure everyone was taken care of! Thanks Max!! Juan our butler was on the job making sure everything we needed was taken care of! Thanks Juan aka J!!!

reviews.author: Jerry K
reviews.title: Winter getaway
reviews.text: A perfect getaway from a Winter snowstorm. We stayed in the Reserve section. Everything was great, although there was a bit of a cold spell/winds. But better than NY! Special shout-outs to Luis in Capella restaurant (Italian), and Joni and Atilano in the buffet. Great people delivering great service. We will be back.

reviews.author: E Loug
reviews.title: What a beautiful resort with amazing staff and food!
reviews.text:
What can I say, we stayed here for a week with a group of 16 people. This resort is incredible! Our rooms were all very clean and nicely updated. We were quickly checked in and headed right to the beach bar. 

Every staff member we encountered was friendly and very helpful. Their covid procedures were top notch. Every meal we had was wonderful. 

Even though we could only sit 6 to a table max they were wonderful at making sure our tables were close to the rest of our group. I think Bana was one of our faves! The sushi and beef noodle bowl were amazing! I loved their fish tacos and nachos by the pool. 

Many of the staff remembered us by our second day and greeted us happily and gave us top notch service everytime. I have to give a special shout out to the swim up bar. We spent a majority of our trip at the pool bar. And their staff was by far amazing! Our server, Rene who was also making our drinks and then delivering them to us took exceptional care of us the entire week. I could see us going back just to see him! He was our absolute favorite and went above and beyond to make sure our trip was wonderful! Galdino was the butler for three couples in our group and stopped in to make sure everything was going well for the group the entire trip. I made sure to tip him as well just because of how attentive he was for us. 

We will definitely be back and next time there is no way we can leave our kids behind. I know they would love this resort as much as we did! They would hate us if we left them behind for another Mexico trip as if is their favorite place to travel to. 

Thank you again to the entire staff that made our trip amazing!

reviews.author: Lvngher_bstlfe
reviews.title: Kudos Melia
reviews.text:
This was my first visit to Mexico. My friends and I were celebrating our birthdays. We were actually reserved at another hotel,  but they were not finished with their renovations so they moved us to Paradisus. Wow, so glad they did!

PROS:
Unique style hotel with plush greenery inside and a koi pond in the lobby which made the atmosphere very relaxing. 

Service! The staff here were excellent,  attentive, and helpful. Two out of the six of us work in the hospitality and hotel industry. Our standards are high and exceeded our expectations. 

Experience! There was nightly entertainment from silent DJ parties to dance techno battles. If fitness is your jam, you could participate in boot camp on the beach,  or yoga on the water. We had a great time. 

CONS:
The food wasn't the best. There are 6 or 7 inclusive restaurants. Breakfast at Fuego was consistent. Outside of that, for this foodie the selections were sub par. We even dined at the only steakhouse that wasn't inclusive. The crab legs were too salty, but the service as always was excellent. 

I have to acknowledge Alfredo and Amayrani at Fuego for their consistent level of service and kindness. I was there almost every day, Amayrani learned my name and that special touch makes a difference. Alfredo was my 1st server upon arrival. My room wasn't ready and he was really sweetand patient. If I went to another restaurant he would be there. You can tell he loves what he does!

Lastly,  we went Superbowl weekend and during the Pandemic. I appreciate their safety protocols, mask requirements, and they offered COVID-19 testing onsite. 

Next stop Paradisus Riveria Maya or Paradisus Playa del Carmen. I'm hooked on Melia!

reviews.author: Michael L
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Roldolfo was our butler during our stay at the reserve. From the moment we checked in he was there to service us. He made the whole stay stress free by taking care of dinner reservations for us, booking spa treatments and anything else we needed. Overall the trip was perfect, the resort was beautiful as well as all of the staff members going above and beyond to accommodate you and they all spoke English very well.

reviews.author: Swietlana S
reviews.title: Club Melia
reviews.text: My husband and I had the greatest experience at the club Melia at the Paradisus. The service was outstanding. Everything was exceptionally clean. The workers are very attentive, hard working and pleasant to serve. We wanted to give a special thank you to the waiter VICTOR at the restaurant “ENSO” who went above and beyond with the service. I would highly recommend who’s looking for high quality service, visit this place,  please be kind to leave  tip,  they work very hard!

reviews.author: Dee S
reviews.title: Bumpy Start, Smooth Finish
reviews.text:
First trip abroad since COVID so let me start by saying that things were different as a result of the pandemic. I have to begin this by giving credit to Paradisus (MELIA) for truly doing their best at implementing a COVID structure by having clear social distancing markers, all their staff wore masks, at the restaurants and buffet - only the staff was allowed to touch or serve our food (they were avoided an excess of handling food/drinks etc.), and I'd say the majority of all guests wore masks in common areas, with the exception of the pool/beach, however everything was adequately spaced out which was wonderful and very considerate.

Our trip almost didn't happen since we left NYC in the middle of a snow storm, so we essentially lost our first day at the resort which was a big bummer. We arrived at 10pm, and the check-in process was not speedy whatsoever, and we barely made it in time before the restaurants closed. The room they gave us was incorrect (despite having emailed them prior to our arrival with no response), and offered us to come in the morning (9am) to get the right room. The morning of, they asked us to come back at 3pm, so we did and then it was come back in another hour. At that point, we had to speak to management due to the fact that we were spending more time at reception than enjoying our stay - so they upgraded us to the Reserve status which offers a higher tier of amenities.  After getting our new room, we were able to enjoy the rest of the trip.

The beach was gorgeous, the entire property was SUPER clean and wonderfully tended to, and the food & drinks were delicious. I wish the weather had cooperated more, BUT we were still able to get some sun coming from freezing NYC. 

I have to give props to the following team members who truly went above & beyond with care: Aiko & Ismael at Reception, Armando at the main restaurant, and Maximillian & crew at the Reserve pool. Thank you guys so much, you were rock stars!

Can't wait to visit another Melia hotel!

reviews.author: tajamer
reviews.title: Customer
reviews.text: We had an excellent experience at paridusus hotel. I am surprised how clean everything was. Staff was all very friendly especially our waiter Moises. I will definitely revisit this location again jn the near future.

reviews.author: Nada A
reviews.title: Customer
reviews.text: We had an excellent time. Everything was super clean and covid friendly. The staff was excellent especially our waiter Moises. He was very friendly and accomadating. The whole experience was great. Thanks again

reviews.author: Shelby M
reviews.title: Cancun 2021
reviews.text: Amazing trip. Paradisus Cancun have really stepped up to meet COVID guidelines. We were comfortable and had plenty to keep us busy and entertained at the resort. Tons of food choices, however, due to COVID you are required to make reservations. COVID-19 testing to return to the USA was included in the all inclusive. I would come again.

reviews.author: Thor Pitt
reviews.title: Stay Away
reviews.text:
So I stayed there before and while hotel is good, getting your refund is almost impossible. After the Corona, they closed the hotel and told us that we would be getting refunds in 2-3  months.

Now it's a year later and after countless calls, emails, they still haven't processed my refund.

In times of travel restrictions and possible closures and delays, avoid this hotel. You will NEVER get your money back.

reviews.author: Nicholle P
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: I like the beach and how everyone helps and gives you advice I like the food it’s very delicious and everyone is so sweet and very cautious gracias a Tannya me gusts las actividades y coming me ensena nuevo actividades

reviews.author: CSanchez24
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Breakfast was good, they make omelette at request. All waiters, Cristian L., Alfredo A., and Armando Uc were very attentive. Always brought my husband fresh squeezed OJ in the morning. Remembers after second day I loved their habanero sauce and would bring it out. They even gave me a habanero lesson to make at home. Love Meliá hotel chain always top notch.

reviews.author: Manal S
reviews.title: Fuego -Joel rojano
reviews.text: Joel rojano is the best waiter ever!! He’s here for dinner time. He made sure our experience for dinner was nice and smooth and accommodated to our needs. I high Reccomend requesting for him ahead of time!!  Oh and he makes the besttttttttt alcoholic drinks :)

reviews.author: Camila B
reviews.title: The Paradisus Experience
reviews.text: I stayed at Paradisus Cancun for a couple days and it was an incredible experience. The amenities, the food, the people are all amazing. I have to give a special shout-out to Moises and Max! Moises is a waiter in one of the restaurants at the resort - Mole restaurant. He is definitely the best at his job! Very friendly and courteous. Max works at the Reserve pool and is also the best at his job! Max is always really nice and attentive to detail. I want to thank them both for their work! Never going to forget about Paradisus!

reviews.author: catamesa449
reviews.title: The best Birthday ever
reviews.text:
We had a amazing time in check in Julian helped us with the rooms 
In breakfast Ignacio and his team kept bring us our favorite Mexican dishes in the Pool we had a amazing time we recommend this hotel to make amazing memories will never forget and will come back !!!

reviews.author: Valdez A
reviews.title: Mole - Restaurant
reviews.text: What a great experience at the Mole restaurant in Paradisus! Carlos was very nice, attentive and hospitable. Will definitely come back! Highly recommend asking for him as your waiter. The food was delicious!

reviews.author: jaira c
reviews.title: Girls trip
reviews.text: Went to Paradisus with my girls for a weekend of relaxation and fun. The boys at the pool, bartenders and cabana Cornelio, Julio, Samuel, Rene, Miguel to name a few and the restaurants were so great, the reserve waiter Cesar was amazing. And the front desk, Julian, Christian, and Andria were also great. The best part was the doctor who did our covid test to return to the USA, Dr. Misael Morales, he was gentle and made an uncomfortable situation very comfortable, not to mention he was hot!

reviews.author: constancesillence
reviews.title: Great Hotel with lovely beach
reviews.text: Nice rroms, beautiful interior, gorgeous beach and fantastic pool. Special thanks to Betsy, Veronica and Elliot for their friendly and great service. Pool has a fantastic size. The hotel is well maintained and offers a good place to relax.

reviews.author: scot g
reviews.title: Resort and Staff Is Amazing!
reviews.text:
This is our 3rd time back to Paradisus. We have been to other resorts in Cancun and none of them compare to this resort.
I could go on for pages, but in short the staff makes all the difference to this hotel. Other hotels have amazing amenities as  the Paradisus, but the staff goes above and beyond to make your stay as pleasant and stress free.
We utilize the buffets as well as the restaurants in the complex and the food is fine, not the reason we would pick the Paradisus, but good. All restaurant staff is always going out of their way to get you everything you may need. 
We have come to know a few of the pool attendants very well. All of them are amazing from the bartenders to the wait staff.
