Because we try to get the same chairs everyday, we have to give a shoutout to a few individuals that stand out with us. At the pool, Rene, Flor and Victor. These staff members are part of the reason we continue to come back to the Paradisus in Cancun.  They go above and beyond to make sure you are never thirsty or hungry and are so pleasant, they feel like you know them personally. From the minute you pull up, Raul and staff work diligently to make sure you are taken care of 110% This is the service we find up until we are in the van head back home.
I would highly suggest this resort to anyone looking for a very relaxing vacation!

reviews.author: Korey
reviews.title: Amazing as always
reviews.text: This is our home away from home. Been a Melia fan for almost a decade and don’t see that changing. They are the best at customer service, consistency, and overall quality. When we want a break, we immediately book Melia bc we know we can relax and not worry about anything. Sandra, Melina, and our butler Violeta made our stay over Christmas truly outstanding. We’ll be back soon!

reviews.author: Judith31555
reviews.title: Just ok
reviews.text:
Here we go again with one of these hotels who have removed all room daily housekeeping coffee maker, hair drier from rooms . Just left a 5* hotel20 miles south on Riviera Maya who can’t do enough to make their guests feel welcome , all services plus room make up and towel change at least every day, and this place who are using the excuse of COVID to save themselves effort and money. Feels very “Motel6”....
Have to say service is excellent. Nothing changed since we were here 3yrs ago. Other than the eye rolling by the waiter when told his Chardonnay was somewhat lacking , ( an understatement )Things are going well ! The 4 kids , as usual are enjoying everything. No decaf at coffee shop this morning ( not the waiter fault). Wel see what  last 2 days bring .

reviews.author: barnarders1
reviews.title: Our Memorable Birthday Stay
reviews.text: We booked this trip to celebrate both my and my wife birthday. From the time we arrived on the grounds  we were impressed with the hotel. The grounds from the front to the back were well kept and spoke volumes. We didn't stay in the Reserves but the staff made us feel like we were. The staff at Paradisus went out of the way to make us feel welcome and went above and beyond to meet our needs. During our stay it was definitely like being in paradise.  Anyone wanting to go to Cancun I would recommend that they stay at Paradisus.

reviews.author: Jwayda2002
reviews.title: Great views!
reviews.text: Many great features about this hotel and a few improvements could be made.  Amazing location on the beach. Nice balconies and wonderful views of the Caribbean. Great beach space.  Hotel design was well thought out. Restaurants also all have their own ambiance. Omar, service manager , Mariana in the spa/gym  and Victor at the pool were friendly and helpful.  Gym was closed upon arrival which was upsetting because I called 8 neighboring hotels who had their gym currently open. Mariana put a spinning bike in my room to assist with my workout and gym then reopened on Feb 22. Kayaks and paddle boarding are not currently available as advertised to be included with the hotel, which was disappointing to my kids. Aqua world does not currently have them in stock to use. But, Omar was quick to assist with making our pool experience enjoyable,  compensating  for our inconvenience. Victor by the pool was very helpful and friendly, My Kids enjoyed seeing him everyday with a smile on his face,  I have to say reservations for restaurants can be challenging at this hotel. As long as book them one or two days in advance, you usually can get a time. You just have to plan you dinner quire a bit in advance.  The staff cares about their guests, which was a nice touch.  Not much entertainment. They have dancers or a band some nights . I don’t believe there is much entertainment at any hotels right now though. Overall, hotel is a great choice to spend time in the Caribbean as an alternative to cruising,

reviews.author: Anderson G
reviews.title: Service
reviews.text: My wife and I had an amazing time. The hotel was beautiful, and everyone was extremely friendly. The sushi restaurant was definitely the best I've had in a while. Finally Jorge our pool side server was by far the greatest part of the trip. He went above and beyond for us. I recommend this place to everyone

reviews.author: Blake V
reviews.title: Paradisus is UNMATCHED
reviews.text:
This was the best decision me and my girlfriend could have made. Just based on the stories we heard from other people we talked to at the airport. If you have the chance and money I would 100% suggest to upgrade and get The Reserve package and request Rodolfo. This man took care of us hand and foot. Even after our flights got delayed and we had to downgrade to to the regular part of the resort Rodolfo continued to take care of us for the remainder of our stay. 

The resort itself has a free show every night around great restaurants. All the food we had was Amazon regardless of what kind of food it was. The staff was always smiling and trying to make sure you want for nothing. 

I don't see ourselves trying any other resort next time we go back. Forever going to be Paradisus Cancun 

Thank you Rodolfo.

reviews.author: angel m
reviews.title: Valentine’s and Anniversary Vacation
reviews.text: I have no idea where to begin. My boyfriend and i reserved the “reserved - all adults” and from beginning to the end everything was amazing. Rudolfo was our concierge and took care of everything we needed, from booking restaurants, reserving a time for our Covid 19 test, cabana times, to even making our last dinner there very special. Rudolfo really made it to where we didn’t lift a finger. I would highly recommend getting the reserve if you want a stress free weekend.

reviews.author: Daniel P
reviews.title: Beautiful resort with mostly caring staff
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed here for 6 nights. The resort was absolutely beautiful and food was top quality.
There was a lady in guest services that really helped us out by giving us insight to what was outside of the resort such as a really good pizza place.
I did have issues with our door swipe cards twice on the trip. The first time we waited 40 mins for it to be fixed- this was also my wife's birthday and I had a cake waiting inside. You can imagine that really ruined the mood!
The second time the door malfunctioned was at 10.30pm at night and it took them an hour while they replaced the lock. We weren't able to sleep until after 11.30pm when the technician had gone. The lady at the front counter didn't care or apologize and Jose the manager on duty refused to give us a new room or fix the issue.
What changed our perspective of the resort after those 2 incidents was Ismael from guest services. He understood that there was serious service failures here and did everything he could to make things right. We were very grateful that he cared and was able to allow us to really enjoy the rest of our stay! Thank you Ismael!

Overall besides the door issues it was a great stay.
I would recommend having an official money change service so we can get $1 notes to be able to tip the staff.

reviews.author: fmiroshin
reviews.title: Hotel super nice , very one is no much kind , and looking to help you, food is the best! All kind foods available!
reviews.text: Hotel super nice , very one is no much kind , and looking to help you, food is the best! All kind foods available! When I left hotel, I had a feeling that I wanna come back for sure !!! Love being there!

reviews.author: Chelsea S
reviews.title: Great Hotel!
reviews.text: We just got back today from 7 days at Paridisus! We have stayed in many hotels in Cancun and I can honestly say this one was one of the nicest. I am a sucker for technology so having everything at my fingertips on my phone was a huge plus. I was slightly nervous to travel with all of the covid variables but once we got there I felt very comfortable with everything they do. For all of you reading and worrying about getting a covid test (that was my biggest worry) they do them on site! If I can recommend anything though it would be to spend the extra money and get the reserve package. The rooms are 100x nicer and newer. The butler is worth every penny. Shout out to Rodalfo he was so amazing and helped me with anything and everything I needed! He set up our dinner reservation every night, he set up our covid tests and he called and scheduled our airport transportation. He was genuinely such a nice addition to our trip! Another perk of the reserve is the private pool and the cabanas that you can basically get everyday. Max at the pool was super nice and accommodating!  And the restaurant that is only for reserve guests was our personal favorite spot for breakfast and lunch. Drinks were 10/10. My only complaint was about the food..but let me be honest I am a super picky person so it could have just been me and I have never been madly in love with the food at any all inclusive resort. Our week spent there was extremely relaxing and we enjoyed it very much!

reviews.author: Lilah A
reviews.title: 10 Day’s Of Magic
reviews.text:
Just got back home from 10 magical days at the Paradisus Cancun. Our buttler Rodolfo delivered the greatest service to me and my husband. When we arrived he made us feel like family. I got sick the last 3 days and he checked up on me everyday even on his day off. If you ever stay at the resort i recommend you asked for Rodolfo. 

Ceci from the reserve check in was fabulous. Once we arrived she offered us something to drink and the check in process was fast and easy. 

We booked a reserve Ocean view room which faced the main pool in Tower 3. The room was very clean and had a sanitary sticker on the door when we arrived. The mini fridge was stocked everyday with Beer, Soda, chips & Oreos. They also had glass bottles with water i personally did not like that water it taste weird to me and i used it to brush my teeth gotta play it safe lol. I recommend to ask for the small plastic bottle waters. 

Max from the reserve pool was so helpful and set us up for Bali beds during our stay so ask for him!!! 

I had wanted to do something romantic For Valentine’s Day. Jonathan from premium Moments emailed me some ideas for a beach dinner and it was so easy to set it up. He was so friendly and the dinner was so beautiful. We ended the night dancing under the stars and listening to the waves.

The best part of my trip was the Nespresso bar they had!!!! So freaking delicious! I started my morning’s everyday with my Almond Latte made by Ricardo Once he saw me he already knew my order Lol

The restaurant’s were really good 
My Favorites were: 

Vento- Italian 

The mussels and salmon with polenta was delicious. You Must get the Baked Peach Dessert!!!!!!!!! Hugo & Omar were our server and they were so attentive to anything we needed.

Bana- Japanese 

Shrimp & Chicken fried rice was yummy
The sushi was also really good we had 2 of each on the menu.

Here’s A few tips! 

Definitely book the reserve it’s completely worth it. When you arrive at the hotel have your butler schedule all your dinners and reserve your Bali beds on the reserve side for the rest of your stay.....Adults only pool which was nice and peaceful. 

I recommend you set up a dinner at Rosa Negra around 8:30pm which is across the street from the resort. The food is amazing and the show they put on is even better. They have fire works on the lagoon around 10pm. 

For Excursions i used Getyourguide app which was way more affordable than what the hotel and people outside were offering. 

I will definitely recommend this hotel to friends and family and i will be back!

reviews.author: Maria K
reviews.title: So nice!
reviews.text: I stayed at Paradisus a couple of days ago and I really enjoyed being there! The host Rodolfo helped me greatly with making reservations at restaurants, settling the appointment to doctor in order to be tested on coronavirus. He did a really good job and carried out everything on time! Thank him for making my vacation amazing and unforgettable!

reviews.author: Takny
reviews.title: PARADISE AT PARADISUS
reviews.text:
Recently spent 6 days at Paradisus and it was perfect! I am not a fan of large hotels as there are usually large crowds to go with them but due to COVID the hotel was just at 50%.  The hotel itself is HUGE but easy to navigate. Most of the restaurants are in the main building with shopping nightlife and the Spa.  We did upgrade to the Reserve club that had a small restaurant and bar just for the patrons which was nice.   The butler service that comes with the upgrade was pleasant and effortless to get all of our dinner reservations and anything else we needed arranged. We dined at all of the specialty restaurants and the food was decent for all inclusive.  The menus weren't over the top, but enjoyable.  The grounds are well maintained and the staff was OUTSTANDING.  
I started my list a little late so there are a few people missing but here are most of the people that took care of us:
Valeria : la palpa restaurant, Javier : mole restaurant, Daniel : manager / la palapa, Oscar: reserve restaurant, Max: reserve pool, Caesar & Miguel, Ruben: beach waiter, Daniela & Gemma: masseuses, Claudio: Bana restaurant, Armando, Martin, Atilano: Malva restaurant, Carlos & Moises: Blue agave, Joel & Pasquale: Fuego restaurant.
Will visit again

reviews.author: soniabestrealty
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: I really love this hotel and I recommend  to all my friends since I am sure they going to have a good experience. The room, pool, beach,food and services were excellent.  I am happy with my experience ☺

reviews.author: Josh F
reviews.title: Omar
reviews.text:
Omar was the best waiter. He was so fun, funny and attentive! He made every meal very enjoyable and we always had the best time with him. The manager Hugo also made sure we were well taken care of. Excellent service!
OMAR IS SEXY AND HE KNOWS IT ;)
(Inside Joke 🤣)

reviews.author: Mia Norm
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: I just wanted to share how great of experience was at this hotel. The staff starting with Rodolfo and then the servers Armando, Alejandro, Alfredo and Orlando took such good care of us. Saul and Jennifer in the activities and Ivonne at the pool really made us have an unforgettable experience. The lady that helped us clean our room and just everyone was so great. Thank you. We really enjoyed our time, the food and the room.

reviews.author: Clarisel
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: We loved our stay! This is our second time at Paradisus Cancun and we loved it even more than the first time. From checkin in to the beach, to the pool. The food was out of this world. Every single restaurant was espectacular. The waiters were friendly, attentive and on top of our every need. A big thanks to our waiters Orlando and ALfredo who were always there for our every need both at breakfast and at Mole Restaurant. Excellent resort overall, this won’t be our last time here.

reviews.author: Olga K
reviews.title: Vacation at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Everything was great, nice food, welcoming people. Hotel is the most attractive one out of all hotels in the area. Our buttler Rodolfo delivered great service. Strongly recommend him, courteous, thoughtful and responsive.

reviews.author: Emma
reviews.title: Honest review READ ! Roldolfo as an amazing butler/host. He made the experience more pleasant at the resort .
reviews.text:
Rodolfo is the only reason I would ever go back to the hotel. He was amazing . For the price the resort was good . Food was decent . The lamb chops at fuego very good. Tacos at the taco bar were good . The resort was renovated but it is an older property.  Roldolfo went above and behind texted us multiple times a day to make sure we had everything we needed done . We used the “reserve”‘part of  the hotel which gives you premium access to all with your personal butler. Roldolfo, the shows (entertainment )  and the beach were the best things at the resort. The beach is obviously nice and clean since it’s in hotel zone . The beach was warmer the the pools. The pools are very very cold . I did read this before I went and I decided to see for myself , and YES they are very  cold . If you have kids this is unpleasant , and an adult won’t want to swim in it. The service at the hotel was not typical “Cancun “ service . No one goes above and beyond and if you are dissatisfied they ultimately won’t care . The waiters are extremely slow and the food takes forever to come out even if you are the only table at the place . We booked through Meliá . They promised us a certain room type which was not what we were given , we couldn’t even upgrade
 ( and pay) because they had no rooms . They booked us in a room that had a see through shower , and a thin white curtain. Having teenage boys this was hard for me to take a shower , they had to leave the room for me to do so . House keeping always left sand on the floors which constantly stuck to our feet and eventually came home with us in our suitcases. The “suites” at the reserve that are for family’s , used to be couples only. Which is why they are more romantic. ( see through shower in middle or room).  They refused to change the room because they had no rooms , yet the hotel was at 30 percent capacity. Our  flight was  cancelled due to a winter storm so we booked another at it as the latest flight in Cancun . This time we booked and demanded the correct suite , needless to say we were given the Correct one this time we actually booked the first time . 80 dollars a night (which is fine ). Most the dining needs reservations which is where rodolfo came in and did that for us ! It was a big help!  The pools are not only cold but too deep for kids , you won’t be able to enjoy the sun since your constantly looking and watching the kids , with the cold and deep water . There is a kids area but it’s segregated from the hotel ,and a Boring area. No one wants to be there. The dj was great at the main pool and the belly dancing shows and Mexican shows were great ! They had an amazing band all the time. (Other resorts have zero entertainment ) . 

Would I stay there again? Maybe in July when the pool is natural warm since they have no heaters . Other then that no. They were oftenly “out “ of guacamole which I find hard for believe . The waiters are very  lazy and barley give you what you want , they leave and never return to the table. You will die waiting for a refill. Dinner would take  4 hours sometime due to the snow service . Last but not least the airport transfers with “otium” that are free or cme  with the  reservation are ok, but with the changes we had they were so cold to us at the otium desk and threatened not to take us back to the airport because of the flight change . In fact the man at the desk was so so rude and blamed the “resort” for him not making changes to the new pick up time and date due To the snow storms !! 

Hotel is located in a nice area, beach is good , entertainment is good and Rodolfo is great . He should be offered a manager position . He did everything he can do fix the weird
 problems we had .  Hotel was ok with being  clean lots of nice places to take photos . Other then that , find somwhere else to stay.

reviews.author: Kela G
reviews.title: Amazing dinner!
reviews.text: Our waiter was amazing! Joel Rojano was the best! He was very friendly and knowledgeable. Ask for him as your server!  My friend and I ordered the beef appetizer and lamb and chicken for our main courses!

reviews.author: HENRY C
reviews.title: Overall Good Hotel
reviews.text: Great Hotel with great food and activities. Amazing experience. Room were comfy but the door lock wasn't working and we discovered by accident the next day. It was fixed eventually, but the hotel management failed to do its due diligence.  Shower hot water wasn't working but it was eventually fixed.

reviews.author: Diani_C
reviews.title: Best stay in Cancun!
reviews.text:
The resort is beautiful, food is delicious, ocean view is breathtaking, the precautions taken on this times make you feel safe, room and amenities always clean. The service was amazing everybody is super friendly and take really good care of you. 
From the beginning in the from desk Julian Ortega made sure we had everything we needed to make us feel at home! 
The breakfast buffet was delicious, we felt special by the attention we had from Delia, Armando and Edier, going above and beyond with their service. 
We loved the beach and the service provided by Enrique was great, he was always making sure we had your refills and drinks at all times. 
We were expecting good service but not such a service that would have make us plan another visit in the next few months. 

Julian, Delia, Armando, Edier and Enrique, thank you again for your excellent service.

Juan y Diana

reviews.author: Roy S
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun. Rodolfo
reviews.text: Last week was a very relaxing week for my wife and I. Rodolfo was super awesome, anything we needed or wanted he got it done for us. Definitely planning on coming back as soon as we can. Some of the bluest water Iv ever seen in my life!

reviews.author: Der P
reviews.title: Vacation with my family
reviews.text: I came here February 12, and on the first day we played volleyball, it was very fun. Everyone was very nice and we did many activities like water gym, and beach boot camp, finger painting and volleyball. Saul and Jennifer, thanks so much for the activities, it made my week great.

reviews.author: huskerdoc
reviews.title: Great Trip... Great Resort
reviews.text: My wife and I just got back from a wonderful visit to the Paradisus.  We had a great stay.  The property is beautiful.  We did the Reserve package which is an upgrade from the basic all inclusive package, but well worth the the extra charge as you get your own butler, your own pool/beach side restaurant for breakfast and lunch, your own buffet area for breakfast and lunch if you don't want to eat outside etc.  The service was awesome,  food was good, views were amazing.  We have stayed at Melia resort before in Punta Cana and there are very nice.  Our butler Aaron Ruiz was so attentive to our needs,  got us into the restaurants we wanted when we wanted.  Set up our covid test that went smoothly and was a great resource for what we wanted.  The manager Daniel at the Reserve pool/ beach area was fantastic always with a smile and a welcome and always asking if we needed anything.  Thanks to the bartenders Sergio, Javier and Samuel who greeted me with a nice welcome by name  everytime and set me up with cold Cerveza.  Thanks to our waiter Oscar at La Palapa for breakfast every morning.  Cesar and Francisco were the best pool/ beach bar servers!!!  Made friends with all of them.  Highly recommend and will be returning!

reviews.author: jemhogan74
reviews.title: Wonderful resort all around
reviews.text:
Everyone was great. Good food. Good entertainment. Wonderful staff
Especially-Saul, Augustin and Jennifer pool entertainment. Victor pool concierge. Samuel pool bartender. Jorge, Sergio and Alfredo pool servers , Kemil with our baggage and help with shuttle to airport. Andria on check in. David from spa. We loved everyone and the wonderful job they did. We hope to return again in April to the resort

reviews.author: Cj32x
reviews.title: Awesome service
reviews.text: I loved the overall service from the staff. I really wish there was a dedicated shuttle from the airport or something so I wouldn’t have to talk to the vendors they had. Food and drinks were awesome. Reservations and time frames for appts need work

reviews.author: Jenny Eberle
reviews.title: Just meh.
reviews.text:
Our travel agent booked us a week long trip in The Reserve Junior Suite, Ocean View. 

Our experience here wasn't awful, but we weren't overly impressed for the money we spent on our trip. 

For the pros: 
•Hotel did a wonderful job with sanitation due to Covid regulations. There were hand sanitizer stations everywhere and mats to clean your shoes. Also, they always used tongs to place your wrapped silverware on the table and no one was allowed to touch the buffet to serve the food except for the staff. Each room also had a sealed packet with gloves, face masks, and sanitizer. 

•Staff is extremely friendly. 99% of them will greet you or stop to talk with you. They would do anything for you if you asked them to, which was awesome! And they were sincere about it! Excellent service!!

•The resort itself is very pretty. We loved all the plants throughout the buildings, along with the decorations. Also, the reserve pyramid is very quiet, which we loved. No loud music or screaming kids. 

•The grounds were very pretty and well kept. The beach is beautiful and clean. 

Cons:
•As soon as we stepped into our room after checking in, Fernanda was immediately calling us on the room phone to set up a meeting with her. She led us to think it would be her showing us the resort, when in reality, she tricked us into a 3 hour timeshare meeting. Because of this, we don't even want to return to this resort. That was 3 hours we could have been on the beach relaxing! So rude to trick your paying guests into these meetings!! 

•The smell! If you have a high sensitivity to smell, I do not recommend this resort. They have boxes all over the buildings blowing out horrible scents. I don't know if they were air fresheners or oils or what, but they gave me migraines the first half of the week until I got used to them. 

•We weren't impressed with any of the food and we ate at every restaurant, including Sal's. It didn't taste awful, there just wasn't anything special about any of it. 

•One of the things that irritated us the most was all the construction around us. We get that you have to fix things in the hotel and that's fine, but don't start early in the morning! We were trying to sleep in one morning and they were in the room next to us hammering and drilling and painting and it was SO LOUD. We wanted to relax and instead had to be woken up by power tools.

•The last thing that bothered us was that this was a honeymoon and it didn't seem like it. Other resorts go all out to make a special occasion special and all Paradisus did was send a plate of chocolate covered strawberries and truffles to our room. 

Now that I'm finished being negative, I do have to compliment our concierge, Aaron. He was always so friendly and just a text away if we had any questions or needed anything. I love Mountain Dew, which the resort doesn't serve, and he offered to stop at Walmart before he came into work to find some for me. Aaron was seriously so nice...he seemed like our friend, rather than concierge! Thank you Aaron! 

Overall, the trip was just okay. Not my favorite place that I have ever been to, so I don't know that I would come back. If I did, it would be because of how nice the staff is.

reviews.author: Svetlana Dimic
reviews.title: First time in Mexico
reviews.text: I had previously booked two other resorts in the area, but after reading an article that Paradisus offered Covid testing on site and travel insurance, I canceled the other resorts and booked this one instead without even looking at the reviews or pictures. Testing was scheduled upon my arrival and it was stress and hassle free. I had never been to all inclusive resort before, so this was all new to me.  Location was amazing and my view from the balcony was to die for. I honestly wish I booked more nights. My junior suite was great, I liked a big bathroom. The whole place is huge and beautifully decorated. The staff is absolutely amazing and friendly, every one is always smiling. They really make you feel welcome and special. I was in Tulum prior to coming to Cancun and I was walking a lot, so I hurt my feet really bad. When I got to Cancun, it finally got me, I had trouble walking and I just got there. I asked a lady that was walking by next to me, to see if she could be able to help me and she called someone right away, told me to wait there. Even though I was doubting someone would come, after not even five minutes, two guys showed up, they did not speak English, but they were so helpful and kind, they saw my feet, and they took care of it right away. They had to call a third guy that was a translator, and he told me that I had to call them in the morning and in the evening for the rest of my stay so it doesn't get infected. That really made me feel like they cared, and that meant a lot since I was there by myself, the whole resort was a great experience for me. It was my first time in Mexico, and I can't wait to go back. I had never had a better service, everyone going above and beyond and doing it with a smile. Big shout-out to Roberto at Bana (Japanese restaurant, Roberto was so funny, he was making jokes and I really liked sushi rolls he recommended, thankful for the great conversation), Rene from the Coco's beach bar was my server from day one,  he made great drinks with mezcal and brought me food even when I did not ask for it, he was so caring and finally Andria at the front desk who answered all my silly questions and helped me  get a taxi to the airport. I highly recommend this place.

reviews.author: Benny B
reviews.title: Safe, Friendly, and Beautiful!
reviews.text: Nervous to travel with COVID around and needing a test to get back to states, but they made it so easy, relaxing and non stressful.  Super safe, clean, and attentive to customer service!  Felt so cared for!  Huge thanks to Max in The Reserve for his poolside reservations every day!  Dejorgie (George) for his amazing Butler skills providing custom touches for our 17 year anniversary!  And Valeria in the La Palapa Cafe for serving us daily and making it an easy experience!  Can't wait to come back!

reviews.author: MW1207
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Incredible experience, excellent service and very friendly and warm staff. Everything felt very clean and sanitary in the midst of covid. Highly recommend this trip to anyone and everyone! Would go back in a heart beat.

reviews.author: Jan C
reviews.title: Family Trip
reviews.text: Our family vacation wacation was great at Paradisus Cancoon. Facility is verry clean they take everything very seriously and sanatize everything. Food and drinks are delicious. Plenty to do for everyone. Rodolfo who was our butler took care of us well we highly recomend him for everyone. He answered all questions and helped with any issues and was verry responsive. Our family was verry happy to meet him. Aldough some places are closed do to covid there is still plenty do do. We would defenatlly go back there again.

reviews.author: Nicole Martischewsky
reviews.title: Best service ever
reviews.text: We throughly enjoyed paradisus Cancun. Their customer service is one of a kind.  A few people I would like to personally recognize.   Victor the server, Victor the concierge and especially Celeste with the kids club.  She was SO wonderful with our kids!!!

reviews.author: Michael D

reviews.author: Ammar E

reviews.author: Ed H
reviews.title: Best Ever!!
reviews.text:
If you are looking for somewhere that will treat you GREAT, this is the place BEST vacation ever, people were AWESOME.....honestly, i TRIED to find one thing to complain about to make this review believable..... Could not think of one thing that wasn't a great experience.

You HAVE to do the "RESERVE" for adults. From check in to check out, everyone was spectacular!!!! We met so many employees there and ALL were nice, helpful, smiling and willing to go the extra mile, from the bosses to the newest employee!

Our "Butler" was Violet (WOW) and Rudolpho was our friends. Get either one if you can, you won't regret it! See Max at the pool for your towels and anything else there you need. 

So quickly we ate at all the restraunts except for ENZO, all were very good. We also ate at SAL out last night as guests of the manager. WOW....

Overall, it was by far the best all inclusive trip ever. Thanks to everyone there!!!

reviews.author: richi671
reviews.title: Accountant
reviews.text: My experience at Paradisus Cancun was a delicacy among the choices available in the hospitality business. The staff is caring, the food is delightful, and the activities and amenities are pristine. Best value for an all-inclusive so far.

reviews.author: Molly Sledge
reviews.title: Cancun Paradius
reviews.text: This resort far exceeded my expectations from the moment I check in and until I left for home. The staff is so attentive to all the guests. I’d highly recommend the Reserve as it’s well worth it. Daniel and his staff at the Reserve pool are the beat. Oscar, Miguel, Cesar, and Ruben kept the Ketel One flowing. Max was amazing in taking care of cabanas and pool beds. The food is wonderful as well. Planning my next trip to this wonderful resort.

reviews.author: Fiona Centro
reviews.title: BEST hotel in Cancún
reviews.text: Truly one of the most amazing hotels i’ve ever been to. My family and I felt extremely welcome, the service was excellent and the food was BEYOND delicious. They have great COVID-19 protocols which made me feel very safe. Also, the beach was very beautiful and it was a nice view to wake up to.

reviews.author: Matthew G
reviews.title: Beautiful resort with great staff
reviews.text:
Pros:

Staff was friendly, welcoming & attentive. Resort is extremely clean & updated. I felt very safe with the Covid precautions they take. They were constantly cleaning & disinfecting. 

Good variety of restaurants. The pool is wonderful. The resort was only 24% occupied so I had plenty of space & quietness. It's a slower paced environment & I didn't feel pressured to do anything. I felt very relaxed.

The beach was nice, though it was a bit windy & the waves were rough (not sure if it's normally like that). There was only one day where going into the water wasn't allowed because the waves were too strong. A lot of beach to walk if that's what you enjoy doing. 

Minor inconveniences (for me):

The food was ok. I'm a picky eater so take that into consideration. However, if I didn't like something, the chef would accommodate me and make something I did like or I just ordered something else.

The resort charges, surprisingly, a $5 delivery fee for room service. I feel that should be included in the All Inclusive. Instead of having coffee delivered to my room, I asked to have coffee & milk be stocked in so I could make my own coffee with the coffee maker supplied. They are very helpful in figuring things out for you & getting what you need. Use bottled water to make coffee. Don't drink the tap water.

The coffee & Gelato stations were only open a short period of time each day. The coffee shop opened at 4pm, not in the morning. The Gelato station was not open every day but when they were, it was only in the evening. Not sure if that was part of the Covid precautions they take but it would have been nice to have them more readily accessible, especially the Gelato station. Who doesn't want a nice cup of Gelato to cool you down after being outside in the hot sun? 

No maps or pamphlets to guide you around the resort or let you know what is going on. They tell you to download their app but that gives limited information and was not up to date. Entertainment was almost non existent (which I was ok with). Again, not sure if Covid related or if that is their norm. 

The staff could have communicated better with some of their Covid procedures. There are markings on the floor and nobody told me what they meant, especially in the restaurants. You need to stand behind them and the staff gets your food for you. Some things you just figure out. 

Overall I had an awesome vacation. I got out of it exactly what I needed!! R&R away from the cold & snow in Massachusetts!!

reviews.author: Denise F

reviews.text: Rodolpho gave amazing customer service! He was always attentive and available. Resort was beautiful. We did Reserve service and it was worth every penny. Good food big selection. Willing to make any drink with the good stuff! Will be going back!

reviews.author: William
reviews.title: Amazing Resort
reviews.text:
We loved the employees at Paradisus! The first thing the gentleman said when we arrived was "no need to stress, because we will stress for you." And he was right!
Every issue we had was taken care of in 10 mins or less. 

The pool area is so nice and it has easy access to the beach. Once we posted up at a beach chair they ask us for our drink orders and if we want to eat anything. 

I could go on and on about how much we loved this resort. 
My friend and i agreed that there is no other place we want to stay at when we come to Cancun

reviews.author: Jeff B
reviews.title: Stayed at the reserve side
reviews.text: Stayed at the Reserve at Paridisus for a vacation with my girlfriend for her birthday. Food was amazing, drinks were really good and the facility was beautiful. If you are only adults, spending the extra bit to go to the reserve side if certainly worth it. My attendant Rodolpho went the extra mile to make the whole experience unbelievable. He set up a special dessert to be brought for her birthday, had the waiters randomly bring snacks we liked while we are at the pool. 10/10 would go again. And go now. The weather is perfect and there are not many people there.

reviews.author: Rodrigo N
reviews.title: Awesome service!
reviews.text: Great place and great food, many food options to chose from and staff service is impeccable, very friendly people. Eddie and Alejandro made our experience really pleasant, definitely a place to visit again!

reviews.author: Gabriela
reviews.title: Wonderful resort& friendly staff
reviews.text:
The resort is simply amazing, I enjoyed the fact that the occupancy was not high and you had your private space in restaurants, pools and the beach. 
The Covid protocols are very well kept within the resort and also in the destination. 

The rooms are clean and the housekeeping comes every day. The minibar is full when you arrive and you must ask for a refill whenever you want. The staff is very friendly and they assist you with every wish you have. If you want a renovated room you should book a higher room category like a luxury junior suite (standard lagoon or ocean view jun suites are ok but furniture is dated, they have bathtubs instead of shower, etc) 

The breakfast in Fuego or Malva is buffet style, very varied but it is not self-service (you have to wear face masks inside when you select your food; and you have to inform the staff what you want to eat from the buffet and they serve you)

Lunch & dinner are a-la-carte; you order from a set menu; for dinner you need to make a reservation in advance at the restaurant you want. All restaurants have kids menus (though the selection is limited and mostly the same every day) 
The Melia app did not work on my mobile phone but we could do the dinner reservations via reception without any problems; 
There are many restaurants where you can serve dinner and there are included in AI package (Fuego - very tasty; Mole - Mexican food, Vento - Italian food, Bana - Japanese food); there is also Sal (Stake) Restaurant which is with extra charge

There are shows and good music almost every day; the drinks are amazing (Cuba Libre, Mojito, Tequila, the coffee at Nespresso station); restaurant staff is very friendly, smiling and assist you with every wish you may have; they change the dinner dish if you feel it is not well cooked or not your taste; 

The pools are clean, water a bit cold in the morning
Pool/beach towels are at discretion; 
The beach is endless a pleasure to walk along it; the sea has different shades of blue and turquoise, absolutely divine; now in Feb. sea water was warm enough, but the rough waves were a bit problematic for my kids. I understood that in other period waves are not that high and bathing in the sea can then be a pleasure too. 

Excursions or extra services (like spa, boat tours, parks, souvenirs, taxi, etc) are very expensive; 

The bus to the city is only 1 USD/pax/way; they function 24/7 and the bus stop is in front of hotel; very easy to go around 

I you want to have more services included you should book the "royal" service (there is also "Palapa" restaurant included, or the beach cabanas, etc) 

The only regret is that my husband did not have the chance to experience the destination and this beautiful resort together with us (he was sent back on arrival without any explanation by the Mexican authorities by the same flight we arrived in Cancun). I and my kids in spite of the awful episode from arrival had a great time in the resort; I was simply amazed by the friendliness of the staff, the quality/presentation of food and drinks and I would like to express my sincerest thanks again to all personnel from the hotel for making our stay there very pleasant. 

with very best regards,
Gabriela 
Bucharest, Romania 
February 2021

reviews.author: jennad1202
reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.text: Traveled here for a 5 day getaway in January and it was everything we needed. The property was so beautiful and the staff was even better. Cannot wait to book my next trip back here at the same resort.

reviews.author: kgreen1123
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: We didn't have hot water 3 of the 4 days we were there. The AC was barely cooling the room. We were not happy! No one told us that all the resturants were not open everyday so we didn't even get to eat at Blue Agava.

reviews.author: David Fleck
reviews.title: David
reviews.text: Elliot and Ale was truly the best they took care of us more than anyone ever has and they will be the reason we come back again they made our days so fun always checking in and taking care of us we have never experienced such better customer service ever I recommend this hotel to anyone very one to check out you will not be disappointed we are sad to leave but will be back soon.

reviews.author: Terra E
reviews.title: Hopeful this review gets the hotel's attention
reviews.text: I have been trying to get a reservation problem for arrival 2/8/2021 for an entire week. I have called no less than 15 times and emailed 10 times with no response. I get the run around that the manager Patricia isn't available or that another person a supervisor is in a meeting and they transfer me to another guest service person, Cristhian to help?  I guess the only way to get a real response is to write a bad review. It isn't a good way to start a trip. I tried to cancel on Feb 1, a full 7 days before the trip only to be told it had to be by 3 PM Cancun time and there would be a one day penalty which isn't what the website says that it has to be that specific. Then I decide to keep the reservation and try to check in online only to get my free upgrade reward that is on my account for my birthday. They tried to charge me a $67 upgrade fee instead of applying the reward. I called and they said someone would call me back but no one does. Then I find out that the fitness room is closed due to COVID but called the Golden Parnassus and all the Riu's Fitness rooms open. I ask if they can comp me a golf rental to compensate for the loss of the amenity and they say no. This was going to be my second time visiting but now I will never be coming back!!!!  BTW the name dropping on reviews seems like fake reviews and not got information.

reviews.author: Khadija M
reviews.title: Mr
reviews.text: Great service from Rafael at the BANA restaurant!! Very helpful and he has great recommendations ! You gotta try lil bit of Paradisus - Paradise ! when you come to Cancun!  Music is awsome and you will feel like your in your own personal jungles.

reviews.author: Regina L
reviews.title: Great hospitality
reviews.text: Great service, wonderful atmosphere beautiful music and the best host RaFael ! Patient and understanding & to top it off Delicious foods, it’s Paradise with itself ! This is my 1st time but it’s certainly not my last.

reviews.author: Fernando Bernardino
reviews.title: Great Vacation and a great experience!
reviews.text: The hotel is very large and very beautiful. The room was very clean, the space is great, nothing wrong. The Reserve was a nice choice, pool services, diner reservertions, the bali beds by the pool. I have a great time with my friends!

reviews.author: Ashley D
reviews.title: First time at Paradisus
reviews.text: I loved my stay here. They were following covid protocols and were very accommodating in a weird pandemic time. The pool is where I spent most of my time and Sergio, Didi, Jorge, and all the guys at the pool service bar were amazing! They really went above and beyond. I would come back to this resort for their service alone. Salvador at the Avenue bar was very good too and Theresa who booked my airport shuttle was a sweetheart. Everyone was kind and welcoming. I would come back and visit here again!

reviews.author: Michelle N
reviews.title: WONDERFUL experience!
reviews.text: The staff at Paradisus go ABOVE and beyond to help your every need. It felt very COVID safe and they followed all protocols. I want to give a VERY special thanks to Cesar, Manual and Karina for making our trip amazing. Also wanted to mention Oscar, DiDi and Max were wonderful as well. We were in the reserve section, the food there is AMAZING, the best all inclusive food I’ve experienced at La Palapa.

reviews.author: Angela B
reviews.title: Wonderful resort
reviews.text: We loved our stay at the Paradisus Cancun for our 20th anniversary. The facility was beautiful. The members of the staff were attentive, friendly, and genuine. Djordge was an amazing butler. He even checked in with us on his day off to make sure we had everything we needed and wanted. Maximiliano at the pool was very helpful and had a great sense of humor. Everyone was very patient as we practiced our very limited knowledge of the Spanish language. We would definitely recommend this exquisite resort!

reviews.author: John Jackson
reviews.title: Anniversary
reviews.text: The most wonderful service and people. All of the staff were so helpful and knowledgeable, my wife and I are beyond impressed. José a server at Mole was especially amazing. Thank you, Paradisus & Mole!!!

reviews.author: Lisa K
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: This hotel is wonderful in every way. During pandemic they try to make your stay as smooth as possible. We arrived around 4pm and the restaurant fuego was about to close for lunch but JUAN invited us in and took care of us in every way he can. He was an amazing server with the biggest smile on his face. Right away he became our server and friend till the rest of our trip. Amazing person and a super employee. The food at the restaurants are very good. Buffet is open only for breakfast but there are plenty of places you can grab a bite to eat. We upgraded to reserve status and we had our own butter George and he was terrific. Anything we needed he got it for us. The beach is super clean and the water is perfect. Been to cancun many times but this was by far the best.

reviews.author: Family Travels
reviews.title: Excellent Hospitality and  Beautiful Resort
reviews.text:
My family and I stayed at the Paradisus for a week and wanted to move in. The wonderful people who work here went above and beyond to ensure we were comfortable and that all our needs were addressed. Not only do they pride themselves on customer service but they do so with a smile. 

The resort is beautiful and smells very nice. The lobby has a beautiful Garden Jungle - and the greenery makes for a spectacular entrance.  

The Guest Service Department includes Ismael Mendez and Christian Morales who were very accommodating and went out of the way to ensure our room exceeded our expectations and was prepared with anything we needed. They did all this with a smile which made the experience of staying there even better.

The Head Pastry Chef - Ivan was beyond gracious in accommodating our very strict diet and was in touch with us constantly to see what else he could make for our kids. 

The Chef Jorge from Bana and wait staff Joel Rojano from Fuego also exceeded all our expectations, they were professional, friendly, courteous and truly strived to make everything perfect and accommodating. My husband wanted to move in. 

Will definitely be back there soon.

reviews.author: lsmiley20
reviews.title: Wonderful dinner service!
reviews.text: Rafael was wonderful at Bana! The Japanese menu offered delicious food and sushi and the amazing service was so appreciated!  You took great care of us and our children. Thank you Rafael for the great dinner experience.

reviews.author: Dalia A
reviews.title: 4 night getaway!
reviews.text:
My boyfriend and I spent 4 nights at the paradisus Cancun, we upgraded to the reserve package and it was so worth it. We had our own butler, Rodolfo, who was so welcoming, he showed us to our room, explained to us all the resort has to offer, he made our dinner reservations every night and also scheduled our covid antigen testing. He was very attentive and always asked what we needed. Definitely made us feel at home! 
The food was great, drinks strong, and service was wonderful. Our room was very clean and always had fresh towels. The breakfast buffet at Malva was perfect to get the day started. The quesadillas and cesare salad at the palapa (only for reserve members) was our go to for snacks and to lay on the balinesa.
Strongly recommended! Thanks rodolfo!

reviews.author: Andy Truesdale
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: We had the most amazing time during our stay at Paradisus. I visit cancun often and this has to be the best resort I have ever stayed in. Amazing food, clean, and amazing staff. Our host Rodalfo was incredible and helped us out with everything and anything we wanted. Jimmy and Hugo at vento restaurant were awesome , Miguel working at the Palapa was the best and we loved Cesar at Fuego restaurant. Loved the staff loved the hotel what a great experience. We cant wait to go back!

reviews.author: Naomi M
reviews.title: Girls vacation
reviews.text:
Wonderful food. Great rooms. 
The staff was amazingly wonderful and helpful everywhere. 
We so enjoyed our stretching, dancing and water aerobics with Dora and Wilber. 
So much fun!  Amazingly nice and fun hosts!

reviews.author: Cindy F
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text: Spent 9 days at the Paradisius with friends. Resort was clean and beautiful. Staff was exceptional. Everyone went out of there way to make sure you had everything you needed. Food however was not great. Buffett foods were always cold. Reservation restaurants were much better. Vento and Fuego had wonderful menus, but not much to choose from. Entertainment was always outside, so acts were hard to see and sometimes weather could be a distraction. Good resort for the money.

reviews.author: Rubina M
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation - family concierge
reviews.text:
just returned from a 1 week holiday at Paradisus Cancun. This was our first all inclusive experience. We took our two daughters 7, 4, with us and opted for the 1bdrm lagoon view suite. We also signed up for family concierge.  I read alot of reviews and can see why some had an amazing time and others sadly did not. We had a great time and i think its mostly due to our butlers Gloria and Brenda. They took all the brain work out of everything for us...from booking restaurants each night to ensuring we had all ammenities and offers available to us. Majority of restaurants require reservations and so did the daily activities.  Paradisus is like a well oiled machine and they run with precision.  So much  thought in everything...daily incense burning throughtout the resort, staff raking seeweed from beach each morning, scrubbing the pool throughout the day. So much care to ensure we have a good time. 
The butlers are amazing! Do yourself the favour and go that route. In speaking with other guests it seemed those who didnt opt for concierge were the ones who a just ok time...it is hard to find info, directions, costs etc without the butler help. 
The food. So wonderful. We didn't have one bad meal while we were there.  The eating is a bit formal, where even at buffet you need to be seated and greeted by staff. Dress code is resort casual though. Everyday the buffet was slightly different, with mexican, NA and basic breakfast options. Coffee is good and always hot. The restaurants are very good. Portions are great, and each restaurant is different from the rest...this makes a difference after a few days! House wine is a decent table wine. My preferred drink was premium tequila lime margarita. 
There was also alot of attention to our kids. Each night they had cookies and milk waiting for them and every other day or so they received a special suprise. From toys, to crayons to a large octopus balloon in the tub! Our final night, we had a bottle of champagne,  chocolate covered strawberries for us and a tradition mexican puppet for the girls. 
The service is above anything i have seen...
Tips- if its a nice day, go and get your pool chair. But if you dont get around to it, 1pm is usually good time to try again. Try all the restaurants! 
if  are looking for high activity, this isnt your place. Its relaxation and very low key. Even the swim up bar was  and just right for us. 
Im really glad we went with paradisus.

reviews.author: TheCentury
reviews.title: 5 Days in Paradise! Perfect Weather! Perfect Beach! Perfect Service!
reviews.text:
We had a great time at the Paradisus Cancun Resort, this was our second visit. The room (#2015) was extremely large with an Ocean view! They come with a fridge stocked with beer and water (glass bottles of water, nice touch.) We were upgraded, do to our loyalty with the Melia Company which was nice because we bought the cheapest room which we still though was on the high side for price for the area but the service is the reason why... You are going to have access to the a la carte restaurants at night but the Malva buffet will be the main restaurant you will be eating at, mostly breakfast and lunch. There was one particular waiter who always went above and beyond taking care of my wife and I while we dine in and thought it was important to mention in this review, most of the wait staff was good but the one I wanted to mention name is Javier Zalasar. It was of great amazement of how he treated us, with his attention to detail being second to none. He even on a couple of occasions, when the restaurant wasn't complete full, would take my wifes plate from her on her way back from the food bar and carry it to the table we were sitting at. The is my defintion of a waiter who is a real professional. This extra bit of service is what makes this the 5 Star review. This is the service that makes me loyal to the Melia Brand. Our worst meal was at Enso but the service was still good, my wife enjoys Indian and Thai cusine but still did not believe it was prepared correctly. Mole is our favorite with good service and good food. Get the Coconut cream dessert. The atomostphere at Fuego is hectic but a nice change of pace and still delicious food and great service. 

The beach view is absolutely heavenly with no seaweed and great water clarity. The water is rough so this wouldn't be ideal for little kids but we had fun crashing into the waves with the GoPro. We travel a lot and have found only one beach the comes close to the color of that water, in Saona Island Dominican Republic, you will see silimarlities in the beauty. They have shows at night (dance, magic, acrobatics) and a night club with a DJ (Club and lounge music.) Coco beach bar is the smoking spot and has good hookah!, again great service.

The only area of improvement i can mention is although the room was very large with a great view, it appears to be time for a renovation. The lamp shades had stains on them and the power outlets didn't offer USB ports. These are modern amenities that have become standard in 2020 at hotels around the world. We looked into upgrading to Royal Service but didn't feel that the $100USD a day could be justified for the service offered. If you come as a couple and won't want to be around children then Royal Service would be your only option to avoid the families and FYI this is listed as a family resort.

reviews.author: Darrell W
reviews.title: 5 Star Goods & Services Not Offered Automatically / Timeshare Greeting
reviews.text:
I just returned from a 10 nights vacation at the Paradisus Cancun. The facilities were clean and well maintained. 
The staff were great and the buffet meals were ok. The specialty restaurants were a plus and I enjoyed the meals they served. I have vacationed at many 5 star hotels from Hawaii to Jamaica. I was disappointed at having to request goods and services automatically offered at other 5 star resorts. 
I had to request bathrobe and slippers as there were none in the room upon arrival. 
I was lead to believe by the snack guy replenishing the fridge that the only snacks available were chips. I had that corrected quickly by calling the front desk staff. 
I spent the first 2 nights with no turndown service and cleaning in the evening and had to call the front desk again to request the service. At other 5 star hotels the service is automatic. 
Upon arriving at the Paradisus Cancun I was greeted by a rep who introduced me to the facilities at the Paradisus lookand later attempted to give me a timeshare pitch. I wasn't impressed. 
Pool towels were not properly checked out and in by staff by taking room numbers from hotel guests. 
As a result rather than guests returning towels to the staff in the towel shack the towels were left on lounge chairs making other guests believe that the lounges were being occupied and not available. Quite a nuisance. I understand many towels were stolen by hotel guests too.

reviews.author: Tayo
reviews.title: The food is not great and service could be better.
reviews.text:
The dinners were consistently below par and with the exception of a Peruvian gem of a restaurant called Fuego, I  would’ve had no joy as far as lunches and dinners are concerned. 

The second con was the frequent up-selling tactics of some of the restaurant employees.  I feel that they need to be re-trained. They come on too hard and are obvious in being overly eager. 

The last con is that for the first time in my life I was propositioned to buy some cocaine as I was at the beach. I’m not sure what can be done to prevent this from happening as far as security is concerned but it’s a bit scary that there’s nothing in place to prevent that type of person from accessing the hotel’s beach area. In the very least, there are families with kids to protect. 

On a positive note, the hotel architecture and infrastructure are just fantastic. Just a beautifully amazing place to take-in aesthetically.

We stayed at the Royal Service garm of the hotel and so we were provided with a butler called Alex. He was good. He was helpful, knowledgable, resourceful and patient. Funnily enough, I spoke to another couple who also spoke well of him.

The buffet breakfast was always well stocked with a lot of variety. No complaints.

reviews.author: R772KMbarbaral
reviews.title: Fabulous Resort
reviews.text: We stayed in the Family Concierge area with Alexa as our amazing butler. She gave us such wonderful service and followed through on everything we asked of her.  Paradisus is SO lucky to have her employed there.  The resort has excellent housekeeping staff and our room was kept immaculate.  The food is excellent, especially in the buffet area and in the Japanese restaurant.  The servers were so nice. I wish I could remember more names, but Alexandro and Dania were so kind, patient, and couldn’t do enough to make us satisfied.  They should be specially recognized.  This was my family’s first visit to Paradisus Cancun And we highly recommend this resort for terrific vacation!!

reviews.author: syphane
reviews.title: 5 Star Resort!!!
reviews.text: I can't wait to have the opportunity to go back to Cancun, I will definitely be staying at the Paradisus Resort, it was everything and more!!! The resort is amazing, it will definitely be a lifetime memory for sure! It has been 2 weeks and I am still talking about the resort, the employees, the beach.  Everything was beautiful! This is definitely a 5 star resort! I would recommend any and everybody to experience Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: karinagarcia0183
reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text: It was a wonderful stay! We all had a great time! We were a family of 11 and all had plenty to do, we really enjoyed the Water Aerobics with Agustin and the service by the waiters at the Bali Beds was awesome!

reviews.author: Kbenton
reviews.title: Best breakfast waiters!!
reviews.text: Atilano and Martin were the best waiters! They made our 2 and 6month old so happy every morning. We thoroughly enjoyed our whole stay but to start the morning out with two rockstars that make our kids smile, was an amazing start. Can’t wait to come back.

reviews.author: Amy D
reviews.title: LETS TRY THIS AGAIN
reviews.text:
Since our trip to Melia Paradisus in December 2019, I have been debating how to write this review because when we originally stayed in Feb 2019 we stayed as not the full Royal Service but as an add on when checking in. Since both services were so different and we returned due to a previous negative experience that corporate wanted to remedy, see previous review, this isn’t an updated review, but a new review based on our second experience returning in the full Royal Service.

Much better!! No upsell‘s this time! And same great service from the staff! Daniel was there once again leading his team to victory but now there was a new fabulous addition; the new manager, Ramon. They are a dynamic duo and trying the highlight of both trips. 

Wasn’t worth the butler service… While the butlers are very nice, they weren’t really around to build that personal connection, and if you’re there for a week the butlers do have days off. Our butler was very responsive and very sweet and we enjoyed getting to know her but unfortunately we only had 2 days from the week with her and then we were passed off to another butler and two days later another. Also, one of the big downfalls in my last review were the restaurants and how hard it was to get a reservation so most of the time you’re eating in the main buffet. It was still a huge challenge this go-round even with a butler to make your reservations. Again, most meals we ate the snacks the Royal Lounge or at the poolside Royal restaurant La Palapa. 

The staff was raving about the new international buffet a.k.a. the main buffet, it was newly renovated since we had been there the first time, and while it was fine and offered many many many options, it’s a bummer that they took out an actual restaurant to make the main buffet larger. Maybe this is how they intend to accommodate the lack of reservations…

AND FINALLY, OMG PLEASE CHANGE YOUR TOILET PAPER TO UNSCENTED!!! - thank God I remembered this from our last stay and brought my own toilet paper roll, but this is a huge problem! I ran out of my roll the last day and had to use a very small amount of the hotel toilet paper in our last hours and yet again (both trips I encountered this from vacationing here) suffered a UTI when returning home. Women’s bits are sensitive and scented toilet paper is not good for anyone’s health; leads to UTI’s and yeast infections (I know bc I got one both times after returning from our week stays and had to see a doctor). 

All in all - great experience this time and it was 100% better, but I would be curious if it’s only bc of our complaint to corporate or if this will be the new standard for guests going forward? And although no improvements this trip were gigantic I do think the improvements made were vast. 

Recap:
No upsells which was GREAT!
Still lacking at dinner reservations
Consistent incredible restaurant staff!
CHANGE TOILET PAPER

Last plug: splurged on Tempo and it was worth every penny. Excellent job. Look for a separate review.

reviews.author: Anne G
reviews.title: Amazing Paradisus
reviews.text: This is our 3 time staying at Paradisus Cancun. We have stayed at many hotels in the Cancun area and always come back to Paradisus. The Royal Service is amazing with everything you need. Thank you Leslie for making our stay great again. Also want to thank Eddy who does an amazing job on the Beach and Angel who was our friend at Mole and the Taco restaurant next door. We will be back for sure.

reviews.author: Ioanna N
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, but limited space.
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed here for a quick 3 day getaway last week.  The hotel is beautiful! The lobby is stunning and lush.  The service at check-in was..ok. There was a mixup with our room, we wanted a king junior ocean view suite.  They put us in a double room.  After waiting on the phone for half-hour, hubby finally just went to lobby to complain.  After some arguing, they provided us with the room we originally booked.  First off, whoever had the idea to place tall planters on the balcony was crazy. They COMPLETELY obstruct your view.  Oceanview means standing unconfortably at cement planters to see it.  Bad idea.  It wasn't just ours, this is every room.  

The hotel has several options for dining, however if you want to make reservations, you must do so before you ever arrive at the hotel because they are full...constantly. the restaurants are so small, seating is very limited so you are unable to make reservations at any of them even with 3 days as we had.  

The hotel is huge.  There ARE five pools, however only one has a swim-up bar and the others are fairly small.  Also, beach chairs are also very limited.  I'd go down at 7am to watch the sunrise and they were all reserved then!  It's a shame to have such a large hotel, and such limited space!  With the number of families, young children, it's difficult to find anywhere to sit in the afternoons.  

With so many other options, larger pools, more swim-up bars, better service, and activities, we won't be coming back here.

reviews.author: Majeed
reviews.title: Amazing resort.
reviews.text:
It was a beautiful and huge resort. Clean, elegant, with complete facilities. 
The best part was the amazing butler Javier who can make dreams come true.
The food is ok, but not the best.
The beach is magical.
I also loved the gym as they have good equipments.

reviews.author: john m
reviews.title: Feb 2020 Family Vacay a Success!!!
reviews.text: This was our 2nd time to this resort. It was the first time using the family concierge...which was so great for not only our kid and his friend, but for my wife and I to get some alone time together. Rodolfo and Fernando were amazing as our butlers-- Highly recommend them!! The food is amazing with your choice of cuisine each evening, ranging from American, Italian, Japanese, Asian Fusion, Peruvian... just to name a few. We had GREAT entertainment each night...I actually had to do the limbo, which was quite funny!!! Weather was great. resort is great for kids and families. service awesome. We will be back for sure.

reviews.author: Lynn H G
reviews.title: February staff at Paradisus Cancun Royal Service
reviews.text: We travel each winter and Mexico has become our destination of choice, based on reviews we looked fwd to the Royal Svc at Paradisus but it did not live up to our expectations.  Smooth and quick checkin process although there was a little pressure to attend a time share presentation; our firm no addressed this.  When introduced to our butler we learned we needed to download an app to communicate with him. Potential to be efficient and effective but responses were inconsistent - some delays were by several hours (up to 24). We mainly used this for dinner reservations.  Service was also slow at the restaurants and food quality was not as good as we hoped. We also booked an ocean view but the view was limited. A bit disappointing.  If you are sensitive to scents be aware there is a lot of incense used everywhere and was quite strong.  We had great service at the pool and really appreciate Aaron’s efforts.  The water in pool was so warm; the beach was lovely too however every day was a red flag day. If you are looking for evening entertainment or daytime activities this resort had little to offer. We did appreciate how attentive staff was really attentive to the cleanliness of the resort and this was evident everywhere we went.  Housekeeping did a good job on our room but on last two nights we were left short on towels even when we asked for more.  When we checked out the process again was very quick. Surprised that we did not get assistance with our luggage as there were lots of stairs and quite a distance to main lobby.  Would we go back? Not to this resort unfortunately but definitely toMexico.

reviews.author: Rick R
reviews.title: Excellent food/drinks and great atmosphere and very clean beach
reviews.text: Great place to stay...room was very clean, as was the beach.  Staff was friendly and very helpful. Restaurants had good food for being an all you can eat style, and bars were great as were the drinks.  Resort overall is beautiful and very clean.. Some arears need updating but it appears that they are working on that.  The only real comlaint I had was the check-in process.....it was very slow (took over an hour) and the desk was lacking staff.

reviews.author: elickstein2
reviews.title: February 2020 Family Vacation
reviews.text:
My Wife and I went to the Paradisus Cancun and stayed in a Family Concierge Lagoon View Room. This was our first stay at a Melia Resort and truly enjoyed our week! We traveled with our two kids (2 and 4) and found the kids pool to be spectacular - we've done a number of all inclusive trips and thought that this was the best kids pool around. The beach set-up is wonderful as well - can't beat the white sand!!

What sets this property apart, in my mind, is the service of the staff. Overall, everyone on staff was extremely friendly, helpful and attentive. The "Fuego" waiters went over and above to make sure we had everything we needed at breakfast/lunch. 

I'll also add that the food was very good and the restaurant experiences were tremendous. Also, the alcohol options, especially for tequila and mezcal were broad, varied and wonderful. 

We had a great experience and look forward to going back to this and other Melia Resorts!

reviews.author: 997shaun
reviews.title: Nice resort but lacking in entertainment activies and terrible food.
reviews.text: I stayed here with my family 2 kids under 4. Nice resort but lacking in entertainment activies and terrible food. There was no yoga for example on the beach no volleyball nothing. The place was focused on house music and drinking not ideal for a young family. We got lucky the weather was perfect staff friendly but they create a division of people of class when you are in the resort to pay extra for different beach chairs etc.. I would not come back becuase the food was terrible specfically a restaruant called Mole. This was terrible food. It was overpriced place I should of went to super clubs for this price sandals. I'm going back to cruises in future.

reviews.author: Lindsey M
reviews.title: First timers to Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
We are first timers at Paradisus Cancun. We have traveled 3 other times to Paradisus La Perla in Playa Del Carmen.

Stats:
1. Grounds were beautiful
2. The beach is white sand, no rocks, crystal clear water, stunning
3. Oceanview room is a must
4. Close to airport, 15min ride
5. Every employee was so helpful and friendly.
6. Lots of chairs by pool, bali beds. Never an issue getting one. 
7. We are Club Melia members and were treated like royalty. 
8. Malava the new buffet restaurant was very good!
9. Vento was our Favorite resturant. Very very good. 
10. Drinks flow all day long and not very weak :)

Shout out toGaude in Malava....he is an amazing waiter!, Lilian in Club Melia...very helpful and friendly, Alejandra in club melia....set everything thing up we asked for and very friendly, Carlos in club melia was also amazing! 

If your double guessing resort, please don't. Its fantastic.

reviews.author: Michael T
reviews.title: Not for kids : Don’t come with kids
reviews.text:
Arrived first day , changed kids, went to buffet , Hostes Mar said they can’t wear swim wear and we need to change.. toolk may starving kids to change again.. came back in 30 minutes.. she said they are closed .. still starving and cranky kids .. we go to the grill.. slim pickings .. no chicken nuggets in the entire resort , good burgers if you get the 175$ a day cabana.. 2nd day we walk in to the marva buffet the same girl Mir, tells my wife she doesn’t like that her dress is opened at the top and we need to go change
.. I asked for the manager Guervo .. who tried to tell me the same until he saw her and then he just walked away .. the rest of the resort is not bad.. adult food and drinks are very good.. don’t come here with kids

reviews.author: jgoldie
reviews.title: Gorgeous resort
reviews.text: This is a beautiful resort inside & out. Great staff always friendly and helpful. We have been coming here for 20+ years and love it. The check in process for member services is brutal 30 min + to check in & 30 min + to check out. This needs to be changed....Who wants to spend that kind of time on vacation??? It should be a few minutes for check in & out. The hotel guest can check in & out quickly..why can't members??? This NEEDS to change......They have entertainment every night. Which is usually pretty good. Although this week it was hard to see. We miss the Michael Jackson show they usually have. It would be nice if they had chairs around the pool to see the shows... the high tables should be set way back... they block the view for everyone else. This is in the hotel zone right next to the JW Marriott.  It's about 20min from the airport. The pools are beautiful.  There is a swim up bar. The beach is huge. There could be more chairs & umbrellas around the pool so people don't take other people's chairs & umbrellas. I saw other vacationers removing personal stuff from chairs & taking them. Unfortunately there are people from other countries that this is common practice but just maybe if there were enough chairs they wouldn't do it. Always a great vacation & excellent place to stay and one of the most beautiful resorts in Cancun.

reviews.author: Jarrod K
reviews.title: A winter getaway!
reviews.text:
we were here 3 1/2 yrs ago and wanted to visit again.
Some noticeable wear on the rooms, slight decrease in food quality and great service in general.
I would recommend this place to anyone a quality place to get away as an all inclusive.

reviews.author: Kiki
reviews.title: Meh
reviews.text:
With all the other choices in the area, this resort needs some improvements to be competitive.  Good points:  families with small children love it (good news for families with small children);  beach is one of the best we've stayed in the area; food pretty good; friendly staff; close to airport.

Not so good:   Reservations needed TWO days ahead for most restaurants other than buffett; Needs a facelift around resort; Air conditioning in our room totally didn't work and we complained twice;  no "big" shows like other resorts which are kinda fun; bathrooms way too far from pool....hmmm...I've had intestinal issues for 5 days and counting now🤢.

Bottom line:  to each their own.  This resort is not for us.

reviews.author: write_to_me___
reviews.title: Golf at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
I noticed not much said about the golf course, so will tell you about my experience. 
Cost is $25.US for your clubs which include pw,sw, putter 7 & 8 iron in a small golf bag. All holes are par 3.
This can be picked up at a place called "the store" lower level building 3. Balls are extra charge so we had our own.
Most holes are marked once you find hole number one, which  is beside practice putting area. 
Grass is not cut short so you are playing in the rough the whole time. Which means if you try to bounce it onto the green, it would just stop dead. Greens are just ok and are not fast. 
You have to sign a form before you play that says you are responsible for any damage. 
I can see why as a few holes are close to traffic and hole #9 is beside a parking lot with a lot of nice cars. 
We just played it once and took about an hour for 9 holes, we were losing the ball even when we were on the fairway as it sinks down in the grass. 
The course is only open till 1 pm, not sure why maybe because it's too hot after that. 
Hope this helps as I could not find much information about this before my trip.

reviews.author: kram102
reviews.title: What a great vacation
reviews.text: What a great vacation form the time I got here from the time I left what a place I will be back and George my butler he was fabulous and I will let everyone I come in contacted with how great this place is thank you again

reviews.author: talbott1976
reviews.title: Great beachfront
reviews.text: Great beachfront. I saw several beaches with other hotels and this one was perfect! Not a lot of activities, but it was very relaxing and wonderful experience. We are going to have a hard time beating this trip.

reviews.author: Patrick W
reviews.title: Beautiful hanging garden atrium
reviews.text: This is pyramid shaped resort with a golf course. Aqua world is just across the road. The main focal point is the central atrium with plants hanging down all the way from 8th floor. It is quite spectacular. All the restaurants are located around the atrium.The main one is the buffet. The others are quite small with limited menus. The white sand beach is wide and stretches a long way. There are plenty of lounge chairs and I have no problems in getting one. There are 2 large pools but no infinity pool though. There is no theater but has a nightly entertainment around the pool. They are usually acrobatic acts and dance which are better than the other resorts. All in all it is a pleasant resort but I like the sister hotel Paradisus del Carmen La perla better. The rooms and foods are better over there except for the beach.

reviews.author: Lola O
reviews.title: Needs improvement
reviews.text:
The hotel was beautiful and the location/beaches were breath taking!!
The waitstaff was attentive and kind.

However, for the amount of money that is paid to stay at this hotel, they need to be more accommodating and honor what guests paid for.

Neither my friends or I (2 rooms reserved between the 3 of us) were what we paid for. When we went to the front desk to ask to switch to the correct rooms, they originally refused and referred to a ridiculous disclaimer on the website. This is unacceptable. They eventually moved us, but they made it very difficult.

They also fumigated my room in the middle of my stay. This is absolutely not okay. If a room needs maintenance, do not book it until complete.

reviews.author: Daniel G
reviews.title: Can't give a 4, sorry Paradisus, needs to improve
reviews.text:
My family and I just returned home from Paradisus Cancun. Stayed there 5 nights and six days.
