It's our third time in Cancun. Also been in cruises,  Dominican Republic, Spain, france, Italy, Norway, Denmark, Finland, Estonia, Canada, Bahamas,  Chile, Peru, Colombia, Brazil, Panama,  among others. So I'm not a rookie traveler.

Yes thos Hotel is outdated but that's not the problem. There are several major issues with this potential great place:

1. Infrastructure 
It's a mess having to go up stairs and down stairs all the time cause pyramid 1 ONLY communicates with pyramid 2 in 1 floor. And same between 2 and 3. So from our room to go to lower level and the major restaurant we needed to go down to then go up.

This hotel has little real estate. Yes, we were while hotel was  85-90% full but there was a line to get breakfast at 8am. The place is designed not considered people flow, so accumulates people in certain areas and makes it over crowded. 

There are also 1 unique breakfast place, in a buffet restaurant, where you need to make a line. No other options and people are forced to crowd some areas.

There is also a need to grab a place in the beach or at the pool before 8AM. There are several hits left, but no resting "reclaiming chairs". How can you explain that?

There are two lounges, one is never used, red lounge, and the other and open space with sort of Bali beads with very loud music, electronic music, not appealing to the non millenial guests. This place needs some serious musical consultant,  musical selection at the pool and beach is deeply needed. Were in a tropical place, relaxing and all music is for electronic partying. 

The restaurant, newley renovated is uninviting and poorly designed. People come and go, again no flow, so always crowded and you have to bump to everyone, and different to ikea, again, there is not a smart flow of traffic.

Did I mention wait in line? Possibly understaffed also. Too many co charges all over the hotel trying to upsell Melia Club CIRCLE but not so many servers. And some empty staples that can be rotated faster.

Finally. Very important,  this place needs a pastry chef. Not even ice cream is good desserts are really, really, really way below average. Everyday, incredibly, in all restaurants, especially in the main, awful, desert is a treat, on vacation is important. Really poor selection, not fun, not tasty.

Finally, lack of Mexican experience. We really wanted a real mexican experience. The night we set aside for the non reservation was closed when hotel busy. Not even a quesadilla,  fajita, kind of disappointing.

Finally, the "Hispanic manana syndrome" . 10AM can be 10 or 10:30AM. This means checknin and check out are a nightmare. Specially checkin. They have credit card, all info, taking a copy of a passport and keys should be simple, but takes for ever. Even more disgusting, you are bombarded by these converges trying to trick you to give them 90 minutes (it's really way more than that) to listen to a sales speech to get you to purchase circle membership. You are tired from a long day, flights, airport drop off and pick up. You want to get vacation started ASAP and you are in a check in process that takes 20 min wait and then 30 min for them wanting your attention at the worse possible time....

reviews.author: jomodt1582
reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text: The best part of our stay was Miguel our pool/beach side server.  He was outstanding and very kind.  I have been to several resorts and he was the best.  Always there to greet us in the morning with a smile on his face.  He always made sure we had a glass of cold water waiting for us when we came back from the ocean or a walk.

reviews.author: Emily
reviews.title: Of all the all-inclusive resorts...Paradisus leaves something to be desired.
reviews.text:
We've done a February trip to an all-inclusive resort in Cancun the past 5 years.  We "upgraded" this year and paid a little more to go to Paradisus (last year we did Panama Jacks and I have to say - it was nicer...AND $500+ less!!).  However, even though we thought we upgraded, we left with just an "okay" rating.  It was fine - the rooms were clean and nothing terrible happened.  However, there was really nothing to brag about.  

My biggest complaint - the buffet was quite terrible.  NO variety...day-to-day the only fresh order options was the pasta station and with one slow employee working, it was at LEAST a 10 minute wait.  There were also no "kid friendly" options which EVERY other hotel we've stayed at offered.  Also, 2 out of 7 people in our party did get VERY sick from the food (one of which was my kiddo) which we've never had happen in our previous Mexico stays.

Service was fine - staff were all very friendly but SO SLOW.  I know things are more laid back and slow in Mexico.  However, things were SO SLOW.  Check-in took 25 minutes and we were the ONLY ONES THERE.  I already mentioned the pasta station...

We paid for the family concierge - the two gals we had helping us were very nice and responsive but the other benefits were minimal.  The "family lounge" that was supposed to have snacks and beverages available was never stocked - couldn't get a beer, diet coke, or bottled water half the time because it was never stocked.  They had a bunch of booze out but no mixers because the other beverages were empty.  Totally worthless benefit.

I don't normally leave reviews but I was really looking forward to an upgraded experience this year and was very disappointed.  Hopefully I can stop someone else from making the same mistake!

reviews.author: Cindy M
reviews.title: Waiters at Buffet
reviews.text: Tomas,Ricardo, and Malva gave great guest services. Our group was always waited on in a timely manner. We were always greeted with a smile and provided everything we asked for. Our group of 8 requested their tables for breakfast and lunch. Service like this keeps us coming back!

reviews.author: Mohit Gupta
reviews.title: Good resort, but highly irresponsible reservation staff
reviews.text:
Our experience, frankly, was quite terrible. I had made the reservation for my parents. When they arrived at the resort, they were harassed by the reception and reservation staff. Their reason? They wanted me (the person who made the reservation) to be traveling with them. This would have been fine had this been specified when the reservation was being made. However, in the reservation form, I CLEARLY specified that I'm making the payment, and that the guests will be my parents (I put their names down). Despite this, and the fact that their entire stay was pre-paid for, the staff kept harassing them. They even got me to send several documents to them, which I promptly did. 

This was painful, but, I would have understood, and put this down to miscommunication. However, unfortunately, it got worse. During check-in, they AGAIN charged a credit card my parents were carrying for the entire stay (about $1200). After this confusion was resolved, they promised to refund this within 3 days. It has been more than 3 weeks now, and they **still** haven't refunded it. I have written and called several times, but haven't even received a reply. They are taking advantage of the fact that I cannot travel there from a different country. This is unprofessional at best, and bordering on criminal since they have double charged my card and are completely ignoring my requests to refund. 

I had very high hopes, but, am quite disappointed and frustrated because (a) they harassed my elderly parents for no fault of theirs (it is really a bug in their reservation system), (b) I was double charged, and (c) they are not even responding to my emails to correct this (they were extremely responsive when they wanted something from me).

reviews.author: rockglenlmjohn
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
This particular hotel is located in a very appealing and attractive spot. The White sand beaches were incredible and it’s location for shopping and restaurants was ideal. The employees were very friendly and helpful. Room service was impeccable. 
This hotel is very pricey. I am not sure what employees are paid but they depend heavily on tips. I am not sure if the stay was worth the money spent. The rooms are starting to show their age. Pin holes in the blackout shades, taps backwards, and food at Buffet is not up to prices charged. Hot food warm at best and foods that are cold are under lights so questionable. Hair salon changed $80.00 US for a wash and blow dry.  That was totally a rip off. If you are a member of one of their time share plans it might be worth the money they charge but if you are planning a stay st the Paradisus without a time share plan. Definitely not worth the money

reviews.author: Jaison98
reviews.title: Don’t expect good service
reviews.text:
What a bizarre stay. The Paradisus Royal Service does so many things right but always finds a way to make you say “huh?” 

The Good: 
- Some of the best liquor selections I’ve ever seen at an all-inclusive resort (Grey Goose and more in Royal Service). Note: I said liquor - the free wines were below average and the mixed drinks were hit and miss. 
- The food at most restaurants was above average quality for resorts and the buffet had a number of great options 
- The entire establishment was clean (except all the flies on the food in Royal Service) and housekeeping did a very thorough job each time they came 

However the contact problem for us was often aloof and generally disorganized service

Here’s an example from our first moments there. Getting out of the cab, we were warmly greeted and provided a face towel. A gentleman took our luggage and we were guided to go through the door to the left. Inside someone said they’ll be with us in a minute so we sat with our towels... and continued to sit longer. Around a corner I found welcome snacks and quality Moet champagne available. I proceeded to open a new bottle (as the previous one was closed) and enjoyed a wonderful first drink. Still clutching my dirty face towel and sipping champagne, I found a table where several other guests had tossed their used towels and proceeded to add mine to the collection. After about 10 mins, my name was called and I was asked to follow an associate to Royal Service. He spoke a little but was mostly glued to his phone, laughing at what apparently was a funny situation with coworkers. Finally (I mean it really was over a 5 min walk) we reached the checkin desk. A new associate asked for our passports and spent the next 15 minutes getting us checked in. This process should have taken about 3 minutes given we checked in online but we sat though it.

Soon after, our butler arrived and guided us to our beautiful room. Things were looking up but he then informed us there were no reservations available at any of the restaurants during our stay but if we text him ahead of time next time we visit he can help. Wow... not helpful and honestly confusing as the hotel appeared very empty on our mid-week stay. 

Throughout our trip, a series of the butler telling us he could get us into restaurant X at a certain time, us showing up and not being able to get in, a series of chaotic events and then suddenly we have a table occurred on multiple evenings. I could go on but TA says we’re done!

reviews.author: baga862020
reviews.title: Not the paradisus you are used to
reviews.text: this place was not nearly as good as the paradisus in playa del carmen. Food for below expectation with poor presentation, no steakhouse in 5 star hotel....wow. No life flowers, no theme drinks that were introduced in playa. only 3 types of beer available no corona or modelo, shame. Drinks were very inconsistent at each bar, and they all had maracuia fruit in them. Only good food was at the taco joint, buffet was decent too. Place was clean, and had beautiful beach. bring your own toothpaste.

reviews.author: behrang2020
reviews.title: Had amazing vacation
reviews.text: One of the cleanest and best hotels that I've ever been there so far. Their staff are very nice and friendly and ready to help you at anytime. Their amenities are very clean. They make every thing ready for you to get relax.

reviews.author: Shergril-La
reviews.title: Disappointing for a Paradisus
reviews.text:
We have been to both the Paradisus Playa Del Carmen and Cabo San Lucas in the last 2 years and loved them. This one is more of a 3 star because of services and condition of rooms - Tub is cracked and mirror is all spotted. 
Rooms are very rundown and need renovations although common areas are stunning. 
The other Paradisus' we had gourmet coffee shops but none here. They put out a coffee station that ran out of coffee. They didn’t have pool towel cards available until second day and pool chairs don't recline flat which is a bit annoying. Good wifi though.
Way better sister hotels in playa del Carmen and Cabo where I'd choose again.

reviews.author: Alexa Croce
reviews.title: Highly recommend staying here if you are traveling to Cancun
reviews.text: I have been to this resort 3 times. I have stayed at other Paradisus and Melia locations and nothing compares to this one. From the view of the ocean from the balcony to the food and the staff! I will forever make this my go to resort.

reviews.author: ls5j
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: We continue to return to this resort, and are never disappointed! The beach and pools are beautiful, and the atrium is spectacular. Staff is always friendly, and plenty of choices for dinner. We had butlers this time, and they were very helpful and cheerful. We also love the private balconies. Can't beat Paradisus!

reviews.author: Jingo99
reviews.title: Better places. Do your research
reviews.text:
Room was a good standard for a standard room however they put you above the night time disco so you have to pay to upgrade to a better location. Sea View from 2nd floor was good though. 

The buffet food was very good for a buffet and the drink service by the pool was good. 

Check out is interesting and I recommend do not charge anything to the room as they conveniently do not have change.... their little hands are twitching expecting it to be a tip.... this is stuff I’m paying for that I have been overcharged for at the hotel shop!!! 

Vanessa on the reception of the restaurant felt like the only genuine staff member who was interested in you as a person not sizing you up for a tip.... probably the only person worthy of a tip! 

Coffee station was a good touch and the man in the nesspresso coffee shop tried hard but never listened to what you ordered. Coffee was good though. 

Clean surroundings and a busy hotel who favour the guests who are here on business or royal service. 

Irregular daytime entertainment at the pool..... shame as this could be so good everyday. 

Air con on room is hit and miss and WiFi too. Seemed dependant on number of ‘business’ guests in the hotel. 

Great location for bus into town. If not use Uber very cheap. 

I recommend doing the research as I feel for the money spent you could do better.

reviews.author: Adrian
reviews.title: High and Lows throughout the Trip
reviews.text:
I don't normally leave reviews, however this was a very interesting stay that I had at the Paradisus. We'll start with what we loved about the hotel.

Staff: A large majority of the staff was incredibly welcoming and helpful throughout our stay. Most of the staff work multiple zones throughout the day so they get to know you.

For breakfast: Hosts Vanessa and Noemi, and waiters Martin and Pascal were incredibly nice and welcoming.
Our bartenders at Avenue bar Luis & Luis were fantastic. We would come and grab a few drinks to take to our room and by the second night they already knew what we wanted.
Orlando from the Blue Agave restaurant was fantastic as well.

The hotel itself is absolutely gorgeous. You can tell they take pride in keeping the common areas clean and well maintained.

Overall the food in the hotel was great. You can't go wrong at the buffet and we went there almost everyday for some meal. Blue Agave, Bana the sushi restaurant, and Enzo were our favorites.

Now for some things we didn't love about it.

Restaurants: Making reservations for the restaurants is rather difficult. If you decide that day what restaurant you want to eat at you have to book before 5 PM. You can walk over but they make it seem like there is going to be a ridiculously long wait even though the hotel was largely unoccupied. Every restaurant we went to was pretty empty and we dined at various times between 7 and 10 PM throughout our stay. We came back from an excursion at 10PM exactly, I ran down to let the host know we were going to take ten minutes to change and she said she couldn't hold the reservation. There were four occupied tables in a restaurant of 40 tables.

The room left a lot to be desired. The bedside outlet was ripped out of the wall, and a few lights didn't work alongside the poorly laid out lights throughout. There were no hooks in the bathroom and the bathtub spout didn't work. The balcony had a great view of the ocean but they plant shrubs on the balcony to act as privacy. They directly block your ocean view when you're sitting down. The mini fridge was fully restocked every day which is awesome, but the water bottles are glass and they don't provide you with a bottle opener. I get that these are small things, but they should be thought about from a guest convenience aspect.

The pool bar is only open 11 to 6. So if you want to grab seats early because they filled up quick you'd only be able to drink brunch drinks within the breakfast area. Instead of making the pool a dry area until 11, confine it to brunch drinks until then. 

Finally, upon checkin they offer you time the next morning to plan out excursions and get a discount on other facilities in the hotel like the spa. In reality they sit you down for a Timeshare pitch that took up 2 hours of our day.

reviews.author: Kathleen P
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: The service in the buffet area was outstanding!! Loved the hotel and pool area!! The service and food were excellent!! The hotel was also excellent, the rooms clean. We had problems getting reservations to eat in the restaurants though!

reviews.author: Ralph S
reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: A wonderful experience with great pool, service, and food. Special people Daniel, Norma and all the waiters. They are the best. Make you want to come back. Anything you need help with, they are very happy to assist you

reviews.author: ikhawaja
reviews.title: Disappointment
reviews.text:
For the 1st time in 23 years I was disappointed in the service I received at Paradisus. We are Melia Club members who bought twice (Upgraded) because we love this resort. This time thou we felt unwelcome at times. Ate at Bana the 1st night the food was not as good as usual. we tried to eat at Fuego. After being seated we were given Menus that were without prices. We were then told we would have to pay the Buffet price to eat even if we only ordered one item or everything on the Menu. we walked out. Tried to eat twice at blue Agave. Once it was closed for a private party and another time we were told it will be available only after 8. The Marriott next door was happy to take our money and serve us an excellent meal Ala cart.
 Everything else was wonderful as usual. The workers were Friendly and as accommodating as possible. Paradisus has changed Managers and they need to take care of this disorganization quick.

reviews.author: JLL37353
reviews.title: Annual February Vacation
reviews.text: This place is fabulous! This was our second time at the Paradisus! We went 3 years ago, tried a couple of other all inclusives in between, but had to come back! They set the bar high! You won’t find better service anywhere!  The restaurants are great! You won’t find a better buffet! And, if you have the pleasure to sit and have Hector wait on you, you won’t be disappointed! He is fabulous! There are so many wonderful employees I can’t begin to name them all! If you sit by the pool, hopefully Miguel or Flor will be there to wait on you hand and foot! This trip confirmed that each February, there will only be 1 resort we will go to! The rooms are nice, each has a balcony to sit and enjoy the beautiful weather. We never have to worry about our belongings and they restock the mini fridge every morning! We always hate to leave and look forward to going back! Thank you for another fabulous week!

reviews.author: Dustinius
reviews.title: The Good, bad and ugly
reviews.text:
Just returned from an 8 night trip with my wife and another couple (without kids!!). 

The Good:
The grounds and beach are truly spectacular. Without this, I don’t think that the Paradisus Cancun would get away with calling their resort 5 star. 
The addition of a few hammocks throughout the resort would be welcomed, and please replace the lounge chairs!!! The majority do not lay flat and are very uncomfortable. The Bali beds are nice, but are only for those who wish to suffer through the timeshare/vacation club presentation or for those who upgraded to the “royal service”, or those who want to pay out of pocket. 
As for restaurants that are currently opened, the only ones that fit in the good category would be Vento and Fuego. If you are a foodie, then you will most likely agree that none should be considered 5 star dining, however, Vento and Fuego did satisfy. 
The service is very good. They are attentive and hard working. Please tip them appropriately... it was disgusting to see how many people I saw get up in the restaurants and leave nothing. Special shout-out to the boxer/waiter in the buffet and Fuego, Andres. He worked his butt off. 

The Bad: 
Blue Agave tacos were really bad. This is not something you can get wrong in Mexico, especially at a 5 star resort! The theme in most restaurants is that the food is prepared en-masse well before hand and kept out for long periods of time. This results in dry and cold food. This was evident in every single restaurant. Bana served me rock hard rice noodles in a stir fry! I understand that there are plenty of people to feed at once, but they need to sort out a system that allows them to at least reheat/flash-fry the food prior to serving it. 
The rooms on the Lagoon side could use some upgrading. They weren’t horrible, just a little dated. I don’t spend much time in my room, so it didn’t completely turn me off. Also, there are no hard alcohol dispensers in the room. I’ve stayed at several resorts, and this was a first. Not everybody wants beer. Granted, you could go to a bar to get a drink, sometimes it’s nice to make your own in the comfort of your room. 
The buffet food was hit-and-miss, which is to be expected. The lunch was pretty good, with many options, including sushi. However, they cheap out on the good stuff, like sashimi. They will put out one plate, and once it’s gone, they won’t replenish it. The amount of times I was told “sorry senior, no more left” was bothersome to say the least. Until they sort this out, I suggest arriving to the buffet at 1pm when it opens. 

The Ugly:
So many things are “extra”. If you don’t upgrade to the Royal Service, room service comes with a $5 fee. Speaking of room service, it was the worst I’ve ever had in my life. I tried almost everything on the “24 hour menu” and the only thing that was edible was the Caesar salad. 
Little things like coconut water and Perrier are “extra”. My wife and friend were told that the quesadillas that they were preparing at the pool-side snack bar were extra. Seriously? Tortillas and cheese? It’s not a “Most Inclusive”, it’s an “ALL Inclusive”. They really cheap out on many things! We were there for Super Bowl. If you wanted to sit down with a view of the screen, you had to pay $220 usd (for a group of 6), this came with perks, but not enough to make it worth it. If you wanted a difference tier of seating, you had to pay for an expensive bottle of wine. If you declined either, you were allowed in the “nose-bleed” section with the rest of the peasants. We all paid a lot of money to be at the resort, stop the penny pinching! 
The activities are non-existent and if you’re looking to come with kids, there is little to nothing for them to do. Moon Palace has a Wave simulator, and a full arcade, wave pool, lazy river, play centre for kids. Paradisus Cancun has nothing. We were without kids, but should we take our kids back to Cancun, it won’t be at the Paradisus. 
Their Gelato station was only opened sometimes. You’re a sunny, hot destination. Keep it open all day!! Also, not all restaurants were open everyday, and trying to get reservations is comical. You get the run-around daily. “Sorry senior, our system is down, please come back later” only to come back later to “sorry everything is booked, come back tomorrow”. They cater to the royal service people first, where reservations are completed via their personal concierge, and if there are any  tables left, you can maybe get in. They want you to eat in the buffet for every meal. My advice, don’t take no for an answer. Speak with the manager if need be. 
Is Royal Service worth it? They want you to think so as you pay top dollar for it. Do the math yourself. About $800 usd extra for a lame section of the hotel (everyone I spoke to said it was extremely boring there). In addition, you will have to tip your concierge another couple hundred. This gives you access to Bali beds for a couple days and allows you to eat at Palapa restaurant and you don’t pay the $5 room service charge. IMO, I’ll keep my $1000 and go to one of the several fabulous restaurants in close proximity of the hotel. 
Another thing worth noting; they water down their alcohol. If was extremely obvious, especially if you like things neat like me. 
All-in-all, I enjoyed myself! I definitely didn’t leave disappointed, however they need to make changes or stop claiming they are a 5 star resort.

reviews.author: thompayment
reviews.title: Amazing Family Vacation
reviews.text: Amazing family trip with 15 month old little girl. The staff was so friendly, and the service was top notch. The resort is absolutely stunning, and food is so good. We did not have one bad meal, and there was a lot of food for our little one to enjoy as well.

reviews.author: The Doctor D
reviews.title: Not 5 star.
reviews.text:
Pools are quite nice rooms ok.  Make sure if your booked here not to have a room on the 2nd floor we was kept up by the screaming and shouting Mexican and America drunks till about 2:15 am most nights.  Hotel staff in reception are just rude Miguel you should be a toilet cleaner not on the front desk.  What I noticed most is the only thing that motivates the people here is a nice big tip.  Money is all they want.   The hassle the staff give you to sell trips and treatments is way too much. 

As you can see this is not the hotel for me and this is just my opinion.   If you have a different view fair play. I feel this was more then likely a really good hotel once but has gone down hill.  

Pool bar waiters are good they keep coming round and getting you drinks. But I tipped well for that service.

reviews.author: rii2020
reviews.title: Best family vacation
reviews.text: This was our 3rd stay at a Paradisus Resort. Rodolfo and Fernando took such good care of us through family concierge. Everyone is so genuinely kind and attentive. The kids had so much fun at the pool. The beach was gorgeous, clean of seaweed. The night time entertainment was a lot of fun. Never ending options for food.

reviews.author: Aula K
reviews.title: Best experience
reviews.text: I can not say enough about this beautiful breathtaking property. The service is out of this world. We got the Family Concierge package which was the best choice we had made. Everything was top notch. The staff in this hotel is so attentive will go above and beyond to satisfy and fulfill your needs. Our concierge Alexa is the best. We loved dealing with her. Anytime you experience a small glitch you get someone on a matter of minutes to resolve the issue. The variety of food doesn't make you bored. You can literally eat something different every day. Landscape is a WOW! Caribbean Sea beauty that I am still dreaming about. The ocean breeze every morning made feel like a new person. The sunrise Oh My!!!! Entertainment was phenomenal. A resort that will fulfill your needs. I definitely recommend Meliá Chain of Hotels and In particular Paradisus. Loved it! My kids and husband want to go back.

reviews.author: BIll S
reviews.title: Getting a little tired
reviews.text: Throughout the week pretty-much every staff person that we interacted with were pleasant and helpful. The room:  Bed was very comfortable, but the air conditioning was a bit of a challenge to get right.  the room had its own wifi antenna, so the signal was great anywhere in the building (and throughout the grounds). Housekeeping were on their game and things were cleaned and tidied-up quite well.  It took a day-or-so to get the hot water working properly, but it worked-out.  Food: Just OK, but a la cartes seem to rotate opening and it was not possible for us to get what we wanted, either because there was no availability (which seemed odd as there were very few guests there), or it was closed on the days we wanted to go there.  The buffets are quite small in size and selection is limited.  Pools/Beach:  Both the general pool and the Reserve pool are very well maintained and there were lots of lounge chairs available, and I didn't notice any early morning "reservations" on chairs (which is a good thing).  Service around the pools was very sparse and I can't say that I saw someone gathering drink orders more than a couple of times per day.  The property backs onto a beautiful beach that is very deep and long enough to provide for a good long walk in either direction.  The waves were quite large the week that we were there but we did go out a ways and were impressed that the bottom is all sane; no weeds, mud, or rocks. Overall, it's a nice place but it can use some work on the meal side.

reviews.author: N G
reviews.title: A dream vacation at Paradisus Cancun!
reviews.text:
I read some of the negative reviews and I am seriously wondering whether these people actually stayed at this resort! We just got back from a week-long vacation at Paradisus Cancun and can honestly say it was a dream vacation! My husband and I stayed at Paradisus La Perla in Playa del Carmen in 2018 and loved the experience so much that we picked the Paradisus resort in Cancun for our family vacation. 

Paradisus Cancun is obviously an older resort, but there was always maintenance going on (nothing intrusive) that it's obvious that the owners and workers take great pride in this resort and want to keep it in tiptop and beautiful shape. We stayed in Family Concierge in an oceanview room, and that was a great decision. Not only were the views from our room stunning, but the service that comes with Family Concierge is outstanding. Upon arrival we were ushered into the private Family Concierge lounge for a personalized check-in experience where we got to meet our butlet, Alexa. She was by far the highlight of our week! She organized all of our dinner reservations, constantly checked in with us to ensure we weren't missing anything, left traditional mexican toys for our son and often left us special snacks in our room for us to munch on when we'd get back to our room after a day at the beach. Alexa went above and beyond throughout the entire week and made our trip all that much more special! She gave us great recommendations for excursions and even put in some calls for us when we were looking for additional information for a particular location. If you ever stay in FC at Paradisus be sure to ask for Alexa as your butler, you won't regret it!

Our room was lovely, renovated and impeccable, and directly faced the ocean. Our minibar was stocked daily with beer, soft drinks and snacks, which was always appreciated. A major perk of FC is the above-mentioned lounge, which is open throughout the day. FC guests can drop in whenever to enjoy snacks and premium drinks, and there's a play area for kids to enjoy while mom & dad enjoy their drinks. 

We got to the resort literally weeks after they were done renovating the restaurants, so we never experienced any closures. We tried all à la carte restaurants, and the best ones in our experience were Vento, Mole and Fuego (the seafood soup there was to die for!). If staying in FC and are able to send your kids to the kids' club or are looking for a solo dining experience, be sure to head to La Palapa (which is adults-only) for a wonderful oceanside lunch (get the fish tacos!). If you have any dietary restrictions or allergies, Paradisus is the place to go as the restaurant staff would constantly inquire about any food-related restrictions. We don't have any but I'm sure this attention to detail would be appreciated by many.

All employees were super friendly and eager to serve. We'd eat breakfast at the buffet most mornings and many of the waiters would insist on carrying our plate to our table or would offer to Irish up our coffee with Baileys or paper cups so we could take the coffee (which is absolutely delicious!) to go. We'd always get a smile and an "hola" from all employees we would come upon, whether they be waiters, maintenance workers, security personnel, or anyone else. The friendliness we experience at this resort by all employees was nothing like we've ever seen before at any other resort. Special shoud-out to Asunción, a poolside waiter who went out of her way to bring us coffee when we were at the pool early one morning! 

My son is young so we spent a lot of our time by the kids' pool -- one side of which is quite shallow, so great for the little ones. The beach is just a few steps away from the pool area and is absolutely beautiful, with the softest, whitest sand and clear blue waters! We split our time between the pool and the beach and had a great time. There were sufficient chairs for everyone, no need to get up at the crack of dawn to reserve chairs which is great! Special shout-out to Enrique, Ivette and Eliot at the towel station who were always happy to provide us with fresh towels whenever we asked and helped us find the best chairs and Bali beds.

The only negative aspect I can think of is the fact that there's a beach club right on the property (Coco Club), which has a DJ playing music throughout the day. The music is rather loud and would carry over to the beach and poolside areas, so it was a little annoying at times. Other than that, this was a dream family vacation, and we will definitely be back!!

reviews.author: FrankieF
reviews.title: Love La Palapa!
reviews.text: This was third time we stayed here, absolutely love Royal Service! La Palapa restaurant by the pool/beach is amazing both in food and service - differentiator that keeps us coming back. Special shout out to the manager, always welcoming us "home".

reviews.author: Gnarcia
reviews.title: Amazing establishment/service w/ Poor Food Quality
reviews.text:
Paradisus is an absolutely beautiful establishment. The appearance and cleanliness is great. The staff is very friendly and eager to serve well above anything you would experience in the US. 

KENIA was our butler and helped us with all of our reservations and also surprise set up a bubble bath with champagne and chocolate covered strawberries for my wife and I which made for an unforgettable moment for us. 

We stayed 4 nights. The first 2 mornings we woke up before 8am because of a man pressure washing outside our room. Not happy with that. Our butler said if it happens again (so 3/4 of our stay) that they will move us. We thought that they’d offer to move us anyway and maybe feel bad that we were woken up by maintenance personnel but they didn’t. 

The bathroom in our royal service junior lagoon view room is absolutely amazing. Best part of the room. Our lagoon view was actually a view of the tennis court with mcDonalds in the background. Not even a hint of water or a lagoon. Whatever. 

I would only return here if the food was not substandard. The only food that’s fresh is fruit and salad stuff. Everything else is most likely frozen and tastes like cafeteria food. There’s better food at airports. 

The beach and Bali beds are great and the service out there is excellent. Very genuinely friendly and thoughtful. 

We would give this place 2.5 stars because of the poor food quality. I read lots of reviews and I don’t see how any could possibly say anything amazing about the food unless those people are accustomed to low food quality. 
We tried a wide variety of foods at the restaurants and room service and were mostly dissatisfied. 

The spa area is nice. The pool, that looks like a giant hot tub should be warmer to be more appealing. The sauna is nice. The steam room is loaded with essential oil that is very irritating to lungs and skin. The pool area is relaxing. 

We chose royal service to be away from kids and that was successful. When we at at the buffet, there were typical vacation families with kids playing around their tables and riding scooters IN THE RESTAURANT. Whatever. 

Overall we had a great time and will most likely go to a different resort in the future, hoping to spend less and have a better experience that we hear about from others we talk to.

reviews.author: Joanna K
reviews.title: Not a 4.5 star resort
reviews.text:
We decided to book our annual family trip with Paradisus Cancun after staying at Paradisus La Esmeralda in the prior year and loving it. Sadly, Paradisus Cancun, is nothing like its sister property in Playa del Carmen. This place is a fraud. It is a 2 star motel pretending to be a nice resort. Before I list all the issues we encountered, I would like to praise the staff. They were all very, very nice and professional. If it wasn't for their efforts to make our stay there a bit more bearable it would have been a totally ruined vacation. Leo at the pool bar and Armando at the buffet stood out the most. We are truly grateful for their hard work and positive disposition. 
Pros:
Beautiful beach
Great staff
Comfortable beds
Good pillows
Decent buffet 
Fairly clean
Cons:
Lengthy and disorganized check in
Very limited selection and low food quality 
Theme restaurant are hard to get into and beyond disappointing in terms of menu, service and quality of food 
The bartenders only offer three types of drinks: mojito, margarita and electric lemonade 
Food service station not sanitary (especially the ice cream parlor)
Run down facilities 
Damaged furniture in the common areas
Lack of decorations 
Roaches and mosquitoes in the room
Stained sheets
One electric outlet in the room
No coffee maker 
Poorly stacked mini bar
Hair dryer not working 
Clogged sink and tub
Paint chipping off
UNSAFE CRIBS (called ahead and asked if I should bring my own, told they had proper cribs for infants and not to worry)
....among many many other problems....
Bottom line is that it simply is not a 4 star resort they advertise themselves to be. Perhaps they should learn from their sister property in Playa del Carmen and stop cutting corners at the expense of their guests. I am highly dissatisfied with the brand and just want to warn those who were thinking of staying at the Cancun property. Don't! There are plenty of other choices.

reviews.author: marci w
reviews.title: Holiday Vacation
reviews.text:
Rode in Royal Service is the best! He went above and beyond the necessary requirements to ensure our vacation was superb and without hassle.  He used is own free time to make us delicious meals to bring on our all day excursion and even sent us with his own personal Tupperware.  

The red lounge was a blast! Francisco and Alejandro always had drinks ready for us even before we ordered them and memorized our favorite drinks as well as made sure we were responsible and respectful. These gentleman enhanced the experience immensely and my family cannot thank them enough. Cannot wait to visit again!  
Thank you all again for making our Vaca the best!

reviews.author: magould9
reviews.title: Adult vacation with friends.  Had a great time?  Great resort
reviews.text: Our new favorite place.  Beautiful, excellent service, lots to do.  Agustin was the activities host for the resort and he was wonderful.  Always letting us know of upcoming activities, always making sure we didn't need anything, and just a very nice person!  I would like to give a shout to Alan (always making us laugh).  Awesome bartenders at pool bar...they always made sure they were stocked with my 1800 blanco tequila! Service excellent at pool...making sure you have water or cocktails!  Service excellent in all the restaurants we visited.  Everyone really goes out of there way to make sure you have a great time!  We will be back.

reviews.author: Kathrina K
reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text: Honest review,,, here it is ... beautiful resort with just a breathtaking ocean. We travelled 6 of us with 2 being 7 tear old twins. Check in was good, only was disappointed with the promise of connecting rooms for our kids but that was settled. We didn’t upgrade to family or royal and didn’t feel like we missed out on anything. My one big complaint though is the price of the Bali beds,,, half the time the were empty and the price I think is crazy of 190 even if it comes with champagne and lobster. We opted for that one day and we enjoyed it but think it was overpriced. The food was good, lots of options with the buffet and the burgers at fuego were delicious, the snack bar was great as well. The other restaurants were just ok, Mediterranean was very limited and wish they had a Italian restaurant because they all very very repetitive. For a 5 star I’ve never had to pay extra for steak which was also disappointing as I think that should be included and we did opt for it 2 nights and the first night it was awesome but second night it all came out cold so we sent back and they re made it... I have to say the staff here are amazing from the bartenders to the breakfast staff to the waiters, all so friendly ( special shoutout to Alfredo ( cricket man ) at the breakfast buffet who totally went out of the way for me and my kids. Manuel who was our waiter on the beach was great as well. Most of all my kids loved loved loved the kids club. The ladies there were just amazing and my kids cried everytime I took them out. They take them for dinner and make great crafts. We did the island tour one day which was great as well. Overall beautiful place but wish the extras didn’t add up as we paid a lot to go... one thing please tip and keep that in mind, they work hard so we tipped everyday at breakfast , lunch and dinner ,, a few bucks goes a long way .. some of the rooms could use an update as well but the view made up for it ... overall an amazing family trip with a few recommendations for the hotel for the future

reviews.author: Sandy M
reviews.title: Coming Home - Club Melia
reviews.text: My husband and I come every year to stay for 3 weeks.  We have met other couples who do the same and the reason we all agree on - is the staff!  It is so great to see many of the same people year after year.  They treat us like family and do everything possible to make our trip extra special and memorable.  From Ruth at check in, Jorge our butler, Lilian, Carlos at Concierge Services and many more.  After coming here for almost 16 years - I can’t find one negative thing to comment on.  We have toured many other resorts in the Cancun area and can hardly wait to get back home to Paradisus.

reviews.author: 805traveller
reviews.title: Nice resort,
reviews.text:
This was our first time staying at Paradisus Cancun, the resort is beautiful and very well kept, many restaurants and bars, and beautiful beach.. 

The service was great throughout the resort except at the buffet restaurant where it was only good if you sat in the right side section (where it's Fuego restaurant at night) thanks to Andres and Altalin (i'm not sure if I got his name right), it was pretty bad the rest of the restaurant inside.

The staff worked very hard to please everyone.

The food was mediocre at best (you get what you pay for). Mole had the best food and the Market grill had good prime ribs. 

The staff was very friendly and helpful, always smiling and in a very happy mood. The person that stood out the most for us was Hugo at the main pool.

The resort was very nicely located about 15 min walk from the Luxury mall and a 25 min walk from La Isla mall. Or if you want you can take any of the public buses for 12 pesos and it will take you into town or even all the way to Downtown Cancun. 

It was very safe we even walked back to the hotel around 11 pm. You can see police presence everywhere.

If you end up going downtown you should definitely try Los Trascos tacos. It is some of the best tacos I have had (I eat lots of tacos)

reviews.author: SpreadSparkle
reviews.title: Not up to expectations this trip :(
reviews.text: We have stayed with Paradisus 4 times now.  The first 3 times we had Royal Service, which is amazing.  This time, it was not available so at the time of check in we asked if by chance it was - they said it was and upgraded us for a fee.  However, they said the rooms were not available in that area, so we would still be in the main building which we thought was fine.  First of all with Royal Service, the check in is so quick and easy in the past.  This trip, after a long day of travel we stood in the check in line for 1.5 hours!  It was CRAZY!  The desk clerks were not friendly as they usually have been in the past either.  That aside, we were still excited to get settled in our room.  We had booked an ocean view junior suite.  We walked in to look out to a large roof with very loud air conditioner and the sound of clanking plates and dishes (we were right above a restaurant).  The worst part is our king sized bed - it was slid up against a wall with no access on one side.  I have NEVER seen that.  We both had been sick and this was not going to do as we needed easy access to the restroom in the night.  We visited the front desk and stood in line again to be told nothing was available, but tomorrow at noon they could move us.  The next day at noon we stepped into the office and were told AGAIN nothing was available, no notes on our account.  Very unhappy at this time, but just went to the beach and ignored it for now.  The 3rd day was a little rainy so we had time to visit the front desk again - this time to be told they had a room but only 2 double beds, nothing else.  So needless to say, we had had a few bad nights of climbing over each other to get up in the night, we took the double beds.  At least we now had an unobstructed ocean view that we paid for. Disappointed as all other 8 travelers that were with us had beautiful LARGE rooms with an extra sitting area and they all booked and paid for less than we did.  On another note:  The dinners:  We had to call every day to book a reservation for dinner.  Only ONE night were they able to accommodate a dinner time for us, everything else was booked.  We were only able to eat at one reserved restaurant and the other nights had to go to the buffet, which was very disappointing. DO NOT book Paradisus unless it is Royal Service - it is definitely worth it.  We were so disappointed in the treatment/dinner reservations and our room this trip.

reviews.author: Mary_Livin' Off the Land
reviews.title: Excellent Service, Full of Amenities, Tasty Food
reviews.text:
Pros: The food is super good. Even in buffet. Many options, every restaurant is thematic. Deal 0 to reserve and the concierge will help you anyway. I book my 3 nights since day 1 and non inconveniences. Pool clean and a lot of fun. Hotel clean and well maintained. Melia is doing a good job there since landscaping, ambiance, etc. Super safe. Control in the gate so you can feel like at home. You can drink and enjoy mind free.
Every night they have a show. In addition, in the afternoon they have many cultural options as piano, classic music in the main lobby, etc. 

Cons: seafood night is Wednesday, so they should change to a more convenient day like Saturday, otherwise you wont see a lobster or good shrimps at all. The prices for the spa are super high.  Come on, everyone wants massage but for 150$ it is not a good idea at all. The beach in this area of Cancun is not good in general. I mean, I am from Cuba living in Miami, Cancun is not the best beach in the world, but if you are traveling from cold countries you will be happy with the sun, palms, and sand.

Best restaurant: Market Grill, best meat in my life. The cordero was awesome.
Best spot: Coco Beach, do not miss this area, is super relaxing.
Nexpresso station: super!

Tips: tip for good service. the staff work a lot. $1 $2 $3 dollars is appreciated. It is not a must.
Take bus R2 if you want to go to Mercado 28 or Walmart. The trip is like 30 mts and only 1 dollar or 12 mxn per person. A taxi is almost 40 dollars.
Mercado 28 is expensive, you can find the same souvenir in the airport. 

Viva Mexico!

reviews.author: Kellie P
reviews.title: WOW BEST EXPERIENCE EVER
reviews.text:
I would like to thank the General Manager, Jair, Big thanks to Royal Team Lazaro, Veronica, Joel, and everyone in Paradisus Cancun.

This hotel has made from the pre-arrival to every minute my parents stayed in the hotel PERFECT.
It was the PARADISE for my parents. I have booked the trip for my parents birthday and I have asked the hotel to do something special for my parents. WOW what a great customer service from the start to end. 
All my parents talk about is the PARADISUS CANCUN and they want to go back as much as possible.

I have been to cancun myself twice but the quality of service was not great. HOWEVER, this hotel is exceptional service.

THANK YOU EVERYONE. I am so pleased and thankful for your service.

reviews.author: swimupbarlover
reviews.title: Great Time!!
reviews.text: This was our second time visiting this resort! Can't say enough good things about the staff that work so hard to make your stay great! We visited 3 years ago and I could tell the resort could possibly use a little touching up around the edges, nothing specific or anything to complain about though!! Our room refrigerator and coffee were not restocked daily, which kind of surprised me?! They have a great little coffee bistro that was close by, so that was fine! The food and drinks are excellent! Great beach, great location! Definitively would recommend this resort!

reviews.author: PJKIENTZ
reviews.title: Awesome staff
reviews.text:
I can’t say enough about the staff who are so willing to take care of you!

A big thanx to David our waiter on the beach, the best service we could have along with taking the time to entertain us!

To “Nacho” at the Market Grill, great service  and making our time at meals fun!

I really do not have one bad thing to say about the hotel and staff, would definitely return!

reviews.author: Jackie RL
reviews.title: Can’t Wait to Come Back!!
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancún exceeded our expectations, and it’s certainly not what you think of when you think “all inclusive”. The resort is lovely & bright, the staff is welcoming & helpful, the food is delicious, rooms are stunning (definitely opt for an ocean view)! 

As our first real trip with our 11 month old, we were nervous about juggling it all. But taking advantage of the Family Concierge service was the best decision we made! Rodolfo was absolutely superb, and on top of everything we could possibly need, from dinner reservations, babysitting services, reserving prime lounge chairs, coordinating spa treatments and even surprising us with lovely amenities for us and our daughter! 

I cannot say enough wonderful things about our stay. I’m already dying to come back next year!!

reviews.author: rzolt
reviews.title: 10th Stay at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
My family and I just returned from our 10th visit to Paradisus Cancun and had a wonderful time.  Whenever we return we notice improvements in decor, activities and the overall experience and this visit was no exception.

The staff that greets us at Club Melia check-in remembers us from year-to-year and they treat us as old friends.  In fact, they sent flowers to our room with a thank you note for our loyalty which we thought was a very nice gesture.

The hotel itself is beautiful.  The hanging vines throughout the facility give it an outdoorsy feel while the staff is always doing their best to make your stay memorable. We also enjoy the laid back environment. 

This year there seemed to be more evening activities that included different singers and acts each night.  My wife and daughter enjoyed several of the shows and thought it was a pleasant way to end the day.

Next January we’ll be returning for our 11th stay and look forward to seeing the different improvements while enjoying the same level of customer service we’ve come to expect.  We know there are lots of choices in Cancun.  However, Paradisus Cancun checks all of our boxes which is why we return. We also appreciate the attention we receive from Karina in check-in and Ivette in Operations. Both have become friends who we look forward to seeing each year.

reviews.author: Daisy K
reviews.title: Perfect Holiday!
reviews.text: Hi all, this was our first time at Paradisus, and I am in aww of words. This place is just amazing. I loved the property, the ocean view and pool areas. This amenity did not have that water smell like other resorts. The rooms were nice and clean. Samuel Norma and Alma helped us with our room change for my daughters which was kind. The staff was exceptional. At Naos Buffet, we had Andres, David Contreras, Alejandro, Lalo Rodriguez and Rafael who would always be there with there smiling faces and amazing service! Thank you!!  The restaurants were phenomenal. The best  taste of food everywhere. Fuego we had Darwin who was amazing, Mole (i forget his name..but even having an injured leg he served us, such a nice guy), and Vento we had Juan (just loved him, hopefully he tried our special drink by now!) The staff was welcoming cooperative, and the food is 5 star in each location! Food presentation was wow! The pool side we had rented a bali bed, our servers Sergio, Manuel, Miguel, Rene, and Sofonino were just great! Amazing service and always there to bring us whatever we needed. Thank you guys!  Cant forget Elliot who is always the first guy we saw at the pool every am, making sure all was a- ok!! He was a pleasure to talk too always!  We will be definitely coming back. Loved our stay and everything was just awesome....Thank you Paradisus

reviews.author: Connie S
reviews.title: Royal Service delivers Again
reviews.text: We've used Royal Service now on three occasions on three different properties. Without a doubt it is worth every penny. The staff is attentive, there is always room at the pool and the beach.  We enjoyed out stay very much and look forward to returning.

reviews.author: Richnyc
reviews.title: Run down
reviews.text: Their receptionists and management are not welcoming - they make you feel like simply a number. The workers at the pool and restaurants are hard-working but you get the sense they don't get treated well by management. Our rooms on the lagoon  facing side were run down and old. At night, the shows are so loud that you feel like you are trying to sleep inside a night club. More than half the resturants on our last night there - a Wednesday- were closed. They make getting restaurant reservations really hard unless you pay extra $$ for their royal or family services. I don't know if other all-inclusive are similar but I would stay away from Paradisus unless you want to feel like a 2nd class citizen in your vacation.

reviews.author: dave g
reviews.title: Our loyalty has been earned
reviews.text: This is our second time visiting this property and our fourth at one of their (Paradissus) locations. We could not be more pleased. We find the location to be ideal and the  facilities we find to be outstanding.   We had the Royal service which comes with a butler. While this option is not at all important to us, our butler, Hector, could not have been more accommodating, professional and delightful. Overall, the facilities are extremely clean.  The entire staff whether part of the maintenance crew or waitstaff or whoever quite frankly… They would always greet you with a smile.    My wife and I truly enjoyed our experience and feel comfortable saying that we have found a place that will continue to go back to maybe even on an annual basis.

reviews.author: rachnad
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel
reviews.text:
Had a short vacation with my partner, we stayed here for 3 nights. The hotel is amazing, the staff were very helpful, room service was quick and had a good range of restaurants to chose from. The rooms are slightly dated but they were clean, we had a jacuzzi on our balcony which we made good use of. The weather was amazing and the location of the hotel is perfect, 15-20 mins drive from the airport. 
Only con I have is the hotel is massive and a bit of a walk from the building we was in to the main building were the restaurants and shops are. 
I would definitely recommend this hotel and would definitely stay there again. 
I would like to also thank the staff around the pool....Micheal, Elliott and Sergio they were amazing, we were never out of drinks they worked really hard. 
Definitely 5 start service 😊

reviews.author: Carla L
reviews.title: Great Birthday Weekend + ROYAL SERVICE WITH DJORDJE
reviews.text:
Went to Paradisus Cancun for my 27th birthday and i am SO GLAD i chose this wonderful hotel! Everything from the staff, the property and the rooms was impeccable. I had every request met with enthusiasm and care. I felt famous!

I went with Royal Service and it was worth every penny. My boyfriend & i were assisted by Djordje and he was an absolute gem. So kind and helpful. I wanted the ocean front cabana for my birthday and he delivered! He always made sure we were taken care of. If you book Royal Service request Djordje!!!

The food was delicious, the rooms clean, the beach was beautiful, the lobby gorgeous with plenty of daily activities to keep you entertained. They even have a fun dance club with themed nights. 

Overall, wonderful A+ experience we will be returning! Thank you Paradisus!

reviews.author: williamsT1056SQ
reviews.title: Our stay at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Over all the property is very nice and the ivy growing on the inside was very nice. The service was great especially the service and attention we received from Vincent Guerrero in the buffet area. However getting to the beach is not very handicap friendly due to many steps. Also at check in we were referred to a sales person which is not very pleasant when all you want to do is get checked into your room. Also in Room [3111] the lock on the glass sliding door did not work.

reviews.author: Pioneer27318922416
reviews.title: Great to have good time and relax
reviews.text: Employees were excellent and very polite and will do their best to comfort and accomodtae, location was very good. Very clean and everybody were going at it to have shine. The balcony door needs adjustment.

reviews.author: Maps18445591913
reviews.title: Beautiful property
reviews.text: Overall a very good experience. The grounds were beautiful. The beach had nice white sand and seemed one of the better ones along the strip. The hotel keeps it clean ftom seaweed et al. The water was clean and at a good temperature but a little rough and has strong currents so you must stay closer to shore. There are lifeguards snd theyhad to pull out people a few times. The inside is an atrium with hanging leaves. The atmosphere was tropical and beautiful. The property was s good size - not too big, not too small. Service was very good and attentive. Asuncion, the beach waitress, works extra hard to please. Tomas’ service in the buffet was exceptional.  The rooms were very nice. The junior suite was huge with 2 bathrooms. The shower gel had a really nice scent that will always remind us of the Paradisus. The view from the rooms overlooking the ocean was magnificent. Each room has a private balcony/terrace. Improvements include: better inviting furniture and decor on the terrace, more beach chairs, better quality food preferred (except guacomole was excellent), it was plentiful but I would have preferred less but better quality in both the buffet and restaurants.  Some of the shows were very good, others just ok. I think a more fun-loving, entertaining filled environment. For this trip, it was fine as we were there for much-needed R&R. But for the next trip, I would like a more fun, engaging atmosphere as at some other resorts.   Overall, a great experience and I would highly recommend for a relaxing vacation.

reviews.author: L M
reviews.title: Amazing vacation!
reviews.text: This beautiful resort provided the best week for our family! Our butler, Jonathan, went above-and-beyond providing happy and wonderful service for our family. The entire staff at the resort was cheerful and friendly and the place was beautifully kept clean! We would love to return to this resort again soon!

reviews.author: Tdeevie
reviews.title: Eighth Time
reviews.text: We'll be back. No doubt that there will be a ninth visit. Special thanks to Sergio, our frequent butler, and to Roberto at the pool.  Our room was very comfortable as always.  We liked the improvements to the bathrooms.

reviews.author: Katie P
reviews.title: Awesome!
reviews.text: I wasn't sure what to expect after reading other reviews on here. I was worried because we didn't book the Royal Service and it seemed other reviews said we would have issues with dinner reservations, etc. We had ZERO problems getting reservations each night to the restaurant of our choosing. Everything was so nice. When checking in they greeted us with drinks and then showed us to our room. Of course the pool gets crowded when you get into the late morning, most pools do (I know my complex pool is the same way) but we were always up early and could find a spot. If we were late to go down to the pool because we were off on an excursion then we would just go lay out on the beach. Even on the beach they serve you drinks! We were even closer to the water at times and the service staff would go out of their way to come down and get us drinks! It was so great. Our first night we had sushi and our waiter continuously had my drink filled. He was amazing! Needless to stay we didn't have any issues here. Once or twice our fridge wasn't restocked but all it took was a phone call and they would fix it immediately. Our room was nice, it was an ocean view and very spacious for the two of us. We definitely decided that we would come back to this location because we had a great time. Plenty of food, drinks and sunshine. Thank you for making our stay awesome!

reviews.author: Amy D
reviews.title: So Much Potential.
reviews.text:
Alex and I just got back from the beautiful and sunny Cancun. Getting away from the snowy D.C. was sensational. We stayed at the Paradisus all inclusive. We chose this hotel because it was gorgeous online and had plenty of restaurant options. Being foodies we also chose it for Tempo, a restaurant operated by a chef holding eight Michelin stars. Here are the pros and cons of our trip:

Pros: 
1. Aesthetically: gorgeous hotel. The greenery, flowers and koi in the ponds all around the resort are exquisite. The layout is beautiful and it’s right on the water. Looks just like the pictures online. 
2. Staff is so attentive and nice. While being there we learned about countless servers/bartenders/staffs families, where they are from and their way of life. There are plenty of people to help you out or just get you a drink! Every meal we had we had a friendly server who spoke English very well and was outstanding! Daniel was an incredible manager who really cared about his staff and cared about the guests. One morning I even asked for some citrus for my gin and tonic and he brought ALL the citrus LOL. Also, Edgar was very good as well. He was very attentive and kind, always going the extra mile. These two made the entire trip awesome!
3. Expansive pool options.
4. Alcohol: free flowing. If you would like a bottle for the room you can just ask downstairs and they will give it to you with cups to enjoy on your balcony. Tried a lot of new drinks. Like all all-inclusive resorts that go light on the pours so we always asked for doubles. My favorite was the Hendricks G&T (double) with a lime and an orange.
5. Restaurants: Fuego delicious (see pictures). Enso meh. Mole ok too good. Will have more individual reviews on their Yelp pages.

Cons:
1. While there are a lot of pools, there aren’t a lot of pool chairs. We are not morning people, but forced waking up around 8:30 just to get a spot around the pool. It was always packed. One morning we waited until 9:15 to go down and we were screwed. Oh and pools FREEZING!
2. The Clientele: Rudest people I have ever encountered. EVERYONE staying at this hotel was a jerk. Most self indulged and insufferable people I’ve ever encountered, all in one place. I have been to Mexico several times, including another all-inclusive and never seen such ugly hearted people. I don’t know if this is due to the cultures the brand attracts or because it was high season so the amount of people attracted to Cancun was higher, I can’t pinpoint it. Was here for 4 days and met only one nice older group from Canada and that was it. We are a very friendly couple and love meeting new people but guests at this resort made it impossible. We even had an incident at dinner one night with a 40-something year old dad who was sitting at the table in front of ours. His table was in our line of sight of the beach and when he got up to leave confronted Alex saying “you have a staring problem”. We were floored. After some back and forth and him not quitting the staff had to get involved. Don’t need this while on vacation. You are on vacation people, this is supposed to be the most relaxing time!!   
3. BIGGEST CON: Restaurants. As I said it was high season and every night 2 to 3 of the restaurants are closed. Sunday - Blue Agave, Bana and Fuego all closed. You have thousands of people and the only offerings at 4/7 restaurants are available. Not to mention, as all other mentioned, it is IMPOSSIBLE to get a reservation. We had read this so emailed the hotel the week before but no answer to several emails. When we checked in we mentioned it and was told you can only reserve from your hotel phone. We called as soon as reaching the room Saturday afternoon and all reservations were full until after our departure on Tuesday. This seems non-sensical. I have never seen reservations nor a business run so poorly. Either have a way to make reservations ahead of time and set aside tables for walk-in’s or don’t have reservations at all. Seriously. Somehow later we snagged a 9pm at Mole on Monday night and half of the tables in the restaurant are empty. We also noticed this when walking by Vento. Thank God we did the Royal Service upgrade when arriving because we ate at  La Palapa for nearly every lunch and thoroughly enjoyed the La Palapa lounge for snacks and drinks in the evenings. Tip: The hotel should give our a brochure of restaurants operating hours, what meals you can get at which and which you have to pay extra for.
4. Speaking of paying extra: This place is terrible with the upsell’s, every corner we turned, upsell, upsell, upsell. Sat thru their timeshare presentation and the rates were awful; 50 vacations for 30K at 16.9%. As money savvy people no one in their right mind would take this. As soon as they realized we weren’t going to buy they were done with us. Everyone was upsell and tip greedy (minus Daniel, Edgar, Javier and Hugo - they were just genuinely customer driven). Beware of anything you do here: any photo opportunities, any different wines at the restaurants or food specials of the night - all uncharges. Even room service was a fee, at an all-inclusive!!! Oh and the food you get at Naos (the buffet) don’t even think about bringing that up to your room, not allowed! So much for enjoying a nice cake or snack from the balcony.
5. Lastly, Maid Service: minibar not stocked, no water available in the rooms and no robes or slippers. Saturday, Sunday and Monday morning none of this existed. Maid came once a day and on Sunday, I even laid out a tip and a note about all of these things and when we arrived back from the pool nothing was there and the money was not taken… maybe the maid didn’t read/speak English… not sure. Then miraculously, Monday we walked into our room and there were robes/towels and lots of water; money and note gone. Then while we were relaxing on the balcony we get a knock on the balcony door and its the maid ready to do turn down service (whaaaaa? turn down service is now a thing?! last night and now it happens…). She turns down and leaves we walk in and there are now more items and chocolates on our pillows, where the F has this been the whole time?! Service is so spotty, but heck we chalked it up to being in Mexico!

Last tip before I leave you: They don’t tell you but I realized the last day, when I was full out itchy, that the toilet paper is scented. May be a nice perk for some folks but unfortunately for a girl with a scent sensitivity would have been a great heads up! 

All and all was a nice time, but had we been given the level of service that was shown on Monday after 3pm and restaurants weren’t such a disaster to make a reservation at we would likely be back. We love traveling and love relaxing and after this will likely try a different resort next time. To put it in perspective we even received a free 4 day/3 night stay for listening to the sales presentation and are debating even using it because we would rather go somewhere else.

reviews.author: roxyzym
reviews.title: Impressive!
reviews.text: It is impressive design wise and a lot of effort is put in details. There is entertainment on almost constantly - on Saturday it even changed every hour or so, first there were singers, then drummers, then chill DJ music and so on! There is a lot of choice food wise, if you can't find anything in a buffet there are several other restaurants that are included in all inclusive deal. Beach is great, the bar in the pool also but my favourite was the service - staff are constantly walking around asking if you'd like another drink while you are sunbathing and relaxing. Honestly everything was just fantastic :)

reviews.author: MG4489
reviews.title: Average
reviews.text:
Check in is a disaster. Waited 45 mins for this and was told to go and speak to the concierge for further details. The concierge redirected us to the luggage man who was probably the most helpful staff member throughout this process but had basic knowledge on what was included/ not. 

Rooms are very outdated 

Food is average but what is to be expected for mass produced meals 

Everyone appears to shot gun all the loungers so effectively little space to sunbathe 

Th activities are actually very good (but no one tells you about these) and the majority are complimentary 

The staff inside the restaurants are very pleasant but i will not be coming back here and thought it was overpriced for Mexico which is a very beautiful and pleasant country if you leave the resort

reviews.author: Guide62350921511
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel with salty food.
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel but restaurants need more staff especiallly when it rains. Coffee service should be improved. The hotel offers Nepresso service only in a certain time. Regular coffee is ready on the hallways but milk bottle was empty whenever I needed it. Food is very salty. They need more staff at the restaurants especially when it rains because most people stay inside the hotel when it rains. My room window was leaking water from outside when it was rainy. I didn't report it since it was minimal leakage. I just put towel on the window side. My other family's rooms were ok though... staff are kind and attentive. Easy check in and out. Oh!! The spa is wonderful!! Amazing deep tissue massage!! My mother's back pain is so much better after getting massage from David! Amazing!! Overall, hotel is nice except food.

reviews.author: LISA B
reviews.title: Great Family Vacation!
reviews.text:
We booked a Family Concierge room through Cheap Caribbean for February 10-15th. I was extremely pleased with the pricing and the value of what we received compared to other packages we looked in to. 

When we arrived at the hotel we were greeted and ushered into the check-in area where we were immediately offered a drink. The staff let us know, however, that Cheap Caribbean did not confirm our room as a Family Concierge room, rather a regular room. I was forced to come up with my reservation email and contact Cheap Caribbean to get this straightened out. It was an unfortunate first impression but things only got better from there. 

Our room wasn't quite ready but we were introduced to one of our Butler's, Gloria, who greeted us and escorted us to lunch at the buffet. By the time we were finished eating, our room was available and the reservation had already worked itself out. Our room was perfect! Clean, comfortable and when we noted that our children would be sleeping a bit too close for comfort, Gloria arranged to have an extra bed brought up for the duration of our stay. 

Booking Family Concierge means you have access to dinner reservations that are made for you easily and you don't have to deal with that hassle. Also, little treats were given to my 10 and 7 year old's throughout our trip. The only small issue we had was being able to communicate easily with our butlers, Gloria and Alexander. My husband and I both had the What's App application installed on our phones but did not activate it prior to our travels. Based on our cell phone carrier, we were not able to receive the activation code required to make the app actually work. Unfortunately we weren't able to communicate easily with our butlers but it really wasn't a major issue for us as we didn't want to be glued to our cell phones during our vacation. My advice would be to install and make sure the What's App app is working on your phone prior to leaving for your vacation!

The grounds of the hotel are absolutely stunning. There is never a shortage of waiters to bring you a drink, staff to help accommodate your needs, and smiles to go around. We enjoyed the family pool and one of the employees in that area, Elliot, made our time even better. He checked on us over and over again to see if we needed towels, extra chairs, etc. He even blew up my pool float for me when he saw me struggling with it! He went above and beyond and I cannot say thank you enough to Elliot. 

The employees in the kids club were also amazing. My children bonded with them and had SO MUCH FUN they didn't want to leave when we came to pick them up. Thank you to the staff there - especially Paula! You all (Ivonne, Sarahi, Adriana and Lucia) made us feel extremely comfortable leaving our children there. 

The food was good, not spectacular, but I am an extremely picky eater. We never went hungry and if you can break away from your children I'd HIGHLY recommend La Pallapa for lunch in the adult-only area. That was definitely the best food we ate. The Mexican restaurant, Mole, was also one of our favorites. 

The beach is kept beautifully clean and we were able to spend some time jumping and playing in the waves despite the "red flag warnings" due to the strong winds and currents throughout our stay. Yes, there is seaweed but it is not an issue at all. You just step over it and it certainly didn't bother us in the least. 

Any time we made a request at Paradisus Cancun, we were always told YES and received what we asked for within 30 minutes. In addition, after any requests were fulfilled, someone called to make sure we were happy with our service and that what we asked for was received. Great follow up from an extremely conscientious staff.

All in all, I'd recommend this resort over and over again. And I'd highly suggest the Family Concierge package as well due to the amazing service we had from Gloria and Alexander in addition to the sweet little perks throughout our vacation. 

*** A couple of notes... we experienced a FULL DAY of rain while we were there. I did wish they had more activities to do inside that day. Also, if you do the wax art for your children in the Kid's Club - bring something sturdy to transport it home in. It caused a lot of anxiety trying to get those hands home in one piece but - WE DID IT! :)  

Thanks for making us feel at home, Paradisus Cancun! We hope to return some day!

reviews.author: Weimiao L
reviews.title: Average experience
reviews.text: Rooms are very outdated. Online pictures are deceiving. Buffet dinner and lunch is disappointing, and it is difficult to get a spot at the reservation only restaurants at the hotel. Room cleaning always run late and maids don’t restock the fridge. The plus is beautiful beach. Overall definitely not a five star standard and would not return.

reviews.author: William O
reviews.title: This one is a pass....
reviews.text:
Pros: nice beach, and pools. Cons: dated property, bad service, cheap food, hidden fees, bad policies, etc....
Since we all work hard for our money, better pass on this one as there are better options!

reviews.author: Extraordinary317244
reviews.title: Royal Service at Paradisus
reviews.text: Stayed in a Royal Service beachfront Jr Suite. Room was exactly as described. Property is probably 40+ years old but has been consistently remodeled to stay very nice. All areas were kept clean and tidy at all times: room, pool area, halls, restaurants, bars, beach, grounds. Everyone on staff from waiters to maids to maintenance were friendly and courteous at all times. We had Royal Service which means we had a butler (Norma, who does a great job) and access to the adults only pool, the adults only section of the beach, and a couple of eating areas which are off limits to majority of the 700 rooms spread over 5 buildings . This is a must because it means you are not crowded at the pool or Bali beds (complimentary with Royal Service) or palapas on the beach. Beach is beautiful, wide, and clean. Ocean is beautiful color but would be a challenge to swim in due to currents and waves. Here is the big downfall: the food. Breakfast is acceptable, lunch is disappointing but dinners are mediocre on the best night. We tried everything but it’s about a 2 on scale of 10. It won’t make you sick or anything it just has no taste, texture or allure. Waiters are great and friendly but they can only serve what is cooked. So, my advice would be if you can secure a nightly rate in Royal Service you are happy with then book it. Eat their breakfast, enjoy their drinks all day, grab a sweet snack or two all while enjoying a beautiful beach THEN plan on going to dinner at one of the many restaurants across the road which overlook the lagoon.

reviews.author: Lee J
reviews.title: Above Average Resort
reviews.text: Great staff and service. Melia hotels are run as a business so efficiency geared towards profits is apparent. Particularly in the dining venues.
