Food comes from a common kitchen for most restaurants. Restaurants are closed based on occupancy so availability takes some planning. Reservations are hard to get at times.

reviews.author: Isidoros K
reviews.title: Could be better
reviews.text:
cleaning should be checked in buffet area, glasses , spoons tables etc.
Shops are very expensive
Shows should be more interactive
Rooms should be more equipped 
Very friendly staff at check in and checkout
Gardens very beautiful 
Beach amazing

reviews.author: Josephyeremian
reviews.title: The Hotel, the service and Management are all Excellent I give more than 6 stars.
reviews.text:
The moment we arrived to the last minute we were treated royally. 
Everything was excellent, especially under the directive of Mr. Michel Albahari, he must have trained his people excellent. Looked after all the details to keep customers very happy. The hotel is excellent, we will come again and again and bring Friends with us.

reviews.author: Rosemary Y
reviews.title: Excellent hotel and service!
reviews.text: My family and I stayed at Paradisus Cancun for a week and it was pure bliss. The food was amazing, the service was excellent, activities were fun and the room was great! I loved how the staff were always around to answer questions or help out in any way they could. I would highly recommend it!

reviews.author: Sightseer06965494877
reviews.title: Paradisus Birthday Party
reviews.text: We went to the Paradisus for a friend's 40th birthday and had an amazing time. The resort and beautiful and extremely clean, and the service was great. The staff is extremely attentive and very friendly.

reviews.author: Grace L
reviews.title: Amazing Honeymoon Stay, Highly Recommended
reviews.text:
This resort exceeded all our expectations! We stayed three nights for our honeymoon. The food is great and there’s lots of choice, there’s lots of inclusions and amenities. The service was very very good. 
The only downside was that on the first night we found ants in our bed and although they moved us to another room, we had to keep explaining our room change when calling room service and checking out etc. 
Otherwise it was a wonderful place to stay and we will highly recommend it to other couples

reviews.author: joseM2111OP
reviews.title: Destination wedding
reviews.text: Paradiscus Cancun was not a great experience for me and fiance.  The food was not good and the service was very poor.  Entertainment at this resort was terrible and there was no information put out indicating what kind of entertainment they were having each day.  The hotel workers were not friendly like they are at other resorts. I will not be going back to this resort for sure.

reviews.author: Clauschapo
reviews.title: BEST PLACE & BEST HOTEL CANCUN
reviews.text: The moment you enter the hotel you will notice the years of experience of the company behind the operation,the hotel is full renovated.  Every single space is thought to make your stay a super experience. The rooms with ocen view are incredible !!! The food is divine and the beach is wide and we had no seeweeds at all. We stayed for 6 nights and enjoyed almost every restaurant of the hotel. We kept going back to the buffet, which is amazing. The employes know their job and were very helpfull with our special requests. The bar at the main pool offers every  brand you can think of. We played the par 3 golf course, we used the gym every day and it´s very well equiped. We had our special treat and tried the ¨"Tempo" restaurant (the only payed restaurant) it was totally worth it.  The food was 5* and plus... We will return to this hotel in the future, it's close to Cancun, close to all the parks and the beach is the best in the area. I visit the  Cancun area almost every year and Paradisus offeres the  best service and best beach in my experience

reviews.author: Jen R
reviews.title: Mother-daughter trip
reviews.text: We had an amazing time! The resort was gorgeous, clean, and welcoming! The food choices were excellent and they offered top shelf alcohol as part of their all inclusive package. The service was above and beyond and the activities and entertainment were great! We had so much fun and will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Sandy M
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: In one word - FABULOUS!!!  The staff go overboard to make sure your stay is memorable.  We have travelled extensively and are always made to feel at home and welcome at the Paradisus.   A great place for people of all ages!!   Special thanks to Ruth at check in, Claudia and Jorge our guest services specialists who continually gave us the WOW factor and  Diego at poolside.  We are already checking dates to come back!!

reviews.author: Momrob3x
reviews.title: Wonderful Winter Gettaway
reviews.text:
Second visit and service and experience was wonderful! Stayed in the club Melia area and everyone was super!  Victor Hugo at the pool was excellent! Diego made sure all needs were in order. Reserved a Bali bed all 8 days. Food selections are great. You do not have to eat the buffet every night and you do not need a reservation every night which makes a more relaxed time.
Loved lunch at Blue Agave for a change. Having lunch served in the Bali bed was a treat also. Market breakfast on the porch is delightful!
Great service from Gaudencio,Alberto, Cristina Lovera and Armando.  Omelets are great. Change to eat breakfast the atrium. 
Great for dinner. Great dinner 2 nights Enso. Great being outside.
Luis is the best waiter! Kind friendly
And aims to please! Chef Carlos had a great dinner selections! Manager Jose let’s the staff take good care of diners. Housekeepers and room cleanliness was super! No complaints! We will come back and bring our adult children!

reviews.author: angiedaouk
reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: Only down side was the kids pool was freezing! and the restaurant main one didn't have a lot of grilling variety like other resorts we have been to. Everything else was great! Friendly people and very clean rooms and hotel overall.

reviews.author: Thad K
reviews.title: Excellent Service
reviews.text:
The service here was 5 star.  Miguel at the pool and Gabriel were exceptional.   Food was ok, best meal we had was at Enso.   I would rate it at the top of the all inclusive aghast I have visited.   All severs, bartenders, facilities people were top notch.  

Why not a five star is that the building was a bit dated and our room in main tower was very loud.  There were small examples of paint in showers peeling, grout around showers looked rough, a need for more modern and better charging outlets, and stains on chairs in room.    These are all cosmetic

Overall because of the great staff this place is returnable for sure.

reviews.author: Norman G
reviews.title: Girls trip
reviews.text: Nice resort and great activities and beautiful beach. However we struggled with the food choices. Little weird on some stuff. Loved the breakfast but struggled at buffet and other restaurants for lunch and dinner for quality food.

reviews.author: Taylor M
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: The trip was amazing we only had one problem and that was a lady who worked at the buffet but other then that everything was amazing and so so so beautiful I plan on coming back but with my son and mom

reviews.author: Flyer34458034733
reviews.title: Perfect in every way!
reviews.text: From the property, to the rooms, to the service to the food/beverage.  We were 100% happy with every part of our trip.  We will definitely be back!  The staff is entertaining as much as they are helpful and quick to help with whatever you need.  Thanks for a great experience!

reviews.author: Heidi S
reviews.title: Absolutely Amazing!
reviews.text:
Looks like my pictures came out sideways so I'm sorry for that. 

A friend of mine found a package deal and had plans to stay here one weekend in October. I checked my schedule, was off from work and bought my package that same day. I'm usually always working for all holidays so I don't celebrate them and sometimes I don't even remember it's a holiday. So we booked to be there 4 days, Halloween included but I was unaware that their Day of the Dead celebration was the same day.

Let me start with the pros:
I found the hotel to be so beautiful!
We arrived early morning and check-in isn't till 3 but the staff is amazing and EVERYONE goes above and beyond to help you out. Well, they let you do the check-in process but you don't get your room till later.
While you're checking in someone is passing by offering alcoholic beverages.
As soon as you check-in you have full access to the facilities. 
They have a spacious luggage area where you can leave your bags and you're provided with a ticket to claim later so you don't need to be going all around the hotel with your bags. 
They tell us at the front desk that we've juat missed breakfast but we can pass by the center of the hotel and see if there's anything left.
Here we met Andres "Andy". He sees us walking around and asks if we wanted to eat. It's very clear that almost everything has already been taken away so we ask what he has left. He tells us there's some fruits, yogurts, cereals and bread but we can order whatever we want and he'll have it made nice and warm for us. Whaaat?! Hell yeah!! We ordered 2 omelettes and mimosas. All the tables were cleared so Andy brings out our silverware and in no time our delicious omelettes are out. 
Breakfasts are amazing! Andy is the absolute best server I've ever had in my life so if you see him grab him but you better treat him right.  
Everything was included but we still made sure to bring a lot of cash for tips and even though the service is amazing when you tip they make you feel like royalty!
The pool we used was very clean and I love the pool bar.
The bar is fully stocked! And they actually have good liquor included which is not always seen at these all inclusives. Not everything is shown so if there's something you want but don't see ask, they might have it stored. 
The service at the pool is great. At the bar the bartender is making rounds nonstop so you're never waiting too long for a drink and if you're outside of the pool there's people going making rounds delivering drinks as well. The times I was drinking I never had an empty cup before the next had been delivered. They remembered what I was drinking and if they saw I was low they'd get me a drink before I even asked!
When you get you're room you call and they deliver your luggage to you so you don't even have to get it and bring it up. I'm telling you you will feel like royalty here.
The room was nice and had a great view to the pools and the ocean. The bathroom was amazing!
You get complete room service to tour room and you can call and ask for anything at all and they'll bring it. We only used it once I think cause we were rarely ever in the room.
Every day they restock your fridge with alcohol which of course is included.
I fell in love with the Day of the Dead decorations! I hate being repetitive and saying amazing a couple dozen times but it's just what suits them lol. They go all out with these decorations! These altars are beautiful, everything is fresh, it is the real deal and everything is done to perfection. They make skull designs out of different colored beans!!!
I loved the movie Coco and they had a very long and enjoyable performance on it. It was like a little Coco play but instead of rust seeing actors everyone was in full costumes head to toe. The kids loved it but most of us there were adults. And of course while you're watching they're bringing drinks around.
I love that we didn't have to make reservations for dinner because I am totally unpredictable on vacation. I might make a reservation by 9 but be starving by 7. Or make a reservation for 7 but still be partying and not want to eat just yet. 
I love sushi so I didn't really give other restaurants a chance and I only had sushi for dinner the whole time I was there.
Andy worked every day we were there in the mornings and early afternoons so we always made sure he was our server but even the ones we got at night were great too. Andy introduced us to his friend Pascual when my friend and I made some friends and expanded our breakfast group so they both served us and everything was always perfect, quick and delicious.
I was hungover one morning and Andy recommended and quickly brought me some hangover concoction they drink over there. Don't remember what it was but I loved it and it helped.
There's a small bar by the pools that plays all kinds of music at night and is a great place to have a few drinks and chat with friends before bed. I'm not a clubber so I  didn't even go in once and can't tell you anything about them. 
My friend and I drank the water they would bring us in cups and we never got sick which was a big concern for us in Mexico.

Now let me go over the cons which before I go into are so minimal to me and outweighed by the pros that I've already booked my next stay for May.
Lunch time we were always in the pool area so we would go to the buffet or a small hut by the pool with hot dogs, hamburgers and pizza. Lunch for us and anyone we spoke to was horrible. I'm sure the restaurants are great but who wants to get out of the pool, change into dry clothes, go eat and then change back into bathing suits to go back to the pool? We didn't want to cut our pool time short so we always stayed there for lunch and met many others that did the same and felt the same about the buffet and the hotdog/hamburger hut. I tried absolutely everything at the buffet multiple days and could not eat anything other than cheese. The food was either so salty it was inedible or just plain bad. Everything we tried tasted bad. We ate hotdogs and pizza every day for lunch because it was much better than the buffet but even that wasn't too good.
The hotel is pretty big and maybe it was cause we were drinking all day but it took us forever to learn how to get to our room! Lol it was a bit of a maze for us and we got lost the first 2 days all day. But again, most likely caused by our drinking and not the hotel.
I'm severely allergic to dust mites and my allergies were out of control in the room, especially in bed so I'd wake up completely congested. But my friend was fine so it's most likely just cause my nose is too sensitive.
Only other thing that was a con for us and is not a big deal at all is that everything but the clubs close relatively early. We were more bar people and like to lounge and relax so we were disappointed when the only options we had after dinner was to go clubbing. 

I think that's it! I think I've covered everything. Like I said, pros definitely outweigh the cons. Eat pizza or hotdogs for lunch or get your butts out of the pool and get dressed for lunch amd you'll be fine.

I've already sent a few friends there in the 3 months since I came back and like I said I'll be back there in May with my best friend for her birthday. I hope I'm able to make it back for The Day of the Dead im October as well because it was one of the best experiences I've ever had in my life. 

I love this hotel,  I love these people! Go and have a great time!

reviews.author: Ling
reviews.title: like a paridise
reviews.text: Our room is right in front of the sea and the large swimming pool. The view is so great and the hotel's overall facilities are great. The family concierge service is special from other hotel and make us feel like royal service. Thanks for the hotel's romatic arrange for our annivesary. It make our trip more memorable. My two little kids enjoyed the very beautiful swimming pool and beach so much and they didn't want to leave in the last day in the hotel. I will highly recommend this hotel for your vacation.

reviews.author: Petya L
reviews.title: Great service!
reviews.text: The experience was great! All the personnel makes sure you feel pampered and at home. The food is good, the beach is great! I had an especially great experience at the pool bar with Jaime, Samuel, and Gamaliel who made me feel like I was at home, and like I was a close friend. They actually were the people that made me finally forget about all the stress at home and really start my vacation! Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Paula C
reviews.title: Gorgeous views but the food was never hot
reviews.text:
Beautiful grounds and views.  The beach is gorgeous and I've never seen such clear beautiful water.  There is an open-air dining room for breakfast, lunch and dinner.  I thought the staff was always helpful and considerate. Overall, I really enjoyed the quiet and relaxing atmosphere. Grounds get an A

Hotel check-in was slow.  We checked in before 3 and had to go back at 3 to get our keys.  Our junior suite with an ocean view was roomy enough, but the sliding glass door leaked during very heavy rain - housekeeping had to put towels down on the floor. There was a ceiling light that wouldn't work and they couldn't fix it so maintenance put a lamp on the table.  The room and bathroom were very clean and my bed was very comfortable. The bathroom does not have an exhaust fan. There is no additional way to lock the door from the inside - none of those swing arms that prevent the door from being pushed open. Check-in and Room get a C (that lack of security took it down from a B

The food wasn't bad but it was not hot. There are multiple restaurants but theyr'e more like dining rooms than restaurants - you can take your buffet lunch from Naos and sit in Naos or Market Grill or Fuego or one of the others. You need dinner reservations at Fuego, which is a la carte for dinner; Vento, a tapas restaurant; Market Grill which is Argentinian / Brazilian Steakhouse where meat is carved onto your plate but you get your own sides.  There's a sushi restaurant but it wasn't always open. Any hot dish I took from the buffet was never more than warm-ish. My favorite place to eat was Market Grill because it's open air and even in the rainy weather it was a delightful place to sit and relax.  Warning, though. The wood tables need to be scrubbed, sanded and refinished.  They always felt sticky; I had to open my napkin and spread it out like a large placemat. The wait staff was all very nice but also very obvious about looking for tips -  Food gets a C

What? No bingo! No! There weren't a lot of activities to do - unless they were all at the family pool.  I didn't mind that too much - I was more interested in just relaxing and decompressing after a stressful year.  Each evening there was a show at the Avenue Bar but it seemed to be about 30 or 45 minutes and it was family friendly.  Activities get a C

It's not a dump but it's not spectacular (in my opinion). Overall, I'd give the resort a C+ (2 1/2 stars).

Hey TripAdvisor - you need to add 1/2 stars (circles?) to your rating system.

reviews.author: Carolyn T
reviews.title: Amazing holiday in an amazing place
reviews.text:
Family holiday over the new year break. Wonderful place, great food and drinks and right on a lovely beach! Strange hearing Christmas songs whilst sitting in the sunshine
We travelled with virgin and did a trip to swin with turtles and to visit the Cenotes which we would highly recommend

reviews.author: TravelerForLifeNow
reviews.title: This place is a dump.  Don't be fooled by the reviews here
reviews.text: This is the 2nd year I was forced to attend a conference at this hotel by my employer.  The food is absolutely HORRIBLE.  The resort while having the appearance of being clean is filled with mold.  The resort burns incense continuously to mask the horrible smells of mold and rot.  The resorts is very dated and dark. And if you stay in the main town, they play blaring music well into the night.  I would NEVER bring my family here and hope I never have to stay here again.  If you like nice, airy, CLEAN resorts with good food there are so many other choices in Cancun.  Heed my warning

reviews.author: Chelsea G
reviews.title: The best vacations
reviews.text: Saul and Julio best activity directors. Inviting and make you feel right at home. If you have any questions about Cancun they have they answers! If you are at Paradisus, make sure to look for them ans then write a review on trip advisor!

reviews.author: Shannon S
reviews.title: Had an AMAZING trip
reviews.text:
We had an AMAZING trip! All of the staff were so helpful and friendly! LOVED the energy of the dancers and the music playing all weekend. Would highly recommend and WILL be coming back. 

Rodrigo, Julio, and Saul were amazing!!

reviews.author: V2185CXdave
reviews.title: Super Service
reviews.text: This was our second time at Paradisus Cancun in less than 6 months.  We chose the "Royal Service" this time and it was great.  Javier was a wonderful "butler" and helped us with whatever we needed.  The pool service and the Palapa was great!  We had a wonderful time and can't wait to go back.

reviews.author: janw48
reviews.title: A fair hotel
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun is a beautiful hotel and well maintained. The service was excellent and the rooms were spacious and clean.

There are lots of palapas on the beach and near the pool which provide shade. Waiters even come to the beach and the poolside to take orders and bring you drinks. 

The biggest downside to this hotel is the food in the buffet. EVERYTHING was cold so food that should have been hot was not even warm.  I never had any food that was remotely warm.  The selection was the same every day with not many cooked vegetables.  Most of the food was very bland and salt and pepper were not on the table.  You had to ask the waiter and he put it on your food for you.  Never had that experience before.  I talked with several guests who had the same complaints about the food and said that it was definitely not up to the standard of a 4+ hotel.

For this reason I wouldn't go back to this hotel or recommend it to any of my friends.

reviews.author: SamTheSamSam
reviews.title: Another Great Melia
reviews.text: This was our second stay at a Melia all-inclusive resort.  We loved our experience at the Las Esmeralda resort in Playa Del Carmen and took a chance on this one.  We great enjoyed the resort.  It was the same quality experience, however, the resort was definitely older that the previous one we had visited.  There were some repair issues they needed to address like some leaks.  But overall it was very clean and the staff was absolutely excellent.  The beach was beautiful as well with extremely attentive personnel.  We got a studio which was spacious but sparse.

reviews.author: Alexandria L
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: Such a family friendly hotel! Thank you Lucia, Adriana, and Rodrigo for a great time! The service at the hotel was great. It was a beautiful resort. Staff were excellent and friendly! Will definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: Luis Ramos
reviews.title: Great way to celebrate Mom's 50th
reviews.text:
My sister and I invited our Mom to Cancun the weekend of January 25th to celebrate her 50th Birthday. We came to Cancun on a very wet weekend with nonstop thunderstorms. It was upsetting to not be able to enjoy the beach however our stay in the resort was fantastic. Several restaurants to choose from. The bars try their hardest to not see an empty class. Great attractions every night. The spa was very relaxing.

Best event: Silent Party

One thing I can see as an area of opportunity is the resorts lack of seating for their restaurants that require reservations.  There's nothing on the website of the restaurants that need reservations and by the time we checked in, there was no availability.

reviews.author: CMY26
reviews.title: Great family vacay!
reviews.text:
A well deserved 4.5/5! This is a late review, but our family had a great trip to the resort in November!  We had not originally booked family concierge, but my husband, 9 year old son and I quickly upgraded and don’t regret it. Alexander and Rodolfo were our concierges (one during the day, one during the night) and they were amazing!  They were quick to learn our preferences - wine, fruit plates, kid snacks, etc. They utilized What’s App to communicate with us daily via cell phone multiple times a day with scheduled activities and status checks. It was a great resource!

The beach was nice. We had no trouble getting chairs, umbrellas, and towels each morning. The waves were a little strong for our 9 year old at that time of year, but with an adult there were no issues. Also the beach servers were attentive. 

The pool was great (and clean), but would recommend floats/tubes for younger children as it can be deep. Also, the concierge staff (Rodolfo and Alex) were very helpful in reserving cabanas by the pool when available and checking in on us everyday. 

The room was modern and quite roomy for 3 people (king bed and twin size roll-way cot).  The restaurants were good, but compared to other Paradisus hotels the food could have been better at some restaurants. 

Overall, the resort is amazing and we would not hesitate to book again with Rodolfo and Alexander by our side!

reviews.author: E-Rick
reviews.title: Very disappinted in Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: We went over Christmas vacation a few weeks ago and had a very bad experience from check-in issues to bad food and service.  We have been to several other resorts - Paradisus and others and this was the worst overall experience we have had.  In short, we did the all inclusive and the food was poor - cold and just bad in most places.  Had a few good meals, the outdoor pool bar was probably the best aside from NAOS.  Didn't find the staff overly attentive or pleasant to deal with.  There were not many activities being run during the week.  Got in to arguments with 2 different workers at restaurants.  Had issues with rooms, tennis equipment old and broken.  We are club melia and had family concierge and had issues on what was included with what.  We spoke to someone mid-week about everything going on and never was contacted by a manager or anyone else to discuss.  Honestly, after 2 days we were considering leaving to go home or find another resort but decided to just deal with it.  I could probably keep going but I think you can get the gist from here.  We have been to the carribean several times and at other Paradisus resorts and had extremely good experiences.  Maybe it was just an off week but I don't think so. We were told that melia bought this hotel 4 years ago and has been working on transitioning to Paradisus - doesn't seem like they did any work/improvements and can't understand why it would take so long to get things up to speed.  Just seems mis-managed and there are probably plenty of other resorts in Cancun that are better.

reviews.author: George P
reviews.title: Our stay at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Great staff good live entertainment and most restaurants food was excellent beach area very clean and well attentive the gym was excellent and very clean your golf course was in prime condition but over priced for balls and equipment

reviews.author: Martin R
reviews.title: Really awesome vacations
reviews.text: It was a very memorable vacations!!! The staff is great, always polite and helpful, the food experience was also great, lots of choices, some a la carte restaurant without reservations (maybe an italian restaurant would be a good add) lots of choices at the buffet.Great service/staff overall and really clean everwhere you go!

reviews.author: Popsicle-t0es1
reviews.title: Very food overall experience
reviews.text:
We stayed here in Jan 2019 and were happy with our stay. 

CHECK-IN: we booked through Melia's website and took advantage of the online check-in. Found out it didn't really make a difference as we still had to wait for our room since we arrived early.

ROOM: Our room was a Jr. Suite Ocean View and it's in the main building (Building 3). This is where all the restaurants and nightly entertainment are located. IF YOU ARE A LIGHT SLEEPER, ask for a different building / tower. The entertainment can be loud at night. The room size is decent, although it's smaller than Paradisus La Perla in Playa Del Carmen. This one had a tub/shower combo, whereas the one in Playa Del Carmen had a separate shower and separate big tub. The exterior room design, especially the balcony is a plus and minus at the same time. A plus because it's private, so you can't see your neighbors nor can they see you, so if you want to do topless sun bathing, you can go crazy without worrying about privacy. But, it also means you can't see the sea view while sitting down - you have to stand up to see the beautiful sea view.

WIFI - This was a work-cation for me, so I made sure the WIFI reviews were good before booking. It didn't disappoint. The speed measured 50mbps on my measurement, so it's considered Premium WiFi for Mexico standard. Speed was good, although coverage was hit or miss at the beach. 

ROOM SERVICE - there's a US$5 room service charge. I thought it's supposed to be all-inclusive? The one in Playa Del Carmen didn't have room service charge, just sayin'.

FOOD - there's equal reservation-only and walk-in allowed restaurants and we got into a couple of reservation-only restaurants without one by showing up early around 6pm. The reservation-only restaurants were good, Vento, Mole, Fuego. Ensso and Bana (sushi bar) were decent too. But buffet food was boring after a while, the breakfast and lunch selections were the same every single day. 

SERVICE: service was excellent from everyone we encountered. 

BEACH: loved the beach! It's wide, with soft sands that stretch for miles and easy on your bare feet. Plenty of Bali beds (extra pay) and lounge chairs under palapas (included in your All Inclusive deals).

POOLS: plenty of pools to stretch out, from Adults only, Family, to the one with pool bar. 

Overall, it was a good work-cation for me. In terms of hotel layout and rooms, I prefer Paradisus La Perla in Playa Del Carmen. It's a bigger resort and more spread out. The one in Cancun is still big, but more contained, but the beach is definitely better in Cancun.

reviews.author: Quest10407573140
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun review
reviews.text: Excellent resort, very clean attentive staff, great experience overall. Needs to work on food options, although there are a couple of great restaurants including Vento, Market Grill, and Enzo’s. 7/10 for food options and quality of food.

reviews.author: kane702
reviews.title: Great hotel with a few service issues.
reviews.text:
I was a little disappointed that we weren't able to check in an hour early, but it was nice that we were allowed to begin using the amenities before getting our room.
There was a little confusion with our luggage, and it ended up coming to our room later than we were expecting.  The room itself was fantastic!
The pool was beautiful, but it was a little difficult to find a spot.  Almost all the lounge chairs were taken (covered with a towel), but their owners were elsewhere.  There were many empty daybeds, but we were told we had to reserve those in advance, which wouldn't have worked since we were only staying one night.  
Our dinner reservation at Bana was lost, and we ended up eating there around 9:30.  The food was great, and the service was very friendly.  We decided to check out their club after that.  It had a slight smell, and could definitely use an update (and maybe some softer lighting), but we had a good time anyway.
Overall it was a very fun stay, but we did run into a few unexpected issues.

reviews.author: kamim555
reviews.title: FAN--FREAKING-TASTIC!
reviews.text: We stayed Feb-18-24, my husband and I went with another couple and did the Royal Service ( Adults only, butler service) and it was awesome! It is hardly ever a situation where you look at the web-site and it looks just like the photos. I 100% recommend getting the ocean view, this ocean is gorgeous! we have been to the Bahamas, Jamaica, Turks and Caicos and this part of the ocean was the prettiest we have seen yet..it isn't a "quiet" ocean it was moving pretty good but we still were able to go play in the waves and it was just awesome to hear those waves crashing at night. They have a huge pool in the Royal Service section and we were in it a bunch, the pool was nice and warm and there were days when it was literally just us in it. It not one time felt crowded. We were able to have a cabana each day we were there ( remember to check in to the cabana by 11:00 am ) Jose was the pool concierge and he was SPECTACULAR!!!!! he was simply awesome and did everything in the world to make sure we were taken care of.. Find him the first day you are there and the rest of your stay will be excellent! the pool staff were also just amazing.. Vincent, Ricardo and a woman named something like Valoria? man they were just so great! everybody just went out of their way to help and make sure you got everything you wanted/needed. The room was super clean and the balcony was nice and big! inside the resort was a little tricky getting around at first but after the first day it isn't a big deal. The food was great too, we were able to go to all the restaurants except Tempo. They were all just so good. Get with your Butler when you arrive so they can get your reservations all set up. I would recommend this resort to anyone who would listen... Oh and the trip from the Airport to the resort is simply stunning, man everything was so pretty and clean! we for sure will go back..

reviews.author: Shah K
reviews.title: So so
reviews.text: First trip to Cancun. Disappointed. Good service. Food not good at all. Bad choice for buffet. Speciality restaurants not good either. Night time shows were so bad and arranged in a poor manner. I had a concierge room but she would come up with excuses all the time. I’m never going back to Mexico.

reviews.author: 162verah
reviews.title: THE BEST!!!
reviews.text:
Room 3216 at the Paradisus--and paradise it was!  Everything was beyond perfect.  The hotel is VERY VERY well kept up, and everyone who works there takes pride in keeping all aspects of the hotel in an excellent and clean condition.

All of food at the the restaurants is SO good--and the buffet is great too!  The service is beyond words.

We have been to this resort 2 years in a row (something we have never done before), and we plan to visit again ASAP!  LOVE LOVE LOVE!

Shout outs--HUGO, VICTOR, JAMIE and JUDITH!!!  In a word:  WONDERFUL and we already miss them.

reviews.author: Clyde S
reviews.title: Paradisus but for...
reviews.text: Four of us traveled here together to attend a private wedding involving only 20 people.  ALL four of us became victims of “Montezuma’s Revenge.”  As we were leaving I learned others there for the wedding suffered similarly but to different degrees.  We didn’t all eat or drink the same things.  The only thing we had in common was we never left the property.  So who knows the cause, but it had to be food, water, ice?  It’s like the stories you read about cruise ships where a few people get sick and it spreads through the whole boat.  But for the revenge, I’d be giving this place close to 5 stars.  EXCEPTIONAL service, great facilities, great beach, beautiful rooms etc.

reviews.author: Rogelio14
reviews.title: Just starting and it has been way below expectations!
reviews.text:
Room: 5312

We just arrived on Feb, 25...it has been only one day and we have been dissapointed several times. This review is not done in a vaccum as we have been in sister properties who has been much better and also lots of other hotel chains on the same price range. Here are a couple of issues we have had in less than 24hrs:

1) We arrive at the hotel around 2:30pm, after being escorted to Royal Servicd we actually started checkin at 3:10pm...and only one of two rooms were ready...after pointing out that check-in is at 3pm the person responde that hotel was near capacity..THAT IS NOT MY PROBLEM. After they saw I would not just take that argument they "found" us a ready room.

2) First day at the pool, we booked the Balinese beds...they are cool! But pool service is really slow...they need more waiters or a better system.

3) Tried to go into the big jacuzzi and to our surprise it was not even close to warm...there is absolutely no heating on it...a cold jacuzzi is not what you expect on a hotel on this price range....the pool temperature could be hotter but it was close to acceptable.

4) On out first full day we left our room at 10am...came back at 4:30pm and the room
was still not done.

5) We have not seen the night shows but their so called "show venue" are the bottom of the main steps...people actually have to seat on the floor and the space is very reduced which means shows are probably not good

We have gone to a lot of different all incluse chains including Paradisus Playa del Carmen and the comparison ends in the name...they are not on the same level, pricing showed that a little but expected a lot more from the brand....

Nothing in this post is extremely bad...its mostly that the expectations where a lot higher on this brand and property.

Regards
Rogelio

reviews.author: Kyle K
reviews.title: Cancun Vacation - February 2018
reviews.text: I stayed in Paradisus with my wife and 4 year old daughter during our vacation in February of 2018 - great hotel, very clean, kids and family friendly.  Above all though I wanted to highlight staff friendliness and their willingness to go above and beyond to make sure you want to come back to this hotel.  I wanted to mention our servers at Naos - Christian Lovera, Edwin, Atilano and Ricardo.  Your service is absolutely amazing - thank you!  And if you stay at this hotel, definitely make reservation at Fuego restaurant - great food and again, unbelievable service.  Thanks everybody at Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: pablittus
reviews.title: Family Concierge @ Paradisus Cancun - One of the greatest decisions
reviews.text:
In February 2018 we decided to visit Mexico, most specifically Cancun. It was our first time and with 2-y twins it could be a real mess if you don't decide well where are you going to stay. As a final decision we booked directly with Paradisus by Melia using Family Concierge option and it was a great decision! 
Maria and Gloria were the two concierges assigned to us, they helped us in all ways possible. Making the kids really happy with all the gifts and also the parents with wine and food. All 10 days there were really amazing and every day with different. Maria and Gloria helped us booking in all restaurants inside Paradisus and many other things. Everyone in the hotel was lovely and very respectful, always keeping the customer well cared. 
The only 1 thing they need to improve is Enzo restaurant which seems really interesting but the food and desserts are not really at the same level like Bana, Mole or Fuego. 
If you have kids, this is the place that you shoud go for vacations!

reviews.author: Leo D
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun-2018
reviews.text: Beautiful beachfront property! Most expansive beache in Cancun. The adult only Royal Sevice tower is the place to,be.Wevwere treated like royalty! We have stayed here many times and have never been disappointed! Looking forward to returning next year

reviews.author: rzolt
reviews.title: Paradisus Does It Again!
reviews.text:
This was our 9th visit to Paradisus Cancun in 7 years so, it’s obvious that we like it.  We enjoy the interior design with the greenery and the laid back atmosphere that permeates all the pyramids even though they are a beehive of activity from men and women working feverishly to maintain the facility.  We love the beach and although the water can be a little rough it never stops us from enjoying it. 

What really makes Paradisus special is the staff some of whom have come to recognize us each year when we return and greet us like old friends.  Ivette, from Operations, has also been wonderful to us.  We had a problem during our second visit years ago that she promised to make up for when returned and she did just that.  We’ve returned 6 times after that visit because of Ivette’s efforts to make that 3rd stay nicer.  Karina, at Club Melia check-in is also a welcome sight and greets us warmly whether or not she is actually the one to check us in.

We also noticed changes from last year that made this trip a bit nicer.  There was new artwork throughout the buildings and our room, new activities on the beach and pool and one night there was a trio similar to The Three Tenors who sang to us from balconies in the internal atria.  Their performance was certainly special.  Paradisus also started serving dinner around the pool which is an amazingly nice touch.  It can’t get any nicer than after spending an incredible day at the beach to dine poolside and let the evening breezes cool you.

I could go on forever.  Our daughter is 16 now and has many wonderful memories of Paradisus that she will likely reflect on all her life.  Yes, we love Paradisus Cancun and hope everyone finds the same joy here as we have.

reviews.author: Mom2girls165
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: Great time at the Paradisus Cancun resort. Hotel is immaculate and beautiful! The staff is extremely friendly and helpful. Our butler, Alexander was very accomidating. He helped make reservations, left goodies and surprises for the kids and was available to assist us. Family Concerige level with a suite provides a large room. The restaurants were just ok, but overall we loved this hotel!

reviews.author: Shawna L
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun Hotel was Fantastic!
reviews.text:
This is the first time we have stayed right in Cancun, Our other 3 vacations in Mexico,have been at hotels in Riviera Maya.
This hotel is beautiful, the restaurants were splendid. Our favorite was the Bana, great staff.

Marco, with the entertainment team was great. Beach Volleyball, Zumba. The other thing that he did was, to make sure we were aware of the evening entertainment. Thanks Marco.

Laura, was at the main pool. She was fabulous, and made sure we were very well taken care of. Thanks Laura

The 9 hole, par 3 golf course was fun. It was in good shape, We went every morning at 7:45. It took about 45 mins for 9 holes. The longest hole is 122 yards. We  bought our own clubs as we new we would go out every morning.(PW,SW, and putt) If you need to work on your short game, is course is great. The cost for rentals  was $27.00USD plus balls. It is not busy at all.

reviews.author: BrianandTrish
reviews.title: 5th year anniversary visiting Paradisus
reviews.text:
We are so excited to be going again in a few weeks for our 5 year anniversary(same week every year) to see the fantastic staff at our home away from home.  
Royal Service is awesome and everyone is there to make sure your stay is enjoyable.  
Every year there are new improvements to the property, and the same great staff is still there.  
They work so hard to make sure all your needs are met.  
See you in a few weeks.  Can’t wait for breakfast by the ocean, my favorite Bali bed, and relaxing in perfection for 7 glorious days.

reviews.author: Lis V
reviews.title: The name suits them well! Paradise.
reviews.text: amazing hotel. beautiful lobby area! rooms were comfy and modern. Ignacio, Martin and Edwin at breakfast buffet restaurant went above and beyond to serve us and make us feel welcome!  Great location in reference to the nightlife outside of the resort. Amazing spot on the beach! great food.Overall, can't wait to return.

reviews.author: Licia M
reviews.title: Cannot wait to get here
reviews.text: We were here three years ago and we are going back March 1, 2018. Let me start by saying as a couple everyone should go for the royal service.  You have access to areas for adults only.  Makes your trip totally worth it. The bali beds by the private pool are truly amazing.  The gentlemen who work this area are the number one reason we are returning here.  The second reason is the fabulous bartender's. These particular people know how to give excellent service and make every person feel very special.  On the negative side, our last trip was almost totally ruined by our "butler". He did not accommodate in any way.  His first response to us after saying hello was that he doesn't do that!  We asked him to get us a bottle of wine  after a long day of traveling and just wanted to chill in the room awhile.  He also was not helpful regarding restaurants.  I will say the NAOS buffet is very sufficient and we didn't even care about the restaurant problems we were having last time but still the butler is supposed to help you!  My comments to the management is THANK your staff who keep people coming back.  The cabana men, bartenders, maids, servers at NAO.  These people are the gems.  Looking forward to going back to Market Grill, Vento and LaPalapa.  We will be here for 12 days this trip and I hope some of the great people who were there last time.  I will update my review when we return from this trip.  Can't wait to go back! (Hopefully a different butler)

reviews.author: Californiatraveller7
reviews.title: Great time at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
Our family had a great time at Paradisus Cancun.  Service level by all personnel was, on the whole, outstanding and the outdoor amenities (pool, lounge chairs, palapas, etc.) was top notch and availability of these amenities was not a significant problem.  It is on a gorgeous stretch of beach that is less crowded than other parts of the beach in Cancun.  You won't be disappointed.

We had a one-bedroom Family Concierge suite with an Ocean View.  We were pleasantly surprised by the quality of the room; it is very comfortable and both the living area and the bedroom have their own balconies which was great as we were able to enjoy the sound of the ocean while the kids were asleep.  The view was amazing.  The Family Concierge butler assigned to our family was an outstanding resource making restaurant and bali bed reservations and making sure that we had everything we need from band aids to towels to a bottle of wine for the terrace.  I don't know if I would find the butler service particularly useful if I weren't traveling with our kids.  But with kids, it was a really valuable service.

With respect to the food at the Paradisus, it should be said that you shouldn't come with expectations of great cuisine at the food options in the all-inclusive plan.  Yes, there are a lot of options and variety and everything is fresh which is great but the execution was wanting.  We came for the beach and the weather, not the food, so this didn't detract from our experience.  We figured we couldn't go wrong with the Mexican food but Mole was disappointing.  Blue Agave was good but only had tacos and soups, no rice and beans which my kids love.  Fuego was decent.  Naos could best be described as lower-midgrade Vegas buffet.  You can definitely find some diamonds in the rough there but nothing special.  Breakfast in our opinion was the best meal of the day.  

That said, we had dinner one night at Tempo which is not included in the all-inclusive plan.  It was a world-class experience and rivaled tasting menus I have had at top restaurants in NY.  Definitely worth the splurge.

Overall, we can highly recommend the Paradisus Cancun.  Yes, the resort is showing its age a little bit in the indoor common areas but the rooms and outside amenities were great and well maintained.  The staff definitely bent over backwards to make sure we had an enjoyable stay and the wait staff covered the outdoor beach and pool areas very well.  Our family had a great time and we would be happy to come back again.

reviews.author: Momof2travelerTXNY
reviews.title: Beautiful pyramid, relaxing stay
reviews.text:
Just got back from here and I have to say, we truly enjoyed ourselves.  As with any property, if you really wanted to dissect it, there are pros and cons to everything.  Overall, this was a relaxing and beautiful resort! Kathia at Naos, Felipe the busboy, Jose my Nespresso guru and the omelet lady for breakfast (picture in my review) all get an A+ in my book!

Not 5 stars b/c the quality is lacking just a bit as they cater to A LOT of rooms/people, but still excellent.

Pros:

·        Big hotel with lots of food options.  Dinner restaurants are reservation only (that can get tricky) but if you don’t make reservations, the buffet is always open.  If you can’t find something to eat at the buffet, you are very picky! Breakfast was my favorite part but I always found SOMETHING to eat.
·        Beach is simply amazing! The water was a *bit* choppy while we were there but still could swim and enjoy. The weather was AMAZING this time of year.  Breezy and 82 everyday!
·        Hard workers can be found EVERYWHERE!!! Really! It’s amazing to see what it takes to keep this resort so beautiful.  I ALWAYS saw someone cleaning, watering plants, cleaning the hundreds of vines that fall from the center, sweeping etc…. Hard working people!
·        The resort is literally across the stress from AquaWorld if you want to partake in any water activities. All you do is cross the street.
·        Ocean view room was worth it!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
·        The Noon Maya show by the pool was pretty cool.
·        The seafood platter from Cocos Beach Club was the most amazing thing I have ever seen!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Highlight of our trip!

Cons:
·        Swim up pool is nice but they close early, at 6 pm.  Who closes a pool that early? That’s a first for me!
·        There are stairs.  A lot of them.  All over the resort.  It’s shaped like a pyramid so expect pyramid type stairs.  Not a huge issue for me but it could be for others.
·        While we were there, the Nespresso bar only opened from 11-6.  I drink my coffee in the early morning. Again, they have coffee in your room and at the buffet but I LOVEDDDD my daily coffee from Mr. Jose so I want to whine about this.  The hours are not posted so I just asked him. The day we left, it seemed they were changing them so I guess it’s a weekly/monthly thing.  In any case, I would’ve wanted earlier coffee hours. I miss Jose already =(
·        Same with the Gelato location.  They were only open 12-5 while we were there. I get they have to cut costs in some areas but some days we couldn’t get crepes b/c they were closed.  However, the lady that makes them is SUPER sweet!!!!!!!!! When we did have them, my kids said that was their favorite part! She was very sweet.  She was handling both the Gelato and the Crepes alone. Always with a line but always with a smile!
·        The Asian food was really not good. As in really bad. I hate to even say that but save your reservations for any place other than Bana and Enso. Bana was tempting b/c it’s the restaurant smack in the middle of the hotel but no bueno.  And Enso was by far our worst meal. BUT we just ended up grabbing a bite at Naos (the buffet) so we really can’t complain much b/c like I said, you can always find food!
·        The evening performances leave a lot to be desired. Don’t expect a Broadway show.

reviews.author: TravelerForLifeNow
reviews.title: The food is HORRIBLE
reviews.text: Stayed at this all inclusive resort for a business conference.  The property is run down and dated.  The food is absolutely horrible, especially the buffet restaurants.  The remaining restaurants all require reservations.  I would NEVER stay here again

reviews.author: Mr. V
reviews.title: Lost our flight or Extended vacations?
reviews.text: So we lost our flight back to the states on Sunday afternoon. Instead of getting angry and ruining our trip we decided this one-day vacation extension was meant to be - so we made the best of it. We stayed at Paradisus and the stay was fantastic! The room was neat and clean and the overall resort was fantastic. We really enjoyed the pool with the music. The cabanas were a little extra but our stay was truly fantastic!

reviews.author: jrwriter64
reviews.title: Wedding Anniversary
reviews.text: My wife and I just returned from celebrating our wedding anniversary and we couldn't be more pleased with our service. Alain from royal service did an excellent job making sure we had what we needed!! Alain also provided great deco for my wife and I throughout our stay and especially on our anniversary night. Could not have enjoyed ourselves any more than how we did.

reviews.author: Emily R
reviews.title: Third time at the Paradisus and will be back!
reviews.text:
We’ve just returned from 5 days at the Paradisus Cancun, and had yet another great vacation! The resort is gorgeous … the pools are large and never feel crowded, the food in all the restaurants is fresh and delicious, we especially enjoyed the Market Grill and seafood night at Naos. In every corner of the resort the Paradisus staff is friendly, happy and the service is always first class. The rooms are clean, large and very comfortable. The fridge was restocked daily with water, soda and snacks. There is  entertainment and activities that we all enjoyed and there were decorations for Valentine’s Day, the staff gave my girls roses by the pool and they loved it. The beach in Cancun is gorgeous and Paradisus is in a great location. We were able to jump on the bus for a quick ride downtown for a little afternoon shopping. 

We are Club Melia members and there is something about the member check-in that always makes us feel like VIPs. We had Claudia Arriola as our concierge for this visit and when we were there in 2016. Claudia is the best! Before we even arrive she is in contact to help us plan the best vacation we can have. She sent us details on roundtrip transfers from the airport, which was super easy to reserve in advance and made our arrival at the airport simple and smooth. She makes sure we get dinner reservations at the restaurants we want to eat in, lets us know about special events, shows and offers available to us as hotel guests. She checks in periodically to make sure we are enjoying our stay and have everything we need … but is never pushy or intrusive. She understands we are on vacation and want to relax. Claudia is attentive, smart, professional, dedicated and one of the sweetest people I’ve ever worked with to plan an unforgettable and fun vacation for my family. We look forward to returning to Paradisus Cancun again and again.

reviews.author: Love2travel19892
reviews.title: Perfection...
reviews.text:
We’ve been to Cancun more than 30 times staying in various hotels and resorts and found the Paradisus by far the best hotel in the ‘hotel zone’.  The service is perfect, buffet and restaurants perfect and the staff goes out of their way to help. 
There are several specialty restaurants that are included in the all inclusive including the best steakhouse where they bring you large selections of meats and cut them off the bones at your table 
The Mediterranean and Sochi restaurants were also perfect.   
Poolside has 1 more restaurant and a place to get hot dogs, burgers, chicken wings or Mexican cuisine. 
If you prefer the buffet, they offer everything including a huge selection of seafood and almost everything you can imagine or want.  
The pool is huge with a great swim up bar and a staff member always there to take your order.   
In the evenings there are nightly shows and the ‘red’ bar opens at 10 pm.   
Yes, they will offer you a timeshare presentation but they are not pushy.  Out of curiosity we took the time share tour and saved big money on tickets to Xplor  (zip lines) with the kids
If anyone finds any fault with this hotel, I’d be surprised.  

We’ve been at this hotel several times and just can’t see going to any other resorts while in Cancun.

reviews.author: PT1280
reviews.title: Great second trip back to Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
We decided on returning to Paradisus this year with a group of 4 adults and 4 kids January 11-18.  Unfortunately 6 out of our 8 days was bad weather but the staff and management went above and beyond making sure there were lots of activities to keep the kids occupied.  The President of Mexico was also on site on one of the days to speak at a conference, and there was little to no disruption to our vacation which was really appreciated considering the amount of security and bankers on the property. 
The food selection was excellent. Our favorites were the Japanese and Tapas.  We are extremely grateful for the hosts/hostesses for always finding us a table for 8 at anytime of day, particularly Katia who remembered us from our visit last year. Thank you Katia. 
The beach is great with loungers available if you can reserve one early. Otherwise, there are always some avail on the far sides.  It was great to see Luis again this year. Thank you for the drinks Luis!
The pools are fantastic.  Wish we had more nice weather to enjoy them. Would be really nice if they had a warm pool or a hot tub as it was pretty cold during our stay. This wasn’t a big concern as it was the same last year. There are lots of clean towels available to warm up. Hopefully warming the pools is something Paradisus can address in the future to make it a 5 star rating from us!! 
Our kids favorite is definitely the kids club.  Best kids club at any resort we’ve been too. Lots of space and stuff to keep them busy. Thank you Andrea and Hali for making the kids experience memorable. 
Lastly, the one thing that will keep us returning is the impeccable service we received from every member of the hotel staff.  From check in to check out, we really felt welcome and no request was out of the way.  To see a few of the staff members from the last year is amazing and we hope to see our friends when we return again. 
After our trip last year, we weren’t sure we would return as there are so many other hotels and resorts to try, but we’re so glad we did and it won’t be the last.

reviews.author: ronika80
reviews.title: amazing service
reviews.text:
We stayed at this hotel last week and have to say the service and ambience of the hotel was excellent. We found it to be very kid friendly and loved everything from the pools, the rooms and definitely the food.  

We had called ahead and informed them that we were vegetarians.  We were provided with a variety of off the menu vegetarian options regardless of which restaurant we booked to eat in.  I would like to mention in particular Chef Eduardo Mukul who was fantastic and made our stay memorable with the amazing food he made for us.

We would highly recommend this hotel for vegetarians, families with young kids (my son did not want to leave the kids club) and for anyone looking for a wonderful relaxed holiday.

reviews.author: kaj
reviews.title: Surprisingly GOOD
reviews.text: We booked this hotel trough a sharp deal through booking. Compared to the price with other hotels, we didn’t had a very high expectation.  That all changed when we arived.  More then friendly check in. We did now that the former melia was a bit dated. But hey! We expierenced a. Nice a newly up to date athmosphere, overall very friendly staff.  Good drinks, an absolute nice wine.  We had an upgrade to Royal service. Wich was absoluut nice. Sperate nice pool and some other opportunities.  We have expierenced the whole resort without showing our gold bracelets en efforts. We were helped and serviced everywere good!.  Had food en diner in almost every restaurant. Without reservations , and plans where we wanted to eat. We checked without plans to go somewere, and never got dissapointed. We were very happy with our room in building 5. But we checked also the other rooms in the complex, when we walked through the corridors. The all look nice and comfortable.  Paradisus thanks! It was good.

reviews.author: lgvill
reviews.title: Caring staff
reviews.text: Great time for our family of four. The staff is so friendly and thoughtful. The grounds are amazing. The hotel beautiful and the whole place is so clean. We did family concierge- our butler Violeta was so sweet. Shout out to the excellent servers that put up w our toddlers including Christian and Armando. There were so many others that I can’t recall all their names. Never blinked an eye when our kids weren’t at their best. They knew what we were drinking each meal and had it ready before we even got situated. And every day our cabana /pool guys Jaime and David were so attentive.  The staff truly makes you feel cared for. My 4 year old already wants to know when we will be back.

reviews.author: Priscilla N
reviews.title: Awesome service!
reviews.text: My husband and I truly enjoyed ourselves at Paradisus Cancun!! Yamil Padilla and Jose @ Enzo restaurant provided superb service!!! All of the hotel associates are super friendly and we can’t wait to go back!

reviews.author: Dale M
reviews.title: Treated like honored guests!
reviews.text: We are Melia Club members in Dominican Republic and moved our time share over to Melia Cancun for a new experience. During our week's stay, we were gratified at the commodious ocean view room (wished we had a hot plate), extended pool, pristine beach, towel service, attitude of all staff members, and drink service everywhere. Even the evening entertainment was better than expected. The checking in and out could have been more efficient. We can't comment on the food/restaurants as we ate out instead of choosing the all-inclusive, but certainly would return in a heart beat. Very welcoming!

reviews.author: Lawrence E
reviews.title: Fantastic Resort
reviews.text: The first time we have stayed in Cancun and the Paradisus and booked thru RCI.  We had a 1 bedroom 2 bath unit that was comfortable and very clean.  Couple housekeeping issues but nothing significant and was fixed right away.  The All inclusive was not that bad price wise.  9 Restaurants on property, including buffet. The Buffet had a variety of selections, but most were lukewarm and need to be reheated somehow. The other restaurants were outstanding on selection and quality!! The beach area was very clean. Staff was always friendly and helpful. I would recommend the Paradisus in Cancun.

reviews.author: LIZBETH P
reviews.title: Awesome Employees and Service
reviews.text:
I want to thank the Club Melia employees who always give the extra mile to make you feel wonderful and treated like family. Thanks to Betsy, Fabiola, Karina, Ruth, and the Butlers Brayant and George. Also, I want to thanks Ivette who manage and serve an excellent team.

In the SPA area the service is very good, nevertheless the massage therapist Liliana Marquez exceeded all my expectations.  She treats you with respect, kindness and professionalism.  I want to thanks Liliana for her exceptional work.

For sure I will return to the Paradisus. I feel like home

reviews.author: Meagan G
reviews.title: Shoutout to our boy Marco!
reviews.text:
This resort is simply amazing. The restaurants were great and we had wonderful nice dining experiences. Bana, the Sushi Bar is to die for!! We could have ate there every night. The beach was gorgeous and well maintain. The pool was amazing and is close to the ocean. You do however need to get to the pool semi early as chairs get claimed real fast. 

Watching the Entertainment Crew dance to Zumba every morning was definitely a highlight. The music gets you going for a day of drinking. Ps. The drinks here are soooo good and go down way to easy... 

At the pool is where we met Marco from the Entertainment Crew! He is one of the nicest individuals you will meet. Professional, personable and super charming. You look forward to seeing that infectious smile everyday. 

The one thing that stood out for me the most though was Marco setting some time aside to come up to lobby (while we were waiting for our shuttle) to say bye and see us all off. Melted my heart a bit and definitely appreciated that. We as a family have been to Mexico many times over the years, and never has someone made a point in doing that. Keep this boy around! He's lovely! 

Our annual family vacation was a success and I will definitely be back. The only negative I have is that there weren't any midday pool games. Beside that... top notch!! 

Thank you Paradisus, you were wonderful!

reviews.author: Butch F
reviews.title: Love Love Love it!
reviews.text: Go here! My wife and I have done extensive traveling and this place rocks, one of the most beautiful hotels we have stayed at. Top notch service, great food, friendly staff beautiful beach, plenty of room to not feel crowded. There were a few more children than we would have liked but it was fine. Shows were so so. The water was pretty rough, not good for children but my wife and I enjoyed the beating from the big waves. :)  Overall our week was fantastic!

reviews.author: Johnzags
reviews.title: Second Awesome visit at Paradisus Cancun!
reviews.text:
This is the second time that we’ve been to Paradisus In the last 6 months and we have not been let down! The second visit has been every bit as great as our first.  We highly recommend this resort!

Some of the employees here that have made our visit exceptional are Jose (pool concierge), Hector (our butler) - the incredible wait staff including Orlando, Hector, Victor, Josua, Eddie, Moises, Jorgie, and so many others! Sorry if we missed you because all of the staff here goes out of their way to ensure you enjoy your trip! 

We are already planning our next visit and can’t wait to return!!

reviews.author: Don Q
reviews.title: 2nd TIME BACK
reviews.text:
My wife and I came back for a second vacation at Paradisus Cancun.Both Vacations were for two weeks and I tell you..... Royal Service at Paradisus is just great. What makes this hotel so good is the people who work there.From Lazaro (service manager) our butlers Gerry and Hector and all the staff at the pool and Palapa, Cesar, Eddie, Moises, Victor, Daniel, Hosue, Vallery, Carlos and many more. What a great gang. Cesar your the best!
A special thanks to David Zarate "THE GUITAR MAN" who provided us with excellent and tasteful music at many of the restaurants.A GREAT guitarist with a Mexican flavor.
We stayed in room 5119.The room, the ocean view, the cleanliness and the service was fit for Royalty.
The food was very good but after two weeks a home cooked meal was terrific. 
I could go into more detail such as the restaurants and the beach but this review is intended purposely to point out what for us is the most important.....THE PEOPLE WHO MAKE YOUR VACATION UNFORGETTABLE>

reviews.author: DWF78
reviews.title: Great spot for families!
reviews.text:
We spent a week here in February (Saturday to Saturday) with our two small children--our first full family vacation. We went with the family concierge option, which was well worth the additional cost. Our concierge hosts, Gloria and Maria were very attentive and responsive, and made sure that our time at the resort was not spent on worrying about reservations and the like. 

Of particular note was the Kids Zone/Baby Club, which we used frequently. Our 5-year old loved going to the Kids Zone, and the entire staff made sure the kids were always entertained with games, crafts, and other activities. We also made use of the Baby Club as well for our 2-year old. This feature gave us time to enjoy a couple of dinners without the kids, who we knew were happy and in good hands.

The food was very good, and the service--on the whole--excellent. The buffet, Naos, was good, with a wide variety of options. I particularly enjoyed The Blue Agave as a lunch spot, which had very good tacos and quesadillas. For dining, our favorites were Fuego (our server here was first class) and Market Grill. 

The beach is very nice, and we were always able to find an umbrella. Although the water was a little rough, my 5-year old loved playing in the "big" waves, so at least for us, this was not a negative.

The kids pool was also great, but it could get busy, making it difficult to find an available umbrella. We we able to get a Bali bed most of the days we were there. 

The spa is nice, although the massages, etc. are little pricey. Unlimited use of spa facilities (sauna, steam room) were included with the package we booked, so no complaints here. With that said, the massage I got was really very good. 

Another thing to mention is that the hotel is right across the street from a marina with a wide range of excursions, which was convenient for us given the age of our children.

Overall, for a family with small children looking for a high quality all-inclusive, the Paradisus Cancun was a great choice for us.

reviews.author: MissXTraveller
reviews.title: Great resort with all the expected perks, though inconsistent housekeeping
reviews.text:
I recently stayed here for 6 nights for a work conference. I stayed at the Jr Suite Lagoon View and had the "all inclusive" package. It was pretty special being able to go to most of the restaurants and bars on-site and have unlimited food and drinks. You did feel very VIP. 

The resort itself is lovely, large with many downtime options, including pools, bars, spas, the beach just at your doorstep, etc. Also, the staff were all varying degrees friendly and accommodating to very much so. 

The only main gripe was the housekeeping. I always find it quite disappointing when 5-star venues do not uphold consistent and standard housekeeping. Always makes me suspicious about what other standards may not be upkept. For instance, my bed was always made up differently, sometimes my toiletries were refreshed, sometimes not. Sometimes I got clean towels, sometimes not. Sometimes my toiletries items were nicely organized, sometimes they were left scattered. Sometimes the floors were cleaned, sometimes not. (You can tell by sand). 

Also, on my first evening, while I was in my room for a quick outfit change, I was almost instantly disrupted by very loud, ongoing knocking on the door - I had to YELL "one minute!!!" on the top of my lungs... And all it was, was a staff member asking if I wanted more bottles of water. He didn't even give me 30 seconds to respond before he kept incessantly knocking. I had to put the DND sign on my door every time I was in my room.

Also, the restaurants on-site to vary in quality, and aside from Bana (which I found to be very western, unauthentic Japanese, with sashimi not being fresh, and certain dishes very oily), all the restaurants were fine to very good. 

All in all, very good resort, adjoining the beautiful beaches with plenty to do on-site.

reviews.author: Stephen C
reviews.title: Awesome Vacation - set a new bar in Awesomeness
reviews.text: Stayed here for 5 incredible nights for my company’s annual sales conference and it was spectacular!  the food was phenomenal in all the restaurants, the service was top-notch, the views and the accommodations were absolutely awesome.  Will be heading back there for my own personal vacations very soon highly recommend place

reviews.author: EZ_Pickins
reviews.title: Good Vacation Location
reviews.text:
Resort: Fifteen minutes from the airport. Check in was quick and efficient. We were then given a briefing about the hotel and how it works, where the restaurants are, how to make reservations for dinner and other amenities. We were given a booklet explaining the resort and the number of the person giving the briefing to call if anything is needed. The grounds are beautiful, and well maintained. The beach is beautiful with white sand and turquoise water. There was a show every evening at the central beach access. The Power Girls show was great. Especially the second half light show.

Accommodations: We had booked a Ocean View Junior Suite. Our room was in building one on the fourth floor. You could not ask for a better view. The room was a good size, clean and the bed was comfortable. The sofa appears to have been spilled on in the past but you could see that it had been cleaned (normal wear and tear). The bathroom was stocked with four face cloths when we arrived but were not replaced when used. Bath towels were replaced. Housekeeping stopped by the room in the evening and we would ask for more then. 

Food: We ate breakfast and lunch at the Naos buffet nearly every day. There was a lot to choose from beyond the standard buffet items. There is something for everyone. Other than Naos for dinner we ate at other ala carte restaurants to try different cuisines. The Market Grill (Brazillian Rodizio) was very good; Bana (Japanese fusion) was OK but only OK because it was new to us. Wait staff very good explaining the menu. Enso (Asian) was OK also, same reason as Bana. There was a problem with my wife’s meal that was promptly corrected.

Staff: The staff is exceptionally nice and helpful. You are greeted by every staff person you meet in the resort with a smile and a happy greeting The service was great at the restaurants and the pool. We need to mention Asuncion, the waitress at the pool. Get in her section and you will not want for anything.  A special thank you to Ignacio Vazqez at the Naos restaurant. We ate breakfast there and when we returned for lunch the first day he knew our names and provided us with excellent service each and every meal. Also, Richie Vasquez and Jorge Alberto at Naos restaurant.

reviews.author: SearchrTrvlr
reviews.title: Top notch resort with world class service!
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun is a wonderful resort with phenomenal service.  A special big Thank You to Sandra and Alex at the Family Concierge.  They both are simply excellent at what they do, and were always so ready to help out with anything we needed.  Thank you again, we will be back to see you for sure!  Another thanks to Pascual, crishtlan, and Armando at Naos restaurant, we went to see them every day and they always had smiles waiting for us.  See you next year!!!

reviews.author: David B
reviews.title: David & Akemi’s Valentine’s Vacation
reviews.text: Enjoyed the resort immensely.  Great service!  Rooms were clean beautiful with a great view of the Ocean!   I recommend Royal Service program.  It is the best way to go!  Gaudalupe at the front desk and Cristian Lovera at Naos Restaurant took really good care of us!  Francisco at Red Lounge knows how to party!

reviews.author: Mark G
reviews.title: Amazing Family Trip!  Would Highly Recomend!
reviews.text:
Just got back yesterday from a wonderful trip at Paradisus Cancun with my family.  We had a fantastic time.  

SERVICE: Absolutely outstanding in every way.  The workers here are fantastic people with great attitudes.  It made our trip so great.   My wife was unfortunately sick for a lot of the trip so I had to manage our 10 month old and our 4 year old without her quite a bit.  I really appreciated the help that I got from a lot of the workers.  Especially at Naos, where they would see us and hold my 4 year old's hand and hold our plates to get to our table (even though this is a buffet).  Workers where very attentive everywhere and made sure you had everything you needed to have a great time.

FOOD: Food was delicious everywhere.  Some places better than others.
  -Naos: Buffet spread was amazing.  Every breakfast choice you could imagine.  I wish I was there for days to be able to do the buffet at lunch and dinner more.  They have a ton of staff there making sure the choices are refilled immediately and will get you drinks or help you if needed.
  -Vento: Delicious tapas, probably one of the best restaurants at the resort.  Highly recommend the foie gras creme brulee or the shrimp with black risotto. 
  -Fuego: This is a great spot for romantic dinners.  Food was some of the most delicious choices of the trip.  As other reviewers have noted, it is kept a little too dark in here.  At least for us it was, we had 2 kids in there and they were falling asleep. 
  -Market Grill:  Just like a brazillian steakhouse, lot of delicious meats.  Only thing I wished they had was the cheesy bread that usually is at those places.  But a terrific place people who aren't vegetarians.
  -Mole: Appetizers and desserts were tasty.  Our entrees were ok, but I kind of thought this restaurant would be one of the best in the resort, so my expectations were a little missed on this.  Having said that, it was still good!
  -Enso: Similar to Mole, appetizers and desserts were spot on, but entrees were just ok.  Had I been there more than once and made a different choice, I may have felt different.
  -Blue Agave: Only went there very briefly, but food seemed tasty.  
  -Sunset Grill: This is the poolside food area.  We had lunch from there almost everyday.  They have burgers, nachos, hot dogs, chicken nuggets, chicken sandwcihes, and wings ready to take at anytime.  Can also ask them to make you pizza, wraps, and sandwiches if you're willing to do a small wait.
  -Room Service: Menu was small and not particularly great, but was still good.  Go to Naos and ask if you can make up a plate for them to bring to your room, they just might let you.

POOL: There are plenty of areas by the pool and we didn't really need to fight for shade or pool chairs like previous reviews stated.  The workers around the pool will gladly let you take someone's chair if all they left on it were towels.  You have to have personal belongings there, otherwise its up for grabs.  The pool did feel cold, as its not heated.  But once you are in there and moving around, you're fine.

DRINKS: Delicious drinks at the resort.  They're pretty willing to make you any cocktail but there is a charge for Red Bull.  Otherwise, they're more than willing to let you drink as much as you want.  We loved visiting Timoteo and Alan at the swim up bar everyday.  They made virgin drinks for my 4 year old and happily intoxicated my adult family.

FAMILY CONCIERGE: We got a Lagoon View one bedroom suite with Family Concierge and it was great.  Our butlers, Alexander and Sandra were extremely attentive and did a fantastic job.  We used WhatsApp with our phones over the wifi and communicated with them throughout the trip that way.  They took care of our restaurant reservations, left us surprises in our room every day, and helped with all our extra needs.  We were very grateful for them. This service is well worth the extra cost if you're coming with your family.  We also got access to the family concierge lounge which always had food and drinks waiting for us.  Sandra also reserved a Bali bed by the pool for us for 2 days. 

My only disappointment of the trip is that they didn't allow us to have my 10 month old go in the kids zone.  We were hoping to have a few moments of kid-free time and weren't able to do so.  They have a kids club and a baby club, but the baby club doesn't allow kids until they turn 1 which seems confusing.

I read a lot of reviews on here before the trip, and can tell you that the people who complained about this place are just the type of people who will complain no matter what.  The hotel is not falling apart and the food is delicious.  Don't be scared off by those reviews.

reviews.author: nick_ng
reviews.title: a very popular place ...
reviews.text:
Stayed here last week for 6 nights and had a delightful experience. The staff are all friendly and helpful. Check-in was smooth and the front-desk staff were informative and efficient. F&B staff in the restaurants are engaging and always willing to serve. There are many restaurants to choose from. Since this is a popular hotel with many guests, it is a good idea to book in advance for dinner.

Getting to downtown Cancun is easy. The local public bus stops are directly in front of the hotel. The ride is a standard flat rate of 12 Mexican Dollars/Pesos or US$1 (you don't get change if you pay in USD) and it takes approximately 30 minutes.
