Costs the same to travel the opposite direction to the popular public beach at Playa Delfines.

The hotel's beach and swimming pools are great.

This is a great location for a vacation.

reviews.author: Hopsing129
reviews.title: Big Cancun All-inclusive
reviews.text: Paradise Cancun is a very nice place to go. Friendly folks, good food, nice beach ( very rough water though).  Even the buffet food was very good and the restaurants even better.  The drinks were tasty but weak. Room was nice but a bit more attention to detail in the rooms would help....restocking. It is a very large facility so be ready to walk off the food.

reviews.author: kga375
reviews.title: Great family trip except for our phones and wallets were taken from our pool cabanna.
reviews.text: Great food. Very clean outside and inside. Workers were wonderful  On the last day, 2 phones and wallets were taken from our pool cabana. The security never contacted us after the initial contact to let us know what happened.

reviews.author: Peter Krzystek
reviews.title: Best Trip!
reviews.text:
Another great stay at the Paradisis!  We have stayed here many times before. The staff is wonderful and they make us feel like family. The food is delicious and, at the buffet, there is a lot to choose from.  There is always something for everyone. We really enjoy dinner at the specialty restaurants as well. We really enjoyed the Market Grill, a Brazilian steakhouse, and dined there twice. I don't know if it was the food that brought us back there or the excellent service we received from Rafael, Antonio and Jaime. Either way, the dining experience was a real pleasure!!  We enjoyed breakfast and lunch at the buffet.  There's plenty of fresh fruits and vegetables and a myriad of dishes to choose from. Again, we chose to sit in our favorite waiter's section. A big shout out to Pablo!!!  He was our waiter last year, as well, and we had a wonderful time with him.  Excellent service!  We didn't know that he would be there this year, but when we saw him, we recognized each other immediately and were greeted by a big hug.

We love staying here and always request an oceanfront junior suite. Honestly, you never know which particular room you'll get.  Some  are better than others.  This year though, Norma, at check in, found us the perfect room!!  It was on the fourth floor, corner room, with two balconies. Amazing!  Best room ever!
Anyway, we obviously love staying here, some years are better than others.  Sometimes you also just need some patience and any problems will be made right.  They really strive for that. 
We also choose this hotel because we like the location on the beach.  There are plenty of thatched huts to lay under, either on the beach or by the pools, overlooking the beach. We also like the location in the hotel zone. It's a quick ride to shopping and dining. 
Lastly, we originally booked this trip at another hotel, as this hotel was starting to show some wear and tear.  At the last minute, we rebooked our trip, to stay at the Paradisis and am so glad we did!  They have done a lot of upkeep and the resort looked fresh and new!
And, in closing, I just have to say the overall service this year, far exceeded our expectations! Thank you, Paradisis, for a wonderful vacation!

reviews.author: DLep
reviews.title: Great trip
reviews.text:
We recently stayed at the Paradisus Cancun from January 30 to February 13. It was a great trip. Here are the pros and cons.
Pros: It was a beautiful hotel. Very clean. The grounds were well kept. The A la cartes were all very good and they served our meals family style. This gave us the chance to sample many different dishes we wouldn't ordinarily have tried. The beach was beautiful. We spent more time at the pool than we usually do because the ocean was very rough the whole time we were there. The pool was warm which was very nice. The service was great at the restaurants, pool, and at the beach. Housekeeping did a great job. The gentleman at the coffee shop and the girl who made crepes (sorry didn't get their names) were wonderful. Special shout out to Gaudencio at the Naos restaurant. We ate our breakfasts there. He provided great service. Very entertaining and fun. One of the ladies in our group had a birthday. The hotel staff made sure she felt special.

Cons: They need a better venue for the nightly entertainment. It is very uncomfortable sitting on concrete outside and, when inside, the Avenue Bar has a terrible seating.

reviews.author: Kellyz0212
reviews.title: Decent size hotel at Cancun Hotel zone
reviews.text: Just came back from 4 days 3 nights vacation from Cancun, had previously been to cancun multiple times, this visit we decided to stay at Paradisus as we have heard so much great reviews about this hotel. It did not disappoint, the hotel ground is beautiful. Beach is beautiful, but I think given the season we were traveling, the waves were too strong for a swim, and the beach has a lot of seaweed. The rooms and décor in many places seem a bit dated, but overall the view is amazing. I also love the pool, and there's always beach chairs available for the time I stayed at the resort. One thing I do want to point out is that all the pools are deeper than the ones I am used to. As I do not know how to swim, but in the previously hotels in Cancun I've been to, the pool is usually around 4-5ft deep, but instead I think all the pool area except for the kids pool area is 5ft or deeper, making it difficult for me to even stand on my feet when I'm at the pool, I had to tippy toe because again I dono how to swim. The hotel provide many restaurant options, although I believe all inclusive is all inclusive, the food is never as good as fancy restaurants in the city, but given the number of options that are provided, I think it's definitely a plus, I also enjoy the breakfast buffet every morning- it has more than enough options. Rooms are decent size. Avoid staying around tower 3 (main tower where everything is) unless you plan to party and drink all night long and sleep after 11PM, we had to change our room from tower 3 to tower 4 as we were traveling with a baby, and it was impossible for the baby to fall asleep with the noise going on in the lobby. Overall I think it was great experience, its very family friendly. The kids zone and baby's zone was amazing, because of them, my friend was able to leave her baby there and we were able to enjoy spa for 2 hours. However, I do want to point out that I think the spa facility was disappointing and small, especially for the price we paid for (145 dollar for 50 min). all the workers in the hotel are super friendly and nice, always available to help! That's wat makes this an amazing experience.

reviews.author: Ebony M
reviews.title: Beautiful Property/Front Desk Staff...not so much
reviews.text:
This is an absolutely beautiful resort. It is very clean, the staff members are excellent (with the exception of some of the front desk staff).
My husband and I just wanted a quick getaway, so we decided to take a trip to Cancun. We initially booked a different hotel (3-star) but left within an hour because it was just unacceptable & nothing like the pics on the website. So we quickly jumped on trip advisor and found Paradisus. Upon arrival, we had some issues with the room given to us. Karen checked us in. She wasn't very friendly to begin with, and was even less friendly when we told her that she was giving us a room different than what we had booked (she gave us one on the 4th floor but not the bed we requested). After asking to speak with a manager (Guadeloupe), she offered us a different room, only to find out that the room she gave us was a bit of a downgrade from the 1st room as it was on the very bottom level (Level 0), and the bellhop let us know before we even got there that there wasn't really a view (which we had paid for). The truth is, they didn't have the room I requested and instead of upgrading us, they put us downstairs because that was the only one similar to what we had booked with a king bed....like I said, it was a downgrade without the view we paid extra for.
Nonetheless, Guadaloupe refused to upgrade us so we took the initial room. 
Thankfully I was able to speak with a different manager, (Reuben) and he was very accommodating to the point that he upgraded us to a room better than we ever expected! We were more than satisfied with that he offered, but I had to wonder why I had to make such a fuss about the room before something was done.
Overall, I would't stay here again because I felt unappreciated as a guest, initially. But I wouldn't discourage someone else from staying here because it really is a nice resort.

reviews.author: Kyle L
reviews.title: Such a Great Vacation
reviews.text: This place was fabulous from the moment we walked in. My wife and I take trips every year to different parts of the Caribbean, we've been to Cancun before and this hotel so far is one of our favorites. It is very unique with its atmosphere and is just a very nice set up from where to go and what to do. The room was perfect for my wife and I with a king bed and large bathroom. The food was excellent, plenty to offer. The drinks were fabulous and will always accept a margarita from them! Beach was perfect and the water was perfectly blue. We will definitely be back to visit this resort. The entire staff was excellent, they went out of their way to make sure your stay was going well and everyone always said "my pleasure"

reviews.author: nycsunnyside
reviews.title: Perfect birthday getaway
reviews.text: Just returned from a 4 day birthday trip from the Paradisus and loved every minute of it. It  was the perfect way to spend a nice relaxing holiday. The hotel is immaculately maintained and the staff is exceptional. The Paradisus is located just a short trip from the airport on a beautiful beachfront property. The property is beautifully decorated with tons of natural foliage and open spaces. All of the restaurants were great, especially Mole for perfectly prepared Mexican dishes and Vento that had fabulous tapas. The buffet at Naos is perfect for anyone who likes many different options. The staff really help make Paradisus a very special place to visit. Francisco at The Red Lounge and Cocos Beach Club always went out of his way to make sure we were well taken care of and had everything we needed. Everything from the rooms, to the staff, beach, pool and property were perfect. We would not hesitate to visit again. We cannot wait to go back again. Cancun is a beautiful place to visit.

reviews.author: Carlos Rodrigo O
reviews.title: Perfect Resort
reviews.text:
Very nivel resort. Five stars.
Food, room, staff are perfect.
Swimming pools are more than perfect.

Shows in the night is very nice
This is a very nice place for families.

I didn't like some rules.
The bars close to swimming pools , they close at 05:00 pm.
They should leave one of them open until later.
We left the swimming pool and tried to go to the restaurant. You have to take a shower and change the clothes.

This is a very nice place, of course I recommend it for everyone.

reviews.author: tashcr0
reviews.title: Overall Experience
reviews.text:
Our family of 4, children aged 3 and 8months stayed at the hotel beginning of feb.  I’ll write my review in sections (sorry for the length):
Service: I have to start with this because the service was OUTSTANDING. Everyone we dealt with was amazing, from the front desk, waiters in the restaurants, chamber maids, waiters by the pool, we were so happy with everything.  Special shout outs to Pasqual, Armando and Oscar in Naos restaurant, as well as the head chef (I’m sorry I never got his name). My son has a peanut allergy and they ensured everything he ate was peanut free.  Oscar would get my children special dishes made for dinner for this reason by the head chef which we truly appreciated.  Pasqual and Armando always ensured the dishes my son ate were peanut free for bfast and lunch.  
David served us by the pool throughout the day by the kids pool always ensuring we had cold drinks for us and our son, he worked hard in the hot sun! 
The girls who worked in the kid zone also did a great job with all activities for our son, he had a lot of fun with them.
Although we never came across the chambermaids, our room was always very well cleaned and nightly turned down service was always done.
We were asked multiple times if we were enjoying our stay Andy if anything could be done to make it better, it was a nice touch.
An excellent job done by all... 5star service for sure!
Rooms:  we stayed in a jr suite, 2 beds and requested a crib.  The rooms are spacious for the standard room, a really good sized balcony and bathroom.  No complaints
Resort itself, beautiful! The indoor greenery is really nice, the grounds are kept very clean, there are workers constantly cleaning and maintaining.  If you are sensitive to plant/flower aromas I would caution you on this.  I liked it but ppl who are sensitive may find it overwhelming.
Beach: beautiful white sand, gets raked every morning for seaweed, beautiful water.  Unfortunately we had red flag almost every day, so we didn’t get to enjoy the ocean as much as we would have liked but that’s nothing that can be controlled!  Within the hotel and by the pool is all accessible, except the beach was not.  There’s quite a number of stairs to get to the beach so this wasn’t very handy to get our stroller down there.... we ended up leaving our stroller poolside when we went down to the beach.
Food: naos restaurant is your typical buffet, lots of items to choose from, we definitely never went hungry.  If we wanted something in particular all we had to do is ask, and they would make it for us, again amazing service.  We tried Mole, Fuego, Toji, Vento and Enso a la carte.  We were impressed with all of them.  We had no problem making reservations.  All the service in these places were also amazing, the waiters always explained everything to us, and again, would ensure my son ate things peanut free.  Our favourite a la carte was vento.... yum!! (Although they were all good!)
Overall we were very happy with stay.  We would definitely recommend to family and friends, as well as go back. I gave a 4.5 star only because there was no ramp to the beach... otherwise a 5 for sure

reviews.author: SamerDaher
reviews.title: All inclusive means all inclusive - almost
reviews.text:
Annual conference. Where else? Cancun.

Where in Cancun? The Paradisus...

I have mixed feelings about the place which is no fault of their own. The food is abundant but dietary restrictions are one thing they’re not sensitive to. I don’t eat pork or non-halal meat so it was quite a feat to convince the staff on the pasta station to use a clean skillet and clean utensils that aren’t tainted by ham. Not their fault I have dietary restrictions but they’re insensitive to it as well and will look at you like a Martian.

The beach is awesome. Fine smooth sand. Even on a cloudy and windy day, the sea is refreshing.

The restaurants aren’t that great. The fish has a funky taste as if it’s been in the open for longer than it should be. The sushi place is NOT recommended. It qualifies as the worst sushi I’ve ever had. Sincerely.

The Spanish tapas are good and yummy for a change but we ended up in Naos, the main buffet most of the time.

The staff are helpful, the views are amazing (see attached pics).

My trip was disrupted by a visitor. The culprit was a cockroach lying dead on its in the bathtub. Apart from that, the rooms are clean.

Would I go there again? Yes. Overall it was a positive experience.

reviews.author: 357grgrgr
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Friendly staff various restaurants and a great beach. The golf is tiny and seems a bit dangerous but ok for a pitch and put. Breakfast is great and the restaurants and bars are excellent. A special mention for the market grill.

reviews.author: kfheimer
reviews.title: Paradisus is Paradise for Smaller Meetings
reviews.text:
We hosted a smaller sales kick-off event at the Paradisus for a week and everything went perfectly. Claudia from the sales department was responsive and helpful in her response to our RFP. Apolo in the meeting groups department was beyond excellent, and was there every step of the way - from check in to check out and everything in between. 

The hotel is beautiful, right on the beach with loads of restaurants, food choices and is always immaculately clean. Our group was able to find small meeting spaces when we needed it, and the bars and clubs provided options for night time activities.

The conference center was larger than we expected, and although our rooms had no windows the set up was perfect and kept us focused.

Overall a great event, and we hope to go back!

reviews.author: Diakopes359
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text:
We spend one week at the hotel. The rooms are spacious, clean and comfortable. The service was excellent. The staff was super friendly and hospitable. I should mention the following names of people that served us. Christian Lovera, Atilano, Pascual and Gaudenllo. They were excellent. Always with a smile there to help us and make us feel good. The sunrise at the hotel was also breath taking. Siting at the beach reading a book was very relaxing. The stuff was constantly offering drinks.
I would defiantly recement this resort.

reviews.author: Bob E
reviews.title: Week of relaxation
reviews.text: Spent a glorious week here and will definitely come back. The rooms are spacious, clean and comfortable. The service is five star and the beach is clean and beautiful. Many choices for food and beverages and a casino about a block away.

reviews.author: NotASnowQueen
reviews.title: Better Late than Never - Great Vacation
reviews.text:
We stayed at this resort back in November and it was fantastic. They only reason I give it 4 stars is because of the construction while we were there. With that said that didn't deter us from having a great time! We stayed in Royal Service and it was well worth it! Rosanna our butler did an amazing job making sure we had everything we needed. I have experienced Royal Service at Paradises in Punta Cana, but I think our experience in Cancun was better overall. The staff was super friendly and the drinks were consistently good. 

Beach
I must say this is the most beautiful beach I have ever laid my eyes on. The gradient of the water colors were breathtaking. The beach area for Royal service was top notch and we loved that they served bottle water without having to ask. 

Pool
The royal service pool was heated and very relaxing. Service at the Bali beds added a special touch that made this trip unique. 

Food
My husband and I loved Vento the most. We're a fan of small plates and this restaurant was the perfect way to start off our trip. Not to mention our server Leobardo excellent. We had no problem getting any reservations for any of the restaurants. 

All around great vacation!

Room
We went for a ocean front room and all I can say is wowza! Most beautiful beach I've ever seen AND we got to wake up to it every morning! The room was well equipped  and the cleaning staff did a great job keeping everything fresh and clean.

reviews.author: john l
reviews.title: Mayan Treasure
reviews.text: We just spent a week at Paradisus and it's week we'll never forget. It was my Wife's birthday and it was more than we could have imagined. Our room was decorated with balloons and on Her Birthday they brought a complimentary bottle of Champagne and a Piece of Chocolate Cake. Both were excellent. The restaurants are excellent and staff incredible. We dined at Tempo the night of Her Birthday and it was like a show you dine on. When in Cancun we've found our home.

reviews.author: Edward_S2012
reviews.title: Beautiful property with outstanding service
reviews.text:
My wife and I spent 5 days at Paradisus and very much enjoyed our stay there. 

The only downside of our stay was that I booked a room on their website several months in advance of our stay and requested a room with a king bed and none were available on our first night. We therefore stayed in a non-renovated double bed room the first night and it was directly above the nightclub. The room was pretty dated and the noise from the nightclub kept us up for several hours. The rest of our stay was in a newly renovated king room, and it was quite nice (and quieter than the first room). 

I think what set Paradisus apart from other similar resorts is the service. The wait staff in the restaurants, the housekeeping staff, the bar staff at the pool and beach, and the fitness center and spa staff were all consistently outstanding. In other resorts I sometimes get the feeling that I am bothering the waiter or the bartender but that never happened here. Everyone was extremely friendly and helpful, and they made our stay very enjoyable. We will definitely return to Paradisus!

reviews.author: Ralph S
reviews.title: Always good experience
reviews.text: Keep going back for great time in January.  Weather can be iffy but always have some nice days and the beach is so good. Pool bar waitresses ASCUNION and LAURA take such good care of your every need.  Market Grill waiters Rafael, Alberto and Maniel give service beyond expectation.  Food is so good at all restaurants and all staff is so helpful. Will be back in 2019

reviews.author: alsr2018
reviews.title: Wonderful vacations!
reviews.text: We like everything in the hotel: the employees, the restaurants, the beach, the room...it was wonderfull!! I recomend to take some activities like swin with dolphins or diving...this completes the vacation

reviews.author: chunkabunk
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time at this resort. The rooms were clean and bathrooms amazing, the staff was wonderful and the food was great! I enjoyed Zumba by the pool every day and beach volleyball. The activities crew were great (thanks Daniel, Marco, Andrea and Vasti!!!) We loved our time at Paradisus

reviews.author: mdfugh
reviews.title: Great Resort!
reviews.text: After doing my own research online I selected the Paradisus Cancun to celebrate my 40th birthday.  I stayed five days and 4 nights with my husband and another couple.  Overall, everything was great!  The site itself had beautiful beaches, pools, good food, great spa and breathtaking views / scenery.  The staff was on point and nice.  Location: We were in close proximity to other resorts, restaurants, malls, etc...and so on.  They also had a great Super Bowl party.  The only downside to our trip was our room.  As soon as we checked in we were offered an upgrade for Royal Service (which I highly recommend) but the only downfall about accepting the option was that my husband and I ended up in a room with double beds.  We made the best out of the situation though. I will recommend this hotel to others.  One last thing...the resort does a great job catering to both families with kids and couples.  Some parts of the resort were for Adults Only.

reviews.author: 240garyo
reviews.title: woudl have like to spend everday in the ocean, but there was a rip tide
reviews.text: Hotel was all inclusive and very nice. But I would like staying not all inclusive to go and explore more of the area. Swimming in the ocean was not possible due to the rip tide. I had hope there would be snorkling there or near by, but it was not clear enough.

reviews.author: alberta1232014
reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: Lovely resort and wonderful beach area with beautiful white sand and clean clear water.  Minimal seaweed.  Good food with great staff who were very attentive.  Thoroughly enjoyed the evening entertainment.

reviews.author: khughesphilly
reviews.title: Fabulous Resort
reviews.text: We love Fernanda in Family Concierge!!!!!! This is our second year staying at the Paradisus.  We love this place so much! Fernanda in Family Concierge made our daughter feel like a princess from the moment we walked in the front door.  Every time we left the room and came back there was a surprise for her or us.  She and Violeta always let us know who was on duty and we could easily text if we needed anything!!!!!  This place is a gem.  Food is incredible too and we have never had a bad meal while staying here!  I would highly suggest family concierge if you have kids.  They make it so fun for them.

reviews.author: Jennifer K
reviews.title: Very nice place
reviews.text: We stayed with a big group and had a ton of fun.  The service no matter where you ate or even on the beach was great.  Our first experience with an all inclusive resort.  They are very organized and the resort was well maintained and clean. Market grill was our favorite restaurant.  Raphael and Manuel were so funny and we had a good time.

reviews.author: Michael Y
reviews.title: Servers are good - management as some issues to work out
reviews.text:
Overall Paradisus Cancun is showing its age and as other reviews have shared, there are better All Inclusives for the price within Cancun. The servers we had at the restaurant and the pool were very friendly and helpful, the fault lies with the management.

The main building is stunning, and the pyramids are something else. My infant daughter loved walking through and looking up at the vines. The downside is that being on the 2nd floor of the main pyramid means that everything is really loud, especially at night. The rooms on the other hand while pleasant have some renovations that are needed. The paint is chipping at places, the toilet seat needed to be replaced. We had to ask to have our patio door fixed twice and the lamps don't turn on at the side of the bed.

My main issue has to do with management, here are a few examples:
1) On the first night, we were locked out of our room twice. With my daughter screaming, we went to front desk and they told us to go our room to wait at the door while a repairman came up to fix the batteries on the door. We waited 20 minutes and no one showed up. Only when I went down and forcefully asserted myself did someone come up to help. No apologies, from management or acknowledgement of the trouble on our first day of vacation.

2) Food is mediocre. There is a lot of selection and the servers are great, but it definitely feels like all-inclusive dining. At the sushi restaurant they served frozen sea scallops as sashimi rather than fresh scallops. 

3) Various other issues with management - room not made one day. One night the entire room smelled like paint varnish.

The beach is great, the facilities are nice, but it feels dated and there are definitley better ones in Cancun.

reviews.author: Johi B
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text:
We enjoyed my wife's birthday in this hotel, we always stay at red level because its exclusive for people+16 years old and it has also a PRIVATE beach only for red level guest, so its quiet and calm atmosphere.
The food is good, the stuff is friendly, good butler service.
To improve: control better the people who come and its not from red level and use the private beach, you can distinguish this people because of a color arm brasalet, one waiter let the people from other resort stay there because the pay him some money!!!! I saw it personally and complained inmediately with the Manager, its not fair that we pay extra money for this service and the workers anxious to receive extra money give us the nasty situation, i would appreciate  better control and service in the beach. Some times you stay waiting long for service...
Also i find very bad that the hotel allows a external company who "takes pictures" with the guest bringing EXOTIC ANIMALS, this should be FORBIDDEN and not accepted, doing this you only activate more traffic of all those exotix animals who should be in their enviroment!!!! There are plenty other ways to entertain the guest, many people was complaining also with us abou it, this is bad image for the hotel.
The rooms were clean and in general is a beautiful place.
Beer without alcohol would be great to incl in the drinks.

reviews.author: ithecaptain
reviews.title: 4.5 star hotel that could be 5!
reviews.text:
Stayed 4 nights in the hotel and it was brilliant, very clean and beautiful hotel. Great beach access with perfectly blue water. The hotel has a good variety of restaurants and bars, breakfast buffet is good but a bit dull after a few days. For dinner you need to make a reservation, we had no issue with getting a table for any of the nights. Especially liked restaurant Mole and less the Spanish/Mediterranean tapas which had extremely small plates and portions. Wish we would have tried the Asian fusion restaurant.

Service is excellent and everyone is very polite, if they ask you to upgrade when checking in I would say it’s worth it depending in which tower your room is. Main tower 3 is to be avoided, super noise and you will be woken up I the middle of the night. 

FYI, If you like party this hotel has no nightclub but excellent bartenders and lounge.

reviews.author: Andy Z
reviews.title: Sales Reward Trip/Meeting
reviews.text: We had a great time for the 4 nights we were here.   The staff were all great, friendly and attentive.  In particular Sofonia and Hector were great keeping us fed and watered.  Lots of places to hang out and eat.   We ended up using the Enos restaurant for morning meetings and it worked well by just using multiple laptops.

reviews.author: dlw240
reviews.title: Loved it!!
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful! We have never stayed at an all inclusive place before and didn’t know what to expect. My hubby and I went as part of a work conference so we got to see how they do two large dinner events in addition to the normal day to day activities. Staff and service were amazing. The food was delicious...everything from the conference buffet dinners to the buffet to the many restaurants. We didn’t have time to try them all! Everything was clean and comfortable. The pools are huge and gorgeous. Lots of beachfront with cabanas and lounge chairs. There is a lifeguard and the staff walked the beach keeping it clean. There was a lot of live entertainment, which was all excellent (and we are disappointed we missed the jet ski in the pool with some acrobats doing a routine!). We are thinking about going back with our kids and grandkids. We did see they had a kids indoor play area but didn’t go inside. It is showing its age in some places (some ripped/broken beach chairs and cabana cushions, for example). Although we were supposed to get our in room mini bar restocked each day, that wasn’t done, nor did they give us more coffee or water for the room after we used what we had been given. I feel certain had we brought this to management’s attention they would have fixed it, but it wasn’t important enough to us to bother with. Don’t expect great TV in English - there was only one channel with English-speaking shows...reruns of CSI, NCIS and Criminal Minds. We we’re too busy enjoying the resort to care, but this is something to keep in mind if TV is important to you. As other reviewers have mentioned, bring cash to tip the terrific service staff. All things considered we had a great time and would definitely go back.

reviews.author: gwr6464
reviews.title: Royal Service team is Amazing!
reviews.text: We went our second time to the Royal Service side of the Paradisus resort. The level of service is what keeps us coming back.  From when you walk in, to meeting your personal assistant, to arranging for Bali beds at the pool, to lunch and drinks poolside, ...the staff greets you with a smile showing they are genuinely happy to be there. I will forget some folks here but Adan, Moises, Javier, Carlos, Omar, Giovanni, Eduardo, Jorge, Claudia and Cesar are incredible!  Thanks Paradisus...we tell everyone about Royal Service and LaPalapa and our experiences at this tremendous resort!

reviews.author: Adrienne L
reviews.title: Relaxing getaway
reviews.text:
Visited Paradisus Resort and opted to not purchase Royal Service upgrade being out first time here. Purchased a Bali bed two days in a row instead at Coco Beach Club. Best money spent with impeccable service!!! Thank you David, Jaime, Jesus and Manuel!!! Such great guys... took good care of us! You guys are the best!! 
Adrienne & Mitch

reviews.author: travelfun881
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation
reviews.text: We have been to Paradisus in Cancun three times, first time just me and my husband and next two times with parents and our 4 children. It was an absolute relaxation and pleasure to vacation there. One of the best advantages was the kids club and baby room. It was safe to leave children and the staff really took great care of them. Thank you to Marisol, Sheila, Pamela, and Fernanda. These girls took great care of our children, played with them, took them to lunch/dinner, always in active play and safety. Rooms are nice and clean, many restaurants to choose from. Overall a great experience. Would definitely recommend and go again.

reviews.author: shailabs
reviews.title: I'd go back again and again!
reviews.text:
We spent 5 days and 4 nights at this incredible hotel. The view of the sea is breathtaking! But also the service was amazing: housekeeping spoiled us each day, all the restaurants have great food and the waiters are super attentive. The shows and activities were very fun. 
During our stay, we were able to meet Abraham Franco, who does a great job of room manager.
I can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: mandywlai109
reviews.title: Just ok
reviews.text: We just return from Cancun. We stayed 4 nights here and it was just ok. I've been to Cancun 4 times, and this hotel is just average. The service at the restaurants were average. The service at the front desk was below average, they are usually very eager to help but I didn't feel that way. We booked two rooms, we expected both rooms to be at least on the same floor. needless to say, we did not get what we wanted. I had to take a handicap room just to be on the same building as our friends. The problem with the handicap room is every time you shower, the water spilled over to the hallway. The food sucks except fuego. The beach is very nice though, but will not return again.

reviews.author: cottager
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun is paradise!
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun is one of the best resorts I've ever been to. We upgraded to the Royal service, thanks to Rosy at check in and were very happy we did. The service was second to none they could not do enough for you. The variety of food was really good. Royal Service has its own breakfast and lunch restaurant right on the beach, its own butler which made all your dinner reservations, stock your bar in your room, and pretty much did any request within reason. Royal service also provided our own restaurant/bar within Pyramid 5, appetizers in the afternoon, music in the evening. You could go to Pyramind 3 for nightly entertainment but it was Loud and not my cuppa tea. 
 I could go on and on but you must go and experience it for yourself, I would go back in a heartbeat.

reviews.author: jgyv
reviews.title: Best allinclude vacation we ever add!
reviews.text: Would will gladly go back ! as soon as possible! If we can take more vacations tha the place! Especialy if you like to rest and take it easy we recomand Adult with ocean view many tanks to our Vacation agent Guylaine Joyal from Vacances JETSud  that recomanded PARADISUS CANCUN !!!!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Angela D
reviews.title: Who could ask for anything more???
reviews.text:
We loved this resort for its beauty and wonderful food, top shelf liquor and friendly staff.  We would like to say a special thankyou to the following:  Andres from Noas and Market grill, Pablo (we loved seeing you for breakfast every morning) Alberto at Enso, Keyla and Alex (who discussed the timeshare and respected our wishes), Leonardo at Mole, Norma who booked our snorkeling trip, Talina from housekeeping (you were so sweet and helpful).  
I was there with my husband and another couple and we all agreed that we would stay here again. We had a great time.

reviews.author: Michael S
reviews.title: Birthday get away
reviews.text: One of my favorite places. From right out of the airport to your first step into the resort we were greeted with nothing but friendly faces. We were offered the Royal Service upgrade and very happy that we did it. Our Butler Susan took great care of us no matter what we needed. Susan was there every day and always had a smile on her face which brightens our day. The food and service at each restaurant was excellent. The property was clean and welcoming, plenty of seating at the pool and beach. Everyone that was working at the pool, bars, and restaurants are fantastic. During are stay we asked to see the rooms that are part of the club Melia membership and meet Luis who showed us around. Luis was very informative about each room and how the membership works. We can not say enough about Luis, he is very out going and personable. Luis help us with question we had about our next trip. I would recommend this hotel to all my friends

reviews.author: Nguyen
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: My family and I took our first all inclusive vacation to Paradisus Cancun. The resort was clean, with a beach next to it. The atmosphere was pleasant the staffs were great. Our 2 girls didn't want to leave even though we have been here for 7 days. Here we had an opportunity to get to know many great staff. The one that we stood out most were Roberto, a waiter from Bana the outdoor restaurant. Next is Altilano  and his cousin Orlando were such great guys. They make you feels very comfortable while they serve you. I am sure there are many more great things to explore here but we didn't have enough time to. Only negative thing I have to say is the ppl that tries to sell you club Melia membership especially Deon he waisted 1/2 of my day doing it. At the end we didn't buy the membership he got quite rude towards my wife.

reviews.author: Cheryl F
reviews.title: Club Melia
reviews.text:
We had a great stay at this hotel.  We are Club Melia members so we stayed in the members only pyramid. 
The food is great. The buffet area was always quite busy (March Break) so we had to wait for seats at times. 
The water at the beach was rough during our stay so we mostly swam in the pool. 
The interior section of the main pyramid is absolutely beautiful with the vines hanging in the large atrium. 
The only negative experience was when the staff watched us leave the resort- we were going to another time share presentation and they followed us down to the end of the road where we met the presenter. They were trying to tell us not to go to the presentation. This was very frustrating and I believe it infringed on our privacy. 
For those who feel pressured to attend a Club Melia timeshare presentation, say "No!!!!"
I am regretting the pressure I succumbed to when I purchased the timeshare when staying at Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana. What I purchased barely gives me a week every 2 years for 50 years or once a year for 25 years. I have had to pay extra to get a full week stay at this resort and for my upcoming trip to Melia Caribe Tropical in Punta Cana. I realize I bought in with not many "options" as they call them but there are some resorts I can't even visit because they take a lot more options than what I have.

reviews.author: Tadny
reviews.title: Terrific Family Concierge!
reviews.text: We just returned from a wonderful week long vacation. The hotel and the beach are beautiful. The food at the buffet is really good with a lot of variety. The extra expense for the family concierge level is worth every penny. Mitzy and Gloria are outstanding! They are very friendly and eager to assist with anything you need. They made our trip extra special and are a big reason for why we will return again in the future!

reviews.author: Nicole S
reviews.title: Poor quality hotel
reviews.text:
Mediocre hotel with great service,
ok food, great beach location. But will not go back as the quality of the hotel rooms were old and small.  We traveled through the Melia club, through RCI and it was very clear we were secondary guests and were not offered the same amenities or well cared for rooms as their club members. They were mainly interested in getting you to buy their timeshare and once you went to their breakfast, didn't bother helping you with anything.

reviews.author: rzolt
reviews.title: Fantastic Vacation - Our 8th at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
Sadly, we'll we leaving this paradise in a few hours after a week of a nearly perfect vacation.  This has been our 8th stay at Paradisus Cancun and each of them was better than the last.  The staff are marvelous and the beach just couldn't be any better.  I must admit that we also lucked out with barely a cloud in the sky all week.  

We "discovered" Paradisus Cancun a few years ago when a friend asked if we wanted to use his timeshare.  I said "yes" not knowing what to expect and was never sorry I did.  The resort was being upgraded during our first stay from The Gran Melia to Paradisus Cancun and we've noticed improvements during each of our stays.  We're particularly happy that they added many palapa and beach chairs and they've redone some of the lounges, as well.  Since we've continued to use my friend's timeshare with Club Melia we've always opted out of the all-inclusive meal plan and have had our meals outside the resort.  However, many people we've talked to have spoken highly of the food.

For us, as long as we can sit on the beach we're happy.  What makes it so easy for us to enjoy just that is that the staff always work incredibly hard to make sure our stay is problem free.  We're looking forward to coming back next year and I'll be starting the process when we return home.

reviews.author: jhs74
reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text:
I rarely write reviews but I feel compelled to for Paradisus Cancun.  I have been to many all inclusive hotels (Bahamas, Punta Cana, Jamaica) but this one was by far the best.  We went Feb 16-Feb 23. 

The thing that sets this hotel apart from the other all inclusive hotel is the staff.  They were unbelievable- attentive, friendly and fantastic. We did not even do the royal service or family concierge!! The waitress and waiters along the pool and beach come by very 5 minutes asking if you want a drink.

The hotel is beautiful. It is right on the beach and the pools are amazing. The room was big and very clean.  At night when you are at dinner they clean up the room and replace your towels.  Rooms were also cleaned early in the day. 

The food was so much better than all the other all inclusives we have been too. The taco restaurant was fantastic. The buffet had a huge selection and the main buffet is right off a the pool and you can see the ocean- beautiful setting.

My kids (11 and 8) had a great time as well.  We did not do the kid zone or kids club but I saw a bunch of kids in it.  They have several actives/shows during the day by the pool that they loved watching. They had a water show with a jet ski, dancers, crafts etc.

I hope to come back next year- I already promised my kids!  Maybe we will try the family concierge if we can swing it!

reviews.author: arashkow
reviews.title: Phenomenal
reviews.text: Beautiful. Food was varied and delicious. Pools,beach and rooms perfect. My only complaint is what looks like the best pool was reserved for "special guests-Melissa" or whatever. At the beginning of the week they lean hard on you to look at their timeshare and club. We did need to say no at least 3 times. Also music pretty loud but fun. Gym good. You need to work off the food.

reviews.author: Stephanie Y
reviews.title: Fun in the Sun
reviews.text: My husband and I celebrated our 25th anniversary at Paradisus Cancun. It was fabulous! The service was impeccable. I would definitely return and recommend to others. The food was delicious and everyone was very accommodating.

reviews.author: SBWesley
reviews.title: Above & Beyond
reviews.text:
I rarely, if ever, write reviews of places even if they are really great. Yet, within a few hours of our stay at the Paradisus I had already made up my mind to write about this place. I haven't been on many vacations and this was only the second all-inclusive place I've stayed at. The thing is, in a place like Cancun, there are many beautiful resorts and the beach is of course all along these places so the actual amenities were only a small part of why our stay was so fabulous.

Let's get the basics out of the way. The room was nice. Nothing spectacular but very comfortable, spacious bathroom with a large tub/rain shower, always clean and well stocked. Honestly though, if you do it right, you'll be spending the least amount of time in the actual room. It more than gets the job done. The biggest issue I've heard about all-inclusive is the food. Well, Paradisus Cancun nailed it. Extensive buffet running just about all day/night that has everything you could want, plus about 5-6 restaurants within the resort that are included and available to guests as well. We tried just about every restaurant during our stay and enjoyed all of them (note: if you're a hardcore sushi fan, Bana might be slightly underwhelming, mostly because the art of making proper sushi rice has yet to make it down there). We stayed at the Royal Service (RS) section (no kids, fewer guests booked into the tower) which has a separate pool and outdoor restaurant only for RS guests. My suggestion is, if you can swing it, and appreciate a little less noise and commotion by the beach/pool, definitely go with the Royal Service. You'll also be assigned a staff member who you can assist you with anything from a bottle of bubbles waiting in your room to booking you a cabana. Both pools are immaculate, the beaches very well maintained, all in all its a gorgeous, clean, well-run resort.

Now the real gems of this place: the staff. I've worked in the service industry for upwards of 6 years. I know how hard it is to deal with a smaller group of guests all speaking your native tongue for even a few hours at a bar. But over multiple days? Knowing that everyone wants their vacation to be the best vacation? That's a hard task to take on. But within an couple of hours at the resort, multiple people we interacted with knew our name and truly wanted to make sure our stay was incredible. Rode was our point guy and took care of making all of our reservations at the restaurants, booking us cabanas, and making sure our room was stocked with everything we could possibly need. From the RS restaurant, La Palapa, Alex, Josue, Eddie C, and Carlos became friendly faces that would go out of their way to stock our drinks, bring us food & water, towels, etc. Andres at Market Grill was there every morning ready with coffee and a joke as we sat for breakfast. It even got to the point where they would remember what we liked to eat/drink or what cabanas we liked and they would provide them for us without even being asked. It felt great to be treated so well. It felt like a vacation. 

I can imagine it'd be easy to just go through the motions at an employee of such a place. Thousands of faces come in and out and most people stick to themselves and their travel companions and interact little with the staff. It would be easy to just treat the job like a job and do the minimum to get by. But every person we encountered, from the maids to the bartenders, to the gift shop guys, they were are ridiculously friendly and genuinely got joy from serving their guests to the best of their ability. It makes all the difference to feel known, to feel welcome, to feel...Royal. 

It was my first time in Cancun and, honestly, when I return there will be no need for googling reviews to see where I should stay next. Alex, Eddie C, Andres, Rode, Josue, Carlos, if you see this, Mr. Blank (VJ) says what's up! The Paradisus completely won us over, and we cannot wait for our next visit.

reviews.author: reneej205
reviews.title: Another Melissa trip and I am in love...
reviews.text:
This place was beautiful. First off I want to thank them for the complimentary upgrade to Royal Service. 

I also sat through the time share presentation and got 400 worth off spa credit for $50. My fiance and I got two 40 min massages and an hour to use the spa services (sauna,pool steam room) for the $50.

Eduardo was great as my Butler and everyone else was very helpful. I had an issue with my bank card and they were able to call NYC for me. 

Thank you everyone for your service

reviews.author: Anjanette B
reviews.title: Fantastic!!!!
reviews.text: Loved everything!!!  Food, staff, resort - AMAZING. Flor and Laura on the beach were fab!!  Christian in the "lobby" bar was the best.  They somehow infuse beautiful scents into the atmosphere.  You will not be disappointed!!

reviews.author: Love2travel_495
reviews.title: just returned from Paradisus
reviews.text:
We just returned from 4 days at Paradisus. This was our 8th time in Cancun so it's nice to stay at new places to compare other trips. I hope this helps others that are looking at places.

Check in/lobby: We went with a group of friends so on this trip, we had a travel agent make all the reservations. Check in was smooth and quick. Our room wasn't ready so we changed in the bathroom. We're used to that so we're always prepared. The lobby and hotel are beautiful and it is a BIG property. So if you don't like that, look elsewhere. We returned at 4 to check in and secure our trip back to the airport with Apple. Speaking of Apple/Amster - that entire process at the airport of finding your ride, waiting - total chaos. Just be prepared. We've done that before but this trip seemed extra chaotic. We felt they forgot us so I finally asked someone and they put us on a bus.

Room: We were in pyramid 3, the main one, and upgraded to an ocean view. Gorgeous view from our balcony and so glad we did that. We didn't need the royal service on this trip. If were were by ourselves, sure maybe. But with a group, we didn't want to be separated. The room was spacious and clean and our fridge was restocked each day. We always leave money for housekeeping. We liked being in 3 because it was close to everything: beach, food, admin service, etc.

Food: we ate the buffet most mornings. The coffee situation is strange. My boyfriend is a tea drinker so we didn't use the machine in the room because there was only one pot. His tea would taste weird from the coffee. So in the lobby, by the buffet is a coffee station setup. And then around 10 am, the coffee bar opens. So strange to me. We also ate at Blue Agave (ok), Enso (very yummy) and the Brazilian night at Market grill (our favorite). Other than that, it's standard fair for an all inclusive. We did not utilize the room service.

Beach/pool: Gorgeous beach. Probably the biggest and cleanest of anywhere we have stayed. That entire chair situation is out of control. I watched groups of people put towels to reserve on chairs at the beach AND at the pool - and then sit in neither! I realize it's hard to control that but every hour, they should walk around and if people aren't there, take the towels. People are so rude with leaving one sandal or a book to make it look like they are sitting. We are serious beach people and sit there for 8 hours. We watched groups of chairs sit empty for at least three hours most of the time. Let others have a seat! Don't be selfish.

Staff/customer service: Excellent. Every single person was happy and courteous and said hello. We had no trouble getting service or drinks.  Nice job Paradisus! And those folks work hard. They were constantly cleaning, sweeping, maintaining, etc. Give them tips when you can.

We enjoyed our stay and would recommend it to others. Would we go back? Not necessarily. It is just a big complex and there were a lot of kids. We like smaller places with less kids but that is not a hit against them. We went with a group choice; otherwise we go elsewhere for some quiet. I'm already sad to be out of the sun and warmth of Mexico!

reviews.author: artp52
reviews.title: Another great visit to Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: My wife and I went to the Paradisus Cancun for the second consecutive year.  The goal was to get as much sun and pool time as possible.  When we arrived we were checked in promptly by a friendly staff member.  Our room overlooked the pool area and ocean.  We couldn't ask for anything more.  The room was a very nice one bedroom suite with a Jacuzzi on the balcony.  The bed was very comfortable.  The friendly cleaning staff made sure that the room was exceptionally clean in the morning as well as arriving at night to turn down the bed.   The food in all of the restaurants was good.  There was a theme for each night in the main dining room Naos with a Mexican slant on each of the theme foods.  A convention being held at the resort made some of the dining a little more congested than what we experienced the previous year.  We tried the Tempo restaurant, the only restaurant where an additional charge was levied.  This restaurant did not disappoint.  The food was a step above the all inclusive food at the resort.  The pool attendant, Jorge and our server Assunciation were very friendly and made sure that our needs were met.  They even remembered my wife and I from the previous year.  The only annoyance that we experienced was due to construction that was taking place at the hotel next door.  Not Paradisus' fault.  Overall, a very good stay at a very good resort.  We'll be back.

reviews.author: Azb7150
reviews.title: Wow is all i can say!!!
reviews.text: From beginning to end our family stay at Paradisus Cancun was amazing!! we came here at the suggestion of some good friends who met up with us while we were there. they are time share holders we are not, nevertheless impeccable service! we never felt pressured to sit through a presentation. PS I speak Spanish(learn a few words) it helps!! the pools were super clean and not too rowdy. I have a 2 year old and 10 year old and their stay was great. Staff treated everyone kind and super attentive!! See Gaudencio at Naos breakfast and lunch buffet. Hes the best. Super kind !! Tipping is our custom since these people make very little ($4/day) and they run around for you like nobody I back home. A few bucks here and there helps the local economy and supports this community we love to vacation in. My 10 year old enjoyed ceramic painting , musical chairs and some other kids games they offer through kids club...I of course enjoyed the pool, sun and endless drinks that Miguel by the huge serpent like pool provided. also we tipped often ,I turned I had a new frozen concoction. Yum to all the drinks and food!!! Very flexible to kids oriented meals. Also make reservations at Enzo if you like Asian food...Get the spring rolls, lettuce wraps, and end it with a flaming coffee !! its quite the show especially if you order 2 or more!! love everything, will be back!!

reviews.author: jphillips2017
reviews.title: wedding aniversary trip
reviews.text: We spent 5 days in Cancun at the paradisus in the royal service area. it was fantastic and Eduardo took such fabulous care of us. he was attentive to our every need and helped us with everything from check in, reservations, Bali chairs, check out, etc. if you go to the Paradisus upgrade to royal service, its worth it and get Eduardo if you can as your butler.

reviews.author: Toby T
reviews.title: Great family getaway .. if your kids are over 5 and under 12
reviews.text:
When we got to the airport the hotel car service greeted us promptly right out front and couldn't have been friendlier. The hotel is about a 15 minute drive from the airport. We got in at midnight with 2 very rambunctious toddlers and everyone was kind and accommodating. At check in we upgraded to family concierge and even though she said they couldn't technically give us family concierge until the next day she still charged us for it for that evening which was a bit frustrating especially since it was already so late at night and we'd have to go back the next day for new bracelets to reflect our stay in family concierge. They also did not have record of us paying in advance so make sure to print out and bring your confirmation with you.  

The hotel itself is very pretty when you walk in. We were in the main building in a lagoon view room. The lagoon view is basically a view of the main strip in Cancun, not very appealing. I'd opt for ocean front. The room is clean, nice and updated, nothing specia but comfortable. The mini bar is beer and cold sodas. Not impressive for someone who drinks wine and hard liquor.  

There is a nice little balcony with lounge chairs but again if you're lagoon view it is not very peaceful as you hear the buses at the bus stop right out front as well as the cars and traffic.  The breakfast buffet -- there's only one place to eat --  is your typical run of the mill breakfast buffet with every option imaginable and the food was fine. (Make your own omelettes, waffles etc. as well as random lunch/dinner food) .. we met our concierge Alexander who was very nice and helpful. He made our dinner reservations for us and put fun toys and surprises in the room for the kids.  Beware, they bring bath supplies for the kids that are all watered down big time, bring your own shampoo etc! The walk to the pool from the main building is easy. The first thing we noticed on the walk to the pool was a LOT of noise. As we approached the kids club section we realized there is an old, unattractive building next door that they are doing construction on. The noise goes on ALL day.  The pool is fine for the kids. There's a small section where our 3 & 4 year old could swim and play semi-safely, however, there are built-in loungers that kids were running and jumping on and apparently someone had slipped and cracked their head open the day before we got there. There's also a teeny drop in the pool and if you aren't paying attention you stumble which we all did at least twice but got used to after a few days. There is no bar at this side of the pool so you're at the mercy of a server. The servers seemed a bit overworked and while they did try to come around frequently they were bombarded with orders so it could take a good 10-15 minutes to get a drink.  There's only about 5 food items you can order at the pool. Your best bet is to walk over to the Sunset Grill and grab it yourself...  after swimming we went to check out the kids club... kids under 5 are considered babies and my 3 & 5 year olds were not happy with the baby play area (I don't blame them, it was meant for infants to 18 months old in my opinion) ... One morning the 5 and up kids club had coloring outside and no kids showed up, I asked if my kids could color and I was told no which was very disappointing. They did have a pool activity one afternoon and they did let me kids interact (not play in the games) but dance and play after the activity. The kids enjoyed it a lot. They def. have a very entertaining staff for the 5 and up crew. If you leave your 4 and under kids in the baby playroom they don't really interact with them very much. My kids were so happy to see us after dinner the one night we left them that we didn't leave them again (meanwhile there was a dance party going on right next door in the 5 and up room that my kids really wanted to participate in) .. 

I would say the family concierge sounds great but it is def not worth the additional money. In terms of Alexander, he was an extremely nice guy and while he did several nice things for us including a bubble bath for the kids and a bottle of champagne for us one night and a bottle of wine another night, he was rarely seen and didn't do much else for the kids... we asked him to decorate the room for our daughter's 3rd birthday but he thought my husband said it was my birthday so rose petals and romance and a card wishing me a happy birthday (which they got my name off my passport so could clearly see it wasn't my birthday) ...  All in all, I think you'd be just fine without doing the family concierge. The free beach toys and backpacks are def. not worth it.  I'm guessing if you are a little more aggressive with what you are looking for etc. it might be beneficial but that's def. not our style.

as for the restaurants..   The first night we ate at bana, the Japanese restaurant.. we thought the food was above average and we all enjoyed it quite a bit. The ceviche was amazing and their sushi is fresh. The service was great. Note that the wait staff does ask for a tip in a very non-aggressive way but they do expect it.  We actually thought all the restaurants we tried were quite good.. we also ate at fuego, also amazing ceviches and the tapas restaurant my husband thought all the meats were great.. as well as the market place brazilian steak house... the hotel food is above average for an all-inclusive.  Blue Agave is a decent mexican joint and open all day.. Mole their mexican restaurant was also decent. We did not try the Chinese restaurant.

One night after dinner we needed pull ups for our son and the family Concierge did have someone go out to get them for us. We just needed to reimburse them which was totally fine and Super helpful!  A little about the $1500 US dollar resort credits.  Sounds great in theory but what they do is give you a coupon book and tell you how you can spend the credits. It's basically a few bucks off whatever the full price of something is.. for example $10 off a $100 bottle of champagne... $10 off a $50 Bali bed... and so on. And you can't combine so only 1 coupon per purchase.  It's clever marketing but kind of pointless.   We used 1 the entire time we were there.

We did their "it's not a time share" time share meeting..  while it all sounds spectacular, and it really does.. they ask you for $1800 deposit and then SIX HUNDRED DOLLARS A MONTH. You're weclome. I just saved you two hours of your life you won't get back. 

The time share folks and the beach photo folks will hound you relentlessly.. the photos while you are sitting at the pool and the time share folks while you are walking through the hotel.

All in all, we thought it was a decent vacation. We are interested in checking out their location in Playa Del Carmen  next go round since we hear they have more for our little ones to do. Overall, it was a great family vacation with the pros and cons of any great vacation. The bottom line, it's a great price and you get what you pay for.

reviews.author: Tania M
reviews.title: Awesome stay
reviews.text: Loved and enjoyed every bit of our stay! Beach was spectacular, view was awesome! Service was great, loved all the restaurants specially fuego and market grill. The tacos were fresh and one of the best we have had for lunch at blue agave. The bartender Oscar was our favorite, took great care of us! We loved our vacation and experience at Paradisus!

reviews.author: Wolf P
reviews.title: Poor quality of the hotels!
reviews.text:
Let me start off with the positive:
The beach and pool is beautiful and the pool is kept very clean. There is alot to do and it's fun and relaxing. The ocean is beautiful too. The food is excellent, nice hotel, housekeeping is clean, there is alot to do, good and helpful staff.
Now here is why I am writing this review. I had only made a TripAdvisor account because I wanted to write a reveiw.  They had put us in a first floor room, no problems, but the thing is we wanted a hotel with an ocean view. So, we stayed in the first floor room one night, and the next day we had arrived in the next room with the ocean view. Whoever was in that room before us left it disgusting... The walls had spit stains on them, ethier from spitting alcohol on the wall, or something. Second, the floor was dirty of footprints. We had entered the room, it had reeked of vomit. Not children vomit, but someone had vomited from being drunk or something, because the smell was that strong. Not only that, but the bathroom had stains on the counter and the light switches had brown liquid stains on them. When we'd asked for them to clean the room, they said the vomit smell was just the "paint" on the walls and it's nothing, but they were going to clean anyway. So, when they finished, the light switch still had the same stain on it, the floors were cleaned, and the vomit smell was still there. It was so unbearable that we asked to switched rooms. We could not get settled, so we were very angry. Third room, was fine the first day. But the thing is, we had no hot water. None. The maintenance guys came and did absolutely nothing to get it working. The hotel was clean, but no hot water! They couldn't get it working, so they had offered for us to shower in a "new room". The shower water was hot in this room. However, the shower was not clean  at all. The shower had yellow stains in it which appeared to be urine, so I wore flip flops in the shower. The second day, our family had to take showers in cold water! And not only that, but since the building is so old, and the sewer systems are so slow, some parts of the day we would be able to smell sewer in both of our bathrooms. We had to shut both doors. And they couldn't do anything about that, because the sewer systems are "slow". And it eventually goes away, but if you did leave the door open the whole room would smell! I recommend you stay somewhere else. We are not happy with our stay so far.

reviews.author: Jenna M
reviews.title: Awesome vacation at Paradisus!
reviews.text: My husband and I, along with some friends, stayed at the Paradisus earlier this month. We had a great time and would absolutely return! Everything was excellent, from the food and drink to the property itself. We were most pleased, though, with the staff. Everyone we encountered was great—kind, friendly, helpful, and fun. We want to thank Miguel, our bartender at the pool, for taking great care of us every day. He never let our drinks go empty and made us feel important, even though I’m sure he was waiting on plenty of others at the same time. Thank you, Miguel, you’re the best! Special shout out to Emilio at the swim-up bar for making excellent shots! Balan (swim-up bar) was great, too. Each of our servers at the restaurants were great, as well, especially Roberto at Bana, Atilano at Naos, and Efrain (I hope I spelled that right) at Market Grill. Really, I wish I could remember everyone’s name so I could thank everyone!

reviews.author: JBZ318
reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: We have stayed at other Melia and Paradisus Resorts many times before, we were there over Super Bowl weekend and thought the resort was beautiful.  We paid for the upgrade to Royal Service and we had Daniel as our butler he was awesome he really went above and beyond to make sure our stay was perfect.  Carlos at the pool was equally attentive and really made our stay wonderful.  The beach was great waiter service was good as well.  The only room for improvement I think would be the food.  Breakfast by the pool at the palapa was good but the dinners were just ok. All in all it was a great long weekend.

reviews.author: Carol H
reviews.title: Paradisus Camcun
reviews.text: Great resort! Lovely property, great food, pristinely clean, very friendly and pleasant staff. Would definitely stay there again. Easy to get to from the airport. Each restaurant had very good food. The wine and cocktails were of better quality than most all-inclusives that we have visited.

reviews.author: BCtravelerette
reviews.title: Fantastic gateway for family with a toddler
reviews.text:
Staying at Paradisus Cancun in January left us with tons of happy memories. It was the very first true vacation for my family of three ever since I was pregnant with my son 3 years ago, and it was really a relaxing, hassle-free and enjoyable 7 days. Overall, I give it a 5-star. Here are some more details of what I like the most and least. 

Pros: 
-	Location and layout of the hotel is 5-star!  At 15-minutes driving distance from the airport, the hotel is huge compare to some of its neighbors! But it is smartly designed to lay out the five pyramid buildings in one line parallel to the beach with all main restaurants and bars in the middle. Three exits (in building 1, 3, and 5) lead to the pool areas. We stayed in building 2 and didn’t feel far at all to walk to anywhere. The Kids Zone is just a few floors down in building 2 and the kid pool is right out of the exit of building 1, which are bonus for my toddler.  
-	Staff everywhere is generally very friendly and helpful. Some (front desk, a la cart restaurants, room service, bars, concierge) are more pleasant than the others (a few from the buffet), but it is understandable to see exhaustion or numbness shown on faces of those working like a sonic in the busy buffet all day long. 
-	We had a room in building 2. The room is very clean; never saw any bugs or mold anywhere. Furniture and decorations are a bit dated but in good conditions (The first room offered to us in Building 3 was more modern, but we gave it up to avoid noise at night from the bars. Guess they are going in phases to renovate).  Room service was amazing. We always got prompt responses: asking for extra towels and saw a huge pile of clean towels when returning in 15 minutes. Care and attention showed in little details: having some wet swimming suits drying on the baloney chairs and noticed the room server re-positioned the chairs for more sun exposure. 
-	Most of the free a la cart restaurants are fantastic. We loved all of them, except Ehso (Asian cuisine – we are Chinese and are naturally more picky in Asian cooking). Each restaurant has a unique setting: Bana sits in a little tropical plantation; Vento has tables right by the side of a fish pond; Mole has a traditional bright color Mexican feel; Fuego, Blue Agave, Market Grill and Ehso all have fantastic pool/ocean views. Each has its own welcome drink of the day, and food is generally delicate and tasty (loved the tapas from Vento, the butterfish filet and sushi from Bana. Mole’s Mexican cuisine was interesting; Fuego’s shrimp risotto and black crusted salmon are appetizing. Blue Agave’s tacos are tasty quick bites. There weren’t many duplicating items on the menus you may get in the buffet, and the waiters/waitresses were all very attentive and caring. Making reservation is no problem at all, and all you need to do is to dial “0” on your room phone. This is way more convenient than lining up in person, a practice in many other all-inclusive resorts. The Naos buffets were acceptable with good varieties, but it was our least favorite compare to the other restaurants. I did love the deserts at the buffets, the juicing station at breakfast where you could customize your drink with fresh fruit/veggie, and the freshly grilled quesadillas from the morning omelet stations (but the lineup was long most of the week).  
-	Breathtaking beach and prompt beverage service. Needless to say more about the fine white sand and electric blue water. I did notice the beach in front of Paradisus is particularly wide with few seaweeds compare to other hotels. The waves are very strong. But it’s like this for the entire vertical side of the hotel zone. Including my 2-yr-old, we had great fun jumping the tides. January may be a slow season or we could be just lucky as we always got palapa and chairs closer to the entrance no matter what time we went out to the beach. The bali beds look comfy but we never felt the need to rent one ($50-80/day). 
-	Kid zone: two spacious rooms adjunct to each other: baby zone(1-5yr) and kid zone (5-10yr) that are equipped with climbing structure, cribs, lots of toys, TV, videogames, table hockey, foosball, billiards table, and etc. They have different class activities and performance (both indoor and outdoor) throughout the day, and the caregivers are attentive and fun. 

Cons (or more of personal preference, and thus doesn’t affect the 5-star rating): 
-	It’s pretty dimly lit everywhere inside the hotel except the buffet, the gift shops, and the front desk areas. We arrived around 7pm, and had a hard time to locate our rooms in the dark corridor. Some a la cart restaurants (Vento, Bana, and Ehso) are also very dim. For example, the Bana restaurant locates in the middle of tropical plantation. We ate there twice and were always sat at the tables hidden on a side of a little trail into the woods, very unique and private settings. But there was only a tiny candle on each table and definitely hard to see the menu or the food in front of you after 7pm. My toddler also didn't like eating in the dark and kept knocking off his glasses or became fussy very soon. 

-	Indoor scent/odor: 1) the common areas in the main building are heavily scented. Incense sticks are burning everywhere. It wasn’t a big issue for us as we rarely spent time there. But for those who have asthma or allergy but do want to hang out in the common area, this could be problematic.  2) The Kids Zone, although well equipped with toys and staff, the lack of air ventilation was a problem for us. The smell of plastics or chemicals from the floor mats or decoration was obvious. I could feel irritation to my respiratory system after stepping in for more than 2 minutes. As a result, we never left my son to play in there for more than 15 minutes each day. The Family Concierge member-only play area and the gym have the same ventilation problem and I wish there could be windows to those rooms to bring in fresh air. 

-	I was a bit disappointed as there weren’t many exciting seafood items in all restaurants as I have hoped to get in a seaside city. The common ones were octopus, mussels, fish, and scallop. Shrimps or prawns were only regularly available on the a la cart menus. Never saw lobster or crab in any restaurant despite our willingness to pay extra (maybe the adult-only la Palapa restaurant have some?). All the crab dishes were really made of imitation crab meat and it didn’t say that on the menus. 

-	Adult pools are deep (minimum is around 1.6M and quickly goes to 1.8M). Kids pool was not as exciting as some of the other hotels offer. There were only one shallow baby pool and a shallow section of the big pool without any slides or other water play structures. It was OK for my toddler this time. When he is a few years older, it will be for sure a bit boring for him. 

-	Small stage for shows. There was a show every night taking place in the centre stage of the Avenue bar, on the second floor of the middle section in building 3. A pretty small intimate setting surrounded by lounge chairs, corner sofas, and bali beds. Limited by the space, shows were small-scale such as a couple of dancers, acrobatics, or small band performance. The shows were from 8:30-9:30, and was a source of noise to all rooms in the main building for those who rest early.   

-	No cocktail menu: I never found a drink menu anywhere. Again this could be only for me not knowing many cocktail options, but I do wish there could be a menu so I didn’t have to keep asking the server what the interesting drink others were having.

reviews.author: sobrinae
reviews.title: BEST STAY EVER!!!!
reviews.text: This hotel is so amazing. The staff was so amazing and they made everything so perfect for us. The food was soooo good. I remember eating tacos after a long night of dancing. They made everything so easy and relazing.

reviews.author: Darin B
reviews.title: Paradisus wins me over again!
reviews.text: I've been to Dominican Republic Paradisus Palma Real a few times and loved it so I decided to give Cancun Paradisus a shot as well and loved it almost as much. Cancun's Paradisus is much more compact in geography, meaning you don't need golf carts or trains to get around the resort. The food is probably a little better in the Dominican, but overall I was very pleased with my Cancun stay. I was there two weeks and had beautiful weather the entire time!  Coco Bongo was a great time too.

reviews.author: cubaboundmanitoba
reviews.title: Treated like royalty without paying for Royal Service
reviews.text: Feb 13-20.  Before we left, there were a lot of great reviews, but most from people who upgraded to RS. We thought in order to have a great vacation we needed to do this as well.  Unfortunately, the hotel was sold out and we were unable to upgrade.  Well, let me tell you, we would have thought we had upgraded.  The service was exceptional!  You didn't want for anything.  All you had to do was ask. We spent our days at either the quiet heated pool outside of Naos (buffet), or on the beach.  You did not have to get up at the crack of dawn to reserve sunbeds, but be sure to get there by 9 am if you want shade.  We only went to three a la cartes, and probably preferred the buffet.  It was always amazing.  The only downside was that the food was warm at best.  This is the only area this hotel needs to address.  There was always good grilled food pool side, and the last full day there they had the most amazing food (grilled steak, chicken and ribs)!  We initially requested a king bed, but only room available was in the very tired Melia Club building.  We immediately called the front desk who repositioned us on the 7th floor of building 3, but we had to put up with two doubles.  Minor concession for a much nicer room!  All in all, one of the best we have stayed at.  The people who work there, regardless of their position were extremely kind and accommodating.  Of note, we ordered room service for dinner one night as we were very tired (and lazy), and had one of the best burgers ever while on holiday, and service was really quick!

reviews.author: Kman E
reviews.title: Great All-Inclusive and Better Service
reviews.text:
Just returned from an 8 night stay at the Paradisus Cancun. This is the third all-inclusive resort that I have stayed visited in Mexico. It is now the best one, and we will return next February. Had a great room in Tower 1 with Royal Service and ocean view. Room was excellent, great accomodations, and impeccable maid service. Only quibble would be the water pressure in the shower, a very minor issue.
Upon arrival, Getsabe welcomed us and was wonderful to work with. Along with Luis, the concierge, we were able to obtain a wonderful room, get reservations for dinner and all of our questions answered within minutes.
My past experiences with all-inclusives has been the quality of the food, but not here. All the restaurants we ate in were very good. I had no issues with quality whatsoever.

The service from welcome to departure was wonderful. I would like to call out Eddie C., Jorge, Ricardo, and Valeria at the adults section of the resort. They spent the better part of a week taking care of us at the pool and beach serving us food and cocktails the whole week we were there. They were wonderful people and we had fun with them all week. Finally I would also like to thank Carlos from the adults pool. He took care of us every morning that we went to the pool or beach. He arranged for lounge chairs, towels and Bali Beds for us whenever they were available. Wonderful people, wonderful resort and a great time. I want to thank all of these folks as well as others who provided a great experience for me and my girlfriend. We are looking to book again next February and will extend our stay even longer.

Thanks to everyone at the Paradisus Hotel, and Club Melia. Outstanding job.!!

reviews.author: Travis M
reviews.title: Gaudencio at Naos
reviews.text:
