Gaudencio is the best server in Cancun! Ask for him on the breakfast shift at Naos. Treated us like family.  He was very accommodating throughout our entire vacation. We were spoiled. 
Thank you Gaudencio for making our trip memorable.

reviews.author: 7355curt
reviews.title: Attentive Waiters
reviews.text: Jorge, Eddie and all the waiter staff at the adults only La Palapa Royal Services, Paradisus Cancun are the best at what they do. We will miss them. Also Ruth, Betsy and Jorge at Club Melia, pyramid #1, Paradisus Cancun are the sweetest people you could ever meet. My wife Sally cried the day we had to leave.

reviews.author: videodude_Fremont
reviews.title: The Good, The Bad, The Ugly
reviews.text:
Before I begin, let me state that we are Melia Vacation Club members, and our 
experiences are slightly different than regular hotel guests.  That said, I will 
concentrate most of my comments on areas of common interest.

Appearance

The physical property is lovely.  The view from the drive is very impressive, with all 5 pyramids visible.  A woman in our shuttle said "Oh My God, you're staying HERE? This place is incredible!".  And it is. The lobby is open, very airy, tall, and inviting.  

Reception is to the left as you enter the lobby located in pyramid 3, in a separate check in area.  Never once did we see long lines, or people with typical front desk issues.  That seems to be a good sign.  MVC members check in in pyramid 1, which isn't immediately clear but a staff member escorted us to the check in area.  Check-in was fast and efficient.  The entire lobby area is clean and appears to be well maintained.  

Rooms

As I was never in a regular hotel room, I won't make any assumptions.  The room we 
reserved was a Studio, which had a king bed a bathroom.  There is no kitchenette in the studio units, despite what the website shows.  The bath was all granite, and included a tub/shower, and a bidet.  We always had sufficient hot water and pressure.  Our room was always kept clean by housekeeping, and the refrigerator was always stocked with water, soda, and beer.

Pool

There is one very large pool.  There is also a small children's area of the main pool, which we noticed a number of families were using.  There is also a "private pool" for Royal Service customers.  More on them later.  Bali beds surround the pool, but they are all reservation only, and are extra charge for everyone, including MVC members.  Other Melia properties offer Bali beds at no charge for MVC members. There is no whirlpool or hot tub.  At one end of the pool is a pool bar, which closes at 6pm.  Drinks of any kind are NOT allowed in the pool.  This rule doesn't seem to be enforced.  We never had a problem getting pool chairs, despite the resort being full.  No diving is allowed, the pool isn't deep enough for that.  There is no "artificial beach", for easy access, you have to use the steps.

Beach

Cancun sand is like no other; it's like flour.  The sand is soft and very white, and is never hot.  Very different from Pacific sand.  There are palm trees, palapas, and beach chairs.  We saw very few beach vendors, which is nice.

Food and Beverage

There is a beach bar.  It is open until 12 or 1am.  There is no actual lobby bar, at least not one that is quiet.  The beach bar is often windy, and there isn't really a view.  Everything is very dark at night.  Drink taste is pretty consistent from bar to bar, leaving me to believe that the bartenders use the same formulas for mixing.  The "so-called" lobby bar is used for entertainment, so it is impossible to find a quiet corner to have a drink and have a conversation.

Breakfast is always at the buffet, located on the ground floor of the main building.  
Although never disappointing, it's always the same.  The only way to get something hot for breakfast is to have an omelette or have eggs made to order. For reasons unknown, the Paridisus Cancun has NO steam tables in their buffet.  Hot food brought from the kitchen quickly gets cold sitting on the bricks that have been placed in the steam table openings. Sometimes, even food from the kitchen that should be hot, is cold before it is even placed on the bricks.  I watched kitchen help bring a tray of tater tots out from the kitchen, and place them on the bricks. Hoping to get them "fresh out of the kitchen", I got some to go with my eggs.  Surprise!  All were cold as a stone.  Whomever had the lame idea to disable the steam tables and fill them with bricks ought to be shot at sunrise.  FAIL. 

Lunch is either at the buffet (same issues as at breakfast) or the pool snack bar.  The problems with the main buffet speak for themselves, and the pool snack bar isn't much better.  Burgers and hot dogs are placed in stainless steel trays and allowed to get cold.  Another FAIL.  There is a Mexican "taco place" inside that will actually make you "tapas style" tacos and other items.  It is pretty good, especially considering how bad everything else is.    

Dinner was either at the buffet (different themes every night) or one of the specialty 
restaurants.  Our MVP concierge had made reservations for us at all of them, so we had something different every night. All I'm going to say is that the menu for each 
of the specialty restaurants NEVER changed for the week we were there, that should 
tell you everything  you need to know.  Now, if the menus were extensive, that might 
be fine, but the offerings were very limited, and not main stream at all.  The best of them all was a Spanish Tapas restaurant, which was reasonable.  For that reason 
alone, most of these restaurants get a FAIL from me.  We never went back after the first time.  The nightly buffet was marginally adequate, at least there was an attempt to change things up every night, but there was nothing exciting, and nothing that was served hot.  Not memorable.

Entertainment

What entertainment? There is no showroom, so the "shows" are put on in the lobby bar, which is inadequate at best.  The room is too small, any "show" is difficult to see, and the acoustics of the space make everything impossible to hear.  For a property of this caliber, it was the second major disappointment, next to the food.

Staff

The staff is attentive and helpful.  We never met anyone who didn't have a positive attitude.  There is, however, an emphasis on the "caste" system.  There is this "thing" at the Parisisus called "Royal Service", which is an extra charge for hotel guest who want (or need) a personal concierge, and a private pool, and a private dining area.  This seems like an East Coast thing, as we have noticed similar types of service levels at properties catering to East Coast folks.  Different strokes, I guess.  Maybe you have to have "Royal Service" to get hot food.

In Cancun, eating out isn't necessarily an easy option.  One would need to take the bus or a taxi to town, nothing is within walking distance.

Conclusion

It probably sounds like I am trashing the Paridisus, I'm not.  I just see room for major improvement.  First off, we will likely come back.  However, I won't expect much from Food and Beverage.  The all-inclusive is very expensive and I don't feel that I received value for what it cost.  I would plan on eating out, and would get a larger room with a kitchenette, so we could at least prepare our own HOT breakfast.

I would challenge the Food and Beverage manager to eat in his own restaurants, just like a guest, not sampling food in the kitchen.  There IS a problem that needs to be addressed.  Fix the food and I will be in love with the place.  Otherwise, there are other properties in the Hotel Zone that do a better overall job.

reviews.author: jsl898
reviews.title: Best in Cancun
reviews.text:
My original booking was for the Iberostar Grand Paraiso in Playa Del Carmen, but I arrived one day early to avoid a storm. Looking for places to stay the night in Cancun, I came across Paradisus which offered an Ocean Front all-inclusive room for $190. Seemed way too good to be true, but I booked it anyways.

It wasn't too good to be true, Paradisus delivered! The room was absolutely beautiful, with sweeping views of the ocean. Everything felt so modern and clean. The beds were very comfortable and the bathroom was marbled.

The pool was warm and big, it was so fun to swim from end to end! The beach was stunning, with white sand and crystal clear blue water. It was a wonderful way to enter paradise.

The hostess at the Market Grill gave me a very last minute reservation, and sat me directly by the ocean view. I couldn't believe my luck. Then my dinner was made perfect by Armando and Efrain, who were the two nicest and most professional waiters I've ever met. They were so full of fun energy and excited to tell me all about the resort. They made me feel at home.

The breakfast was great too, tons of options. Unfortunately I left shortly after, but I was super impressed by this experience! I think my cheap price may have been due to the last minute (same day) reservation, but I'd gladly return for twice the $$$. Thank you for the awesome preview of the Paradisus, I'll be back!

reviews.author: saracbates
reviews.title: Excellent!!!!!!!!!!!!!
reviews.text: We just got back from the paradisus Cancun! It was amazing. We had the family concierge service and Maria was wonderful.  We were treated so well with Rudolfo and Maria! The kids loved the extra touches... the coloring books, milk and cookies, bathtub filled with balloons!! We loved all the special treats we got too!! Champagne and strawberries, wine and cheese plates.. etc!! We will be back!!!! Thanks for everything... see you next year!!!!!!

reviews.author: LondonM23
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text:
Overall an amazing trip, but hopefully the below are useful to both travellers and the hotel.

Good points:
- The spectacular location and view
- Wonderful resort with lots of entertainment (it’s the little things that count)
- ALL staff were amazing, a credit to the resort, much thanks to the lovely waiter Jamie
- Room was great, no complaints
- Very impressed with the buffet
- No delays with check-in or check-out

Bad points:
- I was trying to email the hotel prior to the holiday but I struggled to get a response and when I did it was a week later which is a real shame as I have always had good contact with a hotel previously on email
- Although there were signs that say not to, people still reserve sunbeds! I suppose this is a common theme with all hotels but it is so annoying
- We were on the top floor of pyramid three and when we wanted to come back to our room for a snooze before dinner we couldn’t as the noise from the entertainment on the ground floor was so loud. It is essentially open plan and outside your room door, so I guess this is down to the design of the building
- The individual restaurants we found a bit strange. Although the food and service was lovely, it was as if the menus were trying a little too hard to be fancy and the atmosphere was a little odd (exception to the market grill where the atmosphere was great!)

reviews.author: Ahtziri M
reviews.title: A fluid and sumptuos experience
reviews.text:
On this ocassion we visited the hotel for business matters. Although it seemed a rare choice for a business trip it turned to be ideal. During the morning we had to go out into town for work, and be back in the afternoon to report and analise. The efficient and exact labour force engine that make the place work smoothly is a great comfort and asset. 
Therefore we had very flui transitions between fieldwork and reflection time, knowing our needs would be solved immediatly, plus we could continue the work discussion in a very rich and unique enviroment that enhance our reflection time. Without a doubt this was a delicious working experience in a very relaxed atmosphere!

reviews.author: Arlene Miskar
reviews.title: the three s's
reviews.text: I arrived I was greeted by beautiful smiles and warm and friendly people the hotel was amazing with all the greenery   there was always someone cleaning something all the time. the food was great the drinks were wonderful the room was clean and had an ocean view.  the ocean and deck chairs were fabulous

reviews.author: Joan M
reviews.title: Another spectacular vacation at Paradisus! They never disappoint!
reviews.text: I visit this hotel every year and absolutely love every second of my time here! The grounds are beautiful, the staff is best in Cancun and you meet the best fellow travelers here!  Be sure to tip the staff as they work very hard for you to have a wonderful experience. The buffet, Naos, has such a variety of food and the waiters are great. Be sure to have Andres wait on you as he is the best. The pools are large and surrounded by lush gardens. Thanks to Balan and Emilio at the pool bar for excellent service. In the evening you must go to the Toji bar located in the Bana restaurant. Cozy bar with great atmosphere. I guarantee you will meet and have conversations with the most interesting and friendly fellow travelers in this bar. Thank u, Christian for your service. The rooms are ver nice and clean. If you have any problem they will do their best to correct it immediately. Our maid,Carmen, was the best!  My family has a time share at Paradisus and their is special staff to cater to your every need. Thanks to Fabi and Betsy for your service! There are man restaurants to choose from for dinner. Be sure to make a reservation early in the day as they fill up quickly. I can't wait to return to Paradisus next year. I have made wonderful friends!

reviews.author: David K
reviews.title: First Visit To Cancun
reviews.text:
Paradisus is a beautiful property on a spectacular beach. Ocean-room views are tremendous.
As a member, I will have one point of information as a complaint but, otherwise, facility, services, food was very good to excellent.
Food ranged from very good to excellent.
Service was excellent, from welcoming us to servicing us at the pool, beach, and restaurants.
The service provided at La Palapa by Valeria and Edier was--well, if you're fortunate enough to be serviced by them--was courteous, professional and yet warm and always welcoming and we wish them well.
At the pool for Royal Service, Carlos, Omar, and Degner were helpful and attentive and we appreciated their attention and service each and every day.
And welcoming us on arrival, Jorge and Liliana were informative, helpful, and insightful.
The only complaint is that the building for members has one elevator, which is used for both the staff and vacationers. This ties up the elevator for long periods of time. If your knees force you to use the elevator if you're located on the fourth or fifth level, your time is taken us by an elevator that stalls and stops on each level, pretty much a test of patience and also a waste of your vacation time.
We look forward to our next trip to this wonderful property.

reviews.author: eleonardi
reviews.title: Thank you Maria!
reviews.text:
We have been to Mexico many times and have stayed at many resorts. We are experienced travelers who love local life and don't make many requests or complaints. We are fairly easy to please. Expedia completely mishandled our entire vacation and it should have been disastrous and stressful but thanks to Paradisus it was amazing.

We arranged for family concierge which caters to families and couples and provides a "butler" for anything you need. 

Our "Butler" was Maria and she was amazing. She was extremely genuine, helpful and was more of a friend than anything else. I cannot stress enough how much Maria saved our vacation and made us feel so welcome. 

I sincerely would have rather had her just hanging with us enjoying the sun than ask her to do anything as she was such a joy to be around.

If you have the opportunity and pleasure to upgrade to family concierge and have Maria as your contact, you will have the most amazing experience. 

It is very rare I write reviews unless I am very passionate about an experience. But Maria deserves the best review I can give and I only wish we could have paid every cent that Expedia was paid directly to her. 

Again thank you Paradisus and thank you a million times to Maria for everything you did to assist us out of kindness.

reviews.author: cionavysubguy
reviews.title: Amazing Staff!!!!  Great location and beach!!!
reviews.text: Once we got past check-in, which was a little bit of a mess, the rest of the vacation was top notch.  Thank you so much to Cristhian, Lovera and Atilano for the great service at NAOS...never had better breakfast service anywhere in the world.  The Coco Beach beds with service by Jorge and especially Alejandro will keep us coming back!  Alejandro thank you so much for your great smile and fast service!  Paradisus staff from maids, to room service, to guest services, to restaurants are all top notch.  This was our 2nd visit to Paradisus and we will go back again for sure.  Club Melia runs top notch hotels and we even joined the Club because we love this resort so much.  Visit the Paradisus and they will take care of you!!!

reviews.author: Shawnydrum
reviews.title: Beautiful Backdrop -- Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: This was a very nice resort -- also very large. There certainly are positives and negatives to that. Check in was fairly efficient, but different than anything I have experienced. (Beware the time share sell). We didn't have a King bed in our room (for my wife and I) and had to move rooms. The new room was in the oldest part of the hotel and needed a makeover. The hot tub water pressure and heat was pretty sub-par. The food options were great, but service was slow. Again, a big resort. All the common areas were beautiful and their beach was pristine. Although I have noted a few issues we had, we did like it there.

reviews.author: X7786ENmichaele
reviews.title: beach getaway
reviews.text: great place to relax with great beach at very reasonable price. beach terrific and very close to hotel. dining options were very good and food great. staff was very friendly and did anything they could to enhance our stay.

reviews.author: bregabe
reviews.title: Perfect in every way!
reviews.text: We have a timeshare with RCI and visited two Paradisus resorts this year.  Cancun is our favorite.  The rooms are not as nice as the Playa resort, but it is so much nicer in every other way.   For starters, the all inclusive fees are half at this resort. We are still trying to figure out why Playa is so much higher.  The beach at Cancun is much better. The resort at Playa del Carmen is much closer to the water adventure parks, so that was convenient.  The Playa del Carmen resort does not have a dance club and the Cancun one does.  The Cancun resort is MUCH more tropical in decor.  The buffet and restaurants are AMAZING!  You are spoiled silly at both resorts. I wish I could just move in permanently!

reviews.author: sasha0122
reviews.title: Amazing vacation
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful and all the staff are so friendly and helpful. Didier was our favorite person to help us by the pool and cabana. We will definitely be returning next February or earlier. Can't wait to come back.

reviews.author: Greg G
reviews.title: EXCELLENT - Service and Food and overall Layout of Property was outstanding.
reviews.text:
No need to get Royal Service, trust me.  This resort caters to all your needs.  When we arrived they gave us a room on the first floor with no view of the lagoon which we payed for.  one call to the check in front desk and within 30 min, they relocated us to a beautiful 5th floor room with an amazing view of lagoon.  Rooms were big and clean.
The Food and Service was fantastic.  Beach was fantastic being soft sand and very wide.  We went during their winter which is the reason for the heavy waves in the gulf at beach.  I would rate this property with all things considered a 9/10.  Only complaint is that the show area is very small and they should have a separate building for this.

reviews.author: Julie P
reviews.title: Blown Away
reviews.text: From the moment we walked in, the service was unbelievable.  The resort is spotless.  The staff is constantly cleaning the place to make sure it's top notch, which it is.  The restaurant staff was very nice and it was fun to learn spanish from them.  Food is excellent.  The housekeepers were excellent!  The shows at the Avenue Bar were fantastic.  I can't say anything bad about the place.  Our room was on the Lagoon side, which was still a beautiful view.  You can upgrade to Ocean view, but no need to.  They had fun activities planned by the pool.  This place will not disappoint.  The temperature in the restaurants/hotel, etc were perfect - it wasn't too cold and wasn't too hot - the AC wasn't freezing you out.  The resort was full of different ages - young couples, a few families, middle aged, and a couple older couples - a great mixture.  It was really a perfect vacation.

reviews.author: fmiruna
reviews.title: Paradisus Riviera Maya is better for families
reviews.text:
We chose this resort because we previously have went to the Paradisus Riviera Maya and absolutely loved it. We stayed in an Family Concierge Ocean View Suite. Don't get me wrong, this is a great resort, but in comparison with the one in Riviera Maya I had to rate it less. And here is why:
1. Paradisus Cancun is heavily focused on the Royal Service, and while we paid quite a bit of money to upgrade, it did not feel that we had half of what the Royal Service had. The Royal Service has a private pool, private beach, private restaurant, you name it. The Family Concierge has a lounge. We went to the beach but there topless women around so we tried sitting by Royal service, but we were told we can only be here, just not our kids. Same with showering on the beach: if we left our stuff on a bed nearby to shower, there was staff watching us for 5 min, so we don't sit on the bed without paying ?!. In Riviera Maya, there is half of the resort for families and half for adults. Family Concierge enjoys a private beach area, private pool, private building, private restaurant. It's simply amazing and worth every extra penny.
2. Beds cost $50. They said they had an area for family concierge before with beds included, but now they just charge for them. It's not about an extra $50, it's about their constant need to make more and more money.
3. We had one of the most expensive suites. The suite was great and the kids were sleeping in a separate room. They left snacks, bottle of drinks, toys, cookies out for us every day. However, the suite was full of tiny ants. They were everywhere. My daughter left a cookie on the nightstand and the next morning it was covered in ants. The mattress of the pull out couch was filthy and covered in stains. The furniture in the rooms was pretty old. Other than that, the view and the rooms, were great and we loved it. 
4. The waiters at the restaurants would not serve cognac because they said it was only included in Royal Service (we actually had it in the lounge and the Family Concierge did say it was included). It's not an expensive drink and it would have cost them close to nothing to pour a glass. They were so weird about it. 
5. The beach is nicer here, in Cancun, than in Riviera Maya.
6. There were spring breakers in the pool that were loud and drunk and took over the pool with inflatable floats. Really wished they cared more and had something separate for families.

Overall, we had a great time. The staff for Family Concierge was simply incredible (Fernanda is the best) and the Kids Club staff was so great. The staff for the Kids Club was also amazing. Because this is a mach larger resort in Cancun, you get different service than you do in Riviera Maya. In Riviera Maya staff is more attentive overall, but it's totally understandable, since in Cancun they do have more customers to deal with. But overall I will pick Paradisus Riviera Maya.

reviews.author: firegloglassart
reviews.title: Fabulous vacation destination!
reviews.text: Had a great time. Beautiful beach, pool, restaurants were great, live performances and shows were very good. Would highly recommend Paradisus!  Very elegant. Good variety of restaurants. Room was spacious and comfortable.

reviews.author: Fabiola C
reviews.title: Amazing and relaxing 2nd honeymoon
reviews.text:
My husband and I had the most amazing time in Cancun, not only was the weather excellent and the property but most importantly the hard working people that works there making you feel like VIP everyday. it wasn't our first time at this property and that's why we went back because every time we get excellent service. I want to Thank the following people they made our stay very special.
Faby from front desk at club Melia, Alan our bartender at the pool, Hector & Asuncion our cabana servers, Faby & Roberto our beach cabana servers, Sergio & Francisco from Blue Agave restaurant. Overall I want to THANK all Paradisus staff for their great service, we will definitely be returning next year.

reviews.author: Xerxes W
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: Great experience with Royal Service. Butlers Gerardo and Rode were very helpful and went out of their way to make sure we were having a pleasurable stay. Avenue bar waitress Veronica was very friendly and attentive.  We will definitely stay at this property again.

reviews.author: SeanRogg
reviews.title: Honeymoon in Cancun for a couple in their early 30's.
reviews.text:
We stayed here in January for a 10 day honeymoon. For reference we are both in our early 30s and I have stayed at a number of all inclusive resorts. We stayed in an ocean view room in Pyramid #3 and did not get the Royal Service (not worth it). We booked through WestJet Vacations. 

The service and food at the Paradisus is out of this world. There are five or six restaurants to choose from all offering unique menus and cocktails. Reservations are required and easy to make. My wife is Celiac (cannot have gluten) and she was treated with great care everywhere we went. She always had lots of options on each menu and if required they would make something special for her sin gluten. 

The beach was great, upgrading to Royal Service to access the adults only section of the beach in my opinion is not necessary, the beach is wide and there is plenty of seating. Beach staff are by on a regular basis to ask you if you would like a drink brought down from the bar. A+ service once again. 

We booked a photo shoot with the on site photographers somewhat hesitantly but we are so glad we did. The quality of the photos and the time spent with the photographer alone would cost $1000+ here in Canada. We purchased a package of photos and opted to have a photo book printed which they do overnight ready for you at reception the next morning. The photo book is high quality and flawless. It cost approximately $500 CAN for the two hour photo shoot, full size photos air dropped to my iPhone and the photo book.

If you have stayed on the Cancun strip before you know that there is a bus that takes you to nearby shopping / bars all day long. This hotel is no different. It is a 5 minute walk to the bus stop and yes, it is safe. 

I will say that we met travellers who rented a car and went on their own excursions. They were taken advantage of by police pulling them over and charging them for no reason. I would recommend you stick to the bus / tourist areas / Hotel offered excursions. We went snorkelling and for a few trips to town but for the most part we just enjoyed the resort and everything it had to offer. 

I would recommend staying in the main pyramid (#3). This is where you check in and where most of the action is. There is live music that ends around 10:00/11:00pm so if you are travelling with a young family and go to bed earlier you may hear the party downstairs.

We didn't bother with the melia resort presentation that they will offer you for a "free gift" and I recommend you don't either. Its not worth your morning. Enjoy the resort! 

We will likely be back. Loved it.

reviews.author: philgraves1990
reviews.title: Awesome Honeymoon
reviews.text: Awesome experience!! We went on a delayed honeymoon also with 2 other couples, only thing we didn't like was having to make reservations at there restaurants. Other than that an awesome time with great people. Good food, good drinks, tip well and they'll remember you and take care of you the whole time.

reviews.author: LeBeltran
reviews.title: Everything excellent
reviews.text: Was the 3rd time we came back. The facilities, the service, the food. Everything was just great. This time we liked the change that they make at the shows (at pool, at lobby, and at bar). We hope to get back soon.

reviews.author: imellon
reviews.title: Photography at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Please go see Parbie, she is the sweetest and the cutest little thing! Our Engagement pictures turned out fantastic inside the resort and outside on the beach! Don't waste your time, go straight to the photography desk and ask for Parbie!!!

reviews.author: 993margareta
reviews.title: M Annuzzi
reviews.text: This hotel was awesome. The restaurants were amazing and entertainment by the pool and in the club were great. We had a wonderful time. We took a cab to downtown and felt really safe. Highly recommend this trip to anyone. Plenty to do at the resort.

reviews.author: ds2530
reviews.title: Perfect vacation
reviews.text: We had a blast during our week vacation at the Paradisus. I've been to Cancun several times before and this is the resort I would come back to again. Special thanks to the awesome bartenders at Tojo bar Christian and Santiago, as well as to Luis who served us endless drinks by the beach. Great service, wonderful beach, and overall a great vacation!

reviews.author: Joey S
reviews.title: Great get away
reviews.text: Amazing all inclusive resort, have been using Paradissus resorts and have yet to be disappointed.  very friendly staff and always concerned for the customers.  Amazing staff.  Always someone there to elp with any needs you might have.  Tennis Pro was amazing , had a fantastic yoga class.  Reservations needed for some restaurants and can be done the day before, but none disappointed

reviews.author: JLL1957
reviews.title: An addition to our favorites
reviews.text:
We booked our vacation with Sunwing vacation and everything was perfect. The hotel is about 25 minutes from the airport. 

At check-in witch went quickly considering the number of people, we were offered our choice of drink  (juice, soft drink, wine, liquor) while waiting. We were upgraded to Club Melia since there was some sort of over booking (building 1). We really enjoyed the Club Melia for it's quiet and ambiance even though we could not access it in full. We were told that Club Melia and the Royal service gave the same service.

The food was very good to excellent everywhere we ate. We tried the Bana, Enso, Market Grill, Blue Agave and the Naos (buffet). We especially liked the Market Grill (Brazilian). The quality and variety of food at the buffet was surprising. Service everywhere is more than excellent. there is absolutely no problem making reservations for any of the a la carte restaurants; call a day in advance before 11:00.
For lunch, we tried a couple of times the Sunset grill. It was nice for fast food or for a light lunch.  

Every night at 8:30 there is a show at the Avenue bar. There is no big stage but the shows are very good and the atmosphere is quite intimate as you are very close to the stage. Get there early if you want a good spot it is very popular.  

This one of the few if not the only hotel that has such a wide beach front. You really don't feel squeezed in between other hotels. The sand is powder white and water is really not deep but differs in front of other hotels. 

There are in fact four sections to the pool witch makes the witch of the hotel. One for Kids, one for the Royal Service,  two Main areas. You have absolutely no problem getting a lounger (very comfortable) in the shade. There is always or almost always a spot on the beach or by the pool unless you want a specific place, there are plenty of palapas or umbrellas. There is always a waiter/waitress checking if you need a drink. if you order a beer, they will bring you a small bucket with 4 beers, water and lots of ice. This was great.

What amazed us the most is the quality of the service offered. Although we could not remember everyone we encountered, here are a few of the great people who helped us: Jaime and Arturo at the Naos, Arturo at the Banos. Yamil (the best) at the Avenue bar.  Miguel at Martin at the Naos for dinner. Hugo with the activities staff who took us on a nice kayak trip (ecotour) a free activity. 

We certainly recommend this hotel and are in fact planning to go back this spring with friends. If you want to be really pampered and enjoy the whole benefits the hotel offers, take the Royal Service.

reviews.author: Dolores W
reviews.title: Great service and amenities
reviews.text:
Room great nice ocean view. Food great especially Fuego and seafood night at NAOS buffet. Great Brazilian steakhouse with unlimited meats.  Water a bit rough this week for swimming in ocean. Pool water a bit chilly except for Royal service adults only pool which was warm. Desserts great. Try the coconut ice cream and apple ice cream served in an apple. Amazing!,,!
Butler Jorge great and most of the staff. All friendly and accommodating would go back

reviews.author: Jodie S
reviews.title: Luxurious Vacation
reviews.text: Upon entering, we experienced the WOW FACTOR!!! The hotel is beautiful, customer service is over the top, the view from the room was vivid, and the water was electric blue!!! My only complaint was that the trip wasn't long enough!!! The mall isn't far and we took the city bus which was pretty cheap. We did excursions, Jet Ski's, Parasailing, and rented a boat (saw alligators). Amazing trip! Came home to winter weather here in Houston.😌

reviews.author: johnguillette
reviews.title: Great hotel but  ocean beach can be dangerous.
reviews.text: Fantastic hotel, great food, nice pools.  Only issue was the beach always had big waves, and some undertow.  Beach flags were red every day for two weeks.  Two deaths on the beach in the last week, one at Paradisus, another death a  hundred yards south.  Not nice to see CPR on the beach and no successful outcomes.

reviews.author: Rene T
reviews.title: Fun
reviews.text: So fun! Rooms were beautiful and ocean front. The whole place smells like a spa. Staff was wonderful. We had so many different types of restaurants and bars to choose from! Food could be better, however, the drinks were included! We had cocktail service on the beach!!

reviews.author: Smiiley1
reviews.title: Definitely will go back!
reviews.text:
We are in the Melia vacation club - purchased it in 2003, and I am so very glad we did!  We enjoy our Caribbean trips and never are disappointed with the Melia Hotel chain.  We are partial to all-inclusives, and can't wait to plan our next trip.

Though we were offered to upgrade our plan, we are very happy with what we currently have - and I felt no pressure at all....in fact, I only met with someone out of curiosity of what is now being offered as oppose to what was offered to us 14 years ago.

reviews.author: Courtney L
reviews.title: Long weekend escape ... and it was perfect!!
reviews.text:
My husband and I booked our trip to Paradisus a couple weeks in advance to get away for a long weekend. It was our first time in Cancun and the Paradisus did not disappoint. Everyone was friendly, helpful and always had a smile. The amenities were amazing, pool was perfect, beach was clean and the food/drink was just what we needed. A couple of people to thank ... 
Cindy by the pool --- the toughest job in the resort yet she always had a smile on her face! Big hugs :-)
David, Amelio and the other poolside bartenders --- fantastic service!
The staff at Mole ... best dinner we had the entire time there. 
Thank you all for making the Paradisus feel like home for 4 days. We will be back!!!

reviews.author: Robert H
reviews.title: The best trip I've ever had
reviews.text: I would go no other place number one hotel I've ever been in the service the best the attention to detail is unsurpassed  The staff top shelf friendliest and safest place to visit Will definitely return

reviews.author: Alemartrz
reviews.title: New Stop in Cancun
reviews.text: After 4 successive trips to Playa del Carmen we opted to stay up in Cancun proper this time. We are big fans of the Paradisus destinations so the Paradisus Cancun became our stay for the week. The actual location is about 15 minutes from the airport and is amongst numerous other hotel/resorts. Our stay from start to finish was very nice and enjoyable. Melia does a very good job with their facilities and Paradisus is their top of the line. The people and place made the week a most enjoyable time. The food was very good and the beach is wonderful. I will happily return.

reviews.author: Julie K
reviews.title: Beautiful week!
reviews.text:
This is the best vacation ever!  The quality of service there is more than amazing.  Nothing bad to say about this hotel everything is excellent from the check-in to the room service, the waiters at the buffet and what to say more about the service at beach.  WOW!  Is all I have to say!  

I would go back in a heartbeat and I usually don't visit the same hotel twice.  This is how wonderful my stay was.  Thank you Paradisius Cancun!

reviews.author: FredCarolEdmonton
reviews.title: 2 weeks in Paradise
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus from Jan 20-Feb 3/17 and  had an amazing vacation. We had stayed there 2 years ago and knew we wanted to return. Royal Service is the way to go  and worth every penny. The service was the best,  buckets of cold water at the pool and beach as well as any drinks  including top shelf liquor . Our butler Gerardo  made sure we had dinner reservations and anything else we requested. We dined at almost all restaurants and found all very good but FUEGO and The market Grill were unbelievable. Moses our waiter at the pool/beach was wonderful, funny and always gave us great service. Daniel, Carlos and all other staff including their supervisor made our stay awesome, we are planning to  return next year. KUDOs to the Paradisus!!!

reviews.author: Robert G
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text:
The paradisus resort was beautiful! 

There was no real option for swimming in the ocean as the water was extremely wavy, and most of the beach had severe under tow/ rip tide! 

Carlos the bartender at the pool bar was amazing!  It's so nice to have bartenders who are friendly and having fun at their job! 

The beach servers are very friendly, attentive and quick with serving drinks, they also bring bottles of water to all guests in beach loungers because it's important to stay hydrated! 

Pool entertainment is excellent, they had a good band playing, and like to involve hotel guests! 

The food at paradisus was more Mexican than another resort we had stayed at.   Downtown club zone was a short 10 minute bus ride away. (The bus cost is 10 pesos per person).

reviews.author: Moejackel
reviews.title: Amazing Holiday
reviews.text: After reading through several reviews, we decided to treat ourselves and upgrade to Royal Service.  What a great decision.  When you come back from a vacation (4 of us) and you struggle to find a fault or something to improve, you know that the service, food, amenities are superb.  We have to thank Eduardo, our Butler, for outstanding service, he made our trip so enjoyable, looking after all our needs, even things we never thought of.  We are foodies and wanted to stay somewhere that had great eats.  The food was great - our favorites were Bana, Fuego and Mole.  We wanted to thank Miguel (Bana) Rigoberto(Mole) for making these experiences truly memorable.  We ate at La Palapa for breakfast and lunch each day and were amazed at the quality and taste of the meals.  Valeria and Victor were great.  Pool/Beach service - Joshe, Daniel and Edier work so hard to make your day wonderful and succeed.  To be honest there were so many others who provide outstanding service but their names allude us.  If you are looking for a resort with great food, service, rooms, beach - look no further.

reviews.author: Leeyuk
reviews.title: Welcome to Fantasy Island
reviews.text:
The Paradisus Melia is like a fantasy world that you have no reason to leave when you’re on vacation in Cancun.  It is a very large and sprawling resort, relatively low-rise with 700+ rooms and amazing facilities.  

Stepping into the hotel is like stepping into a hidden realm: around the large central atrium, natural light filters in from the overhead glass pyramid into a lush garden with running water, dense plants and a curtain of hanging plants extending downwards from inward-facing balconies. It’s stunning.

The hotel has over a dozen restaurants, with varied cuisines – everything from Mexican to international to Japanese.  Food quality is generally outstanding, although the Asian restaurants are rather disappointing in terms of authenticity.  

Outdoors, there are several free-form pools and there’s the incredible beach and the Caribbean sea rolling in, with lounge chairs on the beach. It’s the kind of beach you see in movies, rather than real life. 

The hotel complex is simply vast, and it doesn’t show its age, as it’s maintained by an army of staff.  My room, with a balcony, was very comfortable and cosy. Under the hotel’s all-inclusive package, the contents of the mini-bar, as well as access to almost all the restaurants for unlimited dining, were included. 

The facilities are all you’ll need, from spa to shops to gym. Paradisus is like a sort of paradise, and a home away from home.  Magnificent!

reviews.author: Dan A
reviews.title: Ceviche class
reviews.text: Leticia and Andrea who lead the class are the nicest people you'll ever meet. They give a great class - Leticia the cook and Andrea the conversationalist. You'll learn a lot and have a great time. If you can't make this to please everyone you aren't paying attention

reviews.author: Letty G
reviews.title: Thank you
reviews.text:
Coming back July 2017 for my husbands birthday celebration   I have booked 4 rooms but would like to see if there are additional discounts we can have   Bringing our three grown children 
And their kids    Please call us if there additional discounts

reviews.author: Sal23859
reviews.title: Great week !
reviews.text: Stayed February 4-11 with wife. Very well kept facility with easy access from our 3801 room in the central building.  Room was very clean with a good mattress unlimited hot water and a perfect view from the balcony.  Lots of steps but very manageable. We stayed on site to enjoy the beautiful beach and pool.  It knocked the winter doldrums for sure.  Breakfast was full of selections and fresh.  We only ate lunch by the pool. Sunset grill has great wings if you find the sauce. Evening meals were sufficient but not elegant  the food was ok just seemed to be missing the wow effect.  Cindy the pool supervisor is very attentive and policy driven. Early birds parking towels all day and not using chairs will be removed.   Cindy is a good lady with a job to do Don't save it if your not going to use it.  We enjoyed the pool drink service. Sofonia always kept a fresh bucket of ice waters and never let our drinks run out.  He is a good man. If you are looking for a pleasant get away to a beautiful beach I recommend Paradisus.

reviews.author: Melissa D
reviews.title: Amazing trip!
reviews.text: An amazing resort with friendly staff, beautiful property, delicious food and gorgeous rooms! Can't wait to visit again. We were here with a large group and the staff made our stay as comfortable as possible and always with a smile.

reviews.author: Catherine Sparling
reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.text: Had an awesome stay at this fabulous resort! Stayed Jan 23 to Jan 30/17. Upgrade to the royal service and ask for Daniel he is amazing. Don't listen to the negative reviews this is a 5 star resort and they treat you like royalty, they go over and above for everything you want and need. Can't wait to go back!! the only negative thing I can think of was too much incense was burning all the time.

reviews.author: richardy91
reviews.title: Wonderful place to stay
reviews.text:
The property is gorgeous.   Incredible views and easy access to,the pools and beach. The staff was super friendly and hard working.  The meals in all of the restaurants were excellent.   The excursions staff were knowledgeable and friendly without being pushy.  
Tons of little things done right add up to a great experience.

reviews.author: claudette_garneau
reviews.title: Very nice hotel
reviews.text:
Very satisfied, excellent stay. The staff.are very pleasant. The hotel is very clean. I would come back no prroblem.
 There is a biig choice of food at. the buffet. The site is beautiful and well kept.

reviews.author: swright_utd
reviews.title: More like 3.5 star.....
reviews.text: The Paradisus is a beautiful hotel inside and out and is positioned on an amazing beach. That is where the positives end.  Long check in and out process.  Tons of beach beds left empty ( literally like 90%open) because they charge $120usd while there are no open beach chairs because everyone takes them by 9am.  There is no nightlife.  The food is not on par with other resorts.  We were here during the Super Bowl and they charged $90 per person to get to watch the game. At an all inclusive. Rediculous. I just booked another Mexico trip for May to the Hyatt.

reviews.author: betha842
reviews.title: Great time!
reviews.text: We had a fabulous time on our vacation to Paradisus Cancun.  Our time spent beach and pool side was made great by Cindy (Guest services at the pool), Manuel, David, Hector (pool wait staff), and Benjamin (activities).  Cindy was extremely helpful in making sure we were taken care of.  We enjoyed seeing her smiling face each morning when we arrived to the pool!  Manuel, David and Hector greeted us quickly and made sure our drinks were always full!  Benjamin came by each day to make sure we were having fun and were aware of the activities going on around the resort.   The check-in process was long.  They did not have a King room for us which was inconvenient/uncomfortable but the staff was very friendly.

reviews.author: 999dericka
reviews.title: Paradisus. Paradise
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel. All inclusive. If you have the money you should experience their royal suite package. They treat you like a king and your lady as queen. 10 restaurants. Night club beach party.           Enjoy!

reviews.author: DJO
reviews.title: First room had electrical problems, had a front door that didn't close properly and was badly outdated.
reviews.text:
We then attempted to upgrade to royal service, but were informed none were available. We requested another room, but nothing comparable to our booked room was available - so we had to pay for an upgrade - but not royal service.  

2nd room had air conditioner problems, and after waiting 8 hours for "repairs" the room was still uncomfortable.  And the fridge didn't work either.  These things can be repaired, & resolved but being told they are fixed, when staff know this is untrue is what we call a lie where I come from.  

After waiting this long, and calling back the front desk (after a supervisor checked that the air conditioning was working), I asked to speak to the general manager, but they were gone for the day.  The acting manager for the night was to call back to discuss, but never did.  

I'll be reaching out to the general manager in the morning - stay tuned (have 7 more days here).  

Bar and restaurant & entertainment staff are excellent, food great, common facilities great, beach fantastic.  

Dave Johnson

reviews.author: Lauren H
reviews.title: Fantastic First Trip to Mexico!
reviews.text:
I will shortly be visiting the Paradisus Cancun for my second time next week. I had a fantastic time the first trip and am certain my second trip will be just as good. The rooms are gorgeous... I decided to upgrade on my first trip to an ocean-view for the second half and so glad I did! The sunrises over the ocean were breathtaking! 

POSITIVES: food (try Fuego!!), drinks (they use real puree and make fantastic cocktails!), location (so close to the airport!), view, service (we made certain we tipped throughout our stay for such great service; really felt like one of the family)

NEGATIVES: wish there would have been more space around the pool, the center pyramid is very loud - we couldn't fall asleep until after midnight every night due to the noise.

I will make sure to make another review following my trip next week. Hopefully my second stay is as good as the first!

reviews.author: Kimmee P
reviews.title: Amazing Resort, Friendly Staff, but check-in is HORRIBLE!
reviews.text:
Food and Service (except during check-in) is amazing! Great resort --- lots of food and drink options, lots of seating with/without shade around the pool and along the beach area. Rooms are nice although we didn't spend much time indoors. 

Fuego (one of the restaurants in the all-inclusive package) was great, from the appetizers down to the dessert. 

The check-in was cumbersome, took soooooo long and they even gave us a room that someone else was staying at. Imagine our surprise (and the guest's surprise) when we entered using our keycard and they still had all their things inside. They took our bags from us when we got to the hotel as they were going to deliver it but it took forever for us to get them. If you don't have much luggage, best to just take them with you, that way you don't have to stay in the room following up on luggage when you can be outside enjoying the sun.

reviews.author: Brian C
reviews.title: Paradisus Hotel in Cancun
reviews.text: A beautiful hotel set appropriately off the street. Great ambiance, fantastic atriums, pools, location quality and variety of food and drinks. Staff were fabulous, friendly, helpful. Only complaint was check in was a bit slow.

reviews.author: Sunshine
reviews.title: Paradise on earth
reviews.text: complex amazing.  Food is excellent, lots of choice and plenty of fruit. When you walk out of complex the blue water is right in front of you. We had lagoon view excellent view. Hotel staff amazing. Paublo at buffet on out door side for breakfast and lunch with his team were incredible.  Also Cindy pool side was a amazing.  Evening variety shows  were excellent and also pool side entertainement was excellent.  All around exelellent resort have travelled alot and is my favorite to date.  Nothing negitive to say

reviews.author: Roger D
reviews.title: Excellent staff
reviews.text: We stayed for a week in late January.  The staff are really a credit to this location - friendly, efficient, interested in you and really helpful.  We ate in a different restaurant every night with the Market Grill and Fuego being our favourites.  The only possible criticism is there are perhaps not enough umbrellas on beach

reviews.author: Michele S
reviews.title: Paradisus = World Class Service
reviews.text: Paradisus was an amazing experience. The staff were very eager to please. The facility was beautiful. We loved the fresh floral arrangements in the lobby and the hallways leading to the outdoors. The whole place smelled so nice. Even the toilet tissue smelled like baby powder. Paradisus was, simply put. . . Amazing!

reviews.author: wheeler604
reviews.title: 2nd time at Paradisus
reviews.text: My husband and I decided to return to Paradisus because it wAs so spectacular the first time around. This time we learned a few tricks. First book directly on the Melina.com website... you will def get the best price... books regular room and then upgrade to the adults only section when you arrive. If you can live without the butler and cabana it should be about $80 extra a night. We just wanted access to the VIP heated pool and the adults only section lounge available in pyramid 5. Our room was in pyramid 3, which was fine because it was closest to all the restaurants so it was a win-win. The food this time around was ok... not as good as the first time around. The sushi place is def your best bet. The buffet was only ok this time... coffee was always cold and the food wasn't as HOT as I felt it should have been. I also come from Chicago which is a "foodie" city so I am def a lil biased. Overall we enjoy the Paradisus because it's all about the pool and beach for us and they, by far have the best pool.... its heated!!!! We stayed at Aqua last year and while the pool was gorgeous it was COLD.... so just keep that in mind....

reviews.author: Jessica F
reviews.title: Definitely recommend
reviews.text:
I went on the trip with my boyfriend. It was his first all inclusive and my second.  I had previously stayed at the Me by Melia resort however this time it was under construction and went with the sister resort.  It was huge and we loved the location in Cancun.  In the hotel, we had a great room location too in tower 3.  It was quiet, convenient getting down to buffet in the morning, a close walk to the gym, and out the back to the pool. We had an ocean view and waking up seeing the sunrise everyday was pretty amazing too.  

For dinner you can make reservations at the included restaurants up to a day in advance.  
We were able to try all of them while there and did the buffet for breakfast and lunch most of the time. The food was really good not mind blowing but no complaints either.  There were plenty of options to choose from.  They always asked about food allergies too.  

We went SCUBA diving through the on sight Aqua World option which worked out quite well for us. The facility and boats were directly across the street too so no need to take a cab.  For the Aqua World package that we chose it ended up being a little over $200 USD per person including tax.  We were able to parasail, get an hour SCUBA training plus a dive and then for the other 2 activities we had left  we opted for a double dive.  If we had wanted we could have done a jungle tour or wave runner or a few other options instead.  This was a good deal in my opinion.  They also have an on sight car rental through Dollar that we used to rent a car for the day and drive to snorkel and see sea turtles.  This was seamless and reasonably priced too.  

I will definitely recommend to any friends and family looking for an easy Mexico trip option.

reviews.author: ahorn56
reviews.title: Paradisus Paradise
reviews.text: This place is Awesome. Our concierge Paulina is the best. Check in was quick and the ocean view from our room is great. The staff is very helpful and you never go without a drink of any kind.The nightly shows are very good and enjoyable. I would definitely recommend this to anyone.

reviews.author: Eric S
reviews.title: I can now say I have had a butler, and I loved it!
reviews.text:
I spend 5 days at this hotel and it ranks as the most luxurious experience of my life so far. My girlfriend and I stayed in the Royal Services section which has a butler who really does take care of almost all the busy work which goes into a vacation: unpacking, restaurant reservations, handling hotel issues, etc.

The food was also exquisite. We did choose this hotel for its food and we were not let down. We stayed away from most of the buffet's and (with the help of the butler) got reservations to the various restaurants which included a generous sushi restaurant, Mediterranean tapas, and Brazilian BBQ to name a few.  

This hotel is more of a relaxation zone. I lounged in a cabana or beach chair most of the days, swam a bit in the ocean, etc. We took a dancing class, but were the only ones to attend.

I highly recommend visiting this hotel, especially if you are looking for a relaxing, romantic get-away. I also recommend the royal service area if you don't like dealing with busy work. They also had great Wifi, I was able to stream NetFlix on my FireStick quite easily.

reviews.author: jenandjay10
reviews.title: Amazing time
reviews.text:
We came here the last week in January. 
What a fabulous resort.
We have always stayed in the mayan riviera but thought we would venture to cancun since the brach is so wonderful. 
We were worried about cancun being a Spring break place..well not at all at this hotel..we stayed in the adults only section and had a room facing the ocean in the royal.service area. It was perfect..just what we wanted peaceful and no kids..yahhh
Everyone single person at this resort that we came across was so pleasant and helpful. Our Butler was Daniel he was great.always asking what he could help us with or could he do anything for us from.reservations or Bali beds or our check out confirmation and he went to get that info for us so we did not have to leave the beach and he came back with the information.
This was my husband and my 13th trip ad we have been to jamacia and Punta Cana and mexico and this is our new home away from.home.
Worth the extra money. Every bit of it..
Trust me.
The minute we came home we were looking into the next time we could. Return..
Book more than 7 days you will.want it once you are there.it is perfect. .
If you go see Carlos at the towel area he will hook you up with a Bali bed for the day and towels.

Thanks
Jennifer and Jayson

reviews.author: cynthiacV4209JK
reviews.title: Great vacation at the Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: We loved our stay at the Paradisus Cancun.  It is a beautiful hotel with a beautiful pool area.  And a nice beach  just steps away.  Staff was extremely nice and helpful.  Food could have been a little better but was still pretty good.

reviews.author: Jean M  B
reviews.title: We'll be back to Paradisus!
reviews.text:
We made friends with several of the servers. We especially liked Effrain in the Market Grill and 
Darwin in the Japanese restaurant.  We also enjoyed Fuego and the servers at the poolside 
were helpful and accommodating.

reviews.author: H1604ZBsonial
reviews.title: The service was amazing
reviews.text: The service was great glad we upgraded to Royal service. Antonio our Butler was amazing. Food was great. The only thing lacking was a nice show with a stage. The shows were put on in a bar and not enough seats for people to see.

reviews.author: Alexandra K
reviews.title: AMAZING!
reviews.text: Nothing short of amazing. Food was great, beach and pools were amazing! You can eat off the floor the hotel was so clean. The rooms were huge and very clean every day. There was plenty room for storage and to completely un pack and get settled. There were armoatherapy diffusers throughout the hotel therefore it smelt incredible. The staff was as friendly as friendly could be. They were taking our drink orders before we even checked in. A few tips: make dinner reservations in advance, the pool on the left hand side when you walk out is heated, the one with the swim up bar is not. Iwould definitely return again  and I would reccomend anyone to stay here.

reviews.author: alissaa23
reviews.title: Awesome Trip
reviews.text: Went on this trip not knowing what to expect! It was amazing! The staff was the nicest we have ever met. Everyone was always willing to help, and always had a smile on their face! The food was excellent, with so many different options to chose from, you never ever got bored with food and the beach was AMAZING. Best I have ever seen with amazing clear blue water! Loved it here

reviews.author: karendanza
reviews.title: Amazing resort
reviews.text: There is nothing bad I can say about this place.  Amazing resort and wonderful entertainment every night!!  Fantastic restaurants especially the Peruvian restaurant.  Service from the time we arrived until the time we left was unbelievable!!!  Definitely 5 star service!

reviews.author: Carla C
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel and the water is breathtaking.
reviews.text:
The hotel was an easy commute from the airport. The staff was friendly, but check in took longer than I'd like. It also took a little too long to get our luggage.( I wanted my swim suit so I could jump in that beautiful blue water.)
The only real complaint I have is the food. It was more like cafeteria food than high end restaurant quality.

reviews.author: Erin C
reviews.title: Rooms were nice, beach is great, drinks were terrible, and food was ok.
reviews.text: The staff and the rooms were very nice.  The beach was absolutely wonderful.  The all inclusive drinks were absolutely horrible.  We ended up paying for bottles of wine (which were so over priced) in order to have something to drink.  The buffet food was ok, and the reservation restaurants were nothing special.  There were also way too many children there for our liking.  With this said, it is great for families with children, but terrible if you are looking for an adult only vacation.

reviews.author: Lyndy49
reviews.title: Wonderful all inclusive resort
reviews.text: We had a lovely room overlooking the ocean & pool ,with a bottle of champagne ,fresh fruit & chocolate covered strawberries upon arrival.  Each day our refrigerator was restocked with bottled water,sofas,beer, candy & cookies. We had turn down service nightly - Paradisus  slippers where layer out with a chocolate on the bed. There were 8 restaurant options to chose from plus a coffee bar serving cookies & donuts at different times during the day, a snack bar at the pool and a swim up bar in the pool.  Many of the restaurant dining experiences were unique but always very good

reviews.author: marinetraveler
reviews.title: Incredible vacation for the family
reviews.text:
Incredible vacation for the family. Fantastic resort. Excellent staff. My first time at an all-inclusive and I think I'm spoiled now. Food was great, pool was awesome, room was very comfortable, amenities were all we could want.

We splurged on the family concierge service and it was worth every penny. My children loved the Kid Zone (there favorite part of the trip). The nightly treats and the on-call concierge were great. 

Basic room size is the same as one would expect at a standard US hotel; if children are older I'd recommend upgrading for a bit more privacy. We stayed on the beach side and had a great balcony that allowed us to enjoy the music from the pool and see the water. The lagoon side would be cheaper for the not quite at enjoyable view.

Staff was wonderful throughout the stay. Evening entertainment was an unexpected highlight. Beach was pretty but the water was rough (as we learned while researching Cancun). Resort location is good- directly across from one of the main marinas and easy to hop on a bus or call a cab to go out exploring. 

Simply put, can't wait to return.

reviews.author: megan kelly t
reviews.title: Service is great , food is terrible
reviews.text:
We had the royal service and we upgraded our room , to the renovated oceanview royal service room . The renovated room is amazing! 

Royal service is great and the premium alcohol makes a big difference, but the food is really bad ! Chicken undercooked, cold food at the buffet and restaurant very poor selection 

Hotel needs some improvement ( ripped cushion,chairs) no evening show and uncomfortable beach chairs

They need more bali beds in the royal service,

reviews.author: dpw19
reviews.title: Wonderful Time
reviews.text: Our vacation began on a wonderful note when the receptionist Guadalupe informed us that she may be able to get us a ocean view if we could wait an hour.  We went for a drink and when we return Guadalupe informed us that she had been able to upgrade our rooms to an ocean view.  The service throughout the hotel was exceptional and we had a wonderful time.

reviews.author: Helen C
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: I came here with my significant other and I was very impressed. I been to Cancun numerous times and it's more of a young crowd all the resorts are filled with young adults. This resort had many families and didn't feel like I was at a frat party. It was very clean and the staff was super friendly. I had a great time but beware of the timeshare spiel as they will waste your time as try to manipulate you to purchase one. The liquor is top shelf and there is a huge variety of restaurants to chose from. A must if traveling to Cancun !!

reviews.author: Gabriela E
reviews.title: SERVICE SAVES THE HOTEL, EVERYBODY IS REALLY KIND AND HELPFULL.
reviews.text:
The staff are great always very kind, always eager to help.
Food needs to improve, need more option wine wise... most of the desserts are terrible besides the ice creamand lemon tarts..
The hotel and rooms need work.

reviews.author: Adrian M
reviews.title: 6 out of 5 stars if I could!!
reviews.text: From the minute I arrive until my checkout (I stayed for 5 days as a birthday treat from Jan 28 - Feb 2), Paradisus treated me like royalty! Royal Service is just that and more! My butler during my stay, Gerardo, was simply amazing! The man took care of anything and everything I needed and went above and beyond any style of service I've ever experienced in my life! I stayed in the Junior Suite with the Lagoon View and the room/view was immaculate. The entire staff in the Royal Service area were very nice, cordial, and caring. The service I got at the private pool area anytime I went there (which was every day haha) was truly remarkable. Carlos, Cesar, Eduardo, and Victor went above and beyond to ensure all my needs were met; whether it was speedy service for drinks and snacks from La Palapa, ensuring I had a Bali Bed booked for the next day, to adjusting the Bali Beds so I could overlook the Caribbean Sea (and mind you, THEY suggested this for me, I didn't even have to ask), safe to say I was beyond spoiled. To add to that, on the day of my birthday, Gerardo had room service deliver a bottle of champagne and a beautiful slice of chocolate cake to my room, then the staff at La Palapa surprised me with a slice of cake and some tequila shots to wash it down as well! The restaurants were great: Market Grill and Blue Agave were my standout favorites. I splurged a little on a massage at Yhi Spa (Royal Service guests get the hydrotherapy service complimentary and I HIGHLY recommend taking advantage of it) and that was the best 80min I've come out of the pocket for in quite some time! I've never done an all-inclusive trip before and after my experience with Royal Service, I can't recommend it enough (Trust me, it's well worth the extra money to get). I WILL be booking another stay here later this year (or at the least, for my birthday) and I've already told family and friends that THIS is my resort of choice!

reviews.author: donq0948
reviews.title: Paradisus is Paradise
reviews.text:
Worth paying the extra for Royal Service. No matter what your needs are the staff is a glance away. Whether on the beach or at the pool waiter service is there to look after you.They have completed renovations to building 5 which is the Royal Service Adults ONLY. The rooms are fresh clean and inviting. Our room was visited a number of times a day to ensure that the mini bar was full as well as checking our towels,generally to ensure that everything was good in the room. this was one of may vacation trips and i must say that the service is the best.

Food was very good with a good variety. My wife and I preferred the Royal Service Restaurant La Palapas for breakfast and lunch as they would wait on you whether you were at the beach, pool and the restaurant. Many restaurants to choose from and your Butler looks after all the reservations.

The Beach is beautiful, well maintained and extremely clean. You can walk for hours in either direction and once again waiter service is usually a glance away.The pools are clean and the water is quite warm with lots of lounging area. Again great service.

What else can I say... A little expensive but well worth the quality and service.

reviews.author: Angel H
reviews.title: Great Resort/Charge for 6 year old.
reviews.text: We recently visited the Paradisus Cancun for a family trip. Initially my fiancé and I were going but a month out we decided to take our 6 year old. I contacted my travel agent and she informed me that she contacted the resort and my son could stay free. Once we arrived at check-in they told me that he could not stay free and that it would cost $142 a night! We were staying for 4 nights. They would not work with us at all. I contacted the travel agent and she tried to call the same person she spoke with but no luck. So we paid it. It was not in our budget but what could we do. We had a really great time. The resort was awesome! My son really enjoyed the Kids Zone! The girls there were really awesome! I would definitely recommend for a family or a couple.

reviews.author: PT1280
reviews.title: A very nice family vacation ( with 2 kids, infant and toddler )
reviews.text:
Our family just returned from a nice week at Paradisus Cancun on Jan 31. 

This hotel is well reviewed, but here's our  experience with 2 kids.

The property is about 20 mins from the Airport direct transfer. 

Check-in was done in 5 mins even without the family concierge upgrade. 

With 5 towers, this property is very spacious. The grounds are beautifully maintained and the interior is thoughtfully designed with lots of natural elements to set the relaxing mood. 

The layout can be confusing to understand at first. It took us a full 2 days to navigate and figure out which elevators to use. 
Getting around with a stroller is easy with lots of elevators throughout the hotel and ramps outside to access the pools.  
The beach is NOT accessible with stroller. Only access to beach is by stairs. 

Room -
We had an ocean view room in tower 4 on the 4th floor.  Room was clean and in good working order. We found the bed too soft. Housekeeping comes 2 a day, but often didn't restock enough towels.  Front desk was quick to send more up though.  Janet from front desk was very professional and always followed up with us to make sure we got everything we needed. Highly recommend  bringing a power bar if you have lots of electronics to charge. There were 2 outlets in the bedroom, 1 usb behind the TV and 2 in the washroom.

Food - 
The buffet is the only restaurant open for breakfast and doesn't require reservations at any time. Breakfast is very busy.  Dinner could be improved a lot if they had better warming stations. We found majority of the hot dishes to be luke warm although variety was good.  Hostess Katia is so kind and considerate when finding us a quiet table. 

The grill by the pool is open at lunch and serves burgers, hotdogs, wings and nachos for a quick pool side snack. 

Reservations are required for all the alacarte  restaurants preferably 1 day in advance, but we were able to get in if booked before 4pm same day. 

Ibana Japanese restaurant was our favorite. Really amazing for all inclusive standards. Probably the best we've had in Mexico, Bahamas or DR.   

Pools - 
Pools are large and clean. There is one warmed pool in front of the buffet. There was not a specific kids pool but there was a shallow pool were most of the kids were able to splash around.  Loungers are often reserved early, but we were able to find the random one everyday.  Cabanas are available around the pools and beach, but at a daily fee.  Look for Dider, if he doesn't find you first and he will keep your refreshments topped up all day long.  We miss you Dider. 

Beach- 
The beach is well maintained and spacious.   Loungers there are also reserved quite early but the odd one is usually available at the far ends of the resort.  Not so great when stuck beside smokers. Property claims to be 100% smoke free, but its hard to regulate. We love swimming in the ocean, but the surf on this side of Cancun is quite rough and can be dangerous for younger children.  We didn't swim at all and didn't spend as much time on the beach as we wanted.  When we were there, Louis managed to always find us at the farthest ends of the beach to make sure we were well hydrated. 

Baby & Kids Club - 5/5
Our 3 yr old daughter loved it here. Even our infant son enjoyed the baby room with its baby toys and nursery style play room. 
The space is big and the staff are so attentive and friendly making the kids time there even more enjoyable. Our kids were especially close to Alma and Adriana who were amazing with them.  

Service - 5/5
Service is excellent and everyone we met genuinely made sure we were well taken care of and enjoying our stay. 

Overall, Solid 4 stars. Service was great, amenities are great. Food was above average for alacarte and below average for buffet.  Evening entertainment is good. 
Lacked a daytime bar in the lobby. Opens around 3 or 4pm. 
We had a fun and relaxing week but, will probably not return. Finest Resorts in Playa Mujeres set the bar too high for our expectations.

reviews.author: Brooke H
reviews.title: Amazing!!!!
reviews.text: I had the most wonderful time at paradisus resort. I'm already planning my next trip and it has only been 7 months since I have been home. Cancun is my happy place. Thanks to paradisus....I had the most unforgettable experience. Food was good... drinks were great and the ocean view room was to die for. U must see for yourself.

reviews.author: Megan W
reviews.title: Paradise at the Paradisus
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful, clean and has so many great amenities.  I would go back in a heartbeat.  The food was so, so good.  Just make sure to make reservations for dinner the night before.  We went with out two year old and she had a great time and the resort was very accommodating to families and kids.

reviews.author: Alison H
reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text:
The service was wonderful here, just steps to the beach and excellent table service on the beach! Our favorite waiter in the huge buffet was Pascual, he was so friendly and remembered everything that we liked!! The bartenders in the Toji bar were wonderful also, we made a point to go there every night just because of them. All in all we felt very pampered.
The only things that would stop me from returning was the amount of small children at the resort. Although they were cute, there were a lot of unhappy kids and that made it uncomfortable. The music on the beach was redundant and booming all day, that got to us after a while also.

reviews.author: jenniferkS436XH
reviews.title: Royal Service was a dream!
reviews.text: My husband and I wanted a week away of downtime and relaxation to unplug and re-charge and the Paradisus Cancun, Royal Service allowed us to do just that! We upgraded our room to Royal Service Lagoon View only a week before we left and I was so thankful we did. The resort is beautiful and the atmosphere is really great. There isn't a ton to do at night which would be the only downside. Erik was our butler through the Royal Service and he was absolutely incredible and truly made the experience. He was thoughtful, polite and helpful. On our last day after hearing me mention I wanted to purchase some Vanilla, he gave me some before we left! It made my day! I have never ever had better service than we received at the Paradisus. The Bali bed service and LaPalapa restaurants were incredible. Moses, Carlos, Caesar, Jose and all of the servers were amazing and went above and beyond to make each day great!

reviews.author: Tim Miller
reviews.title: Paradisus is Perfecto!
reviews.text: Beautiful resort property. The facilities are well maintained. Excellent customer service demonstrated by a willingness on the part of all staff members to respond to the customer's needs. 9 restaurants with a diverse variety of meal selections. The breakfast buffet is top notch. We also enjoyed the daily activities that were provided for guests. We participated in pool-side Zumba classes and daily water aerobics. Yugo, Andrea, Victor, Mirabella, Jose, Carlos, and Ernesto provided excellent service and helped to make our stay truly memorable. Gracios!

reviews.author: lloyd s
reviews.title: Great Hotel - Royal Service FANTASTIC
reviews.text: Spent a few days enjoying the Paradisus Cancun.  Large hotel with a small feel. This hotel offers the best of three worlds. If you want a Family experience they have a spot for you, If you want a Spring Break experience - that's their too.  For me the Adults only Royal service was just what I wanted.  Separate from the rest of the hotel - Great pool, Great Beach, Fantastic food and really ROYAL service.  The restaurant at the Royal Service pool is by far the best food in the hotel.  A great time and a great value

reviews.author: crokriguez
reviews.title: Pleasantly satisfied!
reviews.text: I stayed at this resort for a conference and I was pleasantly satisfied with my whole experience! It was fantastic! I would easily stay here again! The staff, property, amenities, food, and spa were delightful! I've stayed at many all inclusive properties and this one was great!

reviews.author: Madddd123
reviews.title: Woooooww!!
reviews.text:
We stayed here for 6 nights and absolutely loved every minute of it!
ROOM -
We were originally in pyramid 3 level 1 directly above the Enso restaurant and all we could here was cutlery clattering. I called the front desk and they said they could move us to pyramid 4 level 3 but unfortunately not until the next night. We packed our stuff up the nect morning but unfortunately couldn't check into our new room until 3pm which was a bit of a bummer. The new room was superb. It was above the spa and was so so quiet! Very clean and modern and the bed was comfy. Only wish the pillows weren't small square ones and were a bit more comfier. Ocean view was fabulous and we could watch the sun rise from our balcony. We were all inclusive so our minibar was restocked daily which was lovely. Waterfall shower was awesome!

FOOD-
We booked dinner about 7:30am the morning before and didn't have an issue. You can't get in anywhere if you try and book day of even though there are seats in the restaurants.
Market Grill - this was by far our favourite, we ate here twice. It is like an all you can eat meat restaurant. Waiters come around with meat on skillets and offer it to you as well as sides such as corn, tomatoes, mashed potatoes, asparagus. The Brazilian steak was amazing!
Enso - this was their Asian restaurant and was quite nice. We both enjoyed their wok meals which you choose which meat and sauce you'd like.
Vento - tapas. Was really really lovely. I know tapas are small plates which are shared but to me they were too small. The lovely waiter warned us and told us how many plates a person usually consumed. Upon finding out that neither my partner or I at fish he talked to the chef who was more than happy to cook a chicken or steak meal for us but we were able to find choices on their standard menu!
Blue Agave - Mexican. Not very authentic but I guess it is very touristy. We enjoyed their tacos and quesadillas deciding to order a couple of each different meat and sharing them. You get given tortilla chips with salsa, guac and picco de gallo and they were so delicious! I would've been more than happy to have that as my meal.
Buffet - buffet breakfast was okay especially their egg station but it does get busy. I have no idea what cheese they use but it tastes a bit old.. otherwise you do have lots of variety.
