We had buffet dinner one night and I was not too fussed about it. I found the food to be a little on the cold side and much preferred the restaurants.

HOTEL - 
Hotel was gorgeous. Loved how they had restaurants inside. They're doing a lot of fixing at the moment. We never went a day without seeing someone doing something. It was mainly plasterers fixing cracks and lots of painting just to keep the hotel looking superb.
Nightly entertainment was good. All acts were definitely entertaining and a good way to end the day.
Volleyball with Benji was a downright hoot! He taught you how to hit it properly and although we started with 3 of us and him others ended up coming along and we had a great game of volleyball.
I believe they charge $80 a day for a cabana - we never rented one although they looked gorgeous. They may want to consider doing something, especially in down season, to increase their renting number as we only seen one rented the entire time.

TIPPING - 
Coming from Australia we don't tip so we found it difficult knowing the correct time to. Not sure if we ever done it right but we did tip in Pesos when someone got us our drink and to our waiter at the end of the night.

I am so upset this hotel is so far from home because I would come back in a heartbeat!
Thanks for an amazing time!!!

reviews.author: sylvs89
reviews.title: Solid 4 star
reviews.text:
Pros:
Service-The service at this hotel is incredible. I was very please. They could use a few more servers at the pool. 
Pool-fantastic
Kids club-awesome
Food-enjoyed the food
Tempo-must do!!!

Cons:
Hard to get a drink in the main building during the day and early evening
We had a baby and the room was loud from the entertainment below. And it was loud...
No quiet evening entertainment place. Having a spot to sit and watch the live singing that happens in the centre in the evening would make this place so much better. We ended up dragging chairs to the centre just to have a place to go that wasn't too loud for baby, or we would go to our room because we had no where to go. 
Hard to see entertainment show. Why not do it in the conference room?
Not enough seats around pool with nice view. It was disappointing to have to be fighting for chairs when they had all those open cabanas that no one wanted to rent. Get rid of them and have more chairs for guests. 

Overall we enjoyed this resort. I would consider going back again if they solved the evening entertainment issues.

reviews.author: salt-life
reviews.title: Amazing hotel --- Royal Service recommended
reviews.text: You can't go wrong with this hotel, it is simpy stunning. All employees are as polite as can be and always smiling. We upgraded to Royal Service and have to say Antonio was incredible. He took great care of us and his recommendations for restaurants were perfect. Shout out to all the guys in the pool area ... Bali beds were fabulous !  Service from Cesar and the rest of the guys was amazing. Room was incredible and exceptional service all the way around .... We will be back !

reviews.author: Peter G
reviews.title: Family Getaway to Somewhere Warm
reviews.text: This was our first vacation to Cancun. The hotel was nice, lots of great amenities. Our Butler from family Concierge Alex was fantastic and attended to all of our requests. Lovely vacation! We will likely be back in the future.

reviews.author: Steven Braden
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancún, a great getaway in the middle of the winter.
reviews.text:
We have been to three different Paradisus properties, and the staff continue to out do themselves with personal service, and making you feel special.
The restaurant choices being all-inclusive, or excellent.

reviews.author: chrisW0727
reviews.title: January 20-28 2017 Paradisus Royal Service Cancun
reviews.text: Go with royal service all the way, great trip , for a couple in the young 30's we had a great time, no need to ever leave the resort, food is great, bars are great, drinks are top notch, couldnt ask for anything else!!!!

reviews.author: Meghan O
reviews.title: Awesome!!!!
reviews.text: Loved everything about this place! Put it this way....we did not even miss our own bed! The employees were extremely accommodating and the resort was very clean. We were in the adults only section and loved it. Don't think I would bring my kids to stay in the other part of the resort, didn't seem to have much for the kids to do.

reviews.author: Steve S
reviews.title: Winter getaway
reviews.text:
My wife and myself went for 7 nights starting February 20th.
We found the experience excellent . The food was better than we expected for an all inclusive as we are not huge fans of all inclusive food. The beach and pool areas were kept clean. We had great service at both areas. The service in the restaurants were above expectations especially in the Naos where Kauil our waiter everyday was super.
We were amazed at how hard the entire staff worked and still be so gracious!!
Steve

reviews.author: wareagle2013
reviews.title: Great Food and Service
reviews.text:
For an All Inclusive Resort the food and service was excellent. 
Daniel, Eddie, Juan and Cesar all went above and beyond to make sure all our needs were met. 
Excellent Staff!  We will return to the Paradisus.

reviews.author: Raj K
reviews.title: Great stay at a great property
reviews.text:
We stayed here celebrating my daughter's birthday.  As soon as we checked into the room, we were greeted with welcome drinks, in the room we had a special birthday cake and balloons for my daughter.  The kids were super excited.

The pool area was superb.  Service was good, not incredible as I have experienced at some other resorts. Overall it was a great experience for all.  We loved the variety and the quality of entertainment.  We took Ceviche making lessons, Mixology class, zumba by the pool and some water aerobics classes.  Kids were also kept busy with activities and play rooms for them.  

The only negative I have for the resort was that the beach was covered with sea weed and we could not get in the ocean at all due the amound of sea weed.   I am not sure if it was over all the entire cancun thing or just the location of the this resort.

We had a good time and would consider returning if we are in the Cancun area.

reviews.author: Charlie C
reviews.title: My wife and I have been here 3 times now and we love it!!!!
reviews.text: Resort is one of the cleanest we've stayed in. Great food selections in all restaurants. Outstanding staff all the way around. Friendly, Polite and Courteous!!! My wife and I were pampered all week by this amazing staff. However, we would both like to say that there were 3 primary staff members that just amazed us all week long. Special thanks to Jorge, Alexander and Pedro. These 3 gentlemen were just incredible and make deciding to go back again a "No Brainer" decision for my wife and I.

reviews.author: ReignOfLegend
reviews.title: Overall great experience but some small tweaks required
reviews.text:
We've just come back from a 5 night stay at this hotel and overall we had a great time. We would definitely recommend this hotel to friends and family but there are a few things we think would improve the experience for others.

Pros

1. The hotel and the location are beautiful. The hotel itself is right on the beach with crystal clear water and white sand. We couldn't have asked for a better location. The hotel is very clean and it's obvious that the staff go to great lengths to maintain a certain standard.

2. There are several different restaurants to choose from and we never had any issues with making a reservation. The quality of the food is good and the Market Grill (Brazilian cuisine) was our personal favourite.

3. We booked the family concierge package which came with a personal butler. Ours was called Keyra and she was fantastic. Keyra handled all of our restaurant bookings and often left nice gifts (cheese boards, chocolate strawberries, puppets for the children) in our room. Any queries or issues we had were handled efficiently and we couldn't recommend this service enough to anyone with children.

4. Entertainment was of a high standard both for adults and children. The kids club was very good and both Adriana and Alma went to great lengths to make sure our children had a fun time. Activities included arts and crafts, pirate parties and an excellent magic show. The children even received gifts on their last day.

Cons

1. Whilst the staff are very friendly and efficient, you do definitely notice a difference in service if you don't tip. Coming from Europe where you don't typically tip in an all-inclusive resort, this was an adjustment but one we happily made. The difference was most evident in the restaurants.

2. On our first night, we were given a room that obviously had a damp problem. We complained to the family concierge who informed us that the resort was full and that a room would free up the next night. I then had to ask to be compensated for the night that we would spend in the damp room. After a few calls, this was agreed to. However, in my experience of other 5 star establishments, I don't feel that I should have had to ask for this rather it should have immediately been offered by management. In the end, we were given a new room the next day and we were much happier. 

3. We had a junior suite which was a little smaller than expected. For those with children, I would recommend a one-bedroom suite.

4. The pools are very nice and well maintained. There are sun beds available by the pools as well as a selection of cabanas. The sun beds are free but disappear very quickly. The cabanas range from $50 - $100 per day. Having paid quite a lot to stay at the resort, we were dismayed when we were told we would have to pay extra to use the cabanas especially as the majority of them lay empty during our stay. We were given free use of a cabana for one day as a result of our earlier room issues but it would be nice if guests were given 1 or 2 free nights as part of their stay.

Like I said, overall a great experience but a few small things could make this an even better resort.

reviews.author: frankigos2HOLLYWOOD
reviews.title: Spring break 2016
reviews.text: Great sand and ocean, enjoyed the sand and ocean, and the sand and ocean was very good, we really enjoyed the sand and ocean, you will be really impressed with the sand and ocean,  and the sand and ocean are really nice.

reviews.author: YardDoctor
reviews.title: Exceeded expectations!
reviews.text: I'm one who is very aware of cleanliness and good design......I give Paradisus high marks on both counts. The property is sweeky clean. Additionally the staff was superb. Without exception every person on staff that I incountered was genuinely polite and helpful. I recommend requesting a room away from the main biulding because the entertainment lounge is LOUD! Bottom line is the Paradius is an extremely well maintained and well staffed resort.

reviews.author: brianlU3384VJ
reviews.title: Great Place
reviews.text: I have been to a bunch of similar resorts.  This one has been the best.  Rooms were good.  Food was good.  Sushi was similar to what we get back home.  Beach service (the biggest one for me) was on point.  Service was always top notch.  We did the Royal upgrade but just dont love to be pampered but the rooms and royal area are VERY quiet so it might be worth it on that level alone.  Bottom line well worth the $$$ and I will return.

reviews.author: Mohanarangan
reviews.title: Wedding Anniversay
reviews.text:
One of the excellent property, well planned and maintaining Cancun. We stayed in Royal service pyramid number 5. It has its own unique restaurant La Palapa and Bali cottage for Royal service guests. We dined in Vento, Market Place and Naos. The food was excellent and service was of high standard.
 We really enjoyed our stay. We will defiantly come back to this resort.

reviews.author: Lynn M
reviews.title: Beautiful but not 5 stars
reviews.text: My overall impression of this resort is beautiful and well kept but not 5 stars. The staff is very friendly and there was always someone there when you needed something and they aren't "in your face". Our room was large and spotless. There was a nice variety of food in the restaurants. However, there were enough little annoyances that made me give the resort only 3 stars. Our room in pyramid three was very humid which I assume is because it was on the ground floor. Our clothes, the bedding and the towels always felt slightly damp. The hair dryer only worked on low. Several of the nights we spent there, we had no washcloths. The food was ok but nothing special. The one exception was the Japanese restaurant, Bana. It was excellent and we had a lot of fun trying all the different kinds of sushi. The pools are clean and attractive and the beach of course is awesome. However, there were too many cabanas that you had to reserve and not enough regular lounge chairs. It's kind of disappointing when you just want to sit in the sun and there are no chairs. We had a wonderful time because we wanted to get away and spend time together. But unfortunately I would not go back to this resort.

reviews.author: Sdccowen
reviews.title: Never mind your blow drier...bring your own robe if going to the spa bc one size does not fit all
reviews.text: If you have never been to an all inclusive, you would probably give this place a 5 but we have been to all inclusives in Riviera Maya, Cabo San Lucas and Puerto Vallarta before that far exceed this place. The hotel is huge (really too big)! The breakfast and lunch buffets both inside (Naos and Bana) and out were both cold (sausage, French fries, hot dog, pizza, etc.)...there were very few things at breakfast or lunch that I would consider good bc most was cold. By the time we left , I longed for a hot meal. We did have a good dinner at Vento (tapas) but they brought out things so fast that you couldn't enjoy the experience of trying new stuff. The same at Enso and the Market Street Grille. The rooms and bathrooms are ok (standard room) but we have had bigger/better/nicer elsewhere. They have huge balconies on the rooms but nothing else on them (no chairs or tables; you have to ask for chairs). The spa is ok. Again we have been to nicer ones. Not all the jets work in the spa pool. The room with the couples spa pool is not very appealing (black walls and panes above beds with either paint or bird poop on them). The robes at the spa are small. I put on mine and thought that, having been to other spas were you normally have to roll up the sleeves. The men's robes were REALLY small for the average American male. You have to make reservations to eat at most places but you cannot do it more than 1 day in advance and before 11 am. Their computer system cannot accommodate earlier and if you wait until after 11 am the day before, you are unlikely to get into most places. The ocean was rough. The pool on the right is not heated and if you want a drink before 11 am at the pool you have to go get it yourself. If you like sushi/sashimi you probably will like Bana. I did not, the wait staff there at dinner was the most friendly and funny!!! The red lounge (disco) is awesome if for no other reason then to people watch!! They played great music!! We watched part of a show in the Avenue Bar...could not see well...for a place this big they show have a big enough area to have chairs out front so all could see. It rained the day before we left and many rooms, hallways and stairways had towels thrown on them that were still there the next day.

reviews.author: hcmcb210
reviews.title: Fun, Fun, Fun
reviews.text: The service was great, for and drinks were awesome. The room was good for the price. Could use a little updating, but I would love to go back!! The hotel staff was spectacular. We were treated like royalty. The food was pretty good. The restaurant Agave had amazing quesadillas. The pool bartender, Salvador, made our trip. He was so much fun!!!

reviews.author: swimupbarlover
reviews.title: Truly Paridise!
reviews.text: My husband and I traveled with our daughters and husbands who are in their 20's. From the moment we stepped onto the property we were treated like royalty. The resort is classy, but not overly fancy. We have gone to many all-inclusive resorts and this is by far the best one ever! The service was unbelievable, and all the food was delicious. Our room was on the lagoon side and was very quiet. Our daughter had an ocean view room and it was gorgeous, but noisier at night. We have a few picky eaters in our group and they were also amazed by the quality and the choices of the food. I just can't say enough about this place, we will definitely be making a return trip! We also loved that we had a choice of cerveza's and were able to get them in a can at the bar!! Even though tipping is included, we tipped the staff, they work so hard,deserve it, and are so appreciative. Free Wi-Fi was an unexpected perk! I cannot think of one negative thing to mention! Truly Paradise!

reviews.author: Ben L
reviews.title: Another Great Vacation at Paradisus "Paradise"
reviews.text: Everything about this place is wonderful!  First and foremost is the service and the people providing the service...Jorge, Josue, Wilbert, Valleria, Octavio, Daniel and the two butlers that always made sure we were comfortable Sergio and Juan!    Spending time in the balinesas along the beach was our favorite activity! There are many restaurants on the property and they are all very good!  We spend 9 days and never left the property!  Thank you all and thank you Mr. Lazaro, the Royal Service Manager, for the excellent staff you have  serving us and for making our vacation "Outstanding" again!   Ben and Tricia Lopez

reviews.author: Stephen Lee B
reviews.title: Great Time with the Royal Service!
reviews.text: We really enjoyed the Royal Service! Never stayed as a regular guest, so really have no way to compare. With Royal Service you could get a beach or poolside cabana for 2 days per room. It was a great experience!

reviews.author: Amara B
reviews.title: Entertainment
reviews.text: Hugo, Freddy, Fernando, chancho, uziel, and Rodrigo are GREAT! The activities are super fun and they get people excited for them. LOVE THE ENTERTAINMENT BOYS ;) :)The food is good, lots of different choices. The beach is beautiful and warm.

reviews.author: dicklo
reviews.title: Fabulous resort
reviews.text:
Staff was excellent. Alexander the pool concierge was exceptional.
Food was very good, nice variety.
Property and pools were well maintained, with a very large beach area. The resort is large enough that it never felt crowded

reviews.author: Larry D
reviews.title: Excellent winter getaway
reviews.text: Definitely recommend Paradisus Cancun.  Staff are very friendly and attentive.  Room is comfortable with great view of the Caribbean.  Food, drinks, and entertainment were first rate.  Wednesday evening seafood buffet was awesome as were the endless margaritas.  Beach and pools are clean and beautiful.  We will be returning.

reviews.author: James l
reviews.title: An English review
reviews.text:
If your into faceless hotels with no continuity of staff or service then this is for you. The ocean view junior suite with club room benefits is a Virgin holidays upgrade and  only worth it for the service on the beach and the room. Be aware that because of your different band it allows a constant sell by Club Melia reps to target you every day. We were targeted the moment we checked in by a Club Melia rep who while giving us information about the hotel (made it over complicated about moving around the hotel) wanted us to sign up to a Club Melia upgrade over a hard sell breakfast of 90 minutes which we avoided. You are then targeted throughout your holiday by reps looking to upgrade you. 

Ok the hotel is pretty impressive but is too big to have any atmosphere. Trying to book your restaurant for your evening meal is impossible for the same evening ( even thou you see empty tables ). The food for the masses restaurants where you don't have to book is rubbish and mostly cold. Even the Blue Agave Mexican restaurant is hit and miss especially with drinks and service. The Market grill is novel  but food not up to five star quality. 

The pools are cold as well as the jacuzzi even in the Royal service area ( the sea is warmer). To sum up, the hotel is showing its age and leaks everywhere when it rains. Hit and miss service and not 5 star quality food.

reviews.author: Jeremy R
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text: Me and my girlfriend came down between February 13 to the 17th it was amazing first thing before I forget there was a DJ in the red lounge I believe it was the Monday we where there that DJ was amazing the waiters where very helpful the best restaurant in the hotel was blue gava I probably spelt that wrong but hopefully you understand the environment was awesome me and my girl had lots of fun only probably was not all the food was good but that's not a big deal most potatoes they made tasted old and they where dry only potatoes we liked where the mashed potatoes but that's minor people so no worries and for the people who are complaining about how big the hotel is do your research before you go yes it was big me and my girlfriend got lost at first but we got the hang of it after a day and they had amazing entertainment so great experience and I hope to return one day. I lost my sun glasses there hopefully a manager reads this and can look into this for me if not no worries

reviews.author: Meander312403
reviews.title: Review
reviews.text: Overall, the place is beautiful and perfect for couples and their families. The Jacuzzi, I think, on the room on top of my room was so loud. The humming was loud that I have to look around where that came from. I have difficulty sleeping with the humming going on for hours.

reviews.author: mlbergamo
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun Resort
reviews.text: This resort was absolutely beautiful!   Very nice accomodations. Room was spacious, clean, comfortable. The grounds well cared for, but the inside , I kept snapping pictures because the unique decor was like a tropical garden.  Friendly staff, many restaurant choices, provifing delicious and novel menus. We highly recommend Paradisus  we go for the beach and it was one of the prettiest we've been to. Check it out!

reviews.author: SILVIA G
reviews.title: The grounds are beautiful!! BUT....
reviews.text:
The room was not up to par for the price. The sofa in our room had large stains. I found a contact in my outdoor hot tub.  The furniture on the balcony was cheap & plastic. The room decor was not layed out well. 

The restaurants were inflexible when seating larger parties. We were there for a wedding and our groups were large and they were unwilling to sit us all together or add more people. 

You have to pay for the beds by the pools something that is standard in most other resorts.

reviews.author: DaveSC_7
reviews.title: Cancun vacation
reviews.text:
We stayed at paradises Royal service, comparing it with the paradises ponta Cana and Costa Rica was a little bit disappointing.
we arrived at 8.30 at night they checked us in without giving us a tour of the hotel and what we could expect from the Royal service also offered us water in champagne glass instead of a refreshing cocktail (seriously).
Our Butler didn't do much at all accept making restaurant reservation which we could have done it through the Royal service personnel ourselves, he did not offer us any suggestion as far as hotel amenities concern, for example we didn't know on Wednesday there was a sea food buffet or there is facility cross the street from the hotel that we could use for water sport activity and so on, he was a nice guy but obviously he wasn't trained that well.we still tipped him$100 for each couple because we know that without the tips they can't make a living with $5 a day. Royal service itself and all the staff from house keeping to the server and the cooks were fantastic and absolutely first-class worker.
our favorite was Alexandra he was at the Royal service bar at night and server at Royal service restaurant by the pool,also Valeria was amazing lady who served us lunch  every day at the Royal service restaurant.
The only restaurant for Royal service was opened for breakfast and lunch only and is located by the pool area, without a question that was the best eating place in  the entire resort, we tried all the restaurant for dinner, Brazilian restaurant was a joke all the meat was tuff, Thai restaurant was beautiful but food and service was awful, Mexican restaurant was better than the others with very limited menu and no traditional Mexican food, i must say I have been in restaurant business for 30 years and I know about food and service , in general they can improve  their restaurants and foods, I can't believe you couldn't find a fish taco or plenty of fish dishes in any of their restaurants.
Spa facility was great Angel at the reception was very helpful , Ana was my message therapist she was great and my wife had Lulu for therapist and she loved it. We also played golf 3 times and it was nicely maintained
Royal service beach is great but the ocean is always Rugh and it's not a snorkeling beach .

This is my suggestion for the management.

1- when your Royal service guest arriving treat them like royalty and have knowledgeable staff to greet them and show them around .
2-Royal service concierge should be smiling , happy and helpfull.
3-you should have one restaurant for Royal service guest for dinner time.
4- improve the quality of the food on all restaurants and have more seafood in all menus.
5-give more Training to Royal  service butler so they can service the  guests better.

reviews.author: jfbf2015
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text: Would have given an excellent rating except for a few areas that need addressing--for whatever reason the used bath towels in our room were taken to be laundered but not  replenished. Also, it might help to control the number of beach towels given to any one guest so that there might be access  to a towel everyone. I don't think it be too much to ask your guest to return their towels to the towel hut when they are leaving, so that you can tell what lounges are  available. I would recommend that you get to the beach or pool area early in the day.  Other  than those glitches, the food and drink are plentiful and the staff is outstanding!

reviews.author: Consuelo L
reviews.title: Amazing Family Trip!!!
reviews.text: From the moment that I made my reservation with Pilar Alvarez, I knew I will have a great vacation. Since the moment that we check in everyone was very professional and courteous. Francis, Sheila, Jacqueline, Marisol, Michelle and Luciana did an amazing job at the Kids Zone. The food was excellent, the waiters were very professional and attentive (Kauil, at the Market Grill  went above and beyond). Claudia Arriola, Fernanda and Carolina (From marketing) did an excellent job. If you are looking for a great, excellent and an amazing vacation, don't hesitate and stay at Paradisus Cancun, you will never regret it.  I cant wait for my next trip to Paradisus Cancun!!!! Great Job!!!!!

reviews.author: sjp6790
reviews.title: Beautiful place - subpar service
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful, walking in is like walking into a tropical rainforest. The decor and layout are amazing in the lobby and all of the restuarants. Of the restaurants we visited the best was Ibana, which is located right in the center of the hotel. The restaurant we liked least was Enso, the place is located outside and has a lot of potential, but the food was just ehh and the decor/general feeling was just blah. The buffets for breakfast/lunch were nothing special, your standard all inclusive menus, but the service was just... off. No one working there seemed happy to be there and were not helpful. When we checked in they talked us into upgrading to an ocean view for an extra cost (highly reccomend, the view is worth it). They promised our room would be ready well before 3pm. It of course wasn't and they promised they had given us a $50USD credit to our room (get it in writing because later we found out it had not been added!!). Our new room was located on the third floor of pyramid 3 (the main pyramid). DO NOT STAY PYRAMID 3. Our room was located directly above the resorts 'night club' and all night and into the early morning it felt like we were in a sub-woofer, our complaints were only met with apologies and they said they couldnt move us without giving us a lagoon view room (obviously didnt say they would give us our money back for upgrading). Every morning we woke up to dishing clinking and plates dropping as they prepared for the breakfast buffet. Stay in a different pyramid. The beach and pool are beautiful, the service in those parts depends if you're lucky or not because some people were great and other people were horrible (no in between). Our last day we splurged and wanted to get one of the Bali Beds on the beach. The beds are like a cabana and include a lobster lunch and bottle of champagne or other type of alcohol you choose. This is where we were going to use our $50 room credit. The Bali Bed manager spoke only a little english and after waiting 30 minutes outside in limbo they brought out a manager from the front desk that told us we can have the second tier bed (there are three tier depending on the location closest to the water) for free but no lobster lunch or bottle. We countered that we were willing to pay for the first tier bed ($163USD) just with our $50 credit that was promised to us- argued that for awhile back and forth and finally they gave in. It's a nice place, but vacation shouldn't be so much stress.

reviews.author: CathyMom180
reviews.title: Great family vacation at Paradisus Cancun in Family Concierge
reviews.text:
Just returned from our first family trip to Paradisus Cancun (and to Mexico in general) Feb 13-20 and absolutely loved it there.  It's not perfect, and it is an older resort, but hotel itself was incredibly clean, the beach so beautiful and fun, and the service impeccable.  We had a Family Concierge Ocean View suite, and it was exactly what we needed.   I highly recommend the Concierge suites; the service and pampering are worth the extra money.

Please note that this is a middle aged mother of 2 school aged kids (11 and 8) writing this review, so this is ENTIRELY about the family experience; the ultimate goal for me was making my life as stress-free and quiet and relaxing as possible.  So if you are a young couple or traveling without kids and looking for a lot of nightlife and partying, don't read this review.  It will not help you at all. I think this is the problem some users of this site have; it is not beneficial to read reviews of people who have completely different travel entourages and expectations.  That is not to say that you will not find this resort enjoyable without a family; I saw many honeymooning and older couples having a great time.  This is just to say that as a family of 4, our goals for vacation are quite different from others, and this resort met or surpassed our goals.

So first the cons, as no hotel is perfect.  There are not too many but some you should be aware of:
1.  None of the ice-makers worked in our building (4).  A small annoying thing.  We would have to call room service for ice every day, and they brought it promptly and with a smile, but still, I personally like to be able to pop down the hall for ice anytime.  Hopefully this will be fixed.  
2.  There are very few outlets in the rooms, and many did not work well.  This is a function of it being an older resort.  Thankfully, I had experienced this in older resorts and brought a power-strip with me.  Yes, my husband made fun of me, but boy, he was grateful in the end.  With all our iPhones and iPads and the kids' Nintendo DSs and DVD players, we needed a lot of outlets for charging.  Bring a power strip if you have as much technology as we have.
3.  Internet is very slow.  I have come to expect this in the Caribbean resorts, where there is probably no space or depth to bury large cables.  It was a huge resort, and there was a big conference going on, so I'm sure the broadband was maxed out.  It worked fine, but was just slow.  Count to 10 between taps/clicks.
4.  Check out is very slow.  They do not prepare your bill or charges before you check out.  So we had to sit there while they went through and double checked every extra charge.  I guess we Americans just expect that itemized bill ready to go the morning of check out.  Not so here or in Mexico in general.  Next time, I am going to ask the front to tally up our bill the night before.

That's it for the negatives.  For the pros, I could go on and on...
1. Service was stellar, and for me, this is THE most important thing at a resort.  At home, I am the one running around getting things for my husband and kids.  On vacation, I want to be waited on hand and foot, and at the Paradisus, you will have that in spades.  Gabriel, our Family Concierge, and his co-workers in the Family Concierge Lounge were great (Ramon notable as well, and so sorry I can't remember anyone else).  Gabriel was always accessible, and constantly checking in, and took care of all the restaurant reservations and our excursion to the indoor Aquarium.  He did a fantastic job.  The pool service waiters were fantastic as well, specifically Victor who was incredibly attentive, and served always with a smile for 6 straight days.  He brought me my champagne and my son's favorite grape juice without our even having to ask.  My son actually said he missed Victor on his day off on Friday.  Fortunately, Sergio who took his place was equally as great.  Our family opted to rent a Bali bed every day ($50 by the kids' pool) because I'm not one for getting up early to grab chairs, but there didn't seem to be too much trouble getting chairs/umbrellas, as long as you got out there before 8 am.  Was harder later in the week when the conference arrived, but if you can't find anything, I suggest just renting a Bali bed.  They're great.  I'm just lazy.  Thank you, Alexander, for securing us the bed trouble-free for the week.
2.  Restaurants were mostly great.  For dinner, our favorites were Fuego, Mole, Market Grill and Blue Agave.  And my kids loved the Naos buffet.  Every night before the buffet closed before dinner at 5, we would grab the kids dinner (or get room service), and then they would have dessert with us in one of the fine restaurants later (they're picky eaters, so it's great they could eat what they wanted, and be happy while we adults at our dinner in peace).  Lunch we had at the Pool Sunset Grill, nothing fancy, hot dogs and nachos, but that was fine, and Victor frequently brought the food right to us by the pool.  And buffet breakfast was always great.  And a few times we ordered breakfast room service (no extra charge) which was also wonderful.  Loved that room service 24 hrs.  If you are not an early riser, the buffet breakfast gets quite crowded, so I would recommend room service breakfast.  Less choices, but no crowds.  Bana is OK but not for those who are real sushi snobs.  Enso has good curry but we were not a fan of their other dishes. But the Blue Agave tacos I could eat every day until I die.  With some of their special tequila.  The Market Grill Brazilian meats and Mole's lobster and steak were heaven on earth for my husband.
3.  The pool and beach were not crowded at all.  I thought at first the hotel wasn't full because the pool was so open, but it clearly was full, once you saw the restaurants and night clubs filling up.  I think the pool is so enormous and well spaced, it doesn't feel crowded.  
4.  The ocean was so fun.  Yes, the waves were rough most days, and I was anxious about my young son, but both kids just LOVED body surfing and dodging the huge waves.  It was their favorite part, the surf. 
5.  Room and common areas impeccably clean. Housekeeping was excellent.  They came twice a day.  They came at the time we requested.  I was amazed how they kept all the marble floors and glass so clean in the entire hotel.  Especially with us tracking in all that sand.  
6.  Family Concierge check in and getting the room were quick and efficient and smooth.  This made up for the slower check out, but again, I think this can be alleviated by asking the night before.

Here are my tips:
Tip the staff often.  A little goes a long way, and the staff really appreciate a little here and there.  I know all-inclusive implies you pay nothing, but I really think tips are a MUST.   I think $2-4 per person for the waiters (who were ALL great, especially at Market Grill with the meat carving, so sorry I can't remember your names!) and similar for the pool waiters, and $5 or so a day for the maids, is not at all extravagant, and it is truly appreciated, and good will is returned in kind.

Room Service is quite efficient and free and 24 hours.  Great for if you are feeling lazy and not wanting to dress up for dinner.

Family Concierge (or Royal Service for adults with no kids) is the way to go.  The concierge/butler eliminates the hassles of planning and stressing about reservations for dinner, and provides a lot of perks for your room.  I had a sense that the non-concierge guests were a bit frustrated with getting restaurant reservations and planning excursions.  

Get umbrella/beach chair early.  You can't leave a towel and hat there forever, and there are signs saying that they will remove them in 30 minutes, but typically people will leave your stuff alone for about an hour, so you have time to run to breakfast and back to your chair.  Best if you have an early-riser family member to just camp out there.  Or rent a Bali Bed, as we did.  No shortage, but they are a bit pricey.  Again, worth the no-stress for me.  Some people were complaining about the extra cost in the all-inclusive environment, but come on, stop your whining, this is the way life is.

Bring power strip.

Ocean view room totally worth it.  Try to get on a high floor if you are in the Main building (3) or we were in building 4 which the spa, which was very quiet.  I go to bed at 9.  Don't need to near the band and the shows, which can get quite loud in the main building.

As a final endorsement, I have just booked a return trip to the Paradisus Cancun already for February 2017.  Can't wait!

reviews.author: SamanthaKallusky
reviews.title: Our Favourite Yet!
reviews.text: Stay here! Everything is spot on and enjoyable. This was by far our favourite resort we've every stayed at! The food is incredible and doesn't taste like the typical resort style food you always seem get. The a la carts offer dishes you feel like you should be paying extra money for but don't have to. The grounds are gorgeous and the entertainment at night is phenomenal. We couldn't get over the beauty of this place. Thank you Paradissus, for a wonderful week!

reviews.author: E6859HPjohnw
reviews.title: Excellent Service from the Royal Service Section and the Restaurants on property
reviews.text:
Sandra, Sergio, Omar, Alberth, Daniel, and Lazaro all in Royal Service were the keys to such a wonderful experience this year at the Paradisus.  This was our 5th visit to the resort property and we cannot wait till our return next year.  The housekeeping staff too made sure the room was kept properly and arranged for comfort.
Sandra in Royal Service went above and beyond in making sure we got a room like what was originally PAID for AND confirmed by FunJet and The Travel Haus in St. Louis.  FunJet did step up to the plate in assisting us to get back into the Paradisus but I would NEVER use Travel Haus again for any reservation

reviews.author: CathyJ715
reviews.title: We loved our stay at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Our stay was made extra special through the family concierge service, our butler Alvara was excellent, and went above & beyond to ensure we had a pleasant, easy stay. The beach & pools were amazing, beautiful cabana's. Loved the music throughout, Quality of food was great. The only downside was the pool was too cold, but it was an unseasonably cold week (temps in 70's and low 80's) for February. Also, the room was a little tight for a family of four. Beautiful resort, magical place, staff are amazing.

reviews.author: Pfpizz
reviews.title: Great family place!
reviews.text: Had a wonderful time at this resort, the grounds are great but what really impressed me was the service. The people working there take pride in their job and show it! The food is of good quality and restaurants did great accommodating a large group. Can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: Erikos K
reviews.title: Nice stay
reviews.text:
We were at the hotel for six nights. The grounds and facilities of the hotel are all in excellent condition, well maintained and clean as you would expect. We had a room in Pyramid 3 facing the lagoon. It can be noisy durring the day, however it is ok in durring the night time. So if you plan on spending most of the day outside as I would assume most people do on holidays then its ok.

A couple of points which I did not like and I would not expect to find in a hotel like this. First we were a couple in a double room yet there was only one chair on the balcony! No extra inside which you could use outdoors. Secondly the metalic part of the shower hose was broken and you could see all the plastic inside. I know its only a couple minor things, which will not ruin your stay, but at this price range you expect everything to be perfect! It's the little things that make the difference. Appart from this the room is very large and comfortable. 

The staff, service, surounding areas, general cleanliness, and facilities of the hotel are all great and what you would expect at this price range.

reviews.author: Jennifer W
reviews.title: Beautiful property on pristine beach in Cancun!!
reviews.text: Excellent trip at beautiful Melia property. We absolutely loved everything here... We would definitely come back!! The vines hanging all over the hotel were stunning!! Royal service pool / beach cabanas are so cozy... We are planning our next trip to stay in royal service for sure!!

reviews.author: Yasmin A
reviews.title: Absolutely Wonderful!
reviews.text:
We had an amazing trip! Our stay at Paradisus Cancun was fun and relaxing.  We have previously stayed at other Paradisus in Punta Cana and we thought nothing could compare BUT we were in for a wonderful surprise.  We took 5 kids between the ages of 8 and 12.  The Kids Zone was filled with fun activities and the staff was fun, amazing, patient and caring.  Sheila, Marisol, Jacqueline, Michelle, Luciana and Francis enjoy my highest respect for such an amazing job with the kids.  Every time we dropped the kids off they stayed happily and at pick up time they never wanted to leave!
The food at the resort was excellent with a wide variety.  The waiters were very pleasant, professional and attentive especially Kauil at the Market Grill.  
The rooms were kept wonderfully clean.  The beach is amazing... So much to brag about!
We cannot wait until our next trip there!... Great job everyone at Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: Joan M
reviews.title: Another Amazing Vacation!
reviews.text:
I have vacationed at Pardisus for the last several years.  This time I had the good fortune to be able to stay for 2 weeks.  It is a beautiful resort, well maintained and as I say every year, it is the staff at this hotel that makes it the best.  The rooms are big the views are great, the grounds beautiful and the restaurants and food are terrific.  
I would tell you that most hotels accept American dollars but if you big large bills and want to get change they will only give you mexican pesos.  If you want change in American you will need to ask either the bellman or bartenders, who will look at their tip funds and see if they have enough to make change.  So bring plenty of $1 and $5 dollar bills for tips.  If you do not mind having pesos however there will be no problem.  I must mention the following staff who went the extra mile to make my vacation pleasurable.  Big thanks to Emilio and Balan the bartenders at the Bana bar who always remember what you drank, always had a friendly smile for you and went out of their way to make you feel comfortable. Be sure to stop at this bar as it is the best one in the hotel.  To Andres at the coffee bar who was so pleasant and made everyone laugh.  He is very busy but manages to be very efficient in getting everyone served quickly.  To my hostess with the mostest in Naos, Christina, who is a joy and always makes you feel welcome.  To the great waiters Mario and Victor.  Naos has the best staff you could ask for.  And finally to Antonio and Luis the bellman at the front door that were always polite and very helpful.  You all have my gratitude!  I would recommend this hotel highly.  One helpful tip is to try and not have a room near the Red Lounge.  This dance club is open to 2am and plays loud music that may keep you awake!

reviews.author: FrequentFlier311973
reviews.title: Why would anyone ever want to leave Paradisus?!!!
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our accommodations. Building and grounds were pristine.  Caring and professional staff took care of our every need.  Restaurants and food service were top-notch. Be sure to take advantage of the variety of dining options and activities.  We enjoyed the high quality of the entertainment throughout our stay.

reviews.author: Creditgirl
reviews.title: First stay in Mexico
reviews.text: Visited the Paradisus for 10 nights at the beginning of January, we had a lagoon view room in Pyramid 3 but it was almost in Pyramid 4 so far enough away from the central pyramid to be quiet, any room in the central zone will be very noisy. Bonus about a lagoon view room is that it's cheaper and gets the sunsets plus the hotel has such a large frontage that it's set well back from the road.We didn't have an upgraded room but it was large and comfortable. The restaurants offer a variety of cuisine and we enjoyed most of them plus we celebrated our wedding anniversary at the Tempo Restaurant (extra charge) which was really lovely except for the ridiculously high priced wine list, paid £60 for a very average California Sauvignon Blanc, be warned in any of the restaurants if they bring an iPad over for the wine list it will cost you! The staff are very accommodating and helpful, particularly Martin Sanchez in the Market Grill restaurant and all the lads in the Pool Bar.  The hotel is largely visited by Mexican families and Americans, not many Brits, if you don't like being around children then maybe avoid but we didn't find it a problem. The grounds and pool areas are really well kept and the beach is lovely with Bali beds and a DJ on it! My criticism would be that the central atrium in Pyramid 3 is very noisy because the main entertainment bar is open to this area and the acts can be noisy, also this area at night is very dark, I'm all for subtle lighting but there were times I felt I needed a torch! All in all we really enjoyed the hotel and would definitely return.

reviews.author: chicagocj
reviews.title: excellent poolbar staff
reviews.text:
The best bartenders reymundo,eduardo,erick,cristian friendly and fast service everyday id join them for cold drinks at the poolbar around 2pm suns perfect about that time. Cj gracies amigos salud.
I also recommend royal service while staying at the paradisus. Ive been to cancun 9 times and by far was one of best resorts all inclusive ive stay at. Food was great and the room service was just as good, fit for a king and will return.

reviews.author: 732lloydm
reviews.title: Very good staff
reviews.text: Staff very friendly and polite they work very hard to keep you happy!  Good job! We had to be switched to a different room upon arrival as the room we were assigned was right above a restuarant air conditioner and was very loud and hard on the ears. Also I feel the pools should be heated 2 or3 months of the year as even the kids didn't want to go into them! We were at the resort for 10 days.

reviews.author: Jas B
reviews.title: Good hotel
reviews.text:
Went in June with a group of friends, a few highlights to mention are:
Hotel - Huge with several connecting buildings, we stayed in the premium side of the Hotel which was a bit more expensive but you have an added VIP feel but was quite a walk from the main reception and bars. Facilitates are good but the only shame was the weather where it rained half of our stay.
Food & Drink - the VIP area has some additional premium brand liquors available, although most  of the time we spent by the pool or generic bars which had a good selection of drinks so not sure it was worth it. Food was generally good, with the Mexican and Breakfast buffet my preferences.
People - Staff are very helpful and hardworking, tipping helps as always and customer service was 5 stars without doubt. Hotel attracts a mixture of visitors, mainly families/couples although some younger groups too.

reviews.author: sankhasp
reviews.title: Perfect place to be
reviews.text:
Royal service is worth it, you have a butler. There are people like Samantha, Gulimero who will take it up-to them to make sure you have a great time there. Everything about this place is wonderful and worth the money. 
Go there, enjoy your time there and you are destined to come back again and again.

reviews.author: Theresa S
reviews.title: Everything you'd want
reviews.text: 3 girlfriends and I did a 5 night trip here. My first time at an all-inclusive. Enjoyed it very much. The hotel and rooms are clean and nicely decorated. The grounds, including all the plants hanging in the interior, are well cared for. There is a buffet serving all meals. Might be closed for an hour between meals, but not sure. It was always open when we went looking for food. There are another 6 or so specialty restaurants. Make your reservations early if you want to eat there...like a day or two ahead so you get a better seating time. We ate at 3 different ones and really enjoyed all the meals. The servers were extremely friendly and always ready to get you something else. We had some fun bartenders, Emilio and Balan, at the Bana Bar, who made a couple of our evenings very enjoyable. The entertainment staff does various things throughout the day. Zumba in the morning was a good break from all the food and drink. They also put on a nightly show with singing and dancing that lasts about an hour. Talented people!

reviews.author: Mike M
reviews.title: Nice place, but not the best
reviews.text:
This was our first visit to Paradisus in Cancun.   We have previously visited 3 other Paradisus resorts, all in Punta Cana, DR.  The Cancun resort was nice and the service was good.   My wife and I liked the Punta Cana resorts better.   The two main reasons were the food and the resort's layout. 

Mole was not very good, their menu was much too exotic for our tastes.  Bana, the sushi restaurant was so-so (tiny pieces of sushi).  The room service food is terrible.   

But, the food we had in the Paradisus resorts in DR was out of this world. 

The layout of this resort is 5 connected pyramids.   It is very maze like and very easy to get confused.   

It was a nice 5 day trip,but I doubt we'd return to the Paradisus in Cancun. 

Upside is the service was good.   Even though tips are included In the all-inclusive, I think many of the service staff gladly are hoping for tips.

reviews.author: wrdfixer
reviews.title: Still Impressed the Second Time
reviews.text:
We vacationed at the Paradisus Cancun for the second time and would return. We were here 2 years ago the same week and thought the resort was terrific and decided to return this year. The Royal Service upgrade is available to adults and is definitely worth it for the extra attention for priority dinner reservations and the private beach and pool area. It is also a wonderful choice for families who also have a beach and pool area. There are supervised programs for children and the babysitting fees are reasonable compared to other destinations. The resort is immaculate and well tended. The rooms are spacious and nicely decorated. The food in the main buffet as well as the specialty restaurants is always fresh, well prepared and nicely presented. It is actually superior to many of the other all inclusives in the area. The liquor is top shelf for all guests.
The service at the pool and beach is first rate. A special mention to Omar- who provided great service at the pool and beach. The wait staff is well trained, fluent in English and will comply with almost any reasonable request at any meal time. Special mention to Cindy, a waitress in the Royal Service area whose polite and attentive demeanor was a nice touch during breakfast and evening service. The Avenue Bar is well tended by Eddie who is good humored and makes every guest feel welcome. By our third night, he remembered our preferred cocktails and how we like them prepared. The Royal Service Manager Lazaro is respected by his staff which is evident in their training and their ability to make every guest feel welcome and special. Each room is assigned a butler. From our two experiences, there are 2 areas of the Royal Service experience that could be improved. First, the butler service is really useless unless you are assigned a butler who is on duty in the morning to assist with dinner reservations and other incidentals. In our case our butler's schedule dictated that for 5 of the 7 days we were at the resort, he began at either 1PM or 3PM so there wasn't much he could do for us since we were outside at the pool or beach every day. We made our dinner reservations each morning with the desk attendants on duty and they reconfirmed our flights and transfer for us as well. Second, it would be great i there was a restaurant dedicated to Royal Service. Other resorts with an adults only area offer this and many guests we spoke to commented on this.
In conclusion, this is a well run full service all inclusive resort with good food, top shelf liquor and a beautiful beach and pool area. It is only a 20 minute ride from the airport and great value for the quality of the overall experience.

reviews.author: Rich K
reviews.title: Chillin in Cancun
reviews.text: The resort was clean and well attended to. Our lagoon side one bedroom had a tremendous balcony with comfy lounge chairs. Check in and out was painless with a great hospitality room for us to privately shower and change after extending our time at the beach as long as possible. The beach was beautiful with ample chaise lounges and palm umbrellas with tables without the need to scrounge for chairs starting at sunrise and we were there President's week. The food was diverse and plentiful, dinner reservations were simple to get and the liquor was top shelf whereever you sat or swam. The wait staff was attentive and friendly throughout the resort, but my favorites were Orlando at the Naos restaurant who's never ending smile welcomed you as if you were at his home and his efficency was impressive. I think he'll be managing the place before long? Salvador at the main pool bar had my name and usual drink down by day two as i was welcomed each and every time with a hearty hola Mr. Rick and fist bump. Will definitely return to this place...

reviews.author: adrimac83
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text: Loved it, my family and I were very happy with the overall experience at Paradisus Cancun would return. The staff was very friendly I actually didn't know anyone who had stayed at Paradisus but I am happy I chose Paradisus because now I can mention to others what a great resort this is.

reviews.author: Gabriella H
reviews.title: Best Food and Service Ever
reviews.text: From the moment we checked into the (all inclusive) ROYAL SERVICE section of the Paradisus Cancun, our butler GALDINO was amazing from beginning to end, handling all of our restaurant and bali bed reservations. The Royal Service has it's own building (tower 5), it's own pool area with it's own outdoor restaurant (LaPalapa), and lots of bali beds.There is a beautiful indoor lounge (tower 5) with a bar that serves premium coffee, liquor and appetizers that change 3 times daily. We stayed 5 nights and ate at 5 different restaurants. We ate at Market Grill (Brazilian type) with lots of meat, very good. Bana (Asian) sushi, fusion, excellent. Fuego (Peruvian), fish, meat, excellent. Vento (tappas), very good. Mole (Mexican) fish, meat, excellent. All restaurants had great food and excellent service and located in tower 3. Our room was a Jr. Suite and the only complaint is the bathroom, with a tub/shower combo. We are used to a separate shower and tub including double sinks. Perhaps moving up is different. We did have the royal service and will be back soon. FYI, pay with credit card for both to and from with a 50% discount on return. From Airport to Paradisus Cancun $68US with credit card round trip, wanted $102US cash for same trip. Use credit cards as much as possible especially without international fees.

reviews.author: Denise R
reviews.title: A good all-inclusive for families
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun over the February school break. This is a lovely resort with many good qualities and a few detractors. 
The good: In my opinion, for an all-inclusive that must cater to everyone, this resort's food is top-notch. Yes, you need dinner reservations (which are difficult to come by for the first night or two), but the buffet option and the casual Mexican (blue agave) are very good. Service is also very attentive beach-side and in the eateries. Many of the staff go out of their way to be helpful and cheerful. The rooms overlooking the ocean have stunning views and the balcony is a nice respite. The layout is also very convenient. We stayed in the main tower and it was minutes back to our room from almost anywhere-beach, pool, restaurants. The beach chairs and umbrellas were fantastic -- just get there early. There were a lot of "beach beds" that went unused (because you must be a member of a special club -- which apparently doesn't have a lot of members).

The not-so-good: The wifi is awful-it only worked well in our bathroom or just outside our room in the hallway. Sometimes it would work at the pool or beach, but it was spotty and would drop in a nanosecond. The check-in was efficient, but lacking in helpfulness. Luckily a woman with the timeshare people (we later found out) gave us some brochures and helped us make our first dinner reservation, after explaining all that was included with our all-inclusive price. I just wish that it didn't end in an offer to attend a sales pitch. Room cleaning was spotty -- they didn't come until the end of the day, when were back in our room, the first day. Then when they finally cleaned they took all our face towels and wash cloths without replacing any towels at all. When I called for more towels, they brought barely any! It was odd. 
Then there's the constant music which reverberates throughout the lobby and the building. It was a faint background sound, going all the time--even at 7 in the morning! My son was bothered by it (he's 12) particularly when there was a private party by the pool that went late into the night (music from both directions!). 
The beach staff should be firmer with people reserving chairs on the beach - one day a lady near us had put items on chairs that made up at least a third of the available seats on that side of the beach. About 5 people ended up joining her, most at least an hour later. Meanwhile a poor couple nearby was reduced to sitting on their towels on the sand. A staff person questioned the woman, but then did nothing about it.

reviews.author: rzolt
reviews.title: 7th Stay - 7th Heaven
reviews.text:
This was our 7th stay at Paradisus in the past five years.  We discovered Paradisus Cancun about 5 years ago when it was the Gran Melia and have seen many different improvements made to an already great experience.  For one, they've added many, many new palapas which completely changes the beach experience.  Previously, it wasn't always easy to find a palapa unless you were up very early.  Now, they've more than doubled the number of palapas and there doesn't seem to be any problem getting comfortable on the beach.  In addition, they've added a considerable number of Bali Beds as well as day beds giving guests many choices of how they want to enjoy the beach.  Having walked up and down the beach in either direction I can tell you that no other resort has anywhere near the number of palapas, Bali Beds and day beds. 

Of course, none of this would matter much if the service offered by Paradisus wasn't top notch and I can assure you that the staff does everything possible to make you comfortable.  Yes, I can say we've had a problem or two during each of our stays.  However, the staff has always responded appropriately and would not allow a small problem to get out of hand.  And, they do so with an element of warmth and hospitality that adds to the total enjoyment of the place.

Check in for us has always been easy at the Club Melia pyramid.  Karina and the other ladies who work at check in are always welcoming and have come to recognize us as returning guests.  So, the check in process has become a bit more personable which is something we appreciate.

Cancun is a magical place and staying at Paradisus makes it that much nicer for us.  We're already looking forward to our next stay and enjoying all the hospitality Paradisus offers every time we're there.

reviews.author: Lindseyo21
reviews.title: Unbeatable views and service!
reviews.text: This was our second year at a Paradisus - last year we did the one in Playa Del Carmen (La Perla). While the service at both resorts was top notch there were many similarities and many differences. This time around it was my boyfriend any myself, my parents, and another couple we are good friends with. We had a BLAST! Completely worth upgrading to an ocean view room!! The water is amazing. Playa Del Carmen does not have these ocean views but I did end up enjoying that resort better probably just because it's newer and a bit more luxurious.  My boyfriend actually likes this resort more though so it all depends on what you are looking for. Both resorts have too self liquor- this one does not have corona where the other one does. Many of the restaurants are comparable with fantastic food especially for being an all inclusive resort. I say overall la Perla beats Cancun thought. The Buffet and room service often had food that was room temperature. They also would not deliver alcoholic beverages to the room at this resort unlike the other. The pool was HUGE and plenty of space to float around.  The bartenders were all wonderful! Christian at the pool stood out to us but they all did not lack any enthusiasm and the drinks were great. ALEX!!!! Alex is or appears to be the manager of the pool area and he could not do a better job. If you leave your chair for a second he has your towels fixed and everything tidy. He remembers everyone's names, helps with reservations, and also does a great job of kindly making sure people are not just saving 20 seats that they will not use by the pool. He is so friendly and really stood out as such a hard worker but with a constant smile! Thank you Alex from the Odgrens! The pool entertainment was good many fun obstacle type relays daily that were funny to watch. I would recommend to definitely try this place out. It's huge plenty to see and also very close to airport so not a long ride in at all maybe 20 min or less!!

reviews.author: spadre99
reviews.title: mid winter vacation
reviews.text: we have a timeshare with melia properties, we booked a room for 6 days, not 7 and got a gulf view room, we requested an oceanview room and were told they couldn't honor that request.  i also don't mind tipping for good service, but find that it is ridiculous that you can't get good service without tipping at an all inclusive resort, we didn't feel right not tipping our waiters after a nice dinner either. Also, that they don't mention anything about it to people when they're booking the resort so they can plan their cash accordingly.

reviews.author: Darlene B
reviews.title: A step away from heaven
reviews.text: The best girls trip I could've ask for!!!!! My and my 3 closest girlfriends went for a weekend here in november and ABSOLUTELY fell In love with this resort. Right when you enter the hotel you feel so accommodated and welcome during check-in. Since we stayed in the concierge level, we had a special check- in and we're offered the best service. It was soo quick and easy and we were given a butler to call if we wanted to make reservations or reserve seats by the pool. The food was beyond amazing at every restaurant including the buffet that I would never stop eating!!!! I sware I gained at least 5 pounds. The nightly entertainment was amazing and the lounges and nightclubs were amazing. We were also always served top shelf alcohol even at the pool. I will make sure to book my next family trip here at PARADISE CANCUN!!!

reviews.author: 458armindam
reviews.title: Great Hotel!
reviews.text: Best hotel we ever stayed at!!!! We were shocked that an all inclusive could be so classy and private. We go to Cancun frequently for business and pleasure and have stayed at many other hotels in the area. This is by far the best! It is a beautiful and tranquil hotel. We had our our butler that was kind and helpful. He set up our dinner reservations and had our ironing done. Every details was taken care of to make our stay effortless and stress free. The beds were so comfortable and the rooms very clean.

reviews.author: James B
reviews.title: Amazing Resort for a relaxing vacation
reviews.text: My wife and I just came back from the Paradisus Cancun Resort and had an amazing time!  We stayed in the Royal Service section and it was definitely the way to go - couldn't ask for better service.  The staff was very friendly and very attentive without being overbearing.  Our butler Rosanna was wonderful and able to fulfill any request we had!  Every staff member we encountered was warm, friendly, and willing to do anything to make our stay more enjoyable.  This goes for the staff in the YHI Spa as well!  The room we had was a Junior Suite with a Lagoon View and while it was not an Ocean view it was still a wonderful room.  We noticed that the resort in general was very clean and well maintained.  We ate in several of the restaurants (La Palapa, Mole, Enso, Bana, Blue Agave, and the Market Grill).  We found the food at Bana to be the best   All in all we were very happy with our choice of resort and will definitely be back!

reviews.author: rissysmith
reviews.title: Coco Beach DJ
reviews.text: Best Sunday day party ever at Coco Beach!! DJ Artel Govea Tabata Ortiz was absolutely incredible for anyone looking to enjoy the most fun dance party at the most gorgeous resort. He plays tech house, perfect for a beach party groove. We were there for our friends' wedding & had such a perfect day with our closest friends.

reviews.author: andrei1086
reviews.title: excellent resort but you need to upgrade to the Royal
reviews.text:
We just came back from a week vac at this resort. We've been at Paradisus at Riviera Maya before so we knew it supposed to be a great brand. This one isn't an Adult Only so we had to upgrade to a Royal service. No regrets but a little disappointment when we found out that another couple got a FREE upgrade... Overall, as expected, it's a great resort, with nice decor, good food, very good service. Our personal butler Gerardo was very attentive and eager to help. We missed the Wednesday seafood buffet that featured unbelievable choices including Stone Crabs! After I mentioned it to Gerardo, we got it for lunch the next day and even day after - he special ordered it for us!
Alejandro and Moises from La Patapa were excellent and bartender Gerardo there was very nice making our stay very very comfortable.
The day-time entertainment disappointed us - it looked like they tried to do something but often they played music at a wrong place or time when nobody was listening or participating. We missed those guys like at other places (and we travel often) who are always around a pool/beach area to engage the guests into sport, games, just to fool around and have some good time...I played little golf - but it isn't serious setting... I think we will consider to come back again - memories of the beach and that color of the water will definitely bring us back!

reviews.author: RGS0416
reviews.title: Beautiful resort and amazing staff
reviews.text: We just celebrated our 25th wedding anniversary here, and it was wonderful.  The most beautiful ocean (even better than the DR), a clean and comfortable room with a great view and a big balcony, and excellent service everywhere we went.  Rodrigo, the beach/pool waiter, was wonderful - he readily accommodated our unusual requests, remembered our preferences each day with a smile, and came around often.  Darwin, at Ibana, was funny and personable, and so professional - he and his helper Alejandra made our dinner memorable.  Jose at Venta provided such great service - he helped us navigate the menu and choose the perfect dishes.  Gabriel, the bartender at Enso, personally secured a last minute reservation for us (he was just so incredibly nice).  Antonio and Jaime - and all the staff at Naos - made each breakfast a fun time, pouring champagne and freshening our coffee, and teaching us Spanish and making us laugh.  And the team that served our dinner at the Market Grill - I don't remember all their names, but that experience was our favorite and those guys were fantastic.  Everyone we encountered here was professional and sincerely interested in making our stay a good one.  We also noticed as we walked down the beach (both ways, pretty far) that Paradisus has the best beach chairs and thatch umbrellas - we were even able to stay dry during a short downpour under the umbrella.  The towels are big and soft, the outdoor restrooms are clean and sleek, and the pool area is fun but not too loud (one day an adorable band played great music, and all ages had a great time listening and singing along).  Drawbacks:  the mini bar in the room didn't include alcohol or wine (so no post-beach or pre-dinner drink on the balcony), the shows are put on in a very small area with not enough seats, you have to make a reservation for dinner at all the restaurants (and if you forget to call early you won't be able to get one until late), and the food in general is just OK.  But the service and the beauty at this place totally makes up for it.  I highly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Loyce L
reviews.title: Overall, a great first all-inclusive experience for us.
reviews.text:
The Paradisus is a very large, lovely all-inclusive on the beautiful Cancun Beach about 15 min. from the airport. The service was excellent, especially in the Naos Restaurant when sitting in Kauil, Alberto and Ignacio's section!  They are the best team ever and I would highly recommend sitting in their section. The Ocean-front Junior Suite was very nice, but not really a suite, just a room with oversize king and a couch.  The balcony offered a beautiful view but the seating was uncomfortable.  When we arrived, our fridge was warm and not working but they fixed this within the hour. It was stocked nicely, but no wine (disappointing) and no hard liquor.
What my husband and I liked best:  The beachfront location and the service.  
What we liked least:  The hard sell upon arrival by the concierge to upgrade and to attend the next morning's breakfast to get you to become a member of the Miele hotel group.  And, the quality and selection of wine was really sub-par.

reviews.author: Miiike
reviews.title: Amazing Experience at a beautiful property
reviews.text:
My stay at the Paradisus was truly extraordinary. The hotel itself is beautiful. It is clean and luxurious. The check-in process was easy. There are tons of little touches that make the experience memorable. For example, the all-inclusive bracelet is not some little plastic band. It's actually a nice keepsake. The rooms are fantastic. They're clean, spacious, and beautifully decorated. The bed is super comfortable, and the bathroom is top notch. The patio/balcony is huge. The ocean view is really pretty, and it gives a great view of the pools as well.

The food was amazing here. The Naos (buffet) had great selections that anyone could enjoy. It was all super tasty. It didn't seem cheap or average. Market Grill offered a great churrascaria-style meal. The amount of food was unreal. All the meats were super delicious. Agave had great tacos and fantastic drinks. The biggest standout for me was Mole. The meal and service was amazing. It made my dinner truly something special.

The beach is beautiful here. The chairs are great, and the umbrellas are appreciated. There were servers out on the beach, so that was a great convenience. The pools were fantastic as well. They were large, and the swim-up bar was cool. I was afraid that the crowd might be too wild or loud. It was not. It was a really luxurious and relaxing environment, and not some obnoxious spring break party.

The service that I received here was amazing. Everyone was super welcoming and attentive. I couldn't have asked for more. I had a truly memorable stay here, and I would recommend the Paradisus to anyone coming to Cancun.

reviews.author: Carl B
reviews.title: Big Fun Resort!
reviews.text: My wife and I always wanted to stay at this big resort. Cancun is our favorite winter getaway and we have been many times trying different hotels. The restaurants were very cool! Even though it was a pain to have to call every day to get a reservation for dinner. The payoff was an incredible meal with great service! Every restaurant had amazing food! Gerardo, Edgar and Daniel made our experience enjoyable at "Enzo" and at the restaurant "Vento" Jose, Katha and Gerardo did a great job! We enjoyed the dance show every nite before we went to dinner. The rooms are a little tired and the pool water is a little on the cold side but we couldn't help but have a great vacation at this hotel! The entertainment staff do such a great job entertaining you and changing up the music and festivities from day to day. Rodrigo was so funny and his staff Freddy, Chacho, Hugo and Fernando were great! If they could warm up that pool water just a little bit we would come back and stay at this hotel.

reviews.author: dina a
reviews.title: Family Trip - ages 2 - 81
reviews.text:
I recently organized a family trip to Paradisus in Cancun. It was the first time my entire family vacationed together. We consistent of 18 people ranging in the age of 81 to 2 years old!  I planned and hosted a week long Christmas vacation trip. 

At first I was apprehensive about planning such a big trip. It was the first time I have ever been to an all inclusive resort. I selected The Paradisus Cancun based off of the recommendation of our travel agent. I then decided to book at the Family Concierge level.  I booked 9 rooms! We stayed from December 27, 2015 - January 2, 2016.

From the time I booked the 18 flights and nine rooms I had many many requests from the large party. Requests for connecting rooms, the quiet pyramid, dinner times, babysitting, excursions - everything.  I decided to contact the Family Concierge.  A hotel concierges job is to  provide guests with highly specialized services meant to improve guest experience -This is exactly what I experienced in working with Ms. Maria Nieto.  
She was simply the best concierge I have worked with.  You should note that I travel quite a bit both professionally and personally.  Prior to our arrival I exchanged several emails and had many phone calls with Maria to discuss our logistics. Maria was successful in making our dinner reservations, putting all nine rooms in the same location, connecting rooms for my sister and her three small children, setting us up with Gabriel our butler and ensuring we had made our New Year's Eve party reservation. While Maria handled all these matters I was able to spend time with my family and relax. 

From the moment we checked in Maria was welcoming. She personally checked us in, walked us to our room to ensure we were satisfied  with the room and throughout the entire trip would check to see if we were having a good stay and asked if there was anything she could assist with. 

 Maria's welcoming personality and her ability to accomplish what seems to be the impossible made our stay delightful.  

Other individuals we worked with at the hotel that were extremely resourceful and friendly were Gabriel our butler, Sam who works for Coco's beach club and Lulu, who gave an amazing massage.

reviews.author: Sangita P
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text:
Excellent hotel with really good service.
We went for my nieces wedding.location is good aswel.
There is local buses that run into city centre every 3min and save to travel with.
We highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Piperkid
reviews.title: Pretty Mediocre - Not a great choice for adult only
reviews.text:
My wife and I are pretty frequent travelers and visit three to four all inclusive properties a year. This gives us a pretty good basis for reviews. I have really mixed feelings about this resort. There are a few positives but a number of area's for improvement. 
Positives first, room was pretty nice (we were in the Royal rooms), there was a seating area in the room but only one TV by the bed, grounds nicely maintained, the bars did have premium liquor and the beds were comfortable. Very friendly staff. The Atrium in the center building very impressive. 
Now the negatives, check in was not a good experience. Most properties here in Cancun will greet you with a welcome drink and a cold towel, that did not happen here. Many of the rooms have twin beds rather than king or queen and they wanted to put us in a room with 2 twin beds - on valentines day weekend. Wouldn't work and it took a couple of hours to get it sorted out. The room we did get didn't have any view. The balcony only had 1 chair and I called multiple times to get a second so we could use the balcony. I was lied to and told that all rooms only had 1 chair, when you could clearly see that others had 2 chairs and a small table- we finally gave up! UPDATE – on our last day (raining) a chair magically showed up (only took 5 day’s)
There are a number of palapas on the beach so you can find shade while out there (many properties have none and you're only option is sun all day ). Royal service does get you access to the adults only pool, but there really isn't any shaded places to sit, other than the day beds which were an up charge. Pool is really cold and none of the Jacuzzis work (all cold). There is a section of adults only beach (Must be Royal to use it).
Service was spotty, rooms were not always cleaned or turned down. Drink service on the beach is slow and limited (at most 1 person serving the entire Royal section). The atrium in the Royal area is a nice touch and it's nice to have a quiet place to go for a drink.
Restaurants require reservations (except buffet and Mexican) and even if they are half empty they will not seat you if you don't have a reservation.
