You have to make reservations either the day before or up to 4PM the same day if available. Since check in is pretty late your only option one day 1 will be the buffet.
Food was pretty mediocre except for a dinner at the Market Café, which was an interesting concept and the sushi at Bana was quite good. Virtually everything I got at the Buffet was cold, eggs in the morning pasta for lunch, etc.
Another thing that we have been accustomed to at other resorts is the bellman giving us a tour of the property while accompanying us to our room with our luggage. Here we were given the key and left to find it on our own. This is a pretty big property and the signs to direct you are limited. They do not have a good map of the property and the list of restaurants and bar's was a barely readable copy from a copy machine.

There was some entertainment at the main bar each night. The entertainment was fairly good but amateurish. There is very little seating at the bar so most had to stand around to watch.

In conclusion – we went here because they had an Adult only product and found that if you are looking for an adult experience don’t go to a family resort with an adult section. Yes you do get an area of rooms and beach that are kid free but the whole property is designed for families. The restaurants are designed for family, as are the menu items. It is a real compromise when compared to properties that truly have an adult only product. (Try having a quiet romantic dinner on Valentine’s day when the next table is a family) Bars were limited as was any nightlife (not that we are partiers).

As noted in other reviews, building does leak big time when it rains

There are a few properties (adult) that we go back to somewhat regularly, but this will not be one of them!!!

reviews.author: Lisa C
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel, beach and pools
reviews.text:
I thought the little things were great - the hotel smells very nice, very clean, restaurant reservations are easy, poolside service was excellent.

My only complaint is that the pools are not heated - I couldn't even go in because the water was so cold!  The kids had a hard time swimming given the temperature of the water.  Very few kids' activities - I'd say it is only so-so for children.

reviews.author: Mel R
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text:
Where to begin – this was our first trip to Cancun, but third stay at a Paradisus resort.  We’ve previously stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real (a dream come true!) and the Paradisus Punta Cana (just ok…) - we were so excited to try another stay with the Melia brand, and it did not disappoint.  I am someone that does a ton of research before picking a vacation spot – I read every review possible, even after we are booked and up until the day before we leave.  This resort lived up to every great review I read, and the poor reviews really must be written by very picky people.  We upgraded to Royal Service and it was one of the best decisions we’ve made.  From the moment we checked in and met our Butler Memo, it was non-stop luxury from then on.  We weren’t initially thrilled with our room selection and went down to the check in area to speak to them about possibly moving – after trying to find us something a little better, the Royal Service manager Lazaro came over and got us situated in an unbelievable room – Lazaro – we cannot thank you enough for everything you did for us – you truly made our vacation amazing! Our room was incredible and the Royal Service lounge was an added perk - light breakfast every morning, snacks and top shelf liquor throughout the day, and at 7pm every night, there was some entertainment that you could hear in your room while having a cocktail or getting ready for dinner.  The violin player and the Divas were great, but il Divo was just incredible - unbelievably talented opera trio that sounded like the 3 Tenors!
Memo, our Butler, was super attentive and always available if we needed anything.  He made all of our dinner reservations for us and delivered champagne and strawberries for a special little anniversary night.   Thank you for everything Memo!!!!

The beach is gorgeous – the sand is perfect, water is clear blue, waves were just right – pure paradise.  At the beach, Albierto, Roberto and Vincent were great and always kept our drinks replenished –usually without asking!  Moises on our first day at the beach really set the standards for the rest of the trip! He was excellent.  On our 5th and 6th day, Cesar was out on the beach serving and on the last day, there was a huge crowd of people and he was the only server out there.  He juggled so many drink and food orders, he deserves something special for dealing with the rowdy demanding work group on the beach! Thank you to all for making our beach days just perfect!

The restaurants were great – Enso is just alright- it’s the one restaurant we would not go back to.  Mole, the Mexican restaurant was delicious and Market Grill (Brazilian Steakhouse) was by far the most fun meal we have had – the food just keeps on coming- we laughed so hard, but the food itself was really good.  We also splurged on Tempo – this is definitely a meal to spend the money on –the gourmet tasting menu is really something to experience and the wine pairings and service was beyond anything we have ever had.  Bana (Sushi/Asian) was awesome and the bar was always fun to hang out in, as was the Blue Agave bar – we had a great time with the Mariachi band.

All in all, this is a vacation I am still depressed to be home from.  I cannot wait to come back!!  (If you want to send a voucher for a free trip, please do!!!! We would love it! haha) 

reviews.author: flubber f
reviews.title: Amazing piece of paradise
reviews.text:
We were at Paradisus in April 2015.
The best hotel I ever stayed in Mexico. A lot of "thank you" to all the staff for the best service, special thanks to Alejandro, the uruguayan manager at Fuego restaurant. Me, my wife and my son were treaten like kings. Now, in february 2016, I'm still wearing on my wrist the hotel bracelet. It's my real pleasure to refer you to all the people I talk about vacations. Please say hello to Alejandro from Flavius. We'll be back for sure.

reviews.author: James T
reviews.title: The perfect resort for a relaxing vacation
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful resort and flawless experience from start to finish. The resort looked amazing as soon as we got in, the main lobby is a big pyramid with an indoor garden. Our room is very luxurious and clean despite not being oceanview, the balcony view is beautiful. The beach is nice and the sand is soft. The best part about paradisus however is the food and service. We had reservations at about half of the a la carte restaurants and they were all delicious. The one buffet (Naos) is straight up amazing. The food is always awesome and caters to a wide variety of tastes. I have never received better service in my life from room service, to the bars, to the restaurants. Jason and Giovani at the pool bar hooked me up daily and were always friendly and attentive. The servers at blue agave also stood out to me but I can't remember their names. They catered to my requests and were very friendly. Pablo and Martin were also wonderful at the Naos. I found out Martin's full name (Martin Ku Y Miguel) after having a conversation with him over dinner. He (and every other server I met over my entire stay) catered to my every need and was always attentive to when I was done with a plate or needed a new drink. He also talked to me extensively about Mexican tequila and gave me a lot of advice about my travel plans in Cancun. Overall, everyone at the resort just cares about your experience at Paradisus and making your vacation as perfect as possible. Even Karen at the concierge went over the top to help me with questions about the hotel and Cancun. To be honest, I read reviews before I came here and I can't understand some of the negative reviews some people left, especially regarding the customer service. I'm just going to be straight up blunt about it, but I saw some disrepectful and arrogant guests while I was here, and if you're a dick to other people you are obviously going to be treated like trash. But that's neither here or there. Overall, Paradisus is an amazing resort in every aspect and I definitely will be coming back here,

reviews.author: Bartbad1
reviews.title: Bart
reviews.text: Great all inclusive in Cancun. The Melia family of hotels are well appointed and customer service is of paramount importance. We've been to 5 or 6 of their properties and enjoy the level of accommodation. Great for families and couples. Water is picture perfect, both the ocean and pools. Common areas are gorgeous.

reviews.author: E8546RXsandrar
reviews.title: Vacation!
reviews.text: Best service in Cancun, great food, wonderful beach and pools. Royal Service is amazing! La isla mall is located only 8 minutes away from the hotel. Staff very friendly and always very helpful. Spa is great

reviews.author: Rupinder L
reviews.title: No Heated Pools in Winter Months...
reviews.text:
The hotel is absolutely great! The only drawback was that they have no HOT TUBS outside by the pools and the pools are NO HEATED; which means in the winter months and especially when those clouds hit and go.... its freezing. We stayed there Feb 10 to 15 and we weren't in the water at all. I went in for a minute and would jump out. So I didn't enjoy being in the water; which sucks. No swim up bar/nothing - cause it was damn cold....

Other than that the restaurants, rooms, service - TOP NOTCH!!!!

I loved the fact that main lounge area inside where the evening entertainment happens has beds everywhere. My 3 year old around 9pm would crash on the bed while us adults would finally be able to relax. Next the the lounge is a little night club. It's soooo packed and awesome every night. Crazy that youdont have to leave the hotel for the night life.

Cheers!!!

reviews.author: Thomas Kevin L
reviews.title: Oustanding Experience!
reviews.text: We had the Royal Service and it was truly outstanding!  The staff was always attentive to us and wanted to make sure we had a good time. Eddie was our server at the pool and he was outstanding.  He made our trip!!!

reviews.author: W7664LLdavida
reviews.title: Royal Junior Suite --Royal Treatment
reviews.text: My wife is now spoiled to the point that future vacations may not be affordable.  Room was magnificent and service was impeccable---I wasn't even allowed to carry my own coffee to our table at breakfast!  my only complaints are: 1. lift chain on toilet broke and it took 36 hours to fix it ( I volunteered to do it -- I've had to fix my own several times in 70+ years--but was denied the "privilege")    and 2. not enough channels on TV were in English but watching "The Big Bang Theory" in Spanish was a hoot

reviews.author: Z8966OZkatiec
reviews.title: Paradisus stay
reviews.text:
Great food, beach front, assistance for travel excursions, and service.   

Our room (3108) needed a little TLC on some minor cosmetic issues of wear and tear (eg chipped tile around a phone jack in the bathroom, some outlets didn't work, missing art work on the wall, needed some touch up paint on marks on the wall, art work glass was dirty, mis-match tile grout).  The rest of the hotel was well maintained - our room just felt a little less luxurious because of the visible wear and tear. 

We sat through the Club Melia membership sales pitch.  Very kind and knowledgeable saleswoman.  However, I'm not sure how Melia has the best interest of their guests at heart when the membership offer is not a standing offer where the guest can truly step away and examine if this is a good financial decision.  The motives feel a little like an adjustable rate mortgage (more beneficial for the seller then the purchaser).  Are these sales pitches, heavy in persuasive techniques, really 'taking care' of hotel guests?

Many thanks to all the staff that made us feel very pampered - front desk, guest services, cooks (!!!),  bartenders, housekeeping, wait staff (including but not limted to Guillermo Pech, Oscar Cesar, and Pascual), the spa staff (including but not limited to LuLu).   We felt like royalty for the week.   *applause*

reviews.author: Jerry1934
reviews.title: The name Paridisus is accurately reflects the exparience here
reviews.text:
The architectural design and layout of the resort, both inside and outside, is nothing short of extraordinary, with so much of the common area devoted to beautiful landscaping and comfortable relaxing areas. And the beach and pool areas are very large and inviting. Being Club Melia members, we have returned to vacation at the Cancun Paradisus resort for over 20 years and we will continue doing so.

The rooms are beautifully appointed and well laid out. While we always choose ocean-view rooms, the somewhat less expensive lagoon-view rooms are very pleasant too. Rooms on level 3 or higher provide the best views. We particularly like the balconies, with beach lounges or chairs, that all rooms offer.

The resort offers many restaurants with different cuisines. The resort operates on an All Inclusive basis unless you are a Melia Club member, where you can then dine A la Carte if you wish. Our favorite restaurant this trip was "Tempo".

The staff are very courteous and attentive. Our experience is they go out of their way to meet your needs and assure that your visit is a pleasant one. During our vacation a week ago, we want to especially thank Aaron and Monserrat for their wonderful restaurant service provided to us.

This truly is a 4 star resort with all the amenities you could ask for, sited in one of the best locations on the Cancun peninsula strip. You wont be disappointed.

reviews.author: 정완 김
reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.text: The place is perfect. They provide me and my family the best service. We are already making a plan to visit there again. Specially, Quality Manager Angelica is the best worker. She managed every issues, even though they are minors. We were impressed by that.

reviews.author: Mary B
reviews.title: PARADISUS...SLICE OF PARADISE
reviews.text:
If you're looking for an All-Inclusive that has: High quality food in its 9 restaurants, exercise classes & games to enjoy daily by 1 of its 4 pools, chase lounge chairs under umbrella trees to shade you (not many resorts have umbrella trees to shade you!), music to listen to & enjoy in the afternoon, wonderful live shows every night, DJ every night, you can do as much or as little as you like...go to the PARADISUS, in Cancun, Mexico.
Hats off to ALL the employees.  They work very hard and are always pleasant & accommodating.  A special "Shout -Out" to:  Melissa Garcia - Consiere  
                              Daniel                - Photographer
                              Andres               - Nespresso Bar
Victor, Rafael & Orlando               - Market Grill
All the Beach Servers!

I give the PARADISUS a solid 4.5
A couple of things need to be "Tweeked."
In Pyramid #3  music starts to play at 7:30a.m.  That is the central pyramid where all the restaurants & entertainment is.  Because of the dome you hear everything.  Stay in Pyramid #4, if you want quiet.
In the Red Lounge the wood dance floor is quite small.  It's difficult to dance on carpet.
In the Avenue Bar seating is limited for the great live shows they put on.  Get there early!  I would go back tomorrow, if I could. These are small cons.  The pros out-weigh the cons!

reviews.author: 314evamarial
reviews.title: Pleasure beeing at Paradisus Resort Cancun
reviews.text:
Enjoyed the Service at the Naos  very helpful and friendly. Mr. Pablo Alvarez and Abraham Cunche are the best Servers we ever had.
Alltogether the Hotel is more than we expected and we will certainly return.

reviews.author: William B
reviews.title: Return Trip Even Better
reviews.text: This was the second trip to Paradisus for my wife and I in January, and it surpassed our first experience. We did the Royal Service, which is a must for couples without young children. You are in a quiet section of the hotel, and most importantly, a pool for adults only. We did our children thing, and this is now time for us. The service is great, especially our butler Sergio, the food outstanding at any restaurant. The Market Grill is especially good if you like meat. There was a dance floor show several times a week featuring different musical styles like disco and Broadway that is amazingly fun> Parasisus is really the place, and we can't wait to go back.

reviews.author: sbelle50
reviews.title: Exceeded expectations
reviews.text: My husband and I have never been on a cruise but I imagine this property offers all you get aboard while on dry land .   The activities offered were wonderful ( thank you to the energetic ZUMBA staff)...the nightly entertainment was first class for adults and children alike , OMAR at the poolside always warmly greeted us, SINDY prepared my coffee each morning , FERNANDO. Provided us with exceptional concierge attention.   I will always be grateful to NALLELY at the spa , and to whomever in the laundry , found and retrieved my necklace that I left in the robe pocket after my amazing massage .. Thank you !!!  The room was always fresh and clean , housekeeping can make or break a trip so thank you !  Each day was relaxing and each evening was entertaining .

reviews.author: STEPHEN M
reviews.title: Overall good resort
reviews.text: Just returned from week at the resort. We were there for Super bowl and we're happy to pay the extra $120 for comfortable reserved seats and champagne for the game. 2 big screens and some company made it a fun night which we would never do at home. Service at resort is great always a smile. I brought $150 in singles for tips and gave it all out. Our room was great, spacious, 2 beautiful baths, no leaks. Food at restaurants was very good, drink service at beach was great. Beach and pool are best in area, plenty of chairs, although you may have to be there 8 or 9am to get a particular tiki hut, there were always some available. Would avoid staying in main tower,(3), we were in tower 2 and it was quiet. I believe the main tower may be loud due to nightclub activity. Night club is a little dated, not an issue for us. A little lacking in nighttime outdoor bars. Cocos is only one and is very small but staff there is great. Had issue with din reservations. Tried to change din reservation in afternoon due to Ash Wednesday. Was told nothing available anywhere. We went ahead to Enzo which was half empty the night before. Walked right in at 7 and it stayed empty again. We think they shut down reservation to steer you to buffet where they have a ton of food to get rid of. Aqua world is across the street and offers a number of excursions if interested. Public bus is $1 and runs all the time. Big shopping 2 miles down road. Overall very happy with resort.

reviews.author: M M
reviews.title: Work trip
reviews.text: The resort is excellent. The conference services manager was exceptional. She worked non stop to ensure every detail and request was completed. The grounds are beautiful and well maintained. The food is excellent with a lot of variety. The one area of improvement would be in the dining room service. Two encounters were; one, being charged a wine sommelier fee without warning and, two, attempting to be charge for lunch on the last day when we paid separately for 2 group dinners and not dining in the all inclusive restaurants. Otherwise it was an excellent trip with outstanding staff and facilities.

reviews.author: Kevin962
reviews.title: Cancun Trip
reviews.text: Had a great time at the Paradisus Cancun.Melia Club  representative Niki was very friendly and helpful. Our two favorite bartenders were Carlos and Christian(Gato).Both were perfect gentlemen and Carlos gave us a great tequila class! I wanted to highlight two dinning nights.First at Fuego the staff Darwin , Miquel , Katia and Alex were all fantastic ! And than our dinner at Enos was fabulous not only the food but the friendly people who work there,Benito,Rodrigo, Jose and Sandra.Sorry can't mention everyone at Paradisus but didn't have one unfriendly experience all week. Thanks Michelle and Kevin

reviews.author: Yvonne C
reviews.title: Excellent Stay
reviews.text: Stayed the first week in Feb at Paradisus. Could not fault this beautiful hotel. Food was amazing especially in Fuego the tapas in Vento. Great variety of buffet food for breakfast and lunch in Naos with brilliant service from our waiter Antonio and his crew! There were activities in the hotel and by the pool from 9am daily and entertainment every night which was brilliant. You are given a full schedule of events upon arrival at the hotel which we took part in daily. Special mention to Freddie, Hugo, Rodrigo and Fernando who are doing a fantastic job trying to get everyone involved in the activities!! The events by the pool were most enjoyable and the wine and tequila tasting were very interesting!!  Overall a brilliant stay and would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Anita O
reviews.title: MY DREAM WEDDING COME TRUE !!!
reviews.text:
I want to start by apologizing because this is going to be kind of lengthy.....

Rewind back in time when I got engaged to the man of my life in cancun mexico in 2014!!! little did we know that we would be getting married in Cancun only a year later. After visiting cancun several times and visiting many hotels for site inspections, we fell in love with the Paradisus for so many reasons on so many levels. 

First, HOSPITALITY. From the moment you walk in to the moment you check out, everyone, and I MEAN EVERYONE, takes time to stop and greet you and say hello. Every time one of the staff would walk by you, they would put their hand on their heart and say buenas dias or buneas noches. It really really makes you feel cared for and welcomed. People started remembering our names. From the nespresso coffee guys to the bartenders and even our maid. 

They have something for everyone. During our two week stay, we had 70 guests ranging in age from 1yo to 75yo. Not one person ever complained that they could not find something to do. There was an awesome daycare and play area for children both indoors and out. There was quiet areas in the lobby where the older people hung out and hand coffee and there was several activities for everyone through out the day. And that's what we really loved about this resort.

CHECK IN: smooth, especially if you are staying in royal service. Stayed at this resort 2 times and both went ok.

ROOMS: Paradisus is compromised of 5 buildings with two views. Lagoon view for main street and Ocean view, for well, the OCEAN and the pool. Either way you get great views because not many people spend time in their room. One plus side to ocean view is that you get to see the amazing sunrise. The plus side to the lagoon view is that you get to see the amazing sunset. So each have their perks, it just boils down to how much money you want to spend and how much time you want to actually spend in your room

GROUNDS: OMG !!! Everywhere is so clean and so well maintained. When you are in the resort you feel like you are in a rainforest. It is so tranquil and the hanging greens in each building add a nice ambiance. The running water noise and the koi fish ponds are amazing. There was always something so relaxing about being able to walk from one pyramid to another and hearing the sounds of the waterfalls and seeing how well everything flowed so well together. There are people constantly cleaning and doing maintenance to keep up with such a high volume of people. THE ONLY COMPLAINT I ever heard of, and not even a complaint on my end, was people learning the layout of the property. After two days of being there you definitely understand how it works, but some people just had a hard time figuring out the layout and navigating through the property which was frustrating for them. No biggie !!! 

BARS/RESTAURANTS: I have to say it is the best service we have received in an all inclusive resort by FAR !!!!! People go above and beyond to fulfill your needs. And I'm not saying that because we stayed in the Royal Service Side. We spent most of our time with our wedding guests in the main pool area since all the action would be there anyway. However, waitstaff really do an amazing job making sure you have everything you need. They have several different options for dining. Ranging from sushi(BANA) in the main pyramid, from NAOS(international buffet) which had pretty much anything you could ever want morning noon and night, Vento(tapas) which was really nice, and our favorite which was the Brazilian bbq(market Grill). Most places you need a reservation so make them when you arrive to the hotel and you will not have a problem. The food is always plentiful and tasty. they had a great selection of food at this resort and was amazed at the quality of food and top shelf liquor they offered. Not one of my 70 guests complained of the service. Everyone, and I mean everyone in my wedding party was FLOORED by the level of service. 

ENERTAINMENT: They had the red lounge which was a mini club that opened to guests 18 and above which was a nice meeting point for a lot of the younger ones in our crowd. Especially for people who liked to stay up late and dance. The Avenue Bar is where they would do the nightly entertainment and shows. The bartenders here really work their butts off. Shout out to Chris for making the best drinks everrrr all week. !!!!!!!!!!!!! If you like espresso martinis, uhm yea go to him !

POOL/BEACH: What can I say ? We picked Cancun for the lovely white sand beaches and crystal blue water. It was an amazing wedding week and everyone who came was so happy with the water temp of the ocean and the pool area. Most parties rented cabanas all week so we knew where everyone was hanging out all day. You can hop back and forth from the beach and pool since its so close. We had no difficulty getting chairs in the morning. And usually other guests were really nice to give up their chairs if they were not using it for us. 

ROYAL SERVICE: Ok I have to admit, the first time we came, we thought it was definitely worth the upgrade. For the wedding, they upgraded us to the royal service side. And while it was nice to be able to get some peace and quiet at night, there were times when I felt that we didn't fully utilize the Royal Service Side. We had a butler for the whole two weeks when we were there and he did an amazing job. Not always in your face but attentive enough to get everything you needed when you requested it. 
If you are looking for a relaxing vacation and some quiet mellow time, royal service is definitely for you. Located in the 5th pyramid, adults only, they have their own small "snack buffet" which is convenient if you don't want to walk to the main pyramid for food. they have a bartender and nightly entertainment here as well. Usually every night some jazz music or cigar roller. So definitely geared more for adults. 

WEDDING: It was a fairytale. The romance team at the Paradisus really put together an excellent event for our special day. Everything was so seamless. They really do know how to master wedding planning. At first, I was skeptical since they don't really start communicating with you all the plans until a few months prior. When normally everyone doing a wedding at home would normally be finished with major planning. But everything fell into place so wonderfully. From coordinating all communication with vendors( florist, dj, videographer/photographer, wedding planner, reservations for guests, etc) to making sure all our special requests were honored. We had the chef come up with a custom menu last minute just to fit our needs and wants. They were able to bring in a bellydancer and hookahs on each table since we had requested it. They put out our traditional deserts we had flown in, in addition to the wonderful spread they had. They literally did anything and everything to make our dream wedding come true. From the welcome party on the beach the night before, and throughout the entire wedding day, Lorena, Esther and the whole team did such an amazing job turning all my visions into a reality. I am forever grateful and still wish I can go back to repeat that day. 

To the whole staff, the whole Paradisus team, thank you for making my dream wedding come true. Thank you for always striving to make the resort a better place and ensuring the guests are number one. I am so pleased with the MELIA chain, that from now on, when making reservations, I will make sure to opt for your hotels.

reviews.author: SailclothBritches
reviews.title: A Wonderful Resort Experience
reviews.text:
I stayed at Paradisus with my family for a week this winter. It was a wonderful, relaxing resort experience. The room was comfortable, with a magnificent ocean view; the hotel was beautiful; and the staff were exemplary.

The resort offers a lot of different and great restaurant options. As a vegan, it is difficult for me to find good food, but the staff at restaurants like Naos, where Guillermo, Montserrat and Moises helped me enjoy many great meals; at other restaurants (my favorite being Mole) I had delicious food.

All the staff were extremely friendly and helpful. As a bitter New Yorker, it was mood-lifting to be greeted with genuine smiles by every member of the staff.

Special shoutout goes to the staff of the Baby Zone where my baby daughter got the playtime she needed in this adult atmosphere. Alma and Adriana were very kind and responsible presences there.

The beach was gorgeous, the drinks were plentiful and the space and staff wereamaizng. A terrific experience!

reviews.author: catherine r
reviews.title: Great Service
reviews.text: Shout out to Rodrigo in Royal Service.  Great service.  We went for 3 nights in Jan. to check out the Paradisus chain as I was booking for a girlfriend and myself at Paradisus La Perla.  Loved the Royal Service, beach, and food.  Only drawback was the wall thickness as I had a nasty woman banging on my door in the middle of the night for watching my tv at a Very Low level.  Older Building I guess.  Everthing else was fantastic.

reviews.author: James P
reviews.title: The Paradisus met our high expectations including a beautiful beach, clear blue water and unlimited food and drink!
reviews.text: The quality of the entertainment exceeded that of similar resorts we visited and the night club kept the party going.  The staff was pleasant and the food was very good.  A special highlight was the sushi restuarant which we enjoyed immensely.

reviews.author: Lisa D
reviews.title: Good but...
reviews.text: This was our fifth trip to Cancun and this was our fifth resort in Cancun. If this had been our only experience at an all-inclusive in Cancun, I'm sure we would have thought it was wonderful. However... in comparison this resort fell short in some areas. Mostly management, on our arrival/ check-in we were met by our "personal " concierge named Melissa. We never were able to contact or did we lay eyes on Melissa the rest our seven day stay, and not for lack of trying.There seemed to be a general feeling of apathy toward the guests from most of the staff. On Super Bowl Sunday we walked along the beach and saw the other resorts preparing big barbecues with jumbo screens to watch the game. Our resort offered , for the minimum of ninety dollars, to reserve a seat in one of their clubs to watch the game. they told us our only other option was to go to the Outback or the Marriott next door. The resort also seemed to have a real problem with water leakage/ plumbing. They had towels placed all around the common areas , lobby, and our own bathroom. we had water leaking from the ceiling above our toilet.                         On the positive side, the rooms were very nice and well cleaned by our maid service. The restaurants were great.The best part of every day was having breakfast in Marco's section of the buffet at Naos. Management could learn a thing or two from him about personal service and how to treat the guests. Marco always had a huge smile for everyone and happily attended to your every need! Overall a good resort, but I wouldn't consider it five stars.

reviews.author: DGSNYC
reviews.title: Not as advertised - room for improvement
reviews.text: The quality of the rooms are not as advertised. The first room they gave us was a horror show. The food was just - could be much better quality.  Tempo and Fuego (we went 2x) were the standouts.  Our waiter Aldo at Fuego was great as was everyone at Tempo. Tempo was pricey but a worthwhile experience. Overall it's a good 3 star hotel but just average and in need of renovations.

reviews.author: Cassia R
reviews.title: Average
reviews.text: The hotel is well located and huge, but breakfast and decoration could be improved. Dinners need to be booked but experience was better and food too. In the pool if you are not a member of the club you cannot use chairs facing the ocean, a pity, as chairs should be allowed to all guests no matter where...

reviews.author: dandd747
reviews.title: stayed feb.3rd thru feb.12th
reviews.text: beautiful resort with very wonderful staff. our stay at Paradisus included Royal Service,our butler Rossana  was super and is now a friend.thier is so many people that we wish to mention.Daniel,Jorge,Javier.Rodrigo,juan,Alejondro,Moses.Edie,Valeria @ La Palapa Samantha,Angel and Sandra at check in and Julio with beverage service.it was a pleasure to meet them all and we look forward to going back.

reviews.author: Valeri W
reviews.title: Great Resort! My husband & I truly enjoyed this trip!
reviews.text: We just recently returned from spending 2 weeks at the Paradisus.  We have nothing but good things to say about this resort. We were met at the door by smiling staff and never saw anything less. Any staff that you met in the hall would all acknowledge you with a smile and a greeting. Very impressed with that! Check in was very smooth and efficient! Our 1st night dining we went to Blue Aquave. Very good food with excellent service. We went back 2 more times to eat at that restaurant. Naos breakfast buffet wait staff was the best. Orlando, Alberto, Javier, Aaron-they were all great and after the 1st day would have our coffee and mimosas waiting for us to pick a table! When we finished breakfast we headed to the pool for the morning. Alexander the pool concierge was AWESOME!! So attentive and willing to help. He is so good at his job. The bar staff at the pool bar makes the best Mango Lillies ever! In the afternoon we moved to the beach and had Hector, Luis and Angel for our wait staff. They were so willing to get whatever we needed. They work very hard and always would greet you with a smile. They remembered what we liked and always brought us water to make sure we did not dehydrate! Those little things make this resort the awesome resort that it is. In the evening before we went to supper we would go to the Avenue Bar for drinks. The bartender William and Karina the waitress were the best. They remembered what we liked and were so attentive. Niki was our concierge that was always able to get us reservations at the restaurants we wanted. That made the trip so much better because we did not have to deal with that. We ate at all of the restaurants on the property except Tempo. They were all very good with well prepared food, excellent service and very attentive staff. Our favorite restaurants were Enso and Market Grill. The food was amazing there as was the staff. It is very difficult to mention everyone that we had but needless  to say our experience was a great one. Our maid did a great job with our room and we always had clean towels and the room done up by 10 am everyday. We did sit through a timeshare presentation and were very happy with no high pressure sales people riding us to purchase their timeshare. I really want to give out a shout out to Karina from the Avenue Bar and Hector on the beach. They were always going above and beyond in service. We had such an enjoyable time at the resort and we will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Amy H
reviews.title: Perfect location, beautiful property, relaxing stay!
reviews.text: We visited the Paradisus 1/24-1/29/16.  We were upgraded to the Royal Service as there was a large party in the main building where we were originally slated to stay.  It was incredibly quiet, I'm sure this is lower season than normal.  Staff was all fantastic and helpful.  If you want a vacation that requires you to never lift a finger and have someone wait on your every need--Royal Service is for you.  There was literally always 3-4 people within reach ready to help you in some way.  If you want to be totally left alone--this may not be for you. We did love the extra restaurants and private area with lower key entertainment on this side of the property.  If we wanted excitement we could go to the center building, but we didn't have to be in it all the time.  We felt like we really got a feel for the property.  It is beautifully designed, rooms are reasonable-but not huge.  Honestly, with such a beautiful beach we didn't spend much time in our room.  Restaurants were pretty good-it does take a day or so to figure out the reservations process to go to the nicer, sit down meals.  We have pretty basic tastes, so our fave was City Grille-a Brazilian Steakhouse type meal where they bring out various meats and sides until you are crazy full.  I didn't think any served what we thought would be Mexican food--I looked forward to basic tamales, sopapillas, tostadas, etc., but they really didn't have much in that way.  There were nachos in several places--and we did not eat at the Blue Agave-which might have been more along that fare.  The food was beautifully presented, but definitely felt like all the restaurants were aiming for presentation and unique food, rather than focusing on fairly basic, good fare. It seemed like they were all trying to copy the idea of "Tempo" the fancy restaurant at the resort that is an extra charge.  Not everyone likes to dine that way, so I wish there was just a middle of the road restaurant with a more relaxed feel-not burgers and nachos-but somewhere in between with authentic Mexican food. I felt like they celebrated American culture more than Mexican.  The shows were fun-but again, mostly American.  Michael Jackson, pop, disco.  Going to a foreign country for the first time, I would loved to have seen some more native entertainment and food and I doubt I'm alone in this.  You go somewhere-you want a taste of what they do best!  The whole building design is based on the Riviera Maya, cenotes, etc., and is really gorgeous.  The activities were fun-sometimes you have to ask some questions to figure out what is free, but they will try to sell you on excursions since they are connected to that company.  Volleyball was fun, Zumba was fun, even the games were fun.  The activities staff works HARD--they are there having high energy and excitement from the start of the day to the end of the day.  Another note--they say tips are included with the all-inclusive, but it seemed clear that many of the staff expected to be tipped-and I struggled a little with not wanting to have people come do things for me because I felt like I owed them a tip-and that's a LOT of tips with as often as you are approached!  I wish they would be upfront about this policy so people could really relax or understand the expectation. One last suggestion--there was NO hot tub onsite--I would highly recommend they get one-especially this time of year when the evening get chillier we searched and searched the first night.  Not even one in the spa-there's is air-temperature.  The others were had bubble capability, but the water was cold and not heated.  This is HUGE for many couples!

reviews.author: Michael H
reviews.title: Fantasti!! But...
reviews.text: I have stayed at the paradisus royal service two times in the last year. The leve of excellence I have not experienced before! However I was there for Super Bowl this year. They made me Pay $85 for a bottle to see the large screen. This annoyed me so much(as the other guests) that I will look elsewhere when returning. Not a way to treat loyal customers. Ps. The Marriot nex door had big screen at no charge!

reviews.author: Balázs K
reviews.title: Amazing family holiday in January
reviews.text: We spent an unforgettable week in Hotel Paradisus between 23.01.2016 - 30.01.2016. We chose family concierge suite and I feel all cents was worth it! Everything was just perfect: The morning sun from our suite, the white sand, the picturesque view of Caribbean Sea - just like in NatGeo -, the restaurants, the pools, the amazing and friendly staff, and of course our butler: FERNANDA! Thank you so much, God bless you! Maybe it is a daily routin here but we felt ourselves like kings. We always found some surpises when we got back in the suirte. Every requests were fulfilled, every untold wishes were found out and satisfied by FERNANDA! Thank you Hotel Paradisus, for having such a great people like our butler, but all the hotel staff was just perfect! I hope we can go back!The thematical parks around Cancún are also awesome, including the guidance and transfer is very professional, but be aware of those many people who cruises around the hotels and want to sell something - sometimes on a very agressive way. Also take care, if somebody is very kind in the city, they will ask money for the kindness and will be very upset if you do not want to pay! So stay in the hotel, visit themeparks+Mayan ruins and look around in Mexico with official tourist guides.  Balázs Kovács & Family, Hungary

reviews.author: Laurie S
reviews.title: Paradisus is Paradise
reviews.text:
We have stayed in many all-inclusive hotels, many of which are in Mexico. The Paradisus Cancun is one of the best! It may be over 25 years old, but its charm can't be beat. Its exterior is an architectural feast for the eyes and the first floor is like being in a jungle wonderland. 

The food in the buffet was fresh and varied. The specialty restaurants offered fare that we would otherwise never have sampled at home. The wait staff was amazing-especially the waiters in Enso. 

This hotel is right in the middle of the hotel zone, so the beach walking opportunities are great. There is a public bus stop right in front of the hotel, which makes it easy to get to malls, other hotels, and restaurants. 

On the downside, although the pools are lovely, there is only one hot tub and we couldn't even use it as we did not pay the extra fee to become "an exclusive guest". Also, there is no theater, so nightly shows, which were very good, were held in the main bar area with very limited seating available.

The few areas that were lacking at this hotel were more than compensated for by the wonderful staff of the Paradisus.  We never ran into a single employee who didn't go out of his/her way to smile and offer assistance if needed. We will definitely stay at this terrific hotel again in the future.

reviews.author: tgdr4
reviews.title: Sun... Sand... Recouperation
reviews.text: My husband booked our trip so I could recouperate from a double mastectomy.. I was sooo nervous because I was still weak walking wise.. The pictures I saw looked like I would be walking a million miles.. The hotel is nicely laid out. The lobby is a lush tropical paradise, an instant feel of relaxation. The pool was amazing .. Although chilly it was refreshing. One thing it was very deep except for pool bar, so i would suggest a small float or a noodle.. The best was the seats under the palapa by the pool although that great hubby of mine had to go down very early, to catch a spot it was soooo worth it .. The view of the ocean was amazing as there was a clear  railing.  We have been to cancun 16 times and this was the best pool view.  The food was  well resort food.. We did not do resturants as we never seem to want to leave pool time to make reservations and don't like to be stuck to a dining time.. The food I had was good but seemed the same selection at the buffett except for seafood night when they did have small lobster, shrimp, scallops, mussels, washed down with a merlot yummmyyy.. The shows were good but you need to get there early, the show is in the lobby that barely sits 75. The rooms were nice but needed updating I hear there are towers that have updated rooms  .. We were obviously not in one  tower 4 ..

reviews.author: Natasha C
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort!
reviews.text: My time in Cancun overall was AMAZING. Granted the time that i went was kind of gloomy but overall wonderful time. Now into the good stuff. Overall the resort at Paradisus Cancun is BEAUTIFUL. My boyfriend and I had such a great time. The staff is so nice very attentive. I will point out one bartender in particular Carlos! is amazing he made us have a wonderful time at the CoCo bar lounge by the beach. Everyday that we were their we went to that bar. The scenery from our room on the top floor of the main building was a gorgeous . What a great ocean view. Food was excellent in the main dining hall. Lots of selections. My only concern was that i wanted a bit of a mix with the desserts some things were repeated more than others. in my case i wanted a little custard pie that was delicious! The beach was clean and nice but it was kind of chilly on my trip and therefore i didn't get as much beach time as i would have liked. No fault to Paradisus... i can only blame mother nature. Other wise i will be back again! I LOVE THIS PLACE!

reviews.author: 327naddyf
reviews.title: Stay at Pardisus Cancun
reviews.text: A well located hotel, with well trained, cordial and responsive staff. The experience is the epitome of ultimate relaxation, comfort and choice,. The staff ensures that the experience is not limited to the hotel but well integrated into the overall culture.

reviews.author: heew0n
reviews.title: Hi
reviews.text: Overall service was EXCELLENT. Each and every server was so kind and tried their best to satisfy our needs and requests. Yhonny who works at Naos kindly served us foods and drinks and asked us to do the rating on TripAdvisor. My favorite restaurants in the hotel were Vento (Mediterranean) and Enso (Asian). Anyone who is planning to stay in Paradisus Hotel should try Naos' roasted shrimps skewers. I ate about 15 of them during my stay. Bana, the Japanese seafood restaurant, serves sushi but it was rather sweet. The location of the hotel was the best of the best, since you could look down from the hotel the best part of the Caribbean Ocean. The hotel activities that include performances are enjoyable. I'm so satisfied with my stay at Paradisus Hotel and I would like to visit and meet Yhonny again.

reviews.author: Brenda V
reviews.title: Wait Staff
reviews.text: Our family recently enjoyed a holiday stay at the Paradisus Cancun and were treated like family by the wait staff. One waiter in particular was continuously attentive and caring for my family throughout the week, making our stay feel much more personal. His extended good will was evident among his fellow waiters to other guests as well making the whole atmosphere festive.  We really appreciated Martin Sanchez in helping making our trip so much fun and easy.

reviews.author: Ivanca891
reviews.title: Beautiful Family Vacation
reviews.text: We decided on Paradisus Resort as we read lots of good reviews and we were not disappointed. My 2 year old had a blast at the evening entertainment and the kiddie pool. The rooms are clean and the ac is very comfortable.  I was surprised that room service stopped by about every 2 hours from either some cleaning or to stock up on the minibar snacks and drinks. Towels were changed and the room was cleaned in the morning and was prepared for nighttime. The restaurant staff was outstanding and always courteous and helpful. Can only recommend

reviews.author: Felipe V
reviews.title: AMAZING RESORT
reviews.text:
We`ve been to paradisus for a week on the end of january. The place is incredible. The staff is kind and very prestative and the facilities are great.
Food is amazing and there is a good diversity of restaurants.

Wifi works great in all the resort and is FREE!

We definetly we`ll come back!

5stars

reviews.author: BettinaCancunQuenn
reviews.title: Great Beach and Pool Area
reviews.text: I have stayed here many times before when this property was The Melia The Pool and Beach are still fabulous. The restaurants updates were very nice but buffet food was the same everyday. The Market Grill was the best. Make a reservation every morning or you wont get in. Their was never enough towels left and we had to call everyday for towels to be brought up. The safe didn't work but they fixed it right away. Overall this is a beautiful resort. Entertainment at night was good but you had to get there at 7:30 for the 8:30 show or you wouldn't get a seat.The rooms and bathrooms still need to be updated. This is not a 5 star hotel so don't expect a luxurious room and bath. I stay at this resort for the pools and beach. Ask to be in tower 3 on the 5th floor or above. I have stayed at many of the resorts in Cancun and Playa and this is hotel is in my top 5 for the money. I have been traveling to Cancun for the past 25 years.

reviews.author: beatrizc396
reviews.title: Excellent Stay at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus January 25 through the 30.  We had a fabulous experience. We stayed in the Royal Service, which I highly recommend.  Our Butler Galdino, went out of his way to make sure my birthday was very special.  He was also so helpful in scheduling dinners and taking care of any needs we wanted.  In my opinion, one of the best restaurants on the property is the Palapa, which is only for Royal Service guests.  The bali beds by the pool and the beach are exquisite. The service is impeccable.  We experienced excellent service all throughout the hotel, with a smile.  The spa was incredible.  I had a facial and a message.  Both were excellent and so relaxing.  The water spa is so special and relaxing.  I've never seen anything like it.  The gym is state of the art and I especially loved the yoga.  Again, with the royal service, yoga is outside Monday, Wednesday and Fridays and it's only for the Royal Service guests.  The Royal Service Lounge, had really nice breakfasts, with fresh fruits, green juice, that was so yummy and just about anything you could want for breakfast in a beautiful setting.  We also enjoyed the dalily shows by the pool, at The Avenue each night and music in the Royal Service lounge.  Wonderful and relaxing stay.  They do a great job of making you feel Zen but if you want the party, it's there too!  Highly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: H952CRdeborahw
reviews.title: Best snow escape ever
reviews.text: We went to Paradisus when our original reservation couldn't be extended. It was a change for the best. The service was superior. The food was great .The room was comfortable. The mattresses were great. Premium liquor store flowing. The entertainment was diversified and professional quality.  CONS- water temp in shower was warm at every time

reviews.author: adguy121
reviews.title: Great time
reviews.text:
Just got back from five days in Cancun. Thought we'd get out of town for a few days, so we booked package deal through Orbitz that included the Paradisus. Overall, we had a great time. Very happy with the service...props to William (Ave. Bar) and Orlando (Naos) for a job well done. Never met the folks who cleaned the rooms, but they were awesome. Also, a shout out to the performers in Ave Bar show...really enjoyed it.

Food was ok...we're from Louisiana, so we have high standards when it comes to meals. :-) Not fond of the whole reservations thing for the restaurants. We only ate at one of those - Mole - and it was so-so. Could have been the dishes we ordered. Other than that, we ate at Naos and were happy with what was offered. 

In the end, the Paradisus is a great value with a hardworking staff. Rooms and beds were fine. Food was fairly good. Beach and pool are very nice. If we had to do it over, we'd go a little later in the year. Pool was chilly due to lower temps, clouds and wind. That said, we would love to return.

reviews.author: stacyt128
reviews.title: Bachelorette Party Fun
reviews.text: There were 18 of us and we LOVED staying at Paradisus. I didn't want anything wild for the trip, just good girl time on the beach! Dinner at Enzo or the Market Grill was our favorite and the beach club cabanas were perfect. We booked a private boat and went downtown one night. Other than that, we stayed at the hotel and had such a good time under the sun.

reviews.author: Laura C
reviews.title: Our relaxing honeymoon
reviews.text: My husband and I went on vacation for our delayed honeymoon and we decided this resort from our travel agent Angela from Liberty Travel. We started off with private transfers to the resort and when we got there we were blown away! Not only was it amazing but everyone is SO Friendly. We had Royal Service accommodations so we had to walk over to the third pyramid and when you get over there you have to swipe to get through the glass doors which made it feel exclusive. We got top of the line service and then we got introduced to our butler Fernando. He was absolutely amazing. He always had little tricks up his sleeve like rose pedal bath or knowing I loved champagne and having a bottle at night chilling for us with a cheese platter. One night my husband in conversation was talking about how much he enjoyed dry red wine and then that night we came back to our room with fruit display with an amazing bottle of wine. He was always willing to help us, if we were down by the beach he would walk down there to come find us! We spent most of our days relaxing by the beach in the cabanas (reserve them, they are amazing!) and because we were royal service they would bring out a bucket of bottle waters to us throughout the day and around noon they brought us over a lunch menu so we never had to leave our ocean view. They were constantly checking to see if we needed anything like drinks or even shots!! Caesar was amazing! Loved him! We weren't huge night seekers on this vacation it was more relaxation but I will tell you the restaurants were amazing. Every night we would rank our meal and we would always give it a 10. The meals felt like 5 star type of dining! We never once had any complaints about or meals and the service was outstanding! We loved the breakfast buffet server Martin Sanchez he was so amazing and you could tell he really loved his job! My husband and I have been talking and we want to go back and bring a group of people back with us! We just enjoyed our trip so much and could not say anything bad. I see some reviews on here aren't as good and I was so surprised. If you look for the negative you will find some no matter where you go. If you are going to relax and have a good time then you are going to an amazing resort with lots of food and activity options!

reviews.author: cortnol
reviews.title: My Wedding Weekend (Party of 33)- wedding went great- hotel disappointed on so many fronts
reviews.text:
This is perhaps the hardest review for me to write. There were few things this hotel does right. 
- The food is good, restaurant service is great
- The facilities are beautiful

For me, choosing a wedding venue was hard. I visited Paradisus a year ago and was not expecting to have the mistakes, errors, services, etc as I had in hosting my wedding day at this hotel. Some of these things are unforgivable in my opinion, thus, I am not recommending for folks to stay at this resort

- I reserved a VIP Suite and was told I could get an upgrade, which did not happen as part of my wedding package. This was to come with a Butler, we only saw our Butler once and the VIP services were minimal, definitely not worth the extra $$, rooms were not much better
- our room was practically never cleaned. My sand ceremony bottles were broken and sand got on the floor- the floors were never cleaned. We never tipped our maids for this reason. 
- The Hotel was turning off 1/2 of their electricity at times, and the night of my wedding, I had no AC and no outlet use for a hair dryer so I could not wash my hair the night before my wedding day.
- Red Lounge has hours listed to be open until 2am- the only night club. They were closing all together and did not even have it open the FRI/SAT of my wedding. They provided NO alcohol to my wedding guests after 10pm- at an all inclusive, this is unacceptable.
- I asked as it is included in my wedding package to have my Wedding Dress pressed, and it was provided to me with an Iron Stain on the front- they scrubbed it and got it off, but ruined the silk. Upon checkout, the tried to charge me for this which was horrible! It was to be free and included anyway
- 2 guests rooms had no hot water
- When a guests was missing because he fell asleep in the hotel and could not be found at 5am, the manager on duty was not helpful at all, nor was any of the security staff to help find him. Then he told us it was 'impossible for anyone to drown' when I asked if he had security cameras, they do not.
- The same night manager came down to the beach after my wedding and blamed me, the bride for taking 10 beers from the bar... one of my guests stole the ten beers, I did not and did not know it had happened. Instead of yelling at the bride, you should have asked her if she needed a case of beer! This was supposed to be an all inclusive resort.
- Because the red lounge was closed, I had to pay $2,000 more for my wedding reception to be extended from 10pm to midnight. I had to pay at an all inclusive to keep a bar open. Ridiculous and HORRIBLE!
- Planning the wedding remote was not easy either as I had to work with several people over and over and would have preferred to just work directly with all the vendors myself. I asked repeatedly for a new remote wedding planner as I did not like mine and they refused.  She told me NO for everything I asked for as  a bride. Instead of telling me no, offer me something else or offer for me to pay. It was horrible.
- Upon arrival, I was happy to see the person I met a year ago when I planned my wedding, but unfortunately, she herself was very disorganized as well as the remote planner. They never told me I would have to change the location of the reception until the day I arrived, and I was planning the wedding for a year. 
- When I stayed a year ago, I did a make up trial in the spa- and it was horrible, so I do not recommend anyone to pay for this service either. I did my own make up and eye lashes.
- When I asked for chips and guacamole for my guests at 11pm at my reception, we were told yes... but at 11:30 when I asked if we could get it again, we were refused.
- VIP concierge could not help my husband and I get a car.

I have never been told no so many times in my life. We left this resort and went to the AM Resorts line, Zoetry resort. The Zoetry was an amazing 5 days and they never told me no, even when my husband had the wrong attire, they gave us everything we could have dreamed of. It made Paradisus seem rude and not worth the money. My wedding venue looked beautiful and I ended up enjoying my wedding day with my guests and great service staff. That said, the management of this hotel needs to get their act together! Especially for a large 30+ party like I had provided to you.  I gave you well over $50K of services and expected more. I recommend folks to stay at a Dreams/Secrets resort going forward and not a Paradisus. The Gazebo here is beautiful, as are the grounds, the food is good and some of the wait staff, but it stops there. Cleanliness, Concierge, etc are horrible. Michael Jackson show is the best and only show I liked too.

reviews.author: nic0lej100
reviews.title: I will definitely be back!!  Amazing resort and exceptional service!
reviews.text:
Pros:  Everything!  The resort is beautiful and very clean. The lobby and main tower is gorgeous with the flowered vines hanging down, and the smell of the flowers was incredible! The staff was very friendly, helpful, and made us feel like royalty. Alexander and Rodrigo took excellent care of us by the pool. They made sure we had a full drink all the time, and they also brought us food whenever we were hungry. The guacamole was delicious! Maybe the best I have ever had. All the bartenders at the swim up bar were great! Christian was especially wonderful!  They had a great sense of humor, made us creative drinks and shots, and made sure everyone had a good time! The food in the buffet was very good for every meal, and again, the service was spot on. We asked specifically for our waiter, Pueblo, after the first morning because he was so friendly and took great care of us. We only made it to the Market Grill one night, but the food was amazing!! The beach was beautiful and was kept very clean and well maintained; they had servers on the beach, as well, and they did a great job! The Activity Staff were friendly, fun, and tried to get people involved as often as possible (and many times were successful!). We did not have any complaints or bad service our entire stay!  
Cons: If I had to give 1 con, it would only be that there wasn't a hot tub, and the pool water was a little chilly...however, when the weather is sunny, warm, and gorgeous, does the water temperature really matter all that much? Nope.

reviews.author: norphano
reviews.title: Paradisus Quality Once Again
reviews.text:
We have been going to Paradisus resorts for three years now and along with this one have tried Playa Del Carmen and Punta Cana. The is an older hotel rebranded into a Paradisus, so it did not have the same modern/newer feel that the others ones we had been to had. That said, it is still a very beautiful and well maintained property. The lobby and entrance area has a very impressive view once entering the building. 

The staff is consistently very friendly, the food across all restaurants and meals is amazing, pool areas are good with a lot of cabana and chair availability, beach area is consistently nice as Cancun beaches are, kids club was great and the kids loved it. The rooms were a bit dated, but we spend so little time there that it wasn't the end of the world for an overall amazing vacation. 

It would not necessarily be our first choice if we were to go back to a resort a second time since we thought the Playa Del Carmen and Punta Cana properties were nicer, but would definitely recommend none the less for someone who has not been and wants a good all inclusive resort in Cancun.

reviews.author: conniemaet
reviews.title: Friendly clean resort
reviews.text: music was very loud at night, TV keeps turning its self on, had it happen 4 times one night. Hot water didn't work the 2nd day but was fixed, had water drip from AC one night. Otherwise it is a very beautiful place with extremely friendly staff inside and out. Pools were very clean and inviting.

reviews.author: K3298IPsteve
reviews.title: extra ordinary beach
reviews.text: the water was amazing.  traveled to area for 35 years and were very impressed with the beach, property, dining, and staff.  the beach is maintained/drug each morning and absolutely pristine by the time you get out there.  it's an older property, but it is very hard to find an area of property that hasn't been lovingly tended to.

reviews.author: BRuss97
reviews.title: 2nd Time to Paradisus
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun, overall, is a fantastic resort. The grounds are meticulous, the pools are beautiful, the rooms are very well kept and the scenery is beautiful. I can't say enough about the poolside service--they were very attentive and seemed to always be asking us if there was anything additional we needed. As part of Club Melia, we did have access to a poolside cabana for two days and it's AWESOME. If you can swing it and are willing to pay some extra to get a cabana--it's worth it. 

If there are any complaints, they relate to our bed and the food service at the restaurants. The bed in the rooms are fairly uncomfortable and hard. After the first night, my back hurt and my wife's hips hurt (and we're in our 40's). As for the restaurants, that had to be the biggest disappointment....with the exception of the Naos buffet in the mornings. We ate at Blue Agave the first night we were there on the all-inclusive package and it was fine.  Nothing spectacular, but nothing to particularly write home about. The second night, we ate at Enso--outside by the pool. While the appetizers were fairly good (the asian wings were delicious); the noodle dishes were not. They were drowned in a sauce that was not very tasty and there was very little meat in the dish. Desert was disappointing as well. As part of the all-inclusive, you are encourage (required?) to have dinner reservations. Our "butler" had stopped by on our first day to take our reservations, but when we got to the restaurant on the 3rd day (Vento), we were not in the system and the hostess called to check on our next evening's reservations as well--which, according to her, were not in the system. It turned out to not be a huge deal because there wasn't a particularly big crowd there that night, but it was still a hassle. The food at Vento was quite possibly the most disappointing. Not very flavorful, incredibly small portions (yes, I know tapas are small portions...but these seems ultra small). The service at these first three restaurants was great, but the food was not.  The last night we ate at Bana in the main lobby. This, unfortunately, was the biggest disappointment overall. Not only was the food mediocre, the service was terrible. It took at least 20-30 minutes between "courses" to get our food or drinks refreshed. We decided to not stay for dessert.

Overall, as I said before, Paradisus was a wonderful vacation for my wife an I and is very well suited for families as well. The all-inclusive package is worth it--if only for the fact that you don't have to worry about money and paying at every turn. If you're a foodie and are looking for a culinary adventure, then this probably isn't your best choice...

reviews.author: Peter Krzystek
reviews.title: Paradisus Stay (Feb. 1 - Feb.5)
reviews.text:
Have stayed several  times before. Had another wonderful experience. Food was excellent - we ate at Fuego (order the Peruvian fish which is a paella dish ), Brazilian Steakhouse, Vento and Mole (order the soup and shrimp dish). Service was excellent all around and very pleased. 
We dined at 7 pm - made reservations ahead of time without any issues. 
New additions from other years - Nespresso  Espresso Bar, activity sheets and posting board by pool, and evening entertainment. 

Found the staff attentive and polite - be sure to reward them for good service- the smile and attentive goes along way. 

One negative - pillows not to our liking -one too soft and one too hard.
Wi-Fi worked w/o any problems. I was able to work efficiently while there.

Take the city bus for shopping - 10.5 pesos / person (.60) 

We reserved an oceanview king bed. At check in, we were informed they only had a room with 2 doubles for the evening - we moved the next day without incident. 

Would strongly recommend - the beach and beach huts a real plus versus other hotels that have beach chairs lined up in rows without any shade. 

Remember - you are in Mexico and need to adjust their pace and culture.

reviews.author: Daniel G
reviews.title: Second time here, and I will definitely be back!
reviews.text:
The Paradisus Cancun is an amazing hotel, the service, cleanliness, food, and people are all 5 stars. From the minute you check in, to when you leave, you will have a great time. The restaurants are all amazing, the grounds are beautiful, the staff is always friendly and you can tell they will go the extra mile for you. This is my second time at this resort, and I am already planning on next year to return. Definitely definitely do the royal service upgrade, it comes with a bunch of great perks (private beach and restaurants, priority reservations) and the best part of it is the butler. This person will ensure your stay is great, and will go to great lengths to make sure you want for nothing. Ours was Juan, and he was awesome and I will most certainly be requesting him next year. I cant recommend this resort high enough, if you have any questions feel free to ask. 

-Dan Gross

reviews.author: valipr
reviews.title: Amazing Holiday!!!!!
reviews.text:
We had the best holiday ever!!! Although the Air France had lost our luggages, concierge staff have been so helpful and...we forgot about it.
There are no words to describe the care from Chef Moises Garcia and Manager Alejandro Mallardo, special people who treat us like their friends and made us feel so welcome!!! They made our holiday a blast!!!!
It's hard to name one restaurant, because all of them are exquisite, but most special for us are Mole, Fuego and Enzo. Really, the best cuisine ever!!!! Nevertheless, main restaurant Naos has great food and Market Grill also.
Waiters are all well trained, know English and are ready to help with a big smile not on the face but from their heart (we've felt it!)
We think that Paradissus Cancun is the best choice for an unforgettable holiday!
Gracias de verdad!

reviews.author: Sandra M
reviews.title: We went to Paradisus cancun for my Birthday, we went from Januart 31st- February 4th, we stayed 4 nights.
reviews.text: We had an amazing time at this hotel. The rooms were emaculate and very nice. The service was excellent. The people who work there were so nice, they always greeted us with a hello when they saw us in the hallways, they went out of their way to make us feel welcome. We rented a day bed on our 2nd day there,  and our hosts Sofonia and Jesus were so attentive, they always made sure we were good with drinks and food, etc. The food was amazing. They had great shows at night also. My husband and I would definitely come back to this hotel for vacation. I also liked that it was a family friendly hotel.

reviews.author: 591akig
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: I think everyone should try Paradisus resorts, it was amazing!!! The service was excellent, the room was cleaned everyday, very nice area, thank you for everything that you did for us!! Don't miss Paradisus!

reviews.author: Wendy R
reviews.title: hotel staff
reviews.text: The hotel staff was amazing!  Sofonia & Jesus, both pool/bar staff were attentive and never let us want for anything. The recreation staff were fun and entertaining and interested.  One morning when I didn't get up for zumba, one of the guys approached me to find out if I was ok.  The staff at the concierge desks were helpful and polite.  One day I complained about the beach bathroom being clean, and the next 10 days the facilities were immaculate.  All in all the staff is wonderful and they made our stay very enjoyable.

reviews.author: Jacqueline N
reviews.title: Pick and choose your battles
reviews.text: The distance from the airport to the hotel was perfect (15 minutes).  Check in was seamless.  Staying the main building is definitely a great location.  The hotel and rooms are very clean.  A couple of hiccup in the room; safe did not work and the bathtub would not drain.  Other than that the room was always well cleaned.  The pool area was not hosed down every night so if someone dropped a drink the day before it would certainly be there if it doesn't rain.  Pool service was by far our best experience.  In my experience going to all-inclusives for many years, the bartenders tend to be slow and inattentive at times.  NOT hear, all the bartenders at all the locations were friendly and fast.  We had the pleasure of having Sofonia, Carlos and Jesus cater to us by the pool the whole time we were there.  They were so kind and knowledgeable on the different tequila.  We are both not big tequila drinkers but they introduced us to a few different ones and were quite surprised that we did enjoy them.  Our massages were incredible; we had a couple massage (unfortunately I only remember one of the two names of the two women, Caroline and ?) but I do think they work as a pair so it would be easy to find them  It was one of the best ones I have every received.  Negative - The omelet line in the morning was slower than a snail.  You can never get the same name or type of red wine when you have dinner nor can you call the same vodka brand at different bars.  We had an ocean view room but if you are sitting down on the patio chairs they provide you, you are unable to see the ocean.  The whirlpool in the spa was cold and some of the jets did not work and if they did work I would need someone to press the button on for me because it is too difficult.   The tennis courts needs to be repaved and new balls should always be readily available (dead balls) were given to us.  We decided to golf and rent the clubs from the hotel.  You should be a shame of yourself for even charging $30 for those clubs... they were not worth $3.00

reviews.author: Gumaro R
reviews.title: Summer Vacation
reviews.text: Great place to stay 100% satisfied especially in the restaurant Naos the server Kavil is the best wish I can have that type of service here in the USA, the room was clean, beach area lots of sand and plenty of room, what about the pool bar another spectacular service the bartender would not stop serving us drinks which I can not complaint they made sure we felt like kings which I did feel that. I would definitely return to that hotel and I do recommend

reviews.author: Anna H
reviews.title: We only stayed one day but found it just nice...
reviews.text:
After spending an amazing week at the Hyatt Zilara our flight back home was cancelled and the Hyatt was sold out...so we spent one night at the Paradisus...it was nice...but HUGE and it felt that way...the food was nothing like the zilara and of course all the restaurants were full so we had to eat at the buffet, the food was not hot and they layout was confusing.   
The hotel is beautiful, like a rain forest and nice lounge areas.  We needed money for tips but they wouldn't give change for a $20 without our passports and the elevator took so long we didn't bother.  The main building is VERY noisy but the beds are Very comfortable and the AC worked well.   Beware there are bars not included in all inclusive as well as restaurants. 
It is advertised as a 4 star resort but felt like a 2.5-3 at best.  A nice place if you don't mind LARGE resorts.

reviews.author: Lisa W
reviews.title: Amazing service and vacation
reviews.text: Wow!!! What a vacation!! We stayed in the Royal service, which is a must!! Rosanna our butler was wonderful and made sure our every need was take care of, She is such an asset to the hotel!! All of the service we encountered at this resort was top notch!! If you want to be pampered this is there place to go!! A few standouts....William was great at the pool area made sure we had our desired Bali bed. The servers at the RS pool second to none!! Thanks to Victor and Alberth they were amazing and every 15 minutes that elapsed they were checking on our comfort!!! Pool aerobics with Freddie were also great!! We had an issue with electricity in the hotel but it was handled to out complete satisfaction by Juan Carlo in the Royal service...I believe the true testimont of a property is how they handle adversity and resolve situations and this was handled to perfection!! We were so satisfied we almost forgot what the problem was!!  The food at this resort was second to none and the standout restaurants were bana and Brazilian grill... Awesome!! All of the bartenders and waiters work so hard to satisfy so we tipped everyone, they completely deserved every cent!! My only advice would be keep the avenue bar open later, The only downfall of this hotel is the nightlife its limited... maybe keep the avenue bar open until 1 am and heat the hydrotherapy pool in the spa.......Bottom line, will definitely come back in a heartbeat!! The atmosphere, food and service was pure perfection and I'm VERY picky!! One final note....we left a wallet in the safe when we changed rooms and they tracked us down to return it!! Just awesome service ☺️

reviews.author: Z2827PHpatricks
reviews.title: Great Stay, very relaxing
reviews.text: Very relaxing stay. Only stayed 3 nights but it was well worth it.  Will return some day for at least a week.  Everything available when you want it with all inclusive package.  Don't think I'll ever not get that option from now on.  Highly recommended

reviews.author: Stacy H
reviews.title: We look forward to returning.
reviews.text:
We really enjoyed our stay at Paradisus Cancun.  Our family went for a week during Winter Break 2015.  The majority of our time was spent on the beach or poolside which is exactly what we wanted.  This property to me is the perfect mix of fun at the pool but the music wasn't screaming all day, great food and wonderful service. 

Our favorite server was KAUIL in the Restaurant Naos.  He was amazing, a real pleasure.  He moved around the dining room & within his section with purpose and it was to serve his guests as if we were in his home.  Thank you for your dedication Kauil.  

Our butler was Bladimier.  He made sure our reservations were made and that we had everything we needed to make our experience the best it could be.  He always seemed to be present and available to us.  We appreciated everything he did for us.         

We look forward to returning in the future.

reviews.author: C Calzoncit L
reviews.title: Anniversary get-away!
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time! Food was amazing!  Excellent pools and night life. We visited Red Lounge Club every night! Alma and Eden do an excellent job!!  Great music/dancing. Alma always made sure we had our drinks waiting for us when we finally got off the dance floor for a breather!  We plan to return to Paradisus Cancun in the near future.

reviews.author: Ki L
reviews.title: excellent services
reviews.text:
excellent services,good foods
these are the names of the peoples did an excellent jobs 
1 - wilbert at naos 
2 - hector at the club melia beach side 1/24-31 2016
3 - daniel at fugeo 
4 - nacy at club melia front desk 

this resorts should not allow peoples wearing flip flop at the night time to any restaurants,
in paradisus punta cana they dont allow guys wear short at the dinner and no flip flop
peoples should dress nice and not too casual at the night time

reviews.author: gabps
reviews.title: Family vacation!!
reviews.text:
We went to Paradisus Cancun the week of January 30th and had a great time! I am tailoring this review for those travelling with infants as we all know that can be different than travelling with kids over the age of two!  This resort is great for travelling with babies as it is quiet and very relaxing. For those travelling with kids over the age of two, it might not have enough play areas, as the playground is very small and they dont have a splash pad or slides - i can see kids getting bored. But for babies it is great! 

Room: our room  was in pyramid 4, which is the best as it is quiet. Pyramid 3 is the main one that has the nightly shows so i can see how that could be a bit loud.  we got a room with two double beds as i was not sure our 8th month old would be ok sleeping in a different crib, so slept with me in one of the beds.
