The room has a seeting area as well that is great for enjoying the room service (which we used quite a bit).  Two things to note is that the air conditioning and the toilet are loud, so if you have a baby that is sensitive to noise when they sleep, you might have to accomodate for that.  The bath tub is deep, and i couldnt figure out how to use the plug, so for baths i just used a hand towel to plug the bath. As well there is a hand shower with a long cord that you can use to bathe the baby easily.  

Food: the food was good.  The buffet has a great variety and we were able to try the restaurants Mole and Vento.  Mole was by far our favoret food.   We never had to wait in line and were able to make reservations to the a la carte restaurants. The one thing to note is that the buffet opens for lunch at 12:30pm, which might be a bit late for those babies taking naps.  The Market Grill opens for lunch at 11am and it is supposed to be a la carte, but the entire time we were there they had a small buffet with fajitas, handburgers and pasta - simple but good.  But it can get boring if you are only doing lunch there.  Dinner service at the buffet and all the a la cartes start at 6pm, which again can make it difficult if you have an early sleeping time for the baby.  Our normal sleep time for our baby  is around 6:45pm (after a bath and bottle ) so in order to eat dinner at a restaurant we had to make his bed time an hour later at 7:45- he is an easy baby so we were able to do it but it mght be tough for some.  We packed our own baby food, but there is so much fresh fruit here that you can easily find things for a baby.   The servers even offered to have some special pasta made for our son. 

Beach and pool: the beach is amazing!  So beautiful.  It is not accessible with a stroller, so we just carried him when going to the beach.  The pool is very large and accessible by stroller.  It has a deep end and shallow area.  It is a bit cold, but our son was okay in the water, and he swam every day. We never had any problem getting chairs by the pool. 

Shops: i just want to add that the shop sells diaper ( not all sizes but some) wipes, swimming dipers and other small things you might need. 

Service: the service is amazing!  Anytime we needed anything we were helped right away, from getting our mini fridge restocked to changing the time of the cleaning of our room to not interfere with our son's nap time - everyone was extremely Accomodating. The internet was great in our room - we never had a problem with it.  One of the only things is that one of two elevators in the mail lobby was down for a few days so going up and down took longer than usual.

Overall we had an amazing trip and highly recommend it!

reviews.author: Ryszard R
reviews.title: Excellent holidays time we had with family
reviews.text: i was staying in Paradisu Cancun resort with family for 10 days. Overall experience is really excellent from the quality of service, variety and wuality of food to all services which we experienced during the stay. I'd recommend this place especially for couples as you migh have here really great time

reviews.author: ArneyBelfast
reviews.title: Hospitality at its finest
reviews.text: Stayed at Paradisus for twelve nights. The Hotel was fully inclusive,with lots of choices of various cuisines.The standard of food and service was of a very high standard. On our first night my wife and I struggled to sleep , various reasons jet lag and the fact our bedroom was above the foyer bar.Next Morning Thomas at reception was fabulous no fuss no negativity just got the job done and moved us immediately . Before I finish I have to mention Alberto the man who looked after my wife and I ,not only our luggage but advice and recommendations . He is first point of contact and he fulfills this role in a very Professional fashion. I would highly recommend this delightful Hotel.

reviews.author: 451donalde
reviews.title: Fantastic hotel
reviews.text: Paradises can only be explained as paradise . All  staff were brilliant . Special thanks goes to gaudencio  our waiter in nanos . It was our ruby wedding and he helped to make it very special . Had an amazing ocean view. We went in all the a la cartes  restruants  several times . Food can only be explained as amazinging . Hotel was like a rain forest . Can't wait to go back  again . All staff were brilliant . No complaints  at all .

reviews.author: Anya S
reviews.title: Beautiful winter excape
reviews.text:
This resort is beautiful. The beach is long, wide, nicely kept. The food was excellent. Too many restaurants to get to try them all, but everything we had was delicious. 

We did opt to do the time-share presentation, because we knew there was no way they could convince us to buy. In exchange for 90 minutes of our time we got $150 to use toward excursions and a 4-day/3-night package to use next year. For us it was worth it. 

We stayed in tower 5, 6th floor. Room was clean, quiet, had all the amenities you need (hairdryer, safe, toiletries)

The food was fantastic. We ate at (Fuego, Bana, Mole, Market Grill, Blue Agave) for dinners. Each had wonderful food and service. We made reservations each night, but often went to the restaurant early to see if we could be seated sooner, and were always seated immediately. 
Blue Agave, no reservations needed, is a great option for the day you arrive. They open at 4:00. They only serve tacos & quesadillas, but they are fabulous. 
We ate at Naos for breakfast & lunch a few times. The buffet is extensive, plenty of options. We loved the fresh juices in the morning. I'd also recommend the quesadillas at lunch & the tamales at breakfast.
Market grill is also open for lunch, some days it's a small buffet (but you can also go inside and get food from the Naos buffet - the two are connected) other days they have an a la carte menu. The beef fajitas on the buffet are wonderful.

With regard to food, my only complaint is the limited options for eating at the pool or beach. The Sunset Grill is the only place you can get food to go and they serve mainly American snack food (hamburgers, chicken wings, pizza, wraps). There is always guacamole & salsa and the seafood salad is very tasty.
The drinks were fine, a little sweet for my personal taste. Servers on the beach were attentive. 

We had no issues at all, other than key cards that had to be reset a few times, but that's pretty minor. 

As far as dress codes: 
Noas & Market Grill (for lunch) - anything goes as long as men wear a shirt & women at least have a coverup on over their bathing suit. Flip flops are fine.
All other restaurants, including Market Grill for dinner (Except Tempo) - Women: shorts, capris, dresses, sandals    Men: shorts, t-shirts or polos, sandals (I saw a few in flip-flops but the dress code says no to them). Long Pants & Closed toe shoes were not required.

We booked transfers & day trips through Best Day. There is a representative in the lobby each day.

reviews.author: Shawn H
reviews.title: Amazing Resort
reviews.text: Beautiful Resort, Amazing Pools with the White sandy beach right there.  But it's the service that makes this resort Extraordinary!  The service was amazing.  The staff is super friendly and definitely want you to enjoy your vacation and experience at Paradisus.

reviews.author: Egle J
reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text:
The hotel feels like 2.5 stars and definitely not 4.5 as they claim. It lacks in all aspects. Upon check-in they gave us an old ugly room in the basement of the hotel facing the main street, after I complained they gave us another ugly outdated room with dirty sofa and broken cabinets, very ugly. Then after I screamed on them that their rooms are nothing like displayed in Expedia pictures, they gave me a third room, supposedly "nicer". We didn't want to adventure through more rooms so we stayed there. The room was outdated, bathroom (with one sink) old, bathroom door broken with no lock at all, light switches broken, dirty towel, no bathrobes or slippers... Also the room was in the main pyramid, we (with 2 kids) couldn't sleep half of the night due to noise, loud music and drunk people screaming in hallways. 
The buffet was the worst I've ever experienced (we've been to Mexico 15+ times), food for lunch and dinner cold and really really bad, with very little options.
Pools cold and very old. Service OK. We are experienced Travelers who travel to Cancun, Rviera Maya 2-3 times a year and stay only at 4/4.5/5 star hotels. We know how 4.5 star hotel feels like, and this was a total dump, 2.5 stars at most. 
Total disaster, I wish I could get my money back.

reviews.author: Victoria M
reviews.title: Love this place!
reviews.text: We stayed here from Dec 29 to Jan 5, and it was an absolutely amazing vacation. We did not have Royal Service, but we still managed to enjoy ourselves ;) The food was plentiful and delicious, as were the drinks. I loved that wine was included with dinner, as I am a wine girl at heart. The staff were very helpful, and went out of their way to help us even when we asked for things that weren't really their jobs. The pool was beautiful and we loved how the beach was just steps away so we went back and forth between the two all day. Yes, it was annoying that people reserved chairs at 6 am, but we always managed to find a spot somehow. I love the ambiance of the whole hotel - they have aromatherapy in the common areas, so you get the scent of orchids or roses when you walk through the doors. At night they lighted incense in the inside gardens, which was also very nice. The rooms were very comfortable, and the bathrooms were nice and large. The shower had a rain showerhead, the toilet and bidet were separated by a door so more than one person could use the bathroom at the same time. Oh, and the toiletries were by Thierry Mugler and smelled divine - what a lovely touch! The balcony was lovely with an amazing view. Ahhhh, I cannot wait to go back. It really was paradise.

reviews.author: josephpN3865WC
reviews.title: Something for Everyone
reviews.text: A great place to party, or a great place to take the family. You don't see many places that offer so many options whether it's food/drink or activity. The entire staff is friendly, especially Christian at the pool bar, Sergio on the beach, or Cesear at Market Grill. It was relaxing and exciting all at the same time.

reviews.author: Marvin E
reviews.title: Overall great experience. Not too crazy, but still very fun and relaxiing
reviews.text:
I had gone early Jan. 2016. The hotel is beautiful inside and it is fairly easy to navigate and walk around. It's big, but not too large where you feel like you will get lost. All the restaurants, bathrooms, and our rooms were extremely clean and tidy.

Service here is excellent. Servers truly want to make sure you have a great time during your stay. At the breakfast buffet, our servers Pascual and Jaime were great! They were excited to see us every morning and they made sure all of our needs were met. It helped with making our overall experience very comfortable.

Wifi sucks in the rooms. It's in the main parts of the building.

Access to the beach is easy and fun. Food overall was generally good.It wasn't the best. The food is very rich and so you will feel very heavy and tired. I recommend the Brazillian steakhouse and Fuego for dinner. the taco restaurant for late night snacks.

Make sure to check out the nightly show. Go there early to get good seats!

reviews.author: Mark B
reviews.title: Paridisus Cancun
reviews.text: Lovely place, beautiful plants, streams, walks, etc. Butler service was very attentive but was only on duty beginning at 3:00 PM each day. Pool butler (Daniel) was superb. Had a clogged drain but was quickly fixed. Restaurants offered unusual menus and were very good. Bali beds around the pool were fantastic. Check-in was a little slow but we were offered a room to change. Overall experience was very positive.

reviews.author: Bctbct
reviews.title: A beautiful hotel and excellent service
reviews.text:
We loved our stay in the Royal Service area of this hotel.  The buildings are extraordinarily beautiful, with towering central interior courtyards full of gorgeous tropical vegetation and koi ponds. The Royal Service area has its own building and courtyard with food always available and private butlers for all.  it is an adults-only area, which we appreciated, with its own pool, beach restaurant, and beach area.
The facility was scrupulously clean - people were constantly polishing the floors and washing the windows.
The food was good - it varied from good to excellent depending on which of the many restaurants you went to.
I think it is worth the extra money to get an ocean-view room.  The lagoon-view rooms were the same, but the view is nothing special.  The ocean view is special.
I want to put in an extra word for the employees.  I have never been to a hotel where the service has been so polite, friendly, and helpful.  They were truly outstanding.

reviews.author: Christine S
reviews.title: Too Beautiful for words
reviews.text: The room overlooking the golf course and lagoon was incredible to wake up to each morning.  The beds were so comfortable and the room was spotless.  All of the hotel staff were friendly, helpful and fun.  Pablo greeted us each day for breakfast with superb service.  Oscar (bar manager), your staff are top notch, especially Erich, Christian, Alexander and Rodrigo.  Thank you so much for a wonderful time.  We will be back again.

reviews.author: cakes2005
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text: Wonderful resort. Had everything for adults as well as children.  Great restaurants with a lot of variety of food.  Would recommend this resort.  The staff and servers were so accommodating and went out of their way to make sure you were happy.  Can't wait to go back again.

reviews.author: aam154
reviews.title: Great Beach Average Food
reviews.text:
The beach was amazing and the facilities were great. Everything you could possibly need for our stay was provided. 

The service was also excellent. The only problem I found was that the food wasn't worth the price paid. If you like to travel to eat then this probably isn't the right place.

reviews.author: MPeg39
reviews.title: Butler Ramon was a STAR but resort didn't shine!
reviews.text:
We stayed as a family here Nov 2-7 and enjoyed it but a return trip is unlikely.  The butler staff were exceptional and deserve a 5 STAR rating! Ramon, Josheu and Rodolfo were key to making our trip a success. They went above and beyond with service and were fully engaged in what they do. They are over qualified in customer service for the calibre of this resort. If you do visit here, please request them. Since I'm taking the time to write this 2 months later, you can see how impressive they are!!

This resort needs a transformation. The rooms are very dated but have lovely views and balconies. I liked that it was a small resort and would consider coming back if they upgraded the overall decor and amenities as it's so convenient to the airport and the setting is beautiful.  The food was good for buffet style but decreased in quality throughout the week. Our favorite was the Market Grill  - the big hit for us and the boys (12 and 14). We had a cabana which was essential. The same depth pool made it tough to just hang out in since I'm not tall. I ended up doing some work and the wifi was horrible. I couldn't work in my room and had to move around the public hotel areas to try to get a consistent connection.
The golf was a joke and was actually a factor we booked this resort so the boys and husband could have some fun together. As per other reviews, the evening entertainment doesn't have adequate seating. There was ongoing construction and on the day it rained everything was leaking. My limited interactions with the front desk were less than stellar. The family concierge area is dark and dingy which is not what people want to see on a sun vacations. It should be bright and inviting. The  game room needs some serious investment.
Apart from the super butler service (thanks again)  I don't have anything to say to encourage travellers to book and stay here when there are plenty of better options unless they make major improvements.

reviews.author: donald607
reviews.title: Short Trip
reviews.text:
I don't read reviews because vacation is what you make of it. unfortunately 90% of bad reviews are done by people who will NEVER be satisfied with anything or bored house wife or husband.  
I have been traveling to Mexico and the Caribbean for over 20 yrs now and really don't like Cancun. This hotel and the service is the best we have encountered besides the Ritz Carlton. We were blown away, paid a few bucks more for royal service and im telling you it was outstanding. I will be trying the other 2 Paradisus soon.

reviews.author: Renee M
reviews.title: 50th birthday celebration
reviews.text: This trip was a last minute decision to celebrate my husbands 50th. Upon arrival our room was decorated with balloons, there was birthday cake and a bottle of champagne waiting for us. What a nice surprise. Everyone is very friendly and helpful. The resort is immaculate. Samuel, who works in the gym, was very attentive to my husband and helped him with his workouts every morning. Our servers by the pool, Sofonio and Jesus, were excellent. They knew what drinks we liked and would bring us drinks without even asking. They were excellent and went above and beyond. Restaurants were delicious and the buffet was extremely clean and had a wide variety. I would definitely recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Kirsten
reviews.title: Great Beach but property needs to be updated/upgraded - disappointed
reviews.text:
I had a room in tower 2 near kid zone with parking lot view :( which I did not mind since I was here for work purpose and not on family vacation. 
The thing that really bothered me was there was no hot water at all in the shower - it was only lukewarm - no matter how much time I let it go to get hot water. I guess because my room was at lowest level. 
Another biggest disappointment was there was a hole in the bathroom roof which had a leak, yikes…

Do I need to say more?

Also heard from my other friends who had room in the main tower was that it was very loud even at 4am and they could not sleep.

I will never choose this place for family vacation.

reviews.author: teresa142017
reviews.title: Great food 24 hrs
reviews.text: Great to meet the pool bar team Chris, Josue,Lalo,Erick, and Rey couldn't have been friendlier top class service. Excellent service throughout the entire place. Would love to go back again soon. We went in January weather was in the low 80's perfect for us.

reviews.author: GeBeLoe
reviews.title: Great Vacation at a really great Place
reviews.text: We love this place.  We did not like the Room they put us in for the first night and changed it without a problem to a much nicer and more modern layout for the remaining nights. Location is excellent, Beach is awesome, Personal is outstanding and always helpful.  Being an all inclusive the food quality at Restaurant Bana was as expected high and always plentiful. Best Mango's I ever had by the way.  Thanks to Oscar, Rodrigues, Jesus and Martin at Bana, Andres and Eder at the Nespresso Bar [what a tread that was and part of the all inclusive too..] and Sergio on the Beach who made sure we where always with a drink.  And many more who always wanted to help.   All in all we did not wanted to leave and certainly will come back.

reviews.author: Samantha L
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Upon arrival I was very happy that the hotel was very close to the airport, located on the main strip. This was a last minute planned getaway booked about a week before we left.. we booked through cheap carribean with the intention of going to a different hotel but they were offering such a good deal at the Paradisus that we figured we try it.. truly an amazing experience! We read all the review about upgrading to the royal service so we did when we got there! Check in was prompt, they accommodated our request and we're very helpful. Food service in the common area was ok.. but royal service areas were on point. The La Palapa restaurant was good with great service!! If you can request Moises he's amazing and full of life with great customer service! Also our butler Rode was amazing, we barely had use for the cell phone we werw given because he made it an appoint to make sure we had everything we needed and reservations ect were taken care of! Overall the is  the nicest hotel we have stayed at thus far, great ambience, customer service and great location. Rooms were modern and well kept. The only thing I would suggest is more staffing in the common areas since the restaurants seemed overwhelmed with the amount of tourist. We stayed at the Barcelona Maya Palace Deluxe in September and the Paradisus has by far been a way nicer experience!

reviews.author: Dee M
reviews.title: Lovely hotel disappointing experience
reviews.text: We are currently staying at Paradisus, the resort and all inclusive has been a wonderful experience. However, we have booked couple months in advance for a King size room which hotel management could not accomodate us but instead they put us in double bed room on the top floor which we were pleased with. 2nd night, our hotel room had no water and maintenance came up and told us to have front desk take care of us..and when we spoke to KAREN at front desk she simply asked why we had no water in our room and told us why bother coming down stairs (as she laughed in our face). Then we asked for management if they could provide us with any assistance and she told us a simple no, and that she could stick us in double bed room (again) on the ground floor. She did not offer us with any inconvenience services which we were very disappointed in after the way we were treated by KAREN. But eveything from the beach, amenities, hotel, and staff was a pleasant stay here at Paradisus.

reviews.author: Adventuresofme
reviews.title: Paradisus knocks it out of the park, again!!
reviews.text: My husband and I recently stayed at the Paradisus Cancun for a long 4 day weekend February 19-22.  We chose this hotel primarily because we had such a great experience at the Paradisus in Punta Cana, DR.  All I can say is...WOW!  I work for Hilton, and the service at Paradisus is second to none.  We booked the Royal Service, and our butler, Rode, was an absolute delight!  We felt welcomed right off the bat at our private check-in where Rode warmly greeted us and offered to get us a cocktail.  We couldn't check in yet (we arrived around 1130am, so no big deal), but we changed clothes and decided to spend some time at the amazing pool.  We hung around the adults only pool, which was just what we were looking for.  The view of the beach is AMAZING - make sure to book the Ocean view room!  But back to the service...Rode not only made all of our dinner reservations, but reserved us a Bali bed, even though we were told they were unavailable.  He just made everything happen - and had a can-do attitude.  He was funny and always made us feel special.  On the last night of our stay, we were surprised and delighted to find chocolate covered strawberries and a bottle of champagne on ice with a bouquet of red roses!  Seriously?!  It was just fabulous. I also remember our pool bar tender, Alberto, who always kept our hands full with a drink - I feel like every time I needed a refill, he was right there.  The bartenders at the Avenue (main bar where the nightlife happens) were also amazing.  They remembered who we were since we were patrons every night - and remembered our drinks.  The housekeepers were very sweet too - honestly every single person we came in contact with was very friendly and warm.  I could go on and on!  Our room was perfect - it was cleaned early in the day with turndown service every night.  The restaurants were all great as well.  Our favorite was Fuego, where I had the best sea bass I've ever eaten.  We had no complaints whatsoever, only that we had to leave last Sunday!  I highly recommend this hotel for anyone - it's ideal for a couples getaway, and I feel like it would be great for families as well.  We definitely will be returning!  Thanks again Paradisus for blowing us away!

reviews.author: mrrhd
reviews.title: The best staff!!
reviews.text: Where do I start? From Karla (our conceirge) to Rogelio, Carlos, Enrique and Karla (provided pool aerobics and other activities). Their service was second to none. They went above and beyond their requirements of their job. They made our stay well worth while!! Overall a very nice resort, a little quiet for our taste. They could have had more entertainment in the evenings.

reviews.author: Kris V
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort!
reviews.text:
My husband and I just returned from a 6 day stay at The Paradisus Cancun.  The hotel was really beautiful!  We stayed in the Royal Service area and I highly recommend paying a bit more for this experience.  We had our own butler (Rode) who was extremely helpful.  The check-in experience was outstanding!  We were greeted with a glass of champagne and were made to feel like VIPs.  Our room was incredible!  We overlooked both the private Royal Service pool and the ocean.  Just spectacular!

My only complain was the food.  The buffet had a wide variety of food, but many of the hot entrees were cold.  The best dining experience was Bana, the sushi restaurant.  The Market Grill (Brazilian steakhouse) was also very good.  The portions are extremely small, so order accordingly.

The resort was very "zen" - beautiful décor and very relaxing and peaceful.  There was not a lot of options for nightlife activity, but honestly, we weren't looking for a party.  The Avenue was fun, but seating was very limited.  We watched two shows during our stay, but had to stand.  

The beach was fantastic!  Staff was incredibly polite and attentive.  Royal services provided covered beach huts poolside for free.  We were able to reserve a hut 3 of our 6 days there.  It was great to have the option to lay out of the sun for a bit.

Our overall experience was really great.  My only complaint was the food.  It wasn't horrible, but it wasn't a 5 rating.  I would highly recommend this resort.  You really can't go wrong.

reviews.author: Nancy S
reviews.title: Phenomenal service!
reviews.text: We just returned from our trip to Paradisus Cancun. This was our third time staying at this hotel and the service just keeps getting better and better! The entire staff is very friendly and helpful. Karina Reyes, our server in the Avenue Bar, is the best! She is very attentive and was always surprising us with new and creative shots! Bumblebee is my favorite! There were six in our group and she made a point of remembering our favorite drinks, so when we came back the next evening, she greeted us with our drinks without us having to order! She took care of us when we were there two years ago, and is one of the reasons we came back! The food is outstanding compared to other all inclusive places that we have stayed and the grounds are kept clean and beautiful. There are always activities going on during the day (zumba, volleyball, soccer, etc.) and the beach is very large. AND free wifi!! We will be back again!!

reviews.author: SLF1979
reviews.title: Amazing family week at the Paradisus Cancun!!
reviews.text:
Just returned from a great week at the Paradisus Cancun! Would highly recommend this resort. I loved the buffet and a la carte restaurants, we dined at a different restaurant every night and all were delicious! Service at all restaurants was fantastic! My kids wanted to go to the kids club and baby club every day, the staff there are amazing (Baby Club: Janette, Lili, Adriana, Rosario. Kids Club: Jacquie, Francis, Paulina, Deya, Luciana and chef Brenda)
Rooms were clean, beach and ocean were beautiful, they have a heated pool and drinks were perfect! Would definitely return!

reviews.author: richardmNYC
reviews.title: Caring staff
reviews.text: Just finished our 4th stay at this spacious Melia resort and found the staff to be consistently caring once again, especially the NAOS restaurant's hostess Gabriela, who was quick to help us with an injury when it occurred.

reviews.author: Slmonroe
reviews.title: So much potential
reviews.text:
Don't get me wrong....  We had a great time.   The hotel is very well kept.  Awesome service (from the wait staff and others who get tipped).  The front desk wasn't as helpful.   The restaurants were very good overall.  Feugo and Vento were are favorites.   Mole was the worst.  Two things really messed up our experience...   First, we reserved a King bed.  We wound up with two full beds.  Because they were at 100% occupancy my wife and I couldn't change.   Next, our room (3453) was two floors above the "Red Room", the hotels discotheque.   From 10pm to 2am every night we tried to sleep through pounding bass and music.  Terrible.  I recommend coming here, but stay in a part of the hotel not among the main atrium.  

Pools and beach are amazing!

reviews.author: Bonniez65
reviews.title: Lacks nightlife
reviews.text: Resort is beautiful. Service is fantastic and the people are so friendly. The evening shows are wonderful but seats are few. Not a good location for it. After that, no night life with music except for one disco(which for older people is not good).

reviews.author: Katia P
reviews.title: Heaven on Earth!
reviews.text: Simply paradise, from food to service, the welcoming nature of people and resort. We cannot say enough, it was one of the most magical places and vacations we have ever experienced. The quality of both people and location played a huge part in it. From our friends in the Avenue bar, Salvador, to our faithful morning companion Oscar, we shall miss you and can't wait to see you next time in Paradise! We felt very welcome and part of the family. Can't say enough... definitely the place to go in Cancun. Will not think twice about coming back!

reviews.author: Happiness150390
reviews.title: Feb 15-26 2015
reviews.text: Great hotel. It was fully booked the week that we stayed there. Stayed in the Royal Section and was a great choice. Hervik was our butler. Did everything he could to make sure we enjoyed our stay. Food in restaurants were great. Buffet was good, not great. Pool in Royal section was heated, but they need to work on the hot tubs. They were colder then the pool! Service was great. The hotel just needs to improve on their night life. Shows were okay, but too small of an area to see them in. It would have been nice to have some music and dancing for all ages to enjoy. Hotel is very cleaned and well maintained. I would return to this hotel again.

reviews.author: Sue H
reviews.title: Beautiful, clean and friendly All-Inclusive Resort
reviews.text:
Have just returned home from a very enjoyable stay at the Paradisus All-Inclusive Resort in Cancun, Mexico.  We appreciated the all-round high standard at this resort, from the cleanliness in all areas, the super friendly staff, the entertainment and high quality, variety and presentation of the food.  We enjoyed an ocean view suite in the #4 tower close to the spa and loved this area as it's quiet and has great views.  We certainly recommend this resort and look forward to returning.  We stayed at the Paradisus in Punta Cana a year ago and loved the high standard at that resort also.

The only negative about our vacation package was with Orbitz and we will NEVER book anything with them again.  On arrival in Cancun we found there were no ground transportation arrangements for us. So, we paid for a taxi to take us to the resort and I sent three emails to Orbitz customer relations over the remaining six days asking them about this.  Did I receive a reply? No. No reply to even one email. They were very discourteous in not responding.  Conclusion:  Orbitz is not providing a complete service with the All-inclusive packages they sell and though there is a customer service email address, don't waste your time sending a communication to them as they will not respond.

reviews.author: Jessica G
reviews.title: Loved it! Can't wait to go back!
reviews.text: We had an amazing time celebrating my 40th birthday at the Paradisus Cancun. We brought our kids and stayed in a Family Concierge room. My parents, SIL and brother came along as well. EVERYBODY was happy with everything. The food was great, scenery and beach were incredible and the service was perfect. Hervick was our butler and we were amazed with how attentive he was. He made us feel like to most important family in the entire hotel!! Our trip was in September 2014, so I'm not sure if Hervick is still there, but would highly recommend him if interested in experiencing the Concierge level. Because of him and the other attentive staff members, we will definitely go back!

reviews.author: Katie c
reviews.title: Relaxing,beautiful all-inclusive!
reviews.text: Nice rooms,good food,friendly staff, and good entertainment! The hotel was beautiful my husband brought me here for my birthday. Nice location right outside the hotel was the bus stop to the mall. The buffet was very good and each of the reservation restaurants were good as well.

reviews.author: ILEANA G
reviews.title: Wedding planning
reviews.text: Couldn't have been happier with our stay. Lourdes from the romance team was excellent catering to all our wedding needs and Eric de la Cruz from the pool bar was the best bartender (want to request him for our wedding reception). Couldn't be happier with our stay and can't wait to be back there in November for our wedding.

reviews.author: sulada
reviews.title: Great Resort with Great Service and Staff
reviews.text: Loved staying here! Would go back in a heart-beat! Amazing location, beautiful beach, excellent service, very clean, Good atmosphere and mood. Large pool and plenty of space and things to do. The nightly entertainment could use a new theater style seating but other than that, everything was perfect!

reviews.author: Jessica S
reviews.title: Fantastic!!
reviews.text: My husband, brother,brother in law and I were just there. We were told about this place by our brother in law and brother. They have been there 5times.....for a reason!!! This resort was worth EVERY PENNY!!!' The rooms,food and service was AMAZING!!!! The beach was like a dream. Never had a problem finding a place to relax. The service was fast and friendly both in the pool and on the beach. The market grill was a great experience. The restaurants were fantastc and every night got better and better. Coco lounge at the beach had a great set up with the lounge and hookah pipes on Bali beds overlooking the ocean. The staff there was very attentive remembering our names from day one. All in all I give this place a 10 out of 10. Everyone I know and those I dont should pay a visit to this amazing resort. Were going back!!!'m

reviews.author: Kris W
reviews.title: Awesome!
reviews.text: We just came back from a long weekend (Thursday-Monday), the resort was great, the service was excellent and so was the food. Want to especially commend the bartenders at the bar Toji, Ernesto and Eduardo! They were so much fun and provided great service! The rooms and the resort were clean, which is a must. No complaints, one suggestion: maybe more games/activities during the day by the pool. Had an awesome time overall!

reviews.author: Blue1309
reviews.title: Amazing place, service a little lacking in some areas.
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of staying there for a week in the Royal Service area of the resort. The views are amazing. The resort itself is very well kept. If I walked by any sort of garbage or drink cups it would be gone within meat minutes. The beaches are very clean aswell as the rooms. My only complaint would be that the service was hit or miss. Some of the servers were great and would attend to your every need. Others would take close to half and hour or even 40 mins to get. All of the restaurants had really good food, but most you had to book a reservation and not very many lunch options aside from the buffet. The reservation system was a little annoying aswell, we were not able to reserve a day in advance. Had to call that day and it was almost impossible to get through to the reservation center. All in all though a great experience. A very nice treat in a beautiful resort.

reviews.author: Kimberly S
reviews.title: True paradise with excellent service
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisius from February 13- February 20th in a family concierge junior suite.  From the moment we arrived until the moment that we left, we were spoiled beyond belief!  The service was fantastic!  All of the staff were friendly and helpful.  They couldn't have done anything more to make our stay any more amazing.  Our butler, Ramon, excels at his job.  He was a very important part of making our stay so memorable!  I highly recommend a vacation at this beautiful resort.

reviews.author: Companion562369
reviews.title: Great hotel shame about the Food
reviews.text: Great hotel service is good, we like to walk outside the hotel but there is nothing right out side but you can get a bus for only 60p each way to the shops and it is a good service. There is only entertainment on for 30 min. each night, The big complaint we had that did not get changed was the temperature of the food in the self service restaurant it was all well well under the 63 deg. it has to be in the UK

reviews.author: YannAtParis
reviews.title: Quality resort at Cancun
reviews.text:
Generally, I'm not a fan of big resorts in Mexico but This one is different !
1) Restaurants and buffets are really very good : the buffet of the main restaurant is really incredible with seafood for instance. Moreover, enjoy to have a lunch or dinner outside !
2) The Beach is amazing : White Sand, a lot of sundbeds and furious waves !

In a Word, a gold expérience for a resort at Cancun

reviews.author: jbailey2014
reviews.title: Amazing Weekend!
reviews.text:
We just returned from a 3 night stay at Paradisus Cancun and had a wonderful time. I traveled with my best friend, but this resort would be great for a family vacation or for couples. The resort was clean, the waiters and workers were attentive and very friendly. We especially liked the Naos breakfast and lunch buffets - Fidel was the best! We stayed on the beach for the majority of our time - but you must get there early (before 9AM) to claim a spot under the umbrella. The drink waiters were so quick and extremely nice. 

We did not leave the resort for the extent of our trip - we literally had everything we needed within Paradisus Cancun. 

This resort is perfect for a quick get away and the service was absolutely amazing! Be sure to notify the hotel if you are coming for an occasion (e.g.: birthday or anniversary). We did not do the royal service, but everyone was more than accommodating with any request we had. 

We will most definitely be back for more!

Jennifer

reviews.author: Steffie681
reviews.title: Great Honeymoon
reviews.text:
My husband and I went here and we loved it. Lots of food and lots of drinks. Very clean, very big. 

There are a lot of excursion shuttles from the hotel and they offer packages.

The spa was amazing...so great..lots of beds..great massages. They had a snack bar ...great bathrooms...the sofa pool and shower was huge.

The beach was beautiful. People stayed by the pool because of the drinks, but we took advantage of both.

They had a lot of food. It wasn't premium but it was still good. I'm a huge foodie, but the food was not the best. 

The atmosphere of the hotel was gorgeous. It was very large and it was like walking into an exotic rain forest, with beautiful streams with fish. 

Our room was pretty big. We had a king size bed, a kitchen with a stove..a table..a nice bathroom..and a Jacuzzi. It was clean and the view from the balcony was great.

There was wine in the room with flowers on the bed.

reviews.author: mj1464
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, great service
reviews.text:
This was our first visit to Cancun and to this resort. We visited from 2/14 to 2/21. Even though we didn't get to the hotel until 2 am due to flight delays, the staff was ready for us and very pleasant for a middle-of-the-night arrival. For reasons unknown to us, we were given a room in Pyramid 3 with a family concierge despite traveling as a couple with no children. But no complaints here. Loved the surprise treats in our room each night left by our butler, Fernanda, and found Oskar and the rest of the staff in the family concierge area to be very helpful. They even provided access to the Royal Service area of the hotel intended for adults only, but to be honest, we preferred to hang by the other 2 pools because we liked the music and liveliness there. We were very impressed by the constant upkeep at the hotel and the cleanliness of the rooms, pool area, and beach. 

We enjoyed our meals at each restaurant we tried (Fuego, Market Grill, Vento, Blue Agave, and Mole). Different atmosphere at each one and good service at each. We especially enjoyed the few nights we hung at the bar within the Bana dining area. Ernesto and Eduardo are excellent bartenders with a good sense of humor and great memory for remembering your favorite drinks while not hesitating to introduce you to some new ones! Our stay was really enjoyable and would recommend this hotel highly. The minor drawbacks were the attempts to sell the Club Melia services (they are very slick at wooing you with a special breakfast or free beach bag - we politely declined and weren't bothered again); the lack of washcloths in the room, although we did eventually get them; and the occasional nighttime noise as guests returned to their room after a late night (just keep the fan on in your room to provide white noise and this problem is eliminated!).

reviews.author: Cheri H
reviews.title: Unforgettable Family Vacation!
reviews.text: What an incredible week we had at the Paradisus!  We felt completely pampered and spoiled the entire week we were there. The staff was extremely friendly and helpful and the resort was immaculate. Definitely worth the money!

reviews.author: Berry M
reviews.title: Royal Service Worth the Money!!
reviews.text: The Royal Service was worth the extra money! Adult only area was perfect for our needs. Sergio was our butler who was more than accommodating. The entire staff was polite and catered to our every need

reviews.author: Gary V
reviews.title: A fun time!
reviews.text:
My wife and I, along with in-laws, stayed at the Paradisus Cancun from February 11th through February 18, 2015.   This was our fourth visit to Cancun, and our third different resort we stayed at.  Overall, we had a great time at the Paradisus.  Here are the high points:  1)  Beautiful beach. The best one we have been on.  Plenty of white sand that extended out at least 1,000' into the water.  2) Great food.  The restaurants were all good, with Ibana (sushi) and Vento (Mediterranean) the best.  Even the poolside restaurant was good!  Room service was also very tasty, with a large selection of food.  3) Service.  Service was good all over the resort.  Big shoutout to Luis Cortez, who took care of us down on the beach. He was always there to refill our drinks and take care of us.  Great job, Luis!  4) Top shelf liquor throughout the resort.  That was awesome! 4)  Great location - close to the airport and to shopping. We landed at 10:00 a.m. on the 11th, and were on the resort at 11:00 a.m.  That was so nice!

My big knock on the Paradisus was the pressure to upsell, especially to buy into Club Melia.  You are assigned a personal concierge the moment you get there, and that is their job- to get you to sit in on a 90 minute hard sell session for Club Melia.  That got old, to the point that we found ways to avoid walking anywhere near the concierge desk.  My only other complaint was that the pool was so cold (the ocean was warmer).  We were told that the pool on the Club Melia side was heated.  Not cool.

Other than the upsell, I would recommend the Paradisus to anyone.  Even though the resort is 24 years old, it is up to date, well kept up, very clean, and in a great location.  We had a great trip, and would recommend the Paradisus Cancun to anyone.

reviews.author: Brenna79
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort to Stay at!
reviews.text: Our rooms were very nice and clean, quiet(we had a VIP suite) which was the VIP tower(tower 5) was so nice. Had our own bar to self serve at, nice apps and breakfast away from everyone else in the resort.  Our rooms were newer and had a porch overlooking the ocean. Staff was very accommodating and nice..food tasted good. Ocean was wonderful! our private suite area also had a heated pool(all other resorts in Mexico I have stayed at don't heat their pools and so they were FREEZING!)

reviews.author: Joy P
reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: We just returned from a 4 night stay at Paradisus Cancun. The interior of the main pyramid was  beautiful, lush and green with plants.  Very relaxed atmosphere with music and incense burning (not overpowering but pleasant). We went to the buffet for every breakfast and lunch and all but one dinner and were pleasantly surprised at the selection of food.  We thought the food was excellent. The waitstaff was also very excellent and always there when you needed a drink or had a question.  We went to Mole restaurant one night which was good, and loved our waiter Rigoberto. The beach was gorgeous.  White sand and beautiful blue warm water.  We were able to walk on the beach for miles. The drinks were STRONG.  We have been to other all inclusives and the drinks are usually weak, not at Paradisus!!  The only negative comment we have is the "sales pitch" when we first got there.  I understand their reasoning, but the salesperson was really persistent in wanting us to have breakfast and listen to their timeshare presentation.   I would definitely return to this hotel again.

reviews.author: Cmblackschleger
reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: We arrived Saturday, wanted an impromptu wedding and they made it happen for Sunday: flowers and photographer! Incredible staff: everyone all smiles and helpful. Jesse, the photographer is very skilled, more than a pleasure to work with. We will be back!!!

reviews.author: BandJandLil
reviews.title: Heavenly!
reviews.text: Paradisus Resort was a wonderful experience. We opted for the Royal Service and were delighted with the attention and care we received from Marcella, our personal butler. She was so responsive and helpful and really enhanced our experience. How could she have known that we were thinking of a relaxing Jacuzzi one afternoon when we returned to the room, and the tub was already filled with towels, robes and slippers nearby! All of the restaurants exceeded our expectations, and it was especially nice to have the Royal Service only restaurant so close to our room -- and the pool. The spa was first class, and the instructors in the drop-in yoga class were excellent. This was our first time at an all inclusive resort, and we couldn't be more pleased with everything about it.

reviews.author: Lizzy D
reviews.title: Amazing Honeymoon!!
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus in the royal service section the first two weeks in February. We would highly recommend paying the extra to stay in this section as it is adults only, you have access to your own private restaurant overlooking the beach for breakfast and lunch, evening entertainment prior to going out for dinner and your own personal butler. Ours was Hector and he honestly couldn't have done enough for us! He helped us book tickets, ran baths for us after we had gone out for the day, decorated the room for our birthdays and was regularly coming to find us on the beach and telling us our dinner reservations for that evening....we literally didn't lift a finger!

The staff are the main reason I rate the hotel so highly, and I would especially like to mention Eddie who was by far the hardest worker there. There are some servers who clearly don't pay much attention unless you tip them, however Eddie went above and beyond each and every time asking us if we needed a drink or food, it was always a pleasure to see him! 

Under royal service you are "guaranteed" a cabana by the pool for two days a week of your stay. I was extremely disappointed to see that our name was tippexed out on the last day that we reserved and saw that certain individuals had a bed every day...clearly again due to being tipped which I found to be extremely disappointing. All the staff on the booking desk for the cabanas were very rude and dismissive and couldn't be bothered to help. 

The food was ok....the buffet food was very cold and for about 5days of my stay I couldn't eat due to a bug I picked up. Mole had the best atmosphere, market grill was ok, vento was lovely didn't go to the sushi one but that's due to personal preferences. 

The evening atmosphere was also a bit dead, after the show finished (in a very small area so only a handful of people can actually see) so wasn't really much to do in the evenings, but was plenty of daytime activities like tequila tasting and yoga. 

Beach was gorgeous, recommend taking a trip to coco bongos and explore the local area, buses are regular, safe and only cost a dollar each way...also take a trip to Isla mujures and take a golf buggy around the island. 

Thanks for a great, relaxing honeymoon!!!! Very sad to have to come home but overall would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Estrada Rony S
reviews.title: enjoyed ourselves immensely!
reviews.text: We had a great time at Paradisus! I could not recommend this hotel more! The service was excellent. The hotel was beautiful and every care was put in to make it a good experience for the guests. For example, at sunset, all the candles were lit in the common areas and evening incense would be lit. This added a lot to the atmosphere. The music that was played in the common areas and the water features added to the ambiance of the entire property. The rooms were bright - unlike the videos we saw on YouTube (just bad videos?). The cleaning staff also worked hard to clean up every day. The food was wonderful in every single restaurant we went to - except for room service. With so many great restaurants, who needs to order room service anyway? We also walked around the shore and confirmed that Paradisus Cancun had the BEST BEACH ever.

reviews.author: Helen-Cascades
reviews.title: Beach Volleyball, Stupendious Service, Restaurants Galore
reviews.text: After having visited Playa Del Carmen twice, we wanted to try a place in the heart of Cancun. This resort delivers with food, entertainment and five-star service. It's a large resort but the servers make you feel like you're the only guests. Ibrahim, host at the main restaurant, was especially helpful. He anticipated our needs and even brought us ice cream from the main restaurant when we dined at the Blue Agave for lunch. Angel and his team of volleyball entertainers kept us playing for hours with laughs and camaraderie. We even teamed up with a guest from Sweden, Marco-who came to the resort alone, on a daily basis. Because of them and the crystal blue waters, we never even went to the pools that were sprawling throughout the resort. There are 9 restaurants and each has their specialty food which made for an international feel. My husband enjoyed, Mole, for their authentic Mexican cuisine. I loved Vento, because of the small plate set up, we got to enjoy about a dozen different "chef's" tapas creations. Our server at Vento was extremely cordial and attentive, I cannot remember his name but it was out of the ordinary like Maxamillian. Please give him his praise for us. Naos had their crew, like Jose and David, working night and day, although they never showed any signs of weariness and were always smiling. Bana, overlooks the atrium and it has a nightly lounge type singer that soothes you into the night. It's an all-inclusive resort but you just can't help but to "give a gift-tip" everyone because they make your trip so pleasurable. The shows were quaint and our favorite was the circus night but they have your usual Michael Jackson night also, which was entertaining. The only drawback was that they don't have billiards tables, there's only a children size table in the family lounge, so don't let the website picture fool you like it did to us. We were told that it's not that popular in Mexico, but I say they need to add it since they attract an international crowd anyways. Also, bring your own pillows! The weather was perfect and only rained once for about 10 minutes even though the forecasts I was receiving before our trip said it was going to be stormy all week. I came back more "sun-kissed" than two co-workers that went on a cruise at the same time, and I used SPF 50. This is a family resort that delivers!

reviews.author: irishtravelerSocal
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: Just returned from the Paradisus Cancun and did not want to leave.  The resort exceeded my expectations.  This was my first trip to this resort. Really enjoyed being in the Royal Service portion of the resort. This section was an adults only section.  You needed your room key to enter.  I enjoyed an adult only pool, beach, and atrium.  The rest of the resort was for families and those that did not wish to partake of the Royal Service.  My friend and I needed a break from our hectic lives.  It was so nice to enjoy the peace and tranquility of an adult only resort.  We only left the resort once and quickly returned.  The service exceeded our expectations and the resort was immaculate at all times.  It is definitely a resort to enjoy.

reviews.author: James c
reviews.title: Great beach and drinks, average otherwise
reviews.text: Went for a business trip, stayed for the weekend when joined by my wife.  Sun and pool and sand and drinking are great.  Keep you expectations in check for other amenities.  Food is OK but hit or miss.  Nine hole par 3 course is fun, bring your own balls and tees

reviews.author: Jerri B
reviews.title: Treated like Royals! Beautiful sight! Looks like something out of a magazine! A+
reviews.text: I was treated as a guest because of my work Windstream held our Windstream Idol competition and celebration here. We were treated as a royal customer which gave us our own "butler" and our own special section of the hotel only for us with extra activities with our very own restaurant just for us along with our very own pool and beach area separate from the other areas.  Our "butler" Tony was very nice and tried to be accomodating, I believe he was fairly new because the cell phone we were given didnt work correctly and we didnt have as much contact with him as we liked. Some of the other fellow employees has "butlers" that drawed them baths with rose petals. There was a little communication issue with some of the cleaning maids but all in all it was a beautiful place and we were treated like royals. We had a stocked refrigerator that was constantly being replenished. They had 9 restaurants with unlimited food and drinks. Pina Coladas were excellent. Be sure to ask for the coconut ice cream! It was out of this world. They had bali beds where you could lay outside. If you plan on going either work on some basic spanish words or download an app on how to translate. Also we downloaded an app that changed USD to pesos. It came in handy a lot! I very elegant and beautiful hotel,

reviews.author: on2thenext1-SM
reviews.title: Pure bliss. A must stay!
reviews.text:
I am going to start with the only negative aspect of this hotel. If you do not book your dinner reservations at least a day in advance, you will not get to eat at the many restaurants. We were able to eat at most of them after tipping to make reservations, but that shouldn't be necessary. The resort is huge and I think the only drawback is that they cannot successfully handle that many people. We also had the royal service package which didn't seem to help with reservations. Nonetheless, throughout this process the staff couldn't have been more accommodating in assisting us with getting a table. The food was absolutely outstanding which is why I stress making sure you take full advantage of the restaurants. The buffet is so so.

As previously mentioned, we had the royal service. Outstanding room in separate quarters of the hotel. There were Procter entrances and pool/beach areas. You can most definitely tell a difference in class with people who stay here. Mainly couples and people on business. It is also adults only which is wonderful. Ask your royal service concierge about the benefits you get with royal service because at check in they were too busy and were not clear. Two most important things you should know - you are guaranteed cabanas for at least two days of your stay. Make sure you take advantage of those. There is also private poolside breakfast for royal service and the menu is excellent. 

I have never been to a resort where the staff looked happy. It would be my guess that their management treats them well. They are the most accommodating, nice, hardworking people. Octavio by the pool was excellent. They never make you feel obligated to tip, but please do. They will go the extra mile and truly deserve it. 

I never like to travel to the same place twice but my husband and I agreed that we will be back next year. Amazing food, gorgeous property, spectacular beach, and kind people. Besides the restaurant reservation issue, I never heard the word no.

reviews.author: Anita F
reviews.title: Paradisus Paradise!
reviews.text:
My husband and I just recently returned from a one week stay at the Paradisus (Feb 8-15,2015)  We had the most wonderful experience at this hotel right from the moment we stepped inside the lobby!  We were greeted by the very friendly and informative staff.  Our flight arrived extremely early in the morning and so we were at the hotel by 7am.   The check in staff were so welcoming and helpful and we were told that we could use all of the hotel amenities and have breakfast, etc. and that if they could have a couple of hours, they would have a room ready early for us! We went for breakfast to the buffet and it was amazing...anything you could possibly want for breakfast is there...fresh, healthy and delicious choices.  We enjoyed our breakfast overlooking the pool and with a view of the beach also.  Then we strolled the grounds and the inside of the hotel and went back to see if our room was ready.  Just as they had promised, we were given an early check-in!!  The inside of the hotel is absolutely beautiful; it smells sooo fresh and floral; it is a tropical garden inside and so peaceful and clean!  Our room was also very clean and we had our own hot tub out on our private patio.  The housekeeping service is very thorough and our room was cleaned everyday as well as a turn down service at night.  And, because it was our anniversary and my husband's birthday, the staff had some special surprises for us!  There were rose petals on our bed in the shape of a heart; balloons and streamers hanging ; some special desserts; and a bottle of sparkling champagne !!  I must also say that the staff were very quick to come and address any problems. For example, our safe wasn't working and my husband called down to inform them about it ,and within about 10 minutes, someone was up to fix it for us.  Anytime extra towels were needed or a different pillow, they were prompt to bring what we needed and they also followed up with a courtesy phone call to make sure we got what we asked for.  
The beach at The Paradisus Hotel is so beautiful!!!  Very long stretch of beach, lots of chairs and excellent service!!  Laura and also Luis were our servers on the beach and I cannot say enough good things about them!!!  They were so friendly and they continually came around to ask if we needed anything else....they brought us waters and drinks non-stop...and they were so much fun!  We were also by the pool a couple of times and received the same service.  Also I give a shout out to the entertainment staff by the pool; especially Angel who did the zumba by the pool and volleyball on the beach; and to DJ Freddy! There are 9 restaurants in the hotel and they are all very good.  Our favourite restaurants were the Brazilian one called "Market Grill" and also the Japanese one called "Bano" and the Latin American "Fuego".    Delicious food, great ambiance, and fast service!  A very big thanks to my most favourite restaurant mangager/waiter Abraham Gonzalez...he made our stay so memorable and we will never forget his kindness and attentiveness to our needs and to our special celebrations!  Another thing the hotel has is entertainment every night; and the shows were very fun and well done!  Just can't say enough good things about the Paradisus Cancun!! We will certainly be back at the hotel one day and I hope it is soon!!!

reviews.author: Janice T
reviews.title: Great time!
reviews.text: We had a great Time in royal service. Our butler Hector made our stay very special.  Royal service is the way to go!  Weather was great, room was wonderful, food was exceptional - a great time!  I would recommend paradisus

reviews.author: Joan M
reviews.title: Heaven on Earth
reviews.text: Just returned from 12 days at this hotel.  I have vacationed here for several years.  As usual, I had a wonderful time.  The hotel is beautiful, there are several very good restaurants and the beach and pool areas are superb!  In addition, the hotel is spotless. Had a great room overlooking the Lagoon, very comfortable bed, big bathroom. However, what really makes this hotel is the staff.  The buffet, Naos, is an excellent choice for both breakfast and lunch.  Such a large selection of food and all so well presented and seating is inside and out.  We usually sat in the same area every day and the service we received from Luis and Ceasar was outstanding.  The hostesses, Sonja and Barbara, were some of the most pleasant people in the hotel.  I must give special thanks to the Manager, Abraham Gonzalez, who went out of his way every day to make you feel like family and assist you in any way he could.  Eric in Bana, Jose in Feugo, and Diego in Tempo were also special people.  We ate at all the restaurants  and had great meals.  My only complaint is that if you stay in the main building, it can be noisy in the evening.  However there are several buildings, all connected, so you will have a choice.

reviews.author: pjkdenver
reviews.title: Outstanding service - Family Concierge and all around
reviews.text:
We have stayed at a number of all inclusives in Mexico including Excellence Playa Mujeres, Secrets Maroma, Barcelo Colonial, and El Dorado Royale to give an idea of our basis for comparison. Also, we traveled with family, ranging in ages from 11 to 70. 

Paradisus definitely ranks up there with these resorts. EPM is still our favorite for adults only, with Secrets a close second, but we would definitely return to Paradisus again for a family vacation (over Barcelo). Here are the particulars of our trip, which I hope you find helpful. 

Food (let's start with the food)
I miss it already :). I had an omelet every day at the Naos buffet, and they were excellent. We were there when the resort was fully booked, so there was typically a line of about 4-5 people for omelets, which was not bad at all. There was something for everyone at the breakfast buffet. We typically ate at La Perla for lunch which is a more limited buffet, but we enjoyed making our own fish tacos there. 

As far as dinner restaurants go, we ate at Market Grille, Mole, Fuego, and Blue Agave. I could not disagree more with the earlier review of the Market Grille. If you like meat, you cannot go wrong here.  We sampled steak, pork, veal, lamb, and chorizo among others, and they were all great. The chorizo was fantastic...highly recommended. If I had to pick one restaurant to go to, it would be Market Grille. Our least favorite was probably Fuego, although the tenderloin there was great. The members of our family who ordered otherwise weren't as happy. Some really great tacos at Blue Agave as well. All in all, the food was fresh and yummy. 

Rooms
We had a junior suite lagoon view, and other than the size, it was fine. It was definitely smaller than the rooms we've had at the other resorts mentioned above (although at EDR we stayed in a casita, so not a fair comparison). The lagoon view was actually quite nice for sunsets. We didn't miss having an ocean view at all as we saw plenty of the ocean from the rest of the resort. The beds were pillow-top mattresses, so pretty comfortable. That's the reason we wouldn't go back to Barcelo as the beds there were not good. 

We were in building 3, and I really don't understand the comments about the noise from entertainment. The entertainment is over at 10 p.m., and we could only barely hear it if we were in our room earlier than that. We were slightly down the hallway, so if our room was on the main atrium that might have made a difference, but still, this was a non-issue for us. We liked the central location of building 3. 

Wifi
Wifi was good in our room. We were able to stream video on Netflix. It can be spotty around the resort, but it's a big resort, so this isn't a complaint, just a reality. I can't remember if wifi was free or just included with family concierge. 

Reserving Pool/Beach Chairs
The reviews that mention the towel game here are spot on. I looked for chairs with shade by the main pool (where the pool bar is) on the first morning we were there at around 7:30 and there were none to be had. On subsequent mornings getting there between 6:45 and 7:00 was sufficient for getting chairs either on the beach or at the pool. There are a few umbrellas to the North of the central beach that are first-come, first-served for Family Concierge or Club Melia (timeshare). These were great spots for beach shade. 

The beach is absolutely beautiful and the water as well. We had seaweed one windy day, but other than that, the beach and the water were incredibly clear.  

Activities
It seemed the resort struggled with activities a bit. They had some activities planned, although sometimes it was hard to tell. At other resorts I've been to, they walk around the pool recruiting people and organize the activities. It seemed like they just let them happen here or not. Barcelo seemed particularly good at that in comparison. 

Golf course
I did play the par 3 golf course a few times. The longest hole is about 120 yards, and most were 90-100 yards. The first time we tried to play it, we went to the Market and they told us it was closed for the day, even though it was absolutely empty (4:00 p.m.). We asked our family concierge butler and he checked for us and allowed us to play. After that, we just walked on. It rarely gets used, and the holes are not clearly marked, but if you are not too serious and just looking to practice your short game, it's fun to do. Be careful on #7, as it is parallel to a heavily trafficked sidewalk and road. It is free to play if you have clubs. It was definitely worth bringing clubs (all you need is a wedge and putter), as it is expensive to rent them ($30 I think from other reviews, and not worth it for the quality of course). We flew Southwest, so didn't have to pay for the extra bag. If you plan to play, you should know that Hole #4 is across the street and not right next to Hole #3 as you might expect. 

Evening entertainment
They are really lacking a central place for entertainment. The other AI's we've stayed at have theaters where they put on shows. The shows there were in a lounge that has a fairly small capacity. 

Overall and service
All in all, it was an excellent place to stay. They were definitely at capacity (over President's Day weekend), and other than chairs being reserved super early and one busy time at the breakfast buffet, I thought they handled the crowd really well. We had the family concierge butler, and it was really nice getting help with dinner reservations, having access to the family lounge, and having someone looking out for our needs. The service we received in restaurants/bars/etc. was outstanding, and was not dependent upon tipping. We would definitely stay there again

reviews.author: andyclippard
reviews.title: All Inclusive
reviews.text: It was a good experience...perhaps a little pricey for what we got!  I have only been to one other all inclusive, which was Beaches in Turks and Caicos.  It had better food, but the beach wasn't as good as Paradisus!

reviews.author: abautz
reviews.title: Great Service!  Gracias Ramon!
reviews.text:
Just returned from a 4 day trip to the Paradisus Cancun with my 15 year old son.  We stayed in a Family Concierge Suite.  What a great room, but the best part was our Concierge Ramon.  Ramon was constantly checking to make sure we had everything we needed, brought bottled water to the room immediately, and even located me on the beach to confirm flight times and return transportation to the airport.  First class service and a big shout out to Ramon.  He also made dinner reservations and left confirmations in the room as well as daily notes and treats.  I do not know if all the family concierges are as good as Ramon, but if you go the family suite route, be sure to ask for Ramon!  Management should be proud to have an employee like Ramon who takes obvious pride in his work - well done Ramon.  The beds in the room were very nice and are among the softest that I have slept on in Mexico (typically very firm beds) and we slept very well.

As for the rest of the review - We had a great get away and really enjoyed our stay.  The beach is great (it is Cancun after all) and the service on the beach was wonderful as well.  We ate at Blue Agave, Vento, Market Grill (at night it is a Brazilian meat on a stick place) and the main buffet.  We enjoyed Market Grill and Vento very much.  Blue Agave was fine and the buffet was ok.  The actual layout and location of the food in the buffet didn't seem to make much sense for traffic flow etc, but was fine.  Waiters Carlos and Andres in the buffet were excellent!  We had a large group with us and everyone said the food was better than previous locations we have stayed in Cancun.  The buffet could be crowded, but we were also there on a holiday weekend with 97% occupancy of the hotel so that was a factor.  Even with the hotel full, you never felt like it was that crowded either in the hotel or on the beach.  The property is very very long so plenty of room to spread out on the beach.  Get to the beach by 8 or so to reserve your Palapa or they will be gone...  They do have covered day beds you can reserve for a fee if you are a late sleeper...

Another suggestion for management would be to tone down the pumped in "scent" into the main atrium area of Building 3.  At times it was really strong and overpowering.  About a 1/4 of what they pump in would be plenty.  

The property is well maintained and very clean.  We did not go into the main pool as it was very cold.  I understand that the adult pool may have been heated but we preferred to hang out at the beach and the ocean...  Again, service was outstanding at the beach and easy to get waters, beers etc.  I especially like that they bring canned beer to you instead of little cups of draft beer.  They also don't give you straws for your frozen drinks that always just end up littering the beach - Well Done Paradisus!!!  The beach area is kept very clean and there are places to recycle your water bottles, cans etc.

We have a group of 22 people on the trip and not one person had any major issues or problems.  It was a wonderful trip and Paradisus is certainly on our list to return to.

reviews.author: AnastasiaOlive
reviews.title: Thank You Paradisus!
reviews.text:
We had a fabulous stay the first week of Feb 2015. We were welcomed promptly in the lobby and escorted to the royal service lobby.   Angel greeted us in the concierge lobby for check-in. He made the process easy and even allowed us to check in early!  Our butler was Rode. He was very attentive. Thank you, Rode for all of your help and kindness in making our vacation relaxing!

The breakfast and afternoon snacks in the royal service lobby were wonderful. Fresh, healthy and delicious! The setting is beautiful. Tropical plants, and a koi fish pond make for beautiful scenery while you enjoy your snack, meal, coffee or cocktail. One night there was a beautiful show- 3 men singing, We were getting ready for dinner while the show was on in the lobby so we didn't see the show, but we could hear it in our room. It was early, and not disruptive at all. In fact, that was the only thing we heard in our room all week! Our rooms were very comfortable, quiet and clean. 

We enjoyed lunch at La Palapa overlooking the beautiful pool and ocean. The pool waiter Fransisco was great. The royal service pools are both beautiful and the bali beds are extremely comfy!

Eddie took care of us by the beach! He was so fun! He brought us waters with out even asking...and kept the drinks coming! We could just relax all day! The beach at paradisus is stunning. Crystal clear water with just the right amount of waves. It truly feels like paradise!

After soaking up the sun and wanting to take a nap, we ordered room service and enjoyed lunch on the balcony. The food was delicious and the service was fast! The Caprese salad was the best I've ever had!

We had dinner at The Market Grill the first night, which was like a Brazilian steakhouse. The atmosphere was laid back, resort casual. The food and service were great. We had to keep flipping the coin to pause the food....there is definitely no shortage there!

 We also had dinner at Fuego which was good. We were not aware that Cancun did not change their time as of Feb 1st. So we operated an hour behind schedule all day and showed up to our dinner reservation an hour late. This was no problem for the staff! We figured out after dinner why they seemed slightly rushed to get our meals out before closing!

The chocolate martinis on the beautiful couches of the Avenue Bar made for a fantastic evening watching a show. From acrobatics to rapping,,,,the show was great and we had a fun time here!

The Blue Agave which is described as a taco bar The salsas, were outstanding. They were of course spicy and authentic! The tacos were amazing! Fast service! Blue Agave will not disappoint for lunch! 

Mole was our favorite and most memorable dinning experience at the hotel. There was entertainment for dinner. Beautiful guitar and vocalists. The decor is warm, stylish and inviting. Oscar was our waiter. He was by far the best server we had on the property. He was very friendly and clearly has a love and knowledge for food and culture. He pleasantly described the dishes and made our dinning experience at Mole an evening to remember. I can't wait to return just to have the mole sauce again!

The hotel overall is beautiful. It is true that it is very large, but it makes exploring fun. We enjoyed walking the property after all the food we were eating! We did get "lost" a time or two but the staff is so friendly they will just happily direct you where to go. There are also maps of the property all over. We enjoyed our vacation very much. Thank You Paradisus for a wonderful stay and all of your hard work. We cant wait to return!

reviews.author: Roger1c
reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: Everything went fine. Until I ate at Market Grill Restaurant. The assistant waiters where unprofessionals at the point they made me feel uncomfortable. And the food had very bad quality.The worst service at the hotel. Is to bad just because of that can't give the hotel 5 stars.

reviews.author: Peggy B
reviews.title: Awesome Vacation !!
reviews.text: This is our 2nd time at the Paradisus Resort in Cancun and we were not disappointed!  We selected the Royal Service again this year for the adult only area's and the extra special service it provides.  Upon arrival we were greeted by our butler Hector.  We requested "Hector" from last years visit, although we found he was not the same Hector.  We were not disappointed!  I would have to say he was better!  It was my birthday and when we entered our room I was surprised with balloons, cake and champagne!  Hector was pro active in selecting and making daily dinner reservations for us each day.  He was always looking for us daily at the beach or by the pool to offer his service.  Never once did we have to call or look for him!  One afternoon after spending the day on the beach we came back to our room to find a lovely hot bubble bath with rose petals!  We very much enjoyed the the service at the La Palapas, exclusive for Royal Service, we found Christian, Oscar, Francisco and "Rocky" provided excellent service!  At the Coco's bar we found an old friend from last years visit who remembered us well, Jerry!  He along with his crew at Coco's provided exceptional service and entertainment!  One of the servers (sorry his name escapes me) was tossing and twirling bottles and glasses like Tom Cruise in Cocktail!  We found the food and service at all of the restaurants was very good!  There was not one we did not enjoy!  A big shout out to Misele and team at the Market Grill!  And to the small lady at the omelette station in Naos who was there last year, always service with a smile and the genuine feel from all that customer service was there first priority!!   We choose this resort again this year because of it's relaxing atmosphere, we indulged in the spa services and we're not disappointed!!!!  We booked a message for two and had to book another one because it was that good!  I also need to mention the cooking class at the La Palapas, they demonstrated how to make Paella and Sangria.  The entertainment staff, chefs and bartender Christian were truly fabulous!  Looking forward to our next visit!  Thank you Paradisus Resort!

reviews.author: IslandDayDreams
reviews.title: Would not stay here again
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed here on an anniversary trip from Feb. 13-17 with my sister and her boyfriend.  The hotel grounds are very nice, but the food is average. Also, the hostesses do not honor the mandatory dinner reservations & you will be forced to eat at the dinner buffets when this happens. Finding warm food at the breakfast or lunch buffets is impossible, except the omelette station. The only good meals we had were tacos & quesadillas at Blue Agave & lobster lunch on the Bali beds that Coco's Bar operates. Because by 9:00 am, all the beach chairs were towel-reserved, we ended up paying $70 each for a lobster lunch so we could use the beach beds. Also, when we arrived, I advised the front desk that I am pregnant & had allergies, but they still put us in Tower 1, which was so strongly scented that I began itching all over & my husband got a headache.  They eventually moved us to Tower 3, which does not have that issue, but they put us in double beds. Great way to spend your anniversary! After calling back, they offered to moved us into a room that had a king bed in Tower 3 a couple days later. We wasted a lot of the precious few hours of sunlight on room changes and were never even offered an apology or late check out for the inconvenience.
