The front desk was responsive when we called after being woken up at 2:30 a.m. by loud drunk guys in the room next door.  We really enjoyed Secrets the Vine on our prior Cancun trip in August, but tried this resort because it was less $$. If you are looking for a party atmosphere and care less about quality dining and helpful front desk staff, you might enjoy Paradisus.

reviews.author: Tammy Lorraine P
reviews.title: nice
reviews.text: Nice place.  Didn't appreciate being led to believe the timeshare spill was mandatory.  Then the lady that was supposed to be our "go to person" was no where to be found after we declined to buy the timeshare.  Place was clean, food was good but was never hot, more like room temperature.  The only "hot" food was when we had omlets made by request for breakfast.

reviews.author: ptnp02
reviews.title: Excellent location
reviews.text:
Just home from a 6 night stay - pros:  location is great - the beach is beautiful - the public areas are very pretty and well kept - spa is beautiful and relaxing - wait staff was excellent, friendly, cleaning of rooms was great - even wait staff on the beach for drinks was awesome - our first time in cancun and we do not speak Spanish but had no problems at all 

pros:  we had a junior lagoon view in the main building, 3 - room had musty smell, especially the dresser - our room, 3620, faced into the atrium - this could be quite loud some nights as two of the main bars are right off the atrium - most nights didn't bother us, but we were awakend one night by the noise about 1230 or  1 am - rooms are nice with marble floors, but a little dated 

pools were huge and beautiful but COLD!!!! I would think with all that sunshine down there they could figure out a way to heat them with solar - we didn't use the pools nearly as much as we would have if they were even a little warmer

food in buffet was good for breakfast and lunch - yummy omelets, just about anything you could think of for breakfast was there, but if you didn't have a reservation for dinner you were out of luck - the dinner buffet had lots of choices but the food was COLD!!  I mean they put out a new pan of pasta I wanted and it was cold when they put it out and it was not supposed to be a cold dish - even in the restaurants with res sometimes the food was not warm, it was all good but not always good temp - can't say any of the restaurants were outstanding, but we only used the ones that were included in the package - Ventos, the tapas bar, was our favorite

we were there for a wedding and I must say they did an excellent job with it and with the reception and buffet for the wedding 

overall an excellent stay - we were there over valentines day weekend and they said they were at 100% capacity and I think they were just overwhelmed - there were a LOT of children there, so if you are looking totally for romance, may want to weigh your choices - also wifi very spotty

reviews.author: Nancy K
reviews.title: Great all-inclusive hotel. Many families with children ages newborn to teen, stay here.
reviews.text: My husband and I came here on a business trip. Very nice area. Even the drive from the airport to the hotel was beautiful. BEACHES, swimming POOLS, workout rooms, RESTAURANTS, SPA. Lovely. Erick, a very good waiter in the Bano Restaurant in the center of the facility, gives excellent service!

reviews.author: MariocmBrasil
reviews.title: EXCELLENT ALL INCLUSIVE
reviews.text:
Wife and I stayed for 14 days 
here our review:.
 Service was 5 stars for what you pay
 bed was 5 stars for what you pay
 food was 4 stars for what you
 entertainment was 3.5 stars , not much of ...
 location was 5 stars, can't ask for better
 staff was 5 stars, always helpful
      We been in various resorts all inclusive and Paradisus is a well mantain resort.

reviews.author: Tri L
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Paradisus is wonderful hotel. Food was excellent and so were the workers. Beach was very nice with many water activities for hotel guests to do. This was the first time my wife and I traveled to Cancun and the trip was amazing and very relaxing.

reviews.author: Cheeseheads
reviews.title: Royal Bliss
reviews.text: We stayed in an ocean view room in the Royal Service section Feb 12-16th and enjoyed every moment.  The service was amazing from the front desk to the maid service and everything in between. Thank you to our butler Rode, the pool concierges Arturo and Omar, waiter Rogilio, sommelier Iran and so many of the other awesome staff.  We enjoyed long beach walks every morning followed by lazy afternoons at the beach beds or in the heated Royal Service pool.  We ate breakfast every in the Royal Service lounge which was very fresh and convenient and ordered lunch delivered to us by the pool.  We thought the food was good at all the restaurants.  The only thing we wished is that they would have kept at least one restaurant every night rotating adults only to keep us in our Zen mode. On the last night we splurged on dinner at Tempo which was an extra charge but well worth it - definitely a night to remember!  We also participated in the wine tasting event which was fun. We would highly recommend this resort and especially the Royal Service.  We can't wait to return!

reviews.author: Jake T
reviews.title: amazing stay
reviews.text: I visited this resort during February 2015 and the accomdations and service was above and beyond any explanations. There were many different choices for food and they were all excellent. Royal Service was amazing and I highly recommended it.

reviews.author: DeeDee2002
reviews.title: Best all inclusive yet!
reviews.text:
We have been to quite a few all inclusive hotels in Mexico, and this is the best yet! The food was amazing, the quality and variety blew us away! The drinks were great and the staff always went above and beyond.  Be sure to eat at the Naos Restaurant for your buffet meals, we never had a bad meal here!  The servers were wonderful, when a child wanted only plain pasta or a cheese pizza they were happy to bring one especially for you. Moises Maldonado, our server most evenings went out of his way to make us feel special.  The hostess, Barbara Torres, saw me struggling with my little one and a plate of food, she whisked over and helped both of us back to our table with a smile.  
The typical breakfast, lunch and dinner at Naos had easily 4 dozen options for dinner. Just to list off a few for dinner (grilled sashimi grade fish, scallops, pork shoulder, proscuitto, 4 types of chicken dishes, beef dishes, pastas, salads, fruits (EVEN FRESH FIGS!) 2 different soups every night, salsas, veggies, desserts were always beautiful, chocolate fondue fountain every night (highlight for kids when the dipped pink or while marshmallows in them).  They have a kids buffet too (taquitos, chicken, corn, steamed veggies) Really way to many to list. 
I'd go back in a heart beat! 
But be sure not to have a room to close to the Red Lounge, unless you will be partying it up there then the noise shouldn't bother you and if your intoxicated, finding your room wouldn't be to difficult.  Otherwise, do not stay near! It was LOUD! till about 2-3am!
Oh, and Tabita at the beach cabanas! We secured 2 cabanas through Tabita and it was a wonderful treat (runs around 50-100$ per day, which is steep but was well worth it for us to keep the kids out of the sun and sand for a bit).

reviews.author: Richard S
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Very good.  I would recommend the Royal Service.  The beach was amazing and the Cabanas and service at the adult pool was great. The all inclusive did not include wine and liquor for the room and they charged extra for lobster and most good steaks.

reviews.author: Daniel G
reviews.title: Amazing Experience
reviews.text: Just stayed for Valentines week 2015, with the upgraded royal service, and I am now spoiled. Any hotel in the future will need to step up their game to match the time I had at Paradisus Cancun. From the aroma of the royal tower, to the excellent food at all their restaurants, to the Butler service (Hector was great!!!) Other resorts need to take notes. The views of the Gulf were extraordinary, drinks were strong and top shelf. The rooms were also spotless and cleaned twice a day, with turn down service in the PM. Already talking about going back next year, cant recommend enough.

reviews.author: Beachfans2015
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: Stayed here Feb 12-16, 2015.  We are lovers of Aruba, but this year just wanted a short trip to get out of cold weather and to do nothing but relax. We did not do any excursions, stayed at the hotel the entire time. We did upgrade to the Royal Service. We are not ' needy' people and were more than pleased with our butler Sergio. In fact, we thought every person who waited on us or had contact with us in any way, was exceptional. We loved the wide, clean beach, palapas and Bali beds and the service on the beach is the best we have ever experienced. We were impressed that servers never hung around expecting a tip and were very appreciative when they were given tips.Even though our room was near an elevator, it was quiet. The rooms are not new, but are clean and the bed was very comfortable. For the price, we loved our stay and would return. I do agree with others, food is not excellent and was generally cold. We felt that they tried to make the food " fancier" than it needed to be, instead of making it simple but hot. We did not have children with us, but felt that there were not many kid friendly food choices either.

reviews.author: traveltheglobe2015
reviews.title: Excellent stay!
reviews.text:
Visited this resort during February 2015 and the stay and service was above and beyond any explanations.  There were many different choices for food which made the stay even better. We were travelling with a group of friends so we were doing quite a few nights out in downtown cancun along with a couple of tours around cancun (snorkelling, xplor, chichen itza).  The concierge and staff were very helpful in helping us make arrangements for getting there and etc.  The resort itself has a show every night at the avenue bar and then has the red lounge open at 10pm- 2am as a mini club within the resort.  During the day, the pool bar and beach are gorgeous and extremely relaxing.  The servers would walk around the beach while you got to relax.  The only con of this resort is that it is really big.  So if you want to stay central in the resort without having to do too much walking, I would stay in pyramids 2,3, & 4.  (3 is the noisiest though as it is the central location).

One more thing i forgot to mention, they let us check in at 7am instead of 3pm because our flight arrived early without any problems! It was extremely convenience as we were exhausted and even after we checked out at 12pm on the day we were leaving, they took our luggage and let us enjoy the remaining couple of hours we had on the resort.  They were very flexible.

The stay was fabulous and the staff service is amazing and the views were breath taking. I would most definitely make a trip back to this resort.  And there is 24/7 room service as well.

reviews.author: Mlannert22
reviews.title: An absolute gem !
reviews.text:
This hotel is absolutely amazing ! I took 12 family members on a 5 day vacation to Cancun. I'm from NY and have pretty high standards , I travel for one long weekend a month so I've been to plenty hotels. For an all inclusive this place is amazing ! below are all the pros and cons ,

Pros-
Great location 
For an all inclusive the food was Reservations were very easy to make 
Beach and pool are well maintained 
Staff was very friendly 
Excursions are negotiable, do not settle for the first price they give you ! If they are not willing to negotiate go to the excursion place by the beach 

Cons~
Not enough lounge chairs by the pool ( very annoying )
Beds aren't very comfortable 
Not very handicap accessible

reviews.author: Nicole F
reviews.title: Absolutely gorgeous
reviews.text: Had an incredible trip at Paradisus Cancun. Everything from the service to the beaches. The food is outstanding, the hotel is well kept and the workers are constantly looking for ways to better your experience. Benito, Carla, Carlos (the supervisor) Jonathan (at the beach bar) and Cesar made our trip one we will never forget. If we had one problem with anything with our stay, it was immediately taken care of. The view from the room is unbeatable and there is no doubt I would go back in a heartbeat.

reviews.author: letsdance2015
reviews.title: A true paradise
reviews.text: Just completed a great week at Paradisus.  This facility offers beautiful grounds and the staff were attentive and accommodating.  The activity staff of Arturo, Angel and others were outstanding.  They made our stay so much fun.

reviews.author: AdventureLandTravel
reviews.title: Where is the Gran Melia Cancun? Still there: AKA Paradisus Cancun.
reviews.text:
Hi travelers, 
It's right here!  I was looking for one of my favorite resorts called Gran Melia Cancun and couldn't locate it. So I looked thru the photos and sure enough they changed the name to Paradisus.  It is still a great place to stay and the atrium is still breathtaking. There are a few new updates to it along with the same best spot on the beach. You can look down the beach for miles each way and view all the other hotels. This is the widest stretch of beach in Cancun. There are nice pools for everyone and the atrium has philodendrons hanging hundreds of feet down above tropical pools of water with plants, trees and large goldfish. Great food great fun. 
You will need your walking shoes at this large resort.

reviews.author: avpl
reviews.title: Not so good, won't be returning and can't recommend
reviews.text:
The good: The staff around the pool - Omar & Bernardo, and Jesus in the breakfast restaurant.  Our butler Hector was OK too.  They all went above and beyond to try and make our stay enjoyable. The staff (in general) are the hotel's best asset.

The bad: Food in the buffet was very poor; always cold (breakfast, lunch, and dinner) without exception. There also appeared to be a lot of nothing in terms of choice too. The other restaurants we ate in were merely acceptable, no stand-out meals in any of them

The other bad:  They closed Market Place on Friday night for a private party.  This is not acceptable when I've paid for all-inclusive for a set number of choices and restaurants.

The other other bad:  The rooms are not in great condition. Our bathroom mirror was eroding around all edges, the bathroom towel rail was held on by sticky tape, eventually falling off.  We also requested only coke and water in the mini-bar and to keep it stocked up, which took 3 days to get actioned.

Other gripes:  The resort is big, maybe too big and is a pita to navigate.  For example to get from 6th floor Pyramid 5 to the main breakfast area you need to go down to floor 2, walk through pyramid 4 to 3 and then down to the sub-ground level.

Compared to other 4/5* hotels in North America, Europe, and Asia this is at least 1-1.5 notches below.

I've started with three blobs, taken two off due to the above negative points, and added two on, purely because of the attitude of the staff members mentioned above, ending up back at 3 blobs

reviews.author: Cheryl M
reviews.title: The search stops here
reviews.text:
Book your vacation with Paradisus Cancun NOW! My girlfriend and I went for 7 days 1/29-2/4. The entire stay was absolutely ridiculous. Don't waste your money on royal service. 15 minutes from the airport on the main strip of hotels, 5 minute bus ride to downtown for shopping/clubs. Aqua world is DIRECTLY across the street for ALL excursions. We booked BestDay (BD) when we booked out vacation for shuttle to and from airport and that was the best decision we made. They set up everything for us, easy, and trustworthy. They have a booth located within the hotel that they are at 6 days a week if you have any questions. Back to the Hotel. The food was amazing, my girlfriend is an extremely picky eater and she tried new things and loved it all. We ate at every restaurant except vento because there is no need to pay for food and La palapa because that was for royal service. All the other restaurants were amazing with the best being The Market Grill. The Market Grill and Naos and connected and used together for breakfast and lunch as buffet style. Then at night The Market Grill becomes an amazing outdoors brazillian steakhouse. 

Depending on where you were drinking we were allowed certain drinks. Some bartenders were serving us top shelf while others required an upgrade of some sort. That was confusing at times but there was never a drink I was not 100% satisfied with.

It seemed as if out room was cleaned and towels refreshed 5 times a day, realistically 2-3. They restock your room refrigerator with pop, beer, water, cookies, chips whenever you eat/drink anything at no charge. 24 hr room serive that was delievered in 20 minutes

The entire staff from the moment you arrive to the day you leave are there to serve you and are happy to do so. The hotel has entertainment every night in the Avenue Bar. The entertainment was actually good and would draw quite the crowd. We liked to hang out at Avenue Bar after dinner for drinks where Damaris and Enrique took excellent care of us every night ensuring we had everything we needed

There are 3 pools, 1 for royal service which is connected to 1 of the pools used by everybody. That pool is heated. The 3rd pool is for everybody and has a swim up bar and is not heated. I was there in Jan/Feb and people (including me and the girlfriend) were swimming in this pool and using the swim up bar.

On our 3rd day of 7 I asked the girlfriend to step things up and asked her to marry me, she said yes..blah blah blah...Well on our last evening we had already ate at all the restaurants so we had the choice to go back to 1, of course we decided The Market Grill. We sat down, got some champagne and a salad. A worker approached us and asked what we were celebrating, we told him we are recently engaged, he told us that he had a special dinner for us. He proceeded to walk us down to the beach lead by tiki torches and candle light where we had 6 private waiters with any bottle of wine we wanted to choose from and had the most romantic and elegant dinner with a saxophonists playing on a platform above. The waves were crashing up 5 ft from out feet with the breeze in out hair and a full moon. The food of course was amazing where we enjoyed salad/lobster soup/filet/potato/chocolate covered strawberries with Love and Heart written in chocolate. They left us with a rose and a full glass of wine to walk down the beach. The resort provided this service for us for FREE. This was insane. The amazing people who made this dream come true were Gerardo, Edier, Octavio, Wilberth, and Elizabeth from the royal service staff.

There is not enough time to say all the amazing things Paradisus does for its guests. We stayed in the main tower (3) and it was not to loud, it was nice to be close to everything. I cannot wait to return. We are not sure if we are going back to Paradisus Cancun or may try one of the other 3 Paradisus locations.

If you are booking your vacation with them I am so jealous and enjoy.

reviews.author: colradomikeandtraci
reviews.title: Best Employees and Service ever!
reviews.text:
In a world with all human beings refuse to look each other in the eye cause their cell phones need more attention.
Welcome to Heaven on earth!
The employees here show you continually that,...from their hearts,... you are more important.
Daniel at Naos buffet is one of the nicest human beings we have ever met.
Ceasar, "in royal service" treated us as though we were family." 
Elizabeth M. pampered us and made us feel like a long lost friend.
This place is wonderful, the people working their are forever in our hearts. 
Michael and Traci M.

reviews.author: Adam J
reviews.title: Fantastic family vacation!
reviews.text:
I'm currently staying at Paradisus in Cancun with my wife, our two year old daughter, and our four year old daughter. We did a package that included the family concierge. Ramon, our concierge is awesome. He has booked us reservations each night, has a daily personal gift for our girls, and checks on us regularly each day helping with little things like Bali beds at the pool and toiletries for the room. I highly recommend the family converge package, the kids loved feeding the fish, their personalized coloring books, water guns, and nightly treat. Ramon has helped with a lot of small benefits that make the stay extra special and enjoyable.

We travel a lot and rarely write reviews, but this is the best place we have taken our girls. Last year we took them to beaches in Jamaica and also to Hollywood, FL, but this is the best and least expensive. The service, food, weather, and beach are just wonderful. 

We have a two room suite ocean view. The pull out couch is perfect for two small kids and gives us some privacy at night. Our girls also love dancing to the nightly music. We have had a wonderful time and will likely come here again.

reviews.author: Sharon B
reviews.title: Interesting stay
reviews.text:
So... I'm on my fourth day of my eight say vacation at this resort and there's some good and bad. 

Good : nice looking resort

Bad : extremely cold pools (nobody even uses them), some of the restaurants taste so bad it's better off skipping dinner than eating at them (especially, fuego), when we first arrived everyone was willing to help us make dinner reservations and extremely helpful but they'd always end the conversation with asking if we had attended the timeshare presentation. Whenever I would tell them I'm not interested they'd immediately change their attitude. I eventually ended up saying yes to get a discount on an excursion and to receive a free four night stay (prolly won't be easy to get this) after being promised it would take 90 minutes max. I spent three full hours refusing the timeshare to the sales Rep that couldn't take no for an answer. After the presentation, I asked the staff to help me make a dinner reservation and all I got was someone pointing at a phone telling me to do it myself. 

They basically make you feel like you are here on some sort of free vacation because I am supposed to buy a timeshare. I paid 4000$ for this vacation and I don't owe them anything but I guess the staff were trained otherwise. 

The resort is nice looking and clean but if I were you I'd avoid ANY melia properties. The timeshare presentation was stressful and wasted three hours of my day

reviews.author: M D
reviews.title: Great Holiday!
reviews.text: Just returned from holidays at the Paradisus Cancun Resort and can not say enough.  The food was great, rooms were clean and well maintained, pool very clean and the beach well kept.  The customer service from all of the staff was excellent, very friendly and with our Spanish being a little rusty the staff went out of their way to make sure we all understood each other.  We would like to send a big thank you to Erick Delacruz who was are bartender for most of the vacation, Eric went out of his way to make sure we were happy and well taken care of at the pool bar and did it all with a smile.

reviews.author: scubaprop4
reviews.title: Great, Relaxing Vacation
reviews.text: Royal Service upgrade:  very much worth the cost.  We were given a butler who arranged our poolside seating, towels, tanning products, restaurant reservations, etc.  The beach was lovely.  Pool was clean and kept at an adequate temperature.  The restaurants that we tried were all very good.  The buffet was your typical buffet--probably something for everybody but I'm just not a fan of buffets.

reviews.author: Ben L
reviews.title: Awesome Place, Awesome People, Awesome Vacation!
reviews.text:
First I should state that I have been vacationing at this place about 12 years…when it was the Grand Melia.  A couple of years ago it changed its name to Paradisus.   I like the property because of its awesome location and it backs up to a great beach with white sands, crystal water and plenty of palapas for shade.  

 The people at the resort have always been great but this year they were outstanding and felt I needed to tell others.  I purchased the Royal Service (all inclusive) package and they lived up to their name.   I am an early riser so every morning they provided an awesome continental breakfast spread for those in the Royal Service and if you wanted a full breakfast they also have two restaurants available (La Palapa and Naos).   The continental breakfast area had great WIFI so I could read my home paper online on my Ipad and enjoyed my coffee and lattes.  ….In the afternoon they provide a spread of fruits, cheeses, cake and appetizers too many to list.  Full bar as well.   The servers working the area were totally awesome.  Vallerie and Francisco and others working the continental breakfast area made sure that my coffee cup was always full and were at the ready to make sure that my needs were supplied.

The servers at the pool area were awesome as well and made sure that if I needed anything they were there to supply our needs.   Edier, Wilberth, Katrina Javier were great hosts/servers and made sure that we were having a great time.  We had lunch at our ballinesa (cabana) several days and the lunch was fantastic.  A couple of times we walk to the Market Grill for lunch, which was also great!  If you go to the Market Grill look for Jesus.  Jesus was a great host/server providing great recommendations for drinks and dishes.   We tried most of the restaurants on the property and we were happy with all the servers and all the meals.  Our favorite restaurants were Fuego and Mole, but they were all good restaurants.

Sergio was our butler and he check in on us daily to make we had anything we needed and that we were happy with the service being provided.  Sergio also made all of our dinner reservations and was generally very attentive to our needs.

Thanks Paradisus for making our vacation GREAT.  We love the place and the people!  We never left the property because all we needed is supplied on site. You will see us again soon!

ben

reviews.author: websterny
reviews.title: Service beyond any place I've ever stayed.... Excellent!
reviews.text:
This was my husband and I second trip to the Paradisus in Cancun. We went on our honeymoon last year and returned because of the superb service. Upon our arrival Jose, the bellman warmly greeted us and assisted w/ our luggage. Then we were given lovely refreshing towels. Our concierge was Claudia A. She had helped me even before I arrived w/ details to celebrate our anniversary and always replies promptly to my emails. I cannot say enough about her and the follow through with every single request. This is what makes a vacation a truly relaxing experience and certainly makes me want to return to a hotel. Exceptional service from Axel in the Blue Agave. Alejandro in the buffet was kind along with all the waiters. Service is top notch along w/ a large variety of foods. 
On our last night we ate at Tempo which is an extra fee but well worth it! We spoke with the manager ahead of time and asked about the tasting menu and asked if it could be altered to accommodate my husbands palette ( no seafood). They completely omitted and changed things he didn't care for. Best meal of my life! I'm writing a complete review of restaurant later. Thank you to all the staff for a fantastic vacation!

reviews.author: VeronicaInMichigan
reviews.title: 99% Satisfied, 100% beautiful resort
reviews.text:
My husband and I just returned from a five night stay at the Paradisus Cancun. This was our first stay in Cancun and except for a few minor things (and one kind of major thing) our stay was amazing.

We upgraded to Royal Service for $100 more per night (I saw another review that said $90 per person, but that's not what we paid). The upgrade put us in Tower 5 (Rm. 5704) on the top floor (7th). The tower was adults only and that was a major plus for us.  Royal Service also includes premium liquor and guaranteed reserved Bali beds near the pool/beavh for two days of your stay. You can reserve a bed on other days and one day we forgot to make a reservation but they still found us one. 

ROOM: We had a lagoon view junior suite on the top floor with the two double beds. You can choose to keep the beds separate or they will push them together for you. The marble floor was a little uncomfortable but wearing the slippers that are provided for you helps.  Also, depending on the weather, keeping the balcony door open can lead to moisture and humidity in the room and the floors become slippery. That only happened once, but with slippers, the floors didn't seem slippery. The only minor complaint I have about the room is the power. The hotel strives to be green (yay!) and there is a "master switch" that turns off the lights and the power source to the outlets. The first morning we woke up to completely dead devices that we had plugged in to be charged on to discover that the power source was turned off with the lift switch. We figured it out the next morning. There is a mini bar that they will stock with whatever you like but we didn't use it much since we did most of our drinking at the beach.

DRINKS: We were literally drinking all day long, every single day. The drinks were great and the waiters were really good about keeping a drink in your hand. We had Wilberth as a waiter when we were on the beach a couple of days and he was awesome!

FOOD: My biggest complaint about the food is the buffet place, Naos. The food was always cold. Not lukewarm, I mean downright cold to the point where I couldn't even eat it. Fruit and salad should be cold. Mushroom ravioli and roast beef should not. We ate there twice and I refused to eat there again. Even the omelets were cold. The were made to order but the ingredients were on a cold bar and just thrown on the eggs for a few minutes and served quickly. I don't know if it's an American thing to have food piping hot but I would have settled for slightly warm. I was very disappointed with Naos and can't recommend it at all.

Blue Agave: The second best place in the resort! It was a taqueria and the food was out of this world. I had the following tacos (they are small, like 3-4 bites and served on white corn tortillas): Bistec, carnitas, and lengua (beef tongue) with a bowl of Posole. Everything tastes authentic and home made. I am picky about Posole and I was really impressed with theirs. My husband had the chorizo and papas quesadillas and he liked it very much. We waited about five minutes to be seated (no reservations are needed) and that was the longest we ever had to wait. Drinks were great there too. No stars for this place.

Mole: My favorite restaurant in the resort, wish I had gone there first. Carne asada chalupas, beef ribs for dinner with mashed sweet potatoes, mariachi singers, beautiful setting. Five stars all the way for this restaurant. Everything was delicious and well seasoned. I would have eaten there every day. This restaurant is adults only, also a plus. Reservation needed.

Vento: A tapas restaurant. Again, a top quality place with amazing food and excellent service. I had the creme brûlée de foie gras and I could have eaten five of them! The shrimp risotto might have beaten the foie gras except that it had lots of red/green peppers in it and I personally do not like those peppers. The grilled shrimp on top was delicious but I skipped the risotto. Absolutely eat there. Five stars. Reservation needed.

Market Grill: So many meats!  The servers come around with giant skewers of assorted meats and slice off whatever you want: chicken, sirloin, ribeye, bacon wrapped turkey, sausage, lamb, etc., etc. They also come around with sides like salads, rice, vegetables, etc, and you can chose. At his was my husband's favorite place. Reservation needed.

La Palapa (Royal Service only): This restaurant is outside near the pool and Bali beds. We had breakfast here several days and wer never disappointed. Made to order omelettes that were actually HOT, incredible franch toast, assorted fruit, yogurt parfait a, cereals, etc. The view is beautiful but the food was really good. They also serve lunch and snacks while you're out near the pool/beach. We snacked on guacamole, chicken wings, sweet potato fries (yummy!!) and regular fries while lounging on the beach. They close at 5:00 p.m. You do not need a reservation.

We did not eat ant any of the other restaurants because they are not to our taste and we never used room service.

The other place we ate/drank was in the lounge exclusively for Royal Service guests. Drinks were all hand made with premium liquor, snacks were good: squid ink cheese, black and red caviar, hummus, assorted breads, fresh Parmesan cheese, Swiss cheese, salami, pepperoni, prosciutto, fruit, fruit tarts, desserts, all beautifully displayed and in a lovely sitting area over a koi pond, fire lamps, nice plants and floral arrangements.

My other minor complaints:

Fragrance. The entire resort seems to be heavily scented with burning incense every where. (To be fair, I never went to Tower 1 or 2 so I don't know if they have the same smell there)  A quick walk outside helps but for someone who may be sensitive to the scents, it could be a little overwhelming.
 
Dim lighting. It's nice for setting a romantic mood but it's a little hard to read menus in the dark. They do offer little flashlights but that just makes me think they need to rethink their lighting. Even the hallways are dark at night but there are places that have motion sensitive lights to help you see in the halls. During the day it's blinding bright because they take advantage of natural sunlight. 

Welcome package and "free gift". .someone called our room at 9 a.m. offering us a welcome package and free gift. When we finally made our way down there, it was a sales pitch. The free gift is a very flimsy string style backpack. I guess they are all just doing their jobs but I wasn't happy about the early timing of their call.

Our butler was Galdino and he took care of everything we needed: reservations at restaurants, reserving the Bali beds on the beach, directions to the local church, bus routes, and he even gave us a bottle of champagne and chocolate covered strawberries since we were celebrating our 10th wedding anniversary. He was a HUGE help to us and a very nice young man.

All in all, we LOVED our stay at the Paradisus. The resort is beautifully decorated with flowers, plants, vines, etc. The check in and check out procedures were fast and simple. The service is absolutely top notch. Anytime we were walking around, if you saw an employee, they always greeted you with a smile and made you feel welcome. We never heard loud noise or people in the hallways. We could hear the music coming from the Royal Service lounge area but it was only for maybe an hour or so each night and it was usually as we were leaving for dinner.

As I remember more things about our stay, I will update this review. I only gave 4 out of 5 because of the food issue at Naos, the other minor issues were not really a factor in my rating, they were just my observations.

The next time I go back, I might go with my girlfriends for a quiet, relaxing trip.

reviews.author: Tammy K
reviews.title: Great vacation, Great Service!!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus for 3 nights for a sisters get away.  When we arrived, we offered to purchase the upgrade to the Royal Service.  It turned about to be well worth the additional money.  Our Butler, Rode was excellent.  We were celebrating my sister's birthday and the attention to detail to create a memorable weekend was excellent.  The all adult section was very quite, it was nice to have a stocked bar, snacks and other items outside your room at most hours.  Having the option to have lunch on the beach brought to you was wonderful. Our pool/beach waiter Francisco was absolutely a pleasure.  Dining by the pool for breakfast, Valerie was great and remembered us and what our favorite items were.   The room was clean and well maintained.

reviews.author: Michelle P
reviews.title: Fun in the sun
reviews.text: We stayed at paradisus for 5 nights. There were 3 of us and we requested 2 double beds, but I guess when you book the hotel states they will try to accommodate requests but nothing is guaranteed and we ended up with a king bed and rollaway bed for the first 3 nights. The first room we had was on an inside corner that didn't get much light or wifi. The room was kind of dank and nothing seemed to dry in it. We also had hot water problems. After 3 nights we moved next door to a room with two double beds (they are regular double beds not queen beds like you would get in the USA just fyi) this room was only next door but made a world of difference - much more sunlight, full wifi, things dried, no hot water problems. We were much happier in this room. The resort is beautiful and very modern. Gorgeous lobby, beautiful pools / beaches, excellent service, fun DJ at night. I was impressed with the food too - usually resort food is kinda blah but this food was actually good, especially the taqueria (blue agave was the restaurant name). We took a few of the gym classes which were fun and we were able to do outside on the beach. The day trip planner was extremely helpful and friendly in assisting us in booking day trips. The 3 things I felt this resort was lacking: an outdoor hottub for late in the afternoon when the sun goes down or if its a rainy / cold day out. Some type of towel rack or clothes line for the balcony to dry your wet clothes and also after around 3 pm the sun moves so it is on the lagoon side of the resort - so it would be nice to have an area to lay out on that side to catch a few afternoon rays. Overall we had a great time and were happy with our stay.

reviews.author: tomzam
reviews.title: Excellent Vacation
reviews.text: Just spent 8 nights at the Paradisus Cancun and it was an excellent stay.  We stayed in the Adults only section which included it's own pool, beach area and one restaurant - breakfast and lunch only.  The stay also included your own butler, and while I skeptical, it turned out to be a nice service.  Our butler was Cesar and he would search us out and make sure that we were taken care of and that we had dinner reservations.  He not only made our dinner reservations but also arranged for us to have a hut at the pool everyday.  The service overall was excellent.  I would definitely go back and actually can't wait to return.

reviews.author: Greg V
reviews.title: Great Hotel, Wonderful Staff
reviews.text:
My wife and I just returned from an 8 day stay in a Royal Service Ocean view suite.  This is our third trip to Cancun over the last few years and was the best one yet.  The room and facilities at Paradisus were clean and well appointed.  We hit all the restaurants except for the buffet (no specific reason… just worked out that way).  Food was very good, service was excellent.  We ended up really enjoying the Blue Agave for tacos on many evenings.

But, by far, the best experience was having our own Butler.   Ivan Silva was extremely friendly and professional and really made us feel welcome.  What a great young man who really made a difference in the quality of our stay.  He arranged all our dinner reservations and even had a nice birthday surprise for us on the big day.   The Royal service pool and beach area are amazing and again, the staff was excellent.   Very attentive, friendly and professional.   Meals at the La Palapa were perfect!   Everyone should have that view while they eat breakfast.   We miss it already and are looking forward to returning as soon as we can.

reviews.author: Tammy U
reviews.title: Paradise at the Paradisus
reviews.text: We just returned from a one week all inclusive stay at the Paradisus Cancun and it was paradise.  Thank you to Rode and all the staff who helped make our stay so fantastic.  We chose to upgrade to Royal service and it was well worth it.

reviews.author: bblfoot
reviews.title: Fabulous stay
reviews.text: Just spent a week there.  Room was fabulous. Corner room, ocean view. All personnel were very friendly and very helpful. Restaurant reservations were finally very easy (compared with prior years) but call early (Royal Service customers get priority).  Did not have Royal Service and did not need it. ($90/person/day).  Tempo restaurant was incredible. It matches any great big city restaurant. Wine steward was especially helpful and attentive. Molé restaurant was excellent. Vento also great.  Naos has endless buffet with excellent selection.  Fuego, unfortunately was great disappointment.  Great Sea Bass completely unnecessarily drowned in bread crumbs, butter and salt. Why?  Appetizers were not good. Crème Brule desert (classic egg custard with brown sugar glazing)  was excellent, except a tablespoon of (more) regular loose brown sugar was dumped on top.  What was the chef thinking?  Restaurant seriously needs a new chef (probably thinks a moustache on the Mona Lisa is necessarily).  Beach great.  February is a good, uncrowded time to visit.  Creative and highly relevant architectural and art attempt at evoking the Mayan heritage of the region was wonderful. Most other hotels had no sense of this. Inside you can't tell if you are in Cancun or in the US. Note that This is more of a family hotel than a young adult entertainment hotel (e.g. Hard Rock hotel)

reviews.author: Karin F
reviews.title: Rules!!!
reviews.text:
Spent a glorious 8 days here, weather was pretty good even with the wind! 
Checking in was quick and efficient, and our bags were delivered to our room very quickly. The room itself was pretty large and the bed was two doubles pushed together.  There was no clock on the nightstand, but we did find it at the end of our stay. It was underneath the bed, as the nightstand was moved to accommodate the two beds being shoved together.There was the standard mini fridge with beers, some pop, chips and some cookies. There was also the usual coffee maker with instant milk powder. However disappointing was the fact that these items were not replaced on a daily basis, we had to phone for them if we wanted them re-filled. It was also difficult to get water re-fills.
There are quite a few restaurants here, but getting a reservation was a bit challenging. It appears that you must make a reservation 24 hours in advance, and if you try to make one after 5:00, you are out of luck. Most of our meals were taken at Noas, which if a buffet style overlooking the pool area. We went to this place and wanted a table for six, and were told by the hostess that we would have to sit at two tables. The tables are not nailed to the floor, so this sort of left us with an unwelcome feeling. Our waiter came, and seeing our situation, promptly put two tables together. The serving staff, no matter where we went, was amazing, not only professional, but also entertaining. 
One evening at Coco's bar, we had a server that we called "Ricardo Montalban", as he had an uncanny resemblance to this actor from Fantasy Island (hope I didn't age myself), and he was excellent at his job, as well as having a great sense of humour! We had many laughs that night. Job well done!
The restrooms are a bit sparse and all the restaurants on the first floor, all share the two public restrooms. So, you had to hike to one of them or go to your room.
We did have a cockroach visit us, and believe that it came up through the drain, but, this being the tropics, is not unheard of. Just cover or close the floor drains. We ordered a bottle of wine through room service one night, had about half the bottle. We had left the remainder on the dresser. The following night, we went to finish it off only to discover that it was gone :(  
We did go to the ruins, very, very well done, our guide was very knowledgeable, and then to the water park to snorkel. It was a fun filled day, even though it rained pretty hard!!
There are lots of walks to go on, one being the high end mall with Gucci, Armani, etc. 
The beaches could be a little cleaner as there are lots of cigarette butts, straws etc littering the sand.
Overall, our stay was pleasant, just found the rules a little bit constraining

reviews.author: Peter N
reviews.title: Very Clean, Very Friendly
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed here as part of a corporate event.  We stayed 9 days and was all-inclusive.  The restaurants have good food, and there are many options.  The wait staff is fairly aggressive at pushing the "extra charge" wine, ranging from 700 pesos to 3,000 pesos per bottle and up.  The house wine is above average for a house wine and it worked fine.  Beware the Market Grill for lunch, it's extra for lunch, but included for dinner.  This was not clear to us.  Lots of beach and pool seating, but get there early (10am) as it filled up quickly during our visit.  

Directly in front of the hotel you can catch the public bus into Cancun and to the shopping areas.  For the two of us it was 21 pesos each way ($1.68 USD for two).  The bus is the way to go.  There is no apparent schedule, but they run continuously and frequently.

We found the facility to be spotless and in good repair.  It's a beautiful resort and we had only good experiences with t he staff.  All the desk and wait staff spoke English.

I rated it a high value, but in all honesty I don't know the true cost because we were part of a 195 person group on a group rate.

reviews.author: andy d
reviews.title: Just returned from a stay
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed at this hotel 20 years ago when it was the Melia Cancun, and it is still a really nice place to vacation. It's right in the middle of the hotel zone and is on a broad, clean, sandy stretch of beach. Lots of hotels strive for a high level of service but they really take it seriously at the Paradisus. All the staff are polite, and remember your name, what you like to drink, etc. We went there just looking for a place to veg out in the sun, away from the snow and clouds in Michigan. Mission accomplished! 

The restaurants are all good. The buffet has so much food that no matter what your tastes are, you'll find something good to eat. We especially liked Tempo, the high end gourmet restaurant. I wouldn't recommend eating there if you haven't eaten at that type of place before (really unusual ingredients, prepared in really creative ways). Portions appear small but you will be full by the end of the meal. 

The building and grounds are well maintained, and the lobby area is beautiful. One interesting thing about this place is that they accommodate a number of different types of clients. While we were there, there was a Herbalife convention of some kind. We never saw them except occasionally at some of the restaurants. They have a separate pyramid for families, and a separate pyramid for adults only on the far other end (with its own pool, bar, restaurant, etc.) So no matter what kind of vacation you are looking for, you can find it here.

Shop around for a good price. we booked our stay here at the last minute (maybe 10 days before the plane took off) usingTrip Advisor to find good rates on Cancun hotel properties (shameless plug).  We got an unbelievably GREAT deal at the Paradisus, especially compared to some of the other high end "boutique" hotels they compete with. Rates seem to change daily, so don't give up. 

We would definitely stay here again, and without hesitation recommend it to others.

reviews.author: kerenbd
reviews.title: Not satisfied
reviews.text: The to stay at this hotel wasn't pleasant at all. Service was bad food was bad, very loud, we were having dinner at the sushi place couldn't hear each other that was music there that was so loud with the sender that was so bad it just ruined  the all evening. We had to walk to the restaurant for every meal we needed very uncomfortable. Don't recommend this hotel

reviews.author: Leonard L
reviews.title: Really good resort
reviews.text:
The Paradisus Cancun is a nice hotel for those who wants to visit Cancun with the family, during our stay we do not seen any spring breakers, whats is good for people like me, who just want to spend time with the family for vacations.

This place is recomended for every person who wants to enjoy the beach, a nice pool and good service.

reviews.author: MovinToHI
reviews.title: My first review, because it was THAT good.
reviews.text:
This was my wife and I's first trip to Mexico, and only our second all-inclusive.  I was extremely impressed with the resort, service, staff, as well as the food.  We spent 7 days here with another couple, the second week of January.

The accommodations:  We were in Tower 1, on the 6th floor.  We booked a room with a lagoon view, but our room looked to the north so we could see both the ocean side, as well as the lagoon.  The room itself wasn't huge, but was big enough for us, and our favorite part was a jacuzzi tub on the balcony - an unexpected surprise.  The pyramid structures look pretty cool as a whole, but it is an older resort that is very well maintained. There is a 8-hole Par 3 course on the property, a fun activity to do one morning, but do not take it too seriously.  The course is included, but they do charge for club rental and allow you to share with others.

The food: We had great meals at all the restaurants, and there was so much variety that you do not need to leave the resort if you do not want to.  Bana (sushi) was our favorite restaurant, and coolest atmosphere being located in the center of the Tower 3 atrium.  Naos (buffet), open for all three meals but you can eat breakfast and lunch in the open air patio of the Market Grill, overlooking the pool and the ocean.  Another reviewer said there wasn't much to choose from at the buffet, and that couldn't be farther from the truth.  The Market Grill (meat festival) is a Brazilian style steakhouse game of red light/green light, also very good.  Our friends made our dinner reservations for the next two nights each day, which worked out well.  Other good restaurants were La Perla (very quiet and relaxing), Fuego, and Vento.  My least favorite was Mole.

Entertainment:  Avenue Lounge (bar) is a cool spot, and has awesome views of the ocean.  If you want to catch the shows there at night (which were pretty good) I would recommend getting there 30-45 minutes early and get a drink while you wait.

The service: This is probably the part we were most impressed with.  Everyone was so nice, and welcoming.  When you pass by an employee, many will stop and acknowledge you with a "Buenos Dias/Noches." I want to make sure to highlight a few individuals.  At the pool bar, Erick and Enrique were great, and fun to talk to while at the bar.  They went out of their way to make sure we were having a good time.  Luis was also great running back and forth to our spot by the pool with drinks all day.  My favorite was Manuel at Bana.  He was our waiter the first time we ate there and was so good that we requested him when we ate at Bana again on our last night at the resort.  He had a specific table reserved, special drinks for us, a personalized dessert, and small gifts for our wives.  He was a great waiter, and an even nicer guy.  He definitely helped make the trip very special.

Tip:  We booked direct through the Paradisus website, but joined the Melia Rewards club (free) and saved a substantial amount of money.  Also, on your booking confirmation email there is a link at the bottom to "Click here to get your free hotel shuttle."  We took advantage of that and it worked out really well - saved us about $70.

Drawbacks:
If we could do it again, we would skip the sales presentation.  They signed us up for it when we first checked in.  We have sat through a handful of presentations before, but this one was really pushy.  If you get irritated by a HARD sell, I would decline the presentation at check in.  

The internet in tower 1 could be a little spotty, but we were on vacation to relax and get away, so it wasn't too big of a deal to us.

Overall, I would definitely go back to Cancun, and to the Paradisus.  

Bonus tip:  At the bar, try Kraken Ghost (if they have it).

reviews.author: MRS.TRAVELS.OFTEN
reviews.title: AMAZING
reviews.text:
We stayed here January 25- February 01 2015
This place has amazing service in the restaurants, pool and beach. We were not even Royal Service.
HOTEL  -  there are 5 pyramids
               #1 - members usually
               # 2 seemed to have royal family service
               # 3 the main one with lobby and bars and restaurants, nightly shows from 8pm-9 pm,
                     Can be loud in your room if you are near center of it.
               # 4 quiet I guess

our first room was 3365 but too loud so moved down the hall to 3306 much better ,both ocean front rooms.  they asked if we wanted to upgrade to royal service ,it was $100.00 USA more a night. we said we would check out our room and if needed to maybe in the middle of the week switch ,but didn't have to.

Beach- always enough chairs ,great beach service was great and you didn't have to be royal service ( loved my pineapple mojitos :) , beach volley ball, soft powder white sand no rocks or seaweed on the ocean floor( any washed up on the shore gets bulldozed away every morning) Bali beds can be rented at cocoas bar on the beach for $50.00 usa, but its right infront of the loud DJ so we didn't.

reviews.author: Talee8
reviews.title: We had a great time!  Easy and relaxing. Friendly and hospitable staff.
reviews.text:
My husband and two girls (10yrs & 4yrs) travelled in November 2014.  

We arrived at the resort in the evening.  After checking in we went straight to the buffet, where we were greeted and seated, the buffet is one of many places to eat during dinner.  After being seated we were greeted by there friendly staff, one that really stood out was "Isaias" from the Naos restaurant, the evening staff. He was so friendly and genuine. He was so professional and very hospitable.  He had the biggest smile on his face and was ready to give you the best service.  You can really see that he took pride in his job. We enjoyed seeing him whenever we dined   in the restaurant. Other staff members that really stood out were Eder and David @ Naos (am) breakfast staff. The gentlemen work so hard and really make there guests feel special. They would have the kitchen staff prepare a special dessert as well. I really enjoyed my mimosas during breakfast / brunch, they made sure that  I had my fix-I am on vacation.  The staff work very, very hard so we would always give them a tip cause they deserved it for there superior service.  We are from Vancouver, BC - the service is pretty good here but Mexico staff are always going above and beyond, so please tip!  
We also really liked the fact that we could just walk into an ala carte restaurant without making a reservation or on a waitlist. 
The beaches were beautiful, however, we felt that the pools were a little chilly.  The pool just outside of the buffet is warmer than the rest of the pools.
Yes, we would visit this resort again.

reviews.author: Golfkatt
reviews.title: Breathtaking water front, outstanding service, and excellent restaurants!
reviews.text: On our night to dine at Vento my wife and I were treated to Royal Service from La Papa Restaurant. Dinner on the beach, waves lapping at the shore ---- outstanding service and fantastic menu. This is night we will always remember and a trip we will repeat. The smiles were everywhere, the service was spectacular, and the food selection at every restaurant was great!!!! Highly recommend

reviews.author: Tommyboy-YVR
reviews.title: Minor  Warts keep it from 5 Stars
reviews.text:
My wife and I enjoyed 8 days at the Paradisus in February 2015 and found the property and service to be generally very good. Drawbacks to the property were minor but enough to be noticeable.

On the plus side; great food, convenient location, attentive service and an interesting  vibe. The minuses though we're more and more annoying as the week wore on. Endless times our keys had to be reprogrammed. Often 2-3 times per day. The management wouldn't change rooms but just kept a steady stream of Technicians to come and unlock the door....Over and over...At night in the resort, a vampire would have trouble seeing as the light levels are stupidly low. Enjoy your neighbours as the rice paper accoustics will have you hearing more or less everything from adjoining rooms.If you enjoy a 14 hour bass driven single song...The pool scene is to die for!

The negatives are always easy to spot. The resort is very good, immaculately clean and the staff were attentive and friendly. It was good but not great and to return I might try another before returning to Paradisus.

reviews.author: Amaru_y_Jorge
reviews.title: Great for Adults, not so many kids
reviews.text:
Great place for adults and families with children well educated (that means not noisy at all!).

Families in there seems to understand the concept of Adults-only and they keep their children quiet. Also the staff is conscious of this so they try to keep children in special areas so they also can enjoy in kids' activities.

Hotel is beautiful and comfortable. Location is good, just a few steps from "La Isla" mall and 10 minutes by car from the nightlife area.

Guests are mostly adults (around 30 and 45 years old).

One of the most fancy night clubs is located inside hotel so you may spend some time in there, with a great view to the pool and many beds to lay down to relax to watch the moon or the sun.

Beds are great also for the beach.

Food is great in every restaurant.

Pretty expensive but it worths it!

Definitely one of my favorite places to stay in Cancun.

reviews.author: jacquesrober
reviews.title: Plus and cons of Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
5th February 2015
We are back from a 11 days stay at Paradisus Cancun.
The hotel was beautiful and the staff was outstanding.
The list is long:
Maxime Mathey: Restaurants and beverages
Audeberto Campos: on loan from Melia Los Cabos, restaurants and beverages
Abraham; Naos restaurant
Atilano: Blue Agave restaurant
Jose: Bana restaurant
Guadelupe: front desk
Efrain & Rogelio and all barman: bars
Samuel, Fares, Ismael& Felipe, Carlos: Tempo restaurant,
Luis and many other: Market Place restaurant
Nayela and all staff: concierge desk.
There are many others who helped make our stay memorable.
Thank you to all these people for that.

The beach was beautiful except for walking, we prefer to walk ON the sand rather than IN the sand.
There were a lot of waves, some rather large; it was difficult to get out of the water. 
There were many chairs on the site that were not on the beach but still gave THE view of the beach.
There was a pool, overflowing in the Royal club pool that was heated. In January  it made for a very pleasant swim.

BARS: Service at all bars was outstanding and the alcohol list was filled with top of the line brands.

FOOD: This is were we have a mixed opinion.
Breakfast and lunch were OK
Most restaurants a la carte were barely OK. The quality of the meats was the culprit;
example: beef, almost all commercial grade. If you wanted higher quality (Angus), you had to pay extra(betwenn $45 and $100 extra as shown on the included price list on the table).
Choices on the menus were very limited, with flamboyant names to describe very common food.
Service was always very good.
Restaurant reservation were a pain: they accepted only one reservation in advance, that is for the next day only, 
and it only could be done after 9 am. Time lost every day.

Paradisus prides itself in having on site, a privately owned restaurant whose owner has , altogether 6 Michelin stars.
We were to Paradisus La Perla 2 years ago, and we tried the first of these private restaurants called Passion. The water and house wines were included since we were staying at Paradisus La Perla. It cost us $40 Us per person for the degustation menu.
All different plates were outstanding (10/10).
Tempo the equivalent restaurant??? at  Paradisus Cancun charges for water and wines. They refused to serve us regular bottled water and house wines and served branded water and relatively cheap wines at a cost of around $100 US.
The food was mostly very good except for a few plates that carried flamboyant names and consisted of not much. (7/10). Price, after water and wines was around $55 US per person.

ROOM: Very clean and comfortable.
The whole site is very clean.

All in all we probably would not go back to this hotel, because for us, food is very important, and also there are better beaches to walk on.

The weather was marvelous!!!!!!!
Marie & Jacques

reviews.author: Celsner
reviews.title: A Place to Rest
reviews.text:
This hotel is a great place to rest, with marvellous self service buffet for breakfast-lunch and dinner. It is a great location, though it takes 20 minuts walk until La Isla Mall - which is far the best mall in Cancun. 

However, as Cancun is a place for touring around, Malls is one of the least worries! Within the Hotel there are several Tour Agents, so then you can compare prices of trips and decide with whom to go! Don´t take any decisions before you compare prices and options. However, renting a car I for nearby trips is the best option!

If you are a traveller willing to stay at the beach only and resting, the all inclusive system of the hotel may be a good option. But if you prefer to visit around - Islands, Mayan Ruins and Cenotes - I don´t recomment the all inclusive option. There are so many restaurants nearby, in Malls and close to other attractions, that the all inclusive option makes you a "prisioner" at the hotel. Hope this tip helps someone!

reviews.author: TRieck
reviews.title: Great 50th B-day at the Paradisus!
reviews.text:
My husband and I and 3 other couples went to the Paradisus Cancun Dec 4th-8th 2014 to celebrate my 50th B-day. We had such an amazing time. 

This was my first time in Cancun as well as 2 of the other couples. We arrived in the afternoon at the resort and were immediately whisked away to the Royal Service area (Adults only section of the hotel). We were seated and served champagne...what a great start. They got us all checked in within about 30 minutes as we lounged. We were then introduced to our Butler Ivan. He was very friendly. He showed us to our rooms and explained the Royal Service and made sure we all felt very taken care of. We could order whatever liquor we wanted. We had rum sent to the room. I asked if could send a treat to all the rooms from me which he took care of. He sent chocolate covered strawberries with a note from me.  

We enjoyed almost all the restaurants but have the most fun in the Blue Agave Tequila Bar and Grill. The Brazilian restaurant was really good but too much food for one sitting so go hungry. Did the breakfast buffet and it was pretty good. I think our favorite breakfast was outside by the pool with a view of the ocean. Not many people out there in the morning. It is like a hidden secret. There is also the Hookah Bar that faces the ocean that never seemed to have too many people. The nightly entertainment was ok not spectacular but that wasn't high on our list. 

Our favorite was hanging out at the beach with food and drink service, we felt so pampered. Another day we reserved the Bali beds by the pool and again felt so pampered by the service. Ivan even found us and checked in to see if we needed anything. Both the beach area nad the pool area were adult only. This is part of the Royal Service.

Overall the whole experience was next to perfect. All of my friends (including my hubby and me) would return. They do have a family side that looks pretty nice as well but since we don't have small children we prefer to vacation at an all adult resort or one with an adult only section.

All the staff were super friendly and helped me a few times on how to get to one side of the building to the other. The resort is huge and can be a little confusing. By the time we were leaving I was finally getting it down!

The only thing I didn't really care for was how dark the hallway areas and center of the resort were. At night it was beautiful with all the lights but during the day it was a little dark but I didn't spend my days in the hallways so it didn't really matter that much. 

The overall feel of the Royal Service side is Zen...very Zen. 

Go you will have a great time!

reviews.author: Jeni B
reviews.title: Wonderful long weekend!
reviews.text: My husband have been to Mexico 6 or 7 times now and have stayed in various areas and hotels.  Last March we stayed at The Ritz Cancun and enjoyed our stay.  This trip we decided on Paradisus Cancun and are we ever glad we did!  Quite honestly it was equal to if not better to where we stayed last year.  The food was great, lots of selection, the royal service pool was quite and relaxing with a stunning view of the ocean and steps away from the beach.  Service in all areas of the resort were very good and the view from our balcony was amazing!  The Royal service area has a full bar and snacks all day and as shocked as I am to say this, the evening shows were actually pretty good.  We generally skip them altogether when we are away but we caught 3 of them and they have a very talented group of entertainers.  My suggestion is to ignoring any bad reviews or anyone who wants to give you a minute by minute account of their entire vacation (no one really cares) and book a vacation at this resort.  Sun, sand and wonderful views!

reviews.author: Sumaia
reviews.title: Very good
reviews.text:
I want to thanks the family concierge for making our holiday the best ever , especial thanks to charly , he is just amazing person , always with nice surprises for my baby sophie , we are so thankful ...
Also Reyes , and all the staff they are so good workers 
Sr. manager , you should be proud of your staff ...they are so professional 
Surely we will come back

reviews.author: LaurenAnne25
reviews.title: This is Paradise!
reviews.text:
Breath-taking..... From the moment walking into the lobby, I knew I was in Paradise!!  Magnificent lobby with ivy cascading down from each floor.  "Luxurious-ness" from every angle, every view.  Junior suites are well appointed, furnished with the best of everything.  Views of ocean and sounds of the sea from morning to night.  Our suite had 2 balconies furnished with everything to make an evening of star gazing perfect.

Breakfast and evening buffets was a feast in itself with everything you can imagine.  I especially enjoyed the grilled veggies, fresh fruit, and for those who love sea food, this is the place for you.

We arrived on Super Bowl Sunday and enjoyed watching the game in their premier lounge on huge TV screens while enjoying their party appetizers.  (Didn't enjoy the last minutes of the game.)

I highly recommend this resort for you next trip.

reviews.author: Kayakingfools
reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: We stayed in early November and could not have been happier. The check in was easy and we were escorted to our room. At first I was a bit leary of the place as it is a bit 1980ish. There is ivy coming down from the middle atrium of the hotel and the rooms are along the sides of this. Once you get past the fact the yes the hotel is a bit older, it doesn't matter because it's amazing. Our room was spectacular with a great view of the beach. The food was the best we have had anywhere in the Caribbean, especially the sushi restaurant. Breakfast is huge and we sat by the large koi pond every morning while drinking our coffee. Service was excellent. The best service was from Asuncion, our waitress at the pool bar. She was always friendly and always brought us new drinks even before we knew we needed them. Please tip the service staff. It goes along way. The beach was gorgeous and there is a great jet skiing place down the beach you can easily get to. Room service was efficient and timely. Additionally, as a lesbian couple, we had no problems with either guests or the staff. Everyone was accepting, friendly and professional. Overall, we loved our trip and honestly can't wait to go back.

reviews.author: Christian C
reviews.title: A slice of paradise
reviews.text:
Just got back from a 7 day stay at the resort - all-inclusive.  My wife and I were looking for a pure relaxation stay and this place certainly gave it.  

Check-in - pleasant
Restaurants - Very good for an all inclusive, but I did not like the reservation system, two of the nights we were not on the list although we had made reservations.  Jesus at Mole did a great job rectified one of the nights and quickly for us and fit us in promptly.
Cleanliness - impeccable
Pool and beach - very nice, clean and nicely setup
Service - excellent all around, everyone was very friendly
I got to say Francisco the waiter was extremely warm and professional.  He went above and beyond.  Guardino was a great butler, it was a pleasure to meet him, and Manuel the instructor at the gym was awesome, lead cross-fit classes to cater to all levels yet provide challenge to someone who is a gym rat.

reviews.author: MirandaandRyan
reviews.title: 11 nights in Paradise!
reviews.text:
We are just back from an amazing 11 night stay at the Paradisus, Cancun. We stayed in the Royal Service part of the hotel and thought this was great value for money. We stayed on the lagoon side of the hotel, which sees the sunset. We stayed during a quiet time of the year. 

The royal service means that you get use of the adult only pool area and beach where there are always waiters on hand to serve drinks and food. You can also use the Bali beds around the pool during your stay (these have to be booked). Bernado, a pool concierge is so helpful and has excellent customer service skills. 

We enjoyed all of the restaurants at the hotel, we used our butler to book the restaurants so had no problems with reservations. Our favourite restaurants were Fuego, where I got spoilt on my birthday!, Mole and Market Grill for dinner which was great fun. The waiters that stood to us were Oscar (Mole and blue agave), Francisco and Luis at market grill. 

We enjoyed having a drink in the centre of the royal service pyramid before dinner and listening to the various live music provided. We would like to thank leticia on the reception in royal service, who organised my birthday treats and was very friendly and funny! And also to Flavio who was always helpful filmed the fabulous il divo singers, singing to me on my birthday! Also big thanks to Hector our butler, who always came to find us on the beach or by the pool side to see if we needed anything, got anything we asked for done very quickly and also helped my husband arrange birthday celebrations for me. His ironing skills will also be missed at home.. 

The only reason for a 4 star is not the service but due to two things: 
The hot tubs next the pool were cold! So could not be enjoyed. 
The pool in the spa we also heard from quite a few other guests is cold, this is sold as a luxury experience, so we didn't venture in, we also went to book a treatment but once we found the price was very expensive we didn't go ahead. 

This hotel is one of the older hotels in Cancun but if your looking for somewhere with some character and charm this is defiantly it. We would most definitely return the White sands and sparkly beaches of Cancun and particularly this hotel.

reviews.author: BoSoxFan510
reviews.title: Absolutely Amazing Service and hotel!
reviews.text: We stayed at this hotel for 5 nights in the Royal Service Ocean view suite.  The view was amazing  and the Royal service was even better.  You stay in the 5th building with other Royal service guests and have your own Royal Service pool and beach area.  In the Royal service you have your own food area as well, not a true restaurant, but open bar and snack foods as well as breakfast.  Our butler Juan was an amazing!  He was the nicest person and made you really feel like he was there to serve just you!  He made the whole trip special, he poured a rose filled bath one night with roses on the bed.  He also had chilled champagne one night facing the ocean, it was so nice to be treated that way.  We also became friendly with Rode as he was our friends butler and he was just as nice to us as he was to them.  Rode, let's go to Walmart!  The Royal service pool was quiet and relaxing and the pool concierges Omar and Bernardo were amazing out there, they tried to accommodate all of our requests and gave us everything we wanted.  The beach area was beautiful and clean, the ocean was a little rough, but it was fun.  Francisco helped us on the beach as well as at the Royal service open bar, he was hilarious.  He nicknamed my friend Grandote, which means big guy.  All of the waiters on the beach were excellent as well, they came around constantly to make sure you had drinks or food.  The food at all of the restaurants was really good, you can't go wrong with eating at any of them.  We used the spa for a massage and that was really good as well.  We used the golf course 1 time and had the whole place to ourselves, a really nice 9 hole par 3.  They had some night time shows at 830 every night and all of the shows were awesome, especially the Michael Jackson show.  There isn't a crazy night life here, but there are a couple of bars open if you want to drink late night.  We will definitely be back here and do Royal service again.

reviews.author: George S
reviews.title: Great value for your dollar..but
reviews.text:
We arrived in Cancun using the MagniCharter Airline/Reservation from Monterrey, N.L. They treat you like 1st class. Always polite and courteous. All drinks and beverages included with your ticket. No extra charges and they leave and arrive on time. Never fly Viva-Aerobus if it can be avoided.
Arrived at the Hotel Paradisus Cancun by just after 12 noon. We were told that we would have to wait for at least 2 hours before we could get to our room,a simple request made for a non-smoking with a King Size bed,  which we had reserved months in advance.
 After waiting for 2 hours we returned, explained again what we needed , went through the check in process with a young lady who seemed totally confused, got to the room and found that it had two twin beds and not the King we had requested. When we immediately called down to the front desk,their response was that they could'nt do anything about it..?? No room change, no building change ..
We also upon finding out that we were in building 3 asked about up grading to one of the others and were never given the opportunity.
Fortunately everything else went well. Great staff and very well prepared food made our stay enjoyable.

reviews.author: ilitvino
reviews.title: Paradisus is always the best!
reviews.text: We just returned from this wonderful resort. Overall Cancun is too busy -- to many hotel on the beach, too many people, but if you are in Paradisus -- you don't feel that. There is always a beach chair available and the hotel is very spacious. They also clean algae on the beach in this hotel (not the case in nearby hotels). Inside the resort is very serene with ivy growing and lots of vegetation. Basically, while you are inside -- you feel like you are outside. You can hardly notice the concrete (unlike other hotels). This resort has lots of pools (we stayed in Royal Service section). All pools (at least in Royal Service section) are heated -- which is nice after the sunset. The drinks are good -- but Pina Colada is "from concentrate" -- so we ordered Mojito, mud slide, amoretto sour, etc. The complimentary wine selection is also very nice. Finally we were very pleased with the dining options. There were no lobsters -- but the sushi in the ala cart restaurant were delicious. We also LOVED everything in El Fuego restaurant. DOn't waste your time with La Perla restaurant -- it is a very simple buffet by the pool. There is lot's of nice choices in a la carte restaurants for people who like things tartar and medium rare (e.g. filet mignon). For those who like simple stuff there is also lots of bacon, burgers and fries :-)) But me and my wife don't eat that. We were too busy in the evenings with friends -- so we did not go to the shows (thus, I cannot judge). The rooms are luxurious as well (marble all around). The hotel service is very friendly and they really do try to satisfy even your most ridiculous request (5 star all around!) Overall, great hotel -- worth every dollar and every penny. I would go back again and recommend it to others.

reviews.author: Hjremlinger
reviews.title: Customer service is a plus
reviews.text:
On this 10th visit to the Paradisus Cancun, we received a room in the 1st pyramid, which is heavily scent.  My wife who has asthma could not stay in this room.  

Since accommodations for an ocean front room could not be granted at the time of check in, the supervisor gave us a lagoon view room with Royal Service for the first night.  To comp. us for the inconvenience they have allowed us to use all of the pool side amenities of the Royal Service during our stay.  By the next day they had placed us in the correct accommodations.  

A word of advise, for travelers with allergies and asthma. 
-Pyramid 1 is highly scented
-Pyramid 2 is musty due to the beautiful in door gardens
-Pyramid 3 and adjacent side wings are minimally scented and beautiful, especially the ocean view rooms and is easy on the lungs.
-Pyramid 4 similar to 3
-Pyramid 5 (Royal Service) is quite, private and also minimally scented but still could pose breathing problems depending on the individuals condition.  

Try to contact the hotel prior to your stay to see about requesting a room in pyramid 3 if you are affected by perfumes and air fresheners.  

As in my previous review we still HIGHLY recommend this resort and only received 4 stars due to the inconvenience the first night with our room.

reviews.author: dmerc0302
reviews.title: True paradise!!!!!
reviews.text: We just returned two days ago,  We were there for 7 wonderful nights.  This was our first all inclusive vacation.  We had booked a ocean view deluxe suite, once we got there we upgraded to Royal Service ocean view deluxe room.  Well worth the extra money.  The peace and quiet was so nice  We had the BEST butler ever Hervik. We had gone on a long excursion, came back to the room to find rose petals leading to the bathroom, petals all around the sink and a wonderful bubble bath with rose petals.  He even left a nice note saying after a long day we might like a long soak in the tub!!! (still don't know how he knew we were on an excursion)  We could call him anytime and he would bring us drinks to our room.   If we go back there I would request him. If you go request Hervik you wont be disappointed!!!  The beach was gorgeous!!

reviews.author: Matthew B
reviews.title: Beautiful Beach, Nice Service
reviews.text: Know what you're getting here: beautiful beach, great service, but older building, all indoor restaurants, and "all-inclusive" quality food. Breakfast and lunch oceanside is perfectly fine, but dinner is only ok. Stay at the Royal Service pyramid to get the better beach/pool experience.  Generally it was a nice place and worth the great deal we received (the savings from which we used to go out to dinner instead of staying at the resort).
