reviews.author: kvzw
reviews.title: Wonderful Experience
reviews.text: Every year my family and my in-laws go on a trip, this year it was the Paradisus in Cancun. Hands down, best service and food! The rooms were clean and the staff was very accommodating. If you need any help, just ask for Hector Laguna Weither. He not only is polite but is just a riot to be around!

reviews.author: Wendy M
reviews.title: Less than "Royal Service"upon arrival......
reviews.text:
Let me start off by saying we previously stayed at Paradisus Punta Cana in Royal Service Suite and it was one of our best vacations ever which led us to choose this resort.  After a two and a two and a half hour flight delay and a hectic one and a half hour adventure getting thru customs and waiting 1/2 hour to get on our airport transfer we arrived at the resort to check in around 5:30
pm. We were greeted by a sorry your room isn't ready yet - no real excuse but why don't you have a cocktail and we will try to get it ready- went back hour later still not ready - by this time I
just wanted a shower and to relax and have dinner - they offered us another room we could just
shower in and then they would move us after - I said no wanted our room and wanted to shower
and not be moved. we went to dinner - still with no room  - on our way back we stopped in to 
main resort check in and asked to speak with manager - I was exhausted and very upset - he made a call got us our room in royal service gave us our keys and had our luggage sent there - he apologized and told us he would email the Royal Service Manager and have him contact us
regarding the problem - we were there til Wednesday morning - NEVER heard from him!!!!!!

reviews.author: Lisa F
reviews.title: I will be back!
reviews.text: I just got back from spending 6 days/5 nights at Paradisus Cancun all-inclusive resort with my son, daughter-in-law, and grandson.  What a great experience!  From the moment we walked in the door, we were treated like royalty.  Bianca escorted us to check-in and from there, explained the things we needed to know and helped us make our dinner reservations for the rest of the trip.  Any time we ran in to her, she remembered our names and our schedule!  She even made a point to say goodbye to us when we left.  The food was excellent at every restaurant we went to and room service was quick and delicious.  Jaime, one of our servers, went out of his way to get some cheese rolls and a specific drink and did it all with a smile.  All workers at Paradisus are kind, curteous, friendly, hard-working, and do everything with a smile.  It is not unusual for them to go the extra mile.  Francisco was especially helpful on our departure.  Rooms were beautiful and clean with large windows, sliding glass doors, and balconies.  In general, the hotel was gorgeous and had an elegant, relaxed feeling.  Live music was performed in many of the restaurants with the "three amigos" authentic Mexican singing group and the saxophone player being my favorites.  It was always easy to find someone to answer questions as well.  The pools were kept very clean.  My 2-year-old grandson had a wonderful time in the 2-foot-deep pool.  The beach is very close and kept clean as well.  The only draw backs were that if we wanted a palapas, we would have to wake up at 6:00am to place our towels on the recliners under the palapas in order to "reserve" our spot.  We had to do the same thing to "reserve" a recliner by the pool.  If not, there was no place to sit.  I understand they are in the process of replacing their old recliners with new recliners and should have more available by the end of March 2014.  Overall, I would highly recommend this all-inclusive resort to anyone.  I can't wait to come back!

reviews.author: Harry__Hood95
reviews.title: Beautiful beach, average food
reviews.text:
Just got back from a week-long stay at the Paradisus Cancun.  We were booked at the Paradisus Playa del Carmen, but after the hour-long bus ride to Playa, we were told that they had over-booked and would have to send us to Cancun.  We weren't happy, but made the most of it because this is a very nice resort.  Nowhere near as nice as the resort in Playa that we paid for, but still more than adequate for our needs.

To start, we had an ocean view room on the 5th floor, and the view was stunning.  The room itself was nice but not special,  The fridge was stocked with beer and soda, but no liquor for cocktails which was disappointing as most resorts I've stayed at in the past provided whatever you wanted in your room.  Our TV went out one day and it took longer than it should have to get someone up to take a look at it.  And we only had one chair on our balcony, even though we could see plenty of other rooms that had two.  

The food was good...not great but I didn't have any complaints.  We ate at most of the restaurants and nothing stood out for being especially great or poor.  Only real problem was that it was almost impossible to get reservations at a decent hour.  Seriously, book your reservations EARLY if you don't want to be eating dinner at 9:30 or later.      

The pool was nice & big, very good swim-up bar and it allowed you to enjoy the sun almost all day.  Not even close to enough chairs, and no floats or anything to lounge around in the water.  Also, it's not a big deal but the pool was really deep (I think 5+ feet) with no shallow areas besides the kids area.  Not enough chairs is a pretty big negative.

Beach was very well maintained, which is a big plus for me. Again, not even close to enough chairs, but I don't mind laying down a towel in the sand so it didn't bother me.  I did a fair amount of walking up and down the beach, and it seemed the Paradisus's beach was as-well or better-maintained than almost any other resorts on that strip of beach.  

Service was very friendly, although things seemed disorganized.  We waited 2-3 hours to get our room, with very little input as to what to do in the interim.  There wasn't much of a map, or list of restaurants or spa services or pricing for excursions that I saw.  I was interested in either taking a day-trip excursion or getting a massage at some point; however it was near impossible to tell what desks were for what, who worked for the resort or who was a "tour-guide pitchman", or how much things cost.  

I would definitely stay at this resort again for the right price, and would recommend it to a friend as the resort was clean, the staff was friendly and the beach was gorgeous.  It's not a 5-star place, but you're not paying 5-star prices so as long as you have the right expectations you should have a great time.

reviews.author: Bart A
reviews.title: Had a blast!
reviews.text:
My wife and I just returned from this resort last night and had a wonderful vacation.  The resort is very large and has a lot to offer, but not so large you have to walk a mile to get to anything.  I've probably been to 10 or so All Inclusive resorts and the food was better than expected.  Most resorts your stuck with the buffet more often than not but here they gave you some extra options if you look for them, even for breakfast and lunch.  Make sure to book your dinner reservations immediately each day for the following day at the nice restaurants, they do fill up.  Don't fret over which ones to pick, they were all excellent and offered a great variety.  Mole was our personal favorite though.  The biggest surprise to me was the quality of food on the buffet and the large variety.  Of course it has some stuff on there that not everyone will like, but hey, its a buffet, if you don't like what you got just get another plate and try something else.  The only complaint we had on the food really was the stuff they were offering down by the pool at the tiki hut place.  It wasn't good at all but no big deal, we just tossed it and moved on over to the buffet.

The lobby and main areas of the hotel are absolutely beautiful.  Lots of vegetation, great lighting, and very open.  We felt as though we were walking through a village surrounded by fountains and gardens.  The bar in center of that was great too.  Ask for Francisco and Josue.  They made very creative and delicious drinks.

Pools were huge with great views of the beach and ocean.  The largest pool was more of a fun atmosphere with music, dancing, swim up pool bar, etc.  The pool on the north side of the property was very quiet and peaceful though so you could choose either.  Tons of beach space which I noticed right away that a lot of the other resorts didn't have.  Plenty of room to toss a football or play in the sand.  

Service was pretty good for the most part, but even though they tell you tips are included, the service is noticeably better once they realize your willing to drop a dollar or two here and there.  But that's been the same at any of the all inclusive resorts I've been to.  If you don't tip they will likely take their time getting to you but the good news is that it doesn't take much.  

Location is good in terms of shopping and night life.  It was a $10 cab to the center of all the action.  I'm guessing the resort is 3-4 miles south of it.

reviews.author: Jon G
reviews.title: Royal services
reviews.text: Upon arriving we were informed we were being upgraded to Royal services. This was far and beyond anything we expected! The staff from David in the pool area to our house keeper were excellent! We were truly treated like royalty! The restaurants were overall very good. Our time there was relaxing and rejuvenating! Would recommend this hotel without reservation.

reviews.author: Greg S
reviews.title: Still full from my vacation!
reviews.text:
The last time I was at an all-inclusive was when I was 13 years old and had an amazing time.  I had the same feeling with Paradisus Cancun and felt young again!  Service was absolutley amazing.  The buffet at Naos is one of the best I have ever been to.  You need to make reservations to all the restaurants for dinner except to the buffet and to Blue Agave.  If we couldn't get a reservation, we were ok with that as we loved the buffet.  Asuncion at the pool, who served us our drinks and kindness, was amazing.  She treated us like royalty and brought us drinks even when we didn't ask for it.  Asuncion was the our highlight of service at Paradisus.  She made us feel welcome and we always tried to be at the main pool where the pool bar is because.  Also, Salvador and Giovanni, the pool bar bartenders are the nicest and welcoming guys ever!  If you ask for the best liqour they have, they'll give it you, not only with a big smile on their faces, but going along with party with you.  There were activities everyday from Zumba, to beach volleyball to beach soccer.  Angel and Fabian was always there and keeping everyone motivated and having fun throughout all the games!

Things to note: You have to wake up at 6:30AM or 7:00AM to grab a good seat at the pool.  People will take you chairs after 30 minutes, so be careful.  Resorts where you should relax, this not be allowed and should be changed.  It got frustrating at times when people would take your chairs even if you were 30 minutes before.  This is the only negative.  I give this hotel a 99%!

reviews.author: NOLABassMan
reviews.title: Location, Service and Complete Luxury
reviews.text:
My wife and I took our honeymoon at Paradisus Cancun. Full disclosure is that a family friend gave us their Club Melia timeshare at her annual cost. So, we started out ahead of the game with a gorgeous room, a concierge (who we didn't really utilize that much), and access to some items that might not be part of the off the shelf rate.
That being said, we couldn't have asked for a better week.
I'll start with the negatives. It rained one day out of seven (weather gods be darned). The buffets were, well, buffets. I'd stay away from the seafood lunch buffet. Hadn't had heartburn like that in a while. Skip Fuego, there's better dinners to be had. Lastly, not enough bathrooms close to the pool area down in the Club Melia/family concierge area. I've got to stretch to come up with negatives though.
Positives were truly everything else. Beautiful location. World class service. Great room. Everything we requested was fulfilled professionally and quickly.
I need to give some shout outs and some tips for y'all ---
Restaurants:
If you like sushi, go to Bana. It is very good. All of it. Sashimi was rollin'. Spicy tuna very good, really everything there is good. Just order to your taste.
The tapas restaurant, Vento, is the best restaurant there. My wife was starting the transition from vegetarian to meat eater before we left. Vento put her over the edge. 
Personal shout outs: My boy Cristian at the cabana service/pool bar took very good care of us every day. You're lucky if you're in his service area. (aside: Cristian, call me about Mardi Gras for real bro. Bring your old lady to New Orleans and let us get your drinks for a week)
The servers at both Bana and Vento are professional, top notch waiters. Valeria, our concierge, took good care of us.
My tip to future visitors: talk to the folks who are taking care of you. They are the cream of the crop in the Cancun area. Make sure you tip these folks. I know it is an all inclusive and you've paid for that. But think about it, you tip at home. Tip these folks more. If the service is anywhere near the level that we received you will agree that they deserve to be tipped as well if not better than you tip at home.
I hope that we can visit again soon. Truly a wonderful trip. It was made better by all of the fantastic folks that took care of us on this close to perfect honeymoon.

reviews.author: marinahftz
reviews.title: Great vacation but not ideal for families with younger children
reviews.text:
This was our first time at the Paradisus Cancun. This place is only 25 minutes or so from the airport. We arrived early in the morning and had to wait till 3pm to check in and get a room key. The place is very beautiful though and all the staff are very friendly and helpful! Judith was particularly helpful in supporting us in anything we needed and made sure to book various restaurants for us throughout the trip.

The beach is AMAZING! It's white sand and clear blue ocean! Very clean. The only down side was the competition for the lounge chairs on the beach, people are up early to reserve them with their towels and stuff! Lets put it this way, if you come past 7 am you may have trouble finding a spot! Otherwise, it's great.

The thing that really disappointed us was their lack of activities for younger kids. Their kids club is for ages 5+. We have a 2.5 year old who was excited to be with the other children and wanted to get involved in activities when he saw them, but they wouldn't let him get involved (even in arts and crafts) despite the parents being there with him. However, we did borrow a little car for our son for the time we were there and he enjoyed riding in it throughout the hotel. 

Otherwise everything was good and the food was delicious! Staff was helpful and the place is gorgeous! We didn't really go to the nightly entertainment but they had live music in the lobby during dinner at the sushi bar and at the buffet place.

reviews.author: Samantha S
reviews.title: WOW! Absolute Paradise at the Paradisus!
reviews.text:
We recently spent 6 days at the Paradisus and had a fabulous time.  We were able to get the upgrade to Royal Service for a discounted price and it was ABSOLUTELY 100% WORTH IT! A separate building, separate pool area, cabanas included (everyone else has to pay $60 a day for a cabana), private beach area, special lunch restaurant where food is delivered to your cabana, aromatherapy pillows at night... AND a BUTLER to take care of all your dinner reservations and any other needs you have... I MEAN!!! Doesn't get better than that!!! 

The only thing more impressive than the Royal Service is the staff.  From the second we walked in the door, the staff was friendly, super helpful, and really went out of their way to take care of us.  We were especially impressed with the servers who worked the Royal Service pool area... They were walking around all day taking drink and food orders and were really on top of their game.  The overall work ethic of the staff was so impressive- they really made us feel like they wanted to take care of us.   Also, HUGE shout-out to our butler JUAN! He was fabulous- by the end of the trip he could anticipate what we needed before we even asked! 

Finally, we loved the food at the Paradisus! We tried Mole, Vento, Bana, Fuego, Naos (the buffet) and La Palapa (Royal Service restaurant).  The servers at Mole were super nice but a little slow, but everyone else at the other restaurants were fabulous.  The food is themed at each restaurant so you get a different feel every time, and all of the food we had was delicious... Our favorite was Vento because it was more classic Italian food that we're used to but Fuego was a close second.  Also, the steak at La Palapa was outragous!! Overall highly impressed! 

And the views... absolute perfection.  It's the picturesque Caribbean-blue water, white sand, palm trees, and sun that everyone is looking for on a vacation in Cancun.  

Honestly, our stay here was more than what we had hoped for... We joined the Rewards program and will definitely be back!!!

reviews.author: acer1010
reviews.title: Awesome vacation at the Paradisus Cancun Resort!
reviews.text:
This was our 1st time at the Paradisus Cancun Resort.

Our Transportation from the Airport to the Hotel was well organized, on time and only a 20 minute ride.

Checking was quick and easy with the assistance of Judith.

Our room was spacious and very clean, thanks to the hard working  Housekeeping Staff.

The Transat Rep (Eduardo) was helpful with any questions we had about Mexico and Excursions.

We truly enjoyed our day trip to Tulip!

All of the Staff at this Resort were very friendly and helpful.

The Hotel, Beach & Pool are spectacular! 

We ate at most of the a la carte Restaurants, inn which our favorite was Bano (Sushi), our Waiter, Francisco was awesome!

We would highly commend this Resort to anyone visiting Cancun.

Mr & Mrs Williams
Toronto, Canada

reviews.author: Ethan
reviews.title: Sadly wasn't mine
reviews.text: This hotel is lovely. In this hotel you can get everything from Russian soup (borscht) to sushi and that's in the food department. In the drinks area it is basically like all other all-inclusives in Cancun,   Corona beer to Smirnoff Vodka just on alcohol but for kids as always the menu lacks drinks with no alcohol. My relatives had a 4-bed room in this hotel but I was in a 2-bed room in Gr Solaris. This hotel isn't for first timers in Cancun, it is more for people that have already been in Cancun multiple times.

reviews.author: brad p
reviews.title: Food was amazing
reviews.text: This resort has some serious wow factor with the entry and main lobby, The food is definitely 5 star and the best I've ever had at an all-inclusive resort. I didn't like the different levels inclusivity that were available as we never knew for sure what was included and what was extra. The bedroom looked nice but we found it quite humid, almost damp in the room even though we kept the doors closed. Really nice stay and would go again

reviews.author: EFC398
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text:
We just got back a few days ago, stayed for 9 days.  My family had 2 rooms next to each other in the main building.  We really enjoyed our stay and PLAN on going back next year!n Just for comparison, we have stayed at Dreams Puerto Aventuras and Iberostar Playa Carmen and like Paradisus Cancun best of these.

Rooms:  Pretty nice, just like in the professional photos.  Not new but not outdated either.  We had all that we needed, no complaints.  The only downside was the noise was a bit much on some days as we were right above a restaurant and near the dance club but it didn't impact our stay enough to really mention more than that.   I thought that being only on the 2nd floor we wouldn't see the ocean but I was wrong, we had a beautiful view of both the ocean and 2 pools.  It was so nice for my husband and I to sit on the balcony at night, our kids next door.  The sound of the waves and ocean breeze was great at night.  We had our balcony door opened a bit while we slept which was amazing.

Drinks: Good.  We are not big drinkers but after dinner we would go to  the bar and order some drinks.  I usually had them make something that they recommended which was great.  They seemed to take great pride in pleasing and always made something special.  I loved trying all of the new drinks!  I didn't find them watered down but we tipped pretty well and I'm sure that made a difference.  

Beach:  Amazing!  Best beach I've ever been to, hands down.  Clean, gorgeous water and white sand.  We did have to get up early to get beach chairs but it was worth it and not that big of an issue.  

Service:  Great!  We had basic service, not royal but it was still great.  The staff all went to great lengths to help with whatever we needed.  Most servers had smiles and "holas" for us but even those that didn't did not bother us.  We are from Boston, so we are good with this :)  I would rate the service as very good.

Cleanliness:  Great.  Housekeeping was great!  They came when we asked them to and did a fabulous job with both of our rooms each day.  There were workers cleaning every inch of the property every day it seemed and it showed because the place practically sparkled!

Overall it was a great experience and we WILL be back!  Note:  Please tip the service staff, they work so hard and really rely on tips to just pay their bills.

reviews.author: bigrjboxer
reviews.title: 12 day trip
reviews.text: Overall trip was pretty nice.Excellent weather everyday.Theres not enough chairs by the pool or the beach so we would get up at 530am and reserve the ones we wanted.Did see some fighting over chairs.Drinks were weak and watered down.Entertainment was short and not very good.Tried to get some different music at the 5th avenue.Record spinner was rude and wouldnt even consider it.The sushi restaurant was great but the other restaurants were just avg.Nice pool area though.Music sometimes too loud though when your trying to read and relax.Beach area always clean and nice.Staff overall real friendly.Nice golf course.$30  for pull cart balls and clubs.Par 3 so pretty short.Buses come by every 5 min so $1 each to go shopping or restaurants.Overall pretty nice.Spread out over large area so be prepared to walk.Rooms large,Mostly all nice views.Would go back.

reviews.author: Brent B
reviews.title: Hit and Miss
reviews.text: This hotel had some good points and also some bad points on our trip.  The facilities are mostly very nice.  They have 3 nice pools, one of which is no kids, if you upgrade to the "Royal Service".  The staff was nice and seemed to be very customer minded.  The rooms seemed a bit dated and in my opinion, need updated.  Every morning when we went to the beach and pool, it seemed there was not enough beach chairs with umbrellas and the chairs around the pool seemed to be in short supply.  We actually did not sit on the beach any because of not having enough chairs and umbrellas.  The spa was so-so.  Not the worst message but a far cry from the best I have had.  The food was ok for an all inclusive.  I did think the breakfast was not very good.  I would go back, but also would have my eyes out for something better.

reviews.author: tugacrab
reviews.title: Great Service and a Relaxing Time
reviews.text: The hotel has beautiful common areas and nice rooms. The staff are very friendly and efficient and we felt that they took care of us. It's a great setup for a family with children and we recommend Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: Lucas B
reviews.title: Never before seen Amazing!
reviews.text: This was by far the best trip ever! The food was Amazing and so fresh. The pool was gorgeous and the staff is very upbeat, easygoing and fun! The general staff is also very nice and accommodating. Also the rooms were very nice and if you stay in family concierge you have a jacuzzi on your balcony. I would definitely buy a timeshare here. One of the best hotels in Cancun! The beach is a must to see,it is so beautiful and the waves are very good! I would definitely recommend the restaurants Fuego and Market Grill. This is hands down the best hotel EVER!!!

reviews.author: NuttyCrab
reviews.title: What we were looking for....
reviews.text:
This is a beautiful location, with beautiful facilities, and everyone at the resort really gets the idea of customer service, which goes a long way.  I especially liked how the entire resort was connected so you didn't have to go outside in the heat of the day or a rainstorm. The pool was nice because I could swim the entire length of the hotel property, connecting from one pool to the other. And the beach is wide and clean. Getting a chair is a bit of a pain, but I got up at 6 everyday and so it wasn't too bad for me. 

Special kudos to Grace in family concierge, who took great care of us from beginning to the end. We were traveling with a young child and she did the little things and big things to make it all work out great for us. The direct transfer with Cheap Caribbean was very much worth it for my family of 3. 

None of the food places (except tempo which we didn't get to) are outstanding culinary delights. But the food is very good and there are lots of choices (I give food B+). I liked the main cafeteria (Naos), Fuego (Jose did right by us), and Blue Agave the best.  Ibana has the best bar, but I wasn't impressed with its sushi.  I agree with some reviewers that this isn't the newest facility and that there are signs of its age...our a/c broke for part of one night and the balcony hot tub leaked. But both were quickly addressed. As I said, good service goes a long way. 

Overall, this was a top notch vacation for two very tired, over worked, and sleep deprived parents. We swam, played with the kid, drank and ate, and took two hour naps each day. Never left the property. Perfect!

reviews.author: hiritos
reviews.title: Good-looking hotel from outside
reviews.text:
Hotel looks nice from outside and public area.
Once you are in the room, back to 80's.
Rooms are very old and tired infrastructure.
Water dosen't drain correctly, furniture very old and needs to be refurbished.
We had opted for royal service.
Only good thing about this was in that area, no kids are allowed. If you want to relax without hearing kids screaming, good choice. Otherwise quite useless.
Most of the staff are very helpful and welcoming.
Special thanks to Victor at royal service concierge and Asencio royal service manager who made our stay better than how it started.

reviews.author: rzolt
reviews.title: Always a great stay.
reviews.text:
We just returned from our 4th stay at Paradisus Cancun and have a reservation for November, 2014, as well.  We have always enjoyed ourselves there and appreciate the many little things the staff may do to make our staff more comfortable.  The room was nicely furnished and the beach is amazing. 

Although we always travel as a family we noticed that there seems to be plenty to do for singles and that scene doesn't seem to get rambunctious as singles scenes often do.  So, while Paradisus has always been great for us it looks as if many different people with different ideas of how they want to spend their vacation have also enjoyed themselves.

I would recommend Paradisus to anyone who wants a wonderful stay at a first rate resort in cancun.

reviews.author: Jetsetting Jogger
reviews.title: met our high expectations
reviews.text:
My husband and I went to Cancun with a group of friends for a mini vacation. We paid a bit more to stay at Paradisus, but I think it was worth it. It was maybe a 20 minute ride from the airport in a more quiet part of the Hotel Zone. We stayed in the main building of the hotel which is open in the middle the whole way up. Vines  It can be a little noisy at night because of the nightly entertainment but I noticed it quieted it down around 11 pm. The main building opened up to the beach with two pools in front of it. The one was directly in front of the Market Grill while the other, larger pool had a pool bar. I never noticed kids, but I believe families are welcome here. It also was not a Spring Break type of resort, but a relax and have a cocktail by the beach type of place. 

Food and Drinks
The buffet had a decent selection of food and was pretty much what you expect a buffet to be. They had indoor and outdoor seating. The Market Grill is right next to the buffet and seemed to serve lunch and dinner. We ate there for lunch and would not recommend it. It could have just been the timing or our meals, but the food was subpar and took forever to receive. There is a little taco restaurant bar (I think it is Blue Agave) which served amazing tacos. This might have been our favorite little place to go and relax. Our favorite meal though was at Mole. With a party of 8 we had a small room to ourselves. It also seemed like a Mexican wine cellar. It was 4 or 5 courses of all excellent food. The next night we ate at Bana which is in the middle of the hotel. I was under the impression it was more Asian fusion, but in fact it was almost strictly all sushi. They brought an extensive wine list on an ipad, but these were all at an additional charge. At all the places the wine choice was 'white' or 'red'. 

Entertainment
There were a couple of bars on the resort. The one had the nightly show and very comfortable chairs and loungers. Unfortunately most of the seating was to the side and behind the show so we never saw that much of it. The nightly show was held on a small stage facing the open area of the middle of the hotel. Outside there is a list of daily activities going on in the resort. 

Beach
Cancun has beautiful beaches. There were waiters on the beach to provide us drinks. The beach was always full but not overwhelming so. Most days we were able to get enough chairs, but had to be willing to drag them to get enough (keep in mind there were 8 of us). 

Rooms
We booked the cheapest room which was the lagoon view room. It had specactular views of the lagoon (and Aqua World). Frankly I do not think it would be worth it to pay the extra money for a beach view. We were able to see the sunset most nights while we got ready for dinner. The room had a small balcony with two chairs (although some of our friends had loungers).There was a flat screen tv with a number of channels in English. We had the king size bed and a  couch. The mini bar was stocked with beer, soda, plenty of water, chips, and Oreos. The hotel also provided a couple of bottles of water in the bathroom to brush your teeth. The shower took some getting use to (there is a low hand held shower head popular in Europe plus a raindrop shower head). The one knob was for the hand held and the other for the raindrop. Make sure to read the diagram. 

wifi
Since none of our phones worked in Mexico we used the wifi to communicate via iMessage. The wifi was throughout the property- lobby, rooms, beach, pool, balcony and it was free. However, it was spotty, really, really spotty. Sometimes it'd be perfectly fine then you'd lose it and couldn't get it back. 

Service
Excellent. I unfortunately was hit by a car while running and was out of commission most of the trip. The resort did room service the entire time I could not get out of bed. They even opened up the kitchen when it was closed. They allowed us to use the wheelchair more than normal and helped carry our bags. They truly took care of us when we really needed it. We tipped our bartenders but never felt like we had to. I've been to resorts where the workers come right out and ask for tips, but not here. There were a lot of upgrades at this hotel you could pay for. We chose to only do the one on Super Bowl Sunday. My friends paid to have two couches directly in front of the big screen and have bottle service. 

I would highly recommend Paradisus!

reviews.author: JMW2712
reviews.title: Best staff and most beautiful resort
reviews.text:
We spent 10  days at the Paradisus Cancun..... what a beautiful resort. The resort , restaurants, beach and grounds were gorgeous but what made the holiday perfect was the staff .Everyone was so helpful,  the staff at the front desk, the staff in all the restaurants and the waiters.

We spent most everyday on the beach and  had the best service of any resort that we have visited in Mexico. our server, Sofonia, was amazing. 

Sofonia took such good care of us. He not only kept our glasses full but he also made sure no one took our chairs or palapa,  when we went for a walk on the beach or in the water for a swim. Such a nice guy. !!!
Paradisus has done a wonderful job of hiring great people..... but we think Sofonia is the best !!!!

reviews.author: Jonoco2013
reviews.title: My Favorite Hotel In Cancun
reviews.text:
We stayed at Paradisus Cancun 5 nights to celebrate our anniversary. First of all, the hotel is GORGEOUS. It is spotless, with a dramatic lobby. Everything in this hotel is luxurious. We previously stayed at Dreams Cancun and Live Aqua and found Paradisus to be so much more beautiful than the other two.

We HIGHLY recommended that you pay extra for Royal Service. It is worth every penny and they truly make you feel like royalty. As part of Royal Service, you are checked at a separate, access restricted and adult only building. Victor checked us in and he was GREAT. While sipping our welcome drink, he explained everything in detail and provided us with a cel phone so we could contact our butler when needed. He also went ahead and made our dinner reservation for the next day (another advantage of Royal Service is that your butler takes care of making your dinner reservations).

Hector was our butler and he took us to our room. There was a bottle of champagne, berries, and a rose petal heart in the room. The rooms are also VERY beautiful, clean, and comfortable. And contrary to other hotels in Mexico, the bed was actually very comfortable. Hector was also so nice and took care of our requests. From pillows with aromatherapy, freshly squeezed pineapple juice from another building, drawn bath, etc. On our anniversary night they surprised us with another bottle of champagne and chocolates. Made our anniversary very special. Thank you Victor and Hector.

Natalia is the Royal Service manager/supervisor and we really have to give a special thanks to her. She is AMAZING! My husband wanted to surprise me with an extra night but he couldn't get in touch with Orbitz to make the change. Natalia went above and beyond to help him. She spent almost an hour making calls and coordinating everything. If it wasn't for her, we wouldn't have been able to stay because it was just impossible to contact Orbitz. And once she got that done, then she told my husband to go enjoy the day and she took care of contacting our airport transportation, doing our flight check in and printing our boarding pass. We had never experienced such outstanding customer service. THANK YOU NATALIA!

Royal Service has its own pools, jacuzzi and beach area.  Also very beautiful! This adult only area was quiet and not crowded. We walked around the other non-royal pool areas and they were crowded, noisy, etc. A special thanks to Alexander, the pool concierge. He was also great. Every day he made our reservations for the Bali bed, set them up for us, and if we preferred another location (closer to the beach) he would move us as soon as one became available. (Make sure to reserve your Bali bed in advance). We had a Bali bed everyday and didn't have to worry about getting up early to go reserve a bed, chair, etc.

At the pool and beach area, Gerardo R. was our waiter. Wow, he was so diligent. Before we would finish our drinks he was checking on us, getting our drink or food order (you can order lunch at the pool from the Royal Service exclusive restaurant- La Palapa). It was nice not having to interrupt our day at the pool or beach to go get lunch. 

As for the food, we tried several restaurants. They were all top notch, great food and service. You always felt you were dining at an expensive restaurant. We only did the buffet twice and the variety was amazing but of course, crowded. We recommend that you have your breakfast at the Royal Service area. Not as much variety, but still good food and it is quiet, relaxed, and you can quickly get an espresso or cappuccino. It was a good way to start your day. By the way, don't miss trying the tacos at Blue Agave. Yummy and no reservation required. You might catch the mariachis while you are there.

As for nightlife, there is plenty to do right in the hotel. We didn't leave the hotel at all. There is nightly entertainment (actually really good), live music, etc. The bars are awesome and the music at the Red Lounge is great for dancing. Jesus was our waiter at Avenue Bar and Red Lounge and he was fantastic. He remembered our names, our drinks, etc. Always very attentive.
Thanks Jesus.

Don't miss doing the hydrotherapy at the spa. It is included as part of Royal Service. The spa hydrotherapy pool is actually pretty romantic in the evening. 

Again, go with Royal Service. Read about all the advantages of this service at the hotel's website.

Again thanks to all those mentioned in the review who made our stay at Paradisus unforgettable. We can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: Murray D
reviews.title: Great times had walking the beach and enjoying the music.
reviews.text:
Had a 4 day three night pass for the Paradisus resort from when I visited just a year ago.  Have never stayed in Cancun before at the resorts always going to Cozumel or Playa Del Carmen.  Meals at the buffets were nice and the chef's had even better chicken fish or beef and pork to cook in front of you.   I don't like scallops or octopus but noticed the chef dumping big piles on the frier.  I had chicken or regular fish.   The regular fish is always excellent in Mexico.   The fried fish was so good at the Mole Restaurant I tried one night Al La Carte.   I just ate at the buffets because I found them to be fine for me.   Lots of different things to satisfy most people.   
The beach has nice benches but they get taken early by people putting towels and leaving for the day it seems.   I sat several times and seen 50% of the places empty with some book or sandals left there to guard the spot just in case they decided to return.   They have the rule in place to avoid this but no one pays any regard.   
The entertainment in the evening is best suited to couples with children.   Nothing too damaging happens.   I really enjoyed Monday night.   The shows at the Melia club in Playa Del Carmen were much better last year.  
The beach is big and goes both ways for miles all sand.   Down a Km was the Oasis where the Student City was set up.   They has DJ's and dancing events on all afternoon so that was fun to walk to.  Nice and quiet at night here at the Paradisus.  I was going to bed at 10 PM every night.  There is no CBC or Canadian programming on the TV's here.   So some Olympic events like Can Vs Lat could not be watched and Can Vs USA hockey was only in Spanish but it was OK just to watch!

reviews.author: mutzy44
reviews.title: vacation
reviews.text: Great time ..nice staff....very clean...I will go back for sure...There were 4 of us on this trip.The service was fantastic and Royal Service is the way to go.The food was good and a good selection of restaurants..The pools are very clean and beautiful.The beaches are great,just one problem,they need more shade.You got to get up early to save a spot.Been to many hotels and that seems to be the problem where ever we go.The rooms were always had a clean fresh sent when you walked in and the room service was fantastic.I am looking forward to going back next year...

reviews.author: Sanazita
reviews.title: Great Restaurants in a beautiful hotel !!
reviews.text: The hotel is very beautiful, really well decorated  with a lovely beach. It is relatively an old hotel and you would notice that in the rooms. They are renovated but you'd notice they have spent much more on the exterior than the rooms. I believe they have 9 restaurant which we tried at least half. The food was incredible !! The other all inclusive hotels that I have been to ( mainly in Turkey ) the quality of food was just ok but here it was THE BEST. It was worth all the money we paid ( it is expensive ). The waitresses & waiters are well trained and you feel you have gone to a fancy restaurant. The bartenders are great , I had so many amazing drinks & cocktails there. ( do not forget to tip them, they deserve it). Apart from the receptionist that lied to us (nothing major though) the rest of the staff were friendly. They have a cool pool bar too and the place is a popular wedding destination ( we saw at least 3 weddings ). The only thing that I did not like about this hotel was the strong spa smell in the lobby area. ( I was not sure if they wanted to mask a smell or it was just the Spa) BTW the Spa was pricy !

reviews.author: Kez_tiva1
reviews.title: Service was excellent...best holiday ever!
reviews.text:
I would recommend this place to anyone and everyone. I find it to be more suitable for families, couples even groups say 25+  

The service was excellent and very friendly, the amenities and restaurants were great. I like to eat healthy and clean and there were so many healthy options from the buffet. This was one thing I was worried about eating at a all you can eat buffet. 

Jesus was one of our servers at the Market grill/Buffet restaurant for breakfast he was very engaging and super friendly. Got to know his life story and you really learn and understand how hard these people work, always have a smile on their face and for what we earn in Canada they slave away for not much $$$ so we always made sure we tipped wherever we could. The bar tenders and servers at least $2-$5 every time. I heard they only get 60 paso a day, thats like $5 american.

The rooms were clean and the beds very comfortable. The resort had 5 pools to swim in and the most excellent beach front. Plenty of chairs to use however you would want to be up and reserving them by 9am-10am if your lucky.

The smell of the resort was so fresh and delicious I cannot talk it up anymore.

I have only stayed in Cancun once before but this resort should be up there with your option :)

reviews.author: Carin D
reviews.title: Our home resort
reviews.text: My husband and I bought a timeshare here when it was Gran Melia, Melia Vacation Club.  Paradisus has made some changes, which are mostly good.  The service hasn't changed, excellent, welcoming and constant catering....Can't say more about that, if you want to be waited on you need to go there.  At the pool, or on the beach, it doesn't matter.  The entertainment is new and very welcomed.  We went last year, which was the first year that Paradisus owned it and were pleasantly surprised at the updates in the Ave. Bar. The beach is the best that we have been to, cool/soft sand.  We like to visit new places but none compare yet to this resort.

reviews.author: Kenvet810
reviews.title: As good a vacation as you want
reviews.text: I always read the reviews before I book a vacation and have been writing them too so I hope this helps. We have owned a timeshare here for over 15 years and have watched this resort grow, because it is a great place to stay. BUT it is also a hotel and the timeshare people will chase you around promising you the world if you don't say NO. Just say it and they will be gone. I have read many of the reviews good and fair and the one common complaint is the resort not pampering enough. This is a 4star on a bad day and 5star on a good day resort. If you want Ritz treatment and food and services, stay there. This is an affordable and well maintained resort with many restaurants, bars and long beautiful beaches. The service is great, but the corporate offices need to realize that they are understaffed so the waiters,bus boys, maids and staff are so overextended that they can't be every time you stick out your hand for a drink. So don't be mad at these people they are working as hard as they can. On the timeshare side Nancy Jimenez the supervisor is the one to speak with and your every need will be met. The restaurants are many, a few no kids allowed so know that ahead of time. Fuego, Bana and Market were exceptional. Naos,  the cafeteria always has many choices and is open round the clock. February is probably the busiest month so the place is packed. Reservations for dinner are first come first served so book early . The waiters can't do enough for you and will even go off menu to get a special order. A big problem is pool seating. There are NOT enough chairs for everyone and as I write this review at 5:20 AM. yes it is dark, beautiful stars, sunrise in an hour, I am saving chairs for my sleeping wife and son. By 6:30 all the chairs will have towels on them and if you sleep late or arrive at the resort later in the day, be prepared to sit on a towel on the grass around the pool or on the sand at the beach. It is the same everywhere and it's a problem with no answer. There are Bali beds that have to be reserved so check them out with the pool staff.  The rooms are clean and well maintained, you always see maintainence people working to keep the resort nice. The entertainment is in one of the lobby bars, haven't seen it. You don't come here for it..go to town after dinner of you want a show. All of my criticisms are corporate issues and timeshare policies. This resort really great. You won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: TravelRN1129
reviews.title: South Seas Travel LOVES the Paradisus!!!
reviews.text: This is an absolutely GORGEOUS resort. I recommend it highly! We recd. a very warm welcome from the minute we walked into the door until the day we left. The lobby area is absolutely breathtaking. I loved everything about it. Beautiful hanging vines, Asian themed & modern. We chose to upgrade to the OCEAN view suite which we enjoyed SO MUCH & was well worth the extra! We were in Pyramid 5- the Adults Only part of the resort & had the Royal Service. Our Room # was 5517, close to elevator which was a plus.We had a HUGE balcony w/ 2 loungers on it, with some of the most beautiful views ever! Loved the little Hibiscus plants in the flower boxes; beautiful touch.Resort is very easy to navigate. SO QUIET & peaceful & the Concierge/Royal Service Lounge was SO relaxing.The Royal Service offers GREAT amenities; we really enjoyed the little extras. Pillow Menu was great ! I had the Green Tea, White tea & Eucalyptus. Our Butler was very nice, I think I was expecting so much more having had Butler Service at other resorts. You always had to call if you needed anything, though requests were pretty prompt. (Butlers we have had before were trained by the English Guild of Butlers & they always would check in with you via phone, check in for any special plans or requests,offer to pack/unpack, check your plans for the day, etc.). One HUGE amenity is the Bali Beds (rent at other resorts for up to $200/day), it was so relaxing. Enjoyed the Poolside Concierge & the LapaLapa royal service only restaurant. We ate lunch there everyday.The room service menu was PHENOMENAL , lots of choices & we had room service for breakfast each day.We ate lunch there everyday. It was SO NICE being in the adults only section; YET, if traveling with families you can stay there & go over to the family side anytime you want. ALL restaurants are family friendly, except for LapaLapa in Royal Service. The housekeeping employees in this resort deserve a huge "kudos". ALWAYS kept us stocked with amenities, turned down the bed & just took overall GREAT care of us. Always friendly & helpful. Resort was SPOTLESS. That's really important to me! My favorite restaurant was hands down "MOLE". It is also where I had my new favorite margarita the CACTUS! Every restaurant had EXCELLENT, welcoming service & we had no wait. We had reservations made by the Concierge/Butler Service & it was very impressive at how promptly you were seated & served. Shows were really good. Seating was not so good. You had to arrive pretty early to get a seat or it was standing room only, shows located in the Avenues Bar. Loved the drinks & the Quesadillas were EXCELLENT in the Blue Agave. Bana, Market Grill were some of our favorites. The YHI spa was very nice, a very ZEN experience, esp. in the private "oasis" area of the spa! We thoroughly enjoyed the Hydrotherapy pool, sauna, etc. Spa service prices pretty average for an upscale resort & SO many choices. Very nice spa menu. Golf is also available on site, though we did not golf. Nice gift shops though very pricey! There was a little gift shop there on the 1st floor by the jewelry shop that had EXCELLENT prices. You could shop for local products & cute souvenirs without ever having to leave the resort. FREE WIFI is a huge plus. Loved the beach, pools & bar facilities. The beach was red flagged the entire week, so waters were a little rough. As I said, this is a gorgeous facility & we are already planning one of our next travel group trips to THIS resort! LOVED it !!!!!

reviews.author: jjorow
reviews.title: Excellent Hotel, Terrible Food
reviews.text:
My wife and I booked this hotel for a quick getaway for four nights over Valentine's weekend. The lobby, pool area, and beach at this hotel are beautiful, but the hotel is very large and can be difficult to get around. We kept running into dead ends and had to go up and down flights of stairs to get to where we wanted to go. Check in was a disaster with long waits in line and then an even longer check in process once you got to the counter.

The pools were beautiful, but they were unheated (it wasn't working), and all of the Jacuzzis were ice cold. There was also construction of a cinder block wall going on in the pool area. There are a lot more people than there are chairs, so you have to get there early to get a spot.

The biggest issue we had was with the food, none of which was what we expected after reading descriptions on the website. Market Square is a Brazilian style restaurant and was good, Mole was described as Mexican but had a menu that looked so bad we cancelled our reservation, and at Vento my wife and I ordered 3 entrees to split and there was barely enough food for one of us. On top of that the filet was inedible. We left there and went to the buffet. The buffet is nothing special and the food was always cold. At breakfast, rather than have eggs in a chafing dish, you have to wait in line and order them to be cooked for you. We also had to wait a long time for them to refill anything that runs out. At lunch and dinner, most of the food had a Mexican flair to it. They do not have standard fare like hamburgers or chicken strips there. There was never silverware or condiments on the tables, and you had to ask and then wait for everything. As far as drinks, it was all standard. I read a review that said the drinks were top shelf, but I never saw anything better than average, i.e. Absolut Vodka, Cuervo Tequila.

On the plus side, the room was very nice and the people were very friendly. Overall we had a great time and made the best of it, but by the end of the trip we had pretty much given up on the food and were eating bread for breakfast, lunch and dinner.

reviews.author: cmcdon5
reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: We stayed here for 4 nights. First of all they gave us 2 double beds when we requested king. It wouldn't have been that bad but the double bed was about size of a twin bed! Not one day could we get a chair for beach or pool. This hotel needs more chairs!!!! Food was okay. The hotel he ugly. Looks like a shopping mall. Only thing we enjoyed was the sushi restaraunt and Roberto at sushi was great server. It also took them a few hours to get our room ready after we arrived. So annoying. Definitely should not be number 13 on tripadvisor. Westin lagunamar is a lot nicer of a hotel. We stayed there before.

reviews.author: tooljunkie60
reviews.title: Very good.
reviews.text: All resorts have their plusses and minuses; and there is no exception to that rule.  Plusses are: lobby is one of the best, drinks use top shelf liquor, music playing everywhere, private balcony (wink, wink), service, beautiful beach and blue water, soft sand, nice bed and linens, well maintained property and facilities, beautiful room and bathroom, snack bar.  Evening entertainment was brought in and very nice. Acrobats, dancers, singers.  Minuses: hotel check-in is disorganized (room is never ready) and they tried (unsuccessfully) to downgrade us.  They did provide a nice courtesy changing room with shower and towels.  Restaurant reservations is also disorganized.  They are constantly dialing the numbers and getting nothing.  You can only book one day ahead so get to the desk before breakfast.  There is a rush to get places at the pool and beach so get there early and place your stuff.  People will sometimes take your chair and just dump your stuff.  The main buffet is also a little disorganized.  They sometimes will only have one omelet station open and a long line.  They have not figured out how to keep the food and water (for tea) hot.  it was always tepid.  The coffee station was hit and miss (mostly missing something).  The fruit and deserts were excellent.  The Tapas, sushi, and Market Grille were fantastic.  Fuego and Mole were fair.  We never do the same place twice...until now.  once you know the ins and outs you will do well here.

reviews.author: Sunshine525593
reviews.title: Hotel Paradisus, Cancun
reviews.text: Have just returned from a two week stay at the Paradisus with my wife.On arrival we were impressed with the service until we had the hard sell of upgrading to royal service ,we declined ,the price dropped and we declined again. Our room [1514] had a lagoon view which was not a problem other than the room was set back and so we had very limited view to the right hand side.We only had one sun lounger on the balcony but decided not to complain as there wasn't room on the balcony anyway. The first week seemed quite quiet with no problems having to queue for restaurants etc or sunloungers on the beach.                 The breakfast was first class as was the lunch.The evening buffet was disappointing with most of the food only luke warm.There appeared to be a problem with a lack of spoons on the tables as we had to ask every day, also no condiments on the table.We also had the problem of going to select food and finding somebody else sitting at your table, this happened on more than one occassion. During the second week it appeared to be much busier and people were entering the restaurant, selecting food and then realising there were no tables available. We were told that the large round restaurant by the pool would not be open during the two weeks we were staying.We also noticed another bar near the main walkway to the beach was closed during our stay.                                                         The only bar that appeared to be open during the evening was the Avenue which hosted the caberat which was of a very good standard, the only problem was if you didn't get there early there were no seats.We found that there were very few areas that we could sit and have a drink and a chat.                                       My thoughts on the hotel are that it couldn't cope when busy and that it could really do with a upgrade as it was not much more than a four star standard hotel although the staff really worked hard.

reviews.author: 88granny
reviews.title: Awesome Vacation
reviews.text: This was my first trip to Paradisus Resort & it was one of the best vacations I've been on.  The beach & water were breath taking.  The service, food, & drinks were top notch.  I played golf on their 9 hole course & tho it's small I worked for me.  I'm a average golfer at best so won't complain.  The only restaurant I didn't care for was the Authentic Mexican one.   I can't say the food was bad, I'm just not a fan of authentic Mexican food.  My friend & I stayed on the Lagoon side in the main pyramid.  I was able to see several awesome sunsets.  If I had to complain about anything it would that we were asked numerous times to attend the "timeshare breakfast".  Even when we stated we were not interested, someone would ask again every time we walked by their station.  The booze was top shelf & we were able to get whatever we wanted.  I didn't have one bad drink.  Definitely would go back.

reviews.author: R B
reviews.title: Fun Hotel
reviews.text:
The best restaurants get booked up quickly.  Make your reservations early!
The staff was very helpful and friendly.  In particular Amaury and Veronica at the front desk.
Excellent convenient location and nice beach.

reviews.author: Willowdale1
reviews.title: Visit once and you will return!
reviews.text: First visit to Paradisus Cancun for 5 days over the Valentines Day weekend.  Resort was everything our online research promissed. From the minute of arrival to departure, the staff were friendly, knowledgable and made our stay excellent. Great Beach and very clean resort that is well maintained.  One disapporintment - the water in Royal Serive Pool needs some heat.. very few users due to temperature.  Ocean was warmer. Go for Royal Service ... worth the extra.Thanks to Raul Lorano at the front- an employee Melia should be proud to have on their Team

reviews.author: Brithewineguy
reviews.title: Excellent Kids camp
reviews.text: We were at the Paradisus for a week with our 6-year old. We used the Kids Camp (Kids Zone) on multiple occasions and could not have been happier. Everyday they had fun, interesting activities for the kids to do, in a safe environment. We wouldn't hesitate to book another stay at this hotel and the Kids Camp is a big reason why. Extra thanks to Aline, Jaqueline, Adriana, Andrea and Francis for all their great work.

reviews.author: beantownbabe
reviews.title: 50th Birthday with family, in Royal Service adults area
reviews.text:
Flight was non-stop to Cancun from Boston was smooth. We arrived at the same time as 4 other planes, so it took about an hour and a half to get thru Customs.  At least the lines were inside and we were off the plane. Make sure you get in the right line for "Foreigners" unless you're a Mexican citizen, as I saw several Americans in the wrong line.

Transfer was complimentary thru the hotel with Otium Intl, as I'm now a Melia Rewards member. I signed up for free as I booked directly thru Melia.com and got a great Black Friday deal. It took the Otium rep a while to find the driver, and we were outside for about a half hour before we left. 
DO NOT get sucked into talking to ANYONE once you clear customs (unless you want to buy tours from them) until you get outside and see the transfer company sign. They pose as official this, that and the other but are just trying to sell you something!
As our transfer it was complimentary and not a private transfer, we dropped off 2 other groups before we arrived at Paradisus about 45 minutes later.  So, we landed at 1:45 pm and arrived at the hotel at about 4 pm.  

Check-in was smooth and seamless. When we arrived, we were seated for about 10 minutes in a little room in the main lobby and then escorted with a few others to the Royal Service adults-only in pyramid 5. We were then checked in immediately by a very nice and efficient Natalia who I had exchanged emails with prior to arrival. 
There were no cold wet towels or champagne offered to any of us, as I'd seen them give others during the week.  I had to Ask for 2 bottles of water as we were VERY thirsty. And the champagne was just sitting there in the big bowl of ice with only one glass on the table.
We then asked for some, and they had to go and get a wine glass as there was only 1 champagne glass left. We also met our butler/concierge Jose' who was very nice who escorted us to our room and given a brief overview of the resort and services.
 
Room was Ocean View on the 6th of 7 total floors.  It was a very nice clean room with a large balcony and 2 comfortable beds for myself and 70's mom.  I also had a roll-away bed (complimentary) for my 20's adult son who flew in a few hours later for join us for my 50th birthday week :-) 

Bathroom was roomy and adequate with fairly decent but not very bright lighting. The toilet area is smallish and has a bidet (Googe for info haha) and a door that closes off from the sink area, which is nice. The shower is a rain head and the tub is big, but is about 2 feet high to step into it, just so you know.

Service in Royal area, barring the champagne and towels at check-in issue, was excellent! Wi-fi is very good and the self-service coffee, bar with wine, beer and cocktail items and hors devours and continental breakfast was very nice.

Beach is awesome with limited palapas. Red flag was up all week, but we're good swimmers if it was needed and we were okay. We loved the waves, but is too strong for kids and elderly. My mom was swept off her feet just 2 feet in and we had to get her up and out. I'd recommend hotels at the top of the 7 shape on the strip or Playa del Carmen for calmer surf.  

Pool in the pyramid 5 adults RS was nice but is 6 feet deep except fr the outer edge, so you know. The main pool pyramid 3 has the swim-up pool bar, and even that pool is really deep. My son gave my mom a piggy back ride across that pool to get to the pool bar! 

Bali Beds are AWESOME! I'm spoiled now and def want a place with them now.  They can fit about 5 to 6 seated and 3 to 4 lying down. They will also set up a few lounge chairs so you can get some sun if you want it. There are only 30 Bali beds, so you MUST reserve one thru your butler or the pool concierge the day before, preferably the morning before. We had one for 3 of the days and could have had more days but did shopping and tours etc. If you don't claim you bed by Noon, they will give it to those on the wait list, fair enough!

Pool Service is very good and they have a nice lunch menu in the RS area and will serve it to you at the Bali bed.  We had Javier for 2 days and Enrique for another.  They will usually bring you another drink before you're finished with the last.  I find that a few $ every other round and for food service goes a Long way!  

Hotel is very nice with lush vegetation and fish ponds. I personally don't like but they have strong potpourri scents in the major entry and bathroom areas.  Also, it gets very hot in the main pyramid 3 with no to little air flow in the central area. They need more fans to address this. 

Food is my biggest negative on the whole. The buffet Naos is good for fruit, salads, breads, cheeses, soups, oatmeal, grill to order items and desserts, but most of the other cooked items that are set out are luke-warm to cold! They have NO sterno or flames under chaffing dishes to keep them warm. They just set them out in dishes, and that's it until it needs to be replaced. 

Blue Agave is hands down the best restaurant there and does not require a reservation. Great little bar in there and awesome tacos, guacamole and Mexican fare! 

Ala-Cartes: Vento is good tapas style food. Bana has good sushi, hot sake and spring rolls. Market grill has good beef and chicken, but we didn't care for the sides. They had a really good saxaphonist playing during our dinner.
It does have a pretty good lunch menu that does not require a reservation. Mole we did not like their offerings and preparation. Same for Fuego, and that was our Least favorite.  

Alcohol: The all-inclusive wine is pretty good considering, and the drinks are NOT watered down and top shelf at all levels. The drinks taste like they do at home :-) They have Belvedere and Stoli vodka, Bacardi, Crown Royal, Don Julio (no Patron though) They do pour single shot drinks, so just ask if you want a double. None of the ala-cartes prepared flaming coffee drinks however, which was a little dissapointing.   

Avenue bar has evening entertainment at 8 pm that is very good ie singer, acrobats etc. but get seats ahead of time on the bed-type seats or you will be standing.  We did not do the Red lounge which opens at 10 pm.     

Cleanliness: everywhere was spotless!

Would I return?  Probably not because I like to try new places. I do love those Bali beds as I'm Very fair andar and loved it), as it has low-rise buildings and more Mexican versus European feel to it. 
The vibe here is very sort of nuevo.   The one brand that I've stayed at 4 or 5 times is Palace Resorts which we love, due to outstanding service and above average food. 

If you have any specific questions, please fell free to private message me by clicking on my name.

Enjoy!

beantownbabe

reviews.author: Rockydogjustice
reviews.title: Loved It
reviews.text:
We wanted an easy to get to, long weekend trip for Valentines Day Weekend & decided on Cancun.  I had a friend recomment Paradisus Cancun so we went for it.  We had the Royal Service so experienced the Butler Service & private check in which was nice.  Loved having continental breakfast right outside our room as well as a private bar in the evening.  

The Staff was amazing as well - we especially enjoyed Francisco at the pool.  He learned our names on day #1 & called us by name everyday we were there.  Was great to have the cabanas at the pool too.  A note when you're arriving, head to the pool right away or ask your butler to reserve a cabana for your entire stay while you are there.  If it's busy you definitely will not get one the 1st day.  

Only a few suggestions would be to add umbrellas in the pool area since not everyone gets a cabana.  Also, the coffee maker in the Royal Service breakfast area was very hard to figure out.

Other than that we had a great time & will definitely be back!

reviews.author: SCB Mom
reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text:
Absolutely picture perfect setting! 

Gorgeous lobby area and indoor atrium with fish ponds and tropical foliage.   Was initially blow away.  Long stretch of beach area was incredible with fine white sand and spectacular outdoor area.
Lots of public areas to sit down and relax.   

Our ocean view rooms were awesome, talk about a view...well worth it!   Added bonus was balcony gets shade in the afternoon so it is usable.

Greeted by smiling friendly face (Gal) who gave us an orientation to the resort.  We ran into him periodically throughout our stay and he was always smiling and asked us how our stay was.  He was also there when we departed the hotel and again with a friendly smile. Thanks Gal for making our day.
Requested late checkout but front desk said hotel is full.  Ran into Sergio while trying to get our sick 1.5 yr old to sleep the night (2 am) before we were to depart.  Sergio made the late checkout happen. Thank you Sergio!   

Service was overall very good but with a few exceptions.

We found the front desk was inconsistent with inquiries...answers depended on who answered the phone. Should have known, prior to our arrival, we sent out an email to inquire about restaurants and to make sure we had a crib and rooms near by (travelling with 8 people total). Had to sent out 3 emails before someone wrote back with a reply.  

We did go to a time share presentation to get 2 excursion tickets and 3 free night stay at Paradisus in Playa del Carmen voucher.  Be careful!!  They said it would not be longer than 90 minutes but 2 hours into it, I told them we needed to go as we had lunch plans with our family.  Then they brought out their ACE sales person and put on the sales pressure and kept us for another hour or more. They will not let you leave!  

HINT:  Do not go to Naos for breakfast at opening (6:30am). I arrived with my 1.5 year old (early riser). Took 25 minutes and had to ask 3 different people before a high chair was brought to our table.  I already finished feeding our 1.5 yr old (had him on my lap) and wanted a place for him to sit so I could eat.   I went to grab the high chair myself before someone decided to help me.  Very poor service!

HINT: We are good tippers...this helps a lot!  Better and more attentive service.  And desiring for the restaurant staff, as we have 3 young children and tend to make a bit of a mess. 

HINT: Restaurants.  Must reserve, Cannot just arrive (other than Naos(buffet) and blue agave). Hard to get reservations morning of.  Can only book day before.
Try to book the night before.  

Vento is excellent and a must!!!  Mole was above average. Fuego was average.
Tempo(not included in all inclusive) was above average for fine dining based on their Valentine's day menu. Not exceptional given the price ($280 USD for 2 people with bottle of wine) but we found the Valentine's day menu to be plain with very little complexity...probably wanted easier food prep given the full restaurant for Valentine's day.  Thought the food at Vento was better for flavor.
Wanted their tasting menu with wine pairing but was not offered. Will have to come back just to try it.  Service was exceptional.   

Kids pool was very well layout and our kids had a blast. Overall our experience was very good and relaxing.

reviews.author: Rachael A
reviews.title: Great Service and nice trip
reviews.text:
This was my first experience with an all inclusive resort and at first I was very nervous. The Paradisus Cancun really exceeded my expectations. The drinks were well made and top shelf (you have to make sure to ask for a particular liquor). The food overall was good. Not phenominal but good none the less and perfect for our needs on the beach. They had entertainment at 8 pm everynight and it was enjoyable. I even got to dance on stage with a mariachi! 

We did decide to do Royal Service (which price was negotiable to upgrade we found out). Our butler Juan was mediocre at best but the concierge was phenominal as well as all the food service on the beach. Royal Service was nice for having the particular beach restaurant for lunch that wasn't available to the rest of the resort. They had phenominal ceviche, guacamole as well as hamburgers/salad/chicken wrap etc. Very good food compared to having to use the buffet for lunch. Also with Royal Service children aren't allowed in that pool area and that is nice as well. The service at the beach was very good. Those guys work very hard so we made sure to tip them well. Because our butler was overwhelmed, we booked our own dinner reservations and worked with the concierge to get our palapa bed secured for a day. The palapas are great for hot days to get out of the sun but only a few of them face the beach, the others face the pool. 

Our room was very nice in tower 5. Comfortable beds, flat screen TV, our balcony faced the bay but very nice sunset view. 

My favorite restaurant was Mole and the Market (empanadas were awesome). I also really enjoyed the Blue Agave tacos. We did not try Tempo ($90/person) or bana but the restaurants we did eat at were perfect for our needs. With our Royal Service we were able to use parts of the spa. Steam Room and Sauna were fine. I do wish they had some sort of hot-tub or warm pool. Overall great experience at my first all inclusive. Would recommend.

reviews.author: rubentko
reviews.title: An average hotel, with friendly staff
reviews.text:
This hotel's best days may be past and it's age is showing, but the staff are incredibly friendly. My family and I (daughter, aged 10) visited during the New Year's week. First, the food is better than average. Most meals are at the Nao's, a buffet style restaurant. Food's hit or miss and frankly not really that bad, if you know what to look for and how to ask for certain things (like omelets). In the evening, I'd recommend the Blue Agave, a really good restaurant. No kids allowed, however, but the cuisine is worthy springing for a sitter.  There's also a restaurant called La Perla, which is all sea food but a good choice if Nao's is crowded. I agree with other comments about the long waits to enter Nao's.

Our room, tho with an ocean view, was smallish and again, needed a little TLC. The bed was relatively comfortable but the fridge was scantily stocked with local beers and water. 

The pools are standard, with the typical swim-up bar and a kid's pool. It's true that seating around is limited and you have to be an early bird to get pool-side lounges. But perhaps what bothered me most with the outside of the hotel (and probably overall) is that the beach, which as has been noted is public, is accessible by two sets of stairs from the pool/hotel area down to the beach. So the hotel doesn't have that "integrated" ocean/pool/hotel feeling like others I've been at. There's a physical barrier and again, it's not a big thing but this bothered me and it may you too if you have kids and want to easily go from pool to ocean / ocean to pool….The beach itself is nice and clean however. 

This is the second year in a row that I've been to Cancun area and like before I recommend taking single dollar bills to leave as tips to the staff. A buck here and there really means a lot to these folks who work very hard. 

The interior of the hotel is pretty nice, I must say. The center "pyramid" is where all the action takes place in the evening. Again, here, this central area is feels apart from the beach and ocean because there are these large (somewhat dirty) windows. 

The hotel is about 10-15 minutes from downtown Cancun by cab and the airport, too. You can probably do better in the central Cancun zone but such hotels probably also charge more. In my view, the setting and food is important, so I would look for a newer hotel. But if you get a really good deal then go for it. You can't really have a bad time in Cancun when you have a gorgeous ocean, friendly people, food at the beck and call and an unlimited supply of libations!

reviews.author: Joan M
reviews.title: Very Friendly and Accomodating Staff
reviews.text:
I have been going to this hotel for several years and have never been disappointed.  The entire staff really does go above and beyond to give you a very pleasant experience.

The grounds are beautiful and kept immaculate , and they take great pride in keeping the common areas the same.  The restaurants and the buffet are very good.  We ate at Mole twice and had two excellent meals.  However, the best meal was at Tempo!   Although there is an additional charge to dine at this restaurant, it is really worth the money spent.  We had the tasting menu (9 or ten courses), along with the wine pairing and it was truly a gourmet experience.  The wait staff (Webster and his assistants) and the manager, Fares, truly are professionals who made sure our service was 5 star.  After our dinner we had the opportunity to speak with the chefs, Ismael and Felipe, further exhancing our experience.  Be sure to stop by this restaurant to see the menu which is displayed in the window.

There are many acitivities each day but one you should not miss if you like wine is the wine tasting with the Sommelier, Carlos.  I subscribe to all the gourmet magazines and consider myself a foodie, however, I learned a great deal from him and it was a very interesting presentation and well worth your time.   He selected the wine pairings for our dinner at Tempo and they were all excellent.  He is very passionate about wine and very knowledgeable.

Paradisus is not one of the newer hotels in Cancun but in my opinion it is a cut above.

reviews.author: Crystal H
reviews.title: Paradisas Cancun
reviews.text: In 25 years of staying at resorts each year in Mexico this trip was by far the best.  The staff are genuinely happy to make every effort to please, regardless if it was their duty.  I was very impressed

reviews.author: Aida M
reviews.title: I can't wait to go back!
reviews.text:
This is by far one of the best resorts I have ever been in my life. We stayed for 10 days and forgot about everything since checking in. 
The quality of service is at its highest level, and all the staff seem to be really happy while at work, I never saw a bad face or attitude, just the opposite. They would leave whatever they are doing to open a door for you, or to find out the answer to any question if they don't have it at the moment. Apart from that, the quality of the food in any restaurant and the cleanliness of the room was absolutely outstanding. 
We didn't go out of the resort apart from a couple of excursions (that we booked there in the desk by the pool) but we didn't feel the need at all. We had lunch at the buffet almost every day (always surprisingly different!) and a couple of days at the Market Grill restaurant. We also tried almost all the restaurants. The mexican and the japanese are worth trying, we even repeated despite the different options. 

I can't wait to go back again!!

reviews.author: Sil
reviews.title: Cannot understand these bad reviews about this amazing resort, seriously!
reviews.text:
I have just come back from a 8 days stay in Paradisus Cancun and I cannot understand how we can complaint about this resort, it is just amazing!

Stayed in a Junior Suite sea view and the room was very comfortable and pleasant, nothing was missing and if we needed something else, we used to call and receive everything very quickly.

I may add for the rate we had paid, it was indeed worth the money: usually in Europe you don't get such a big room.

Staff: simply very good service, anywhere and we have took great advantage of the resort as we were looking for an extra relaxing vacation.
Restaurant choice is great, you never get bored and the quality of food is extremely high with all fresh products.
We want to thank all the staff that made our stay a special one, in particular Antonio at the Japanese restaurant who attended us a couple of time, Javier at the Mexican Restaurant who welcomed us as nobody else, and Laura and Leticia at the beach area that never forget or took too long to ask us if we wanted another drink! Thank you all for being so nice, genuine and attentive!

We had a really great stay and we will definitely go back again because we really felt at home and very well looked after during the entire stay!

See you soon Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: Gutierre_Blanco
reviews.title: Underwhelming family concierge experience
reviews.text:
If you are Looking for a vacation filled with disappointment then this is it. We were very disappointed with the entire experience and are surprised with all the positive reviews which just can't be true, or maybe we were just unlucky. We paid a premium for family concierge and the one bedroom suite but felt that we were constantly haggling for every single thing every single day.  

We are a family with two kids aged 4 and 2 and felt that the resort did not cater to this demographic. 

1.  Our butler was terrible. We got nothing from her and none of the perks that some of the other members mention in their reviews. Not worth the premium to get two free backpacks with some trivial items included. 

2. Getting a spot on the pool was hard. Not enough beds to accommodate the demand and if you wanted a Bali bed then you had to reserve in advance and hope they can accommodate you.  Again they offered us a bed in the adult area which was not appropriate. We haggled and finally got a bed by the kids pool.
