3.  Wifi is spotty and not reliable. I know this is supposed to be a vacation but these days connectivity is more for the kids than the adults. 

4.  Food is resort food (ie to be expected) but service is average and wait times for food and drink is much longer than anywhere else. They don't let you take food out to be consumed elsewhere like around the pool or in the room. 

5. If you have young kids and put them to bed early and have to hang around the room then forget about in room dining. The food is pool bar type food and they cannot bring wine or alcoholic drinks. You have a daily quota of 4 cans of beer which was their response to our request for some wine. Finally after much haggling we got a bottle of white wine which they did as a favour to us. But we had to haggle and I hate haggling on vacation. 

6. Spa is overpriced and overrated. No wonder it was empty. Our 50 min massage was 20 mins long. After we complained they offered to give us another massage for the full 50mins. Again. More haggling required. 

7. The beach was very nice. But then again it is a public beach. Still hard to find a spot to sit or free beds. 

8. Grounds are above average and staff is very friendly. They always say hello and were quick to respond to requests such as extra shampoo or forgetting to give the milk and cookies they promised the kids (4 of 7 days). However I did not feel like I was getting any premium service given that we paid a huge premium to stay here. 

9. Resort did not cater to younger kids and to be honest I did not see many families with our kids ages (4 and 2). Bathrooms not convenient to the restaurant area and you always had to go up and down stairs, ie all the amenities were spread across 2 floors which isn't an issue for older kids and adults of course but gets trickier when they are younger or if you have to lug a stroller around. 

I normally don't go out of my way to complain and we are a low maintenance family. However I was sold on this place being a premiere family oriented resort and frankly I felt ripped off. I tried to be specific so that others can get a better sense of the negative feedback I am giving this resort.

reviews.author: Nate M
reviews.title: Not Thrilled with Stay
reviews.text: It was nice to be on vacation bringing in the new year, but our experience was not as good as we hoped it would be. We were not treated with a lot of respect from the hotel staff and guests.  We felt more welcomed at Paradisus Punta Cana.  Our "personal concierge" ditched us after the initial meeting because we didn't want to attend the time share presentation. We missed out on a few resort activities because we didn't know where to get the information until our last couple of days at the resort.  Our room was not as grand or large as our room in Punta Cana, if we stay at a Paradisus property again, it will be back in Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Lorraine Astrid G
reviews.title: Amazing ambiance!
reviews.text: My husband & I decided last minute to take a 4 day trip somewhere, we had a babysitter, just needed to figure out where to go.  We came across all of the resorts in the Cancun, Mexico area and immediately knew that Paradisus Cancun would be for us.  We were so impressed from the moment we walked in, we were given a hand towel and offered a drink.  We couldn't believe how beautiful the entrance was with all the hanging Ivy and aroma throughout.  The staff were all pleasant & always willing to offer to make our stay comfortable.  The rooms were very clean & fresh compared to other resorts in Cancun we've stayed at previously.  My husband & I kept saying over and over "Wow, we really lucked out finding this place".  Laying poolside was just as impressive as inside the resort, the calm & cafe'ish music playing throughout the adult pool was so relaxing & tranquil!!!  We started planning our next visit to the Paradisus and inviting our friends for the next trip.  We will definately return, hopefully for a full week next time, I didn't want to leave.

reviews.author: staceyvee
reviews.title: Lovely Hotel
reviews.text:
My husband and I traveled Feb 1-7/2014. We enjoyed our vacation very much. We are members at Melia Caribe Tropical in Punta Cana DR so this was a change for us.
Overall the resort is very nice. I prefer a little more foliage, but being close to the beach and pool at the same time was very nice.
The staff were great, particularly Enrique Alcudia (I hope I spelled that correctly). He was always there with a beverage or two. We never had to go looking for him.
The restaurant staff were also very attentive including; Violeta Mauricio in Bana, Leo in Vento, Roberto and Carol in Mole, and Martin in Fuego.
Our doorman Jose showed us around as soon as we got there (which was just after midnight so it was nice to know where everything was at the get-go the next morning).
Lastly, Karina at Club Melia was fantastic. She always made sure we could get reservations and helped with a room issue right away.
This is very nice resort, particularly if you enjoy walking on the beach.
I would definitely return.
Stacey and Rob V

reviews.author: Valeri W
reviews.title: They have made changes not for the better
reviews.text:
My husband and I were at the Paradisus for the 1st week of February. This is our 5th trip to this hotel-we always came back because of the good food and spectacular service. I am very disappointed in the resort this year in that they have made changes that are not for the better. I do not know that we will be back again. They have eliminated the the pool menu and delivery of meals on the beach or at the pool. This is very disappointing as we enjoyed that and would tell others to stay at this resort because they would serve you food and drinks on the beach. A lot of other resorts do not do that. If you want a noon meal your options are the buffet or the Market-with a limited menu. We could not get a pizza unless we went to our room and ordered room service. This is a very big disappointment and if you were a family with kids you would really be limited. There was a small area where they had hamburgers and hotdogs and you could get a bag of chips with it but that was it.  Very disappointing! Our bright spots on this trip were the staff.  Arturo-our concierge was absolutely amazing and went above and beyond to help us with issues we may have. We had issues with our Air Conditioner which was supposed to have been fixed and the next day it still was not working. Arturo made some calls and said if it did not get fixed they would get us a new room. We also had the absolute best service from Miguel Gabriel Quinones at the Pool Bar. He would always start our day with a bottle of water and make sure we had everything we needed.  He was the best!!! 
We have been Melia Timeshare owners for several years and this is the 1st year we have been disappointed.  We have always thought that there should be more upgrades done to the facility, but realize that it is very expensive to upgrade a property of this size. Some of the changes they have made have been really good but eliminating the pool menu and food delivery are not good changes. They now do not require you to have towel cards. Not a big deal but just one more thing you had to keep track of while at the resort in the past that you no longer have to do. 
The Vento and Market Grill restaurants were very good and we really enjoy these. The buffet is average but most buffets are. The Blue Aquave tequila bar is VERY good.  The staff there is very accomodating and helpful.  We also enjoy going to the Avenue bar in the evening before our meal. The staff is excellent! We would come back to the Avenue bar after our meal for the entertainment. It was always very good. 
We were very disappointed in the Super Bowl party this year. If you wanted a table you had to reserve it for a cost of $160. Not worth that kind of money. You did get a bottle of alcohol and a tray of snacks for that $160. The tray of snacks that you could order was $23.50 and consisted of 4 chicken wings, 4 onion rings, 4 hotdog snacks and that was it. You could not order your snack tray until 7 pm and by the time we got ours 50 minutes later it was cold. Last year they set up La Perla for the Super Bowl and had buffets of food available for you. When you pay for the all inclusive and you are planning on this being your meal since the game is right over the supper hour, you would like a little more than cold snacks that are supposed to be hot. VERY DISAPPOINTING!!!!!
As others have posted we always bring money for tips. They claim with your all inclusive fees tips are included but how do you know what your servers are receiving. They work very hard and very long days for probably not much money. We feel they deserve the extra. 
With the changes that have been made at the resort we do not know that we will be back. They have not been good changes. We were very disappointed in the resort this year.

reviews.author: Ottertail24
reviews.title: Great experience at the Paradisus
reviews.text: A friend and I stayed at the Paradisus Cancun this past week and I can say it was one of my favorite resorts and I've been traveling to Mexico for 30 years.  We try different resorts and usually get different experiences.  The Paradisus offered great service, good food, and an outstanding beach.  The view when you walk out of the hotel doors toward the beach is just breathtaking.  There was 3 colors of blue waters to greet you.  Then there was the pools on both sides and what more could you ask for?  We stayed in Tower 3 and it was a perfect location.  I certainly can't complain about noise and late night music as it was practically non-existent.  I'm guessing if there is a special event pool side in the evening and you have a nearby ocean view room, I could understand hearing noise.  But I'm guessing those are few and far between.  From what I could see, most bars were closed by 11 and only the Red Lounge (disco) was open late.  (And it gets pretty loud inside there but doesn't seem to filter out into the rest of the hotel.)  The rooms themselves were a little dated and a tad bit musty.  But they were nice size and the views, even on the lagoon side were nice.  I really didn't see any reason to upgrade to royal service as we got plenty of good service in a basic room.  Ocean view would be nice but we were rarely in room except to change and sleep.  Beds were fine and sheet quality good.  Nice, huge bath towels.  Could have used a robe and slippers like we usually see in this quality of hotel.  The food was presented well and the buffet was above average.  Specialty restaurants were good.  Not outstanding but good.  We only noticed one night out of 7 that the service was a bit slow.  I'm a picky eater and found more than enough to make me happy.  The hotel offered free wi-fi which worked well most of the time.  It was spotty on the beach but when it's free, I certainly couldn't complain.  The best part of the hotel was the beach and the water.  It was just such a refreshing view.  The beach lounge chairs were reserved by towels by 8 am so you just have to work on getting a spot early.  The beach itself was large and not crowded.  The waves are strong and you need to be careful.  We saw several people rescued and heard of several more that week.  Staff was quick to respond and you could tell they were well trained to keep a watchful eye.  There are several "drop offs" of sand, both on the beach and in the water.  Nothing to worry about but just need to be careful.  If you have children, you can find a sandbar where this isn't a concern.  And I'm guessing it isn't always that windy.  The wind was welcomed though as it was in the mid to high eighties most of last week.  Weather was great.  Only one afternoon did we experience any clouds or drops of rain. If you are looking for a party hotel, you won't find it here.  Lots of people having fun but most are couples or families looking to get away and relax.  The only negative I really have to say about the hotel is the timeshare people never stopped asking.  When you arrive, you jump out to help you check in and "tell" you about the hotel and the amenities.  After a short time, it's easy to see they want you to participate in their sales pitch/breakfast.  We firmly said no thank you many times during the week.  Even when we made dinner reservations, we were asked again about attending.  (It's free.  You don't have to buy anything.  Don't you want $200 at the spa?)  It actually got to the point where I didn't want to make dinner reservations if I had to say no one more time.  I honestly think the hotel needs to ask ONCE and then if the guest says no, respect that.  We were even approached by staff as we were enjoying a drink and asked about our stay but as the conversation went on, you knew they were trying to get you to give enough information about yourself for the timeshare conversation.  Management really needs to work on this as I felt this was a big turn off. The entertainment at night was good to great but it would be more enjoyable if the space was larger and more people could view.  For a hotel of that size, I would like to think they have other alternatives.  The bar service was good and liquor was of good quality and not skimped on as you usually see.  It was a nice touch to be able to have a waiter on the beach.  It's so appreciated by the guests. I'm not sure there really is a reason to upgrade to royal service unless you can easily afford it.  We walked over to Royal section in the hotel and we didn't see a sole except some workers at a desk.  They have their own "lobby" and special treats but we didn't see anyone enjoying it.  I'm guessing having the pool and your own bar is a nice treat though.  Everything is just so convenient in building 3 that I'm not sure I'd want to be anyplace else.  Overall, it was a great hotel and one of the few I'd probably visit a second time.  We never once left the hotel in the 8 days were were there.  But we are beach people so that was the highlight for me.  My friend golfed at the hotel.  It's right out front.  I believe it was $10 to rent the clubs and another $8 for the pull cart.  It wasn't anything fancy but will give you a cheap place to golf in Mexico just so you can say you did.  We used USA Transfer for private shuttle and it was well worth it.  Our flight was late but they have drivers standing by it seems so once we found our guy with the USA Transfer sign, we were off on our way in about 5-10 minutes. They were right on time too, when we departed.  Friendly and reliable is what we experienced.  If you get the opportunity to stay at the Paradisus, I don't think you will be disappointed.

reviews.author: Katie M
reviews.title: Lovely vacation!!
reviews.text:
My boyfriend and I found this place on Hotwire. I'm not going to tell you how much we paid, but let's just say it was significantly less than the list price- which was around $500 a night last I checked.  So for what we paid, we have zero complaints!

Our room was so-so. Definitely in need of an update. Stains on the tub, linens were yellowish, drawers rattled, etc. The patio was private, but nondescript. Only one lounge chair so we didn't spend much time out there. The TV situation was fantastic! We actually got US stations and were able to watch the Winter Olympics! 

The highlight was definitely the service- it was was world class. Everyone from the housekeepers to the towel guys to bartenders were just fabulous. Everyone spoke nearly perfect English and were there within minutes to refill coffee, drinks, etc. Enrique on the beach was our favorite server. He would bring us new drinks before we could even ask! Be sure to stop at the bank before your trip and stock up on 1s and 5s for tips. We did this and it worked out perfectly- we noticed a lot of other guests not really tipping - you get the same level of service, but these guys work hard! Reward them!

As for the food- I was very very happy. The buffet was full of healthy options and just a bit of unhealthy options. We ate at Vento, Fuego, Bana, and a Marketplace for dinner. We both loved the first 2- my boyfriend was not a huge fan of Bana and I found the meat at Marketplace too fatty. I really like that all of the restaurants adjusted the portions so that we could try a bunch of different things without wasting food. Lunch at the pool options were limited. Just a small buffet of nachos, burgers, and hot dogs. I was hoping for a full menu to order at pool. We did not have royal service, but there were apparently more options on that side.

The beach and pool were perfect. The chairs filled up fast! We were out there at 7 am every morning to get chairs. I'm glad we did that because any later and we'd be out of luck. The swim bar was a completely stocked bar, we were very pleased. The night time entertainment was so-so. I'm glad they had it, but it wasn't something we felt we should make an effort to see. 

All in all a fantastic vacation!  As I sit in the Cancun airport awaiting our flight back to snowy Chicago, I have few complaints!

reviews.author: Kelsie D
reviews.title: We LOVE this resort!!!!
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed at this resort from Feb 2nd-8th 2014 and it was absolutely wonderful!! It was our first time at this resort and at Cancun in general and it far exceeded our expectations. This resort is a 15 minute drive from the airport and it was very enjoyable. Cancun is very modern, clean and beautiful unlike other islands that we have traveled to in the past. 

Our check-in and check-out with Guadalupe was excellent!! She was so nice and very accommodating. Irma sat us down after check-in to give us all the information about the resort that we would need to know and we loved her! She was so sweet and helpful. We got to the resort at 11:30am and they said the rooms usually aren't ready till 4pm, but our room was all ready to go. We went up to our room and unfortunately, it was two double beds instead of one king size, but it was quickly corrected when we let Guadalupe know and she gave us a new room with a king size bed. 

We booked a lagoon view room, not the ocean view but it was still a gorgeous view. The grounds of this hotel are beautiful. It is very well kept and there is a golf course in the front of the resort. The view of the beach when you walk out of the back of the resort is breathtaking! Every morning when we walked out to the pool or beach after breakfast we were still shocked to see such a beautiful view. The pools are great, as well as the swim up bar. The chairs on the beach can be hard to get after about 8:00am so I would recommend getting out there early. 

The food was some of the best that we have had at an all-inclusive resort. The service was the same, the workers are all wonderful which really makes a difference! We have to give a shout out to our two favorite waiters, Francisco at Bana(Japanese) and Gerardo at the Market Grill(Brazilian steakhouse). They were both so fun, nice and accommodating! Our favorite restaurant was Bana, we went there twice and it was delicious!! Christian, the server at the pool was awesome too, as well as, Louis the server on the beach! They kept the drinking flowing all day long :) 

There was only one negative of this resort and it was everyone trying to make you go to a Seminar to try to convince you to buy a time share. Ugh, it was very annoying! They were offering you free gifts and free nights if you just went and listened, but we heard many people that got persuaded into buying a time share and it's just not worth it. 

Besides this one negative we had a wonderful, relaxing week!!! My husband and I usually stay at couples only/adult only resorts and we were hesitant to stay at a family resort, but it was great! We highly recommend this resort for obviously, many reasons! 
Just book it, you will love it!! 
-Kelsie & Mike

reviews.author: Wayne R
reviews.title: Money gabbing machine
reviews.text:
Just returned from a week at the Paradisus Cancun, a week shorter than planned due to illness. 
When you consider the amount of money that we paid for the holiday were expecting the height of luxury.The hotel had an impressive entrance and that was about it. The room was pokey and small not luxury at all. There was peeling paint, a noisy old fridge that was the 'mini bar' and a sofa that smelt of stale urine. The so called mini bar was supposed to be refilled every day but it was only done twice in the week. The hotel information said if we wanted more of the drinks etc in the fridge we would have to buy them so we were rationed to two cans of coke in fridge, not in my view all inclusive. We ordered room service and the food arrived cold and unappetising. 
The hotel itself was a pure money making machine and had no interest in the all inclusive package. The restaurants were not of a brilliant standard and the service you received was very so so.  There was no where to go and simply get a coffee or cold drink and just sit and relax or as a takeaway, so you could only drink either with your meals or when on a sun bed outside meaning there was a risk of dehydration in the heat. We got charged for cold drinks from the hotel shop. A serious issue is one of sun beds, they did not provide enough sun beds for all the guests but offered the Bali style beds at a heavy fee. This was blatant money grabbing. We all should have been able to lay on a sun bed without extra costs as we had already paid for the privilege with our holiday. The hotel pumped a heady scent throughout the buildings that after a few minutes made you gag this even went into the dining areas making eating very hard indeed, this aggravated my partners sore throat. Another important point is I was fed up of hearing about 'Royal Service'. The Paradisus offered this at a massive extra cost entitling those with it to get easy reservations at the restaurants, Bali beds, own pool and loads of extras. It made me so cross considering the amount I paid for the holiday that we were treated as second class customers in the hotel. The one small positive is the friendliness off most of the staff. We paid for all inclusive which I would have understood that we all should get all the perks. It's just not a fair environment to holiday in.

reviews.author: DebFB
reviews.title: Don't think twice about staying here!
reviews.text:
We are here right now. Staying in room 3547. Great ocean view which we paid $30. extra for, per day, when we arrived. This room is super, not in the Royal section, and we are very happy! Seems like they change the sheets and pillowcases every day. Sometimes you may not get enough clean towels or face cloths, but call for them and they are brought to your room pronto. Get beer and water bottles, juice and pop everyday. Even have Oreo cookies and chips in the fridge everyday! Beds very comfortable. We had two doubles but my brother had a king and thought it was very good too. There's very little noise on the fifth floor of the third pavilion. With the door open to a nice breeze off the balcony you hear nothing but the waves. And with the air condition on overnight you don't hear any noise. There is music from below, but stops early as far as we can tell. 
We've had beautiful hot weather the last 9 days. Today is cloudy, but we're still sitting out by the swimming pool. Nice actually, as I got a bit too much sun, by playing in the waves. The sea is gorgeous, some days the undertow very strong. The lifeguard has been out a few times, collecting people that are not good swimmers. Red flags out everyday on the beach, but there's still people playing in the waves, just don't go out too far.
As we sit by the pool, we've had great waiters, notably MARISOL who is a fantastic waitress, always remembering each day what drinks we like. What a memory!! Shout out to JUAN, the pool concierge, so accommodating, so cheerful always laughing and joking!
The restaurants here are ok. We've tried them all, but like the buffet better, as you can get exactly what you want cooked to your taste. We've eaten lots of chicken, pork roast, beef roast, and lots of shrimp fried fresh for you in a garlic sauce. There's lots of fruit, papaya, pineapple, cantelope, guava, melons etc. the salad is extensive, the cheeses are superb and the desserts are 'to die for' REALLY!
Order cappuccino, or regular coffee, green tea, or if you want ice cream..
House wine not to my taste, but my brother likes it.
The entertainment at 8:30 pm every night in the Avenue bar, 1st floor has 1st class entertainment, and we've seen a lot on our frequent travels! Acrobats, singers, dancers. Really fantastic. Only complain here was the seating, it could have been a lot better. But the drinks are very good here. I had a mudslide and it was smooth and delicious. 
We read a lot of bad reviews, of this hotel, and were nervous at first to come here. But don't give the complainers a thought! A vacation is what you make it, and this is Mexico, after all. But just come and enjoy. You'll have a fab time!
Shout out to our waiters in the buffet who work SO hard to please you.
Special thanks to our entertainment crew. Thanks ANGEL and NESTOR, my ZUMBA guys!!!!

reviews.author: FootballFanTampa
reviews.title: Almost Perfect Anniversary Trip
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed at the Paradisus from 2/6 - 2/11 and were celebrating our 18th wedding anniversary.  We had been to this hotel several years ago when it was not all inclusive and were excited to give it another try since we had such a great experience the first time around.  First the positives, and there are a ton!!  The hotel is beautiful.  The beach is amazing.  There are waves, but they are not huge and we spent a lot of time swimming in the ocean.  I was up at sunrise almost every day and hotel staff was out cleaning the beach of seaweed.  The beach is truly amazing.   We were in Tower 5 in an Ocean View Jr. Suite and loved it!  We had a bed area and a sitting area and were able to walk down a grassy hill right to the beach.  The adult only pool area is gorgeous and the service was excellent.  We were able to get a bali bed every day except for one and ate lunch at the private restaurant outdoors almost every day where the food was delicious - especially the guacamole.  If you have the Royal Service, you have access to a full bar in the lobby with everything you could want - including snacks.  Our refrigerator was re-stocked daily and the room was always cleaned amazingly well.  I would never expect this but our maid actually folded the clothes that I had left out one day accidentally - I had never experienced this before.  She was awesome.   We ate at Vento which was very good and our server Gerardo  was FANTASTIC!  Not only was he incredibly kind, but he made a lot of great suggestions for dinner and all were exactly as presented to us.   Gerardo was great!  Mole is definitely not traditional Mexican food but very good.  Our favorite restaurant was the taco/quesadilla bar called Blue Agave.  We ate there twice and we ate a lot!  We have never had better Mexican food and highly  recommend it!   Room Service was also good and relatively quick!  Again, this resort is gorgeous and I would most definitely return!  Now there were a couple of negatives which could definitely be overlooked but I figure that if you are paying for the Royal Service, you may want a heads up:  Our flight arrived late morning.  When we got to the hotel, we were told to go have lunch and come back - that our room should be ready soon.  We ate and returned and the room was not ready yet.  This was fine as the lobby was lovely, but for almost 2 hours we were told "just 10 minutes more."  When we finally checked in, we met our butler and that was pretty much the end of any butler service.  We are self sufficient and made our dinner reservations ourselves - but the one thing that we did ask for was a Bali Bed reservation.  I was putting dishes outside of our room when our butler saw me and took them from me.  It was the first time I'd seen him since check in several days earlier.  He asked if I needed anything and I said that a Bali Bed for the following day would be great.  The next day, there was no reservation for us.  Unfortunately that was our last day of the trip, so it was kind of disappointing.  That was really the only interaction that we had with him during our entire stay.  One very positive point worth mentioning - every time we walked through the main lobby, we were asked several times if we needed anything by multiple members of the hotel staff.  They could not have been any nicer or more helpful.  The staff at this hotel is really top notch for the most part and I cannot say enough nice things about them.   We will definitely return and would highly recommend it to others.

reviews.author: Kateenelson
reviews.title: Beautiful, but disappointing food
reviews.text: My husband and I have been to several resorts and this one was up there in how beautiful it was and the service was good, but the food was not great. The buffet was not very good, the mole a la carte was not good either. The sushi a la carte was very good though, as well as the market grill and fuego were pretty good. The entertainment shows were good, but the location is terrible. They don't have a stage, it's just in a bar and it's hard to get seats where you can see the whole show. The service was great, staff is very friendly and the snack bars were awesome!

reviews.author: Brittney T
reviews.title: Overall good experience
reviews.text:
My husband and I recently stayed at this hotel Feb 3-10th along with another couple.
I will breakdown the overall stay
Royal service/family concierge- We booked into the family concierge, I did not realize royal services and family concierge were separate until we arrived... with no children. This was fine, and my mistake, services are virtually the same, you just receive a few more bonuses for child related things via the family concierge. You do receive a butler with this upgrade, however, we found there was really not much use for one. So for the price, I am not sure the upgrade for this service is worth it.

Rooms- With the upgrade to 'family concierge' we had an ocean front room. The view is well worth every penny. We were on the 1st floor. We had an unobstructed view of the beautiful ocean. The one of the 2 down sides to the room was that the balconies had flower boxes that just contained dirt, so it was a bit of an eye sore when out on the balcony. The second down side was the crappy wi-fi in the rooms. Our friends had the same issue. It was consistently inconsistent, cutting out often throughout the stay. However, outside the room, in the common seating area and at the pool we would have excellent signal.
 
Food-As per most resorts the buffet was so so. Their desserts were probably the best part in our opinion. However, there was a lot of variety between B and lunch.
We ate at al la cartes all but 1 night. They were quite good. Bana and market grill were by far our favourites, and also had the most commendable service. 

Atmosphere- the overall mood of the resort in my opinion is quite zen and calming. There was nightly entertainment at avenue bar, which was for the most part pretty good. Only downside was there is a large lack of seating in the area, which made it difficult to view the show if you weren't there at least 60-90 minutes before it started. We did not attend the late night bar (the Red lounge, open 10pm-2am) so I cannot speak to it.
I usually attend the spa, but this trip I did not. The gym is small but contains god equipment.

Beach- The beach is spectacular! Clean and large!
We did have some trouble with booking the cabanas around the pool- it required several days in advance for booking was which a large pain.

Overall good trip and decent resort. I would recommend it to families travelling with children.

reviews.author: Becky E
reviews.title: Absolutely Incredible Resort
reviews.text: This resort was AMAZING!!!  The service is incredible.  I don't think I have ever been to a place where absolutely everyone was always willing to go above and beyond to help you out and always with a smile on their face.  You can tell that the people who work there are genuinely happy to be there and enjoy their jobs.  From the moment we arrived, we were treated like royalty. Even our kids said they felt like princesses.  We had a family concierge deluxe junior suite.  I have to say, if you have kids, there is no other way to travel.  It is worth every penny!!  Instead of the main check-in lobby, you are whisked off to the family concierge lounge to check-in.  The lounge is perfect for families.  While we checked in, our girls went exploring and were in heaven when they discovered all the candy and snacks and juices for kids as well as a game room for the bigger kids and a play room for the younger kids.  For parents, the lounge has a large assortment of liquors, water and an espresso machine.  I have to admit to stealing a few gummy bears now and again myself ;) All of the staff who are part of Family Concierge are wonderful.  They were so helpful with any questions we had all throughout our stay.  One thing that I really appreciated about the staff in family concierge is that whenever you would run into them throughout the resort, they would greet you by your name.  It may seem a small detail, but just goes to show how much they take an interest in you as an individual.  They even bring cookies and milk to your room every night for the kids.  I don't think I can possibly say enough about our incredible butler, Hervik. While we were checking in Hervik met us in the family concierge lounge and came with 2 backpacks, 1 for each of our girls, filled with sunscreen, toothpaste, toothbrush, a t-shirt, hat, sand toys, and pool toys.  Throughout our stay he would leave the girls little gifts in our room such as coloring books, crayons, Mexican chocolates and fruits.  He also left them some fish food one day so they could feed the fish that are in the koi ponds throughout the resort.  As we were leaving, he gave each of the girls more gifts. He helped us with anything we could possibly need on our trip such as reserving us a bali bed by the pool or making our dinner reservations.  Anything we could possibly want, he could make happen, all with a huge smile on his face.  We really enjoyed getting to know him and by the end of the trip, our girls wanted him to come home with us =) We spent a lot of time at the family pool which was great for the little kids since the water is shallower and that's also where the kid's club does a lot of their activities.  At the pool, Juan was awesome at taking care of us and also so friendly.  One of the big things for our family when we travel is worrying about food.  Me and my girls have Celiac's and thus can't eat any gluten at all.  We've shied away from all-inclusives in the past because of this.  However, I was so impressed with the variety of gluten free food that was available at this resort.  Every waiter was so willing to help us with the menu and the chefs were willing to make the necessary changes to make their dishes gluten free.  Blue Agave has the best Mexican food and margaritas.  I think one of the best waiters we had was at that restaurant.  I unfortunately can not remember his name now but we were a party of 8, 4 adults, 4 kids and were there Friday, January 31st sitting over by the bar.  Maybe the manager at the restaurant will be able to figure out who it was?? He definitely deserves praise for his hard work.  Blue Agave also has a mariachi band that comes into play and takes requests.  They are excellent musicians. At the buffet, Naos, items were marked that were gluten free, and there was always plenty, including dessert. One little suggestion I could make for the buffet is that maybe they could put all of the gluten free food together so it's easier to find and it would lower the risk of cross contamination just in case someone used a spoon from a dish with gluten to get a gluten free item.  But the gluten free food was delicious and plentiful!!  The beach is gorgeous at the resort and it is very long so it's not crowded with people in one spot and there was never a problem finding beach chairs or pool chairs.  The sand is super soft and there's no rocks or coral in the ocean so no risk of stubbing your toe while playing in the waves.  Since the resort has such a great kid's club, me and my husband were able to check the girls into the kid's club and get 2 couples massages at the spa.  The spa is so relaxing and all of the staff in the spa are also wonderful and the massages were excellent.  The hydrotherapy pool is a must to try while you're there.  They even have a kid's spa that offers mani/pedis and hair braiding for the little girls. The fitness center is also very well equipped and even offers classes such as crossfit.  The trainer in the fitness center is excellent!  Paradisus Cancun also offers nightly entertainment.  When I first saw the venue, the Avenue Bar, I'll admit I was skeptical about if the place was big enough to put on a show.  But once again, Paradisus did not disappoint.  The first show we went to was a circus.  We all marveled at the talent and strength of each and every person in that show.  All of the shows they offered were incredible and each and every one of the people in them is incredibly talented.  This place is amazing whether you're traveling as a couple, attending a convention in their large convention facility, or traveling as a family, there is something for everyone.

reviews.author: Vikvak
reviews.title: Waist of money!!! Terrible food&service!!! Never again
reviews.text: It's not my first time in Cancun all inclusive, but deffently the one I want to forget!! We got small dusty room with a view to the parking (I paid for big room with a lagoon view) the food was horrible I got sick from the food twice!! The staff is very rude and not friendly, a lot of them not speaking English!! The service taking hours!! And you have to make reservations to all the restaurants that not the buffet, the buffet have the same bad food every day. And the restaurants even worse. We had bags in the room(more then one) the wifi was very bad we couldn't use it in the room!! You don't have service on the beach and in the pool when they taking an order it is taking hours!! Somebody steal my sunglasses and no one in the staff didn't try to help me find them!! We didn't had any bath robe in our room!! Everything there is old and not updated. It is maybe 3 star hotel and not from the good 3 stars hotel. I have been in sandos, and live aqua before and they not even close to this hotels!!! Don't go there!! I have no idea how this hotel have this rating in tripadvaisr but you have way better hotels for this kind of money !!! So make yourself a favor and go to anther place  !!

reviews.author: darl h
reviews.title: Great Hotel experience
reviews.text: This hotel was absolutely amazing. We had the royal service package, which i would highly  recommend to anyone. The service was unlike anything i have ever experienced before. The hotels 5 different restaurants were all top notch. Our favorite was Vento, the Mediterranean themed one. They all have very good dishes to chose from and great service. The hotel smells like heaven everywhere you go. Most definitely will be returning here or at least another Melia hotel.

reviews.author: Patrick d
reviews.title: Wonderful hotel, great service!
reviews.text: Great hotel excellent service. Food is very good. Best beach in Cancun. You can't beat the value. Our butler Hervick was awesome he always went above and beyond. Herbert in the breakfast area always took care of us.

reviews.author: 129dea
reviews.title: Worth every penny!
reviews.text:
Recently stayed at Paradisus for 3 nights and it was a great stay!!  From the moment you reach the front doors you're treated great and you realize what you're paying for.  The environment is very zen and calming.  The views from all around the hotel (restaurants/rooms) are indescribable.  The beach and the pool - So Amazing!!

All the staff I came in contact with were very friendly and always willing to help!  The food was great in my opinion for an all inclusive spot.  It's nice that they have different restaurants you can go to, so you don't feel like you're eating the same food everyday.  Don't even get me started on the drinks..they were all great!  Although what was included in the "all inclusive" alcohol sometimes varied by restaurant/bar, which I guess is a little odd, but there were always some good options and more than I would expect!

The reason I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 was b/c there were little things here and there, like the phone in our room smelled AWFUL!  I also never asked anyone to clean it, so that's my fault it never got fixed, but it was literally repulsive and smelled like it hadn't been cleaned since it was first plugged in.  Also we asked for some towels which never showed.  Also the main reason for me taking away 1 star was that the lights went out on us on several occasions!!?  I'm not sure what the reason was, but it was a little frustrating when you're trying to get ready or taking a shower and the lights go out on you and you Can't get them back on.  It happened to us on at least 3 different occasions...but after I called they would come back on it at least 15ish minutes or so.

All that being said, I'd go back in a heartbeat...I wish I was there right now :)  I know I was hesitant when I was first booking/deciding where to stay because of the price and I haven't had the best "all inclusive" experiences in the past - but this was GREAT!!  If you try to keep most of your meals on the resort and get your drinks in when you want, it's definitely worth every penny!

reviews.author: NYtouristo
reviews.title: Great vacation!!
reviews.text: The resort is amazing!!! The pool , the beach and the restaurants were great , especially Market Grill and Vento.The service was excellent- Gabriel, Giovanni and Salvador at the Swim up bar , Natanael, Wilberth at the Market Grill, as well as hostess Giovanna and manager Jesus - all were helpful and nice!!! We will definitely be back here. The only problem is that they dont have enough sunbeds at the beach and the pool( but the rest was excellent!!!

reviews.author: Tammy H
reviews.title: Wonderful hotel
reviews.text: We had a fantastic stay at Paradisus Cancun.  The resort was extremely clean and well kept.  The staff was friendly and helpful and the Family Concierge was very accommodating.  The food was amazing and there were many choices for us and our children.  It was nice to be on vacation and have the children eat healthy food rather than fried meals.

reviews.author: Tom B
reviews.title: Summer in the winter
reviews.text: Returned from Paradisus yesterday after a 5 night stay (2/04 - 2/08).  Great trip and great hotel.  Everything was first class from the food/restaurants to the bar tenders and shows.  And you do not need Royal service in my opinion.  Everything is fine just the way it is.  Junior Lagoon room is fine also.  Not in there that much anyway.  My wife, son and girlfriend would definitely return.  Excellent time at the beach.

reviews.author: Susan E
reviews.title: OUTSTANDING HOTEL that was truly  Paradise and more!!!!
reviews.text:
We just got back from our 6 day stay at this hotel and I am so excited to share what a fantastic stay it was!!!.  My husband and I were on like a second honeymoon.  The staff was so welcoming it was like greeting old friends and throughout the stay they wanted to do everything to make us feel welcomed.  The hotel is georgous and the pool and beach is to die for!!  The all inclusive food is EXCELLENT with a menu that has delicious food for any taste buds.  We recommend the NAOS restaurant as we were there for the delicious breakfast, lunches and dinners.  An enormous foood selection and the entire hotel was emaculate.  Our room was beautiful with a great sunset view of the lagoon.  Beds were very comfortable.  The hotel is a tropical paradise by day inside as you really feel like you have stepped into a tropical wonderland but at night it is a whole other romanitc experience with wonderful lighting and relaxing couches to enjoy the soft music and just melt into the beauty.  We ate in the Market Grill and the Fuego restaurants which were part of our package and also very good.  The staff is so happy to serve you and accommodating.  I am already selecting the days for next year to return to this tropical paradise which was a 10+ vacation!!!!!! A+++
Susan- Long Island, New York

reviews.author: Marcus V C N Alves
reviews.title: Luna Del Miel in Paradisus Resort Cancún !!!
reviews.text:
Hola! HI ! This review is about my HoneyMoon in Cancún...
Nice place with funny and security places....
WOnderful Beaches and local animals...
Private Beaches one for each resort..
Good Malls to buy somethings...

reviews.author: Monroe2022
reviews.title: Beautiful Beach & Great Service!
reviews.text:
We stayed at Paradisus Cancun from Jan 28th-Feb 3rd and we had a great vacation!!!  We decided to book the Family Concierge Ocean View room. Our check in was very smooth as we had a private check in at the Family Concierge lounge.  All of the employees were very helpful and our butler, Nancy, was great!! 

We hung out at the family pool and the ocean all day! The beach was beautiful even though the waves were pretty choppy. We were able to book a Bali bed everyday at the family pool and it was amazing! We have a 3 and 1 year old so they were able to take their afternoon naps everyday in the Bali bed, which worked out perfectly! We loved our pool server, Yolanda, she was AMAZING and became a friend by the end of our vacation! 

Our favorite restaurant was Vento. The buffet was amazing during breakfast but we didn't eat there during lunch or dinner but I'm sure it was great during those times as well. The best service we had the entire trip (besides Yolanda) was from Mesero Eduardo at Bana. He went above and beyond and made our dinner very enjoyable!!!

The only reason I did not rate this resort a 5 star is because of the rooms. I would consider the rooms a 3 star but it didn't bother us too much because we were never in our room unless it was to get ready or sleep.  They were out dated and defiantly need some things in the room replaced/fixed.

Some other information about the resort:
-The par 3, 9 hole golf course is included if you bring your own clubs & book Royal Service or Family Concierge
-XX Dos Equis & Dos Equis Amber are the beer they have on tap but they also have other can options
-They have a great liquor selection (crown royal, don julio, Bacardi, ect)
-The restaurant, Mole, and the bar, Red Lounge are adult only
-You need to make dinner reservations for every restaurant except for Naos (buffet) and Blue Agave but it is very easy to make a reservation and we were able to go to every restaurant we wanted to without a problem!
-This is a great resort for families!!

I would defiantly recommend Paradisus and would consider going back but just don't expect immaculate rooms!!!

reviews.author: Rick A
reviews.title: A Great First Impression
reviews.text:
This winter getaway, we chose Cancun. We also chose the Paradisus because it's a Melia property. In Punta Cana, we've stayed at the Melia Caribe Tropical and have been pleased. Although the spacious grounds & choices for restaurant and bars are better in Punta Cana, the food & (house) wine was sooo much better. Also, the beach seems a bit better and the beautiful water was warmer.

Ok, I'll start from the beginning. A big HEADS UP for 1st time to travelers to Cancun.Going through customs was ridiculous!!! From the time we went down the escalator to get in line, to finally talking with someone up front, took 1 HOUR!!!!! Just be ready, patient and hope you don't have anywhere to go soon! Coming back was so much better.

We reserved a taxi (van) in advance to the Paradisus with a company called "Happy Shuttle." Very reliable as if you try to get a taxi on your own, they can vary in price.....if you know what I mean. Happy Shuttle will be waiting for you outside with their name and yours posted on a sign. Once you're dropped off at the hotel, they tell you what time they will pick up up when leaving. Awesome!!

Upon arrival, as soon as you get out of your van, you're greeted warmly by all. This warm greeting goes for the whole staff for your entire stay. There's a ton of competition out there, so they have to kiss up to you. Of course, they will try to talk you into the Melia Club (long term time share) but will not be all in your face about it.

For water activities, across the street is "Aqua World." Be it diving, snorkeling (which we did), jet ski, etc. they do it all. It's on the up & up and they do a great job. FYI, they have a kiosk by one of the pools at the hotel for info. You don't have to go across the street necessarily.

If you want to go shopping, there are several malls and of course the open markets. By all means, do what the locals do and take the bus. Each way it's 9.5 pesos (under $1). A cab will be $$.

Like I said earlier, the buffet food is very good, the separate restaurants, which require reservations, are good and we never had to upgrade to anything but house wines. Certain ones are better, so sample and chose.

I'm a professional trumpet player and even sat in with a couple sax players. One was early evening in the atrium and another in a restaurant. Both played along with canned music and slightly amplified. Made for nice ambiance.

In short, we will be coming back!

Rick A.

reviews.author: LynR55
reviews.title: A beautiful hotel and beach - staff service was excellent!
reviews.text:
My boyfriend and I just returned from Cancun yesterday, and we couldn't have been more pleased with the Paradisus, the staff and the service we received while we visited.  This was our first trip to an all-inclusive hotel, so we didn't know what to expect.  We did not go with the royal package, but still received royal treatment.  From the moment we were greeted at the door with cool towels when we arrived, to the door staff who placed our bags into our shuttle to the airport, we were taken care of.  I booked the Paradisus online and knew exactly what hotel I was looking for after having visited Cancun 9 years ago...I wanted to stay at the hotel that looked like pyramids.  It stuck in my mind after my earlier visit.  The hotel absolutely glows in the dark and is very beautiful.  The interior is as beautiful as the exterior with marble floors and stunning trees, plants and fountains inside.  
Our Guest Services representative was a delightful woman named Bianca, who helped us with money exchanging, any trips we wanted to book, arranging our massage at the spa...anything we needed help with, we went to Bianca and it was taken care of.
Our beach days were made more relaxing because of the service of Miguel.  I have to mention Angel, too, who was the water aerobics instructor.  And I got my first experience at Zumba with the instructors at the pool.  
The food at the restaurants was very good.  We visited the Market Grill for outside dining, the Blue Agave for delicious Mexican dishes, but our favorite was Naos, the buffet.  You couldn't ask for a better selection of dishes.  Restaurant service was excellent.
We had a wonderful time and I would recommend this hotel to any of my family and friends.

reviews.author: Randy O
reviews.title: Wonderful facility with a few problems
reviews.text:
Found that the food on the buffet was never hot - just warm.
The show is in a bad place.  It is in a lounge and it only allows maybe 50 people to see it comfortably.  They need to create a stage with theatre style seating for a lot of people.  Of all the restaurants the best was The Mole, Extremely friendly hostess Carol, Waiter Joel  - you never had to ask - he was always there to serve you. One of the best facilities we have been to.  The lounge chairs by the pool need to be monitored better - often people would go early in the morning and place towels on lounge chairs - then not show up for hours to use them. The policy is that after 30 minutes your towels and personal belongings will be removed - but there is not monitoring by the staff. Solution: In the morning if staff see people placing towels and starting to walk away - either tell them to remove them until they are ready to use or provide many more lounge chairs so that finding a chair is not a problem.

reviews.author: Rachel A
reviews.title: Overall Great Experience!
reviews.text:
I had never been on a vacation before and as a first time this was a great experience. My boyfriend and I took the trip together and we were both pleased by the service and amenities provided by this resort. My boyfriend had travelled before and he even said that it was one of the best resorts he had stayed at. My view could be seen as biased because this is the only resort I have stayed at but it exceeded my expectations heavily.
I read some other reviews about having to pay extra and unfriendly service and I did not experience this at at all. I was in with the Royal Service package though so my review is strictly based on that.
First off I want to mention how helpful and friendly everyone was and the cleanliness of the hotel. Everyday people were washing windows, floors and inside glass doors. If my boyfriend and I walked by any staff member they always greeted us. 
The butler addition with Royal Service was a real treat. Not only was our butler (Juan) very helpful but he surprised us on occasion. One night we had ordered aroma therapy pillows and Juan came up with a bottle of champagne and some mini desserts along with the pillows. He also offered us suggestions for places to go in Cancun. He was very friendly and helpful.
I would also like to point out how my boyfriend and I had some trouble when leaving, our original flight to leave had been cancelled due to weather. When speaking with the concierge he was very helpful and said if we needed another night he could offer us another room that would be affordable to stay in. Thankfully my boyfriend and I got on an earlier flight, but it meant we had to leave the hotel at 4:30 in the morning. The concierge let us know that we could still have room service bring us breakfast because the buffet did not open until 6:30 am. The room service brought us breakfast right at 4am (when we requested it) and made it easier for us to get something to eat before we had to make our way to the airport.
This was so helpful, this being my first time traveling, I was very upset when the flight got cancelled and concerned. The hotel and staff worked with us to get home after our lovely visit.
Our favorite restaurants were Vento and Fuego. Vento had a nice atmosphere and our waiter was so helpful in explaining the menu to us, he even introduced me to my new favorite drink: Bahama Mama's.
We also enjoyed the buffet they offered, the food was delicious and they made something different every day. The omelette bar was fantastic.
We definitely recommended this hotel to all of our friends and family and we will be coming back again!

reviews.author: Danielle B
reviews.title: winter getaway
reviews.text: The staff was very friendly and assertive but our Butler didn't service our fridge when asked they mixed us up with the other couple we were with.  Our bathroom backed up with toilet and we had to move rooms but they did move us to a suite, the view was so so.  The pool service was good and the adult pool was very nice!  We had to leave Fluego reastraunt because they ran out of both fishes, the market grill was the best!

reviews.author: USCThersa
reviews.title: Nice hotel, poor service
reviews.text:
This is the 2nd all-inclusive hotel I stayed at in cancun.  The hotel itself is pretty nice.  But the service is not at the 4 or 5 star level, nor was the food (except Mole, which was very tough to get reservation at).  Here are some of the reasons why I only gave it 3 stars.
-  They up sell you the "royal service" but didn't really get any of the special services.  The exclusive "restaurant" was just a poolside cafe, that was open for a few hours a day.  The food available in the atrium was terrible.  Basically, you get an adult only pool with chance to reserve a cabana. 
-  House keeping did not refill all the amenities everyday
-  They don't really respond to your requests, we had to call a few times to ask for things
-  Restaurants were only open at night by reservation.  And the food was not very good
Overall, their service was very restrictive and not accommodating, very frustrating. 

There  were some positives though
-  Food and service at Mole restaurant was good.  Our server Roberto was very professional.
-  Pool was very clean
-  Hotel was very big, and had a huge beach front

With all the options in Cancun, I would not be going to Paradisus again.

reviews.author: Jeneve29
reviews.title: First all-inclusive resort for me
reviews.text:
My husband and I traveled with another couple to this resort in late January.  It was everything I was looking for.  The hotel is very wide, so it has a lot of beach-space, and the kids section is all the way on the other side as the adult-only section.  There weren't too many kids there, but it wasn't exactly spring break time either.  The hotel renovated a lot of their main areas (restaurants, lobby, etc).  The rooms are not newly renovated, but the bathrooms are nice, and each room has its own outdoor balcony.  The rooms were definitely fine for what we wanted.  

The food was fantastic.  The buffet was much better than expected.  Our favorite restaurants were Vento, Fuego, and Mole.  We didn't check out Tempo because it required additional fees.  Bana's sushi was pretty good too, not the best I've had, but better than average.  We made reservations each day for the night of.  They did say you could make reservations for the following day as well.  We never had trouble getting into the restaurant.  Sometimes they told us they weren't available at the time requested, so we pushed it back, but there always seemed to be extra spots (except at Blue Agave around 5:30).  My suggestion is that if they say they aren't available at the time requested, make it later, but you can always go at the preferred time to see if they let you in.  

The drinks served were great, and everyone was always helpful when suggesting a new drink to try.  The y had top-shelf booze, but many times it was behind a cabinet, so you have to ask for it.  

If you are looking for a ton of entertainment during the trip, this isn't the best option.  There was an entertainment crew during the days for things like zumba, football, volleyball, but they aren't in your face about it.  I actually loved that.  The option is there for you, but you don't feel pressured into it.  I know I've heard of other hotels doing more, but this is just what I wanted.  They also had small classes you could take throughout the day (wine-tasting, tequila-tasting, guacamole-making, ceviche-making, etc).  Those were simple, and offered a nice break from the sun.  At night there was a show at 8:30 each night.  The show was different each day, and lasted about 30-45 minutes each.  The show just took place in one of their open bars.  Again, it was something different to do at night.  

We didn't leave the resort at all during our stay.  It was perfectly relaxing!  We got up each morning and put towels on our spots on the beach.  At 10 they start coming around to take orders.  The spots on the beach were usually full by 10, but there were usually a handful of spots always available by the pool.  The service overall was pretty good for us.  My husband randomly met some of the hotel management, and they took great care of us.  They seemed to really care about the service that was being provided.

reviews.author: funz1915
reviews.title: Awesome weekend!
reviews.text: Went for the weekend with a friend. Loved it! Great beach (could not go in the water) too rough, good food, wonderful staff, good drinks, comfortable room.  We stayed at the resort and enjoyed the beach. Yes I would go back again to this resort with my family.

reviews.author: Bernardo S
reviews.title: Fairly good experience, but with reservations
reviews.text: The general quality of the Hotel was very good. The restaurants were generally good except the steak house, the Pearl Restaurant where the steak was so tough that I had to return it. The room needs some structural repairs because the rain semi flooded the room through the sliding door to the terrace. And I really regreted that the pool and the whirlpool were not heated, and, at least for us, unusable because the water was really cold. The attention from the staff was excelent

reviews.author: Charlotte040
reviews.title: Great family vacation!
reviews.text:
We had a bit of a bumpy start with "0" level room (below 1st floor) and a noise problem. The staff took our complaint very seriously and made sure we were satisfied by moving us to a nicer room (remodeled) on a higher level in a different tower. I don't like complaining but if you don't say anything "in the moment" I find you don't really have the right to complain later.

That said, the hospitality was amazing. Someone at the resort commented "Is there such a thing as too much hospitality?" because they were a little uncomfortable with the level of attention. For the record we opted for the Family Concierge service.

The beach: wonderful, lots of chairs and umbrellas and no annoying towel card/policy. Sometimes service was a little slow on the beach but in their defense the weather had been a bit iffy and one day the beach would be practically empty and the next packed. I think it was hard to staff ahead of time. There is substantial beach at the hotel. Probably at least 60 feet of sand to the water from the last row of umbrellas. I know that can change with a storm but as of our stay in Jan of 2014 the beach was huge. The reason I mention this is because in 2007 when we were in Cancun the beaches had eroded in some areas from storms and we were disappointed about the lack of beach. I think all of the hotels have brought sand in from somewhere to improve the beaches.

The room: it's hard to comment on the room because they seem to have many kinds of rooms and I can't say for sure what kind of room we were moved to compared to what we booked. I think we were upgraded but other travelers with the same vacation packages described their rooms as being similar to our 2nd room. We booked an ocean view junior suite with family concierge service. The first room was much smaller than the 2nd and needed some work. We loved our 2nd room! Jacuzzi on the deck, 2 TV's, lots of drawer space, double sink in bathroom, rain shower and a regular tub (good for kids), private room with commode and bidet.

Room service: sometimes language/communication misunderstandings (brush up on your Spanish and it will serve you well) but they worked their butts off to get everything perfect!

Housekeeping: Awesome! Well-stocked mini bar, clean towels offered day and night

Family Concierge: Super friendly, they made contact with us every day to make sure everything was perfect, made our little boy feel so special, cookies and milk at bedtime, Karla was our personal Family Concierge and she was great!

Restaurants: During the day the buffet is the main option. In my opinion, breakfast was great! We only ate lunch once the whole week (it was okay) and dinner was good one night and okay the other night we ate there. The buffet is arranged to cater to American, European and South/Latin American tastes and eating habits. If you are like me and like trying new things (not just Mexican hamburgers and pizza) then you will love it. Frequent ceviche dishes, spring rolls, traditional Mexican foods and tapas spreads (including meats, cheeses, pickled things like capers and peppers, etc.) that I sometimes didn't understand (no disrespect intended). We loved The Market Grill and Mole. The Blue Agave was good but our experience was tainted by a crabby child! We didn't make it to Fuego officially because the babysitter had a problem. We ate our food in our room. It was good but the experience just wasn't the same. We didn't make it to the other restaurants on the premises. OVERALL, we were never hungry and there was always something to satisfy our appetites!

Gift shop: reasonable prices if you don't want to leave the resort. 

Pools: we only went to the kiddie pool. Perfect depth for the kiddos, kid friendly service and private huts (can't remember what they were called) if you booked them in advance. THERE IS NO SLIDE in the kiddie pool area. The pirate ship pictures and other slide pictures on the website are at other resorts.

Kid services: Kid zone is like a huge playroom that takes kids 5 and older (I think) by themselves to give parents a break. Under 5 needs requires a parent of babysitter. Babysitting arranged through the hotel was $15/hr in Jan 2014. They have ceramic painting by the pool. Family concierge offers fun stuff like a balloon bath in your room, cookies and milk in the evening, I'm sure there is other stuff I am forgetting. They give the kids a backpack with pool or beach toys when you arrive and have candy and treats in the family concierge area.

I think that covers it! We can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: Betty L
reviews.title: Horrendous HORRENDOUS Service
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun and had absolutely horrendous service.  The Paradisus facilities were fine, the customer service was atrocious.  We checked in and our room wasn't ready, but it was before 3pm so we went to the beach.  Upon looking around there were several bars/restaurants closed.  When we asked why the beach bar was closed, we were told there were not enough customers to keep them all open.  We had just listened to a 5 minute speech on all the beautiful facilities.  So,  we had been lied to upon check in about the availability and times of all the facilities.  We were also bounced around three times when we asked where we could best change.  We were first sent from the check in desk to a concierge.  There was no sign for a concierge, so we asked again and were told to wait.  Once no one came we began to wander the hotel.  Once on the beach there were no beach chairs.  We asked if two could be brought since the hotel was at such low capacity, we were told to wait 10 minutes, so we waited again.  The waiter got a staff member and 15 minutes later he came with no chairs but we were told we could pay to upgrade for chairs.  This is a hotel that is not full enough to open 2 or 3 bars and restaurants a day but I need to pay for a beach chair?  Then we waited for our email telling us our room was ready.  We went to the desk after receiving our email and were told our room wasn't ready because it was not yet 3pm.  My husband told the staff we packed up and left a sandy beach because we had received an email saying our room was ready.  We were told to wait again and I thought my husband was going to walk out and book a new hotel room at a different hotel right then.  No one apologied to us, no one offered an explanation.  We were told to wait 10 minutes.  The front desk staff didn't tell us which tower, or where to go, just a room key with no words.  After wandering the hotel AGAIN we found the tower we needed and out room.  The fridge in the room was turned off, all the beverages were warm and smelled of stank unplugged refrigerator.  The TV was lopsided about 20 degrees off of center.  We decided to shake it off and get ready for the Super Bowl, which was shown on large screen tv's at the top of the lobby of the hotel.  We arrived to be told, once again, that there were no open seats, but if we wanted to upgrade and pay 80 dollars we could have one of the 25 open reserved BEDS/CHAISE in the bar.  We paid for an all inclusive resort only to be asked over and over again to wait and that if we wanted basic services like a beach chair or a seat in a bar before a Super Bowl we had to PAY MORE money.  The screens were horrid, there was options for 100 more seats if they brought it chairs and could have left their cheesy beds for those who wanted beds in a lobby bar.  The spots we found we on the back side of a projection screen so we saw the reverse image.  It was a joke.  My husband ordered room service after the game and was asked twice how he wanted his burger, medium please.  It arrived as a hocked puck, over done and not freshly prepared.  It was inedible.  It was a joke.  The service was a joke.  It was a waste of emotions and our time and money.

reviews.author: ladycane015
reviews.title: Amazing!!!
reviews.text: This resort is amazing in every aspect. I would definitely suggest the Royal Service! the staff was extremely friendly & helpful. We were escorted to a private check-in with wine & a cold towel waiting for us upon arrival. The royal service has it's own tower, a butler with a phone for you to call personally for any requests, and there is a private eating area with a bar and snacks available 24/7. the room was amazing & very clean. The balcony is huge and gives such a great view. The royal service guests have access to a private pool as well. The food was great, especially at the places that require reservation. The entertainment was great and the bars played great music. We literally didnt need to leave the resort although we did go shopping. I cannot wait to return! I cannot stop talking about my trip to anyone that will listen :) There was not a single con at the resort.

reviews.author: Thomas T
reviews.title: Nice property on the ocean with friendly service
reviews.text: Recently returned from business meeting at this property.  Nice all-inclusive option with premium liquors and obviously unlimited supply.  Found food in Naos to be more of the same as the four days wore on - plenty of variety but not all that high quality.  Had a room in the 'C' Pyramid (main building) and found that the noise from loud music went fairly late into the night.  If you go to be early, ask for any rooms not located in 'C'.  WiFi coverage throughout the property is spotty at best but if you are there on vacation, this should not matter,

reviews.author: Deborah B
reviews.title: My very best vacation yet!!
reviews.text: I truely must say this place is by far the best. Everyone was so friendly and helpful. from breakfast waiters to bar tenders. The swim up bar had  the greatest  personality and had us laughing so much.everyone everywhere was so attentive of you . we went with 7 friends and all of us will for sure want to go back again. And yes, the " Royal Service " is the way to go. that is how they treated us all.. Like Royals:)

reviews.author: Shawn S
reviews.title: wonderful experience
reviews.text: We went to the Paradisus Cancun for our youngest daughters destination wedding. While there we had the pleasure of experiencing a truly professional and wonderful staff. We arrived early for check in but fairly close to the wedding,, a room was made available if needed to get dressed for the wedding, Fortunately, it was not; the staff had a room prepared early and we were able to unpack and dress at some leisure. In the mean time we were seated in the Market Grill where we had appetizers and kept an eye out for others from our party. Jersus was the primary waiter and over saw others who also took care of us as it got busy and or party grew. He was also our main waiter in the Market Grill on our last day; I can not say enough about his service it was very much our pleasure to have him attending to our dinning experience. We had dinner in the Market Grill on our second night at the resort, the skewered meat dinner was  outstanding and again the service was remarkable; i would like to commend our hostess Giovanna, but even more our waiter Guillermo. He kept our glasses full, our plates cleared as needed, and was unintrusive throughout the entire meal. We highly recommend the Paradisus for a party of two right up to a large party of over 24 including children.

reviews.author: intenseot
reviews.title: I want to tell you about Francisco and David and Mauricio
reviews.text:
Francisco was such a doll, David was so genuine and Mauricio made sure you were really heard! All the guys at the Royal Service pool were truly amazing and you knew they really had concern for you, but these 3 were outstanding.
 They remembered what you liked, be it food or drink and they really payed attention to you. It meant a lot to myself and my husband. 
It and they made the trip truly memorable.

reviews.author: TNclogger09
reviews.title: Life is just better in flip-flops
reviews.text: All I can say is "wow".  The Paradisus is not like any place we have stayed in Cancun before.  It is so eleganat, we felt like we were royalty.  The breakfast and lunch buffet had lots of variety.  The restaurats were all 5 star.  The pool faces the beautiful blue ocean.  The Red Lounge was hoppin' and so much fun.  There's a little gift shop on the main level where prices rival the straw market.  And last but not least, the staff was truly incredible.  If you go, be sure to check out Fuego, ask for Benjamin and have him make you a Myan Coffee.  mmmmmmm-good.  It was an awesome trip and very affordable.

reviews.author: Lisabeif66
reviews.title: Vento restaurant
reviews.text:
We chose the all inclusive meal option, the only way to go.  Two of our dinners were at Vento.  We had Emmanuel as our waiter both times (he was the reason we went back the 2nd time). 
The food was superb and Emmanuel was able to make recommendations based on taste, portion size, etc... Every recommendation he made was perfect.

If you stay at this resort, make sure to eat at Vento, and ask for Emmanuel.

The resort is beautiful.  All of the employees are extremely nice and helpful.  Betsy really helped us to switch rooms, as we were assigned a lagoon view (aka parking lot), on the first floor with a king bed, but we got reassigned to the high floor ocean view with double beds as requested.

Pillows need replacing, and bathroom fixtures need some repairs.

The beach is pristine, with very few vendors harassing us, which is a pleasure.

reviews.author: CasWoodstock_GA
reviews.title: Good but.............
reviews.text:
Stayed there with my fiancee last week in January.  Overall the impression was good but not great.
The good is with the facilities, since the "renovations" the overall impression was that the money was spent mostly on the public areas, e.g. Lobby, pool area etc.  The room although comfortable was dated, even though we were given a complimentary upgrade.  When compared to RIU hotels, Paradisus differentiates between guests.  Many of the top shelf liquors are NOT included in the 'all inclusive' rate, neither is liquor in the minibar in the room (only beer and sodas).  At Riu hotels, the minibar is stoked with liquor dispensers.  The bar tenders at the Paradisus with a few exceptions, will not hesitate to tell you that top brands are NOT included.  The restaurants are good with two exceptions, the main restaurant NOOS is too small to accommodate the large number of guests every morning overflowing to the outside tables and consequent poor service.  BY contrast, The BANA, Vento and Fuego are excellent restaurants with great food and excellent service.  There are other restaurants that are only for guests that have booked "The Royal Service" a category of service that ORBITZ (our booking agent did no let us know existed).  The Market Rodizio, an attempt at Brazilian food was not very good with limited meat selections and very tough beef and lamb.  Overall, if I had to do it again I will book at RIU where "All inclusive" means All Inclusive.  Having said all of that, the people were very courteous and helpful especially the guys at the pool bar.

reviews.author: k0sm056
reviews.title: Very large and a beautiful setting
reviews.text:
We were invited to stay at this resort by our son and daughter - in - law.
The beach and pools were beautiful !!!
The a la cartes were quite good too.
The rooms however were a little tired. Now we were in the "members" building.
You'd think they would treat their members better, but I don't think this is the case.
The price they charge for all inclusive is way too high. But you have no choice as
the prices they charge at the resort are astronomial !!
Plus the charging of the pool beds for the days is just not right.
Not sure if we would go back again or not

reviews.author: Cancunconron
reviews.title: Great beach & service,  but some things lacking
reviews.text:
My husband and I, 30 y/o, stayed at Paradisus Cancun Feb 17th-22nd. This was our first time staying in the hotel zone. we stayed at a handful of "luxury" AI resorts in riviera maya and punta Cana.  Paradisus is by far the priciest, but didn't "wow" us as much as other resorts such as Now Jade or Iberostar Paraiso Del Mar.  Dont get me wrong, Paradisus has a few great things to offer, but the things it's lacking can left us feeling flat. Here's a few examples:

Good things:
- the beach is wonderful, huge,  full of shells, and pretty easy to find a chair or palapa. Note: pay attention to the flags. We had red flags out our entire stay. The ocean was very rough to swim in past the waist. The life guards had to help numerous people back to shore.
- the lobby area is beautiful, great for photos
- the ocean view room view was incredible, glad we paid extra for that. 
-Staff are fabulous,  every single one of them are helpful and courteous, and do a great job handling some of the obnoxious, sometimes overly intoxicated,people they encounter. The staff really make this place shine.
- the food is pretty good. Reservations are easy to make. The buffet food was hot and decent to grab a quick meal. fuego and the Market grill are highly recommended. 
-Quick activities are offered daily such as wine tasting and pole dancing ( yes pole dancing). We tried the wine tasting, per the recommendation of Diego. We are so glad we did! Carlos, the sommelier, is fantastic, funny, and knowledgable. It's worth trying at no extra cost. 
-a bus stop is located right outside of the resort and offers a safe a cheap way to quickly travel to shopping and restaurant.
-the nightly entertainers are very talented

Not so good things:
- upon arrival we were asked to participate in a marketing "breakfast" the flowing morning. We politely declined, but  was continued to be asked to attend this. We had to get very assertive and say no multiple times. this was a bit uncomfortable and not a very good first impression. 
- the pool was Freezing! Too cold and deep, way too uncomfortable to swim in. We didn't swim or lay out by the pool our entire stay. It was impossible to find a chair by the pool unless you went out there before 9am. People claim multiple chairs for the day, first come first serve. There is no oversight on this. 
- Although very clean, the building and rooms are showing signs of aging. You could get a newer resort for your money. 
- there was not enough entertainment at night. After the 45 minute entertainment show, the only other option is to go to the red room, which is a small club. The red room is good for a visit or two, but there were times when a live band with dancing out in the lobby would have been preferred.
