Overall, it's unlikely we will return to Paradisus Cancun, not because we had a bad time,  but just because there are better AI resorts out there for the money.

reviews.author: babycakes_13
reviews.title: Not a 5 star! More like a 3
reviews.text:
First I will say the resort is beautiful, however the rooms are completely outdated. The bathtub is gross, almost looks like it was not cleaned. The drapes in our room were full of mold! And we asked for a king size bed but had no choice but to take two double beds. We were told we would be charged extra for a king bed, after we already spent close to $5,000 to stay here. 
Our rooms were not cleaned until 4-5pm, which I think is unreal, and I have traveled a lot and have never experienced this. 
The service on the beach and pool area was great and the staff was always so pleasant. We only ate at one restaurant because our waiters Antonito and Luis were awesome. Whatever we wanted to eat, weather it was on the menu or not, they provided. They truly made our vacation. 

I will return to Cancun, but will NOT return to Paradisus.

reviews.author: Egide B
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun Equal Paradis
reviews.text:
The Paradisus Cancun is an incredible Hotel, with excellent food, impeccable service...They really take care of Everything....The choice of all the restaurants with a great choice of very good imported wine, One of the greatest Wine Cellar...at reasonable price...

And the Restaurant Tempo is the best experience of restaurant and food .... in my life....And I have the chance to travel alot, and always in very good restaurant....

reviews.author: Denis2755
reviews.title: ABSOLUTE GORGEOUS SETTING
reviews.text:
We were there for 2 weeks and BOY,,, talk about a beautiful hotel and location. Situated in the middle of the strip with lush lawns and trees in front of the hotel (9 holes executive par 3) a beautiful beach with lots of palapas( enough for everyone). Bar service and lunch delivered at you palapas (Hamburgers,club sandwiches,wings,nachos) by friendly staff (no charge.... but leave a tip). The sea was warm and the waves  were fun to swim in. The hotel is made of 5 pyramides connected together as pyramide 3 is the main one where all the activities take place, such as ,,, the main buffet, all the À LA CARTE restaurants , shops , the avenue bar where the nightly shows are, the Red lounge disco,the spa  and a medical clinic.Inside these pyramides, you will experience  a boidome like feeling, There is lush vegetation  , vines hanging from every floor down where small pools with exotic fish ,an Asian restaurant, a bar are,,,, FABULOUS.Since this pyramid has 8 floors. Take the time to go up there and see this exotic rain forest from above..... Breathtaking !

               We were in pyramide 1 (Club Mélia) . This place was very quiet and relax , The rooms are comfortable , had a very good matress (king size)... We even had a jacuzi on the balcony .... Ocean view is a MUST. 

               Food was great everywhere , Buffet was great, We really liked the Market Grill where they serve huge  pieces of meat from gigantic brochettes...... Make sure to eat breakfast at the buffet outside on the porch..... what a VIEW of the Carabeen sea !!!!

               We travel a lot and believe me .... the house wine is good at this hotel. The wine is always from a corked bottle. Spanish,Argentine and YES... we even drank fine Merlot from Bordeaux at tha Asias restaurant BANA.

               Staff is very nice and attentive to your every needs, A thank you to RUBY,our concierge..... a fine man,

               All in all, Paradisus Cancun is a wonderful 5 star resort that is a must if you're planning to go in Cancun, I stongly recommand it.

reviews.author: CBAPLG
reviews.title: Royal Service is the Way to Go!!
reviews.text: If you are looking for 5 star resort experience at 4 star pricing, than the Royal Service upgrade here is it.  We had our own private sit down check in that took no more than 5 minutes (were able to make all our dinner reservations for the same time every night as well with no headaches).  Royal Pool is secluded (no kids, thank God), private cabanas that are included at no extra cost, and tons of beach towels (no room card required).  Consuelo came by at least 3 times per hour with tasty drinks and tons of bottled water, she was wonderful.  The food at La Palapa (Royal service only) was outstanding for lunch (panko breaded gruyere is awesome) .  Way better than buffet food for the normal guests.  Didn't eat buffet at all, no need to when you are a Royal Guest.  The breakfast items at the Royal service restaurant are amazing.  The full -time staff there is excellent, they made us fresh espresso every morning, cocktails in the evening (Grey Goose only here) and plated scrumptious desserts to take to our room for late night cravings.  We were never told no, ever!!  Fuego is by far the best food in the entire place, although the other restaurants were awesome, Fuego tappas were great, wine was great, and service was perfect.  Vento was excellent (Omar and Yazmin) took great care of us.  Sushi was great, and Toji bar had the best homemade Sangria, thanks to the great service of Luis and Benito.  Great evening shows, always friendly staff, and awesome food (although we really didn't eat much at the buffet) makes for a perfect vacation getaway.  My wife and I made it a point to always tip above and beyond, and I guarantee that will make a difference.  I say the same thing to everyone if you don't tip don't expect much, if you treat people like they deserve, your experience will be flawless.  Upgrade of only $40 a night for a 1 bedroom 2 bath suite is highly worth it, especially if your significant other takes forever in the bathroom.  If you are looking at the Royal or Gran Caribe (stayed at both in the past), look at the Royal service at Paradisus instead, chances are you will save $300 plus and have just as good of an experience.  Yih spa services that are included with Royal service are worth it in itself.  Awesome relaxation pool!!

reviews.author: jennifer c
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation!
reviews.text:
We just returned from a Valentine's Day romantic getaway to the Paradisus Cancun Resort and had an amazing time!  From the moment we stepped in the hotel we were whisked away by our own butler, Francisco, to the "Royal Service" building and pampered every second. The handed us some champagine, towels to wash our hands, took our bags, and made us feel like royalty.  We HIGHLY recommend the Royal Service upgrade.  The building is much quiter, clean, and the service they give you is outstanding.  You also have your own pool and bar on the Royal Service side.  ALl adults and no screaming children splashing you.  Worth every penny!

Our butler, Francisco, was outstanding!  We arrived on Valentine's Day and that night while we were at dinner, he had rose petals put on our bed in the shape of a heart and a bottle of wine waiting for us.  He was wonderful!  He made us our dinner reservations each night (highly recommend this) and was always available to help us in any way.

We never left the resort because there was so much to do!  Plenty of restaurants and bars to choose from.  The pool bar area was our favorite spot.  The cabana boy, Sergio, was outstanding!  He made us beach bed reservations every day, brought us towels, fruit, towels for our hands and faces, etc.  We loved him!!  

The bartender, Alvaro, was also outstanding!!  He knew the drinks we liked and would have them sent to us before we ordered another round.  We never had an empty cup thanks to Alvaro!  He makes unbelievable pina coladas and mudslides.  I'm drooling just thinking about them.  

Make sure you stop by the Royal Service pool and meet Alvaro at the bar and Sergio at the cabana!  They will make your trip to Paradisus even better!

Thank you to the entire staff at Paradisus Cancun.  We can't remember all the names, but the waiters at all the restaurants we visited were all so outgoing, friendly, helpful and charming.  The food is out of this world!

Jennifer and Ned

reviews.author: Antelope2
reviews.title: Wonderful staff. Great food an entertaiment
reviews.text: Don't submit to the indifference you may encouter on checkin, when the assigned room isn't what you requested. Find an ally among the staff, get what you requested, then enjoy all the benefits of a remarkably freindly staff , a wide variety of excellent food, and don't miss the 8:30 PM show in the Avenue Bar, which exceeds any cruise we have been on.

reviews.author: Olga K
reviews.title: Terrible reception, average service and food, plenty faults, night repairs
reviews.text:
On the 2nd of February we, together with our friends, came to Cancun, Mexico on vacation and were met by an Apple rep.
Usually it takes about 10-15 minutes to fill the bus with passengers and move to the hotels.
We know that it’s a dispatcher’s job to distribute different customers to different minibuses, however we don’t understand why we had to wait for over 40 minutes until the bus started moving.
We entered the beautifully designed hotel and were so much surprised to find out that we were not welcome, as it seemed that nobody expected our visit. And mind, we were over an hour late for check-in, way after 4 pm. Our rooms were not ready, the receptionist couldn’t find available rooms, then with the help of her supervisor Ramon tried to offer us rooms on different floors – 0, 1 or 8. To get rooms at least on the same floor we had to wait for another hour or two. Meanwhile we decided to have something to eat – it turned out to be a problem in a 6-stars all-inclusive resort: the buffet was closed at 5 pm, you could get no food till 6pm. We were asked out of the buffet and offered a room service. Tell me, please, how you can get room service without any room. Amazing logic! The only open option was a bar with drinks, thanks God, we at least could quench our thirst with some soda and juice. No complains here, there was some waitress who brought us some nuts and dried fruit.
When we finally got to our rooms, it was too late to go down to the Sea to take the first swim as our tradition.
Anyway, we got to a restaurant and had nice food. Good people, good staff, good quality. We thought – finally we can have a well deserved rest. No way, people! I was startled around midnight by the noise of drilling and somebody talking loud on a walkie-talkie in the hallway, somebody was running on the roof and doing something. The receptionist when I called stated that the manager is there to take care of the noise. Nothing of the kind. In  the flyer we got the next day it said that they were upgrading conditioning system. Wonderful! We are all for it! But should it be done in the middle of the night when everybody is sleeping? It wasn’t an emergency, it could be done during the day. And three nights on the row it’s too much. The call to the receptionist didn’t solve the problem, only the conversation with the supervisor in the morning did. The only thing we wanted to know is how long it was going to continue – should we stay or request another hotel.
In spite of human errors and some lack of organization we liked the place. And Mother Nature did her best, thanks to Her - the sand, the sea, the sun - our vacation wasn’t completely ruined.
As for the food, not much variety. Besides, for 3 days they were fixing something in the buffet, so everybody was served in the open air – picnic style from morning till evening.
Yes, and conditioning system in the building leaves much to be desired. 
So 3 stars at most. They need to fix the drawbacks first, then claim 5 or 6 star level.

reviews.author: Erich75
reviews.title: Magnificent service at a great price
reviews.text: We had a long weekend with a few friends at Paradisus. We "splurged" for the Deluxe Royal treatment in Pyramid 5.  There was a mix up with our reservations, but they made a few phone calls and remedied the issue promptly.  The staff at Paradisus is outstanding.  In our pyramid, we had happy hour every day with top shelf liquor (self serve, if you preferred) and exceptional service.  The restaurants served innovative and delicious food (especially the sushi at Bana), and the Red Lounge (with DJ Rolando) was where we ended up dancing and drinking each night.  The pyramid atria are beautifully adorned with plants, water features, and vines (Philodendron?) draping down from each floor.  We will definitely be back.

reviews.author: zachMNmedic
reviews.title: Cancun's Best Kept Secret
reviews.text: We are a late 20's couple who were looking for a low key resort. Paradisus was more than we could have ever hoped for. After 10+ trips to the caribbean we know what we are looking for and found all of those things at this resort. The staff made this vacation our most enjoyable yet, the staff there functioned as team and genuinely seemed happy to be at work and to take care of us.  Salvador in the Avenue Bar was fantastic, if you come to Paradisus be sure to meet him. Our biggest concern with coming to Cancun was the resorts feeling crowded with the party scene. Paradisus did a fantastic job of making those fears go away. They have activities if you are interested, but they don't make it in your face or pressure you into it (a.k.a. water aerobics). We loved the food at all but one of the restaurants on the property, Vento's food was not to our liking, but everyone has different tastes and the service there was fantastic. They have enough beach chairs for everyone, which helped us avoid the 6am beach chair hunt. The check in was easy, quick and for the most part pressure free. Like most resorts they do attempt to get you to join their "Vacation Club" but were very low pressure and took "no" for an answer. Our room was nice and clean everyday, had a modern feel, and was very up to date. The air conditioning was the most effective I have ever experienced in this area and made the room very comfortable. The beach was well maintained, clean, and very wide compared to all of the surrounding resorts. The liquor is top shelf without any restrictions, and each bartender was happy to recommend their favorite drinks. The only recommendation i would make for Paradisus is to have a drink menu at their bars for people who don't necessarily have a "Beachy" drink in mind. My wife and I will definitely be back to this resort and found it nothing short of perfect!!!

reviews.author: Patty P
reviews.title: The best relaxing vaction ever!
reviews.text:
The hotels serene atmosphere was very relaxing and calming.   The hotel staff in all aspects were very kind and helpful.  The beautiful resort made it the dream vacation I've always wanted.
The entertainment was a bonus that I was not expecting.  I was able to watch or participate in events of my choosing.  The events added to an enjoyable stay.  The variety of restaurants made it easy for me to enjoy many different delicious food choices.

It is the best vacation that I have ever been on and hope to go again someday!

reviews.author: imlug5
reviews.title: Family Vacation in Paradise
reviews.text:
We went to the Paradises, Cancun for one week Feb 5-Feb12. When we arrived in the Royal Service Area, Eric our Butler and Lizabeth were there with warm smiles. 
The inside area was like a rain forest...my daughter said it reminded her of the movie Avatar. The smell from the plants and the wonderful scent of vanilla incense just lured you right in...We were finally on vacation. 
We had a great champagne punch and a cool towel to revive us after our journey.
The staff couldn't of been nicer. We were able to book all of our dinner reservations right there, as well as any thing else that we needed or wanted. IT was all done with a smile, and I couldnt wait to settle in and start vacation. 
Corina Reyes was there mostly everyday,  when we arrived back from the pool or beach, she  asked  us if we wanted a cool drink (tequila Boom Boom), or if we just wanted a coffee and again, was more than happy to oblige . She made us feel like we were the only people in the Royal Service Area, and was willing to get us anything we might need. Corrina  was so pleasant and nice, it just made the vacation even that more special .
Every day was just relaxing and nice..much more than i ever expected 
We had breakfast at both Royal Service and the Buffet...
Both were good, although i thought sometimes the food was a little cold and could of been hotter.
The waiters there were also very attentive and came with coffee immediately upon sitting down .
At the pool, we met a wonderful man Octavio...He was by the Royal service pool bar and Restaurant. 
He was the highlight of the vacation...
Nothing was to small, or to big for him to get for us....Whether it was the fresh pico de galo ..the crispy tortilla chips, or the homemade Guacamole..it was wonderful. The lunches by the pool were always fresh and delicious . He always bought us cold drinks...and water if we needed it. I cannot say enough about him. 
The pool area where you picked up your towel in the morning had assorted SPF supplies for your use. Sergio and Juan Jose always had a smile on their face, and had either the beach chairs or the hut ready for our arrival. It  was the best service ever.
The restaurants were above standard for an all inclusive..the sushi restaurant was fresh and it was a beautiful atomosphere. 
The last night we went to Tempo Restaurant . It was great..the food presentation was out of this world. The chef came out and introduced himself. We did the wine tasting with the 8 coarse meal...well worth the additional money ..

reviews.author: roben l
reviews.title: Big, clean but poor service and food
reviews.text:
Stayed 2 weeks from jan. 23-feb. 6 and after day 3 I went to Walmart to buy king size pillows. They refused to give more than 1 towel at the pool.Mini-bar staff forgot to replace the coffee almost every day- bad training. Internet is almost too slow to send a picture attached to an email. The buffet is the same warm food every night, the specialty restaurants except for Vento were not good- seems like the same kitchen cooks all the food.We ordered steaks on 4 occasions and although they asked us how we would like it cooked it always came out well done- which i can deal with and its probably safer too.The wine offering would make you cringe if you really were at a 4 star hotel. For the most part the staff are friendly but very poorly trained.The problem is the management, they were also very hard to reach. i would not recommend this place to anyone, unless you get an awesome rate and don't mind a 650 room 3 star hotel. i will say that it is very clean and the spa is great.
Its a shame because we've stayed at their property in Cuba and it is really a 4.5 - 5 star property.

reviews.author: Wahoowa97
reviews.title: Nice beach, great food, descent hotel
reviews.text:
Just about right for a 4 star hotel. We (4 adults) spent 4 days/3 night at the hotel.  The rooms were nice, had a lagoon view. Clean, modern style, very comfortable beds. Check-in process was rather seamless, checkout process was rather slow mainly due to staffing.  We had a concierge assigned to us who assisted with dinner reservations at the resort restaurants and provided some good tips. We had the all-inclusive package which covered all meals and drinks at all the restaurants except for Tempo (one of the restaurants).  The food overall was great. Blue Agave served Mexican appetizers and was absolutely delicious.  Mole was the fancy Mexican restaurant and was also fantastic.  We typically had breakfast and lunch at the buffet place - Naos, which was average. Had a nice juice bar, omelette station, and salad bar.  Ventos was the Mediterranean tapas place and was average.   Bana was an Asian place and had your typical sushi and asian curries.  The margarati's and mixed drinks were awesome, not watered down and very tasty. The beach was awesome. The towel service was not very good, the first day we had difficulty getting beach towels until the mid-afternoon. There are sales peoples at the towel shop selling various excursions. We did a parasailing excursion which was about $55 a person and descent. They advertised 10-12 minutes of parasailing but we only were on for about 6-7minutes.  

In summary,  good accomodations, great food and drinks, very nice beach.

reviews.author: jammal28
reviews.title: Wonderful Winter Get-Away
reviews.text: Definitely enjoyed our stay at the Paradisus Cancun.  Restaurants were top notch and it was nice having the ocean so close to our room.  Everyone on the staff was very friendly and helpful.  Liked that the shows started at 8:30 PM.  They had great talent, especially Circus D'Sol, and lasted just the right amount of time. Ocean waves were fun and warm.  Thank you to Avril, our concierge, and a big hello and thank you to Benito Galicic, our favorite bartender at Bar ToJi - great guy!!!

reviews.author: Darlene T
reviews.title: Just What We Needed
reviews.text: My husband and I just spent two weeks at Paradisus Cancun with an all-inclusive package and we are already talking about our return trip.   We were looking for rest and relaxation and we found it here.  The food at the resort was amazing and we enjoyed the variety of options available to us.    We tried each restaurant and we were impressed with the selection and quality of the food.   Our favorites were Market Grill and Vento, although we enjoyed all the restaurants.   The Buffet offered a wide, always changing, selection of cheeses, fresh fruit, salads, hot entrees, fresh made items and desserts, all delicious.      The meal reservation system was simple to use and always ran smoothly.   It was nice to know a table was waiting for us at the restaurant of our choice and at the time we wanted to dine.   The service was exceptional in all of the restaurants, whether it was buffet or al-a-carte the servers were attentive and helpful.   The beach was beautiful and there were always plenty of places to lounge and relax.  The beach and pool service was also top notch and we never waited long for our order.  The resort was clean and well maintained.  Guest services was quick to react to our requests and we were extremely happy with all the services provided.  We would definitely recommend this resort to friends and family and hope to return ourselves.    As is often the case in vacation destination resorts, the “vacation club” selling tactics were there but subsided quite quickly after we expressed that we weren’t interested in their product.

reviews.author: Todd P
reviews.title: Great Beach - Average Hotel and Service
reviews.text:
Just spent 5 days at the Paridisus, formely Gran Melia.
Check in, concierge staff very slow and not responsive, booked a King bed in a Junior suite, we got two doubles, no attempt or apology was ever made to remedy.  Hotel room (3553),had delaminating mirrors and plumbing fixtures held in place by lots of white caulk. Dining was ok, quality was good, portion size extremely small, i.e. scallops were the size of a quarter, and only 1 per entree. Best meal in all 5 restaurants was the made to order breakfast on the deck/buffet.
Spend 20-30 nights per year on business per year.  Hotel nice, but expensive and lower quality service/food than I have experienced at the Westin or Marriotts.

reviews.author: stacey O
reviews.title: Can't wait to go BACK!
reviews.text: I LOVED this place!  Friendly staff, nice selection of dining options, great drinks, plenty of amenities.  I got a great deal the night before and was taken care of upon arrival.  They offer a tour of the property in hopes that you will buy and in exchange you get a 20 dollar massage.  Ask for Lucy!  At the buffet ask for Francisco and Antonio, they are the BEST!  They made a flamin’ coffee that was TO die FOR!  The lifeguards kept us all safe and the wait staff kept us happy with top shelf liquor which was nice considering I had the all-inclusive package.  The nightly shows in the main lounge were fascinating, I was happy to be there FAT Tuesday, that show was amazing!   Loved it, sad to be back in the cold... Clean beach, beautiful sand.... No real hot tub outside, I heard it was part of the pool.  The hot tub in the spa was killer....

reviews.author: Jason R
reviews.title: "Bana" Restaurant-Waitress/"Sandra"
reviews.text: I travel quite frequently, and I was uncertain about the latest choice of hotels for a very special trip for my wife, and I. It was the first time that we stayed at Paradisus in Cancun, and I will never stay anywhere else again. The service in the hotel itself was amazing. The rooms were spectacular, and most importantly are the staff at the restaurants onsite. We stopped into "Bana" one of the restaurants in the hotel, and I am certainly glad that we made this choice. We were taken care of by "Sandra". She was the most sweetest, hardworking, and genuine people that I have ever met. She was always anticipating our every need, and had great suggestions on what to choose from the overwhelming menu. The food was excellent, and I really think that my experience at "Bana" was so great was really because of "Sandra", and her service, great suggestions, and incredible hospitality. If you every visit Cancun, I highly recommend the "Bana" restaurant, and make sure that you ask for "Sandra".

reviews.author: Stefanie S
reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text: This place is Awesome! It has some really amazing views of both the ocean and the bay. The pool bar is more then you could ask for. We stayed in one of the lower rated rooms and it was beyond nice with amazing ocean view, marble floor, patio. Lots of restaurants to choose from and buffet. Room service was great, drinks got you drunk... they also have a club and several other bars. I dont know if it was the time of year we went or what but it seemed to have more of a 40+ crowd but we still had an amazing time... the water was clear as day... just beware of the timeshare !!! they try and suck you in and say its only 1 hour tour and they give you a discounted massage and free trip for 4 days 3 night but its NOT worth the time you could have spent at the pool.beach... I would def recommend this place ... quality was amazing...

reviews.author: Alejandro E
reviews.title: The Greatest Experience
reviews.text:
First of all, we ended up in the hotel by compensation of the Me by Melia Cancun Hotel, we had made reservations here 2 months prior to our visit but when we arrived, the hotel had been overbooked so we were offered a transfer to the Paradisus formerly Gran Melia.

Service is truly amazing, every employee in the hotel greets you with a smile and are always worried that your experience is the best during your stay. 
On the other hand, the building has its years now and it is evident on room furniture, room doors and other not more important stuff. 
The pool and beach areas are amazing but then again you must either have Family Concierge or Royal Service in order to take advantage of the bed huts, otherwise you cant even reserve them. We suggest you wake up veeery early, by 8:00 AM there were no places left on the pool side or even the beach.
Food was generally very good taking into account it is an all inclusive, breakfast was great at Naos Restaurant but lunch variety was not that good. Ranking from best to worst: 1. Blueagave 2. Market Grill 3. Bana 4. Naos 5. Fuego. Unfortunately we didn´t have the best experience at Fuego one night with one of the dishes, felt like the fish was old and rotten.  

The Yhi Spa, although it looks wonderful, the prices are extremely high, for a 50 minute massage they charged around 150 USD or so, we left without living the whole Yhi Spa experience unfortunately.

This was our first trip as a couple to Cancun and the general experience was wonderful and without a doubt we would recommend the Paradisus hotel for anyones stay.

reviews.author: Patomartel
reviews.title: Family concierge
reviews.text: We bougth a 5 night stay including family concierge and the service from them was perfect. They took great care of the kids and where realy friendly. Rooms ok , food too considering it's an all inclusive , good pool with private palapas , just tip anyone with $10 and they will take care of you as if you are a big shot. I would say it's a great value and we will come back for sure.

reviews.author: AMajer1
reviews.title: Tempo restaurant in Paradisus, Cancun
reviews.text:
Our dining experience was excellent, as was the service from our waiter, Webster.  He was very personable and professional.
The eight course dinner was interesting and tasty, served in a very relaxing atmosphere.
Thank you for making our evening special, Webster!

reviews.author: Keven C
reviews.title: One of the best Hotel
reviews.text:
Stayed there with 3 other friends.

Very nice hotel, but not much entertainment at night.  But it is good for stay with friends and have a quite time.

Food are great and the restaurants are excellent. The Mexican one is the best in my opinion.

Rooms are clean and room services are quick.

reviews.author: Steve C
reviews.title: Great Property
reviews.text: I thoroughly enjoyed my stay here.  The property is exquistely appointed and the staff is very friendly and attentive.  I especially enjoyed Victor, Webster and Yareli,  they were awesome servers in the Grill.

reviews.author: 11Nancy
reviews.title: Wonderful Vacation 2-9 Feb 2013
reviews.text: Had a very enjoyable and relaxing vacation. Beach and water were breathtaking.  We had the Royal Service and the staff and service were outstanding.  The hotel is elegant, serene and the lobbies are majestic and well cared for. Tempo restrauant was an upscale restaurant with attention to every detail. Waiters and chef were top notch. Each course was perfectly planned and beautifully served. This is a 5 star restaurant and was total enjoyment for the palate. Denisse, our waitress at the Avenue Lounge was wonderful. We can't say enough about Sergio our pool and towel attendant. He always had a smile on his face and is an asset to your staff. Our pool and beach waiters Gerardo and Octavio also did an outstanding job. They always were so accommodating.  Thanks to everyone for making this a wonderful vacation for our family.

reviews.author: Vickie R
reviews.title: Far beyond AMAZING getaway!!!
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus the week of January 26th to February 2nd for our annual ladies getaway and were blown away by our experience! The resort is gorgeous, clean, and the service highly exceeded my expectations. Book the royal service!! It is well worth the extra money! Upon arrival we were quickly greeted and introduced to our butlers Francisco and Erik who made sure we had everything we needed for for the week. They were so accomodating and friendly! We found a tequilla at Blue Aguave that we wanted to purchase to bring home but wasnt for sale on the resort so Fransico offered to purchase it for us on his day off and bring it in for us!! Every single employee that we encountered on the royal side was amazing and always greeted us with a smile and went out of their way to make our stay special!  Our favorite servers were Karina and Consuelo! They made our stay so much fun!

As for the restaurants your definitely not going to leave this resort hungry or thirsty for that matter.We enjoyed all of them but our favorites were Vento, Bana, and Tacos. Juan Carlos and Victor were our servers at Vento and they made the dining experience a BLAST! Probably the best service I've ever recieved anywhere!! Anotonio at Bana was fantastic also! Make sure to check out the blue aguave for tacos and tequilla tastings. We vacation quite often and my biggest complaint about a lot of the resorts is the food! Definitely not the case at the Paradisus!

The nightlife at the resort is great and fairly laid back. The Avenue Bar is a lot of fun and you can expect to meet a lot of fun people! Look for the server Danielle! She was so friendly, remembered our names from day one, and never left us thirsty! The Red Lounge is a little small but a good place for dancing! Make sure you find Gabriel and order a Mexican Baby Maker!! He was such a fun bartender and always made sure our drinks were full!! 

When we first booked this resort we were a little weary because it was in a transition period from the Grand Melia to Paradisus but were so happy with the experience. The only thing I would suggest is playing a little more latin/vacation music throughout the resort! Thank you for a wonderful vacation!! We will definitely return!!

Side note!! Tip the employees!!! Yes it is all-inclusive but the employees work very hard and deserve a little extra!!

reviews.author: Trucker13
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text:
Wife and I arrived back to the cold and snow of MN, last night, from our week at Paradisus Cancun.

After a slow check in, we went to the pool area, until our rooms were ready. Rooms were ready by 1pm, and we changed to our swimsuits, and headed back to the pool.

Met some nice people, and had a few cool ones before dinner. Good friendly bar staff, as well as the server staff. Service is the key for me, and it was outstanding there.

Chicken wings was my lunch choice most days at the pool, the hambugers were very good too, but the wings were excellent. The pool area is very busy, so the most IMPORTANT tip I can give is, get up early, like 6am and bring towels or books, and stake out the spot you want, because by 7am the choices (if you want some shade) will be limited. 6:45am Sunday the 10th, there were no shady spots left. If you pick your spot, and go to breakfast, no one will claim your place.

We took advantage of almost all the resturants, and the food was excellent, as was the service. The skewers of grilled meat at the Market Grill, were to die for, but the chicken was the best I've ever had. Love to know how they marinade it. Lots of choices at Naos for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Very well stocked buffet. The other restuarants were excellent as well, but make sure you have reservations, where needed.

The rooms were nice, and good sized, and our view of the lagoon was great. The beds left something to be desired, as I just couldn't sleep very well, but who needs sleep, you're on vacation. We were in the Main tower, numbered 3. Some had said there was music until 1-2am, but I didn't hear it, if there was. Most nights the noise died down by 8:30-9:00. The maid service was wonderful. No problems there.

The staff was friendly everywhere, and if you have questions, they willingly give you the answers you need. Want a cab? They order it for you. If they see you with your luggage, they rush to help you. As I said, service is the key for me, and here, it's excellent.

We had a water pipe break above our room in the hallway outside our door, but we didn't get much water in our room, and the maid service and others were there in seconds, to make sure our belongings were taken care of. The bottoms of our shoes in the closet got wet, and that's as far as any water went in our room. In other words, about 4 feet. Nothing else was wet. Great response to that event, which could easily happen anywhere.

I would not hesitate to return to the Paradisus Cancun. Wonderful experience, great food, great staff. Great beach. Simply a wonderful, if not blazing hot vacation. 

Well done Paradisus, very well done.

reviews.author: carolynjankiv
reviews.title: Fabulous !
reviews.text: Pay for the royal service...it's quiet but not too quiet and waited on hand and foot. They book everything for you, it's like you're a queen!  Sergio is amazing amazing amazing and sweet and so is Consuelo at the pool bar! No complaints except for music. Would prefer Spanish music instead of techno/slow/spa. We love everything about Cancun including their music. Beds around pool are awesome!

reviews.author: Dino1968
reviews.title: Excellent hotel
reviews.text: We arrived on February 7, 2013 at 7:30 pm. We were late we no fault to the hotel but the Air Canada plane was late coming from Toronto. As soon as we got out of the airport we were taken to the hotel within minutes. When we arrived we were greeted by the staff immediately. One person brought us cold towels and then the other staff escorted us to a quiet lounge to relax while we waited for our butler to take us for check in. I had heard about people bothering you for time share this was definitely not the case. We then were escorted to Pyramid 5 where we had a private check in. I had arranged for a upgrade to royal service with Mr. Sotomayor and Mrs Galena via e-mail. I have to say that Mr. Sotomayor went the extra mile to make sure I had what I wanted. Eric our butler has arranged for our Bali bed  for the week and Sergio has and goes the extra mile to make sure we are comfortable. I strongly suggest the upgrade to Royal service. We still have 4 days to go, but extremely happy up to now.

reviews.author: Jlitty
reviews.title: A fantastic little getaway!
reviews.text:
I was a little worried after reading some of the reviews prior, but we had a great experience. We upgraded to an ocean view room for about $25/night. Worth the upgrade. Although they placed us in the building all the way to the end where the time share owners stay-(tower1) and our room was dated and a little rough around the edges.The bed was very firm, but we got used to it. Great views of ocean. Lots of exercise hiking over to the building! It was nice to have the outdoor whirlpool, though. The rooms were clean, and the shower pressure good! even a little dining table, which was great for room service- which I highly recommend, especially for breakfast!
The pools were cool- so we never took a dip- a little bummed, because i wanted to sit in the water at the pool bar- but it is mostly shaded. The pool bar is nice though, and all the bartenders were great- especially Alexander (the great) at the beach bar. Fun hangout!
We did wish that there was an outdoor bar open in the evenings. Was our first experience with all inclusive- which was great not to have to worry about money... the food was pretty good. We arent buffet people, but always found things we enjoyed at the buffet. Great selection of fruit and veggies. We enjoyed the sushi restaurant. Also the funghi(?) restaurant was really yummy. Didnt care for the market grill, meat carnival...
Guacamole was fantastic...ask for things you dont see--- they buffet restaurant always made me cappuccinos when I asked.  Beach was nice. Location convenient to airport (maybe 20 minutes). The staff was plentiful and friendly. 
We met friends from home there who upgraded to royal service- we were glad we didnt- there wasnt much value in that to us. Their tower was more modern (tower5) and kid free.
We did the time share presentation(even though i said I would never!) and it was worth our 90 minutes to do that- ended up with a free massage and another at over half price (so 2 massages for $50!) Spa was very relaxing- and massages were fantastic.
Was a nice getaway, good value, nice resort.

reviews.author: Canadian99999
reviews.title: Housekeeping...not great
reviews.text:
We are writing this from our room in this resort.
The resort is well located and the grounds well maintained. Staff are fantastic.  We have been here 6 nights.
The rooms are very average size and well appointed.
Our ongoing problem has been with housekeeping.  The first time our room was cleaned was 54 hours after we checked in, and after 6 calls requesting service. Examples of what has not been cleaned .... We doubt if the table tops and glass door and windows have been cleaned within a month. The deck has had a beer can in the flower box and French fries on the floor since we arrived.  The coffee pot is never emptied or cleaned ... We do it ourselves. 
Aside from that, with the exception that there are probably 5 hotel guests for every poolside or beach lounge chair, not too bad of a stay.

reviews.author: Valeri W
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation experience
reviews.text: We just returned from 11 days at the Paradisus Cancun-formerly the Gran Melia Cancun. We were there from January 30th until February 9th. We were wondering how things would be with the changes and were very happy with them.  We have timeshare so check in was wonderful with Blanca Taboada.  She remembered us from last year and was very efficient, helpful and friendly.  It is so nice to see familiar faces when we come back.  Our room was ready for us when we checked in so we got right in-very much appreciated!  We never had issues with getting into the restaurants.  We always called the day before to get a reservation and had no issues.  We very much enjoyed the Vento Restaurant and The Market Grill-the food was always VERY good.  Jonathan and Emanel were our waiters at the Vento and they were AMAZING!!  They were so accomodating.  The Mayan coffee that Emanel made for us was really something and we highly recommend you try it.  Yarmin was our hostess when we went to Vento and she always managed to put us somewhere we really liked!  The Market Grill was a nice way to try different things.  We always managed to eat too much! We ate at Naos a couple of times and that was always good.  We also went to Mole and Blue Aquave.  We wanted to make sure we tried everything.  We preferred the Kuhna restaurant from last year to Mole from this year.  We just liked what they offered better.  The food was good, but we just preferred the old restaurant.   We especially like that the resort did not do away with the beach service.  Friends went to Cancun and stayed somewhere else and they had no beach servers.  It is nice not to have to run up and get food or drink but rather have it brought to you on the beach.  We really appreciate the fact that this resort has lifeguards who are very vigilant and always watching not only the water but also to make sure that non of the beach vendors hassle anyone.  It is another thing that seems to set this resort apart from others.  We watched the lifeguards go help a swimmer in trouble one day and they are very good and got the swimmer back in without issue.  Very reassuring since I am not a confident person in the water.  Our favorite from last year-Raul (He is now a waiter at Tempo) was there and remembered us-it is nice to feel like you are coming home when you come back!  Our maid was very good in that she had our room done early every day and it was always clean and well done.  The turn down service at night was nice also.  Having the mini bar be part of the all inclusive is really nice-that way if you want a bottle of water in the evening and you can just get that out of the fridge.  Overall we have nothing bad to say about the resort or our trip.  We very much like all that they do for their guests.  It makes the vacation experience a wonderful one.  We will DEFINITELY be back.  They are always trying to improve the resort and what they offer.

reviews.author: Janel548
reviews.title: Wonderful hotel...recommend the royal service.
reviews.text: Just got back last night and will go back to this hotel again. We upgraded to the royal service. You will get assigned a private butler who you can reach whenever via the cell phone they give you. With the royal service you are in tower 5 which has no kids and is very private. We were celebrating our wedding anniversary, the night of our anniversary our butler had champagne, candles and rose petals in our room. The butler will set up dinner reservations and your private cabana near the private pool or on the beach. We hung out in the cabanas each day...food and drinks when you want them. None of the food is ever real hot but it is good.

reviews.author: laliberte58
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun.... nice resort!!
reviews.text:
We arrived on January 24th for an early 30th wedding anniversary!!
Once the reservation desk realized that we had book Royal service, they asked that we wait to be taken to that section and it took a while... but once arrived at the private check in, the check in was fast! 
Room: make sure you bring with you the description of what you have booked because we were told that they were giving us an upgrade but once in the room, it was exactly what we had paid for. Other people that had arrived prior to us had problems with that and had to go through a lot of hassle to get the room they had paid for. 

Francisco, the butler, showed us our room and gave us a cellular phone so that we could reach him at all time...very nice man and A1 for the service he gave us. With that cell phone he can arrange for you the restaurants reservations and reserve a bally bed at the private pool, which is very nice. The service for the bar and the restaurant at the private pool is top notch!! 
Room tip: Get a sea view, it's spectacular and worth every penny,

Restaurants: the decor at every restaurant and bar of this resort is incredible and the food is very good. The only problem is that you rarely get HOT food!! Our big disappointment was the buffet. There is only one and the food is always the same, not very tasty and again, lukewarm. An improvement is needed there.

The rest of the resort is beautiful and clean but avoid the golf course!! There are no numbers on the tee offs and on the flags, you never know where to go from one tee off to the other, no bench to sit on and no water anywere. It's as if it's not ready to be played on... but we had to pay 65 $ anyway, even though we complained about that. Also, the boutiques in the hotel do not accept american dollars. You can only pay with pesos so beware of that.

reviews.author: Jenny M
reviews.title: Paradise at the Paradisus
reviews.text:
Our yearly getaway of 4 close friends that live far away from each other was spent at the Paradisus Cancun. We stayed on the royal service side (which a highly recommend) and were blown away by the service we received.We stayed here from Jan 26th to Feb 2nd.. and if I knew how great it would be I would have booked a longer stay! It began with check in with Aidee who was extremely friendly and welcoming. We were then introduced to our butler(s) for the week.... Erik and Fransceso... who were amazing. They gave us cell phones to call them for anything we needed... they literally got us anything we needed and even found us on the beach to make sure that we had dinner reservations for that evening. I thank the two of them for making our stay extra special.

The beach was gorgeous, a little windy the week we were there but felt great on the hot days! Our servers for the beach/pool and "happy hour" in the royal service were Consuela and Karina. I want to give them a special thank you for their service...outstanding! They were sooo sweet and never let our drinks run dry! 

Now for the food, awesome!! Vento and Bana were our favorites! I want to thank Marcos and Victor from Vento and Antonio from Bana for their superb service. (We liked Bana so much we ate there twice..try the curry beef or chicken yum). Tacos were good but the tequila was even better. Moles was good too. La Palapa was great for lunch... try the spring rolls and chicken nachos. Our server there was Fransceso (I think) and he did an awesome job. Everyone always had smiles on there faces and were constantly asking if we needed anything!

Our rooms were nice... Erik even brought us aromatherapy pillows one night.. so nice! We got the lagoon view but I would recommend the ocean view. 

The Avenue bar was a great place to hang out and meet people at night.. the bartenders were so friendly but Danielle the server from the Ave bar was amazing. She was so nice and was always asking if we needed anything! Gabriel from the Red Lounge was so much fun and is an awesome bartender! Thank you for the mexican baby maker shots...delicious..lol. 

I hope I am not forgetting anyone... everyone of the staff was amazing. I would go back in a heart beat!

reviews.author: Traveler791
reviews.title: Highly recommend Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: We had an excellent 10 day stay at Paradisus 1/26-2/5/2013.  The staff are helpful and universally friendly.  The waiters/waitresses in all of the restuarants were well-trained, efficient and friendly.  At the Market Grill in particular, a tag-team of waiters Raymondo and Elberto, and another night Victor and Bernardino, give us especially good service.

reviews.author: James D
reviews.title: They do it right
reviews.text: The staff greatly impressed me and my wife on our week long stay at the Melia.  The service was great and the staff very pleasant and helpful.  The room with the ocean view was extraordinary as well as the general condition of the hotel.  One main reason our stay was exceptional was the greeting, professionalism and pleasant demeanor displayed by the receptionist at the vacation club reception desk, Betsy Ornelas.  She made sure our stay was problem free and always responded to any type of service request we made.  Thank you to Betsy and expect our return next year.

reviews.author: Yves L
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun: nice resort!!
reviews.text:
We stayed at Paradisus Cancun the last week of January 2013.
We stayed in the adult only Royal Service Pyramid. The private check in is made directly in that section for people who booked Royal Service, so you have to wait for somebody to bring you there. At the check in, the person told us that we were given an upgrade for the room... but the room was exactly what we had paid for...luxury junior suite with an ocean view and... what a view !! Wow...directly in front of the ocean.The butler, Francisco, showed us our room, explained the amenities and was very helpfull.

The royal service section is private and very calm. Beautifull bally beds and the staff is very present to see to your every need. However, if you want action, you have to go to the other pools and in the main pyramid for the bars and restaurants.The à la carte restaurants are beautifull and the food and service are excellent!! 

Our main complaint about this resort is the main buffet which is the only one available : always the same food... not very tasty. An improvement is needed there to offer more variety.

reviews.author: Portocigar
reviews.title: The best ever !!!!!
reviews.text: I would like to let know my appreciation about this hotel and  particulary  the restaurant Bana for theirs  sushis. Everything was excellent and the service is very professionnal. Our maître d'hôtel was Antonio Ortiz who  made a great job. Everything was just perfect and we have had a great time  at the Bana Restaurant. I recommand this restaurant to everyone !!!!!

reviews.author: nsw43
reviews.title: Anniversary vacation
reviews.text: Wow!! It was a very nice vacation,we stayed on the Royal Side and had a oean veiw suite.The checkin was very quick and our bulter Eric came to the main lobby of the hotel to picked us up.From there we went to the Royal side checkin,which was very quick.We were took to our room where we were given chocolate covered strawberries and a bottle of champion.Our bulter eric was there to help us with what ever we needed,it was wonderful.The staff in the royal side I found wonderful,they were all great,from the pool boys,servers,bartenters and our maid.The reservations to the La Carts were easly done though the front desk of the royal part or Eric.We enjoyed the food at all resturants and the red wine was excellent.Royal side is worth the extra ,I would go back to this resort tomorrow if I could.The scenery of the resort is beautiful,and the beach is has well.The royal side do provide suntan lotion.They serve your lunch right to you if you wish,they have a menus for you to chose from at the poolside bar.The food ther is wonderful,.Our favorite lunch was there burger and fries.They do a great job keeping you happy ,they ask you 100 times a day if eveything is to your liking or if you would like something.We were given eveything that we asked for ,we have travelled now twice a year for 11 years to resorts in Mexico ,Cuba and both sides of the Dominican.We have always stayed at 4 and 5 star resorts.Believe me when I say this one is a 5 star for sure.I can speak for the other side of the resort also,the resturants are over there and they are all top!! The food and service was great.The night clubs were very nice ,great service and the alcohol was wonderful.We did see a few shows that was held in the Avenue bar,which were good.Im not a big fan of the shows .but they were up to standard.Has for the pool you have to book your beds though the pool boy who will lay out your towelsand make the beds.We had no trouble getting a bed for the week.If you want to do any shopping of the resort PLEASE take in the La Isla mall it is 7-8 mins from the resort by taxi .It cost $10 each way,there is coach,Tommy,Guess and also their souvier stores.It was great ,these stores do take Visa.The trip to and from the Airport is about 15 mins.I really dont think you would be disappointed here .We are of to Cuba in April ,but I would go back here has soon has I can.Loved evey minute!!!

reviews.author: John A
reviews.title: John A Help from staff
reviews.text: I had a booking problem on arrival at the hotel and things were going down hill. Lourdes and Lizeth of the Royal Service step in to help. They took a bad experience and turn into one of the best vacations that I have had in years. I will be going back because of the treatment that I received from the staff of the Royal Service at this hotel.

reviews.author: Peggy
reviews.title: Had a great time at the Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
We stayed from Jan 27 to Feb 2.  A GREAT vacation!!!
The hotel staff could not do enough...from the housekeepers to the maintenance staff. Not one person ever passed me without putting their hand over their heart and greeting me.
That is the warmest and most kind act of excellent customer service I have ever witnessed!!!!
The food was excellent and had a great variety. Favorite restaurant was Fuego which was Spanish Fusion.
The daily breakfast buffett was a wonderful source of nutrition and interesting offerings for such a diverse group.
Ernesto and his group at the Friendship Bar were outstanding. These men provided excellent customer service, and should be commended for their great teamwork and welcoming nature.
I experienced one negative act from a waiter (outside buffett) on the day of departure. We had an early breakfast and had our bags packed and ready to depart. Since we had several hours to wait for our transportation to the airport, we decided to go to return to the outside tables, for a cup of coffee. When I asked Manuel if we could sit at a table in his area he replied,  "weren't you over there earlier this morning?" 
I was embarrased by this unkind and unecessary comment. I think Manuel would beneft from some additional customer service training. 
While I would not want anyone to lose their job, this was the only person whom I felt was not in sinc with the hotel's mission of excellence.
I would recommend the Paradisus Cancun to everyone!

reviews.author: William H
reviews.title: Don't bother
reviews.text: It is a 3 star hotel and that's it. We are 10 days into 14 and are almost anxious to get back to Canada. The staff are horribly under trained. This place is too big there are too many deficiencies to post. Frankly ill be surprised if the internet here is even fast enough to send this review. We drove to Playa do Carmen and are a bit sad we didn't stay there, try the Aldea Thai hotel.

reviews.author: Jaqueline R
reviews.title: Cielos
reviews.text: Was able to dine at Cielos Mexican inspired restaurant. Our server was Moises and he was amazing! Prompt and great service. The rest of the Trip was one to remember and we WILL be returning. I am looking forward to visiting again. I recommend getting the reserve option if you can it was worth it.

reviews.author: Desiree M
reviews.title: Arce made the difference.
reviews.text: Excellent experience. Great for large families. Food was excellent at all restaurants but the food and service at Lemonfish stood out from them all. Arce , our waiter did an excellent job of taking care of our large family. Will dine here again soon.

reviews.author: katy R
reviews.title: The Kids Club employees were very friendly and professional. Overall, our stay at the hotel was fantastic.
reviews.text: We had an amazing experience at the Paradisus hotel in Cancun, Mexico. The staff was excellent and the facilities were always clean and well maintained, but what really stood out was the Kids Club. Our children greatly enjoyed the activities and games organized by the team. From crafts to beach outings, everything was perfectly planned to keep the little ones entertained and happy.

reviews.author: Kathy L
reviews.title: Traveler Beware of Paradisus Candun
reviews.text: My only bad review: 9/2024 Paradisus trip 2nd after excellent 2018 stay. I highly recommended our group’s Paradisus stay due to 2018 experience but was very embarrassed with 2024 experience because it suffered greatly by comparison. We stayed in 3rd pyramid. Loud 1st floor bar music nightly until 11 pm entertained less than 20-30 occupants but music permeated through pyramid disturbing all that wanted romantic evening or to get offspring to sleep. VERY BAD Paradisus planning. We told Expedia check in staff we didn’t want to be disturbed by noise everyone complained about in Expedia reviews & were assured that our rooms wouldn’t be impacted which was a complete Expedia check in staff FALSEHOOD & MISREPRESENTATION. We endured EVERY night with great displeasure–it was too inconvenient to pack up & move all parties to different rooms. We were isolated in resort 1 day due to rain & watched it pour from ceilings all day. Unenthusiastic staff squeegeed slowly all water that fell & was sometimes 2” deep onto travertine tile–a hazard to all. Mold comes with water & great health hazard to all. Malva buffet food was cold & often unidentifiable concoctions so we would eat elsewhere. All resort restaurants serve breads & pastries that are delivered & frozen until served only to taste like cardboard. Most food would be uneaten due to lack of quality–horrible waste of resources. Waitstaff accommodating for tips but food, rainwater and noise at Paradisus VERY disappointing.

reviews.author: ddswong
reviews.title: Always a Great Visit
reviews.text:
I have been going to the Paradisus Cancun for over 20 years( even when this hotel was called the Gran Melia) and our October 2023 trip was my 3rd time this year!!! I am scheduled to returno n February 16, 2024 and I am an extensive traveller with my family. This year alone, I have been on 7 vacations and I plan at least 2 more visits to Paradisus Cancun beyond my Feb trip.
The reason that I always return to this wonderful hotel is not only the great location, the amazing food or the contemporary and traditional decor, but rather the wonderful staff that I have come to know. Every time I return there, we get treated like family. Many of the staff remember us from our frequent visits and the Paradisus Cancun has by far the best staff that I have ever seen of any hotel that I have been to.
A worthy mention to the following amazing people who make our stays memorable :
Poolside- Joel and Moises at the Reserve really go the extra mile to take care of us. We couldnt ask for better service. These two should be taken aside and commended for their outstanding service. As well, Ruben, Oscar, Valeria are absolutely fantastic to us. At the Yha spa, Freddy and Julian are the absolute best to us. Julian always is attentive and so pleasant to us every time we go there. He is wonderful to take care of every single detail and he makes the spa so enjoyable.
At Aqua Marina restaurant, Carlos and Armando are phenomenal. Top class service. As well, Jesus, Christine and Francisco made my wife feel amazing at our dinner at Aqua Marina when we celebrated her birthday.
Sal restauarant is always our favorite. Our last waiter was Juan who was absolutely so warm and welcoming. He made our meal so enjoyable that we went back the following night. Another time, Yostin took care of us and gave us superlative service.
My wife loves the Italian restaurant and Gerardo and Xavier really took care of all her there. First class all the way. And finally, Nury was our last courtesy maid....unbelieble service. She made our room extra special, especially when we celebrated our anniversary there.  Diego as the head of food services always welcomes us with big smiles and amazing service. Best wishes to you, Sir.
Lastly, but definitely not lease- a special thank you to Galdino for being our wonderful Resrve Butler. We ALWAYS request him as he takes our vacations over the top. Wouldnt have it any other way.

As you can see, I dont think that you will find anyone who visits the Paradisus Cancun more than my family. We are looking forward to our February 2024 trip. I strongly recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a wonderful vacation with top notch service. Many thanks from the Wong Family from Toronto, Canada.

reviews.author: susant123787
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun was Paradise?
reviews.text: You never know what to expect when you try a new resort.  Being a frequent traveler, I can tell you this resort did not disappoint. The all-inclusive fee was one of the lowest I've seen, so I was skeptical, but OMG all 8 restaurants had tremendous selections that were just mouthwatering.  The liquor served was all name brand and poured with a heavy hand.  Did I mention the Gelato Bar and Personal pan pizza/Calzone restaurant poolside?  Pool service, providing food and drinks, around the huge pools was amazing.  There was also a 24-hour coffee bar with tasty pastries/sandwiches and a sports bar.  Nightly entertainment and daily craft activities added to the fun.  Our suite was huge with a bedroom, 2 full bathrooms, kitchen, living room, and 3 balconies (one with a jacuzzi).  The mini bar was stocked daily with beer, soda, water and snacks that could be tailored to your preferences.  I could go on and on, but I will conclude with saying the staff is a real gem of this resort.  They all treat everyone like royalty.  Ramiro, one of the breakfast buffet waiters actually carried our plates of food to our table, pulled out our chairs, and kept the mimosas coming.  Ignacio also one of our breakfast buffet waiters was always very cordial and helpful.  Some of the poolside waiters that took good care of us were Laura, Irinia and Asuncion.  Karina at the Ginger bar was most accommodating.  Shame on me that I didn't get more names, as I said everyone was just great!

reviews.author: LordEthan
reviews.title: UK Review - Important points for British travellers with ALLERGENS
reviews.text:
This review is primarily for British/UK travellers as we have different needs/wants when travelling abroad. 

To start you’re welcomed with tequila shot and asked if you’re celebrating anything. If you are they’ll offer a voucher book for massages and food options for things outside of the package you’ve already paid for. The catch is that the next morning before you’ve seen the hotel or experience the hotel in any depth you have to sit through a timeshare presentation. I won’t bore you with the details but it’s a 20 year commitment costing about 40k for a one week holiday once a year. Whether or not you think it’s worth your time to sit through this, the timing was horrible as not only are you jet lagged, they’re asking for a deposit of 3-5k immediately and then a monthly payment of about £200-500. That is insane. 

The hotel itself is fine, there’s an option to get the ‘reserve’ package which upgrades your room and allows you to another part of the pool area and one or two other restaurants. It costs about $50 USD per night extra and to be honest it’s absolutely not worth it unless the hotel is super busy which it wasn’t when we went. 

THE FOOD. 

The hotel has a good number of decent restaurants to choose from. It also has a buffet and this is where the experience really is disappointing. The breakfast and lunch food is either lukewarm or cold. It is never hot. It was always lukewarm or cold. Even the fried foods were cold. Like not even remotely warm to the touch. 

Also you’re asked if you have any allergies. One of us had a nut allergy and although we told the staff that we had a nut allergy, on SEVERAL occasions we were brought food with almonds or pistachios and had to send it back so I cannot recommend this place if you have a severe food allergy. It’s simply not safe. The food is not labeled correctly and the staff don’t understand that a nut allergy means all nuts can be dangerous. 

If you can get over the constant upselling (I respect the hustle) it’s a decent hotel but they make you feel a little bit ‘less than’ sometimes.

reviews.author: John S
reviews.title: AVOID!
reviews.text:
Arrived back from a 10 night stay at Paradisus Cancun. The hotel itself is beautiful, however do not be fooled by the grand lobby that greats you on arrival.

We checked in around 9pm with my wife and two children, and were assigned a room in Pyramid 3 on the 3rd Floor. We had booked a Junior Suite - Luxury Ocean View and while the Ocean view was stunning, the room was far from Luxury. The sliding door was broken and hard to open, the furniture was broken, numerous areas of the bathroom just in general disrepair and the sink blocked with small bugs which flowed out and sat in the basin after use. We attempted to sleep however the noise was horrendous from the entertainment which went on to 11pm.

At 5am the next morning I went to reception to request a room change, I was told this was possible but not until 4pm. I advised that there were live bugs in my sink and that I didn't want my family to have to wash in it, I was asked to wait and was then offered a temporary room until our new room was available. The temporary room was lovely.

At 4pm we collected the key for our new room, and it was much better than the first although given the claim that this was a Junior Suite - Luxury Ocean View, it didn't have tea or coffee making facilities which is a basic even in a Premier Inn! I requested a kettle which was delivered, I think requested tea and coffee and was provided with some tea bags and 4 Nespresso pods?! I explained I couldn't use those and asked if a Nespresso machine was being delivered but was met with a blank response.

If you chose an Ocean View Room be prepared to not get any sleep until 11pm, as the evening entertainment alternates between the inside bar and the terrace outside next to the beach, you cant get away from it!

The food was ok, but basically the same every day, apart from one station which changed. My wife witnessed bugs crawling through the food so didnt eat the whole of the holiday. The pizzas were very good which can be ordered outside near the pool.

The pool itself is dirty, our daughter ended up with an ear infection and my wife and I both had blocked ears after a few days.

There is very little entertainment for children, both in the day and evening.

The entire hotel is getting a bit weary, just needs a makeover as parts of it are literally falling down!

On a positive, the staff are amazing and so friendly! Could not fault any one of them! They work tirelessly and always have a smile on their face.

The beach is beautiful.

All in all, I wouldnt recommend staying here, it was a big disappointment after looking forward to it for so long, spending a lot of money and enduring a long flight.

AVOID!

reviews.author: Janet D
reviews.title: Unless you’re a Meliá Member, don’t recommend
reviews.text:
I booked a last minute trip for Labor Day weekend and I would not recommend this place unless you get it at a super cheap rate or you have the top tier Meliá status.

As a regular paying customer, you will not get any special treatment. They even convinced me of paying an extra $400 to get the “family concierge treatment” so we went for it. We arrived at 11am and the lady assisting us didn’t really engage or seem happy or communicate much but she told us that they would text me when my room was ready. We waited and waited and went back around 1pm and then she told us that it wouldn’t be ready until 3pm and that the family concierge would notify us when the room was ready. 

The family concierge reached out to us around 3pm and asked how we were doing. I said we were waiting for our room and she said that the room was actually already ready. She also asked us to meet her to go over the itinerary. I said we were at the pool/beach and it would take us about 30 minutes to get there. We got there and she had left already. She then messaged me to come back down so I did. She really didn’t do much except call to make a few reservation which we could have done for minimal effort. Nothing worth an extra $400. She said she would send something up for my birthday but nothing came. She said she would set us up for a Bali bed and nothing, I had to reach out to her on our last day to see and she said I had to go on the waitlist. On the last day, we were supposed to meet downstairs to get our transportation and she promised our baggage would be picked up and it never was. They said they didn’t have it on the list. They ended up coming late and when we went down they told us to check out before we went to the transportation. The people at guest services took their time even though there was no one else there. They didn’t even say hello when we walked in. I waited and starred at them for a few minutes. By the time I checked out I went to the transportation and they said it left and it was a no show. The transportation company said it’s the hotels fault. The hotel family concierge said there was nothing they could do. So we ended up having to pay another $70 for a taxi.

We ended up doing the Melia circle presentation which honestly sounds like a good deal but based on my stay I wouldn’t want to go back. They basically tell you that if you’re a member, you would get the room as soon as you arrive, you would get the best treatment.  Which makes me feel like, I paid to be here and to have an all inclusive trip but because I didn’t buy in to their program, I do not get the best service. I have stayed at the Fiesta Americana and even paid less there but they gave us the best accommodations just for being their guest without having to sign up for anything. 

Lobby, pool and beach: 10/10

Food: 5/10 - the buffet is not great. The restaurants are 50/50. 

Alcohol: they did not have the best selection and even when I asked for recommendations they just said “we have everything” but really they don’t unless you pay extra

Rooms: 4/10. Apparently we got the upgraded suite but the rooms look outdated, shower smelled, paint was peeling, beds and pillows were hard and uncomfortable. 

Service: 2/10. There is a huge lack of communication and again, unless you have their “white wrist band” which we were even told in the presentation that they would put it on us so we could see how it feels to be treated better, you don’t get any special service and I don’t know if it’s because it’s off season but the workers don’t acknowledge you and are just on their phones and don’t seem to want to be there.

reviews.title: TERRIBLE SERVICE AND ATTITUDE OF THE STAFF
reviews.text:
Hello, good afternoon,

I wanted to share my experience and the truth is that it was not good at all:

- Attitude of the waiters and concierge is very bad.
- They received a large group and it couldn't be that they didn't prepare with enough supplies, in all the consumption centers they didn't have what they offered on the menu, if we asked for certain dishes their response was "oh no, we don't have that one" until They said they didn't have water of the day.
- In the bar on the 1st floor we requested a snack (peanuts, since most bars offer them and being an all-inclusive hotel we assumed they had them)
and the response from the waiters and bartenders was "oh no, we don't handle peanuts here, sometimes we take the leftover snack from a quarter of the ones they put in the rooms) what answer is that?"
Minutes later when we tipped $100 pesos, they were able to get a snack and brought it to us.
- There is no good communication between the staff, they gave us the wrong timetables at the consumption centers, they said that the last sitting was 10:30 and once you arrived at the restaurant they told you no, it was 10:00 pm

I don't know if the employees don't feel motivated by their bosses but if I ask them to improve the service, I was quite surprised by the negative attitude of the staff being a hotel in Cancun.

reviews.author: Vera R
reviews.title: Amazing Stay At Paradisus 5⭐️
reviews.text:
🇬🇧 English and Spanish Review 🇪🇸

🇬🇧
We had the opportunity to spend 7 nights at Paradisus Cancun from September 6, 2023 (Wednesday) to September 13, 2023 (Wednesday).

We also chose The Reserve option. It was our first time as a couple at an All-Inclusive Resort, and we can definitely say we had the most amazing time here.

We're not sure if September is a slower season in Cancun, but the hotel wasn't fully booked, which was awesome for us. The beach was almost empty, and it was very easy to book a beach bed next to the pool.

❌ Cons:
* Some restaurants were inconsistent in terms of flavor. Some days they were great, and others not so much. We mostly dined at the buffet restaurant, and the food was always great there.
* The ATMs at the hotel didn't work, which made us walk 30 minutes to the Kukulkan Mall to withdraw money (We took the bus for the other times, $12 mxn for each person, you can take any bus). The peso ATM didn't work from Thursday, September 7, until the end of our stay. The dollar ATM didn't accept our card.

✅ Pros:
* The Reserve room had a lot of amenities, and the minibar was restocked every day.
* The bed was very spacious and comfortable.
* High-speed internet was available.
* The beach had minimal sargassum. A worker removed it every morning with a tractor.
* There were many different restaurants with delicious food and plenty of sweets 🍬.
* Events and various nightly activities happened every day.
* The biggest pro: everyone was extremely nice, friendly, and helpful.
*There was a bus stop right in front of the hotel.
* Drinks and food were readily available at the pool or on the beach loungers.
* We received special pampering during our stay, including tequila, sweets, and champagne on some days 🥰🤗🤗.
* The room was thoroughly cleaned, and we always had fresh towels for our bathrooms. The cleaning staff even put away some of our stuff. Thank you so much.
* We had a visit to a cenote with a Yoga class included in The Reserve stay, and we loved it.
* We had an included dining experience on Sal Restaurant, very good meat and staff. Our favorite restaurant for sure.
* You can stay at the hotel until the transfer arrives, even if it's after the checkout time.

⭐️ Biggest Pros:
Our Reserve concierge was Violeta, and she was an angel to us. We couldn't have asked for better support. When we asked to switch the beers to water in the minibar, it was done immediately. Having trouble with warm water? Don't worry; Violet fixed it. Everything we asked for was handled with care and speed. We don't know how she does it, but our stay was incredibly improved because of her. Thank you so much, Violeta 🤗. We hope to come back or at least try the different Meliás in 🇲🇽.

🌮 ⭐️ Restaurant Pros:

We had the opportunity to spend 7 nights at Paradisus Cancun from September 6, 2023 (Wednesday) to September 13, 2023 (Wednesday).

We also opted for The Reserve option. It was our first time as a couple coming to an all-inclusive resort, and we can definitely say we had the most amazing time here.

We're not sure if September is a quieter season in Cancun, but the hotel wasn't completely full, which was great for us. The beach was almost empty and it was very easy to reserve a beach bed by the pool.

❌ Cons:
*Some restaurants were inconsistent in taste. Some days were great, and others not so much. We mostly ate at the buffet restaurant, and the food was always excellent there.
* The hotel's ATMs were not working, forcing us to walk 30 minutes to the Kukulkan shopping center to withdraw money (we took the bus on other occasions, $12 mxn per person, you can take any bus). The peso ATM did not work from Thursday, September 7 until the end of our stay. The dollar ATM did not accept our card.

✅ Pros:
*The Reserve room had many amenities, and the minibar was replenished daily.
*The bed was very spacious and comfortable.
*High speed internet was available.
* The beach had little sargassum. A worker removed it every morning with a tractor.
*There were many different restaurants with delicious food and lots of sweets 🍬.
*Events and various night activities were held every day.
* Biggest plus point: everyone was extremely nice, friendly and helpful.
*There was a bus stop right in front of the hotel.
* Drinks and food were available at the pool or on the beach loungers.
* We received special attention during our stay, including tequila, sweets and champagne on some days 🥰🤗🤗.
*The room was cleaned thoroughly and we always had fresh towels for bathing. Even the cleaning staff kept some of our things. Thank you so much.
*We had a cenote visit with a yoga class included in The Reserve stay, and we loved it.
*We had a dining experience included at the Sal restaurant, with very good meat and excellent staff. Our favorite restaurant, without a doubt.
* You can stay at the hotel until the transfer arrives, even if it is after departure time.

⭐️ The biggest pros:
Our concierge at The Reserve was Violeta, and she was an angel to us. We couldn't have asked for better support. When we asked to change the beers to water in the minibar, it was done immediately. Problems with hot water? Don't worry, Violeta fixed it. Everything we ordered was handled with care and speed. We don't know how she does it, but our stay was incredibly improved thanks to her. Thank you very much, Violeta 🤗. We hope to return or at least try the different Meliás in 🇲🇽.

🌮 ⭐️ The pros of restaurants:
*One of the best interactions we had here was with waiter Daniel Danzú at Lemon Fish (sushi restaurant in the center of Pyramid 3). He was so helpful and made many good suggestions. We tried different drinks and foods that we wouldn't have tried if he hadn't suggested them. Thank you very much, Daniel; you are amazing! 👏

We think the stay was amazing. The hotel is great, and we had an amazing time. We truly believe that our experience was greatly improved by the people who work tirelessly at this hotel. reviews.author: Omkar N
reviews.title: Go, Go, Go - Excellent Family-friendly Destination!
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun is an excellent all-inclusive resort.  We visited in September 2023 with our kids and couldn't have asked for a better vacation.  The beach, pool, and premises are very clean and well maintained.  Though the building is a few years old, everything was clean and fresh smelling.  Food quality was impeccable and the buffet restaurant offered numerous menu choices - a great option with kids.  The entertainment staff, especially Ariel went above and beyond to make everyone feel included and entertained.  Kidsdom offered a variety of kids activities and childcare options.  Overall, highly recommend this destination for a quality vacation!

The only downside was the sales pitch to sell Circle by Melia membership.  If you're not considering it, please decline the sales meeting upfront and have more fun in the water!
