reviews.author: Ana G
reviews.title: I would take away a star
reviews.text:
They made me wait a long time before giving me my PREMIUM SUITE with a view of the Lagoon. The photo I attached corresponds to the view I had… view of the Lagoon? Only it was one floor below the reception… my eyes then went to the parking lot. I ask for a room change and they give me an ocean view room (not a premium suite) that was under maintenance (they said it was the only one available). They charged me almost 5,000 pesos more for three days. In total 26,000 pesos for three days. The sea view room should have continued maintenance and attached photos to support my words.
A hotel of that category and that price cannot afford to accommodate its clients in rooms like that. Not to mention the treatment of the receptionists who treat you as if they were doing you a favor. They lack a customer service course.
The rest of the staff excellent. Especially the waiters from all areas. I congratulate them for their always kind treatment.

reviews.author: Victor T
reviews.title: The staff makes you feel valued providing friendly and great service…
reviews.text: I found the service great by friendly and professional staff with a few standouts: Gaby (sports bar), Orlando, Luis & Leonardo (pool bar), Alejandro (Nespresso) and Ramiro, Alberto, Manuel, Rafa, Pascual, Julio & Arturo (Malva restaurant ).. All resorts have the same beach and weather but what makes a difference is the great service… Gracias!!

reviews.author: JaneLotriet
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus
reviews.text:
We came from the UK as a family of 4 to stay for 14 nights. Paid for an upgrade to Nikte at check in - we wanted the ocean views and the renovated room. We had no problems with our room - good AC, clean, well stocked mini bar. 

Pros: For the most part this is a beautiful resort. Being there for 2 weeks meant we really got to explore the resort and meet a lot of the staff and some (below) went over above to make us feel welcome. It really was service with a smile and a touch to the heart, and we will definitely be back. 
The gym is adequate and oftentimes we were the only people in there. 
Great pool facilities although it is quite deep. There is a kids pool at one end where they hold a foam party and some pool games for the kids. In the main pool there were games and often an inflatable assault course. There was always entertainment, even on rainy days, none of us could say we were bored at all. 
Because of the time of year we were so lucky to see both baby and mama turtles on the beach. That was a magical experience and the hotel do a lot, it seems, to lessen the impact on their environment. No straws, no disposable cups, no plastic cutlery. We noticed this and commend them. 

Cons: sometimes the food felt like it could have been served hotter. We experienced this in the buffet (Malva) and at the Aqua Marina. 
The music at the main pool - sometimes it was so SO loud you had to shout at each other to be heard. I’m all for music at the pool and enjoy the party vibe but it was taken to the extreme sometimes with huge speakers set up at the DJ booth and I know other guests commented on this too. 
The gift shop is SO expensive and more than once we were met by unhelpful staff. We avoided it in the end. 

The staff who deserve recognition for looking after our family especially my 2 children (aged 8 and 6) are:

At the main pool, seek out Didier, Rodrigo and our number 1 man Sergio Cano. They cannot do enough for you, are on the go all day in the heat and rain, and were always happy to see us and do whatever they could to make our holiday marvellous. Sergio - you made our holiday. Thank you. 

Lemon Fish - gold star to Miguel. He made my kids so welcome and recommended to us the tastiest pudding we had all trip. 

Sals - Leonardo was a fantastic, knowledgable host who again gave some pro tips on what to order for our best experience. 

Malva/Lunchbox - Richer. No matter what time of day, what the weather was doing, how busy he was, he looked after us and made us feel so welcome. 

Blue Agave and Cielo - we were lucky to have Moises in both places. What a charming, polite and happy man! Look for him, and you will be in good hands. 

Concierge - even though he wasn’t our dedicated concierge, Oscar helped us a number of times and always had a fun story to share. Thanks Oscar!

Lastly the kids club. Both my children liked going here, it seemed to have a bit more structure than other kids clubs we’ve used and they were all great. Thanks Tessa, Bruno, Rubi, Ivana, Ivon and Itzel. 

Cancun 2023 - you were a blast!

reviews.author: Juliana P
reviews.title: Delighted to be here.
reviews.text: Too happy to be here. Everyone's attention has been excellent 😊 from the reception with the BellBoys, at the check-in register and in each of the restaurants, especially Mr. Gerardo who served us at the buffet and likewise at blueagave the boys Santos and Ahmed .

reviews.author: irwin j
reviews.title: MCV at Paradisus - Wonderful facility, great waiters
reviews.text: This location in Cancun is not only beautiful (go on the beach at sunrise for a truly remarkable experience and great photo opps!), but way more than you would expect for an all-inclusive "timeshare" type resort.  The rooms facing the ocean are spectacular, spacious with balconies and comfortable.  (Pillows in Mexico are not as plush as in the US, but the bed was comfortable.)  The waiters and drink servers -- in the restaurants and on the beach -- were amazing, friendly, responsive, and fun.  Everyone is relaxed and engaged.  The food in the buffet of all places is the best!   The individual restaurants are so-so; not a great meal at any of them.  But the buffet offers terrific options all day and evening.  The drinks at the bars are NOT watered down, as you might expect.  (Besides, if it is, just drink twice as many!)  The only thing to beware of is the concierge services.  They are primarily there to sell you a timeshare, not to truly help you with entertainment, excursions and comfort.  Nice people but once you go on the tour and say you do not want to buy, they ghost you.  Other than that, the place is great and we would go again in a heartbeat.

reviews.author: elisgambier
reviews.title: Highly recommended
reviews.text: It was a beautiful experience, not only is the hotel beautiful, but the staff is incredibly friendly, the food delicious. Many special thanks to Soni, a super kind girl who was always attentive to us and took a moment to advise us. Bravo!!!

reviews.author: Gonzalo Hoheb
reviews.title: Pleasant experience at the Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: The entire experience we had at the hotel was excellent, from the moment we arrived our concierge Alexis explained to us exactly everything related to the Hotel, the excellent food and restaurants. The whole experience was very good, we would return without any problem.

reviews.author: Ruben R
reviews.title: One of the best vacations I have ever had in Playa, spectacular hotel.
reviews.text: I spent 6 incredible days with my wife in this wonderful place, full of amenities, unique details, various rest and relaxation options, extraordinary food, fabulous beach and above all the warmth of its people with exceptional treatment from arrival to departure. You simply don't need to go out to anything, you have everything there and more. I take this opportunity to recognize @Fernando Sandoval and @Liliana Morales from "The Reserve" for being attentive to us at all times, to Luis from BAR Santé who delights us every day with his treatment and delicious drinks and especially to Annette Koelhemeij, leader of the hotel that facilitated a unique vacation from arrival to departure.

reviews.author: Blanca C
reviews.title: "Excellent service"
reviews.text:
Excellent service
The staff were attentive and helpful
Our waiters Armando, Alfredo and Ramiro
And Miss. Fernanda -Hostess
And in the Eduardo Pool.... everything is excellent.
We feel very cuddled

reviews.author: Sandy H
reviews.title: Lemon fish
reviews.text: Cesar is amazing, best server many surprises, got us birthday cake and Don Julio reposado, loved his energy! Highly recommended! Food recommendations were fire habachi rolls are my favorite. A must try

reviews.author: Kumee21
reviews.title: Like family
reviews.text: Staff is super attentive and caring. From my personal butlers Margarita and Jose to my masseuse Gemma at the Yhi Spa to Elliot, Josue, and Luis at the pool palapa beds, everyone made me feel right at home. We look forward to coming back next year and see everyone again.

reviews.author: Leslie
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Lemon Fish was our absolute favorite restaurant at PARADISUS. Rafael made our dining experience much fun! He was hilarious, made excellent recommendations, and made our meal so memorable! We can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: Jen L
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Wow! Amazing food. Order the skewers & ask for Rafael for top notch service. The atmosphere is so chill and spa - like. The sparkling wine is sweet so if you like dry wine, order the Sauvignon Blanc. :)

reviews.author: Kameron W
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Excellent service! Great food! Raphael was amazing! I will definitely be back. The hotel is amazing! The customer service everyone is so nice! I think I’m going to make this my spot! The atmosphere is top notch!

reviews.author: Jason B
reviews.title: Dinner celebration with friends
reviews.text: Jorge, Miguel, Emanuel, Rafael and Alejandro were amazing servers. They made sure the food kept coming and our glasses were full. We had pretty much everything on the menu in our 15 person party and everything was amazing. They gave us a champagne toast at the end. 5 stars!

reviews.author: Josh
reviews.title: Lemon fish restaurant
reviews.text: Jorge and Miguel provided great service to us.  The food was amazing and so much flavor!  The staff was fast and efficient and they were very accommodating to our needs with the young children.  Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Akachani1
reviews.title: Lemon Fish was amazing
reviews.text: What a great tester aunt to go to. My family and I had a great experience here. Rafael provided great service, Miguel made some awesome sushi and Jorge is a real master at the grill. Thank you everything was amazing

reviews.author: Zel M
reviews.title: BEST CUSTOMER SERVICE!!
reviews.text: I want to say that the breakfast buffet staff was one of the best we have ever received. ARTUNO AND ATILANO ARE AMAZING! They had a table ready for us every morning and even remembered our difficult drink orders. We had a party of 8 with us and they took care of us and our pregnant wives. Thank you for great service and amazing time!

reviews.author: Simon M
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Rafael was fantastic. He went out of his way to make sure that we were all accommodated and taken care of. He was super kind and even modified some dishes for us. Thank you to rafael for making our meal great. The food was really good too!

reviews.author: Ian N
reviews.title: Amazing food and Ambience
reviews.text: Wow. What can I say. Stepping into the restaurant immerses you in the middle of the Paradisus resort with the pothos vines hanging from all levels. The purple light in combination with separate eating platform really brings you into another zone and creating ambience and tranquility for the meal. The service was amazing. Additionally, the fusion of food, flavour, and presentation was quite sinply exquisite. I highly recommend anyone within the Cancun area checking out this place.

reviews.author: Jose Hernandez
reviews.title: Buena atención recomendable.
reviews.text:
Excelente hotel y la atención muy bien. 

Amazing experience and the attention of the staff is incredible.

I loved the restaurants and all the food. 

Except for the steak restaurant it wasn’t that good and the attention was really bad but the rest of the restaurants were incredible.

Violeta our concierge was amazing. 

100% recommended for couples and families.

reviews.author: Nico M
reviews.title: Paradisus - Concierge (Levi) and overall service staff is amazing
reviews.text: Our concierge (Levi) was a true professional. Without asking, he coordinated important details with our car rental company, booked our dinners, sent milk and cookies to our young toddler, arranged transportation, bus boys, activities, etc. Truly 5 star service — all while doing it asynchronous via WhatsApp, which gave us our privacy that we wanted but also felt connected with him that we could reach out at any given time. He also gave us a very helpful tour upon our arrival and made us feel at home.  Amazing experience!! Regarding the hotel, The food was amazing at Cielito Lindo restaurant at Paradisus. The hotel is beautiful, the beaches are picturesque, and the service is top notch. Absolutely will return again in the near future.

reviews.author: Neha R
reviews.title: Overall- good experience.
reviews.text:
We had an overall good experience. 

First day: Make sure to meet your concierge to find out information on the restaurant reservations, entertainment shows, kids activities, spa etc., our assigned concierge was not very helpful. Luckily our friends concierge Victor helped us with all the information.

Kids Club: Great engaging activities. Our kids liked it.

Restaurants: All restaurants were great and special in their own way. Would like to mention one restaurant in particular. Lemon fish: Do plan to visit this restaurant. Many thanks to Alejandro Camelo for providing us with the best experience. Malva buffet front desk can do better hospitality wise. We had a bitter experience with a lady working at the Malva buffet front desk (Friday, 23Sep2022 at around 1:30). 

As a Reserve member, we received a great room service (food, house keeping).

Nespresso: Great for coffee lovers. Really appreciate this service.

Medical service: A single visit with doctor within the resort will cost you around 195$.

One downside observed for families with younger kids. Wish there was more entertaining space for kids. May be few slides, arcade area.

reviews.author: Emily D
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Cesar was an amazing waiter. He made our experience so enjoyable and the food was absolutely delicious. Would recommend to anyone who asked. The chefs choice was a great mix of fish, meat, and vegetables.

reviews.author: Rami
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Jorge Ramos was a wonderful host. The food and experience were truly second to none. Everything from the ceviche to the sushi was splendid. The ambiance was also very enjoyable. Would go back in a heartbeat!

reviews.author: Saad S
reviews.title: Amazing service
reviews.text: Miguel and Jorge had amazing customer service and they both delivered the food very well. The food was amazing and the ambience and decor is also awesome. Keep up the good work and awesome service. Thank you guys!

reviews.author: Michael P
reviews.title: Lemon fish dinner
reviews.text: Amazing food and service to match. We don’t eat much seafood and Alejandro Camelo still found us a salmon appetizer that was great. He also offered a dessert coffee that perfectly ended our meal! Make sure to book lemon fish for one of your nights at paradisus.

reviews.author: Chris T
reviews.title: Amazing dinner!
reviews.text: Miguel and Jorge were amazing! The service was very prompt and Miguel had some great recommendations! Definitely enjoyed how he explained everything on the menu. I would definitely come back again if he was the waiter!

reviews.author: forouzan m
reviews.title: Fun class
reviews.text: It was very funny and useful class. Jeovani  and axel were funny and we enjoyed it . We made 2 different kind of cocktail and i differently make it for my family. The hotel staff were very friendly and polite

reviews.author: Earl A
reviews.title: Cocktail Class
reviews.text: Had the best cocktail class with Axcel and Giovanni. It was well worth the experience. Two delicious cocktails featuring a mezcal and flavored vodka. The Paradisus is definitely one of my favorite vacation resorts.

reviews.author: Negin T
reviews.title: Fantastic mixology class
reviews.text: The mixology class was fantastic and out of my mind, I really enjoy it and it is going to be something I will use in the future, axcel and geovanny were awesome, I really enjoy the food and every single aspect of the hotel

reviews.author: Ayaaa
reviews.title: Relaxing getaway
reviews.text: My husband and I had an amazing stay at Paradisus! The resort was clean, massive, and there was a lot to do. The beach had some seaweed, but they managed it throughout the day. Timoteo from the sports bar was AMAZING!! He was so attentive and really made us feel welcome. The Italian restaurant was our favorite, and we definitely recommend making a dinner reservation there if you get a chance. Overall, this resort was perfect for a relaxing getaway.

reviews.author: Beckie N
reviews.title: Mavla Breakfast/lunch
reviews.text:
Amazing breakfast/lunch staff. In particular big shout out to Ivonn, Eddi, Geraldo, and the incomparable Martin! 

Really took care of me and my colleagues, always going the extra mile. Made us feel super cared for and were all such genuine people.

reviews.author: John I
reviews.title: Amazing vacation from start to finish!
reviews.text: Fantastic experience from start to finish. My girlfriend and I booked The Reserve Ocean front room for 5 nights through Expedia. Our room was always clean, spacious and had a stunning ocean view. I would say The Reserve is worth it all the way. Check in was smooth and we were introduced to our designated concierge Galdino. Galdino assisted us with scheduling dinners, and was available for almost anything we needed via a text on WhatsApp. Galdino you are the best! The entire staff by the Reserve pool and restaurant (Sante) were just as awesome. VERY high praise for Joel, Yamil, Valeria, Manuel the bartender and William the supervisor. They all took excellent care of us on the reserve side of the resort, especially by the cabanas at the pool where we could order lunch and have it brought right to us. Keren did a great job facilitating fun activities for all to participate in. We enjoyed the breakfast buffet at Malva in the mornings with great service from Alberto, and the delicious tacos and tequila from Blue Agave with Filiberto for lunch. All restaurants and food on premises were top tier, as we tried almost every option to dine at. I forgot that we were at a resort each time we sat somewhere to dine, the dining experience was really the best we’ve had at an all inclusive resort. This was an unforgettable vacation and we can’t wait to come back to the Paradisus Cancun, thank you all!

reviews.author: Grabiela S
reviews.title: Amazing birthday experience!
reviews.text: Had an amazing experience with the waiter Natanael. He was so welcoming took time to explain each item on the menu as well as the area of Cancun. Learned so much about the culture and the surrounding areas as well from him. I definitely recommend everyone trying this place out and ask for Natanael as a waiter.

reviews.author: Ellen S
reviews.title: Lemon Grass
reviews.text: Great service and food! Server Daniel was excellent and made our dining experience most memorable. This restaurant is highly recommended. We enjoyed the cerviche, bao, and sushi. The drinks were also delicious and looked beautiful.

reviews.author: Mikaela G
reviews.title: Great food and service
reviews.text: Daniel is awesome! We had great food and a wonderful time. Every time we needed something our server was there and eager to help. The food was fresh and very high quality. I highly recommend the ceviche. It was delicious!

reviews.author: Excursion568828
reviews.title: Good experience
reviews.text: Really good treatment of my kids. They played in the play area while my husband and I went to have dinner. When we picked them up they wanted to stay. Really good service and great way for my husband and I to relax while the kids where really good take  care of

reviews.author: lawrence g
reviews.title: Fake Liquor
reviews.text: I am currently at the Paradisius Cancun, the liquor they serve is water with flavoring. This is how they make money with all inclusive. I ordered several different Tequilas, they are all water with flavoring. I even asked the bartender if he realized it, he just winked at me and walked away saying nothing I can do Senor. I’m sure the executives at Meliá know about this and are purposefully violating the law. Stay away from any Melia resort. Cheats and scammers.

reviews.author: Ilham F
reviews.title: Finger painting at Paradisus
reviews.text:
Karen and Amelia were really good! They helped me paint throughout the process. Very fun and relaxing. I painted by the beach at the reserve side at Paradisus Cancun. 
It was definitely a lovely experience.

reviews.author: LouB
reviews.title: AMAZING staff all around!!!
reviews.text: Everything from our greeting upon arrival, to the helpful concierge staff, pool bartenders, & amazing food made this a beyond amazing stay!! Our waiter @ the LemonFish restaurant, Alejandro Camelo was VERY helpful explain the dishes, recommending drinks and getting us to try the desserts!! World class service all around ❤️🏝🌊

reviews.author: Resort229241
reviews.title: Conference Stay
reviews.text: I stayed at Paradisus for 10 days and it is truly one of the best hotels I've ever stayed at. Aside from the gorgeous grounds and facilities, what amazed me was the fantastic attitude of the staff. It's not possible to walk past a staff without them giving a warm hello. In particular, Astrid was amazing, she is an absolute ray of sunshine who went put of her way to help me, she even gave me her WhatsApp number and would check up on me regularly. I have never seen this level of good customer service. Raphael and Moises from cielo and lemon fish restaurants were also really kind and welcoming. I would feel privileged to come back here!

reviews.author: Mariela C
reviews.title: Best service
reviews.text:
Rafael at lemon fish restaurant was excellent service, he recommended the perfect food for our dinner. Rafael was very proactive and kind every single time we called him.

The food at lemon fish was delicious and on time, very fresh fish and hot food as we loveee itttt.
Thanks Rafael for the best service at this restaurant. GOD bless you and your family 😊

reviews.author: jessica m
reviews.title: Lemon Fish Restaurant
reviews.text:
Fantastic place! Very tasty food! And excellent service! Highly recommend. Will definitely come back! 

The food is fusion of Japanese and Peruvian. Everything we ordered tastes great!! Our waiter is Rafael and he delivered excellent service and made our experience one of a kind!

reviews.author: Ross A
reviews.title: Lemon Fish Restaurant
reviews.text: An amazing experience!! Japanese Peruvian fusion restaurant in the Paradisus resort. Every single dish was exquisite, and Rafael's service was above and beyond. Can't wait to come back and experience more if what they gave to offer. A+

reviews.author: Maresa C
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Excellent service!! It was so great, we’ll be back again this year but bringing our whole family with us next time so they can also enjoy the experience.Thank you for making this such a memorable vacation.

reviews.author: Mrs. Martinez
reviews.title: A must stop
reviews.text: Absolutely best food on our trip. Jorge made sure we had an excellent dinner time.  He and Emmanuel, manager, were attentive and gave great recommendations from the menu. They have a great sampler.  Refreshing drinks and a beautiful place!

reviews.author: Hamza S
reviews.title: Excellent and wonderful trip
reviews.text: We were on family vacation in paradisus cancun for one week, we had real fun, and especially at the Malva restaurant, at any time of the day. The service was so wow ! Especially Atilano, Arturo and Janet who took very good care of us and our daughter. We felt like home, thanks to the staff for making our holidays wonderful. We will surely come back!

reviews.author: Daniel R
reviews.title: Lemon fish
reviews.text: Very professional. Kept checking in. Would recommend to anyone. Accommodated our reservations despite being late. The drinks he got us were also amazing. The food came out at a steady pace and all of the food was very flavorful and presented nicely.

reviews.author: Priscila R
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Rafael was amazing at lemon fish!!! Came for my bday (and we came late) but we’re so nicely accommodated. Rafael recommended some plates for us which were all good. Everything was absolutely amazinggggg! The short rib  and the portobello skewer we’re our favs. Very attentive

reviews.author: Vini A
reviews.title: Wonderful experience with Miguel & Jorge
reviews.text: We had one of the best and most wonderful experiences with Jorge and Miguel they were the most vibrant and exclusive VIP servicing waiters that I have ever had the pleasure to be around and be served by them the sushi and the food was exquisite. my beautiful girlfriend soon to be wife, she has the most beautiful Eyes. Meguel was so attentive and help me get her strong drinks enough to loosen the night up and extended our wonderful evening into the perfectly temperature  room, and fulfill all my pleasures. Without this wonderful dinner I would’ve never achieved such climax. Thanks to lemon fish and especially Miguel & Jorge 🙌

reviews.author: Ricardo H
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text:
Delicious food and great service from Rafael Cime! 
Definitely recommend visiting this great restaurant!
The margaritas are yummy and the Taku Taku and the short Rib tacos are so delicious! And to top it off the desserts are amazing!

reviews.author: Mpho
reviews.title: Amazing service at Paradisus
reviews.text: The service from all the staff was remarkable. It really felt like home and felt so welcomed. In particular Richard from Malva was so attentive and courteous at all times! Highly reccomend!! Great food

reviews.author: Selam A
reviews.title: Kidsdom
reviews.text: Brenda, Nicy ,Rubi, hzel, Keren , maribel, lvou. They are really nice and excellent with kids.  My kids like the kids Dom. They keep saying they want to go every single day. All the employees are so welcoming. I really Appreciate your help.

reviews.author: Lolabear88
reviews.title: Paradise with lovely staff
reviews.text: Restaurant Malva had lots of yummy food and very friendly staff. Had a nice chat with Gerardo and Richer one evening and Atilano, Ignacio and Eddie were great at breakfast. Service with a smile! The location is amazing. The sea is beautiful. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Happiness721881
reviews.title: 9 days stay
reviews.text: The  waiters in the restaurant are very good and helpful most of the them are extremely good . But food in the restaurants didn’t enjoy at all . Hope they rectify this . Hotel is overrated in my opinion as we have been to few hotels with all inclusive in different countries. But I can’t find fault with the hotel staff they were extremely helpful with the exception of  check in reception staff who were very official and not helpful in any way

reviews.author: T0sin
reviews.title: Remarkable experience
reviews.text: The Paradisus Cancún is beautiful, warm, it has a heart! Lunch at Lunch Box, dinner at Lemon Fish  served by the most efficient waiter ever- Alejandro Camelo. Alejandro deserves to be commended and he needs to share the secret to his amazing skills. He is a thoroughbred professional. Fernanda Paola at reservations was so kind, patient and helpful as our trip neared. She supported with all information. She is a leader.  Astrid at the front desk is worthy representative of this hotel. She was so helpful when we needed to find our colleague who was not answering her calls. Coolio Ceasar is very responsive and responsible.  Jesus at the pool side is a remarkable young man who made a lasting impression. All these people and more will make us come back!

reviews.author: Sarah S
reviews.title: Make sure you eat at Lemon Fish!
reviews.text: Not here leaving a review on the hotel but the restaurant Lemon Fish - honestly I hadn’t eating so good sushi and ceviche in a very long time!!! It was surprising to find such a nice restaurant as part of an all-inclusive experience. My waiter Alejandro was just the best, so professional and attentive that he made the experience x10 better. Most restaurants at this hotel are quite average, but honestly if you do stay make sure you have dinner at Lemon fish!! If you can. ask to be served by Alejandro and you’ll also make sure you are getting the best experience possible.

reviews.author: Frank P
reviews.title: Fun times cancun-woo woo!!
reviews.text: Hi guys want to say Melia Paradisus cancun is superb gem of a resort. It’s clean,safe and well maintained. All workers are over the top friendly. My wife and I love  this place. Liz our butler/concierge did a fine job coordinating our activities. Pools were clean and well maintained, the pool  quality control engineer was doing quality control of water on a couple of the days there- I was talking to him - cool guy, keeping water super clean. Beach was right within walking distance from the pool- 200-250 feet  and there is expansive area to walk the beach white sandy clean except for patches of seaweed-all natural and added to the natural beauty, is very safe- many beach walkers they are all pleasant , no one hounding you to buy things. Nicole and Jenny were our pool girls at the Reserve pool that got towels, gave sunblock, shared stories and made our stay that much nicer. Joel,Javier,Valeria,Julio,Moises,Luis,Ruben, Miguel,Cesar,Eligio,Yamil,Oscar,Josue,Lorena did a great job at the Reserve pool/ bar and Santo poolside restaurant. We did the all inclusive and food and drinks were over the top way great!!  Rogelio was our main security guard at the resort , he is competent and made everyone feel safe.  Salvador and Karina were great bartenders at Kanna pub on the beach, super friendly and so great at making our drinks. I would return to this resort tomorrow - we are Platinum Melia resort members but cancun Paradisus and Paradisus Punta Cana -Palma Real are 2 of our favorites. My recommendation is just join the Melia club - we have been members for 15 years now and fully happy we joined.

reviews.author: Ashley S
reviews.title: Breakfast service
reviews.text: Arnulfo is an amazing server. He took care of us several times throughout our trip. He always makes it fun for the kids. On our last day, he brought us a sign for our table and went out of his way to bring our youngest bacon because they were out at the buffet. Highly recommend requesting Arnulfo.

reviews.author: David C
reviews.title: Great service at Malva A.M
reviews.text: Great service from Arturo at Malva. He was attentive and very quick at service. The restaurant is beautiful and overlooks the ocean. Great place to dine as a couple. After you're done with food you can take a dip in the pool.

reviews.author: ThandivH
reviews.title: Excellent friendly service!
reviews.text: We experienced really Excellent service from Ignacio, Candelaria and Raul - they were efficient and friendly and made sure we had all our needs met with the most delicious  food at the Paradisus Cancun all inclusive Malva restaurant.

reviews.author: FarAway208592
reviews.title: Lovely!
reviews.text: We had a lovely time here. Big shout out to Atilano for making us feel so welcome at breakfast and lunch. Such a beautiful place and the staff are wonderful, especially at breakfast :) Thank you also Arturo and Jannett!

reviews.author: Mae
reviews.title: Lemon Fish Restaurant
reviews.text: Jorge and Miguel were amazing! The nigiri, robatayaki, and tacos were also amazing! You have to try the lychee sorbet too! So fresh, to die for! Definitely would come back for delicious food and great service!

reviews.author: Maria M
reviews.title: Best Dinner & Stay at Lemon Fish at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus Cancun and everything has been simple amazing! I am so sad thinking about our trip coming to an end! The best restaurant at the resort is Lemon Fesh! Miguel and Jorge were amazing waiters and we had the best service with them!

reviews.author: Marshall H
reviews.title: Best dinner at lemon fish / stay at Paradisus
reviews.text: Miguel and Jorge were amazing staff members and the food was incredible. Would 100% recommend lemon fish and Cancun Paradisus if they are your staff, they treated us excellent and provided the best service / food in the resort

reviews.author: Edward K
reviews.title: Outdoors Photo Family
reviews.text: My wife and I recently visited Paradisus Cancun and had a private photo shoot and purchased a set of photos from Jonathan (manager and business guy) and Eugene (photographer) of Outdoors Photo Family on the premises.  Both guys very friendly, engaging, and accommodating.  Photo quality was excellent and I highly recommend using these guys.

reviews.author: RocketAroundtheWorld
reviews.title: Beautiful building, nice restaurants, very friendly & efficient staff but the hard sell to buy stuff was too persistent
reviews.text:
The building is beautiful. The staff was very friendly (I've never been called Princessa so many times in a week (lol)!  The lagoon view side is nice and there are fireworks every night at 10pm from a restaurant across the road but unfortunately also a very loud discotec thumping music from midnight until 4am Wed-Sunday nights... very loud bass  :(

The Pool was beautiful and large but there was no ramp for handicap or elder people to access inside the pool nor a ramp to get down onto the beach so unfortunately our elder person couldn't access getting in any water at any time during our week+ stay.  It was also difficult to access certain restaurants if the person cannot take stairs.  
This hotel is best suited for younger mobile people or families and those wanting to drink/eat a lot and party. They had a childcare area and the girls seemed to have their hands full as 1 girl for each age group (younger/older)
The food in the various restaurants you reserved in was delicious, well-presented and well portioned.  The buffet is plentiful but always the same so definitely reserved in their individual restaurants. The certain waste from the buffet was depressing but that seems evident in all-inclusive places. 

The welcome staff was very persistent to get you to have meeting with them trying to sell you time shares, tours, photos, activities... a bit too much so you feel hounded by them. They messaged, whatsappd and even tried to video call us to push us to come talk to them.  After a few days we asked them to please stop pestering us.
A huge highlight was the Nespresso 24/7 coffee stand with pastries & sandwiches and friendly and funny servers. 

The overall staff was excellent, and we hope they are well paid for all the hard work you see them doing. 
The beach itself was wrought with algae and rough waves so not very enticing, unlike other places in Mexico.  There were ample pool chairs, also canopy beds at $50 or $250 a day. The pool had service for drinks & food... you can eat 24/7 if you want to. There is a Mall at a 10min taxi drive ($15 one way)
Overall we enjoyed our stay but much preferred Isla Mujeres nearby where the beach was so much nicer and more authentic Mexico feeling. But for an all-inclusive it was a nice choice. The room was comfortable, clean and offered a full minibar.

reviews.author: urania C
reviews.title: Limon Fish
reviews.text: Awesome server and caring, gave us details about the food menu also gave us everything on time. Rafa is friendly and smile the whole time, we had him. Thank you so much Rafa….. I’m enjoying the good company with family..

reviews.author: Manuel C
reviews.title: Lemonfish restaurant
reviews.text: Food was amazing, atmosphere was wonderful, Rafael provided excellent service and brought up many varieties of combinations to eat well. The style of the restaurant feels cozy and luxurious. Had a great experience.

reviews.author: Sunny W
reviews.title: Lemon fish
reviews.text: Rafael is the best server. manager Hugo was also very helpful. He is kind and patient. He is very considerate and very passionate about this work. My boyfriend has food allergy. He cannot have soy. They alter the menu to fit his needs. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Kristy C
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Made a reservation and had dinner at Lemon Fish. So delicious! Especially enjoyed the short rib with jicama and the nigiri. Rafael was a great server, very attentive to us the whole time. Great wine selection!

reviews.author: Jessica C
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun Great service
reviews.text:
After a great 3 days of vacation at Paridisus Cancun my husband got stomach virus and wasn’t feeling well. The staff helped provide other alternatives to eat and help make are last two days more comfortable. Thank you to Frieda concierge, Atilano and Samuel the waiters for providing excellent service.

I also wanted to give a great thank you to Martin, Gerardo, Ivón, and Edie for their outstanding service! Truly appreciate all they did for us while our stay at Paradisus.

reviews.author: RhiRhi8739
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: I booked Paradisus The Reserve because this is where I stay in DR and I love it.  I was completely disappointed.   The Reserve is building 5.  There is nothing offered in building 5 except a small bar and finger foods with nats flying over them. There is a concierge/butler offered.  I saw her once.  She made dinner reservations at 2 restaurants and I never saw her again.  My traveling companions never met theirs at all.  Building 3 is where you will find all restaurants, the pool and any entertainment offered.   Imagine the walk daily from the upgraded reserve area.  The food was awful.  The beef and pork in the buffet was so tough, we had them make us hamburgers.  One day it was descent/edible.  The breakfast was good.. fresh omelets and mimosas.  The steak house was just ok.  The Italian restaurant was ok but there was no AC and it was very very hot.  I can not tell you anything about the Lemon Fish as we were turned away because we did not have reservations.  The Blue Agave was good however we had to take our menu to the cook and order because we could not find a waiter and I had to literally go behind the bar, go in their cooler and get my own beer.  The only person that provided good service was an older gentleman at the cabanas.  I tipped him 40 dollars because he worked hard to ensure we were taken care of.  Speaking of the cabanas, we had to stand in line to reserve one because our concierge/butler was not to be found.  We had a chilled bottle of champagne left in our room and I thought it would be our night cap only to find it gone when we returned.  I called to see if I could possibly get it back but no luck.  I can say that the place was clean.  I will NEVER book here again.  Completely disappointed and spent a lot of money for nothing.

reviews.author: sukhjitm600
reviews.title: LemonFish
reviews.text: Lemonfish was such an amazing experience. We went there twice during our stay. Our waiter Jorge we met during our stay at Paradisus last year and we were excited to see him again this year. His service was exceptional and he is one of the reasons we returned to Paradisus again. reviews.author: Janna B

reviews.author: Cess
reviews.title: MONEY STOLEN IN ROOM. Don’t stay here if you want to feel safe.
reviews.text:
DON’T STAY HERE. YOU CAN GET ROBBED AND THE HOTEL WILL REFUSE TO DO THE RIGHT THING.

We had a reservation for 7 nights at the Paradisus Cancun to handle some business while trying to enjoy a bit of a vacation getaway. Half way through our stay we had left money in our room for a few hours and had $2,000 USD in cash disappear. When we arrived back in our room, the room was reset and our money was gone.  

We tried to talk to security and guest services. They triple checked our room and reassured us they would do an investigation to follow up on what happened and who entered. 

To be honest, for most of our stay we have had really great customer service. From Antonio up at the front desk who helped us move rooms our first day (since our original assigned room did not have a working air conditioner), to every smiling face that laughed and joked with us at the 24hr coffee station, and all the very sweet staff at each restaurant who would remember things about us and would joke with the other visitors children.  We really had enjoyed our first few days at Paradisus. It is hard for us to feel so sad and disappointed in the end when we have tried to be patient and understanding, believing in the due process which they promised us would amount to something. Perhaps we were naive to think that any place would be safe from the dark things that can happen in the world but we did expect better from the hotel in regards to a response to help us cope with our financial loss. You come to a inclusive resort to melt your worries away, not to add to the anxiety we already deal with on a daily basis to even make the dollars to get here.

After 72 hours of patiently waiting for their investigation to be completed , speaking kindly to those every morning at the guest services hoping for an update, I am left in tears of frustration that the only reassurance and compensation they are willing to give us is a voucher for 2 nights to come back to the place that tarnished my first memories of Cancun. Imagine paying for a 6 hour flight round trip from CA to stay 2 nights at a place that literally stole your money. How does that even make sense? We asked for at least 3 days to make it more reasonable.  Their reasoning for the result of the investigation, you ask? Their room staff had worked here for years and so they trust them. That’s the whole investigation, justification and conclusion.

We tried to resolve this with them directly but as you can imagine they are protecting their staff and hotel. We understand it is a business and like I told Christian the supervisor at guest services and Astrid the guest services supervisor who assisted us in trying to recoup some kind of compensation for our loss, that we also worked very very hard to even make this trip happen and saved all we could hoping to have a vacation we would remember for a lifetime. We know they work very hard too.

All I will remember now, is not the music at the bars and dancing with the performers, the great dishes at the restaurants, or excellent service from everyone else we had interacted with. But instead the frustration of coming everyday to speak with them when I would rather have been at the beach, the hurt of dealing with people who originally told us they would do nothing, and the last 2 days of our trip that we spent almost begging for them to do more than shoo us away and tell us to forget about it.  I’ll always remember all the tears, the deflation of walking to our room trying to figure out how we could swallow and  recover from this loss, and the shock we first had when we came and couldn’t find it.

In the end all we have is a hotel voucher for 2 nights with the expectation we will have to spend even more money to even make it a reasonable trip, coming all the way from California. Please don’t spend your money here. Pick a different hotel, there are so many other beautiful places in Cancun. Behind all the nice things at Paradisus, there are so many things that can happen that you’d never expect and they will do little to nothing about. This is a warning to all my fellow travelers. And to Paradisus - do better, no one wants to leave a vacation in tears.

reviews.author: Jamie K

reviews.author: Alon B
reviews.title: Worst experience you can imagine.
reviews.text:
This hotel doesn't have a manager. So you could literally see how nothing was functioning:

- The reception had lines almost every time. Once we got to talk with the staff, they 
   were nice, wrote down our requests but never dealt with them.
- The 'booking department' is in charge of the restaurant bookings. Yet they are 
  hardly there. When I finally got the speak with them you could see I was disturbing 
  their chit-chat. You couldn't believe how rude they can get (Alexis).
- The hotel was constantly dirty; the elevators were always wet, we spotted dead 
  cockroaches at the restaurants and there was food in the water in the swimming 
  pools more than once.
- They tell you that they have workshops or parties at the hotel. This is partly true.
  They had 2 events in the week we were there. We attended a cocktail workshop 
   the only consisted of tasting. We did not prepare any cocktails.
- They published to have 7 restaurants. When we got there, one was closed.
   Another cost a lot of money even though we had an all-inclusive package. A third 
   (the tacos place) was always empty, cause you had to wait 10 minutes for every 
   small taco.
- Don't get me starting on their beach: not a nice one to start with. The beds there 
  were constantly dirty. There was no staff. So no drinks and cleaned our beds by 
  ourselves. When we wanted to take one of those big beds suddenly someone did 
  approach us, only to try and sell it to us for 250 $ (!).

One good thing?

Their children's staff was out of this world. Best regards especially to Esmeralda.

Also, many thanks to: Arnulfo, Ada, Manuel, Jonathan and Raul, who tried their best to save our vacation. Single people in a otherwise not recommendable hotel.

reviews.author: beachmamajm
reviews.title: Not Recommended Misrepresented the Reserve
reviews.text: We are seasoned travelers and work in the travel industry and have vacationed in Cancun previously. First the Pros: The servers in Malva (buffet) were wonderful! Housekeeping was thorough. Beautiful landscaping and pools. Concierge at pool & cabanas also wonderful.  Coffee Nespresso shop was very good too.  The views are amazing from this resort making for great vacation photos. Now the Cons:  The Reserve (adult only building) Premium Suites was misrepresented. It was NOT adult only with young children being chased by parents and yelling throughout the halls and lounging areas. I have photos of it all. The so called concierge they provide in the Reserve is nonexistent. Whenever I asked for things or info I received neither. Texts are saved on my phone also. Room service didn’t show up in the morning when I ordered coffee but in the evening was very good and fast too. If you like air conditioning you can forget that at this resort. The room never reached cooler than 75-77 and the resort common areas, Ginger bar/club, most restaurants and lounge areas have zero ventilation or ac. It feels like a rainforest/sauna from the second you leave your suite. Maintenance came twice to our hot humid suite and stated that was as cool as our room would reach. Bathroom door didn’t close all the way and no lock. We did bring to the attention of guest services that families w young children were staying in our building and were loud and their response was yes we put them there and maybe next month we will not. So they charge you premium price for adult only but they are misrepresenting! Food absolutely atrocious everywhere we ate. Room service was the only good food. This is so far from even a 4 star resort that it’s sad. The staff give you free breakfast if you leave good reviews which is why you will find some good reviews. This resort needs a complete updating and new director of entertainment and food service. The app and menus online are all in Spanish only.  Elevators were scarce and poorly lit hallways or no lighting at all.  They did provide a portable fan in our luxury suite which really didn’t do much to cool the room but they tried & offered to move us but when shown the suite it was hotter than ours. This all made for an extremely disappointing stay at the Paradise Cancun Reserve.  I do not recommend this place and I certainly would never come back. Don’t waste your money there are too many great places to stay in Cancun.

reviews.author: Kim W
reviews.title: Always excellent service at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
I am a Club Melia member and have been traveling to this resort over the past 25 years.  Normally I stay in the far Pyramid where the Club Melia members typically stay.  On this trip, we did not use the timeshare, but purchased our vacation on line and we stayed in "The Reserve".  You pay a little more to stay in the Reserve, but it is worth it!!  Reserve guests have private access to a private adult only pool.  That particular pool has MANY Bali beds, unlike where I stay on the other end of the property with Club Melia.  The Reserve guests have their own private pool restaurant by the pool (Sante), and their own private pool bar for only Reserve guests.  In addition you can eat at the Reserve restaurant called Sal in the evening.  The atmosphere is nice.  It is primarily steak.  Also, in the atrium in the Reserve Pyramid they offer a full bar with bartender, and a small snack buffet at breakfast and lunch.

All of the staff at Paradisus Cancun are wonderful, but I want to mention a few that went above and beyond:

Francisco checked us in at the Reserve Pyramid.  He went above and beyond welcoming us and putting us into the room that worked best for us.  He really was a delight to engage with when we first arrived.  He is excellent at his job!

Jennifer, our pool concierge was extremely helpful and just a wonderful bubbly personality. 

Oscar was our pool server and took great care of us on the day he was assigned to our Bali bed.  It was like he could read our mind...If we even had a thought that it was time another margarita, he was there with a fresh one without even asking! 

PEDRO is the best mixologist of all time!  He works in the Ginger Bar and takes such pride in all that he creates.  He really makes guests feel so special.  Don't miss him when he offers the Margarita workshop inside the Ginger Bar once per week.  He is an asset to Paradisus Cancun!

It is the people who work at this property that keep me coming back after all these years!!

reviews.author: Chris Volney
reviews.title: Lemon Fish Restaurant
reviews.text: Rafael was quite helpful and polite in bringing our food on time and understanding our needs. We came down with our family and was impressed with his service delivery and professionañism. We will recommend him over and over.

reviews.author: Joe R
reviews.title: Paradisus and their staff make it feel like home
reviews.text:
A++

Highly recommended for families and groups. Couples seeking adults only experience can use the reserve area where we didn't have access with baby.

Gorgeous interior, huge pool, large variety of food and areas to enjoy time. We stayed in Pyramid 1, former time share site that had separate living and sleeping areas. Great for baby!! + Two balconies and a soaking tub w/ jets.

My wife and I traveled with our 9 month old son. Upon arrival Juan Carlos (JC) helped us feel welcomed, got us checked in, and even held our baby while he walked us to our room.  He gave us his WhatsApp number to have instant access for help. He graciously provided overview of amenities, booked reservations for dinners.  We saw JC and ask questions frequently through WhatsApp. Each time he was courteous, helpful, and always quick to respond. Thank you JC.

The property is clean and we'll staffed. Staff is always kind and say hello, they are professional, and make you feel safe and cared for.  Their goal seems to focus on your enjoyment and satisfaction.  Daily cleaning and maintenance are visible throughout.

The atriums and gardens are well kept, and the beachfront is clean.  Our beach & pool attendant Balta was quick to keep our drinks and food available, and trash is quickly removed. The bars are well stocked and drinks carefully prepared. 

Don't miss the mixology bar, see them for their high quality and unique drinks.

The buffet for breakfast is diverse, tasty food, and we'll staffed. Antonio, Guardencio, and many others played with our son, made him napkin dolls, and helped keep him laughing. Everyone wanted to hold and affectionately play with him.

Restaurant service was attentive. Food was good, and the ingredients were fresh.  Shout out to Joni, Ramiro, and Artufo. Daniel at lemon fish fish was helpful. Everyone found steamed veggies and pasta for baby, and made sure he was comfortable.Too many great staff to name them all. Thank you to all who helped us, nice work 👏🏼👏🏼🙏

Sargassum red tide is becoming an issue throughout Caribbean waters FL down to Cancun so be mindful of seasons if beach access is your #1 priority.

Occupancy was low as time we visited. I can see it getting hard to find chairs and reservations when at full capacity. Get to chairs early and book reservations at check in to avoid that.

We didn't enjoy entertainment due to 7 p.m. bedtime for our baby. Quick walks out to check separately did show that events were planned and looked good.

At pool kids groups and daily activities were happening.

Many kiosks and teams available for excursion and activities off the resort.

9-hole par 3 golf looked fun, didn't make it to play.

Spa looked well equipped and gym facilities were clean and functional. 

Great times were had and this is a resort we'd happily visit again.

reviews.author: QuEeNyGuRl
reviews.title: Disappointing Stay and Lemon Fish is overhyped
reviews.text:
At $400/night I expected excellent service that Mexico is known for and great local cuisine.  While the resort grounds were huge, beautiful and luxurious, the experience here was just mediocre.  

I'll start off with the pros:

- The location of the property is right in hotel zone, sitting in front of the gorgeous Caribbean Ocean.  We had an ocean view room on the 3rd floor and the view of the ocean was spectacular!  The room came with a balcony so it was nice to relax outside with the sounds of the waves.

- The main pool area was huge and never felt too crowded in the late afternoons.  The pool bar did close early like 5pm.  The pool water temp was perfect, not too warm or cold. There was a cart by the pool serving hamburgers and hotdogs.

- The bar at the Kanna Beach Club had great drink service, I recommend the Sexy Banana blended drink.  This is the bar where it had the swing chairs for your gram photos.   We were the only ones there at 11am.

- Cielo, the contemporary Mexican cuisine restaurant had the best food at the resort.  I recommend the bone marrow with sopes, shrimp ceviche, shrimp entree and octopus entree. Special shout out to our server Noe, who was excellent and was very attentive.  He always made sure our drinks were full and finished plates were taken away immediately.

- The bellmen (forgot his name) who brought up our luggage to the room, provided us tips on what to do at the resort and how to explore the hotel zone via the red bus.  There's a bus stop right outside of the resort.  The buses come every few minutes and are only 12 pesos per person.  We took it to the luxury mall a couple miles away.

- 24-hour espresso bar was nice.  We could get our coffee fix at anytime of the day or pastries for a snack.

Now for the cons:

- At check-in the card reader device was giving an error and saying it couldn't read my card.  I know there's nothing wrong with my card as I had just used it in Mexico with no problems, the credit limit is high, and I already put a travel notice on it.  So it wasn't me.  Plus the error was that it couldn't read it, not decline.  The agent asked if I had another card to use.  My answer was no and do not put the onus onto the customer to resolve your device technical issues.  Not my problem your device is broken.  He looked stunned by my response and didn't know what to do.  I told him to use another card reader and voila it worked!  Annoying that he couldn't think outside the box to solve their hardware issue. Escalate to your manager if you need to, swipe it, tap it, manually enter it but don't put it back onto the customer.

- After check-in, our concierge lady was giving us a tour of the resort and recommended some restaurants, like Lemon Fish.  We were only there for 2 nights and both nights were fully booked.  We just got here and you're already telling us we can't eat at your highly recommended restaurant.  After some back and forth at our displeasure, they magically found something at 10pm the next night.  I understand the reservation system is needed to help manage the crowds and making sure that staff is available.  But it is ridiculous to not have any availability for guests at the property.  

- Blue Agave, the taco restaurant was awful.  We've eaten delicious tacos from SoCal, Tijuana, Cabo and Puerto Vallarta, and tacos here were just sad.  There's a billion waiters but only 1 cook.  4 tacos took like 30+ min to arrive.  The taco meat was bland, dry and lacked any flavor.  Even after drowning them in salsa, it still tasted awful.  My partner couldn't even finish one taco.  How can you mess up tacos in Mexico?

- Now for the big night at Lemon Fish that was fully booked to the grills and everyone is raving about, was a huge disappointment.  I don't know what their definition of fully booked is but the restaurant was 50% empty!  They made it sound so exclusive, high in demand and hard to get into but we were surrounded by empty tables.  There seems to be plenty of staff members too. My theory is that they purposely make it hard for guests to get reservations here because it's considered their more "premium" restaurant and want to funnel guests to their lower tier restaurants like the buffet. Living in SoCal, we've had our fair share of excellent sushi so our standard is pretty high.  The sushi here is joke.  The people who gave this place a glowing review has probably not eaten at a proper sushi restaurant before.  The sushi was dry, rice was hard, and tasted like store bought ones from Trader Joes. Costco makes better sushi than this place.  The meat skewers, had this weird grainy texture to it.  It is partially our fault for having such high expectations for a sushi place in Mexico.  If you're a sushi lover, I recommend you SKIP THIS PLACE, not worth the hype. You'll be severely disappointed.  Or just lower your expectation that is a C grade sushi restaurant.

- For a resort that advertises as a luxury resort, our room was the total opposite.  The decor was all over the place and didn't flow together.  It looked like it was designed for a 4 year old with cheap Ikea furniture.  I've stayed at 3 star Marriots and Fairfield Inns, that had rooms more well put together than this trash.  Our closet doors were just cheap white curtains, the bathroom sink did not drain properly (yes the plug was open) and our couch was missing cushions so it was unusable.  The sink was so annoying, we sometimes just used the shower to brush our teeth. For $400/night this is unacceptable.  The little details matter at a "luxury" resort. 

Never returning to this resort or any other Melia properties.    After the first night at this place, we were already over this place.  Thank goodness the remainder of our trip was at xCaret Arte which was million times better.  ✌️ Paradisus

reviews.author: I Gorman - London
reviews.title: A few Improvements could make this resort so much better
reviews.text:
We visited Paradisus Cancun for 13 nights from 22/08 (2 adults and one child).   This was our 5th trip to Cancun but first to Paradisus.  I have mixed feelings about this resort as there are so many positives but a few negatives that really let it down.

Starting with the positives - The service is EXCELLENT. The staff literally make this a 4/5 star resort and it would be a lot less without them.  They are friendly, polite and hard working, could not fault a single one of them.  We hired a sea view cabana bed every day and the serving staff were exceptional, nothing was too much to ask, drinks and ice buckets filled without even having to ask etc…. 

The view are stunning. Lots of sun beds and cabanas looking over the beach…. It was literally paradise.  There was lots of seaweed when we visited but the beach was still well maintained and beautiful. 

The main pool design is great, its in need of a bit of tlc but it’s huge, warm and a large shallow area for kids to play in. 

The one big negative about the pool is that it was not filled high enough and so the filter system was not fully in use so it was dirty….. which was ok to start but got considerable worse by the second week when the resort filled up a bit more. 

The food was average.  We tried all restaurants and whilst there was a good selection everything was just warm and not hot. Again after 2 weeks this starts to grate on you, so we ended up going out for dinner a few times just to get something hot.  

The room was ok. We were upgraded to an ocean view on arrival which was lovely.  Good size balcony and sufficient space in the room.  The rooms are a little tired but that wasn’t a problem for us.  A few small negatives were the air con wasn’t that cool and was soooo noisy (although after a few nights we got used to it) and whilst the maid service was excellent on a day to day basis the room was quite dirty underneath cupboards and on shelf’s etc. 

There was a leak in the ceiling in the corridor leading to our room and whilst there was a bucket there every day there were no wet floor signs etc and it was still leaking when we left so clearly not in a rush to fix it.

The main lobby and entertainment area was very nice to look at but my goodness it was HOT. This is not made clear to you when reading the hotel information  on line. There are lots of amazing plants so it’s clearly a good eco hotel but other than your room, the main buffet and the sports bar there is no aircon anywhere.  This made for some very sticky and uncomfortable evenings.  It was actually cooler outside then in after about 8pm but unfortunately there are no outside bars that allow children, so we had very limited choices. 

Another big negative about this hotel is the price of things…… I appreciate the world is a different place currently and everyone needs to make money again but the prices they wanted to charge for some things was criminal.  To withdraw cash from the ATM there was a $25 transaction fee!!!!!! If you literally went outside the hotel at the end of their driveway and used the public machine it was $6.99.   We also went to the 1st floor shop on the day of arrival as my son wanted a ball for the pool and they charged me $30, for a cheap basic beach ball.  We also had to get him a rash very at one point as the first few days were extremely hot and I had to pay $70….. after that we discovered there was a huge shop in aqua world across the road that was a fraction of the price so got everything we needed from there going forwards.  I dont mind paying a little over the odds for things in hotels but the prices they charged were ridiculous and insulting. 

Over all - I enjoyed my holiday here, I tried to overlook the negatives and just embrace the wonderful location and spectacular service, however would I recommend this hotel or visit here again? No I’m afraid I wouldn’t.

This is our first time in Cancun and we had the best time. I can truthfully say a lot of that has to do with Paradisus. Not only is the place BEAUTIFUL, but the service was beyond our expectations. Mauricio at Cielo made my birthday celebration so memorable. Raul at Lunchbox/Malva was so amiable, kind, and thoughtful. He offered us amazing advice when we wanted to go out exploring. reviews.author: Jay P

reviews.author: janet g
reviews.title: Hot rooms (77*-82*). Very hot
reviews.text:
We were originally scheduled to go to Paradisus Cancun in March of 2020. And then the world shut down. Fast forward to August 2022. 
We’ve been to many all inclusive resorts (including reserve paradisus punta Cana)

The rooms are hot. 80*. Not kidding. They try to fix by changing the filter but it will remain hot in your room. Don’t pay for ocean view bc you have to keep the curtains closed. 

We stayed for a full week in the reserve section. We had a deluxe ocean view room. Before arriving, we received an email stating we were in a jr suite. When I called CS to make sure they had us in the correct room, the man on the phone was unbelievably rude. Told me to “stop talking” so he could read my reservation info to me. Huh. 

Upon arriving at the resort, we noticed how beautiful the lobby is. Humid but gorgeous. 

Our room was lovely. Housekeeping is exceptional. Eva, I think, did a great job. 

A few mornings a week, yoga is offered at the outside gazebo overlooking the ocean. The waves were so soothing. I wanted to try the stretch class but the instructor never arrived so I used the well appointed gym. 

We used the Bali beds which is a really nice perk. We loved the ocean view ones. Joel at the Bali beds was a great server. Valeria also AMAZING!
Caesar in tower 5 reserve area was great about clearing our glasses and plates during a cocktail hour. 
Lunch box service by Teresa and Antonio and richer was perfect. They checked on us constantly refilling our drinks. 
At Capella, we also had great service. (Maybe Josue. I can’t recall)
Pedro and sofino at sports bar so so good. Seriously Pedro is the best bartender. The. Best. 
Roberto great server also at sports bar. Polite and friendly. 
Sofonia and giovani were friendly and professional. 
Ernesto at Lemon Fish was amazing server. And that food was really good and fresh!
I hate buffets. Hate. But the buffet here was good. Each day had different choices. 
Our favorite restaurant was Cielo. That food was unbelievable. 
We’ve been to many all inclusive and some have cost a lot more money (sandals). The service and food here was very very good. 
Our concierges were Violeta and Mauricio. They were extremely responsive every time we made any request. They were professional and friendly. Ask for them. You won’t be disappointed. 

Would we stay here again ? No. We would not. 

Why? Because the temperature of the room was too warm. Goodness knows they tried several times to make our room cooler. Even with their efforts the rooms temp never got below 77* (it was btw 77*-82* the entire stay) and that is uncomfortable for us. We are from Houston so heat is not foreign for us. But the room was way, way too hot. 

***Don’t spend extra money on ocean view bc we had to keep the blinds drawn or would have been unbearable. That was a rip off for us. Wasted money***

Sadly, that is a deal breaker for us. I understand it’s been a warm summer. We live in Houston, so we are used to the heat. We’ve traveled many places in summertime (Guatemala, Jamaica, DR, PR). My husband has MS and it’s triggered by the heat. And the entire stay, he dealt with issues bc of the warmth of our room. Usually we can go to the room and cool off. Not here. We’ve never dealt with a hot room before. We visited many tropical locations and the heat in the room has never been a problem. 

So sadly, in spite of the good food, great cocktails, and amazing service, we won’t be returning to Paradisus Cancun.

I emailed management about the AC. They responded that I told the concierge that we were enjoying our vacation. 

Management doesn’t address the issue. Before booking checking thr Facebook groups. The room temperature is a constant issue for most of the guests. It’s uncomfortable. And not enjoyable.

reviews.author: Traveller & Foodie
reviews.title: Back to this hotel after five years - third visit in fifteen years
reviews.text: I came here for business meetings again, not by choice. Five years later and I get an outdated room again. Maybe some rooms are renovated but don't be fooled by the website pictures. My friend's room ceiling collapsed while she was in the room because of water damage.   She was lucky not to get hurt.   The hotel changed her room and upgraded to the V.I.P section.   My room had two queen beds.  The balcony overlooking the lagoon was not very appealing; the chairs were dirty, and so was the balcony, but great views. I also called to complain I had no hot water; the receptionist told me to let the water run longer. I took cold showers during my whole stay.   The buffet restaurant had a good selection of food. The wine in the all-inclusive package was horrible. We could order wine; however, if it is all-inclusive, please have decent wine for the guests. The restaurants were ok, not fine cuisine but acceptable. The pools and the beach are lovely; come early to find good chairs. The lobby where you check in is charming, then the main area in the middle of the hotel is a central jungle of plants; that produces too much humidity. In fifteen years, I have been here three times. I think it's time they change this look. Although the hotel seemed short-staffed, most employees I ran into were always pleasant at the bar and restaurants. I have to add I appreciated the coffee shop at the exit to the main pool area with muffins and donuts. I tried to change my room, but because it's a group reservation, the staff told me it was impossible. The best part of this hotel is the ocean view rooms, pool area and beach views. Depending on which room you get once you check in can change your experience.

reviews.author: Janet H
reviews.title: Our stay in reserve
reviews.text:
My review just returned home 8/29- 9/3
We arrived on a Monday landed at 1130 and were at the hotel by 1230 there was no traffic getting to the hotel ... We checked in at the main lobby reserve area .
We had to wait a bit and asked for margaritas. Nothing was offered....  Andres our concierge met us I can not say enough good things about him very attentive .. stayed with us the whole time we were there and then we were escorted to our room  we were in 5504 Lagoon view because my boyfriend wanted to look out at the night life instead of a black ocean... when I tell you we were never in our room only to sleep it was fine. The room was
A little warm asked for a fan but more for noise since the club rosa negra across the way was hopping every night.  First day We headed to pool Jennifer got us a cabana  she was awesome gave us ice pops reserved our beds for the week which we never did not have one it was so empty.

Lunch box night one not good really.  Out to oasis casino...Tuesday had our cabana early  ate breakfast buffet one and only time. Not my thing.
2nd night Cielo was very good.out on town to La isla and sky zone ferris wheel and casino.
Wednesday we did a jungle tour at 9 came back and were able to get a bed since it was empty in reserve again. That night Cappella fantastic.
Thursday rained on and off we took a bus downtown at 8 am to go shopping then up by the forum area. Great time 
Back to hotel by 230 and another Bali bed again empty.
Thursday night was Sals it was pretty good atmosphere very quiet empty actually I  Got the lobster and it was good but his rib eye not so good.
Friday pool all day at Bali bed a very noisy crowd showed and  kind of ruined the zen of the week.plus non reserve guests were with them and somehow were given bracelets right at the pool so they could stay.

All week we ate breakfast in reserve something light or Sante. 
Lunch was always at the beds but did have Aguamarina once the coconut shrimp and cerviche were outstanding. 
All week Andres touched base was very helpful. Even when our door didn't work he helped get security to reprogram
Offered help with our reservation to Rosa negra Friday night , which I already had booked on my own. Our last night was fantastic there. We walked across the street, the show the people the food amazing.
Highly recommend and it was cheaper than the extras at Sals believe it or not.

Drinks ..Great always ordered top shelf ! At reserve pool Ruben is terrific!
Even out of reserve for drinks everywhere at first they said no Belvedere etc but saw our bracelets then said yes.

Transfer to airport 830 for 12 15 flight no traffic we were at the gate by 915!!
Too early
Complaints...pool is tired skimmers don't work the pool level is low barely any filtration there.  Things floating around yuck.

The stairs to beach by restrooms are  dangerous a couple I met the woman fell on last day and was in a wheelchair to airport.

Our bed was terrible hard as a rock!

I slept about 4 hours every night if that.
Lighting in room too dark.
Coffee refills hard to get in room also.
The koi ponds water levels too low my bf builds them at home and was worried about the water levels.
It's a little warm in lobby but I could handle it . Others complained a lot. It's tropical I get it. But I didn't mind
All in all a great trip we walked alot!
All over town out and about 4 out of 5 nights.
I cant really comment on the hotel at night since we always went out.but towards end of week it was very busy..
If not in reserve I would have hated this whole trip.i like peace and quiet and adults only type experience. And reserve was perfect.
I will not be back to cancun since I've been 7 times.
But may visit the melia in DR
Next time.

reviews.author: brianlazerus
reviews.title: August trip in Cancun. Paradisus was great!
reviews.text:
Did a RCI extra vaca for a 2-bedroom and was given just that. It was a 3 room lock-off with the center being a living room, kitchen and bathroom. 

We had a friendly concierge (Janick) who was not too pushy as I know he wanted us to attend timeshare presentations but we declined. All reservations we wanted, we got thanks to Janick. 

We had ocean front rooms that could use a little updating but the size of the accommodations made up for any minor improvements that could be made.

Each room had HD flatscreens that we could hook up xbox or usb drives to for in room entertainment. Had 10+ channels of TV in English. 

Housekeeping was great each day. No concerns with valuables at all but each room had a safe if needed.

Room Service is $5 per and nothing great to speak of. 

The buffet was solid for breakfast each day with friendly service, omelet station, french toast, fruit and surprisingly good coffee. Thank you Janek, Manuel, Alfredo (bird caller) and Joni. 

The Italian restaurant Cappella was very good with the exception of the polenta with my beef short rib. Son loved the linguini gamberi (shrimp pasta). My wife enjoyed the carbonara. Great service from Javier and Omar as we dined there twice. 

Celio is a authentic mexican restaurant and we once again received great good and service. Thank you Moises for the menu tips/advice. Highlights include the marinated pork leg, sea bass, and shrimp dish once again for my son.

For lunch nearly every day we had tacos at the Blue Agave. 

Another dinner highlight was Agua Marina. I don't eat fish so I inquired what the steak w/gravy was. Bonus, it was a delicious filet with a nice potato on the side. Had a nice football convo with Francisco who used to live in Texas. Sons favorite meal from the whole trip was the shrimp shawarma. We had dinner here twice as well and had great service from both Francisco and Henry. 

I enjoyed the teriyaki options from Lemon Fish but the seafood lovers were not impressed with sushi or other dishes. 

Lunchbox for lunch has a decent menu but the service and food was not up to the standards of the other restaurants on this trip. 

Whiskey/scotch options include Jim and Jack, Jameson, Chivas, Red Label, Ballantines, J&B and maybe a few others. No longer have a single malt, black label or a decent bourbon. 

24-hour espresso stand with nespresso drink, pastries and sandwiches. Richar was very friendly and even helped me break down larger bills for tips. 

All in all it was better than expected with weather, room selection, service and food. Thanks to all involved for a great trip.

reviews.author: Danielle V
reviews.title: Great food & even better service
reviews.text: Cesar at Lemon Fish went above & beyond to make our meal perfecto! He was enjoyable & was on every request & more! Our favorites were the ceviche, the chicken karage bao, & the tuna tar tar tacos. Thank you, Cesar!

reviews.author: Vladimir A

reviews.text:

reviews.author: Jorge V
