reviews.text: Miguel and Jorge were absolutely marvelous ! Service was first class and the food selections were awesome. Great experience! We will certainly come back next time we visit Paradisus. A job well done. Kudos to the chef and definitely to Miguel.

reviews.author: Isamia0715
reviews.title: Didi Is The Best
reviews.text: Didi at poolside was such a great experience. He was very attentive and friendly. Always checking in and making sure we had everything we needed at all times. Make sure you ask for DiDi at the main pool

reviews.author: Heather A
reviews.title: Family stay
reviews.text:
The whole stay was amazing. Gracias a Romero, Rafael. Didi, and those housekeeping staff that made our 4 night stay so memorable. 

We went with our 3 year old and stayed in the reserve, our concierge team Mauricio and Levi helped us make reservations for all the restaurants, pool beds, and brought cookies and milk as well as a robe and slippers for our little girl. 

We went to Chichén Itzá with Otium and it was a long day but totally worth it. 

I also want to shout out Daniela my masseuse for giving me back 10 years of my life-incredible massage! Definitely don’t sleep on the spa services as the spa has a hydrotherapy section.

reviews.author: Fernando C
reviews.title: Dream catcher
reviews.text: My wife and I was looking forward to this Awesome activity. Keren came out to our Bali bed and helped us 1 on 1 and made some really cool dream catchers. My wife caught on quick, but I was having a tougher time, and keren had all the patience with me to make sure it came out great.

reviews.author: Czolg
reviews.title: Great AI resort with lots of fun
reviews.text:
Together with my 2 daughters (6 & 10) and wife we spent a week in Paradisus. Even though this is all inclusive facility we decided to go even one level up and went for Reserved experience. In Paradisus Reserved level (kind of upscale VIP service) is located in a separate tower/piramide, has its own lobby, reception and small, but very well equipped bar and self service food corner. On top the that you are having variety of additional services like unlimited access to theme restaurants (and 2 only for Reserved guests), special Reserved only pool area (separate pool with cabanas around and very nice bar & day restaurant that kids has NO access, which we considered negative as we were with 2). As a Reserved guest you can also have free of additional charge cabana in main pool or main kids pool area. The negative is that you can book them only 2 during your stay and in other occasions you need to put yourself on the waiting list and count on availability after 11 am.) As a Reserve guest you are also allocated to personal concierge that is suppose to help you with anything you might want during your stay. In our occasion I have to admit the concierge was pretty slow and did not accommodate properly to our requests/suggestions (i.e. preferred dinner time => our 6 YO is falling asleep after 8 PM so reserving restaurant for 8:30 or even 7:30 was not that convenient). 
Room was very nice, furnished in light colors and well equipped. We went for a bay view which was not the best option due to the fact that bay in on the other side of the garden, road and water sport center... so we saw a bay but not as you might see in the hotel's www ;-) Room service very good, with exception of night service which sometimes happened and sometimes not. 
Food is generally great in Paradisus. All theme restaurants were really good and run on the high, International level. One cannot really feel "hotel-like" feeling in the restaurants (except the main one). I guess we liked the most lunch restaurant in the Reserved pool area and restaurant Lunch Box for dinner (however Cevicheria and Mexican were also top). Breakfast was spectacular! I cannot recall similarly vast variety and quality at the same time anywhere else.  Maybe only coffee might have been a bit better ;-) 
The whole day activities and fun were offered in a way I like which means everybody knows what is happening, level of activities was very high and noone is pushing you to do anything :-)  My kids loved kids club activities and we enjoyed few nice evening ones (especially good one was deaf disco => participants were provided with headphones, there were 3 live DJs and everybody could choose which DJ they are listening. So much fun dancing in a group that is adjusting their moves to 3 completely different types of music and rhythm! 
Service in the hotel is perfect (even with below expectations private concierge). There is nothing they will not do to make you feel good and cherished. 
Our kids (both of them :-)) had little accidents and in both cases hotel behaved perfectly. 
I would have one suggestion to avoid shop located in the hotel. Even though service also there is very friendly and nice, prices are simply ridiculous. I paid USD 35 for a small bottle of Nivea sun cream :-) You should expect 3 times higher prices than in the shop on the other side of the street (you just need to go out of the hotel, walk through the garden and cross the street => 5 minutes one way). The shop is also 7 times more expensive (seven!) on the souvenirs items comparing to Mexico City or even Chitzen Itza.  
Overall we loved the resort and we would recommend it to anyone travelling to Cancun!

reviews.author: MjIsa
reviews.title: LemonFish (Rafael)
reviews.text: Hands down one of the better restaurants at El Paradisus in CanCun. From the shrimp ceviche to the short rib tacos. The selection was unique, fresh and delicious. Rafael was very attentive, knowledgeable and friendly.

reviews.author: Steven O.
reviews.title: Lemongrass
reviews.text: We went with our family here including 4 children.  Great ambience and the service was fantastic.  Rafael took great care of our table and family. I highly suggest visit the restaurant.  Sushi platter and short time tacos, can't go wrong

reviews.author: Marion C
reviews.title: Lemon Fish Restaurant
reviews.text: Rafael was amazing! Made our night enjoyable! Thank you for a wonderful night! Food was amazing. He was very helpful with selections. Definitely gave us 5 star treatment. Can’t wait to come back again

reviews.author: ash a
reviews.title: Cocktails at Ginger Bar
reviews.text: 5 stars ⭐️ to Pedro and team @gingerbar!! He has treated us with delicious cocktails for past week. One of our favorites is his newest creation “Guava n Love”. Also try Chili Mezcal. Thank you Sofonia for excellent service. Must visit ginger bar at Paradisus Cancun and ask for Pedro!!

reviews.author: Paul in KY
reviews.title: Paradipartying at The Paradisus
reviews.text:
Had an ocean view room on 6th floor of the central pyramid. There with my wife & young son. Had a great time. Room was very clean & staff was so polite and hard working.

Food was copious and great. All restaurants, except the Italian one, were 1st class. Ocean was beautiful & warm. There were a couple days when the seaweed basically stopped you from getting in. The municipal cleaning crew did what they could in this regard.

The daycare for our son (and other kids) was great & the staff running it really did great by the kids.

Have a few quibbles I will share below that stopped me from giving a 5 star review. This one would be about 4.5, but they don't let you do a half star:

The pool (which was very large) had 3 jacuzzis built in. Unfortunately the pool water needed to be about 6 inches higher, as the jets would be spraying above the water surface. This caused you to not use the jacuzzi, which was a bummer.

This may be something to do with the COVID, but when you were on the beach to the left of the main egress to the beach, there was no staff service. If this was planned, they needed to inform via signage, IMO.

Some of the cabanas needed maintenance & although the fixes seemed quite simple (nail a table back to pole), were not done while we were there.

One of the elevators had a malfunction (could not get it to go to lowest floor when you pushed the button). They were informed of this on day 2 of stay. On day 7, the malfunction still existed.

Would not use the Otium Taxi Service associated with the property. They were substandard.

reviews.author: roger
reviews.title: Service is top notch
reviews.text: 3rd time staying at this resort because the service is excellent . We stayed in a Reserve room & were blown away by Ruth Avila . She is so attentive and easy to contact . I can't see myself not staying in Reserve ever again and will request her again. Great experience a d she is so pleasant

reviews.author: Katiuska2013
reviews.title: Did not meet expectation
reviews.text: I traveled from 9/16/21 to 9/21/21. On 9/16 was my boys birthday and I said on the reservation we were celebrating their birthday but yet  there was no courtesy birthday acknowledgement on their part which of course they don't have to but it would have been a nice surprise for the boys. There are a lot of employees at the reception area but they don't seem to know what they are doing and it takes an insane amount of time to check in. The rooms were not ready so we went to eat and came back. It was already 4pm and rooms were not ready which was odd because the hotel was nearly empty but after waiting another hour they finally gave us the room. By the way the lobby area where the beautiful garden in the center is supposed to be was under construction so no nice pictures or entertainment. Once we got the room it seems they gave us the worst room they had on that floor and the key was not working. I went to the lobby at least 3 times to get it reset and also after giving complaints about the room being too hot, the lock in the bathroom and balcony being broken, they gave us another room which was also outdated, small, the beds are full size not queen, the safe was not working which I informed them about but didn't do anything to fix it, etc. The buffet is all the same every day. The restaurants I did not like any of them. I did not try Sal because it was extra charge and it seemed excessive. You don't get any attention unless you upgrade or buy a timeshare. You have to constantly tip the staff to get some kind of decent service otherwise they don't come to ask you if you want anything while you are at the pool or beach. Junior lagoon suite is jut a room with two full size beds and a mini fridge. Not impressed and will not be coming back.

reviews.text: La palapa is now Sante but the food and service is still excellent. Thank you to Diego and Maria who we only just met.  A special  Thank you to Valeria and Moises who have been making our stay perfect for years now. Hope to see you all again March 2022!!!

reviews.text: We had a great time at Paradisis resort. We had great food. Most nights we ended up at the ginger bar. Wendy took care of us many nights in a row. She was fantastic. She always took care of us. We had a great time.

reviews.author: pushpak P

reviews.text: Carlos Chay , Veronica Mendoza ,and Javier Jimenez are awesome. Great service at Malva restaurant. Pool bar has amazing service. Best place to come in Mexico. We really had a grate time. They work very hard to provide vegetarian options for couple of our family.

reviews.author: Raj P
reviews.title: Amazing service

reviews.author: Emily H
reviews.title: Wonderful trip!
reviews.text:
What can I say about the last 8 days to sum up our experience??! 
It was awesome!   The service is wonderful, the food was amazing! Views spectacular! 

We stayed in the reserve side.  A definite if you can swing the extra $$.    We loved that there weren't kids on that side so all you hear from your Bali bed were conversations and the ocean.  I'm glad the party and daily DJ were on the other side, we could join that when we wanted to.  We had 2 concierges that split our week.    They accommodated every request.  Dinner reservations, room change requests etc. Big thank you to Ceci (Ce-CHI!) and Violeta! 

Sante restaurant was our favorite for breakfast and lunch.  It's in the reserve, so quiet and wonderful. Amazing food on the patio under shade with an amazing view.  (see photos) The menus are at this resort are creative and wonderful.  We noted at the pool that those complaining about the food didn't even try anything!  They didn't recognize anything on the menu and would leave!  What a shame.  If you are looking to eat American food all week and hotdogs, go somewhere else. We were NOT disappointed with anything we ordered the entire week.  (And we are foodies and travelers) Everything was cooked perfectly from lamb to steak to fish.  They are extremely accommodating- anything you want, they will do it so just ask.  We would combine favorite menu items together etc.  Hats off the chefs here.  It was great!
Pool service on the reserve side was unbeatable.  Thank you to Lucas, the pool concierge,  for getting our bali bed everyday with a smile!  Because we were there for 8 days we had different wait staff at Sante for breakfast and for the pool.  A huge shout out to Valeria, Ruben, Moises, Joel, Julio, Josue, Yamil, and Maria!  And to Oscar for sharing your love of Tequila, the amazing history lesson and taste testing!   We appreciate Tequila now!  They were ALL fabulous.   Seriously, thank you everyone. 

The absolute only thing I can complain about is it is definitely hot in the lobby.  It's structured like a botanical garden so beautiful and unique, but humid like a greenhouse.  I don't know if this is on purpose or something needs to be fixed.  It did make dining at the buffet during the day uncomfortable (its fine at night) and the Italian restaurant, which is located in a side part of the main lobby, is very warm in there.  Some restaurants have outdoor seating only so make reservations about 8pm when the sun is down.  It's pleasant and they have fans.   Sals and Blue Agave have great air conditioning as well as the sports bar in Ginger lounge.
We did have to call for a fan in our room which helped tremendously.  If you like it cold when you sleep, the rooms do not get colder than 70/71, a common theme among those we met also.  The Asian restaurant is under construction in the middle of the lobby.  
No place is perfect and this would not keep us from coming back!  We miss it already.  Melia has not disappointed us thus far.  We enjoyed this as much as Spain and Orlando.

reviews.author: sarah a

reviews.text: Not only is Paradisus a gorgeous all inclusive resort with great food and top shelf liquor it is also the most hospitable! The staff was next to none! Anything we needed was at our fingertips and the staff was all smiles. Very impressed with how well the resort managed COVID with disinfecting and being so careful. Thanks so much to Sofania, Wendy, Roque, Carlos, Enrique (best bar staff ever!) and Cristian Sanchez (buffet waiter). You guys made our trip extra special! We can’t wait to return in February for another week! I’d also like to thank the kids club! Our daughter loved going! The Lifeguards who wrapped my wife’s foot up when she injured it. Security team who made sure we were comfortable. reviews.author: C B
reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: This was our 2nd time staying at this resort and one other couples 3rd time. We love this resort. We always stay in the adults only section (Royal Service & All Inclusive), so the other sections I don't know about, but Royal service is worth it! You get a butler that will help you make your dinner reservations,  Bali bed reservations and any other requests you have, like particular drinks you want in your room or anything really.  The staff are always so attentive and seem like they genuinely want to make you happy. We have stayed at another resort in Cancun where this was not the feeling you got from the staff. The hotel is clean, smells great and beautiful. The food is pretty good, not amazing but still enjoyable.  The drinks are great and you get as many as you want Haha. All and all we would return again and all 8 people who went, want to go back too. So that's a good sign. There is only one other hotel we have been to in Cancun that gets the edge up because of food, but we have had a great time at Paradisus both times now!

Jorge the mixology teacher taught us how to make delicious drinks & Anczel, our activities guy was a great host. He organized vball and water polo for us to play and made it very fun. reviews.author: Jennifer M
reviews.title: Amazing honeymoon!
reviews.text: We have had such a great time at Paradisus Cancun. We loved the food especially Sante for lunch. Valeria, Moises, Yamil, and Joel were excellent and made great recommendations for food. I'm glad we have a few more days here so we can come back!

reviews.author: Justin
reviews.title: Paradisus - premium moments
reviews.text: Guendoline from Premium moments helped me surprise my girlfriend with an amazing birthday bouquet of flowers! Paradisus also gave us a beautiful romantic dinner with cake and champagne. Thanks so much, our experience was amazing!!

reviews.author: Judith M Brousssard
reviews.title: Fuego Restaurante.
reviews.text:
Best Peruvian culinary experience. 
Chef Ricardo is outstanding. The food was delicious. 
Service from Antonio and Captain Guillermo was impecable.

reviews.author: jade1331
reviews.title: Great Resort!
reviews.text: Staff was super friendly. Resort had everything you need to stay and have a great time. The resort brings local vendors in for you to buy great souvenirs. There are also several places within the resort to buy and book excursion for a competitive price without being hassled about a presentation. If you choose to leave and do an excursion like we did you are usually the first stop back.

reviews.author: WynR
reviews.title: Not quite what we were expecting....
reviews.text:
Traveling with a young family during COVID, we were well prepared to be understanding of the challenges and roll with the punches but Cancun Paradisus was still a pretty big disappointment.

Young families - this is not the hotel for you. The general pool is a full on party with tons of smoking, guests that bring their own boom boxes and loudly blare competing music and occasional pot smoking. We spent all of our time at the small kids pool which bored my 4 year old, but I didn't love the noise/smoke at the other pool.

Family concierge was also a huge disappointment. We had a few small requests upon arrival (i.e. to switch out the feather pillows for my husband who is allergic, a bottle opener for the water in the room that requires a bottle opener to open it) and each time it took several hours and several attempts to get a response. After our first day, we reached out a few additional times (i.e. to make dinner reservations which are required everywhere ) and were told we had to call ourselves from our hotel room between 9am - 5pm. However, with the kids, our preferred schedule was to go out early and be back midday for a nap. Sometimes by the time we were back, we were told the restaurants were "sold out" (for 6pm!) even though they always seemed empty.  The concierge service seems like a huge scam as all she did  was send us the days activities and request meetings to talk through joining the Club Melia  (though reading some of the reviews, other families appear to have more luck).

The food is fine. The hotel (as described elsewhere) is fine though showing quite a bit of wear and tear but for the price, there are several better options in Cancun, especially if you have young kids.

reviews.author: Kindel
reviews.title: Amazing Staff
reviews.text:
We had a lovely, relaxing time at The Paradisus Playa del Carmen for a corporate event September 16-20, 2021. The staff was exceptionally polite and helpful. Everyone always had their masks on and could speak very good English. Lots of cleaning being done all the time and it was super convenient to have COVID testing on site. We felt very safe here. 

Special shout out to Ivan who served us at the Market Restaurant, Luis at Fuego and our favorite Jose at the Water 💦 Park for the incredible and personal service. 

Mil gracias Jose para el servicio rápido y amigable. Nuestros mejores deseos a ti y tu familia.

reviews.author: Kevin Herrera
reviews.title: Fuego
reviews.text:
The food was great!  Attentive service. The quality of service is beyond expectation. Guillermo was very nice. The experience from the moment you enter to the end, absolutely amazing. Miguel our waiter on his first day on the job was absolutely on point to making sure you are having a great experience. 
Thank you Fuego staff 
We will forever remember our experience & recommend to friends and family
-Camarena•Herrera Family

reviews.author: Monique A
reviews.title: Another great stay at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
This is 4th time my husband and I stayed at Paradisus Cancun in the last two years with the Melia Club which we belong ; this time I only put 4 stars as some disappointment began when we arrive at the Club and start our checking process; this time we invited our cousins as we wanted to share the great experience and professionalism  we always received from the Cancun resort but our concierge didn’t show up until next day and the girl in the front desk  whom my husband had a hard time explaining he made the reservations under a promotion  and did with the reservations club since past Aug ( which in the system should be documented as all major companies such as Melia reputation do in the world) she just just insisted that if he didn’t show an email with that promotion she couldn’t honor that ! 

Besides this fist hiccup , we had a great time and just the amazing service of great employees who really know about service and how to make you feel special , big apologies just to mention a few:
Julio from Reserve
Victor with his always big smile and Nurbi and Antonio from the pool and Kanna Bar
Alejandra the Supervisor from Melva Buffet and his team 
Martin, Raul , Johnny and Atilano
Karen and Cristian chefs from Melva Buffet

The room always was immaculate clean thanks of the great effort of the cleaning staff whom always had a great smile and made a heart signal to recognize you were greeting them 
The bartenders at night also superb and the coffee stand staff too … like I said there is too much to mention about the great staff that works really hard to make you feel special and have a wonderful vacation time!

reviews.author: 69w
reviews.title: Perfecto! But...
reviews.text:
Great place! Huge! 5 Piramides! We've asked for a quite room and were placed on the top (6th) floor in the Piramide One. Didn't disappoint, slept well all nights. It takes about 3 minutes to get to it's center area (Piramide 2) from there... I put 5 stars hotel rating because I enjoyed my vacation time there and appreciated the hard work and hospitality of its Staff. However, there are few items that could have been better/improved.
The hotel is doing some renovations here-and-there. But overall in a good shape and well maintained. Some furniture is ready for replacement, but not a big deal. One comes to Cancun for the Sun, Beach and Pool. Those are "Perfecto"! The pool is the largest in Cancun I think. Never was crowded. The beach is clean. But we couldn't relax due to loud noise coming from "reserved area" speakers, VERY LOUD club music! 
The day and night entertainment was awesome! 
The food is nothing to brag about. Actually, it was the worst we've tried in Cancun, buffet meat dishes couldn't cut by knife...

COVID TESTS: 
- We asked about Covid test at check-in. For a basic antigen test we got a QR-code with URL to a  Google form to schedule an appointment. It's free (covered by hotel). Submitted the form for "antigen test" and within 30 minutes received an email confirmation with appointment date and time. Tests are done in the hotel's convention center. In the first room you show your passport and sign a paper form, in the second room a nurse does the actual collection. Everything is very well organized, test was done within 5-10 minutes. The results were emailed as PDF within several hours (later asked the reception to print the PDFs for us).
- Covid PCR test. We had to come to a concierge (in reception area) to schedule a PCR test. The test completed by an outsource medical company in your room at scheduled date and time. Cost: $125 USD or pesos (cash only). We filled out and signed paper form. Received an email with an appointment date and within 12 hours. The nurse was in our room right on time (5 minutes earlier). Test took about 5 minutes. After 9 hours received an email with PDF test result. All good!

Buttom line: If you plan to go to Paradisus, give it a try.

reviews.author: mskesq
reviews.title: Birthday Week
reviews.text:
Our Fifth Time at Paradisus, or as we call it Paradise.  Driving up to the Hotel in the shuttle, I said to my Wife, “We are home!”  The trip was for us to celebrate my 60th Birthday and did the staff at Paradisus deliver!

We booked an ocean view junior suite in The Reserve.  We have been staying there since the Hotel was called the Gran Melia Cancun, and The Reserve was called Royal Service.  The service and amenities have changed very little and are always wonderful.  When we were checking in, we started to have an issue, however.  The room initially given to us was in Pyramid Three.  We said we wanted to be in the Reserve Section, Pyramid 5.  They changed the room but told us it was not yet ready for us, so we went to lunch at the Buffet.  The Buffet is ok.  There is nothing wrong with it, a nice variety and the food is fresh.  The Reserve has food set out in the mornings and then in the afternoon and evening.  Just little bites, cheese and meats, etc.  They have a full bar, and they are so attentive and obliging in making drinks.  The food does get monotonous, as it is always the same, but it is nice for a little snack on the way to your room, or late afternoon.

We were told our room was ready midafternoon.  We have stayed in this type of room, and it is beautiful.  Last visit we must have stayed in a larger suite, as this room did not have the free-standing tub, but otherwise the room is the same.  Just a quick tangent, but it seems that bathrooms in hotels lately do not have the best lighting.  This one is in line with that.

One change with respect to The Reserve is that it previously was Adults Only.  Management has changed that to allow children to stay in The Reserve.  Children are still not permitted in the Adult Only Pool, however.

The Adult Only Pool has the lovely Palapas around it.  Lucas and his partner (Maxx?) are terrific in taking care of setting you up with towels.  They are professional and friendly.

Our first day at the pool Yamil took care of us.  He was great.  Never had to look for him as he was always checking in on us.

Violeta was our concierge/valet.  She made all the reservations for dinner each night and took care of anything else that came up.

As I indicated, my Birthday was during the stay.  We arrived on Saturday and Sunday was my Birthday.  Saturday, we had Dinner at Mole.  Such a great restaurant.  They brought out a special dessert to celebrate my Birthday!

Sunday (my actual Birthday), Diego, who was supervising the pool came over to me to wish me a happy birthday and had a bottle of sparkling wine brought to our Palapa.  We went out of the resort for dinner that night (La Habichuela – an amazing place).

The Birthday theme carried over all week.  Every day at the pool, I was wished a Happy Birthday! We ate at Fuego for dinner, they had another bottle of sparkling wine brought for us.  The Waiter, whose name I cannot remember but might have been Ricardo, was so exuberant and enthusiastic.

We also ate at Enso.  That was good, we had sashimi and sushi.  We had Dinner at the Italian Restaurant, that was just average.  We were supposed to eat at Mole again, but we decided that since the reservation was for 6:30 that it was too early and I was not really feeling up to it, that we would go to the Buffet for dinner about 7:30.  Dinner there was just average, not really much better than the lunch.  However, the Maitre’d of the Buffet came over to us while we were eating to ask if we knew we had a reservation at Mole and did we not go because we did not like the Menu there.  We told her that we loved Mole, but just did not feel like it that night.  The waiters surprised me with a special dessert in the Buffet for my Birthday!

We had breakfast and usually lunch at Sante, the Restaurant by the Adult Only Pool.  The staff there is amazing.  From Diego to Maria (the Maitre’d), as well as Luis, Oscar (they also took care of us at the Palapa) Valaria, and the rest of them.  The food was always hot for breakfast and lunch, and the service was top notch.

On Friday was had lunch at Blue Agave.  The taco restaurant.  Ahmed was amazing.  He kept bringing Margaritas as soon as we were finished with one, and the tacos were great as well.  We also went to the Margarita Workshop at the Ginger Bar one afternoon.  We were the only ones there. Rpque and his partner bartender, Carlos, showed us the best way to make Margaritas!

Overall, we had an amazing week, and I felt like my Birthday was celebrated the entire time.  We can not wait to go back “home” again.

reviews.author: Daniela G
reviews.title: ME ENCANTO!!
reviews.text: I loved it so much!! This hotel was spectacular. The service, food, drinks! & organization was just perfect. The buffet had really good food we were so happy with our service from Gaudencio & Ramiro! They were the best 🥰 definitely would come again!!!

reviews.author: Alessandro Pacitti
reviews.title: Amazing!!!!
reviews.text:
This review is well overdue! 

First off I need share compliments for amazing restaurant service by:
-Jose Palesti, Sonia Correa, Teresa de Jesus and Roberto Islas. 
When we arrived at the restaurant, we did not have an appointment as we believed we were at the buffet that would be open. So Jose right away took care of my family and said he would get us a table at the Italian restaurant (which he did) :)

Another special thank you goes to our hotel greeter (I believe his name was George) he is tall and welcomed us to the hotel and made sure we received a nice room. 

Also a huge thank you to Amayrani who was the friendliest restaurant greeter. Her smile made our day every morning :)

Ok so now to the review,

Hotel: 
Super Clean! Everything was sanitized and we felt very safe considering Covid 19. 
The hotel staff were very diligent and made sure even the wheels on our suit cases were sanitized!!! We absolutely loved all of the towers in the hotel. They are very beautiful with an amazing atmosphere. 

Food: 
Amazing. We absolutely loved the Italian restaurant. The Mexican restaurant was great too! If you like seafood, the Japanese restaurant was SO delicious and the food/sushi was ultra fresh! 

Room: 
Very cozy and clean. No complaints at all. The beds are comfortable.

Beach: 
Absolutely amazing. The beach was very clean, the bar is nicely situated at the front before you walk down which is convenient. 

Pools: Beautiful :) There was awesome deep house music playing for most of the day and our family loved it!!!! The DJ was really nice to share the playlist with us!

Bars: The bars are great. Friendly bartenders! FYI they have grey goose and belvedere, you just need to ask for it!

Club/Entertainment: Great! There was almost always an event every night and the dancers/performers were really good. Great for kids and Adults!

Overall experience: We really enjoyed our trip and would definitely return. 
Tip: watch out for the timeshare offers as it can be persuasive just like any other hotel :P

Thank you so much team Paradisus, we will soon see you again!

Alessandro Pacitti

reviews.author: Paula D
reviews.title: Going home

reviews.author: Yahel222
reviews.title: Fuego!
reviews.text: The best option while you are here. Jonathan is the best at attention to detail. The manager Guillermo was awesome. We would dine here any day. It’s simply amazing. Please go to this restaurant, you won’t regret it.

reviews.author: Paolo Villanueva
reviews.title: Memories that will last forever
reviews.text: We celebrated our daughter’s 3rd birthday in Cancun and choosing Paradisus Cancun as our home for this milestone gave us way more than we expected of the majestic Cancun. The place is Paradise. The accommodation, the overall vibe, the food and heartwarming employees made our short vacation very memorable. Omar and Hugo from Cappella, Alfredo Avcos, Alexis Ozuna, Janeth, Armando y Armando, and all the staffs and management team of Malva from the welcoming of the hostesses to table sitting and outstanding customer care, Richer of the Expresso bar, Blue Agave and Enso staffs (i wish i could have taken all their names), the cleaning staffs, bellboys and people in the welcome and check out counters… Paradisus Cancun, you are doing everything right. Right from the moment we stepped in the hotel and lifting our last foot off, happiness is all I can remember. Truly, our daughter and our family will cherish this memory and wonderful people forever. We will come back again! God bless you all.

reviews.author: Kboyce24
reviews.title: Mother son trip
reviews.text: I stayed at Paradisus Cancun for 5 days and 4 nights with my son who is 17. We upgraded to the Junior Ocean View Suite Reserve and it was worth the price to upgrade. We stayed in Pyramid 5. The rooms were clean. We had an ocean view from our balcony which was amazing. Armando was our concierge and he made us feel welcome and comfortable from the beginning. He booked our dinner reservations, our poolside cabanas, and took care of any issues that arose during our stay immediately. He offered great recommendations during our stay and made us feel like we knew each other for years. He was a pleasure to be able to work with. The resort was very clean and the food was good. The decor of the resort was beautiful. Juan the waiter in Fuego was amazing and very accommodating. All of the staff were personable and very friendly. I look forward to visiting again. I would highly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Jasmin B
reviews.title: Birthday in Cancún Paradisus
reviews.text: Our first vacation since Covid and it was very relaxing! We came to celebrate my sisters 40th birthday and stayed at Paradisus Cancun, for the 4th time. Although the hotel is being renovated in some areas, our stay was very pleasant thanks to the following: Armando in the Malva Buffet, Lucero in Concierge, and Luis, Victor, Axcel, Sergio & Julian while outside by the pool. Their attention and service was great and made our stay very enjoyable.  Thank you again for everything! Gracias por todo!

reviews.author: Anthony I
reviews.title: Malva cenas

The manager, Carlos, was very professional and hands on. Chef Alex prepared a wonderful seafood and ribeye steak platter that was to die for. It was definitely a taste of Mexico. reviews.author: Kyle

reviews.author: Marlin O

reviews.author: CharnaeY1
reviews.title: Vow Renewal at Paradisus
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience at Paradisus. The resort is breathtaking and my Vow Renewal was absolutely Beautiful. Ana was my wedding coordinator and she went above and beyond to make sure my Vow Renewal was perfect. She steamed my dress for me and my guest even raved about how nice she was to them. I had 32 family who traveled from North Carolina to Cancun and they all truly loved the Vow Renewal Ceremony and had an amazing time at Paradisus.

reviews.author: Stacy M
reviews.title: Nice stay at Paradisus
reviews.text: We had a really nice time on our delayed anniversary trip. The staff we encountered were great. In particular Guadicio at Malva, he was the best and always went out of his way for us. Orlando in the morning, Jorge for dinner too from Malva and Jonathan from Fuego were also awesome. Our concierge Ivan, as well as a ton assistance from Juan Carlos and advice on getting off the beaten path from Abel- he told us we could go to the mall at home, lol, all looked out for us. The resort was clean, and we only had 1 night where our room was warm. My only complaint would be if they were not at full capacity, maybe they should not put people in the main atrium. The construction noise was pretty bad during the day when we wanted to cool off some from the heat we were in room 3565 and our room pretty much faced the atrium. Also, if you stay in that building you will  here the nightly music and entertainment at least we did from our room, but didn't mind that much as we enjoyed the nightly shows. All  in all a good trip and we'd definitely recommend the Paradisus as a resort to visit!

reviews.author: Daniel K
reviews.title: Super bueno hotel y service es perfecto
reviews.text: I would like to thank Violetta and Wen for their super service during our stay. I loved everything about the hotel and i would love to come here again. Mexico treated me very nice. Also the restaurants were good, comparing it to other hotels.

reviews.author: Jackson T
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Had a great stay at paradisus. The staff all are so generous, kind, and fun (particularly Antonio, Wendy, Raphael, David, Hugo, Daniela, and many others). The food and drink were all good. We particularly enjoyed Fuego.

reviews.author: Gabby L
reviews.title: Vacations 2021
reviews.text: My daughter's and I had an amazing trip in cancun at Paradisus Resort. We really enjoyed the service and hospitality that the workers provided.  They were awesome, very attentive especially at the resorts pool. Agustin and Dael from the entertainment section were super nice and showed us a really fun time. Julio, Tony, Lucas, Max, just to name a few we're full of good vibes, great service, and awesome personalities. We couldn't have asked for a better time. Can't wait to come back!!

reviews.author: vacationers
reviews.title: Relaxing getaway
reviews.text:
There were a few people who made this trip amazing! One was our server at the buffet, Martin who made us feel like family. He was so easy to talk to and really made our trip! Another shout out to Norma at the front desk who was kind and very helpful with all of our requests. I recommend doing the spa, it was such a relaxing experience.  Victor at concierge was another person who made this trip one to remember and helped make a friend's birthday really special. 
The staff, in general, is very helpful and kind. Thank you for a relaxing week.

reviews.author: Candiago
reviews.title: It was Okay at best
reviews.text:
We visited Paradisus for a Birthday Getaway. We were a group of 7 (3 couples and 1 single traveler) Check in was not too bad but they do try to up sell everything and they make up prices as they go along.
One Couple opted for the reserve experience. The said it was great and the butler that was assigned to them was extremely attentive. They had a nice huge room for 2 nights but had to move due to a leak. They were moved to a room with twin beds and no ocean view. The resort said that was the only room available which I believe was B.S. We did not do reserve but upgraded our room to the "newer renovated" rooms for 150.00 the only difference was the furniture and bathroom style. The A.C. in all the rooms except for the reserve was HORRIBLE!!! this includes restaurants and lobby. The Ginger bar is where the shows and nightlife happens. it has a air conditioned area where you can drink and sit but the shows and DJ are in the open air area so no A.C. there. The shows were decent though. The drinks were okay as well some too sweet. Top shelf liquor is available with all inclusive. The Best thing about this resort for us was the food and "DIDI" the pool bar batender. For an all inclusive resort the food was very very good. Our least favorite restaurant would have to be the Italian restaurant. DIDI the Bartender/server was AMAZING! extremely attentive. He would bring drinks and food to us and would constantly come to see if we needed anything else. He was GREAT! In addition, the restaurant in the middle of the lobby is being renovated so there is construction going on throughout the day that can be loud. Covid testing was quick and easy as well. I personally would not be returning to the Paradisus Cancun because I feel there are better resorts for the money they are asking.

reviews.author: Sasha B
reviews.title: Lovely Get Away
reviews.text: We had a great get away in Cancun. It was very nice, I can say that the restaurants were very HOT! Like no air circulation. My husband was dying! We were helped by Joel at the pool on the Reserve side. He was great and went out of his way to make sure our stay was nothing less than amazing. He deserves a raise and a bonus! Also, Christian at the buffet was amazing. He made sure that they met every single little req

reviews.author: Vacationer542489
reviews.title: Good place Great views, great service
reviews.text:
Great views and great service.
Blue Agave was out favorite place. Filiberto was amazing and the chef anibal  made the best Tacos we every had, every day is taco tuesday here in blue agave.

Please do not fall for there membership sales people so pushy and so shady. Every time u say No they give a better deal. Its not like straight forward deal or offer reminds me when buying a car experience which definitely no one need in vacation. 

Finally, the place worth ur money and time  we will come back

reviews.author: karla h
reviews.title: Malva restaurante
reviews.text: Verónica, Javier, Alejandro and Francisco were amazing very single time. I loved that they were super attentive to our needs. Very happy with the managers. I only had one complaint, food was cold once but as soon as we brought it to the servers attention, the manager immediately visited our table and fixed the problem and went above and beyond. They make you feel very welcomed all the time. 100% recommended!

reviews.author: Kaitlyn C
reviews.title: Overall OK
reviews.text:
For the price we paid I am disappointed. Music blaring from 8:30-12am, impossible to sleep even with ear plugs and two pillows over my head. We were in pyramid 3. In the daytime there is roaring loud construction in the center of the hotel, we were not aware this would be happening. As many others say, be prepared to sweat like you've never sweat before. We talked to the front desk several times about the lack of air in our rooms and hand a handyman come in at least 4 times throughout our stay. The air kept going off and on because it's monitored through a switch on the back patio. We had a leak on the first day in our room and they came and fixed that also. Don't expect to be cool here it is very humid and rooms at best get to 72 or so, feels like 78 with the humidity. 

Food is good at the restaurants, buffet is subpar. Breakfast options are limited to the buffet- we got very bored of the same breakfast every day..

Service was great! Front desk really needs to improve but all over staff members or incredible!  This is the second time Ive been here and I would not return a third time.

reviews.author: Melanie D
reviews.title: Excellent service all around
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus Cancun for 4 days and Martin was super welcoming and accommodating at Melva during breakfast he made sure we had anything we wanted including making omelettes for us himself so we wouldn’t have to wait on line even though we didn’t mind.  We stayed at the reserve and our concierge was Victor and he truly went above and beyond for my fiancé’s birthday, he helped set up birthday decorations i brought for us in our room and also brought more decorations to make it look amazing.  he truly made this vacation an amazing one for us.

reviews.author: Gillian H
reviews.title: Nice hotel
reviews.text:
PROS:
Follows COVID precautions wonderfully
COVID testing on site
Beautiful hotel
Atrium in the middle of the hotel
Friendly staff
Great food
Outer areas are beautiful and relaxing
Drinks were good

CONS:
Construction in Atrium area
No air circulation in the lobby areas surrounding the Atrium - I would have loved to be able to sit and enjoy it more but it was stifling, especially wearing a mask.
Poor air circulation in the main Buffet Restaurant - The hotel should consider installing ceiling fans in the Buffet Restaurant and lobby around the Atrium
Prices for cabanas and beach chairs are too high

Mexico weather is more comfortable during winter in the US. In the summer months the heat can be very uncomfortable.

I will stay at the Paradisus again if I visit in the cooler months. Maybe then I will be able to enjoy the Atrium more.

reviews.author: Joseph N
reviews.title: Best Vacation at the Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
All the staff were exceptional. Excellent Covid protocols.  Lovely resort. Could use more Palm Trees but a lovely resort.  Thank you Violeta our concierge who made every day special. Special thanks to Victor the main pool concierge who also made us so comfortable and welcome.  Thank you Atilano.  You were always so attentive and great with our boys. You provide impeccable service with grace.

Thank you Paradisus!!  Well done during a challenging time.

Joseph & Marcie Neuberger

reviews.author: Robert Glenn Godwin
reviews.title: This hotel is ruined by new Management Mr. Diaz! Loyal employees fired after years of service and no one answers phones!
reviews.text: I've been going here for years and at least 10 times. We last went in April  of 2021 and found the new manager Mr Diaz had fired several long time employees and friends. We returned today and what a circus it has become! Rooms are dumps, phones unanswered and every employee brand new and learning their job. We left and went to Canopy by Hilton. Mel8e, you need to send this clown back to where he came from. He has ruined Paradisius Cancun! 0 stars!

reviews.author: David G
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: I went to Paradisus Cancún on August 2021 and it was just beautiful. When you first walk in, you get a beautiful view of the hotel and the hotel room was really clean and neat. The food was delicious and the pool is beautiful. I love the vibes that I got from that place. I am very happy with the service that they provided and a special shout-out to Ignacio Mendosa who attended us the whole time that we were there. He has been very kind and generous to us and if you do decide to go here, I recommend asking for Ignacio Mendosa who will be there for you for anything that you might need or to just recommend places to visit while you are there. I am very glad that I came to this beautiful hotel and got to meet Ignacio Mendosa!

reviews.author: Billg68bg
reviews.title: Excellent Cancun vacation
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed at the Paradisus Cancun August 21-28, 2021.

We have been to different parts of Mexico six times and to this specific resort three of those times.

Overall, the trip was fantastic and I truly recommend this resort.  I have only one major issue with the Paradisus and one minor one.  I will start with them to get them out of the way.

My major complaint is with the reservations staff, which needs retraining or replacement.  I dealt with @ four different people, prior to leaving for Mexico.  I was trying to nail down how the resort app works and get them to send me the information/link needed to pay our all-inclusive.  It took numerous phone calls and e-mails, many of which were never responded to.  I paid the all-inclusive and attempted several times to get confirmation from the resort without success.  We arrived at the resort still not knowing if they got paid from the payment center and, based on the actions/reactions of the staff checking us in, I don't think they had confirmation.  We brought our payment center receipt, e-mail from resort staff stating what to pay and our credit card receipt.  I suggest you do the same if you go there.  After that hiccup, things went smoothly.

The only minor issue I had was, the lobby is under complete reconstruction and that was a major draw for us, to this resort.  I know restoration and modernization is needed.  Just bad timing on our part.  The reconstruction is expected to continue through December 2021.  

Enough of the bad.  On to the good/great.

Though unexpected, we had a personal concierge.  Ivan was fantastic.  He really handled our every need.  We didn't have a lot but he took care of us and deserves recognition.  He asked us our preferred dinner times and food choices.  He then proceeded to make all dinner reservations and text us where we were eating each night.  Easy breezy.  No stress.  He took care of setting up a sunset dinner cruise for us and was of major assistance for setting up our COVID test, which went smoothly.  I was very appreciative of his assistance.  

We hit all of the restaurants, except the steak house, which was a separate upcharge.  They were all excellent.  We hit Enso a couple of times, because their sushi was amazing.  The Blue Agave taco bar, that doesn't require reservations, was a big hit for lunch.  All of the food was very good to excellent.

Mask requirements in the building are not strictly enforced, but we are not, "OMG! They're not masked!" types, so it didn't bother us.  Virtually nobody masked up at the pool or beach. Staff, however are required, regardless of interaction or contact with others, to be masked at all times, whether inside or out.  AN they follow it strictly and are constantly cleaning.

As for the pool.  There was plenty of seating, but, if you have a favorite spot, I suggest marking your territory early in the morning.  This was not a problem for us as I am an early vacation riser anyway and would go down each morning, set up camp and grab coffee at the coffee bar on my way back to the room.  The staff at the pool made frequent stops to ensure everyone was adequately supplied with food/drink.

AquaWorld has two booths, one at each pool and are located directly across the street for easy access.  Their staff is phenomenal and I booked a couple of dives and a snorkel trip with my wife through them.  I have used them on other occasions and highly recommend them, too.

The room, for us, is just a place to lay your head between adventures.  That being said, we were on the top floor of tower 2.  I think we were the only one s for a few days, as we saw nobody for the first few.  The room was immaculate.  Juana took good care of us. We had a one bedroom, which is basically a studio and a hotel room with a door between.  Our balconies overlooked the lagoon, which was great, because a night club apparently announced it's opening every night @ 10PM with a small fireworks display which was cool.  The room was adequate and spacious.

There is nightly entertainment in the Ginger Bar, all of which was very good to excellent, ranging from Mariachi to acrobatics to an Elvis impersonator.  The bar staff was very attentive as well.  Frankly, all of the staff on premise were very attentive.

As for the beach, the surf was a bit rough and the seaweed hit and miss, but I have seen it worse.  I didn't think it was bad considering a hurricane hit the Gulf and just below Tulum, prior to our arrival.

All in all, the stay was great.  The staff and food was great, with the exceptions mentioned, and I would highly recommend this resort.  If not for the reservations hiccups and the lobby reconstruction, I would give this resort a 5.

reviews.author: Shealyn K
reviews.title: Best customer service experience EVER, even without the Reserve
reviews.text:
My friends and I stayed at the Paradisus from August 29th to September 3rd, and we cannot say ENOUGH amazing things about our vacation. Firstly, we are 4 late 20s, early 30s travelers, and decided to skip out on The Reserve upgrade, as it was out of our price range. With the level of service we received, you would have thought we paid extra and then some! Every step of the way, staff made us feel so special. My birthday was halfway through the trip, and I felt like I was surrounded by old friends and family. Saul, from the activities team, Antonio at the swim up bar, and Didi at the pool went above and beyond to make myself and my friends feel special! They even surprised me with a cake. One of us has a gluten allergy, and was always given food options to make sure she ate a great meal. The food at each restaurant was delicious, and we were able to easily make reservations at each one. We loved Blue Agave, Capella, Enso, and The Malva buffet was always delicious for breakfast, lunch and dinner. We loved playing volleyball in the pool, the wine and painting event at sunset, and water aerobics in the morning. There was always something fun for us to do. The Yhi Spa was amazing, and David was so helpful with us scheduling our massages. He made sure to see us later in the day and made sure we had an enjoyable time. My relaxation massage with Daniela was INCREDIBLE. I would recommend this hotel to everyone, and can’t wait to plan a trip back again. We wanted to thank the following staff members, for making our vacation the best:
Axcel - activities
Saul - activities
Alfredo - buffet
Alejandro - buffet 
Didi - pool
Sergio - pool
Dael - activities 
Antonio -swim up
Gilberto -capella
David - spa
Carlos-blue agave
Daniela - masseuse 
Esteban -buffet
Luis - buffet
Martin - buffet
Gladys - buffet

There were so many more staff members that went above and beyond. I truly don’t have one bad thing to say about this resort at all! I can only imagine the level of service you’d receive if you booked the Reserve Upgrade, but if you can’t afford it, don’t worry. You’ll still have the most amazing vacation. Thanks for everything!!

reviews.author: Alejandro G
reviews.title: Great Hotel with Great Staff and Food! Book now!
reviews.text: The hotel is Excellent! We changed from Paradisus Playa Del Carmen to this Hotel because of the Seaweed on Playa Del Carmen, the beach here was super clean, although we understand that seaweed is something that they cannot control, the staff in Cancun had a very different attitude of service, Jesus y Gilberto from Capella, Gaudencio from Malva and Pascual from Fuego were Excellent and you should ask for them, fully commited to assist you and assure you have a great time, COVID Protocols work here, the restaurant at the pool "La Palapa" and Enso are great and the seafood is delicious, we were a large group (14) kids and adults and maybe we were difficult to help but they always had the best attitude. Here they understand what service is about, congrats to the waiters specially! Keep up the good work! When you go to Cancun this hotel is a definitive destination you should consider.

reviews.author: Hdsa
reviews.title: You won’t regret it!
reviews.text: I could write an almost brochure, however concrete that it will be appropriate to summarize that my experience in this hotel was simply another level, we had been there for 4th of July all inclusive hotel that is very clean and neat, the staff are absolutely adorable people, whole hotel keep social distance and COVID safety. Hour happy hours was during the breakfast time at the buffet we met such nice people like Johnny and Alfredo but all Staff are super friendly ready to help and make your experience fabulous. I will back to this place as soon as I can and I highly recommended.

reviews.author: Sandy A
reviews.title: Amazing!!
reviews.text: My Fiancé and I stayed at the Paradisus Cancun from 8/24/21 to 8/31/21. Before he booked the trip he read the reviews and was conflicted if he should book. There were some questionable reviews. He decided to book anyway... I'm so happy he did ! The staff was so pleasant and helpful. Every staff from the pool area to the maintenance men. The food was beyond delicious.  Except for one restaurant (Mole) we did not enjoy that one to be honest. That was one out of 10 that we attended. When we asked for anything our needs were met without any issues. I'm so happy my Fiancé decided to book this resort and not listen to the other negative reviews.  We're going back with some friends and considering maybe having our wedding here. Thanks to all the staff that made our stay so amazing!

reviews.author: Kim S
reviews.title: Such a disappointment with a few silver linings
reviews.text:
My family and I visited the Paradisus, Cancun July 27-Aug 2, 2021. We had previously stayed at the resort in 2018 and we were so impressed with the facilities,  the staff and all inclusive features we were determined to come back! Unfortunately,  we were not impressed during our most recent visit.  

Disappointments: 
1. The hotel was under MAJOR INDOOR construction with Jack hammers and all from 10am-5pm daily during our visit. We were not notified of this construction prior to our visit and our rooms were directly across from the construction. We could literally taste the concrete as it seeped into our rooms.  We immediately experienced severe headaches as well.
2. The rooms are literally falling apart. Between 5 reserved rooms our group experienced; leaking roof from bathroom above, flickering electrical,  peeling bathtubs, broken AC, mini bars not being refilled with water after many requests, edge pieces of counters falling off, mini bars not cooling off, broken in room coffee pots.
3. The hotel spa is also falling apart! Only 2 jets work in the large spa. The sauna and steam room were also out of commission. 
4. 3 days of my six 6 day vacation were spent in guest services trying to get the room situations taken care of. our group had to move rooms multiple times. 

Silver linings:
1. The staff is very friendly and communicates best via whatsapp.
2. There was an exceptional staff member in guest services. His name is RICARDO!  This young man deserves a promotion!  He went above and beyond to right the wrongs we were experiencing.  My parents had the worst room experience of the entire group and we were there celebrating their 50th anniversary.  Once we got the room fiasco settled, Ricardo arranged to have a cake and champagne delivered to their room❤. This is one of the many things he did to salvage our experience.  
3. one member of our group stayed on the reserve side and those rooms are a better maintained.

reviews.author: JonathanDS7991
reviews.title: Cancun Paradisus Not Paradise
reviews.text:
My wife, myself, and our 9 year old daughter went for 10 days of vacation, and it was not even close to what we expected. We were in room 3356 in the center pyramid.
Day 1
We did not have the king size bed we requested and were told we would get. Thankfully the beds were not bolted in place and I was able to move the room around to fit our needs.
Day 2 
We were preparing for hurricane Grace to hit. We called maintenance as the slider was leaking and 4 men showed up. They adjusted the door as it wasn’t making a seal. They placed a 3” wide flexible adhesive strip to block the air flow. Nothing worked. That night the hurricane hit hard. The balcony had 4 inches of water on it because the drainage vents were all clogged and had not been cleaned so the water backed up into the room. I found the vents clogged the next day. The slider, as heavy as it was, was leaking water and the water was coming up from the bottom track. There were holes in it and the water was bubbling up through it and being forced up due to wind and water pressure from outside. The strip they installed for the wind started to vibrate and rattle all night. I travel with duct tape (and some tools) and I used it to hold the vibrating strip to the glass to quiet things down. We were up all night soaking up water with the towels and wringing them out in the wastebasket. We had 1” of water in the room everywhere. The beds were wet, everything was wet. 
Day 3
I went to the Front Desk and Guest Services starting at 4:00 am and the hotel was full of water everywhere. The room a few doors down from us literally had water pouring out from under the door into the hallway. I made 8 requests for maintenance and housekeeping. Maintenance NEVER showed up at all for the duration of our stay. Housekeeping did not show up either. My wife kept cleaning up the water with towels. I went looking for anything to clean the room with. I found a housekeeping cart nearby with a large floor squeegee in it. I borrowed it and went back to the room and started to clean the water off the floors. It seems the housekeeping person I borrowed the squeegee from wanted it back and she came knocking at the door. She saw what we were doing and stayed to clean the room for us. She dried he floor, plugged the holes in the door track with towels, and gave us clean and dry bedding and towels and made all the bad stuff go away. Her name was Makely and I wanted to keep her. She saved the day for us. She was an amazing, hard working woman. She deserves so much credit. Please recognize her. We were told that every room facing the ocean had water in it. This tells me as few things: The sliding doors do not make as good seal (and it doesn’t mean in high winds because the next day there was a slight shower and the water still came in), this most likely not the only hurricane to hit the hotel so this is a known problem that the hotel chooses to NOT FIX due to high cost for the occasional hurricane every 3 years or so (why spend the money when you can just blame it on a hurricane and let the guests suffer), if anyone goes there then need a hefty supply of Flex Seal products as they will not get any help from maintenance. On my 2nd request for maintenance, they NEVER showed up at the room again for the remainder of our 8 days there.

Other issues:
In the room they give you a stocked refrigerator, an ice bucket, but no glasses and no ice. I requested glasses for 4 days and finally I had to go downstairs to Guest Services to get 3 plastic cups. I also requested ice for 4 days and finally on the 4th day I got a bag of ice that would fill 5 ice buckets and I only had 1. I requested ice every day during our stay and got ice 4 times only out of 10 days. On the 6th day real glass glasses mysteriously showed up in the bathroom.
We had blood stained bed linen for 5 days. The shower controls would work one day and not the next. The tub was 2 & ½ feet high. It was impossible for me at 65 with arthritis and degenerative joint disease, and needing hip replacement surgery to get into and out of it without severe pain and help.
During the day time there were power tools and noise from construction work being done in the atrium area as it was demolished and being rebuilt which at the rate they were going will be finished sometime next year if they are lucky.
We were on the 3rd floor in pyramid 3 in room 3356. Directly below us was a sport bar which is where they had nightly entertainment. Seating was made possible for 30 people and the performing area was about 25 feet away from them. The speakers were at high volume. From 8:00 pm until midnight EVERY NIGHT we had to listed to whatever was going on. It was so loud, you could not sleep. It you were roomed in the atrium area in that building you would not be able to sleep until after midnight. Not good if you travel with a child and are older person who needs a little more sleep.
We needed toilet paper, so back to Guest Services to request toilet paper. The 2 rollers in the bathroom were empty. When we got to the room, there were 2 rolls of toilet paper on the counter in the bathroom. They wouldn’t even put them on the empty rollers. Not a huge deal as we all do it at home anyways, but when you spend thousands on a vacation, you expect a little pampering.
For 4 days we could not get the toiletries refilled in the bathroom. Back to Guest Services to get that done. Also, I had to go to Guest Services to get towels. When housekeeping made the room they left the towel bar in the bathroom empty. Now you would think that in doing your work routine you would see a long empty towel bar and say to yourself…hmmmmm, something needs to go there, and you fill it with towels. But, Noooooo.
Never in all my travels in whichever part of the world I have been in did I ever have to call EVERY day to request the beds made, toilet paper, soap, shampoo, towels, glasses, or ice. It seems here you have to do just that.
I had a blinking, red message waiting light on the room telephone that NOBODY in the hotel knew how to clear. Listening to the message (in Spanish) would not clear it. It blinked for 6 days until we left because no one knew how to clear it. I covered it with duct tape.

There was one day that my stomach wasn’t just right. We were out by the pool and there was a seafood restaurant close by so I figured I would find a toilet close by. There was 1 toilet in the bathroom and when I lifted the lid, well, not a pretty sight. Here’s the good part….I had to fix the toilet myself to get it to flush so I could then clean the seat and use the toilet as I was in desperation. My only other option was the ladies room which I figured would not have gone over well. As I was leaving, a maintenance man came in with a plunger. He looked in the toilet and saw it was empty and clean and he looked at me while I was washing my hands. I told him that “I fixed it”. He says “You fixed it”? “Yes” I told him. He flushed it twice and it worked fine. He looks back at me and says “Thank you”.
On our last day we saw a 2 year old boy who was not wearing swim diapers have a bowel movement in the pool. His family quickly tried to get the feces out of the water. The kid left a trail of feces out of the pool onto the walkway. His mother took him most likely to their room to clean and change him. We told the nearest resort worker about it and nothing was done for the next 3 hours we were there. On a cruise ship they drain the pool, clean it, and refill it. Here they ignore it and let the people swim in feces contaminated water. Ignorance is bliss.
That night in our room my daughter plugged in a table lamp and got a tingle. The lamp cord was in need of repair and had some black tape on it. 
That was pretty much the bad stuff. Now for the good.
I told you about the Makely from housekeeping. Awesome lady. 
Waiter Orlando Bello is phenomenal. This man remembered us by name, what we drank per person, and gave us the best possible service. This man was so good at what he did. He made us all feel like we were the most important people there.
There were 2 people by the pool area. Ivonne and Luis. Luis was always there if you needed something. He would literally run to get it for you so wouldn’t have to wait. Ivonne was so good to us. She gave us the best service outside, reserved a specific cabana for us which was a first come basis. She would block it off for us and reserved it for the entire day. She always stopped by the chat with us and we got to know her which was really nice. She was so attentive to not just us but everyone there. She cared about us and our timer there.
Two people in Guest Services I need to mention. Wen is a young lady who cared about the guests and helping them. She was a sweetheart for all that she did to help us. When we needed ice one day, she left her desk and brought it to us herself. She liked her job of helping people and it showed.
But the very best person if all, who actually deserves so much recognition is Christhian from Guest Services. This guy loves his job and takes great pride and enjoyment out of helping other. He upgraded us to gold standard which came with perks, he intervened with housekeeping to get us what we needed cleaned and done, and he literally bent over backwards to help us. Christhian literally is Paradisus Cancun. He should be on a sales brochure of the Paradisus with the hotel in the background and Christhian standing in the foreground with his arms crossed and his usually smiling face with the sparkle inn his eyes. This man loves his job and is proud of where he works and the service e performs. CHRISTHIAN IS THE PARADISUS RESORT ! He was the most important person there. He is also the first person I shook hands with in 2 years. That’s how well we got along. Funny story about him, I was looking for some umbrella sunblock for my wife. He said he was going into town that night and would look for me. The next day he texts me to come to Guest Services. I get there and he is beaming with pride as he hands me a 3 foot blue and white umbrella. I looked at him and showed him a picture of what I wanted and he hung his head in embarrassment. Wen, mentioned earlier, looked at him and said: “I told you his wife wanted sunscreen!” We all laughed so hard. I love this guy. If we ever go back there again, it will be because of him. He is by far the best Guest Services person I have ever known in all my years of traveling.
The people in the MALVA Restaurant were great. Alondra and Karen and Grace were always professional and attentive and friendly. Enrique, Arturo, Ignacio all are outstanding.
Henri, outside by the pool, a wonderfully attentive person who would do anything for you.
Daniella was the nicest and kindest young lady who was always there to help you out and listen to what you had to say to try to help.
Axel was probably the only person to repeatedly knock on my door and ask me what I wanted for my refrigerator in the room.
The people working there saved our vacation. It wasn’t a great vacation, but it was an okay one.   

There is a huge and serious disconnect from the people working in the hotel like maintenance and especially room service and housekeeping from the people waiting on you and Guest Services. This is the real problem there, They don’t work as a team there.

reviews.author: Tx-foodee
reviews.title: Last time here. Most dangerous hotel for families. Stay away!
reviews.text: We’ve stayed here multiple times in the past 10 years, this is our last time here or at any Melia property. This “high end” brand does not take security of their guests seriously. My family was attacked by drunk partygoers at the nightclub, reported this and the hotel did absolutely nothing to make sure my family was safe. After this incident, the same gang members kept threatening my kids in the public areas and still no action from the hotel. We called the federal police to have them look into this but everything seems to be swept under the rug, the hotel probably “takes care of the issue” if you know what I mean. I guess the rates have dropped so much that the hotel has no care or control over who stays here and they clearly do not have a policy to keep families safe. Not the same place, stay away and keep your family out of there.

reviews.author: Dam6395
reviews.title: Wonderful 25th anniversary trip
reviews.text:
We came to celebrate our 25th anniversary. Stay in Royal Service ocean view room. The room was perfect, great view and cold AC. The restaurants were very good, (we really enjoyed Enzo) we especially enjoyed being able to have food served to us at the pool.  Some special employees were Joel, Oscar and Daniel the pool restaurant manager (I believe) along with our butler Galdino. We didn’t use our butler much because we never really knew what we wanted to do from one minute to the next; we aren’t the plan everything out couple however he was always available by text if we had specific  needs. He reserved Bali beds for us a few times and that was really nice. We never had trouble finding chairs at the pool. We didn’t see much evening entertainment but what we did was nice.  CoCos was a fun place to go before dinner and have drinks. We did however see some locals (staying at the hotel at that time) taking advantage of a young couple, so just be aware. Long story but thankfully it turned out ok for the couple. Thankful we were there and paying attention. The staff did handle it well after realizing what was happening as well. The Royal Service pool was a great place for relaxation, grab a float and enjoy your day. The hotel was very clean and we were not hounded by any vacation club employees. 
We used the hotel photographer for some anniversary photos and they were pricey but beautiful. Rosa Negro is right down across the street and is SO GOOD, make a reservation and try it. We took the bus in to the restaurant area and shopped and ate, always feel safe. This was right before COVID hit big in the US and we began to worry a little when we would turn on the American channels and it was all doom and gloom at home but thankfully that was at the end of our 10 day stay so we made it home with out incident.

reviews.author: BKA2019
reviews.title: Had a wonderful time
reviews.text: There was four in our group celebrating two birthdays. The staff was amazing and a Special Thank You to Carlos Gonzalez at Enso’s For treating us like royalty and amazing service! Carlos at the Swim up bar who also took great care of us with some amazing cocktails,  you Rock!!! There was also Mariza that was a hostess at Mole and Market Grill, you took great care of us and always had a beautiful smile! We had Breakfast at Mole every morning and Gaudencio always had our coffee and juice at our table as soon as we walked in. We nick named him “Tweet Tweet” ! The Gelato booth is sooooo good!   They are doing some renovation at the resort so a few restaurants were closed. Shows in the evening we done well. We were able to watch a football game in The Avenue and our waitress was always so happy and didn’t let the beers run out! They also had great shows at The Avenue. They didn’t have much going on around the main pool by swim up bar. Places we have stayed at before have had a lot of activities around the pool. There is NO AC in the main lobby and floors, it can get very warm and humid. They have incense burning in the landscaping inside the main lobby area, which the scent can be a little over whelming. Overall Paradisus is a very nice resort and fabulous service!!!

reviews.author: Vlad G
reviews.title: When your expectations are higher than reality
reviews.text:
At Royal services we expected a bit upgrade,such as extended wine selection,a room comfort,as we used to have it elsewhere. Unfortunately we've been offered only 3 types of wines: white,red and sparkling. During our stay we changed our room 3 times,as AC was awfully noisy and we couldn't sleep well. We noticed the resort tries to be eco friendly and saves energy consumption,as the result overall temperature inside the building was quite high and uncomfortable.
Food was just mediocre,probably because 2 major eateries were under construction,which wasn't announced while we were shopping for this resort. Minor thing,but left some taste of unpleasantness.
The only really bright side of our stay (besides the Sea,of course) are people working there. They are genuinely friendly and really do whatever they can to make your stay comfortable.Thank you STAFF!

reviews.author: ZKS
reviews.title: Best Birthday Celebration!
reviews.text: Had a great time celebrating my friend's 50th birthday!  The staff were all so helpful and friendly. Lillian helped us get checked in. Mesero, Alfredo, Pascual, Vicente and Arcos greeted us every day with whatever we needed.  They recognized us each day and had our table ready for breakfast and lunch.  Superb service from all of them. We will definitely be back; and hopefully, they will still be there to greet us with their happy faces.  Mole and The Market Grill were our favorite restaurants.  The mariachis at Mole were the best!  The Market Grill has the most beautiful view and excellent food!

reviews.author: kaitlyns0713
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation
reviews.text:
This trip was amazing for the 3 of us ladies. Royal Service is the way to go! I loved that we had our own pool and restaurant. The no kids on the Royal Service side was my favorite part! It is mostly for couples, but us 3 girls had a blast. 

Our 2 butlers Norma and Rode were the best. They both helped make our stay wonderful. They communicate through WhatsApp and could help make reservations for dinner, anything we needed for our room and even set up baggage/transportation to the airport home. We had a reservation mix up, but Norma was able to help us fix it. Rode surprised us with a special treat in our room. Shout out to Norma and Rode for being awesome!

I loved all the food we had there. Very delicious and authentic. Our first night at Market Grille wasn’t the best food and it took about 2 for us to get all of our food. La Palapa, Enso, Blue Agave and Mole were fantastic and we ate at multiple times. 

I recommend bringing floats and a speaker for the pool. The wait staff are happy to please and keep the drinks coming. 

I would highly recommend booking royal service for the exclusive pool that adults only! Ask for Norma or Rode as your butler. They will take care of you! 

Thank you for an amazing trip!

reviews.author: Kacey R
reviews.title: Best Resort in Cancun
reviews.text: Our stay at Paradisus Cancun was fantastic. The staff are so friendly and welcoming we enjoyed their excellent hospitality.The resort is beautiful and highly maintained. The kids club was great our son loved being there. The resort put on activities and shows every day which is really good. Rooms are cleaned everyday to perfection. Will definitely be back again.

reviews.author: Cruiser59606025195
reviews.title: Beautiful Spot
reviews.text:
The view from the balcony was breathtaking. The staff were wonderful. The food was good but there wasn't a ton of variety (especially if you didn't feel like making a reservation). The pool closes at 8PM which was unfortunate as it would have been a great experience. All in all we wouldn't definitely return. 

P.S. If you decide to stay here; Andres at the Market Grill goes above and beyond in his service and always has amazing cocktail recommendations!

reviews.author: Rafael M
reviews.title: Excellent place to stay, excellent service and facilities
reviews.text: The place is in excellent conditions, the service from all the people there just excellent. Should mention in special a guy named Carlos at the pool bar, he deserves a WOWW. In general, I should congratulate the managers at that place, you can see their work with the employees, they all performing just excellent.

reviews.author: Jenny P
reviews.title: Exceptional!
reviews.text: The hotel is simply beautiful. I have never been so welcome in a hotel before. Everything is clean, chic and tasteful. The a la carte restaurants are excellent and the Enso buffet is absolutely delicious. A wide variety of dishes are offered and it changes all the time. Perfect to discover but a pity when we have a crush for a dish :) The employees of the buffets are really kind as those who serve on the beach. We have always had excellent service. My favorite of the week goes to the animation team. An INCREDIBLE team !!! Always smiling, Angel, Rodrigo and Alan made us spend a memorable week. They are catchy as much in their animations at the swimming pool as inside. Always smiling, motivating, listening and above all good advice. Model employees! Our week would not have been so successful without them. A week at this so soothing hotel is not enough. My only 2 negative points are for the music you hear on the beach and at the pool during the day and the dress code. First, where is latin music ?? We felt like we were in a club in Miami and not in Mexico. We expected to dance salsa or to hear Latin rhythms and not techno or american music. And to conclude, the dress code was horribly sexist. At the Enso buffet, camisoles are accepted during the day, but in the evening no.
