Women can wear tiny dresses that cover virtually nothing, but men can not wear a shirt with no sleeves or even a t-shirt with shorter sleeves. That it's sexist and offending. Where is the logic in it? Otherwise, everything was beyond our expectations.

reviews.author: Jesse V
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: By far one of the nicest resorts I’ve stayed at. Beach is beautiful, pool is massive, rooms are great, extremely clean, and the staff is next level friendly. Francisco, Eduardo, and Luis are incredible bar staff - friendly, fun, make you feel like friends. 10/10 would recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: Chad V
reviews.title: Amazing trip
reviews.text:
The hotel was absolutely magical. The staff is very attentive and you really feel like you’re on vacation as soon as you entire the resort. The white sand beach is absolutely incredible and we were lucky that there was not too much algae. They have multiple restaurants you need to reserve and we tried the sushi restaurant in the middle of the giant pyramid that is the resort. It was pretty good, but we realized that the buffet was already good enough and ended up eating there for almost every meal. One thing really bothered me though. They won’t allow shirts with no sleeves at dinner which on it’s own is okay. But only for men. I was told to go change while the woman I was travelling with was wearing a top with no sleeves. Another time, I was told that my shirt didn’t have long enough sleeves. (It was a proper night shirt with sleeves, just not long enough for the resort. Again, it was pretty sexist and I was offended.

The resort is very Miami style. You wouldn’t realize you’re in Mexico if not for the staff. The music they play is very American and I would have loved to hear more latin music. 

My highlights were the white party and the silent party at night. Those were incredible. A huge part because of the team there. Special thanks to Rodrigo and Alan. 

I need to add a HUGE thanks to Angel who is one of the supervisors there for his amazing work with us. He guided us not only through all the activities at the resort but also told us what to do around in Mexico and because of him, we had the best time while there. Some people really make the difference. This one did!

reviews.author: cindylouf498
reviews.title: Mexico2019
reviews.text: Great atmosphere, people bars and pools however the food was not good. Buffet was always cold, steak house was always tuff and cold with the hamburger being the best. Service was good except the last night they forgot about us and served a meal very cold and tuff meat again

reviews.author: Elvinwaight
reviews.title: Nothing Short of Excellent
reviews.text: We stayed at the Royal Service location, managed by Lazaro. Our Butler Maria truly provided us with a great experience. Mgr Sonjay and a host of royal service employees and others were extremely helpful in providing with simply the best vacation possible. We are delighted to say it was a great experience and one that we are eagerly anticipating returning to in the near future.

reviews.author: Zivia K
reviews.title: Mrs. Zivia Kocher
reviews.text: My son had his wedding at Paradisus Meliá Cancún. We had a fun experience with the resort. Norma and Rode our Butlers were amazing! The resort is very beautiful! The wedding was fun and Diana did a great job organizing everything for the wedding

reviews.author: REM1of3
reviews.title: Nice Place
reviews.text: Very nice, very attentive staff.  I have been to Cancun a few times and this place had some of the best bartenders I have experienced there.  My husband and I both commented that the sheets were spectacular.  Very soft, that usually doesn't happen in the big hotels.  It was nice.  Quiet, but we were there in Sept. off season.  It was fun!

reviews.author: Badri N
reviews.title: All inclusive
reviews.text:
When I was book this hotel I didn’t know anything about it just see some photo and fall in love with the beauty of greens all over the hotel.
Hotel itself was super clean ,staff was very polite and friendly and happy face
Food was good especial dinners which have to make reservations and breakfast was so good
If I was able will give ten star to this hotel
Close to air port about 15 minutes 
Highly recommended to every one

reviews.author: Nikki
reviews.title: Beautiful resort! Ask for Alan!
reviews.text: My friends and I had a great time at this beautiful resort. We participated in many of the activities held on and off the resort. Alan, one of the workers, made sure we had a wonderful time and always went out of his way to include us in the activities. Because of him we all had a great time. I would definitely stay at Paradisus again.

reviews.author: Estephany L
reviews.title: Should informed 3 if the restaurant are closed for renovations
reviews.text: We arrived 21st September, looking forward for the five stars service, but when we arrived the t was so confused, the front desk did not give out enough information about three restaurants been closed for renovations, and the website should stated they are under construction because we were looking forward for the international buffet and other restaurant like Vento, unfortunately they are closed. The hotel barely have sign have the room number, activities and restaurant hours , on top of that, there are no coffee and desserts available 24 hrs, their coffee are very average and this is Mexico right. Would I come back? No! Make sure states in website the restaurants are closed for renovations,

reviews.author: Sarah
reviews.title: Time to relax and unwind.
reviews.text:
The Paradisus Cancun blew us away from the moment we arrived at the hotel. A short drive from the airport (this should cost you no more than 400 pesos, the guys at the airport ripped us off on the way there charging 1000 pesos so be careful!) and when we arrived we were greeted with cold towels and a very friendly face, which was much needed after the 14 hour trip we had to get to Cancun. 
Check in was quick and easy, we were offered a room with two double beds, however, upon noticing that we were a couple they offered to move us to a room with one king size bed. The rooms were super clean and spacious and the views were stunning (we had a junior suite with ocean view room). However, our safe did not work and no one came up to fix it for us (this did not bother us as much but I can imagine this would be annoying if a safe was essential to your trip). I was apprehensive prior to coming because it was suggested that the only way to go was Royal Service, however, I could not disagree more. The pool area can be quite noisy with activities going on throughout the day and music played, however, we really enjoyed this. There is no pressure to join in the games either- if you want to lay on your sunbed all day you most definitely can.The entertainment team are fantastic- in particular Augustin Mercardo was a fantastic host and we only found out towards the end of the holiday he had just joined!! You would never know...
The only real difference between Royal Service and the 'standard' holiday, in my opinion, are a quieter pool, an exclusive restaurant and a butler (however, the staff round the pool are so attentive we felt there was no need for one!).
The restaurants were all open (apart from one) and the food was really enjoyable. 
We wanted to specifically give recognition to Martin who works in the Enso restaurant, every morning he would remember us, giving us advice and tips on what to see and do around the area. He is a real asset to the Enso team and he always has a smile on his face no matter the time or day!
The only reason I have not given Paradisus 5 stars is because when you ate dinner you could not enjoy it over a few hours watching the sunset, you were in and out within the hour. Another factor stopping me from giving this 5 stars was when we checked out we had a 25 pesos a night environmental tax we had to pay that we were not told about prior to checking in- if we had been told upon check-in this would not have come as such a surprise (good job we had some pesos left over!)

All in all this was a much needed break and one we thoroughly enjoyed. If you are heading to Cancun I would recommend the restaurant Fred's (just a 5 minute walk from the hotel) and a night out at Coco Bongo's Show and Club- one of our favourite evenings!

reviews.author: Lann Rubin II
reviews.title: Wow
reviews.text:
I have stayed at another Melina property in Putnam Cana, and it was nice. Similar business model and both times I upgraded to the best service package for families and a suite;this time a gorgeous one bedroom with 2 private patios!, here the package was called family concierge. 
      What differs in Cancun is the people, don’t get me wrong, both have nice service at the higher level, here every staffer knows what is going on. Even the guy cutting the lawn may not be fluent in English but he finds a way to guide your family. Everyone knows the program and we even took notice that they treat the people whom did not upgrade exemplary.  This is important because as you get royal treatment you don’t want to feel like you have to pay up or else suffer a substandard vacation.
      Furthermore, the upgraded service was a reasonable fee and had a plethora of benefits. Yes tons of stuff, gifts, access to special areas, but most importantly of all were Alexa and Violeta.  It was our butler(concierge) staff that shines above all the trinkets. They text you throughout the day, run for anything your heart desires, make every reservation, including events unrelated to the hotel and most importantly treat our boys ages 10 and 13 like kings.
       Finally, the maid service and mini bar crew were impeccable. Every corner; every mirror spotless, special requests catered to at once; again if there was a language barrier they found a way to communicate effectively and never overlook even the smallest detail or request. 
       It is critical for staff to have the companies best interests in mind, it is the only way for the corporate family to survive. Mitigating Waste, for example was clearly on every crew members mind. Yet, you still felt indulged to the maximum.      
      The talent is when they can take customer care and corporate house interest and combine them into something extraordinary. This property is a testament to the staff and Melia should be proud of Manager Chrystian Rodrigues and every last one of his crew.

reviews.author: Dorothy Nicklis
reviews.title: Dorothy Nicklis
reviews.text:
Great service by our Butler Rhode.
All of the employees were very pleasant and helpful. Food was very good and rooms were well kept. Managers were always concerned about our happiness on a daily basis. It was my first time there but I would go back again.

reviews.author: sunnileo
reviews.title: I love this resort!
reviews.text: I love this resort and all the people I meet working at this resort. This is my third time staying here in Cancun. The first two with my husband and this last time with my brothers, their spouses, my Dad and Stepmother. Thank you to Bianca for the warm welcome! I want to give a special thank you to our servers in the Disco, Karina (thank you for your warm welcome back!) and Francesco. A very special thank you to Sergio Gonzalez our server in the outside pool area for you exceptional service. In Blue Agave (the breakfast area) we want to thank Guadencio for making our Stepmother’s Birthday wonderful with cake paired with Mimosas and Alejandro for your great disposition. A great thank you to Orlando Bello for the wonderful service at Blue Agave (our favorite taco place in the afternoon) and at the Nescafé, thank you for the best coffee ever! The key is the Baileys :) The food is great, the Ocean View rooms are breathtaking, the service is exceptional and the drinks are wonderful. You will love this place and we will be back again! Thank you everyone at Paradisus!

reviews.author: Tom Hovanec
reviews.title: One word Excellence
reviews.text:
This was our first all inclusive and they definitely did not disappoint. The resort is absolutely beautiful, the food is great and they give you a ton of options, no shortage of activities. Live entertainment every night is a plus too. The staff is amazing, Everyone goes above and beyond to make your stay as best as possible. They treat you like family. The pool is great and the beach is gorgeous. 

All in all one of the best vacations we have been on.

reviews.author: Aimee
reviews.title: Never Again
reviews.text:
My husband and I have stayed at this resort on 9 different occasions, but this will be the very last. We started staying here in 1998 when it was Melia Cancun and we really enjoyed the resort. This was before it became an all-inclusive. The resort had great amenities, good restaurants, and awesome service. It was clean and modern. Over the past several years, many changes were made. Names went from Melia Cancun to Gran Melia Cancun and now Paradisus Cancun. With each name change, services got to be worse and worse. Prior to our last stay, which was 6/22-6/29, was in 2014. What a huge difference 5 years makes. The service was horrible and many rude workers were noted. The food and restaurants were horrible and disgusting. We used to enjoy the Market Grill for lunch, as it was a menu offered with a sit down lunch. This lazy buffet crap has got to go for the price you pay. The rooms are terribly outdated, the check in, check out customer service reps are the rudest in our history of staying there. The pool is filthy, and we never saw them attempting to clean it. We’re done...if you want a relaxing vacation where you don’t have to struggle with laziness, this is NOT your place. I will deter anyone that asks my opinion about staying here. There are much nicer resorts in Cancun...SEE YA, Paradisus! 

BTW...7 nights, we ate at Ruth’s Chris, La  Parilla, the Crab House twice, and La Dolce Vita for dinner. Don’t waste your time on warm melting mousse on the buffets.

reviews.author: Aleisha Ross
reviews.title: Great accommodations and friendly staff
reviews.text:
Entertainment staff was fantastic! Alan was extremely friendly and got everyone involved at the pool games. He was genuine & funny! 
Servers were very friendly too & kind :) If you introduced yourself and said hello they remembered your name 

Check in was full AC too. Front desk staff were very nice. 

Accommodations were very nice. AC in the rooms was super good. Bed was comfy. We had a lagoon views& it’s was great. 

Lots of restaurant choices. 6 total for dinner and the 7th you could pay for. They give you a lot of options if you want to upgrade for different features but it can get costly.

reviews.author: Honest_Reviews
reviews.title: Impressed with Structure and Service - Rodolfo and Gloria
reviews.text:
I stayed at Paradisus Cancun in a group of 19 people. Some were family concierge and some couples with no children. We all loved our experience. Let me break it down:

Family Concierge - Simply amazing and totally worth the extra money. Rodolfo and Gloria were awesome arranging all restaurant reservations, Balinesa Beds and even going the extra mile arranging a Birthday Party for my daughter. The lounge is the perfect place to chill after lunch. It’s always stocked with food, drinks and there’s air conditioning. The oceanview rooms are simply amazing, fairly new and the view is to die for. 

Swimming Pool and Beach - Swimming Pool is beautiful and large. We hang out mainly at the kids pool as it’s very shallow. The bar pool was always full but the bartenders always managed to serve the drinks with no wait. Beach was beautiful and the ocean colors are amazing. Drink service a bit scarce but still
come.

Food - It was good. A lot of variety, and Mole and Lapalapa are worth the reservation. Market Grill was pretty average in my opinion but the location is great. The ice cream bar was a go to 3 times a day and the Nespresso Bar is awesome too. Limited hours but can’t complaint. The Japanese was delicious!

Hotel Structure- OMG.. it’s beautiful! The lounge is something to be remembered! They burn incense throughout the day so it smells amazing too. 

Service - I thought the hotel had great service. I would say 95%. You do have the odd waiter in the restaurants that is not having a good day. The waiters in the pool were pretty amazing! 

Entertainment- I loved all the shows. They were well done and different every day.

I think my only cons is that they need more air conditioning areas. There was only 2 
restaurants with air conditioning. When you are at a 39C all day, would feel good to have more options with air conditioner. Another one was just the music at the pool. It was a bit of a hit and miss.

Thank you again to Rodolfo and Gloria for taking care of us every day.

reviews.author: 449ashac
reviews.title: Girls Trip
reviews.text:
On arrival the hotel is stunning and luxurious from the drive up the entrance and walking into the hotel. The staff are happy and helpful. They handed beautiful smelling towels that’s very refreshing after a long flight.

On checking in there was an issue, we was given the wrong rooms. The check in staff did apologise and sent a bottle of Prosecco up to apologise. We was moved to the correct rooms 2 days later. 

The food isn’t great considering it’s 5*. I was expecting better. My group and I got food poisoning from 2 of the restaurants (Mole and Mix grill).

There could be more sun loungers with umbrellas as it’s too hot and dangerous to be laying directly in the sun all day. Skin cancer is real people! They have booths that are in the shade however you can’t sit on these for more that 2 mins without staff saying it’s $70 for these. Which is very cheeky as they all in the shade giving most people not much choice but to either burn or pay extra. 

You also have to pay $35 just to use the spa facilities considering it’s all inclusive I think this is also cheeky. Access to use the facilities should be free. 

However all being said I had a lovely stay! The staff couldn’t be more helpful and cheerful. The hotel is clean, room was always cleaned well. Thanks

reviews.author: 362hugoh
reviews.title: Beautiful beach - average hotel
reviews.text: This hotel has to sections; normal and royal service. We were in royal service. This comes with a butler service. The hotel has a beautiful beach and the amenities are in okay condition. The food and drinks offered are sub par. The butler service is nice, however our butler had a day off during our 4 night stay and no substitute was appointed. We booked with an offer that gave us 500 USD in hotel credit. They forgot to mention that this credit was in the form of worthless coupons where most were for services already included. SPA and other offers on property is prices far over market price. There are lots of other hotels to choose from. We are Melia gold members, however this made no difference at property. Super slow service in all restaurants and by the pool. Beautiful beach.

reviews.author: Michelle B
reviews.title: Wish I could give it a better rating..
reviews.text:
Forewarning, unless you are booked in Royal Service, you will really feel the difference. 
Several restaurants were closed so choices were limited, Enso, Blue Agave, Mole and finally Market Grill, 
There is virtually no daytime entertainment or activities going on, which can make for a boring day, and there is no lounge with pool or ping pong tables, which would make a nice break if you wanted out of the sun.  There are no signs or notices as to what the nightly show will be or where, which was odd, but I found unless you wandered around on your own, there were no signs for the concierge desk or anything really.
The beach was beautiful, and we lucked out that we always found chairs, 
We only went to the pool once, and it was ok.. 
my biggest gripe.. The room, we were in 1414 in the Club Melia tower
It was old, and in need of renovating, desperately. We want down to the check in desk, and asked if we could change rooms, and although the resort was apparently at  60% capacity, this could not be accommodated if we wanted to keep our king bed ?!?!   We were given the option of 2 beds or spent the $480.00 USD to upgrade to Royal Service, NOT COOL    
We were told others would love our King bed,this left a bad taste in my mouth
We asked to be put on a list if a room came up, and other than a phone call the same day asking if the room was ok (I said not really) no one ever followed up.
Overall I'm not one to complain, but would I consider this a 5 star vacation ? NO, would I come back here ? NO

reviews.author: JocelynS777
reviews.title: Paradise for all
reviews.text: The people were so nice and accommodating and the views and service and food were all exceptional. We stayed using all inclusive Royal Service and we could not have been more happy with our choice it was all so nice and relaxing, we didn't have to worry about anything.

reviews.author: Greg Marchand
reviews.title: Horrible Place
reviews.text:
I am reviewing this place as an all inclusive resort in the price range of the Excellence Resort and other high-end resorts.  I am aware there is a way to get this place cheaper and pay a-la-carte.  It is a horrible deal for the money for all inclusive.  1.  Crickets and pigeons are on the menu.  2. Almost none of the staff speaks any English.  3.  they will constantly harass you to come to their time-share rip-off seminar.   

Take your money to one of the excellence resorts instead where you will get good service and better food.

reviews.author: zoefsf
reviews.title: The most relaxing vacation!!
reviews.text:
My best friend and I stayed at Paradisus Cancun 9/5/19-9/12/19 for her 26th birthday. We booked this trip well in advance and opted for the Royal Service. I highly recommend this if you are traveling without children. You get access to your own wing of the resort, a private pool and beach area, and extra restaurants. Because we were there on the off season, the place was basically empty! It was so relaxing. The service both with the butler, and all the staff on the resort is exceptional. 
We had Galdino who was super helpful and helped us book all of our reservations. He made sure we were ok everyday we stayed at the resort, even on his days off! These guys work SO hard, and even run up and downstairs, through the sand, in the 95 degree heat just to bring you a water. PLEASE TIP THEM. it's the least you can do. 
Our room was absolutely amazing, we had an ocean view and woke up with the sound of the waves everyday. It was so clean and our mini bar was stocked fresh every single day. 

I highly recommend this hotel if you are looking for pure relaxation. 

The only thing we didn't love was the food. some of the food was honestly inedible. We are from San Francisco, so we may be spoiled in terms of what we are used to...but it was disappointing to not have access to any solid Mexican food, while you're in Mexico... But it wasn't a deal breaker. There are 3 amazing spots across the street that we ended up going to when we needed a break. 

Thanks so much Paradisus cancun and Galdino! We will be back!

reviews.author: Wael
reviews.title: Babymoon with my awesome wife
reviews.text:
To be honest I love everything in this resort and we meet alot of ppl and workers 
I like Alan and Agustin from the pool side and you get the best service at pool from server Nourbi. The staff is very friendly and they help you with any informatio  you need regarding local stuff as well.
Thank you guys for making our babymoon so amazing hope to see you again.

reviews.author: Scott S
reviews.title: 10 out of 10
reviews.text:
Just had the most amazing 5 nights staying at this wonderful resort and highly recommend it to all. If you are going without kids, definitely grab the upgrade package “Royal Service” for better pool, bar and around amazing service. Whilst there grab a day trip to Tulum to see the ancient Mayan temples and community. Then go for an amazing swim at Dos ojos Cenote (Sub-terranian) natural spring. 
Isla Mujeres day trip also highly recommended!

Special thanks to Galdino our host with the most!

Scotty and Alba

reviews.author: Tina
reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text:
Very disappointing vacation if you don’t do royal service . They knew it was our honeymoon and they sent a bottle of champagne and tiny slice of cake ...  , no flowers, and we got an old outdated room . Other resorts I’ve stayed at they leave cute little towel animals and flower pedals or chocolates . 
And be forewarned .... there’s ALOT of steps and no railings to get to the beach which was very difficult with a bad knee . 
The restaurants were extremely hot . 3 restaurants closed for renovations and the ones left were outside and hot . Not much of a selection .... food no good . Breakfast was buffet only every day ... same old stuff . Hard cold pancakes and waffles . Even all the bars ... very hot .
I was also told that there was snorkeling available on site . Never seen that . There were some water activities but you will have a long walk down the driveway and across a highway to get to those . 
I would say that if you get royal service your stay would be better . More food choices and more help with finding things and maneuvering around the huge resort .

reviews.author: dwceilingslimited
reviews.title: Food poisoning!!
reviews.text:
Never done a trip advisor review & have stayed in many Melia Hotels in Punta Cana,Mallorca etc all of which have been excellent but need to let people who visit this hotel in Cancun aware, we have recently visited with 2 families celebrating a birthday- 11 people in total unfortunately out of those 6 people have been ill keeping them in bed for at least 2 days of our 7 nt stay. Since we arrived back in the UK 2 people have had to go to the doctor for further checks confirming food poisoning/stomach bug ! On arrival at the hotel we found cleanliness not up to 5* standard at all, the lifts in the hotel were disgusting the flooring/carpet within the lifts was filthy, the pool areas needed attention the hotel is very ‘tired’ and in desperate need of renovation. We visited all the restaurants, all of which served lukewarm tasteless food & food that was uncovered therefore open to the elements - if you are going to this hotel be extra vigilant with the food & water.
This experience has put us of Meliá hotels & Mexico

reviews.author: michbratt
reviews.title: Amazing family getaway!!
reviews.text: Our family had a great experience at Paradisus. Our kids loved the kids club and never wanted to leave when we picked them up. The food and service were both top-notch. The room was beautiful and matched our needs perfectly.

reviews.author: CareyC
reviews.title: Construction everywhere
reviews.text:
First - check in staff are not trained. Mistakes mistakes mistakes. We had to go back and forth 3 times to get to the right room. We even had to tell the bell desk to take our luggage back from the wrong room which is already occupied by other guests. 

Second - construction EVERYWHERE!! Majority of indoor restaurants closed for construction. We were sweating almost every meals except that one dinner eating at Mole.

Third - facilities chipped and cracked. The hotel looks nice from far away but when you actually use the facilities, you see chipped and cracked everywhere.

reviews.author: timK7501ET
reviews.title: Absolutely Incredible
reviews.text:
One of the best resorts I have stayed in. The Beach is incredible, rooms were spacious and clean, Incredible views from balcony. The food was amazing except for Bana (Sushi), pass on that. Not good quality at all. 
The breakfast at the buffet is great, the breakfast at Blue Agave is amazing. The lounge was ok, not my style of music. They were playing Disco. (pass)
The service of all the employees is wonderful. Overall an incredible experience here. 
I used the fitness center, it was just ok. No views, kinda small. 
I would return again without a doubt.

reviews.author: off2thekeys
reviews.title: Not anywhere close to perfection
reviews.text:
Walking in was very lovely with a smell and vibe of a spa inclusive of cold fragrant towels to wash your face upon arrival. We were taken to the check in the area until that our room would not be ready until three. They went over the policies of the resort and then you meet with a resort planner to tell you about the restaurants and such. It was at this time that we found out that three of the restaurants were closed.  They asked if we were celebrating anything so we share we were celebrating my birthday which is this month. 

We went to the taco/quesadilla place for lunch only to find out that if you’re vegetarian your only choice is cheese. They only offer pork, chicken or beef. The beans are not vegetarians he cannot have that.

We looked on the site before coming here and there is zero mention of any renovations or construction. But I’ll put arrival we found out that three of the restaurants we could’ve used are closed for renovations. When we spoke with Margarita she told us that it was on the website which we went back on the website to confirm that it actually was not listed as having any construction she was quite defensive with us and kept telling us that it was posted on the website but in fact it is not. 

When we finally got to our room the door was broken into the balcony so hot air it was flowing in as well as water. We tried to have air-conditioning compensate her but it was impossible. We call downstairs six different times asking to be changed to a different room. Keep in mind we were told a check and that they were only at 40% occupancy so we know that there are other rooms available. They sent to people from housekeeping and one person for me except they never shared with us what was happening. Finally during the six calls we spoke to said she would get somebody to move us in 45 minutes. At that hour we called and they were told that they were on our way it was another 15 minutes before anyone showed up. Unfortunately couldn’t do much on the resort because we needed to wait to get to our room and get everything settled.

The new room was bright and well appointed with perfect air-conditioning. There is a small step to get into the bathroom   This is a major fall risk and horrible trip hazard. 

But we had wasted three hours of her first day which was not appropriate. When we went to talk to Margarita about it, she made it as if she did it a favor to ask by changing our room. We explained that we paid for with air-conditioning and so really just change our room was not doing us a favor. It started to get a little heated which was also inappropriate.

She asked what we could do for us and we asked if we could have dinner in the upscale restaurant and we were told that it was not for us only for private guests. We tried to explain that we we’re not asking for a discount in the room; she didn’t even offer an upgrade or a free massage or a free cabana on the beach or anything just to make the reservations for dinner that night in a restaurant that was included. She offered an upgrade towards the end but at that point we had already moved and did not want to do it again.

We went to the sushi restaurant which was not good and then went to moly the specialty Mexican restaurant. I’m sure if you eat some of the items there it would be great but if you’re a vegetarian it’s very limited. Also on the vegetarian menu is grilled grasshoppers. And my book that is not going to work. We ended up going to the buffet which was lackluster.

The next morning we got up had breakfast in the downstairs restaurant which was buffet style but good. Of note the omelette has a large selection but be careful to ask for a little cheese otherwise you will have an enormous amount. If you like that then you’re in the right spot. There was no cocktails offered at breakfast which was strange being in an all-inclusive resort.

We came out to the pool looking for a towel service as we had that cards to get towels but could not find where to get them. Once we finally figure that out we asked where there was a bar. There is no bar open before 11 AM. You have to go to the buffet and ask for a drink there. I guess this is one of the ways that they save money by not having to serve alcohol. I’m not saying you need to drink your entire day away but on vacation having a bloody Mary, Mamosa or margarita in the morning would be nice. But that is not available here.

We were approached by someone in for a massage telling us that it’s normally $140 for a 50 minute massage but today only you could get it for $90. Since there were three of us we asked to get it for 80 each. She came back inside now. Again not trying to be cheap about it but if you’re telling me you only have 40% occupancy and that you have tons of openings then work with us or say hey for the $90 we can throw in an extra five or 10 minutes but they do nothing of that here.   We have been to Moon Palace, Nizuk, dreams and they are significantly better with food, service and beauty. 

We were told Market Grill was open for breakfast it is not. It is open for lunch.  

Manuel has been the best service person here. Very attentive and friendly. 

There is a gelato place but it closes before 1000pm. Really??

Overall if you were looking for a budget friendly, clean hotel this is it. If you’ve been anywhere else that is truly five start this will not meet your standards. I would give it a two star.

reviews.author: Nicole H
reviews.title: A Relaxing Stay at Paradisus
reviews.text:
I just returned from a stay and had such a relaxing time. If you are not traveling with children it is worth it to upgrade to the royal service. The hotel is hot at times but the royal service tower is air conditioned and our room was modern. The butler assigned to us was Alex and he made sure to make our stay carefree. We stayed for 5 nights with the royal service that included 2 days of a reserved Bali bed next to the pool. Oscar provided spectacular service by the pool and seemed to read my mind whenever I wanted a drink. Entertainment was ok but we really enjoyed the margarita class with Eduardo and the Michael Jackson impersonation show.
Our ocean view from the room was memorable with a nice sized private patio. The room felt a little warmer later at night (even with AC) but was adequately cool for the most part. It is an older hotel but from what I can see it has been well maintained. The staff is great and it is always appreciated when you tip good service.

reviews.author: carolin A
reviews.title: amazing
reviews.text:
It was the most relaxing vacation I've ever had. 
We were pampered from the minute we walked in.
Everyone is super nice and they do everything to make your stay unique. 
Thank you for our great vacation

reviews.author: Annie T
reviews.title: Pluses and minuses
reviews.text:
Dated but still beautiful. Grand entrance brings outdoors in. They are renovating so it will be even nicer. Some restaurants were closed so that was a bit disappointing, but overall pleased with food options. Don’t like the initial timeshare pressure sale, but just tactfully and firmly decline. Rooms are dated as well but nice sized (at least one bedroom) though divider was heavy, glass, and very hard to use. Liked that there was a full kitchenette if you wanted to use including a nice sized mini fridge. Perfect for families. Balcony was nice with tub (nice thought... although super dirty so would never use). 

Spa was nice. Again dated but facilities included pool with multiple jets, vitality soaking area, sauna, steam room, etc.  Expected more of a spread for snacks instead it was literally a jar of peanuts and a jar of slivered almonds. Nice staff and attendants. Massage was pretty good. Expensive of course, but still nice and worth the relaxing time. Beach has a lot of seaweed but still nice area and not busy. 

Worst part was getting sick... either heat or food... but miserable for part of trip. Then baby got sick as well but different. Caused by kiddie pool according to the pediatrician when we got back stateside. So, very unfortunate ending to the trip...

reviews.author: nickpatel2017
reviews.title: Great place for family vacation!!
reviews.text: Great place, great service, good food, good drinks, family friendly. Def recommend to anyone traveling with family. Great evening activities for families and kids. Club for 18+ which is open until 2am. Kids day care for free. Best sunset with the lagoon view.

reviews.author: Cindy V
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Lovely service. Jennifer Pena, and Maria Lena(circle) are great and very helpful. Very friendly staff at this resort. The resort is beautiful and very clean. Facilities were very useful and the resources were great.

reviews.author: amyxho
reviews.title: Amazing Stay
reviews.text:
My boyfriend and I were a little hesitant from the reviews in regards to the lack of A/C, but once we arrived we aren't too sure what other people were referring too. The hotel conditions were GREAT. 

We stayed for a total of 5 days and 4 nights, there was not a day where we were not greeted by almost all of the hotel employees. We decided to reserve a bali bed on Coco beach for 2 out of the 5 days, where we received spectacular service. I believe our servers for the day were Caesar and Victor, they were amazing, they continuously brought us our go to drinks without being asked, they serves us a lobster lunch and really gave us a great experience. 

The pool area was HUGE with plenty of entertainment throughout the day, the entertainment team did a swell job of getting everyone involved as well as hyping up the crowd. 

The restaurants within the hotel were good, if you are traveling on the weekends I would recommend for you to make your dinner reservations for the weekend upon arrival. We also utilized the late night room service, where we received our food within 25 mins of ordering.  Our favorite restaurant was the Taco place I believe is called Mole. 

Unfortunately, we were unable to enjoy the night time activities at the resort, but as we walked by one night there were night markets, dancers as well as a silent disco. 

Overall we had a great stay, upon leaving my boyfriend and I even agreed that we will be returning Paradissus in the future.

reviews.author: jaan65
reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun from August 31-September 7th. I normally do not write reviews but felt that other people's reviews were helpful in my decision making so I would return the favor.

We booked a regular package ( lagoon view) online and contacted the hotel before our trip to upgrade to Family Concierge. It was much cheaper to do it this way.

Family concierge is great for those travelling with children. We had our own air conditioned lounge for check in, with snacks, a bar, computers for the kids to play on and a play area. My kids loved ending their night off here before bed. Our assigned butler was Violeta and she was grea! She was always available to help us with any questions we may have had or anything we needed for the kids and to make our dinner reservations.

Our room was great, no complaints at all. Family concierge had little treats for the kids throughout our trip which was an added bonus. The family concierge section of the pool was a bit dull and the pool was too shallow for my 9 year old to enjoy. Even my toddler preffered the bigger pool. 

Our only main dissapointed for this resort was the food. We always heard that Mexico had the best food from any other place down south. A friend of mine recently went to cancun but another hotel and said the food was amazing. they were served lobster and crab legs at the buffet in abundance. We never saw lobster or crab and when we asked, we were told we had to pay for it. The buffet lacked variety and the food was bland. We have travelled to many placed and the buffet always had a pasta station to have your own pasta made or a grill where you can get the meat or fish grilled for you but not here. 

Restaurants were closed for renovations which left us with not many options and by mid week we were bored of the food. For such a great hotel rated at 5 start, we were not impressed with the lack of food options.

We have no regrets, the hotel and service was great however they really should consider uping their game when it comes to food. Also the main pool lacked entertainment, I mean the music wasn't great...I wouldn't mind hearing Spanish music or reggaetón all day but it needed some more upbeat stuff.

reviews.author: Jasmin Nina G
reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: This resort is absolutely beautiful. The foliage in the main pyramid courtyard is pretty. The ambiance of the entire place is luxury. My fiancée and I came to Cancun for a post-engagement/birthday celebration and it was wonderful. The staff is very accommodating and so friendly! I would return here for the customer service alone, if not for the beautiful place that it is. The room was spacious and we had a balcony with ocean view. The bathroom had granite-top counters and a bidet! The food wasn’t the best, but since it’s all-inclusive it’s to be expected. You have to go to the Tempo restaurant! It’s not included in the all-inclusive but it was a worthwhile experience!

reviews.author: Megan M
reviews.title: Royal Service at Paradisus Highly Recommend
reviews.text: This was our 2nd time staying at Paradisus Cancun in Royal Service.  We are pretty low maintenance,we like to hang out in the cabana by the pool, have some drinks, eat decent food and relax.  It's a great place to relax and not have to worry about anything.  This is because we are assigned a butler to help reserve cabanas, restaurant reservations and help with anything we could possible need.  Our butler was Alex and he was great.  We ran into him a few times during the day, but we could always reach him with WhatsApp.  Alex has a really nice balance of helping without disturbing which is a really excellent quality.  The rest of the staff were also extremely nice and helpful and gave the impression that they were enjoying themselves as well, even though they were working really hard.  There were also some added perks that Alex helped arrange with a bottle of bubbles and chocolate covered strawberries in the room and a heart made of rose petals on the bed.  If we go back to Cancun next year, we would def stay here again.

reviews.author: Pathfinder25950
reviews.title: Great Vacation in Paradise
reviews.text: Lodging, services, food, variety, facilities were all very good. However, the 9 hold golf course was terrible. Stayed from 8/29 - 9/6 and the mosquitos were terrible. Hotel did not provide relief for avoiding them.

reviews.author: PJ Arden
reviews.title: Unsatisfied
reviews.text: Issues from room, requested king got 2 single beds, went to ask a change told no. Took some convincing then got room with mold (maintenance guy painting in room even though room was suppossed to be ready. Beach closed at beach resort at 8pm and pool clised at 7pm

reviews.author: Amy V
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text:
PRO: The rooms, grounds, restaurants and pool area were kept very clean.  The staff were also welcoming and nice (if you tipped) - a special thank you to Flor at the pool and Guadencio at Blue Agave for their help! So attentive! The drinks were very good, not watered down at all. The other pro would be the check-in process was quick and staff were polite at the front desk...which leads me to the cons. 

CON: Although check-in was quick we were given an ocean view with two double beds when we booked a king. We were told we could switch to a ground floor room with a king bed 2 days after check-in (no ocean view) or switch to an ocean view king 3 days after check-in...which wasn’t helpful since we were only staying 5 days. Disappointing since this was a celebration trip for my birthday and our friends anniversary. The same thing happened to our friends but they were able to switch to a king the next day after check-in. We were told they just don’t have the rooms available and a big group was coming in and they got priority?!? I feel as if I had upgraded to Royal Service or thrown a fit at the front desk they would have accommodated us - but I wasn’t interested in getting upset and putting a damper on the rest of the trip. 

Another con is that they’re doing a lot of construction which limits their restaurant and buffet availability. Our group ended up going off the property for dinner so we could get a better variety of options (and air conditioning) - by day 4 we were done eating the same thing over and over. 

RECOMMENDATIONS: Before leaving the front desk at check-in make sure you have the correct room that you originally booked. Make reservations at the restaurants you want on day 1 so you can get in at a decent time, especially if you have a large group. Make sure to get to the pool early to grab a spot under an umbrella. Finally, I recommend staying somewhere else. Other all-inclusives I’ve stayed at service was better, they had more food options, and staff was friendlier...and I got the room I booked!

reviews.author: rpeks
reviews.title: Wonderful Resort for Bachelorette Party!
reviews.text:
We had 9 girls with us and we were treated like royalty!  The staff was attentive and fun always accommodating to our larger party.  The rooms were clean and tidy, the check-in and out process was seamless and the amenities were fantastic.  We enjoyed the food the most at Fuego and Bana but were impressed with all of the dinner places we made reservations at.  The one issue was the outdoor dinner areas just wear light clothing and bring sunscreen and the view will make up for it! Will be back again with out a doubt.

PS. If you go to Blue Agave or Mole as for Aaron, he was the best!

reviews.author: yeojinc104
reviews.title: Spoiled my vacation
reviews.text: I went to paradises Cancun last year and I really enjoyed it which was why I decided to go back. This year, the experience was totally opposite. The check in was difficult because the guy at the front desk kept refusing my husband’s signature. He said it didn’t match with the signature in the passport 100%. I got so sick by the third day because I ate the yogurt which was served warm. They never keep the food at the right temperature at breakfast buffet, warm food is cold, cold food is warm. My favorite restaurant was being renovated and they didn’t mention it on the website. I was forced to eat somewhere else, the experience at one of the restaurant near the beach was horrible because each one in my family got 50+ mosquito bites while we were eating outside. It is hard to avoid bugs outside but they could’ve provided some insect repellent light/sensor near each table. I reserved the hospitality room when I checked out, the shower drain was clogged so badly I felt i got more dirty by taking shower at that room. In the middle of the shower, with shampoo on my hair, I had to switch the room. Overall I was really disappointed.

reviews.author: Renzo A
reviews.title: Experience at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Hotel overall was excellent, the cleanliness and service were outstanding. Leyner, our Royal Service butler was incredible friendly and helpful during our stay. Will definitively come back and recommend this to anyone planing a trip to Cancun.

reviews.author: Cathy D
reviews.title: Embarrassing encounter at pool
reviews.text: We were so impressed by the Melia Paradisus Cancun resort that on our first day  we decided to sit through the sales presentation about their rewards program, and were even seriously considering purchasing the package for both of our families. We were having this discussion by the pool under an umbrella, when an hour and a half later, another guest and her family came “back” to these chairs and hovered over us for over 30 minutes, causing a scene and even speaking to the waitstaff and pool staff about us. (We had done nothing; it was embarrassing.) When we spoke to pool management all they said is they accommodated the other family so we should be okay now. While I can appreciate this, nothing was done to help us. It certainly left an impression... accommodate the load screaming lady by giving her an upgrade or cabana... tell the innocent guests they are “ok” now. That said, we have found a super sweet pool server in Asunción.

reviews.author: Duresa M
reviews.title: Best first experience in Cancun!
reviews.text: This was my first time travelling to Mexico. I came with family who are visiting Cancun for their 4th time in a row and Paradisus is their first time here. We absolutely loved it here! The staff was absolutely amazing, from the hotel staff all the way to the staff from the restaurants including the two men who work at the coffee shop and gelato shop. Everyone here is so welcoming and friendly. The pools are amazing, food is great and the hotel rooms are very spacious and relaxing. Special shout out to our waiter Martin who we had a few times at The Enso restaurant, very nice guy and was so helpful. Also a shout out to the entertainment team; Alan, Julio and Rodrigo, they made sure that we had a fun day by the pool all day, everyday! They had different activities throughout the day all the way from 8am to the end of the night. They were my favourite boys I met here and I can’t wait to come back and see what they have in store for us next time! 10/10 would come again.

reviews.author: Magentaq
reviews.title: Amazing trip with my daughter
reviews.text: My daughter and I spent ten days at paradisus and we had a great time. We spent a lot of time at the pools and the beach. Both were very pretty and clean. The employees were attentive, polite, and friendly. Our favorite was Alan and Rodrigo, who ran a lot of activities around the pool and gym. We would not have tried so many of the activities without his encouragement. The food was also great. It’s defini worth it to check out Bue Agave and Market Grill. Every night the hotel had shows and performances out by the pool. My daughter and I enjoyed it very much. We even had to see the hotel doctor once and were quite satisfied with the experience.

reviews.author: David C
reviews.title: Family vacation 2019
reviews.text: Everything was great. Plenty of stuff to do and eat.  Beautiful scenery!! Alan, Julio and Rodrigo were great at the Pool with the activities.  The food and drinks were great and tasty.  Our room attendant Gloria and Rodrigo were amazing.

reviews.author: Ryan W
reviews.title: Best trip with my friends hands down
reviews.text:
Hotel is amazing, food is great and staff are so welcoming. I love the pool parties and unlimited drinks!

Water aerobics with Alen, Julio, and Rodrigo are the best!! He keeps the party alive and going at all times of the day!

reviews.author: eagleeye1
reviews.title: Nothing but sunshine ,great treatment and plenty of rest
reviews.text: As having not been to Mexico for two years ,I wanted to express my gratitude for such a magnificent week of being spoiled for a week 8/24 to 8/31 .Our room was updated and beautiful  in the first tower,the mini bar always had been well stocked everyday.the house service was also great and kept very clean.there was always fresh towels.The flowers brought up by our butler ,George was lovely.Our conceirge ,Flor Iglesias was also lovely as well.we appreciate the the ramps on the way down to the pools since was traveling with a reduced vision person.I would also like to thank the  manager for his part in arranging tempo.The staff was wonderful and the food tasting was 5 star plus.After the superb treatment I belive they need to be recognized.when ever we needed any thing Flor and George was there.It was also great to meet up with Edna who was so nice, Between every one ,you made a wonderful vacation week.I do have a suggestion if it is possible,having a ramp from pool to beach .there may be too much of an incline but if its possible ,that would be great for your guest that need one.Also check out was a breeze since I could check out in my tower and not at the main lobby was a relief.The palapas that were there for us the whole week was worth  it .  There was two people in charge of towels and reserving the palapas ,one was yerry and not sure of the other person.we will be back next year.Also they kept the beach cleaned from the seaweed .It did not affect swimming.I also find coming at this time when alot of children had to go back to school made it even more relaxing.The pool water was as warm as your bath tub. I hope when I come back next year I get flor and george .

reviews.author: Franz S
reviews.title: Great place to stay for a while
reviews.text: Great place to stay for a long time. The restaurants offer a great variety as well as a good quality. The staff is very helpful and friendly. The only bad thing was the few umbrellas by the pool for so many people.

reviews.author: liveridesoulfree
reviews.title: Above expectations
reviews.text: What an amazing stay ! Everything from the room to the food to hector our butler and Aaron the pool concierge were above and beyond our expectations!! Every restaurant and room service asked if we had any food allergies and cooked to our needs !! Heavily recommend this paradise !

reviews.author: ninad
reviews.title: No wow feeling this time
reviews.text: We are presently at the resort 3 days in and I’m must say that the experience I  had 3 yrs ago was not the same ! Resort is showing it’s age and presently 3 restaurants are closed for  renovations ! I was given a side partial ocean view in pyramid 4 (last time was given ocean view higher floor in main pyramide without asking for any upgrades) I was surprised  to know that rooms have tubs/shower with over 2ft climb can be tricky is you are not  careful I asked if any rooms have walk-in showers and was suggested the first floor handicap room which I declined since we are not handicap and that room would kill any vacation vibe !!! The staff are all amazing they work hard and will accommodate  any requests !  The buffet is just okay I’ve had better and the à la carte restaurants like Mole mexicain and Bano Japanese are pretty good .  The other downside for me is trying to get a good night rest as the air conditioning runs very loud once in the middle of the night it sounded like a jet engine ! The pool and beach are great we find the cost of the Bali beds too expensive as I’ve stayed in other resorts and if you get one early enough ... are free! I am a Meliá reward customer and always chose this chain and I’ve been acknowledged at other resorts with upgrades in Punta  Cana, Cuba but not in Cancun so this resort will not be on my return list as there are so many more option along  the Cancun coast !

reviews.author: DayTrip14857457299
reviews.title: Excellent resort, especially for the price!
reviews.text: This was the 3rd resort I've stayed at in Cancun, first time coming with children though and I was absolutely more than pleased with this resort. My wife, 4 year old son and I stayed in one of the family concierge rooms, and our butlers Alexa and Violeta were awesome! Made sure we always had everything we needed. As far as the resort itself goes, I had read reviews before coming that didn't speak too highly of the food, but I thought the food was great, especially Market Grill and Blue agave. The pool was perfect, especially if you have kids, my 4 year old isn't much of a swimmer yet so having the kids pool that he could play in was huge for us. The beach was great as well, in a very prime location compared to the other resorts ive stayed at. Overall the stay was great and I have no complaints, definitely will be back!

reviews.author: Gazi S
reviews.title: Visit Cancun and stay in Paradisus
reviews.text: Service is too good. I will always recommended Paradisus Cancun to everyone. Also,if I visit Cancun again my first selection will be Paradisus. My kids enjoyed a lot. Also, the location of the resort is very near to airport.

reviews.author: Elina M
reviews.title: Unforgettable Service
reviews.text: There are specifically two gentlemen waiters that were working at both the Gabi Club and the Red Lounge. Their names are Carlos Reyes Tuz Lopez and Jorge Moreno. They provided me, my family, and my friend unforgettable service every single day for 8 nights. They are both so friendly and they make you feel very important. They are also very very hard workers. I sincerely appreciate everything they have done for all of us and I still can't forget them. They are the best!!!!

reviews.author: Anna Z
reviews.title: Aug 29-Sept 5
reviews.text:
Me and my boyfriend came here for 7 days and we have mixed feelings about this resort. 
Pros: Big Resort, Close to the airport and mall, amazing service, and nice view of both ocean and lagoon. Royal service (adults only) is absolutely necessary and worth the upgrade!! With out it this resort feels more like a 3 star. 

Cons: Food is TERRIBLE unless you're apart of the Royal Service. Royal Service has an exclusive restaurant called La Palapa which is pretty good for breakfast, lunch & dinner. Market Grill is also good for dinner (Brazilian steak house) but during the day its a tiny buffet with nothing other than salad and pasta. 
Entertainment is pretty lame unless you're into listening to opera and watching dancing performances. 
Room service is hit and miss, somedays they wont clean your room until 4/5pm and some days its done by 1. Fridge also isn't stocked every day.  
Condition of the room is pretty good, i felt like the shower needed some updating but no big deal. It seems like most of the hotel is going through renovation, 2-3 restaurants were closed so our options were very limited. 

Over all i dont think we would ever come back to this resort.

reviews.author: Simone W
reviews.title: Paradisus, but not the same as I’ve known it...
reviews.text:
Having stayed at two previous FC Paradisus properties ( Esmeralda in Playa Del Carmen & The Reserve In Punta Cana) I was really looking forward to my stay on the white sand beaches of Cancun.  I must say that I left disappointed.  Not due to the staff, our concierge Alexa was always keeping in touch and kept my two kids in all the chocolate milk and nighttime gifts and most of the wait staff, spa staff and Kids/baby club staff were great.  It was just overall the experience was not the same.

Pro’s 
Really close to the airport - maximum 25 minutes transfer
Lovely beach and sea not too rough, so you could swim, but no young kids as waves quite strong.
FC lounge - great snacks all day, staff knowledgeable although kids play area in lounge requires updating.
Great room service - in fact the food was better by room service than in the restaurants ( which should not be the case!).

Con’s
FC service amenities no way as good as previous. Towel cards, lack of FC beach space - poor in comparison.
Food - not great at all - three restaurants closed whilst we were there. Vegetarian options really bad.
Bali-beds should be unlimited in FC having it for only one day is silly especially as they sit there unused as no one wants to pay for them. 
FC is in Tower three and nightly entertainment is in the atrium of this tower. So loud music after 8pm is not great for young familiies. 
Property is very old and is showing its age, despite the upgrades to rooms.

Yes to FC, but not in Cancun again.

reviews.author: Carmen
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text: Just got back from a 6 night stay with my family. The service here was amazing, thanks Valentine and Oscar for being so awesome and going out of your way to make our experience wonderful. The resort is beautiful but it’s hot. Needs more areas with ac, only 1 restaurant with ac, omg we were melting. The restaurants had great food except the buffet. Buffet needs major improvement and I’m not a picky eater. The place was super clean, excellent location. Again the service only deserves 5 stars but the heat and buffet needs improvement

reviews.author: Max N
reviews.title: Average Resort
reviews.text:
I spent 7 days, 6 nights here. I primarily chose the hotel because it was rated highly by many of the users on Expedia & TripAdvisor plus I had some acquaintances tell me it was good. To start, the check in process was a little frustrating. We had requested two rooms with 2 double beds but were told they were no longer available and rooms with king beds were only available. After some negotiation, we managed to get the rooms as requested. The rooms are mediocre at best - with outlets that don’t work & a gazillion light switches. The shower controls were confusing as you have to play around with it to get the desired water temperature. Beds were comfy.
Pools were clean and very well maintained. The bars and all the staff members were courteous and friendly throughout our stay. Particularly, Ignatcio at Enso was helpful. 
Food wise, many of the dishes were similar with not that much variety. Outside of the market grill which serves primarily an assortment of meats, most of the other restaurants had similar foods and minimal variety. In the Japanese restaurant, sushi was 90% rice with very little fish / veggies in it. The desserts were awful. I had “fried banana with rice pudding” and it was horrendous. Most of the restaurants offer a buffet-styled design. My favorite restaurant was the sunset grill - the chicken burgers are good there. Overall, the food was just average. 
For entertainment, there was very few options. There is a lounge called the red lounge open from 10 PM - 2 AM which is small and mostly people with family / significant others. By the market grill, they have shows occasionally. 
At the beaches & poolside, they have Bali beds but they have to be paid for (pretty expensive) just to use. I’ve noticed that most of the time they’re empty meanwhile other people can’t find tanning beds to occupy. It’s a ridiculous policy. Room service costs a $5 delivery fee. Massages are $150 per person. And one of the restaurants is not included in the all inclusive package deal. The Mediterranean restaurant was also closed for renovations. 
I highly recommend activities to be done here (jet ski, scuba diving, paragliding, etc either through Expedia / TripAdvisor or you can book on the resort itself, they have agents there). The resort itself is relatively bland in the evening.
Overall, it was just a decent stay. I wouldn’t necessarily say it was a 5 star experience though. More like a 3/5.

reviews.author: Michelle R
reviews.title: amazing place, not sure about the food though.
reviews.text:
We have just come back from a week here and it was pretty amazing, nice venue lovely and chilled. 
rooms were cleaned everyday, could normally find a pool bed , although with 6 of us we opted to have a Cabana for a few days.  beware you don't have to have the lobster or champagne with the bed... you CAN take it off as we did. 

The food .... was awful to be honest,  bland boring and very very repetitive.  Not all of the restaurants are open at the moment. They failed to tell us this.  
The service in some of the places wasn't the nicest either.. I feel like this probably let the whole place down. otherwise it may of been a 5

on the whole it was a very pleasant trip . 

Massive thanks to Sergio at the Pool... he was immense and very attentive. We noticed the difference when ha had a day off  ...

reviews.author: Annette Sofia E
reviews.title: Best experience ever
reviews.text: The hotel is so beautiful I had such an amazing time but I need to mention the service of several people... Antonio, and Timoteo at Toji bar! Tee did the cigar bar, guacamole bar, and margarita bar: it was a cultural experience and I had such a great time thank goodness for these free experiences that we get to enjoy! Special shout out to Alan in activities we’ve met him several times and he’s awesome and great with details he makes us have a great time and keeps our spirits up!!! Love this hotel!!

reviews.author: katherinel0427
reviews.title: Awesome Trip
reviews.text: Cancun I figured totally wasn't our vibe but Paradius was a blast. They accomdadated our friends greatly. It works really well for large groups. I really appreciated some of the spontaneous stuff that just occurs through out the resort. There was a random silent disco that was a good time. Three hotel workers (Alan, Julio, Rodrigo) came and played volleyball with us multiple times. They were such a solid addition to our trip. It was a great surprise. We also loved our waitress down on the beach, Irena.

reviews.author: sthiggy
reviews.title: Excellent holiday for the whole family.
reviews.text: Probably the best family holiday we've had. With the mix of the family concierge guidance, the use of the excellent kids club which our boys loved and we felt secure in leaving them. And with the use of the Royal Service amenities we had the best of both worlds. 4 of the restaurants closed on our 2nd day which could of been emailed to us beforehand as this came as a surprise and they don't open again until October. However there were slill plenty of places to eat as they managed to rotate the different cuisines. The nightly entertainment was excellent and service for drinks prompt and polite. We are definitely looking at another Melia hotel for next year's holiday on the sublim customer service alone.

reviews.author: Yuda K
reviews.title: Royal service and superb staff
reviews.text: We had an incredible experience. Guadalupe who’s the check-in desk supervisor was amazing. She made us feel really at home. The royal wing is one of a kind place. Highly recommend and will definitely return.

reviews.author: Climber341154
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancún Family Concierge
reviews.text: I would definitely recommend Paradisus Cancun. Especially if you are traveling with a family. We did the Family Concierge package and the moment we walked in to the hotel we received such excellent service. Fernanda, our concierge, was amazing!! She took care of every request we had. Overall, the whole experience was great. We will definitely be coming back next year.

reviews.author: Ali A
reviews.title: Royal service
reviews.text:
This our first time in this Great and amazing resort, great location and great staff . The royal service is excellent and our personal Butler Jesus, went above and beyond in insuring we had great time great restaurant and great food.
We would like to go back, definitely recommend this resort

reviews.author: Nmcbrown1
reviews.title: Great family friendly resort!
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun is a great resort for families. There is nightly family friendly entertainment as well as a great kids club that puts on little events by the pool that are appropriate for kids of varying ages. We have stayed at this resort twice and would definitely go back!

reviews.author: kmbelle
reviews.title: Total Recharge
reviews.text: This is our 4th stay at Paradisus over the last seven years and it's as great now as it was the first time.  The hotel has maintained it's beauty and it's clear they work hard to keep it in pristine shape.  We spent most of our time on the beach on the cabanas and I cannot say enough wonderful things about the guys who took care of us: Didy, Rene, Sofonia and Manuel-just the absolute NICEST people-!  Food was amazing-as always!  The only slight bummer was the shop downstairs that used to act more like a small grocery store with a great selection of things you probably forgot to bring, has turned into yet another souvenir/swimsuit shop.  Overall, another amazing trip the one of the most gorgeous places on earth.  Planning a spring break trip already!!

reviews.author: Rebecca L
reviews.title: Royal Service
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun and had opted for the Royal Service. My husband and I would highly recommend the Royal Service option if you plan an staying at the hotel for the most part. We stayed 3 nights and as soon as we pulled up we were taken care of. A valet took our bags and we had a very nice lady at the door lead us to an air conditioned room where out Royal Service concierge came to bring us to the Royal Service pyramid. They have a private check in/out and we never had to wait for any of it. They go through everything that is included in your stay. On top of the all inclusive drinks and food we were given a bottle of whiskey in our room, royal service has a private bar, snack bar for breakfast, lunch, and dessert, with waitstaff to make your drinks, coffee everywhere, a private lounge for only 18 and over, a private pool, bali beds that you can reserve for they days you want them when you check in at no extra cost (highly recommend, amazing views!), butler service that proved to be indispensable, and access to the spa's water therapy pool, experience showers, sauna and steam room. 
Our butler Arturo was amazing! He went above and beyond to make sure we had a wonderful time on our 5-year anniversary trip. From making all of our dinner and bali bed reservations to literally cleaning our room when we checked in so I could sleep from our 12 hours of travel to get there. He answered all of our questions, took care of our transportation back to the airport, made sure our mini bar was stocked how we liked it. I would recommend downloading WhatsApp so you dont have to use texting or phone calls on your plan to stay in contact with your butler.
The hotel is filled with plants, small ponds, koi fish, and they burn incense in the mornings. Our pyramid was they air conditioned but the main pyramid was not. 
There are several amazing restaurants to try. Something for everyone's taste. 
The views, service and whole experience was completely worth it. 
If you go please ask for Arturo for your butler, he's an amazing guy and made our trip that much better.

reviews.author: A W
reviews.title: AWESOME
reviews.text: What an amazing Resort and Staff. The service EVERYDAY was EXTRAORDINARY. I cannot say enough about the our time here. The Dtaff was always will to go the extra mile to make sure you were comfortable and enjoying yourself at all times. My husband & I will be visiting again soon. Thanks Paradisus for the AMAZING Vacation.

reviews.author: Linda H
reviews.title: Exceptional Vacation created by Exceptional staff!
reviews.text: This was our family's first time in Mexico and first time at the beautiful and immaculate Paradisus Cancun! The facility is clean, comfortable and the soothing aroma's throughout the facility is a great touch! From reservations where we received a wonderful deal on Family concierge and was upgraded to ocean view, to the outstanding service we received from our family concierge butlers Sandra & Alex - they were amazing at attending to our needs, being kind and welcoming and ensuring we knew about all afternoon and evening activities! We loved receiving aromatic sprays on our pillows before bedtime and my girls loved the milk & cookies left for them before bedtime! We were amazed at the exceptional customer service demonstrated by each and every team member from the wonderful and pleasant restaurant attendants to the hospitality staff. I would definitely attend this resort again and for my first all inclusive experience - it's the only way to go! It's stress free to not have to worry about tips or paying in restaurants but to eat as much as you want and to be able to get up and leave is wonderful! We are planning our next trip back to Cancun and back to Paradisus for 2019! We hope we have Alex and Sandra again as well! We enjoyed them so very much!!!

reviews.author: dlpearsonjr
reviews.title: Don’t go
reviews.text: Went for anniversary and birthday trip. Got food poisoning on the second day and was sick almost the whole stay. Observed a worker dropping food then retrieving it and putting it back on the bar, and this was the location where I had ate and got sick, saw a worker retrieve something out of a drink with his bare fingers and deliver it to a guest. Also observed workers picking there nose.

reviews.author: Rishma B
reviews.title: BIRTHDAY BASH!
reviews.text: Our family of 14 stayed in Paradisus for 5 days to celebrate our niece's birthday and our sister's birthday.  The staff was excellent in helping us celebrate especially Antonio, Pablo, Ignacio and David at the buffet.  Always had our table ready for breakfast and very courteous.  Darwin was a great host as well in our sushi dining experience! Hotel was beautiful and relaxing.  It's our 3rd trip back to Paradisus. Beach views were excellent, pools were amazing! Food was very good.  Enjoyed our stay!

reviews.author: washingtonsammy88
reviews.title: Check reviews b4 booking
reviews.text: Great location nice front hotel features nice lobby nice decore great food in resturants rooms need upgrading slow service when checking with staff members more staff needed at front desk slow service when checking out room service with towels and cleaning is slow.

reviews.author: jaxmaxdad
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun gives the Melia group a bad name!
reviews.text:
Our family of 10 stayed in Club Melia for a full week. Our same group had previously stayed at The Level at Melia Caribe Tropical in the Dominican Republic (see that review in my profile Aug. 2016). This time we had a completely different experience and will not go back!  

Our Hostess Claudia should not be trusted to make any arrangements for you.  On more than one occasion she told us she had made us dinner reservations only to find out when we arrived at the reception desk that they were not aware of our reservation!  One time we had to settle on going to the buffett. The second time we experienced this after questioning Claudia and her telling us it was a misunderstanding an apologised to us we inquired further.  We were told she does this regularly?? This is mind blowing and I really did not want to believe it but it was true.  

Food was ok, Rooms were ok, Staff were ok just not the same mindset from the resort staff as our previous Melia experience. My sister received a written apology  from  Melia.

reviews.author: Brandy D
reviews.title: Relaxing stay
reviews.text:
Here's what we had to say.  We stayed in the Royal Service Luxury Lagoon suite for 4 nights.  The most beautiful room we've every stayed in.  The huge tub and double shower was fantastic.  First of all, we want to acknowledge a few folks.  Rode, Rode, RODE!!!!  He was the best butler ever!  A butler is included with Royal Service, so make sure you request Rode if you can.  He was excelente!  He anticipated all our needs, made wonderful suggestions for dinner reservations and hooked us up with Mauricio who got us 2 awesome tours for a discount.  Rode also set up a birthday surprise in the room that was very thoughtful.  ASK FOR RODE!!!!
Andres in the Market Grill also provided us with a lovely experience.  He was a very attentive waiter in the restaurant.  He even suggested a lobster platter to celebrate a birthday!  Thanks so much Andres!  YOU ROCK!
The hotel is beautiful!  There's a lot of activities.  We especially liked the Royal Service amenities such as a private pool and beach area along with a private restaurant, La Palapa. We had our own private check-in and check out desk.There was a Royal Service luxury area where breakfast, heavy hors d'oeuvres and dessert options.  The Yhi Spa was a very nice amenity.  Via Royal Service we were able to utilize a specific hydrotherapy service multiple times. Unfortunately we didn't get to eat in every restaurant.  The coffee and ice cream kiosks were a nice touch.  We also enjoyed the nightly entertainment when we were at the resort.  Be prepared to do some walking.  This resort is huge!  
A few things to note, to get the most all inclusive experience, we suggest upgrading to Royal Service.  Lobster is not included.  You will have to purchase any lobster options and you would actually need to ask the waiter about them as they are not listed on the menus for the restaurants where we had food.  We are used to transfers being included in an all-inclusive resort.  However, that is not the case with Paradisus Cancun which is one of the main reasons for a score of 4 out of 5.  It was difficult to get information from the resort on a recommended transfer company.  It took us 3 separate calls to get a suggestion.  We paid $70 for transfer to the resort from the airport and back via Otium, which we recommend.  They have nice, clean vehicles and are timely and courteous.  We felt safe at all times.  There was an issue with the wildlife which is the other reason why scoring the resort 4 out of 5.  The Market Grill had great food, but during daylight hours there were birds everywhere.  Birds standing on the chairs..walking on the tables where the cutlery and napkins were placed...pooping everywhere..literally.  On several occasions, we had to switch the chairs out.  This needs to be addressed by the resort.  Visiting during the month of September meant the beach was heavy with sea moss...so much that we didn't get into the water.  So, be mindful of that.  The resort credits end up being coupon books that the resorts tells you how to spend.  For example, you could get a coupon for $50 towards a room upgrade, but you would not be able to use the entire $550 resort credit on the room upgrade.  One more suggestion, reserve restaurants for every night if possible.  Most of the restaurants seem to require it.  Download the Melia app if you can...but it sometimes acts up.
All in all, this resort was very nice.  Check it out!

reviews.author: Waynemw
reviews.title: Good stay but few issues
reviews.text: We had a  good stay over all, we found most people friendly apart from the spa reception staff. housekeeping was very good, our Room Attendant was very good. out door pools where amazing and a great view. issue for us where the spa reception staff we found rude. and  the food were a lot of fish dishes with limited other options. only place we had diff options was the Brazilian restaurant on site which was good. the buffet was ok but not amazing, I lost weight on this holiday which im sure is unheard of at an inclusive resort lol

reviews.author: Katia walton
reviews.title: We couldn't have a better day!
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed there for one day for our anniversary. And it was awesome! The hotel is really beautiful, the food and it's variety is great, nice swimming pools and great shows. Very welcoming and attentive staff. We were very happy! We already look forward to coming back!

reviews.author: JOSE M
reviews.title: 50/50 experience
reviews.text: During my stay I wasn't able to try every restaurant so wasn't completely satisfied and we had encountered elevator problems and restrooms through the hotel didn't have paper towels so I had to dry myself with my own shirt ...

reviews.author: Guillermo R
reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text: It was a wonderful experience overall. The check in desk experience was good, just it has to be a little more efficient. We were waiting in line for almost 30mins. But other than that it was a excellent experience. Definitely recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: mariamL9541FA
reviews.title: Exception Royal Service
reviews.text: Every member of our family of 13 LOVED this resort and especially the Royal Service treatment.  Our butler Rode was attentive, friendly and on top of everything we needed.  From Felipe the bell boy to the amazing wait staff at the exclusive Royal Service breakfast and lunch restaurant we can't thank you enough.  Clean property, great food.
