Royal Service has it's own smell.  We loved walking into our pyramid and smelling the air.  The atmosphere was perfect. Not one complaint except for the red tide of seaweed during our August stay.   We are beach people and were so disappointed, but the resort, beautiful pools and Bali Beds were all so great, we didn't miss swimming in the ocean.

reviews.author: Samantha F
reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text: Beautiful clean resort and exceptional customer service. Did not meet one rude employee my entire stay. Rooms were clean and room service came multiple times a day. Had a junior suite room on ocean view side and I would definitely recommend paying extra for the ocean side and not the lagoon, lagoon is across the street so it’s really a street/parking lot view. Plus, you get a really nice balcony in the suites. There are a total of 3 pools (1 is adults only, I did not do) and of course a very clean beach. Main pool with swim up bar gets very busy around 3 every day. Make sure you try the gelato, it was amazing! I tried every restaurant (besides the extra $ one, Tempo) and Fuego was my favorite and then Market Grill, the Brazilian steakhouse at night. Market Grill is outside so you have an ocean view while eating dinner. There was some kind of show going on every night, sometimes outside by the pool or sometimes inside in the middle of the resort. Resort is exceptionally quiet by the rooms and you won’t even know someone is staying next to you. A couple downfalls is the resort is huge inside and it’s very easy to get lost, but there’s always someone around to ask, no matter the time. The drinks are watered down, but so is every resort I’ve been to. I recommend buying a bottle of liquor at the airport to add to your drinks and drinking the cans of beer they provide in your mini bar, you can even bring those to the pool or beach! I would definitely stay here again and I even have plans to check out other Meliá resorts.

reviews.author: Natali S
reviews.title: Family trip
reviews.text:
We spent 5 days in this hotel. We have been to other Paradisus hotel. since we're members of the Melia program.
The hotel is beautiful, it's really one of a kind. The interrior with all the plants makes it really special. I have never seen something like that before. 
Wen had a beutifuly room, with amazing view of the ocean. 
The food was excellent, like always in Mexico.
The staff was friendly and professional, they took care of us. We didin't get  our butler, as promissed, but we didn't need one eiter. It's just part of the program. I guess they were very busy and we booked last minute.
The beach is famous in Cancun. The water wasn't for swimming though.
The swimming pool was too full and loud. There's another part of the hotel that is quiet, costs more of course and it's adults only.
The gym is really small for such a big hotel.
Entertainment was ok.
Activities were not really good. My son 14 was bored.

reviews.author: miissgenii
reviews.title: Would go back in the future!
reviews.text: Very accommodating, services was excellent and cleanliness. I want thank Armando from restaurant Naos lovely gentlemen wonderful server!I would go back in the future to stay and enjoy more of the place.

reviews.author: arkrok
reviews.title: Perfect for anybody
reviews.text: Excellent adults-only section called Royal Service. I would recommend (if everyone is over 18) staying here and going between the two areas. Nice pool, lounge area, and beach. The smell of the Royal Service building is absolutely wonderful. The staff is extremely friendly and helpful. The restaurants are also wonderful, especially Blue Agave and Fuego (definitely my favorites of the trip). Nighttime entertainment is good. Lots of pool space, good for families and kids if you stay in the main areas. All in all, would totally do it again and was a great value for the money.

reviews.author: Wanderer797787
reviews.title: Weekend Getaway with Kids
reviews.text:
We had fun this weekend, we visited Paradisus Cancun for the first time. Our overall experience was good. 

Check in: Enough people doing check ins. We did an early check in so when we went back to get room key and we werent offered someone to take us to the room and we got kind of lost but we found our way.

🍲Food: Not bad but not what we expected.

📍Location: 
* Hotel has a big lobby and below all of its restaurants plus the exit to pool and beach area. Its kind of confusing at the beginning but one you know which way to go you’ll be fine. 
* It has kids area, baby area, small playground, kids pool, only adults area, nespresso area, ice cream station, spa. 
* Wheelchair and stroller accesible except for the beach up to pool area you are ok.
* It has beds which can be reserved at an additional cost in pool area and beach area. Regular deckchair are available through out pool and beach.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Kids Amenities: 
* Spa: Has a menu with services for kids. 
* Baby area: Designed for kids from 1-4. Can be left with nannys or be there with parents.
* Kids area: Designed for kids over 5. They also have acctivities for them indoor and outdoors.
* Kids pool: Its till the end of the resort so you have to walk 👎🏼 Doesnt have slides, fountains or anything special.
* Ice cream: opens from 3-7

Check Out: Fast and they offered to take care of our luggage while we finish enjoying the hotel. I also heard they offered a complimentary room to take a shower or get changed so if you need this service ask the hotel for more info.

reviews.author: l0riann7
reviews.title: Quick weekend trip
reviews.text: Location was fabulous. Seaweed was a lot. Everything exceptional except housekeeping did not clean room after day 1. Even tipped good on day 1.  Guess I should not do that next time. Beautiful beach. Also no a/c ootside of rooms - only in some restaurants. All but one restaurant was excellent.

reviews.author: Vauneeka L
reviews.title: Bachelorette weekend
reviews.text: Visited Paradisus cancun with a group of girlfriends for a Bachelorette weekend. We paid for the Royal Service. Totally worth it! The hotel was extremely accommodating and I definitely felt the experience was elevated compared to my previous all-inclusive vacations. Jesus was our groups butler! He was FANTASTIC! So patient, so sweet! He definitely takes the time to make a genuine connection with his guests. The reason for the 4 stars was because the food in the restaurants in my opinion wasn't the best! Shout out to Daniel and his team at La Palapa for taking great care of us everyday even when we were loud and obnoxious and needy! Lol! I'd return to Paradisus Cancun for the experience but not so much for the food.

reviews.author: SarahYoussef
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: Its our first time in Cancun and we decided to stay at the paradisus. We booked a junior suite ocean view with family concierge. Our butlers were Sandra and Alexander. The hotel is very very clean everyone we encounter was super friendly and helpful. Alexander and Sandra did not leave us for a minute always making sure we were taken care of always checking with us to see if we needed anything. Every day sandra would leave a toy for our son and every night Alexander would leave milk and cookies for him. For our anniversary they surprised us with flowers champagne and strawberries for 3 days straight we felt very special.  Our housekeeper Jessica was super sweet she would clean our room well and make sure it's well stocked with anything we needed for the baby. Armando and Vincent from Nao were super attentive to our needs and always running to get us what we want. It was always nice to go get a cup of coffee from Orlando at nespresso bar he is always up beat and had my drink ready before I even ask for it. Overall this vacation was A+ thanks to the Paradisus family

reviews.author: claudiamN5129HL
reviews.title: Very disappointed!
reviews.text: First and last time in this hotel.  I can not complain about the service but the food is terrible, the rooms are dated and small. My husband got really sick we only ate at the hotel. (350 dlls to see the doctor at the hotel) had to come back one day earlier.  The only thing they gave us for leaving earlier were two bottles of electrolytes for my husband.

reviews.author: tdumain
reviews.title: Fabulous 40th in Cancun
reviews.text:
This trip was to celebrate my husband's 40th, and after three nights at Paradisus, I'm thinking we need to celebrate his 41st, 42nd, and 43rd here too. :) From the pools to the white-sand beach and well-appointed rooms, we enjoyed every minute of our stay. 
The hotel itself is tremendous; there are lots of restaurants on property, along with bars and shops, but the greenery and koi ponds within each pyramid makes for a beautiful and serene setting. The beach is beautiful: we had one great day of blue waters and calm surf, followed by a slightly stormier day that brought a lot of seaweed to the sand. But the huge pools made up for it. Plus, the drinks are always flowing, and the food, for the most part, is impressive, particularly for an all-inclusive. 
We splurged for Royal Service, and had the pleasure of Rode as our butler-- he took care of dinner reservations, secured Bali beds, surprised us with champagne, balloons and a drawn rose-petal bath on our last night, and made check out seamless. He was kind, and made the stay extra special. 
With Royal Service, you get access to a restaurant called La Palapa, which we loved the most. Each dish was as beautiful as it was delicious, and the service was impeccable. Some standouts: our waiter Julio was kind, helpful, and introduced us to our new favorite drinks, and Viktor on beach service was awesome.
Our favorite eats: La Palapa for breakfast and lunch, or Naos buffet for breakfast. 
The meats at Market Grill's dinner were fantastic. We didn't love dinner at Vento.

reviews.author: Marcus C
reviews.title: Unbelievably good.
reviews.text:
We stayed here after transfering from yucatan princess which we were not happy with. But Paradisus cancun totally made up for the bad start to the holiday.

The staff cannot do enough for you, squeezing us into alacart resturants that were booked up, drinks refilled without asking, the food in all resturants was amazing coming from a fussy eater.
Especially the buffet and sushi restaurant ( bana ) which was awesome! I have got to give a massive 5 stars to Antonio in the buffet, the guy was just amazing, went out of his way to make sure we were happy with everything! And Darwin in Bana the sushi restaurant, he could not do enough for us, real nice guy, always cracking a joke with us and making sure everything was okay, not to mention getting the chef to make us something extra special on our last night! Ask for them if you come here. Eduardo’s food, the chef in Bana was just 10/10. Id pay to eat at this resturant, it is actually too good for all inclusive. My girlfriend wanted something that wasnt on the menu, it was no problem.. Eduardo cane to the table, asked us exactly how we would like it cooking and it came out perfect. If that isnt great aervice then I dont know what is! 5 stars all round, will be back next summer!

reviews.author: Eunice L
reviews.title: Perfect weather
reviews.text: Royal service for 4 nights. food was great, service great. on our last day there we had the calmest sea and clearest blue sky. our butler Daniel was great too. he went out of his way to get drinks for us that the hotel did not have. loved la palapa. they have the best fried chicken wings! went to the buffet a few times, one day they had sushi. their desserts are to die for. loved Mexican Fiesta night. i forgot to make a reservation that night, luckily, fiesta night saved my butt.

reviews.author: bustermania
reviews.title: Wife needed a break....perfect place
reviews.text:
Spend first week of September and as expected, it was very hot and humid....only had a one hour rain shower the entire stay....we upgraded to the Royal Service and it was well worth the money ( almost free)....no drunks in the pool like the other side and people were well behaved and free Bali beds (with a tip, you don’t need to reserve)...to no one’s fault, the beach was covered with seaweed....c’est la vie.....
The food was excellent and the beer was in cans compared to the cheap stuff you get on the other side....overall decent resort....only down fault was the check in which took over 30 minutes...

reviews.author: Natasha Y
reviews.title: Family vacation in September 2018
reviews.text:
We stayed from September 2-12th of 2018.  It rained/stormed at least for 5 days of that! 
The staff tried to cheer us up and provide good service. Lots of seaweed in the water, always red flag so we were not allowed to swim in the ocean and during stormy rain, we were not even allowed to go outside! I didn't like that. 
On the sunny day I would recommend this hotel to someone who doesn't swim in the ocean(:  Good food, good desert, very nice workers! pretty hotel, very clean... nothing to complain about honestly.
Few people that stood out to me: 
Orlando Bello from Nespresso coffee bar.  Always smiling, and remembered my preferences for drinks (:
Sergio Mesero by the pool kept asking me if I want a drink probably every half hour (: It was nice!!! And he is a very honest guy, my husband left him a tip and I didn't know, so I tried giving him a tip and he sure enough told me that my husband already did that.
Juan and Christian at Naos buffet for breakfast were amazing! helped me carrying food for my kids, brought fish food so my kids can feed the fish and let me eat (: Just very pleasant guys and they work very hard!
And if you go to Enso restaurant by the pool for dinner, ask for Luiz to serve you, very nice guy who does things just right!

reviews.author: Tamara C
reviews.title: Amazing Resort
reviews.text:
I was at Paradisus from the 6th to the 11th at the Royal Service...and only one word can describe this resort and that would be FABULOUS! The greenery...the ambience was like a dream land. I honestly don’t know how they manage all of those plants. 

Let’s talk about the service...AMAZING! We had a butler Rode...Hiii Rode it’s Tamara! You were fabulous! Always there! Even when he wasn’t on the clock he never missed a beat! Ask for him if you ever stay at the Royal Service you won’t be disappointed! 

The only thing I must say is the food wasn’t the best. I had my best meals over the Royal Sevice section at our Private buffet and at La Palapa...the Market Grill was the most disappointing...followed by Fuego. Vuelto the Tapas restaurant would have been second best...but they need to work on the food. 

But it was such an amazing place that I would return again and again and again! 

Definitely I would recommend!

reviews.author: Katina M
reviews.title: 12 h back home and i’m ready to come back!
reviews.text:
We been there from 09/07 to 09/12 and every second from the moment we step out of the bus that transport us from the airport to the one that brought us back we’re 10 times more we’ve expected . At the door Raul greet us with a huge smile and a funny joke,took our luggage and direct us to the royal check in where Jennifer took care of our check in,made sure we had immediately our favorite drinks and with her warm smile wiped every sign of tiredness.She was also the one that kept us company while leaving and made us forget the bad weather outside.We were assign a butler as we had the royal serves and that was a mach made in heaven with Leyner who even when on his day off always made everything happen,always had a smile,a solution even to the crazy request of my partner who asked for a fan even tho the AC was all there!It might be his job but we felt like we found a friend in his persona.And when in the bali bed by the pool Joel keep coming around with a fresh beer and margarita and small chat to keep us company!We enjoyed many day and evening shows located around the resort as well different dinner options around the restaurants that the resort offer !To us the buffet breakfast was the best as we always found our favorites and great coffee and service.For dinner MOLE and BATO were our favorite ones for sure but we loved the rest as well!Moises is our favorite server and we were lucky to find him in different locations(is he ever off?! :) ) And the whole green jungle inside with the essence diffusers is so so so beautiful.We Never slept after 7 am no matter how late we were or how many drinks we had cause paradise was waiting for us and we were never tired!!!Thats pure magic there !!!
Well i can keep rumbling but i think you get it!This was and will be our paradise for a very long time i believe.Whatever you’re doing keep doing it.We’ll recommend this place to everyone !

reviews.author: sillygoose520
reviews.title: Great experience.
reviews.text: Great experience. The hotel is clean and the staff are generally helpful, however, there are too many pushy salesmen for tours and activities. Sometimes they can’t just leave you alone. Otherwise it was a pleasant visit, remember to book dinners early because the restaurants(except the buffet) are usually fully booked.

reviews.author: Gustavo V
reviews.title: Excellent weekend with kids
reviews.text:
the service is excellent.  the room was okay with a great view however the air conditioning was not working properly.

3 huge pools, not overcrowd, plenty of chairs around the pool. the bar inside the pool has a good variety of drinks.

we could not enjoy the beach because of the seaweed.

the food was good with a lot of options.

I need to repeat that the service is great!!

reviews.author: bradley829
reviews.title: Great Staff, Hotel Needs a lot of improvement!!!
reviews.text:
I have been to better all inclusive resort, including the Paradisus Punta Cana which is wayyy better than this one in Cancun.  This hotel is very hot!! some of the restaurant have no A/C , and even when they do if the temperatures are very hot, you sweat like a pig. The lobby and common areas have no A/C.  I am not exaggerating.

I was able to stay at the family concierge with my kids, my kids are four and seven. The butler service was excellent: always attentive making sure we had what we needed. the Kids club was a big plus, kids were able to play for some time during the day, they are open till 9PM, I wish they were open a bit later. if you are part of the family concierge, this gives you access to the royal service area as long as the kids are not with you(adults only). The food at the buffet was awful except for breakfast which was decent. The selection of meat and seafood was very poor, almost non. Make sure to make your reservation ahead of time if possible for a la carte restaurant. they tend to fill up quick especially if you are going with a big group. 

The rooms were nice, not all of them. The beach was very bad with a lot of sea weed, I could not swim at all throughout my stay.

I would never go back to this resort, I feel that the property needs improvement and the A/C needs to be repair. The food needs more variety. this is not a luxury resort. Not compared to other Paradisus.

reviews.author: spadre99
reviews.title: wonderful vacation
reviews.text: couples getaway for fun and we are so satisified with our stay, we would highly recommend this resort to another couple or group of friends. we have been here before and would like to go back again to this same resort.

reviews.author: Extraordinary581618
reviews.title: Great Staff - Mediocre Resort
reviews.text: The staff are there to help and do a fantastic job.  They were absolutely wonderful.  The grounds are lovely, although there was a ton of seaweed that was not removed until about our 4th day there; perhaps there's a good reason for that, but it smells and does not make the beach very inviting.  The pools were not crowded at all when we were there the first week of September.  We found it odd that the largest pool (with the only swim-up bar) was so deep.  It's huge and yet the entire thing is about 5 feet deep with the only shallow area leading up to the bar.  It could be because we're mature travelers (late 50s/early 60s) that we didn't appreciate the odd lounges/bars which had beds and low seating in one and just an odd decor in the other.  Maybe it's more suitable for a younger crowd; just didn't appeal to us.  The food was just OK - wasn't really our cup of tea.  We prefer Italian, French, American and I didn't pay any attention to the evening restaurant options before I booked so that's my fault and not theirs.    The buffet had nice options and I would say it was better than many other all-inclusives we've been to.  We were thankful we had gotten the Royal Service because it was the only place we felt we could go and be comfortable visiting with friends at regular tables and chairs.  Every morning and evening they had a (slight) variety of food options if you preferred to eat there and not at the buffet or elsewhere.  They also had a nice open-air restaurant and a bar out by the pool/beach that was exclusively for Royal Service guests.  Coors light was the only option as far as American beers go and they were only available in the Royal Service area. The Mexican light beers were tasty so that was fine. They had nice top-shelf liquors in the Royal Service area as well.Our room was comfortable and we were able to keep it nice and cool with temps outside in the 80s.  The rest of the resort was HOT.  HOT as in sweat your butt off hot.  There were a couple of restaurants with A/C and that's it.  The common areas, shops, majority of restaurants - basically the entire resort was without air.  That would be fine if there were any sort of attempt to bring the nice breezes in off the gulf, but that's not the case.  It's almost like the design KEPT the cool breezes out by putting up doors and glass and walls, etc.  This is the primary reason we will not be back.  We don't like to eat and drink and socialize while sweating.

reviews.author: ameliadixon
reviews.title: Very good all inclusive
reviews.text: We came here on a whim, after the hotel we booked originally turned out not to be all-inclusive.  Luckily the Paradisus was able to accomodate us at the last minute!  The food at the restaurants was very good for an all-inclusive resort - better than some others I've experienced!  The beach is long and nice.  It was very seaweedy and high surf, but not unswimmable, and I think that's due to the time of year we went (Sept).  The pools are kept very clean, the service at the bars is good.  We were impressed with the entertainment staff.  Mariachi band at the Mole restaurant was a nice touch.  Mini fridge gets regularly stocked.  The gym is certainly adequate.  We never ran out of bottled water.  The beds were a little hard, but not awful.  For a "lagoon view" room it was still pretty on the balcony even though it was the cheapest one.  I'd absolutely recommend this place.

reviews.author: Rita G
reviews.title: Most amazing 2 weeks EVER!
reviews.text: This hotel was amazing.  Very very clean at all times.  Ocean view was excellent, food was great but they need to add more options to the room service menu.  Our room was beautiful as well.  We stayed in the Royal Service section which was in Pyramid 5, but if you have trouble walking, it is best to rent a scooter.  Most of the restaurants are in Pyramid 3 and 1 in pyramid 1.  I got a scooter from Cancun Mobility and I had no issues.  Sergio was our butler, and he was top notch.  He arranged all of our dinner reservations daily, our bali bed reservation and made sure we were restocked daily with our favorite snacks and drinks, and even put rose petals in our room 1 night. It was a pleasure to have him.  All of the staff at La Palapa were the best, as soon as they saw us coming, they were getting our favorite drinks ready.  Special shout out to Valeria, Ernie, and Moses!  I also have to mention Elisander,  the pool concierge.  He would have our bali bed made every day before we even got to the pool.  On our last day he brought me chocolate strawberries with Come Back Soon in chocolate.  He is such a sweet guy, he would take the time to come and greet us and chat with us daily.  The manager at The Market was exceptional as well, he always saved a specific seat for me every time we went to dinner. This was one of our favorite places.  Finally, a shout out for Angel at Fuego, he is an excellent server, anything you want, no problem!  All in all, the food was amazing, the hospitality was amazing and I can't wait to get back to my paradise!

reviews.author: Shawn M
reviews.title: Terrible Honeymoon
reviews.text:
We went to Paradisus on our honeymoon for Labor day weekend. First of all right I had requested high floor and noted we were going to be celebrating our honeymoon. They gave us a room on ground zero on the first floor next to the pool the opposite I had asked for. Called to switch our rooms they wouldn't switch it out since there was no availability. After a long phone conversation with the manager they found a room but we have to stay the night and switch the rooms next day. So the next day they switched out the rooms we got the high floor we asked for but the room was a much older and smaller room what we didn't pay for and the bed was terrible. Also the shower tub was clogged and called them to come and repair it while the maid came to make the room but nothing, no one came to fix the tub.
Restaurants were okay, food quality isn't good, only restaurant that was decent was Fuego. The alcohol at the bars were terrible barely put any alcohol. Save your money and time and go somewhere else.

reviews.author: SasaMil
reviews.title: Great service everywhere except reception
reviews.text:
Came to Paradisus Cancun on Friday , couple , requested one bed got 2 double, room was not clean, if you got out in balcony you can’t get back, no handle, night stand  drovers are falling out....when I when to reception with my concerns they told me, no other rooms are available ( even hotel is half empty) and well what can we do. ........
Very disappointed in room 3624 and reception staff service ( can’t even change money).,. Everybody else is happy to do it.
When I asked to upgrade to royal service I got 2 different answers on cost..$400 and then 15 min later $500

Otherwise food is great, service everywhere else is great.

This is my 3rd visit to Meliá and by far moist disappointing .

reviews.author: vashko
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text: Amazing resort , great food , friendly and very helpful staff, our Family concierge butlet SANDRA was very fun and there for us anytime we needed anything , lots of restaurants to choose from and activities to do , resort is very big and has a lot to offer, great shows every night and just a fun and classy place overall.

reviews.author: lyssabartlett
reviews.title: Getaway at Paradisus! Amazing!
reviews.text: My husband and I took this trip and we left our daughter with Grandma. We felt like we were in paradise the whole time. The service was incredible. The resort was breathtaking. Everyone was helpful when we had no clue how to book something. They made our stay a great experience! We needed this trip. Thank you!

reviews.author: wanderlusting2008
reviews.title: Would not waste my time
reviews.text: The food here is HORRIBLE!!!! I mean disgusting!!! not even edible. The rooms were just ok.  You could tell that some of the repairs to the room were cheaply and carelessly done. The resort itself was nice.  Would not recommend anyone stay here unless you like wasting money

reviews.author: Tiffany Nicole
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: I absolutely loved this little piece of paradise! My birthday was nothing short of amazing! The food people and atmosphere added to the beauty of this resort. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a nice getaway!

reviews.author: Whitney H
reviews.title: Amazing Royal Service
reviews.text: Royal service was amazing and 100% worth the money. We enjoyed every minute. The room was nice, the private pool and restaurant were great, the spa was amazing, it was all wonderful. Really enjoyed the pineapple party as well!

reviews.author: Chris N
reviews.title: Paradisus was paradise.
reviews.text: Its shocking that the hotel is as old as it is. It is in great shape and obviously had been updated but it looks amazing. And clean. The service/staff were awesome. Friendly,  always smiling very attentive. We will be going back. Please make sure u take some cash with u for tipping. The service is worth the tips.

reviews.author: 24K60763
reviews.title: End of summer vacation
reviews.text:
Nice place. We stayed at tower 1. The area seems always clean. They fixed our room twice in a day. 
The staff are always helpful on everything you need. 
You can always expect courteous and friendly staff and people around here in Mexico. 
We opted out on all inclusive however, we had few meals in this resort. We had dinner at Mole and Naos. Personally, I think they need a new chef.

reviews.author: Thomas K
reviews.title: Candid Review of frequent Paradisus patron
reviews.text:
I will keep my review to information that I was looking for prior to my trip that I couldn't find along with my personal review of Paradisus Cancun.  Note this was our 4th Paradisus location after Paradisus Los Cabos, Punta Cana, La Esmeralda.

The trip was for my parents (in separate room), and my wife and 2 kids with me in another room.  Both of our rooms were Family Concierge Oceanview.  The check in was done smooth at a Family Concierge Lounge.  The rooms we got were on the "0" floor.  The land is elevated on the front side, so front entrance of the hotel will put you on the 1st floor.  The back of the hotel facing the beach, you walk out of 0 floor.  We were given a room on the floor 0, and of course after checking out the room, the oceanview wasn't so good, so we asked for a change.  Since we were staying for 8 days, we were ok with changing the room on the 2nd day where they put us on floor 3, which provided much better oceanview.  If you actually paid for an Oceanview, I would never accept room on the floor 0.  Even if I got a free upgrade to Oceanview on floor 0, i would opt for a higher floor on the Lagoon side.  All Family Concierge is located between Pyramid 2 and 3, (draw a straight line between 2 pyramids) and the balcony is parallel to the shore, so you get a straight view of the Ocean or Lagoon, no angled views.  

Beach Condition - So we had initially booked a different resort, but we changed to this resort to enjoy the magnificent beach of the hotel zone.  Magnificent no more - the beaches at the Hotel Zone is no longer what I would consider a paradise.  All i want is soft sand with clear water... nope you're not getting that.  If you're the type to lay on the beach for a tan then you're ok.  If you're a type of person who enjoys going into clear water where seeing your feet makes you happy... you need to look elsewhere.  Don't know the proper word, but the sea plant things are ALL OVER.  Someone said staff cleans every morning.... not really.  They just dig into the sand every morning.  Looks little better, but will look nasty again soon after.  There are just so much.... imagine those plastic sea plants you put inside your fish tank.  Imagine a million of those floating all over the water.  The water itself is still clear, but those things are floating all over.  If you look at the shore from 30 yards away, you can see sections/patches of the beach where it's worse than other, but since they all drift - find a section that looks clearer than other then enjoy the water for 10 minutes until you're feeling these things all over.  Some days are obvious worse than others, but if you're staying for a week you should be able to find couple days where it's tolerable to go into the water.... not what i was looking for.  

On the 2nd day of the vacation, I said to myself, heck I'm here, so I will go in the water and see how it is..... until I got stung by a Sting Ray.  Thought I stepped on a knife... pretty painful.  Somehow I was able to hobble to the doctor onsite of Paradisus.  He's the one that told me I've been stung by a sting ray, (it was correct diagnosis based on what I was able to piece together thru internet and also based on bruising around the puncture site for couple days after) and recommended that I get a shot on the arm to prevent swelling then give me pain pills (Mexican Advil) and antibiotic pills.  As I'm in pain, and he's talking for 30 minutes to advise me that total bill will be $415.  Asks me if I have insurance (why does it matter since he's not accepting insurance... oh to explain that I should try to get them to reimburse me. lol) and after agreeing to pay, he put my foot into a bucket of hot water mixed with Vinegar which made it feel better.  He put a waterproof bandage on it, and after asking for one more waterproof bandage for me to have, was turned down.  He was just following " the policy"... what kind of stupid policy tell you to reject another bandage request to a patient paying $415 for 2 medicine that is readily available for $10 at a local pharmacy.  A Complete Joke... funny thing is my parents came across a guy who also got stung by a Sting Ray couple days after me, he also went to the doctor and after talking to the doctor, walked out because it was too expensive.  Poor guy, but he did get a bandage for free... lol, but I bet it wasn't a waterproof bandage that a paying patient like me to get ONE of.

The Hotel itself is beautiful.  For a 30 year old resort, they do a fantastic job of maintaining it.  Don't assume that this is a brand new resort, if you look carefully you can see the wear and tear, but the hotel is still very nice.  The atrium in the center of the resort leaves you speechless.  I looked at plenty of pictures, and when I got there I realize you won't be able to grasp the beauty of this hotel without actually being there.  This is coming from a jock who doesn't know anything about art.  Every morning, it was easy to spot people cleaning the hotel throughout like all glass panels and such..

Liquor and Drinks... decent liquor type, I mostly stuck with John Walker Black on the rocks.  Others got mojito, strawberry or mango daiquiri, and such which were average.  

Breakfast - went to Naos buffett every morning.  The menu was the same everyday, but breakfast menus are generally the same at all resorts.  There enough variety that you can find enough to keep you satified.  

Lunch -  went to Naos or Market Grill on most days.  Market Grill had same thing everyday, and Naos had minimal changes.  There is a mini pool side grill (hotdogs, burgers, nuggets, fries, and salsa), i think the name was Sunset Grill (??).  Average food at best... but if you're into french fries, this is the only place that serves french fries that's worth eating at this resort... fried properly and crispy.

Dinner - Vento - food taste wise is the best at this resort.  Everything is mostly served tapas style in small pans size of your hand.  Order 3 appetizers and 3 dinner dishes to try different things since they are all small portions.  You can also request "family style" where they bring out all their popular food in bigger dishes. 

Market Grill - it's Rodizio... for those of you not familiar, imagine a meat buffet where they come around to your table with big chunks of different meat asking if you want a slice.  There are around 8 different type of meats that they serve throughout along with salads and grilled pineapple and such.  Definitely worth your time unless you're a vegetarian.  

Fuego - others at the resort have told us that this was their favorite restaurant.  We went here one night and due to some problems with our reservation, we were held up by the hostess for 24 minutes for a 6:30pm reservation (considered early dinner) when the restaurant was nearly empty.  After speaking to the manager of this restaurant, Guillermo, who informed us that he will sit us down in 7 minutes in a restaurant that was 90% empty, I felt so insulted by his actions and words that I walked out and dined elsewhere. So I have no comment about the taste of food at this restaurant.  But more to come regarding service further below the review.

Blue Agave - nothing spectacular, go try some tacos when you have a chance.  

Enso - This is the only restaurant that's away from the cluster of restarants located in the center of the resort.  This is an outside open space restaurant near the pool and you can get a good view of the ocean.  The restaurant is consider Asian Fusion.  The menu looked good and when the food came out it looked fantastic.  Taste.. hm not so much.  Pad Thai felt like eating noodle with food colors with no spices.  No flavors in anything that was served here.  The best dish here is Lamb, and i HATE lamb, so that should tell you how much I enjoyed 

Bana - Not bad not good.  For those who have visited other Paradisus (Since all paradisus uses most of the same restaurant names and themes), this Bana is well below the Bana's at other Paradisus location.  The restaurant is located in the smack middle of the resort at the atrium, so when you're sitting down, you feel like you have the best chair in the house.  My kids have loved Bana at all other Paradisus that their request in the beginning of the trip was that we go to Bana for at least 2 dinners during this vacation.  I can tell you we only went once and nobody had problem with it.  The  udon (thick japanese noodles) dishes both pan fried or in soup are pretty good.  The spicy ceviche is only appetizer worth putting in your body.  I asked for a sashmi (raw finish) and sushi (rolled with seaweed and rice) rolls family style.  What we got was 4 pieces (not rolls) of spicy tuna, philadephia, and dragon along with plate of sashimi.  This would be less than the amount that I order for myself in a japanese restaurant.  We asked for more and after waiting for 20 minutes, we had to leave to catch the evening show after waitress told us that we would have to wait longer for our food.  Not sure about you, but I'm not a fan of having long break between food being put in my mouth. 

Food in general - when we were at our Bali Bed one day, we were approach by a couple with children with similiar age to ours.  The guy walks up and asks me if we're enjoying our stay at our resort and we were saying it was ok.  He went on to say the food at this resort is horrible and that he just wants his vacation to end.  He went onto say great things about Moon Palace saying how big of a difference it is.  Yes, I agree with him the food at this resort could be much better.  The food here is average AT BEST, but I wouldn't say it's as bad as he made it sound like.....  Then again, we came across another couple who said they enjoyed the food at Enso the night before but didn't know what they were eating and couldn't describe to another couple what type of food it was... lol so I guess if you don't know what you're ordering and know what it's suppose to taste like then maybe it's not that bad.  

Coffee shop - on floor 3, they have a coffee shop (mini cafe) where you can order specialized coffees like capuccino and espresso... I'm not a big coffee drinker, but my wife is and she enjoyed getting a cup from here everyday.  

Ice Cream Shop - right next to the coffee shop, there is a mini ice cream shop.  Don't know the hours of this place, but everytime I wanted to give it a chance they were closed.  I know they are closed during the evenings, but i think they opened fairly late as well like 3pm or 4pm.  Wanted to try it out since it looked like their ice cream looked better than the buffett ice cream... but most people were getting a ice cream from Naos buffet that you scoop yourself into a plastic cup that you can carry out.   

Food is important to me during this kind of vacation, but it's not the most important thing.  If Food is VERY important to you at an all-inclusive resort then I suggest that you look elsewhere.  All "the food is great" comments, come on people don't mislead others.  And this is coming from a guy have told others to stop complaining so much about food quality on other reviews.  I don't want some guy giving thumbs up to a Big Mac saying the food is fantastic here.... actually I would've preferred Big Mac over many of the options here.  But on the high note, the deserts were all above average at all restaurants, with of course Vento taking the crown with their Green Apple Sorbet, Churros with Chocolate, Flan, and Tiramisu.

Service - Most of the staff were very friendly and accommodating.  I find myself liking the staff at Mexico resorts the best compared to DR, Jamaica, and others... which is what attracts me to Mexico frequently.. and Turks & Caicos, and Aruba being little more expensive also contributes.. =)   Most were looking to help, and most were friendly.  The high pitch voice with some aggressiveness waitress at Bana came off like I was at a flea market more than a restaurant and the poorly trained Fuego manager Guillermo aside most were welcoming.  Of course you will not find a resort where every single staff is to your liking, so this resort was good enough in service category.  On the corners of atrium there is a long table with maybe 2 staff waiting to you help on on the first floor.  I approached one man and asked "can you contact Kids Club and ask where this activity is taking place?", his response was "oh I don't have contact number for Kids Club"... i chuckled and walked away.  Man, you are here as a service.. how about picking up the damn phone and calling one of your colleagues for a number to Kids Club and getting me the info.... Geez.   Just few bad apples in a great orchard.  

Management Staff of Resort -  Avoiding last names to prevent them getting swamped with your special requests.  If you really want to contact them, i suggest you just dig deeper to find the info.  I've had contact with Franco (Director of Rooms) prior to my vacation.  He was fantastic, I ended up e-mailing him Good Luck to Mexico prior to their world cup match.  Also, after the incident at Fuego where I felt insulted (I said to the manager "I'm not eating at Fuego tonight" and his response was a smart "ok" like he couldn't care less) and the manager's lack of common sense.. making people wait by the hostess for 30 minutes in a restaurant that was empty and talking to back to customer to wait another 7 minutes.. i even took a picture of his face along with ALL the EMPTY tables in his restaurant.  I reached out to Juan (Director of Food and Beverages) to basically call this guy out.  Sent him an e-mail while I was in the resort and his response was prompt and he was very willing to meet me to discuss any concerns/issues/comments I had.  When the time came for me to meet him at the lobby, he was with the Hotel Manager (Head Boss of this resort) Jair.  They were both very interested in what I had to say.  I did not book a Luxury Presidential Suite of this resort, but the fact that I was able to reach a Director who's in charge of ALL of the food and drinks of the entire resort in matter of minutes who also brought the Head of the Hotel... I felt like they genuinely cared.  I feel like the Top Management guys in this resort are super... I came across them throughout the resort everyday, and they just seems like everyday hardworking guys, you can't tell who's the boss if you were to line all of them up.  It seemed they had the respect of the staff.  I said to my little son while getting ice cream "that man there is the man in charge of this entire hotel.  He's the big boss", and this lady staff heard me and smiled.  She said he's great and he's always around involved with everything.  I commend the management staff of this resort and frankly, they are the ONLY reason I am giving this place a 4 star instead of 3.  I wish they had a better team they were managing to make this place even better, but I guess that's their job to make their staff better... starting with chefs =)

Entertainment - most of all-inclusive resort entertainment is cheesy... You're not going to find a broadway or vegas shows at all-inclusive resorts.  But I felt the entertainment was pretty good and well above average.  They had multiple shows and events scheduled throught the day and they had different theme nights like the Mexican Night which provided an atmosphere of Big Happy Mexican Family Party.  They hold shows outside by the pool which requires them setting up chairs and so forth, but staff was right on point with all the set up and preparations.  Michael Jackson's fly zipper kept coming down... which made me chuckle as he know himself that his zipper was broken and he incorporated checking zipper into his dance move..lol 

Wifi Coverage - The Wifi Internet at this resort is better than any I've come across ever.  I had Mexico included in my cell phone plan so had my phone on roaming the whole time.  Since I was able to connect to the Resort Wifi, once I put connected it, my phone was connected at ALL time throughout the entire resort and the internet speed was good enough for me to watch any streaming video along with check work e-mails. 

Family Concierge - Violeta and Fernanda were our Family Concierge.  Unlike other Family Concierge at other Paradisus where they give you a 10 year old phone or walkie talkie to communicate with, I see that they were now using WhatsApp (this is a free communication app for those not familiar).  Since my phone was connect to the hotel wifi any and every place in the resort, it was super convenient to just text them and they text us.  They would text us information.  If we needed any help, we ask thru WhatsApp and they answer back within few minutes.  It was SUPER CONVENIENT.  One thing that I admit to regretting is I screwed up on their Tips.  I am normally a generous tipper.  For family concierge, I tip at the end of the trip, and since there were few incidents that left really bad taste in my mouth and I was just ehhhhh.... and I took it out on Family Concierge tips... total bad move on my part.  I tipped them maybe 1/3 of what I would've normally tipped them.  I regret what I did wished I was a bigger man about it.  

Bali Bed - I don't want to get into the great details about Bali Beds.  But during the low season, do you really need to charge over $150 for a Bali Bed that NO ONE is USING.  I have a picture of 8 Bali Beds in a row, completely empty during the smack middle of the day.... come on people.  It's there, let's use it.  During high season, ok maybe charge... during low season when NOBODY is willing to pay that much, just open them up to public.  It's a joke that they just sit there unused prime spots for naps and rest... it was that way EVERY SINGLE DAY. EVERY SINGLE DAY THEY WERE EMPTY.  oh somebody might say some guy rented it for couple hours then left.. NO.. EVERY ONE OF THEM had "RESERVE ME, BOOK ME" paper in the slot where your family name is place if you were to book them.  That's how you can tell when some people who didn't care sometime used without paying because they are hanging out in the Bali Bed that still had "RESERVE ME" paper in the slot.  LOL.   

All in all - it was great vacation mostly because it was when I NEEDED the vacation the most.  Paradisus - you have served me well for few years.  It's time to say goodbye and I plan on moving on to other resorts.

reviews.author: It's Me
reviews.title: Wonderful! Always a favorite!
reviews.text: My best friend and I stayed with Paradisus Cancun back in May for my 30th birthday. From the moment we arrived the staff was nothing short of amazing. We arrived later in the evening, but were greeted with smiling faces. They already had us scheduled for different restaurants each night. All of which were superb. When we got to the room they had streamers, balloons, and a birthday cake with a candle. We stayed in the club tower and had Jorge as our "butler". He was absolutely fantastic. He checked in on us every morning to ensure that we were well taken care of. Also, the restaurant and pool service staff, they were always amazing. For my birthday I think I must have been sang to at least 4 times. The staff at the breakfast buffet always remembered us, and were excited to see us. There is nothing about this resort that I don't love. If you have the opportunity to stay here I highly recommend taking it.

reviews.author: Aixamar R
reviews.title: Awesome experience
reviews.text: Excellent environment, clean, fun, and very relaxing. Everything was excellent, specially HECTOR my butler. Food was amazing and the Rogal Service was over the top. Amazing Spa experience and very relaxing. I recommend this Hotel to EVERYBODY.

reviews.author: Diane221952
reviews.title: Excellent Staff n Beautiful Hotel!
reviews.text:
The staff n food is very good.They could not do enough to make our stay wonderful.The shows during the week,only,were very good otherwise very quiet.
There is a lot of seaweed down the whole coast frm Miami to the Caribbean but somedays the water was clear so u r able to swim. The pools are beautiful also very nice for families to visit. I highly recommend this hotel.I love the Mexican people they work so hard n very friendly.I have been going to Mexico since 1969.

reviews.author: Global638449
reviews.title: Poor quality food!
reviews.text: I recommend to not do all exclusive unless you upgrade to royal service. It's cheaper if you dine out. Everything else was fine. But tours outside of hotels, they charge you more.The beach and pool were nice

reviews.author: chrisjay2018
reviews.title: Surprise Mexico Holiday!!! Family Concierge Service
reviews.text:
I surprised my family with a trip to Mexico this August and we stayed at the Paradisus for 10 nights (Family Concierge Suite Ocean View). From the moment we arrived we were treated like royalty, all of the staff were amazing, friendly and always at our service with any requests/questions we had. The resort is very clean, beautiful and staff are very friendly and hospitable at all times.

Family Concierge - We met our butlers (Sandra and Alex) the morning after we arrived, they were always willing to help and made reservations for us every night at the various restaurants available. We communicated via a WhatsApp group and they were always quick to respond to any questions/requests we had :-). A special touch from the hotel was that we always had a small gift left in our room for our daughter and even for us (adults) every night - which was wonderful. We were given Royal Service bands and our daughter given the Family Concierge band, so we were able to gain access to the Royal Service areas and bars as part of our package.

The view from our room was amazing!! The only suggestion we have would be that the room could do with an update in line with the new revamped Royal Service rooms :-) but overall the room was fine for us. The staff at the hotel work extremely hard and everyday, our room was cleaned, towels changed and whenever we needed extra, they supplied them within a couple of minutes!

The pool areas were always kept clean and drinks were on tap!!!

We didn't get a chance to eat at all the restaurants onsite, but Fuego is one that we managed to enjoy and the service and food was amazing.

Would we visit the Paradisus again? Yes definitely! In fact we are planning our next visit there..

reviews.author: snowlake13
reviews.title: Superb Service !!!!!!
reviews.text: Took a sister trip, just my sister and me, and there are no words adequate enough that I can use to express my gratitude towards the Paradisus Royal Service staff,,, and in particularly to Rode. Rode, one of the top employees of the Paradisus, took great care in assuring that my sister and I were well taken care of, especially since we were traveling alone. He checked up on us every single day of our stay. Rode would make sure that our dinner reservations and our Bali bed (loved the Bali bed) was reserved, Rode was able to upgrade our room to assure that our stay was magnificent. He always asked if there was anything we needed to call him. We love Rode....Thank you for  everything Rode we'll definitely be back next year :~)

reviews.author: Joanne P
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text:
I was at paradisus with my mom and 7rs old son from Dec 1st -8th 2016.
From the moment we stepped inside, it was like a dream. The aroma and all the plants inside.. 
We didn't want to go anywhere.
Stayed at the resort for a whole week still last night came so quickly.
I was at iberostar cancun in November last year and my mom was at moon palace last June. We agreed this resort is better. No time share hassle as iberostar. The beach was clean and beautiful.  The buffet and all the restaurants were exellent.  It was somewhat different foods everyday at the buffet.  Iberostar had a kids pool but this place had no slides.  I was worried that my kid might be bored. But he loooved to go to the kids zone. The staffs were really friendly and they had a good program.
We mostly stayed at the beach and pool area.  At evening, it was fantastic to watch how inside mood was changed with all the lights and candles. 
I enjoyed spa and massage with 50dollar off coupon that I had to ask for it. 
We rented a balibed once and treated like royal people. 
 All the staffs were hard working and friendly. Especially alex at the pool area and Rosa at conceirge. Thanks for a good memory.

reviews.author: cazadorRolo
reviews.title: Excellent view, 360 degrees of the best in Cancun
reviews.text:
The hotel is located in the best corner of Cancun. To enjoy it you have to have enough time for your excellent services.
What we liked most was the center of convections and the views from each habilitation with exclusive terraces with total privacy.
At breakfast time you see a sea with 7 colors, which only invites you to visit it and rest on the beach.

reviews.author: Justin D
reviews.title: Our perfect trip to Paradisus
reviews.text: This was our first trip out of the US and after weeks of research, we chose to stay at Paradisus Cancun. That was the best decision we've ever made. From the minute we pulled up and Jose opened our shuttle door, everything was flawless. The resort itself is stunning. The building is beautiful, full of water features, plants, unique art and architecture; the hallways filled with aromatherapy oils. The creators went to great lengths to carve out incredible detail and themes to create a relaxing vibe and it shows! The Royal Service package made the trip that much better. At check-in, the front desk greeted us with champagne and a friendliness and excitement that you rarely see anymore. We booked this trip to celebrate my girlfriends birthday. Upon entering our room for the first time, the room was decorated with banners, balloons, cake and champagne! Our Royal Service butler for the week, Galdino, ensured that our stay was perfect, from beginning to end. He made our dinner reservations daily and took care of any request we had, large or small. The best way I can describe Galdino, it was like having a good friend that you grew up with, that lived there. The Royal Service lounge, pool and beach were beyond our expectations. Coffee, cocktails and amazing food around the clock, in the lounge. The pool was incredible, starting with Jose and Ricardo, who made sure we were comfortable in our Bali beds (Ricardo even blew up our raft for us!) and the entire service staff including Cesar, Oscar and especially Victor, who visited us non-stop with drinks, food, ice cold water and anything else we needed. Each restaurant we visited was top notch. The quality of food, even at the buffet, was as good as it gets. Tons of variety and many options. We truly loved each of our dining experiences. We especially enjoyed Market with Allen and Naos with Hector. We also dined at Tempo, for my girlfriends birthday. My girlfriend and I have dined at some of the top restaurants in DC, New York, Florida, California, Las Vegas, etc... but we both agreed that Tempo was the best dining experience either of us have ever had. At each restaurant, the food was incredible and the staff went above and beyond to make sure we had a memorable experience. Each staff member at the resort seems to truly love people and enjoy what they do. On our last day, we chose to get couples massages at the spa. Our only regret on this trip is that we did not spend more time at the spa. Best massage I've ever gotten and the most relaxed atmosphere you can imagine. I, again, have to say that Galdino went above and beyond to make this birthday a special one for my girlfriend. The Royal Service package was a special experience but I can tell you that even if you don't book the Royal Service package, you will be treated like royalty here. Our first experience with MELIA was enough that we will not book with anyone else, moving forward. This property, this staff and our overall experience = 5 stars!

reviews.author: kajol
reviews.title: Never ever again !!!
reviews.text:
Being vegetarian food is a big struggle.
Very few people understand or speak English not only that when we spok in Spanish help with google translator still could not get through to them.
Very bias attitude all around if your are not Spanish you don’t get service.
Very loud music starts from 10 am to 8pm so please don’t get sea view rooms.after bringing to management attention nothing changed.
Very rude and argumentative staff in bento restaurants .
Breakfast and lunch buffet is rapetative same food every day and very little selection of vegetarian option. Vegetarian food together with non- vegetarian dishes.
Poor presentation of food. Staff are very intimidating.
Good service provided by Enzo resturrent and mole with excellent food.
Room concierge service is superb.
When these issues brought to attention of manager through concierge manager as he was too busy to talk he offered certificate to stay free night. Which is a joke as I made it clear that we can not wait to leave from here and not coming back.
If you love your drink and pool side food then this place will suit you.

reviews.author: 347sunshine
reviews.title: Paradise and only needs simple upgrades
reviews.text: We couldn’t swim at the beach because there was too much seaweed, but indoors made up for it. They give you so much freedom there and we walked along the beach in the evening. So beautiful! Weather was perfect! They need to update the night club and play more of the music we heard outside, in the disco.

reviews.author: Nav1go
reviews.title: A nice resort
reviews.text: We stayed here as our base to snorkel with whale sharks - about 25 min by van and then 45+ by boat. We chose not to pay the extra money for the adult only and we’re fine with that, but we did encounter lots of families. We are morning people and found it easy to get a palapa by the pool overlooking the ocean but found that as 1030/11 rolled around the noise and music increased. There was some show every night and when in the main pyramid, we could hear the music through our door after 10 pm which was not expected. The breakfast buffet was well done, lunch less so with dry burgers and hotdogs and mediocre but large selection of other dishes, fruit, salad and desserts. Dinner at Mole followed by Bana was the best. We did not like having our reservation canceled Friday night and told we had to eat at the Mexican fiesta buffet. I would say the quality of buffet was the same as the main buffet on Carnival cruises but the burgers, pizza etc fell way short. We enjoyed our trip and were content with this resort but would not call this 5*.

reviews.author: Ramon Valencia Jr
reviews.title: Business trip with company exec's and others
reviews.text: Nice stay, included everything,  fitness center, all inclusive restaurants,  Japanese to Mexican and buffets. All you can drink also, nice Red Lounge on lobby floor, nice little club. Convenient meeting facilities,  good restaurants,  great 5 star service at all aspects. Saturday night buffet and pool show. Great room service, full of Pokemon Stops. Kid and adult friendly , although no special catering to them or section. Very friendly staff, except for 1 obnoxious waiter by the poolside buffet. 99.9% of staff were great. Great pools, nice beach, showers accessible, rooms awesome and spacious.

reviews.author: Zorobawa
reviews.title: Nice but crowded
reviews.text: Pleasant experience, but always had difficulty fining a place to sit comfortably and eat - every meal!  The hotel seemed to be too crowded.  Rooms were good and so was service.  Pool area was also good. Had a better overall experience at the neighboring Marriott.

reviews.author: bstratem
reviews.title: Wedding in Cancun
reviews.text: Fantastic experience! Attended my son's wedding and everything went off without a hitch.  Service at the pool was unbelievable - personnel were very attentive and could not do enough for us.  We got to know them very well and feel like we made friends forever.

reviews.author: Jackquito
reviews.title: Second Time - Wedding Planning - Great Service
reviews.text:
We spent the labor weekend at this property as a quick getaway, but also as part of our wedding planning. We have already stayed at this property before, but due to the upgrades made to Royal Service rooms I thought it would benefit the TripAdvisor Community (TAC) with an updated review. Also, as we plan our wedding, we found it rare to find wedding reviews of hotels.

For starters, the room has been updated. We stayed at a Royal Service Junior Suite Lagoon View room category. This room would be the base room category for Royal Service, and the reason we stayed in this room was to confirm for ourselves that even the base room would be comfortable enough for our guests. This room did not disappoint and we felt confident our guests would be happy with the hotel selection.

The hotel (inside & outside) is well maintained. The maintenance crew is constantly cleaning, painting, and fixing, any issues. Being a repeat visitor to this property I can tell you the property has maintained the same awe experience we felt the first time staying at this property as you walk into the lobby.

Food in general I would say is a notch above the average that you would find in an all-inclusive. Our favorite restaurants were the Mole and Vento. However, amazingly, we found ourselves eating lunch at Naos (buffet) almost every day. The food selection and quality was very good and the service we received was amazing (Ask for Andres Contreras, he made our day every day with his positive vibe and top notch service).

The beach is actually a lot better than what we were expecting. We read the reviews about the seaweed and were expecting the worst. But to our satisfaction the beach was not that bad and we were able to swim in the ocean. The hotel does a fantastic job every morning and cleans the sand of all seaweed left the night before. We lounged on the beach every day. Keep in mind if you do want the perfect water/beach experience this might not be the best time of year to go, but if what you like to do is lounge on the beach (more than swim), then by all means this place is perfect.

As for the wedding preparations (for those looking to tie the knot at a beach location), we are glad to report that everything is going well. We chose their top tier package called Tailor Made, and have been in constant contact with their Romance department for every detail. The Romance coordinator Marlene has done an excellent Job by keeping us updated and sharing past experiences and ideas, which have avoided costly mistakes if she would have not told us. Truly a huge help, and has calmed my Fiancé fears and jitters. We have chosen the recommended vendors by the Hotel (Alquimia, JSAV, & Novia Mia) and could not be happier as each vendor is quick to respond to our emails and phone calls. They speak English and are able to accommodate almost all requests. As for the hotel package, the Tailor Made was the one that made more sense for us as we have 45+ guests that will be staying at the hotel. Though, we cannot comment much further on the package as many of the offerings of the package are available only during the days of our stay for the wedding (for example spa discounts, room upgrade, couples massage, etc.), but we will be writing another review upon our return after our wedding which is scheduled for the weekend of September 14th.

Lastly, we cannot end this review without the main highlight of this hotel which is the service and the staff. They truly work a lot to try and accommodate your needs and requests. Special thanks to our butler Galdino for always helping us out with our restaurant reservations and minor details like room decorations and checking up on us during the day to ensure we had the best experience possible. Also, special thanks to Efrain from Mole and Martin who was at the Market Grill, thank you for making us laugh and have such a nice experience.

reviews.author: Srinivasa P
reviews.title: Nice Resort
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay at Paradisus. Everything is good except the beach, we are little upset with the beach maintenance. During our stay there is some weed on sea shore and couldn't able to enjoy the beautiful beach. People are coming here for these beautiful beaches, so the respective resort managements should focus on cleaning the beach weed.

reviews.author: Alexander B
reviews.title: Worth the money, really good service and food
reviews.text:
We really enjoyed our stay, it’s a beautiful resort. Worth the money. The Mole restaurant and Fuego are excellent! I wouldn’t recommend the Enso restaurant though. Room we’re very comfortable, the pull out couch was perfect for my 2 years old daughter. 
Everything was great except it’s hard to be in the full shade around the pool, we didn’t expect to have to pay to sit in the cabana, the 130 usd per day is exaggerated...  that’s the only issue we had. With a 2 years old and a 9 month baby we found it hard because the sumbrella doesn’t really provide good shade so we couldn’t really stay outside during the hot time of the day.

reviews.author: nunezeri
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun 9/2017
reviews.text:
This was A honeymoon trip.   Check-in was great, prompt and quickly given our room. 
The room left much to be desired. The furniture was dated, and there were dirty curtains in the room and in the bathroom with stains that were so noticeable but have not been tended to.  The mirrors in the bathroom and behind the door where rested and the paint falling off the door. The rails to the sliding doors how much accumulated grime dirt and dust which was hard to look at and shoukd be steam cleaned immediately. 
 The hotel grounds were neatly kept up every day, there was lots of foliage which made it look beautiful, but all over the hotel it was warm and humid as it is open and AC vents should be added and turned on in the hot weather to help with comfort level of guests especially in the indoor restaurant Bana. We sweated through our dinner that night.
The restaurant food was good. We did not get sick throughout our stay. On Wednesdays the buffet has seafood and the lobster was amazing. We tried all of them except two restaurants which were part of the Royal service side. Outside pool area bars and snack bar had a great service and staff was friendly.  The Cocoa bar staff however ran things a bit differently, we were only given top shelf liquor which was on the shelf and clearly available if we bargained tips. This was odd because we were given the same type of drinks or liquor such as Hennessey at the pool bar and other bars around the hotel without a request for a tip before providing it.
The beach was amazing. This is the best area for water in all of Cancun, the hotel zone which ones all the way from down south beach palace to the top point- so any hotel in most of this area is great . Some seaweed in these months at different points in the hotel zone beach stretch doe to the tides and it being rain/urricane season but it was not much even on this trip.
 Overall this hotel is noted it self to be a five star. It felt more like a 3.5 or four people, and the room felt like at three. We would recommend it for the beach and the staff, However comfort level and room we would not recommend. We do not see ourselves returning to this hotel, hopefully they update their rooms.

reviews.author: Tiffany F
reviews.title: Best family trip
reviews.text: We had such a fabulous experience at Paradisus!! Thank you to all family concierge staff and waiters who were so thoughtful, attentive and friendly! Special thanks to Alexander and Maria so making our daughter feel so special!  We will be back again!

reviews.author: Carmen P
reviews.title: Melia Group Forever Fans
reviews.text:
Hi there,

I have been to Cancun 5+ times. Have stayed at the Ritz Carleton (not all inclusive); Oasis; Bahia Principe, and I can't remember where else; but Paradisus by Melia has been by far my most memorable and satisfying experience thus far. 

I'll give you a high level overview of what I consider important:

Room: our room was always clean, neat and tidy and excellent AC system. 
Sure there's 1-2 things that were deteriorating ex: terrace door was rusting in one corner -no big deal! (but this is obviously due to humidity) and some wood panels from the bathroom's door were broken (yet again for the latter reason). 
Also, the look of our room was rustic (which we liked) but if you're looking for modern/minimalistic 'feels' you better pay more and stay on the royal service side or go to Le blanc or Acqua (higher end hotel$$$$). 

Food: it was incredible. I am of Mexican descent and I put my stamp of approval on the tacos at blue agave. Here is in order of preference (from favorite to less favorite) the restaurants we tried: 1. Mole and Blue Agave; 2. Market Grill 3.The buffet (brekfast, dinner, lunch). 

Beach: Cancun beaches are beautiful. Although 1 day there was sargasso at the edge of the beach (so just walk a little past it (4-5 meters) and then it's clear (depth there is 2 feet/69cm), but the day after it was gone completely. 

The hotel: Please remember you are in the tropics (to all those people saying the hotel smelt strange or whatever) and there's plants all over the hotel (which is beautiful and part of the decor), and humidex of +70% most of the time -that does not mean the place is not clean. 
 
Entertainment & activities: I can't comment here cause we did not attend these. We'd just be at the pool/beach drinking and mingling with people from everywhere all day or at the gym (which is in A+ shape). The live bands are a great touch!

Overall, I am extremely impressed with this hotel. My boyfriend and I agreed that whenever we plan for a destination vacation again we will hands down, make an effort to only stay at a 'Paradisus' or 'Me' by Melia. 
Most importantly, I wish for management to commend/reward their staff for being so hardworking & lovely, gentle people. These folks were outstanding: Efrain (Blue Agave); Armando (buffet); Freddy & Giovani (pool bar); Sergio & 'Manager' [can't remember name] (Mole); Angel (reception); Consuelo & Emigdio (Market Grill); and to whomever cleaned our room. YOU ALL ROCK AND WE MISS YOU!

reviews.author: Suzanne M
reviews.title: Last minute relocation
reviews.text: Thank you to Apolo Calderon Sanchez for helping us make a smooth relocation from Puerto Rico when Hurricane Maria hit. The group had a great time and Apolo was very helpful in arranging the last minute meeting space and reservations for the group.

reviews.author: Graciela M
reviews.title: excellent !!!!
reviews.text:
amazing , great service , beautiful pool , great food , very happy stay !!!!
room where clean , sparkling , pool area great , kids have a kids camp , good feeling the entire hotel , we will definitely coming back , thanks to the people at the grill restaurant great service thanks for all the mojitos !!!!!

reviews.author: W8997OMmielr
reviews.title: Hot and hotel of no!!!
reviews.text: Great hospitality but everything is no no no. No to sitting you if your party is not complete no to moving a chair for an old lady to sit on no to connecting room no to late checkout and we went during low season can't imagine what it's like during peak season. Every place in the hotel is hot and humid. I thought I wouldn't mind when I read other reviews but can you imagine having every meal in a sauna??? That's what it's like. And kids zone is filthy!!!! I understand it gets dirty with kids but it hadent been cleaned in maybe weeks!!!

reviews.author: konjoy
reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.text: We had some requests and all of them addressed immediately. We would liked to change us room and they did it. We would liked to have a table the first day we came and couldn't make a reservation and they did it. Excellent service.

reviews.author: tammyopera
reviews.title: NEVER AGAIN
reviews.text:
This was the 3rd time that we stayed at the Paradisus Cancun. I am writing this review to express how going forward we will look else ware as a hotel choice for Cancun due to the total lack of consideration from the hotel for our security as guests. I will say however before I give the details, that the grounds, the food, and the main areas of the hotel were clean and up to par.  We checked in on Saturday night By Monday, we noticed that our room door was not locking. No card was needed to enter the room, all we had to do was push on the door. My husband went to the front desk and maintenance was dispatched to come to the room to fix it.  The man came and it appeared as if it was fixed, but we noticed that we would have to slam the door quite firmly to get it to lock. About a day and a half later, upon coming back from the beach, again, we did not need the key to get access to our room. There happened to be a worker from the hotel coming up the hall, and I showed him the problem. Again, maintenance came and supposedly fixed it. That night we went down to the reception to request a late check out, as our flight was leaving late on Saturday.  We were told that they could accommodate that, but there would be extra charge. No problem I said. While she was on the computer arranging for our late check out, I mentioned to her about our room door not locking, and out concerns and she said that she could see that it has been reported and that actually, that’s why I was able to get the late check out because they were not going to put anyone in the room, because they needed the issue fixed. I was upset at this. I could believe that they realized the problem was severe enough to not put someone in the room the next week, but it was ok for us to stay in there this week! So stupid. When I told her this, she said that we could change rooms. And this in the most stupid part!  We were told that we would have to get up in the morning, pack our stuff, come downstairs with it, put our stuff there until 3:00 pm, until “another room would be available”! I told her that this was not acceptable, that why should we, on our vacation, have all the inconvenience placed on us when it was the hotels door lock and security that was the issue. This was completely unfair. We decided to not be inconvenienced by this so all that we asked was that if we could be assured that when the maid left our room after cleaning it that she would make sure the door was secure when she left. The lady at the front desk told us that this was no problem, that she would make a note, and call the housekeeping  to assure this. WELL guess what! The very  next day, we come in from the beach at around 5:00pm, and found our door was not locked!!! I was so angry.  I called down to the reception and got the usual, “we are so sorry” and “this is unacceptable”. They sent the maintenance guy ( by this time its Thursday) and finally, it was fixed totally. 
SO! I’m normally a pretty calm person, so when it came to the check out, I was pretty calm. The man at the desk told me that for out late check out (we stayed until 2:00) it was going to be $20 usd. I held it in my hand and calmly told him that If the hotel really thought it was important…that if the hotel really needed the 20 dollars then he could ask me for it BUT!!!! And then I proceeded to give him a recap of the week I had with the constant worry of my security…the security of my things and us sleeping in there at night worried that drunk guests would walk in. He asked why didn’t we change rooms! Grrrrrr!!! Then asked if we had made management aware, my husband said yes, And then, and here is the best part, HE TOOK THE 20 DOLLARS! I guess the hotel is suffering for the need of 20 dollars. Anyway I gave it to him and told him that this hotel would never see my face again, and that that is what social media is for. 

reviews.author: Alex_723312313
reviews.title: beautiful hotel but???
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun is a beautiful hotel i would give it a  5* if the staff wouldn't lie from the time we enter the hotel , as soon as they gave us our room key they were pushing us to do a couple minute presentation during breakfast time of a next day , they said that we are going to enjoy our breakfast and they are going to talk a bit about hotel and as complementary gift we are going to receive a 3 nights free stay for the next trip.(we thought you cant go wrong on that )so me and my wife we agree , it was all presented by the front desk by the guy name Mario and after by his manager Pamela , to make a long story short ,when we showed up next day on the breakfast i found out that we   signed up for 90 minutes presentation (not like they said before couple minutes) which ended up 3 hours nightmare with Rafael and his rude manager(dont know guys name)  presentation (we lose 3 hour of our day of beautiful sun ) of trying to sell us a timeshare and convincing us its best deal of our life paying 500$USD/ month for 50 years (or 170 000$), and we can stay 7 days a year  in Melia Hotels in VIP section ( where nothing happen ) in a room with the kitchen ( in all inclusive  hotel (what a joke)) but i first i need to purchase all inclusive which is 89$ a day/person (its not included in this 500$/month lol)and of course you need to purchase  a flight ticket on your own, Im telling you guys what a deal lol , after all of this happen they said because we didin't sign a deal for 50 years with them we can't get a 3 night free stay for next time lol :P ( and you know what i don't  want it  ) to all the travelers out there my review is hones truth and im not saying that i dont recommend this hotel i only dont recommend getting being fooled buy some of the staff member.  On the other hand waiters from Naos restaurant Andrew and Gabriel are 6* waiters ,very friendly ,helpful ,honestly really nice guys .The rest of the stay was great , its very nice and clean hotel , with great food and bars also a night club , its solid 5* hotel , just this second day experience made me so mad that i had to write what ever i wrote on the beginning just remember if you dont wanna waist your vacation time ,( there is nothing for free ) just dont go for any  presentation which you really dont  need, Have a great day every one

reviews.author: Alexandra B
reviews.title: Anniversary trip!
reviews.text:
When we first got there we were given a tour by Victor who was very kind and helpful! Our room was amazing with a beautiful view of the beach and swim up bar! The balcony was very private.
