This resort had the best layout! The armbands they give you are so cool! I am still wearing mine even after the trip! They are not those cheap tape armbands that leave tan marks. They were actually bracelets. Which is so nice since you wear them for a while. The swim up bar had great service! We liked Alan! He seemed to be the one always serving us. The pool was a little deep for me as I am only 5'2. I had to get piggy back rides from my husband around the pool. The water also turned my hair green from the chlorine. Which I am not complaining about because well drunk people in a pool....we know the things that are going on in there. It would have been nice to know so I could have taken ultra swim shampoo. The food was great and great service! There were lots of fun activities going on! We met Andrea the first day and I fell in love with her! She is sooo sweet and fun! We went to all the activities she hosted. We also met Amilio and Mariana at the activities. They were great! My only complaints: We got locked out of our  room at 12:01pm. Check out is at 12 and when we went to get our bags to leave we had to go all the way and try to find help to get our door open. This was a little frustrating since we were trying to get to our car by 1pm. A lot of the places to eat were closed. We loved Market Grill and wanted to eat there before we left but they were closed Friday and booked up on Thursday. Even though we tried to plan ahead we couldn't eat at Market Grill again. I would suggest having the hours posted on the doors so people have an idea of when places are open. The coffee corner was also never open in the morning which was a bummer because they had great iced coffee. Also there are no clocks anywhere. I know no one wants to have to look at the time on vacation but when you have to make a reservation for everything it would be really helpful so you don't have to keep up with a watch or phone.  
The spa was great! I had Lillian who was AMAZING!!!! My husband had Sarah i believe. She was great as well! The servers are all so nice! The only names I remember are Carlos, Jose and Hector

reviews.author: Adri T
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text:
It's an amazing place for a family vacation. The hotel is in a great location. It's nice and clean. The beach is fantastic. The pools are great. The food is amazing. The stuff is so hard working and everyone is nice, knowledgeable and helpful. I have to mention our server at Mole, Sergio, we received outstanding service from him. There are 8 restaurants and a buffet. Restaurants require reservations. Every night there was entertainment.
I warmly recommend this resort for every age, perfect for kids and for adults.

reviews.author: hummingbirdisle
reviews.title: Fun family vacation
reviews.text:
Went with a large group (ages from 4 to 75) late August and everyone had  ball!
Family concierge ocean view is the way to go - we got wonderful service from our concierge Fernanda, who helped with reservations and useful info.  She also did something nice for my mom's birthday, which made it so special.  And the view was spectacular!  Try to get a room on a high floor for great view and less noise from the pool.
Check in was a breeze in the air conditioned FC section.  The hotel is lovely - beautiful atrium reminded me of a cenote.  
The restaurants were very good for all inclusive.  No complaints about the breakfast buffet and for sit-downs, my favorites were  Mole, blue agave and the market Grill.  The  coffee stand is a must, as is the crepe stand.
The staff is awesome - helpful and unfailingly friendly.  Loved Veronica, a waitress by the pool.
The only drawbacks are the pool was being renovated and it got quite loud near the workers. Also the pool is large but ridiculously deep!  Don't understand why the shallowest point (other than the kiddie area) is like 5 '4".  
Overall, everyone in my group had fun, even the teenagers!

reviews.author: Roland S
reviews.title: Great deal!
reviews.text: It was our first time giving the all-inclusive resort a go, and Paradisus  was a great start. If you are in the mood for a relaxing, no hassle vacation, this is a great place to go experience that. If you have kids who like water parks, this place does not have any of that, but we were very happy to travel with our 3 year old and just enjoy the pool, the beach, good food and great service. Rooms could do with an update in the next couple of years, but were clean and comfortable and the service is great. Only negative was the sales pitch for a time-share (via an invitation to a presentation over breakfast) right at check in, when all you want to do is go to your room for a hot shower and some rest. We went when the resort was busy, but post-peak season, so reservations at the different restaurants were not an issue, but may not be the case during peak season.

reviews.author: Luke D
reviews.title: I cannot recommend this place enough!
reviews.text:
If you're considering booking a stay at Paradisus Cancun...Just book it! You will certainly not be disappointed. I don't have one bad word to say about this place, from the second we arrived we didn't have to lift a finger. The grounds are beautiful, both indoors and outdoors. All the staff are incredible and go above and beyond to make sure you have a great holiday.

The standard of food was so impressive. So much to choose from and all high quality dishes. The drinks were great, you barely ever had to wait to be served, the bar staff work so hard to make sure your drinks are always topped up by the pool or on the beach.

If this is your first time visiting Mexico here are two things to remember:

-If you are happy with the service you received, you are generally expected to tip. It doesn't have to be a lot, but it is just the polite thing to do here as the staff are working hard all day in the sun. 

-Ignore the weather forecast, it's always wrong. The forecast for my trip said it would rain every day of the holiday...it only rained once. Perfect sunshine every other day.

No review is going to do this place justice, just go and experience it for yourself, you'll have an amazing time.

reviews.author: petermantungw
reviews.title: Excellent Stay
reviews.text: I just hope Paridisus would clarify the fine print on what was purchased and booked.  I booked a Kings size bed not a two twin size bed.  I felt Karen and Sergio was giving us the run around, either give us an upgrade or give us the bed that we purchased.

reviews.author: Kathy A
reviews.title: Paridisus is paradise
reviews.text: We stay in the Royal Suites. Our butler Edwardo was excellent. He made our dinner reservations, cabana bed reservations, sent 4 liquor bottles to our room, chilled champagne & glasses with romantic flower petals (twice). The nightly bed turn down with chocolates and bed "runway" lights was also very nice to come back to at night. The restaurants were all wonderful! I have stayed at a half dozen different places in Cancun and I will definetely return here. Excellent place!

reviews.author: Sheryl F
reviews.title: Great last-minute all-inclusive vacation
reviews.text:
The main thing keeping me from rating 5 stars is the fact that tipping is expected with everything you do (especially in the restaurants and by the pool side).  
If you want excellent service instead of okay service then be prepared to tip, even though you are an all-inclusive guest!!!

reviews.author: James S
reviews.title: Incredibly beautiful hotel!
reviews.text:
My wife and I loved this hotel's beauty and ambiance. Stunning. We have traveled to Hawaii, Las Vegas, other locations in Mexico, Bahamas,  Florida Keys....but we have never seen a more beautifully decorated, landscaped, maintained, and designed property. 
We loved the pool, the beach, and the service was top notch in all of our experiences. Tips are well deserved. These people work hard serving the guests! Notably, Miguel (or Mike as we called him) in the Naos restaurant, pm, was the best of all. With our every visit , he made us feel welcome, and went above and beyond our expectations. Miguel really made our stay and dining experiences fun and memorable. 
We truly enjoyed our stay, and hope to return one day.

reviews.author: Clare W
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: I deal with the Melia White House in London so knew what to expect of the brand. On entering the hotel it is distinctly Melia, but this is where it ends. For what is advertised as a family Hotel I cannot believe that pretty much all of the main pool is nearly 6ft deep with steps down into it that are not marked, the last one is a large drop down. At check in no one mentioned that there would be maintenance work ongoing throughout our stay (mid August) and there where no warning signs around the hotel either. We would have to use a different staircase to the pool side, hearing banging from the room next to ours as it was renovated, the Sunset Grill not open for the first few days. One day we walked in to our room and it completely smelt of paint.  My husband went to reception and they said they would send a maintenance person up. A cleaner was sent to our room! She did not speak English, (I do not have a problem with this but when you have clearly been to reception speaking English you expect someone to come to you who will be able to communicate with you) in the end the cleaner put me on the phone to talk to someone who said they would send a maintenance person!. They never materialised and the only reason we did not complain again is that the smell did go by the time we was going to go to bed. The last few days all of the sunbeds by the shallow end of the pool was shut off but with no screen to the pool, meaning that although children could use the shallow part of the pool dust was constantly blowing across this area. The restaurants are not geared towards children at all. If you have a fussy eater it is very hard to find food that is plain! Turn down was erratic. The beds are ridiculously small! My husband and I are not large people and to have a more comfortable nights sleep my husband slept on the couch! We where in pyramid 3 for our stay which is convenient for being near the restaurants and reception but if you want to be able to get your children to sleep at a reasonable time I would suggest you avoid this pyramid as there is regularly loud music late into the evening. On the last day we had a cockroach in our room!  Thank goodness that was the last day as I would not of been comfortable staying after that, there may be a lot of plants but I still don't expect one of those in my room. Kids Zone was the best thing about the Hotel, the staff here are lovely and made my children feel very welcome for the hour or two they spent there a day.

reviews.author: davrak81
reviews.title: horrible. I would not recommend it to anyone
reviews.text:
My experience there was horrible from the time we got there until the time we left. We always book with family concierge. Upon our arrival, we have called ahead of time and requested that our room be ready upon our arrival, we were assured that It would be taken care Of. When we got there we were told we had to wait three hours, after arguing with them for 20 minutes they finally gave us a room, which had  unsafe conditions because broken doors.  I asked the butler to call maintenance to have the door fixed, four hours later when I called him to see if it was fixed he said that he was only going to call them now! as we were going back to a room we were denied access because they shattered the glass door  in our room, so they decided to change your room without our consent. Our butler was so horrible in an experience he even forget to make reservations for dinner,  which I had to remind him to do again. With exception to want to restaurant, the food there at the restaurants was  horrible. And one of the restaurants for dinner I decided to order a duck, the chef had no idea or clue on how to properly prepare that dish. It came out overcooked and dry inedible. They really take it off the menu of they don't know how to properly prepare that dish.  Another thing about the restaurants is that I don't thing that they turn on air-conditioning in the restaurants because it was very hot and humid I literally had to step out of the restaurant  several times and go to a concierge lounge to cool off. 
At the pool and beach area, be prepared to pay extra if you want to use the beds which were over $100 per day.
House keeping room service was ok for the most part until they forgot/neglected to clean my room.  Unacceptable!

reviews.author: jacarelli
reviews.title: Wonderful for the most part...
reviews.text:
We recently visited the Paradisus Cancun for a family vacation.  We booked 2 rooms one with a beautiful ocean view. When we arrived, we were escorted to the concierge and checked in. We had been traveling since 3 am and were all exhausted, hungry and ready for the beach. 

They told us only one room was ready so we went up to change and encountered a room filled with construction workers and equipment!
We had to go Back down to the concierge where we encountered a woman named Guadalupe. She was rude and though spoke English, spoke only Spanish to her co-workers regarding my rooms. She told me I was lucky that they were attempting to accommodate me at all because it was an hour too early for check in. She said she tried to do me a "favor" and it didn't work out. Oh well.  If it weren't for the bell man who heard her, I would have walked out of the resort right that minute. He was very kind and apologized for her.  
The rest of the trip was wonderful. We had the loveliest waiters, waitresses, cab drivers and overall experience after that initial bad example.
The food was delicious and the rooms were perfect. Loved the beach and the pool each day

reviews.author: cavilav
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text:
AMAZING hotel! Loved everything, excellent service from all the employees, amazing food in the breakfast buffet, excellent food in the lunch buffet, good options on the poolside, great dinner buffet, and Fuego restaurant its delicious!!! The gelato stand was also very good.
For some reason we were given a room in pyramid 1 which is for Club Melia only and it was great! 
The lobby and hallways are very impressive with lots of vegetation.
I visited the Yhi spa and I had the best experience ever, loved all the hydrotherapy and the massage was best ever.
The bar was very good and the waiters at the beach were always with a very good attitude.
Loved everything about this hotel and for sure will be coming back.

reviews.author: vacationlover310
reviews.title: Excellent from start to finish
reviews.text: I traveled from August 10-15 2017 from arrival until departure the entire stay was incredible- if you read my other hotel reviews I have above average standards when traveling. I was a bit nervous as I have never heard of the Paradisus upon arrival you encounter manicured grounds, five pyramids, and attentive staff. We were escorted to registration where it was a bit dark which made me nervous however the staff were friendly, efficient, and explained the all inclusive process. We were informed of the multiple pyramids and where things are located. We were escorted to our room it is unfortunate I do not recall his name he was incredibly pleasant, told us abut the hotel while walking us to our room (be prepared to walk if you stay in pyramid 5 however it s WORTH IT!!  The room was a 1 bedroom suite with 2 bathrooms 2 balconies, a stocked mini fridge, and a living room.  The room was beautiful! It was clean, well furnished, beyond spacious, and overall exceeded my expectations. We were celebrating our anniversary and were welcomed with a heart made of rose petals on the bed. That was the beginning of a week long amazing vacation. The Royal Service allows you access to an exclusive pool that is not crowded and an exclusive restaurant that offers AMAZING customer service as well as excellent food choices. ALL of the staff was polite and genuinely friendly.  During the entire week I did not encounter one negative experience which is unique as I have high expectations. Some staff went above and beyond excellent customer service I have waited too long to write my review so I do not recall names however they work in the exclusive restaurant for Royal Service. Some reviews say it is not work the upgrade I do not agree, it is well work the upgrade.  The food is amazing, the drinks are great, the service is the best I have encountered anywhere.  Please remember to tip. the resort is all inclusive and it advertises that gratuity is included however the level of service is well worth tipping. I highly recommend the resort and will be returning the next time I travel to Cancun.  Outside of the resort we traveled by bus (it was $1 US dollar) (cheaper if you use pesos) the bus runs every few minutes up and down the hotel zone it felt safe using the bus, they were clean and the drivers were friendly announcing your stop if requested.

reviews.author: A.G.
reviews.title: RUNDOWN RESORT
reviews.text:
The lobby is gorgeous... But that's all.
Check in lady is very unfriendly  (belive her name is Karen )charged us twice for the room, even though we told her we've already payed.
The ROOMS are very outdated, and smells like mold. 
The materass is old and uncomfortable,
The toilet is inside a closet
 the tub/shower is very old 
The KIDS/BABY zone is very dirty and unsanitary.
The BEACH  is not stroller accessible.
NO KIDS POOL
The SERVERS are very nice and polite, that is the only reason why I'm giving 3 stars otherwise I would have given 1.
THEY SHOULD PUT THE SAME EFFORT IN UPDATING THE PLACE AS  THEY DO IN PUSHING YOU TO BUY A 50 YEARS MEMBERSHIP.
ABSOLUTELY NOT A 5 STARS RESORT! MORE like A 3 STARS RESORT.

reviews.author: Solepack N
reviews.title: Family vacay
reviews.text:
We had such a great experience thanks to the wonderful service of the family concierge team. Our butlers for the stay were Gloria y Maria and we couldn't have asked for better service. From getting us little things that our girls(3 & 6) requested to other little surprises( won't ruin it for you) that made the stay incredible for them. Truly a blessing to share our family moments here. I'll surely write back soon about the great quality of food which was pleasantly surprising- our favorite was the tasty food & wonderful staff at the Argentinian Steak house!! What a trip:))))
We stayed on the 3rd floor with ocean view in the main building & was perfect!! Thanks again Gloria y Maria!!!
-The Sala family

reviews.author: dondir780
reviews.title: One of THE best
reviews.text: This place is immaculate. Beautiful in and out. The all you can eat is one of the best I've seen. I will definitely be back! The inside area with all the hanging plants is beautiful. Staff very kind and helpful.

reviews.author: scubagirl95
reviews.title: Amazing Resort, Great Staff!
reviews.text:
We stayed at at the hotel last week of August. The resort is amazing inside and out. We stayed in family concierge, but we did not have the perks of family concierge (which was alright). The deck is amazing, we had an ocean view. The way the deck is built is unique, no one can see into your deck. We also had 2 outdoor chairs to sit on. The first two days when we arrived, tropical storm Harvey was just leaving, and we were in a downpour of rain. The hotel leaked a little, but staff were quick to clean up leaks. The rooms were amazing, cleaning staff did a very thorough job cleaning. There was also turn down service available. The only downside is that our room usually got cleaned at 2 PM, so even if we were out swimming all morning, we did not have towels to shower when we came back to our room. Mini bar was always stocked, however he never seemed to get enough water, it was one easy call to house keeping who would bring us water when needed. We ordered room service the first night, stay away from the pizza, definitely one of the worst I've had. If you want a piece of pita with sweet sauce, then go for it. 
During our stay, we are often at Naos (the buffet). Always a good selection of food, and staff was externally friendly and helpful. 

Notably, I would like to mention a few staff that made our stay amazing. Omar Garcia, thank you for introducing us to the Alfonso Trese drink. Your friendly attitude made us always seek you out at the buffet to be our server. A few others to mention, Orlando, Arlmando, Martin, and Miguel. You were all amazing servers, made our trip so much better with your friendliness. Also to mention Ascucion who went served us on the beach several times, we never got a chance to thank her.  

At Paradisus, there is an Aqua World, so no need to go across the street to book excursions. Go straight to Aqua World staff, unless you want to be sucked into a presentation with guest services to buy a timeshare to potentially get a discount. Aqua World staff is knowledgeable, and will book you for a trip. I booked a scuba diving trip through Fernando. 

The pool was great, both of them, and the ocean was beautiful. Lots of chairs to sit in, usually not too hard to find. During our stay, flags on the ocean most of the time were Red, however, we were still able to enjoy the ocean. 

Shows were decent at the hotel, however were repetitive. We seen Elvis and Michael Jackson twice (MJ was a great show though). I will mention the show that happened while MJ was getting ready lacked, and the singers were horrible. When the shows were at Avenue Bar, it was hard to see as the crowds were large, however when the shows were outside, there was lots of room to see. 

We only tried a few restaurants at Paradisus. On the first day we tried Blue Agave, it was very distasteful, and we left our meal and went to the buffet. We never returned to eat at Blue Agave. We made reservations at Vento, which offered a lot of food, 2 appetizers, 1 main dish, and 1 desert (with all inclusive package). Decent food, we enjoyed it. We also are at Market Grill which is an Argentinian style grill where hey bring meat to your table. Excellent meat, great service. We also booked at Fuego. We were weary at first, but the sirloin was AMAZING, I would go again just for that meal. 

Wifi was alright at the hotel, it was very spotty at night however. The lobby was also very hot, not much that the hotel can control as it is basically a tropic inside with all the plants. 

To note, the hotel also has a coffee shop opening during the day that offered coffee and sweets, as well as a ice cream and crape shop. Friendly staff there too! 
There is a store where you can purchase goods, and there is a money exchange inside the store if needed. 

Overall, this vacation was amazing, the hotel was amazing. We will definitely be staying at Paradisus again and will be recommending it to everyone.

reviews.author: goodgirln_mo
reviews.title: First timers and it was enjoyable!
reviews.text:
We decided to celebrate our oldest daughters graduation of HS in Cancun... and we had a fantastic time. 
We spent 5 nights at Paradisus  was fantastic. We had no plans other than to relax the whole time we were there, and we did just that. 
The check in process was a breeze, however, afterwards we were starving and just wanted to grab some lunch and we were stopped by the salemen (for about 20 minutes) trying to get us to commit to a 45 minute timeshare breakfast. Although I do have to say, he took No thank you well and we were on out way. 
Our room was clean and the air conditioning worked perfectly! The only downfall of this resort is no air conditioning in the common areas, makes it hard to want to explore the hotel when you just want to get back to your room in the AC. Specially in the Summer months when it's 90 degrees and 75% humidity. 
The maid service was fantastic! Our beds were made daily and we never had to worry about having fresh towels. If we ran low on water, a simple call and they had it up to our room within minutes. I love the personal experience that once the items you request are delivered they call to make sure you received them. 
We ordered room service one night, it was great. Every restaurant we tried was okay ... it was annoying that you had to book 2 days ahead of time. Knowing that before we arrives I was able to make the specific accommodations. 
We were VERY CAUTIOUS about the drinking water, we brushed our teeth with the  bottled water. Of course I was the only one to get side the last 2 days of the trip. Not sure if it was something that I ate or the water. 
Jose at the coffee bar, super friendly EVERY morning! 
The ladies at the galato stand were always fantastic. 
I have to give BIG props to Luis, our pool waiter! He was absolutely FANTASTIC. Every morning we were down, got our chairs and he had a bucket of water and drinks coming to us right away! Being that we took our 18 year old she wanted to try every drink under the sun, he was so accommodating to her and bringing her whatever she asked. We took well care of him due to this haha. On our last day as we were leaving we told him thank you and he shook our hand. WONDERFUL WONDERFUL service! One minor annoying factor was the warmth of the water ... seemed like if you went first thing in the morning the water felt nice but as the sun heated the pool up it was like luke warm bath water, not really refreshing. 

It was kinda disappointing that the whole time we were there the flags were red or yellow at the beach. We had one green day, but the kids were always able to enjoy the ocean. First day my oldest was a little sore from the roughness of the waves, but we managed. 

The location of the resort is perfect, we rode the bus downtown one day for shopping and let the kids swim with the dolphins and it was a 5 minute bus ride. 

Overall we had a wonderful first experience for the first time and I am so glad that we got to go! 

Thank you Paradisus staff!!!

reviews.author: Ankush C
reviews.title: Excellent resort. Beautiful property.
reviews.text:
We had a great time at this resort. The property is beautifully manicured and  spotless. The beach is clean, there are lounge chairs throughout and waiters to take drink orders. The food is high quality and plentiful with lots if options. Plenty of seafood but no lobster unless you are royal service.  The a la carte restaurants are very good, especially Diego and Mole, reservations are required which can be made starting at 7am the day before. 

The bars are average, with a wide selection of hard liquor and beer, Heineken on tap at one of the bars.  Otherwise local beers throughout. 

The service is impeccable. Special mention of Julio out waiter during breakfast. He provided amazing service and went above and beyond to maker is comfortable. 

This is an excellent resort highly recommend. It is family friendly and there are children around but it wasn't a problem for us.

reviews.author: Paula A
reviews.title: Customer Service was Excellent. Hotel Installations, not so Great.
reviews.text:
We are repeating customers to the hotel, this is our fourth time here. 
We, as always, have experienced great customer service. However, this time, we found the hotel installations lacking a LOT of maintenance. Tons of water filreting through the walls, bathroom showers, etc. Saw many roaches as well. We changed room twice because of the water filtering issue.
They've taken a great amount of "free space" in the pool and the beach area that used to be available for the guest's enjoyment, and have converted it into Bali beds for rent, ranging from $85-$150 per day.
Also, we used to love the Mexican restaurant, Mole. Not anymore, food was bland and with lack of character. It is more like "International Mexican" food, not taste whatsoever. 
Music through the hotel was awful. Although we come to this hotel every year to relax and enjoy the beach, we also come to Mexico to enjoy its ethnicity. Music was more like to put you to sleep. Not even in the Mexican restaurant we found a Mariachi.
Of course, not everything was bad. The Market Grill and Bana restaurants were DELICIOUS. Managers and waiters/waitresses were attentive and very accommodating. Jose at the coffee shop was beyond attentive. He was smiling every time we went there, very nice and a customer oriented guy. The ladies at the ice cream place were also great people, very attentive, and smiling all the time.
Food at the buffet was also very good. The tacos restaurant wasn't really impressive. It was okay overall.
And last but not least, the view of this hotel is MAJESTIC 😍😍😍

reviews.author: Patty C
reviews.title: Wonderful classy resort style hotel
reviews.text:
I stayed at the club melia part of Paradisus Cancun through my timeshare with RCI.  Being club melia, the daily all-inclusive fee is $100 per adult, and the use of Bali beds is $30 per use.  Everything Paradisus offered was well worth the all-inclusive fee, all reservation required restaurants are simply exceptional. Love the Market Grill, Fuego, and MOLE the most.  
   I would really rate the hotel a five star if not for the air conditioning of the hotel.  The rooms have strong AC and fan, but not the common places or the restaurants.  The lack of AC in the heated months while trying to dress up for a nice dinner is really uncomfortable and you can smell server's sweats when they serve you. 
   Overall, Paradisus Cancun did offer me the best experience I’ve had in Cancun, would definitely go back.

reviews.author: Sheril N
reviews.title: Great Resort!
reviews.text: My family and I were very impressed by the hotel. We had an amazing experience. The atmosphere of the hotel was very clean and beautiful. All the staff was very friendly and helpful. The hotel is all inclusive therefore foods and drinks were available all the time. Staff went beyond to exceed my experience. I highly recommend the Paradisus if you are visiting Cancun.

reviews.author: Elly N
reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: This was our second time staying at this resort and we love it however the rooms in building 3 which is the main building with all the restaurants does need some updating. Some of the tiles in the bathroom have cracked and the faucets in the shower were loose and broken.

reviews.author: Thu D
reviews.title: Wonderful first time!
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus for our first trip to Cancun and it was an excellent choice. The hotel was nice and clean. The room service was great. The staff was very friendly everywhere we go, especially Julio Cesar Cazaux at the restaurant by the pool. My kids love the family concierge and I love the Coffee corner. Although I don't know if we should request it or not, but if there is a little introductory tour when we first came to show things around the facility would be much more helpful for us, a family with little child. In general, we are very happy with our first experience. Thank you for making us feel very welcome and safe!

reviews.author: Isaac Bell
reviews.title: Excellent Stay
reviews.text: Despite a horrid rainstorm all but one day here, it was an excellent visit. The hotel ramped up the indoor entertainment and made it fun anyway. Andrea is an excellent entertainment coordinator!  In addition to taking a mixology course, they even did a very informative tequila tasting that was excellent and I don't even like tequila!

reviews.author: Djones7861
reviews.title: Great Resort!!
reviews.text: I can't tell you how impressed we were with the Paradisus. From the atmosphere to the food, it was absolutely amazing. The staff was always friendly and quick with drinks. We did not use the Royal Service and I don't see the need to bc everything was perfect without it. Late August/ early September is the time to go. At night, the Sea Turtles come onto the beach to lay their eggs. It is impressive to see the size of these turtles and how the staff makes sure the eggs are not harmed. We will be back for sure!!

reviews.author: Joseph R
reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: Everyone was very polite and helpful, beautiful resort and beach. Excellent service and a great place to stay. The food was fantastic. Also the performers on the beach and inside the resort made the stay even more fun and interactive.

reviews.author: Amanda C
reviews.title: Wedding weekend
reviews.text: We loved our stay here. The check in process could use some updating but the staff has made it such a wonderful experience. The check in should have two separate lines, one for check in and one for picking up cards after check in. But! Seriously the staff goes above and beyond to make sure you have a great time. I was worried that at an all inclusive that they wouldn't care as much but it's really the best service I've had in a long time. Both Sergio as our server at mole and Roberto the magician in avenue bar went above and beyond to entertain and appease us. Really impressed. Thanks staff for making up for what the check in sucked at!

reviews.author: janaD4709JP
reviews.title: Wonderfull stay at paradisus
reviews.text: We loved everything at this resort. Food was excellent, all staff friendly and helpful . Room and resort were very clean. One day we had an air conditioner leak and it was fixed within 30 minutes of notifying front desk. And I had the best massage at the spa by Daniela

reviews.author: Christian_and_Ann
reviews.title: Magnificent Hotel, wonderful week
reviews.text:
We were taking a week vacation at the Paradisus Cancun the last week of April and came back with wonderful memories. Despite a small incident our first day, our stay was very near perfect.

We start with the check-in because this is where it went wrong and by the time we are finished with the review, you will understand that overall, this hotel is great value for the money, but we feel it had to be told.

Check-in: The check-in process is the big thing which could be improved. We arrived at 12:30pm so our room was not ready. Our luggage was stored outside exposed to the sun, so much that my wife's beauty products were melted. At the check-in desk, there were only two employees working so we had to wait for about 20 minutes in line for our turn. The first night, we were given a kind of makeshift bedroom from a family kitchen room. We had a kitchen counter in it; we were missing the night tables, a chair for the desk and an alarm clock. Moreover, the bathroom's faucet was clogged and the shower was shooting water everywhere except on us. At this point, we were thinking that the hotel prioritises the grounds and interior appearance (because yes, it is very impressive with all the beautiful gardens) but falls short for the rooms comfort. By chance, we travelled with my wife's mother and when we saw her room the next day, we understood that we had been under-graded. When we went to the front desk to complain, we were given another room immediately (one for which we had paid for). Moreover, it was my wife’s birthday and I was disappointed to have to go to the concierge desk to tell the hotel that they had forgot her birthday. Not that it is an obligation but it’s a little something to say: “Thank you for celebrating your birthday here”. After that, everything went great.

Hotel and grounds: The interior gardens are impressive and very well maintained. We liked to have our breakfast next to the fish pond, which was beautiful. 

Beach & pools: Miles and miles of white sand and turquoise water. A lot of palapas to get a break from the sun and very efficient beach service. What more could you want? Pools were very well maintained with enough lounge chairs for everyone, but we could see that the hotel was at its maximum capacity. No need to run for the towels, there is plenty for everyone.

Buffet & restaurants: The buffet was not impressive but standard for a buffet, we felt like some meals lacked in taste especially for breakfast. On lunch time, there was also a BBQ outdoors which was good. Best restaurants we tried were Bana, Market Grill and Fuego.  We also tried the Mole and the Vento which were also good but not our favorites. Overall, the quality of the food in the buffet was ok, but it was better in the restaurants.

Drinks: Yes, they do serve premium liquor and they make mean drinks. You should try the Riviera Maya and the Kelly Kelly. You can also ask for an ice bucket with beers and water bottles, which is a very nice thought.

Hotel staff: We found the service excellent. The staff was always very polite, efficient and friendly. We felt very welcomed and pampered during all our stay. 

Overall, we strongly recommend this hotel and can’t wait to go back!

reviews.author: Tania A
reviews.title: Great vacation to Paradisus Cancun with Family Concierge Service"
reviews.text:
Our family of four (we have 2 boys, ages 5 and 9 years-old) spent 7 nights at this property on August 21. The best part of the resort, for us, is the people who work there. They work so hard to make your stay as enjoyable as possible. They are friendly and work very hard. The hotel itself is beautiful, but its outdated. They need to do major DEEP maintenance work. We had to switch rooms after night 2, because water kept coming from the ceiling as you entered the bathroom. One of the times, I almost slipped because we were coming into the room and did not know there was water all over the floor. At that point we requested a room change and the hotel responded efficiently. 

We did the Family Concierge Service, and our concierges Maria and Gloria were great! They were constantly checking on us making sure everything was going smoothly. They took care of dinner reservations for us, and even helped us move our bags when we had to switch rooms. They regularly left little surprises (toys, bathtub ready and decorated with fun balloons etc for the kids) in our room. Family Concierge has a lounge  for those who have the service. They have a pool table, wii, snacks, coffee, drinks etc. It is a good place to go hang out with the kiddos at anytime. They need to perhaps get some new pool balls and new sticks as well... But the lounge is beautiful and they constantly replenish the snacks. The Family Concierge upgrade is the way to go if you are traveling with kids!!! 

The food at the resort was great, overall. Naos is the buffet restaurante and breakfast is great. Thank you to Cristhian L, Pascual & Martin for superb service as waiters. By the second morning, they remembered us and would make my coffee exactly how I like it, bring fresh juices to the table for the kids and for myself, and were so so so polite, fun and attentive. Our kids were sad to say good bye to them on our last day.

The pool area of the resort is nice, but there was some construction going on. We did not mind but I think they should let guests know ahead of time before booking a reservation there. The bali beds by the pools and beach are for rent, and they are $130-$150 or so PER DAY. It is ridiculous! We ended up renting one by the pool the day before we left. The fee includes lobsters with shrimp or a bottle of champagne. We chose the lobster and let me tell you... IT WAS AMAZING! They bring you soon much food!!!!! We felt that it was our "treat" and well worth it. We had three attendants taking care of us: Victor, Veronica and Nurby and they treated us like kings and queens :). 

The resort restaurants that require reservation are good for the most part. We absolutely loved Fuego and Mole. The sushi restaurant was good too (try the "house sushi"- it was super yummy). But the other restaurants were just okay. 

We had fun at this place. The beach is gorgeous but a bit strong. I would probably would want to try another Paradisus before returning to this one, but would definitely recommend it if its your first time AND find a good deal ;). 

Enjoy!

reviews.author: SpensMiniCoop
reviews.title: Great Resort..but watch for Timeshare
reviews.text:
Resort is beautiful...there is a lot of steps to go to beach area..but we had no problems with that.
Rooms could use some updating. .but were clean, comfortable and spacious.  We had the lagoon Jr Suite..Awesome!
Staff are friendly; however, we checked in and then were escorted by Mario to bellman. Mario explained hotel amenities etc but than slipped in a spiel about something to the affect of timeshare. We stated we were not interested, and he was fine with that..never bothered again..although was persistent at first. Just be aware of this!
Food - chicken was excellent. ..servers were always making sure you were comfortable and happy!
Beach is terrific..waves at times were rough but no problem to get cooled off! Bar Server Emanuelle (I think) was AWESOME...HE MADE SURE WE WERE CONSTANTLY FILLED AND ALWAYS BROUGHT WATER AND ICE...HE really was terrific! We tipped each day..they work hard to make sure you are getting what you paid for 😊
Went downtown Cancun..fun, safe and everyone was so kind and helpful. Went shopping at one mall..Louis Vuitton. .etc..great mall..must go! We took the bus..it stops right in front of hotel..drivers were great as well as the folks who live there..very kind and helpful!
All in all..Fantastic Holiday!

reviews.author: Jon S
reviews.title: A winner once again
reviews.text: We came back to Paradisus after a year away and had another great experience. We stayed in Royal Service and commend the updated rooms which are lighter and more modern. The dining and bars were consistently solid, but what makes Paradisus different is the fantastic staff and service. We would recommend considering Paradisus if you are going to Cancun.

reviews.author: Laurie S
reviews.title: Overall a lovely stay
reviews.text: The hotel is in the hotel zone, which makes it really easy to hop on a bus to go downtown and enjoy shopping and other restaurants and entertainment venues. The waitstaff were plentiful at the pool and beach. The beach provided plenty of waves to play in the water. The food was good and we enjoyed the Market Grill the most. The room was lovely, large and clean. The mini bar was restocked like clockwork and room service was prompt and efficient. The  room is serviced every day, and every evening there was turndown service. The spa services were amazing. Overall we had a lovely time.

reviews.author: dennyq920
reviews.title: Amazing geat away
reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay and will return. The Blue Agave , Fuego and pool side in Royal service has the best food. The staff is very helpful, kind and attentive. The pool on Royal service side and beach were very clean.

reviews.author: alan t
reviews.title: A week in Cancun
reviews.text:
The hotel is a splendid modern structure situated on an expanse of clear sandy beach next to a turquoise sea. The hotel is vast although neatly divided into 5 discrete areas with the central of these areas accommodating rooms and bar / restaurant facilities. All of the main internal areas are beautifully decorated and tranquil in appearance - almost the hanging gardens of Babylon in appearance. We had a good room which was well serviced daily and the hotel staff were all polite and helpful. What the hotel lacks is that last little bit of finesse - maybe difficult with such a large hotel.. On the negative side, food, except in the main restaurant was not good to bad, The hotel should serve food it is familiar with, not try to serve international foods of which the chefs clearly have no working experience.Worst was the noise in the central area where an open bar area disseminated excessively amplified music over a wide area such that one could not speak to one's neighbour at table in the "Japanese" restaurant in the central atrium. This restaurant was also so dark that the waiters used torches to allow guests to read the menu. Thoughtless stuff which could easily be rectified with a little effort. These things took the edge off what could otherwise have been  a fantastic holiday.

Alan and Soledad , Birmingham, UK

reviews.author: Sta-Sea63
reviews.title: Wonderful time at Paradisus, Cancun!!
reviews.text:
My husband and I spent a week at the Paradisus Cancun (9/21 to 9/28). We had a wonderful time there. Our concierge Paulina and Ana were Very helpful to us. We liked the fact the hotel was close to restaurants outside the resort, and we caught the bus to the mall Playa del Isla. They even had a ATM  machine outside the resort where you can get American dollars. The ATM in the resort only gave pesos. 
They have entertainment shows every night by the Avenue bar. And the pools were very nice with entertainment too.
The restaurants inside the hotel were pretty good. We liked Bana(sushi), Market Grille(lamb, steak, chicken), and Blue agave(quesadila  and tacos). Mole and Fuego was a little different,  we didn't care for those too much. 
We went to the Crabhouse for seafood across the street from the resort and that was tasty. If you get there around 6pm you might catch them feeding the alligator. 
We also went to Harry's Steakhouse... OMG!! THE steaks were DELICIOUS. my husband had the cowboy. and I had the dry aged ribeye with garlic mashed potatoes, and creamed spinach. We REALLY enjoyed this spot.
Overall we had a great time and would visit this resort again!

reviews.author: Tracy Y
reviews.title: Royal Service
reviews.text: We have stayed at this resort previously, however this time stayed in Royal Service.  Now we are spoiled and will continue to stay in Royal Service.  Our butler, Sergio, made our experience so relaxing and top notch.  The adult only area and LaPalapa was amazing.  Highly recommend! Request Sergio!

reviews.author: Bjetttttt
reviews.title: Disappointing - and this is our FOURTH trip to this resort!
reviews.text:
Let me /begin with CHECK-IN.  Arrived at noon.. our room was not ready until 3  - fine, but arrived at 3:30 - was given keys to a room with NO AIR CONDITIONING!  We were tired from the flight, and it would have been considerate when checking in for the front desk to let us know that the A/C was out throughout the entire property until approx 8pm!!  We would have left the resort and went to somewhere else with A/C if we had known!   What did they do?  "don't worry we will compensate you'.. So they gave us keys to another room in tower 1 - long walk to the other side of the property - to the same type room but still with NO A/C!  Then offered another room (same as our ocean view) - which was the SAME - NO A/C.  The blower was even broken in this room - so no air flow at all.  The supervisor Veronica came to the room and told us the blower was working.  She didn't believe me until I stood on a chair and showed her what we meant.   Seriously?  She was the one who said we would be 'compensated', -- why in the world would you not accommodate a guest who had to stand on a chair to prove the blower was not working?  Why would you not compensate a guest who you knowingly handed keys to a HOT room that would remain HOT for 5 more hours??  All she could say was that this was the best they could do and the manager was in the next day.   We expected to hear something from the manager, but never a word-- and this is day 6!

So we stayed in the room we had our luggage in - and did not have a cool room until 9pm.   Compensation?  No - nothing.  They called to see if our a/c was working later that night, that's it. 

I noted we have been to this resort 4x in past two years and loved it.  This time is different.  We wonder if the management has changed because things were NOT the same and we were just here in February on our honeymoon!  This trip was an anniversary of my husband proposing to me last September, so it is sentimental to both of us - and we had planned on returning every year to celebrate.  Now we are thinking about looking elsewhere.  We spend a LOT of money when we come here and we have other choices, but we chose Paradisus to stay. 

Bana:  The food was subpar.  That is the restaurant where he proposed to me, so it was kind of special to return there, but we were not happy.  The food was sooo much better in February and the other two times we visited!!!  

I wrote a review on day 2 here at Tripadvisor and it told me it was 'under review' and I have not seen it posted.. so let me recap our 7 day trip. 

Today is day 6 of our stay and in addition to the lack of caring on check-in problems with no a/c -- here are other things that happened. 
1.  Had to call for soda and ice delivery 3x each time we made a request. 
2. Had to call for toilet paper -- did not receive it until late afternoon when they made up the room. 
3. Room keys.. during this stay - had to have the keys re-keyed 3x .. so far. 
4. The room mattress was completely broken down -- my husband's back is bad and on day 2 - had to have this replaced.  That did happen.. but took a couple of hours. 
5.  Pictures.  Oh the pictures.  We ALWAYS commemorate our trip with pictures taken by Outdoor photography, an company on-site.  We have been so pleased always with these photos, until, of course, this time.  I do NOT recommend the photographer we had Enrique -- as the photos turned out terrible.  He didn't seem to know the basic fundamentals of being a photographer.  Which is really truly sad because the water was amazing and the day was perfect for photos.  We were excited to see the 50+ shots until we viewed them.  Oh my gosh.. only two were acceptable which we reluctantly purchased. 

It is ridiculous to book a trip like this 6 months in advance in anticipation of greatness that you had the other 3 trips before and then have these things happen.  We feel like it really doesn't matter that we are patrons who keep coming here and recommend this place to EVERYONE we know!  The lack of response from management speaks loud and clear that we do not matter to them. 

I had seen on facebook that a lady wrote a review for Paradisus and said that she was complimentary upgraded to Royal Service for FREE upon checking in as well as other people in the lobby.   I wrote a letter to Paradisus last month, not asking for Royal Service, but an upgrade to a bigger room.  They wrote back and said no- but for $75/night I could have royal service lagoon view.  We do NOT like lagoon view as we always pay extra for the ocean view.   I thought being 4x patrons, asking for a bigger room was not really asking for much, but apparently it was.  I wanted to surprise my husband, but was not able to.  We spent $2800 to visit Paradissus -- spent over $600 in tips/gifts throughout the week.  Spent a lot of money shopping in Cancun.  All of this -- for a week.. to have a less than acceptable visit.  

 If the management of this establishment cares about their repeat patrons, they should really fix all of this!  That will determine whether we ever visit Paradisus Cancun EVER again.   We were actually going to plan a family trip next year for us and our 3 daughters; however, seeing the cost that would be involved, we want the trip to be memorable for our kids -- soooo glad we did not bring them this time!  We always RAVE about this resort and if they came with us during this stay - we would have looked like liars to them.

reviews.author: jessejbizanos
reviews.title: Couples Vacation
reviews.text: The resort was beautiful and the location was awesome but, food, drinks, activities need improvement! I was really hoping for more then eating drinking and lounging around! One out of ten, I give it a six!

reviews.author: Erinaustin3698
reviews.title: Better than any Thai or Balinese resort
reviews.text:
Our kids absolutely loved the service levels this resort provided. Makes life for us parents so much easier. Would recommend the family concierge package upgrade. 

The restaurants also provided a good variety with little extras like cookies and milk delivered at bed time very much appreciated

reviews.author: nikkaaayyyy
reviews.title: Loved it.
reviews.text: We really enjoyed every moment at the Paradisus Cancun! Great tasting food options especially for breakfast. The pina coladas and mango margaritas are delish. The staff were amazing and also held our extra baggage whilst we did our side trip. We sadly only had a short stay but we will be back!! Loved it and worth the price!

reviews.author: Bxavier712
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: This resort was awesome! The staff was very helpful and polite. The suites were very nice and accommodating. The food variety was great. I had a great time and enjoyed my stay here. I will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Nisha_Liyana
reviews.title: Amazing honeymoon :-)
reviews.text:
WOW!!! We just got back from our honeymoon at Paradisus Cancun, and I cannot think of anything negative to say. This is the most amazing all inclusive holiday we've ever had. The main reason for this is the staff and the customer service, I would rate it a 10/10. We didn't upgrade to Royal, but I can tell you that it didn't make any difference to us. The staff are the nicest people I've ever come across and will bend backwards for you - just shows you don't need the royal service to receive this. The royal pool and restaurant looked boring anyways! :-P

Arriving at the hotel early evening we had no issues with check-in, was very quick and straight forward :-). They did however accidentally assign us a double twin room instead of a kingsize due to availability, but without us even having to say anything they immediately offered to move us to the king suite the following morning (which was done smoothly with no problems).

We were a little nervous about what to expect after reading the negative reviews before our trip, but thank god we didn't let them put us off, as our experience was nothing like theirs! 

Our room was in Pyramid 3 on the 8th floor - Lagoon view. Okay Ocean view would have been nicer but to be honest we didn't spend that much time in the room anyways, but more time in the restaurants, pool and the ocean. The room itself was lovely, clean and peaceful with a fully working AC. The minibar was stocked daily, but you'll find that you'll hardly touch those drinks because you'll spend more time at the amazing pool swim up bar drinking the fantastic cocktails :-).

And as for the negative comments regarding the lack of A/C - ermm where??? Everywhere has AC except for the outdoor restaurant. The AC was a bit weaker in the main communal area pyramid 3 but that's understandable as it has a high glass roof with so much sunlight coming through. Don't let that put you off going. 

The ocean - woww!! The most beautiful ocean I've ever seen, and beach is also very well maintained and manned. 

Tips - 
1. We went 3rd week of Sept, and that was the best choice we made! Hardly any children there (because they are back at school in Sept) and NO issues with booking restaurants, availability of sunbeds at pool/ocean, or busy check in. Everything was spot on. The resort was 80% full and that suited our trip perfectly as it wasn't overly crowded and service wasn't compromised.

2. Suggest walking down the beach and booking excursions directly with the companies who are running them instead of going through Paradisus, as it works out cheaper and they do allow negotiation on price slightly if you do more than one activity through them. Definitely recommend doing the parasailing, what a view!

3. Suggest sitting near the same waiters for breakfast/lunch every day as they will be double attentive and start remembering your preferences. They made us feel so welcome :-)

4. $ Tips. If you don't already know about the culture in America, you will need to tip for almost every service you receive. We averaged tipping US$1/2 a time.

5. If you fancy going to the local town/market/clubs/restaurants, catch the bus from the bus stop which is directly outside the hotel, it's only 10.5 Pesos each way and takes 10mins. The hotel cabs are very pricey so wouldn't suggest that. 

After seeing the whole of the strip, this is by far the nicest hotel there. The interior is beautiful, very-well maintained and always smelt fresh. 

Thank you Paradisus for a truly amazing honeymoon, we cannot wait to come back!

reviews.author: HolliferH
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Just travelling back from absolute paradise. Loved everything about this hotel and its services. Our favourite restaurant was Bana. The sushi is incredible. The only thing I would say is missing is more space outside to relax in the evening. The staff work really hard to make sure you have everything you need. If you are from the UK don't expect to meet any other Brits here, but this didn't bother us at all.  I will be recommending this hotel.

reviews.author: xeimex
reviews.title: Know before you go..
reviews.text:
We booked Paradusis for a luxury getaway before travelling through Mexico on a much tighter budget. As a pair of girls we wanted a safe and luxurious all inclusive option where we didn't have to think about anything. We booked an all inclusive stay for 4 nights in a twin room. 

We checked in late at night with no hassle. The concierge told us we were in Pyramid 1, and that we could have a Lagoon Room with twin beds or be upgraded to an ocean view room and share a king bed. We went for the upgrade. 

Rooms were nice, aircon worked but was extremely loud. We later realised this was probably a good thing because the noise from the clubs and beach was so loud in the beach view rooms in Pyramid 1 and the doors were definitely not soundproof. 

Bathrooms are a little run down, but clean and stocked with essentials. Bed was comfy and the turn down service at night was a nice touch. 

The beachfront is beautiful, if you manage to get a good day bed, you're set. But be aware that the nicer beach beds are reserved for members or you have to pay extra to use them. 

There are a few different restaurants in the resort, all average unfortunately. If you're after western style food and buffets, you will like it. If you want some gourmet.. forget it. Or, pay extra to eat at the expensive option. 
We had a manicure in the spa while we were there, prices were extremely expensive. I wouldn't pay these prices at home, but we were on vacay. Had the manicure in a kids room because apparently there was something wrong with the usual room. Sitting in a kids chair for over an hour hunching over a small table for an average manicure was not ideal. 

Otherwise the pools and service was great. Good wifi. Tacky entertainment, but lots of people love that sort of thing. Minibar and water in room was only restocked once, had to keep asking for water to use. Beachfront was definitely the best part of the hotel. 

If your not a club member, or paying extra to use the beach club, make sure your room isn't internal to Pyramid 1 so you can get some sleep.

reviews.author: Angelique C
reviews.title: Looked Better from the Outside
reviews.text:
ROOM:
My husband and I made reservations here to celebrate our first anniversary. The outside and common area was very nice; however, our room was not very impressive. We were on the 3rd floor in the center of the complex.  The drain on the bathroom floor reeked of raw sewer and the odor would fill the room.  Housekeeping's solution was to spray the room with air freshener to mask the smell. No bottles of liquor in the room.

CHECK IN:
Check in was fairly easy.  They served you drinks while we waited which was nice.  Since we arrived at the property before normal check in time, we were given a short tour and allowed to eat lunch while we waited for our rooms. Betty was the one who gave us a tour and made our dinner reservations.  She also convinced us to do the membership tour so that we could take advantage of the gifts for our anniversary.

MEMBERSHIP TOUR:
Rafael was really great and knowledgeable of the resorts. When it came down to decide whether or not we wanted to buy, my husband and I decided that it was not a good time to buy. He asked if anything would change our minds, and I said no money down and $100 a month.  He said, that would be a really good deal but didn't think they would have anything.  We were okay with that, but I guess he was still required to bring in the "second" person. Her name was Carolina.  Carolina was the rudest person we have ever met.  She asked why we took the presentation if we knew we weren't going to buy. We told her that we liked the gifts and were undecided about becoming members when we took the tour.  She then said, "Next time do me a favor and don't come again. Don't waste everybody's time." This is obviously not the job for her.  If you can't handle rejection without being rude, then you're in the wrong business.

FOOD:
The restaurant selections were just okay.  You needed to make dinner reservations unless you wanted to have buffet all the time. Some of the seats worn especially in Vento.

POOL/BEACH:
Both areas were very nice. We got to enjoy a Bali bed by the pool as part of our free gifts which was very nice.

FREE GIFTS:
One of the gifts we received was for 4 days and 3 nights stay at Paradisus.  However, when we got to our room and read the fine print, we noticed that it was for the room only.  It was not an all inclusive trip. That was very disappointing.

reviews.author: Audra C
reviews.title: Amazing vacation
reviews.text: The hotel and staff were great. Made you feel comfortable and took care of everything needed. Very easy to make reservations at restaurants. The nightly entertainment was amazing. Cancun is a nice place to travel to. Very easy to get around the hotel zone. We booked a few excursions. Some pick you up right a the resort. We stayed in pyramid 3 level 8. Had a lagoon view which was very nice. The food at the restaurants were great quality! We loved the market grill, bana and tacos at the blue agave.

reviews.author: Jessica J
reviews.title: Paradisus cancun
reviews.text: Only complaint is that the air went out in our room and the door to the room didn't shut properly. Other than that we had a great experience! We rented a bed on the beach for our honeymoon and the service and food was great! It was also great food and service all through out the hotel. We plan on planning a trip back as soon as we can!

reviews.author: Liz P
reviews.title: Baby Club
reviews.text: The Baby Club was awesome! Alma and Adriana were amazing with our 9 month old Nicholas. The Baby Club is very clean and has great toys. Nicholas enjoyed it greatly. We will for sure go back to Paradisus specially for the care Alma and Adriana had towards our baby. Thank you Alma and Adriana, we hope to see you again next year!!!

reviews.author: Jesenia Q
reviews.title: They did it AGAIN!!!
reviews.text:
Fourth time at this Hotel and counting.
These guys always strive above and beyond their responsabilities to meet your expectations.
There is no one that I can give a complaint. THANK YOU!! and we will see you soon!!!

reviews.author: alicia944
reviews.title: Couple vacation
reviews.text:
My boyfriend and I stayed at the Paradisus  Cancun for a week, this is truly a very beautiful hotel. We decided for  the Royal service adults only area. Our butler Galindo was not always physically present but every time we called him he answered and made our request possible. We were given a phone that we were able to contact our butler anytime we wanted to, that was a very nice service.
This property is huge and there is a lot of walking, I will also say that their air-conditioning it's not too efficient in the common areas and some restaurants. The beach is one of the most beautiful beaches I have seen in the Caribbean, the rooms are beautiful and I was definitely treated like a queen. 
We ate at the following restaurants, Bana ( fantastic), Vento ( ok),  Mole ( great) , Market grill ( ok) and on the  royal service area Palapa rest by the pool ( great). 
I have to give a shout out to the executive chef  and Moises at the Palapa restaurant for making us the most incredible fish I have tasted. Moises even cut it up for us. Juan at Mole rest and Rafael at Palapa. All the workers were great and did a fantasy job. Take advantage of the Hydro therapy ritual which is included as part of the Royal service. My boyfriend and I went twice and it was just very relaxing and much-needed. 
This resort it's not a place with a night life, and their shows have a lot to be desired. They have a little area with some performances but there is no real night shows like other resorts.

reviews.author: Christina B
reviews.title: Royal Service Paradise
reviews.text:
We booked a Royal Service Lagoon View Junior Suite in June. We did a lot of research on other hotels and loved the Royal Service aspect of this one. We checked in Sept 8th around 3pm for 6 nights. When we arrived, we went into the general check-in desk and the second we said RS, we were whisked away to the private sit-down check in lounge. We were given champagne and cold scented towels almost immediately. It was lovely, we signed a couple forms, were given a cell phone to contact our butler, and were on our way to our room. We asked about an upgrade to an ocean view and were told they were all booked.  However, when we got to our room, it was an ocean view! We were pleasantly surprised! The woman who checked us in was very nice, as was every single employee we came across in the whole 7 days. Everyone greets you, we loved it. Our butler was Susana, and she was so amazing, just the sweetest person you can imagine. She left us bottles of Chivas Regal in our room, drew us a bubble bath on two nights, left notes  and rose petals on the bed. We also had beautiful plates of small desserts and two tier boxes of chocolates delivered to our room most nights. It was incredible. Our last night, we were given a bottle of Paradisus Tequila and Mexican candy! We loved all the little special touches.

The Hotel: The hotel is gorgeous, we loved the hanging plants, koi ponds, zen gardens,  plants, and incense everywhere. All of the restaurants are decorated differently, and everything is always being cleaned or maintained in some way. Wifi worked great at the hotel and pool! 

The room: We loved the room, the King bed was very comfortable, and the pillows were nice and soft. They do offer a pillow menu in the room information binder, but we didn’t need it. The room was clean, modern, and there was a bidet, which was nice. The shower was nice, some people would probably have trouble getting in and out of it as the sides are high, but we did not. There was plenty of Thierry Mugler soaps, lotions, shampoo, conditioner and body wash. There were also shower caps, nail files, makeup remover pads, etc. The balcony was huge and had an amazing view. The air conditioner worked very well. There was no handle on the outside of the door, but it was no problem to open. The minibar had potato chips, M&Ms, granola bars, and a fruit bar. There were Cokes, Diet Cokes, Sprite, Tomato Juice, Sparkling Water, Mango Nectar, Heiniken, Dos Equis, and Tecate. They also offer a beach bag with towels and an umbrella. There was a small coffeemaker, but I was hoping for a Nespresso machine as the RS lounge and Nespresso coffee bar don’t open til  9 or 10am.

Royal Service: The Royal Service pyramid(5) is currently under construction until December. These rooms are being renovated so we can’t wait to see them next year. We were in pyramid 4 in room 4205(perfect location), we went down a floor and there was the spa which had the most incredible fragrance(not overpowering though) in the hallway. We did not use the gym. The Royal Service lounge is temporarily in pyramid 4 and is open until 10pm. They had 3 chafing dishes which they had some breakfast items, meats and cheeses in the afternoon, and appetizers such as empanadas at night. They also offer pastries, danishes, and fruit in the morning as well as amazing lattes. I adored the little desserts they had at night, macarons, brownies, cake, mmm!! The drinks were amazing, they made really strong drinks! The Spa offers a complementary hydrotherapy ritual which we did our last night. It consists of a sauna, steam room, a couple different showers, and the hydrotherapy pool with different jets to massage you. Royal Service is for people who want to totally relax on vacation, I highly recommend paying the extra money because it is very much worth it. 

Food: We had Susana book all our dinner reservations and she would find us during our day or leave a confirmation in our room. We tried Market Grill, Bana, Mole, Fuego, Enso, and Vento. We only ate at the buffet for breakfast, so I can’t comment on the food during lunch or dinner there. Our favorites were Market Grill (Brazilian steakhouse), Bana(sushi), and Enso(Indian, Thai, Chinese fusion). The service at Bana(Victor), Enso(Manuel), and Vento(Carlos) were the best. At Vento, the Nicoise salad was very salty, and I didn’t like the pizza, also the fried lamb chop was well done. The service was incredible though, Carlos took our picture and upon learning it was our last night, brought out a special cake that was so delicious. He was wonderful! At Bana we tried both Ginger and Wasabi ice creams, so amazing. We loved Victor and his recommendations, they had Mexican sushi!  I wish I could describe every dish and experience we had, but this review is already long. Some of the restaurants offered a small welcome cocktail which I loved. At Enso, Manuel brought us White Russians before dessert without being asked. I had never even had one and I loved it. The buffet breakfast was always great, I loved having a mimosa. I loved the Chilaquiles, Ham and Cheese Pastry, Quiche, Omelets, Bacon, French Toast, Mueseli, Oatmeal, fruit, juices, and everything. We loved La Palapa, the Royal Service restaurant which is open for lunch and dinner. The food was always piping hot and fresh, the Tuna Tiradito and Grilled Prawns were our favorite. We had Cesar as a server and he was great! Loved eating here! 

The Beach: The beach was beautiful and the waves rough. The palapas were wonderful as well as Jorge, our beach server. Way too many vendors though, one guy wouldn’t leave me alone when my husband got up to go to the bathroom. He kept putting jewelry on me and asking why I didn’t want to buy anything from him. We stuck to the pool after that. Also, people would play music and leave it on when they went into the water, but we just moved down to a quieter area. 

The Pool: We had a Bali Bed reserved for two days, this was absolutely wonderful. We had Edier(Eddy) the first day and he was great, I love that they will deliver food right to you! We had Raphael the second day and he was the best! We ordered Miami Vice drinks with extra shots of rum and he brought us more without even ordering. We ate Mini Burgers, Spring Rolls, Chips and Guac, Chicken Wings, Fruit, and Tuna Skewers. We took naps, ate, listened to the soft music, and enjoyed the pool. It was paradise. On Monday, we went to the Royal Service lounge to request another Bali Bed and were given one behind the pool concierge, not the best location, but still nice. I love that they put your name on them when you reserve them in advance. The ones backing up to the ocean were the best because the view was amazing and you were close to the bar and restroom. The pool concierge has towels, sunscreen, and aloe vera. We had Ramon as our server that day and he was amazing as well. Eric, the pool bartender was amazing and made us a special Monkey drink inside a coconut. It was so good!!!! While in the Bali Bed, we got the chance to take a photo with an Albino Burmese python named Wormy and a tiny monkey named Muneca. The photos came out great and we had to buy them. They are one for $20 or 3 for $50. Some employees come around to sell you massages and professional photo shoots which we will do next time. The pool concierge comes around every so often to offer cold towels or popsicles, the watermelon was amazing. 

The Entertainment: The main pool had very upbeat music and I saw pool aerobics and dancing going on, but we liked the quieter adults only side of the hotel. We did not use the swim up bar, but from what I saw, kids sat there and splash and jump in so I don’t think we missed out. The nighttime entertainment started at 8:30pm but the seating fills up fast so everyone just kind of stands there. I enjoyed the pop night which had Lady Gaga, Madonna, and Beyonce singers.  They give you a schedule of what’s going on but we just relaxed the whole time. 

Check-out: Check out was very easy, only took one minute. Susana called our airport transportation company the day before, I highly recommend Gray Line for a private transfer!! We can’t wait to come back to this hotel and check out the new Royal Service rooms, in my opinion, RS is the only way to go. We had an incredible vacation and haven’t taken our wristbands off even a week later!

reviews.author: Arial7777
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel...
reviews.text: This was our second visit to Paradisus, my first visit was September of 2015 and I do have a review on that stay. This year myself and 5 other family members stayed there from September 11-17. We booked total of 3 rooms and we paid ocean view suit price for all 3 rooms and it was also indicated on our confirmation email. After a 5 hr flight from Los Angeles and 1 Hr of delay due to weather condition we arrived to the hotel. The check in process was unacceptable. The employees working at the check in were extremely rude and unknowledgeable. One kept interrupting another when I was trying to ask questions and finalize our check in. Long story short 45 minutes later they gave us the 2 ocean view suites and one lagoon view, the lady said they didn't have 3 ocean view suits available which was a complete lie. We were tired and we just wanted to get to our rooms and rest. The two ocean view rooms were right above the Market Grill restaurant which were unbearable, the smoke and smell was coming up straight to the point where we weren't able to open the window to enjoy the view which defeats the purpose of ocean view room. We came down and complaint to Veronica the manager and she immediately changed our room, which goes to show the other employee had no idea what she was doing.or saying. Our stay was very pleasant the property is stunning and the beach and pool areas were amazing. All employees at the restaurants and buffet and the pool side were nice and accommodating. Overall I think this is one of the nicest hotels in Cancun hotel zone but due to bumpy check in process I don't think I will be staying here next time I decide to travel to Cancun.

reviews.author: Nap time B
reviews.title: Beautiful resort!!
reviews.text: This had to be one of most beautiful resorts I've been too. The service was amazing and there is always something to do. They keep the drinks and food coming, and the restaurant Bana was great. My boyfriend and I picked the perfect resort to celebrate my birthday. Already planning my next trip!!

reviews.author: Christian P
reviews.title: Not a Paradisus like the others we visited
reviews.text:
We have been to other Paradisus in Punta Cana and Playa del Carmen. This one cannot compare to the others by any means. Other than the Beach, the rest is just below average compared to our previous Paradisus Experience. We are not going again to this Hotel.
If you compare it with Paradisus La Perla, this one onlye has a better beach only.

reviews.author: Guvinda
reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text: This is an amazing hotel with very attentive staff. I stayed for ten days and both my partner and I loved every second of it. Excellent facilities and restaurants. I have every intention of visiting Paradisus in the further.

reviews.author: spirosa897
reviews.title: One of a kind property
reviews.text: A beautifully designed and maintained property, definitely a one-of-a-kind. Service seems to be slipping a bit...I recommend the royal service option.  Staff was friendly but a bit unpolished.  The food options and quality was very good.

reviews.author: Cindy L
reviews.title: Didn't have to lift a finger!! A true vacation for a Mom!!
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus with family concierge service -  the hotel is all around top notch! The level of customer service and the cleanliness of the place was amazing. 
Our lovely butler Liliana went beyond my expectations with the bookings of restaurants and reserving the special activities for the kids that took place twice a day at the kid zone, to information about the things to do and places to go. Every day she made my girls feel extra special with little wooden Mexican toys left with a note on their bed, to the ballon bubblebaths waiting when we got in, and the cookies and milk on a nightly. She didn't forget about the adults either - champagne, fruit platter, chocolate treats were also a nice surprise. The whole family concierge staff is wonderful - always willing to assist when Liliana was off. 
Now onto the pool and beach - stunning! The pool staff is the best and i would like to thank Alex by the bali beds for such pampering and Hector who also gave outstanding service throughout the week. They never stop and work so hard to accommodate everyone. How can you not tip for fantastic service!? My recommendation is to rent a bali bed for at least one day out of your stay. Its worth every cent. 
The kid zone - my kids couldn't get enough time in there. The kid zone ladies are wonderful. To deal with so many kids and always have such energy and smiles on their faces was reassuring when your dropping off your kids. Thank you for doing such an amazing job. When my kids do not want to leave - i would have to say they are obviously doing an excrllent job entertaining. 
We loved the buffet! Plenty of variety for even the pickiest of kids. Ate well and never left dissatisfied. Naos is air conditioned to the max and is a bit frigid - please bring a light shawl, or jacket, to eat comfortably throughout dinner. Or you can request an outdoor table and enjoy the ocean breeze which we did. 
Overall this resort is luxury and a dream vacation destination. 

We will be back next year! 

Thank you Paradisus for an unforgettable vacation.

reviews.author: Luciane R
reviews.title: Family and friends vacation
reviews.text:
The hotel it was great, very clean, beautiful, the sushi bar it was unbelievable, some of those people was very friendly. Francisco from the pool bar, Hernesto from de pool entertainment he was great, Guilhermo from Market grill, Leticia and her friend that worked at the hotel for 20 years those people it will be in our heart. 
Very disappointed with the restaurant reservation, I did reservation on Fuego day before we left to celebrate my two son's birthday and asked for a cake and they didn't do anything, We were waiting and waiting and nothing, I left very sad.

reviews.author: bonnievv07
reviews.title: Beautiful ocean view and great staff!
reviews.text: We spent a week at paradisus cancun from sept 10-16 for my birthday, it was a beautiful resort. We were expecting a lot from the resort since the year prior we stayed at the paradisus la perla in playa del Carmen which was OUTSTANDING but this resort was also good. The Staff was exceptional we especially bonded well with Abraham, Moses, and Pablo from the Naos buffet, those three men were such a pleasure to have as our waiters, they made us feel so welcomed and have such great personalities!! If anyone goes to the buffet request these guys as your server and you will not be disappointed. Andres from Nescaffe was awesome as well. Overall the trip was great, we had the ocean view in the third pyramid and the view was spectacular. We took our one year old with us and he absolutely loved the baby zone with all the toys the staff in the baby zone were exceptional as well.
