The staff is the reason this resort is so awesome to go to. We tipped as much as we could since the staff make you feel like royalty. We noticed a lot of people not tipping which was sad how could you not tip exceptional service! Stop being cheap and tip the people that are going above and beyond for you!!! I would recommend this resort the views alone are gorgeous!

reviews.author: Gramps76
reviews.title: Greater than good!
reviews.text: Room 4508 has an unbeatable view over the lagoon. It has all we need. Our butler Antonio caters for our every wish...a pleasant and intelligent man (I think we may take him home with us!!). He reserves tables for dinner at the many & varied restaurants each night. Try a Balinese bed by the adult pool. Antonio will arrange that too (of course).

reviews.author: Jiggiddy
reviews.title: Friggin Awesome!
reviews.text:
We loved the Paradisus Cancun Resort! The staff culture of this resort is 5 Star, and everyone made us feel welcome from the reception desk to the Timeshare presentation, bartenders, restaurant staff, Pool Staff, House keepers. We never felt like we were treated badly at all. Before we came we read all of the reviews to know what we were in for, and I have to let you know if you are like me, and read reviews, the food is amazing! Don’t believe the bland comments. There are many restaurants to choose from and they’re all great, including the buffet. Everyone is helpful getting you booked, excursions, dinner reservations, directions, taxi, room service, where is this, where is that, the staff is amazing!
Check-in they offered us the royal service, which gives you access to the boring side of the resort for stuffy old people, 2 extra restaurants that looked snobby, and a small portion of the pool without kids. I would have only preferred the pool portion as I find that parents trying to teach their crying kids how to swim on my vacation is very tacky and needs to happen in a backyard somewhere, and not a resort. So the private pool would have been nice but not for an extra $45.00 per person, per day. Overall we chose to not upgrade to Royal service and didn’t regret that decision at all. This resort is freaking awesome already and Royal service wasn’t necessary in my view.
As an RCI member we were given an owners suite and it was beautiful, the staff recognized us the whole trip as owners, based on our wrist band, and treated us as such. Even outside of the resort, in town and excursions the locals recognized us as Club Melia and it made us feel special. Paradisus carries a big weight in town even the shuttle driver took us back first, to get a bigger tip.
FYI - Make sure you drink lots of water and electrolytes as my wife had heat exhaustion and almost had a stroke due to the heat and drinking alcohol with not enough water, drink lots of water & electrolytes. 

Pros -  Drinks are not watered down, Food at all restaurants is great and over abundant, Staff bends over backwards for you, room A/C works great, resort is beautiful, Staff is very professional, everyone speaks English, beach is super clean, Ocean is not cold at all, pool towels are big and fluffy, timeshare presentation wasn’t pushy and obnoxious, daily entertainment was good quality, housekeepers didn’t steal money left out on accident, they kept our room very clean and nice.

Cons – Hard to think of any but I have to be honest and subjective,  Humidity, The only A/C in the resort is in your room & restaurants, The currency exchange (Dollar for Peso) is lower in the resort than on the streets, shops in the resort don’t take dollars, the clothing gift shop ripped us off, energy drinks aren’t included in the “all-Inclusive”

reviews.author: Cathy A
reviews.title: Great service- not much for kids- food poor
reviews.text:
September 19, 2016
Hotel is great if you are traveling with out kids. 1st night the a/c was not working had 2 fans so around 11pm we finally was able to get a room change which the new room was much better. if your traveling with kids and longer than 3 night consider family concierge. 

Food horrible the restaurants were blah,  the buffet for dinner seems to serve the same thing every night. Breakfast and lunch ok....
ENSO - WAS THE BEST I AM NOT A SEAFOOD PERSON AND THEY MADE ME A FRIED RICE WITH NO SEAFOOD.

the market was ok id suggest arriving early we arrive at 9 and most of the meat was really rare.

didnt try blue agave and mole just seemed they were serving the same thing a nao, tacos, alot of seafood and weird tasting pastas.....room service is good hamburger & fries... 

desserts we good, ice cream vanilla and coconut yummy.

Service in every aspect of the resort was excellent aside from check in/ check out crew

The waitstaff/bartenders/room service all we super great!!

The restaurants are all about the same.. Tacos, Asian, sushi and buffet which serves about the same thing....
 
WHAT I DIDNT LIKE

Nothing to do for the kids, play area but not entertaining enough they pool area nothing fun to keep the kids entertained. I took him to the kids corner and both times the girls were sitting up front and letting the kids run free (indoor playground) not entertaining for them...pool side for kids very boring nothing to do.

 only 1 swim up bar. so bring lots of singles to tip that way you dont have to worry about fighting the swim up bar....take care of your waitstaff and they will take care of you.

Evening night show was not so great either.

This is a great place for older adults who are not looking to do much but relax and dont care about the food......

Beach was always cleaned and service was on point. jet ski you have to walk about 3 hotels down.

i dont think I would visit Paradisus Cancun again...For my family we need much for entertainment and stuff to do for kids.

They said ZUMBA at 10 am by the pool i waited from 9:45-10:30 and nobody appeared.

Spa - they rushed us around we werent allot to try the pool out.

reviews.author: Preeya M
reviews.title: Amazing!!
reviews.text: Manuel and Rafael at Ensõ are amazing!! They were so professional and fun. They helped explain the menu and suggested various dishes and drinks to try. The service here was super fast and the food was delicious!

reviews.author: NickiTocci
reviews.title: Romantic Trip for Two
reviews.text: Paradisus is an excellent and beautiful resort where you will not be let down. The service, food and amenities were all exclusive of a five star hotel. My husband and I traveled for a romantic getaway for 7 days 6 nights, everything we needed and wanted was here at paradisus. We had reservations for a Bali bed which was awesome for relaxing and taking in that sweet sun and sand. The pool and swim up bar was great, we met people from all over the world and made a lot of friends, had a great time! Everyone who worked at the Paradisus introduced themselves by their name and their title and was very accommodating to my husband and myself, and wanted us to have the best experience imaginable. We will gladly be making a return trip to Cancun and other Paradisus family resorts in the future.

reviews.author: Dany L
reviews.title: Great Hotel and Property.....Food Average.
reviews.text:
Just came back from Paradisus Cancun. Great hotel and staff was excellent. Best restaurants are Market Grill and Mole. Upgraded rooms are really worth it. Beach was incredible and very clean.

Only reason I am not giving it 5 stars is the buffet food is always cold. You need to get it warmed up by the grill cooks. For a resort this size I expected more from the buffet.

reviews.author: Sandi G
reviews.title: Great relaxing vacation
reviews.text: Spent 6 days at Paradisus in a junior suite ocean view room.  Excellent service by all..no issues with check in.  The spa was excellent...recommend massage.  All of the restaurants were good..bana,mole,Enzo and the market grill.  The servers Marco and Gaudenico were fabulous..always had a smile on their faces.  The beach and pools were the best part of the trip.  We will be back soon!!

reviews.author: Briana K
reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text: I would go there all the time if possible, everyone is so nice and the place is beyond beautiful. I didn't not wanna leave I was so comfortable and having so much fun. It was one of the best trips I have ever taken

reviews.author: Babs C
reviews.title: Relaxing in paradisus!
reviews.text:
Such an amazing time... Im here on my last night wishing I could have just one more!! All inclusive at paradisus is so worth it! 
It is such a relaxing worry free place. This is what a vacation everyone needs to experience in their life... I have more videos than pictures cause there is so much beauty all around that a picture alone cant capture! The service is amazing! Very friendly workers with big welcoming smiles!  Definitely recommend!!!

reviews.author: foxymifflin
reviews.title: Average hotel not average price
reviews.text: Hotel is dated, poor staff work hard but very understaffed great spa. I won't recommend Royal service it's not worth the money . Average hotel for an expense price. Sushi restaurant was great and room service food was good!

reviews.author: Croix K
reviews.title: Beautiful property, amazing resort, and wonderful staff
reviews.text: The building and property were amazing, and out of all the hotels on the strip, it really looked distinct and unique  The atrium was breathtaking!  The food was great at each restaurant.  The breakfast/lunch/dinner buffet had anything and everything you could imagine, and it was always up and running at a restaurant called Naos.  By far one of the best things on our vacation was breakfast each day with our waiter GAUDENCIO!!!  After the first day we requested to be seated with him everyday!  He was THE BEST!  He was so kind, pleasant, so attentive, and just went consistently above and beyond every step of the way.  He was so good to our daughter, and made her feel like a princess.  Gaudencio started our mornings with a smile that lasted the whole day.  If you ever visit, just trust me, ask for Gaudencio, and you will be very happy you did!  Thank you Gaudencio for making each day special for our family! :-)

reviews.author: Carla W
reviews.title: A great stay for every member of the family
reviews.text: This is the 3rd time we book at Paradisus .. You get great offers the beach area is clean and beautiful next to the hotel theres a mc donalds plus other great Restaurants also aquaworls where you can book water activities ...The Resort is huge and has so many details the staff is good the Housekeeping ok ..sometime a little bit  slow but ok you are in Mexico so you wont regret it....

reviews.author: YogiTiggerPolo
reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: Our favorite resort in Cancun!  The Royal Service is outstanding as well as the huge beautiful beach!  It's a must go for anyone from couples to families! The grand pyramid is unbelievable at night as the center skylight changes color, the live vines stretch from ceiling to floor.  Water flows through the entire resort with Koi swimming.  The piano bar is a great place to hang out after dinner and relax with a cold drink!

reviews.author: Paisaman312
reviews.title: 6 couples trip
reviews.text: All inclusive is the way to go. Statehouse wasn't that great. I called in advance to have good mariachis and they cancelled my surprise at the last minute saying no mariachis were allowed in the property unless is something like a wedding.

reviews.author: Maggiecourt C
reviews.title: Purely a personal holiday
reviews.text:
Having been to this hotel last year which was amazing, so decided to go back this year which we booked in January, we chose Occean View room again, the room was very nice, but sadly some things were missing i.e bathrobes and slippers, after five days we finally got the bathrobes but no slippers, we also reported the missing balcony light to our Virgin Rep who told us it would be dealt with but sadly never did during our stay.
The pool area was always very clean as was the beach.
Could not fault the food at all, we only used Naos restruant as we knew the staff was always extremely friendly kind and always made you feel welcome, one in particular was Christian always on hand to help us.

reviews.author: John S
reviews.title: Second visit
reviews.text:
Great to return to our requested rooms. Special treat to meet Chef Ivan Gomez at Vento restaurant. Enjoyed his stories about the cheeses of Northern France with tastings of Comte and Morbiere. Mole is another favorite restaurant. Elegant Mexican Cuisine hosted by Daniel. 
Look forward to coming back!

reviews.author: cesars873
reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: Great hotel to vacation in and enjoy some relaxation.  The food is excellent  as is the rest of the services.  The staff are very polite and welcoming.  This hotel is perfectly located in front of the beach giving great panoramic view

reviews.author: Jim H
reviews.title: Restaurant Service
reviews.text: Our server, Gaudencio, during our stay was fabulous at the Market Grill was fabulous.  He did an exceptional job and entertained our 1 year old grandson beyond belief.  Kudos to him.  You should be proud of him.

reviews.author: 381deirdree
reviews.title: Hotel stay
reviews.text: Good friendly employee nice weather,,drinks wel well beach was clean and nice,,,weather was great shows were nice,, view was beautiful make more television programs in English everyone doesn't  t speak Spanish

reviews.author: MaryM480
reviews.title: Best Vacation Ever!
reviews.text:
It is honestly hard to think of ONE bad thing to say about this resort. We booked with Vacation Express/Nexus, and opted for the 'Royal Service.' I HIGHLY recommend the Royal Service. From the moment we got to the resort, which is only 15 minutes from the airport, they offered us cold towels, champagne, and drove us to our private check-in room. The check-in process took about 15 minutes where they explained what amenities we had, gave us a map of the resort and our wristbands and a cell phone to call our butler on, and introduced us to our butler, Gerardo, who showed us to our room. Our room, a Junior Suite with an Ocean View, was in a great location in Tower 4. We had a welcome fruit tray, 4 bottles of liquor, and our fridge was fully stocked with beer, soda, water, and snacks (which they restocked everyday). They also provide a beach bag with towels to take to the beach everyday. The AC worked well in our room, and so did the shower. After that, we went exploring around the resort.

THE FOOD: Everything we had to eat was amazing. I am a very picky person, and I found something I liked at every restaurant we went to. I do recommend Vento, Market Grill, Blue Agave, and La Palapa (which is only for Royal Service guests.) We went to breakfast at La Palapa every morning because it was right on the beach, and not crowded. We got fresh fruit, omelets, hash browns, coffee, and mimosas pretty much every morning. We had 24 hour room service, that we only used the last morning, and it came right on time and was very good. Everyday for lunch, we either walked up to La Palapa, or we just ordered food directly from the beach from our waiter. We especially loved Eddie (both of them), Rafael, and Octavio.

THE DRINKS: Literally any drink you can think of, they have. All the drinks were strong, and delicious. We had pina coldas, beer, champagne, frozen coffee, etc. on the beach every day. There was also a little coffee bar we would go to in the afternoons to get a latte. There was a bar, Avenue Bar, right around the corner from our room that we could go to each night to get whatever we wanted.

THE BEACH/POOL: The beach is absolutely beautiful. We stayed on the beach under our umbrellas all day, every day.The waiters would come around from 11:00am-5:00pm, so you never had to get up if you didn't want to. The water was the clearest, blue water I have ever seen, and it wasn't too cold either. There are people selling things on the beach all day everyday, but you just kindly tell them "No," and they leave you alone. Since we had the Royal Service, we had our own private section of the beach which was never crowded and always quiet and relaxing. We only went to the pool for about 30 minutes at the end of each day, but it was quiet and warm and large. There are beds you can reserve each day by the pool, too... where you have a waiter and they have sunscreen and towels each day for you.

Maybe the only cons I can think of, was the room numbers were a little confusing, so we got lost the first night getting back to our room. And, the gift shop is SO expensive. My beach sandals broke the first day, so I bought a new pair(a cheap plastic pair that said "Cancun") and some sunscreen and it was $55.00 USD!!

I would recommend this resort to ANYONE! It was the most amazing trip, and we are definitely coming back. We did not have to lift a finger the whole trip, and they really think of everything! All the employees speak English and are so friendly and accommodating. A special thanks to our butler, Gerardo, who made everything so easy and relaxing. He sent us something special to our room each evening, and made all of our dinner reservations. 6 nights was not enough! :)

reviews.author: jordanm782
reviews.title: They don't wash plastic cups
reviews.text:
The worst part of the hotel and most disturbing is their lack of washing for all of their plastic cups that they use for the pool and beach area. 

At multiple bars on the property I watched bartenders simply take dirty cups and rinse them off in a hand sink with no soap or bleach solution and promptly put them back on the counter for use. It makes sense now why so many glasses had lipstick on them

I even had a shot glasses given to our party that still had creamy Bailey Irish cream type liquid all over the glass

I loved the property but when I am drinking out of a community cup everyday that makes me sick to my stomach

reviews.author: 429nanm
reviews.title: All Inclusive?
reviews.text: Although the drinks and food were at no extra charge, they were not readily available.  Restaurants, other than the buffet, required advance, not same-day, reservations.  Available bars during the day were few and far between - unless you were a high-ranked loyalty member.  The coffee shop wasn't even open until 10 AM!

reviews.author: Amcwilcoxstl
reviews.title: Truly Paradise!
reviews.text:
Service is the first word that comes to mind to describe our stay at Paradisus!  This resort is lovely.  

The atrium plants are fabulous, although in mid-day it is quite warm in the main areas of the buildings because of the glass atrium roofs.

reviews.author: Nestor Carlos
reviews.title: Did not feel the Paradisus Experience
reviews.text: I was not offered water at check in, check in experience took 30 minutes.  I pre paid my reservation and I was told it wasn't and wanted a credit card so I can get a band.  I was located on Tower 5 Royal service.  The elevator floor was cracked, the same as the 4th floor. In addition to this, someone hang the Do not disturb outside my door and we did not get cleaning towels, shower caps, soap and shampoo on 2 nights.

reviews.author: boozeman387
reviews.title: Absolutely fabulous
reviews.text: Stayed at the paradisus royalty service section and have only positive things to say. The service was absolutely fabulous and the staff was ridiculously attentive to our every need. Our concierge (Rosanna) was gracious and attentive, helping us with among many things, reservations to dinner at the hotels many restaurants of which none were a disappointment as every meal was deliciously prepared. The pool area was quiet and our waiter (Jorge Mata) always made sure our drinks were refreshed. The highlight of our stay was when Rosanna arranged for my partner to meet with the marine biologist (Elizabeth) on staff to rescue baby seaturtles that hatch at the property and are released into the sea. We vow to return to the paradisus again for a longer stay next time.... It is truly paradise !

reviews.author: Jon C
reviews.title: Simply amazing!
reviews.text: We were at this resort when it was Gran Melia. Back then, the beach area was not as beautiful as today. The resort was immaculate! They have preserved the charm of the whole resort and more! The best Cancun week by far...

reviews.author: A_Southernbelle
reviews.title: Great place!
reviews.text: Great resort! Royal service is the way to go, the butler service is amazing with this option. The food is average but you have plenty of options so you won't be disappointed. The Bali beds are great, very comfortable. We will be back!!

reviews.author: Patrick G
reviews.title: Nice Hotel.. exceptional service
reviews.text: I stayed at this hotel Sept. 3-10 2016. I have been a guest at this hotel at least 20 times. The service is what sets this hotel apart. My beach and pool waiters were exceptional. Luis, Leticia, Asuncion and Flor made this visit extraordinary. The property and pool are absolutely clean and well maintained. My complaints: The hotel BLASTS music out on the enormous beach at such volume that it is impossible to get away from the constant THUMP of the bass. NOT EVERYONE wants to be assaulted by this NOISE. The pool has nice pop music at nice volume. My towels at the Melia Club condo were thin and worn out.. FIX THE BEACH MUSIC.. PLEASE

reviews.author: CroquetaLife
reviews.title: Amazing Experience!!
reviews.text: We stayed 7 days on the Royal Service side and I would 100% recoomend this hotel to anyone. The food was pretty good (I ATE A LOT) in all the restaurants. The service is what really made this hotel stand out, everywhere we went we were treated very nice. If you go to La Palapa you have to say hi to Cesar and Jorge for me...(saludos de los Cubanos). Food was great, Service was great, the Hotel is beautiful. I would deft go back!!

reviews.author: Dolly G
reviews.title: Royal Service at Paradisus Cancun is awesome!
reviews.text:
We visited Cancun for 5 days for leisure this month. We stayed at Paradisus Cancun with its Royal Service (Adults only). The hotel is beautiful and simply gorgeous. The beach is lovely but unfortunately during our stay there were high tides so couldn't enjoy it much. But the hotel pool makes it up for that! 

We enjoyed the Royal Service and our butler was Susana who did a great job in pampering us! The staff was helpful and very warm. Our vacation was overall great and we would definitely visit Paradisus again!

Only drawback: My husband and I are vegetarians. There are many restaurants here but they didn't have much veggie choices to eat.

reviews.author: Kym D
reviews.title: "Beautiful Amazing Peaceful  Resort"
reviews.text: My daughter and I stayed at this resort, and we had a wonderful time. Royal service was "Superb"! Maricio went above and beyond to make sure we had everything that we needed. The pool and beach was very beautiful . The beach had no rocks, beautiful white sand.  Eddie and Daniel from the pool staff, took "excellent" care of my daughter and I, both men had a very beautiful heart warming smile ,upon greeting us everyday. Eddie, somehow, always knew that we needed our drinks refreshed, without us having to ask . Daniel made sure that we had a bed and our dinner reservations were correct each night. All of the restaurants served excellent food & excellent service, Marco at the buffet was so sweet, funny and very professional, Ruben & Mirian from the Vento resturant, treated us as if we were very special guest. Our room was very nice, quiet, and greatly appreciate the maid for cleaning it and turning down bed service every night. The private balcony and lagoon view was beautiful. The entertainment was "WOW" Excellent dancers".!! I can't say enough about this hotel. It was very peaceful and beautiful,inside and out. I have told All of my friends to choose this hotel for future bookings.  Thank you All for a 5 star + service. Eddie was one of the highlights of our trip. We will definitely return.

reviews.author: neverhomebrooklyn
reviews.title: Would choose another next time.
reviews.text:
I came with 2 young kids, ages 7 and 9 and had at best an average vacation.

Pros: 
Food is excellent. Plenty of variety and very friendly waiters. Con: You will need to reserve an evening restaurant each day and can reserve for next day as well. But good luck getting a time slot that you want. 

Pools are in good condition. Beach areas are very clean and lifeguards are available as the waves get very rough most days. Enough showers and beds/chairs to find one easily.

Gym is good size and enough equipment including treadmills and ellipticals to have a productive workout and is open 24/hr a day.

Cons: 
Weak kids program - geared for younger kds up to age 7. Kids are not separated by group. Some activities require sign up ahead of time and if the sign up didn't happen, then the child will be turned away.

Entertainment sucks -  Just not enough entertainment options throughout the day. The programs that are there are pretty weak and not of an interesting variety and can best be described as amateurish. Several times I came over and found out that the program was cancelled with no prior notice or explanation.
 Normally I like a nice 1 hour production show for the evening program, but what you get a 45 min at best of a fairly weak caliber. The location of the program is a bit unreal. As they happen in the middle of a bar, and maybe a dozen lounge sofa / beds that fill up instantly. Most people just stand around or sit on a floor to get a good view. 

Map / signs around the resort are just terrible. The layout is very confusing and spread out (ex must go up, to go down)  and there is absolutely no signs, arrows, etc to know which way you are going. If they just put up some simple signs on the walls, that would have saved me so much wasted time.

Room has just 1 dresser, with a maximum capacity of 4 people. I had to get pretty creative to spread everyone's stuff out. Big turn off to use the tables to host my socks.

Overall, for the amount of money I paid in off season, I would expect a way better experience, and would choose a different hotel if I could do it again.

Whatever hotel you choose, make sure you go to the local theme park call XCaret, it's pricey but the experience is very unique.

reviews.author: Gerald T
reviews.title: The best for less
reviews.text: This hotel is unbelievable in all the inclusions and amenities. Many great restaurants and the pool/ocean are only steps from each other. Beach is easily one of the three best on the strip. We have been to the Paradisus 6 times. There is a readon for that.

reviews.author: nkambho
reviews.title: 10-year Wedding Anniversary!
reviews.text:
Overall, we had a fantastic trip. 
Restaurants were good, but some of the food could have been better.  The cheese used on some of the pizza didn’t taste the greatest, smelt/tasted kind of old. However, we ate at Enso and Market Grill for dinner which was great (highly recommend them), and Naos buffet was good on most days. Breakfast was good at Naos. Considering we are Canadian, we like our sushi a certain way-cold. Unfortunately, Bana’s sushi was a little warm when delivered (even the sashimi), but at least the service was great and fun. Drinks were spot on each time no matter where you grabbed them (that’s alcoholic and non-alcoholic). All premium.
The staff were great and very respectful and always had a smile on their faces while they greeted us each time.  
There were 7 of us in total (3 adults, 2 children, and 2 teenagers) on this trip. The rooms were good, clean, and spacious. We stayed in Pyramid 3 on the 7th floor Ocean view (the only way to go). Yes it was a bit noisy because of the shows at night in the hotel but you would be too tired (or drunk) to really let it affect you. Also it is the closest to everything else in the hotel. Staying at any of the other pyramids would have just have been extra walking around you didn’t need.  
The swim up bar and pool area were great. They even let our 3-year old sit there while they made him milkshakes. The beach was fantastic. Sand was incredible and so was the ocean. We travelled Aug 19-27, 2016. Weather was fantastic every day.
And finally our professional photos. What an incredible experience. Our Photography was done by Santiago Gabay photography. We chose to hire him instead of using the resort photography because of the price difference (significant savings). I received my photos weeks ago and they are fantastic. The quality is perfect. He was very professional, even with his communication with us overseas, to arriving at the hotel, the photoshoot, and post photoshoot communication. Top marks. He was very patient with us even though my family was 30 minutes late and my son kept crying during most of the photoshoot (tip of the day make sure all kids have eaten prior and have something to drink during the photoshoot). We are very pleased with his work and it was the best decision we made. We have already referred him to our friends for their wedding next year. 
nkambho
Abbotsford, B.C., Canada

reviews.author: sanchez847
reviews.title: Paradisus- Royal Service Review
reviews.text: Overall I enjoyed my stay at Paradisus. I never had an experience like I did here. A few HUGE problems are that we where not made aware of what was included with our stay, like messages, the pager being extra and we can seem to never get our butler on the phone.

reviews.author: nking225
reviews.title: AMAZING RESORT
reviews.text: This place has everything you could think of having. The beach is amazing and it gets better when you upgrade to the Royal Service.....because you get exactly what its called "ROYAL SERVICE. There are soooo many restaurants and activities to choose from. The YHI Spa is something out of this world. The food in any of the restaurants was AWESOME....I will definitely be a repeat visitor.

reviews.author: bette227
reviews.title: Fabulous place to stay for a great, relaxing vacation
reviews.text: We went with 6 people and had 3 rooms. Each room had a bedroom, sitting room with small kitchenette and 2 high end bathrooms.  There were about 10+ restaurants to eat at so we tried as many as we could. You do have to make reservations, especially at the Japanese restaurant.  No problems at any others.  The food was wonderful everywhere.  Since this was all inclusive, we left tips at each meal and they did remember us!  Entertainment every night at 8:30 or so and bars stayed open afterwards.  There was one bar area outside that 4 of us could go but the other 2 could not..unsure why.  Pool is too deep.. it should be a foot or 2 lower to walk around, otherwise you had to swim and could not touch bottom.  Awesome place

reviews.author: chelsea1991
reviews.title: Birthday Getaway
reviews.text: A friend and I came to the Paradisus for our birthdays last week, and we couldn't have been any more pleased. We had read of some good and bad reviews, but decided to check it out, and we were not disappointed. The food was excellent at each of the restaurants we ate at, and the customer service was absolutely wonderful. Our server, Antonio, at the breakfast buffet was the most sweetest guy ever; we sat in his section every morning. He knew we were there for our birthdays and rounded up an entire group of other waiters to come and sing to us. He even brought us a cake to share. The beach was absolutely gorgeous; very big with no rocks and very little seaweed. The pool area was very nice and clean as well, and the pool waiters were always very accommodating. The hotel grounds were wonderful and it was not a long walk to explore the property, as it was very well set up. Although, we didn't spend much time in the room, it was still very nice. We were on the bottom floor, and it was sort of awkward to get to because it was right off the main pyramid, but we had no complaints. Overall, this hotel was immaculate and we would definitely return!

reviews.author: Diana D
reviews.title: Terrible Experience!
reviews.text: My family and I ran into multiple issues with room 3501. We had to go to the concierge at least 1-2 times a day (we stayed 5 nights) to get our room cards re-keyed. They said it was because we held it close to our phones and tech devices. That was proven not to be true. They key would work as soon as they were re-keyed but within 1-2 hours of sitting at table near NO tech devices, it would not read. The concierge was aware and had sent someone to check but it continued to be an issue throughout our trip. (This was very annoying having to visit the concierge twice a day.) The last night we were here, a terrible accident happened where the restroom mirror in our room fell over on my dad. Luckily he caught it and held it so it wouldn't fall on his feet. There were shattered glass everywhere! I dialed "0" the concierge and explained the situation, and stressed that someone needs to go to our room immediately as my dad was still holding the glass mirror! I called twice and waited in the hallway for just anyone to come by and saw no one. I was getting anxious and scared since I didn't know if my dad was hurt or cut in anyway, so I went down 4 floors to the concierge. I was very upset then, since no one still had come up and it took faster for me to go to them then to us. I had to explain how serious this situation was so the girl at the front called someone to make sure someone came by. This could have been fatal if my dad had not caught the mirror. This is very disappointing coming from a 4.5 star hotel. There was no sense of urgency! All in all, the way the hotel handled the situation ruined my perception of the Paradisus Hotel.

reviews.author: ChasE1988
reviews.title: Best resort I've ever stayed in!!
reviews.text: I love this place. It's breathtaking... We stayed at the royal service secrecy at recieved an amazing butler!! Rosanna I wish we could have taken her with us. She made our dinner reservations every night and ensured we had an amazing anniversary!! The beach is perfection and so is the swim up pool. Every single restaurant we ate at was amazing with five star quality and I can not forget about the live mariachi band!! I will return!!

reviews.author: Andrew Bloch
reviews.title: Don't be fooled by the nice photos on the website!
reviews.text:
The website looks lovely.  When you walk in, the reception is pretty cool.  A bit dark, but nice and modern and a lively atmosphere.  From there on in, that's where the positives end.  I checked in with my family for what was due to be a one week stay.  I'd stayed at lots of Melia hotels in Spain and they have always been great.  This one, however, was nothing short of a disgrace.

The check in process took over an hour - two different receptions, numerous forms to fill out, wrist bands, voucher books, a phone to reach your butler...it went on and on, to the point where I had lost the will to live.

 Eventually, we got to the room - a family suite, and apparently the best room in the hotel.  What a dump.  Old fashioned, basic, dirty, no storage, a balcony with high concrete walls you couldn't see over.  The photos on their website must have been twenty years old. It was like looking at a different hotel (it wasn't...I double-checked!)

By this point, we were tired and hungry, so we left the bags in the room without unpacking and went downstairs to get something to eat.  The buffet was a health hazard.  Food and mess everywhere.  No one to show you to your table, no waiters.  The food was inedible. It was like being in a prison canteen. 

With that, I had seen all I needed to see.  After spending literally a couple of hours at the hotel (mainly at the check-in desk!) we told the reception we would like to check out.  He implied that he wasn't surprised and he would arrange a full refund via our travel agent the next day (we paid in advance).  We left and booked into a different hotel.

Needless to say, no one contacted our travel agent, and nearly three weeks later and after numerous unanswered  phone calls and emails, we are still trying to get our money back.  

A very disappointing experience.  

There are lots of nice hotels in Cancun.  The Paradisus isn't one of them.

reviews.author: monicaandfamily
reviews.title: It could be excellent, but it's not
reviews.text: I arrived Sept 6 and I'm still here now. Check in was easy for us. Hotel is beautiful. Rooms have mold or mildew though. I wake h every morning with swollen eyes. I am taking allergy pills and using a rolled up towel for pillow. Restaurants are meh. Been to most, market grill was our favorite, we would not go back to the others. The buffet is a normal all inclusive one so that's ok. Yesterday I stepped on glass in the pool, they offered to call a doctor but politely refused to help me. I needed tweezers to pull it out. So we grabbed our 1 yr old and packed our stuff and I hopped to the room to get my tweezers. That was pretty annoying. I didn't see them using a pool vacuum to make sure everything was cleaned up. Chicken wings at the snack bar were raw one day. They did grab my plate and run back to the snack bar to make sure  the rest were cooked. Thank goodness I bit it and not my toddler. This is my 5 Th trip to Mexico and we will not be back here. They are so close to being excellent and could be, but aren't. In one of their gourmet restaurants they bread a lamb chop, deep fry it and call that a tapa. Smh...............

reviews.author: oscarfurfaro
reviews.title: Poor customer service
reviews.text: The hotel positions itself a a 5 star resort, but fails do resolve a most simple problem. We have been loyal customers of Paradisus brand for 5 years now, always choose them over another hotel in the Caribbean. Now will have to reconsider, and because of an stupid ignorance on behalf of the superwiser. We had an airport transfer booked to pick us up after the checkout and bring us to the airport. We came down at 10am, as we were told and stood by the door with our 3 carry-on luggages. Came over the bellboy, telling us to put our luggage into storage and go sit in the lobby area to be called when transfer arrives (pointed out exactly where). We tried to protest: the luggage was more then manageable and we had no problem waiting by the door. Apparently that was not an option, so we went. Half an hour later I got alarmed, no transfer. Went to the concierge to inquire - they seemed absolutely indifferent, put me the transportation company on the phone, where I was told: the driver came at 10.05, bell boy told him no ones here to be picked up and the driver left. And that now we need to take a taxi on our own. I went to the check-in stand, explained the situation. They went to look for someone in charge. The manager came out saying that the bellboy looked for us and could not find us! We were the only family leaving at that moment, where was he looking?! We said that no one came looking, however the manager made it clear - if her employee said so - that has to be the truth, no matter what we were saying. I asked if there is a car who can take us to the airport. Apparently, the huge resort as they are has no transportation, at all. And after we have prepaid the transfer we now have to take the taxi. I told them it was their fault we were not picked up so they have to find the solution. The manager, Guadalupe, was absolutely indifferent and at times plain rude. We were late for the flight, so we took a taxi and with that left. I understand that problems do happen, but resolve them as a high class resort you pretend to be when you solicit to become a club member. That was not a solution.

reviews.author: Worldtrekker7777777
reviews.title: Did not meet expectations
reviews.text:
This was our 6th trip to Mexico and we chose to stay at this resort after having stayed at the Paradisus La Perla in Playa del Carmen a few years ago. No complaints with that resort. We expected a similar experience but we're quite disappointed. We were celebrating an anniversary and took our 2 year old son and my wife's parents for their 1st Mexican vacation. We booked 2 ocean view Jr. Suites for an 7 night stay.
Check-in: arrived around 11:30am, waited in a long line, and ultimately were told that we could return by 2pm to have our rooms ready. Also there was an error with one of the bookings with double beds vs a king bed. Upon return, were told that the rooms would be ready in approximately a half hour. Returned within the half hour and were told the rooms would be ready within 10 minutes. No drinks were offered during this time (as they were during our Paradisus La Perla check in).
   Upon arrival to the rooms my wife's parents' room was decorated with balloons and our room was not. They did not decorate the correct room for our anniversary even though we had this listed in our booking (this continued for a few days). Our mini fridge was not working properly and we also requested additional pillows. We tipped the bellman and he said that he would have the fridge repaired and he would send pillows. No pillows and no repair. After going out to the balcony, I couldn't get back into the room because there was no handle on the outside of the sliding door, only 2 small drilled holes with jagged edges. Called maintenance regarding this and the fridge. They repaired the fridge but stated that there were no handles on the outside of the balcony doors. Upon asking how to get back into the room, the maintenance person pressed his hands against the glass and struggled to open the door.
   After a few days of this disappointment, went to the concierge and expressed all of our concerns and even showed him a picture of the balcony door with the drilled holes. We asked if we could be upgraded to Family Concierge in light of these circumstances. He apologized, agreed that the door needed to be repaired, and said that he would speak with his supervisor. When we followed up with this same person, he said that maintenance said that the door was okay as they don't have handles. Even concierge expressed confusion regarding this. As for the upgrade, we were upgraded to Family Concierge services EXCEPT, no butler and no room upgrade (these were the primary highlights of Family Concierege). This individual was polite and friendly but he could only offer what his supervisor granted.
   Had a leak in our bathroom ceiling one evening around 9:30pm. Called maintenance and someone came in approximately 25 minutes. He repaired the leak and put a dirty towel down to soak up the remaining drips that he said would stop in a few minutes. He left debris on the floor and in the bathtub. My wife called and had a cleaning person come to clean it up.
   Lots of disappointments. Still can't believe the balcony door issue and no repair. The positives... Jared in Concierge was very friendly. Fuego food, staff, and service was great. When we discussed our previous positive experiences from Paradisus La Perla with one of the staff of Paradisus Cancun, he informed us that even though these were both Melia resorts, they were quite different in what they offered. Chose this resort because of the previous Melia/Paradisus experience, but this resort did not live up to expectations.

reviews.author: TravelllerLaddy
reviews.title: Fanstastic hotel - for all types of people.
reviews.text:
Fantastic hotel - great facilities, staff, food and drink.

Went above an beyond on all occasions.

Standard of food and drink was great - Even the buffet restaurants.

Staff were very fun and friendly - always wanting to give a great service.

Great entertainment that I was not expecting - even in the day time around the pool.

Already wanting to go back1

reviews.author: yasminm767
reviews.title: great service, excellent hotel
reviews.text: Will recommend this hotel any day.  The staff were welcoming and helpful.  Great value for your money. No request was too much trouble for the staff.  They took care of us with a smile, any time, day or night.

reviews.author: Punty01
reviews.title: Wonderful trip  recommend to anyone
reviews.text: First of all we travel frequently and we were here sept 3-9 2016.check in was quick . We arrived at 12:30 and room was ready. The staff went above and beyond to make sure we had everything.i recommend  ocean view. Our butler Nettal made sure we had everything you could ask for. Had chocolate on bed every evening , different animal design from towels daily. Room are very cold and beds are comfortable. A little humid in lobby area but thats Mexico. This place is beautiful and we WILL be back with our big family of 16 next July and we will stay here. The food is wonderful we had nothing bad at all. Top shelf liquor . At La Palapas Cesartaught us about tequila and was wonderful and made the best drinks you could imagine. By the 3 rd day. The bartenders knew our name and when they saw us coming would have us a drink in hand. Even our teenager would have a different virgin drink ready for her. You have such a wonderful selection of restaurants 13 . The beach is to die for and NO seaweed. The water was very cool perfect for the hot sun. The ocean wAterwas cooler than the pool it the pool was very clean. We stayed at beach.you must try MOLE restaurant was outstanding. And the steak house is beyond.delicious  .remember tot housekeeping they go above and beyond and get very little money.the bus to town is right I front of resort1.00 to ride and just tell driver where you are going and very safe.go at least one night to town to see the light and all the different things to do.definetly do SenorFrogs  never a dull moment and is kid friendly before 10 ish. If you go to the market you can get excursions very cheap . We went on two that at resort the price was 75.00 and 105.00 and we paid 80.00 for both excursions at the market. Well worth a visit. WE LOVE THIS RESORT.

reviews.author: ichim172
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text:
This is second time to visit Cancun. The last time, I stayed The Royal in Cancun (now Hyatt Zilara) for honeymoon. This time, I took my 16mos old kid.
This hotel is very kid-friendly. Baby club's staffs are all awesome and babysitter is very professional as well. 
Room is little bit old, but well maintained. 
Restaurants are good. I recommend Mole. Service is very professional and friendly and Mexican cuisine here is very good. I also like breakfast at Naos. All waiting persons are looking at us well. 
Family pool has plenty space and very comfortable pool side chairs with roof. My kid really like this place. Pool bar waiting persons are very friendly.

reviews.author: Barbara R.
reviews.title: Great hotel but not 5*
reviews.text:
We have spent 4 days at Paradisus Cancun in August 2016 and enjoyed our time. We hadn't initially planned on staying at this hotel but were rebooked from their partner hotel ME Cancun. We stayed at Royal Service, which is the adults only area.

We found the Hotel itself to be quite old, the rooms are oldfashioned, so is the pool area. They have refurbished parts of the inside including the Restaurants and it looked nice overall but not super impressive. Our butler was nice but we ended up not asking him for much help except to make dinner reservations.

The food at the hotel i believe is exceptionally good except that it's mostly cold. Most of the times we had breakfast at the Royal Service buffet, which has limited choices but less people. The Restaurants in the evenings were very good and the selection of alcohol was great too.However, the best thing about this hotel by far is its employees, we have not met one single person there that wasn't friendly and helpful, 

As we had initially booked a room at ME Cancun, we were a little disappointed by the non-existing nightlife at this Hotel. It would've been nice to have a drink outside at the beach bar but it was dead quiet and no music most of the time. In general it would've been nice if there were more outside options but it doesn't seem to be a big thing in Cancun, most things happen inside (Restaurants, bars, Clubs), which we found quite strange coming from Europe where everthing happens outside for those few summer months.

If we ever come back to Cancun, I believe we would stay a bit closer to town at a more modern Hotel and I guess the ME Cancun would've suited us better.

reviews.author: Gen G
reviews.title: Pros and Cons of Paradisus
reviews.text:
Pros & Cons to Paradisus Cancun Resort
Pros:
•	The resort is beautifully constructed and decorated 
•	The staff are friendly and super polite
•	The staff definitely try to get you to drink as much alcohol as possible
•	There was an Amstar desk in the resort to schedule excursions through
•	The sand is white and the ocean is clear turquoise blue
•	There was a “Family Concierge” person upon check in that explained how the resorts work
•	Room service was free
•	Top shelf liquor selection included 
Cons:
•	It is extremely humid inside the resort. There are a ton of plants and fountains with a glass pyramid ceiling, which, with the lack of air conditioning, creates a greenhouse effect. Bad hair day every day.
•	The bars or lounges were sooooo humid, we could not stand being in them to drink. We spent most of our nights in our room where there was air conditioning. 
•	We paid for a Junior Suite with Lagoon View room. All that could be seen from the window was a building. When we complained, they said if we go out on the porch and peek around the corner, we can see the lagoon.
•	Don’t go expecting not to bring additional money. Everywhere you try to sit outside costs additional money. We finally gave in one day and paid for the cabana. It normally cost $140 USD for the day, but they cut us a deal for $80 and threw in a free bottle of tequila as a present.  The waiter brought us drinks and food all day which was pleasant. I don’t usually drink alcohol, so my tolerance is low. I had 7 double shot pina coladas and was not even buzzed at all.
•	We were on floor 0 of pyramid 4. The corridor right outside our room was set up for breakfast and cocktails for people with special gold bands. We were not allowed to partake. The annoying part was that it woke me up at 6:30 every morning when they were setting up breakfast and then there were constantly people congregating outside our room door.
•	All of the restaurants, except two, within the resort require reservations that have to be made a day in advance. So upon arrival, you have the choice between sweating in a taco restaurant called Blue Agave that is super humid, but yummy, or a buffet restaurant called Naos, which wasn’t that great. Actually, I wasn’t overly impressed with the food at any of the restaurants.
•	The bed was hard
•	Being on floor 0, you cannot simply walk across all 5 pyramids in the resort across floor 0. We had to constantly walk up to floor one to cross over the restaurants and then back down to floor 0 again. 
•	We did a snorkeling excursion through Cancun Sailing to Isla Mujeres. It was fun, but all of the coral looked dead. The Amstar guy said we shouldn’t have booked it through Cheapcarribean.com when we booked our resort stay because it wasn’t the greatest snorkeling. What can I say, he was definitely right. Unfortunately, the excursions are non-refundable. I recommend waiting to book excursions until you get to the resort and can talk to the Amstar guys who are local rather than a customer service representative at cheapcarribean.com who doesn’t really know.

reviews.author: rogersprojectsol2016
reviews.title: Paradisus - Royal Service
reviews.text: Spent 10 days at this lovely resort, accommodation was lovely and included a large balcony with jacuzzi, room was kept very clean and turned down each night. We had treated ourselves to the Royal Service which I have to say didn't disappoint us and included an excellent butler service provided by a gentleman called Neftali. Dining out in each of the many restaurants was a joy and the service provided to us was very good at all times, our special thanks goes out to the waiter who looked after us every day whilst at the Royal Service beach, Gibran Adrian is a very friendly chap who obviously takes a lot of pride in the service he provides.

reviews.author: nma0911
reviews.title: Girls trip to Cancun!!!
reviews.text: We had an amazing girls trip to Cancun for Labor Day weekend. The Paradisus hotel is beautiful. We booked the adults only suite with Royal Service and were not disappointed. Our butler Rode made sure that we had everything we needed. The view was absolutely beautiful, and surprisingly for an all inclusive hotel, the food was great. The beach was clean, the pool was clean, the staff was friendly.. I have nothing bad to say about this resort. I will definitely return!!!

reviews.author: Deanna H
reviews.title: AWESOME
reviews.text: My husband and I have been to Cancun 3 times prior to our visit during the end of August. This our first time at Paradisus and I have to say we will not stay at another resort. Our butler Gerardo and he was so helpful and went out of his way to ensure we were more than happy. We had one hiccup during our stay. There was a leak in our ceiling during a pretty bad rain storm. The leak was quickly fixed and cleaned up. The next morning we noticed my husband's laundry was in the closet and completely soaked from the leak. We let Gerardo know and he took the clothes to get cleaned free of charge. We often ate lunch at La Palapa with Cesar. He made sure we had everything we could imagine and more. The at the La Palapa bar was outstanding. He went out of his way to teach us about the differences in tequila during and afternoon sun shower. Jorge was outstanding assisting us when we were in our bali beds. We had drinks before dinner every night at Blue Agave. The bartender made my husband a different Mezcal drink every night. He knew when we were coming and what my husband and I enjoyed drinking. Our favorite dinner was by far the sushi restaurant. Alejandro was our server at the restaurant. We asked him to just bring us what he would recommend. Well it was AWESOME! We cannot say enough great things about this resort and we can't wait to come back. My husband and I agree that Royal Service is the way to go but honestly if people complain we feel like it is not warranted. The resort and its staff go out of their way to assist you and are more than welcoming.

reviews.author: Betty H
reviews.title: paradise
reviews.text: This place is awesome. The food is good. you have 13 restaurants, coffee shops. the entertainment is Broadway style. The ambiance is romantic. You are in a garden of green.     The ocean view room is wonderful.

reviews.author: Laurie V
reviews.title: Best Place Paradisus
reviews.text: Paradisus La Perla was one of my favorite hotel/resort that I have ever stayed at specially in Cancun!! The pool was gorgeous! and i loved how the rooms went out to the pool. My friend and i would go out every morning and sit on our porch then jump right in would just lay out right there. The room service was awesome, andf the dinners there were sooo good. I cant wait to go back and take my kids. My experience there was sooo much fun and there was so much to do and the staff there was more then welcoming, they we so friendly and wanted to make sure i had an enjoyable time. It was a beautiful resort.

reviews.author: Adenir S
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Very friendly people. Clean, comfortable. It was a very relaxed week. If you are looking for a place to take a real rest go there. The only thing you need to do is sleep in a very comfortable bed, clean room, eat and drink around on very nice people.

reviews.author: Jon S
reviews.title: Another Home Run by Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: This was our 5th trip to Paradisus Cancun and once again they exceeded our expectations. The service staff was top notch and we again found the property, restaurants and amenities to be be more memorable and improved from our previous visits-all of which were very favorable. We would recommend Bana, Mole and their new offering, Enzo as must visit restaurants as each one was a hit with us and our friends. The service staff in Royal Service defines attentive and helpful-in particular,  Lazaro, Susanna and Sergio demonstrated the kind of service that other staffs should strive to attain. Lastly, we would note the exceptional efforts of Melina and Esther in the Romance Department. In sum, we have visited this property a number of times, will return soon and would recommend it HIGHLY to our friends and family.

reviews.author: travelqueen504
reviews.title: Paradise in Cancun
reviews.text: I had a girlfriends bday get away at the Paradisus in Jan 2016. I wanted to post this review months ago.  This place was awesome the experience was top notch including the service, staff, & beach. Ocean view a must!

reviews.author: MDtravel23
reviews.title: Okay, but not 5 stars
reviews.text:
We stayed for at Paradisus Cancun for wedding for one of our friends. Overall, the resort is nice with beautiful interiors and helpful people. Some of these are editorial comments, and might not apply to you:

1. I have celiac disease and ability to find gluten free food is of utmost importance. Most of the staff/servers were familiar with what we were talking about. At check-in, I was given a 'gluten allergy' card which every server recognized. They have gluten free pasta and pizza for room service for lunch and dinner, which tastes okay. Buffet is okay, with limited options. My husband who is not gluten free, was not impressed with food at the buffet - except for the desserts. Food was cold. I got corn tortilla quesadillas that were made on request during lunch or dinner and were good. The dine-in restaurants are only for dinner and have gluten free options, they were very good. The menu has some items marked as gluten free and vegetarian, however, the list, by no means, is inclusive. I talked to my server who was able to check with chef. Overall, happy that there were a few safe options, sad that dessert options were non-existent. 

2. Rooms were clean. But everything is old. You can see that most of the plumbing is super old and rusted. The first room we were given, had a non-working shower and a hole in the ceiling where there should be light. We requested to change the room and which they happily did for us. The next room was okay, but still with rusted shower. For some reason, there were instructions in both bathrooms about how to turn on the shower, which doesn't apply to that bathroom at all - weird. There is a bidet, if you want.

3. Housekeeping is nice. Employees are kind and professional. You need to know a few words of Spanish to get by. Restaurant/check-in/concierge people will speak English. 

4. Shows are okay. Seating is limited. 

5. Pools are kid friendly and have either a depth of 2.2 ft or 5.1-6 ft, from what I could notice. 

6. They are trying to make you signup for Melia rewards and want you to attend an early morning breakfast to tell you more about it. We don't travel much and were not very interested, but the concierge were persistent. Called us many times to remind us which was a turn off. I don't want to get up at 730 while on vacation for marketing breakfast!

Overall, nice hotel with not-the-best rooms or food (brownie points for being allergen friendly)

reviews.author: abc19abc
reviews.title: 25th anniversary trip
reviews.text: Paradisus is a awesome place    A shout out to concierge alexander Garcia and Abraham campa and jesus you all done a awesome job   We really enjoyed ourselves. We highly recommend this place    Food and service is great

reviews.author: Darlene C
reviews.title: Wonderful Experience, First-time Cancun tourist
reviews.text: This was our first trip to Cancun, and we definitely hit the jackpot with the choice of the Paradisus. We arrived at 3:00 AM, Labor Day week end, and the check in staff couldn't have been friendlier or more helpful.  We were surprised at what a gorgeous marble clad hotel this was. We were staying in a room with two double beds, and were delighted when we woke up to a stunning view the the Aqua ocean. Wow. We ordered room service for breakfast and it was 5 start service with a smile. The beach was clean and very very few birds, I believe due to it being spotless clean. Perhaps we were there a bit off-season and that could possibly contribute to our great experience.  We are already planning our return trip for next year.

reviews.author: Roberta G
reviews.title: Great week with the Family
reviews.text: Nine of us enjoyed a week at this resort. The service was impeccable even without a concierge. The food was average at the Asian restaurant but we enjoyed the buffet for breakfast, lunch and even a few dinners. But our meal at the Mexican restaurant, Mole was fabulous!

reviews.author: Roger L
reviews.title: Great vacation for family
reviews.text: We had a great time staying for four nights. The food was great and activities are plentiful.  Beach was close and beautiful as usual.  Most of the restaurants that we ate at has very high-quality food. Our kids also enjoyed the swimming pool and the kids pool very much.

reviews.author: renata2302
reviews.title: Great family hotel, amazing food and kids club!
reviews.text: The hotel was amazing and so much more then we expected! Both myself and my husband work in a 5 stars hotel and have very high standards. The service was impeccable, there were concierges and staff to guide you or answer any questions. Food was great in the buffet but also the A la carte restaurants. Although you need a reservation they were always available. Now my favorite part was the kids club ... Kids loved it so much (5 and 7 years old) that they wanted to stay with the kids club all day! They had different activities on the hour, from pirate's parties to make your own pizza lunches it was just great! Me and my husband had time for walks on the beach and dinners it was just amazing! I already recommended the hotel to many of my friends and we will make sure we come back!

reviews.author: Gary T
reviews.title: Excellent resort!
reviews.text: Despite a few glitches in reservations, the experience was very good. The price/value was good for us, as it is a beautiful place to stay. The personnel and service were excellent, the food was good, and the amenities were top notch.

reviews.author: Joel B
reviews.title: Not the greatest...OK resort with inadequate customer service
reviews.text:
Check in was frustrating...we booked a room for 3 people and requested 2 double beds. When we arrived, they said they don't have any double beds available, only 1 king and a pull out sofa bed. After 45min talking with a manager, they suddenly found a room with 2 double beds. The staff was extremely rude and only when the manager witnessed that not having the requested room was not an option did they say there was an appropriate room avaliable. 

When we entered the room, the fridge was not stocked nor were there any towels, robes, slippers or the usual items that are found in Paradisus resorts.

Then they lost the dress bag for my friends wedding dress. They did not offer any solutions just excuses that the person they need is at dinner or a friend of theirs says they delivered the bag when clearly it wasn't there. 

I like the chain of Paradisus but NOT this one in Cancun...very disappointing.

reviews.author: Lindaels
reviews.title: Loved our stay
reviews.text: We spent a wonderful week at the Paradisus Resort! The Resort itself was beautiful. The beach was picture perfect. The food was delicious and the service was fantastic. The drinks were also made well and plentiful. The pool bar was great especially Armando. Always service with a smile. We had a great Bartender in the evening, his name was Gibron. He was entertaining and inventive with his drinks. And treated our adult kids great!  We loved this resort and would definitely go back. Mostly do to the phenomenal service we received from everyone.

reviews.author: Diane H
reviews.title: Girl's Trip
reviews.text:
I just left Paradisus Cancun and it was a great experience. Last year I stayed at Paradisus La Perla in Playa del Carmen and had a great experience. So we did not hesitate when our agent recommended the Cancun resort. 

Both trips we had the Royal Service. The Royal side of the resort was gorgeous and quiet. Truly gave you the feeling of being away and relaxed. Rode was our Butler this past weekend and he provided great Customer Service. He made dinner reservations for us so that we didn't have to worry about figuring that out. He decorated our rooms for our birthdays (3 of us have Sept birthdays) which was special for 2 of the ladies who had never been to an all inclusive. Even if you don't feel you need a Butler  (we barely utilized all that he could do) I do recommend Royal Service as it is worth it. Even our Butler Armando from La Perla was amazing last year. It just gives you a true feel for great customer service. 

The food was amazing! We ate at Enso, Market Grill and Fuego. We also ate at La Palapas for breakfast every morning. For an all inclusive feeding masses of people,  they did not slack in this area. The food was tasty and fulfilling. We were all truly impressed. The only downside is that some nights we wanted wine with dinner but that was an extra cost. But the cocktails weren't, so it wasn't a big foul! The hostesses and wait staff were also very polite, accommodating and always had a smile on their face.

The beach, the beach, the beach! Wonderfully kept, gorgeous water and wonderful wait staff. Moises kept us laughing and you can truly tell that he loves his job. Now the pool! We mainly used the main pool instead of the Royal side pool. Only because it was more of a couples feel on the Royal side. For 4 young professionals we wanted to be around more people. We met singles, couples,  families, wedding guests, a group for guys there for a Bachelor party. It was a great place for everyone and the pool was our social circle. Hands down, it was our favorite part of the trip. Only downside,  the water is almost 6 ft deep, and for a person that is 5'3" my legs got a workout bouncing around on my tippy toes! At the beach and at the pool they are able to provide great bar snacks - my favorite was the guacamole.

Overall, the resort was gorgeous. Very clean. Well manicured. Very nice rooms and bathrooms. Wonderful scent. Beautiful decor. Great entertainment in the evenings. Multiple options for food and even top shelf drinks. We did not have one major problems to speak of, if anything happened it was quickly taken care of. I won't say it was all perfect but to comment on the small things would be petty. 

If you are considering a trip to Cancun, whether as a single group of people or as a couple(s), I highly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: jax A
reviews.title: Feeling cheated
reviews.text: We had booked a lagoon view suite and were told of we wanted a king size bed we would have to be on the ground floor (my view is a parking lot).  I'm also a Melia rewards member and received a promotion for a free 1 level room upgrade for a birthday promotion. This was denied and we were told we would have to book another stay to use it.  Disappointed with the experience because they are trying to sell overpriced extra services and things I cannot use (like my 3 year old son wants to get a manicure-- really?) The check in was horrible, as someone who worked in 5 star hospitality they should learn how to make a first impression

reviews.author: Garret P
reviews.title: Family Concierge is a MUST!
reviews.text:
The family (wife and 2 kids - 4 and 7 years old) just returned from the Paradisus Cancun All-Inclusive hotel.  We stayed here from August 28-Sept 3, 2016.  

I have included as many pictures as I thought reasonable below to share some of what is seen, and not seen on the main website.

The reason we chose this hotel was that it was reported to be a family friendly hotel and had a family suite that would allow everyone to be in 1 room.  This would save the cost on having to reserve 2 separate rooms.  It would also give us the security of having the kids near us.  Even if there were 2 rooms that were connected by a center door, I was worried at their young age - that they could leave their room without us knowing if they had their own room.  

ARRIVAL:
On arrival we were greeted and then taken to the family concierge lounge.  This was great - we did not have to check in with the normal crowd and were taken to the family concierge lounge that was ready for us with a personalized checkin.  Fast and efficient!  The family concierge had couches, wine, beer, other alcohol, non-alcoholic beverages and juices, and food / snacks including cupcakes, cookies, nuts, candy, etc.  There was a pool table, games for the kids, and a welcoming environment only for people with the family concierge status.  We were given a coupon book for in-resort purchases (Spa, market, etc) if we wanted.

During the check-in process we were paired with a personalized concierge for our stay (Fernanda) who was absolutely amazing.  She worked from 3pm-11pm every day and we were given a cell phone to contact her directly with any questions or issues.  If she was not around, the family concierge lounge was open with someone waiting to help us.

Fernanda took care of all of our needs, including reservations for dinners, etc.  This is always a point of anxiety having to make reservations for resort restaurants and they are done 1 day in advance - so having someone do this for us took the stress out of making sure we had reservations.

Almost every day she brought the kids a toy or something neat to have or play with - a gift.  While a small token, this of course made the kids feel very special!

ROOM:
We had a family suite.  You walked into a large living area which had a large flatscreen TV, Nespresso coffee maker, couch, and a few chairs.  There was a door (which could be locked) that separated that main living area from the main bedroom (king size bed) with bathroom.  The large living area couch turned into a sleeper bed for the kids.  It was perfect.  The kids had their own room to sleep and we had our private area at night for adults.  Each room (large living area with convertible bed) and main bedroom had their own balcony with lounge chairs.  I am not a very picky person about rooms - a good vacation you are in the room to sleep…the rest of the time enjoying the hotel, excursions, etc.  But this was perfect for what we needed and wanted.

We did have 1 issue - our first room air conditioner was not working well.  We spent 1 night in the room - they tried to fix the air conditioner and brought us a fan.  The next day it was still not working well, and with the benefit of the family concierge we were fairly quickly moved into a similar room to enjoy the remainder of the vacation - a minor hiccup in an otherwise great trip.

GROUNDS:
The grounds were nice - and constantly maintained. You will see staff throughout the day working on the grounds to make sure they are looking great - the best I have every seen?  No - but nice.

STAFF (and Tips):
The staff was amazing. Although not expected, we did tip the staff – which were very appreciative. At the pool they would bring you whatever you wanted – including both drinks AND food.  The resort was reported to be running at 70% capacity.  My guess was that kids in many parts of the U.S. were just back to school.  Our kids didnt go back until just after Labor day - so it was a perfect time for us to go.  With that said, we never felt crowded.  Our last full day there (Friday) you could tell a new crowd had recently arrived - and the pool bar was a little busy (especially with only 1 person serving drinks) - but not excessively crowded or crazy - and there were other pools on the property (or beach) you could go to if the pool with the bar was a little too much for you.

There were always chairs by the pool and beach - but the better chairs were reserved with towels by 9am or so.  I do recommend getting to the main pool (with pool bar) early if you want specific seats (for example, with umbrellas)…as they are reserved by early-birds quickly.   Some people will place their stuff on the chairs and then go to breakfast, etc. – so they were reserved when they came back – something I quickly adopted to make sure I got good seats for the day.

FOOD:
We went to nearly all of the specialty restaurants at the hotel. Our favorites were the tapas Restaurant (Vento) and the Latin restaurant (Fuego).  Mole (Mexican) was also good.  The others were ok - nothing great, but for an all-inclusive resort serving the number they service, they were good.

Naos - the buffet - was also above average and served meals all day long - so if you wanted something without a reservation, reasonable choice.

ALSO - with a 4 and 7 year old, sometimes they could be picky with food.  Not to worry, all of the specialty restaurants had kid friendly choices - Pasta (with butter, red sauce, alfredo), chicken breast, chicken nuggets, potentially pizza, fries or rice).

During the day, right off the main pool there was also the Sunset Grille.  This was a life saving during the day for lunch, especially for the kids.  Rather than having to dry off or change to go inside, they could walk right up and grab food (hot dogs, hamburgers, chicken patties, pizza, fries, wings, ceviche, salad, sandwiches, nachos, etc) - A real convenience for a quick snack or meal if you didnt want to leave the pool.

SHOWS: 
The shows looked crowded and people were excited, but our 4 and 7 year olds were passed out by 8pm - so we didnt attend a show.

POOL /  ACTIVITIES:
Throughout the day the resort has activities (i.e. water aerobics, beach volleyball, etc) as well as shows that go on (dancers, swimmers, etc) just to keep things fun.

OTHER INFO:
Just to touch on something in other posts - We NEVER have any issues with timeshare people. The resort is gated and they are very specific about who enters the resort – and 
you feel very safe while there.

WEATHER:
We were there for 7 days.  Before we left home we were worried that the weather reports predicted rain almost every day, and some days…all day long.  In reality, the weather here is hard to predict and it rained for about 3 hours 1 afternoon.  There were a few overcast days and a few amazing days - but overall the weather was great, nothing to complain about, and a little overcast weather probably saved us from getting badly burned wanting to play in the pool and beach all day.

CROWD:
It was variable - there were a lot of families and little kids.  There were some honeymooners and singles here as well.  If you are looking for a kid free environment - go elsewhere.  This is reported to be a family friendly resort and I would agree that it was.

KID ZONE:
There was a kid zone area for kids from 9am-9pm.  The kids had to be at least 5 years old to really enjoy the activities, although there was a kid zone for smaller kids.  Even if you didnt want to drop your kids off for the day, there were activities you could sign them up for at 12pm and 4pm which lasted 30-60 minutes (crafts, art, etc) if they needed some activity outside of the normal pool / beach area.

SUMMARY:
Overall it was a great trip - better than expected and a very family friendly place.  I would recommend this resort to those looking for a family friendly all-inclusive resort.

Thanks again to Fernanda for being a great family concierge and helping us make the most of the trip!

reviews.author: Fearless584043
reviews.title: Loved the hotel but very bad management
reviews.text:
I was there for a week and a half. We had such a great experience with food, drinks, and service. Carlos, Andrés, and Flor are the best. We were on the royal service area, but we didnt use it Too much, because basically all the activities are at the main pool. The royal service it is a GREAT option if you are willing to relax, and have a personalized service even With a butler.

Our only bad experience was that there was a wet floor with no signs, and My husband fell hitting his head and blood on his hand, unfortunately the management Didnt care, and actually didnt even apologized for the inconvenience. He was just cold and unprofessional

reviews.author: prisco586
reviews.title: Amazing vacation
reviews.text: My family stayed at Paradisus in July 2016 in the Royal Service (the adult only side). The room, service, food, staff-- everyone and everything was beyond excellent. We have stayed at a few other resorts in Mexico and this one by far surpasses them all! A special shout out to a few staff members that made our already fabulous trip even more enjoyable: Moises, Victor, Victor Manuel, Valeria, Jorge Rafael, and Rode from La Palapa! Miss you all!

reviews.author: Sweetsmiler88
reviews.title: Perfect vacation experience
reviews.text: Beautiful property with beautiful views, white sand beaches with crystal clear water. We did the Royal service package and would highly recommend! The service is fantastic wherever you go, very friendly and workers speak both Spanish and English. Drinks and food were fantastic, our room was comfortable, clean and had a beautiful view. There's plenty to do on the strip for only a $1 (American) per person to get to the other resorts and shopping/nightlife but the location of Paradisus is good because it's not downtown in the crowded traffic area. GORGEOUS resort inside and out and always maintained. What an experience!

reviews.author: Amira L
reviews.title: Paradisus is Paradise
reviews.text: This was my 2nd trip to Paradisus Cancun. I cannot speak highly enough of this beautiful and amazing resort that is all inclusive. From the moment you step into the resort all the staff take over. They take your luggage right to the room. The smells of paradisus OMG is like paradise. Each Pyramid ( 5 in all) have their own unique smell. You have a total of 9 restaurants to choose from that are all inclusive and all are great. I always choose the Royal Service because I love the pampering and the all adult atmosphere. If you do not have children this is the way to go. Royal service gives you a kid free pyramid, your own pool and most of all your very one restaurant to eat at that only Royal guests can attend. The pool attendants Omar and Javier are there to meet your every need. They provide all the beach towels and suntan lotion you need. You will have at least 2 full days under the amazing bali beds by the pool or looking over the aqua sea. If not too busy, Omar and Javier will make it happen to get you one daily. I believe in tipping these employees because they are all hard workers. It was my 26 yr old son's birthday and my butler Edwardo went all out for him. He had balloons all over the bed, campaign with glasses and a chocolate cake sent to our room while we were out. What an amazing surprise to come back to.  The restaurant La Palapa in the Royal service is amazing. Javier, Octivao, Eddie, Roman and all the other hard workers will make you feel like true royalty serving you with your every need. They even bring you food in the bali beds and all the drinks you can want. I do not drink alcohol so they ensured all my drinks were virgin drinks and kept them coming. This restaurant and Mole and Market Grill were my favorites of all the places to eat. All were great but these stood out with La Palapa being my favorite because it was in the Royal service and it overlooks the ocean. I highly recommend this resort to anyone who wants to experience a good time.

reviews.author: Samplusfamilyissues
