reviews.title: Family Trip a week
reviews.text:
Stayed with my family 2 adults and 2 kids for 7 nights. Shout out to the amazing servers at Naos Emiliano, Alexandro, Guandencio and Martino for the impeccable service they provided to us each time we were there. Since my kids ate just plain pasta with tomato sauce Alexandro and Emiliano always made sure they made it fresh for my kids each time. They never made us wait for table at all. Our table was ready in 2 mins and they knew we took non alcoholic drinks. Pleasure to be served by them always. Having a toddler we skipped the restuarants so no idea how the food there was. We ate at the buffet and sunset grill and both were awesome. The coffee bar was good too.
Our room was in the main pyramid and the air conditioner worked perfectly fine and the housekeeper did a agood job always as well. 
My kids loved the pool a lot and we loved the beach. We did do a couple of activities with Aquaworld like Skyrider, Waverunner and Subsea adventure. Sophie at Aquaworld gave us amazing deal and we loved it. 
Overall a good exp and would love to go back again. 
Please tip the people who work there they truly deserve it.

reviews.author: 957tammy
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus August 2016.  The ocean was beautiful and people were lovely.  Enjoyed swimming, the food, renting a bali bed (worth it) and relaxing.  Andres at Nespresso went above and beyond, as did Marco at Naos. We did the family concierge because we have a 10 year old, but the Royal Service (adults only) side looked super nice if you don't have kiddos.  Loved all the special treats left in our room and the wonderful attitude of the entire staff.

reviews.author: P K
reviews.title: All inclusive packages are great
reviews.text: Enjoyed the trip. Rosie from reservations, Nayeli from guest service and Guillermo from Nais were great. Overall satisfied with the stay. The credits given are not something any guests should look forward to.... They should not entice guests with such wrong marketing. The staff was very friendly and courteous..................................................... All inclusive packages are the way to go

reviews.author: CandelariaFamily
reviews.title: Fantastic Family Vacation
reviews.text:
My family traveled from Austin, TX.  We have 5 kids and we brought my mother-in-law as well.  We had three rooms and stayed one week.  The value we received for our money was excellent.  We don't drink, so we really had to take advantage of all the food, which we certainly did.  Several times, my wife and I had a second dinner after everyone else had gone to bed.  Hotel was clean, facilities were awesome, and did I mention the food?  We don't eat any red meat or pork, so that limited our choices to the other 1000 items.

I want to make a special mention of the kids club.  My wife and I took advantage of the gym, which was very well appointed for a hotel facility.  While we were in there, the kids stayed in the kids club.  The staff was amazing, playing with them, doing art projects, really caring about their enjoyment.  In our opinion, this went way above what we expected from a child care facility.

Beach was fabulous.  Pools were beautiful.  The entire week was a great experience.  I've been to Cancun before and this is the nicest place I have stayed.  We'll definitely be back!

reviews.author: NatMan45
reviews.title: Service, service, service
reviews.text:
Paradisus is not the newest hotel in Cancun, but I've been in the area three times and they have the best service I've experienced as well as the best beach. 

Service - A special shout out to Gabriel our Family Concierge, Marco in Naos, and Andres in the coffee shop (the best donuts, ever). These guys were examples of the superb service we received the entire trip. Everyone we encountered was always happy to help us (even to find an area dentist). 

Beach - Cancun has great beaches. I liked the beach at Paradisus because, even in August, it wasn't overly crowded, it was clean constantly, and there were good sized waves to play in. We rented a Bali Bed for a day and that was just great. Definitely recommended. 

Food - All the restaurants were delicious. I particularly liked the sushi place and the taco place. The names confuse me so we just called them by their genre.

reviews.author: Scott F
reviews.title: ANOTHER AWESOME EXPERIENCE!!!!
reviews.text:
This is a little late but we went to Paradisus in February for my wife's birthday.  This was our 3rd time staying here.  It has been a wonderful resort to stay at.  We stayed on the Royal service side.  This was our 2nd time with Royal service.  

Let me just say that our Butler Juan is amazing!  He really takes pride in what he does.  We had him the first time and this time as well.  He goes above and beyond for you,  He is a very sincere person.  I will always request him when we stay.  He made my wife's 30th memorable.  I feel we have made a friend for life.

The rooms are really nice and updated.  The air conditioning has always worked well for us.  It kept the room nice and cool.  They have plenty of room for us and my wife packs very heavy!  The beds are comfortable.  It has a safe in the closet but it will not fit a laptop with a 15" screen.   

The food is always good!   My wife and I really like the Sushi restaurant.  We always request Eric to be our server.  He is always friendly and makes special dishes for us.  All of the employees that we have dealt with have always been great!.  The new Asian restaurant was really good!  We really don't have any complaint's.

The bars always serve great drinks with top shelf liquor.  The margarita are my favorite.  The drinks never stop coming. 

The spa is amazing!  We always get a couples massage when we stay.  They leave you feeling so relaxed.  The prices are pretty good to.  I cant wait to go back and get another! 

The resort is always clean and smells wonderful.  I understand that some people you just can't please .  They will always find something to complain about.  This place has never let us down.  The entertainment is good.  It would be nice if it was in a bigger space.  

We are going back in November for a week.  We are staying on the Royal service side again.  This will be our 4th time going back to Paradisus.   We are going to request Juan again.  He's the best!

reviews.author: Perla Torres
reviews.title: Amazing vacation!
reviews.text: Love everything about the royal service. The service that my fiancé and I received was beyond what we expected. Our butler (Sergio) was the best!!! The guys by the pool were very efficient and friendly.

reviews.author: Mmm470
reviews.title: Enjoyed our stay
reviews.text:
We just returned after staying at Paradisus Cancun for three nights. It was a family trip that included a seven months old and a two year old. We got a very good deal by booking directly from the hotel website just a week before our arrival. Rooms are spacious and modern. Food is also very good. I would highly recommend cajun chicken breast from Market Grill. Staff is very attentive and eager to please you.
I wished they had AC in lobby and common area. It really got very hot especially during the daytime and only places you can get AC would be restaurants or back in our rooms.The nightly shows at Avenue Bar were good, especially the circus. I wished they had a bigger space for seating as almost every night we had to stand to watch the shows even though we got there 15 to 20 mins before the start of the show.

reviews.author: Caytrini
reviews.title: Can't wait to go back
reviews.text: My family and I visited from August 20th -27th. From the first day I was already planning to come back. There were about seven restaurants( brazilian, 2 mexican, asian, sushi, tapas,international buffet) to choose from for dinner.  Food was always available. THe service was impeccable, especially poolside. There is a swim up bar in the main pool.  Lots of actiivities, I especially enjoyed the zumba.  We left the resort once for a tour,  did nt even make it to the town just did not want to leave.  I finished off the week with a  massage at the Yhi Spa, Virginia's hands were a gift!!!  Can't wait to go back.

reviews.author: Steven L
reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text:
Just came back from our second visit of Paradisus Cancun. I have to say the place still is beautiful with a great beach and pool. For an all inclusive the food is very good and the restaurants are great. Sadly a few mis- steps left us wondering if we will be back. We stayed for 4 days on the tail end of a long  Mexican trip, and for almost 3 of those days we had no air conditioner. I understand things happen beyond you control but nothing was done on managements behalf to make us happy. We called several times a day and were told it was being worked on it will be fixed very soon. Luckily with the ocean breeze it was only about 85 degrees in our room but still-  also our jacuzzi never worked and then our patio flooded. Not a big deal, but having to stand in 3 inches of water to watch the ocean and enjoy a glass of wine wasn't what we paid for. I was wondering if Paradisus was just too big a place for management to maintain! The day after it rained there were dozens of beach towels all around the property floors to catch the water leaking from the roof and windows. 
I can say the employees are exceptional. Every single person we encountered was super friendly and made sure they said hello. I almost hate to give a 3 star review, but last time we were here in late 2014 we were blown away by every last detail.  This time when we left my wife & I looked at each other and said "think I've had enough of Paradisus". That was sad for us to say because there are things we will miss, but for the money we spent we might look at other properties

reviews.author: Lisa L
reviews.title: Best vacation ever....
reviews.text: We are in the travel business in U.S. so this time the 6 of us when to Cancun for vacation. Best decision ever! The hotel is great, staff are wonderful... and the foods are fresh and bountiful. Our favorite restaurants are: NAOS and Mole. We love the chefs: Cristian and Irving... the managers and all the staff are just amazing. Atilano, Pascual, Julio,...We stayed 8 fabulous days! Thank you so much for making our vacation memorable! Can't wait to go back for another vacation...

reviews.author: audreyc20
reviews.title: My second time - even bettet
reviews.text: This is my second time here and it was even better than the first (July 2014). I love everything about this place. I stayed in the adult only section and it was amazing. They made my birthday very soevialvvWe are planning to go back

reviews.author: Bill L
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text: Great vacation in cancun, Mexico. Great room. Great Food.  Great beach. I felt like I was in the US. Everyone spoke English to me. Very few Hispanic guests. Buffets have a good slection of American food.

reviews.author: M D
reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text: Super beach and excellent location. Good restaurants with a decent range of activities. We had an ocean view room in the main tower where the reception area is located. View was fantastic. Wouldn't mind going back.

reviews.author: Snax321
reviews.title: Pretty much the best resort in the world
reviews.text:
My girlfriend and I stayed at paradisus cancun from sept 9-16th. We were absolutely blown away by the resorts Decor and service. The layout of the resort could not have been better. The restaurants the bars the pools were all top notch. The resort lights incense in the morning and night and blasts aromatherapy everywhere! It's so pleasant to walk around and smell vanilla and sandalwood!!! I could go on and on about how great this report is, I mean I've traveled across the world and I have been to other paradisus resorts but this one takes the cake. I never thought I would want to visit a resort twice but I think I'll be making several trips to this resort! I would love to give kudos to some workers who made our stay extra special.

1st is Alejandro who literally knew I was looking for something before I even asked! Every single day by the pool he made sure we had everything we needed and never let us run out of alcohol!!! He was one of the best workers out of all the resorts I have ever visited!!!

2nd lizette from royal service who literally took care of any issues we had in literally seconds. She is absolutely top notch when it comes to service and will make sure nothing ruins your stay at paradisus. Dealing with her always made us happier!!!

3rd Carlos from the mini bar service who we asked only one time how we wanted our fridge and literally had the mini fridge stocked to our  exact specifications and made sure we were always happy!!!

reviews.author: ARPatel21
reviews.title: Excellent Service at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: My family of 4 stayed at the Paradisus Cancun for 10 nights in late August / early September 2015. Although the hotel is very good overall, what made the hotel outstanding for us was the quality and warmth of the hotel's staff. In particular, we enjoyed being served by Marco in the main restaurant. The Patel family, London, England

reviews.author: Memere6
reviews.title: Very nice resort with beach issues.
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay at Paradisus Cancun.  We went there to relax which we did.  The staff was gracious and accommodating.  We opted for the ocean view room which had a very large balcony and a spectacular view of the ocean.  The room also was large and well appointed and bathroom amenities were excellent.....faceclothes! Big downside was the seaweed on the beach and the drop offs in the water.  Dining experience was spotty and ran the gamut of very good to okay.  Fuego was our favorite restaurant.  Blue Agave our least favorite.

reviews.author: mr3361
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: The hotel is very clean. They have a large crew of people everywhere from serving drinks to prepping the food. I would suggest you ask for a room away from the pool. It can get loud at times. The only thing I didn't like was the fact that our air conditioner didn't work, but they came and fixed it. Another thing was the electricity went out for 2 days. A good hotel, but beware of the sales people who try to sell you the timeshare. While I enjoy the membership, they try to have you upgrade.

reviews.author: ANNA V
reviews.title: Absolutely FABULOUS Experience!!! I will be back!
reviews.text:
Oh WOW! I don't even know where to start!!! 
My trip to Cancun was quiet a spontaneous one and I didn't have much time to do research on all the hotels and I picked Paradisus solely based on my own instincts…
For some reason I stuck with the idea of staying specifically there and I must tell, I couldn't be happier with my choice!!!
From the moment I entered the reception area, the time has stopped and everything transformed into a beautiful dream that lasted for 5 days... I was greeted in a very graceful way with a glass of champagne( I must mention that the Royal Service was included in my package and it was sooo worth it). 
My butler, Rossana Rico was a true sweetheart, and took an excellent care of me-she organized my daily activities, made reservations at the restaurants etc, so I didn't have to bother about little things… I celebrated my bday there, so Rossana and Antonio even made me a beautiful surprise by bringing in my room a bottle of champagne, a bday cake and filled the whole room with rose petals! I received so much attention from all the staff, something I did not expect at all… I had a feeling that every single person who works there does it just for his/her own pleasure and not because of the paycheck at the end of the week...
Daniel at the Royal Service Pool was so super attentive and friendly to everyone and took an excellent care of me every time I went there-I couldn't be more grateful to him for making my stay there even more special…
Eric at Bana served me first night I stayed there and he made the entire dining experience exceptional. His super professional service convinced me again that I made the right choice and picked the right hotel…Ironically the restaurant I was going to dine in on my last night was closed for some reason, so I went again to Bana and even tough I didn't have a reservation, Eric remembered me and made sure that I get a table promptly! He took an excellent care of me and made sure that I remember my last night in Mexico by serving my dessert at the end with a special Coffee de Maya, and I must tell: this was something really spectacular!!!
I LOVED everything about the hotel: the amenities, clean pools, super professional and friendly staff, decor, beautiful flower arrangements, Zen ambience, fun evening concerts, delicious food, great restaurants, room service, clean towels etc…
 I would certainly (and already did) recommend Paradisus to my friends and anyone else!

Thank you so much to the entire Paradisus team for this amazing experience and hopefully will see you soon!!! 

Best,

ANNA

reviews.author: Ayeletb
reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.text: I came here to speak at a conference and loved the hotel, the people, the service and variety of food. The place has a great spirit and it is a great place to go write a book, with breaks! There is a ton of options for food and every experience was great. The staff wanted to make sure we had a great experience.

reviews.author: lawhpt
reviews.title: not a hotel but a first class resort
reviews.text:
We own a time share on Cozumel that is a sister property.  This was our 4th visit to the Paradisus Cancun.  The suite is two bedrooms with a living room/bed room between.  The room was clean, beds comfortable, bath rooms the same.  Typical Spanish style with everything tiled.  Our suite was 5th floor building 2 facing the ocean.
All 3 rooms have a balcony with sliding glass doors.  
All 3 rooms had AC that was about 70 degrees and cold.  The rooms were quiet with no noise from above or either side.  The rooms overlooked the main pool and swim-up bar.  Music played during the day at a listening level-not blasting.  
We opted for the all-inclusive feature having had it before-a good deal.
They have 7-8 restaurants all excellent.  We ate breakfast in the buffet daily, lunch by the pool ( killer wings), chips, salsa, guacamole.  The pool side bar has good top shelve hard stuff and good Mexican beers.
We were spoiled by Pascual and David in Naos.  
Prior to dinner Umberto plied us with libations at the grand main bar.
We ate at the Brazilin  style eatery twice as it is our favorite.  The sushi restaurant is first class. Mole was excellent.
Plenty of shaded seating areas around the pool but requires staking out one's are in advance.
The main lobby is beautiful with green vines cascading 8 stories around a huge atrium housing the sushi eatery.
We belong to the Melia Vacation club and the all-inclusive is optional.
Many good restaurants are a short bus ride away probably 4-5 stars.
The public buses are a dollar each way.  The Iberostar golf course is just a couple miles south of the hotel.  God was it hot!  Well kept course and friendly staff.  I only practiced putting and chipping and sand play for $4.00.  A round was too salty for my handicap.

reviews.author: Douglas W
reviews.title: My Favorite CANCUN Hotel!
reviews.text: Fabulous Hotel, great location, wonderful service! I have been visiting Cancun for the past thirty years (on and off) and have traveled to many Mexico destinations; Ixtapa, Guadalajara, Puerto Vallarta, Cabo, Acapulco, Mexico City, Puerto Penasco, and others....but my favorite is city is Cancun and my favorite hotel is the PARADISUS CANCUN!!!!!

reviews.author: Khanh N
reviews.title: Awesome butler service
reviews.text: My family and I were here for a conference in December and really enjoyed the butler service. We had Ramon and he really catered to my 8 yr old. He was able to hook me up with a few amenities which would have cost extra if I did not have him. we stayed in the Royal service 1 bedroom suite. The room had a nice ocean view. Although the planters outside did not have any plants in them, the room was really spacious. Mt favorite restaurants were the Japanese and the Brazilian grill.

reviews.author: AshleyRichards0n
reviews.title: Lovely hotel, beautiful Location
reviews.text:
Paridisus is a Lovely large hotel with some great bars and restaurants. The pool area is lively and fun and the beach is spectacular. 

We frequented Bar Cocos on most evenings and Balan and Enrique (Alcudia) were both wonderfully attentive staff. They looked after us and were happy to chat even when busy. In fact, quite often you'd barely have finished your drink before another was presented to you... brilliant!

The only issue is with the resturant reservations, if you miss the 24 hour pre booking slot you may not be able to reserve, even when you get to the resturant its half empty. i can only assume this is to accommodate the "Gold wristband" people, but its annoying. it also means the restaurants were always half empty. 

The sushi restaurant here is AMAZING! some of the best, freshest sashimi I've had anywhere in the world. 

The beach bali beds are also a great upgrade. for $80 we were given our own bed with a waiter all day, DJ playing beachy tunes and a HUGE lobster lunch. it was so good we did it twice. 

Its sometimes frustrating that one of the pools is out of bounds to guests who are not "Gold wristbands" but fortunately the pool bar is fun and you can sit there if you don't have a sunbed. 

In the down season (we went mid September) they should really relax the gold band rules as there was just a handful of this type or guest. Although i'm sure there would be more in high season. 

The rooms were large and clean and very spacious, although could do with some furniture on the balconies. 

All in all an excellent holiday.

reviews.author: mamamyriam
reviews.title: Best vacation!
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed at this resort because a friend recommend to us. I am wasn't  sure if was the right decision, but it was. Hotel Paradisus Cancun has a nice location in the hotel zone around 20 minutos or less from the airport. It is very elegant with an aroma on the air from the main entrance.
Every employee treat us as we were kings. Rooms are clean an have a nice big balcony, our room was facing the lagoon.
Food was very good and different every day. Friday night the buffet is all kind of seafood. The theme restaurant were good, we loved the Rodizzio.
Our special thanks to the Chef Martinez that took good care of us, very friendly and humble person.
We recommend this resort 100%.

reviews.author: Patricia G
reviews.title: "GREAT EXPERIENCE"
reviews.text: I am a timeshare owner and this was my first time to visit  Paradisus cancun and we loved it. I took a friend for the first time and we had a blast. and danced our butts off! Couldn't ask for a better experience the food, drinks and the staff were fabulous. Our RCI manager JIM was so great explained everything to us and gave us a great user guide to the hotel. We stayed in tower 1 it was so quiet and not too far from our favorite place "the swim up bar"! Francisco, Geraldo, Oscar, Julio and my favorite "Jesus Aguayo" took very good care of us. We didn't have to ask for anything our water bucket was always full of fresh ice and a cold beverages. Loved the ACTIVITIES guys and I actually won something. They were always on point with the kids and adults with the music and type of activities for the day! We especially enjoyed the 8:30 daily shows inside the main tower and wow could those people put on a great show!  The restaurants were fabulous and the whole entire facility was gorgeous & not one person every passed without saying hello and with a smile. I appreciate the fact the property is super clean and if there ever was a problem it was fixed ASAP. Cant wait to return and relax especially starting off our day with a "power cappachino" made by MARCO NAOS (BAILEY IRISH CREAM).at the breakfast buffet bar! I miss this place already we will return !!!

reviews.author: Suzette D
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun was PARADISE!!!
reviews.text: Fantastic service, beautiful HUGE resort great for families or couples separate area for either... Food was phenomenal especially enjoyed the rodizio and Naos but there are many options! Beautiful pools and right on the beach lots of cabanas if you prefer shade ... The butler service is fantastic we had Cesar he was a gem! 24 hour room service... Loved it here!!

reviews.author: Caleb S
reviews.title: Perfect Honeymoon at Paradisus
reviews.text: My wife and I spent our honeymoon here and could not have been happier. To start, the building itself stands out from the rest in the Hotel Zone by it's unique shape. From the moment we walked in the front door, the staff was incredible. An initial fear of mine was that we know zero Spanish, but it was not a problem. The hotel was wonderful, the huge indoor gardens, marble floors, and glass accents were kept perfectly. The  included dining was great too. The beach was FAR better than the neighboring beaches.

reviews.author: jeff c
reviews.title: Anniversary trip with family and friends
reviews.text: Had a nice vacation at the Paradises,there for an anniversary,food was ok,tried the butler service much better,couldn't get anyone to keep the room stocked properly,all in all the staff was friendly, hotel was clean,would go back again.

reviews.author: Rose1409
reviews.title: Good stay at Paradisus
reviews.text:
We had a lovely stay, made even better by the activities team, especially Hugo & Mauricio who delivered a daily Aqua gym session which was a great way to burn off the huge but yummy breakfasts! They also ran various other activities such as Zumba, volley ball and other games at the main pool. Everything was done with a smile and loads of personality and offered an alternative to sunbathing or swimming. If this is not your thing the pool area is large enough to enjoy quiet time at the other end. 

The food at the buffet and other restaurants was good and to a high standard with great tasting fresh food and a vast array of choice. The service was always fantastic and it felt like they couldn't do enough for you. 

The only reason that I haven't given this hotel a 5 is due to the Air Con issue we repeatedly had in our room. The first time we had an issue was very late at night and were woken up by the soaring temperature which topped out at about 85F!! We called the desk and the following day were assured that it was fixed and we wouldn't need to move rooms (despite being told we would be moved and had packed all our stuff....gggrrrrrr) however the following night, although the temperature on the a/c unit was set to 65F the room temp was edging up and up. Again someone came out and 'fixed' it but we continued to have problems. On the fourth occasion we were moved to another room in the hotel however the a/c stopped working there as well. Eventually they moved us to another room which luckily had fully functioning climate control although by this time it was our last night so had very little time to enjoy it. We made a complaint about all the inconvenience and were given complimentary late checkout on our day of departure which was very useful as were weren't leaving for the airport until 3.30.

We also discovered the you can't have the iron and hairdryer on at the same time as it causes a power cut to the entire suite... Each time this happened they had to switch it back on at the main isolater which was also rather inconvenient!

reviews.author: jennifer s
reviews.title: Paradise All Inclusive
reviews.text:
Beautiful hotel, private balconies, great food choices, beautiful view, and fantastic swim up bar. Salvador is the BEST bartender EVER! You can have a palapa on the beach  (save one EARLY) and the waiters bring food or drinks right to you. The same thing at the pool as well! 
We've been twice and the service has been unbelievable. Although tips are included in the all inclusive, we take care of staff directly to ensure that they get the entire amount and we also get treated superbly. Love this place. It's 5 star on 3 star budget.

reviews.author: Saazzzz
reviews.title: Loved, loved, loved!
reviews.text:
The Paradisus hotel is great! The service was excellent, the food was great, and the beach was pleasant and relaxing.

I cannot speak highly enough about the service at every restaurant, buffet, and around the hotel. Everyone was very attentive and kind. They have servers at the beach, who are around to provide you with drinks. They aim to please. 

My favorite restaurants were Mole and Fuego. I didn't have high expectation for the buffet, but even that was excellent. 

Overall my friends and I had a wonderful stay at Paradisus Cancun. I highly recommend it.

reviews.author: tommy0195
reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: My wife and I took our first ever trip without our 4 kids for her 40th birthday.  We were looking for some relaxation, fun, sun and cool drinks.  We found it all and more at the Paradisus.  The resort was like walking into a spa, from the pleasant aroma to the subtle music it was all so peaceful and well maintained.  The rooms were great.  Large with all the amenities you could need.  It would've been nice if the AC went below 65 but that really wasn't a big deal.  The pool/beach area were picture perfect.  We've been to many all-inclusives and most tend to skimp on the drinks.  These bartenders were great using quality alcohol and not skimping on the drinks.  You could even do shots which is rare for an all-inclusive.  They had some fun contests poolside during the day and a good selection of music.  If you wanted some quiet space around the pool that was there too.  Just stake out a spot early.  By 7am almost everything is taken poolside.  The beach you can get a chair at any time.  The restaurants were all excellent offering up a very nice selection of different local and international dishes.  Breakfast is all buffet which was perfect as was lunch.   There's also a pool side hamburger type place.  You have to make reservations for some of the restaurants the day before as they fill up but would actually recommend the taco place, Blue Agave as our favorite.  Make to order taco's, enchiladas, quesadillas, etc.  As far as nightlife goes there were some shows that were cute and a small "club" there which had small crowds.  We chose to venture out at nights to something more lively but if you're just looking for a few after dinner drinks than the hotel certainly would work.  There's an outdoor beach bar that's nice in the evening as well.  The hotel is very safe, only guests are allowed in.  There's NO pressure at all for time share presentations (part of the resort is a time share) and there was no one hawking stuff on the beach.  It definitely was family friendly as well and many people had kids there.  The pool is so huge that it easily absorbs everyone and kids/families/couples/singles all easily got along.  It was an absolutely perfect place to stay and for the price you certainly can't beat it.

reviews.author: Aaronpsmith
reviews.title: the best hotel we have ever been to
reviews.text:
Honestly dont know how this place has any bad reviews. its amazing, the hotel the staff the location, the negative reviews must be from stuck up people who expect to be treated like the the king of the world 

Hotel - what can i say about this place, it is breathtaking! when you walk in the main pyramid with all the plants and pools, all you can say is wow, we still walked round in awe on our last day just like we did on our first, the attention to detail is incredible and there are people cleaning/polishing absolutely everywhere, the lighting at night makes it even more beautiful and it even smells amazing

Pool/Beach -  very clean and again very beautiful, the beach has sunbeds and palapas, the pool has some bed with palapas, some fixed covered beds for rental, and normal beds with a few umbrellas, we never had any trouble getting a bed by the pool or on the beach but it is VERY hot so i would advise getting up and out early if you want an unbrella, saw the staff removing unused towels after a period of time also, we did find that salvador at the pool bar was quite ignorant and tended to favour the mexicans/people that were tipping him but the waiters on the beach and pool were excellent so we just used them instead and tipped them occasionally, the pool was not cold, but definately colder than sitting in the sun and yes its deep, im 5 11" and i could stand flat footed the water was to my shoulders, my girlfriend struggled

Room - room was amazing the bathroom was very nice and came stocked with all sorts of toiltetries, the bed was enormous and honestly hands down the comfiest bed we have had in a hotel, the air con was not the coldest but it was a lot colder than the temperature outside, fridge was stocked daily with beer water and cans of pop, and the bed was made sometimes more than once a day, also room cleaned daily and towels replaced daily if you wanted them to be, they also have a laundry service but we did not use this. room was 3301 which was just off the main pyramid and yes it was quite loud during the shows but never later than 11pm when the bars close, sea view was great, wifi was good in the room but not so good by the pool or beach

Restaurants - 

Naos - the buffet, open for breakfast lunch and dinner daily, we ate breakfast daily around 7am and found it to be quiet, nicely presented and a great selection of tasty food, there was something different everyday during our 2 week stay, egg station was great simply select your ingredients in a bowl and they prepare an omelette for you, also a fresh smoothie station along with almost everything you could think of for breakfast, hot sweet things (pancakes french toast waffles) salad, fruit, nachos, some hot mexican food which i thought was strange for breakfast, cooked items bacon eggs sausages etc, breads and cakes, cereals, we visited once later around 9am and it was very busy and some of the buffet was in need a of a refill so id advise going early, same story at lunch and dinner good selection all tasty always different and better to eat earlier in the service than later, javier and pablo were our favourite waiters both very good

vento - tapas, visited on our 2nd night and it was excellent sat by the pools on the terrace next to the fish, had about 9 dishes between us and was all excellent, we went back for a 2nd visit later in out holiday and it wasnt as good

fuego - latin american fusion - very nice place also visited twice due to it being one of our favourites, the salmon is excellent

mole - mexican with a twist - excellent again, unusual combinations of food and a nicely decorated place

bana - asian fusion and sushi, easily the best restaurant there, in the central pyramid so not as cool as others but not unbearable, very romantic setting, our sever jose was excellent in his recommendations, visited again later in out holiday and was just as good

market grill - located outside so its very hot and sweaty, similar concept to bem brasil apart from they bring you the sides aswell, was nice but all the meats we wanted kept going past and the meats we were offered we had already had, and we got very full very fast due to how fast they come round with stuff, nice but not our favourite

blue agave - tacos and tequila, not great, the worst restaurant there, no reservations required and we hardly ever saw anyone in there, open for lunch dinner and late night snack until 5am, but id avoid it unless you have to go or really want to go

tempo - fine dining (extra charge), very nice treat for our last night, tasting menu was great although the wine list is VERY expensive

sunset grill - pool snack bar, good for burgers chips wings pizza etc

room service - ordered once at 3am and it took 40 minutes to come and was barely warm when it arrived

toji bar - excellent bar located under the white spiky roof in the main pyramid, when we were there it was staffed by santiago and gerardo avila, both excellent in knowledge of drinks and just generally talkative and funny and made our holiday so much more enjoyable, thanks guys!

hotel shops - overpriced, can buy the same things elsewhere for a fraction of the cost

around the hotel - blue gecko down the street excellent for tacos, aquaworld across the street for water based excursions, mcdonalds and papa johns pizza across the road along with a conevenice store and a petrol station and a pharmacy, bus stop literally right next to the hotel, 10.5 pesos per person and can go as far as you like, if you want to explore theres only one road so the only choice you have to make is north or south!

reviews.author: Ben C
reviews.title: Lovely holiday!
reviews.text:
My girlfriend and I took a trip to Cancun, Mexico earlier this year in June. We did quite a bit of research before booking it, choosing the right flights and hotel, all of this paid off.
Paradisus Cancun is an incredible hotel with great staff that make you feel very welcome. The food in all of the restaurants was fantastic and all unique in their own ways. Our favorite of them all was Bana Bar the Asian restaurant in which we went to almost everyday of the holiday (not just to eat). Bana is set in the heart of the hotel in the main pyramid, it is beautifully lit up at night time with lights beaming through the hanging vines. If you do end up going to this resort, go to Bana bar and make sure you are served by Ernesto, he will take great care of you!
All of the pools and the beach are stunning at this resort and will make you never want to leave. We had a room that overlooked the lagoon, which we prefered as the pool area gets busy and it was perfect. The only downside is that there is no furniture on the balconies but that isn't an issue as there are lots of chairs in the rooms that you can move outside easily.
The only negative part of our holiday was when our air con broke in the room for a day in which the staff did everything they could to sort it out for us. They gave us the choice of having an upgraded room which we weren't so keen on as it meant packing up our entire room and moving across the hotel. Luckily when we went back to our room to pack up the air condition was working again. Because of the hassle they gave us 2 free massages in the spa which was very kind.
The only other negative part was that the main pool area gets very loud during the day with loud music being played and the pool bar gets very busy. It would be nice if there was another one somewhere that was a little more relaxing.
Overall i highly recommend Paradisus Cancun for groups of people going on holidays or as a family holiday. I wouldn't say it's a very romantic place to go with a partner.

reviews.author: Peter I
reviews.title: fantastic vacation
reviews.text:
We had a junior suite sea side. It was the smallest room in the hotel. It had everything we wanted. The rooms, restaurants, bars, pools were very clean. The staff was very friendly. We were served all the day.

We were in the Rayal Service. Our favorite restaurant was the "La Palapa". Excellent waiters were Alex (chief and Arbondiga cook), Edier, Valeria, Guadalupe and the butlers Juan and Hervig.

reviews.author: Rob L
reviews.title: Best vacation ever!!!
reviews.text: The hotel was very clean and looked even better then the photos online. The staff was very friendly and the food was the best I've ever had. I cannot think of one negative comment about the trip. Recommend this hotel to all.

reviews.author: Bo G
reviews.title: Exceeded Expectations!
reviews.text: This was my sixth trip to Cancun in consecutive years and I have usually gone to the RIU chain of hotels.  Cancun is hard to beat in my opinion for the amazing beaches given it's price point.  I love to stay on the resort so my priorities are Beach, Price, Service, Food, View!  My wife and I chose to book at Paradisus because of a great deal they were running, but we were nervous to try something different sue to our great experiences at the RIU's. We booked a Lagoon view sweet for 11 days/12 nights in September 2016.  Overall Paradisus far exceeded my expectations and more! It beats the RIU's on several levels and I have very little criticism.  Our room was technically a lagoon view, but it was angled to where we had a decent ocean view.  The room was pretty standard, but it had one of the more comfortable king beds I have slept on during a vacation. The hotel design is multiple pyramids and this made for one of the cooler resort interiors I have seen.  Walking around the hotel was a treat due to all the greenery, koi ponds, and incense or whatever they pump into the hotel (the smell is wonderful!!!). My wife and I usually like to hit the gym daily and the YHI wellness spa had a fairly decent gym. The service at Paradisus is the best I have encountered.  They have a whole pyramid specifically for people who pay more for the Royal Service, but my experience was that of royalty.  Everyone is wonderful ,friendly, helpful, and there to serve or help you! They remember you, your name, and your drink of choice! The two things I read in researching Paradisus Cancun that made me nervous was that the breakfast buffet gets crowded and the pool area has limited beach chairs for a large resort.  The breakfast buffet could get a little busy, but it was never a problem. The pool area had limited chairs, but if you got out there before 8:30 there was always options - plus you can rent a Bali bed for $15 USD with the coupon book they give you).  The pool was very large and had fantastic pool bar service. There was one bartender in particular at the pool bar named Salvador and he is an absolute Rockstar!!  When he would walk to the pool bar - there were cheers and applauding! There is also great service when lying by the pool.  once you lay down there is a server taking your order within 5 minutes and they will continue bringing you drinks all day.  One server in particular named Sofonia would show up right away with our drink of choice without us ordering - wonderful! One criticism I have regarding the pool is that the pool bar can get crowded and it would be nice if there were some more options near the bar to hang out and enjoy your beverage.  The pool is also a little deep for my liking.  I am only 5'6" so it was up to my chin when on my tippy-toes. The ocean view was one of the best I have seen in Cancun.  the spectrum of hues and shades of blue is surreal! The ocean was fun, but the waves were enough that my wife did not like to go in the ocean much.  We have stayed at some of the RIU's on the northern part of the Cancun hotel zone where the waves are minimal and you can just hang out in the ocean all day! The restaurants ...overall Paradisus had the best food at an All-Inclusive resort we have stayed at.  They have plenty of options and I only wish we had more days to go back to all of them.  Bana is an asian/sushi place which had the best view while right in the middle of the great pyramid at night with music and lights. The sushi was great and the atmosphere was perfect.  This was our favorite until we went to Fuego which was a latin american fusion restaurant - I highly recommend the Sirloin! The appetizers and desserts were all magnificent and I highly recommend the Blue crab chupe (soup)! Mole is a mexican food place and it was great.  I highly recommend the goat cheese ice cream and our server Alex was hilarious and a blast! Vento is a tapas restaurant and that was a new experience and a ton of fun.  Market Grill is a brazilian all you can eat rodizio restaurant.  Wonderful as well! Like I said - I wish we had more days to go back to all of them! The bars had top shelf options for liquor which was fantastic and they had at-least 5 different brews of beer (XX, XX Amber, Tecate, Tecate light, and Sol). Make sure you check out the Michael Jackson show and show up 30 minutes earlier to ensure a good seat! Paradisus was an amazing experience and it will be my first choice when I book for next year! Thanks

reviews.author: Michelle K
reviews.title: Nice hotel
reviews.text: I was at the Paradisus Cancun for a work trip so I didn't get to take advantage of many of the amenities. The meeting was off peak so the room rate was extremely reasonable. The food was pretty good and the hotel was not crazy busy. It's difficult to make reservations for the restaurants so I recommend calling at 9 am when they open or even a few days in advance. I stayed in building 4 because I heard building 3 was too loud. I had no noise complaints and a beautiful view.

reviews.author: lifesaverrn
reviews.title: McLeod's 10yr anniversary!
reviews.text: We chose this place for our 10yr anniversary. We were not disappointed. We opted for Royal service and was So glad we did. Check in was a breeze, we were immediately escorted to the royal service side where we were offered a drink. Our bags were brought to our room, we did not have to carry them. There were a few hiccups shortly after we arrived, but SANDRA did an amazing job fixing them. LETICIA ROSAS was also such a sweetheart and was very helpful. Market grill and Bana were our favorite restaurants, we wish we would've reserved Bana another day after eating there. Our server Eduardo was a pleasure. We strongly disliked MOLE, we didn't finish any of our food, we left and went over to the buffet. The best part of our trip was lounging by the pool and beach area. We would order food and drinks from there. We walked over to the other side and were so glad we chose Royal service. It was crowded and loud. There was ALWAYS chairs to sit on at the Royal service side. We loved laying on our Bali beds. We fell asleep out there a few times. EDDIE (hope I'm spelling his name right) was EXCELLENT!!! He made sure we had cold bottled water and made sure we got everything we asked for, he was truly amazing and was so pleasant. JORGE was AWESOME too we were completely satisfied with his service by the pool, he went above and beyond to make sure we were good!!! Can't forget ALEJANDRO, if it weren't for these men by the pool, our trip would NOT have been so good. They really made our time by the pool/hotel great!!! CARLOS FARAROL was also very helpful, extremely satisfied with his service. Our room was cleaned well and our bed turned down at night. They make sure you don't lift a finger at this place. The spa was amazing and the hydrotherapy was so relaxing. Okay my only negatives are that certain areas in the hotel are very warm and the room may not be as cool as some may want it. The pool water is also warm, but we still enjoyed relaxing in it daily. The beach did have seaweed, but we still had so much fun in the water. The hotel was a little dark, however I thought it was calming and relaxing. HELPFUL TIP: if by 11am no one claims their Bali bed, you can get it, just ask to be placed on a waiting list. We had a Bali bed every day of our trip because of this. We were so sad we had to leave and are absolutely planning a return trip! DON'T be cheap! Please tip these workers. They work so hard running back and forth in the hot sun to make your trip great and they do it with a smile on their face. They deserve it!!!

reviews.author: CmaMistri
reviews.title: Cancun, Mexico '15
reviews.text: I visited Cancun for the first time this year and stayed at Paradisus, which I thought was a spectacular hotel! The staff were great in particular the barman Chris who made excellent cocktails and Benito at the market grill who was very pleasant and hospitable, the concierge staff were also very helpful! The rooms were spacious and clean, the entertainment was great, particularly enjoyed the Micheal Jackson impersonator and the Mexican show, the opera singers were also fabulous! The food was amazing, we could not get enough and the beach was a great place to relax! Overall a great hotel and definitely recommended!

reviews.author: wesleydavis
reviews.title: Amazing Place!
reviews.text: Everything was perfect! The food and drinks were first class! However the excellent service was the finishing touch to an amazing experience for my girlfriend and I! If you have the extra cash for the Royal service it is worth it!

reviews.author: Sassyy68
reviews.title: The best place I ever stayed at
reviews.text: This hotel was beautiful they did everything for you my butler Pedro suck but my friends butler Carlos became our butler he was awesome and latecia she was excellent we really enjoyed ourself we would visit this hotel again minus Pedro the drinks were top shelf just great I loved it .i give it 5 thumbs up......

reviews.author: David S
reviews.title: Don't Worry, Be Happy
reviews.text:
We finished off our summer with a relaxing vacation in the Royal Service pyramid of the Paradisus Cancun in early September.  Check-in and check-out was a breeze due to the assistance of Roxana, Letitia, and Sandra.  Upon our arrival we were warmly greeted by the Royal Service Manager, Lazaro.  There was no waiting and our luggage was brought immediately to our beautiful 1 bedroom suite with panoramic views of the beach and pools.  Our suite was meticulously maintained by Lissie from Housekeeping throughout our 11-day vacation.

As requested before our arrival, Sergio was our butler.  He is simply the best!
 
On Sergio’s days off he arranged for another butler, Pedro, to take care of us.  Pedro not only decorated our room with rose petals, he escorted us to restaurants for dinners, and invited us to help release newly hatched turtles into the ocean after sunset.  This was a unique and fun experience for us.  Another butler, Rodrigo, added to the fun for us and the other guests in Royal Service.

In the Royal Service atrium we were treated to nightly entertainment with musicians and classical singers.  Our favorite was Juan Manuel, an accomplished violinist.  Eddie was also very attentive at the RS coffee, liquor, and hors d’oeuvres stations.  Josue treated us to his special liquor concoction, a “Peanut Butter and Jelly”.  You’ll have to go there and have him make one for you.
  
The RS pools were warm, clean and relaxing!!!  The poolside service was impeccable – there is nothing like relaxing in the shade of a palapa with a bucket of ice filled with Mexican beer for me, lemonades for my wife, and the beautiful pools and beach right next to us!

The Paradisus offers many fine restaurants.  We celebrated our anniversary with a culinary experience at Tempo with the sampling menu and wine pairing.  Thanks to Samuel, Carlos and the chefs!

We enjoyed Mole with delicious Mexican cuisine served by Angel, Javier, Juan, and Donovan.  The mariachi entertainment made our dinners there especially festive. We also want to thank Manager Rody for some great meals at the Market Grill and Vento.  We always look forward to seeing him and his expert staff.

Our thanks to Lazaro, the RS manager, and his staff for helping us celebrate our wedding anniversary in style! We definitely took the advice of our butler Pedro to heart…”don’t worry, be happy”.  Mucho Gracias Royal Service!

Dr. Dave and Johanna

reviews.author: sandsurf15
reviews.title: My experience
reviews.text: No ice machine available due to it being broke. Had to call front desk when we wanted ice. Hard time receiving washcloths and extra towels. Finding drinks after pool area and restraurant closed was very hard. Was only available in a elegant dress lounge or one in the center of hotel area but that one was limited as to what they could make.

reviews.author: Ron S
reviews.title: Anniversary Trip
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at this beautiful hotel !! We were met with friendly, helpful staff members and that same welcoming, appreciative service continued throughout our stay...
We enjoyed Ana and she was so courteous - even though we told her we were not interested in the Melia program.... 
We loved dining at Mole restaurant...Service was great.Loved meeting Rigoberto Ramirez..  Another favorite was Jose Fransisco at Market Grill, and also.....at Vento, we appreciated Katia, Jose, and Aurelio....And Luis at Bana....
We also liked Eder and Arturo at Nao's Breakfast....Christina (Hostess) at Nao's...always pleasant.  ALL staff were excellent...no complaints

reviews.author: Chachi51
reviews.title: Amazingggggggggg!!!!😃😃😃
reviews.text: This place is so beautiful. They take really good care of the grounds beautiful upkeep. The staff is amazing, they cater to your every needs with a smile on their faces. The rooms a spacious with beautiful views. Bathroom is grand. The food is to die for, drinks a done well with top shelf liquor. The multiple pools are big. They cater to couples and families. Great amenities all around. I recommend this place to any one that visits Paradisus. I can't wait to go back and make more memories.

reviews.author: Lady_M1987
reviews.title: Best All Inclusive Vacation Yet!
reviews.text:
Traveled with my sisters and we truly enjoyed our stay through RCI!   We truly got the rest and relaxation we were seeking.   The Resort/Hotel was breathtaking inside and out and everyone on the staff wanted to make sure that we had a wonderful stay and were very receptive to our needs!  When we had a communication problem with our room during check-in, Nancy worked with us to make sure to meet are needs. 

Also, the food was sooo delicious!  There was an assortment of restaurants to select from for lunch and dinner and availability to eat by beach or pool area if you desired!  I had 5 pounds to show for it :-)!  They also had free Wi-Fi so we could stay connected! Also, while on the beach, the attendants Roger and Luis made sure that our group was taken care of with any of our requests!  Would definitely travel there again!  Great atmosphere, service, food and fun!

reviews.author: edc978
reviews.title: Cruz Family Vacation
reviews.text: I enjoyed our stay.  The people were great!  The service was great.  We could not go in the water due to a lot of seaweed.  We were a family of 5 and only swam in the pool because of the seaweed.  The second bathroom was a tight fit getting in and out of the shower.  The full size beds in the second bedroom was not very comfortable, we had to get a bed topper for one of them.  I would bring my family back, the resort is top notch!!!

reviews.author: JRM
reviews.title: Superb Vacation
reviews.text: Great service from all hotel personnel. I felt that every person working at the hotel was doing their best to make my stay enjoyable. Superb service provided by Family Concierge Hervik Lopez. Great facilities. Fantastic buffet dining. I will definitely return.

reviews.author: tntraveler1
reviews.title: First Time at All Inclusive Was Awesome
reviews.text: ITEX had our national convention in Cancun this year at the Paradisus Cancun. We were used to going to Vegas but got really tired of it. This was a great trip. The flight from Atlanta was direct and only about 2 hours. The hotel was awesome. We had a few hiccups in the beginning but all was good. The air conditioning was not working very well but they had someone there in short order and got it fixed. We stated for 7 days and had a great time. The food was good and consistent. We moved around several of the restaurants and sampled several different cuisines. The pool was fantastic. We had great service and enjoyed the cabanas. It is well worth the $50 to get one for the day. The pool bar food was good and easy to get to. They are in their slow season and that's when they do a lot of their repairs and renovations so don't be surprised if some things are closed or not available if you go this time of year. I wasn't a big deal for us so we don't feel we missed too much. The interior lobby of the hotel is not cooled as you would normally expect in the states. It was quite warm and humid. Tropical if you will. But you get used to it quickly and don't really notice it much. At the time of our trip the sea weed was thick. Not the resorts problem but they seem to have that problem quite often in Cancun. The staff was great. Anything we asked for was handled quickly and with a smile. We did tip at dinner and tipped the wait staff at the pool and the assorted bars. It does get their attention. We always were asked first if we needed anything. It's nice to be king. Overall the hotel and the trip was fantastic. We will be back next year.

reviews.author: Michael  J
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun best resort in Cancun thanks to our butler Ramon
reviews.text: The best vacation ever wonderful resort. Our Butler Ramon was the absolute best he is the reason we will be returning and recommending Paradisus Cancun to our friends. It is so convenient to all the tours and shopping Aquaworld is exactly across the street and the bus stop is in front of the resort.

reviews.author: helencX8563TB
reviews.title: Impressive entrance with a tropical ambience
reviews.text: We were greeted with hot towels and a very warm welcome by the staff. The hotel has a central, tropical effect glass dome which is stunning! Room was very spacious, very clean and comfortable with panoramic views. The minibar was kept well stocked too. The main restaurant, Naos, is large and well organised with an excellent variety of food on offer. The other restaurants needed to be booked 24hrs before which worked really well, these offered different cuisines and were also of a high quality (our favourite was Fuego's). The pool area is large and attractive, very well maintained but suffered from the customary 'towels on sunbeds at dawn!'. However this didn't effect us as the beach was idyllic with plenty of beds with thatched canopies etc - beautiful. The gem of this hotel has got to be the staff, they were most helpful all of the time. Special mention to Gerardo Avila (Yerrii) and Santiago at the Toji bar, they make amazing cocktails and are very friendly and welcoming. We would happily return to this lovely hotel.

reviews.author: chrisanddiane93
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation
reviews.text: Little difficulty getting room we NEEDED.  Wife uses cane, cannot walk very far.  Requested room near elevator when reservations made, reinforced this with receptionist, still got room at end of hall away from elevator.  Problem was solved, but took a lot of effort and extra 30 minutes.

reviews.author: vanveen_kaitlyn
reviews.title: A Great First Experience in Mexico
reviews.text:
We recently just came back from our honeymoon in Mexico where we stayed at Pardisus Cancun! The staff were always very friendly and quick to help you. Our ocean view room was gorgeous and very clean! We loved the excellent service at the beach, and were never without a drink in our hands! 

The resorts many restaurants were very enjoyable and I especially loved all the beautiful gardens both indoor and outdoor! 

We took a day to go to the Yhi Spa and were not disappointed by the 55 minute deep tissue massages we got! We left feeling very relaxed.

I would highly recommend this resort and plan on returning very soon! 

Thank you Paradisus Cancun for your warm hospitality!

reviews.author: 515scotsabroad
reviews.title: Fantastic Stay
reviews.text:
Whole experience was fantastic. Staff were incredibly friendly and responsive and nothing was too much trouble - especially by the Royal Service pool.  In particular Jorge, Cesar and Gustavo made our stay very special.

Galdino was fantastic and helped us arrange everything we needed to as well as giving us advice on the local area and what to go and see.

Will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Alan B
reviews.title: Very Nice Hotel but needs some improvements to live up to the 5 star hype!
reviews.text:
Very Nice Hotel! They have a lot of options for dining! Market Grill was very good for lunch and dinner? Bana was excellent! Just beware that the wine and Japanese beer are extra. They did not explain that and I got a $32 charge for 2 glasses of wine and 1 beer. Blue agave is just so so. We enjoyed our stay and but would probably try Live Aqua next time.  The drinks were very good and definitely not watered down. I' like recognize several who gave us excellent service. Most were from the Market Grill, Karla, Arturo, Benito, Marco and Orlando were all awesome. Jorge who helped us at the main pool was the best. He was waiting on many but always there with our next round of drinks. 
There were a three negatives that I must mention. The biggest was the AC. We left our room set on 65 but our room never cooled. We stayed in pyramid 3 which is the biggest and even in the lobby areas it was always hot. The second concern is the music from the night club and shows are loud. The last is the reservations at the restaurants. You must make them the day before or you are stuck with Naos, Blue Agave, or room service. So when you arrive make sure you call and make a reservation first thing. The restaurants were never full so I don't understand why they do allow walk ups. 
The beach was nice but lots of seaweed in the sand. The service was not good.  We spent most of our time at the pool as a result.

reviews.author: nicolecard
reviews.title: Summer vacation
reviews.text:
Awesome time, my kids luv the night shows even though they were short. Bartenders at the pool, GREAT with my family. Thank you to my concierge Martha, always helping me. We went to swim with the dolphins....we luv it!!
I got sick with cough, but I went to a pharmacy across the street, very helpful cough syrup.

reviews.author: Jesenia Q
reviews.title: Third time and still the best!!
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus Cancun for the third time and we still loving this hotel, special shout out to all our bartenders, Rogelio, Francisco, Salvador, Ernesto and their capitain Oniver, gracias, the waiters Martin , Orlando (Naos buffet) no complains, service is outstanding, hotel overall is spotless clean, we loved Paradisus, can't wait to go back.

reviews.author: latiseh
reviews.title: An Amazing and Memorable Honeymoon
reviews.text: My husband and I had an amazing honeymoon thanks to the staff at the Paradisus. We had a beautiful ocean room in the Royal Service area, which was worth the extra cost. The room was beautiful as well as the hotel.

reviews.author: BillovesCarol
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation excellent service at the Paradisus
reviews.text:
My wife and I and my brother & sister in law stayed at the Paradises Resort in Cancun Sept 7 through 14th 2015. It was a wonderful memorable experience. The entire facility to include bedrooms, restaurants, pool area were immaculately clean.  The moment we arrived we were greeted by hotel staff - very nice touch. They had different restaurants. We ate at the Naos, Vento and Market place restaurants. The dinners and the deserts were unbelievable. We want to thank the following employees; Naos - Christina (Black dress) and Jeanette ( orange & white uniform). They greeted us professionally with a great smile. Alberto Lopez and Eder Wilbert were our waiters. The professional attention given to us was extraordinary. They both had the biggest smile and made us feel very comfortable. Vento restaurant - Katia, Rody & Gerardo provided great service.
Housekeeping - my wife and I stayed in room 380X. Our room was impeccably cleaned each day by Teresa.

The Paradisus Resort was highly recommended to us by our Liberty Travel agent Maria Flyntz who has Been our travel agent for several years. Thank you Maria you did it again - great recomendation.

Bottom line - you will be pleased if you select the Paradisus Resort

Bill, Carol, Bud & Marie

reviews.author: MC9856
reviews.title: Not good for those with disabilities
reviews.text: Friendly staff but the hotel is showing its age - needs updating but there is not much that can be done to the uniques architecture that is really unattractive in this day and age.  Restaurants were okay to good but a few people in our group developed stomach issues. Horrible for people using wheelchairs, walkers or canes.  Too many levels.  Too choppy in general.  Very nice staff.

reviews.author: gsmariags
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
reviews.text:
Beautiful hotel, great facilities and overall a very nice experience. The only complaint I had is that the last 2 days of my stay they were fixing the roof and the noise went on until 11pm. I think that was a bit too late for being working on something. Also the paint smell was quite strong inside the room. Nonetheless, when I call front desk to let them know, they offered me to switch rooms. Also the wi-fi was pretty bad...
Regardless, I will definitely go back to this hotel.

reviews.author: Chiqui190
reviews.title: First Time in Mexico, Amazing Experience!
reviews.text: We were initially going to a different resort and when I looked up the reviews on that resort-it was horrible! So we looked on Tripadvisor and came across this hotel. We have never been to any of the Melia Hotels so this was our first. It is definitely a HUGE resort but it was amazing. I was skeptical thinking that service and food was not going to be that great since they had to cater to so many people but it was the exact opposite. For once, the restaurants in the resort had amazing food. Everywhere we've gone, we've had to leave the resort to get good food. The hotel property itself was well kept and maintained. The beach was great-waves were really rough when we went but we made the best of it. The pool area was great and there's plenty of pool space so no one is lumped in and in crowded spaces. We had a great room with King Size bed and great view out to the ocean. I would definitely go back and recommend it to anyone who wants to experience Cancun, especially for the first time. We don't regret our decision at all.

reviews.author: Ioana T
reviews.title: Good service, but quite expensive, feel somewhat captive within the hotel property
reviews.text: I stayed at this hotel for a week (Sept 5-11, 2015)---so off-season, while attending an industry conference that took place at the hotel.  While the quality of the room, service, food were OK I don't see how they delivered the value for money, at a room rate of USD315/night, and I stayed in their executive/special reserve area.  While there is a diversity of restaurants on site, it is quite difficult to make a reservation (they seemed booked all the time), so I expect during the season is almost impossible.  The food at the buffet is OK but nothing special.  The entertainment throughout the hotel was average quality (lots of loud singing) and could have done without.  Prices at the boutique at the hotel are ridiculous (a regular sun lotion Banana Boat was 24 USD).  Concierge staff was very helpful and friendly.   The beach/ocean water had lots of algae so in some days was quite difficult and unpleasant to swim (despite excellent water temperature).  The conference room facilities could have been a lot better (no windows in any of the conference rooms, air conditioning was either freezing cold or not working at all and logistics support was mediocre at best).

reviews.author: buddy shepherd
reviews.title: paraisus cancun mexico
reviews.text:
the hotel was beautiful and the staff is just to wonderful to believe.
Everyone at the paradisus hotel always,always were so  very friendly
and pampered you...we felt like family being there. all the restaurants
were great..If you go there you will need to go on a diet when you get home..
the food was spectacular..At the vento restaurant katia,rody and gerado pampered us.
thank you paradisus cancun for having this great place to vacation.

reviews.author: Koyarzabal
reviews.title: It was nice but I would consider another hotel next time
reviews.text:
Pros: Good location, nice hotel, good atmosphere & good food
Cons: Restaurant reservation open only until 4 pm. Pool bar closes at 6pm (early) When turning off lights at night, the switches to charge cell phones and cameras turns off too. Hotels does not offer shuttle service from/to hotel/airport. 

For tours: Do not book anything at the hotel as the price for tours doubles.

reviews.author: Jbribeiro
reviews.title: Good, but crowd
reviews.text: The facilities of this hotel is very good. However, we have been there on summer time, so it was full of people. In order to get a good place by the pool with umbrella the people woke up earlier or they pay the guys there to put clothes, hats or towels by the chairs in order to hold a place for them. This can be very unpleasant because you are on vacation and you need to worry about this things. They have private cabins, but they charge extra money for that. They also offer you a lot of choices of restaurants. But again, because of the summer time, we only got chance to eat in four different restaurants, because the other were all full when we tried to book.

reviews.author: HonestCanuck
reviews.title: If this is Paradise, please give me Hell
reviews.text: Never having been to an all-inclusive, this first foray is reason enough to never again repeat.  The hotel is dated.  Burning inscence is understandable from time to time, but can't help but wonder if the inscence was used to cover up the odor of college co-eds and on-the-cheap snow birds.  My partner and I booked last minute and paid a bundle - $10 000 Canadian for one week.  A complete joke from beginning to end.  I love Cancun, and the people, but this hotel is a disaster.  I couldn't help but think it was born out of a sad fantasy hybrid of The Love Boat and Fantasy Island. The food is mediocre at best.  The service is little better.  Kids abound.  Cancun has so many great resorts...this isn't one of them.

reviews.author: Tracey K
reviews.title: Amazing Paradisus Vacation Experience!!!
reviews.text:
We just returned from an 11 day stay for our 25th Wedding Anniversary and had the best vacation of our lives. This was our first time in Mexico and we hit the jackpot when booking this resort! It really is as beautiful as the photos:-)

We stayed in the Royal Service section and it was top notch! We would highly recommend it! The service was outstanding, the staff were very friendly and helpful and I must give a shout out, first and foremost, to our butler, Pedro!!!! He took care of our every need, went the extra mile, and took the time and attention to get to know us, which meant a lot. Pedro is a hard worker, very personable, and the kind of person we want taking care of us! At the Naos restaurant, we were always greeted with a friendly smile and open arms by Marco-he will make you the best cappuccino and make you feel at home. Edgar at Vento surprised us with a special Anniversary cake and attended to our every need while we were dining there. Did I mention that the food was 5 star, delicious, and extraordinary? Our favorite restaurant was Fuego and every waiter and helper we encountered rocked! This place has the best flank steak ever! Not to mention the coconut crème brulee' and seafood. Moises was our favorite waiter at the pool-he was a lot of fun and was very attentive to our needs. In fact, service at the Bali Beds was exceptional because people like Moises, Raphael, Eddie, Allesandro, and Gustavo were always there to take care of you! These guys really know what customer service means! Allesandro even brought us drinks to the ocean when we were getting our feet wet!

In conclusion, Paradisus exceeded our expectations in many ways. Checking in and out was very easy, the restaurants were exquisite and tasty, the Yhi Spa (we had a couples massage that was most excellent), the pool and beaches were great, the resort was very clean, and we had the best butler service! 

The only suggestion I would make is to maybe have ceiling fans in the hallways in the Royal Service area. We understand the need to have humidity for all of the lush and beautiful foliage, but I think some better air circulation would help.

reviews.author: Maricela L
reviews.title: Hot hotel (Literally)
reviews.text: This hotel is eye candy...beautiful interior and exterior...that said..the hotel is hot...once you leave your room prepare to sweat...everywhere else in the hotel is an inferno...workers are not friendly...every time we would ask for something there was an excuse as to why they couldn't comply with us...One waitress flat out told us she would not return to attend us because our group was too big...I could make a list of all the times we were mistreated...but instead I'll suggest you pay the extra money and stay at The Hard Rock Hotel...now that is bang for you buck!

reviews.author: Ivette R
reviews.title: Everything was perfect!
reviews.text:
We had our destination wedding here in early May, and they absolutely exceeded all of our expectations. Their customer service is exceptional, and they ensured not only that our wedding day went flawlessly, but our that our entire week stay and guests' stay was amazing as well. 

Food- I would rate it a 10 out of 10! They have many restaurants there and all the food was so good. I think our favorite place was the sushi restaurant in the middle of the pyramid. Also, 24 hour room service, which is included, is a good plus for those late nights

Ambiance - The scenery is so beautiful, everything is meticulous and they really take care of their property. You feel like you've walked into the middle of the Mayan jungle with the vines coming down from the ceiling - it's really cool! I would describe it like a jungle spa ambiance, because you walk in and feel immediately relaxed.

Night Life- They don't have much of a night life, but because we were in a big group, it was perfect. They have a hookah/bar lounge outside facing the ocean which is great for an evening drink. And later, they open up the Red Lounge inside the resort where there's a DJ playing top 40. It's small, but like I said, if you're with a group of friends, that's all you need!

Family Friendly- This is the best of both worlds. We were really struggling trying to find a place that allowed children, but that wasn't bombarded by running-kids. This location has the family concierge where you have activities for kids and a kids zone. If you're going for a romantic get-away, you can stay at the adults only Royal Service pyramid where they have a private pool, restaurant and beach area for you. We stayed in this pyramid while all of our guests stayed in the regular pyramids, so we were able to have some alone time while still hanging out with our guests anytime we left our pyramid. 

Customer Service - This place truly went above and beyond for us. I could go on and on about this, but the best example is that when my husband (the groom) was getting ready with his groomsmen, it turned out that one of the groomsmen's pants were too big. The room concierge actually left the resort to find a tailor to fix them! No complaints, no excuses, just solutions. I think that was the most impressive thing we encountered. He got his pants just in time before they left to the ceremony. phew!

reviews.author: Cindariv
reviews.title: On a trip with my sister
reviews.text: As we arrived to cancun we did not know what to expect from this new resort . It was completely amazing the service here is outstanding they make you feel like royalty indeed in royal services . We had the best waiters which were Pablo at breakfast and Guillermo at dinner they never failed to outshine in their service. My parents will be coming soon and I'm sure to let them know to look for Pablo and Guillermo to attend them . Nothing but great memories and service here I highly recommend this resort to people who are trying to get away from the party scene . I hope people enjoy their stay here as we did ours .

reviews.author: pani a
reviews.title: Cancun
reviews.text:
This is a great hotel with excellent services and very friendly staff. 
Highly recommended for family. If you are traveling as a couple with no kids, I'd not recommend to stay here because the pool is full of kids.... Definitely hotel needs to have an adult only pool. But overall I had a great experience and enjoyed every minutes of my stay.

reviews.author: Sarah W
reviews.title: Beautiful in paradise
reviews.text: I was there at the end of August 2015, despite the weather it was more than I can ask for in vacation. Place was squeaky clean, staff was overly helpful, service was exceptional. Only tip that I have to recommend is to make your reservations to restaurant as soon as you get there, otherwise its a hassle to get in to the nicer restaurants. Even though the buffet was more than enough, I would have liked to try more restaurants. But that was my fault for not reserving as soon as possible. If you eat at NAOS restaurant/buffet please ask for Rafael Chi, he was unbelievable. Unlike the other waiters, he was accommodating beyond his title as a waiter and you knew he did it because he wanted to and not for the tip money like the other staff. So please ask for Rafael, you will be satisfied. I will most definitely revisit paradisus Cancun. The hotel is so beautiful, peaceful and zen. It was probably the most beautiful, best staff and most fun I've had on a vacation.

reviews.author: Michael S
reviews.title: Literally it's a paradise!!!!
reviews.text:
It's a fantastic place with high-quality hospitality and service. I haven't ever experienced this kind of service before. You can meet very diverse people and service here. I'd like to recommend to stop by the Bana restaurant,a sushi restaurant, It's really good!!
And do not forget to call Mr. Darwin,he is really smart and quick sighted guy,he knows how make the customer really be happy and satisfied. Just call his name at reception.

reviews.author: carmen h
reviews.title: I CANT WAIT TO GO BACK
reviews.text: It was my first time in Cancun, and I absolutely love it, the hotel is really a 5 stars, everything is nice about the Paradisus, you really feel like you're in paradise, the restaurants, pool, the room nice and clean all the time ad the best is the people who work in all the aras, especially at the restaurants and by the pool, they make you feel like you're

reviews.author: Josie R
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun was the best looking resort on the entire strip of hotels. It's beautiful!!! the lobby is breathe taking it looks like you're in a rain forest. The minute you walk in they great you with towels and are very nice. My boyfriend and I got to the hotel before check in and were worried that our room wouldn't be ready BUT IT WAS!! we didn't have to wait or anything. Now when it comes to food the breakfast is very good. For lunch and dinner we both like Market Grill. My boyfriend LOVED the paella (it's a seafood rice) that they serve near the pool for lunch. We weren't to excited about dinner I think that would be the only reason why I wouldn't give it 5 stars. The pool boy Hector was great! He was always soooo happy and helpful. Even in the hot sun in the middle of the day he had a smile. The bartender Jeison was fantastic too! He made the most amazing and delicious drinks.

Our room was very nice as well and they always do their rounds to make sure you have enough towels to last you for the night. Our cleaning lady Neicole was very nice too.

Overall, My boyfriend and I wouldn't mind coming back. Thank you Paradisus Cancun and there wonderful Staff.

reviews.author: brooke b
reviews.title: I want to live there!
