reviews.text: This was an excellent experience!  The staff was amazing!  Rodrigo, Emilio, Omar, Valeria, Lupita, Octavio and everyone else couldn't have been more awesome! I would recommend this to everyone!  The rooms were fantastic.  The energy at the resort was so positive and warm!

reviews.author: Dottie W
reviews.title: royal service paradisus cancun
reviews.text: i am a travel agent from nc and i just returned from paradisus cancun staying in royal service - this is a secret 5 star hotel  one of the best vacations i have ever taken everything was perfect rooms  staff ect--------- one of the concierge in particulate   Leticia Patlaw Rosas was so kind and hard working --- everything i asked for including one almost impossible dinner reservation was worked out for me by her --- her smiling face and her energy to make our stay perfect leaves a lasting  memory . i would recommend this hotel to any of my clients !!! Our favorite resistant was MOLE - we ate there two times the hardest working waiter ever was  Javier Salazar he went above and beyond our expectation best waiter in all of mexico i think !!!  the hostess Sandra and  captain Jesus  at MOLE also did many things xtra to enhance our experience even bring us the mariachi  band to serenade the 6 of us in the private dineing room !!!! Chef Irvin Huerta made the most Delicious Mexican dishes i have ever tasted -- i am a mexico specialist and have stayed at every Paradises mexico and Dominican republic this one Paradisus Cancun  was by far the best experience in Royal service  i have ever had !!!

reviews.author: Melissa M
reviews.title: Very Nice Resort
reviews.text:
Very clean and attentive to guest. Loved the pool area and the swim up bar. Lots of lounge chairs , but you must get up early to get one. The beach area is very nice and waiters are very attentive to you . I never went without a drink.
Lots of restaurants to choose from. Gym was very nice and offered classes which was nice. Rooms are comfortable. Only complaint is that there were no table and chairs on our balcony. I love to seat outside at night :((.And drink my coffee outside in morning. We took the bus to a few places which was easy and only cost a 1.00 . Much cheaper that a tax.

reviews.author: Justice666
reviews.title: Terrible experience. Super disappointed and regret. Waste money and time.
reviews.text:
DO NOT STAY at Paradisus Cancun! You will be wasting you money and time while receiving disappointment. It is a lot worse than a 4.5 star hotel.

Here are the reasons:

1. Super Bad Service: The hotel staff are showing very unwelcoming and impatient attitude, unless you tipping them. The dinner restaurants were hard to book, so mostly of the time we had to eat at the buffet or outside the hotel. This is not convenient for ppl who want to relax and enjoy their vacation.

2. Slow Check-in: It took us at least 1.5 hours to do the check-in and get the room key. The staff pushed us to accept a room near the noisy restaurants, otherwise we had to wait another 30 mins for the other room to be cleaned.

3. Aggressive Sales of the Hotel Membership: We were invited to so-called 'a tour of the hotel', but it was totally a lie, which wasted us almost 4 hours in the morning. In fact, they were trying to sell a $43K USD membership to us. When we refused to buy it, they still kept pushing. They even said that we were giving excuses to them and joked that they will kick us out from the hotel. 

4. Money Gone: One day, we left $5USD on our bed to thank the maid for cleaning up the room. When we went back at 3pm, the room was still uncleaned, but the money was gone!!! Obviously, someone other than the maid had come to our room and took the money. It was so ridiculous and unacceptable.

5. Food is tasteless and low quality. Drinks are watery.

My husband and I went to Paradisus Cancun to celebrate our 1st Anniversary. Our trip got ruined by this hotel. We will never return and won't recommend our friends and family to come.

This is not our first time visiting Cancun. With this price, you deserve a hotel with much better ocean view, facilities, service and food.

Hope my review can help you avoid mistake.

reviews.author: Laura C
reviews.title: Wish I was still there!
reviews.text: My husband and I traveled to Paradisus Cancun with another couple in March and we never left the resort!  As soon as we arrived, we were so happy we had chosen Paradisus Cancun.  Everything about the lobby was great – the look, the people, the foliage, even the smell.  We had a nice little welcome speech on a comfortable couch but there was never any pressure to upgrade or purchase anything additional.  It was merely an informational session about everything our resort had to offer and how to navigate the property.  Our rooms were very spacious and the view from the balcony was beautiful!  One small complaint – we saw that our friends room had lounge chairs on the balcony but we did not.  We asked a few times if we could get chairs but they never arrived so we just pulled the chairs from the room out onto the balcony.  Other than that, the staff was very friendly and accommodating.  We would begin our day with the breakfast buffet which was vast!  We really had so many food options, as well as a bloody mary bar, mimosas, drink specials, etc.  Our days were spent mostly by the pool, just relaxing and enjoying the beautiful weather and views.  We especially enjoyed Christian and his crew of bartenders at the swim-up pool bar.  They were absolutely fantastic and we truly felt like they cared about us.  They really went out of their way to be friendly and make sure we were very well taken care of.  And the premium top-shelf spirits were part of the all-inclusive package as well as several wine options.  At lunchtime, we would stroll over to La Perla where they would set up a really laid-back buffet.  You could fill a plate and stay there to eat or take it right back to your poolside area.  We are still talking about the guacamole & salsa, which became our signature lunch during our stay.  Unfortunately, we were never able to have dinner at La Perla because of the limited nights it is open.  I’m guessing that they might host private events such as weddings or special celebrations at La Perla which would explain the limited dinner seatings.  We did try several restaurants for dinner and enjoyed them all.  I have to say that some of them were a bit warm, especially after spending all day in the sun, so the air could be a bit cooler in the restaurants.  But a beach walk after dinner would make you completely forget that you might have been a little warm during dinner.  And there was a lovely bar on the beach that was a great place to be in the evening.  We met so many fantastic people and would highly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: ali a
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation with my family
reviews.text:
My wife and 4 kids (ages 19, 17, 16 & 9) were at Paradisus Cancun the last week of August 2015. This resort is beautiful and very relaxing. It really exceeded our expectations starting from service, cleanliness & activities. Staff were very courteous. We had 2 rooms (one lagoon view and one oceanic). Lagoon room is nice but oceanic one is nicer and strongly recommended. Both rooms were clean and were served remarkably. 

There are 9 restaurants: 2 don't need reservations and the other do (more than 24 hours to reserve in advance -- that's the only drawback).

In general, it is an excellent resort and would highly recommend.

reviews.author: enaughton
reviews.title: Amazing, Beautiful, Carefree!
reviews.text:
I recently visited the Paradisus Cancun with 6 of my girlfriends and I can say we all had an amazing experience at Paradisus. From the moment I checked in, Ramon, our concierge, helped us check in, offered us beverages, made us smile, and was helpful from beginning to end. He was on top of every little detail we needed, from cabanas each day to restaurant reservations. He checked in on us frequently to make sure we were all well taken care of and happy! 

Everyone at Paradisus was so friendly, accommodating, and genuinely made me feel like they cared about each and every one of us. The food was great, pool was amazing, and the restaurants, So good! They knew I had a large party there for my bachelorette and would accommodate us to have a nice large table or even a private room. 

All of our rooms were clean, air conditioned and had a fully stocked bar. The pool was amazing as well as the service at the pool. 

Overall, this resort was amazing and especially thanks to Ramon, our concierge! He helped our trip go so smooth, without a care in the world! I can't wait to go back!!

reviews.author: lovingthebeach2015
reviews.title: "Beautiful relaxing wish I was still there"
reviews.text: The resort was great. The food and atmosphere was first class breath taking. Stayed for a week with my family of 4. Niki was our concierge and she was the best!!!! She took care of everything from the littlest detail to the biggest. She truly cared about making us happy and stress free. By the time we left I felt like i was leaving a family member. CAN'T wait to go back and I hope that we will be able to get Niki again.

reviews.author: Stay296837
reviews.title: TOP NOTCH!!!
reviews.text: This resort by far exceeded our expectations!!  The food was exceptional & the staff (especially Chris) was perfect!!  The restaurants & bars are a little warm, so dress comfortable. A word of advise...GET THE ROYAL SERVICE, it is VERY well worth the cost.  NO kids & you are literally treated like royalty!!

reviews.author: melissabero
reviews.title: Beautiful vacation!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun 8/24/15-8/31/15 to celebrate our anniversary.  We have been to Cancun before but have always stayed in the Mayan Riviera and not the hotel zone.  I prefer the Riviera Maya but I will say this hotel is beautiful!  It is very large consisting of 5 pyramids.  We stayed in building 4 on the third floor overlooking the ocean.  The rooms are standard with a king size bed, sofa, small table and chairs as well as a balcony.  Very clean and each day was well maintained.  Fridge was always refilled and never had to worry about towels.  (Tip the maid). Air conditioning in room was great.  The hotel has a beautiful atrium in the main pyramid consisting of vines and foliage.  It is very humid inside hotel when not in your room or restaurants.. Could have been the time of year we traveled there.  The main restaurant buffet Naos is excellent.   Breakfast, lunch, and dinner had many choices and was always good.   We ate at specialty restaurant La Perla twice and it was excellent.  Especially the service and conversation with our waiter, Aldolfo.  There is a shortage of restrooms in the lobby of the hotel and for the size of the hotel.  Also no restrooms within the main buffet so had to leave restaurant to walk down hall to find one and the week we were there it was closed for renovations so had to go up a floor to use bathroom.  No big deal but it would be for an elderly person.  The pool is nice but in the scale of the hotel should be bigger but with that said the hotel is in the hotel zone and property outside is not as big as in the Riviera Maya.  Pool was clean but very warm (as in bath water warm).  We honestly didn't use pool much as we prefer the beach.   Pool is loud and crowded.  We got up at 6:30 every morning to reserve a beach hut as is so in every resort we ever stayed in before in order to get a seat.   We never had a problem getting our chairs.  We did arrive to our hut by 8 every day but was obviously not the case with most people.  Chairs sat reserved for hours some even into mid day before people would arrive to use them.   Our waiter at the beach, Jorge, was excellent.  We always made sure to tip him for his service throughout the day.  Speaking of tips..many people don't unfortunately and not really sure why.   The resort is all-inclusive BUT you are being served by waiters to make your stay relaxing and easy.  We never once had to walk down the beach for a drink, never had poor service at any restaurants etc. so out of courtesy to the people waiting on you leave a tip!   The resort also has a spa which is fabulous.  I never indulged in spa services at a resort before but did this time and it was worth every penny!  My 50 minute aromatherapy massage included an additional hour of pampering in the sauna, rain shower, and relaxation pool.  Again service was great.  The staff at this hotel is very friendly and very courteous to make your stay what you hope it will be.   Our checkout was fast...but check in was not.   Only 3 receptionists available which is not a lot when shuttles are arriving.  We arrived around 11:00 am and room was not ready until 4.  We did know to ask for a change room in order to go to beach..but that was not suggested to us.  Upon checkout Raul was so friendly and talkative while we waited for shuttle back to the airport.   He Asked about our stay and if we were celebrating anything which led to a great conversation with an awesome gentleman!As is the feelings of most people, your trip is special to you but the staff here make it special to them.  I would definitely stay at a Paradisus again and heard there is one in Riviera Maya so will be anxious to try it!

reviews.author: Colin D
reviews.title: Brilliant 10 days stay
reviews.text:
Had a fantastic 10 days and loved stopping at this hotel.
We were in a lagoon view room and traveled mid May. We arrived at the hotel along with another couple. The hotel consists of 5 pyramid shaped buildings. We were greeted by the concierge who got a baggage guy to take our bags. Then shown to the check in desk which went smoothly. We were given a woven wrist band with a piece of wood as our all-inclusive band. Which is better than the usual bright coloured plastic affairs you normally get at other hotels. Off to our room and our bags arrived about 5 mins later. The guy told us of the room safe and also about the restaurants we needed to book and gave us the phone number to do this. First impressions we thought it was too large a hotel and rather dark. But that all disappeared once we had been there a few days.
	Over our time there we found the hotel was divided into 3 areas. In one outer pyramid building is the time share part. We saw time share meetings a few times but were never hassled to go to one of these. The other outer pyramid was for the Royal service hotel guests. You get a swipe card to access this area. Then the main middle pyramid houses most of the restaurants. There is the main restaurant which has all the food you can eat and most is good quality. As with most places some of the food does get luke warm. But then we would moan if it was burned due to being too hot. Other than the main restaurant you have to book at the others. 
	We tried the main Naos (International), Market grill, Mole (Mexican), Fuego (Latin fusion), Bana (Asian fusion) all were excellent with good staff. We did get missed in the Fuego for being served the right food but they made up for it. The Blue Agave Taco place is just for a quick nibble if you are feeling a little peckish. If you are English don’t expect your usual fry up breakfast as your abroad and you won’t get it. You can get a lovely freshly made omelette with your choice of fillings. You grab a small bowl load in what bits you want and then give it over the counter to be cooked. Overall food was of a high standard for our 10 nights there. The market grill is food served off skewers they bring to your table. You get a disc with red on one side and green on the other. Leave green showing and they keep serving you. Once full turn it over to red and they stop. Then all you need to eat is dessert and wobbly coffee. Bana was our first taste of sushi and it was lovely. We let our waiter chose most of the food for us and he chose well. 
	Outside you have a choice of pools and the beach. We tried the main pool for a few days with our sun beds. You have Bali beds but quite a few of these are for the time share people. If you do want a hotel one you would prob need to book the day you get there or try to book before you get there. But once the loud American drunks took over the swim up bar it became very noisy. So we then moved to the beach and all you can hear are the waves breaking. We never used the swim up bar as far too over crowded. There is an adult’s only pool but that was near the all day music so not to our taste. As with most hotels you need to reserve your sun bed to get a good one. We were out by the sun beds at 0700 each morning and quite a few had already been reserved. We did see that some Americans (the accent gives them away so not picking on them for the sake of it) reserve sun beds by the pool and on the beach. Once they didn't touch their beach sun beds all day. Also on the beach one couple reserved 6 sunbeds around them so no one would go near them. Later after lunch they would remove the extra towels. From 1000 the staff arrive and bring everyone cold bottles of water. Then after this the look after you all their shift. Once they get to know your drinking habits you hardly ever have to ask for anything as they just bring it to you. 
	The room was cleaned daily and the bedding was always changed and the mini fridge topped up. You get a personnel concierge for your time there on the end of the phone. You ring them and they will book you your chosen restaurant that needs booking. Once they found out it was my wife’s birthday we had some extras left in the room. We had balloons, streamers and a cake with fruit left for us. Our Virgin travel rep was great. Told us of buses and things to do and didn't try the hard sell of tours. We did do one tour and that was the romantic evening meal on a boat. This was for my wife’s birthday and was worth every penny. Great surf and turf with steak and lobster. Each evening they have entertainment in the Avenue bar. We went to them every night and they were all good. 
	Now to the small problems we had while there. Our safe didn't work as checked out by the baggage guy with our room card and his one. He rang to get someone up and they said 10 mins. After 30 mins we left as after travelling most of the day we were hungry and went the restaurant. This was fixed the next day but you need to remain in the room and wait for them as it’s to do with the safe. On coming back to the room on the night we had no working outside light. They attempted to fix this the next day but it failed again and was left hanging. Also when we went to bed the lights behind the bed wouldn't turn off. I had to turn off the main power switch to get them off. Luckily the air con is on a different circuit. This was never sorted out. We had a large balcony but couldn't use it as no table or chairs. On speaking to reception we were told there are not enough tables and chairs to go round. 
	Overall this was a great holiday and hotel. We normally go out on the nights even if all inclusive. But this hotel had everything we needed. Tip the waiters and beach staff and they will love you. You get quite a few weddings here which goes to show it’s a popular place. Its also good to watch the weddings.

reviews.author: misscarlas
reviews.title: Detailed 9 day stay... with children 1 and 4 yrs old.
reviews.text:
First impression- GREAT!  Checking in was great! We enjoyed taking advantage of the space dedicated for families in the family concierge area. Staff is amazing, seriously all around the hotel everyone is so incredibly polite and sweet with our children. Everyone won us over. Staff were one of our favorite parts of this hotel.  Ramon was our butler and was top notch, I know we didn't experience any other butler but I would ask specifically for him in a e-mail to the hotel prior to you coming! I would recommend getting the family concierge service to get the butler service. He was able to book all of our reservations and that was one stress we didn't have to worry about. Yummy smells throughout the hotel and it just felt like paradise!

Children- I was a bit frustrated that they group 1-5 yr olds in what looks like the infant room. My son is 4 and I thought he could hang with the older ones but they wouldn't allow it. The baby club was just too immature for him. Staff in the baby club made it fabulous for him and spent 1:1 time with him. Much of the time there wasn't any kids to play with his age but he still had a good time. We also left my 1 yr old there so we could enjoy a dinner together every night. Baby club staff are so sweet and seem to love their jobs. We were so grateful to feel confident in them and relaxed while eating our dinner together. We  occasionally left both kiddos down there to enjoy the spa "water treatment" which is also included in the family concierge. That is such a great time to really relax with your spouse. 

Food- #1 restaurant FUEGO! Seriously this place is de-lish! We ate there several times and got to know one of the waiters- Ivan. He was very personable and such a great waiter. He was prompt, polite, and taught us a bit about the country, and food. 
All the other restaurants were pretty good as well. Food is very important to me on vacation and we've been to several all inclusive resorts. This resort had all around good food! #2 Restaurant was Mole for us- I'm wanting the stuffed pablano chile and for dessert the goat cheese ice cream  right now! 
Room Service was very prompt and good as well. 
Grill by the pool.... not our favorite. But there is the buffet inside everyday and we enjoyed the fresh selection and different choices daily. 
Drinks were always made quickly and good! We weren't big drinkers on this trip but enjoyed some good wine and liked many of the welcome drinks.

Performances- Awesome! Worth going :) Tons of kids so go early to get a seat. 

A few negatives....
1) I only took a few hot showers. I had to call 2x and it was after a cold shower. Moms.... giving cold baths is no Bueno so this didn't go over well with me. 
 2) We ended up having a sick baby for 36 hours with diahhrea and a fever. I really needed room service to come and change linens and restock our fridge. I called and explained I needed someone asap while we left for 30 minutes on a walk just to get her out of the room for a minute and get medicine. We came back to much disappointment. I called again and someone came up immediately once I spoke to a manager. 
3) Balcony's weren't swept off. Sounds cavalier but I have a 1 year old and she likes to put everything in her mouth. 

Overall- We would recommend this resort and would go back again in a heart beat. We've just been home for 2 days now and am already missing Paradise.

reviews.author: Raghda S
reviews.title: Wonderful Stay
reviews.text: I just got back from a 5-day stay at the Paradisus Cancun Resort and I already want to go back. We stayed at the Junior Lagoon View Suite. We had a pretty cool view of the ocean on the opposite side of the strip.The staff was super friendly, the food was wonderful, the room was pretty and clean, the pool and swim-up bar were great. The pool is so big that even with a lot of people there, it doesn't feel over crowded. This was my first all-inclusive trip and it was a great one! Thank you Paradisus :)

reviews.author: thefoxcla
reviews.title: Love it
reviews.text: Just returned from a weeks stay. We love everything about it. Check in was fast. Room was ready when we got there. We choose the royal service because it was the 2 of us. Sergio was our butler and he did an excellent job. The food was amazing. The entertainment at night was good. The hotel was in a good location. We didn't need a car. We caught the bus to get downtown and to the different markets. We tried the different restaurants but Naos was our favorite.  Room service was very good also.

reviews.author: Arthur
reviews.title: This place is Great!
reviews.text:
We stayed in building 3 on the top floor overlooking the lagoon. We had a nice big balcony and the shower was awesome! 
This was the 1st time we did all inclusive. There were two restaurants that you did not need reservations and 5 more that you did. There was also the Sunset Grill by the main pool where you could have lunch. The food was always good and the service amazing! 
The place was always clean and the beach was was wonderful! Make sure you stop and see Carla at Guest Services near the elevator on the 1st floor and she will set you up on a catamaran trip and snorkeling to Isla Mujeres!
We would definitely go back to this resort!

reviews.author: Katiesmom07
reviews.title: Wonderful Resort--Plenty of Details!
reviews.text:
We just got back from our fabulous vacation in Cancun.  We have been to Cancun many times, although this is only the second resort we have ever been to.  We really enjoyed the resort we previous we went to, but looked for a new one this year due to it closing for renovations.  We are very glad we did!  We have many details to share to hopefully help you in choosing this resort.

First, since we did not bring our children this year, we did upgrade to Royal Service.  Upon check-in, we were taken to a nearby waiting area and were immediately offered a drink.  We waited there only a few minutes before someone came to escort us to the more private Royal Service check-in area.  We got information about the resort on our walk there.  Once in that area, we were given a cold washcloth to cool down and offered yet another drink. (Just to mention a few names, great service from Eduardo, Rodrigo, Leticia and Maria).  We were checked in quickly, but because of our early arrival (noon), our room wasn't ready yet.  Check-in time is 3pm, so we had no problem with that.  We were introduced to our butler who took us to a restaurant so we could eat lunch while we waited.  After we ate, we were taken to our room.  

Our butler was Rode.  He was extremely friendly and always eager to please us.  We didn't ask for many big things, but the one major thing we asked for, he came through and it was absolutely perfect!  He made all of our dinner reservations for us and even searched us out if we hadn't told him where we wanted to go.  He also reserved our Bali Beds for us on the days we requested and gave us beds in the section we asked for.

We asked for Bali Beds in a certain section because we had the absolute BEST waiter we have ever had during any Cancun-resort stay.  His name is Rafael Medina and we cannot say enough words of praise about him.  On our first day, he actually paid attention to us and came to US while we were simply cooling off in the pool.  He asked if we needed anything, asked our names and what we wanted to drink.  From that moment on, our cups were never empty, and we never had to ask.  We asked for our Bali Beds to be in his service areas both days we booked one.  He always came to us and made sure we never were in need of anything,  We highly recommend searching him out if you go to the Royal Service Pool. 

Our room--Seventh (highest)  floor, ocean view.  The king size bed was amazingly comfortable.  It was soft as were the sheets and the comforter was a light down.  The fridge was a mini-bar stocked with waters, juices, beer, plain m&ms and lays chips.  There were also 4 complimentary bottles of liquor (tequilla, rum, whiskey and vodka) in the room which we were given the option to change out for something we'd want.  We always had plenty of towels and bathroom supplies and they also provided a very nice beach/pool bag to use while you are there.   

There are elevators which we never had to wait long for, but there are also a ton of steps in this resort.  There are elevators and ramps to get you around if you need them.  As long as you remember that each tower has it's own set of elevators and the floor to travel on to get easily across the resort is floor 1, you will be fine.  Tower 5 though, which is the Royal Service tower is 'offset' and floor 2 in that tower is level with floor 1 in the rest of the towers.  (It took us a couple times to figure that out.  Lol.)

During your travels/walks inside the hotel, you will always smell incense burning and you will be warm.  There is little a/c in the main parts of the resort, I'm assuming to keep the environment suitable for the preservation of the many plants, vines and koi ponds throughout the inside of the resort.  The a/c in our room also was not the best.  We had it set as low as possible (65 degrees Fahrenheit) and in my estimation, I'd say it never got down to even 75.  It was a very hot week that we went, but there also is a large gap at the bottom of your door to your room and they are thin doors.

That will bring me to the noise level in the hotel.  Since we were in tower 5, we did not hear anything at all from the main tower 3.  We did, however, hear pretty much everything from within tower 5.  They had wonderful evening music some nights (i.e. singing, violin) in our tower which we heard easily within our room with the door shut.  This did not bother us at all as it was always a shorter, early-evening performance, maybe 7:30-8:30ish.  But, since they also serve food in the tower, we also heard every dish clink while serving and setting up and clearing tables.  Every tower is wide open with the access to the rooms around the outer edge.

There was also nightly entertainment in the main tower, but we are early-nighters and only passed by as people filed in when we were on our way to our room.  

Pools--we never had a problem finding a chair for our things, but we aren't picky about that either.  We don't lay in the sun.  Towels are provided in abundance.  The Bali Beds at the Royal Service Pool are free and you are guaranteed one for two days of your stay.  They are very comfortable and provide much-needed shade.  We were even able to eat lunch while lounging.  There are two other pools, one small one and one extremely large one that runs the length of three towers in the resort.  At the far end of the large one, there is a baby/toddler section.  Other than that, the pools are mainly 5-6 feet deep and are at a very nice warmer temperature.  The large one does have a swim-up bar and it gets shallow in that area and also in little 'inlets' that are like hot-tubs, but with the same temperature of water.  You never have to worry about having your own space.   

We didn't spend much time on the beach, but it was beautiful.  We had a stormy day toward the end of our trip which brought in a LOT of seaweed, but that couldn't have been helped.  There were always plenty of people swimming and there was always a lifeguard on duty.

Restaurants--everyone has different tastes, so these are only our opinions.  First, you will see prices on all menus.  Don't worry, those prices are only for those guests with red bracelets who didn't book all-inclusive.  Also, dress code is very relaxed.  I wore clean flip flops every night with my dress and it was acceptable.  My husband wore cargo/dress shorts and a polo with dressier sandals.

Blue Agave--no reservations required--our waiter was Jorge and he was great.  He had a wonderful personality and was very friendly.  This was a very simple meal of mexican-style soft-shell tacos and quesadillas.  They are absolutely delicious!  They will recommend that you choose 4-5 things from the menu as they are small.

Mole--our waiter was Alex (some call him Luis, but he prefers Alex as it is on his nametag).  His was an exceptional waiter.  Make sure you tell him you want to do the 'ice cream challenge'.  It's great!  The food is amazing, some spicy.  My husband had the grouper and I had the mahi-mahi.  

Vento--Our waiter was Juan, who had a great sense of humor!  He gave great recommendations and the food was our favorite!  We highly recommend you get the butter-fish and bruschetta.  Again, they will tell you to order 2 starters, a salad and two entrees since portions are small.

Market Grill--we did not particularly enjoy this restaurant because it was VERY hot (temperature).  I asked for a wet towel and they brought me dry paper towels.  The food was par except for the NY Strip, which was great, but we didn't stay long since we couldn't eat due to the heat.

Fuego--this was also a very warm restaurant.  We also had to wait an VERY long time for our food even though we only saw 3 or 4 other tables with people.  In the end, the sirloin and flank steaks that we ordered were good, but I wasn't able to eat much.

Buffet--we ate here for breakfast.  It is a wonderful breakfast buffet, especially the made-to-order omelet stations.  We also had lunch there one day and it was quite good.

LaPalapa--Royal Service Restaurant--for breakfast our waitress was Guadaloupf (hope I spelled that right) and she was amazingly friendly.  She provided wonderful service and the food came quick and was delicious.  This is also where we ordered our lunch from from our Bali Beds and/or the Royal Service Pool.  They absolutely have the best chicken wings on the planet.  The other food was good as well.

Sunset Grill--It is the grill beside the main pool.  We only tried this once, so we knew what it was like for when we bring our kids in the future.  The food is always ready and you can come and go as you please getting any amount of food.  The cheeseburgers, wings, fries and salads were great.

Bana---we didn't go there because we aren't sushi people.

A few final pieces of advice--

TIP!!  They say you don't have to, but do it anyway.  It doesn't have to be a ton, but respect that they work their butts off to serve us on our vacations.  Without them, our vacations would be terrible!!!  If you want your vacation to be better, TIP!!    

Learn some Spanish.  It doesn't have to be perfect, but at least try.  You're going to their country, at least try to speak their language.  They appreciate it, and we should just do it out of respect.  They are providing us with a wonderful vacation, we can at least try to speak their language.

We were approached only twice during our vacation about becoming Club Melia members.  We politely refused and were not pushed any further.  If your are approached and have no interest, just be polite, it's their job.  

There is an Expedia agent in an office right beside the regular check-in counter.  We highly recommend booking your excursions through that office.  They can give you discounts and book cheaper than the guy at the desk in the hotel or the Aqua Tours Hut by the pool.

reviews.author: nplechy
reviews.title: Great Family Vacation at Paradisus
reviews.text:
My husband and two kids (ages 5 and 1) and I really enjoyed our stay at Paradisus Cancun. We stayed in the 3rd tower, family concierge. After reading other reviews, I was nervous that the our room would be noisy since this is where they have the nightly shows, but we couldn't hear anything. Our king bed was comfortable and our daughter didn't complain about the sofa bed. The room was a little on the small side, but we had a beautiful view of the ocean and pool.

People got up extremely early to reserve chairs with umbrellas, so they'd all be taken by the time we got to the pool, but we didn't let this ruin our time, we reserved bali beds (for a fee) so we could get some shade.

Breakfast buffet was great, and we enjoyed most of the dinners (especially Market Grill and Fuego), but we didn't care for the lunch. Sunset Grill served food buffet style by the pool, and you could order pizzas made fresh, but it was the same selection every day. I would have liked to have seen some Mexican food for lunch instead of hot dogs and hamburgers. Naos, the main buffet, had better selection, but you couldn't wear just a bathing suit. I also wished the restaurants had more dinner options for children. Every night in every restaurant it was pasta, pizza or chicken nuggets (which were all dark meat), with no side dishes. Would have liked to have seen apple sauce or veggies as a side for them.

Family concierge butler was great. Handled all of our requests. On the first night, we didn't get turn down service, and only 3 towels. He fixed this for us and made all our dinner reservations (had to be made a night in advance). And also left gifts for the kids.

The beach, although it looked beautiful, had rough water and a lot of seaweed. We had a great time anyway with the pool. My daughter also visited the kids club a few days and enjoyed the activities there. All of us enjoyed the nightly shows. As a side note, the hotel was impeccably clean. This is our first visit to Cancun, and we really enjoyed our stay. All of the staff were very friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: Dana E
reviews.title: Wonderful resort
reviews.text:
When we arrived at Paradisus we were quickly assisted, given wrist bands to start our vacation. Our first night we ended up at Coco's where Geraldo was our bartender. He entertained the whole bar which various speciality shots. 

The next day we went to the pool where I met the sports and activities team. Those guys are awesome! Pool side zumba, water aerobics and a fun game daily. Oozie, Freddie, Huge, and Mauricio are seriously awesome. 

Several nights we ended up at Coco's where Chris and Gerry were wonderful bartenders introducing us to new drinks and being very attentive. 

The resort really takes care of you for a week, its nice to not have any worries for a week and truly enjoy a vacation.

reviews.author: Aammaarr
reviews.title: Short Break
reviews.text: Visited this beautiful property end of August for 5 nights.  First trip to Cancun and was impressed. Have stayed at many hotels all inclusive but this one was on the top of the list.  Quality of food and drinks very good. All branded drinks at bar and very friendly staff. It's not 5 star quality but for the size of the property and amount of people they deal with very good.  Clean rooms and friendly staff. All 5 days we did not get a drop of rain even though we were expecting bad weather as per iPhone weather app.  So don't let the app dampen your trip asylum may get sun revert day. Only down side was the sea weed which is not in control of the hotel which made the beach visit a bit unpleasant.  The pools were clean and plenty both for kids and adults. I thought the charges for booking cabanas were a bit too steep $50 a day     Food quality is good and booking in advance recommended if you want to use the a la carte restaurants. Obama the sushi shashmi place highly recommended   The buffet restaurant has enough to offer if you don't want to use the other restaurants.

reviews.author: Oscar E L
reviews.title: Aweome vacation
reviews.text:
We had a great time the week we were there. We visited all the restaurants. I recommend the Market Grill along with Vento the best. Excellent food and service, on the Market Grill Elizabeth, Karla, Jaime and Luis made sure we had an awesome dining experience. Bana restaurant didnt impress, and the worst was the Mexican Mole restaurant along with La Perla in our opinion
We got upgraded to the Royal Service for free, that was also a plus in our stay. Great hotel overall.

reviews.author: Retiree4150
reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: We enjoyed our time on the beach sunning and walking. The drink service was excellent. One of the restaurants was right beside the beach/pool area and we could come straight from the beach for lunch. The Aqua Word kiosk was poolside and we were able to plan our excursions on the first day! Towel service was excellent.

reviews.author: Michael L
reviews.title: A Week Of Royal Treatment and Fun!
reviews.text: The hotel was beautiful and relaxing. We stayed in the Royal Service Tower and the staff made us feel so special and welcomed. The ocean view room was decorated very nicely and spacious. Bed very comfortable! We used the Spa services every day. Caesar at the private pool made our stay memorable. He took very good care of us and asked us about our plans and what we did every day. He really cared about our visit to Cancun. The special pool drinks he made for us were so good! The Mole restaurant is a must do when you stay. We went 2 nights during our stay for an  incredible dinner. Javier Salazar made us feel like royalty as he served our dinner and chatted us up. He made every detail so special in our private dining room. We laughed, drank and dined on the most delicious food by the chef. I wanted Javier to sit and talk with us as we felt like family. We will definitely return to the Paradisus Cancun with more friends. Great stay and many memories made!!

reviews.author: Robson R
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Wonderful. We are programming to comeback soon. We love it. This was the best vacation ever. We went with another family and they love it as well. I'm sure they want to comeback too. For the next time problably feel more people will go with us

reviews.author: marvin r
reviews.title: Ex
reviews.text:
Very good
      Excellent very good. I like it a lot. Going again. Very good price good for every thing good for family  every thing around good. Good for families. For very body thank for everything see you sgain

reviews.author: Patty T
reviews.title: Long weekend get away
reviews.text:
From the time we arrived we were treated great. We checked-in well before it was time and our room was not ready. We asked about a hospitality room to change into our bathing suits and the conciergo escorted us to the room. There were more than ample chase lounges and umbrellas on the beach.  Due to the tropical storms we encountered sea weed in the morning but it washed out to sea as the day progressed. It did not keep us from having a great time in the ocean. We took advantage of the private cabanas on the beach and the personal service offered by Coco's Bar. Our butler Rafael took awesome care of us the entire time.  I mentioned once it was my husbands birthday and later in the day they came out with a birthday desert and sang to him on the beach.  The restaurants and buffets we tried were all good and the food was fresh.  We did not spend any time at the pools during our stay although they looked very clean and it appeared there were ample lounge chairs.

Our room was in Building 3 which is the main building. We enjoyed our ocean view junior suite. I am certain any of the buildings would be great for an ocean view room but this was certainly convenient and never far to walk.

reviews.author: mayrametal
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: I had to pleasure to stay in this resort and I can only recommend it. The service is fantastic, all very friendly and polite. Very nice fitness room opened from 6:30AM to 9PM. Excellent restaurants! Great swimming pool as well. Fantastic sea although not really for kids (strong waves). You can also take a kaiak and do a tour at the Lagoon (the Hotel provides that to guests, the so called "Eco Tour"). Many activities for kids and sports for adults as well. Live music in the evenings. Highly recommended!!

reviews.author: Muneesha H
reviews.title: Family getaway with our 8 year old and 5 month baby
reviews.text:
We loved the resort.....food, service,  restaurants are amazing. ....bana restaurant has great sushi. ...Eric in bana offered excellent exceptional service.....suggested great rolls and loved the sauces he got to our table. ...
Hand rolls were yummy.
Naos has great buffet. ....Vento buttermilk fish is great. 
We were hesitant to take our 5 month baby but were amazed to see that all people had babies n little kids! !!!
Would go to the same resort again! !!

reviews.author: Samantha C
reviews.title: BOMB-digitty
reviews.text: We stayed for a week, and didn't want to leave. Everything was perfect from the food, to the service, and atmosphere. We recommend Royal Service, it's where stayed! We are ready to go back! Miss it!!!

reviews.author: misterkeene
reviews.title: Don't get hurt at this resort.  Your on your own
reviews.text:
We have traveled extensively internationally especial in the Caribbean.  We have never thought about the consequences about being injured at one of these resorts until now.  A member of our family broke their wrist at this resort and we received no help from any of the staff members or resort officials. We literally had to call a cab to transport the injured family member to the hospital because the resort refused to do so.

The resort never made any inquire as to how this person was doing (she had to fly back to the states the next day to receive adequate care)  There all smiles though when you order a drink.  Just don't have anything serious that's need attending to.

One other thing about an injury or illness when travelling internationally.  Your health insurance does not cover you.  You will have to pay all fees out of pocket and then attempt to be reimbursed from your insurance company.

Unfortunately given this experience we certainly will never visit this resort chain again and probably will not travel outside the U.S. again.

reviews.author: strykre
reviews.title: Great resort, great food, beautiful beach front.
reviews.text:
Amazing hotel interior.  We stayed in the Pyramid 3, where all the shops, some restaurants, and bars are.  So it can get noisy at night, but its nice to be close to everything.  Food and drinks are great.  Staff are courteous.  We tried to change the room to another pyramid due to the noise, but the other options were quite low-end rooms.  At least they tried to acommodate.  Pyramid 1 is the far end and still seems to be under renovation and is considerably hotter than 3.  So we stuck with 3.  The view from the balcony is just as advertised in the website, I was surprised.  The only thing is that the pool closes at around 7pm.  I expected more fun atmosphere around the pool at night.  Otherwise great place to stay. 

Also, KEEP IN MIND: RESERVE YOUR DINNERS A DAY BEFORE.  They are very strict about reserving the restaurants a day before.  And do it early in the morning before all the seats are taken. (Yes its kinda a chore, and who wants chores on vacation, but that's the way they do it).  I saw several couples get turned away because of no reservations.  Vento is the best, Bana is decent Japanese, the others are great too.

reviews.author: Rebe K
reviews.title: Great all-inclusive - highly recommended
reviews.text:
Excellent customer service at each stop in this resort. Staff was very attentive and responsive to our needs  Several restaurants on site, each different and tasty.  Reservations are necessary in order to assure your spot.
Also, cabanas are available to rent for the day, which is highly recommended because it was very hot in Cancun and the cabanas gave you some nice relief.  Very helpful wait staff come around and keep you filled with snacks, ice water and whatever else you need to be comfortable.  DON'T FORGET TO TIP THEM...  THEY WORK VERY HARD.  You must get up, go to the pool area, and reserve a cabana by 8 am or they are gone and you are out of luck.

Only criticisms are  that it was not possible to exchange money at the front desk.  If you need to get dollars, it is hit or miss that if you ask a bellman, he will be able to help.  Front desk should keep currency for guests to exchange.  Also, at checkout, there was a problem paying for the cabanas.  If we wanted to charge them to our room, we had to go across the campus to pay by credit card.  The front desk could not accept cards, but only would accept cash for the cabanas.  

Other than that, we have only wonderful things to say about this resort.  Thanks for a great time, we will be returning.

reviews.author: Ryan A
reviews.title: TEMPO RESTAURANT  - PARADISUS
reviews.text: We had a great dining experience there last week! Fantastic food and wine pairings! Our waiter, Samuel, Sommelier Carlos Duarte and Hostess Marifer were knowledgeable, warm and first class! Compliments to our Chef, Ismael, creative, gorgeous and delicious dishes for our 8 course meal. I would highly recommend Tempo to any lovers of fine food and wine!

reviews.author: voicemai
reviews.title: Our visit to Paradisus
reviews.text: My family and I visited Paradisus in July 2015.  We expected a lot as this was supposed to be a 5 star hotel. First, our room was more like a 3 star room. Then we discovered that the AC unit was not working and the room was hot and never could get it to cool down.  The room was not very clean but acceptable.  We asked to be moved to another room and asked for a king bed as the double beds were very uncomfortable.  They moved us to another room and this one also had a broken AC unit.  I complained again and the front desk girl seemed to annoyed. I thought this was a 5 star hotel???  They moved us to a third room. This one, the AC worked but it was just above their restaurant and we could smell all the food and smoke whenever we opened the window.  By now I had given up trying to change rooms.  The food was very very bland. We kept trying food and desserts looking for something that tasted good but no luck.  The food was like 3 to 4 star quality but I would say more like 3 star.  The service was so so, but this place was very very crowded.  My little boy asked for a cheeseburger and fries. I asked for a seedless bun as he is allergic to the seeds.  It took them three (3) hours, yes that is correct 3 hours to get us the cheeseburger.  The beach was full of sea-weed but this was only the cause of nature and not the hotel's problem. The pool side drink service was non-existent, I mean NO ONE every came by an asked if I wanted a drink.  This was supposed to be a 5 star hotel.  This is the first and last time we stay here. We stayed at Excellence in 2008 and it was way way better.

reviews.author: Brandi S
reviews.title: Lock your stuff up!!!!
reviews.text: I stayed here on a girls trip In September 2013.  We upgraded to Royal service but did not feel this was worth the extra cost. We reserved a room with two beds and at check in they tried give us a King... The had overbooked our room and were forced to upgrade us. Nothing special though just a little bigger room.  The food they serve in the Royal service lounge was awful!!  The restaurants were all very good and the drinks were just ok...  FYI  always be sure to lock everything up in your room safe!!  My friend accidentally left her drivers license and earrings out on the counter and they were stolen!!  The staff just said.  we're sorry!?  This ruined the rest of our trip until it came to check out.     At check out they had charged me $65.00 for sheets they said had blood on them??? What?  From who?  Wasn't us!!!  I asked for proof and they said they had been washed.  I was very upset and they said  they would not charge me but when I got home and checked my bank account they had not only charged my card but also overcharged me by 25.00 for a pair of flip flops I purchased in the hotel store.  I was so sick about this.  I do have to say thought that the people that work here at the restaurants and around the pool are wonderful and they really do try to make your stay nice.  Just be careful about leaving your belongings out in your room.   Because of the theft and the bogus charges though I would never return here.

reviews.author: dmb207
reviews.title: Nice all inclusive in Cancun
reviews.text:
My room was great, they were kind enough to put us in the adults only section, which was very nice since I'm not much of a kid person myself. 

Hotel was nice, accommodating. 

Tons of food choices, very large resort with just about everything you would ever need at your fingertips. 

The biggest plus of our trip was our AMAZING butler Ramon, he truly went above and beyond to make the experience incredible.

reviews.author: Carmen K
reviews.title: Met all of our expectations!
reviews.text: This resort is awesome.  I can't say enough about how friendly and helpful All of the staff was!  The resort is immaculent!  This place is gorgeous and very well maintained. Miguel from the beach staff is AWESOME!  He anticipated my every need and drink!  He never left us thirsty!  Paradisus has some of the most polite staff I have ever seen. I feel that everyone there went out of their way to make our stay the best. I have been to Cancun several times and the food here was the best variety and the best tasting I have had!!

reviews.author: S T
reviews.title: A modern, clean, relaxing resort with great service, only marred by an unusable beach.
reviews.text:
We were here recently with our two kids and the in-laws and their three kids. Oldest was fourteen and the other three kids were 5-7 years old.

Facilities  the hotel is in great shape and looks amazing the main entrance opens up into a giant opening where you see up through the glass pyramid top ringed by the long hanging ivy, some as long as 20 feet. The rest of the property is very well maintained and clean. I did not see any spots where there was any issue with maintenance.

Rooms: Our room had two doubles and was very clean and modern. We got a room with a balcony on the first floor that some would say was blocked by a tree, but I would say, gave us a view of a great tree. People who complain about the view from their rooms confuse me. Why are you in your room? The TV was a flatscreen and worked well. Word of advice if the volume is too low, adjust the physical buttons on the side of the TV. The AC is loud yes, but not that much louder than other hotels
Wi-fi was ok. We could stream videos and such so no problems,

Service: Great service everywhere, not a word of complaint here. Room service was always good as well.

Food: The restaurants had great food. Only exception was the Perla, I wuld skip that. Not the best in the world but very good for a resort. The Naos buffet was also good but not great. 
 My complaint her would be the heat lamps were not proper heat lamps so all the hot food was only luke warm unless you got it right from the grill. 

Beach: The biggest issue was the beach. Seaweed has taken over cancun beaches, not just at our resort but all up and down the beach. it was so think the beach was basically unusable. We could dip our feet in but not much else. Not really the resorts fault though.

Pools: Yes they are warm but its August in Mexico so there's not much that can be done abut that. people do flaunt the no reserving chairs rule but we usally managed to find one or two to use.

A small complaint is that the main pools are so deep that its a bit hard to enjoy them with the kids. The kid's pool is only a couple feet deep but then it drops off to 5.5 feet which made it hard for my wife who is only five feet tall to play with the kids and have them swim while she could watch them while staying cool in the water herself.

Overall. A great resort, we had a lot fo fun and enjoyed ourselves. Worth going to.

reviews.author: Jefe13
reviews.title: Relaxation with no worries
reviews.text:
The Paradisus is a large all-inclusive hotel in the middle of the hotel zone. The main section of the hotel has a relaxing tropical vibe. The hotel reminds me of the Hyatt on Maui or the Marriott in Palm Desert. 
The truly exceptional aspect of the hotel was the Royal section. The best way to describe this is that it is a hotel inside of a hotel. The Royal is an adult’s only tower that is on the far end of the hotel away from all the general commotion. In our lobby we had a system of fish ponds that were surrounded by wood floors with tables and chairs. There were plants and flowers for a tropical feel to the lobby. The lobby was great for snacks and cocktails from our private bar and buffet. The bar had premium liquor and above average wine. The bar tender made fresh cocktails without using sugary mixes. It was the only place to get a really good margarita in the whole hotel. They also had an espresso bar. The buffet was excellent. They served breakfast and then heavy snacks the rest of the day. There was always fresh fruit, smoked salmon, raw tuna, caviar, smoked meats and a variety of cheeses to choose from. In the morning there were more breakfast items and in the afternoon there were pastries and deserts. We had personal butler service, which we did not really use. We also had access to our own concierge desk and check out.
The Royal section also comes with a pool that is designated only for the Royal guests. We did not spend much time in the pool because we prefer to be on the beach and in the ocean, but it seemed to be relaxing without the obnoxious MC trying to coerce the guest into playing games. Near the pool there was also our own restaurant and bar. We also had a portion of the beach that was sectioned off for just the Royal guests. We had waiters that took care of all our food and drink needs at the beach. The service was quick and friendly. The food from the outdoor restaurant was pretty good. The fish they served were Mahi Mahi and grouper. They prepare it fileted, as ceviche or in a sandwich. They also served wraps, chip and guacamole, etc.
I am snobby when it comes to good food, not necessarily fancy food, but high quality food, and Paradisus was above average, especially for an all-inclusive. We ate at three places in the main section of the hotel. The Japanese restaurant and the Spanish restaurant are good enough that I would have eaten at either one of them a second time. The buffet was not that great. The liquor in the main part of the hotel was average quality, which is what I would expect from an all-inclusive. The beer was not very good. Dos XX was the premium beer. Negra Modelo wan not even an option also there were no imports to speak of.
The one thing that the hotel was lacking was water sports. It would have been nice if they offered Hobie Cats, paddle boards or kayaks for the guests to use.  
Overall my wife and I had a very relaxing time at the Paradisus. I would go back in a heartbeat for a getaway without kids or a couple’s vacation.

reviews.author: 562gingerm
reviews.title: My favorite Mexican resort
reviews.text:
We stayed Sept. 18-23, 2014, and it could not have been more perfect. We loved our room and the oceanview.  Everyone was very helpful, and I plan to return. Plus, it was our anniversary, and whenever we told one of the employees, he got rose petals and slippers and put them all over our bed with the number of years we've been married (2). It was amazing and so sweet! We made so many great memories at this place.

Tips
* Get ocean view - I'm sure the lagoon view is pretty, but you're looking over a road and some businesses to the lagoon.
* Get your towels early and reserve your seats if you want one with shade, either on the beach or around the pool. Don't leave your seat unoccupied too long - they do have a 30-minute rule.
* If you want to be close to everything, stay in Tower 3 (we stayed in 3465) - it's the main tower with all the restaurants, shops, etc.
* If you don't like to hear the bar music from around 8:30-10 p.m., don't stay in Tower 3 because you can hear it. Most of the time, we weren't in the room at that time, but when we were, we could hear it.
* All towers are connected inside so it's really not that far to go to the other ones.
* Get the highest floor you can for the best view - ask at registration.
* They have an amazing on-site photographer if you are willing to pay $200 for some great pictures by the ocean.
* All the restaurants are good so you won't be disappointed. 
* My favorite restaurant - Vento (tapas, and so many are delicious, but not the sea bass)
* 2nd fave: Blue Agave - delicious corn tortilla tacos, especially the beef tenderloin and carnitas
* Food rec's: Fuego red tuna app or entree, nutella syrup on french toast, the foccacia bread
* Bring lots of sunscreen and an SPF long-sleeve swim shirt if you plan to be in the ocean and you're going in September and burn easily. Despite liberal and often sunscreen applications, I still burned. The sun is intense! I always wore a hat so my face didn't burn, but I would have saved myself some pain if I had a long-sleeve SPF shirt, plus I would have spent more time in the ocean!
* Fitness: running on the beach is nice, and a ton of people are out there in the morning; they also have a fitness center (3 treadmills, free weights, a couple ellipticals and a bike), and they have some classes like Zumba by the pool and water aerobics, which are fun.

reviews.author: Lisa L
reviews.title: This Place is Amazing!!
reviews.text: The Paradisus Cancun is wonderful. From the time we arrived, we received excellent service.  We did not choose the Royal service, but we still felt like we were treated royally.  Everyone of our waiters were excellent.  Especially Jaime Carmona at Naos.  This is the buffet.   You can ask to be seated in Vento Restaurant area during breakfast. Its very beautiful.  Also the dinner there was great. During the time we went Sept19-24, we had no problem getting into any of the restaurants. All the food was soooo good & they make your dining experience special.  The Market Grill at lunch is excellant but was our least favorite for dinner. Our room was beautiful with an Ocean View.  Its worth it! Awesome sunrise every morning.  We had 2 rooms 3708 & 3709. We were very happy with the convient location.  We had the ocean view on one side and out our door into the hotel looked over the center atrium with all the beautiful tropical setting of fountains & gold fish pools.  It is so beautiful and relaxing.  Our beds were so comfy, very soft but also very supporting.  We ordered room service several times and it arrived in about 30 min. If you just ask for extra water it arrives in just a few min.  The beach is beautiful and so are the pools.  We had no problem getting chairs while we were there. reviews.title: Beautiful Resort

Room was beautiful, I was given a free upgrade to an ocean front suite....FANTASTIC!!!  I would like to give special thanks to Carlos Rodriguez at the pool bar and Christian and Martin at the Toji bar.  These guys made my wife and I feel very special and very at home. reviews.author: Brandon W
reviews.title: First Class Service w/ Lifetime Memories!
reviews.text:
From the very first greeting to the very last goodbye, not a beat was missed during my recent stay at the Paradisus Cancun. A vacation trip for my friends birthday, we selected this hotel after a very lengthy search. They had a wonderful deal we just couldn't pass--including 30% off the total stay, the ability to partake in their Royal Service option and all inclusive. 

We were greeted by multiple staff at once, rushing to our sides to take our bags and place a drink in our hands. Shortly after three shots of top shelf tequila, we were whisked away to the Royal Service check in area which is where we met our butler for the stay, Leyner. Great, amazing and remarkable are all words which fall short of describing Leyner's service. He set up our resort restaurant bookings, bali bed bookings, overseen staff in the cleaning of our rooms and even spoiled us with numerous bottles of champagne and bottles of tequila as parting gifts. Need I say more? Leyner, you are the man!!!

Our visit was during the low season, so pretty quiet all around with very few kids. The weather forecast mentioned it would storm our entire stay, but we were greeted by rain for roughly 10-20 mins a couple of days--more sunshine than clouds, no complaints really. 

Pros: The Royal Service is a must! It's only a few more dollars more than the other resort options, which includes access to the Royal Service adult only area (bali beds, special poolside food menu, adult only beach area). The Royal Service flatbread pizza with shrimp?! Ahhhh-mazing. You also get a phone to keep in touch with your personal butler. If they're not available, you can dial any of the others to assist you. Mole restaurant is also a high to-do. They had an amazing lamb taco dish. Also, The Market Grill and their Brazilian style set up is just... superb! Aromatic pillows, Thierry Mugler toiletries.

Cons: Blue Agave and Fuego were the two restaurant options I would avoid. Blue Agave is a taco-based restaurant. The soup tasted like Dasani water and the taco's lacked any flavor or seasoning, bland overall. Fuego is their asian-inspired offering, which features rather outlandish entrees. Their creme brûlée was great though!

To Leyner, Eddie, Roger, Rogelio and any other staff we came across during our 6-day stay, thank you! You kept smiles on our faces, shared many laughs with us, made sure we were fat, full and happy, and really made my friends birthday special. I will DEFINITELY be returning to this resort and making it my only go-to when visiting Cancun.

reviews.author: Mike S
reviews.title: Very Nice Place Overall, But......
reviews.text:
We had a very enjoyable time at Paradisus. The hotel is very clean, the employees and service are great, the pools and beach are excellent. We had an ocean view room in the main tower (3) that had an excellent view...especially of the sunrise in the a.m. Now on to a few disappointing things.

- The main lobby - atrium is always hot and muggy. This is where you go to the various restaurants in the evening. It's uncomfortable!!!!
- Our 5th floor room a/c would never completely cool off. Somewhat cool, but not what I'm used to at home
- I cannot for the life of me figure out why a hotel would allow blasting music from a bar all night in tower 3 to the point where paying customers cannot sleep????.That is just rude to customers.
-The Wi-Fi service is terrible. We rarely could get a signal in our room unless it was very early in the morning before everyone woke up.
- After traveling all day to get to Cancun, upon arrival you will be greeted by one of the fake concierges whose only goal is to get you to a timeshare breakfast the next morning. That is sad they have to stoop that low.... 

Enough griping...like I said, we had a very good time here and would never let some of the shortcomings of the hotel detract from our vacation. The service at the main pool was awesome and we spent a lot of time there. We found the food at the ala carte restaurants to be adequate but probably not worth the trouble of making reservations and having to worry about eating at a specific time. (Note: The ala carte restaurants are very small, yet they were rarely full while we were there) The buffet at Naos had a nice selection and changed up the selections in the evening. Breakfasts were excellent!!

One other note - We did not have royal service and still had great service from all the employees everywhere at the resort. 

The positives far outweigh the negatives at this resort and I would recommend staying here. You will have a great time. Just be cautious about the perfect reviews.

reviews.author: the_real_Oscar
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus Cancun, Mexico
reviews.text:
As first time travelers to Mexico, we did our research in advance and every review about this property was pretty nice; now after came back we have to say that the level of service, professionalism and cleanness of the resort excel our expectations every day; by far no review can describe how hard everyone work there and keep this big installation running!
We traveled as a couple by the end of August 2014.
Starting to mention that the resort is big! Five buildings with the shape of pyramids, but don’t let yourself down for its size; everything is so well organized that you never have to walk too far and all the buildings are connected (no golf carts to go around like other resorts in the Caribbean).
We stayed in the Royal Service and it was worth the upgrade. They’ll pamper you every minute and will go beyond to make you feel in paradise! This said, the service in the Family Concierge and the rest of the hotel is great as well... 
The Royal Service level has its own checking desk, they will greet you with champagne and our check-in was flawless, Julie welcomed us and she is a really nice lady, but all the staff is amazing; also, you’ll have your private concierge. Our concierge Hector was the best!!
The entire staff there is exceptional, very friendly. We wanted to thanked specially our friend there Maria Fernanda, she's lovely and always with a smile!!
24 hours Room Service is included in Royal Service, and we ordered a couple of breakfast, they never took more than 20 minutes to delivered, always great service.
Rooms are spacious, very clean and our maid did a good job.
Doesn’t matter if you’re in Ocean View or Lagoon View, you’ll always get an amazing view from your balcony. Our room was Lagoon View and we had the best sunset views in the Caribbean!
Room tip: ask for the highest floor in advance, better view and more quiet.
The Royal Service has its own separate swimming pool, and private Balinese beds that your concierge will reserve for you every day upon request; also, you’ll have your private restaurant in the pool for lunch and servers will bring you drinks and food gently. The beach is beautiful, clear; although is a public beach (means people come from all around), is huge and you’ll never feel cramped there. We have experience more amazing beaches in the Caribbean, but this one is nice too.
About the food in the resort, the buffet is like every other buffet in a 5 star all inclusive, not too many varieties but fresh food, mainly international food. Keep in mind the hotel has 8 more restaurants and we couldn’t try them all.
We went to Fuego (not too impressed here), Vento (although it advertised as Mediterranean, be aware is actually specialized in Spanish Tapas; good to socialize and drink, but not well for great eaters; we enjoyed though). The Market Grill restaurant is really good, open windows besides the main swimming pool close to the ocean and it’s nice feeling the breeze at night; specialty in meats (like Brazilian restaurants), we ate the meat that we’ll eat in a year I think; the meat is fresh, tender cuts and the servers will keep coming to your table with difference choices (unless you turn your table sign red!!)… But our preferred option was Mole restaurant! So glad we reserved! The service is amazing, the ambiance is like a real Mexican “cantina” but more upscale attire, and the food is to die for; authentic Mexican gourmet food, rich in flavors, tasteful and lot of variety… Tip: go for the baby chicken mole with the cactus salad, or the tequila shrimps; I had the best Mexican tortilla soup ever!!
At night, the main activities always are going on in the main pyramid (3), where the main bar and the night club are located; fine lounge and fun music; they have a small variety show every night there but space is limited, so if you want to see it, be there at least at 8pm to get seated.
The resort is huge, but well designed to have quiet areas and lot of fun places as well; every taste will be pleased there. Also, remember that you’re in Cancun and there are a lot to do outside your resort every day and night.
Overall, a safe place, beautiful destination with friendly people; amazing resort, well-kept and run, ideal either for couples or families, very clean, first class service and very good location on the Hotel Zone, close to downtown.
We won’t hesitate to go back there, for sure!!

reviews.author: borismxpanton
reviews.title: Royal Service is recommended!
reviews.text:
We stayed here for 4 nights in September 2014 and here is our detailed review.

The Good:
- The hotel grounds were immaculate, the views were breathtaking and all the staff there were very warm and welcoming, from the Janitors to the Managers (btw most speak English), all treated us like VIP. 

- We received the promotion for free airport shuttle and hotel coupons. The airport pickup was on-time, they were actually waiting on us. 

-The Hotel was pretty big, if you get Royal Service, you will definitely do a lot of walking to get to the main pyramid where most of the restaurants are located, it helped in burning off all the food we ate. 

-Wi-Fi EVERYWHERE!!!! Ok, we expected Wi-Fi in the lobby, and in the room, but we were also able to receive a signal around the pool areas and on the Beach!!! Yes, we were on vacation, and didn't need to be connected to the outside, but it made it more convenient for posting gorgeous selfies on our social media sites. 

-Did I mention the views???? They were postcard quality. The water had two to three different hues of blue, we were in awe every time we looked out there. The beach was clean and beautiful, we weren't harassed by vendors so that made our lounging even better. The water was chilly at first, but we got acclimated fast. It was a little rough before storms, and a little wavy on sunny days, nothing we couldn't handle.

-The hotel pyramids were all draped in lush greenery with hanging cascades of plants. We felt like were we in a large greenhouse. 

-Now to the Royal Service... we thought this was a marketing stunt, but getting it definitely improved our stay. Our private butler, Sergio was amazing! We didn't have to worry about a thing. He took care of our restaurant reservations, bali bed bookings, clothes ironing and anything else we needed! Our last night, we came back to the room and were surprised to see birthday cake, champagne, balloons, confetti and a beautiful heart shaped geese decoration on the bed with roses. We really didn't expect this, as we only mentioned we were celebrating our birthdays early. Sergio deserved every cent of his tip and more. I highly recommend the Royal Service. 

- My girl friend also wants me to mention that the sugar cookies from Noas were delicious. 

The Not-So-Good:
-The coupons were are a waste. When checking-in I tried to use them towards a room upgrade and was told that there were no more ocean-view rooms available, yet I was told by other staff member that this is the best time to stay there because the hotel isn't as full. We also tried to use a coupon at the gift shop and was told by the cashier that I needed to spend US$100 before the US$10 coupon could be applied. The other coupons weren't useful to me, so it was a total waste. 

-There is an app for the hotel, you get the login details at the front desk, I tried to use the app to make an hotel reservation at two different restaurants and was rejected on both occasions. Thank God for Sergio, I mentioned where we wanted to eat, and by the time I was back in the room, my reservation was made. 

-I expected the food to be much better. The restaurants were highlighted on their website, with amazing menu options, but most of our meals tasted mediocre at best. The desserts were good, but I had higher expectations. 

-The day before we left we saw a cockroach in one of the bridge ways, connecting the pyramids. That was really the only insect we saw during the entire stay. 

-I noticed that our shower curtain rob was bent/broken. We had to adjust it before every shower to prevent the bathroom floor from getting wet. We could have mentioned it to Sergio but forgot, i'm sure he would have fixed it for us. 

-A few beach chairs were "reserved" by guests with books & magazines and no one showed up for hours. 

All in all, the Good of this hotel overshadowed the Not-so-good and we were very happy with our decision in choosing this resort. We will come back here in the future, the service, location and accommodations are top notch.

reviews.author: ikhawaja
reviews.title: Keeps Getting better
reviews.text: Keep coming to Paradisus. Started when it was Melia and now Paradisus has taken it to a new level. Love the new resturants especially Blue  Agave for Tacos. Its very affordable and good. The range of resturants from Temp to Blue Agave is extraodinary. The Entertainment keeps improving. That used to be one of Melia's week points. Not any more.

reviews.author: Heather W
reviews.title: Beautiful, clean resort w/ first-class beach
reviews.text: Traveled with my husband and kids. The Paradisus was one of the few hotels we could find that has family suites, and ours was very nice: large, clean, with a lovely view of the ocean. The staff is very friendly and helpful. The on-site restaurants are very good and offer a variety of cuisine; definitely take advantage of them and make reservations. The only restaurant we didn't care for was the one my husband was most excited about--the Brazilian meat restaurant. The meat was dry and chewy that night. Not enough reviewers comment on the great beach in front of the Paradisus. Before going, I was concerned the beach would be nonexistent, because of the hurricanes that plague Cancun. But rest assured, the beach was amazing: wide, clean, and mostly empty the week we were there. We never had a problem finding a palapa for shade. Highly recommend this resort; we'll be back!

reviews.author: Simon L
reviews.title: Great Food, Great Service, but Aging Hotel Room
reviews.text:
Overall I had a great experience for the price I paid (about $1000 for 5 nights all-inclusive, ocean view room during low season: Sep).

Pros:
- The food was great! Definitely recommend Market Grill (many selections of meat on a larger skewer brought to the table and carved right in front of you) and Naos (buffet available any time without the hassle of reservation at the other restaurants at this resort)
- The service staff is friendly and helpful
- The pool is nice
- The spa is nice
- The beach is clean
- The location is convenient (right in the middle of the hotel zone; about midway between airport and downtown Cancun); there is a bus stop right in front of the hotel (20 pesos per person per ride; bus every 3-5 minutes)

Cons:
- Room door does not insulate the loud noise from the night club. I stayed in Room 3201 (which is the center tower, one level above the main level where the reception is).
- Room key did not work; they had to send someone to replace the battery of the electronic door lock
- The instructions for the in-room safe has faded; they had to send someone up to the room to explain how the safe works
- The bath tub stopper stayed down (so the water does not drain); I had to manually pull it out of the bath tub and let it sit on the side of the tub.
- The wifi in the room keeps cutting in and out; I had to go outside to the lobby to get stable wifi internet connection.
- Dinner reservation is a hassle. You have to reserve 1 day in advance and they book you at odd times (e.g. 6:15pm, 10:00pm); I had to keep my odd time and then walk to the restaurant to move my reservation to a more reasonable time. Maybe they are saving the normal slots for VIP guests and only give out normal slots until later in the day.

reviews.author: Amanda B
reviews.title: Pure Paradise
reviews.text: When you step into this place you know you're getting your monies worth. We opted for the Royal Service, which was worth the extra money hands down. The main front desk swept us away and brought us straight to the private section of the hotel for royal service guests only. The head butler was extremely helpful as we did arrive extremely early. She made sure we were seated at the restaurant and had a drink in our hand the moment we stepped foot into this place. Our room was ready about an hour later and it was immaculate. We had a top floor ocean view suite and the view was absolutely amazing. Our butler was great, we had top shelf liquor in our room every night and differently scented pillows which were awesome. We never had an issue getting a cabana or a restaurant reservation thanks to him. Next was Francisco, the pool waiter in the royal service area. He had to have been the greatest server ever! He made sure we never were empty with a drink and new our names and drink order by heart. If you stay here you need to find Francisco.
