Also, I got cellulitis in my foot while I was there and the staff went out of their way to make sure I was comfortable, had ice packs and they brought emts over every morning and afternoon to clean out the infection, my doctor said if they didn't do that it would've been worse. Overall this place is absolutely fantastic and can't wait to go back again!

reviews.author: Mauricio B
reviews.title: Very good hotel (food could be better !!)
reviews.text:
We are a couple (40 and 50 years old) and a daughter of 6 years old. We were there at low season (sep/2014), so no crowds. We loved the hotel and all staff are very friendly. The only thing we were disappointed were the food. As we had previous experience with other hotels, we are sure they can do much better with the food. Buffet in under the average in terms of options, but everything available is clean and fresh.
Other thing is about the AC on the common areas: it is warm all the time and at night it is uncomfortable. Inside the rooms the AC is perfect, but as the atrium is like an open area, the temperature is not comfortable.
Tip: if you don't want go to the club at night, stay out of the main tower. The music is loud until 2pm !! 
Kids Club: low season, no many kids. But they are very nice there and my daughter liked it !!

reviews.author: WhoIAm B
reviews.title: Strictly pleasure
reviews.text: We searched for a long time before deciding on a hotel. This was the best choice BY FAR!!  We have been here 3 days and everything has been perfect.  The weather has been wonderful. Service is impeccable. Everyone at the hotel is very friendly. Our favorite bartender Christian at Cocos is the best!   Rooms are cleaned immaculately each day.  Love love love the beach... Words and pictures cannot even describe it's beauty.  We highly recommend this hotel!

reviews.author: Peter M
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text: We have been to this resort 4 times, the last three to the royal service, and each time we have never been let down.  The hotel is beautiful, the food is very good, but the service and staff are exceptional in every way.  They truly pamper you and satisfy your every need, while being the epitome of gracious hospitality.  There is no better place just to relax and unwind. We will come back often to this resort and the Royal Service which makes the trip so easy, since the entire staff there is exceptional.

reviews.author: Mauricio Jose A
reviews.title: Excellent Vacations!
reviews.text: I really enjoyed the stay at this hotel. I really have no complaints about this hotel. Staff was very friendly and efficient. The help was immediate whenever you needed something; room service was phenomenal. The only thing I really didn't like was food; kind of blend, but I tend to have a picky flavor though and I understand the fact that they need to make food attractive to the tourists who are not used to spicy food.  I got a massage at the YHI Spa; quiet pricy but very worth it; they treat you like a king. Hotel has a good location, right on the Hotel Zone, close to shopping malls and downtown; easy to take the bus. I would definitely be coming back to this  hotel.

reviews.author: Donald Hoskins
reviews.title: Cancun Paradise
reviews.text: Was treated like a King choosing Royal Service at the Paradisus.  Beautiful resort and large comfortable room with a large pristine beach. Many resturants and bars to choose from in the resort itself.  Our butler was there to help in any way Caesar did an excellent job however the entire staff were excellent. Did not go to the presentation with free gift knowing it was a time share like offer which wasn't intrested.  I'll return and definitely choose Royal Servive again !

reviews.author: Spor_c2
reviews.title: Very Good Resort!!!
reviews.text: I recently went with my wife and had an amazing time. The food is very good, the service is amazing and they keep your glass full at all times (tequila). I will definitely visit this resort again. Special thanks to German from Club Melia and the amazing staff that made our stay unforgettable. Thank you Paradisus.

reviews.author: Sandra N
reviews.title: one word....excellente!!!!!!
reviews.text:
This is our last day at paradisus cancun :(. our time has been absolutely wonderful. the food is great, my favorite restaurant was Mole, and my least favorite was Bana only because I am not a big fan of Japanese food. we ate every morning at the buffet, and everything was wonderful, one server really went above and beyond, his name was Eder, he is always at the Market Grill, oceanside view, tip him well he deserves it! I did not do the Royal service, and from what I heard, not worth the extra expense. The hotel is beautiful, the pool is clean and feels great, the beach is clean and breathtaking. This is our second trip to Cancun, and we will return, we love Mexico!!! Visit Tulum and XaHal, it is a great experience. 
My only complaint is having to book a reservation for almost every restaurant the day before, if you dont call early, you might be eating late. Also always ask for a double drink, they are kind of poured weak. Most important, please tip the staff, they treat you so well, and it makes me so mad to see them busting thier butts and not being tipped...

reviews.author: Scott F
reviews.title: Exceptional
reviews.text: We purchased Royal Service and we delighted at every turn. It is obvious that the hotel management has set very high standards in every area.  The hotel is beautiful, exceptionally clean with something for everyone.  All of the restaurants were excellent and our only regret was that we couldn't stay longer to experience them all.  We enjoyed both Mexican Restaurants (Mole Mole and Blue Agave),  Bana for Sushi and Shushimi, Fuego for out of this world Peruvian food.  Fuego was our favourite but none of them left us disappointed.   Tempo (a Michelin four star restaurant by Martin Bergasategui) was a really nice treat even though it came with an extra charge.  We took advantage of the seasonal special and then added the wine pairing for a total cost of about $85 per person....which was well worth it in my opinion.   The Naos International Restaurant provided a ton of variety to suit anyone's taste but matched this with quality that surpassed that typically found at an all inclusive buffet.   Royal Service was a special treat and I would strongly recommend.  There is a small buffet constantly available in the Royal Service building and the La Palapa restaurant was a great place to enjoy breakfast, lunch or snacks by the pool / beach.  But by far the best thing about the Paradisus Cancun was the team of people that were there to take care of your every need.  Lazaro Asencio has instilled in his team  a commitment to not only address your needs but to anticipate them.   Juan was our personal butler and he never stopped looking for different ways to put a smile on our faces. A fresh bubble bath with roses, candles and a bottle of champagne to great us after a day in the sun is just one example.  Others at the resort who helped make our stay exceptional were Julie (our concierge), Eddy and Javier (our servers at the pool), Pedro (who made sure everything was right with our Bali Beds, that we had lots of suntan lotion and even chilled some after sun lotion so that it was just right).  Alfonso and Valeria were always there to ensure our coffee was just right and to make sure we felt like royalty.   Royalty Service is clearly much more than a label.....it is a mindset.  We can't wait to go back.

reviews.author: Jesenia Q
reviews.title: AMAZINGGG!!!
reviews.text: I could spend the whole day writing amazing things about this place, from top to bottom this place is wonderful: location,customer service, every single staff is courteous and eager to please you, the place is super nice and clean, all the restaurants are delicious we tried them all. I will recommend this place if you are planning to go to Cancun for wobderful vacations!!!😉

reviews.author: GetOutofMyInn
reviews.title: Best Hotel Experience I Have Had!!!
reviews.text: I stayed here for a couple nights back in April 2014 and from the moment I entered I felt like royalty.  I had the Royal Service suite with the butler and all the amenities. It was smooth sailing, everyone was courteous and the butler did everything to make my experience top notch. In fact I am getting ready to stay there for another 3 nights next week. So I will truly be able to see if the service is consistent.  The spa was heavenly, you just need to make reservations for the restaurant as they are so popular. I can't wait to return!

reviews.author: Monica V
reviews.title: relaxing
reviews.text: My colleagues and I went on a business trip to Cancun and we love the location of this place! the view are just wonderful and the service of the hotel is outstanding! We will definitely come back in our next business trip to Melia!

reviews.author: Itsajyaknow
reviews.title: Lovely hotel
reviews.text: What a beautiful property!  We loved staying at the Paradisus!  The room was large and lovely, had a jacuzzi on the balcony,  service was great and the food overall was pretty good.  Staff was friendly and helpful.  Would definitely stay there again.

reviews.author: BritiniChante
reviews.title: Breathtaking views with AMAZING service!
reviews.text: My fiance & I stayed at this Hotel and were blown away by the courteous staff & their willingness to be as helpful & attentive as possible. We opted for the "Royal Service" accomadations which were located in a seperate tower with no children allowed. Our personal butler Juan was amazing and checked in with us often to see if he could be of service. Overall, the experience was amazing! Will be returning soon!

reviews.author: Daniel R
reviews.title: Resturante fuego paradisus cancun
reviews.text: Best place to eat food is the best and service is perfect its like eating in a top chef restuarant. for appetizers i recomend the tempura its calamar and shrimp cooked to perfection.. for main dish i recommend tornedo de res itz a steak served with a pure itz delicious.. .

reviews.author: WV4476
reviews.title: Honeymoon vacation
reviews.text: We loved our trip to the Paradisus! We opted for the Royal Service as I wanted all the perks of the all-inclusive and the reviews here suggested it. It was wonderful - our butler Leynar always made sure we had everything we needed, and we even got chocolate covered strawberries randomly one day when he went to get my husband some scissors. The room was nice with a great ocean view. Food was wonderful - we tried all restaurants but one (Vento) as the day I thought I had made our reservation for that restaurant it ended up being closed, but we ate in the buffet that night. Least favorite restaurant was Mole, but we really liked Market Grill and Bana. The La Palapa restaurant available in the Royal Service area of the resort was awesome - they delivered food to you at your cabana. The Royal Service pool/beach area was great - was able to get a cabana for every day that we stayed by the pool/beach. Drinks - were a little weak unless you specifically asked for something strong, but that I expected, no complaints there. Everything was VERY clean - rooms, dining areas, pool areas, beach front - you can tell that they took the time and had great pride in keeping the resort sparkling. And the main reason I booked this hotel - service was GREAT as all the other reviews indicated. Everyone was kind and courteous, happy to help, and we were greeted by most staff members even just passing in the hall. They truly wanted to make sure we had a good time. We were incredibly sad to leave - it was a great trip!!

reviews.author: Luv2Adventure
reviews.title: Great Views, service, beach and pool.
reviews.text: I'm always a little leery when booking an all inclusive resort in Mexico for a couple of reasons.  First one is you never know the exact room you will be getting, they always have a room type you can book but these resorts are so large that the room type and view can really differ, you can have a view of the ocean but be on the 1st or 2nd floor so seeing the ocean while sitting on the patio can be tough, or you can have a tree in the way, etc.  That being said I'm very picky when booking a room and most all inclusive hotels make it hard to switch if you don't like what you get.  That being said the Paradisus did a good job getting me a room I liked with a view I liked.  I started on the 1st floor, I had the problem described above but then was moved to a higher floor and it didn't take much to change, I've had to change at other all inclusive hotels before and it took hours or even days!   The room was great and had a good view.  I liked the selection of the bar in the room and thought the room was very clean and loved that the patio was private and one couldn't see the patio next to you because of how they built and designed the hotel.  I paid for the upgraded Royal Service - well worth it!!  Top shelf liquor, reserved beach chairs, private dinning options, etc.  Make sure you specify the liquor you want in your drink.   The service on the beach was awesome, those waiters work so hard running up and down to the bar and making sure you are always stocked with beer and food!!!  Our pool was nice and quiet (adult only) but I ventured over to the standard pool bar often and it had a good atmosphere and service as well.  Second reason I'm leery is the quality of food.  I thought the Paradisus had good food and options,  some restaurants were better then others and I preferred the Bana and Mole.  My least favorite was the Market Grill, but the Market Grill had the best views of the pool but I thought the steak was ok. They had good entertainment at the bar with dancers, late night at the bar was good, and the beach always felt safe for nightly strolls. Overall I really enjoyed my stay here.  One little touch is the Royal service all inclusive bracelet, it's a very nice golden rope with wood carving, not the cheap plastic bands.  I wore mine for awhile after returning home.

reviews.author: kerryandbria
reviews.title: service with a smile
reviews.text:
Ok this is going to be a long review. We arrived after a 10 hour flight and were welcomed by Norma who was fab she explained lay out of hotel and did the chat on joining the me club which we targeted to go to ( I will come back to this) . The hotel is beautiful the lay out style everything just so wow.
Rooms
Went up to our room an  ocean front in pyramid 3 5th floor. Wow what a view. Room was clean big and we were very happy.
Pools.
Didn't use the main pool that's much we stayed at the quieter pool which was lovely always able to find beds with shade no matter what time we got there. The pool staff we great drinks and nachos brought to us all day thank you.
Beach
Golden sands and clear water. Yes big waves but it doesn't stop you going in. Seaweed yes but it's cleaned everyday and let's face it people it's the ocean seaweed lives in the ocean. So again no problems.
Now what makes the hotel even more special is the staff all with an hola and friendly smile. We were luck enough to eat in all the all cart restaurant's never had a problem getting a booking . My favourite was Due to the food and staff here were great we ate here twice both times were lovely thank you Martin our waiter. My husband favourite was market grill the meat was always cooked well again the staff were fab  Jose,ansenio,Rene and best of all Francisco thank you for taking care of us. Mole thank you for singing happy birthday to me and the cheesecake birthday cake was a nice touch ( thank you Norma for letting them know it was my birthday a little extra touch which was very thoughtful ) rody and our waiter Roberto were fab thank you for being so attentive. We found cost thank you Sonia and Jesus. Vento the food was great again the two times we ate the the staff were friendly ,helpful and just happy didn't get the names but thank you.ibana sushi restaurant yes they only have sushi as the resuarant is a sushi restaurant. So please don't complain that that's all the do if you don't like sushi don't eat here simple really. We enjoyed the resuarant again the staff were great.
Lastly the buffet food good but only ate here for breakfast we were served by Orlando bello who went out of his way to find tea for my husband and made sure eve h morning that's what he had very thoughtful thank you. Yes we tipped not every day and not every staff member this didn't effect the service we had. We had great service with out feeling the need to tip.
AVENUE BAR  We enjoyed sitting at the bar and having the best drinks made by the best bar man every Salvador making cocktails rum and coke and shots I have never heard of. Thank you for making our evenings so much fun. Also thank you to little fish and Garfield I hope I got there nicknames right they too were great bar staff.

Cons
1. It does get hot in the the hotel bar area this could be improved

2. We got moved rooms 5 days before we left as there was a problem with our ac ( we didn't complain so not sure why we were moved ) we got a call at 1930 and were told that someone would be up in half hour to help us move rooms. No one turned up we wait an hour than took a packed bags down to reception were we were meat with the rudest staff member in th  hotel. Who was in no hurry to help us or explain why we had to more. So of we went to new room in building 4 no we're near as nice as our first room. I went down the next morning and saw our rep. That night we had a call to say we were being moved to a suite as a sorry of the the first move. We were happy to stay were we were that's untill 430 that morning I woke up to go to the bath room and the room was flooded so at 8am packed bags again and went down to reception to say we would move rooms this time we were dealt with the same lovely service we had had from the rest of our stay the only problem room would not be ready untill 2 no problem no problem really we went to the beach. Came back at two,a manager came to tell us the suite was not available but again because of the problems we had had they were upgrading us to royal service for the rest of our stay. Wow thank you.
Back to the good
Royal service so wish we had done this it was amazing the staff were great and th  pool and beds fab.

So overall a great hotel with the best staff. With a little problem which the hotel sorted with no problems. I guess by being polite and not shouting and screaming you get things. Please remember this when you are staying at hotels the staff work so hard and are great there is no need to be rude to them.

Overall a great hotel with great staff Thank you for making our holiday memorys even more special. Would we return yes with out a secound thought the only thing we would change is to stay in the royal services this is just because of the adult only pool.

reviews.author: Zee
reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.text: My first time going which was actually in May of 2013 and I loved it. The beds were very comfortable and the food was pretty good. We had an all inclusive deal. Would I stay again..yes I would! I really enjoyed the balcony view, waking up hearing the water and going outside on the balcony.

reviews.author: Dominic Z
reviews.title: Nice stay but was stolen from by housekeepers
reviews.text: Overall the property and employees were very nice. Settlement to our experience was having money stolen by housekeeping. After talking to front desk and being questioned by "investigation team" of hotel employees we were never offered anything in retribution. We were told at checkout to contact their chief concierge. Due to this I would not stay or recommend this property.

reviews.author: jc1222014
reviews.title: 3.5 stars at best
reviews.text:
I did plenty of research before booking this resort.  Speaking as  a family of well-traveled individuals ( 5 adults and one child)  who are used to fine dinning and 5 star accommodations, it is 3.5 stars at best.  Here are my lists of pros and cons, but I have to warn you it is going to be mostly cons:
Pros:
1) room was clean and somewhat modern, oceanview was very nice.  Lagoon view wasn't bad either, you get a view of amazing sunset. (We had one room of each)
2) friendly staff, everyone was saying helllo's to my son, wait staff at the buffet went out of their way to get things for you, then again we tip well so the wait staff loves to see us.
3) we went first week of September, so not very crowded. decent size pool and great beach.
4) My husband wanted me to add that he liked the tacos in blue agave.
5) Confirmation phone regarding the room service items you requested, if you have not received the items, they will resent it.
6) close to airport, convenient to take public transportation if you don't want to take a cab.

Cons:
1) mediocre food, most things at the buffet are super salty even after requesting less salt on cook as you order items. If you are used to fine dinning and 5 star resorts and restaurant, don't expect the same.  All the food at the restaurants taste about the same. All came from the same kitchen pretty much.  I would say the only difference between the buffet food and special restaurant is presentation, or else pretty much the same food.
2) Food at the so call sushi bar, first of all, all they have is sushi, bad sushi.  The only thing we liked from there was the specialty drink of the night.
3) need to make reservation for all restaurants except the buffet, they grilled you regarding your reservation when there are literally no one at the restaurant at all.  They asked me who made the reservation for you, what is the confirmation number...
4) the pushy manager who tries to make you sign up for melia club, went through the presentation that went well enough then the manager guy came in and ruined everything.  My husband and I weren't impressed with the food or the services offered (which is a big part decision making when we decide on where to go for vacation), I told the manager that I am interested but the food is sub par and we don't want to lock in on going on vacations each year to places where I dislike the food.  He then tells me that don't worry, all the other melia club all inclusive resorts are better than this one, don't worry!  When I didn't reply, he started to offer me cheaper options to purchase, when I said it is not the amount of money (which it wasn't, it was more of whether we like the place enough or not), the manager replied it is always about money, and continues to offer cheaper options.  Starting from 35K option to 27K to 20K to 12K... At that point, I walked away from the table, he was insulting.  I have spent more money on bags than the options the managers were trying to push, it was NOT about the money.   
5)NO shows each night, just same lady singing different type of music each night.  So you either stay in your room watching tv or out eating mediocre food or drinking.
6) HATE the incense smell in the lobby, my mom got nauseous after 2 minutes in there.
7) AC blasting at full strength still wasn't not very cold.  Sweating during dinner time is not my idea of relaxing and having a good time. 
8) Children's play area is kind of dirty
9) Not a big menu for room service
10) Horrendous prices for the spa, I could get great facial and spa 
11) I was thinking upgrading to family concierge service at the resort thinking I can get a better deal, but I was very wrong.  They wanted to charge $90 per day per room, and all you get is butler that makes your dinner reservations as per other guests staying at the resort with family concierge. 
12) the 500/1500 resort credits are not resort credits, they are coupons.  The prices of the bali beds are different depending on the person you ask.  Never the same rate, I wonder if they just randomly say a number. 

Overall, don't go if you expect it to be 5 star, if you are expecting 3.5 star then you will be fine.

reviews.author: New O
reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.text: Second time going, cant wait until next month when we go back. Please remember a vacation is what you make out of it. Please stop writing things that have NOTHING to do with the hotel  (example: It was just ok because it rained the whole time....seriously!!!! Please do everyone a favor and just have FUN!!! ;-)

reviews.author: Reggie S
reviews.title: Very good resort staff need improvement at front desk
reviews.text: The resort the food everything was amazing my first time and will definitely come back but as for staff of front desk they need to fire all of them. When I arrived the booklet that was promised me with 1500 resort credit was not given to me according to them it wasn't on my reservation and I had to come back the next morning. I was told that I can get price match guaranteed I didn't. When I finally came back the next morning they gave me 1500 in coups not resort credit and told me that they cant price match unless I have a paper to prove it I didn't know I supposed take papers with me to compare prices. No room upgrade no price match! As for everything else it was amazing resort beautiful needs AC in the pyramid. I as also told that my toddler was going to get a crib instead they gave us a playpen.

reviews.author: Sonny S
reviews.title: Relaxing Stay
reviews.text:
Stayed at the resort last week with another family and we were pleased with the experience.  Plenty of room at the pool and restaurants and the rooms met our needs.

After reading other family reviews about the "family concierge", opted to splurge and do the same.  We requested Hervik as our butler and he didn't let us down.  He really is the best butler at the resort and we have to admit the extra money we paid for the service wouldn't have been worth it without him.  He checked in with us daily and made a real effort to make our stay special, including personalized notes, treats for the kids, and going out of his way to get the adults our bookings at restaurants and the pool.  Also highly recommend Manuel at Bana Restaurant - impeccable service and he really goes out of his way to make your dining experience a positive one.

Only downside was that we noticed that you had to ask for things repeatedly (except with Hervik).  This included towels (we were a family of 4, but they never gave us enough) and family concierge perks such as gaming consoles in your room and cookies/milk for the kids (out of 7 nights, kids only received twice).  And the ocean view is gorgeous, but the AC does struggle to keep the rooms cool.

reviews.author: michellef16
reviews.title: Below average - go to Playa del Carmen resort instead
reviews.text:
After staying at the Paradisus in Playa del Carmen, we were looking forward to the visit to the Cancun resort. There is absolutely no comparing the 2. I haven't been to any other resorts in Cancun, so my comparsion is against that.The only thing better about the Cancun resort is its proximity to the airport. 

Overall is just wasn't good. The food was not good - especially the room service. Also with the room service - no matter what time or what you ordered it always took over an hour (even if you ordered the night before there was a delay). The pools were ok, but the main pool with the bar was pretty deep and hard to stand and talk and relax for a long period of time. The service was subpar. The only exception was the spa! The massage was amazing.

reviews.author: Shani M
reviews.title: Child care is from 5 and up not 4 years
reviews.text:
The picture of paradisus Cuncun shows that kiddie pool had slides but it is In their playa del Carmen location not in Cuncun. 
 Also AC does not work inside the hotel it was very hot. We couldn't sit at the show area because it was like 80 degrees inside the hotel plus the candles added more heat it was very hot.

reviews.author: Rina. P
reviews.title: Excellent place to stay with family
reviews.text: Really enjoyed my stay during September month. My family really enjoyed staying at paradisus.  Definitely coming back to paradisus cancun during august and September month. Don't worry about the rain.!

reviews.author: Adi V
reviews.title: The Mandarin Oriental of Cancun
reviews.text:
The Paradisus in Cancun experience is like Mandarin Oriental without the hole in your pocket. 

First impression of the hotel's setup - layout, decoration, presence, open space - reminds me of the Opryland Hotel of Nashville. 

The views are stunning - I've been to this part of Mexico before, but I felt as if I were in a post card.

Views and creature comforts aside, what earns Paradisus the title of Mandarin Oriental of Cancun for me is the service.  You can train employees to follow this protocol, or that - but you can't teach genuine happiness.  

I was stunned by the genuine happiness of employees at Paradisus and this reflected in the service they provide.  Enrique Diaz Pérez, for example, who mans the main bar [Toji Bar] at Paradisus hosted my company and I graciously 5 nights in a row.  He never missed a beat, never missed a smile - taught us party tricks, and taught us about Mexico from his eyes. 

Service like this is meaningful to me.  Visiting Enrique in the evening is something my company and I looked forward to each evening.

Good job Paradisus.
Adi

reviews.author: AnneBay
reviews.title: Bad perfume/Glade plug-in smell throughout
reviews.text:
The hotel was excellent in service, pool, the people, etc. But the killer for us was the horrible glad scented plug-in smell piped through the air system. Was not in the rooms, thankfully, at least where we were, but all the common areas, elevators, bathrooms, the family concierge... Gave us bad headaches. They seemed to think it was some sort of "ambiance," apparently unaware that tons of research links perfume to migraines. Was really bad in the kids zone. Could not step foot inside the hotel without getting a headache. We complained a lot about it, but they said they could not do anything -- many of the staff hate it too, and would cover their noses. 
Wifi did not work except if you sat underneath the hub, which was in the hallway. 
Their version of a "suite" is a room with multiple beds, the size of a regular motel 6 room. We had to get the 1 bedroom to have any space (mother-in-law and child were with us), and that was a pull-out couch. All that would have been fine - the smell was the killer. 
Oh, there are not enough beach chairs with umbrellas to go around, so you have to go down early in the morning to reserve one -- 7am they were all gone but 1. You could pay for a Bali Bed, but most of those were on reserve for some other special group inside the hotel. And they cost $50 a day.

reviews.author: Dane S
reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: We go to Cancun every year and this trip at this hotel was the best so far.  The pools are great.  They are about 5' deep all around.  The swim up bar is awesome and Eric and Rafael are awesome bartenders.  The beach front is always clean and is great.  All I can say is that it was great.  The Avenue Bar with Salvador was a blast as well.  Restaurants were good and the service superb.

reviews.author: Joy K
reviews.title: 58 Steps to Paradise
reviews.text:
The hotel was good however, needs to improve on a few things if, they want to make it to 5 stars
- Hire a driver to bring the clients up  - always counted 58 steps up, just enough to put you on a  verge of a heart attack but, not quite.( I was wondering why I did not see any seniors at the hotel and now I know why).
- Remove the musty smell from the drawers (that is not good) all the rooms have it and that is a total turn off.
- All restaurants should be all inclusive - Talking about the Tempo.
- Wine should be included in all the restaurants.
- More selections in the buffet restaurant 
- Maitre D to seat the clients in -  clients should not be forced to find their own seats, this is not good customer service, unless it's a 1-2 star hotel.
This hotel does not deserve to be a 5 star hotel
Just a quick hello to Bianca (concierge/hotess) was amazing and quite helpful during our star from September 5th to September 12th.

reviews.author: PJeff81
reviews.title: Way off the mark
reviews.text:
This was my 4th time to Mexico where I had previously stayed at Sercets The Vine/Silversands/Maroma and Dreams Riviera. I thought I would book Paradisus for something different but very quickly regretted that decision. 

Positives:
Amazing beach. Crystal clear water and white sand. 
First impression of the Hotel was really nice. As soon as you walk in you think you are somewhere special. 
Unfortunately that's it! 

Negatives: 
Service: Awful! Too much to list so won't go into detail. 
Amenities: So it's an 'All inclusive Resort' but you need a wrist band? You will quickly realise that not only do you have to book restaurants every night for the next night at a specific time, but not every restaurant in the resort is included! 
Also the hotel don't seem to accept dollars. This would have been good to know at check in to save the embarrassment of going in the shop making our own coffee going to the till to be told you need local currency. 
You need cards for towels on the beach, which we didn't get at check in. Due to the size of the resort the last thing you want to do is be refused towels on the beach and have to walk through the hotel in wet trunks. Why aren't there towels on the sun beds? 
Rooms: Poor. So on the balcony you get 1 sun lounger? So I guess your meant to top and tail with your loved one?  
Food: I'm not a fussy eater in the slightest but I couldn't eat anything that was put in front of me. No taste, no presentation and not really much choice. 

Conclusion: 
Having been to other resorts in the area it is obvious that Paradisus is so far away from being a five star hotel. I would strongly advise you to consider any secrets, dreams or now resort. All inclusive to them means all inclusive, no restaurant reservations required, amazing food and impeccable service. You are treated with a real personal touch unlike Paradisus where you are just a number. 
Two nights into our stay here we knew we couldn't bare it anymore so fortunately our holiday rep changed us to Secrets Silversands, which was AMAZING! Paradisus showed no remorse in losing our custom. Summed it up for us!!

reviews.author: Miguel C
reviews.title: The Best Hotel in the Cancun Hotel Area!!!
reviews.text: The best hotel inside the cancun hotel area. Incredible rooms with great view to the beach, excellent room service and even a personal consierge if you acquire the royal service package. However, the most awesome thing is the work the hotel has placed in designed for all the guest an array of more than 10 restaurants inside the resort. You can make reservation to have a nice rodizo dinner in front of the beach or a great sushi feast at their incredible restaurant bana! Everything has been neatly woven to make the best experience for their guest. To make things even more incredible as a guest you are indulged daily with an aroma of lavender in the lobby or hallways. The best hotel in Cancun! Must stay!

reviews.author: AtxGal90
reviews.title: AMAZING!! Wont stay anywhere else from now on!!!
reviews.text: This place is absolutely amazing!!! Only complaint is make sure your not on floor zero.view was awful but we got moved the next day so everything was fine and please tone down the incense it is way too much and not a good smell while drinking. Food was absolutely outstanding!! You have to go to the market grill and taco tequilla bar those were major standouts. Staff is very friendly and drinks were not watered down. Cannot say enough how much my girlfriends and I enjoyed this resort. Rodrigo and the girl (forgot her name) from the entertainment team were outstanding and team players we even got him to do a belly flop! Angel from Mole and Rudy in reservations/guest services. I will only recommend this resort to everyone and I even work for a resort company here that has one in Cancun I didnt even stay at. Thanks so much for a last summer vacation Paradisus Ill be seeing you again!!!

reviews.author: Melody707
reviews.title: Tempo at the Paradisus Cancun is Outstanding!!
reviews.text: Our time at the Paradisus Cancun was Amazing!  From the time we checked in until we said our good byes, we felt like we were the most important people at the hotel.  The Outstanding service from the staff made us never want to leave. The highlight of our time at the Paradisus Cancun was our dinner at Tempo.  Chefs Ismael & Felipe prepared us a meal like no other.  We had the tasking menu with the wine pairing.  Each course was better than the next, there were 10 courses.   The presentation was out of the ordinary.  The flavors of each course exploded with flavors.  Carlos, the Sommelier brought out the pairing wines that complimented each course. Our waiter Raul was attentive to our every needs.  We will be back to Cancun, and I guarantee I will be back at Paradisus Cancun and Tempo.

reviews.author: jojo348
reviews.title: Royal Service is the way to go!
reviews.text:
A special thank you to Alfonso and Vulery for the great service, wonderful food and superb accommodations. Highly recommend this resort, especially the Royal Service, adults only
 Section of the resort.

reviews.author: Kara E
reviews.title: Very Nice   Butler did a fine job when he was there
reviews.text: We had a great time for our anniversary.  Couple of minor this were wrong, but nothing to detract from overall experience.  Air-conditioning could have been better.  Butler went out of his way the day of our anniversary.  However the next two days he was off and no-one took his place.  I would go again, but not get so drunk lol.  beautiful resort

reviews.author: abrinker
reviews.title: Amazing, but cut back on the "presentations of the VIP suites"..
reviews.text: I racked my brain for 3 weeks prior to booking this resort. I read all the negative reviews because I didn;t want to be disappointed like our last Mexico vacation. Three years prior, we stayed at the Melia Real in Cabo and it was a disaster! This place was beautiful! As soon as we walked in, we were greeted by a man by the name of Juan Pablo. He was amazing! Def deserves a raise! He walked us over to the check in and showed us around a bit. The atrium is beautiful, breathtaking and well maintained. The place smells excellent (thats the first thing I noticed when we walked through the front door). The room was up to par, we got a deluxe oceanfront room. The view was excellent. We were able to see the ocean, pool and the beach. However, if anyone is reading this: PLEASE GET TWO CHAIRS FOR THE BALCONIES! Not sure why there would only be one, but this is a recommendation. Now, I will warn you. Arriving at the airport, we were bombarded with people trying to get us a shuttle (Orbitz failed to email me back about a shuttle, but thats another story) and we got suckered into a timeshare thing right out of the gate. Once we got to the hotel, the same thing..but they call these "presentations". The guy doing the presentations was ok, but this was out of our realm of possibility and they were persistent. Once my husband started to get upset after saying "no" numerous times, they backed off and let us go. They promised us two spa packages (we never got) but we did get to go on a jungle tour (canal tour in the lagoon) and snorkeling so it wasn't too upsetting. My husband did have to go to the hospital because he did get a gastrointestinal infection and put him out of commission for the last two days there, but we do not know where this came from, since I almost ate and drank the same things as him. The food selection for the all inclusive was not too shabby since the Melia in Cabo was disgusting and tasteless.The wifi was meterocre, it was working in the one room (we asked for a king bed and had to wait a day) but didn't work in the other. We had to go out in the atrium to get it to work. Overall, this was a great place for us to spend our 3rd anniversary and will be traveling back at some point in time.

reviews.author: Lawrence C
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text:
It was like the name ...Paradisus says it, Paradise for us.
Some notable staff: Jorge Rosy from Mole, Eder M Mijangos (everywhere), Martin from Fuego...all restaurants were top notch, Vento with great tapas, once is never enough. We will be back...soon.

reviews.author: Judy F
reviews.title: Do not fall for their trap on timeshares
reviews.text: Overall, the resort was amazing. The customer service was excellent. Orlando, yovanni, and Julio were amazing. They were very nice and welcoming at the bar at Bana and at the all you can eat buffet for breakfast. Thank you for a wonderful experience.

reviews.author: Max R
reviews.title: Fabulous
reviews.text:
Wonderful  place. We really enjoyed our stay in this hotel. Employees are really awaiting to assist you. Nice food, never repeated.  Great infrastructure in and out. My 3 years old boy enjoyed every minute spend. 
Large list of liquors not like others All inclusive hotels. 
Hotel and bedrooms always cleaned. 
Sadness of leaving this place but convinced on coming back soon. 1000% recommended.  Recommended book more than 3 nigths if you want to take trips.

reviews.author: Sasha R
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text:
Lets just start by saying that everything about this hotel was exceptional. The location is beautiful, gorgeous white sandy beach.. pretty large beach front for the hotel. 2 pools which was also a plus. We didn't have the royal service and it was still a perfect trip.. the lagoon front suites are just as beautiful as the ocean fronts. 

The food was truly to die for from the general buffet Nao which served breakfast, lunch and dinner.. to Market grill which was another lunch and dinner option .. and the restaurants which only served dinner. Everything was cooked to perfection.. the pozole at blue agave was delicious.. 1st time trying sushi and Bana was definitely the way to go for that. 

The staff was extremely friendly.. Carlos and Erick at the swim up bar were phenomenal, our new best friends. Riccardo at Nao was our waiter most of our stay, so attentive from day 1.

All in all great trip.. will definitely be returning soon.

reviews.author: Babiesjz
reviews.title: Paradisus needs to work on customer service
reviews.text: Traveler be aware! Paradisus is a beautiful hotel but it seriously needs major improvements in the area of customer service especially the folks that work in Tower 5, Royal Service.  Hotel is clean and presentable. It has a lovely smell as soon as you walk into the hotel.  Taking the recommendation from another Trip Advisor review,  my husband and I decided to upgrade to Royal Service.  With this service, you are supposed to have a butler that makes your dinner reservations, free WIFI, bali beds for two days, bed down, a scented pillow with a choice of the aroma you like, etc.  I got to Paradisus on a Friday and left on a Tuesday and never met my butler.  Needless to say I had to go to the concierge desk a couple of times and make my own dinner & spa reservations. The second day when I complained about the poor service we were receiving, I got a temporary (just for one day) butler assigned.  I received a bed down two days because I asked for it.  I received my scented pillow only one day because I asked for it and because I called at 9pm wondering where my pillow was.  I know all these things may sound pity but if you are paying money for these services why not be upset? I'm not sure about the other towers and rooms BUT the walls in the Royal Service are really thin.  I could hear my neighbor's TV and it was so loud that I couldn't even hear my own TV.  The following day, my neighbor woke up at 4:30AM and blasted his TV. This is not the hotel's fault but what I do blame the hotel for was their slow response to my request.  I called the front desk and it took them forever to call "the neighbor" so he could lower his TV.  It was very annoying.  On another note, several workers seemed like they didn't like working there.  Others like Rogelio and Gerardo (they both work by the Royal Service pool) were the BOMB!! I mean top notch service with drinks and food.  Thanks to them is why I'm not giving this hotel a lower rating.  In my opinion, the food was good.  Didn't really like Ibana (I think it's spelled like that) but it's a Japanese restaurant.  Fuego and Vento are pretty good.  The weather was good as well....sunny and then it would start raining but overall the weather was great.  If you are looking for a good place to stay I heard from a few people at the airport Secrets is the place to be. On my next trip to Cancun, I will definitely not stay at Paradisus and check out Secrets instead.

reviews.author: ArthurC123
reviews.title: We had a fantastic and memorable time!
reviews.text:
We spent 6 days at this resort and had an amazing time. We upgraded to a royal service room which brought us into a separate building with loads of extras that are very worth it. We got a larger room, separate dining area, personal butler, and best of all the Bali beds by an exclusive pool. Ask for a butler named "Cesar Conde De La Fuente," I'm not sure how he compares with the others but he was very helpful and made our stay very memorable by leaving surprises in our room and helped me plan a special dinner at one of the restaurants. The restaurants at dinner require reservation so having a butler remind us is really helpful because you will forget.

The separate area that houses the royal service rooms had its own continental breakfast, its own bar with premium liquor, and appetizers as well so you never have to walk too far for a drink or a snack. The royal service area is adults only, so for our entire trip we didn't hear any children or saw them run around except for the main areas. That itself already makes the ideal vacation.

The resort had great restaurants but our overall favorite during our stay was La Palapa which was an outdoor exclusive dining for breakfast and lunch. It was pool side and has a perfect view of the ocean and also only a few steps away to the white sandy beach as well. When we found out on the 2nd day about La Palapa, we were there everyday. If you are at La Palapa or the Pool/Bali Beds look for our new friends 'Francisco Terrazas' and 'Michael Mayorga.' You must look for them as we only wanted them to serve us our last few days as they truly made our experience above and beyond. 
For dinner was definitely Market Grill which was a Brazilian style BBQ restaurant and it's the only restaurant we ate at twice, mainly because of the culmination of atmosphere and the style of food and service. 
The Beach Bar was great for drinks late at night and there is comfortable seating that have a perfect view of the waves from the ocean. We preferred going into town for nightlife but the Red Lounge is perfect for the first day we arrived when we haven't planned anything yet.

Overall we had a fantastic time and if we were to go back to Cancun we wouldn't think twice about where to stay.

reviews.author: George L
reviews.title: Very relaxing
reviews.text: Paradises is a beautiful resort with many amenities. However, for the party people I suggest you venture down town Cancun. The Red Lounge has nicertainly decor but lack the music to fully entertain. The spa is wonderful. My butler Cesar is very courteous and quite helpful. The royal services package is the best way to go. The private pool and Bali bed made our anniversary quite memorable!

reviews.author: Héctor Q
reviews.title: Magnificent service
reviews.text:
Planned a week vacation at the Paradisus Cancun expecting a good hotel stay. Instead I found a beautiful resort with 5 Star service. The all inclusive amenities were great even when we eat only two meals a day and do not drink that much alcohol. This is our third trip to Cancun. The Paradisus Cancun is the best place yet.  What impressed me the most was the outstanding service and friendly staff.  From the minute we got to the lobby to the second we left it was a memorable experience. The white sand beach and beautiful pool was great. 

We had the chance to observe the preparations and attention to detail for a destination wedding.  Great setting. 

Nancy with the Melia Club anticipated our needs at every point of our stay. 

We are looking forward to going back within a year.

reviews.author: Karamarie12
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Paradisus was great. Perfect location (close to mall, near club zone), peaceful and relaxing. Staff is so nice and helpful. The royal service is the way to go. They go above and beyond to meet your needs. The resort has great restaurants and an awesome pool area. I would definitely go back. Cesar was an amazing butler to us during our week. :)

reviews.author: Maryorie O
reviews.title: Amazing hotel!!! Perfect place!!!
reviews.text:
I was the last 5 days in a perfect hotel, for relax, exciting offers of pleasure, excellent workers, I will recommend!!!
The installations so beautiful, the food and presentation was amazing, I have the best vacation ever, thanks paradissus!!!

reviews.author: travelbug0ne
reviews.title: Service with a smile
reviews.text: Just got back from Paradisus Cancun and had a great time largely due to the staff who did their best to make your trip special. Victor Chale from the pool bar worked really hard to make sure all your needs were met. Rafael and Julian at the pool bar were also great bartenders- all were friendly to talk to. The hotel was clean, comfortable and in a great location with a great pool and pool bar. Drinks were good- plenty of cocktails, beers- dos equis,tecate and sol (would have preferred corona).  Night entertainment not bad but too short- done by 9pm. Staff at check in annoying trying to push melia club aka time share-not what you want especially right as you check in. Food was the biggest disappointment- the buffet was always cold except for the eggs from the grill. Layout of buffet odd especially at breakfast. Need to keep hot food with hot & cold with cold. French toast etc should be by the grill and it should be kept hot. Every morning we had warm eggs and cold everything else(toast, potatoes, bacon when you could get it). Restaurants at night average- Vento was the best. Beach was great- white sand,water warm. Rooms and beds comfortable.

reviews.author: Olivia H
reviews.title: Lovely hotel-great all inclusive food
reviews.text:
I stayed with my husband at this hotel for a week at the beginning of May 2014. We booked through Expedia and everything worked great. Overall we had a great time at this all-inclusive hotel: great beach, great service, modern decor, and good food. The hotel lobby is just incredible!  

Beach: sensational as always; the ocean is just unbelievable-we spent most of the time in the water which is warm and incredibly clean and blue; no seaweeds whatsoever; big waves, which are normal for Cancun. The beach had numerous straw umbrellas with comfortable long chairs. We could always find available chairs, even late morning. There were several pools with pool bars.  

Room: We booked a "lagoon view" room which we knew is would be just a non-ocean view. Because we arrived at mid-night due to delays with our flight, the only acceptable room was in the "pyramid 4", on the fist floor with no view at all, big patio, but just a view toward a utility building. The first room that they offered was on 4th floor but we thought the A/C was too noisy so we did not take it. The room on 1st floor was huge with marble floors. We liked it but because we received some coupons for hotel use we decided to move to a ocean-view room two days later. This room had an incredible view of the ocean but the balcony door did not close perfectly (broken??) so the A/C was not able to cool the room very well; even running continuously it could not cool the room below 74-76 F. They tried to fix the A/C but that did not help. We eventually realized that the door was the problem. Anyways not a big issue-we did not spend much time in the room during the day.

Food: very good; great variety of restaurants. The buffet was the best, even for dinner; great variety and tasty. We had dinner at several of their reservation-based restaurants. We liked "Mole", a Mexican cuisine restaurant, the most and "Fuego"the least.    

Service was very good; all restaurant servers were very nice and helpful; receptionists very accommodating and the guys at the concierge desk very helpful.

reviews.author: JOSE RAUL COLON
reviews.title: Want To Return
reviews.text:
Our trip to Melia Paradisus was exceptional in every aspect.  We were a group of seven people that  enjoyed practically everything that the hotel had to offer.  We enjoyed ourselves so much at the hotel that we really needed more days in Cancun, since there is so much to do  To start off our conductor was right on time, even though he was waiting for two different flights.  The fee was reasonable, thanks to Melia Paradisus they recommended "Tropical Incentives"
As soon as we entered the hotel, it was so impressive.  We were welcomed at the entrance with the fragrance of Lavender.  It penetrates from the entrance to the exit of the hotel.  Paradisus truly looks a like a Maya Pyramid..Plants hanging from the highest floor to the first floor.  a beautiful architectural work of art, together with nature. Our concierge Glendy  was very professional and helped us in everything we needed. All the restaurant reservations were arranged by her.. By far to us the best restaurant was the Mole (Mexican food) it was special..Food was served in a replica of a Mexican Hacienda.   The food was delicious in all the restaurants and  the waiters were attentive..There was a wide selection of wines and drinks. Naos is the buffet restaurant, they prepare  your personal omelet or whichever way you want your eggs .The only thing that was lacking was the evening show.  It was too early, at 8pm and every evening at that hour we were dining.  So we missed all the shows.  Another thing have your towels or a personal belonging  ready to reserve your lounge chairs by the pool during the early morning or the evening beforel. Would we return? We will definitely return. Everything that the hotel offered, they fulfilled.

reviews.author: Mary V
reviews.title: Fantastic resort and staff
reviews.text: I loved the Paradisus Cancun Resort and all the staff was so friendly.  I had a wonderful time there.  The rooms were nice and clean the food was great.  I want to also point out that Ignacio Vorquez (hope this is the correct spelling of his last name) in the NAOS Buffett, in the AM hours was the best waiter ever.  He was so helpful and on top of everything.  It almost felt like he was our own personal waiter, but that was not the case, he was helping so many people and was very good at his job.  He was just so wonderful to me and my family every morning.  I would highly recommend this resort.  It is absolutely beautiful and the beaches and pools are great.

reviews.author: Ervis S
reviews.title: Dinning
reviews.text:
Great place for vacation. I love this place. The only thing that I recommend is they should put an ice cream machine at the buffet. The other thing I want to say is the service. The server thing that young people dont leave tip. A few time I had to call the server for a drink or a question I had.
Everything was perfect.
Thank you
Suar484

reviews.author: Mathew Z
reviews.title: It was a nice hotel but with some flaws
reviews.text: I stayed there during x-mas last year and i decided to finally write this review. Staff was friendly but my friends and I was harassed by locals at the beach trying to sell me cigars.  Food was ok but the location and beach was fantastic.  Entertainment was really good. The singers and dancers were gorgeous.  If wasn't in a loving relationship I would hit on every staff member there. but all seriousness. It's a good hotel but the cleaning lady didn't come to my room at some days which really upset me and my friends that we had to take it up to management.

reviews.author: Michael L
reviews.title: All Inclusive All the Way!
reviews.text:
Paradisus was my first vacation to a tropical destination and it did not disappoint.  The beaches and water were absolutely beautiful.  We booked our trip a couple months in advance for the last week of April - post spring break craze.  It was approximately $1K per person for flight and a 6 day / 5 night stay at Paradisus, all inclusive - a total bargain.  The only times we left the resort were for short daytime activities like the dolphin experience at dolphinaris or snorkeling adventures, so we had alot of time to experience the resort amenities and staff.  

The Good:

-The beach - beautiful sands, comfortable chairs (although if you've read other reviews about the war for good beach chairs, it's all true - they're typically all gone by 8-9am).  I believe Paradisus has one of the largest areas of beachfront in Cancun.

-The staff - generally very cordial and friendly.  I spent whole days on the beach drinking Miami Vice's, Mojitos, and Electric Lemonades.  The waitresses would be back before I finished my last drink most of the time.  Just be sure to tip them!  

The Bad:

-Room was poor - we were upgraded to a beach view room right above the bar in the central building.  It was pretty windy while we were there which made our room difficult to cool and 100% humidity - massive air leak through the balcony door.  Being right above the bar was terrible.  Constant stomping and extremely loud music until midnight every night.  The combination of noise and humidity made it difficult to sleep.

-Food was average - it is nice to be able to drop into the buffet for a snack whenever, but besides the buffet and the taco place (blue agave I believe), it was difficult to eat at the other restaurants in the resort.  We were told to make a reservation 24 hours in advance, but they wouldn't take reservations and insisted we try an hour prior to dinner service, so we did.  Restaurants were empty when dinner service started and we were still asked to wait an hour for a table?  It seems like they're saving tables for their VIP or Club Melia guests should they show up... more on this later.  The quality of the food, especially at the buffet, wasn't great.  Blue Agave was decent, the tapas restaurant was good, and the Brazilian steakhouse place was average.

-No Air Condition in the common areas of the hotel - not sure if this was specific to my stay.  It was bearable when just walking around, but if you have dinner at the sushi place in the center of the hotel be prepared to sweat.  It feels like sitting in the middle of a 100 degree rainforest.  One of the most uncomfortable meals I've ever eaten.  I wanted to leave rather than wait the hour it took to get the food to our table. 

-Preferential treatment toward VIP and Club Melia - this happens everywhere but is better disguised than at Paradisus.  I couldn't get a reservation at a restaurant without standing around a couple hours because of the color wristband I was wearing - unacceptable.  Roped off areas on the beach for VIP and Club Melia.  Earlier I said that I believe Paradisus has the largest stretch of beach in Cancun, but for normal guests you only have access to a third.  Two-thirds is reserved for VIP and Club Melia guests.

All-in-all the stay was pleasant - I've been through worse in my life.  The beach was so serene and beautiful that it overshadows the shortcomings of my Paradisus experience.  There was a pretty stark contrast between the service found near the pool and beach vs. the service and treatment inside the resort.  Should I return to Cancun, I would explore staying at a different resort, but wouldn't be disappointed if I ended up back at Paradisus.

reviews.author: HappyHawaiian1018
reviews.title: Great hotel - wonderful location and service
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus for the first time.  
The hotel is only 15 minutes or so from the airport.  
We upgraded to Royal Service after reading reviews here on TripAdvisor and we were so glad we did.  You are assigned a "Butler" who helps arrange all of your meals/times as well as any preferences.  Royal Service has its own building, its own pool and its own beach access.  There was never a time that we had more than 2-3 people near us while sitting in our palapa facing the beach.  Service was great and the restaurants were sooo good.  Breakfast each morning facing the ocean was perfect and there were quite a few healthier options to choose from.
If you are looking for a nice romantic quiet place to spend time with your "Someone Special" the Royal Service at the Paradisus is the place to be.

reviews.author: MichaelPGallagher
reviews.title: Very unhappy with Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: When we arrived we were told there was no room available even though we paid in full 6 months prior to arrival and bookit.com confirmed reservation the day prior to arrival. We were informed that we could be moved to another property called ME, which was a adult orientated resort. We informed the girl at the desk by the name of Guadalupe that we did not think that was sufficient since we were travelling with our children. She continued to argue with us that there was no room and that we had no other option but to stay at ME for over an hour. We refused to accept this offer and insisted we speak with a manager. We also told her we would be contacting the travel agent and will not be providing a favorable review. She stepped away for 15 minute and then came back to inform us that there was an early checkout and there was a room available but we would need to wait 2 hours for them to clean it. When we got to the room 3.5 hours after we arrived, the room was not what we expected. There was just two beds and a small table in the corner. No pull out couch. There was also a puddle of water in the hallway as the A/C was leaking. We called maintenance to fix, which they did and it took 1 hour. During the next two days we discovered that the room had many issues including mold in the bathroom, bugs, the sliding door to the patio was broken, the shower curtain rod was broken and hanging out of the wall. We took photos of all these issues and reported them to the staff. 2 days after staying there the shower stopped working. My wife went down to the front desk and complained and was told by the desk that they would look for another room for us. She told us that she would call us at our room within 20 minutes. 1.5 hours later we did not hear from anyone and went down to the desk and found that the girl had left for the day and had not spoken to anyone about the issue. We then explained our issue to a girl named Alejandra who said she would speak to her manager. We went to eat dinner and when we returned she had another room for us.we received no apologies or acceptance of blame. We came to this resort to unwind and enjoy a vacation, but instead we were extremely upset and stressed out for almost half of our vacation. We were also chased down by the resort after check-in and were told they had a welcome package for us, which we found out was only a ploy to try to get us to sit through a presentation to purchase a vacation package. Based on our experiences, we will never stay with the chain of resorts again, nor would we recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: jnrausch
reviews.title: A Great Way to Celebrate a Special Event in Your Life
reviews.text: Comfort and relaxation from arrival to departure.  Polite, courteous and accomodating staff.  Great beach, great food, great service, and the entire resort is maintained daily by a large staff of workers.  If you want a relaxing vacation, this is the place to go!  We would recommend this destination to friends and family.  Although it is an "all inclusive" resort, they offer many restaurants with a variety of food offerings and the food was great (recommend you make restaurant reservations upon arrival).  I highly reccomend spending as much time on the beach as possible, it is beautiful!

reviews.author: Al E
reviews.title: Melia vs Paradisus
reviews.text:
This is our second trip to this hotel , we came to celebrate my sisters birthday and this was prob not our last trip here. I'll start with some quick tips:

Exchange your dollars at the hotel, they'll pay approx 12.60 pesos per dollar, whereas the US airport pays 11.25, and the cancun airport pays 10.50 approximately.
Wear light clothing and flats cause the hotel is big and some spots are humid.
We reserved through bookit.com and our airport transfer through BestDay with no problems. Do make sure you contact the BestDay rep at the hotel at least 48 hrs prior to your departure to ensure you get your ticket. Shop at the Oxxo across the street (7eleven type of store and much cheaper), there's also a pharmacy next to it. City buses ok to use for less than $1.
we booked all inclusive -makes very convenient. People please tip the staff, they truly deserve it.

Pros: 
Butler service has improved, definitely much better in our 2nd trip.
The staff service: you'll find most hotel staff are pleasant, about 99%of the time they will smile and be courteous. We actually didn't encounter anyone being rude, but the buffet staff you can tell they are super super busy that they have no time to check on you but once, twice the most. The service at Naos and Market Grill not my fav.
The beach is beautiful, restrooms clean, crowd is mostly families and adults. No crazy teenage behavior noted. 
AC in our room: we stayed in the 3rd tower and the AC worked just fine, kept us cool.
Hotel flowery scent: didn't not bother me at all, my mother Loved it!!!
Room service: staff attentive, although limited choices, wait time approx 30-45 min depending on the time of the day.

Cons: lack of shade around the pool. We found plenty of shade on the beach, but none by the pool if you show up after 10:00.
Food and service at Naos: We ate breakfast at Naos everyday, they always had the same things, food is ok, the scrambled eggs have some kind of light green sauce that made them very watery, and I don't consider myself picky but that stood out to me. We had to inconvenient the staff to make special trips for salt cause there's none available unless you ask some one for it. The other restaurants were excellent.

Big thanks to:
Leonardo at Tempo who saved our last night at the hotel with his splendid service !! (our last night almost went sour after being turned down by the manager for being late 30 min. (?)  (due to a misunderstanding on our reservation time). We insisted and the manager finally decided to let us stay after a short unnecessary speech.
Also, Violeta at the Bali beds who was very attentive, very sweet lady. 
And to our family concierge Alvaro who checked on us every day, and provided us with very efficient service. Two years ago when the hotel was still Melia our fam booked in the Royal service side ( now adults only) and back then we never even met our butler or heard from him/her during our stay.  Back then, we really loved the privacy of the 5th tower, and the little private breakfast area in the tower, we had our son with us who was then 1 year old. This time I missed that quiet privacy you get from the 5th tower but Alvaro's service and attention to details made up for it. Very courteous gentleman, always handled everything with a smile.
In general:
Is the hotel 100% perfect? No, but you do get a pretty dang deal for your money, totally worth it. The hotel inside look and environment is beautiful. If you happen to not like it you are definitely very picky in my opinion.
Would I come back to Paradisus? Oh yesss!! 
To management: please consider accepting children in the 5th tower again, this was the reason why we fell in love with this hotel in the 1st place, and please provide salt shakers for Naos, thank you!!!

reviews.author: Ramona H
reviews.title: Wonderful place!!!
reviews.text: Super clean, comfy, best talent ever seen at resort, singers and dancers, romantic and beautiful! Beach and pool amazing, food was very good and exceptional at Moles with Leonardo, Rody and Sonia!!! Drinks were perfect!  Didn't settle for less on anything! Staff was awesome!! Thanks for a perfect week!  We've been to many all inclusive resorts.  Rates in the top!!! Music in Lobby in evening was amazing!  Dancers were super great!

reviews.author: Sam G
reviews.title: Excellent resort and service!
reviews.text:
This hotel is one of our favorite places to visit when we travel to Cancun.....its just a beautiful property!
I would recommend it to everyone I know who would be traveling to Cancun. Very well kept property!

reviews.author: Gan0829
reviews.title: Nice ...BUT.. Choices are not there.
reviews.text: Food choices are very poor. Some staff are really really nice .. while some doesn't seem to enjoy working. We tip every time went to the restaurants ..but the service is not up to standards. Internet very slow. Most disappointment was the food.

reviews.author: Hawra A
reviews.title: Excellent hotel
reviews.text: 3rd time visiting Cancun definitely loved the hotel, all inclusive was a great deal everyone found a restaurant they loved, in room dining lacks variety. Hotel gift shops / convince shop is waaaay overpriced. If you're there for the night life, I would suggest a hotel closer to the clubs, but overall would highly recommend this facility.

reviews.author: Ever L
reviews.title: Coco's bar
reviews.text: Ice cold drinks cocos bar crew treated me like a king great beach the only thing Monday-Wednesday they need a DJ or the music at the bar louder.The best service hands down my friend Antonio Gonzales was the man also Christian & Erick the best thanks again see you guys  next year.

reviews.author: jdogger
reviews.title: Over-rated, Hotel itself has issues.
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus August 23-27.  All the talk about the strong, piped in scents at check-in are true, it did not bother me as much as my wife, but I would have preferred it was turned down about 80%. Upon check-in the receptionist told us they were at 80% occupancy that week, but had been at 100% for a month prior, this is the off-season, so the hotel must be popular.  Another factor could have been the sale, ME, their parent company was offering $200.00 off per stay through  Expedia, that effected our decision immensely.  Service at check-in and through-out our stay was acceptable, nothing great but is worked, we did tip on every service based occasion, it did not seem to help the service level, but it did help the consistency, I noticed some non-tippers did not get as many return check-ups from the servers that my wife and I enjoyed.

        As far as the rooms, we were not impressed, we stayed on the fourth level in building one, This is the building for time-share owners, they must use extra rooms for guests, we are not owners.  They did give us the black bracelets for owners, I think this gave us more access to the shaded beach chairs, they always had open chairs with palapa shade available in the members only area, even after lunch, but the regular guests had much less to choose from, it was confusing, we saw quite a few people sit down and get moved because they did not have the black bracelets, we did not like this, had we been asked to leave there were no shaded areas open elsewhere.  Back to the room, we paid extra for the ocean view upgrade, but we were in the back of the pyramid directly facing building 2, and did not have much of a view, 75% blocked, with a small partial view of the water/beach.  The balcony had no shade, and only one lounger, useless unless you want to get a sun-burn.  The room was somewhat small, the bed did start to hurt our backs after a few nights, the television only had 2-3 English channels, and it took two days to get hand towels.  The AC and other room amenities were functioning properly.  If you enjoy extra time in the room, it's not ideal.

Other issues were:
The heat in central areas/ restaurants.  We are from a desert climate, so I thought the heat would not be a problem, but is did get irritating, every time we would set down to eat, we would lose our appetites because of the heat and humidity in the building.
The confusion over hotel ammenities use, they have a lot of "Me club members only" and "Royal Service only" areas, it is stressful to find a place to sit without getting kicked off. 
Horrible wifi.  Don't come here if you need a lot of bandwith, my wife and I tried to watch Netflix and would get kicked out of  their wifi every 2 to 3 minutes, it was very frustrating.  It was slow and inconsistent, just good enough to check emails, banking sites, etc,  even then it was logging us out all the time.
Stay away from the hotel store, we forgot sunblock and had to pay $35.00 dollars for a $5.00 tube of banana boat sunscreen!

Overall we would not return to this hotel, service, rooms, and ammenities do not 
warrant it.  As for the food, we enjoyed it the most, we hate to wake up for a "chance" at a reservation. so we stayed with the buffet and Blue Agave, the food was presented well, colorful and full of flavor, smoothie bar, green drink, were awesome!  The only down side to the food, was the hot and humid eating conditions.  We tried room service one evening to stay in our cool room, the options were extremely limited, it did arrive on time, but was cold.

reviews.author: AntilleanOriental
reviews.title: In a word... AWESOME!
reviews.text: I have been to Cancun several times... this time for work. The hotel is amazing and the staff makes it even better! the Mole restaurant was my favorite. I didn't experience Tempo but did tour the wine room... WOW!

reviews.author: Englishmastiffs
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text: Enjoyed our stay at the Paradisus. First plus was no aggressive sale personal which was a plea an surprise. Building is very different & cool both. Huge pyramid with five different buildings. Was a bit of walk to the beautiful beach front but that would depend I guess what building you were in but not Abigail deal for us. We had a studio room that accommodated 3 adults just find and we even had a jacuzzi on the balcony. We did not do the all inclusive so little bit more of a challenge to eat but I believe they have changed it to mandatory now. That's a bummer! We highly recommend the Blue Gecko across the street and towards Captains Cove(also delicious and fun). It's a outside small restaurant with fusion tacos of ALL kinds. Worth the walk over there for sure!

reviews.author: Tennesseegirls
reviews.title: Amazing service at the pool bar
reviews.text: We visited this past week for 4 out of 5 visitors first time to Cancun. It was a very beautiful place.  The service at the pool bar was exceptional. They went above and beyond to take care of us. As far as the resort there was a lot of steps and walking that could use improvement. The temperature in the rooms was not good at all and they did work on it a couple of times unsuccessfully I might add.  The shows where good and I do agree with an earlier review it was too crowded. Will I go back? Not sure as of right now.

reviews.author: mark b
reviews.title: location awesome pool staff boring
reviews.text:
The food was very good. All restaurants require a reservation ( make them in advance) except the Blueagave  ( only so-so)= Tacos

Pool staff had little excitement in them. Pool volleyball net was broken

reviews.author: Bobbine
reviews.title: Royal PAIN!!
reviews.text:
Wow, were we ever disappointed!!! We have been to this resort before when it was Gran Melia, and we have enjoyed it. So we decided to make our way back here as they "upgraded" to Paradisus. Well, they certainly, 100% didn't make things better... We paid so much more for a much worse experience! The food was worse, and the service was horrible. They probably didn't upgrade all the staff so same people trying to give an illusion of a better 5 star experience.

We also booked the so-called Royal Service as we truly wanted good service and great food and just a relaxing - and for our first time - a more luxurious stay. But it was more like a Royal PAIN. The better food they claimed to have, was the same as from the general buffet just served different so it seemed as if you were getting fancier food. And don't even get me started on the room service. They said on the phone it would take 1 hour, well 1 hour and 30 minutes later the food arrived, completely cold. And as you can see on the pictures: store bought pizza button and plain hard pasta. WOW!

We also had our own butler in Royal Service. You are supposed to make dinner reservations etc through him. Well, the first day we asked him to book a dinner, he said we couldn't get the restaurant we wanted (even though royal service guests are supposed to have first choice). Funny enough we decided to just go to the restaurant at dinner time and ask if they had any tables. Sure enough around five available.
He was also supposed to book our own bali bed outside and second day he promised one on the beach. That didn't happen either.. Around 5 times we called him for something, no answer..
We went to the pool one day after breakfast stayed for four hours, returned, room wasn't made up, we asked them to do it, returned 1 and a half hour later, still not made. What royal service..

We also had our power (just in our room) go out. Took them 45 minutes to send someone, meanwhile we sat in the dark in our room.

And oh yes it was our honeymoon! When we told them this at check-in they said "we will do something special for you". Well, maybe this special thing was to give us two double beds instead of the king size we booked and treat us badly all stay. 
My husband had to carry our own luggage up three flights of stairs at check out.. What a "royal" treat. 

We are not fancy people at all, but when we go out of our way to pay extra for an amazing experience for such an important occasion, it is gutting to get what we got.

If the Caribbean hadn't been gorgeous that week, they would have ruined our honeymoon completely.

reviews.author: Gerard C
reviews.title: HOT ROOMS
reviews.text: We have visited many resorts in Cancun over the years and the majority of them are too hot in their rooms and most have no air conditioning in their lobby areas as well as some of their restaurants. My family owns a travel agency up here in Canada and we try and steer people away from these Resorts that have not invested money in making sure the air conditioning in their rooms is up to where it should be. I could list off several here that are not up to par but what amazes me is that the general managers on here that see these posts have no idea how much business they loose but not addressing these negative posts. People are not dumb enough to believe the posts that say we have sent your problems to the proper departments to be addressed and it is now taken care off lol. Oh one other mention none of these Resorts want you to eat in their restaurants cost them to much they want you to eat in their buffets that is why when you look in there are empty seats but they say they are all booked up.

reviews.author: Jayne_295M
reviews.title: Amazing Honeymoon Hotel
reviews.text: My husband and I choose this hotel for our honeymoon in June. When we arrived we were greeted by the nicest staff. It's such a beautiful hotel right on the sea front and the staff were so nice and went above and beyond for us. Our room was so clean! I'm very picky about everything being clean but the decor and room was lovely!!
