The only thing was the food and the need to tip, I'm from Ireland so we usually don't expect tips for every job we do and when we go to a restaurant you can either tip or not so we kept that when we went to this hotel and felt sometimes like staff weren't as friendly if you didn't tip we just felt like it was there job and only tipped if we felt the service was good. Apart from that I would defiantly recommend this hotel in general the staff where friendly and the hotel was luxury!! Defiantly would recommend!

reviews.author: bduo1380
reviews.title: Nice resort
reviews.text:
We spent one week at royal service for my husband birthday. We loved this hotel. Service was amazing ( thanks to aidé, lulu ( lourdes), felipé, jesus patino, and our butler hervic.
The food was excellent, especially vento, the decor and the food was pretty amazing at the  bana chinese restaurant.
Only déception, the spa water circuit really needs renovations.
Over all we will recommand this resort.

reviews.author: satvkn
reviews.title: What a nice surprise! Family Concierge is amazing!!
reviews.text: I spent 4 days with my family in this hotel and knowing the outstanding quality for groups & conventions, this time I experienced a different attention. The marketing from the hotel: Make the kids the decision maker - it works, it makes them feel important, they keep this ¨wow¨feeling together with the brand name of Paradisus and you have your future clients save!! They go around in school and talk about their stay in your hotel!! But besides the spectacular attention of Family Concierge, also food & beverage were very high standard. The beach of Paradisus Cancun is much bigger then the beach areas of the hotels competing for the same piece of business. Although the hotel building is aprox. 20 years old, the bathrooms are small, but maintainance is working on all the details. We will definitely come back with the family and will recommend it highly for groups & conventions as well.

reviews.author: Betty J
reviews.title: In the off season--watch for rest.closings without notice
reviews.text:
The hotel was fabulous except when they closed four restaurants in the same  area. At the time there were 800 guests having a party ---they forgot we were even there.Didn't get any thing to eat that  night!!!!!! ----
     Lovely hotel with a great staff --- In the BUFFET- NAOS-  enjoy the services of-Ignacio Vazquez , he will meet your every need with a smile & a feeling of home.++++
   Restaurant-FUEGO --Aurelio,Hector   -----food to die for !! service the best.
    Market Grill--an experience  you should have--once in a life time--for myself 
 three times---wow . Can't wait to return 
   Christen & Marisol looked after every need-- Guest Services  are the best---perfection -wow!!! they have it!!!!

reviews.author: Laurielee2013
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Tropical, aromatic,uniquie and Mayan in its architecture  this resort is lovely.  For all ages. They offer the family concierge along with an adults only area.As you enter the lobby it is beautiful and very tropical - jungle vines and very appealing to the eye.  Open atmosphere and an abundance of food options.  Offering an incredible convention area it is great for those small, medium, and large conventions and Destination weddings.  Beach front property on a lovely white sand beach in the heart of Cancun.  You can walk a great distance on a nice flat beach. Easy access to public transportation .  The Spa holds up to  the reputation of the Paradisus properties and even has a little kids spa.....a dream for every little lady in the family.  Pedicure and manicure station.  Hair and make up station and a choice of candy for the little guest.   Food and service over the top. Fabulous destination resort for wedding or honeymoon for certain.  The rooms are spacious and very nice. Room category will vary throughout the pyramids.  I would recommend the upgrade for Royal Reserve area for adults only and upgrade to the family concierge for those traveling with children.  The Paradisus Cancun is quite incredible and I would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Wendell F
reviews.title: Awesome All-In-One Vacation Resort Getaway!
reviews.text:
We stayed 5 days and 4 nights ar this hotel and overall - Spectacular. Service is great, food is simply 5 star quality. Beach is super clean, rooms are well taken care, and the gentleness of everyone is something unseen in many of these "all-inclusive" getaway locations you find out there. We would recommend Paradisus Cancun to anyone. Its also a great location for families, they have playgrounds, and the hotel is very family friendly! 

Thank you team for a great time!

reviews.author: Sarah W
reviews.title: Great honeymoon spot!
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed here in May 2011 when it was called the Gran Melia Cancun. We took a little bit of a gamble with this hotel, as many of the reviews we read were subpar. However, I could not imagine a better place to have stayed for our honeymoon! We stayed in an ocean view room and had an all inclusive plan which allowed us to try all of the various food and drink options offered on the resort. I would definitely both the ocean view room and the all inclusive package! The "lagoon view" rooms actually overlook the parking lot, with a lagoon in the distant background. The atmosphere in the main building is incredible and has a jungle-like vibe. The hotel itself is huge and has five separate towers.  We did say when we booked the reservation that we wanted a king-size bed, but that was not ready for us when we got there.  They initially told us that it would take an hour or two for the room to be ready, but it was shorter than that.  (This was my only issue upon check-in.) 

Our room was spotless, incredibly comfortable and came equipped with a balcony hot tub (which  I believe was standard on all rooms). The minibar in the room was only stocked with soda and beer, so those options are limited. But if you're looking for late night drink options, the bar/lounge in the lobby is good to keep in mind. 

If you want to eat at any of the hotels three restaurants only open for dinner, it's a good idea to make reservations as soon as you arrive because the reservations fill up quickly.  If you don't make a reservation, there are three more restaurants open to just walk-in.  The food was incredible, especially the breakfast buffet.  INSANE!! It was delicious,

Other people commented on the timeshare marketing and such, but my husband and I did not encounter this at all.  I guess somehow we managed to get around it?? The staff was kind and friendly.  There were water sports available to us, but we didn't do any of them.

Again, we took our trip in May 2011.  Things may have changed since then, but our stay was incredible!

reviews.author: landryhumphries
reviews.title: An incredible resort with even better service.
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun is incredibly big, however, the service makes you feel like you're the only guest at the resort. The food was good at every meal which is uncommon at many "all inclusive" resorts. Wifi was also very fast. I will be back in Cancun in January and will definitely be staying here again. Great experience all around!

reviews.author: Sugarfree_candy
reviews.title: AMAZING!
reviews.text:
Lovely hotel and staff. The decor is beautiful and the choice of restaurants is incredible! 
Pool side is clean and the bar serves the ultimate cocktails. There's a lot of activity in and around the beach and it's impossible to be bored in such an incredible place! The club within the hotel is also nice if you're looking to boogie! Would definitely book again!

reviews.author: Vadim M
reviews.title: Good place to stay
reviews.text:
General impression is good. But hotel appearance is a little old style. It's consisted by 5 connected pyramides. If you are in the middle (3rd pyramide) it could be noisy due to the music in the bar till late night and waterfolls in the main lobby. 
The Royal Service isn't so "Royal". The breakfast provided there is not so varies and if you prefere have a possibilities to chose from big assortment it's better to go to main restaurant. But in the same time you can enjoy by good selection of drinks and snacks from 11 pm till late night in a cosy atmospher of private lounge.
Several restaurants provide good possibilities for launch and dinner. Tempo restaurant is outstanding, providing fine dinning (not included in all inclusive). Degustation menu is very good accompanied with selection wines proposed by chef.

reviews.author: Sbringetto
reviews.title: Incredible!!
reviews.text: I have never been to a more friendly beautiful resort in all of my life. Atmosphere was spectacular, people were so amazingly accommodating, the wait staff, especially Antonio, Alejandro and Carlos were amazing at the restaurant Hadar. I will never forget my stay here and will be back for sure. Oh, and did I mention the awesome dancers and nightlife?? Truly a gem!

reviews.author: Futia
reviews.title: Very peaceful
reviews.text: We arranged to stay at Paradisus Cancun after a ten day stay in NYC. It is certainly somewhere I would chose to stay again and the staff go beyond expectations to ensure your comfort and enjoyment. I was a little hesitant about the food in an all you can eat - the food shone. It was spectacular. The rooms are very roomy, however a little dated. The only negative I have and it's only one was we had a few inclusions in our package which included vouchers for the day spa. Our travel agent advised we had a certain amount to spend and this was refuted by the front desk. Eventually we got the vouchers, however we were informed that they had to be broken down and not used in one transaction. My massage was $220 USD and across the road it was $35USD. Can't compare the setting - but this is the one place in the hotel that they certainly see you coming.

reviews.author: araceli p
reviews.title: Wonderful experience!
reviews.text:
I had previously stayed at this hotel prior to becoming Paradisus. 

We stayed four nights, five days. Hotel is 15-20 minutes from airport. Staff is extremely helpful and welcoming. All the restaurants and bars are exceptional in service. The variety and quality of food is that of 4 stars. 
It is in a perfect location in Cancun! The rooms are very large and spacious. The hotel is kept very clean, there is staff available all day to help with needs. 
I would only stay at this hotel for every trip to Cancun. Why try something else when Paradisus is PERFECT! You will be treated like royalty!

reviews.author: David G
reviews.title: Karla - Family Concierge - Awesome for kids
reviews.text: My wife, 2 kids and mother-in-law stayed for 4 nights.  Weather was crappy but we still enjoyed it very much.  Karla at family concierge made the trip great for us and kids.  Food was great - hotel was nice not spectacular, hence the 4 not 5 stars (also, stuff at the spa did not work, such as showers).  One waiter asked my mother-in-law for a tip which infuriated me - I pay the tips if/when appropriate.  Other than that, all good.  One waiter at the buffet named Miguel was awesome, helped so much and played with our kids.  I would go back.

reviews.author: Nad
reviews.title: Beyond expectations
reviews.text:
This is our 4th day at paradisus cancun and everything so far has been beyond our expectations. We were upgraded to royal service and are enjoying everything they have to offer. We have yet to take advantage of the 24hour room service. 

The food in the restaurants has been very good. We have tried the market grill, fuego, ibana, and naos. Our favourite was the market grill. The service is the restaurants is also excellent. No waiting on drinks or tables. The wait time for food was reasonable. The only time we had to a wait a little longer was at the sushi (Ibana) restaurant. 

The workers are very helpful and kind. They go a long ways to make you happy, especially the staff at the palapa restaurany by the beach. The selection of food they have at this restaurant is also good and is a perfect place for lunch. 

The dotor is also very nice. He is patient and listens to what you have to say before jumping to conclusions. 

We are already planning on coming back here and highly recommend it to anyone.

reviews.author: MikeandIris
reviews.title: 5 Year Anniversary - Amazing Stay!
reviews.text: Our trip was simply Amazing.  5 days and 4 nights stay with Paradisus Cancun and we wanted more!  Wish we were still there.  We went from 9/11/13 and returned on 9/15/13, back to Jersey.  We had excellent service back and forth to the airport using Olympus Tours.  Drivers were excellent.  The onsite Olympus Tours guy Victor was okay but a little rude when we went to confirm our pickup time.  But that didn't stop us.  We were greeted and picked up by our Butler Alexis AKA Justin Timberlake.  He took us to our Royal Service Pyramid by golf cart.  Checked us in with the Royal Service Concierge.  Everyone was awesome!  The girl that checked us in on the 11th was super nice!  Alexis was awesome getting us set up and attending to our every needs.  His hours were 10-6 everyday we were there and answered the cell phone they gave us every time we called when he was working.  When he wasn't working, the concierge gladly took care of us.  They confirmed both of our tours.  Caribbean Carnival and The Dancer Cruise.  Both are must dos for couples!  The crews that run it are awesome.  15 minute bus ride down for just $1.00 each way.  Can't beat that!  We also booked Cancun Studios for our Anniversary day.  We did a trash the dress session, my wife and I.  They were professional, friendly and pictures came out awesome!  They are a must hire if you want quality pictures on the beach!  If you are into photography and want something better than what is offered by the hotel, Cancun Studios are a must hire.  My wife and I are amazed on how great they were!  Ocean View was awesome as it was upgraded for us without us knowing!  Room 5516.  Thank you Paradisus!  Floral heart on the bed and Champagne set off the vacation just right.  Alexis took care of booking our dinner reservations.  Mole was not that good suprisingly.  Naos, Fuego and Tempo were all awesome!  Food and Service were great!  Orlando and his partner Gerardo took very good care of us every morning and afternoon.  Orlando was the best!!!!  La Palalpa was also an awesome experience!  Food and Service was excellent!  The Bali Bed attendant set us up very good.  I can't remember his name but he was very good!  Francisco was the man!  Excellent Service and very friendly.  He even brought us drinks when we were swimming in the Ocean.  Please Tip these people! They work hard to make our stay amazing and they deserve some tips.  We made sure we tipped those that went out of their way to make our vacation awesome!  Alexis, Orlando and Francisco were all awesome!  There were others that were very good as well but I can't remember their names.  We did the YHI SPA buy one get one free couples massage.  Excellent experience.  The people that worked there were very nice and massages were good!  Great Memories made and can't wait to go back!  Next time we are bringing our kids!  If you want to stay in Cancun, best resort I have been to yet!  I have stayed at Beach Palace and KH Krystal and this one is by far the best!  The Beach was big and clean compared to others down the strip.  Must go!  Do it Royal Service Style and you can't go wrong.  Shout out to the folks we met from San Antonio celebrating 42 years Married!  Congrats!  Weather rained on and off but we made the best of it and the rain never messed up our plans!  We miss you Paradisus Cancun!  Be Back Soon!

reviews.author: Libra24
reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text:
This a a lovely hotel, with beautiful decor.  The staff are amazing people and just cannot do enough for you.  The are all always friendly, greeting as you walk past - and humble.  

We stayed at the hotel as part of a conference. Although there were over about 1000 people from our group staying there and being transported around - all arrangements ran seamlessly.

One bit of advice, this a HUGE hotel and you can to get lost finding your room (however there is usually a friendly staff member around to help you find it)

reviews.author: Teresa B
reviews.title: Best Vacation Ever
reviews.text: We enjoyed the entire week. All the staff from the work crew to upper management seemed like they really appreciated us being there. the room was quite clean as well as everywhere else. The food.....well lets just say.....it was very good to excellent. Even the buffet had filet, shrimp, grouper, and everything else that one would expect. You have got to eat dinner at "The Market Grill". This is no hamburger, hot dog joint. OMG...the food is to die for. They do know how to make drinks here at Paradisus. Do the excursions, they're worth it. On the trips we talked to others about their resorts, and it sure seemed to us that they were not satisfied or nearly as thrilled as we were. You have got to stay here! A special thanks to Fred and Karla, a situation arose when we arrived and they went out of their way to make sure we were taken care of. We took some great pictures from the top and had an incredible night at "Tempo". This is their high-end restaurant (+$$). The food and service are...WOW, like nothing else. Get the filet!! We are already talking about going back. The best place ever!

reviews.author: Gilbert G
reviews.title: Most Awesome, Elegant, Amazing Trip - Gilbert G
reviews.text: We had the most enjoyable time ever experienced. It was our 42nd wedding anniv celebration. Hervick made sure we had everything you could possibly imagine. By the time we left we felt he was like family. He knew the drinks we liked and always had one ready and made our dinner reservations daily, he is very dedicated to his job. We were treated like a king and queen by him and all of the staff. Our room was so big, we were like "wow", and the balcony and ocean view so unbelievably beautiful! We loved everything about Paradisus and can't wait to return. I want to thank Hervik and all the staff for the exceptional service they provided during our stay. If i may list the names of other staff: Francisco Segura (Naos), Bianca, Lourdes, Aimee, Ignacio Vazquez (Naos), Webster y Marifer (Tempo), Carlos Durate (Sommalier), Alfonso (Vento), Martin (Fuego), everyone at Blue Agave and Market Grill. We now have familia at Paradisus, Cancun. Con Corazon :) We like meeting people and we enjoyed this opportunity to get to know everyone from the staff to other visiting guests. They were all so wonderful!

reviews.author: marcdegueurce2013
reviews.title: Good for the  free children area
reviews.text:
Ok this is Cancun so whaterever luxury they offer  it  is not as  luxury compared with European  standards. Stayed in the adult  only  part  of the hotel and  all meals + drinks  were  included.
The room was not a proper suite  since  the  hotel must be quite old now.  They think they  re doing top notch  but the management  has not trained the  staff well.
Nevertheless it was good to not to  have  hordes of families with kids jumping  in and  out  of the  pool  and be able to  book your  private cabana  by  the  beach. 
The beach is great  and the water is warm. 
Food wise it  is ok and you  have a variety of  restaurants. Avoid at all cost  the  family dinner times and you  ll be fine. 
The staff at all the bars and the  restaurants always wanted to please even  if they  were not  extremely professionals and the  mexican  are  SO SWEET and SO WLLING TO MAKE SURE YOU RE HAVING A GOOD TIME so  it offsets a few weaknesses. 
ould  I go back ?.Well for   5 nights  it is  ok....longer  humm Inm not sure. 
The hotel is located next  door to the Maya  Museum  which has been  nicely done with an outdoor ruin part  and  a  few interesting rooms.

reviews.author: Jackycolmora
reviews.title: Love everything...I will repeat this amazing experience.
reviews.text: A family vacation could be a lottery you never know how things could result, but in this hotel resort was a dream, the building, the decoration, the people, the food, the service...everything. I was just 5 days and my children wants to live there...if you choose a family concierge room the benefits are amazing, you will have an exclusive service, personalized. Karla was our "mayordomo" they gave us a cellphone and we had communication with her all the time, if for any reason she was busy, there were always a person in charge, but she always make our days the best, also at the beach you will have a "Balinera" (a beach tiki bed) per day, there we had Karina and Luis they were excellent too, you know what I had people all the time that I would like to mention, but is better you go and try by yourself...WE WILL COME BACK...FOR SURE! but try not to go on high hurricane season sept is raining like crazy...but still we had fun!

reviews.author: Fernando F
reviews.title: Fabulous!
reviews.text: We planned a family trip to this place after our original resort was closed and Travelocity moved us here. It was the best that could have happened. This resort is amazing. We were upgraded to their Red level and got a beautiful suite. Food was amazing, service was perfect. The pools and the beach are incredible here. Would stay again if possible.

reviews.author: Julian G
reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: My wife and I planned this trip for our 20th wedding anniversary and had a wonderful experience.  From the moment we arrived we were treated like king and queen.  Our room was clean, spacious and the view awesome.  The service was great and everyone was friendly.  This was our first time in Cancun (5 days, 4 nights) and our stay at the Paradisus left us wanting more.

reviews.author: mouse333
reviews.title: Amazing Service
reviews.text: We just returned from Cancun and a week at the Paradisus.  A couple of dedicated employees really made the trip a wonderful experience.  Asuncion made sure we were consistantly taken care of while at the beach - she remembered our names, took the time to get to know us, offered options, and when it started to pour down rain she made sure to ensure all of our items were kept safe even though she was getting soaked!! Also, in the main lobby bar - Ingrid was wonderful.  She remembered us and our favorite drinks - she went out of her way to make sure we had everything to have a great experience.

reviews.author: sheant M
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text: This hotel was wonderful.My husband and I had an ocean view one bedroom in the Royal Service section.The view was spectacular from our balconies and from the bathroom.This was our third time going to Cancun and I can say this is the best resort that we have stayed at.Unfortunately we only booked a 4 day trip.We enjoyed this resort so much that we tried to extend our trip a couple more days.Everyone at the resort was very friendly especially the young ladies at the Royal Service desk.Our butler Hervik was outstanding. Hervik went past his usual butler duties to accommodate our needs.All the restaurants were outstanding.This resort was beautiful on the inside and outside.My husband and I are already making plans to go back next year.This was the third Paradisus resort that we have stayed at.

reviews.author: S510
reviews.title: Needs upgrading!
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus Cancun in pyramid 1 from July 8th-July 17th. As Melia timeshare owner we pay good money every year for resort maintenance and that's why they have separate section for timeshare owners in most resorts. This resort has gone through a transition from Gran Melia to Paradisus but the quality has not improved at all. Upon arrival we had to give a long list of things to our concierge to have fixed. our fridge wasn't working and had to be replaced. Picture frame above my kids sofa bed was covered in mold and we asked them to remove it from the room. Dinning chairs had mold and had to be replaced. On more than one occasion our sheets and towels had stains all over them and one night we had to ask for new sheets at 11 pm and we ended up with sheets to small for our bed. On our third day which happened to be our wedding anniversary we noticed a bug infestation in the bathroom.  We called to ask someone to come and take a look to see what was gong on since they were taking over our whole bathroom sink and toilet. After 15 min they send someone to our room with a can of bug spray in hand. Since we had 2 small kids with us and my husband has allergy to the spray we didn't let them spray the bathroom. After 2 hours of people coming and going in our room to figure out what was happening they suggested that we should switch rooms. our only room option was in another pyramid which we had to take since there was nothing else available. New room didn't have a kitchen (which we needed because of our 2 young boys) had dirty and old dining table and chairs, very old and uncomfortable sofa bed for our kids and again flickering lights with no WiFi in the room so still not 5 star for sure. To top everything off my 6 year old son slipped in the bathtub few days after and had to be taken to the hospital to get stitches in his chin. very stressful for all of us. After speaking with the manager she told us there should have been a insert for the bathtub to prevented from being slippery and yes our room didn't have one. Over all I'm very disappointed with the whole resort. Managers and staff for club melia really tried to help but they can't really do much because in my opinion all the rooms need upgrading specially the members side since we pay for maintenance. Thanks to Club Melia staff Betsy and club melia manager Ivette Sanchez Ponce for all their help.  I would to go back but NOT till the rooms are renovated.

reviews.author: ONE302
reviews.title: Loved this place...can't wait to go back!!!!
reviews.text: This hotel was wonderful.  I had a room in the "royal service" section and it was beautiful.  Can't think of anything negative to say about this place!  All the food was delicious, bars had top shelf liquor, rooms were beautiful!  Service was great too!  The crowd here was older, so if you're looking for a party resort...this probably isn't it.

reviews.author: Marsha1974
reviews.title: Outstanding experience!
reviews.text: I am a member of Club Melia and this is one of the best hotels I've stayed at! The service and everything in general was outstanding and the girls from the club were wonderful!!! Definitely will come back!! Highly recommended!!!

reviews.author: mainlinenewb
reviews.title: Beautiful but lacking during low season
reviews.text:
We went to the Paradisus late August with family concierge package and it was definitely low-season considering the hotel was empty and quiet. Here's the run-down:

Staff - Wonderfully courteous and very gracious. We were greeted at the door with cool towels and were directed to Family Concierge check-in. The room in itself was amazing with candy lining the shelves and entertainment for the kids while the adults handled the paper work. Valets and bellhops were all very nice. My only gripe was that I had asked the concierge to freeze some b-milk for me for my 5 month old for the plane ride home since I'm not allowed to bring ice or liquids - I was very clear on FREEZING. Our last day, I picked it up on the last day and it was barely cold - I had to throw it out. I was very close to not being able to feed my baby on the ride back and that really upset me. They can't really accommodate a nursing family.

Cleanliness - Housekeeping was great. With family concierge, they left little surprises and treats in our room nightly. I had clutter all over the counters and they helped me organize. Very impressed. 

Accommodations - There is NO AC in the public areas of this hotel. It is We were in the central pyramid which was convenient to the restaurants and pools. The rooms were well-appointed (save for a fridge that could freeze). We were able to squeeze in an extra cot and pack n play with no problems. There was one day, however, where the AC shut down for 5 hours during a 98degree day. That was barely tolerable and I can't imagine that happening during high season. The hotel is old, no doubt about it but it has been updated nicely. Note to parents: the public pool is VERY deep for kids - 5ft. If you want to access the shallower end, you have to have family concierge! They also let you reserve a cabana with the upgrade which is a must-do!

Entertainment - This was our biggest rub. Entertainment was few and far in between during low-season. we were looking forward to our preschooler being in the Kids Club but most of the activities were canceled due to the low attendance. The nightly shows were only on Monday, Wednesdays and Fridays while we were there so we only saw 2 shows for the 7 days we were there. The schedule of activities were pared down to basics like Bingo, Volleyball, Zumba. 

Food - Was very good. Market Grill was a churrascaria which was a unexpected surprise. Bana had very decent and edible sushi (another pleasant surprise). Vento and Fuego was OK. Service in all the restaurants were slow (low staff maybe) except for Blue Agave which also had good tacos. Naos buffet had decent selection as well. Can't speak for the adult-only restaurants but it was overall very good. They are missing ICE CREAM, though. What resort doesn't have soft-serve ice cream?

I would consider returning but not during low season.

reviews.author: Jan D
reviews.title: Excellent vacation
reviews.text: Hotel is situated on a white sand beach in a nice quiet location with easy excess to the city, restaurants, golf course, etc.. I arrived there with my wife and we received warm welcome from the reception staff immediately after arrival.Hotel is newly reconstructed , clean , excellent staff everywhere bars, reastaurants. Food and drinks are excellent and preapred from high quality materials.

reviews.author: Maria C
reviews.title: The BEST Vacation EVER!!!!
reviews.text: The Hotel is amazing, the service is outstanding and Royal Service is a must!!!! You will not regret having paid the extra $$$. My boyfriend and I didnt leave the hotel for the 5 days we were there in Cancun. The food is very good and they have lots of variety at the Buffet called NAOS, and also the "a la carte" restaurants are very very good! everyone gave us the best service like I said before; however, in the pool area ROGELIO, OCTAVIO, IGNACIO and DIANA. Fuego restaurant is delicious and I want to mention MONSERRAT, JOSE and MARTIN, they provided us with a very good service also. And last, I really have to Mention BIANCA who was always around the main lobby supporting everyone with the best service, advices, and guidance to everything we wanted to do! We would definetly go back and will try to do it every year...Can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: Worldtraveler20005
reviews.title: Doesn't live up to its promises and rating...
reviews.text:
Positive: nice view, proximity to the sea, good food, nice staff
Negative: very poor maintenance, room in bad shape, when it rains, leaks in the dining room and bedroom, today no water pressure until 6 pm, staff trying to sell you activities every time you pick up a towel at the beach...
This is NOT a luxury hotel.  Perhaps average quality at best.

reviews.author: nicole m
reviews.title: Cancun september 2013
reviews.text:
Great hotel, Food is amazing, The breakfast buffet has lots of variety. The restaurants a la carte are also very good. The decor is very tropical. The aromatherapy a bit too much for my sentive smell. The rooms are very comfortable. 

All in all great resort.

reviews.author: Keri81
reviews.title: Excellent Value if You Catch a Good Rate
reviews.text:
Before I get into specifics, just a little quick info about my husband and I. We have been to Cancun/Riviera Maya several times and stayed in boutique to large resorts, but this was our first time ever staying in an all-inclusive. Additionally, we got a really great rate when we booked so we went with the Royal Service option which plays a large part of our perspective. Also, we were here during low-season which might have been a factor in both the good and not-so-good aspects.

ROYAL SERVICE

For the price we paid and how we used it, it was well worth it. One of the main reasons we chose this hotel besides the value was the fact that it didn’t seem like finding lounge chairs would be an issue and that those in RS get to have bali beds for 2 days of their stay. These beds were awesome- comfortable and with great views of the ocean or pool and easy access to ocean, pool, bathrooms and restaurant/bar. Not only that, during low season, we pretty much could use the beds for every day of our stay if we wanted and be able to choose from some of the best located beds. Additionally, RS had a special menu to get lunch or a snack from which was both delicious and convenient.

The other aspect that RS was useful for us was the butler/concierge service. We used this and the cell phone they provided on many occasions… everything from booking dinner reservations to changing out money to finding a box to mail a package. Overall, it made many things a lot easier and our butler, Erik, was really nice and professional.

RS also is in its own building and has breakfast, snacks, alcohol and coffee offered throughout the day. Everything there is also available at the main buffet but it can be convenient if you want to grab something on the way to your room, have something closer by or to enjoy a more private and relaxing atmosphere.

RESORT CREDITS

The $1,000 resort credits offered isn’t really that great of a deal. We had to ask for these towards the end of the checkout process when it was clear they weren’t going to be offered. I even had to show her the paper from my email showing we get that so with our experience either they didn’t have it in their system or they really just don’t want to offer it. 

We tried to use the $300 room upgrade to upgrade from the deluxe room to a larger luxury or one bedroom but the costs were still too high for us to want to do it ($120 night for one bedroom, $60 for luxury). The girl checking us in said their system wasn’t working so those figures were her best guess and might not have been 100% accurate… really I think they already had our room ready and just didn’t want to bother changing it.

Since we couldn’t use that, the only other ones I was interested in were for massages and the restaurant Tempo. The massage coupons were 3 $50 coupons that could each be used per service so with only getting $50 off, the massages were still too expensive so I didn’t use that. That left us with just the Tempo coupon. It was $150 at the restaurant but only towards food- not alcohol or any other beverages- not even water! Still the food was so good, and we did enjoy having that coupon for use.

I think the resort credits offering could be improved in several ways: making sure guests eligible for it are offered them before giving the room; combining the massage coupons into one $150 coupon and for Tempo to include non-alcoholic beverages. If you are going to offer this to guests, you should do it in a more complete and valuable way rather than making it come across as a gimmick to help guests book with you and your services.

CHECK-IN/ROOM

We were able to check-in a couple hours early, so that was really great! Additionally, we had previously requested a room on a higher floor and were given that so that was nice. The whole check-in process probably took about 45 minutes. We were brought to the private RS check-in and given welcome drinks and offered cool towels. From being dropped off at the door to getting to the RS check-in, it seemed smooth and organized for the most part.

The room we reserved and were given was a little small, but overall not bad. It was decorated nice and was comfortable. Things that I know would be hard to change but that I have preferred more in other hotels include: wishing the shower and bath were separate and wishing the balcony rail could be seen through more. To enjoy the beautiful ocean view, you have stand versus enjoying it from the lounge chair.

Also, there was only one lounge chair and a small side table on the very large balcony. In the least, an additional lounge chair and maybe even a table and chairs to enjoy coffee or something would have been nice. 

Overall, the room was perfectly fine but there was nothing really special or spectacular that stood out about it.

BEACH/POOLS

We only stayed in the RS section so we didn’t have any experience with the main more active pool. They have the RS pool, the main active pool, a more quiet pool section and a kids pool section. The RS pool was definitely quiet and relaxing. People kept to themselves mostly so if you are looking to make new friends or have more of a party atmosphere, the other might be better. As previously mentioned, the bali beds are amazing… perfect way to relax, eat lunch, tan, read or just feel the ocean breeze and listen to the waves. Loved it!

The pool is fairly deep. I am 5’8, and the water in most parts came up to my shoulders. For me, this was perfect because I like it deeper and to be able to swim, but I can see how that might bother some folks.

The ocean was perfect for swimming in my opinion. We never had any days that were too rough. There were waves but they were not very big, and there were sections that were a little deeper but also plenty of shallow parts. It was fun and perfect for swimming. I could even see lots of fish swimming around me at times. I think children could definitely swim here with some supervision.

I saw plenty of lounge chairs and palapas on the beach on both the RS side and the main side.

RESTAURANTS/ROOM SERVICE

Most of the restaurants require reservations- Naos (buffet) and Blue Agave (taco place) did not. The reservation process became a little annoying for us at times because we were sometimes needing to change plans last minute or even reservations we had ahead of time because my husband had friends in the area we would do things with outside of the resort. During low-season at least, it seemed at least 2 restaurants would be closed a night but they would not decide which 2 until the day before or the day of. So it kind of made planning difficult, especially if plans changed at the last minute. I think it could be improved by losing the reservation process altogether or at least setting a schedule of what is opened every night by the week and publishing that for the guests. Still, our butler did everything he could to help us with process and to get us in to places so that was certainly appreciated.
The buffet has a pretty good variety and is offered from the morning through the night. For me, it was okay- didn’t love it or hate it, but my husband seemed to enjoy it. Blue Agave has a small menu of snack type items such as tacos and quesadillas. The poblano chili quesadilla was our favorite! We enjoyed Mole a lot too. Our first night we had Market Grill, it was okay. We are not sushi people, but thought we would give Bana a try. I think if you like sushi, you would enjoy Bana, but if you don’t, probably skip it as sushi is pretty much the only thing offered. I would have liked to have seen a couple of other dish options offered there for the non-sushi people. The last restaurant we tried was Tempo, which is not included. However, we used the $150 credit towards the dinner. We were only offered the tasting menu so I think that is the only option with the coupon, but boy was that some good food. It was very filling too. The desserts were the perfect ending to the meal- soooo good. Please note for Tempo and the use of the coupons, you cannot use it towards any beverages and they are not included. You will have to pay for alcohol, sodas and even water.

We loved having room service! We ordered breakfast several times, and it was so nice having it in our room while getting ready or just waking up. It’s not a huge menu, but I think there are plenty of options to pick from. It never took too long either. 

RS offers guests the La Palapa restaurant for lunch. I loved the food here! So good and so convenient. I was really glad to have the options available they offered for lunch while spending days at the beach/pool.

Another note, pretty much to have steak or lobster, you had to pay extra for it. I was expecting that for lobster but not so much for steak. But all of the tables in the restaurants had a little card listing different types of steaks and lobster with the prices. That was a little disappointing.

I don’t really drink that much, but my husband was pleased with the alcohol offerings. However, when I do drink, I usually like some kind of fruity or sweet drink. But since I rarely drink, I don’t really know drinks besides the basic pina colada, mojito or margarita. So it would have been nice to see a cocktail menu somewhere but that is not something they offered. So I only tried what I knew. I think offering a cocktail menu would be another improvement that could be made.

SERVICE

Service at the hotel was really good. You can definitely tell pleasing the guest is high on the list. There were a couple of bad moments, but nothing worth mentioning. Overall, everyone was friendly and willing to help. For us, our butlers, the pool concierge and pool waiters really stood out.

Also, maid service was excellent. They seemed to figure out what our schedule usually was and usually never disturbed us to clean the room for the day or to do the turndown service. It was always so clean and well taken care of. Also, our fridge remained stocked throughout our stay.

MISCELLANEOUS

Wifi was good in our room and throughout the resort.

Hotel is big, but definitely not so big that walking from one spot to the other is a problem. We enjoyed it actually.  I can see how it might be a problem for elderly.

If you are looking for a super lively, party atmosphere, probably this isn’t the place. However, we didn’t see the main pool, just RS. Also, we could hear entertainment in the main pyramid one night while dining, but I don’t think it lasts very long or was a huge production. I think we were told in low season, they have it 3 nights a week. 

They offer day and night passes if you have outside guests you want to spend time with you. Day was 10 am- 6 pm and night 6 pm to 2 am. It was $70 per adult and $35 a child and included regular all-inclusive access. Having this option was nice, but I think there should be another time frame that would allow people to both swim in the day and dine at night… or even a full pass without the room. 

When leaving, my husband called for the price of a taxi to the airport and they told him $25. However, once at the airport, the driver told him and showed him a paper for $35. This was the taxi that the hotel called for us. I think what the hotel says and the driver says should be consistent, however it wasn’t a shocking thing to happen. I recommend asking the driver what he charges before leaving the hotel if you use a taxi.

reviews.author: Alison
reviews.title: Fabulous vacation
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I just returned from a 6 day stay at the Paradisus and loved it!  The hotel was very beautiful and clean and the food was great.  We tried almost all of the restaurants on site (some of them are closed on certain days so make sure you coordinate your reservations accordingly so you won't miss any of them) and enjoyed every one of them.  The buffet was also great - plentiful and great selection.  The pool and beach area had plenty of shaded seats available.  The bus stop is right in front of the hotel so there is easy access to getting on for going to the shopping areas.  We would definitely stay here again and recommend the hotel to others.  It was a great vacation!

reviews.author: Michele L
reviews.title: A Great Hotel
reviews.text: We recently returned from a wonderful 8 day vacation. The hotel structure externally is the most beautiful in the area and has a terriffic white sand beach that is great for swimming. The lobby is one of the most beautiful I have ever seen. The food is the best we ever had in Mexico (and we have stayed in nice hotels there many times). Restaurant "Mole" had a wonderful manager, hostess and waiters and terrific nouveau Mexican style food. They went out of their way to provide a romantic dinner for two for us. The buffet in "Naos" had wonderful variety and the food was always properly cooked. This is quite a feat for a buffet. The wait staff provided very good service. One of the chefs even came out of the kitchen to tell me how to create a certain dish that we enjoyed. Every restaurant had a nice hostess, good food, and was well-managed, though three of the restaurants had waiters who forgot to bring parts of our order. Tempo restaurant was not part of the all-inclusive arrangement, but we decided to go for the wine-tasting dinner. We were delighted with the food, though we did not care for all of the wine-pairings. The bars all have top-shelf liquor. The swim-up bar at the pool was especially nice due to a very entertaining bartender named Enrique. Francisco aimed to please at the beach bar. Sofrimo provided great service walking around and waiting on everyone lounging on the beach. Everyone who waited on us at the pool and restaurants came by frequently and brought drinks quickly. The hotel says that cabanas can be rented for the day, but in fact they are reserved for guests who purchase upgraded concierge services. The first ocean view junior suite we were given overlooked a roof-top and only had a sliver of ocean visible, so we changed rooms. Our suite was very nicely appointed, but in need of work. The staff came right away when I asked that they clean thick mold off of the ceiling of the shower. One of the dresser drawers smelled moldy as well. In general, however, the hotel was very clean. The sliding door of our balcony was missing the outside handle and the planter on our balcony had mostly weeds growing in it. The sink was cracked. We had some difficulty obtaining all of the amenities that I had contracted for with my travel agent, but eventually it was worked-out to our satisfaction. Efraim at the front desk was the only person who was ever able to assist us effectively, even though I was told that notes were put into the computer for all staff to see. He was patient and reliable. He always followed-up as promised. Lluvia at the guest services desk was extremely pleasant and helpful. I had a nice massage at the spa. All considered we would absolutely not hesitate to stay there again. In fact, we plan on it.

reviews.author: rfsalmoniv
reviews.title: A TRUELY SPECIAL PLACE
reviews.text:
Let me start by saying this is the first review I have ever written.  To be honest, I still don't know how I feel about reviews.  I agree that everyone is entitled to their own opinion, however the few odd balls that have written mediocre or bad reviews about Paradisus Cancun should have their heads examined.

My friends and I stayed at Paradisus Cancun from August 29th-September 1st.  We have been fortunate enough to travel and stay at many spectacular resorts around the world.  I believe I can speak for all five of us when I say that our experience staying at Paradisus Cancun rivals any of the resorts we have stayed at around the world (Ritz Carlton, Four Seasons, etc.).  The primary reason for this is the unbelievable service we received from the minute we arrived until the minute we left.

Almost a month before our arrival I was in constant contact via email with the hotel concierge, mostly with Ms. Lourdes Gutiérrez.  She was probably sick of me before we arrived, however she promptly responded to each of my emails with an amazing attitude and fulfilled all of our request.  Due to the time she spent working to fulfill our requests (my friends and I are very picky about our accommodations) even before our arrival was the first sign that we were in for a real treat.

I HIGHLY recommend booking or upgrading to the Royal Service.  The Royal Service is everything as advertised and much much more!  I read reviews that "the royal service is not worth it" and I honestly cannot think of a more outrageous statement.  Immediately upon arrival we were greeted by name and served the welcome cocktails each of us requested when we submitted our "pre-arrival" form.  We were promptly escorted to the check in area (which was a breeze) and greeted by numerous staff members as if we were kings.  Although this was our first time to Paradisus Cancun, the welcome we received by the staff made us feel like we were regulars.  I'm still in awe of how the staff at a resort of this size can pay so much attention and familiarize (even before arrival) themselves with every single guest.

We originally booked two Royal Service Ocean Front Suites.  Since we were celebrating my bachelor party, we decided to inquire about upgrading to a bigger suite. Ms. Lourdes Gutiérrez was kind enough to let us know that the Presidential Suite was available for the duration of our stay.  Of course, we figured we should at least take a look at it before making a decision so we asked to see it.  We were politely escorted to the 7th floor and as soon as we walked off the elevator we knew we had to upgrade!  The suite was absolutely stunning.

After check in we were provided with our cell phones to get in touch with the concierge or "butlers" 24 hours a day.  Personally, I don't like to use the term "butler service" because the "butlers" were far more than exceptional service providers, but they became our friends. Juan showed us to the rooms and familiarized us with the resort.  He made sure we felt at home and brought us a bottle of champagne to toast to our arrival.  Juan made sure that each of our bags were placed in the correct room and even offered to unpack for us.

Now let me tell you about the suite....!

The master bedroom has panoramic views of the ocean with on of the most amazing bathrooms I have ever seen.  The bathroom consist of 2 Jacuzzi tubs, one of which comfortably could fit 8-10 people in it, 2 showers (one that had jets shooting from every direction and a waterfall shower head, not to mention an amazing steam room), 2 walk in toilets with bidets, 2 huge sinks with marble counters, and a monster walk in closet complete with exceptionally soft waffle weave robes.  Also in the master bedroom is a sitting area with 2 flat screen TVs, surround sound speakers, and a private balcony (one of 4 in the suite).

Lets move on to the office.  Grand room with a very nice desk to handle any business you may need to tend to.  Of course there is a beautiful armoire in the office with yet again another TV (don't know why you would ever want to watch TV when you are in paradise, but to each is on)!

From there you walk into the entertainment room.  Floor to ceiling windows with views of the lagoon. A very modern feel to it with a glass dining room table with seating for 10.  Full free standing bar with stools to entertain.  Of course there are 2 chandeliers and yet again another balcony with views of the ocean and lagoon. 

Moving into the kitchen  you will be astonished at the full size refrigerator (stocked daily with the beverages and snacks of your choice), island, coffee and cappuccino machine, full cabinets with full sets of nice china, a stove, and again another balcony!  The balcony off the kitchen is the best place to watch the sunset over the lagoon.  We enjoyed a nice cigar and a refreshing cocktail each evening while watching a picturesque sunset! 

Don't get me wrong the suite was absolutely amazing, but again what really made the resort special was the service.  We had the privilege of Hector serving us as our "butler" aka friend for most of our stay.  I cannot express in words how helpful Hector was.  He went above and beyond what I would ever have expected.  He made SURE that our every request was promptly taken care of.  We actually didn't have to make many request because he took care of things before we had to ask.  He knew our drinks of choice at each time of the day.  Hector made sure we had fresh coffee and baileys in the morning and so on and so forth as the day moved on!  One of the things that was so nice about Hector is I could trust him 100%.  One day we were lounging in our beachfront cabana and we realized we left the camera in the room.  One call to Hector and he was immediately at the cabana asking how he could help.  We asked him to please go in our room and grab the camera.  Hector earned my trust so much that I gave him the code to my safe to bring me some cash down to the beach so I could tip the bartender.  Of course, hector brought the camera and cash just as we asked and then so he felt comfortable he politely requested for me to change the code to the safe just so there were no misunderstandings going forward.  I BARLEY WILL GIVE THE PASSWORD TO MY SAFE TO MY FIANCE, MUCH LESS SOMEONE I JUST MET, BUT HECTOR WAS THAT TRUSTWORTHY AND GENUINE.  He literally checked on us 24/7 and helped us with requests that I would never even have thought to make, but of course he offered!  This is what sets the Paradisus Cancun apart from a Ritz Carlton, St. Regis, or any other hotel.  Hector and Juan were there to serve us with ANY request for the duration of our stay.  One of my friends wanted to buy his mother a handmade cross from a local market.  We didn't feel like going into town, so without even asking, Juan shows up a few hours later with multiple crosses to chose from that he personally went into town and purchased!  My friend picked the one he liked and Juan took the others back.  I could talk for days about Hector and Juan's service, but you will have to experience it for yourself to believe it.

The unimaginable service didn't stop with Hector and Juan.  EVERYONE was amazing.  The cleaning staff made sure our room was spotless each day (we definitely didn't make it easy on them).   Not only did the room look like it had been scrubbed by a toothbrush, but we never saw the cleaning crew.  No one bothered us while we were asleep or in the room.  They waited until we were at the beach for the day, came in, did an amazing job, and got out!

The royal service pool and the regular pool are just like everything else, beautiful.  Each day we had a two tiki cabanas along with lounge chairs reserved oceanfront right above the beach (thanks to hector ensuring the reservations!).  The poolside and beachside concierge/servers are on top of their game.  There was not 1 minute that I didn't have a fresh cocktail in my hand.  As soon as I would think its about time for another, mysteriously the server would show up with another round.  It should be noted that the liquor is TOP SHELF.  Grey Goose (multiple flavors), Don Juilo Tequila, Tanqueray Gin, Bombay Safire, the list goes on and on...Beers are served in the can, no cheap keg beer like other all inclusive resorts.  The royal service poolside grill served great ceviche anytime you asked.  

The beach is the largest I've seen in Cancun.  I've stayed at other resorts in the "party" area of the hotel zone and there is little to no beach area.  Plenty of chairs for everyone with fresh towels provided throughout the day.

Each day after enjoying the cabana we would walk down to the beach bar in the main part of the hotel.  It is a hidden oasis that looks like a tiki hut.  I don't have to explain the service again you should have the idea by now....However, Alex had our cigars of choice ready each day and made sure we never went without one.

One of the coolest things about this resort is it caters to EVERYONE.  It is not a place to find spring breakers taking body shots or loud music and bingo by the pool.  Paradisus Cancun is complete relaxation that caters to everyone.  We met people on their honeymoon, family vacations, and of course we were on my bachelor party.  Usually it is hard to please such a wide range of age groups, but Paradisus has mastered it.

The food is great.  I recommend making reservations for each of the restaurants when you arrive so you can enjoy all of them.  However, we never had a problem getting a table anywhere.

The entire resort has vegetation everywhere and a wonderful modern feel.  The Avenue Bar stays open late and has a very cool lounge feel to it.  There is even a disco on site if that is your thing.

Overall, there is not enough I can say about this wonderful resort.  If you are considering traveling to Cancun, make your reservation at Paradisus Cancun now. You definitely will not regret it.  I will absolutely be returning for many years to come!  It should be noted that although the Presidential Suite was a great bonus, I would have been just as happy in a regular garden view room.  

On behalf of myself and my friends we would like to thank the entire staff at Paradisus Cancun for making our dreams come true by experiencing the best vacation we could ever have imagined!

I look forward to seeing everyone next time!   

.

reviews.author: Pina F
reviews.title: JUST WONDERFUL!!
reviews.text:
We had the pleasure of staying at the Paradisus from August 15,2013-August 22,2013.  Our stay consisted of 14 people (adults and children).  We were celebrating a life event, my in-laws 50 anniversary!  Unfortunately my father in law became ill and spent 3 days in a Cancun hospital.  (he's much better now)!  Obviously with worry over his health, none of us could relax!  But I will say the staff was superb!  They could not do enough for us.  Fred Boutouba the operations Manager came to our room and could not be more accommodating or helpful.  He wanted us to enjoy the rest of our vacation as much as possible.  Whatever we needed I am sure he would've provided with a cheerful smile!  
Now to the actual hotel itself!  BEAUTIFUL and CLEAN!  I am impressed at how well managed the Paradisus is because it is a big hotel!  Our view was spectacular, overlooking the pool and beach, couldn't ask for more than that! My kids 13 and 11 loved the pools and especially the pottery painting by the kiddie pool!  The daily BBQ poolside was excellent.  Great food, and again always clean and well maintained!  The swim up bar was wonderful and the bar tenders, men and women were pleasant and very accommodating especially because my kids wanted those non-alcoholic tropical drinks all the time!  
Now to the restaurants!  Our absolute favorite was NAOS!  That was the international buffet!  I am not much for buffets as the food can get boring and its usually the same thing over and over, but not here!  Every day it was different, breakfast, lunch and dinner!  The food was fresh, delicious, and plentiful.  But what made NAOS outstanding was the staff!  They were attentive and knew ahead of time that we wanted to sit together and always tried to accommodate us.  They are cheerful and truly go out of their way to make our dining experience wonderful.  Thank you to VALERIA, JESUS MARTIN ARZETA, IVAN GRANDE, ORLANDO BELLO, NACHO, IGNACIO VAZQUEZ, and if I did not mention any one else that took care of us that week, my sincerest apologies, YOU are what makes NAOS so great, and we thank you! We did eat at the other restaurants in the hotel and they too were excellent!  We would definitely go back!!! We highly recommend this hotel! Great work Mr. Fred!!

reviews.author: PhillipVN
reviews.title: Great Hotel and Staff
reviews.text:
Best vacation hotel we have been to in several years. The arrival welcome from the doorman, Paul to the front desk staff immediately made us feel at home. The hotel was extremely clean and the staff were very efficient.

The maid was always friendly and kept our room spotless. The restaurants were always a pleasure to visit with a good variety of food and good waiters. Our Spanish is not good at all but we found that most staff were prepared to listen to us mess up their language without being offended and switch over to English when we got stuck.

The beach is awesome with beautiful clear surf to play, swim and relax in. There are good cabanas and lots of deck chairs on the white beach sand. We were extremely fortunate to have a waiter named Sofonia serve us from the Monday through to the Friday. He was very friendly and humorous while providing an excellent service. It was not unusual to finish our drinks and go swimming only to find that he had removed the empty glasses and replaced them with fresh drinks by the time we got back to our spot on the beach. One group of guests were a bit grumpy when arriving in the late morning but he had them laughing and in a much better mood by the end of the day. ..Ask for Sofonia if you are down there.. you won't be disappointed.

We did 2 tours with "Experiencias xcaret" and for the first time while in Mexico, a tour group was at the hotel on the exact pickup time for our tours as well as for the airport transfer pickup. The hotel staff seemed to be in constant contact with the tour groups and made sure that hotel customers were not inconvenienced. 

We are almost certain to book the same room for next year and strongly recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: yesenia c
reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Just got back on Saturday and had an amazing time. Food was great service was excellent. We enjoyed the swim up bar, Enrique the bartender was great and kept us entertained with all his tricks. Luis the beach waiter was so friendly and always had a smile on his face. Would definitely stay here again!

reviews.author: IRIDA J
reviews.title: Its worth for money paid
reviews.text: The overall is a good hotel. I would like more lights in the evening but this is a personal request. I had perfect time there. Very good staff. Very taste food. I didnt like kids zone as i have 2 children 12 and 10 and they had to play in zone with babies. The right place for them was teen zone but it was for 13 and up so they didnt stay one day there

reviews.author: 77Pyeman77
reviews.title: needs some updating
reviews.text: overall a good location and place to stay, needs some updating for sure but lots to do.  Beach needs to be cleaned more often of seaweed.  The short trip to Playa Del Carmen was convenient and inexpensive by cab. We paid extra for Royal Service and would definitely upgrade to this again.  Kids had a blast in the pools and the Ocean when calm.

reviews.author: Lilit S
reviews.title: We loved our experience at Paradisus
reviews.text: Paradisus was a beautiful hotel.  We went on August 21-28, 2013.  We were a big family of 8.  Every where we went, they were able to accommodate our big family.  Most of our morning and day was spent at the bar, and Enrique was an amazing bartender!  He really enjoyed what he was doing, and every cocktail and drink we had tasted amazing.  He has a very friendly and great personality, and I could notice everyone at the pool bar enjoyed having him as a bartender.  We spent most of our dinners and lunches at the buffet.  The servers that were very kind and helpful and quick were Javier Victor and Enrique.  They made sure we received a high customer service.  They were full of energy!  I do not remember names of other amazing employees, but we did not once come upon an employee that did not reach high standard of customer service, everyone was great!  Loved every second of our vacation and I will definitely return back to Paradisus, one of the most beautiful hotels I've ever been to.

reviews.author: blvd30
reviews.title: Nice place but some points I wish I knew prior
reviews.text:
The hotel is a short cab ride from the airport which makes it very convenient and the beach that fronts it is beautiful.  The hotel is very well maintained and clean.

Now a few things I didnt like:
1. The pool is very deep.  I was on my tip toes at all times (I'm 5'3" tall) and it was very difficult to bring my baby in the pool since i would have to hold her over my head.  I wish it had been noted somewhere that the pool was that deep because that definitely would have changed my mind about booking this hotel.  We have been to Cancun several times and the pools are usually about waist deep, which is what you want when you want to just relax and enjoy a nice cocktail!
We did find out more than halfway thru our stay that there was a seperate family area with a shallow pool that you could pay extra for to stay in with kids.  Had we known that we may have stayed in that part... 

2. The food was ok at best.  There weren't many options and what was there was usually cold and not very appetizing.  Also, at the buffets, it was difficult to find a meat option that wasnt pork, bacon, etc.  If you do not eat pig you are pretty much out of luck since everything seemed to be wrapped in the stuff.
There were also some restaurants not included in the "all inclusive" that remained empty most nights which was frustrating since we didnt have to many dining options to begin with.  The a la carte restaurants were ok.  Market Grill was the best one and it was "ok".

3.  Oh, small note, check-in took forever.

Other than that, it was all good.  Beach was beautiful, grounds were well maintained and the people were very nice.

reviews.author: LuisCH_Ang
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: This was the second time we stayed at this hotel and the service was even better this time. The all-inclusive option really saved us money that we used towards tours (Tulum, Chichen-Itza, Xel-ha, etc.). We also had an incident where we accidentally left a smartphone at one of the restaurants and the front-desk kindly called our room and left us a VM to let us know they had an item that was potentially ours and asked us to come downstairs, to a security room where we reclaimed our lost gadget. We were very pleased with the service and overall quality of the hotel. We will definitely stay at this hotel again on our next trip.

reviews.author: kcott
reviews.title: Had amazing time, would definitely return!!
reviews.text: My family travelled to the Paradisus at the beginning of June. The hotel itself is beautiful, great beach and pool. Food was amazing especially the taco restaurant and japanese restaurant (sorry can't remember the names). Despite the rainy conditions, and various "leaks" due to the heavy rain, the staff did everything they could to keep things spotless and enjoyable. Staff at the bar and throughout the hotel could not have been friendlier! Our room had an amazing view and large balcony.....very clean and large enough for the 4 of us. Can't wait to return!!

reviews.author: busineevoyageur
reviews.title: Market grill & Noas
reviews.text: Our experience at the Market Grill was amazing. Food and service were excellent. Margarita greated us with a great smile and attention, Jose spoiled us with a fast and attention to details service. Rody, the manager, made the entire dinner a magnificent one, who make us want to cone back again. The food was absolutely fabulous, tasty, and delightful. Noas buffet for lunch and breakfast are excellent too. Tasty, clean, fresh, with a great staff. The service is great, from the moment that you walk in.

reviews.author: A C
reviews.title: Amazing Staff
reviews.text:
We have been going to Paradisus since 2017 around 1-2x a year (with a few exceptions, including during the pandemic). I have reviewed the hotel before in terms of the room, amenities, etc., but will skip that part-- the hotel will be closing for an approximately year-long renovation and it would be better to review once again after the facilities have gotten a refresh. What I would really like to review is the primary reason we continue to go back year after year, which is the staff, most especially the staff across the many restaurants on the premises. I have traveled to many places around the world, including numerous all-inclusive resorts throughout the Caribbean. Experiences have varied but never have my family and I felt quite as genuinely welcomed and cared for as we have at Paradisus-Cancun. These they represent the hotel with the utmost professionalism and customer service. They have become such friends that we keep in touch with them on WhatsApp to share life updates, holiday greetings, and simple check-ins to say “hello”.  The hospitality we have felt from these individuals goes way beyond it being their job. They not only remember our tastes, preferences, restrictions, but go so far as to help us when sick (having soups and other food brought to our room), make special meals and desserts  to accommodate us or just to celebrate our being there, and even bring us gifts and tokens of friendship, which means the world, particularly when done for our young daughter. By doing this and much more, time and again they have shown us that we are not just hotel guests or customers, but family. It is why we return there instead of experimenting elsewhere whenever we want a relaxing vacation away from stress. My husband and I started going there when we were just dating, and since then they have seen us go from dating, to married, to expecting (they took very good care of me while pregnant) to having seen our daughter grow from one visit to the next. During one of our visits, we brought our friends with us (two families with their children) and they felt similarly comfortable with, and well-treated by, our Paradisus friends. The following list of names is not exclusive by any means, but it includes the names of the people who have had the most impact on us and with whom we have developed genuine bonds that go beyond the confines of the hotel and our stays therein. They take pride in their work and, above all, take human connections seriously. 
 
Roberto Ortiz
Francisco Tello
David 
Guillermo
Nacho 
Ramiro Pech
Armando UC Balam
Patricia Sanchez
Alberto Linares
Liliana Garcia
Ruben Gomez 

Hardworking doesn’t begin to accurately describe the work-ethic these people have, but what is even more incredible is the joy and passion with which they show up and how they do everything with a smile on their face and love in their hearts. Thank you to them and all of the wonderful people who have taken such great care of us throughout the years and who have made Paradisus feel like home. We are excited to see the improvements with the facilities, activities, etc., after the renovations, and we look forward to returning, with the sincerest pleas and hopes that the individuals mentioned above be retained-- their presence is what really makes Paradisus, and no number of upgrades or luxury additions will make up for their absence. They are Paradisus-Cancun and their absence would be a terrible loss for the hotel.

reviews.author: doloresvdhlakovic
reviews.title: True paradise.
reviews.text:
Amazing hotel, luxurious rooms, delicious food, reach self-service breakfast, but most of all friendly, helpful, always smiley staff, from concierge, bell boy, cleaner, gardener, entertainer, bartenders- everyone there was always super friendly and customer oriented to fulfill every need. It was exceptional.  
The hotel is cleverly intertwined with a jungle vibe with wooden pathways leading either to another part of the hotel or to the beach. There is Adult only section for everyone to be able to relax, chill etc, while family friendly part offers a variety things to do of you have children. Top attraction is aqua Park.

reviews.author: dward0115
reviews.title: Disappointed with kids club experience
reviews.text:
I am currently staying at Paradisus, and while the resort itself is absolutely beautiful, my experience with the Kids Club has been very disappointing.

I was informed to bring my 8-year-old daughter 10–15 minutes before check-in time if the children would be leaving for another activity or location on the resort. We arrived early, around 5:50 PM (check-in was at 6:00 PM), but I was told that she could not enter because they were only accepting children participating in the show. Her cousins, who were right in front of us, were allowed in, but my daughter was turned away.

She was heartbroken and spent the evening in our room crying, not understanding why she couldn’t return to a place she had enjoyed earlier that day. She had been there all day and only needed to leave because the staff were taking their scheduled break from 5:00 to 6:00 PM. When I asked when she could return, I was told 9:30 PM — which caused me to miss my 9:00 PM dinner reservation.

There also appears to be inconsistency in the check-in process. When I registered my daughter, I was not asked to present her passport, yet another family member was told her child could not attend without showing one.

Additionally, the Kids Club is only available for children up to age 10, leaving limited activities for older kids, which can be challenging for families traveling with children of different ages.

Overall, while the resort grounds, rooms, and amenities are stunning, the lack of organization and consistency within the Kids Club was disappointing. For a family-friendly resort, I expected a smoother and more accommodating experience for children. Unfortunately, based on this, I would hesitate to return or recommend Paradisus to other families.

reviews.author: Vanessa M
reviews.title: Dinner at Cielo
reviews.text: One of the waiters at  the restaurant Cielo ,named Melvin, was very sweet, helpful ,super friendly and accomodating ensuring that our food was correct and exactly what we ordered.  Overall ambiance was lovely ,clean a relaxing enjoyable experience. We highly recommend  this place.

reviews.author: Jessica P
reviews.title: Excitement turned into disappointment :(
reviews.text: We came to this resort for our honeymoon and wanted to come back for our 10 year anniversary. We booked what appeared to be a beautiful premium ocean view suite in the adults only Reserve.  Upon checking in we got to our room - went down under sea level and the room had no view, the top of the balcony wall was actually ground level. We requested a new room and were refused even though we were told that the hotel was not full.  So extremely disappointing. Otherwise everything was amazing but the was so incredibly disappointing and our hopes of returning for each anniversary will likely be a different resort now.

reviews.author: Crypto W
reviews.title: Super happy!
reviews.text: Jesus at the Lemon Fish was amazing! This is a really great experience. The food is great, the ambience is very interesting, and the beach is amazing. I am having a great time here at the Paradisus Cancun, and want to make the most our of every single day.

reviews.author: Christine C
reviews.title: Capella restaurant
reviews.text: For our last night in Cancun at Paradisus we chose to revisit Capella Italian restaurant where we ate on our first night. The food was fantastic but the evening was made even better because of the outstanding service we received from our server Jesus, he advised us about the menu and assured us that nothing was too much trouble. We will 100% return to Paradisus for another trip. The staff are fabulous.

reviews.author: Tonya C
reviews.title: AMAZING
reviews.text: Atilano provided the BEST SERVICE and drinks! Enrique the chef prepared us the most delicious tacos ! Must go. We had a great time and enjoyed our food. We came for our first trip after having a baby and they made the experience absolutely outstanding. We felt welcomed, and we will be back!

reviews.author: Hemlata P
reviews.title: Perfect hotel
reviews.text:
As  soon as you enter the lobby your sprites are lifted the interior is like a tropical paradise with water falls & streams
The service was great the ambiance was lovely so were all the staff 
Our family all 32 of us stayed here for my son’s wedding 
Poolside services were excellent 
We all agreed that this was the best place 
We have all travelled all over the world

reviews.author: Janet A
reviews.title: Amazing Relaxing Family Vacation
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay! The hotel was amazing rooms were clean and spacious service was great food was delicious restaurants service was impeccable pool was great service beach was beautiful service was also great we were with family they enjoyed it as well

reviews.author: Kirat T
reviews.title: Blue Agave Restaurant
reviews.text:
Amazing experience. Luxury and cultural blended perfectly together. 
Blue agave restaurant was fantastic and Osvaldo Avendaño was a very nice, experienced and knowledgeable server. 
Highly recommend. See myself coming back more often.

reviews.author: Dylan Yael R
reviews.title: The truth an unforgettable experience and the service of the waiter Atilano very good
reviews.text: Very comfortable the pillows I consider the stay is excellent and especially the attention of each of the workers is 100% are aware of everything I would recommend to all the public to visit the facilities and that they will not regret it I personally would return

reviews.author: Marisol Veridia... Z
reviews.title: Fantastic.
reviews.text: Fantastic fish food, salmon, very good service of waiters, he are very attentive... especially Sérgio of the Marine Water, the boys of the fantastic wet bar.... Ricardão, Baltazar...Sensational experience...The rooms very good, sensational bed
