reviews.text: Amazing service by our server Jesus and the pork ribs are to die for. The meat just falls right off the bone! The Ramen was also pretty amazing. It’s definitely a must stop place when you are staying at the resort. Highly recommend to other guests.

reviews.author: Luis Gerardo D
reviews.title: Excellent care as always
reviews.text:
Excellent attention from Paola at the Blue Agave restaurant on October 27 and the days since she arrived were always very friendly all the HomePod we spent the day with the
Best way always with a smile and very friendly and no all time with great warmth that made us feel at home

reviews.author: Laura N
reviews.title: Fine Mexican Dining
reviews.text:
Dinner at Cielo was fantastic and Mesro made it even better. Mesro was extremely attentive to our needs and offered suggestions to fit our tastes. 
The atmosphere and music was perfect for dinner and complementary to the food. 
I highly recommend

reviews.author: Pauline Brandon H
reviews.title: DO NOT BOOK YOUR WEDDING HERE
reviews.text:
If I could give this venue ZERO stars, I absolutely would. This has been the worst, most stressful experience, and I wouldn’t wish it on anyone. From the very start, Gloria and her team have been deceitful and unprofessional. Despite having everything in writing—signed contracts and even a voice recording where Gloria personally promises the Del Prado ballroom—they are now refusing to honor what was agreed upon. Instead, they’ve tried to push us into another space, one that was never discussed or part of the deal. This is a classic bait-and-switch tactic, which is completely unacceptable, especially for something as important as a wedding.

What makes it even worse is that they didn’t tell us about the change until we flew out to the hotel for our tasting! After months of planning and clear communication, they waited until we arrived on-site to inform us that the Del Prado ballroom, which we had paid for, was no longer available. They didn’t notify us ahead of time or give us the chance to make alternative plans—just dropped this bombshell when we were already there. The level of disrespect and unprofessionalism is unbelievable.

To top it all off, they tried to scam us on the room block too. The prices they quoted us were actually *higher* than what was listed on their own website. When we questioned it, there was no clear explanation, and it felt like they were trying to squeeze as much money out of us as they could.

If that wasn’t bad enough, the communication has now gone silent. Gloria and her team have stopped answering our emails and calls entirely. We’re weeks away from our wedding, and we don’t even know if we still have a venue. The level of stress this has caused us is beyond words, and instead of offering solutions, they’ve left us completely in the dark.

And to add insult to injury, they are refusing to return our deposit, even though they have failed to honor the terms of the contract and their promises. Holding onto our money while giving us the runaround is just disgraceful.

I cannot emphasize this enough: stay far away from this venue. Gloria and her team lack basic professionalism, integrity, and honesty. The bait-and-switch tactics, inflated room charges, and complete lack of communication have turned what should have been an exciting time into an absolute nightmare. Please don’t make the same mistake we did. Save yourself the heartache, stress, and frustration, and look elsewhere for your special day.

reviews.author: SweTee
reviews.title: Solo stay, loved the attentive service
reviews.text:
I stayed at this hotel as a solo traveller for 4 nights in a sea view room in the main pyramid. I absolutely love the inside of the hotel, all the plants, greenery and height of the main ceiling is a stunning first impression. 

I think the rooms are little tired looking but it didn’t bother me significantly, however the aircon is actually quite loud. Huge king size bed, the seats provided on the balcony were low deckchairs so my short self didn’t really enjoy the sea view when sitting down. The toiletries provided are good and included shampoo, conditioner, shower gel and body lotion which is a nice touch. If you want a quiet stay, the main pyramid is not for you as the evening entertainment and all the bar and restaurants are located there. 

Breakfast is great, although not so many seats outside (maybe because of the time of year I came) which is a shame as I want to eat outside wherever possible. Service is very attentive everywhere including on the beach. That was definitely a highlight! Staff are working hard and super polite and they deserve a lot of credit. Shoutout to Moses in the Mexican a la carte restaurant. Food in general was good. Had a couple of things I wasn’t too sure of but overall, better than some places I have stayed. 

I honestly can’t fault Paradisus as the gym is also amazingly big, the spa is nice, plenty of pool space and sun loungers. The beach could be maintained a bit better as some broken plates laying around randomly in the sand I guess form late night revellers but a pretty minor thing in general. I would love for them to update the rooms but overall there are some cute photo spots for Instagram, the decor is fun outside and I would return as even though I don’t have children it wasn’t crazy loud when I stayed. I have also stayed at Paradisus in Punta Cana and at other Melia hotels and not been disappointed so the chain is consistent!

reviews.author: Connector656016
reviews.title: Based on my experience, I cant recommend this property
reviews.text:
To be clear, this review is a reflection of the property itself. The staff was very warm and accommodating.

The property is very old and outdated. There are newer renovated rooms, but we were in one of the older rooms facing the street. There is a loud night club across the street, it makes falling asleep very difficult if you face the lagoon. Of all of the all inclusive I've been to, this is by far the most outdated property. Outside of your room, do not expect air conditioning. For such a a large property, there isn't a location for their nightly shows other than the lobby...the unairconditioned lobby.  Sure it was not comfortable sitting there, but the performers were drenched in sweat. 

We were there unfortunately during tropical storm Helene...We had almost an inch of water in our room. We thought it was an isolated incident until we went to breakfast and saw the entire hotel was leaking.... hallways, steps, everywhere. Several of the elevators were shut down as well. There was so much water there were trash cans everywhere to catch water. I felt bad the employees were feverishly trying to keep water out during a tropical storm. Lots of people slipped and fell.... we saw someone with a broken arm. 

The women at the kids club were great, but there isn't much for them to do inside. If the weather is bad the kids stay inside and do coloring/crafts. The kids club is fairly small/setup for very young kids.

Food overall was decent. Not great, but not bad either.

reviews.title: Another memorable vacation in the Cancun paradisus
reviews.text:
This is our 5th consecutive year that we go to this hotel with friends, this year there were 10 but other years we have been more. The food and service are spectacular and that is why we have repeated so many times. They really serve us super well.
Our whole stay was amazing!
Astrid from "guest experience" treated us excellent.  
Giovanni always pending that the experience in each restaurant was not to our liking. 
Every moment of the day was special. 
The morning coffee, and the afternoon coffee, in the Nespresso cafe with Alejandro and Fer, they always cheerful and friendly. 
The varied and super rich breakfasts in Malva with people like Ramiro, Ygnacio, Ariadne, Rafael and Calendar taking care that everything was as we like. 
The new Flora restaurant, we loved the first day so we repeated, there Cinthia, Fanny and Tere pleased us divinely.
We also tried the restaurant Santé and the food was delicious and Bernardo super attentive and friendly.
At the restaurant Cielo, chef David and the waiter super friendly and very good food.
On the beach, Jhandi and Gaudencio very good service despite the heat and long haul to get the drinks. 
In the pool area, Roberto and Laura attended us for lunch and/or afternoon snacks, you can not be kinder and more helpful. 
At Lemon fish Jesus attended us very enthusiastically after a day in lockdown due to "Helene". 
Every day we went to see what we could of the varied shows and at the end we went to the ginger bar, there Gabby and her colleagues, with her smile and always positive attitude attended us and she knew exactly what each of our group of 10 people wanted.
The hotel, mainly on the outside of the buildings already need a little maintenance. The rooms are as good as ever. There was a lot of rain due to the passage of Tropical Storm "Helene" and a lot of water entered the hotel. However, the hotel staff worked very hard to solve the problems, it really showed how everyone did the ones that touched them and more to solve problems and on Thursday after the storm everything back to normal due to the effort of the staff.
We felt really on vacation!

reviews.author: R S
reviews.title: Not My Cup of Tea
reviews.text:
The staff were generally good. Several bartenders were exceptionally kind and friendly. Pascual was a waiter that went out of his way to make us feel welcome. The majority of the other waiters were nice enough, but less than attentive after food was delivered. 

Facility wise, there were some problems.  I noticed a roach in the buffet room early in our stay. I recognize this is an ongoing fight they have to content with, but it is what it is. Also, noticed there were government stickers on the front of the Hotel stating some type of health or safety issue. I am not fluent in Spanish and didn't take the time to translate. We stayed in the southern-most building on the property and felt pretty isolated and alone most of the time.  I wonder if it might have something to do with using credit card points to book through a 3rd party agency. 

I got sick one day, not sure why, and there was a maintenance crew that was hammering. This was very annoying while trying to rest from sickness. I had to call the front desk 3 times to get it to stop.

My wife, 2 small children, and I were stopped by the military on the beach and questioned as to where we were going and where we were staying. This was mid day and a little disconcerting. 

The restaurant group across the street Rosa Negra group, which contains several restaurants in an over-water setup was amazing. We toured all the restaurants, but  ate at Chambeau. It was outstanding. After being sick, and not really trusting the food at the resort, it was a welcome experience. 

The pools were very very warm, way too warm for my liking.

My kids loved experiencing the turtles hatching on the beach. 

I love Mexico and I hate to complain but I don't think I will be going back to Paradisus or Cancun. Though the beach is much better in Cancun, I generally prefer Cabo San Lucas, based on my experience.

reviews.author: The_Candid_Traveller
reviews.title: Enchanting
reviews.text:
We've just returned from a wonderful week's break at the Paradisus. The hotel's design as 5 distinctive 'pyramids' marks it out among the usual high rise hotels in the Hotel Zone. Inside, a wide array of trees, shrubs and plants provide a calming and relaxing atmosphere to wander through as you go about your business. The gentle sounds of the water fountains provide yet more relaxation to the environment.  

We found the service to be excellent, and would like to thank Denora, Fanny, Abraham, Valentin, Eddie, Vanessa(gym) and Ian especially for their friendly and helpful service. We'd also like to thank Jenn, our concierge for being on hand whenever we needed assistance. There is always wide selection of fresh food available in the buffet restaurant, or you can go to the specialist restaurants: Aqua Marina (seafood), Asian fusion, steakhouse (not included in All-Inclusive), Cielo (Mexican), Italian, or the Taqueria. We enjoyed our meals at all the restaurants we ate at, and never got bored. 

The beach is beautifully clean, with powdery white sand and turquoise waters. There was no sargassum. Unlike neighbouring hotels, there are plenty of sun loungers, cabanas, and palapas. There are lifeguards on duty also. 

We stayed in a junior suite and were very happy with it. The room was large, with 2 double beds and a large adjoining bathroom with rain shower. We had a lagoon view which was particularly beautiful at sunset. I'm sure the sea view rooms are equally spectacular. The only problem we had  was that the first room we were given had a very noisy A/C, and despite maintenance's best efforts, this was not able to be fixed. Thankfully, we were moved to another room which had  a nice quiet A/C. There is a minibar, although we found that it was replenished only on request. The room service was excellent. 

Tipping is not expected but is appreciated by the staff, and we gave a few dollars here and there to the good ones. We did hire a car and drove to see the sights at Chichen-itza and Tulum. Both enchanting places, and a swim in the local cenotes is a must afterwards. 

There are daily activities for adults and children (in the kids club) and the timetable is on the app or on the dreamcatchers board. We particularly enjoyed the sound healing, the Mayan shamen and the chocolate making. Entertainment is provided in the evenings.

Our only gripe at the hotel was the water-sports salesmen. Sadly, you have to get your beach towels from them, which means facing a sales pitch every time you need a beach towel, even after we had said we weren't interested. We found this to be a bit tacky and unnecessary in a hotel of this standard.

Otherwise, we had a very relaxing break and say muchos gracias to all the staff at Paradisus Cancun for giving us a taste of Mexican hospitality. hasta luego!

reviews.title: Meh
reviews.text: I would not come here again. We came with a chartered group so we didn’t choose this location. It was okay but nothing special. We had a leak in our room and they said “yeah, just put towel down” and didn’t seem to care. Staff was inattentive and not terribly friendly.  Staff seemed clueless whenever we asked for anything as if it was everyone’s first day working there. Food was very good. Bar was great. Pool was very nice and well maintained. It certainly was not horrible. But I’ve stayed at much better places

reviews.author: Sandra T
reviews.title: Paradisus by Meliá
reviews.text:
The experience at the Paradisus hotel is fantastic, from the variety of restaurants, Malva is delicious, Martín, who served us, is a nice person, to the multiple ones you can do; It is a place where you can take time, share with your partner and be with your family.
Everything is very clean
In general it is a wonderful place

reviews.author: Manuel E
reviews.title: Rafael from Lemon Fish restaurant
reviews.text:
Excellent service 👍 the waiter Rafael from Lemon fish very attentive and friendly, I would love to return.
I loved the delicious food and desserts….
He asked us if we had any food allergies.

reviews.author: Heidi B
reviews.title: October get away
reviews.text:
We spent a week in the Reserve and cannot say enough about the wonderful people who we saw every day. Moises and Gabby our pool and restaurant waiters were fantastic. They made sure we had everything and anything we could want or need food/drink wise. Luis our bartender for the week introduced us to new drinks and mixed some of the best Palomas I’ve had. 
Highly recommend this hotel and a stay in the Reserve section.

reviews.author: casiedonromine02
reviews.title: Melia Paradisus Cancun was great!
reviews.text: We upgraded to the Nikte experience, while this didn't come with as many benefits as you would think I will say our concierge was FANTASTIC. Stelian was so informative, positive, personable, spoke great english... even sent a gift up to our 10 year old so she could have her very own robe, slippers, hat and shirt. It was the sweetest touch. I could go on and on. The service at the buffet was entertaining and prompt. Our server at Sal Steakhouse was top notch, we have never had a more professional yet relaxed server. Lemon Fish was on a whole other level, service was incredible and the food was amazing. The waiter made sure we had a chance to try everything on our last night at the resort. The rooms were nice.. no different than our friends that did not upgrade to the Nikte. We requested the hotub on the balcony but didn't receive a room with that luxury. Beach and water was unlike anything you've ever seen. I have been to Mexico many times but this is by far the prettiest resort we have stayed at. The water was unreal.

reviews.author: pcosta68
reviews.title: NIKTÉ Disappointment
reviews.text: Hotel rooms need updating +++ (especially Nikté), the beach area needs to be better organized, there is lack of food variety in buffet, concierge service not satisfactory, disappointing NIKTÉ experience…not sure if I would go back.

reviews.author: Alanna T
reviews.title: Not if you have kids
reviews.text:
If you’re good with a family hotel that doesn’t allow kids anywhere post 9pm this is the one (currently sat in bed in my room writing this)!

Food is good for an all inclusive, the hotel is spotless, and the views are great. However…

I’ve NEVER been to a resort that’s happy to give 14 year olds alcohol in a bar, and then tell you that your impeccably behaved children that they are banned from the one place there is entertainment in the evening. Literally ridiculous!!

Depends what you’re after, but I would strongly recommending not coming here with children

reviews.author: Mkgraspa
reviews.title: Lemon Fish, must try!
reviews.text: Lemon Fish was delicious! Jorge our server was super friendly and attentive. Everything from chef Karen, yum! Try the green shrimp ceviche! Lomo lomo was also a hit with our group. We’ll eat here again before we leave.

reviews.author: Sarah L
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Jorge @ Lemon Fish was a wonderful server. Very attentive and made.great suggestions. The green shrimp ceviche was refreshing. Compliments to chef Karen! We ordered both ceviches, the grilled zucchini, short rib tacos,!omo Salgado with tacu tacu

reviews.author: Janice Smith
reviews.title: Wonderful experience at Paradisus Lemon Fish Restaurant
reviews.text:
Had dinner at Lemon Fish Jorge was our server and he was attentive, friendly, and took care of us. We wanted coconut drinks and he made sure we got our coconuts. Paradisus is lucky to have him. 
The food was delicious, thanks to Chef Karen. Everything tasted fresh and presented well.

reviews.author: Adriana A
reviews.title: Wonderful hotel! Very friendly and kind employees, impeccable cleanliness, great structure. Wonderful restaurants!
reviews.text:
Lemon Fish Restaurant is delicious!
The waiter Mr. Rafael is very attentive!
Congratulations to the entire team!
Water, pool, sea, all meals are very good!
Kind employees, partners and guests!!!
Today I had a massage at the SPA, what a magnificent experience!

reviews.author: Carlos A
reviews.title: Fantastic flavors
reviews.text: Very good !!! Great food and service!!! Great Lemon Fish Restaurant!!! Unique variety and quality!!! There are other restaurants with very good Mexican flavors!!! Fantastic service from Rafael at lemon

reviews.author: Christopher M
reviews.title: Worth a stay
reviews.text: The Food was very good, the waiter Moises Morales lead us threw the evening with great recommendation regarding the food, we are happy for the experiance. Furthermore the location and its view are beautiful.......... Try to visit if you can. :)

reviews.author: Gabriela G
reviews.title: Pool waiters
reviews.text:
The waiter Baltazar from the children's pool area 11 out of 10 excellent service!! Very few waiters like him, we have come to this hotel twice because of the excellent service we have had.
(The truth is, the receptionists are very bloody, especially Gabriela)
But the waiters were excellent👍🏻

reviews.author: lzelaya88
reviews.title: Just ok
reviews.text: Service is spotty with the exception of the two bartenders Salvador and Levy at the Asian fusion bar/restaurant in the middle of the mall looking resort.  They were gracious, funny and helpful.  At aqua marina we experienced sad, bored & unmotivated waiters.

reviews.author: Alejandra F
reviews.title: Good experience
reviews.text: It's our first time at the Paradisus hotel and we had a great time. We met Gaby, Nurbi, Abraham and Levi at the Ginger (Sports bar). They are good people, friendly, fun. They make you feel at home. My only suggestion is to add more connections in the rooms since we lacked charging devices. We hope to return soon and have unforgettable experiences.

reviews.author: Erendira H
reviews.title: The best, service and delicious food
reviews.text:
Everything was excellent, the waiters were very friendly, the food was excellent, the rooms were very clean, the beds were clean.
Good amenities, excellent room service and the beach is super clean and beautiful, I recommend it
Widely

reviews.author: Ca-Me M
reviews.title: Very nice hotel with great service ☀️
reviews.text: We are very happy with the hotel. Service is very important here! We would like to thank the very dedicated staff Toni, Atilano, Manuel Deler and Ignucio. In the Malva Am restaurant of the hotel they were always very attentive and helpful. Great service! Thank you very much ♥️

reviews.author: David Smith
reviews.title: Raffel and great sushi
reviews.text:
Raffel provided excellent service to go with the great food and amazing atmosphere.  

Definitely the best sushi I’ve had in Mexico!

Staying at the parradisus hotel.  Great resort.  

If you are looking for a place in cancun come here!

reviews.author: Inspiration246822
reviews.title: Friends in paradise
reviews.text: We were a large group that were able to meet up for an amazing experience. The Hotel offers all that we were looking for; restaurants, bars, night activities, excursions and an amazing staff. The Reserve made us feel papered and special, the staff catered to everything we needed. Thank you to the Sante staff and bar crew; Yadiar, Valeria, Joel, Moises, Gabriela and Luis. The Cabana staff; Luis and Nicole. All of the hotel and restaurant staff and most importantly our concierge, Galdi. We are already planning a vacation for next fall.

reviews.author: Sol P
reviews.title: Excellent place
reviews.text:
The attention of all the waiters was the best, super friendly, attentive and friendly, we received a lot of good vibes from them.
The food was delicious and varied, everything was very clean, the recreational activities were also quite varied, highly recommended

reviews.author: raulmv540
reviews.title: The small details count for a lot
reviews.text: In general it was good, 2-3 details with the operation of some room accessories. Upon check-in I found the service somewhat forced. The same person attended us at check out, and I didn't like it, on each occasion he made comments that were out of place for his position, his feelings or that of other guests with his companion.

reviews.author: Karina G
reviews.title: Rafael lemon fish
reviews.text:
Excellent service from the waiter Rafael, the lemon fish food was delicious, everything
Shushi
The picaña
The ramen
Desserts
Everything was very delicious and very fresh, we were delighted especially with the service.

reviews.author: Kenny Lloyd
reviews.title: Book it IMMEDIATELY!!
reviews.text: STELIAN, STELIAN, STELIAN!!!!!!!!!!! The absolute best concierge EVER!!! Request him and your experience just got that much better (no disrespect to the other concierges. He has to come from a room full of greatness!)….As if the property didn’t wow me, the service matched…all the staff was friendly. Like so friendly I got tired of reaching my hand over my heart in return greetings 😂😂. But seriously though, I’m coming back soon. I’m requesting STELIAN, and absorb myself in their warmth!!….and special shout-out to the hydro pool guy. That was AMAZING!!!!…photos taken with iPhone and NO filter!!!

reviews.author: Jared D
reviews.title: Couldn’t be happier! Thank you Edi Martin and Arturo
reviews.text: The food and the waitstaff are impeccable. We loved to go to the Bazaar for breakfast and we were always greeted and helped by friendly faces Edi, Arturo, and Martin were amazing! After my wife hurt her knee they made sure she didn’t need for anything so she could rest and get better. Martin even helped us with our bags to the elevator after breakfast on the last day! Thank you everyone!

reviews.author: Jesse D
reviews.title: Best spot in the house Ginger Bar
reviews.text:
My fiancé and I had the most amazing time. This is our second time to this resort. The food, resort, beach, pools, and service is top notch. 

I habe to point out that the sports bar aka the Ginger Bar has the greatest staff and service provided in the entire resort. Shout out to Abraham, Valentin, Dania, and Gaby. They were the most amazing people who gave nothing short of a 1 million star service.

reviews.author: JINX h
reviews.title: Honeymoon celebration dinner
reviews.text: We had an amazing meal and great recommendations from Miguel who was also was nice enough to surprise us with our 2 favorite drinks. Is what a beautiful restaurant an experience.  Thank you again to Miguel.

reviews.author: Sebastian R
reviews.title: PARADISIUS SAVE MY VACATION AFTER A TERRIBLE EXPERIENCE AT PARK ROYAL BEACH CANCUN
reviews.text:
This place is perfect for vacationing, the food is very delicious, there is no need to leave the hotel to eat delicious food, the service is the best. Edgar my cosiyer was very kind and professional, always attentive to me and my family.
Yesenia and Asuncion were the best in the alverca and were attentive to us even if we were not in their section.
And Moises at the Cielo Restaurant was very friendly, attentive and very Professional. I hope to see you next year.
And the kids club team, wow, the best, my daughters wanted to spend there every day.
EDIER very friendly and remembered our coffees wow.
Santiago, thank you for making me strong with so much exercise.
This was the best experience for me and my family. Paradisius saved our vacation after a very bad experience at Park Royal beach Cancun. We left in the middle of our stay and that's how we ended up at Paradisius. Thank you very much Paradisius.
Don't fall into the trap of being Royal Holiday Club members!

reviews.author: Jennie R
reviews.title: 100,000,000 stars to the staff of Paradisus!!!
reviews.text: Every morning, Edier in the coffee bar made my husband and I the best coffees! It only took one time ordering and he remembered me and my drink! In fact, on our last day, my husband went to get us coffee and even though he ordered my drink wrong, Edier made the right thing anyway! Moises is the best server we have had here at the restaurant Cielo. One night they were closed and he was at the taqueria and greeted us like old friends and went out of his way to make sure we were well cared for. La comida esta muyyyy rico. Mi esposo esta Mexicano y dice k esta bien contento con la calidad y el sabor de la comida en el Cielo. Thank you Moises and we hope to see you when we come back next year!! 🫶 at the pool, Yesenia was so nice and helpful and we really looked forward to seeing her, Sergio, Roberto & Asuncio every day. 😊 we look forward to our next visit!! Last but not least, the Kidsdom staff are AMAZING! The last resort we stayed at had a tiny dark room for the kids club, was only open a few hours a day, and the kids had to be dry to participate. Here at Paradisus, Rubi, Itzi, Juno, & many more staff that I cant recall their names, took excellent care of our kids. They had indoor and outdoor activities, water activities, a mario cart race, a kids motorized inflatables race and so much more. Our daughters were excited to go every day and during their breaks, couldn't wait to go back. There were always plenty of staff to take care of the kids and ensure their safety and they always were kind, patient, friendly, and full of energy. 100000 out of 100000 to Kidsdom!

reviews.author: Paola A
reviews.title: Heaven....Mexican food with great flavor
reviews.text: The experience was excellent, the food was very delicious, I ordered the Tarasca soup and the panuchos, the pibil kitchen was very delicious, maybe improve the waiting times for the table. Melvin gave us great attention and a very delicious tequila

reviews.author: Jacqui T
reviews.title: Cielo Restaurant
reviews.text: We ate at Cielo Mexican Restaurant and Melvin was a fantastic waiter. He was great at suggesting options and what worked well together. Especially for our children. Food was delicious. Highly recommend eating here for great, service and authentic Mexican dining.

reviews.author: BL
reviews.title: Great for Families with Young Kids
reviews.text:
Just got back from a trip with my husband and two young kids, and it was FABULOUS. We're ready to book again for next year! We have been to several all-inclusive resorts in Cancun, and our time at Paradisus was the best. 

The two highlights were the beach. WOW! The sand was white, the water was aquamarine, and there was no seaweed, unlike several other areas of Cancun. I know that can't be helped, but if you love the beach like we do, then this alone makes Paradisus a must-visit place. 

The pool side lunch and drink service was fantastic. The waiters near the kids-side of the pool were incredibly attentive and really made our time here. We loved getting to sit by the pool and quickly order lunch-- like baja fish tacos, chips and guacamole, burgers, etc, without having to leave our chairs. Especially with two young children, this was a highlight. 

Food was good-- especially for an all-inclusive. We've been to many and I would put this at the top, especially the Italian and Lemon Fish restaurant. My kids loved the ramen and we loved the nigiri and ceviche! 

The only downside was that it was hard to figure out what was included and what wasn't. We weren't Reserve members and it wasn't clear what we got to enjoy and what we didn't. For example, we went to order the speciality cocktails at the Ginger bar and were told it was an extra charge. And, some of the restaurants are only available to Reserve guests which is fine, but it's not very clear-- either in signage or in the app. The app also isn't accurate-- several times it would say something was open, when it was closed, or the times were wrong. Even with this, I'd still give a 5-star rating and can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: gneth1077
reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text:
All the services Exceeded all our expectations!! Best ever family vacation of 6.  All staffers were helpful. My concierge Lily was amazingly supportive. Recardo from Otium,  Malva restaurant staff were very helpful and kind, as well at the pools and beach . Definitely worth coming back 🇨🇦

Thank you! Gwyn

reviews.author: Alan M
reviews.title: Enjoyable stay
reviews.text:
Worth ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️rating 
All inclusive was very good with great choice of food. Not the cheapest Hotels but you won’t be disappointed 
Location is ideal on the Hotel Strip 
Rooms are spacious and clean and ocoan view

reviews.author: holidaytimeplease
reviews.title: Lovely big, relaxed resort
reviews.text:
Huge, rambling resort. Always a quiet spot somewhere to set up and relax for the day.
Food was good with a clear enough distinction between buffet and a la carte options. 
I enjoyed the catch of the day at Aqua Marina. A whole grilled Tilapia with crisp skin, garlic marinade and buttery soft flesh, served with fresh fried root veg crisps (chips if you’re from the US).
Cocktails were never overly sweet and tasted strong enough. Inclusive wine was as good as I’d pick at home.
Never waited to be seated at any time, breakfast, lunch or dinner.
The stunning atrium is pretty warm but it’s  essentially a 12 Storey greenhouse. Strange some expect it to be cooled, how would that work?
The staff at this resort were great. It’s a tough gig dealing with the public these days, people are getting more and more demanding, rude and impatient but they seem to be able to hold it together regardless.
We broke the stay up with three days away from the poolside. We visited a fully open to air cenote, took a day trip to Chichen Itza and went into Cancun for the day. 
Our concierge Jose was a great help in facilitating our desire to venture from the resort and with all matters in and around the hotel.
We had a top floor “Nikte” room which was worth the extra outlay given the extras included.
In all a great stay. Thank you to all at Paradisus who made our trip a pleasure.
Lastly, be sure to keep a wee treat for Daisy the resort cat at breakfast time!

reviews.author: María del Carmen Palacios Morales
reviews.title: Relaxing vacation
reviews.text: Excellent hotel, very friendly and helpful staff, excellent attention from waiters Don Gaudencio, Richi, Ramiro and other staff. At the Carlos coffee station, very well attended. Variety of food and diet options, (vegetarian etc.) Excellent liquors, activities for the family.

reviews.author: Germain M
reviews.title: Tremendous stay
reviews.text:
Bèst service ever. Good food, loved the ceviche restaurant. The steak restaurant was great too. Even the buffet was awesome. 
We stayed at the adult only part, the reserve. Even though this Reserve part was under construction, they gave us a nice service. 
The best butler ever was Galdino. And a shout out to the best waiter Cesar.

reviews.author: daniel b
reviews.title: My experience
reviews.text: Very good experience, spacious and comfortable rooms, the attention of all the employees is excellent, the buffet meets expectations, but the best without a doubt are its themed restaurants, the Italian, meats, lemon fish, etc. I highlight the attention of Iran (in charge of the restaurants), who always attended to us as if we were his family, without a doubt I would return for him!!!! THANK YOU AND SEE YOU IN LIFE

reviews.author: Kathryn W
reviews.title: Beyond our expectations!!
reviews.text:
Service was excellent everywhere we went. Our favorite restaurants were Lemon Fish and Cappella.  Jesus our server and Chef Emilio at Cappella made sure our experience was amazing; our family loved it! At Lemon Fish we had an unexpected Tequila and Mezqule tasting that was a bonus surprise to our wonderful dinner!

The beach views were incredible and we loved exploring the long stretch of beach in front of us. The pools were clean, lots of chairs and fun activities throughtout the day.

The hotel overall was very clean. Service was excellent everywhere.  We highly recommend!!

reviews.author: christianaguer0
reviews.title: Cancun meeting
reviews.text: Excellent hotel and all the staff were great, only the details mentioned about the room and room service, plus the bathroom had a leak in the ceiling. The drinks were very good, only the food described in the restaurants was a little lacking.

reviews.author: Chirag B
reviews.title: WORST EXPERIENCE - DONT WASTE YOUR MONEY
reviews.text: If I can give negative stars, I would have done so for this resort. Service was horrible, the food was not up to par. Our entire room got flooded with water due to rain and throughout the resort, there were water leaks from roof. In check-in area, they kept water buckets to collect water! Don't waste your vacation time in this resort. It felt like the employees were trained to say "NO" to everything. Lot of the restaurants were not even open. Drinks were all sugary, no alcohol at all in them. We paid for NIKTE and it was absolute rip off! There was no premium alcohol whatsoever. Breakfast has only 1 restaurant option and the menu is the same. There was 1 bread that was not changed/touched for our entire stay! For this price you can find something better!

reviews.author: Diana R
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: We had a great time at the hotel, our time was short but it was amazing, if I will return to Cancún I will stay in it beautiful place. The food, staff, bar, activities, rooms, Mayan Ceremonies <3, everything was perfect

reviews.author: Korin F
reviews.title: great service!!!
reviews.text: The ambiance & service was amazing, our waiter Moises was super attentive & gave great recommendations. My group of four was celebrating a birthday & he surprised us with a cute little birthday corn cake & sparklers! The food has great presentation & flavor.  Would definitely recommend to check if our during your stay.

reviews.author: Jeff W
reviews.title: Wow
reviews.text: Our whole stay was great. Moises at Cielo was a fantastic server. The food was top notch and service was quick and friendly. Every staff member goes out of their way to provide great hospitality. Abel our concierge was so fun and provided great service.

reviews.author: Relax04231622088
reviews.title: A Perfect Addition to Our Vacation
reviews.text: The food at Lemon Fish was amazing! The green shrimp ceviche was the best, and our server Rafael was excellent in his recommendations. I never even liked sushi until I tried the sushi platter appetizer that he recommended. I came away loving it so  much that I ordered more of one of the sushi rolls for my main course. I definitely recommend stopping in for a visit!

reviews.author: Flyer02275151276
reviews.title: Best vacation spot!
reviews.text: The aesthetics of the hotel alone are calming and relaxing and BEAUTIFUL! Everyone on the staff was so kind and helpful. The beach is perfect and you’re so close to many different excursion spots - we recommend Isla Mujeres and ANY Cenotes!

reviews.author: Eduardo A
reviews.title: Disappointing. Will not return to ANY Melia resort.
reviews.text:
I would not recommend this resort.
1- Rooms: I was changed 3 times - AC not working, roaches in the room and finally the last 2 days in one room where only one shower had hot water.
2- Food: Unimpressive. there are no real lunch options if you don't like to eat at the buffet, which is crowded and unclean. They also seem to change/close restaurants for dinner without much warning to their guest. Not a lot of choices to eat as advertised.
3- Staff was ok, but please stop trying to upsell their membership !. we could not step out of our room without someone trying to soliciting us to attend one our their sales pitches. it is annoying and sours the entire vacation.
As a final thought, this resort is old and need basic updating like better AC, more choices in restaurants and better trained restaurant staff.

reviews.author: Roque T
reviews.title: Heaven Restaurant
reviews.text: Heaven restaurant. Moses was excellent. The best service and conversation. Please ensure that it goes very well. I sang my mother's birthday, and she gave us a very nice dinner. Very gentle and good spirited. Very tasty food too.

reviews.author: Denise Z
reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text: We stayed at the hotel for 8 days and would like to stay for much longer! Beautiful view, wonderful structure, varied and tasty food, lots of activities for the whole family! The service provided by the staff is excellent, they are very helpful and friendly. The waiters Ignácio, Vázquez, Atilano and Manoel are very attentive and charismatic. We already want to go again!

reviews.author: norb
reviews.title: WORK WEEK
reviews.text:
Very good service at the MALVA restaurant, especially from the waiter Ramiro Alex. 👍 They offered us mimosas and coffee, always present, above all, the attention and recognition to Mr. Javier
Gaudencio the best service on the beach, always with good humor

reviews.author: Ludovic P
reviews.title: Superb place
reviews.text: We came with young football players. Very warm welcome within the hotel. The staff is always smiling and available. The children were able to enjoy the swimming pools and the beach in front of the hotel. The different restaurants offer quality, diverse food... and which do not hesitate to adapt to different requests. The rooms are spacious

reviews.author: Manuel R
reviews.title: An excellent experience!
reviews.text: This hotel/spa gave us the best experience we have had at any “resort” in Cancun and probably all the ones we have visited in our many trips. From the Barista Carlos Vinalay and the butler Josue, to the photography service provided by Diego Cauich and Teresa and their incredible team of waiters, including Rafael, Candelario, Alberto, Pascual and Arturo. Cleanliness and order are maintained throughout the spa. Everything looks beautiful and with a high level of luxury. The variety and quality of food is excellent. A place to visit again. The only thing that saddened us a little was seeing some of the gardening and pool area teams dressed in uniforms with sleeves and long pants, in black or dark blue, in the strong heat of Cancun and sweating profusely. It was sad to see them.

reviews.author: Dalía C
reviews.text: The hotel is 10/10, the service is very good, everyone is very friendly, the food is very delicious, it is not the typical hotel food without flavor, everything is very tasty, the beds are spectacular (the only thing I think is that the rooms need a change because the hotel, the restaurants are super good and the rooms are already a little old) just my opinion but from then on it's always clean, they always give you snacks, the truth is I loved the hotel if I would stay again and the beach can't be said to be beautiful It's a giant pool!!!

reviews.author: Aman
reviews.title: It’s a paradise. Beautiful resort, delicious food and nice people. Rooms need upgrades though
reviews.text:
Great resort and very friendly people. We initially had a very bad experience due to issues with rooms, not getting hot water however few great people at resort with their great customer service, care and love changed what could’ve been a 1 star review to this 5 star review.

Valentin ( Ginger Bar) was super star of our stay. We talked about different cocktail ingredients, shared our mutual love for cocktails.
He deserves a standing ovation! His mixology skills are off the charts, and he create the most tantalizing cocktails that leave your taste buds dancing with joy. Not only that, but his friendly and attentive service adds an extra sparkle to the whole experience. Whether you're in the mood for a classic cocktail or a creative concoction, he has got you covered. Salud to this amazing bartender! 🍹👏

Rosanna(Guest Services Manager) and Isis

This guest services team is outstanding! They go above and beyond to ensure a memorable and enjoyable experience for every guest. Their attention to detail and friendly demeanor make them a true asset to the team. A big thumbs up! 👍👏

Luis at Sante Bar - My compadre! Hope you remember the Margarita song!
This pool bar bartender is absolutely fantastic! He whip up the most refreshing drinks that are perfect for lounging by the pool. His friendly and attentive service adds an extra splash of enjoyment to the whole experience. Cheers to this awesome bartender! 🍹🌊

Staff at Ginger 1 and 2 Bar ( Gaby, Salvador, Dania, Luis)

Melvin at Cielo ( Best Authentic Mexican Restaurant at resort )

Melvin is incredible! He provides an exceptional service with a smile and makes dining a delightful experience. Kudos to this amazing guy! 👏😊

Feedback on Rooms-
We initially had room with lagoon view in Pyramid 1( room was bit dated, view was not too great, had issue with shower water pressure which they fixed in couple hours).

Then we paid to upgrade to ocean view, and it was totally worth it. Beautiful view of the Caribbean sea. Room was in Pyramid 3. It was newly renovated. We had issues with hot water then. They tried to fix it 2-3 times coming to our room for couple days but were unable to. We were offered to move to other rooms however view wasn’t too great hence we decided to roll with taking the cold showers. Hope you guys can get this issue fixed. Would love to come back soon here!

reviews.author: Antonio O
reviews.title: The best vacation experience.
reviews.text:
Excellent service and great hotel with the best facilities and amenities for everyone.
The theme restaurants are delicious, especially the Lemon Fish with Peruvian Japanese food. Excellent service from Daniel.
At the pool, drinks and food were always within reach, thanks to Didier who took excellent care of us.
The activities by the pool were also very complete, for the children, a pottery workshop and painting of Mexican toys and making a piñata with Ivana, my children really liked it.
For the adults, the alebrijes painting workshop was also great.
Widely recommended. We hope to visit you again soon.

reviews.author: Mr10701
reviews.title: Cancun/Isla Mujeres/Tulum
reviews.text: Stayed here several times. Beautiful resort. The staff, so hard working. All inclusive. Ocean view. People feel because it’s all inclusive they do not have to tip, wrong. Please tip. They work so hard. A dollar goes a long way. Long live Mexico. Visit Tulum/playa de Carmen (2 hrs away). Isla Mujeres (In Cancun Zone). Rent a golf cart. Do a little research. Any questions please hit me up….

reviews.author: Sandra B
reviews.title: Vacation at the Paradisus in Cancun Mexico
reviews.text: My husband and I spent five days at the Club Melia Paradisus Cancun. Our last night we had dinner at Cappella. Service was great and food was delicious. We would to give a special thanks to Emilio who prepared a delicious lasagna and a special thanks to waiter Lucas for such great service and Manager Carlos Chay for his kind hospitality. I would like to thank Max in guest services and Ritchie who was also one our servers in the restaurant. He was great! We look forward to our next trip to Paradisus in Cancun.

reviews.author: Howard B
reviews.title: Date night at Cappella
reviews.text: My husband and I spent five days at the Paradisus in Cancun Mexico and we had the best time. We ended our stay with dinner at the Cappella. This was the most pleasant experience  and the service was great!  We would like to give a huge thanks to Chef Emilio for his delicious lasagna dish. It was the best! He prepared it especially for us,  at my husbands request.  I would also like to thank our waiter Lucas for such kind hospitality,  and Manager Carlos Chay. They're  a great team. If you ever visit Club Melia Paradisus in Cancun, you must dine at Restaurant Cappella!

reviews.author: Carla C
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation!
reviews.text: Alejandro, Ramiro, and Alfredo are Amazing! We spent 6 days at this beautiful resort Paradisus Cancun and they made us feel like family. After one day of taking care of us for breakfast at the Malva restaurant, they knew our favorite drinks and special requests. We will come back to this resort for the gorgeous beach and personalized service.

reviews.author: Matthew M
reviews.title: Amazing. Hotel staff is great. Everyone so friendly. Every staff member said hi. Only thing I can say is it’s hot inside
reviews.text: Everything was amazing on our stay. Ricardo Canto & Anabel Gonzalez were pleasing and great. Their hospitality is amazing. Fernanda Ortega is wonderful. She has been extremely helpful. They all deserve raises and gratitude.

reviews.author: Oleksandra M

reviews.text: We are so so happy!!! Thank you very much!!! Atilano ,Ignacio  are so amazing waiters, they are quick and work very effectively. Also big thanks to Fernanda, she is so sweet!  Resort is very pretty, we got big pleasure to stay at Paradisus!!! Beach so beautiful, all restaurants are very nice, shows were amazing,

reviews.author: Alicia J
reviews.title: Good service
reviews.text: Excellent service, attention and treatment from the collaborator, he served us adequately. He attended to us adequately and the preparation was very good. We leave with a very good impression of the service provided by Carlos.

reviews.author: Bety F
reviews.title: From mega more
reviews.text:
Excellent view, the beach is beautiful, it is very large and clean; The food is delicious in any of their restaurants.
The service is mega plus and all the waiters and staff are very friendly. We've had an incredible time.

reviews.author: Sara F
reviews.title: The best of paradise
reviews.text:
Everything was excellent, the food was delicious, the service was another level, at Lemon Fiji Daniel Dainzu read our minds, I totally recommend, you won't regret it.
And the view is one of the best in Cancun, you will not find it except in the hotel zone

reviews.author: elkinmunoz123
reviews.title: SERVICE WITH THE SOUL
reviews.text: Spectacular place to rest, excellent service, delicious food and plenty of gastronomic variety, service with soul and a perfect location. I have no complaints, on the contrary I found everything very nice and I would return without thinking about it.

reviews.author: Gerardo P
reviews.title: Excellent place to go with the family!
reviews.text: Excellent experience, unbeatable attention, everyone very friendly. Our concierge Diego helped us with everything we needed, was attentive at all times and surprised us with several gifts. 10/10

reviews.author: Maria V
reviews.title: Nice experience
reviews.text: It was our first time in Cancun and we had a great time, everyone is very friendly at the hotel, the food was delicious, the facilities were luxurious. Our concierge Diego Torres made our vacation even better, he was attentive at all times. Definitely if we return to Cancun we will stay here again.

reviews.author: Lander Leandro K
reviews.title: Excellent recommendations
reviews.text: I liked the waiter Daniel Dainzu from the Lemon restaurant that he offered us options to consume taking into account that he had allergies, in addition to always trying to be attentive and careful with the foods he offered us.

reviews.author: Daniel R
reviews.title: Phenomenal vacation
reviews.text: It is always a pleasure to return again and again to Paradisus, as always the best vacation with my entire family, the food, the atmosphere, but above all the attention, they made us feel at home, and especially many thanks to Alberto lineares, Liliana Garcia and Guillermo your attention at the incredible Malva restaurant

reviews.author: Maretza I
reviews.title: EXCELLENT SERVICE
reviews.text:
Excellent service, the shower is missing longer curtains, water drains onto the floor, the entire service is luxurious, food, staff, rooms, the pool and access to the exceptional beach.

The luxury restaurants as well as the availability for any concern

reviews.author: Jill M
reviews.title: Great Resort to Unplug and Relax!
reviews.text:
We love the Paradissus Cancun Resort and have been vacationing at this resort for over 25 years.
Most of our time each day is relaxing by the pool! 
The pool staff is great and especially Asuncion and Laura!  Both ladies are awesome and so attentive and friendly.  They make sure we have everything we need and/or want and make us feel extra special!  
We are already looking forward to our next trip in 2024!

reviews.author: cbkruppa
reviews.title: Great resort, outstanding service
reviews.text: We highly recommend Paradisus Cancun! We’ve been visiting the resort for 20 years and we hope to visit for 20 more. Our favorite poolside servers are Asunción, Laura, & Leticia. Ignacio is also a fantastic waiter in restaurant Sal. You can’t go wrong at Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: SouthsideWes
reviews.title: Paradisus rocks!
reviews.text: Everything we wanted was perfectly delivered on! We had a blast and felt especially cared for by the staff. I would recommend this resort to anyone and everyone! The food, the location, the staff, and everything in between!

reviews.author: Azra S
reviews.title: Rafael from Lemon Fish
reviews.text: The food at Lemon Fish was delicious! Our waiter Rafael was wonderful, very helpful and gave great recommendations. Most all-inclusive locations that serve Sushi isn't always the best, however this restaurant blew it out of the water! If we had this restaurant in Toronto, im positive it would do extremely well. Rafael gave us great reccomendation on drinks too. Thank you Rafael for a wonderful experience!

reviews.author: Farhan
reviews.title: Rafael from Lemon Fish is amazing!!
reviews.text: Went to Lemon Fish on our first night here. We had the privilege of Rafael being our server. Everything was phenomenal! Food was excellent. Rafael went above and beyond - made us special drinks and even offered to take photos to capture our dinner. Highly recommend visiting. Ask for Rafael!

reviews.author: Edgar R
reviews.title: Is this the hotel I'm looking for?
reviews.text:
It offers you a unique experience, with its beautiful facilities and a total green area.

The rooms are spacious with very cold climates and the bed is comfortable, the only thing left to do is the very soft pillows that deform.

Regarding the restaurants in general, the food is delicious, the attention of the staff, both the facilities and the restaurant, are exceptionally attentive. One of my favorite restaurants is Lemon Fish, served by the waiter Jorge and the chefs Karen and Mario, every dish is delicious.

In Summary Paradisus by Melia is the ideal place to relax and enjoy an all-inclusive.

reviews.author: Nina T
reviews.title: lemon fish
reviews.text: The place is totally cozy and comfortable, the sound of the water and contact with nature give it a relaxing touch, the attention of all the staff is excellent and especially our waiter Jorge who was very attentive and gave us the best recommendations, I take All our tastes were taken into account to give us a super personalized experience, the food was exquisite and especially the rolls, the chefs Karen and Mario excelled, what a spectacular dinner they gave us.

reviews.author: pharmerxtian
reviews.title: Good stay made better. Awesome staff.
reviews.text:
Ran into Carlos V, he was super helpful. Made us some great lattes and also recommended a cheesecake at the Nespresso stand. 

Valeria in guest services helped me when there were issues with my chase luxury hotel collection . Chase dropped the ball and Valeria and her team helped remedy the situation.  Fantastic service from the staff and hotel. 

Had some wonderful massages in the Yhi spa.

reviews.author: angydo30
reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.text: In recent days we went to celebrate my birthday and really everything was wonderful, we all had a lot of fun, the service in general is quality, it is worth what you pay because everything is of great quality, the food in exquisite seawater

reviews.author: Juan Pablo H
reviews.title: lemon fish
reviews.text: Excellent service from Jorge, our waiter tonight made sure that we tried the most delicious dishes on the menu, the delicious food, the super pleasant atmosphere make you feel like someone unique on every occasion.

reviews.author: Ana B
reviews.title: lemon fish
reviews.text:
Very pleasant experience, delicious food and excellent service from Joerge.
The view of the place also adds a plus to the experience.

For drinks I recommend the coco paradius

I would definitely return to the place.

reviews.author: Niharika E
reviews.title: Best service and food
reviews.text: Lemon fish - Amazing service, very impressed with ambience, cleanliness, our waiter Jorge was very friendly and he made sure to customize our vegetarian options, chef Karen y Mario made the best food for us. Must try.

reviews.author: Mike T
reviews.title: Lemon Fish is the place to go!
reviews.text: We went to the Lemon Fish restaurant. Jorge was our waiter and he provided some excellent recommendations. Everything was amazing! We somehow made it to desert and again everything was fantastic. Frangelico is excellent with any desert. Thank you to the chefs Mario and Karen for making our meal memorable.

reviews.author: Luis Fernando R
reviews.title: Rafael from Lemon fish
reviews.text: The food is very delicious and everything is very fresh. Very nice decoration. Especially sushi and ramen are my favorites. And Rafael's service was always very attentive and friendly, apart from recommending what to order. 😊

reviews.author: Adam M
reviews.title: Amazing spot
reviews.text: Amazing food. Service was fantastic. The sushi is really good. Lots of variety, but everything was great. Jorge especially was one of the best waiters we’ve ever had. Definitely would come here again.

reviews.author: Julian G
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Jorge was an amazing waiter! He was very polite and tentative, making sure we had the best service possible. Everything he recommended was a 10/10 every time. The food, my Lord was it amazing kudos to the chefs Karen and Mario. Thank you for the experience!

reviews.author: Nidia D
reviews.title: Rafael from Lemon Fish
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our food 🥘 everything that we tried was really delicious, our server Rafael was so friendly and helpful helping us to decide, I don’t eat seafood and they bring me the chicken and beef, I really recommend this restaurant

not impressed with their rooms -rooms need a little more upgrade.

reviews.author: Paul Anthony F
reviews.title: Amazing, romantic getaway.
reviews.text: The employees are extraordinarily kind and excellent which has really made the trip special. The grounds and decor are beautiful. Great pool. Husband and I took advantage of the workout center and spa. I felt like the massage was well worth the money with the amenities that came with the spa.

reviews.author: David T
reviews.title: Raphael from Lemon Fish restaurant Rocks!
reviews.text: Raphael Rocks.  The restaurant Lemon Fish was good, but the service was over the top. Rafael was friendly, helpful, gave great suggestions, and excellent service. Other restaurants were also very good. Saul, the steakhouse was great. Excellent all inclusive resort.

reviews.author: Pastor Paul
reviews.title: Delicious time at Lemon Fish! Amazing food. Exceptional service!
reviews.text: Our server, Jorge, provided a unique dining experience. He got to know our preferences, and build drink and main dish selections accordingly. He went above and beyond to accommodate dietary restrictions. So enjoyed this meal!! Will definitely want to return to Lemon Fish!

reviews.author: Trip12529762720

reviews.text: Carlos at the coffee bar when you come from the beach will always meet you with a big smile  and generous service. He clearly loves people and his job which can be hard to find. Definitely recommend finding him and enjoying some brew.

reviews.author: Nicholas H
reviews.title: We’ll definitely come back!
reviews.text: Loved our stay! Absolutely beautiful resort, quick access to gorgeous beach and amazing pools. There is so much to do, but it’s not shoved in your face like other places. Amazing excursion experience, and great staff!

reviews.author: Emily H
reviews.title: Amazing Experience

He brought us a taste of everything on the menu to try. The chefs, Karen and Mario made excellent dishes that made my birthday dinner very special. We want to come back!

reviews.author: Cody C

reviews.author: Dwight B

reviews.text: Great service all around. Richer and Ramiro did an incredible job serving in the buffet area. Clean, fun and accessible for everyone. Highly recommend. Beaches and optional activities are always available. Amazing experience.

reviews.author: Jasmine G
reviews.title: Wonderful time
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay and everyone was so friendly. All of the restaurants had delicious food and great service. The pool was fantastic with access to all the food and drinks we could ask for. The beach was beautiful with clear blue water. So glad we got to spend a few days here!

reviews.author: Jen A
reviews.title: Jorge is the best!
reviews.text: Jorge was our server at Lemon Fish and went above and beyond to make our experience so memorable! We were at dinner for nearly three hours and he brought us special plates and gave us tips on what to order. The tuna tacos were incredible, and every sushi roll we tried was delicious. We also had all of the desserts - our favorites were the spiced pineapple and the chocolate cake. 1000% recommend, and if you can get Jorge as your server your experience will be that much better. We ate here twice on our 3-night stay. Get there right when it opens at 6, as it gets busy!

reviews.author: Justin G
reviews.title: Rafael crushed it!!!!
reviews.text: Rafael is tremendous! Totally took care of us.  he anticipated our needs and got us all of the food at the right times. outstanding service. highly recommend the drinks never got empty with this guy. So good!

reviews.author: Laura M
reviews.title: Great Service
reviews.text: Rafael at Lemon-Fish was a top notch server! Excellent food and attentive server. Met all our needs and requests. Superb. Every time I turned around there he was, as if by magic, ready to serve, easily the best waiter I have ever had.

Rooms of 10.

reviews.text: The place, landscape, food and the human warmth of its people are too beautiful and Mr. Guillermo in charge of the buffet at the Paradisus hotel is the example of service and love for what is done. My daughters, husband and mother came more than grateful. Marcela Henao. Colombia

reviews.text: Everything was very good and the employees treated us very well and were very friendly. In fact, our five-day stay was very pleasant. There are no complaints from us, nor from any of my family.

reviews.author: 875rober

reviews.text: Excellent stay, quality food, very clean beach, details for my children in the room who were therefore very happy and the kindness of the excellent staff I would return without problem to Paradisus

reviews.author: Roving22075368233
reviews.title: A great resort.
reviews.text: A great resort. Good food and excellent service.  Beautiful beaches.  Highly recommend.  Would be a bargain even at a higher cost.  An affordable yet luxurious getaway.  When combined with an easy flight from the U.S. Paradisus Cancún is a no-brainer for a good vacation.

reviews.author: Amanda D
reviews.title: Dinner at Agua Marina
reviews.text: Kristel Brec was an excellent server and the food was delicious. We ordered appetizers, entrees and cocktails. The atmosphere was cozy and tropical and not very crowded. Beach view tables were an option too.

In general good BUT is an old hotel, the AC not works good, a loooooot of good things with “extra charge”

reviews.author: Suzanne V
reviews.title: Excellent vacation with friends, good food and unbeatable service
reviews.text: This is the 4th time we have stayed at Paradidus Cancun. There were some changes this time but the experience was incredible as always. The food at this all-inclusive resort is fantastic and that is one of the reasons why our group of 5 couples has decided to return over the years. The other thing that attracts us is the friendliness and quality of the people who work there. Every morning we were welcomed at the restaurant by Malva, Candelario, Rafael, Ramiro and Teresa for breakfast and the service was impeccable, they were attentive to all the details. We had lunch at that restaurant one day and Atilano was very friendly too. This restaurant is a buffet and is very good and varied, for all tastes. At the resort they have a Nespresso coffee, in the mornings and mid-afternoon we drink coffee there, Ivonn, Alejandro (who also works at Malva) and Carlos are super friendly. In the pool area, Laura was always making sure we didn't miss anything, super hard-working and efficient as in the other years we had gone. Luis at the pool bar, super funny and efficient. Almost every day we had lunch at the Agua Marina restaurant, which has a variety of meals with excellent fish and seafood, the view was unbeatable, and there Kristel and Alex did their best to ensure that everything was to our liking. The dinner options are varied and all excellent, one of the ones we liked the most was Cielo, we had dinner there twice. Very good Mexican food, personalized service, Chef David came by both days to see if it was to our liking, he gave us information on some typical dishes and in the company of José they made our evenings super pleasant. To close our days we went to see the shows and ended up at the ginger bar where we had different themes every day, neon night, the 80s, Secret Society and others. There Dania, Gaby and Valentín always attended us with a smile. Light in the reception area, super cool and he remembered us from other years. Every afternoon we played volleyball. We had a great time again. We are already planning our return in 2024.

reviews.author: Laura P
reviews.title: The best dining experience we've had anywhere!
reviews.text:
We've only been at Paradisus for a day, (and are loving it) but I had to write a review about the Mexican restaurant Cielo inside the resort, because it's spectacular. We've been all over Europe, and had cuisine everywhere from Prague to Paris to Lisbon, and the meal we had at Cielo blew them all away. 
Everything was prepared perfectly; flavors were flawlessly balanced, beautifully presented, and the quality of the dishes was perfect. I asked our excellent server Moises pass our compliments to the chef because we were so impressed -- and Chef David took the time to come out and speak with us before we left. 
Our server Moises was exceptional, and made our experience amazing. He was so warm and attentive, explaining each dish and answering all our questions expertly. It was clear that he really cared about ensuring that we had an amazing evening. 
It's worth coming to Paradisus just for Cielo-- thank you, Cielo crew, for giving us such an amazing dinner experience!

reviews.author: Emil D
reviews.title: About Sal restaurant
reviews.text: The experience at the Sal restaurant in Mexico, Cancun, was very rewarding; The service, especially from Juan Reynoso, was impeccable. The quantities are satisfactory, and the quality of the food far exceeds expectations. Don't stop visiting them.

reviews.author: Luis N
reviews.title: Excellent service from the Sal restaurant in PARADISUS Cancún from the waiters, especially Juan, very good food
reviews.text: Juan excellent service at the Sal restaurant, and Chef Arturo's food exceeded expectations, one of the best meat restaurants, very pleased with the stay and the service in general, it is worth it.

reviews.author: Lissette Nunez
reviews.title: Dinner in Salt
reviews.text:
Excellent service from Juan at the Sal restaurant.

Very good attention from the waiter. He made us feel at home. Excellent food, premium cuts of meat. Spectacular desserts.
 
Chef Arturo, excellent job.

reviews.author: monicopas82
reviews.title: The conference in paradise
reviews.text: We went for the engineering conference and what an incredible hotel. From the moment I arrived, we were warmly welcomed by the staff. The restaurant team shined with their excellence, providing us with delicious options. The dedication they put into it really shows. Also thank the manager for his kindness and attention upon our arrival. Very good vibes and willingness to make sure our stay was perfect was exceptional.

reviews.author: RAFAEL R
reviews.title: First class hotel.
reviews.text: Excellent Hotel and Wonderful Staff. Nury, the night shift maid in the Reserve area of the Hotel, stood out for her friendliness and good service. Very kind and cooperative. Enjoy our stay at the Hotel and its nature with the Flora. The waiters at the Reserve pool, Oscar, Faby and Miguel, did their best to make our stay unforgettable.

reviews.author: Monica E
reviews.title: Amazing week at Melia Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
We spent a wonderful week with friends at Melia Paradisus Cancun! 

First, the only negative:  some of the rooms still need to be updated/remodeled. 

The positive:  
BEACH- We were lucky there was very little sargassum this year, but it still was cleaned out daily, so the beach was pristine, with the added bonus that we got to see many many baby turtles hatching!  The service at the beach was always great, we really couldn't ask for more.

FOOD - This is by far, the BEST all inclusive hotel I've ever been food wise.  And we tried all the restaurants!
-  The CAFE:  Was our first stop every morning, where Ivonn, Alejandro and Carlos were always friendly, helpful and very quick with the coffee, very little waiting.
-  The MALVA: for breakfast and a couple of dinners, has a great buffet.  Most amazing was the service provided by Rafael, Candelario and Teresa, Ramiro and Alejandro every morning.  They were always so kind and helpful.  Scarlet at the omelette station, was really kind too.  During lunch we were served by Atilano, who also provided excellent service.
-  AGUA MARINA:  We had lunch here almost every day.  We recommend "La queca", "Pulpo zarandeado", "tacos de Camaron" especially, but we didn't eat anything we didn't like.  Thank you to Kristel and Alex who were amazing with our group's needs.
-  CIELO Mexican restaurant, was another stand out.  We had to have dinner here twice because it was too good.  Chef David, was so gracious and kind, and Jose was our wonderful waiter.  You must try the "tacos de lechon", but honestly one visit is not enough to try all the excellent dishes Chef David and his team prepare.
- CAPELLA and TAQUERIA BLUE AGAVE were also delicious and we just wish we had more time to visit them more than once!

POOL -   it was pretty clean and the water never too cold.  The pool bar was great, I'm sorry we can't remember the name of the bar tenders.  Laura was our amazing server at the pool, always efficient and kind.

GINGER BAR -  We went every night for drinks and dancing. Dania, Gaby and Valentin were amazing as well. 

ENTERTAINMENT -  Santi and Monte helped us organize volleyball at the beach, as well as other activities.  Each night there was a special "theme" or activity to look forward as well.  We had a lot of fun.
RECEPTION - Easy check in process, Luz was very kind and helpful at our arrival.

We had a wonderful experience, made possible in great part by the wonderful employees at this hotel has.  Can't wait to be back!

reviews.title: Fall Break @ Paradisus with amazing friends!!  We are Atlanta United
reviews.text:

reviews.author: Mauricio Del Toro

I just really like this place.

reviews.author: Fearless48468
reviews.title: Great holiday
reviews.text: The hotel was a low capacity however this was excellent for us . In the g bar Gaby , Dampa and Valentin were always great with the drinks and the welcome . We stopped in the reserve section which was fab in relation to the Balinese beds which were available on all days and we sorted by the hostess who was brilliant

reviews.author: ShyGurl888
reviews.title: Beautiful well kept resort, great wait staff, rooms are outdated
reviews.text: It’s a gorgeous resort, the staff is always cleaning and maintaining the main areas. The waiters at all the restaurants and beach are very nice. Please make sure to tip them. Everyone on here raves about Lemonfish. We didn’t find it that great, average at best. Loved Capella, Ciello and Agua Marina though. Rooms are ok. Standard room: nothing to write home about. We stayed on the 1st floor and it smelled musty. There were cockroaches in the room but chalked it to being a tropical destination. Made sure to zip up our luggage and shake it out when we got home. I had to call the Operator twice to get a hair dryer and called them again on a separate night to get toilet paper, which they did not bring to the room. So, don’t expect great service when you call the operator if you need anything.

reviews.author: Nishit T
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text:
Love it. Great food. Best Service. Definitely recommend it. 

Jorge ,Miguel, Emanuel from lemon fish made our family dinner really nice. Definitely recommend visiting when your are here. 

Chef Mario and Karen made delicious food.

reviews.author: Joan G
reviews.title: Best Experience and Service!
reviews.text: Gaudencio, Joni and Manuel are the BEST. Look for them and they will take care of you. We will look for them when we come back. Funny, entertaining, and service that is fully accommodating. Thank you for the great experience.

reviews.author: Dave C
reviews.title: Great service from the buffet crew and Ginger Bar.
reviews.text: Excellent service from Gaudencio, Noni and Manuel at the buffet. Gabi at The Ginger Bar was excelente as well. Muchas Gracias!!!!  They took great care of us. Me and our friends had a great time during our stay.

reviews.author: Jobel C
reviews.title: Excellent dining and drink serviceservice
reviews.text: Guadencio, Joni and Manuel from the buffet service did an excellent job! Very accommodating, helpful and excellent customer service. They have been assisting us since our first dining. Gabi from Ginger bar was an excellent bartender. She was very helpful and made us feel very special and made our vacation worthwhile.

reviews.author: talup30
reviews.title: Beautiful with amazing service
reviews.text:
The service is 5 stars!!! We stayed in The Reserve side.  Manuel was an awesome bartender.  The pool cabana service with Ruben and Moses 100% amazing.  We always had a drink. 
Levi our concierge was very nice and helpful.  Jenny was the girl who helped get our cabana everyday.  They were all amazing, nice, and treated us so well.
The resort is huge and took a day or two to figure out where our room was. The food wasn’t very good at all.  Breakfast was good, lunch was okay, and dinners were not good at all.

reviews.author: isaiah w
reviews.title: An amazing time
reviews.text:
Everything here was amazing. From the amenities to the service. I had access to a private beach and a lovely private pool side experience.  When I say I always received service with a smile I’m not joking. Everyone one was very helpful and made sure I was as comfortable as possible wherever I went. 

The Spa on sight was top notch. Liliana gave me one of the best pedicures I have had all year. David the director was also great with helping me set up my appointments and gave me some great tips to rehydrate after several heavy nights drinking. 

The tequila was always flowing, the drinks I got back home did not stand a chance compared to what I received here. The bartenders are wizards, everything was delicious.

I know a lot of people say the food at all inclusive resorts is bad but every meal I had here was great. From the buffet style to the restaurants that I visited, they really took pride in everything that was prepared. I’m sure I picked up a couple pounds.

I would also like to really thank Atilano, Edie, Manuel, Reynaldo, Gerardo, and Diego for offering a top notch experience.

I can truly say that I will be back soon.

reviews.author: Tony
reviews.title: First Time visiting this Hotel
reviews.text: Being out first time to this hotel we didn’t know what to expect. I don’t have any complains at all. Food, service, location, amenities everything was good . Breakfast always good, restaurant lemon fish was amazing and Italian as well. Try them all.

reviews.author: Lizbeth C
reviews.title: Lemon Fish Restaurant
reviews.text: Omg I loved this place. The food was totally amazing its sharing type of seafood. We had their sushi, kabobs type of food we had the beef and the salmon, their green ceviche was sooo bomb!! Our waiter Rafael was wonderful he was so helpful with giving us his honest opinion of what food to order, great sense of humor just over all amazing person. I went to paradisus for my birthday and they were all wonderful I completely loved it!!!

reviews.author: Lobat O
reviews.title: Rafael at Lemon Fish & Noel C'elo
reviews.text: Great friendly & accommodating servers! Yummy food from Chef Ventura & beautiful views! Looking forward to our next visit here Paradisus Cancun!  All inclusive & lots to eat, drink, & do. Turquoise waters surround you...

reviews.author: Haseeb S
reviews.title:
Rafael lemon fish
Noel ceilo
reviews.text: Very good service. Ocean view. Vary fast service. The food is amazing. Very good salmon curry. Very friendly service. Good food. Nice view. Very organized. Nice place to eat. Rafael and Noel did very good service.

reviews.author: Dave
reviews.title: Exceptional hotel and staff
reviews.text:
Paradisus was everything we wished for! The hotel and location was amazing. The service from all staff was exceptional and we really appreciated the service from Didier (waiter around the pool), Juan (the pool barman), Cesar (Lemonfish) and the Malva Restaurant team (Fernando,Alberto,Manuel Mtz,Janeth, Alex and Arturo). 

The service from our assigned concierge, Michelle, was perfect! She went above and beyond for everything and made our trip very relaxed.

We will definitely be returning again!

reviews.author: alexandracV1048BM
reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text: Everything was great. We enjoyed every single minute. The staff is very attentive always ready to help. Our experience was made even more special by Didier (Didi) who was waiting for us with our drinks before we even asked for them! :) We will definitely come back one day

reviews.author: Lisa G
reviews.title: Beautiful and relaxing
reviews.text:
This resort is beautiful, clean and big!  We were here for a week and it was one of the best vacations we've had.  There are plenty of restaurants to choose from. The food is better in some than others.  I really enjoyed the large breakfast buffet they had.  

The staff were all very friendly and helpful.  We are members of the vacation club, and our concierge, Liz was awesome!  She made sure we had everything we needed and made our dinner reservations every night for us.  

The room was very clean and the bed comfortable.  The fridge was always stocked with whatever we needed.  Very helpful staff.

The spa in the hotel is GREAT!  You can sit in the dry sauna, steam room, then get in a very large pool with lots of jets (like a super big jacuzzi) before your massage.  We had a 75 minute massage, and our massage therapists were the BEST!  Leonor & Frida did an excellent job.  We love deep tissue massages and they did just that.  So good!  We loved it so much we went THREE times during our stay!

The pool area is large with plenty of lounging area.  Our waitress, Ada was great.  Friendly, and continually checking to see if we needed anything.

I have no complaints about this resort, the staff or anything.  We loved it and will definitely be back.  Thank you to the staff at Melia Paradisus Cancun for such a lovely vacation.

reviews.author: seneca j
reviews.title: Lemon fish
reviews.text: Had the best waiter named Rafael!!! He was so nice and generous!! 10/10 experience. Food was good as were the drinks. Favorite was the sushi and the chicken sandwich. Lovely wine selection.. Thank you for everything!!

reviews.author: Gmoney222
reviews.title: Amazing service!!!!
reviews.text: Cappella Cucina was excellent and delicious. Our waiter Jesus was amazing. Would definitely recommend making reservations for this restaurant. Beautiful atmosphere and again excellent service. Don’t hesitate to eat here very good.

reviews.author: frank a
reviews.title: 5th time and keeps getting better
reviews.text: Visited Paradisus from Oct 23-29. This was our 5th visit to this property (stayed in the Reserve all 5 times) and there have been many renovations and upgrades since our last visit in May 2021.
