From the moment we walked in, they treated us like family and many remembered our names. Pool staff, pool waiters and restaurant staff were all very attentive. A special shout out to Aaron our butler (5223),  Hugo, restaurants manager, Emanuel, Lemon Fish manager, Jennifer and Nicole, pool staff and Oscar, Cesar, Rueben and Yamil, pool waiters. All were exemplary!!! Our 6th visit can’t come soon enough!!

reviews.author: Alyson S
reviews.title: Lemon fish
reviews.text:
Ate at this restaurant with my family today and the service/food was phenomenal! 
Chef Mario and the manager Emanuel got us a nice private table for our party and the servers Cesar and Rafael were just perfect! The service and food were just chefs kiss! They all took care of our party so well!

reviews.author: Zachary Michaël T
reviews.title: Ok resort with some good restaurants
reviews.text:
Some great restaurants, the Limon Fish, a Japanese restaurant is very good. Great service from Jorge and good food by Miguel. Thanks for the evening.
The hotel rooms though is a bit outdated and the bar are closing way too soon! Nothing to do after midnight, no bar, no restaurant, no shows.
The beach is very beautiful but very small.

reviews.author: MansiP
reviews.title: Memorable trip!!
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun was honestly such a dream! The resort itself was gorgeous, inside out. The surrounding property area is beautiful! The service was impeccable. Every member was so happy, kind, attentive, interactive, assistive, and just a pleasure to greet and talk to. We only have positive feedback for  the staff from every department we encountered - cleaning, reception/check in, food areas, bar areas, etc. The resort had daily activities in the day and evening times which were entertaining and very inclusive of all age groups! It was quite simple to get information and tickets for excursions and things to do nearby on the resort. We are vegetarians so food was an important aspect for us and I would say they had enough variety to accommodate vegetarian needs in select restaurants and buffet. We did not feel unsatisfied ever. Definitely enjoyed the buffet every day. Food there was absolutely delicious! The bars had all the drinks you could ask for! Overall, we are very happy with our visit to Paradisus Cancun and though every individual was a pleasure to speak to, we want to give a special shout-out to the following members we had extensive interactions with:
Axcel, Juan Carlos, Jairo, Gaudencio, Martin, Eddie, Gerarjio, and Diego (Buffet manager and from the front desk)

reviews.author: Palmitos1965
reviews.title: PARADISUS CANCUN, AN UNBEATABLE PARADISE ☀️
reviews.text:
PARADIDUS CANCUN, is a special place surrounded by great service and amazing nature. The best beach you can ever imagine is awaiting for you there. What I love about that All Inclusive hotel is that you can choose your stay based on your own budget. My experience in Reserve was absolutely great, my concierge  assigned Mr. Aaron was able to meet all my needs and expectations in a timely manner! 

We produced two big events this past two weeks with 100% success. 

BANQUET MANAGER, Mr. Jose Vargas was without any doubt one of the most important leaders of our events. His leadership and knowledge was key to manage from room blocking to all the logistics involved in the complicated world of food and beverage.

CHEF Apolinar, was always open to bring creativity and quality to the table, while managing our budget efficiently.

SOMELIER Iran, was always in the perfect location to bring passion and knowledge of the best wine your meal can be accompanied. 

LOGISTIC MANAGER Ricardo, truly understood our needs, offering the best route for our group. 

The overall team of Paradidus is difficult to find in any other hotel of the world! 

Thank you Mr. Mynor, you are a leader that understands how important your people are. Without any doubt, we will repeat 💚

reviews.author: Jawed  A
reviews.title: Malva @ Paradisus Hotel
reviews.text: We were here as a family for a week. The hotel was ok, a little older. We went to Malva for our buffet and were served by Atilano and his team including Alberto, Janeth,  Fernando and Arturo. They were very attentive to our needs and service was prompt and accurate. Best thing is that they remembered us, how we took our tea or coffee and we didn't have to repeat ourselves everyday. Kudos to them. Malva has lots of food option catering to most if not all dietary requirements.

reviews.author: Tatyana A
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text:
We had a good experience in romantic restaurant our server was Rafael 
He was very friendly and very nice guy he was good explains about menu and food was Delicious we will back again for sure Thanks for everything to Rafael!!!

reviews.author: Tazbun
reviews.title: Fabulous Hotel
reviews.text:
We have just come back from a week’s holiday at The Paradisus it was fabulous.
We stayed in The Reserve area  tower 5 we had two rooms they where beautiful such great facilities…..the down side was my 5 year old granddaughter couldn’t go in many areas we had booked one family room something  to be aware of.
The views from the hotel are just fabulous, lots of bed chairs etc to sit on around pool and on beach. We had all inclusive but I think there was other options. Everything was spotless they are Constantly cleaning and  tidying everything the staff are very busy but always seemed happy.
I wanted too mention SANDY in particular she was such a helpful lady,she sorted out a lovely little Teepee tent for my granddaughter, and a few other things really we was grateful as she wasn’t working in the Reserve part of the hotel but helped us anyway.
The pools where spotless as where all of the grounds.
In the week there was a couple of very large Conferences on , so they had a lot of music  which was sooooo loud and  party’s around one of the pools, everyday, was very glad we where not staying in tower 3. 
But all in all a fabulous stay.
The Spa was excellent we all had a couple of treatments not cheep but a real treat. 
All of the staff where really nice friendly and helpful the management should be very proud of their staff

reviews.author: Humza
reviews.title: Amazing concierge service-Celeste
reviews.text: Our stay was tremendously improved by our concierge experience. Celeste went above and beyond every day to ensure our stay was stress free! Definitely would recommend this resort and the concierge service to anyone else who is interested in visiting Cancun!

reviews.author: Jenny W
reviews.title: Lemon Fish Restaurant
reviews.text: Rafael - Outstanding service and made our honeymoon dinner an unforgettable experience. Would highly recommend anyone to visit and recommend Rafael. You will get nothing less than the best service, grace, and the willingness to go above and beyond.

reviews.author: Ericka R
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Rafael was excellent, made us feel very special visiting for our honeymoon. Made us a special desert and took photos for us. Food was great, lemon fish was by far our favorite restaurant at Paradisus.

reviews.author: Philipp S
reviews.title: Great Food at hotel Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
We very much enjoyed all the restaurants and bars of the hotel. Really good food and excellent drinks at the beach and at the pool. 
We wanted to thank especially the breakfast team at MALVA (Armando, Antonio, Ramiro and Alberto) for their excellent service.

reviews.author: SolangeSalguero
reviews.title: Each one of them made me feel this was their own restaurant
reviews.text: I have just come back from a Class - Reunion which this year we held it at this amazing resort.  I have to say I was always so impressed how everyone made us feel.  … it was as if they were the owners!  Attention to detail, sweetness, disposition, and very resolutive ( we were 30 ish people).     They views were increible, but what I take in my heart is the people that made me feel like I was the  most important person to them.  Thank you Malva A.m: armando, antonio, gaudencio, ramiro, arnulfo, alberto!  I miss u already!

reviews.author: Eduardo W
reviews.title: Great place to stay !!
reviews.text: I was very impressed with the location, the quality of the food vs price and the staff is amazing ! Alejandro Camelo at the Blue Fish restaurant is very kind, attentive and Profecional my family loved him.

reviews.author: mario r
reviews.title: 50 bday celebration
reviews.text: Excellent place and better service. Armando Uc. B. At malva Restaurat gave me the best service. He was very helpful and made this a great experience. Meliá is in top of best places to stay in Cancun. I recommend everything about this place.

reviews.author: dolma88
reviews.title: Lemon fish restaurant
reviews.text:
Jorge, Rafael, and Miguel were our servers. 
Antonio was our chef. 
Emanuel the manager greeted us when we walked in and seated us right away. 
Jorge was excellent in service, Miguel ensured our food was correct and made it correct when there was an issue. 
Rafael ensured our drinks were always filled and had excellent suggestions when we had questions. 
Food was amazing as we did omakase style and ordered everything. 
In the one week stay we ate here 3 times. 
Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Henry C
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Best services experiences from wait staff Jorge, Rafael, Niguel, Eminem and Antonio .   Food was delicious and drinks was awesome.  Highly recommend to visit more than once here.  We did and for sure we will be back.

reviews.author: Juanita S
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Excellent service from Rafael, Jorge and Emanuel! Chef Antonio’s food was fantastic and a perfect way to end the night! The menu was incredibly varied and everything tasted wonderful! Would recommend the lomo saltado and chocolate cake for dessert.

reviews.author: Trail33615789328
reviews.title: Paradisus awesome and great service
reviews.text: Restaurant Malva Desayunos had the best service everyday. Janet Fernando Orlando Alberto Rafeal and Candelario were the best everyday we stayed can't wait to come back.  Been here 12 years ago for honeymoon and now coming back to celebrate.

reviews.author: J H
reviews.title: Paradisus Restaurant Malva
reviews.text: I normally don’t write reviews but had to write about my stay at Paradisus. Everyone was extremely accommodating and my stay here was nothing short of amazing. Shout out to Atilano, Pascual, Jennifer and Arturo who made our stay here memorable. We will be back here again!! Thank you to all the staff at Paradisus.

reviews.author: Global00935304682
reviews.title: 5 star lemon fish
reviews.text: Rafael and Manuel are the best you can have would recommend to anyone who visits in future. All the courses were delicious from the sushi rolls, to desert, and drinks i wish i can come back everyday.

reviews.author: Krejjy M
reviews.title: Perfect Birthday getaway at Paradisus!
reviews.text: We had a fantastic 5-day stay at Pradisus Cancun all-inclusive. The place is so grand and awesome, the beach is heavenly, the service is splendid and the peaple are very warm and lovely. Right from Day 1 we knew we’re gonna have an awesome stay. Alberto in the frontdesk is so welcoming and accommodating. So much so that he gave us options to upgrade to The Reseve and gave us an awesome deal when we mentioned that it’s my birthday vacation. And then there’s our personal concierge, Diego Torres, as you get to have one if you’re booked at The Reserve (which I highly recommend you guys!). Diego is awesome! He toured us all over the place and showed us where to go best (to chill) and where to eat (where the food is the best, as there are a number of restaurants included in the reserve list),  and as well on  how to get your way around the hotel as it is sooo big you could easily get lost (and we did lol). He also booked us reservations for restaurants and for the Bali beds by the beach and poolside. And of course he gave me a nice surprise spread in our room on my birthday (on the photo), plus a champagne! Diego is very kind and sweet, truly appreciate him as our personal concierge! Also, we definitely recommend trying the Sal Steak restaurant, the have very good food. We enjoyed all the courses they seved. The other restaurants were not as good, but the buffet is awesome, lots of choices to choose from. Although 1 thing that disappointed me was that they don’t have rice at all even in the buffet. The Asian in me is longing for rice during our 5 days stay there lol. But All in all, we were very happy and satisfied with our stay at Paradisus. We definitely recommend it to others who want to have a relaxing and stress-free vacation.

reviews.author: Brendan H
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancún vacantion
reviews.text: My wife and I came here on our honeymoon and thoroughly enjoyed every moment of it. The staff was very kind and helpful. Service was impeccable and the vibe was unparalleled. We stayed on the reserve side of the resort and Frida was our concierge, she was very attentive and made sure we had every reservation we needed. If you’re a couple looking for a relaxing getaway I definitely recommend the Reserve experience.

reviews.author: LightPacker376631
reviews.title: Paradiso Cancun
reviews.text: Breakfast at the lunch box was magnificent. Gaudencio was amazing! We loved him! Best customer service ever!! Along with his crew Antonio Ivonne and Joni !! They all were amazing! Please when you are visiting resorts in Mexico PLEASE DO Not FORGET TO TIP AND TAKE CARE OF THE STAFF!! I sat and watched soooooo many people get up from great service and not leave a dime!!! So DISAPPOINTED IN HUMAN KIND! Do better people!!!! If you have enough to travel to nice resorts u have enough to take care of the staff !🥰

reviews.author: Koti L
reviews.title: I would recommend Gemma and the entire staff at the spa
reviews.text: Gemma was an excellent therapist! Next time I come back I will definitely rebook with Gemma! The spa was clean up to date! Steam room cold plunge and repeat! With out a doubt much needed when on vacation!

reviews.author: ericamensah
reviews.title: My overall experience was amazing, all the staff are friendly and helpful, they make sure you have a good experience
reviews.text:
Sergio at the pool was phenomenal with the service, I’m daughter and I had an amazing time . Thank you 

All the staff were very friendly, honestly we had a great time. I’m coming back with my friends next year

reviews.author: Adela A
reviews.title: Awesome 👌
reviews.text:
Simply beautiful.  Our experience was awesome. 
Staff was very accommodating, cordial and respectful. Very clean, natural and relaxing environment .  We had a blast during our stay. 
We can't wait to come back for more of the goodness had.

reviews.author: Preston R
reviews.title: Great Experience!
reviews.text: Gaudeucio is hands down the best waiter. We had him every day for our 7 day stay at paradisus. The worse part of leaving the resort is leaving him. It’s very rare you find a genuine waitor. His assistants antionio and ivoun were excellent. Gaudeucio made the trip 10x better and always made the start of our day the best by having him as our waitor.  Definitely going to miss starting our mornings with him. He also went the extra mile and made us a cute sign for our last day. Thank you so much Gaudeucio for making this experience 10x better. -The Roberts

reviews.author: Pete A
reviews.title: First All Inclusive, Adult Resort Stay
reviews.text:
This was my wife and my first All Inclusive, Adult Resort Vacation. We stayed for 7 days/nights. 

Pro's: The resort is absolutely beautiful and right on the beach. 
The Staff were great. Of special mention are Moses, our Pool Waiter who never let our drinks run dry and recommended wonderful pool side lunches! Nicloe and Jennifer our Pool Cabana Managers took really good care of us. Acxel, the Entertainment Coordinator always had really fun events going. 
One night our Concierge put together a memorable Bubble Bath in our room for my wife. The food was really good in all restraunts and Pool Bars.

Cons: When we checked in they put us in a room other than "The Reserve" which is what we paid for and didn't tell us. It wasn't until my Niece saw that her room was much less nice as ours. When she confronted our Concierge about it he got us both better rooms in the Reserve building. Following up, these were the rooms we had paid for and were supposed to be in. Not sure if they over booked or just tried to pull a fast one but it seemed abit shady.
It seemed like even in the Reserve Building the resort was regulating the hot water probably to reduce cost. The Shower, Bath Tub and Sink all had moderate hot water but not enough to use the Bath Tub. When I asked about it, magically it was super hot for two days then back to moderate? 
With the exception of the Bubble Bath, the Concierge Service was terrible! He never checked on us and we always had to contact him for everything. There was even a time toward the end of our stay when he started getting sharp with my wife and I had to have a talk to him. Definately not what I expected for the price we paid! 
The morning of checkout, all services stopped such as the daily coffee service.
All in all it was a very pleasant visit and I would recommend it however make sure you get what you paid for!

reviews.author: Julie J.
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Such wonderful service and great food at Lemon Fish. Alejandro provided great service and went above and beyond to make us feel taken care of. Also, the pineapple dessert was very good. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Viviana P
reviews.title: Best resort ever!
reviews.text: Best time ever! You won't regret it!!! Lemon fish was the best and most fun restaurant! Emmanuel, Alejandro, and libni were awesome! Definitely coming back again! Take their advice on food. They know what they are talking about! This is coming from a Guatemalan princess.

reviews.author: Tran T
reviews.title: Stunning decor, friendly staff, and great food
reviews.text: Definitely have enjoyed our stay here at Paradisus Cancun! Everyone have been so kind and helpful. I recommend upgrading to the Reserve for a more personalized and luxurious experience. Beach front view from our room was a plus. Have to give a shout out to our concierge Freddy (Alfredo). He’s been great! The bed is comfy and clean. The facility is absolutely breathtaking. Love love the jungle like plant interior decor. Food options have been abundant and decent. Having Emmanuel & Miguel y Jorge from lemon fish for dinner was phenomenal. Friendly and attentive! Will definitely recommend and come back to Paradisus.

reviews.author: Sightseer16075900395
reviews.title: Lemonfish restaurant
reviews.text: Rafael, server at the Lemonfish, gave great service and made our anniversary dinner extra special. When he mentioned a bottle of champagne, we thought he was joking, but he brought us a whole bottle. He also recommended perfect entrees and made sure our drinks were always full., Emanuel is the manager of Lemonfish, and Mario the chef made incredible food.

reviews.author: Joshua F
reviews.title: Lemon fish review.
reviews.text: Out of lemon fish, the food was very good, the scenery was awesome. And the service was excellent. This was a great experience, I recommend. The food I like was the beef skewer and the Teriyaki chicken. My personal favorite drink was the strawberry jacquerie.

reviews.author: Frances F
reviews.title: Lemon Fish Resturant
reviews.text: Our server Rafael was very good, he was super nice and had good service. The resturant has good food and had a nice vibe. The dessert, main and drinks are all great!! I love the hotel tooo, it’s a great experience

reviews.author: Lara F
reviews.title: Lemon Fish Restaurant
reviews.text: Rafael the Waiter and Emanuel the Manager and Mario the Chef at Lemon Fish are the best! He made our experience here absolutely fabulous! Rafael is so patient and explained the different culinary experience at Lemon Fish. The food was Excellent, everything we had, Sushi, Bao Steamed Bun, Short Rib and Tuca Tuca were exellent!  Emanuel provided us with free Champagne for our Anniversary!  Thank you Thank you!!!!

reviews.author: Gio B
reviews.title: Axcel and Savannah
reviews.text: Had an amazing time especially with Axcel! Axcel treated us like royalty! My granddaughter who is almost 4 years old fell in love with him. He danced with her, make bracelets with her and treated her like a princess. Amazing job done by Axcel!

reviews.author: juanparamedicpr
reviews.title: Beautiful 5 star!
reviews.text:
This is our second time at the Paradisus and experience was great! 
First customer service is 5 stars and hotel has great security measures. Everyone from the hotel was very polite and friendly. I will start with the inside, it is BEAUTIFUL! We love the contrast and colors inside the main tower that tropical nature look with the plants.
Room was very clean but will definitely benefit from some remodeling, at least the room we had on 3rd tower on 8th floor.
Our concierge Teresa is EXCELLENT! First time we came to this hotel in May of this year she was our concierge and we saved her contact information, and I had already contacted her that this would be our second trip. She was always available to assist us with any questions, recommendations and assist us many times with setting our meals. We even asked her to help us take pictures since it was just my wife and I, she was not in a hurry and walked with us around pool area. Teresa is the best.
   Food wise. Food overall was good and fresh. One of favorite was the Japanese Lemon Fish! Everything we tried was always delicious. Rafael was our waiter and always went above and beyond. You have to try the ceviches shrimp, mix and Peruvian, ask for all 3! And the Japanese Robatayaki, like “beef on stick” that was a bomb on flavors and tender, try the salmon also!
   The Lunch box dinner was 100% better than my initial visit. Waiter Eduardo also went above and beyond with his service we tried Grilled octopus 
Rock shrimp, Baby back , Brisket, Flan all was on point. Don’t forget try tacos in main floor.
I would recommend more live music during whole week for entertainment purposes and also we need live Mariachis at least twice a week since not everyone stays 7 days. 

  The pool was sparkling clean and beach was perfect with no seaweed which we had in May. Tour we did Isla Mujeres which is beautiful I will just take the ferry saves a lot then a tour. Also try the double speed boats across the hotel which it’s super fun and you can snorkel. Take the local bus for 12 pesos= less than $1 dollar and go to the Mercado! Very cheap souvenirs and great local food. Felt very safe but don’t just stay were the bus drops you, the real Mercado is about 2 blocks from the stop. Enjoy the culture, enjoy the food and enjoy Mexicans hospitality. Hasta Pronto Méjico lindo y querido!

reviews.author: Amanda L
reviews.title: Cancun Vacations
reviews.text: I have a great time here in Paradisus with my friends, nice warm weather, amazing staff. Our concierge Frida was very helpful and amazing! She help us a lot with the reservations and information about the resort!!  I definitely will come back soon! Thank you 💜

reviews.author: J B
reviews.title: Paradisus - beautiful resort
reviews.text: We recently stayed at the Paradisus to attend s family wedding nearby. Hotel is lovely snd the amenities are well tended. Large variety of restaurants on site to satisfy most palates. Securing the Reserve option enabled us to access the adult only pool which we enjoyed daily. Ruben was our concierge and was very responsive and attentive. We enjoyed our stay.

reviews.author: Sarah
reviews.title: Fantastic!!!
reviews.text: This is an excellent resort, I’d come back again. We had a group of 14 kids and adults.  The food is excellent, they have plenty of restaurant options, reservations were easy to get but we probably didn’t need them. rooms were comfortable and beautiful, hotel was well maintained and gorgeous, but the staff is what makes it special. I didn’t encounter a single employee who wasn’t incredibly kind and thoughtful. Everyone truly seemed to care that we were having a good time. Even when guests were rude, the staff was unfailingly kind and polite. There were too many to mention but we were travelling with 3 people with a very serious allergy to gluten and the chef at the buffet walked them through each thing they could have and even made them gluten free brownies. Every waiter took pains to make sure nothing had gluten and they nailed it. Nobody got sick. Special thank you to Moises at Cielo, Ada at the pool and guadencio (sp) at breakfast. Questions and requests were answered promptly and kindly…. And often, they anticipated needs before we even asked. I cannot say enough about this resort. How beautiful and clean it is, and how we were treated. The only small, very tiny critique would be the gym could use an upgrade, but, really… I didn’t come for the gym ;).

reviews.author: Amy S
reviews.title: Large family
reviews.text: Moises was the absolute best server. He was so kind, patient, attentive, and incredibly knowledgeable about the menu. Our drinks were never empty and the food was spectacular. He attended to our every need. He deserves 100 stars!!

reviews.author: Brendan H
reviews.title: Lemon Fish, Paradisus
reviews.text: The ambiance of this restaurant is unparalleled. They say you eat with your eyes first, and we were not disappointed. Mario did an amazing job making our dishes look immaculate. Rafael did an even better job at making us feel special on our honeymoon! 10/10 recommend

reviews.author: Alejandro G
reviews.title: Kidsdom
reviews.text: Wow !amazing service by all the people working there. Brenda , Ivonne , Itzel, rubi, Keren , nicy. All super friendly and took care of our two daughters for 5 days while we enjoy the resort. We are truly pleased with their service and kindness. We will definitely come back to this resort and use the kids zone for our daughters entertainment and care. It was a pleasure to enjoy this resort. 100% 👍💪🇲🇽

reviews.author: Umar S
reviews.title: Lemon Fish restaurant
reviews.text: We decided to try out Lemon Fish while staying at Parisus. We order sushi platter. It looked beautiful and tasted great. Rafael provided excellent service. The BBQ skewers were also delicious. Highly recommended!!

reviews.author: MaraKlem
reviews.title: Paradise in Cancun
reviews.text: A wonderful experience all round at this resort. The Reserve is worth it. Violeta our Concierge was excellent and always ready to book us into restaurants, especially as we had a need for quiet tables due to a hearing disability. The staff were all excellent!

reviews.author: Lala P
reviews.title: Excellente Anna Monceda
reviews.text:
Excellente Anna Monceda Massuese. 
Servicio Muy Bien. Very relaxing experience. 
She is very friendly, efficient and knowledgeable. Very much a professional. She is highly recommended. Awesome job Anna!

reviews.author: Darryll W
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Emanuel (I think) the manager was very accommodating considering we had a group with meat eaters and vegetarians. Miguel was the chef/server and everything we ordered was amazing from the skewers, to the civiche, sushi. I don’t think that you can order anything at this restaurant that will not be delicious. Vegetarians in our group were very pleased with what they were able to offer. Easily the best restaurant at the Paradisus resort.

reviews.author: Lauren S
reviews.title: 10 year anniversary trip
reviews.text: Beautiful resort! Everything is a work of art. If you come here you have to go to Lemon Fish and get Miguel and Jorge as your servers. They were very helpful and full of excellent recommendations for dinner and drinks. 10/10!

reviews.author: The G
reviews.title: Wonderful Time! Amazing Service! Great Beach!
reviews.text:
The decor, food, drinks and great beach make this resort a top all inclusive in Cancun! We were celebrating 2 birthdays and I can’t say enough about the Paradisus team! 

Armando and the whole Malva team took care of us every morning for breakfast (8 adults and 4 kids).

Melissa at the Ginger bar rocks! By the second night, she knew our drinks and preferences.

Levi is the most amazing concierge. His attention to detail, carisma, and attentiveness made our time at Paradisus Cancun feel like a WONDERFUL DREAM.

The ladies at the kids club are fantastic! They made our kids feel so comfortable and happy. Our kids were asking to go to the kids club everyday. So many fun activities.

Fernando, asistente of the reserve team, elevated our experience and was always checking on us.

Thank you very mucho Paradisus Cancun!

Carla

reviews.author: Leslie G
reviews.title: Wonderful hospitality
reviews.text: From check in to check out, the staff are lovely. My favorites are massage therapist David at the YHI spa and Gaodencio, Joni, Diego at The Lunchbox. The best!!! The rooms and conference center is beautiful. They keep them stocked with drinks and snacks.

reviews.author: Nicola
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: The service here was incredible. Everyone was so incredibly kind and hospitable. Food was really good and the experience blew my expectations. Thank you Jose at Cielo, Heiner at Lemon Fish bar, Atilano, Pascual and Raul at Malva, Johnathan at Agua Marina- you’re so kind and made our experience so friendly and fun; thank you for helping us practice our Spanish too. Also, befriended the life guard who has been caring for the turtles and we learned so much. Thank you for everything. You made this week really special

reviews.author: cfree94
reviews.title: Incredible time!!!
reviews.text:
We loved this place more than we thought we would! The service was incredible! The amenities were fantastic and the hotel was so clean. Once we found the restaurants we liked we really enjoyed the food and we just had some incredible interactions with the staff. 

We really enjoyed Jonathan at Agua Marina who basically gave us a full Spanish lesson because I said I wanted to practice. And we loved Jose at Cielo who was so kind and personable. Heiner at yellow fish was hilarious and made waiting for our table so much fun. Atilano, Pascual, and Raul at Malva served us almost everyday and we loved them! We especially loved the turtle life guard - we didn’t catch his name but he spent hours talking to us about turtles that nest on the beach. He was absolutely fantastic. 

We would come back for the service alone. It was such a special vacation with family. Thank you!

reviews.author: Andy L
reviews.title: Incredible service, wonderful staff!
reviews.text: Honestly, the staff and service here is was exceptional, in all areas of the experience. In the buffet, Atilano, Pasquale and Raul, in the Yellowfish restaurant, Heiner, and in Cielo our server Jose, all made our trip wonderful! We had the best time.

reviews.author: Alberto I
reviews.title: Alberto Ishida
reviews.text: Amazing experience. Great service at Malva from Atilano, Pascual, and Raul. Loved ever moment. If your looking from a seamless everxperice where you can relax unwine and feel at home this is the place to be.

reviews.author: Lori-Linell H
reviews.title: Relaxing retreat
reviews.text:
The food at dinner especially was not the best. 
The service was often slow.  

However Diego, Joni, and Gaudencio were excellent.

The beach and pools were beautiful. 

My room was fine but the air conditioning was very loud.  

And the last evening I wanted to take dessert to my room but that wasn’t allowed…

reviews.author: Heather L
reviews.title: Bachelorette Party
reviews.text: Alejandro and Emmanuel made sure our party of 5 was taken care of! They were also able to accommodate us earlier than our set reservation. From celebratory shots to champagne, to a surprise dessert and a show at the end of our meal! Food was delicious. Definitely one of my favorite nights here at the resort!

reviews.author: Ashley
reviews.title: This is an absolute must try.
reviews.text: The whole experience was fantastic. Everyone was so accommodating and attentive to our needs and party. I couldn’t recommend it enough. Alejandro , Leon, and Emmanuel were absolutely amazing! I would plan a trip and come again.

reviews.author: Kirk S
reviews.title: First encounter
reviews.text: This was our first experience at the Mexican restaurant at Paradisus. Ian provided excellent service and input on our menu selections to make the experience worthy of the money that we spent to stay at this all-inclusive resort. Great waiter. The food was delicious. Especially the lamb!

reviews.author: Eva E
reviews.title: Paradise in Paradiso Cancún
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful in every aspect. Fantastic pool area, small oases where you can relax and enjoy a meal, a drink or just the beautiful surroundings in the sun. Situated right on the pearl white beach by the Cristal blue Caribbean water it is impossible not to feel like in paradise - especially since we had an angle, Celeste, who assisted us in every possible way and solved any problems if these occurred. We have only positive experiences here. Very clean from pool area to inside building, extremely polite service and luxurious surroundings. Thank you for a perfect holiday Paradiso and Celeste❤️

reviews.author: Norma M
reviews.title: Experience at Malva and
reviews.text:
Very great customer service and food. This is my second time here and I was extremely satisfied with this visit. Will definitely come again. Servers were Ignacio, Janeth, Fernando, Atilano, and Alberto.

Alberto, Alfredo, Angel and Melvin were so fun to be around at the Blue Agave. They kept our drinks filled and brought out a platter of different tacos! Their service is what kept us going back to that restaurant. I can’t thank them enough. Pozole was “para chuparse los dedos” so compliments to the chef! 

I can’t wait to come back. Thank you again for the amazing service from all these individuals! This is by far the best place for my vacations.

reviews.author: Leticia S
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: This restaurant is great! Ignacio, Alberto Veronica, and Angel are great host, and waitress.  The restaurant is clean, full of varieties and great quality food. A must have if you stay here. I will definitely come back.

reviews.author: Trail554401
reviews.title: Great Resort = Great Vacation
reviews.text:
My family and I had a fantastic vacation staying at the Paradisus Cancun.  The hotel was beautiful.  The  grounds were kept immaculate and the staff went out of their way to be welcoming and accommodating.  

I am a beach person and I couldn't have been happier with my choice of resorts.  There was always plenty of space and beach chairs for me and my wife and kids.  There was a lot of seaweed at the time, I cannot blame the hotel for that.  

The buffet was really good.  There was a nice variety of food to choose from.  Keep in mind that the variety doesn't really change from day to day.  But that doesn't take away from the quality you will find at the buffet.  I was VERY pleased with the variety of restaurants available for dinner.  Here you have to make reservations ahead of time, but doing so was easy.  The food and ambiance were excellent and I couldn't have been more pleased.

I want to acknowledge Christian, one of the guest service agents.  Christian did a great job in helping me to retrieve my son's headphones, which he left behind when we checked out to fly home.  Christian not only found the missing headphones, but he helped with the paperwork in order to ship them internationally.  Thank you Christian!!!

I will most definitely stay at the Paradisus the next time I visit Cancun.

reviews.author: traveler mom
reviews.title: Excellent place for nice family vacation.
reviews.text: Nice place, echo friendly ( so if you can’t tolerate humidity think before you going) . Food is good and Violeta from the reserve was very helpful. Beach is beautiful, staff are helpful. Medium size resort so a bit of walking(good for active people)

reviews.author: Destiny N
reviews.title: Absolutely perfect!
reviews.text: We loved everything about Paradisus! All the restaurants were amazing! Specially, Cielo. They did an awesome job for my husband and I celebrating our 2nd wedding anniversary. Moises and Adriana really made our dinner experience something to remember. They spent the time to make it really feel like an anniversary celebration dinner. Thanks to everyone and all the staff! Everyone is so helpful and nice here. Definitely will be coming back!

reviews.author: kdp009
reviews.title: Whomever
reviews.text: Had very very great experience. Food was probably on of the best. It was our son 3rd bday, and they did something very special for him in short notice. All the staff and every member of restaurant were fabulous.

reviews.author: רעות ב
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text:
We come to celebrate our  honeymoon, everything was great!! The food, drinks the all team especially
We would like to thank Nicy for her time😍
Also the activity at the pool
The best hotel at cancun!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Kristin
reviews.title: Great Resort!
reviews.text: This is a wonderful resort!  We stayed in the reserve section. The staff is fantastic! Andres, Moises, Julio, Nicole & Jamil (sp?) were so great! They could not have been more helpful. They went out of their way to make our stay special. Sante & Lemon Fish were our absolute two favorite restaurants. We would definitely be back!!

reviews.author: Eleanna G
reviews.title: Vacaciones Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
Meseros Alfredo Álvaro y Ricardo were exceptional.
Edier at the Nespresso bar was equally amazing and welcoming. 
Ángeles and Guadalupe at the spa were great. My husband said it was the best massage (the best experience) ever.
Los meseros at Blue Agave were also amazing, the food and the drinks were great too. The hotel has everything you need from stores to restaurants, to booking excursions.
Overall, every service we received was phenomenal and we will be returning with more family.

reviews.author: Tim W
reviews.title: Anna is AMAZING
reviews.text:
I recieved a massage from Anna that was world class! She has amazing skills, elite training, a customer focus and found things in our short massage that I discovered after months of physio. She knows how to help the body heal. 

Ask for Anna when you go. She is the best!

reviews.author: Debbie M
reviews.title: Buffet breakfast waiters
reviews.text: Gaudencio & Joni took great care of our family of 6 every morning. The kids really looked forward to seeing them at breakfast. The buffet variety was amazing. But everyone here at the Paradisus in Cancun.

reviews.author: serchOri
reviews.title: Cannot miss Cielo, at paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
The best restaurant we ate in cancun. Every dish is perfectly served, flavours well represented from diferent parts of mexico.
This is a restaurant you cannot miss.
 Chef David & the complete teams will take you to a fantastic culinaire experience

reviews.author: Sharon M
reviews.title: Our Anniversary vacation
reviews.text: My husband and I loved our hotel and the service everywhere was exceptional. Somebody was always available to help with whatever we needed. Mauricio, Melvin and many others who I can’t remember their names were so pleasant. Housekeeping was also exceptional. Our room was great.

reviews.author: Anna W
reviews.title: Mrs Wong
reviews.text: The service was very good. miguel and jorge did a good job in providing a nice environment and helped us out to choose our food.  Food was just ok, not as good as I thought.  Atmosphere was good.  However, it was quiet hard to make reservations.

reviews.author: Matt C
reviews.title: Lemon Fish. Most satisfying meal of the trip, hands down.
reviews.text: From start to finish, Miguel and Jorge were exceedingly hospitable, and extremely knowledgeable about all of the menu choices. Our party of 6 shared a beautiful spread of sushi and ceviche, that blew us away with every bite. Miguel continued to impress us after that with numerous skewers of perfectly cooked meats, and some of the most unique tacos we experienced on this trip. Without hesitation we immediately booked another reservation for dinner later in the week. Cannot recommend this place enough.

reviews.author: Gabriel Quintero
reviews.title: Great Ocean View
reviews.text: Greeted very nicely upon arrival, liked the wrist band to open and secure room, Freddie our conciere took care of our every need from excursions to dinner reservations. All the waiters, waitresses and cleaning staff did an excellent job on taking care of our needs. Joni.  Thanks to Ralph at Lemon Fish, Noe at Cielo Lindo, Gerado   at Capela, Joni our housekeeper, Nicole, Jenny, Axel, Carrie. pool service and activities. Edwardo , bell boy, And the best team work waiters were at breakfast at Malva. Martin, Arzeta. Ignacio, Gerardo, and Eddie Catzin.  Julian and Edgar at Aquaworld, great fishing experience and cenotos , and jungle tour. Very convenient to Cancun and all around activities.

reviews.author: Joan M
reviews.title: Another wonderful experience at The Reserve!
reviews.text: I have been going to The Reserve at Paradisus Cancun Adults Only  for many years and it never disappoints. The rooms are lovely, the Reserve lobby is so beautiful and the staff is absolutely amazing!  They have rooms both on the lagoon side and ocean view.  The larger rooms have a designer tub.  There is a private restaurant, Santi, for breakfast and lunch which overlooks for ocean.  The pool area with its Bali Bed is amazing and Jennifer the pool concierge attends to your every need.  They also have a beach area with Bali beds. William is in charge of the area and is amazing!  Val, Moises, Caesar, and Josue are the best.  Thanks Juan Manuel for making me delicious cocktails!  During the day you can also visit the main pool with its swim up bar . Be sure to look up Victor C, who is the best waiter in that area. There is a sports bar that is beautiful with pool table and other games and the Ginger bar in the main area which has entertainment and a large bar.  Thanks to Gabby, Randy, Katrina and Giovanni for always making my visit special! There are many restaurants.  Be sure to try Lemon Fish as it is amazing.with sushi and much more.  Hugo is in charge and assures that everything is perfect.   The buffet is really good due to Guillermo.  You also have a butler at your disposal in the Reserve.  I highly recommend Aaron, who always makes my stay extra special.

reviews.author: Daniela
reviews.title: Cappella Restaurant- Paradisus
reviews.text:
The food was great, but the service was even better. The place is really beautiful! 
Jesus our server was amazing, he was so accommodating with all our needs. He recommended great options. Our dinner was so special. 
Thank you Jesus!

reviews.author: RosieM
reviews.title: Great food and service at Lemon restaurant at hotel Paradisus
reviews.text: Best food yet at the hotel. Restaurant Lemon Fish & Ceviche bar is great. Food was delicious (we had sushi and street food) and we had wonderful service from the charming & professional Miguel & Jorge. Highly recommend and ask for these two!

reviews.author: Ricardo C
reviews.title: Great vacation spot.
reviews.text: It was a very cozy stay with lots of benefits and great attention. The staff make sure everyone has what they need, Ramiro Teresa was one of our best waiters. The food was great with a lot of choices (be careful with the spicy food). An overall good experience.

reviews.author: Hsandman
reviews.title: First time at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: We had a wonderful visit to the Paradisus on October 2022. We stayed on the reserve side in tower 5. Our Concierge Freddy went above and beyond to get us pool floats after we realized we would have to pay 30-40 USD for a little donut at the hotel or across the road at aqua world- but here came Freddy carrying FOUR floaties down to the pool!!! He also arranged all of our dinner for us and made sure we knew about all of the things that were included as part of the reserve side guests. Our pool waiter Miguel was the BEST- one of our adult daughters forgot her flip flops down at the bali bed and the next morning- here comes Miguel with her shoes! We really can’t say enough about the staff there- they were all great!!!! We loved the mariachi band night and especially loved silent disco! The services included at YHI spa     Were the sauna, steam room and hydro therapy- I recommend doing this as the ice cold plunge pool and the huge jetted tub felt wonderful after walking all over this huge resort. The only negatives were there were that most of the seafood- crab, lobster, oysters- were all an up charge at the restaurants- but the food was good regardless of that. Also- be sure you are okay with stairs because this hotel is full of up and down pathways!!! Over all we really enjoyed this resort!

reviews.author: Nick C
reviews.title: Didi the best pool server
reviews.text: We stayed 4 days here the first week of October. My fiancé and I spent everyday at the pool in a cabana and floating around in the pool. Didi was our server everyday we were there. I’d be hard pressed to say my hands were ever lacking a drink our entire time at the pool. Didi took care of us like we were guests in his home it was truly an experience. People like Didi are the reason that we will always come to Paradisus Cancún and he made our trip genuinely amazing and memorable.

reviews.author: kimmorecombe
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation and service!
reviews.text: Amazing stay and service at the Paradisus Cancun! Outstanding service by pool by Sergio, Balta and Elliott. Room were nice, food was good lots of variety. But we really loved our days by the pool and the service from the above named gentlemen.  Thank you for your kindness and service! Hope to visit again soon!

reviews.author: Travel591036
reviews.title: Great Service at Paradisus!
reviews.text: We celebrated our anniversary here. Wow, there’s not beeping words to describe the great device and expertise we had here. Rooms were great, everyone and I mean everyone on staff were amazing. Whom ever does training needs an award also. S/o tot he waiter that appreciated my YU Yu hakusho shirt lol. Also Pascual, Atilano, Ivonn we’re fantastic waiters in the buffet. We tried all the restaurants and they were also delicious. You get really caught up in the relaxing nature here  Indoor and outdoor.

reviews.author: Ben
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text:
In my opinion this is the best restaurant in the resort. Had two great meals here with excellent service and a very nice setting. Big thanks to our Waiter Rafael along with Emanuel and Mario.

Muchas gracias!!

I would recommend the black tuna sushi.

reviews.author: Ariel L
reviews.title: Lemon fish
reviews.text: Rafael was a superb waiter! Made sure we got everything in a timely manner and checked on us frequently showed us pictures of good options and gave suggestion I love this place!!!! I will be back just for Rafael (:

reviews.author: Paris D
reviews.title: Lemon fish
reviews.text: Raphael…. Very good waiter, will most definitely come back to this resort.. good family vibes and food 🍱 very delicate. Will recommend to friends and family. Love the beach and pool and other activities included also very very fun

reviews.author: Liz
reviews.title: A fabulous experience overall.
reviews.text: Ivonn, Atilano, y Raul son los mejores. Servicio fantastico. Siempre tratamos como familia. Overall amazing service and people. They were always attentive to our every need and would check in to see if there was anything else we needed. The best ever!

reviews.author: jtkinney2
reviews.title: Excellent resort
reviews.text: All around a very nice resort with attentive staff. Very clean and good quality is good. We tried all available restaurants on property and were happy with all. We did occasionally have a language barrier issue when ordering drinks in particular. Definitely would go back

reviews.author: Horatiu G
reviews.title: Amazing Trip to Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: We had an excellent time here. Food was great and service was amazing. Especially Atilano, Ivonn and Raul from Malva Restaurant tended to our every need. Hotel and beach was absolutely superb. We’ll definetly come back!

reviews.author: mike g
reviews.title: Lemon fish
reviews.text: Rafael was an excellent server. We had a birthday boy and he went above and beyond to make sure he was celebrated. Food was pretty good but the service was better. Rafael had us laughing the whole time where there. If you’re in this resort I would make this restaurant one of your top picks.

reviews.author: Marielys B
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Rafael is the best of the best!! He was very sweet and helpful. One of the best servers ever! The sushi was very delicious and tasty, my entire family was very much comfortable and loved the entire experience.

reviews.author: Nick C
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Rafael is the man, he made the dining experience here entirely worth the upgrade to The Reserve package. Some of the best sushi I have ever had and just an amazing place. We would come back here anytime we are in town!

reviews.author: Giselle T
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Great service! Rafael provided amazing service. And the food was delicious!! We will definitely be back. I think it’s the best restaurant at the resort, Paradisus Cancun! 10/10 definitely recommend for anyone!

reviews.author: Carlos S
reviews.title: Rafael from Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Spectacular Service, mouth watering flavors, total tourist experience, my family and I are more than pleased. You have exceded our expectations. Thank you all. We are most grateful with your kindest effort to detail Rafael. Muchas gracias!

reviews.author: Roy H
reviews.title: Enjoyable stay at Lemon fish and bar
reviews.text: I had very pleasant experience with Rafael as our waiter for lemon fish restaurant. He made sure all our request was fulfilled. He also customized our order with special request. Overall I think a trip at paradisus Cancun is worth. Definitely recommend saying hi to Rafael

reviews.author: Claudia Munoz
reviews.title: BEST RESORT IN CANCUN!!!
reviews.text:
Omg what an AMAZING experience I had at this beautiful resort!! I’ve stayed at multiple resorts in Cancun, and HANDS DOWN this was the BEST ONE! Everything was 10/10!! Their food was amazing! Their staff was seriously the sweetest people ever!! Highly recommend Armando and his team at the buffet, they took such great care of us! They made sure we had ocean views while we ate, made us fresh pineapple juice when we requested it. They even surprised me on my last day there for my birthday with a small cake and sign. I felt sooo special thanx to their team. =) 
And their drinks!! Omggg they use REAL ALCOHOL and not the watered down drinks like I’ve had at other resorts. You will get drunk with their drinks ..lol 
We even bought a bottle because I thought the drinks will not be strong and we didn’t even end up drinking the bottle we bought ..lol 
The hotel is huge and soooo pretty!! The water is sooo beautiful I mean everything there was perfect! If you’re doing your research of deciding where to stay, imma make it simple for you and chose Paradisus!!!

reviews.author: antonio a
reviews.title: Armando (Malva AM team)
reviews.text: Armando UC Malvasia am team was such an amazing person to see every morning. He had our table ready every morning, he knew our drinks already by memory and he also had at the condiments ready at our table by the time we sat down. He’s honestly one of the main reasons we continued to come to Malva for breakfast in the morning. Thank you Armando for your excellent service! You really gave us the all inclusive experience!!

reviews.author: David B
reviews.title: Excellent experience!!
reviews.text:
Mi girlfriend and I didn’t know what to expect. I grew up in Mexico but I had only been to Cancun once before. I have to say that we had a fantastic stay!! The food was great and there were plenty of options. The people are incredibly nice and helpful, we couldn’t be happier. Here are just some of the highlights:
Malva AM Team - Rafael, Armando, Orlando, and Condolario were incredibly nice. Not only did they have a table ready for us with mimosas every morning but they gave us tips on a few other things to do outside the resort and they treated us like family. On our way out they even had some cake and sign wishing us a good trip.
Ginger Bar II - David, Pedro, and Gaby were very nice and they taught us a lot about mixology. They kept surprising us with different types of cocktails and they even gave us some recipes to take home.
Beach Servers - Hector and Laura were always checking in to see if we needed any drinks or food. They were friendly and made us feel right at home when laying by the beach.
My girlfriend and I had an amazing time and we will definitely be back to Paradisus. We highly recommend it!!!

reviews.author: Sarah E
reviews.title: My Vacation in Paradisus
reviews.text: Everyday we had breakfast at the buffet (which was amazing) and the servers were excellent. We were always greeted by Martin, Eddie, Gelado, and Ignacio! They were all amazing and welcoming. They went above and beyond to make sure we were satisfied. Great experience! Definitely ask for them while you’re at Paradisus!

reviews.author: Britt
reviews.title: Lemon Fish - Rafael
reviews.text: Great ceviche, great sushi, great drinks, and great service! Our waiter, Rafael, was very friendly, attentive, and helpful — he even went above and beyond to help us celebrate our honeymoon well with extra wine and photos. Would recommend!

reviews.author: Cara D
reviews.title: Great food and service at Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Daniel was an amazing waiter — gave many great suggestions about food and drink. He was very accommodating to our needs! The food was amazing, best meal of the trip! Sushi was very fresh and the desserts were delicious.

reviews.author: Maddie R
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Daniel was a 10/10 server. The food was extremely fresh and delicious- one of the best restaurants at the resort. Great atmosphere and overall extremely pleasant experience. Would recommend this for great sushi and service!

reviews.author: Petko V
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Rafael is the best waiter. All food samples were great. Service is amazing. They treated our whole family extremely well and we got to sample many different dishes from the menu. Deserts as well as all sample food is delicious

reviews.author: Urban O
reviews.title: Lemon fish restaurant
reviews.text: Rafael was a great waiter at Lemonfish! Food and service was amazing.  We loved it. The sushi was so good and we loved the attentive service. We also enjoyed the drinks and dessert. I look forward to coming. A huge

reviews.author: TildeJl
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Absolutely wonderful experience with fantastic food. Miguel and Jorge were fantastic. We couldn’t have asked for a better experience. Our favorite restaurant thus far. All the sushi options were amazing

reviews.author: Richard B
reviews.title: Limon Fish
reviews.text:
Everything was great. Rafael and the Manager Emmanuel adjusted to make this an outstanding experience. 
We missed our appointment due to illness both Rafael and Emmanuel made accommodations for me and my wife. Two Thumbs Up!!

reviews.author: Scott R
reviews.title: Service was Awesome
reviews.text:
Ada at the smaller pool did awesome job.  She is very friendly and went above with service.  Sergio at the pool with bar did a great job also.  Breakfast Waiters out on patio were great.
 Luis at Capella restaurant was very nice, entertaining and did a fantastic job.

reviews.author: Robert D
reviews.title: Fun time at Paradisus
reviews.text: We stayed here from the 3rd to the 6th of October and had a great time. Though we stayed in the Reserve side, we spent all of our time in the main pool area, which is where all the fun is going on... Didier, our poolside waiter, was great with our drinks and food.. Orlando at the swim up bar made awesome tasting drinks.. And kept them flowing😀... Hope to be returning again next year..

reviews.author: Natalie
reviews.title: Martin, Cesar, Luis are the best!
reviews.text:
Ginger bar, Luis really took care of us! He would bring us out next round of drinks without even having to tell him! 
Martin at the Malva buffet was phenomenal! He took good care of us and made us all laugh!
Cesar at the lemon restaurant was so nice! He made sure we were also taken care of! These 3 gentlemen are our family trip phenomenal!! 
We celebrated 2 birthdays and they made sure we kept celebrating! 
Would definitely recommend 5/5!

reviews.author: Tanisha
reviews.title: Cappella
reviews.text: Capella has really great food!!! Jesus was amazing and helpful, he was quick with his service and was very kind. Will definitely come back again just for the service ! Thank you cappella and jesus!!!!

reviews.author: Victor P
reviews.title: Lemon fish
reviews.text:
This evening we eat at lemon fish restaurant 
The manager Emanuel and co worker Alejandro Cob Leon are very nice and helpful and recommended us some of the delicious dishes. I highly recommend this restaurant at the Paradisus Cancun

reviews.author: Victoria Bovt
reviews.title: Paradisus by Melia Cancun - Lemon fish restaurant
reviews.text: I loved how very romantic and unique the restaurant  was inside. The food was just amazing! Really recommend the sushi here. Thank you to Miguel and Jorge for being amazing servers!  :) Will definitely be coming back.

reviews.author: tim g
reviews.title: Costum dinner
reviews.text: The staff and chef were absolutely amazing. My wife has severe allergies to many foods and dave was absolutely outstanding on the cuisine.  Bar none best food we had in a long time. Noel was superb at accommodation and just making the evening what it should be.

reviews.author: Sophia S
reviews.title: An absolute dream
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancún was a dream. Starting with the welcoming hospitality of the staff - Levi, to the decor, cleanliness, amenities, and food. I would recommend anyone to go here. Our room was bigger than expected, and the reserve experience was so worth the cost. Levi made our stay memorable. He was so helpful with ideas of what to do and always available to our needs. We cannot say enough about Levi, and we can’t wait to go back. To Levi and all the staff at Paradisus- we thank you for the most wonderful trip.

reviews.author: John A
reviews.title: Lemon Fish Restaurant
reviews.text: Had a great time here at Lemon Fish! Our server Rafael was great, attentive, and was very accommodating with my food allergies. He also came and showed us pictures of the entire menu's items when we were briefly unable to open the menu from the wifi. The food was excellent. The most incredible thing was the atmosphere and decor. This restaurant is quite simply the most gorgeous we have ever visited, nestled under the big atrium of Paradisus tower 3. Would recommend this place to everyone staying at Paradisus.

reviews.author: Paige L
reviews.title: Lemon fish
reviews.text: Rafael at lemon fish was the best!! The food was 10/10 and the service was the best. Celebrated our honeymoon here and they made a special point to make us feel special!!! The  food was by far the best we had at the resort.

reviews.author: gescatel
reviews.title: Amazing Service
reviews.text: It was my first visit to Paradisus in Cancun and it was the best. The food was delicious and the service was outstanding. Thank you to Ada, Sergio, Didier, and Victor for continuously taking care of us at the pool during our stay. I never had to flag anyone down for help. They were courteous and one step ahead every time. The breakfast buffet  was amazing. Ramiro, Teresa and Arnulfo took care of us during our stay and they went above and beyond for us everyday. It was the perfect start to our days. I will definitely be back with my family. Thank you for the amazing service, Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: Alice
reviews.title: 24H coffee service
reviews.text:
24h coffee service is the excellent option in the hotel with the small snacks. Great  different varieties of coffee. Richer always smiling and welcoming. Awesome service overall 
Will come back again. Very clean hotel, 
The restaurants are very good, buffet is smaller choice I am used to BUT everything very tasty

reviews.author: Julia A
reviews.title: Malva Breakfast 🥞
reviews.text: It’s our last day from our 5 night vacation. I traveled with my husband and 11 month old baby. We were treated with so much kindness. Martin, Eddie Gatzín, and Gerardo always greeted us and got a baby seat for our daughter. We feel like we made friends here and hope to be back next year. We highly recommend Paradisus Cancun and be sure to visit the buffet, Malva Breakfast 😋☀️

reviews.author: Michele C
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: I absolutely adore this place and can't wait to come back. The service was consistently fantastic! I especially loved coming to the buffet every day and spending time with Gaudiucio, Antonio, Jony, Ramiro, and Teresa. I cannot recommend this place enough!

reviews.author: Yameci Maldonado
reviews.title: 1st visit to Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
This is our first visit to Paradisus cancun. The hotel is absolutely gorgeous and the beach is just stunning. The room we had was absolutely wonderful. The resort is so clean. All the plants and nature just make you feel the nature even being inside. 

The food was dissapointing. The buffet at Malva was just ok. We made reservations at lemon fish, and the food came out cold -  every single dish which was super disappointing. The food at Capella was good.  

Altough I was disappointed with the food overall, the staff was incredible. Everyone on the staff was great. 

The bar was nice, but closed at midnight. Way to early and after that there wasn’t anything else going on in the resort. 

All the guys that work at the pool and bali beds are amazing too. So friendly and helpful. Very attentive.

Norma at reception was incredible. She was so friendly and helpful and we just loved her.

Every evening we went to Malva and there were two servers who went above and beyond for us every night- Liliana Garcia and Rodrigo Gorocica. They were so nice we would look for them like they were our friends ! Felipe the chef was amazing too. 

The location of the resort is great. Its close to great restaurants like rosanegra, chamboa and funky geisha.
The buses run along right in front every minute to downtown cancun for 12 pesos or you can pay $1 usd pp.

reviews.author: Shannon
reviews.title: Paradisus Visit
reviews.text: Here at Paradis‘s Cancun, I’m having a wonderful experience every day I’ve eaten at the café and I’ve had the honor to be held by Lilian Garcia and Rodrigo. They’ve come to help me every day. They’ve made sure that I am well fed. The pm staff at Malva….. you will not be disappointed!

reviews.author: Cheriseyyy
reviews.title: Lemon Fish - Rafael and Jorge where the best!
reviews.text:
We are staying at Paradisus this week and although we have many options, we’ve been to Lemon Fish twice already! And we have a reservation to dine there our last night as well. 

Jorge helped us the first night and gave us so many tips about the menu! He even brought us special dishes that he thought we would like and made us the most delicious and unique cocktails throughout our meal!

Rafael helped us during our second visit and was so attentive and made us feel at home. He helped is try new dishes and we had another positive experience! 

Thanks Jorge & Rafael!

reviews.author: Christian A
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Blue agave had exceptional service! One of the many restaurants at paradisus Cancun and you do not need reservations. They are open 11am to 11pm. The food was amazing and the service was well above expectations. They even brought my girlfriend and I an extra drink without ordering. Ian was our server and he was excellent, very nice and always made sure we were doing fine. Probably one of the best restaurants at the resort.

reviews.author: Amber W
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: Wow! I’m amazed paradisus is amazing and this restaurant is very good for lunch! Ian had incredible service and speaks very good English! There service was very fast and impressive they make us want to come back and I never visit a place more than once! I’m so impressed and they have a nice view

reviews.author: Tony Sandin
reviews.title: Excellent Kid’s Club
reviews.text:
Brenda, Rubi, Itzel, Maribel, Ivón, and Nicy were very professional, caring, and always making sure the kids were having fun. 

They have lots of activities, inside and outside, for all ages. But the one they loved the most was pool time, specially with tons of bubbles.

The schedule is perfect so adults can have their “me” time.

reviews.author: Klodi
reviews.title: Malvasia A.M
reviews.text: Great service,the metress Armando UC ,Orlando,Rafael the best.They welcome us ,really friendly,always asking if we need something else.The food great and a lots of choices.thank you guys ,thank you Paradisus,we had a wonderful time,and we really liked the service here,really hard worker everyone!

reviews.author: Bill E
reviews.title: Excellent Meal at the Lemon Fish
reviews.text: The food st the Lemon Fish is tapas style and each selection was well prepared and delicious. Our service staff was Jorge and Miguel and they did an outstanding job explaining each dish and making suggestions. It was a wonderful evening and we can’t wait to go back again

reviews.author: Stevenrsmith777
reviews.title: Fantastic resort
reviews.text: Sorry in advance this is a very long review but please read I feel it will be helpful in considering this resort. Paradisus Cancun is amazing we have stayed at Grand Fiesta CB the previous 2 years and loved it but wanted to try something new. We booked this resort based on rating and then did some research and got nervous and almost switched there are a lot of negative reviews regarding temperature of the rooms and common areas which concerned us as we like to be cool in our room and comfortable in the resort while dining. We booked a reserve ocean view Junior suite when we arrived they quickly took us to the private check in area in tower 5 the process was quick and we enjoyed a drink while checking in. Our concierge/butler was Rafael he took us from the check in desk gave us a brief tour of the resort introduced us the the Cabana girls which set us up with a cabana for the next day and took us to our reserve  room in tower 3. The room was fine other than there was not a glass wall in the shower that you could look through to see the amazing view of the ocean which we expected base on all the research we had done before our trip. We asked if they had a room in tower 5 with this feature. Rafael said they were sold out for the night but he would get us moved the following day which they did by noon. The new room was exactly what we wanted it felt slightly nicer but was the same size and layout as our first. Rafael also made our dinner reservations for the first 3 nights and arranged dinner reservations across the street at Rosa Negra for our second night which was incredible a must do if you want a fantastic meal, service and a lot of entertainment. Rafael checked on us a few times a day through what’s app and in person. My wife forgot a hair brush we asked him our first night if he could help he brought a comb, the following morning he found us on the beach and had picked her up a nice brush on his way to work OMG amazing service and it kept getting better from there. Anything we needed help with he quickly took care of or helped with, Rafael sets the standard for over the top customer service. We have never had butler service at a resort before and he exceeded all our expectations. We experienced similar service from everyone at the resort in all areas we wanted for nothing. The cabana girl’s Jennifer and Nicole had our requested cabana ready for us every day when we arrived at the reserve pool. We had over shopped for souvenirs and asked Jennifer if there was some where we could buy a small suitcase her response was I’m going the the supermarket after work would you like me to pick one up for you and bring it tomorrow(are you kidding me I thought in my mind). We exchanged contact info and that evening she was texting us pictures and prices the next morning she had our suitcase. We paid her for the suitcase plus some for her amazing service. All of the servers at the reserve pool were fantastic once you order your drinks they remember what you like and just keep them coming Moses, Oscar and Miguel top notch service. The food servers in Sante Valeria and others were great William Sante manager stopped by daily and checked on us and the Sante chef Andres was great and accommodated any special requests that were not on the menu. Alfredo in the buffet was our favorite in this restaurant he sings and makes these amazing bird sounds but all the servers we had  were great. David the Spa concierge was very friendly and help us with directions to market 28. We tried every restaurant all the food and service was very good. Sal steakhouse was excellent my wife loved the cheesecake we asked if we could come back during our stay for just dessert they said yes and we went back a couple of times. Abraham at the bell desk was very helpful in setting up our transportation to the airport as we canceled our transportation that was set up because they insisted we be picked up 5 hours before our flight and that was not necessary we left 3 hours before and still were at the airport to early. Our room was comfortable at 68 to 72 degrees our entire stay  all of the restaurants were comfortable but lemon fish and cappella were a little warm but not uncomfortable. The beach has plenty of lounger and is beautiful the ocean was swim-able our first 5 days but rough the last 5 due to hurricane Ian. Overall Paradisus is fantastic in every way the best service and facility we have ever stayed at. We highly recommend our experience was perfect.

reviews.author: Toby M
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel, the people are all really nice and welcoming. All the restaurants are very clean and the food is excellent. Every morning we had breakfast at the malva and our server Atilono made us feel like family.

reviews.author: Colleen s
reviews.title: Paradisus cancun
reviews.text: We stayed here for 4 days. At Malva, we were taken care of by Atilono, Edie, and Ivvon and the service was exceptional. Everyone was very attentive and we were very well taken care of. I would definitely come back here. The food and drinks were amazing!

reviews.author: Ivan L
reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text: As always and exceptional service at Paradisus. Could not start the day without a great breakfast and catered service by the Gaudencio, Antonio, Ramiro, Raul and Tere, the morning crew that pampered us for breakfast. They went above and beyond what you’d expect from a regular all exclusive resort in Cancun, by far the best experience in 15 years of traveling to Cancun.

reviews.author: Paulina
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: amazing! the food was absolutely delicious and unique. The design inside the restaurant had such a nice atmosphere and is very  cool! The waiter was also very kind and attentive. I highly recommend going to this restaurant when visiting the resort.

reviews.author: German L
reviews.title: amazing customer service and food! Rafael was thoughtful, attentive and polite! 10/10!
reviews.text: Out waiter Rafael was friendly, polite and attentive. Food was delicious and with good variety.  The restaurant atmosphere was wonderful and the food was well cooked. I will definitely be back to Lemon Fish and bring all my family and friends.

reviews.author: Virginia F
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Excellent! Our waiter Rafael was very good, very attentive! The food was excellent as well, the service was wonderful, the atmosphere was lovely! I will definitely be coming back to this hotel and restaurant.

reviews.author: Jeff
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: Excellent resort with a amazing views and great staff, everyone who works try’s there best to accommodate you and give you the best time. Our concierge Frida was absolutely amazing, food was okay at the buffet and different restaurants but the presentation and ambiance was awesome across the board. I will definitely return soon!

reviews.author: Sarah W
reviews.title: Facts - Not opinions
reviews.text: Resort is large. It’s about 20 mins from the airport. There is a $15 USD eco tax you have to pay upon checkin. Wifi throughout. Pyramid 3 is the central location for restaurants and entertainment. There’s a few rooms that don’t have balconies because of the design of the hotel. If you want to ensure you have a balcony, make sure you confirm at check in. Balconies are large and extremely private. If you get an ocean view room, the sun will be shining in your room all day long. Lagoon view is much cooler. The rooms are decent and have mostly everything you would need, other than a coffee maker. The bathrooms have bidets. Not many English speaking channels. Your wrist band is your room key. Minimal shelving and drawers in regular rooms. No housecoats or slippers. Mini bar has glass bottles of water, pop, beer and a few snacks. No toiletries in room. Only pump soaps and shampoos. There is a safe in the closet. There is no smoking permitted on the pool deck or in the hotel. You can smoke outside of the doors, on the beach and at the outdoor bar that overlooks the beach. The hotel is eco friendly and doesn’t provide straws. They do provide recyclable cups in the pool area that are washed and reused. The pool is 5ft deep, so beware if you’re short. No sit down snack bar around the pool, but you can order a few snacks from the servers. They do have a small cart that serves small things like burgers, hotdogs and chips. Lots of restaurants to choose from. You can book 2 ala cartes at a time. You pay extra for the steakhouse. There is a $5 charge for room service each time you order. There is no theatre for shows. All entertainment is provided in the lobby area. There is an escape room in pyramid 2 on the ground level (0).

reviews.author: Unknown
reviews.title: Cancun Paradisus: Malva restaurant & Kanna Cancun
reviews.text:
Malva - i had the best time enjoying morning breakfast with Eddie, amando, Martin & Malla Am. They always greeted us with such bright smiles and great service. 
Kanna - karina was on point with drinks and service. My daily stop at this place with breathtaking views and all smiles made this trip worth it. She even witnessed turtle migration and informed all of us how rare it is and ensured to provide us with some great knowledge. MUST COME!

reviews.author: Keri G
reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text: I want to start off by saying how beautiful the hotel was , as soon as we walked in our jaws dropped , we where greeted by Raphael who helped us out during our 6 day stay from making rsvp to all the restaurants checking in on us even on his days off !! Sending a birthday cake and champagne 🍾 on my birthday !!! Wow !!!getti by us transportation to the airport !  The grounds are so beautiful we had 3 amazing service guys who were with us for the 6 days Oscar  and I forgot the other 2 guys names they gave me there name cards and I lost it at the airport !!!!but they were amazing with the drinks and making sure we kept eating they even had hookah on the grounds at certain cabanas you sat at .  I would highly recommend this hotel ! Everyone is just so friendly and always  greeting  you . Thank you Raphael for making our stay amazing !!!!!

reviews.author: angelacorbin1979
reviews.title: Beautiful resort. Great staff.
reviews.text: We have stayed here 5 times and it keeps getting better. The food is great and the staff is excellent. Love it here and will return. We always stayed in the Reserve area and are never disappointed. Spend the extra money to get the royal treatment. You won’t be sorry.

reviews.author: yolanda b
reviews.title: Costume Designer/Stylist
reviews.text:
Service was impeccable. It’s like they were reading our minds. So attentive. The grilled seafood platter was so delicious and pure perfection. It was so fresh! 
Thank you Alejandro Cob, Cristian Sanchez, Carlos Chay, David Contreras and Francisco Tello. You all are the best!

reviews.author: tripin62
reviews.title: Amazing Customer Seevice
reviews.text: Only night 2 of a 5 night stay, but cannot say enough about Paradisus Cancun! The resort is beautiful, grounds and buildings are immaculate and staff customer service are second to none. We are in The Reserve which is adult only and well worth the upgrade if you’re looking for peaceful rest and relaxation but we ventured into the family area of the resort and the pools are never ending and nicely maintained as well. The views of the ocean are breathtaking and the beach is everything you’d imagine in a Caribbean paradise.  We still have 3 nights to go and I’m already planning our next trip to Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: Martin E
reviews.title: One of the best vacations!
reviews.text: This vacation was just for my wife and I, and we couldn't have picked a better place to spend time together. The restaurants exceed our expectations and our room had the nicest view. The beach was easy to access and just as beautiful as in the pictures. But what really made this experience one of a kind was the staff! Gaudencio & Eddie from the Enso restaurant, Armando from the Malva restaurant, Valeria & Lorena & Cesar from the Sante restaurant, all made our trip extra special with their amazing and attentive attitudes. There were so many other waiters and staff who we wish we could give a shout out too as well. Of course shout out to all the cooks who  prepared delicious meals that we already miss. The two Mexican restaurants, Agave & Cielo, served truly authentic Mexican food.  Not to forget, Norma at the front desk was super helpful with her cordial attitude.

reviews.author: patriciamR2960AV
reviews.title: Fantastic vacation
reviews.text:
We thoroughly enjoyed our 11 day vacation.  
Visited the espresso bar most days and the service was great.  All of the servers are great.  Today’s server Richer asked if we would comment on his service.  As I mentioned earlier all of your servers are fantastic.  
We love spending time at the pool in the Reserve.  Lucas and Maximilian (spelling?) were so attentive.  
We visited all of the restaurants. Food  and service was wonderful.  We particularly liked Cappella.  Our server last night, Omar, did a great job.  The breakfast buffet in the Lunch Box was good everyday.  Atilano was particularly good.  All of the attendees were great.

reviews.author: Run with Ron
reviews.title: Lunch box
reviews.text: Had a vip service. Breakfast and sunrise was excellent.  Joni and atilano we’re great, very  attentive and personable.  ! Come here for sunrise breakfast. Has everything you can want. American, international. Omelette station . A+

reviews.author: Tyler Hall
reviews.title: The Lunchbox dinner restaurant.
