reviews.text: Antonio provided the best service. Great recommendations, and made my wife and I feel very special with a speciality dessert and cocktail. The service was fantastic, he deserves this amazing review. 👍👍

reviews.author: Connor W
reviews.title: Best family vacation ever!!!
reviews.text: From start to finish this vacation was the best we've been on in years! Every staff member was very nice and helpful and the events were so much fun, from the dance parties to the pool fun! Augustin was so much fun with the 🏐 and activities and Anna was fantastic at the spa. 10/10 would recommend for everyone no matter the age!

reviews.author: Safari661912
reviews.title: Amazing October couples getaway
reviews.text: Amazing job of attending to all our needs even with Covid protocols in place. Amazing atmosphere, food and the staff was amazing. Antonio on the beach never let our drinks go dry! Highly recommend the Mexican restaurant and the Lunch Box for dinner!!

reviews.author: Kamila Perez
reviews.title: Amazing experience!
reviews.text: The service was amazing, everyone was extremely helpful. Shout out to Juan from Kanna, Soni amd Armando (concierges). Ten ladies at front desk, the bar tenders at Ginger bar, Max and Lucas at the Reserve pool. This is my third time here and as always Paradisus never disappoints. I love this resort, their employees and the amazing service they always provide.

reviews.author: Bella B
reviews.title: Spa service
reviews.text: Liliana was amazing for my massage. She did such a great job. It was super relaxing and I feel great. Definitely recommend her. The overall experience was great. If you go to the spa request Liliana!!!

reviews.author: Patricia G
reviews.title: Best service ever
reviews.text: The servers from the bar Antonio and Enrique gave us the best service we’ve ever had. They treated us like family. They always went above and beyond for our group. We will be back to this resort because of how well we were treated. We made friends with the staff and will never forget them! Thank you Antonio and Enrique!

reviews.author: mrch888
reviews.title: Beautiful place to stay with family
reviews.text:
Our experience in the Paradisus was great it’s our second time this year we feel safe here.
The food quality is excellent they have lot variety of food every day in the buffet plus the theme restaurants you can eat every night only need reservations but they are easy to make.
Service is excellent specially shout out to waiter Ramiro at the buffet restaurant very nice guy.
The coffee shop attendant Cynthia is very kind and friendly always very patient with us always smiling.
They are cleaning all the time all areas we loved that make us feel more comfortable specially during this times.
The pool area is nice and relaxing 
Beach is gorgeous we enjoy everything in this resort.
Family oriented

reviews.author: Isaiah c
reviews.title: Axcel
reviews.text: Best host 10/10 love him wonderful guy so funny and very family friendly if u see him around you will definitely have the time of your life the guy even know magic blew my mind I had four cards and somehow he made me have 3 without knowing

reviews.author: Anastasia A
reviews.title: Amazing resort!
reviews.text:
I can’t write enough praise for this wonderful resort! I’ve spend quite a few days researching before making my choice in favor of Paradisus, there are so many all-inclusive hotels! 
I haven’t regretted my choice for a second, from the moment I stepped inside until the moment I had to leave. 
For me, everything was immaculate - food/drinks, cleanliness, amenities, entertainment, friendly staff - 100%! I’m absolutely looking forward to my return and I recommend this place to everyone! 

P.S. I took off one star just for one reason - there’s a construction going on in the center of the hotel at the moment. Of course, it creates a lot of noise, fumes and dust… it’s a temporary situation and will improve future visits but I can’t deny it caused some inconvenience during my stay.

P.P.S. Don’t forget to tip, folks! Just because it’s all-inclusive, doesn’t mean you shouldn’t reward excellent service, they are working so hard!

reviews.author: Amilcar
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancún Best of the Best!!!
reviews.text:
Paradisus is as advertised (or better). The staff was exceptional, the beach and the outdoor facilities were amazing!!! Everything you need, you will have access to it. Every staff is very knowledgeable about anything you may need. Access to the shopping area and Downtown Cancún is just a bus away (front of resort) for just $12 Mexican pesos (or just about $0.60 cents). 

My personal concierge Soni Martinez was the best!!! She made our experience much more pleasant and easier to navigate. Every restaurant we went to, we had great service and personal attention. But Ediel and Antonio at Malva buffett for breakfast went above and beyond every single time. 

Every restaurant in the hotel was amazing! The views of the ocean are incredible!

reviews.author: Marylu Orozco
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, even better service!!
reviews.text: We traveled with a party of 12 for 6 days. It was the best trip we have ever had. The resort was beautiful and clean at any time of the day. The shows were awesome. There was a great variety of food and restaurants to choose from. The best however, was the service that was provided throughout the resort. Enrique and Antonio were the best down at the pool and beach area. The lifeguard on site was also great and helpful. We can’t say thank you enough for the wonderful experience throughout.  We will never go anywhere else!!!

reviews.author: Jonathan Johnson
reviews.title: Awesome resort! We love Sophonia in the Ginger Bar!
reviews.text: We had an amazing time at Paradisus Cancun! This was our second time and it was even better the second time around. Very clean, very beautiful and amazing food! We can't wait to go back. Sofonia in the Ginger Bar is the best. He is the reason we came back for a second stay at the resort. A big thank you to the guys and girls in the Ginger Bar, Sofonia, Wendy, Gabi, Giovanni and Mauro! Great shows and great service! We'll be back for sure.

reviews.author: tomandjeff
reviews.title: Enso Restaurant,a culinary treat.
reviews.text:
I am pleased to offer a review of the Enso Restaurant in the Paradisus Cancun Resort.
Due to the exceptionally friendly and efficient service provided by Rafael, Antonio and Denise we enjoyed a rare culinary treat.
Every course they recommended was delicious and artistically presented. They chatted knowledgeably about the food and helped us understand the particular Mayan specialties on the menu
We recommend the very drinkable house wine, a Spanish Sauvignon Blanc
Dessert ended our meal most sweetly
Without reservation we recommend Enso, food and staff.
Tom and Jeff

reviews.author: Joan M
reviews.title: Birthday Trip
reviews.text: I have been going to Paradisus Cancun for about 20 years.  I usually do not go at this time of year however decided to go to celebrate my birthday.  I was last there in February and there has been changes.  Bana restaurant is being demolished for a more modern look.  However I was saddened that Toji bar was also gone as I have met such good people and had many interesting conversations at that bar.  Stayed in the Reserve.  Lovely updated room.  Restaurants are all good.  However the reason I visit time and time again is because of the staff and how warm and welcoming they are. In the Reserve they decorated my Bali bed with balloons, special meals, etc for my birthday.  The reason I go back is to see Valeria, Cesar, Mioses, Julio,and Josue, and of course my butler, Aaron, all who I consider to be family.  And then they had another birthday celebration for me at the Ginger Lounge. my thanks to my second family of  Gaby, Karina and Randy.  They are top notch.  And of course Geovany and Luis.  The beach is not as large as before the hurricanes, however still has that beautiful color that you could stare at all day.  Had the best massage ever by Anna - be sure to ask for her.  And last but not least Rosanna, a new friend.  I believe you will love Paradisus.

reviews.author: Teresa G
reviews.title: My experience in Paradisus
reviews.text: Wen from guest services has helped us greatly.  She was very professional and extremely courteous and helpful.  We have had a great time at Paradisus Cancun.  We had a fantastic time and will be sure to return.

reviews.author: Urbinayader
reviews.title: Amazing experience, we can’t wait to go back
reviews.text: First of all; I would like to thank all staff members for their awesome service they provided us, specially the staff at ginger bar restaurant. Some staffs went above and beyond; our number one staff Gabby from Ginger bar, she is awesome, friendly, kind, funny, helpful and I can keep going on. Karina from Ginger bar was wonderful as well, Chef David from Cielo restaurant, his food is delicious and Moises from Cielo, spectacular customer service. The facility is beautiful, rooms are clean and modern, bed is very comfortable. We enjoy all activities, pool, music, food, drinks and the great service by staffs. Definitely we recommend this hotel and we will be back soon. Thank you again!

reviews.author: Morgana K
reviews.title: DAVID was the ONLY POSITIVE PART of our experience
reviews.text: THIS PLACE IS UNDER CONSTRUCTION BE AWARE! first of all no one told us the construction was going on before we arrived so the entire time the lobby was loud and disruptive. we had the worst customer service I have ever experienced, staff was dismissive, not helpful, and often condescending. one of the waiters even told us to hurry up at the breakfast buffet. when we checked in, no one explained any of the amenities or what parts of the resort we had access to so we ended up accidentally going into the reserve area and being embarrassingly asked to leave because we didn't have the reserve upgrade. they had us use an app to navigate amenities at the resort but it was super glitchy, some of the information was wrong and just sucked as an app in general. we requested toothbrushes and bathrobes sent to our room but we had to ask four different times before anyone brought us our stuff. the food is okay at best, but don't go here if you are vegetarian/vegan you won't have anything to eat I barely ever finished a plate of food once during our four-day stay. when we complained to the management they didn't really seem to care and they weren't able to offer us much. the only staff member that relived any of my stress was David at the welcome desk. he made me feel that my concerns were heard and he was honest and helpful. if anyone from Paradisus is reading this, please consider David for a promotion as he is experienced and great with customers and all the other employees here have a lot they can learn from how he handles guests. the beach was nice here tho that's about the only good thing I have to say.

reviews.author: ajay5112021
reviews.title: Horrible.
reviews.text: This was one of the worst hotel experiences i have had in my life. I had to go back and forth to the front desk 4 times because my room key would not work. The hotel brought random peoples luggage into my room and left them there. We had to call the front desk to come pick them up. During the festival my mother was hit in the head with a door that was not secured down in the festival entrance. The door hit her in the head and landed on her foot. She right now has 4 toes that are bruised and is waiting to go to the doctor to make sure they are not broken. We asked the hotel manager for the report for the incident and we still have not yet received it.The air conditioning in the room and throughout the hotel was horrible. I could not find anywhere to cool off. This was a horrible hotel experience for my family and I. I will not be recommending it to anyone and we will not be going back.

reviews.author: raffaellakraettli
reviews.title: Great hotel with great activities!
reviews.text: The hotel offers great activities, restaurants, spa etc.  The pools are awesome. The rooms could be updated. They are a little old fashioned. USB chargers would be great in the rooms.  All in all the hotel is a real paradise.

reviews.author: paulE817QK
reviews.title: Would stay here again!
reviews.text:
We decided last minute to upgrade to The Reserve, well worth it for the laid back-quiet atmosphere of adult only pool and access to Sante restaurant/bar.  All of the staff at Sante are very nice and attentive, food and drinks were excellent there as well as the other restaurants on the property.  Burger Bus was very good as well as Taco place for lunch!

We stayed in pyramid 5 and were very pleased with the room as well as the whole resort.  Some renovations were in progress during our stay but it did not bother us at all. Our only complaint was the beach erosion that had exposed rocks in the surf which made it tricky getting in and out of the ocean.

Overall great resort, excellent service, beautiful property.  Can't wait for the next chance to stay there!

reviews.author: Vero
reviews.title: Noisy, old, bad, run away from it!
reviews.text:
Used to be my favorite hotel and now it’s the biggest nightmare! If you want a nice relaxed vacation this is not for you. Weddings run until pass 11pm on the weekend and you have the music blasting in your room. No regards for people staying here at all.
Rooms are old and outdated. My shower leaks from the ceiling. Balcony door is all rusted. Beds are sooooo uncomfortable. It just ruined my vacation.
Pool… be prepared to pay for 200 if you want to be under some shade. Cabanas everywhere.
No entertainment what so ever. At night they did a silence party WTF is that!!!
Unbelievable how bad the customer service is here.
DO NOT STAY!

reviews.author: sierra
reviews.title: Best trip
reviews.text: Had the best breakfast every morning outside! I can’t remember their names but the servers outside are amazing! Had a blast, definitely recommend coming and eating here, with the best servers around! Ps the food is amazing

reviews.author: Heidi B
reviews.title: Much needed get away
reviews.text: Once again the staff at this resort exceeded expectations. The food was good and our room was excellent. Special thanks to Flor and Manuel our waiter and bartender for making sure our needs were met while at the pool, Elliot and Andrea with activities for getting us lazy beach bums up and playing volleyball in the sand and last but not least to Pavel our butler for making all our reservations and making sure everything was going smoothly during our stay.

reviews.author: Ceils
reviews.title: Reserve Upgrade not worth it for Family
reviews.text: I decided to purchase the RESERVE room, when I booked my Family trip, based on the description on the site.  Did not get any of the services offered. Only 2 dinner reservations, which in all honesty, I couldve made.  Not able to reserve an area at the Pool as told I would be, so we fended for ourselves. would call for services, and was bounced around. Our Butler was difficult to contact via whatsapp, took long. She offered us a meeting with one of the Sales people there, they upsell memberships i guess, but would require 1 hour in the morning, which we kindly declined. after that, unresponsive and she was on a day off one of the days we were there and did not offer an alternate contact.  Eddie in Capella restaurant and Enrique and Flora at the pool however, were amazing!  Nice looking hotel, but will skip the higher pricetag.

reviews.author: nicole b
reviews.title: I really enjoyed myself  and the staff is truly amazing
reviews.text: Ok so I booked a package to stay at this hotel for a family vacation in October 2021. We had the lagoon view. Overall I had a great stay here. There are always some pros and cons. The first thing I would like to say is they have to do a little better with the check in process. They had us walking back and forth saying it would be quicker going to one check in desk over the other. It actually took a little longer than expected.  I must say the lady that checked us in definitely  helped with our accommodations. Now my other compliant with check in was no one gave us  tour or breaking down of the resort. We had to figure it ourselves. The room I had was great. My moms room, not so much there is a tree that needs to be cut down right in front of their terrace view. The shower curtains are sort of weird as well but I loved that it was a tub for my daughter.  Now the great part of the resort was the staff, the food, and the activities.  Oscar Valsquez at the front desk Amazing I will never forget him. The staff that worked the Malva (the food is pretty good we ate their often) the Nurbi,Alfredo Alvaro, Arturo, David.  Oh and the DJ that played there every night was supper nice. There are so many nice and hardworking staff members that work here.  They had activities every night we stayed. Room service was great 24hours. I had an issue with my safe, but they took care of that immediately. I feel they should play a variety of music at the pool. I love that the staff come down to the beach area to bring you your food and beverages. Oh they need to get a Golf Cart to take guest Down to the exit  of the resort the stairs are a lot to handle. A suggestion is to have a TacoTuesday Night. I just knew they would have one for guest. The Covid test was quick and easy I’m grateful they provide that on the resort. The resort is very clean. Oh and the violinist at Mulva was so talented. The kiddie pool shouldn’t  be so far from the adult pool.  Overall, I had good time and I would recommend the hotel.

reviews.author: Martha K
reviews.title: Wonderful weekend
reviews.text: A friend of fifty years and I spent a weekend in Cancun at the Paradisus. We had a great time, with good food and service. Just to mention a few of the people we were impressed by Jose, Josua, Alfredo, Norbia and Olympa. There were many others that I can't remember and almost everyone went over and above to make our stay memorable.

reviews.author: Joe D
reviews.title: The trip was fantastic, everyone was so friendly, we will be back again definitely!
reviews.text: Considering a Cancun vacation? Paradisus is your place, hands down. Fernanda in the front lobby was great and so friendly helping us with our covid test, also sent a gift to our room for our anniversary! Also Alfredo in the buffet was AWESOME, we sat with him for breakfast and lunch every day during our stay, he deserves a raise! He went above and beyond to make our meals a truly wonderful experience. Thank you so very much Alfredo! Also at Malva buffet, i want to recognize Javier Jimenez, Alis Puc, Veronica Mendoza, and many others who’s names I unfortunately didn’t get.  Alejandro helped us several times with general questions and was always friendly and so helpful. Jose at the front was also such a friendly and helpful guy, he really went out of his way to make us feel welcome and helped us with our bags, helped hail taxis for us and made sure we were taken care of at the front of the resort. Last but most certainly not least, our wonderful housekeeper Matilda. Thank you all, from the bottom of our hearts! We loved our stay and will most certainly be back as soon as possible, and can’t recommend enough for anyone reading this to vacation with this fine group of people!

reviews.author: julienQ4782WC
reviews.title: Look forward to returning
reviews.text: Recently returned from Paradisus Cancun reserve and had a great trip. Hotel was clean and well kept. Contrary to some reviews our room was nice and cool.Food was pretty good but we liked some places more then others. Spent a lot of time at the adult only reserve pool. The staff was great! Lucas ,Joel,Caesar were terrific. The entire staff was friendly and helpful. The morning wait staff  at Malva were really nice. Eddie,Blanca, Catherine,Janeth,Alexis and Bernardo. All in all great experience and would go again.

reviews.author: Bri E
reviews.title: Best trip ever!!!!
reviews.text: The resort is absolutely beautiful and my butler Violeta was extremely helpful and I wouldn't know what I would have done without her on my trip. Excellent service by staff and close to everything you want to see. I will definitely be back!!!

reviews.author: SKB
reviews.title: Amazing vacation at Paradisus Cancun!
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun was a great place. The service is impeccable. For breakfast we went to Malva buffet and our servers were Eddie, Armando, Alexis, Janeth, Martin, Bernardo, and Blanca. Every one of them was very attentive, always gave service with a smile and went out of their way to make sure we were more than accomodated.

At the Ginger bar, we had Gaby who hand crafted a special cucumber margarita for us, which was delicious! The servers at the Ginger bar were effecient without sacrificing the quality of the drinks. 

When checking in, we had Stephany who is the epitome of service with a smile. When we had a few questions about the room categories, she explained everything thoroughly and even gave us a mini-tour to help us make the best decision for us. 

Pool/beach service was great as well. Our server Manuel took our orders on the beach and always returned  quickly with anything we wanted. 

We also went to the YHI Spa which was a very relaxing experience. Our massage therapists Liliana and Daniela were very attentive and made sure we were comfortable and relaxed the whole time. 

The service and staff here at Paradisus Cancun are phenomenal and we will be returning in the future!

reviews.author: Emily448
reviews.title: Meh
reviews.text:
I booked this hotel after the most wonderful stay at the Paradisus La Perla in Playa Del Carmen in February 2020. I was under the impression that my family would be getting the same experience and unfortunately I shouldn’t assume things. 
I arrived at the hotel with my husband and 2 boys(6& 8). After about a 20 minute check in experience we found out our room wouldn’t be ready for an hour(3 pm). The bellman had already taken our luggage so all we could really do was sit around with 2 crazy kids. When we returned in an hour our room still wasn’t ready and ended up waiting another hour or so. 
They ended up giving us basically a ground floor/ basement room. I booked this trip back in March and I booked a 2 bedroom 2 bathroom suite. From the photos online it looked just like the Paradisus La Perla rooms but that couldn’t be farther from the truth. I booked through the Meliá website and when I did there was one price for the room I selected so I’m not sure why they acted like a better room was going to be an upgrade. 
After throwing a hissy fit which I never do they ended up giving us a room 2 floors up which was still nothing like the photos on the website. Oh well it’s just a room and I wasn’t going to ruin my vacation over it.
I thought when you checked in you were assigned a concierge  to help with dinner reservations, spa treatments and excursions which was what they do at the Paradisus La Perla. Again I was wrong. You have to call all the restaurants yourself and make reservations. When I asked the front desk about this they looked at me like I had 2 heads. My husband told me to lower my expectations so when I did that I was finally able to have fun.
Not sure about the kids club nobody told us anything about it and our boys were pretty bummed. Every time we walked by it was closed. My boys met a kid at the pool that said it opened at 2 but again we walked by it everyday at different times and it was dark. 
To us this place’s only saving grace was the food and beverage staff. While the food was mediocre the staff at the pool and in the restaurants were exceptional! It’s the only reason I’m giving a halfway decent review. I usually never write reviews especially bad ones but I just felt compelled to say something. Don’t get me wrong we still had a great time because we had fun with each other but this will be the last time I stay at a Meliá property.

reviews.author: Tatiana P
reviews.title: So good Above Expectations
reviews.text: We had the most wonderful time in this hotel, so impeccably clean, it smells good, the food is delicious, so many cute little things. All the staff are very attentive and nice, our concierge Violeta is a wonderful caring girl. This week of vacation - like in a truly paradise

reviews.author: Izzie
reviews.title: I would definitely go here again! Good food and excellent service. Very welcoming and helpful staff members
reviews.text:
I decided to write my first review on Tripadvisor as I was reading reviews here before leaving and a few reviews made me skeptical however I have returned from my vacation yesterday and it was one of the best vacations I’ve had! I’ve been to all inclusive resorts before but this was the best one I have been too. Special shout-out to John working at Malva, he was so hospitable and such a great individual. Additionally, all staff members were so sweet, on tops of things and welcoming! 

People reading reviews on this page: please don’t change trips based on a few different reviews, I nearly did it and I wouldn’t advise doing so! I’m glad I went and experience the resort myself. The food, ambiance, service everything was great. 

I was staying in a luxury junior oceanview suite room (these are newly renovated rooms, I did some research before booking). Only cons are that there is some construction happening but it won’t affect your personal experience at the resort, as long as that doesn’t bother you - you will have an AMAZING time! Highly recommend :)

reviews.author: royalicius
reviews.title: The absolute best all inclusive experience!
reviews.text:
As soon as you walk into the lobby of the Paradisus Resort you can tell there’s good vibes all around. Not only because of the state of the art infrastructure of the hotel and the high-end, high quality furniture and decoration, but especially because of the top notch service from its staff. 

I’ve had the pleasure to stay at a few all-inclusive resorts in other countries in the Caribbean, and I have to say the staff at the Paradisus hotel has been by far, the absolute best customer service experience of any resort so far. Here’s a few highlights:

- Karina from the G bar: Karina provides a level of customer service that is only topped by her incredible people skills. She is the epitome of the word service. She made my boyfriend and I feel at home, she went out of her way to make sure the two of us had a positive experience at the hotel party, bringing us and our friends our drinks at a speed that was unlike anything I have ever seen. Always with a positive attitude and with words of care. If there’s one thing we took away from our trip, it was her incredible people skills and service. We can’t wait to come back next year and do it all again, and that’s in great part thanks to her absolutely incredible service.

-Alfredo from the capella Italian restaurant: on our last night, our group of friends decided to make a reservation at the one restaurant we hadn’t tried yet, and boy were we in for a treat! As soon as we shared with Alfredo that was our last night at the restaurant, he took it upon himself to create the most unbelievable dinning experience we had on our entire trip. From bringing tons of appetizers for us to try before we even ordered any, all the way to bringing a couple of superior quality bottles to our table (on the house!) to celebrate our last night at the resort. Alfredo was one of the best servers we had on our trip and also contributed to our feeling of satisfaction and eagerness to return next year.

Eddie from the buffet/fuego restaurant: Eddie was one of those people who exudes kindness. Something that in our opinion is absolutely a must in customer service. He made sure we were having a positive experience by checking in on our table often, quickly bringing anything additional thing we ordered, topping up our drinks, you name it. His kindness made us all feel at home and also contributed to making Paradisus an unbelievable experience.

Other highlights of the trip were the very high quality food (none of us got sick), the DELICIOUS drinks, how accommodating every single staff member was, the clean pools, the massages, the team at the guest service desk and their helpfulness with some mailing things we needed. 

Paradisus was an incredible experience and I guarantee that by the end of it, you will feel that every penny was so very worth the experience. Definitely the type of experience where investing in creating unforgettable memories outweighs any other type of cost. You will not regret booking your vacation here.

reviews.author: kacay
reviews.title: not for the price
reviews.text:
we visit the hotel for 5 days ,this was my second time in this place but it was only melia at that time so i had a big expectations from this place and the price.
Checking was slow and with many disinformation ,they send us to a room that was occupied wen we came back to the reception .it took 2 hours to find us another room.
And not information at all about the hotel amenities( she told me go to the hotel app for any information. The room was nice clean the air conditioner was not very cold we called maintenance bu they never show up. if you want good service dont forget to TIP because if not you are going to be invisible .waiters look that they dont want to be bother and if you speak spanish the treatment is going to be different . also the hotel is under construction at the center lobby so be prepare for a lot of dust and noise.the service at the beach very poor only one sever for the entire beach.drinks also poor quality .nobody wear a face mask ,the swimming pool and the buffet very crowded .the have covid test at the hotel for free you have to book it through your phone .

reviews.author: Melissa B
reviews.title: Great All Around Family Vacation
reviews.text: Paradisus has everything you need to enjoy your vacation with or without the family! Many restaurants to choose from from Italian, Latin,Seafood, Mexican and a delicious Steak house, Sal! The entertainment here is like none other, we met Agustin from the entertainment team on our first day here and he has gone above and beyond to make our daughter and us feel welcome. He goes out of his way to find us and include us. Everything from teaching us card tricks to salsa dancing! I can’t say enough about the fun we have had. If you haven’t been to a silent party you need come to Paradisus Cancun on a Saturday night and check it out!!! Definitely coming back

reviews.author: Lauren C
reviews.title: Mole at Mole
reviews.text: Dinner with Carlos at Mole was excellent!  The food and the wine was delicious and the service was so good.  Order the pork leg, and sea bass mole! Plus the 'of the comal' a sampler of 3 Mexican classic bites. Came here on an anniversary and had a great time.

reviews.author: Matthew R
reviews.title: Beach Dinner
reviews.text:
Guendoline Flores Premium Moments

She prepared a dinner last minute for myself and girlfriend. She was so sweet and reliable. There needs to be more people who work like that at the resort. My dinner was perfect and romantic. I would highly recommend her services.

reviews.author: Bud V.
reviews.title: Quiet and Loud!
reviews.text:
We visited the resort a few weeks ago, here's a quick review.  Its our 2nd time at this resort, we stayed Reserve side and they tried to pull that BS no rooms in tower 5 crap, but we can give you a crappy room in tower 3 for 1 night and then move you on Sunday.  We were like, no way, find us a room.  Long story short and 3 hours later with the help of the Hotel Mgr., we were back in Tower 5 where we should have been all along. A horrible start to the week.

Room was clean and stayed somewhat cool as you had to pull the shades closed.  Our concierge was useless and certainly earned their no tip. Typically, for any kind of decent service, I tip $100 for the week.  We only saw the concierge 3 times during the whole week and all they did for us was make reservations at the restaurant.  We did, however, tip the pool man and the pool wait staff well all week.  A $10er a day ensured we were in the same bali bed every day with the small hassle of checking in at 9:00 AM. 

The adult pool was quiet most of the week, but the crowd got a lot younger, louder and drunker as the week ended.  We ventured over to the other (family) pool one day for about 30 minutes for the pool party and found it wholly unentertaining, especially with the language, smoking  (you name it, it was burning...) and the presence of 2 blow up dolls.  Not our scene.  Beach was rough most of the week and quieted down enough late in the week for a dip.

Food was OK, we didn't go hungry, but we avoided the buffet as much as possible.  Restaurants were good, we loved Mole, Capella dinner took forever, and Fuego is nice because you are outside. 

Nightlife and shows left a lot to be desired. All were moved inside to the Ginger Bar to varying degrees of success. The Sports Bar was a nice way to end the night. 
Covid tests were easy to schedule and we were in and out in less than 15 minutes.  Results were emailed later in the day.

Overall, we had an enjoyable time.  Monday through Thursday were the most enjoyable days as the crowds were smaller and more quiet, weekends were more crowded and rowdy (inconsiderate).  We will return again, but try to avoid the weekend during our next stay.

reviews.author: MT N
reviews.title: 9/23/21-9/27/21: WORST HOTEL EXPERIENCE OF MY LIFE. 0/10 DO NOT RECCOMMEND AT ALL
reviews.text:
100% NOT A 5 STAR EXPERIENCE. This was honestly the absolute worst hotel experience of my life. I've had much better experiences at a Motel 6

I was here with my friends for a Jack-n-Jill Bachelor/Bachelorette Party. 10 guys + 10 girls. The bride and groom are very organized and called 1 week ahead of our arrival date to confirm and smooth out any details to make sure there were no hiccups. Paradisus Cancun assured us everything was set and in place. WRONG

All guys + bride and I arrived together on the first day and the rest of the girls were to arrive the day after. 

1st Day: Everything was pretty OK at first except the hotel itself was outrageously HOT & HUMID on the INSIDE. So hot and humid that when you walk in, you start sweating immediately to soak your clothes. I have no idea why but the very center of the hotel was set up like a GREENHOUSE. Constantly uncomfortable. Even more unfortunate, our room was humid as well. We couldn't sleep through the night bc of it. I had to call maintenance twice and they still wouldn't fix it and told us the temp was fine. Only until the groom got involved and then finally on the 3rd time, it was fixed. Seriously? On top of that, they gave the guys the wrong rooms. Each room was supposed to have 2 guys per room with 2 beds. They gave each room 1 bed each and wouldn't give them the correct rooms since they were "booked up"

 2nd Day: All the rest of the girls arrived. We tried to check them in and the front LOST all of their reservations. How do you lose 8 whole reservations?? Then they had to scramble and made them wait an extra 2 hours until they could check into their rooms. This was ridiculous, what kind of a "5 Star" Hotel has no idea what's going on and was constantly getting EVERYTHING wrong. They tried to appease us with discounted Spa bookings but they said that they weren't sure if they could get us in because the schedule was booked. ....Then why even pretend to offer us anything? What kind of lack of common sense is this. Then a manager was like ok, for all the trouble, we'll adjust your bookings for ~$900 to ~$600. So we were like ok, can we have that in writing or printed out. They were " Ahhh no, believe us! Don't worry, don't worry, we'll take care of it. Come back tomorrow and we can show you." Suspicious but we were already wasting so much time trying to constantly fix their mistakes instead of enjoying this vacation for the Bride & Groom. So we went to try and enjoy the rest of our day.

3rd Day: In the AM, the girls took a shuttle to XCarat and the boys went to Xelha! XCarat was like a themepark water, safari, zoo experience. Super unique! The closing show is SOO worth it 10/10. Super fun and everything went smooth. Got back to the hotel around 11pm, super tired and drained but we stopped by the front and told them we would be back in the AM for the print-out.

4th Day: In the AM, went to the front once again to check if they confirmed our adjustments in the system. And of course, the front desk ppl still has no idea what's going on and they're saying there's no adjustment and the price is still ~$900. WTF is this?? Called another manager, explained what happened and was told "Ohhh my gosh so sorry, ya'll should be drinking tequila! Not dealing with this!" Uh huh. Then we were promised that it would be adjusted and if we came back tomorrow, the print-out would be ready for us bc they had to wait for upper management to do a final sign-off on it. We said no, we're going to come back tonight for it.

Showed up in the PM, they gave us the print-out. Ok, great, finally. They finally did something right. HAHHH, wrong.

5th Day : This was our last day. During check-out we all showed up and gave them the print-out and the front checked the system. They told us that they don't see what's on the print-out. WHAT? COME ON. Jesus, what is wrong with them? They called the manager, ALEXIS, then the front girl gave us the front desk phone and told us here you deal with it. LOL?! So the bride took the phone and spoke with the manager, ALEXIS and he straight up said "Oh my mistake, it's still ~$900" . We were all FURIOUS, to the point the bride started angry tearing.  At this point we were standing up at the front for 45 min now and the groom said to just leave it for now and they'll email corporate bc we couldn't miss our flights home. And during this time, a line of 15+ people were forming behind us and they still had no common sense to open up another check-in station to help accommodate the other guests until the other guests start complaining why they wouldn't LOLL

They literally lied to us constantly and continuously to get us to shut up and go away. Completely unprofessional and they absolutely have no idea what they're doing in the slightest.

This was hands-down the worst hotel experience all of us has ever had and lots of us have traveled all over. Everywhere in the U.S, Hawaii, Canada, China, Vietnam, France, Germany, Spain, Africa etc... PARADISUS CANCUN WAS AN ABSOLUTE TRASH EXPERIENCE. Totally ruined the whole Bachelor/Bachelorette for the Bride and Groom. Melia is the parent company and all of us will NEVER book at any of their establishments again.

Btw, the managers we dealt with were: Alexis, Daniella and David, all unqualified.

Besides that, the internal buffet, Malva, the food selection was pretty good. Breakfast was better than dinner but the waiters and waitresses there are PHENOMENAL. They remembered ALL of our names and constantly checked up on us. They seem to be the only ones that knows what the hell is going on and how to treat guests. Give them a raise and have them handle the front desk and be the managers.

reviews.author: Frankie D
reviews.title: A must resort to stay at in Cancun 100%
reviews.text:
Beautiful place & excellent services. Top notch, worth every dollar spent. Everything was great from arriving with Raul taking care of our luggages- Sarah at check in for going above and beyond to help us and explained everything since it’s our group first time in Cancun/ Paradisus. All the restaurants were excellent- Jonathan at Fuego is your go to man, Carina at Ginger, Alfredo at Cappella are all grate and so courteous and welcoming. There are so many staff and they all were great but we had our favourite hence the specific names shout out. The resort is beautiful and great but the staff was truly what made this even more special. They made us feel so welcome and like old friends. Very attentive and polite and kind. 

One thing worth mentioning is Covid protocol for anyone worries about that. The staff constantly cleaning and always wearing masks. I’ve observed staff interacting with each other and when no guests were around and they still had their masks on. 

Nothing bad to say about this place. Please definitely check out Paradisus if you come to Cancun… and just enjoy everything this place has to offer

reviews.author: Fernanda D
reviews.title: Incredible!!!
reviews.text:
We were very pleased with our time at Paradisus. The food, service, and entertainment were incredible! At breakfast, we were greeted with the biggest smile from Martin who became our friend throughout our stay and made sure we had a warm welcome literally every time. Then, the bartenders at the pool went above and beyond having our drinks ready and greeting us as we swam up to the bar every single day. Thank you Seney and Orlando! The buffet had excellent options and everything was so clean and presented very well. Our dinner at Mole restaurant was amazing. Shoutout to Victor and Ian for making us feel so special! The nightly shows were also very well put together and exceeded our expectations. Thank you Paradisus staff for an amazing trip, we hope to be back soon!

Cons: construction going on and if you have a room facing the main atrium, you will hear music until 12am (might need to request a room in a different area if that bothers you).

reviews.author: CSanchez24
reviews.title: Horrible Experience Deal w/ Transfers via Paradisus!!
reviews.text: Been to hotel previously and booked transport via Expedia and zero issues. Today, we are stuck at airport after emailing hotel multiple times and even calling hotel directly. Paradisus still couldn’t get it right. Never staying here again! BEWARE!!!

reviews.author: Syed C
reviews.title: Malva resturant good service
reviews.text: Food is great and qualità is also good. Large selection food only thing is missing fried rice. All other cuisine is available atleast once during my 7 days of stay. Server and service is very nice. On the table we only have fork and knife provided, we had to ask separately . Since they have soup for lunch and dinner and cereal/oatmeal for breakfast they should have either spoon provided the table upon seating or spoon should  be on the station.  It so annoying wait for spoon while soup getting cold.

reviews.author: LJ W
reviews.title: Lives up to the name
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed here for our honeymoon and it was magical. The views are breathtaking, the staff is AMAZING and will do everything they can to make you comfortable and happy. Highly recommend The Reserve upgrade, as it gets you access to exclusive parts of the hotel (an additional restaurant, another bar and separate pool area and cabanas facing the ocean) You also get a personal concierge! Ours, Betsy, was outstanding. We love her. The servers are very attentive and friendly, we especially appreciated Oscar and Josue. The food is great, the drinks aren’t weak, all inclusive at its finest. Stay here if you can!

reviews.author: jrm4013
reviews.title: Our trip to Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
My wife and I recently booked a week at the Paradisus Cancun property in the Reserve, Deluxe Ocean View Suite.  We had high expectations after visiting the Paradisus resort in Punta Cana a few years ago.  After arriving at the hotel, we were ushered from the main building (#3) to the Reserve building (#5).  We did have to wait about 30 minutes while they checked in couples in front of us, but Joel at the Royal Services bar hooked us up with a couple of Cadillac Margaritas.  Our concierge was very attentive and got us everything we asked for even though we only saw him a few times during our stay.

Room
The room was extremely clean and had a fantastic view.  Rooms were cleaned well each day and the minibar was restocked all days, except one.  The room service menu was prompt, but the menu was someone limited.  We did have a difficult time getting the temperature down.

Pool/Beach
We had a cabana by the Reserve pool each day and service was excellent.  Everyday, we had a different guy and all of them are fantastic.  If you want a the breeze from the beach, I'd recommend a cabana on the beach side near the hedges.  We spent sometime on the beach as well.  The beachfront downstairs from the Reserve area wasn't large, but our goal was to just chill, zone out and listen to the crash of the waves.  

We did spend one afternoon at the main pool, swim up bar where we experienced great service there as well.

Dining
We tried most of the restaurants.  I agree with a lot of the other reviews in that the food was not the best we've ever had.  Our favorite was Blue Agave.  The main building has a major renovation going on in the main area which can be loud during the day.  The guys at the Reserve bar were always available for a night cap.

Overall
I can't say enough about the service team Paradisus Cancun has.  I would recommend bringing at least $50 in one dollar bills for tips, as getting change is nearly impossible.  COVID tests were a little confusing, but ended up getting through in about 20 minutes.  I wouldn't wait until your last morning to schedule though.

reviews.author: Tamrat T
reviews.title: Buffet Services
reviews.text:
Alfredo Alvaro was one of the kind and great guy. During our stay at this resort, he served us with smile and happy face. He takes his job seriously and excellent at it. I personally believe this is the kind of a guy that the hotel need to recognize and promote him. 

His two coworkers Alexis Ozuna and Pascual Franco also served us with drinks. They show us appreciation for visiting Cancun and we were happy for that.  

This guys are fantastic five star staff

reviews.author: christak2142021
reviews.title: Room issues
reviews.text: We had multiple issues with all 3 rooms we were given. The last room we decided to just deal with the issues as we didn’t want to waste anymore of our time on the room. The restaurant food was good. The Buffett food wasn’t great other than at breakfast. Two servers at the Malva Buffett made our experience wonderful-Atilano and Gaudencio .

reviews.author: saba k
reviews.title: Our visit as Circle Memebers
reviews.text:
We've been coming to Cancun Paradisus since over 10yrs. There have been many changes but we've adopted to them. This time our visit was very different and we brought up all of the changes that don't work for us. We were heard and found a temporary solution to the problem. 

As Circle Members we would like our initial check in to be at pyramid one and we would like to have the same bracelet at Club Members until everything is sorted out and preferably they make new bands for Circle Members because there are many benefits that were limited to us. If I booked with reserve I will not be able to take advantage to pool with kids so it doesn't make sense.

On the positive note we were very happy to see our old friends like Sergio, Elliot, Luis, Fernando, Manuel at the pool and made new friends like Oswaldo who made Amazing Mango Margaritas and Nuri that helped us with food. 

I would like to give a special Thanks to:
 Gaudencio, Martin, Orlando, Richie at breakfast. We loved seeing Maritza and Manuel at dinner.

Kids Club and Activities would not have been the same without: Axcel, Saul, and Nicole. Special Thanks to them. They offered to help with our special needs son. Very Grateful for them. 

Captains of restaurants: Denise, Hugo, and Carlos made everything So easy. They are Amazing and I Really Hope to see them again next year. 

Our Concierge: Margarita and Jose helped us find the right room and took care of l of our needs. So grateful for them. 

A Very Special Thanks to Betsy....our friend for years now. Betsy is Amazing and knows what she's doing. Paradisus is Home especially because of her. She has seen our kids grow. Thank you for everything.

Hope to return next year as Circle Members and 'm hoping we can check in at Pyramid one as we did as Club Members and things are better sorted out.

reviews.author: Pamelalee1952
reviews.title: some great some not so great
reviews.text:
The first person we came in contact with at the resort was Olimpia during check in.  Through out our stay she was an outstanding contact, always courteous, friendly and very helpful.

The overall resort was very nice and we really enjoyed the beautiful pool and the friendly staff at the swim up bar. 

The food was acceptable but nothing great.  While many of the meals were not particularly bad there was not a single one that I would order again

reviews.author: Ashar K
reviews.title: Yearly trip to Paradisus Family
reviews.text:
We come to Cancun every year since 2015. Our kids grew in front of the many staff members here and many who moved to other locations. We keep coming back here because it feels like home. They love our kids like their own and treat my special needs son with a lot of love. This time, we brought my sister in law and her family with us and they loved it. Few highlights of our trip.

Our  Concierge - YoLie (Margarita) and Jose May made our trip great. We know Jose for three years now and he is family. YoLei took care of our needs, help with special sleeping arrangements and the perfect room.

Pool - Elliot  found the best Bali beds for us and my sister in law everyday. Raul made great drinks.

Enso - Roberto gave us excellent service during our dinner. We also met the manager Denise and built great relationship with her. She made our trip absolutely special. Even when she wasn't at Enso because it was closed, she met us at Fuego and helped get all the help with my kids. We love her.

Capella - Hugo made our dinners so very special. He made arrangements for us and accommodated us when we needed help with reservations. The food was great at Capella and that's why we ate there 3 times out of 7. Jimmy was big help at our dinner.

Buffet - Gaudencio is a pleasure to see every year for last three years. He took such a good care. Martin, Alhandro, and rest made sure we were taken care of. 

Sport bar - Yasina and Sergio made great drinks and made sure our glasses were full and drinks were yummy. The tomato and Tamarind margarita were excellent.

Ginger bar - Kuddos to Gaby, Yuan, Giovanni for making the drinks special for us.

And last, we met our old friend Marcia a d Betsy. Merica used to be at the front desk at buffet and Betsy was our club melia host. Both moved on to other positions but they made sure we were taken care of. Betsy went out of her way to connect us with Ricardo at circle so that our feedback is properly given to the management to make the experience even better.

reviews.author: Angie P
reviews.title: Great service at the Bars and Buffet
reviews.text:
We stayed at Paradisus Cancun to celebrate our 1st wedding anniversary this weekend. The first day, we were not happy at all because we are unable to get into our room because of the bracelets. We had to walk back to GS 3 times and complain until a lady was nice enough to walk with us and make sure we got into the room. We were moved to another room, as the view was not what I had booked. I actually did our main check-in online through the Melia app and we were given a free upgrade because of a previous trip and birthday promotion. We were never really upgraded though, even though I mentioned it twice and showed them the confirmation of the complimentary offer. We left it alone because we still had a nice view since I paid for a Luxury Ocen View Suite. 

We never met our concierge and no one ever scheduled our covid tests. Luckily, we have stayed at other Melia locations, so we knew the deal and we handled it ourselves. The food was very dissappointing except for the VIP treatment at the pool, since we paid an extra $220 for a private cabana. That experience alone made the whole trip worth it. I must admit that even with all of the negative things that happened, the service the bar guys, buffet guys and pool was amazing. I normally don’t eat nachos but that was hands down the best thing I ate the whole trip!!

reviews.author: 748richard
reviews.title: Server, Veronica Mendosa
reviews.text:
Amazing, friendly and super helpful with helping us have a good time! 
So great I loved it.
We got a Miami Vice and it was amazing.
Deliciousio as far as drinks go and my friends and I had a good time and the service was incredible

reviews.author: Robert W
reviews.title: Fantastic week at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: My wife and I ate at all the restaurants at Paradisus Cancun. Our favorite was Mole hands down. Ask for the mole negro. It's something to be admired. Great food and service. This was our first experience at an all inclusive and it did not disappoint.

reviews.author: Rebekah M
reviews.title: Rebekah and Corey
reviews.text: Such an amazing time!!! The whole staff is AMAZING ! we are vegan and the chefs and waiters really did everything to make our trip great! Manny, Miguel, Jamir at the reserve pool bar are the best! We will be returning to see them!!! Wendy at sports bar was amazing every night we went there!! Artur and Atiliano at the buffet were great!! The chef at mole made us special food and we ended up eating there Multple times!!  Janick was our concierge and he went above and beyond to do everything for us! He helped decorate my friends Bali bed and made her birthday super special!!!  The hotel is gorgeous! I cannot say enough about the staff! The Bali beds at the reserve pool are a must!!!! Overall 10/10!!!!! Thank you all!!!! See ya soon!

reviews.author: TGabor1123
reviews.title: Memorable family vacation
reviews.text:
This is our "home away from home" for our family of 9. We visit this resort 1 to 2 times a year and love every minute of it.

The COVID protocols they have in place are really amazing and made us feel very safe during our stay.
 
Our trip this year was unlike any other due Hurricane Delta.  Our most heartfelt thanks to Jorge for personally taking care of our family and securing lodging in Merida. Jorge kept in touch with us during the storm and helped relocate us to Playa Del Carmen property once the storm was over since we couldn't return to Paradisus Cancun. 

Betsy at Members check in helped us during our stay and also provided help during our emergency checkout. 

Thank you Jorge and Betsy, we can't wait to see you on our next vacation!

reviews.author: Rina Rangel
reviews.title: Husbands birthday getaway
reviews.text: Like to thank the gm Andrew for getting us set up with our room and our butler Rodolfo!  Rodolfo was amazing! He checked on us throughout our trip and made sure we had every thing we needed!  He went over and beyond!! I wish I could upload a birthday video he sent us singing my husband happy birthday in Spanish it was amazing!

reviews.author: Thomas R
reviews.title: Birthday  weekend
reviews.text: I love this place, the Reserve side room we stayed at is beautiful along with other places throughout  the resort.  The staff is awesome, friendly and very attentive. Its very clean, with with beautiful  pools and views...Hats off to our butler  Rodolfo  who made it a special birthday weekend. He was on top of everything. I highly recommend him to service  you, he made sure you had no worries. Also i would like to thank  the manager Andrew as well... Thank  both of you for a memorable vacation and experience. 😊

reviews.author: C. Moore
reviews.title: Great service!  Loved Rodolfo!
reviews.text: Our family spent 4 nights at the resort in the Reserve section. The resort provides excellent service all around with very friendly and attentive staff.  We had butler service in the Reserve and Rodolfo went above and beyond any expectations we might have had.  He made the trip great!

reviews.author: Lauren E
reviews.title: Clean, excellent service
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus in their first reopening week. Their cleanliness measures are unmatched and I felt safer here than the USA (regarding COVID-19). The property is beautiful and there are several poolside cabanas/chairs etc. The beach access is also great. Even better, our butler Rodolfo was incredible. The service was quick, polite and always made sure we were happy. Rodolfo went above and beyond service standards as we stayed in the Reserve at 5704. Thank you Rodolfo! We will come back.

reviews.author: prettyinpink99
reviews.title: Beautiful property
reviews.text: We arrived October 1st, the official reopening since Covid started earlier this year. We weren't sure what to expect. They've been very cautious and prepared for the health and safety of their guests by having special mats, sanitizers and social distancing floor indicators at every entrance of the restaurants/bars. They even sanitized our luggage when we arrived. We'll be here for 12 days and so far all the employees have shown exemplary service. They all go out of their way to be helpful. We had a few issues with the sink and toilet. However, the manager offered a bottle of Moet Chandon for the inconvenience. They still offer buffets but with more of a cafeteria style serving. The food laid out are mostly snack type so you have to order your  entrees through your waiter. Also, although they have 9 restaurants only 3 are currently open but the front desk said it was due to the small number of guests. I'd  like to specifically mention Edier at Fuego who went out of his way to offer chicken soup, that was not on the menu, to our 15 yr old who had a little bit of tummy ache. I hope this post helps others like myself who had questions prior to booking. We will continue to post throughout our trip.

reviews.author: Claud
reviews.title: Beautiful location
reviews.text:
We stayed here for a week vacation with the kids. The hotel is beautiful and very clean. Amazing amenities . Luxury designs. Friendly staff. Great food. 
We would definitely stay here again and i would highly recommend it to friends and family.

reviews.author: Jermaine J
reviews.title: Great customer service
reviews.text: Yesterday in October 1, 2020 had the pleasure to have the help from Julian Ortega who was completely helpful and explained the experience we was about to have at Paradisus. He went through all of the things we can experience and was great thank you for making our experience perfect.

reviews.author: Great times
reviews.title: Great people!
reviews.text: From the time we got here the people were great. Check was a great Julian Ortega gave us great service.  Come see for yourself!enjoy your best life. The beach is beautiful the food is great. Suport them like you did before covid👍 safe travels

reviews.author: Berhanu S
reviews.title: Gorgeous property
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed here for a quick getaway and it exceeded all of our expectations. Their customer service was unmatched and their food was delicious. Not your typical all inclusive food. More like a 5 star high end restaurant quality. We have to give a shout out to one of their staff members, Julian Ortega. He really stood out and went above and beyond for us and met all your needs. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Golf & Beaches
reviews.title: Excellent Family Concierge!
reviews.text:
My wife, 2mo. Old son and I stayed here at Paradisus Cancun for a short quick family bonding. Got the all-inclusive deal and family concierge. Hotel is decent, not a brand new one but decent. What we loved about the hotel was the excellent family.concierge service! Our butler Gloria and Fernando was the best!!! We were so thankful we had them during our stay and was very helpful esp. we brought a 2 month old baby :) Our butlers was just a ”whatsapp” away, from 8am-11pm, you may ask them to help you restaurant reservations, they even took our baby’s milk in the room while we were in the pool area and ran out of it. Gloria helped us get our stroller when we were in the middle of dining at Mole Restaurant and needed our baby to be put in the stroller while my wife and I eat. The Family Concierge receptionists are amazing as well! Super friendly, cheerful and really hospitable. 

We also love our stay at the Bali Cabana, our server Jorge was super hospitable! He makes.sure we have our drinks, snacks and served us with the Seafood Platter! 

Rooms are okay, not the best but it is clean and fridge are always refilled everyday. 

We love the family concierge.lounge as there were free snacks and drinks all.day everyday! We made a good choice.choosing Paradisus Cancun for our family bonding. We are definitely coming back with our whole family some time next year :) 

Thank you Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: patriciaf592018
reviews.title: Wonderful Cancun
reviews.text:
I visited Cancun in October the weather was very nice at 31 degrees with a very high humidity that made it feel like 38 degrees, I can't complain as I left a cold country so appreciated the heat. As we drove to our hotel I was taken aback to how nice the surroundings were. After a long hot and exhausting journey from the airport we were greeted at the hotel with a nicely scented and calming cold towel which made us feel so much better. the staff from the beginning made us feel so welcomed, once checked in we were driven to our room in a golf cart which was nice as we were extremely tired. We had a nice room with a swim up pool my son could not wait to get into. Our stay at this hotel has been wonderful, the decor and layout of the hotel is exceptional and admired so much the work that had gone into the building of it.  Each morning as we left our room for breakfast we were greeted by staff with a lovely smile and a Ola ( hello or a good morning) so nice to see the staff enjoying their work, Paradisus has to pride themselves on the staff who puts out such a lovely greeting to their customers and the advise and expertise shown by all.  staff was always on hand to help and assist where possible. Paradisus is a great hotel for family and couples as there is an adult only side which we were able visit and make use of the restaurants and other things available to us.  
As the weather was so hot and humid it was nice having the air condition in the room but certain areas like some of the bars did not have fans which made me not want stay at the bar as it was so humid and as nice as the staff were and pleasant I felt sorry for them as we could see how they were suffering from the humidity also and was sweating a lot, it would be nice if fans could be installed over the bars and areas where staff were seated selling tours and reservations for restaurant. Management please take into consideration that if your staff are happy and comfortable in what they do then this will be passed onto customers making them even more happy, please take this into account and provide fans for your staff.    

My holiday came to end too quickly and wished I could have stayed longer, I will be back to visit all those I have met on this trip such as Arianna on the tour desk, Daniel who was so helpful anytime we had a query and Monseratt who along with others greeted and showed us to our seating each morning for breakfast.  I would like to praise our  room cleaners who did an excellent job in the morning and in the evening they provided everything we needed, thank you to them. 
We had a lovely holiday and thank you for making this possible.

reviews.author: Alma B
reviews.title: Great Experience!
reviews.text: From beginning to end great service. The staff very professional, kind and helpful. We had a private dinner by the beach and Veronica, the young lady that took care of us did an extraordinary job from beginning to end, Moises, our server did an excellent job! Our butler, Fernando and Maria, great! I highly recommend this place! Thank you for making our stay memorable! Food and drinks delicious!

reviews.author: Wander133201
reviews.title: That was very memorable experience.
reviews.text: I will recommend this place to everyone who is planing to visit Cancun. Location of this hotel is gorgeous. Hotel by it self is very beautiful and original and most important, very clean. Staff very friendly and helpful. Over all review - excellent - that was amassing time - Thank You.

reviews.author: JoshyPenguin
reviews.title: Not delivering to potential
reviews.text:
The hotel is in a fabulous location on the Cancun strip with a glorious white sand beach and clear sea. The interior of the hotel also looks impressive with greenery and water features. 

In addition the service we received was efficient and very friendly.

However there were a number of areas where the hotel didn't deliver:
- our check in experience was remarkably similar to a previous poster below. We were staying in a suite for 5 but the room only had bedding available for 2. We had to chase twice to get this rectified. When you have children and recognising the material time difference for us this wasn't a great start. In addition I would have hoped that previous feedback would have been heeded.
- two out of the five of us had food poisoning
- the a la carte restaurants were good but difficult to get a reservation. The quality of food at buffets was poor and became quite repetitive.
- for one a la carte restaurant they were apparently overbooked so we were moved to a nearby restaurant but with the same menu. Felt like second class citizens.

Overall it was an ok holiday but felt like it should have been better still...

reviews.author: MakiOsterhout
reviews.title: No Kids Trip!
reviews.text: This is our 3rd time at a Paradisus Resort, the 2nd time at Paradisus Cancun. We can't say enough good things with the Royal Service side of the resort. The royal service staff goes above and beyond for service, food and drinks are great- sometimes even better then eating in the restaurants. If you want a vacation where you are 20mins from the airport and relaxing is your main event- THIS IS THE PLACE FOR YOU! Between the pool and beach- its worth every penny!!

reviews.author: Fowler
reviews.title: All excellent, only foods/restaurants need to be improved
reviews.text:
We spent a week in October at Paradisus Cancun. We paid a little extra to upgrade room to Ocean View which we think is worthy. The Ocean view is so beautiful and every morning you could see the sunrise which is amazing. They refilled the mini bar in the room everyday to provide enough drink to your room. In addition, the design of Paradisus is amazing and it’s a very clean resort.
The white sandy beach is very beautiful, even with a little seaweeds, but won’t bother you. I played volleyball/soccer with my kids. 
The service people always smile and satisfy your needs anytime. My sons enjoyed the time at kids zone with all nice animators, such as Nicole, Saul,Adriana and all others. They provided many activities like sports, handcraft, bakery, video games/movies...
The only thing I think Paradisus needs to improve is the foods quality and variety in their restaurants.

reviews.author: Sydnee H
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text:
When you first get here they welcome you like royalty. It is an beautiful place, the food is outstanding and amazing. There is one thing are family did not like it was the only thing we did not like the hotel building 3 floor 0 and 1 had the strongest smell my family had smelled in a long time. The rooms were great, the maids were awesome our room was so organized. It is a great place. We would come back!!  
The pics are from are balcony

reviews.author: KevMel
reviews.title: Our servers everyday for breakfast lunch and dinner were phenomenal
reviews.text: The hotel was stunning and clean, amazing staff on hand and always freindly.  The hotel was quite and relaing we had a suite and it was beautiful.   The beach was breathtaking! The restaurants on site were delicious and the staff was accomodating. The waiters  Atilano, Ignacio , Enso   were awesome!

reviews.author: Kimberly S
reviews.title: Another beautiful October at Paradisus
reviews.text: Our 4th stay. Definitely not our last. Invited another couple with us and they loved Royal Service and can’t wait to return. Can’t wait to see you all again: Melina, Hector, Daniel, Victor, Eddie, Cesar, Valeria. You all are the reason our vacations are always perfect!!

reviews.author: Ashkani
reviews.title: All inclusive hotel with good kids care
reviews.text:
I stayed at this hotel on early October for 10 days with my wife and little 3 years kid.
We had very relaxing time during our stay with nice and clean room, delicious and wide verities of foods and drinks and top of that we used the kids club which gave us some relief by dropping the little one for some hours to be able have a free time for ourselves.
The daycare opens from 9am and closes at 9pm, there are two category, below 5 years and above 5.
The place was very nice and big, the mids enjoys to play there with indoor and outdoor activities, even they take them to lunch!!!
I'like to really appreciate and thanks all staff who were so kind, specially Tannya Fernando and Nicolle Pauloi for their kind care of my kid.

Regards,
Ashkan

reviews.author: BrandonG23631
reviews.title: Absolute fantastic experience, we’ll be back in March!
reviews.text: My girlfriend and I vacationed to Mexico for the first time, Decided to stay at the Paradisus resort in Cancun. We both had such a great experience, that made us decide to think about booking again in March! Stellar service, they treat you like family, Big thanks to Victor Rodriguez, Josue Velazquez, and Carlos Gonzalez for making our trip an absolute incredible experience, pleasure meeting you guys!!

reviews.author: 609stay
reviews.title: “Paradisus” it was
reviews.text: Superb holiday: great hotel, beach, food, drink, entertainment, facilities, proximity to the airport (without being on the flight path), staff, weather (despite the Met Office’s dire forecast) and no bugs/mosquitos. Hope I haven’t missed anything ...oh we had great company too, and other guests were friendly. Amazing holiday.

reviews.author: Bob S
reviews.title: Beautiful place , but.....
reviews.text: My wife and I visited last week along with my 23 year old daughter. We did Royal Service which comes with an assigned “butler” and is in the adults only section of the hotel. Butler is really a service professional who is assigned to you but also services several other guests. More of like a personal concierge. Norma our butler was fantastic. She comes up to your room with you, shows you the amenities, naked restaurant and cabana reservations for you. Basically attends to all your needs. The hotel and grounds are beautiful. Really nice pools and beach. Cabanas are really nice too. Service on grounds was wonderful. Big shout outs to Daniel ( service supervisor) , Orlando, Eddie, Javier, and Oscar. They always made sure we had a drink of a bite to eat. Where the hotel faltered and the reason it didn’t get 5 stars from me was the food. It just wasn’t good. We first went to Bana , their sushi restaurant and it was awful . Sushi just didn’t taste fresh . It seemed it was frozen and the defrosted. We walked out. Their taco restaurant , Blue Agave, wasn’t much better. My daughter referred to it as dog food. Market Grill was ok, as was breakfast buffet which was a bit disappointing. My wife was sick with diarrhea for 2 days and I got a 24 hour bug. Food was so bad we went off property in 2 evenings. Not what you expect to do at an all inclusive. Best restaurant was La Playaba on Royal Service side. Even Mole , their Mexican restaurant had bad appetizers but decent mains. This should be a five star destination, but the food has to improve immensely.

reviews.author: Worldtravelerwannabe
reviews.title: Great Resort and Fabulous Service
reviews.text: Norma was a fantastic butler.  She had our room decorated with rose petals and a bottle of champagne for our anniversary upon arrival. She tended to all our needs plus more! The rest of the staff took phenomenal care of us as well. The service here is superb! This was my second stay and won't be our last!

reviews.author: Sanda
reviews.title: Celebrated Dad's 60th 🎈
reviews.text: My husband and I have stayed at this resort 3 years ago for our honeymoon and already knew what paradise we were coming into. The rest of the family was pleasantly surprised, they felt like royalty and my dad really enjoyed his birthday trip! The pools are great, the beach nice but waves are killer! Every single employee was kind and professional, but few that went above and beyond with their service were Gaudencio and Alfredo at the Blueagave! Hard workers all around! Lovely people! A big thanks to the gentleman at the icecream stand,the lady making our omlettes every morning, our suit keeper who left extra beers for my husband and chips for our son, all the servers on the beach, who didn't dissapoint whilst having to walk in that hot sun all day! I can't say enough good things. Everyone was amazing! Anyone hesitating to book, well don't! Do it now! It was an incredible family trip and I'm so happy to have had this experience with the ones I love the most!

reviews.author: Candace S
reviews.title: Disappointing Resort Stay
reviews.text:
Hope this review saves someone from having a less than amazing vacation while staying at the Paradisus Cancun. I am not a person to usually be bother or complain on much but the hospitality at this resort warranted a complaint.
The check in process was not efficient and our room accommodation were not what we booked. When asking to be moved into a room in which our booking was made, we were given excuses on how they were expecting a big group and couldn’t accommodated a move to another room on which we booked originally. After a hour of getting sorted out we (group of 5) were able to head to the pool to start our vacation only to find out we needed a towel card to check out a towel that was to be given to us at check in that we did not receive. Food was average, drinks were horrible, no music at the pool or beach and the lounges were not lively in the evenings. Entertainment was scheduled between the hours of 7pm and 8pm which are typical dinner hours for most, and we were not able to make the entertainment.
After returning to our room to get ready for bed my roommate and I both noticed sand in our sheets. Housekeeping did not change the sheets from the previous guest that occupied our room, unacceptable. As it was midnight at the time, we called to complain to a manager we decided to sleep on towels for the night and to have our room cleaned first thing in the morning. The next day we returned to our room after a full beach day at 3pm to find our room had not been cleaned at all. Again, we complained to the manager and she sent for the room to be cleaned. There was a huge disconnect because as we complained it seems like staff was not following up on the request. Even after expressing our frustrations and how the lack of hospitality was putting a damper on what should have been a relaxing birthday vacation, staff did nothing more to go above and beyond to make sure the rest of our short stay was anything less than amazing. Paradisus Cancun really dropped the ball on this vacation and it effected our vacation in a negative way. 
Also, please know there is only a/c in a couple of restaurants and in the guest rooms. Be prepared to sweat while walking through the halls or hanging in the atrium and lounges. It was much cooler outside of the building than in.
The only good things I can complement on this property is that the décor was beautiful, everything at the restaurant Mole was delicious even the drinks, staff was friendly, and the Yhi Spa was amazing.
I travel often and had the pleasure of staying at the Melia Paradisus in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic a few years back and had such a wonderful time. I was completely disappointed with my stay at the Cancun resort.
Overall, I would not recommend this property to anyone. There are so many other resorts to choose from, save yourself the disappointment. 
Melia, you lost me as a customer for any future travels. Work on your hospitality.

C.S.
Travel Dates 10/12/19-10/15/19

reviews.author: Manish G
reviews.title: Family of 30 ppl
reviews.text: Just recently we visited paradisus cancun resort... Gloria and rodolfo  in  Family concierge were great.... they helped us with booking Bali beds and dinner reservations as well as accommodating our kids needs.... they make the family concierge experience...the hotel was overall great , good location , we were a family of almost 30 ppl and service was great... the cons were that there should be more air conditioned restaurants, maybe even more restaurants as one of them were closed for renovations....overall my family enjoyed our stay... our favourite restaurants were market grill and mole ....

reviews.author: mrs_sh_2009
reviews.title: High hopes crushed
reviews.text: Still trying to understand how this place gets so many awards and great reviews. Yes, there are some good things, but they don’t outweigh the bad. Good - overall service was great, Martin and Enzo was fabulous, Lapalapa food was very good, and the beach is one of the best! However, overall the food was not good at most locations, beds were horrible to sleep on, bugs in the room, so incredibly hot in the indoor common areas that we couldn’t bear dinner at Ibana or drinks at interior bars. One evening at Market Place our food never arrived after one hour, we had to leave (kids were hungry) and went to buffet. Food at Mole was awful, beware of cricket salad they don’t warn you about or clearly state on menu. We’ve been to several resorts between Cancun and playa and by far this ranks at the bottom. Sorry Paradisus, we had such high hopes!

reviews.author: Ana C
reviews.title: Compare to Melia Paradisus Punta Cana; Outstanding Family Concierge
reviews.text: This was our second trip to a Paradisus Melia resort. Our first one was a fabulous 5 star vacation to Punta Cana two years ago that my 3 children now ages ages 7 through 11 still talk about with a strong desire to return so we had high expectations. Our first two days were a huge disappointment. Although we had family concierge service, our assigned butlers had the day off. We were checked in by an inexperienced staff member who dropped the ball. We arrived around 7 pm, tired and hungry. No one showed us where to eat and the sofa bed was not made up upon our arrival. My husband stayed in the room and ordered room service while my eldest daughter and I wandered desolate halls looking for food. We had a long hike to a  very ordinary buffet.  Substandard when compared to the fabulous buffets in Punta Cana. We later learned that there was a restaurant in our building that did not require reservations where we could have eaten if only someone had told us.  We had also booked a room for five people, but the room only accommodated 4. We had a king sized bed and had my son sleep in it with the adults. The girls didn’t want to share a sofa bed, so my youngest daughter pulled together two armchairs and used towels as blankets to sleep there. We had only 5 pillows for 5 people even though we usually use more. The second night, housekeeping made up the armchairs with sheets and blankets for my daughter and provided us with more pillo. On the third night, after I complained to our butler about the lack of sleeping accommodations, we learned that the hotel provided rollaway beds at no charge.
