I am still puzzled as to why no one thought of providing sufficient beds for a family of five even after they saw that a child was sleeping in arm chairs. On our first full day,  we spent the day off of the resort and returned in time for a dip in the pool before dinner. We couldn’t figure out how to get towels and by the time we got out of the pool it was very chilly. When we tried to get towels by the pool, we learned that we needed to exchange cards provided at check in for towels. We had not been provided the cards or given that information at check in. After some pleading and shivering children, the towel lady agreed to give us 2 towels for 4 people and said she could not give us more without the cards, so we shared. The next day, we connected with our butlers, Gloria and Rodolfo and they managed to turn our experience around and salvage our vacation. We obtained a very comfortable rollaway bed with a real mattress for my daughter and pool towel cards. We were able to obtain reservations at all of the restaurants, although they could only get us reservations at La Palapa, by far the best restaurant at the resort, at 8:30 pm and only days in advance. The kids loved Rodolfo. He was very attentive to our needs and Gloria went above and beyond our expectations. When we asked her if she could find someone to run 8 minute miles with our 8 year-old son, a nationally competitive cross-country runner who is afraid of the treadmill, she found Rodrigo, the head of entertainment, a very nice young man, who patiently tried to convince my very reluctant son to run through a golf course, around tennis courts and on the beach, at no charge. Our butlers sent complimentary bottles of wine and champagne, cheese and cold cut platters and chocolate covered fruit and marshmallows to our room, provided the children with lovely Mexican toys, bathtub full of bubbles and balloon figures and bedtime milk and cookies. They also helped us reserve ocean view Bali beds and spa services. The resort even has a kids spa that we stumbled upon where we treated our girls to pedi, mani and facial spa packages. We also were lucky to find Luis, a fabulous waiter, who helped us get a table every night at La Palapa, as soon as it opened at 6:30 pm, so that my children could stay awake and enjoy the dinner. We also had excellent waiters at Bana and Mole restaurant although I was not a big fan of the food, and excellent room service by Alexis. Overall, I would give our individual butlers and other service providers and the chef at La Palapa a 5 star rating, but the resort as a whole a 4 star rating due to our rough start and not so great food at most of the restaurants. I certainly would never want to go without family concierge or royal service and given a choice, would rather go to the Melia Paradisus in Punta Cana.

reviews.author: LouiseG 0761
reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text: Went to Toyi bar and had the best bartender ever his name was Giovani he did tricks he got what we wanted before even asked he suggested new drinks he was way better than Tom Cruise in Cocktail He went out of his way to get seats for us and he explained all the drinks he was making for us

reviews.author: Nikki D
reviews.title: Excellent-Ignacio Vacquez
reviews.text: We have had a wonderful stay so far for our anniversary and my husbands birthday trip! The service is impeccable and the resort is very clean and beautiful! Ignacio Vacquez at the Enzo restaurant has been amazing everyday! He is friendly, accommodating and an excellent server and friend! I imagine the rest of our stay will continue to be as incredible as the first half and we will update accordingly. My husband and I highly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Jane doe
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: We pass a week at the hotel its beautiful clean smells good i don't have no complaints i loved it the hotel is big the people that works there are super nice the beach is amazingly beautiful the streets are safe we took the bus to go to the flee market and the mall i really love it. Great hotel great country

reviews.author: angelaclmba7
reviews.title: Expected Better for a Paradisus Melia
reviews.text:
We have been to Paradisus Melia before but to the one in Punta Cana. Wanted to try a different location for a change but we feel disappointed of having choose this one: Paradisus Cancun. Compared to Palma Real at Punta Cana this resort is not as good for many different reasons; before I named the bad let me start with the good: Beautiful Hotel, well-kept rooms, clean and maintain during the day. Kids can get unlimited ice cream. The beach is awesome! Very clean and beautiful water. Daybeds next to pool and beach are great! 

But unfortunately, we feel there are more negatives than positives: Common areas don’t have AC; not even the stores or cafe; the humidity level was awful and to make it worse the Japanese restaurant is right in the middle so you feel like you are being cooked… and we heard it gets worse during the summer. There should be either air conditioned on these areas or a lot of ventilation and fans; but you have none of the 2.
We spent 7 days at this place and felt like it falls short in customer service… except some people like our butler (George) and our waiter (Ernesto) & his team at Bana… they went the extra mile to try to make us feel comfortable and happy! Besides them we can’t really say anything about the rest of the staff… too many rules and too many NO’s… we are not used to that in Punta Cana… for example you can’t grab a plate of food from the buffet and take it to the pool daybed but can’t either seat at the buffet (that’s next top the beach and the pool… if you are wet… not dripping just wet!)…
The worse besides the heat and service was the food… mediocre at its best… one night we went to Market Grill and asked for Queso Fundido… very disappointed to not be able to enjoy this Mexican dish in Mexico! At the Taco place tacos were not what we expected… visiting with a Mexican friend; she was able to confirm that the food was not what she expected either. Visited Mole one night (The Mexican restaurant) my husband hates goat meat and we asked repeatedly to make sure they did not bring him goat… and he got goat meat; very sad.
We ended up going out to eat dinner 2 nights… out of the hotel… and there we had great food! Rosa Negra and Puerto Madero. Highly Recommended!
If you are planning on staying at this hotel, I recommend not to get the all-inclusive package, just the hotel and maybe try it for a day before you commit to a longer stay and be disappointed.

reviews.author: DB1
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: My boyfriend and i just got back from a week vacation and we had a great time! Would highly recommend! The staff is great, Very helpful, super nice they definitely go out of their way to make sure your okay and are having a good time. The one waiter working the pool area was amazing (i believe his name was Jesus or Francisco I’m not sure tho) made sure we had a drink in our hand the whole time! Also the activity guy Agustin was also great, i can’t say anything bad about anyone who worked there. Will definitely be back next year!! The only downside is the main hotel doesn’t have AC so it does get very hot until you get to your room but if you don’t mind the heat then you’ll love this place!

reviews.author: mafischl
reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: Paradisus is a beautiful resort. It has a couple of really nice pools and the rooms. We stayed in the Royal Service section. We played the nine hole golf course. It was a par 3 course. Not in great condition. Some of the food was delicious. Some just okay. Personally I don't love all inclusive resorts, but as they go this is a pretty nice one.

reviews.author: Arsham H
reviews.title: Below average, disappointed
reviews.text: Day 2 of an 8 day stay and the experience has been well below average, many negative interactions with staff unwilling to help, although we’ve certainly has some pleasant experiences. Overall,  below average food, and service.

reviews.author: roshankalra
reviews.title: Great place to stay, even better with Butler Rode!
reviews.text:
Had a great time here! I proposed to my girlfriend on the beach and it was an amazing time. We got the royal room with the butler. Our butler was Rode and he made sure we were taken care of really well! He went above and beyond to help :)

The only thing was that it was SO HOT! There's no A/C in the main buildings until you get to your room. Would not recommend coming in October due to heat. Come in the cooler months. 

Definitely would come back! And highly recommend!

reviews.author: franklopez96
reviews.title: Amazing Staff
reviews.text: The staff was amazing.  Made the experience great. Awesome memories.  Many laughs with the service members. We will definitely return with family and friends.  Everyone had the same to say, "this place is great!" " I don't want to leave ". See you next year.

reviews.author: Daziz
reviews.title: Third visit and DISASTER
reviews.text: This is our third visit here and we took friends because we used to love it so much. Not only was it not the same but half the hotel was under construction and nobody cared to let guests know or offer any sort of compensation that half the amenities were not usable. We had a leaky AC in our room where me and my husband slipped and fell getting to the bathroom in the middle of the night. By the morning parts of the ceiling were on the floor. It took them until 12:30pm the next day to move, so another half a day wasted. The staff was super unapologetic and offered no compensation for the huge inconvenience. This place is going in a poor direction and fast. Such a shame because we used to love this place.

reviews.author: AustinFelich
reviews.title: NOT AS GOOD AS FIRST TIME
reviews.text:
My wife and I got engaged at the Paradisus in 2016. We had been to other resorts in Cancun and the Paradisus was at the top. We made sure we went back. 

I read a lot of reviews before booking the second time, I should have taken them more seriously. Inside the hotel is very hot, you may not notice it the minute you walk in, but it won’t take long. It’s frustrating after a while. The inside of the resort is absolutely beautiful. The service is great, everyone is very nice. There were a couple workers who kept pushing the 90 minute breakfast to promote their Meliá time share deal. They wouldn’t take no for answer. I acted like I was on my phone multiple times to avoid these couple workers. The food was not as good this time around either. There were a couple restaurants under construction so that made the selection smaller. The breakfast at the two buffets is average at best. The snack bar by the pool had decent food. The wings there were really good and the pizza wasn’t bad. The market grill Brazilian steakhouse was good. The Asian restaurant Bana in the middle and the Mexican restaurant Blue agave were also good. My wife’s and her friends stomach were upset for multiple days. Not sure what it was from. 

The bartenders and waiters/waitresses at the pool were all awesome. Great service. One thing about the pool...the most shallow part is where the bar is, and there are kids all over and around the bar area. I don’t mind kids at all but there were way to many around the pool bar. 

Beach area is great, water and sand were amazing. The waiters/waitresses on the beach were all awesome also. 

The rooms were ok, nothing great or anything to really complain about them. I did feel like the AC worked less and less or got a little warmer as the week progressed. 

If it weren’t for the service I wouldn’t have given the resort three stars. We will always remember the Paradisus from getting engaged there. But we will be staying at another resort next time in Cancun.

reviews.author: Cindy
reviews.title: Birthday Trip---Five Stars!!!!
reviews.text: I booked a 5 day, 4 night trip to Paradisus Cancun with the Royal Service. It has been by far the best trip to Cancun I've had. If you are planning to stay at Paradisus, I highly recommend that you include the Royal Service package! Rode was our butler and he made our stay so much more pleasing and enjoyable. Rode, provided service above self, made sure that every day we had dinner reservations, checked on us throughout the day to make sure we had everything we needed and was very prompt in answering any questions we might have. The resort itself was breathtaking. The indoor landscaping in the reception area of each pyramid was very relaxing and beautiful to see. The service that all the staff provided was beyond my expectations. We loved that the bars at the Royal Service section all had premium drinks. Rode, our butler, had my room decorated so nice for my birthday and was surprised with champagne and cake as well. On our last night there, we were surprised with a bottle of imported wine from France. This comes to show that this resort lives up to the Royal Service treatment. I highly recommend this resort and royal service. This will definitely be my go to resort when traveling to Cancun. Thank you Rode again for making my birthday trip unforgettable and special.

reviews.author: SANS36
reviews.title: Brilliant Break
reviews.text: We have just returned from a most enjoyable holiday in this very good hotel. We stayed in Royal Service, which in our opinion was worth the extra outlay.   From  the moment that we arrived to our departure we received friendly, efficient and courteous service.  There are too many names to list here, but one person who deserves a special mention is Norma, our butler.  She was simply amazing and we both wish her all the very best for her upcoming wedding.  Hopefully we will be back, in the not too distant future.

reviews.author: Paul R
reviews.title: So much potential but lacking in many areas
reviews.text:
Visited late September for one week as a couple. The hotel location, grounds and pool/beach areas are really impressive. Food choice is poor, first night there we both had stomach upset. Service in general was very good, had no issues.
There is an issue with the temperature in the common areas, there is no AC working or even ventilation. Try to sit near a window that opens and hope the wind is blowing through.
Getting a sunbed by the pool is difficult but there are plenty on the beach. There are many Bali beds that were always empty. The management seem to have a ridiculous policy where you have to pay around US$170 per day for one of these, come on get real, if these were reduced to a realistic reasonable price they would be utilised much better.
Overall enjoyed the stay but would not recommend.

reviews.author: Kikays
reviews.title: Really a Paradise!
reviews.text: We had a great time staying for one week.The staff are all friendly and accommodating from the Bell Boy,Front Desk Francisco,Concierge Pablo and Rodrigo,our Housekeeper,our favorite staff in Enzo namely Mar,Gabriella and Martin.The food and drinks are awesome.They have a variety of food to choose from everyday.Special mention also to Carlos our favorite staff bringing our food esp at night time.The hotel is very nice and well kept.Really a paradise.Would love to come back again.

reviews.author: Nomad259788
reviews.title: Wonderful All Inclusive Resort
reviews.text:
This was our first time to stay at Paradisus. I was very impressed. I've stayed at many All Inclusive resorts but this has by far been our favorite.

Upon check in I was informed that they didn't have my ocean view room available and that they would upgrade me to the Royal Service for free so that I receive an ocean view. The wonderful thing about the Royal Service is all the extras it gives you. We had a private bar/snack area for Royal Service guests only, a separate pool area and pool cabanas, separate towel service, and a private butler for our room. It was all amazing (except I never met our butler). It would have been nice to use him but I didn't feel bad about it since my original reservation wouldn't have had one. Besides the waiters in the Royal Service area were butler enough for me.

The hotel is beautiful and the food was amazing. The only criticism I can give is I don't really like that you have to make reservations for dinner at the restaurants. It would be nice to just show up and wait for a table if I wanted to. Usually the butler would make these reservations for us but I never got to use him. Overall this was a wonderful trip and a hotel I will happily stay at again.

reviews.author: FellowTraveler33656
reviews.title: Great Hotel and Experience
reviews.text: Hotel and employees all very attentive and great.  Stayed and Family Concierge and need to give a Shout Out to Gloria  (mayordomo) , made it very special for the whole family and specially for the kids.

reviews.author: hrafique77
reviews.title: Overall good experience
reviews.text: Overall trip was good. Lobby/floors really warm no AC. Checking in they gave us a room that already had someone in there. Had to go back to checkin desk and wait another 35 mins. Next day the keys to our room stopped working. Trying calling from "floor telephone" didn't work. Nonetheless they gave us a complimentary champagne bottle. Thank you for that. But I'd prefer a relaxing checkin experience after a long flight

reviews.author: Imrana M
reviews.title: Paradisus, our experience
reviews.text:
Fantastic hotel, amazing, friendly, helpful staff! We loved our experience of the hotel. So many restaurants to choose from. My son has allergies so we were weary. Mole was a great Mexican restaurant. We had a waiter who was so helpful and really knew about all the ingredients used in the dishes. Mario helped us with our choice of dishes...many thanks to Mario PeraHa. 
The Master family

reviews.author: francisrivera7
reviews.title: Pure relaxing vacation place
reviews.text:
Awesome place, 200% recommended. Lots of things to do on it!!  
Bars everywhere, awsome food variety, different shows every day, stores...
Outstanding  blue water beach, smells awesome everywhere. I’ll love to go back!!

reviews.author: Frankhernandez195
reviews.title: Paraiso
reviews.text: I thought it was excellent  and very professional from everyone that works there from the moment we got there all the way until we left .I would definitely recommend this place to all my friends  and can't wait to go back.

reviews.author: jthompsonjr
reviews.title: Amazing!!!
reviews.text: Every thing about this resort was amazing, from the white sand beaches to the coziness of the room. The room was very comfortable, air came out very well, fridge stayed stock. All the staff that I encountered was very nice, professional and appeared to really love their jobs. Outside the hotel was gorgeous, they really care about the appearance. The restaurants especially Enso was the best that I ever had. Food galore and such a wide variety of fish, shrimp, that it was a seafood lover's dream. Staff truly amazing, attentive and caring. This is the place to be in Cancun and I will definitely be going back.

reviews.author: hp0ttinger
reviews.title: Best Resort I’ve Stayed At
reviews.text:
Stayed at the Royal Service at this resort and it exceeded my expectations by far! Top shelf liquor, peaceful and clean environment, all of the staff were helpful, happy and attentive! Pool area was so relaxing it was easy to fall asleep in the cabana. Food at La Palapa was the best in the whole resort, especially the shrimp on the lunch menu. Only coming to this resort when I’m in Cancun. 
Shoutout to Daniel, Caesar, Norma (Butler) and Orlando. All were so helpful staff members that I always ran into!

reviews.author: CliffGran
reviews.title: Wonderful week vacation
reviews.text: The room was great, because it was not busy they upgraded our 2 rooms to ocean view at no cost. Entire hotel was so clean and staff very happy and smiling. Everything worked, even all the motion detector hand paper towels in every washroom. Very impressive, we will be back.

reviews.author: Chris J
reviews.title: Brilliant
reviews.text: What can we say..yet again a fantastic holiday at Royal Service! Attentive service across the board from check inn to check out. Special mention to our butler Alex and thanks to Daniel,hospitality manager. Shame we were there whilst the buffet was having refit but will be worth it for our next visit.

reviews.author: richard z
reviews.title: Fun and sun
reviews.text: We have stayed here before and been to Cancun 12 times, but this hotel is the only one we have done a return stay because we like to mix it up. This place drew us back easily. The food is excellent from make your own bloody mary’s At breakfast if you want to, to the juice bar, to the view and the beach. We have loved the feel of the hotel and the over all atmosphere. The hotel staff are amazing, the bars are alll good multiple pools, fantastic. Beach and ocean view. The poolside waiters Carlos Gutierrez and Charley amador were the best, and left us not wanting to leave but definitely brought us back. The suites with a tub on the deck and ocean view are worth the splurge. But all rooms are clean, and comfortable. Visit the water sports complex across the street and do the jungle boat tour worth it, also any issues at the Desk ask for EL Jefe Francisco he will fix any problem you have. 2 dance clubs one down by the ocean and 1 on the second level.

reviews.author: LanceMannion
reviews.title: Nice hotel, Excellent staff and service, mediocre food
reviews.text:
This is the third Paradisus hotel that I have stayed in and 4th time in Royal Service or Family Concierge (which I recommend). The short version of my stay is that the staff was excellent from reception to rooms, bars, restaurants, etc.). Beach is soft sand and the water was warm and swimmable in September with minimal seaweed. The pool was nice moving between pool, beach, rest room or hotel room is very easy and convenient.

The only negative is that the restaurants were under construction in mid-September, and I suspect will be for a few more months. Which meant, rather than having 5-6 restaurants that take reservation, there were only 2. The food was good at Blue Agave, Fuego (temporarily housed in La Palapa, which, under these renovation conditions is no longer reserved only for Royal Service), and Mole. Stay a week and you will be be bored compared to any other Paradisus dining options. There was no notice on the Melia website (which stinks anyway) when I booked and paid. The App is alo spoitty and very frustrating (The PDC-specific app works great).

Overall, very nice and convenient hotel, great staff, food is disappointing if you stay more than 3 nights. That is not the any of the staff's fault, but Melia should be clear on the website "you will have only half of our usual dining options if you stay here between now XYZ".

reviews.author: Y2966ARricardor
reviews.title: Great all inclusive resort
reviews.text: Great overall experience, very nice staff, great WiFi, wonderful pools, great beaches (although some sargasus was there), variety of food and restaurants, beautiful architecture, they make you feel welcome

reviews.author: MIke C
reviews.title: Wow just wow
reviews.text: First off this is our first time being here and we are club melia. By far this is one of the best resorts we have stayed at by melia. I was also celebrating my birthday and they gave me a 50minute massage which was so awesome of them. They always made sure we were happy and were having a good time. On the 3rd night our daughter came down with pink eye and we had to see the doctor and he was so good and caring. Gave us medication on site and had a free follow up it cost us $234 but we have travel insurance which will pay is back. We met some awesome friends from Mexico and my daughter loved the kids club she wanted to be there all day everyday and wanted no time with us. The staff at kids club was by far totally awesome so good with my daughter and she had a blast. I would say my only complaint is no straws not even paper straws. How am I suppose to drink my drink with no straw it was really upsetting. I understand about sea life that’s why you use paper straws but when we come back in 2 years I’ll bring a pack of my own so I can drink my drink with a straw. Other then that. Awesome resort

reviews.author: Korymeyers
reviews.title: Awesome Resort
reviews.text: The Paradisus resort was a great experience.  The entertainment at the pool was fun, Augustin and Alan were really nice and fun to talk to. Our favorite bar tenders were Orlando and Eduardo.  The service at all of the restaurants was always amazing and everyone was really nice.

reviews.author: JKK123
reviews.title: Nice place but the food...just not good!
reviews.text:
I was at this resort for nine days so got to experience most of it A-Z.

First five days was work meetings at hotel w/ colleagues & last four days was vacation.  Wife was with me the entire time so was only vacation for her.

PROS:
1 SERVICE:  everyone working at resort was extremely nice & courteous...never had to wait on a refill or service request or anything...if every hotel/resort had this kind of service would be great
2 BEACH:  beautiful waterfront beach area...large & nobody really on this section of beach except for those at resort...we very much enjoyed beach time & plenty of covered areas for when you need a tanning break
3 LINENS:  good quality bedding & towels
4 ROOM:  big TV & plenty of ENGLISH channels as well as Spanish speaking channels
5 POOL:  HUGE pools winding all along beach...very nice!
6 LOCATION:  Only 15 minute drive from airport...easily accessible.

CONS:
1 POOL:  closed at 7 PM...what????   makes little sense to close a pool this early...most beach resorts are beach during day & pool time in evening...this made no sense?
2  CONDITION OF RESORT:  appears to be an older property...well maintained but certainly due for some new furniture in rooms, tidying of paint, etc
3  CONFUSION OF OFFERING:  at check-in no real instruction on resort activities, restaurants, etc; some restaurants closed & others open at times that did not match their website description; there was some evening entertainment but we did not know when/where/what...after some days we figured it all out but certainly at check-in a simple information packet would have made it much more enjoyable
4 WEBSITE:  poor website & does little to detail all the offerings resort has
5 ROOM SERVICE:  menu was fine but the $5 delivery charge was not welcome considering the $$ paid for an all-inclusive resort
6 FOOD:  OK...THIS WAS BY FAR THE BIGGEST ISSUE.  Although there were multiple restaurants the food was cheap cafeteria quality at best.  The presentation was very nice, dishes all looked attractive, variety was there, BUT in general it all tasted the same after a few days & food quality just not great.  Even the steaks were quite poor quality.  The BLUE AGAVE restaurant was only one that tasted like something I would pay for willingly at a restaurant BUT you can only eat tacos so many times in a week!  We ate (multiple times) at every restaurant there (except TEMPO which was not part of all-inclusive food) so it was just not good.  Pretty sad leaving a resort after a week craving decent food.  And odd but no easy place during day just to grab a simple sandwich/chips.  Every meal was very heavy.  In the outdoor dining (Enso) we did enjoy the salad/veg/fruit offerings BUT they really need to figure a way to keep things cooler in this warm climate.  Warm salad dressing is a recipe for disaster for sure!  Overall food was just NOT good...almost to point of "bad".

We did not use spa at all so no comments to make there.

OVERALL this resort was decent & for just a few days if price is right & someone just enjoys the drinking aspect of vacation (we are not drinkers) maybe this is okay choice.  But for a long stay I think w/ all the resorts in Cancun/Cozumel/Playa we will not return to this one sorry!

reviews.author: Jane
reviews.title: Paradisus Overview
reviews.text:
Overall, this was a very relaxing vacay. The staff is so nice and accommodating. When I got to the resort, they put me in a room in the oldest tower, that looked nothing like the room shown in the pictures, lagoon view junior suite. We marched right back to the front desk and were then placed in the right room. 

The food is subpar, make sure to book your dinner reservations ASAP. We were told upon check-in to book by 5 pm each day. On the last two nights, they had booked up and we were sick of buffet food, so we went to a nearby restaurant. (Side note: Lavo is a MUST VISIT, ask for Luis as your waiter, and get the rock shrimp. We had it 2 nights in a row, it was divine and not too pricey.)

The drinks and bars were awesome at Paradisus. The bartenders were even better, very nice and helpful with recommendations when you've had 40 too many margaritas that week.

The room itself was OK. The AC doesn't go lower than 65. The bed is fine up until night 4-5 (hard as a rock.) The maid didn't come at first, so on day 3 I had to call and request cleaning service. Room service is only $5 USD and the hotdogs (w/o chili) are great.

Other: The gelato shop is amazing, try the vanilla and coconut. Bring your own sunscreen, because its $40 USD for a spray bottle. 

Pro tip: Tip big on the first few days. The staff will know you by name within a day or two, and you are basically treated like royalty. We tipped the bartenders always.

reviews.author: RAIII
reviews.title: 4th time...
reviews.text: This is the 4th time our family has visited Paradisus Cancun. Still as enjoyable and relaxing as the first time. We did Family Concierge as usual and had the pleasure of being assigned Lili and Alex as our butlers. Lili was exceptional and always had our childrens best interests at the forefront. Kids/Baby club was great. Special recognition to Halina, Sarah and Paola who took great care of our 2 year old, 4 year old and 7 year old. We always felt comfortable leaving them in their care. Restaurants were great, we did Vento, Mole and Fuego. Blue agave was great for a late night taco/quesidalla craving.  Best drinks served here as well. Try the passion fruit margarita. The hotel had a nice Coco show which the kids loved, the usual opera singers in the main pyramid by Bana (which never gets old, only once per week) and the mariachi singers in Blue Agave and Mole (twice per week). We will continue returning to Paradisus.

reviews.author: Lori M
reviews.title: Gorgeous Resort!
reviews.text: This resort is absolutely breathtaking!  And the staff are so kind and helpful.  We were there from Oct 19th thru Oct 26th and couldn't have had better weather.  And beach was the most beautiful I've ever been to.  The only complaints I have are this - The common areas are not air conditioned but I'm sure it's because of all of the gorgeous plants they have growing there.  But I do feel the restrooms adjacent to these common areas need to be air conditioned.  The other thing I was disappointed in was the food.  The buffet was just average - tons of options but a lot of the foods were barely luke warm.  Our fav restaurant was Vento.  And again, can't save enough about the staff - they are such hard workers.  Be sure to tip them well because they definitely deserve it.  Also, we asked for an upgrade upon arrival to the Royal Service but they were completely booked.  However, on the 3rd day they upgraded us to the Club Melila section (no charge) with an ocean front room with jacuzzi on our balcony.  So glad we did that.   Would definitely consider returning but probably wouldn't get the all inclusive option.

reviews.author: Samantha P
reviews.title: So Amazing!
reviews.text: I cannot say enough good things about this resort. My boyfriend and I just spent four nights here and had the most incredible time. We stayed in the Royal Service - Adults only side of the hotel and it was seriously like a dream. Every person who works in this place just wants to make sure you are happy and having a great time. The service was like nothing I've ever experienced. From the second we arrived to the second we left, we were completely catered to. I can't imagine how anyone would have anything bad to say about this place. The room was beautiful, the bathroom/shower was so incredible. I'm still having to get used to my shower back at home! Lol. Our butler (Hector) made sure all of our reservations were made and we never had to wait for anything. This was truly paradise. Coby and I cannot wait to go back. And the views. Omg. The beach was like nothing I've ever seen. I've heard about the seagrass problem in Mexico, but that was not an issue here in Cancun. Seriously, this place is heaven. I promise you, you will love it here.

reviews.author: ioanna_tzio
reviews.title: HONEYMOON IN PARADISUS
reviews.text: We came in Cancun at 19 October for our honeymoon, the weather was amazing and even if it was not high season the hotel was full and it had a lot of activities both for kids and adults.I recommend Paradisus 100% we had an amazing experience. It is great value for money all inclusive resort, highly recommended..Thank you to all the team..

reviews.author: S C
reviews.title: Very disappointed
reviews.text: Booked through westjet vacations we wanted a five star all inclusive. This is not 5 star we have been coming to  Cancun and riviera mya for 10 years this is worst experience. Three restaurants closed indefinitely. There is drywall dust in elevator and on the floors . There are power cords  across the elevators .Room service only came after complaining after an hour.  15 french fries cold burger .....pass on this establishment.  There are many higher rated

reviews.author: Rania Zohny
reviews.title: Highlight of my trip
reviews.text: From nyc to Cancún—this is my second time staying here and I couldn’t seem to book elsewhere. I love my stay at Paradisus and look forward to more visits! The all inclusive options came is handy as my friends and I love food and exploring our options. From casual, to extravagant we had full range and control. The hotel smells and looks incredible and the staff is so kind and generous. They called us after we checked in just to let us know if we need any toileteries or forgot to pack anything they will be happy to provide it for us. They checked in on us often to make sure our mini fridge was full and satisfying. Piece of advice—be kind, generous and tip the staff. We didn’t need to spend much with everything being all inclusive, and the staff is beyond attentive to your needs—so be prepared to leave a generous tip that they deserve. The only thing I disliked was the beach grill food—by 1 pm they were out of most of the options and only had chicken burgers and fries or pizza which all of them were dissatisfying. Stick to all the other restaurants but the bar and grill one by the pool needs a major upgrade in food and quantity. Naos and Fuego have been my favorites. Naos NEVER disappoints and the food options are endless—all you can eat, self serve, and hibachi options and desserts are limitless. Fuego and Molé were also incredible for Dinner.

reviews.author: Pioneer65383269491
reviews.title: Great experience !
reviews.text: Staff very friendly . Accomadation very good .Hostess ,waiters, bar waiters , cook , room stewart , enteriners , managers , front desk all emoloyers are great . Unbelieveble exoerience . I recomend frim the hart . I will get back next year with entire family .

reviews.author: Companion42589110862
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: Excellent hotel, great service, value for money. Perfect location. Beautiful room view if ocean facing and they make every occasion special. Special mention to David at Coco's and Salvadore at the swim up pool bar, excellent friendly and genuinely nice people. Such gems to have!

reviews.author: Passport68290260206
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: We were amazed. Absolutely beautiful and relaxing. Amenities were fabulous. All inclusive was spectacular. Super friendly staff, very courteous and professional. Food was great. Service everywhere was impeccable except Market Grill and Bana. Pasquel, our server at Naos buffet for breakfast table service was fabulous. Our butlers, Gloria and Sandra, made our trip so special and memorable. It not only was our 21st anniversary but the honeymoon we were never able to take due to a special needs son. We will definitely be back, Love this place.

reviews.author: BoardingPass776945
reviews.title: Beautiful resort but not worth it
reviews.text: Resort was beautiful and very clean. Pools were great and beach was gorgeous Stayed in royal service did not feel it was worth the extra money. Service was pretty terrible and food was awful. My husband eats anything and he even complained about the food. Our room wasn’t cleaned for 2 days after we asked numerous times for it to be cleaned. The staff members by the pool were very attentive but anywhere else good luck. Very rude and couldn’t be bothered. Also, felt like we were trying to be sold on everything. The minute you check in someone approaches you about attending a 90minute presentation to buy into a timeshare and they don’t take no for an answer. Needless to say we won’t be coming back.

reviews.author: juliekeith
reviews.title: AWSOME
reviews.text: Paradisus- Is one beautiful (pictures on the internet does not do it justice) clean,very well decorated,friendly staff (everyone),coldest,bottomless drinks, really good food at all the restaurants,and something going on every nite around the pool!

reviews.author: KIM W
reviews.title: Amazing!!
reviews.text: Beyond paradise. Every room is oceanfront with views of the crystal blue water and incredible swim up bar.  Great food,  service, entertainment  and just amazing!  Highly recommend and only 20 minutes from the airport.

reviews.author: Anne P
reviews.title: Conveniet location, great staff and wonderful food!
reviews.text:
We stayed September 29 - October 6, 2018. Rooms were clean, but portion of hotel we stayed in (building 1) smelled of mold. Room snacks and drinks were well stocked daily. Room had a great view! Concierge PETER WUEST was very helpful, attentive to our needs; he informed us of a variety of activities and places to go and helped us purchase good deals for tickets for excursions. His recommendations were spot on for how to take full advantage of excursions and what order to do things in so that our time was well spent. He was professional, friendly, and respectful!

Be aware of when you are travelling; a lot of the restarants at Paradisus were not open because it was not peak season. So, we ate daily at NAOS INTERNATIONAL BUFFET; themed meals changed daily and there was a large variety of dishes for breakfast, lunch and dinner. The NAOS staff were awesome: very attentive, cordial, talkative, and genuinely interested in ensuring we were satifsfied with all details of our meals and drinks. People that made our buffet experience awesome and enjoyable: IGNACIO VAZQUEZ, TOMAS, ALEJANDRO, JOSE, and CHEF MANUEL MARTINEZ. Thank you for a wonderful visit!

Outdoor pools, staff and beach: pool areas were clean, wait staff around pools and outdoor bars were attentive. Beach area access was clean, though at the time we went, beach area at edge of water had lots of seaweed and acces to water was limited because of red tide and deemed unsafe.

We accepted a 90 minute Club Melia sales pitch and presentation. Person was friendly and informative; said that all we needed to do at end of 90 minutes was to give a yes or no with no judgement. But at the end of 90 minutes we gave our NO to being club members and her attitude completely changed; appeared mad and upset and unkind.

reviews.author: Fade M
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed in the paradisus for a week celebrating our honey moon. We had an amazing time and such a memorable experience. Staff were great and extremely accommodating. Jose who worked in valet was extremely helpful as he took the time out to make several calls when our pick up car was late. We were appreciative of his kindness. Very accommodating, great service, beautiful night shows, wonderful views and activities and food was incredible.

reviews.author: KrysDC
reviews.title: Beautiful scenery
reviews.text: We just returned from our stay and the scenery could not have been more perfect! Our view from the room was amazing. The staff was attentive and super nice. We have been to other Paradisus locations and we always get Royal Service, this was our only disappointment. We saw our butler twice in our 5 days stay and that’s because we tracked him down. We are used to the butler service being more attentive and helping set up more things for us. We did the beach club Bali beds that came with a huge seafood platter with lobster and shrimp and it was amazing! Definitely worth the extra money to rent the bed for the day!! This place is definitely amazing views and beautiful. Food was great, we ate at the taco bar the most but every place we ate was great. They are not stingy with the alcohol which is all name brand! We would definitely return.

reviews.author: Nathalie25a
reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: My Husband and I just came back from a 4 night stay in Paradisus Cancun. Overall we were satisfied with our stay. The resort is very beautiful and tranquil. We did upgrade to Royal Service, which we were glad we did. We had an adult only pool area with cozy cabanas and a section in the beach with great service. The workers were very tentative and always made sure we had drinks and food. We specially want to thank Julio, Eddie and Ramon, They provided exceptional service in the La Palapa and pool area. We absolutely loved La Palapa restaurant that is only for Royal Service, If you love passion fruit try a passion fruit margarita on the rocks. Best drink ever! The aroma in the hotel is beautiful and so is all the greenery and koi fish ponds. The room was beautiful too, however the bedding could be better. We were however disappointed in the Naos buffet. We were expecting to have tacos and more of a food variety. It felt as of there were more side dishes than main courses. We also ate at the Tempo restaurant which is at additional cost. The service by Miguel was exceptional. We enjoyed our meal very much, we recommend the tasting menu. Small portions but a lot of courses and amazing taste. The nightlife wasn't great per say. Might be because its off season. In conclusion the beach is breath taking and the scenery inside the hotel is beautiful and clean.

reviews.author: Rumrush
reviews.title: Upgrade to “Royal Services”
reviews.text:
Food: all restaurants were average. The best one (great food) was “Fuego” 

Rooms: definitely upgrade to “Royal services”, their rooms are renovated and their pool is for adults only and very nice. 

Beach: very nice, waiters attentive and friendly.

reviews.author: CaptDusty1
reviews.title: Great vacation with friends
reviews.text:
We visited the Paradisus with 3 other couple and had a fantastic time. My wife and I were the only couple that got a family concierge package. 
Our 2 butlers, Sandra and Gloria, did a remarkable job! They booked our dinners and activities not only for us, but for our whole group. They also left us gifts on our last night there. Thank you !
The food, drinks, pools and activities were awesome. We will be back!

reviews.author: Alan A
reviews.title: Second Time Better
reviews.text:
We are Club Melia members, so some of my comments are specific to that experience.  

My wife and I went to the Paradisus Cancún resort in February 2017 for her birthday and it was quite enjoyable.  They were in the process of making updates to the Club Melia building(tower 1) when we were there.  The amenities were not up to the Paradisus Playa Del Carmen resort, but the pool and the friendliness was better in many ways.

We decided to go back this past October with our friends and it was fantastic!  They have made some significant improvements to the restaurants and the atmosphere was even more relaxing.   We all had a great time and enjoyed most of the restaurants.

We all had favorites, but we went to Fuego, Enzos and Blue Agave twice during our 8 night stay.  We also enjoyed Mole and Vento (try the octopus at either restaurant).  We also went to The Market which was also fabulous, but we did not try this out until late in our trip and they were not open again while we were there.

Our service was always phenomenal and we would happily go back again.  We just need to decide when and for how long.  In particular we are thankful for Jose Meh and Claudia Arriola with Club Melia for their help throughout our stay and wish them the best!   

I am not the best with names, but the servers and wait staff in all of the restaurants mentioned above as well as the Naos restaurant for breakfast gave us excellent service!

reviews.author: Kessla H
reviews.title: Very Accommodating
reviews.text: Paradisus is a beautiful resort! I'm a vegan and the staff at the restaurants were attentive and accommodating to my plant based diet. Senor Daniel and his staff went above and beyond preparing specialized dishes just for me and my husband! The hospitality was exceptional! Thank you for a wonderful stay!

reviews.author: Patricia G
reviews.title: ROYAL SERVICE!!!
reviews.text: After a week on Isla Mujeres (which was wonderful), we moved on to Cancun for 3 days and stayed at Paradisus. I cannot express the surprise of how beautiful the hotel was. The hanging plants around the pyramids, the flowers everywhere, the staff... everything was just lovely. We got the Royal Service and Arturo was our butler... he was great. Anything we needed - he was there. Super friendly and helpful guy. Im not sure how I will ever go back to regular hotels again after this one. The royal service also allowed us to use the spa services which was nice. Our room was a 2 bedroom and we thought our friend would have to use our bathroom.... luckily she had her own. Just another surprise from Paradisus. We will be back!!

reviews.author: Aynna H
reviews.title: BEST trip to Cancun EVER!!
reviews.text:
Customer Service: Front desk welcome was awesome. Check in was hassel free and they offered us champagne while we waited for our paperwork to be done. Our tour guide (Ramona) did a wonderful job covering the grounds for us. Housekeeping was excellent. They kept out room nice and clean, always had fresh towels and washcloths, and the fridge stayed stocked with drinks and snacks. Maria (head of house keeping on the Royal side) could've been a little more attentive to us. We had to make our own reservations for the cabanas and restaurants.

Pool Concierge: Jose Garrido was the BEST!! He made sure we didn't have to ask for anything while sitting pool side. He always made sure we had plenty of water, food, drinks, and dry towels!! He was also available when we need help with something Maria should've helped us with. We had a large group with us and he knew us all by name. He was very attentive to our needs and we appreciate him for that.

Resort & Entertainment: The Royal side was always clean, serean, and quiet. I went for R&R and I got exactly that!! There was always some type of entertainment going on. The Red Lounge was always pumping at night and they even had Cirque du Soleil perform. It was a great show!!

Resturant & Food: A+ across the board!! Especially on the Royal side. The BEST all inclusive I've ever had while traveling. I've been plenty of places and this was the BEST by far!!

reviews.author: uselynd
reviews.title: Picture perfect vacation
reviews.text: I thoroughly enjoyed my stay from the welcoming and courteous staff to the restaurant staff. The ambience and scenery were gorgeous. The ocean view upgrade was worth every penny as I woke up to Paradise every morning. The beach was beautiful and looked like a post card. I am already planning my next vacation. Would definitely recommend highly and will be coming back

reviews.author: Niranjani Sekar
reviews.title: Great resort but not satisfied with the checkin process
reviews.text:
We stayed here for our tenth wedding anniversary, the stay was awesome, staff were very friendly, our kids loved it. The best part was the beach view and the step up swimming pool. 

My son was very fond of international buffet.
We will surely go back, but the one thing made my trip little unsatisfy was, I was totally not given any of my resort credits which was offered by my travel agent Flight centre.

When we checked in our key card didn’t work for few hours and we had to run multiple times to the front desk, we saw even a staff bringing champagne and saying that he will come back later when the key card starts working, and never returned back.

I booked my trip few months before, and totally forgot about the resort credits, but when we realized and went and checked ten front desk, they didn’t offer us any said that there was no offers like that.

There was no surprise or special moments offered for our wedding anniversary even though we were promised for $1500 USD worth of resort credits we didn’t get to use any of it.

I have lodged a complaint with flight centre who was our booking agent but still waiting to hear back from the hotel.

reviews.author: djrchance
reviews.title: Anniversary Trip
reviews.text: The service we received while we stayed at Paradisus Cancun was over the top! We were waited on “hand and foot” from the time we arrived at the airport, to the time we left the resort. The staff was so kind and helpful! We will be back!

reviews.author: chaunguyencgapc
reviews.title: Good resort
reviews.text: Overall very good except the Enso (Chinese restaurant).  They should learn how to cook Chinese food properly. I would like to enjoy at resorts where reservation is not required for dining.  We do not have a lot of choices on the time and most of the restaurants are pretty small.

reviews.author: Edwin G
reviews.title: Spa
reviews.text: Excellent Spa team!! Mae was amazing! My girlfriend and I loved her treatment. Wonderful reception and very kind team. We will definitely come back to this Spa next time we are in Cancun. The Hotel and the resort was very accommodating!

reviews.author: rschanding
reviews.title: GREAT CUSTOMER SERVICE
reviews.text:
Our stay was incredible. The views and weather was great but what stood out the most was the service. To name a few, Mae in the spa gave us the best massage! Leyner our Butler was so helpful and accommodating. Jose at the Royal Service pool went above and beyond each day for us, gave great recommendations and always in a great mood! Joel DeJesus Rojano from La Palapa helped us each day and was soooo sweet and wonderful. 

All of the staff members here were so special to us and work very hard. I hope the owners and hotel management recognize the value in their staff because they are lucky to have each one of them. 

Thank you! We look forward to returning!

reviews.author: stomper1001
reviews.title: Royal service equals royal treatment
reviews.text:
We adored our week long stay in the Royal service section of the resort. Access to Bali beds around the pool, dedicated butler who met all our needs and promptly answered all our requests during the week. The food was generally very good at all restaurants (top score going to the Market Grill) with a caveat to the buffet, which although very good, the food temperature was at best lukewarm. The famous Tempo restaurant is also located within this resort, but not part of the all inclusive restaurants. A 10% or 20% discount for guests would be a definite plus!

The rooms were well taken care of and the whole resort was extremely clean. Not sure of the level of service or support elsewhere at the resort but we recommend spending a few dollars more for the personalized Royal service. Extra polite staff throughout the resort which was very nice.

reviews.author: loshnee_govender
reviews.title: Holiday of a lifetime
reviews.text: It's our last of 7 nights here at Paradisus. Absolutely amazing experience, restaurants were awesome, bars were great, beach is beautiful. All inclusive was better than expected, u got what u asked for incl. Premium drinks. Special mention to Salvadore at the swim up bar he is such an amazing person. So much passion for his job and genuinely friendly and warm, what a wonderful person! David at Coco's Beach bar is a star, we hired a Bali bed with lobster platter etc for my hubby's birthday and what a day it was! Exceptional service from him throughout the day and he's so friendly, always smiling just like Salvadore. Rest of the staff in restaurants and other bars are all so friendly and always willing to help with a smile. Will definitely return. Thanks paradisus, for making my husband's birthday one we will never forget, beautiful memories.

reviews.author: BorisEspinosa
reviews.title: Royal Service is the best
reviews.text:
My wife and I went with royal service, Our host Rodel was excellent, He was available all hours of the day and night. Rodel made our trip better then we anticipated. We look forward to going back next year, Definitely in Royal Service.
Boris & Mio Espinosa.

reviews.author: Brittany P
reviews.title: Our honeymoon
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed here for 7 days recently, my first impression of this resort is wow, gorgeous!! I love plants so absolutely loved the way the did this resort up. 
The food was ok, the only restaurant we ate at was enso ( it was good ) because that’s the only one we could get a reservation for! Every other restaurant was booked or closed, what they don’t tell you at check in was that you can reserve 2-3 days in advance not the day of up until 4 pm like they told us! 

The activities were poor compared to other resorts I’ve stayed at, they had different activities listed throughout the day but they never actually played them which was disappointing. 

We really enjoyed the play Coco, Mexican dancers and the circus! 

Our room wasn’t anything special, we were lagoon view, out bed was so soft and sagging that I ended up in the middle of the bed every night, the bathroom was gross, the bathtub was stained and the ceiling looked as if it was a 2 star resort, ( pictures below ) we also had a few bugs in our room ( ewww )

The coffee bar was often out of coffee or cream and gelato was often closed early. 

The beach and pool area is amazing however I wasn’t super impressed when they brought out 3 dancers on the bar while the kids club was in the pool as well as other kids and families, I know I wouldn’t be impressed if my kids were with me, they were playing some really derogatory music too! 

We love Mexico and are looking forward to a new adventure there in the new year!

reviews.author: N L
reviews.title: Relaxed vacation
reviews.text: Stayed at the Paradisus Cancun for 4 days. It was Beautiful. It was a last minute trip and decided to take the Royal service that was offered by Julio in the res dept. Thank you Julio. The service was excellent. Our butler Leyner was attentive and wonderful. Took care of all our needs. The VIP Pool Concierge Elisander was able to get me the Bali bed cabana I wanted for my complete stay, he worked Magic. My pool staff Orlando and Eddie took care of every desire that I expressed. All of the VIP concierge's were very helpful, especially Christina and Daphne. I had the most amazing spa treatment. I'm ready for my next one.  The food was great and Romano at Vento Restuarant was very helpful with the food selections. Vegetarian and shellfish allergies. Best vacation in along time. Ready to go back.

reviews.author: Fara S
reviews.title: Man I wish I could give this resort a 5 star.
reviews.text: Hey everyone! I'm back with a detailed review of the Paradisus Cancun. First let me begin by saying how much fun I had during my 7 days! What a blast! I went parasailing, jet skiing, boat touring and Flo riding. Alright, the two cons about the hotel is the very long check in procedure. I can't tell you how long we had to wait on the line just to get checked into our room :-( I guess it's expected on a Tuesday/Wednesday. The second and major con were the two small roaches we found in our room during our stay. Oh my goodness I can't begin to tell you how I despise insects in my living quarters. Anyhow, after all the grimace and running back and forth we killed the insects. I can honestly say that this hotel would've definitely been a 5 star if it weren't for one of the two cons (the insects). Other than that the hotel is beautiful, the beach is beautiful, the pool is fun, the reception/conference center for weddings was beautiful! The food was simply ok nothing major and the entertainment was nice too. The rooms and restrooms were spacious, but the hallway leading to our room was a bit dim...I'm guessing it's because they wanted to keep the jungle theme going from the main lobby. One big piece of advice I would give to the wedding coordinators; if the ceremony has to be held indoors because of weather I would advise that the ceremony take place in the hallway outside the reception hall. I cannot begin to tell you how large, bright and beautiful that area was. The wedding that I attended was so dim because of the jungle themed lobby area. Not a good place for a ceremony. Overall, I had a blast, but the only thing that would have made this top notch is if I didn't have to play bug inspector. Oh and I almost forgot, outside my room were towels because the ceiling was leaking.Hotel is handicap accessible, smoking outdoors and is a family resort.  :-( That's all for now. Pictures to follow.

reviews.author: carinap
reviews.title: Hand foot and mouth
reviews.text: Resort was very clean and well kept. Staff are great especially the bar staff by the beach. The restaurants were all really good and the buffet always had lots to choose from. The ocean was very rough when we were there, our kids couldn’t go in as the waves were too rough. Our son enjoyed the kids club, but unfortunately our son seemed to have contracted hand foot and mouth, symptoms began on our 2nd last day and worsen as we got home.

reviews.author: lenayavkina
reviews.title: Animation team!
reviews.text: We stayed in Paradisus one week, it was one of the best hotels I have ever visited. Every department was very courteous to our needs. Amazing service from saul, rodrigo, julio! Thanks a lot! Great resort!

reviews.author: Jyotsna R
reviews.title: Great Vacation!
reviews.text: We went there for a celebration and our family concierge Sandra and Gloria made our trip very special by giving us some surprises every day for my daughter as well as us. I was at first not too comfortable at the thought of leaving my daughter in kids zone ( she is 6) but she met Sarahi at kids zone and became so close to her that she didn’t want to leave kids zone at all! She still says “ I miss Sarahi”. The vegetarian and vegan options for food are very limited for dinner at the different restaurants - that was the only downside. The only rude and inconsiderate interaction we had was with the hostess of Mole. Our family concierge had by mistake made a reservation for 2 instead of 3 and they refused to add a chair for my 6 yr. old - we were forced to forgo our reservation because of no fault of ours. We had a fantastic time otherwise! Highly recommend.

reviews.author: 218marksmith
reviews.title: Food awful no premium drinks
reviews.text:
Just back from a week here been was looking forward for a while to come here.
Hotel is beautiful room lovely see view recommended.
Staff fantastic they work hard, however this hotel is not worth the money for the food and drinks hardly any vegetarian food and they cook the meat same place as they cook vegetarian food as in omelettes and use the same tools etc all rice pasta and soup is cooked in chicken and beef stalk but staff will tell you it’s vegetarian because it has no meat nothing is clear here so it’s hard to know what your eating. Please educate your staff on vegetarian food and how to cook it and what is acceptable  for them to eat it’s really not that complicated.; 
We love Mexico and having been coming for years for the amazing standard of food and premium drinks you certainly won’t get it here.
if you manage to book a restaurant 3 days in advance and if they’re not closed the food wasn’t great either, buffet same food repeated constantly. 
Every hotel We’ve stayed in served us premium drinks as in grey goose 1800 tequila etc here it’s smirnoff and cheap tequila which considering the price we paid is totally unacceptable it’s been the most expensive so far.
We stayed in dreams royalton Rui to name a few the food standards and restaurants there are amazing and always premium drinks.
The drinks are also watered down massively as mentioned in previous reviews. 
I wished I had paid attention to the reviews about the food before booking but I really wanted to stay at this hotel. We feel so disappointed.
The coffee shop is open for about an hour a day as with the ice cream station so catch it when you can think they’ve closed them down because it’s not high season as with the restaurants.
The beach was beautiful weather amazing.
We love you Mexico and can’t wait to come back but wouldn’t come back here we could have saved thousands by booking a cheaper hotel on the hotel zone with the same standard of food and drink.

reviews.author: Sanjeev S
reviews.title: Not bad, but it could be better
reviews.text:
We reached there in the afternoon. Felt good when we were offered alcohol at the check in counter. The reception lady was just interested selling the Royal service upgrade. When I denied, then she rushed us, did explain very little about the resort and handed over the room keys. Room was really good. On the very first night I got sick. I kept throwing up all night. Either something I ate bad or may be the drinks were bad. It was a horrible experience. In the night time I felt hot. The air condition wont go below 18.5.
On the next day, my wife was taking shower and all of sudden there was no water at all in any tap. I called the main reception, they were kind to send a bucket full of water but that was not enough to rinse her hair full of shampoo. To make us happy we were given a bottle of sparkling wine and some chocolate dipped strawberries. There was some noise from a room adjoining to our room. It was either getting renovated or it was being used as a storage. We raised the noise concern but no one bothered.
Overall we enjoyed our trip. We would like to thank few people at Paradisus specially the entertainers: Rodrigo Ramirez, Julio Vacqnez, & Savc Zarate and one server in the buffet place( Naos) Andres Contreras. Yes like many other people has said, the resort is getting old and needs a fresh face.

reviews.author: OscarNavas
reviews.title: Great Vacations!
reviews.text: Great pool, great food (specially Blue Agave, better than most of the reservation restaurants) great beach, great beverages, great kids activities, my family truly enjoyed Cancún, and Paradisus Cancún, hope to stay at the hotel again in the near future. We

reviews.author: hotrod11296
reviews.title: 8 Days in Paradise
reviews.text: Room was great, ocean view. We have been coming here since 2001, missed 2005. Storm got there before we did. Used AMBAR for airport transfer. It was a private van and a  newer model and very clean. Julio C'esar was there on time, our plane got in early, he was waiting, I highly recommend this service. When we got to the hotel we were greeted by Raul , he treated us like family. Check in at Tower one was handled by Betsabe ( Betsy ) Ornelas, she made check in so easy. What a wonderful person. Asuncion, a waitress at pool was just great. The Paradisus is lucky to have such a great staff. As far as food goes, Fred's is great, prices are great, food is GREAT. Captains Cove, as well as Cenacolos was awesome, what can I add but wonderful food and prices.

reviews.author: JTomaaque
reviews.title: Relaxing, but not up to par.. (food and drinks get 1 star)
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful, relaxing time at Paradisus, but we would likely never come back. The service is nice, the main tower is gorgeous and the smells are wonderful. We stayed in Royal Service and our room was very nice. One of the drawers to our dresser was broken and there were some odd, out-dated parts to the hotel, but nothing too bad or uncomfortable. 

The private Royal Service pool was quiet and peaceful. Our first day in a Bali Bed, we barely saw our server which was frustrating. Our second day though, our server was very attentive. Even on the beach one day we had great service. 

The food was TERRIBLE. We read so many reviews and did a lot of research before settling on Paradisus. We saw the reviews where some said the food was bad and thought "well, ya, but its big buffets.." Frankly, I have a guilty pleasure for mid-quality buffet food- typically! Unfortunately, very few things were enjoyable, or even edible, during our stay. Cold, runny, or straight-up weird stuff. The best, in my opinion, were the tacos at Blue Agave and the food at La Palapa (private royal service restaurant). Vento was like the buffet food but in small portions and Enso was cold and mass-produced dishes. The Naos buffet had a few winners (surprisingly enough, the ceviche was decent) but mostly just cold, stale and bad. You get a lot of the same ingredients/tastes across all the restaurants which gets slightly annoying!

Something I didn't read about at all, but killed my vibe personally, was that all the sweet drinks used artificial sweetener! The sour mix and all the frozen drinks had a bad taste/aftertaste that I couldn't stomach after a couple days. Ended up just ordering vodka/tequila with soda water after that. These were fine but I REALLY wanted to kick back with a piña colada on most days and just couldn't put up with the taste any longer. 

I don't regret the vacation but would've traded some of the better parts of Paradisus for better food and drinks and would seek a better all-inclusive experience in the future. 

The weather was fantastic in October. We had rain forecasted every day but only got 1 brief shower in the morning.

reviews.author: hollymasterson
reviews.title: Good Hotel - needs updating. Just missed out on 4 stars.
reviews.text:
A lovely hotel but needs updating, think website and travel agency’s are a bit misleading on this. To begin with we had a nice bedroom located in the 4th tower. Room was nice, bit dated. A couple of days into the trip the aircon unit started to leak – it got considerably worse as the day went on until there was a mini swimming pool by the door. We also had a lot of water coming in through the balcony doors due to the rain. We complained and asked to move rooms. This was sorted and we were moved to a room in the 3rd tower. This room was better and was more modern! However after a couple more days in this hotel they started doing building work above us – which started really early in morning and went on until the early evening. Once again we complained but nothing was really done about this issue and in the end just decided to get on and enjoy our holiday. We found it really strange that they moved us to a room which they knew would be disrupted by the building work – not very good customer service. Tip – if you are planning on staying here the rooms in 2nd and 3rd tower are not very quiet as they are above all the bars! 

Food. Overall the food is good and does well for mass catering. Couple of places to stay clear off
Blue Algarve – food had absolutely no flavour! 
Vento – again really really bland food 
Enso – hit and miss – some dishes are ok and some again need flavour! 

The rest of the restaurants are great, including the buffet. Tip – on arrival they say you can book restaurants 1 day in advance, this is a lie you can book up to 2/3 days in advance so don’t get caught out. Reservations go quickly as not every restaurant is open every night. 

Swimming pools are excellent. There is an adults only/ royal service one, a quieter pool, the main pool ( which includes a swim up bar and music) and the kids pool which connects to the main pool. There are a lot of beds round the pools – the beds round the main pool are usually all gone by mid-morning but people come and go throughout the day. There is a serious lack of umbrellas! Cabanas are available to hire ( they are part of COCOs beach club) The beach is lovely and there are staff on hand to serve drinks.

Entertainment – hardly any of the activities that they advertised on the daily board actually happen… Evening entertainment is what you expect from a hotel. There were a couple of nights where the entertainment is exceeded expectations. 

Vibe – there is a real mix of dynamics at this hotel, couples, families, stag and hen groups, wedding groups. 
Staff – really friendly and mainly very helpful. 

Overall this was a good hotel. I believe they should have done more to compensate for the room problems but we could not be bothered to spend our holiday in reception complaining. There are better Cancun resorts but you will need to pay more so depends on what your budget is.

reviews.author: kristiamalone
reviews.title: Paradisus Melia Cancun
reviews.text: The hotel was built in 1999 and while our rooms were wonderful the outside pool chairs, outside of the building, and some minor leaking in our bathroom indicate repairs are needed. There were buckets in the hallway collecting rain and towels on the ground. If you like buffets vs sit down restaurants for lunch it is a great place. Most restaurants that are not buffets are only open for dinner or there is one for adults only. There are three pool options. One for little children, one for adults with loud club music and another quiet pool but there is no swim up pool bar in this one. If you book family concierge you will be provided with one VIP pool couch but only by the shallow pool and our children are too old for the shallow pool. Despite the rain with many of these couches available at the second large pool they would not move this as part of our experience.

reviews.author: Alfredo F
reviews.title: Escape, relax, bask in the sun, enjoy good food and get pampered with excellent service!
reviews.text: Second time we came after one month to Paradisus Cancun, given our great experience. This time to celebrate our long Wedding Anniversary! We were not disappointed. Long and quiet beach, clean ocean (just some algae but you can find clear spots), great service where you can actually get to know the amazing personal and family lives of our attendants in learning hospitality and educating their children towards a better future! Thanks to Atilano from delicious Naos Asian restaurant, Nicolas Panti from the Enso restaurant; José with the towels, Valeria and Zasdiel in Palapa; receptionist Gloria at fabulous Mole restaurant, where Mexican "Charros" beautifully sang "Como han pasado los años" (How all these years have gone by) for us! Alejandro took the initiative to prepare three gorgeous dessert samples (see picture). There's a disco at night ("Red") where you can have fun dancing to all world rhythms (while Francisco comes and serves you drinks!). Unforgettable!

reviews.author: CPre17
reviews.title: Great visit
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time at Paradisus Cancun. Not only is the hotel beautiful, but the staff is exceptional! A special thank you to Hugo for taking care of us while we enjoyed the pool, Edwin at Bana for finding something for my picky daughter to eat, and the Nespresso barista for knowing my order by my second visit. We will be returning to  Paradisus!

reviews.author: Curious618264
reviews.title: Paradisus cancun
reviews.text: Overall was nice ,clean,good entertainment, the toilets  outside need renovation and the AC to work . The drinking cups are gross ,don't reuse them .open earlier the ice cream shop and the coffee shop as well.

reviews.author: Atulupadhyay2015
reviews.title: Awesome is the word
reviews.text: amazing property, great hospitality loved the greenery, rainforest kind of greenery inside the hotel..view from balconies is absolutely stunning all restaurants serve fab food. we enkjoyed our stay thouroughly. English seems to be bit of problem with some staff..

reviews.author: Fer_MdelC
reviews.title: Not as good as before
reviews.text:
We were here two years ago and it was an invaluable experience. Service was great, food excellent and the premises were beautiful. 

This time we found an average hotel, the food was nothing exciting, it lacked the sea food and room treats we had on our last visit, the pool facilities lacked maintenance and the room jacuzzi didn't invite us to use it.

It's a shame to see that maybe because by trying to reduce costs they sacrificed quality.

reviews.author: StefB
reviews.title: Budke
reviews.text: Very nice experience. Our first room was on the lower level and we could not see the ocean. I asked if we could move to a higher floor and they were able to accommodate this request for us. Second room was wonderful. I felt like the red lounge could use some updating. Too much fabric that felt dirty.

reviews.author: Phyllis A
reviews.title: A slice of Paradise
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun may be an older resort but the service couldn't be more excellent.  The people were amazing in their attitude and service.  As an all inclusive nothing was lacking.  The Cirque de Soiel show was really a fun way to spend the evening, and the beach and the pools were the best.  There is even an adults only side away from the activity of families.

reviews.author: colleen123102
reviews.title: paradisus cancun is a paradise on earth
reviews.text:
the paradisus is one of the nicest places i have ever stayed in.  the service and food 
was excellent.  the people and staff were so friendly i made new friends.
the rooms we slept in were clean and nice.  many different pools to pick from to swim in 
and the entertainment was spectacular.  i would not hesitate to return.

reviews.author: V2185CXdave
reviews.title: Wonderful place!
reviews.text: My wife and I wanted to stay here for a week of relaxation after a very busy Summer.  We had never stayed in an "All Inclusive" so it was a new experience.  Even though we do not drink, we loved the food, the service, the people, the relaxing atmosphere!  It was so nice to just sit and be pampered!  We are planning to go back as soon as possible.

reviews.author: stltraveler_7
reviews.title: The Paradisus lives up to its name
reviews.text:
My husband and I recently spent a week at the Paradisus in celebration of our son’s wedding.  Given how nice the resort was, and how close to the airport it is, we thought the couple made a good choice. The wedding went off without a hitch [even with an unexpected shower], and all their family and friends seemed to have a good time. I would rate the Paradisus 4.5 stars if allowed, rather than just 4.

This was our 13th time at a Mexican resort, and like most places there were pros [lots more of these] and cons, so here goes.

SERVICE: Service was definitely 5 stars. Everyone we encountered was friendly, courteous, and obviously committed to top flight service at all times. This was true whether you tipped or not. [We do think tipping is appropriate.] The maids, bar tenders, and wait staff could not have been more attentive. I split my coffee one morning, and I do not think it took our waiter more than 30 seconds to appear at our table to clean it up.

POOLS and BEACH:  This was also 5 stars in my book. The pools were kept very clean and were in excellent shape – no missing tiles, etc. We are both tall and loved that the water was 5 ft deep. This made swimming or just hanging out in the water so much more enjoyable. A BIG advantage was NO TOWEL CARDS.  The beach towels were also nice and large. The beach was beautiful, and the Paradisus cleaned up as much sea weed as possible every day. This was a losing battle. The ocean was too rough to swim in, but that was not the fault of the hotel. This was one of the very few resorts we have gone to that has enough palapas on the beach. We also enjoyed checking on the turtle nest enclosure daily, and were lucky enough to see new born turtles. When we alerted the staff to this fact, they sent hotel security to collect the babies so that they would not get eaten by the birds. My only negative comment, is that the presence of all the bali beds by the main pool [which you must rent and were almost all empty during our stay] took up so much space that could have been used by regular chairs, of which there were not enough. My suggestion is to move the bali beds to the quiet pool and replace them with palapas and chairs.

ROOM:  4.5 stars. We were in a Jr suite lagoon view, which was just fine with us. [see photos below] The room was in good shape, with very beautiful marble floors and stone tile work in the bathroom. There were plenty of hangers in the nice-sized closet which included the safe and an umbrella, and one set of drawers. The bathroom had a bidet which was a nice surprise. The shower was great with both a large rain head and a flexible wand type hose. Instead of bath towels, there were bath sheets. There was shampoo and conditioner, but I was glad I brought my heavy duty conditioner. Our mini-bar was restocked every day with bottled water [You can get as much as you want, which was very nice], soda, including diet sprite and coke, juice, beer and a few snacks.  The balconies are large and VERY private. We enjoyed sitting out in the morning with a cup of coffee.

FOOD:  3.5 stars. If the Paradisus has a weak spot, it is the food.  Getting into one of the a la carte restaurants was almost impossible. If some of our party had not been in royal service with a butler to handle this for our group, we all would never have gotten in. We ate at Vento, which was fun. Our favorite dishes were the butter fish and the curried shrimp. Or favorite restaurant was Market Grill’s Brazilian restaurant. What fun! The Buffet was fine with dishes and desserts changing daily. When I ate something I was hoping to catch again, I never saw it a second time.  There was always something tasty to eat. You could have raw meat grilled fresh, but no fresh raw fish which was a big disappointment. I thought many of the baked goods were over baked and somewhat dry. Two of the a la carte restaurants were attached to the main buffet, which was unusual.

Bars: 4.5 stars. All the bar tenders were friendly and efficient.  They would prepare anything you asked for. The re-usable glasses were 8 to 10 oz. It you wanted a specific liquor brand, all you had to do was ask. Beers on tap were Sol, Dos Equis Lager and Dos Equis Amber. Gins  [we are a G & T family] included Tanqueray, Beefeater, and Bombay Sapphire. You can also get sprite zero and diet coke, which we appreciated. The service at the main pool was exceptional, with bar staff making the rounds of guests regularly to see if you wanted anything. They also came down to the beach palapas.

COFFEE: 5 stars. We are coffee hounds. The coffee bar did not open until 8:30 am, but there is coffee service set up outside the coffee bar [just outside the buffet] complete with take-away cups. I loved the lattes. If you are a coffee drinker, you get a carafe for your breakfast table, which was great. We both liked the coffee.
MISC: 
WiFi ; The wifi signal is strong throughout the resort.
