Bus stop and shopping. There is a bus stop directly in front of the resort on Kukulcan Blvd. The bus drivers will stop for you and wait if you just wave at them. We went to the La Isla shopping mall which was 12 pesos each way on a 5 minute trip. It was easy and fun. Just tell the bus driver you want to go to La Isla on the way there and stop at Aquaworld on the way back.
Kayaking. Just go across the street to Aquaworld and resister as a Paradisus guest.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at the Paradisus.

reviews.author: Jennifer T
reviews.title: Excellent entertainers!!!!
reviews.text: Saul, Rodrigo & Julio made us feel so special on this trip, like real celebrities!  They do such a good job organizing activities and making us feel included. They really made everything fun and became a part of our family. We can’t wait to come back to vacation with them!  Come stay here and you won’t be disappointed- 2 thumbs up for sure!!

reviews.author: Christina D
reviews.title: Mucho fun at the Paradisus with these awesome guys.
reviews.text: If you want to have fun in Cancun this is the place to be. They will make sure you have activities all day long. They are so sweet and accomadating. Saul, Rodrigo, and Julio have been so great with making sure we were always having fun. From sushi workshops to tequila workshops to beach volleyball to water polo. Always having a blast.

reviews.author: mskesq
reviews.title: Home Again
reviews.text:
We returned to the Paradisus Cancun after a 10-year absence.  The last time we were here it was still called the Gran Melia Cancun.  It was our fourth time staying at this property, all in the Royal Service Section.  When we walked into the Hotel, my first comment was “I’m Home!”.  It felt just as the past three times, so familiar and warm and welcoming.  Now the hotel is all-incisive, when we were here last, it was an option.

We were brought directly to Pyramid Five, the Royal Service part, and sat down to do our check in.  Our room was ready, and all we had to do was wait a few minutes for our Butler, Hector to take us to Room 5123.  The room have been redone since our last visit, and all I have to say is WOW!  The bathroom is marvelous, almost larger than some hotel rooms we have stayed in, with a huge standing tub and shower in a “wet-room” arrangement, with a class wall to the rest of the huge room.  The air conditioning is adequate.  The room does not get ice-box cold, but you are in Cancun. (As an aside, we did a tour of the Secrets on the Vine property for the Vacation Club – don’t get me started, but that is a story for another day.  That resort is very contemporary and does not feel like it has the same Mexican Influence and feel that Paradisus has.  The room there wasmuch smaller.)

Our luggage arrived quickly, and Hector offered to unpack for us.  We said that we would take care of it as we wanted to get out to the pool ASAP.

Hector asked about our Dining Preferences, location time etc. and said he would make reservations.  We also talked about reservations for the Palapya’s around the pool.  Hector was terrific, taking care of every request we had.  Moises and Ramon at the pool were wonderful.  Everyone in the Hotel is friendly and welcoming.  The only less than enthusiastic response we ever got was from Jose at the Palapya Desk at the pool.  He was kind of a downer.

If anything, the all-inclusive makes the experience even better than before.  We ordered drinks and food and gave no thought to the cost.  The only draw back is you are less inclined to go into the Hotel Zone and explore the other restaurants and bars.  We did get out one night to La Distilleria to meet a friend we have in Cancun One of the old Gran Melia employees we met on our first trip.  We became very friendly and have met up several time in Cancun, Cozumel and even in NYC).  That dinner was fantastic.

The food at Paradisus Cancun is amazing.  We had only two complaints.  The first day the French Fries we got with the pool snacks were cold and soggy and there was one other dish that was only average.  We loved Mole, went there twice, Bano (the Asian) was terrific, the Market Grill was great.  Fuego was good, probably the number 3 favorite.  La Palapya Restaurant at the Royal Service Pool was great for Breakfast and Lunch and the food they put out all day (breakfast type in the morning and non-breakfast the rest of the day) in the Royal Service Pyramid was terrific.

They had a show at the Avenue Bar every night.  Just a dance group, or acrobats or singers.  The Red Lounge was a bit of a disappointment. 

The property is stunning gorgeous and very well maintained.  The inside is lush with plants and incense and the architecture makes if feels like a Mexican Resort.  And yes, the Lobby Main Pyramid gets very warm, but regardless it is still a great place to spend a week.

We can not wait to go back and enjoy our second Home.

reviews.author: apriljeanjoell
reviews.title: Very much recommended
reviews.text: Guests should be made aware of the burning of insence due to any asthma and allergies. Every evening there was burning that changed any indoor evening plans we had. We stayed in our room most evenings due to it and enjoyed the in room entertainment.

reviews.author: Connector591584
reviews.title: Best service ever experience!!
reviews.text: Every staff is extremely friendly.  Very nice beach.  Resort has a lot of restaurants to satisfy your need.  The service level of our butler gave us the most valuable experience ever.  Definitely recommended!

reviews.author: Jeff P
reviews.title: 2018 Vacation
reviews.text: Excellent!!! Great food very clean, smells great. Friendly people beautiful views great spa and nice gym. Thanks to Rosanna our butler. Oscar, Valeria & Orlando at The Palapa Restaurant. Also the Bartenders at the Royal Service pool area Eder & Sergio and Orlando and Argenis at the Avenue Bar. Thank you for making our vacation great.

reviews.author: Mark H
reviews.title: Mr
reviews.text:
This was our 17 th time to Cancun area. The reviews you read about this hotel are pretty accurate. The people are friendly that work there. The place is elegant, views are awesome. Food is confusing, pay here$ , not here, all inclusive means all inclusive. They will charge $ at certain restaurants. To confusing. The reviews , like I said earlier , are pretty accurate. However, no one addresses the “FUN” factor , this is not a “fun” place. They worry about elegance. It’s more for the 1 % ters of the world, not the common person, middle class. Of all the places, 36 throughout the Caribbean, we have been to , we have never been in a pool like theirs. 5’2” deep!!! Your kids can not play volleyball, basketball, etc....my wife is short , 5’4” tall. It was a struggle walking to the pool bar. Every pool we have been to is 4 ‘ (48”) deep. Kids playing everywhere. Absolutely no entertainment at the pool during the day, what? I’m not kidding. Everybody has entertainment at the pool, just not here. The music is European electronic dance music, and very loud. This is Mexico!!! 
This hotel is Beautiful, elegant, amazing, just not “ FUN”.  

Make sure you see the Whale Sharks.

reviews.author: Desiree R
reviews.title: Fantastic Resort and Amazing Service
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I visited Paradisus for our first international trip. We decided to upgrade our stay and book the royal service package. Even without the upgrade I’m sure our stay would have been amazing but the royal service took our trip from great to phenomenal! The property is beautiful and clean but the real stars are the employees. Each employee we encountered was friendly and beyond accommodating. I would like to personally recognize Leyner (butler), Daphne (concierge), Eddy (pool service), Miguel (Banna) and Angelique (Aqua World). Each of these individuals excelled in their position. Leyner and Daphne were especially helpful throughout our trip. They helped with booking restaurants and gave personal recommendations in regards to what to do in the city. Thank you Paradisus Family for making our first international trip one to remember. We hope to back within the next six months.

reviews.author: J R
reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: Enjoyed the experience at the hotel.  Decently priced for a couple's getaway.  The tours available at the hotel are a must, but make sure they tell you what is and isn't included, as this was a huge issue for us.  The staff is incredible, they are there to serve and you can see how honest they are with their welcome!  The food is okay, definitely try to make reservations at restaurants, as the buffet is not that great.

reviews.author: Vinnie D
reviews.title: A very nice, family vacation
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus for a week stay with my wife and 11-year old son.  We were very happy with our experience.  We did have the Family Concierge level of room and the staff/butler were extremely helpful and the family lounge was nice to have.  They were very friendly and took care of all of our needs.  Elliot at the pool was fantastic, he made sure we were taken care of every day!  He is a huge asset to the hotel.  The restaurants were good, some of the food was bland, but all better than most resorts we've been.  The morning breakfast buffet took care of my son by making him chocolate chip pancakes everyday, even without ordering them (a few tips go a long way...).  We visit many resorts and we will definitely be back to Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: Mrsva1dez
reviews.title: Fun times...
reviews.text: We had the best time at Paradisus. From the beginning, Itzel at the front desk was super patient with us. Especially since we had traveled overnight. The food was delicious. The service at the restaurants was spectacular. We were served by Carlos and Alan multiple times and their service was always above and beyond. We can’t wait to go back and try all the restaurants and enjoy all the amenities

reviews.author: PricklyPear18
reviews.title: Just OK
reviews.text:
We just returned from 5 nights at the Paradisus where we were part of a wedding party.  We've been to a number of all-inclusive resorts in several different places in Mexico and found the Paradisus to be underwhelming.  

Check-in unfortunately includes a sales pitch for a "club" membership (don't call it a timeshare, they'll correct you endlessly).  Almost every member of our party was told that their room wouldn't be ready for 20 mins at check-in and given various degrees of pressure to purchase a "club" membership.  Magically, as soon as the sales people gave up, the rooms were ready every time.  This is not how I wanted to start my vacation.

We stayed in a lagoon view room and it was fine.  The room itself was quite.  As it was low season I can't be sure if there were people in the rooms around us but I'm a fairly light sleeper and wasn't woken up once.  The bed was OK but the pillows definitely needed to be replaced.  The elevator by our room was broken during our entire stay which was a little inconvenient.  

The highlight of our stay was the service.  Every single person we interacted with was kind and generous.  People really went above and beyond consistently (this was also true of the servers at the wedding who were particularly amazing). We had several members that went the Royal Service route and the butlers were great.  The staff is 5 star all of the way.

The beach is also very nice but the ocean was very rough every day we were there and was technically "closed."  We still swam briefly but this location is better suited to sitting out than swimming.  We had no problems getting chairs on the beach or by the pool but I could see it being difficult in high season.

The lowlight would be the food.  At check-in we were given a list of all of the restaurants   and their hours of operation.  This turned out to be consistently wrong.  We tried to go to Blue Agave numerous times during our stay but only found it to be open one time.  The same was true for the sit down restaurants.  We would try to make reservations only to be told that the restaurant wasn't open that night, the next night, etc.  Look, I get it's low season and that could cause you to reduce operating hours but there's no reason you can't update the sheet so we know what our options are instead of wasting time trying to figure it out.  Additionally, the sit down restaurants took very few reservations.  The couple of times we succeeded in making a reservation, the place was more than half empty but they were turning down additional reservations.  We also consistently struggled to get reservations for larger parties.  The two times we were successful, the restaurants insisted that we do family style and made the food selections for us.  We were told that they would bring everything out but this didn't end up being the case and I was disappointed that we didn't get to try some things.  The food at Blue Agave and the sit down restaurants were pretty good but the buffet was bad.  

Overall, for the price there's better to be had.

reviews.author: pedrord650
reviews.title: Cancun 2018 Vacations
reviews.text: We have traveled to different places and have had wonderful experiences with service at the hotels but this one is unbeatable!!! The hotel, as it is named, is a Paradise, marvelous all over, in size, shape, location and extremely well clean and kept. The restaurants are first class, excellent service and food in not matter which one of the restaurants, delicious high class type. Personnel always smiling and willingly to help you in not matter what situation could be. Room service and cleanliness, the best of the best. If a ten stars rating could have been used, that would be the one I would have given!!!

reviews.author: marie e
reviews.title: Decent for the price
reviews.text: We returned to paradisus because we were here 2 years ago and really enjoyed our stay as well as the quality of everything for the price of the deal that we got. This visit was not as great. The quality of both the food and drinks has gone down. It's still a decent hotel if you can get a good deal on your room but it's just not great anymore. All of the drinks (even the ones that aren't supposed to be) were very sugary and very weak. I ended up having to buy a bottle of wine just to get a drink that wasn't loaded with sugar....then again, maybe that was the plan on the part of the hotel? The restaurants are not bad but we were not blown away. The red lounge was fun...until you wanted to go to sleep and couldn't because all you could hear is the noise coming from the red lounge if your room is close to it. The gym was pretty good for a hotel gym and the excercise classes were not too bad. The "entertainment staff" was not good. They often had events posted such as beach volleyball and pool Zumba that never happened which left a lack of things to do during the day if you weren't out on an excursion. Overall, not terrible but I don't think that we'll be returning.

reviews.author: Etown S
reviews.title: BEST VACATION EVER!!!!!!
reviews.text: This was our first trip to Cancun and we will definitely be back! Family Concierge is a must as they really make is special for your kids. Alex and Lili were absolutely amazing taking care of our needs in the room, dinner and Elliott at the pool was willing to help with anything we needed. The food was the best of any all-inclusive we’ve stayed at. Sure, there are misses, but ask for something else if you don’t like it and they are extremely accommodating. I can’t imagine any of the reviews talking about rude staff being accurate, because everyone from check in to maintenance bent over backwards to make sure our stay was spectacular). Rooms are spotless and the pools crystal clear! We are already discussing a return to Paradisus Cancun next year!

reviews.author: mhs228
reviews.title: Wonderful place but average food
reviews.text: We stayed for all inclusive 5 nights at Paradisus Cancun in an Ocean view room. Staff is very nice and helpful. Hotel location is best in the area. Everything was excellent. Breakfast was excellent. Lunch is below average. There is only one restaurant open during lunch time. Dinner is above average. There are many restaurants available in the resort for Dinner but not many options available in menu.  Looks like they tried to save money by not including food items like Shrimp, salmon, tilapia etc you normally see in a beach resort. There might be hotels out there with litter better food and more price. Overall, we are satisfied with what we got for the money we paid.

reviews.author: ryanthomas973
reviews.title: Very good
reviews.text: We came to this hotel expecting a great time and we got that in abundance, from the moment we got to the door to the process of leaving we were greeted with smiling faces and professional attitudes. I can’t stress enough how above and beyond the staff go to ensure you enjoy your stay. The royal service rooms have been renovated and are amazing, comfortable beds with the room being spotless from top to bottom. The inside of the hotel is just as picturesque as the views outside with each pyramid with something different showing as a centrepiece. Would reccomend anyone to stay here!

reviews.author: adela f
reviews.title: Wonderful place to stay for vacation.
reviews.text:
We went there for a 6 day vacation, and we reserved a room with an ocean view.the room have an excellent view and the room was clean. The location of the hotel is great.  All the employees are very friendly . There’s many restaurants to choose, we had dinner at mole,vento,  market grill and Naos . The food and service at vento was great, and the food at market grill is delicious. Naos is a buffet restaurant withgreat international food, thank you to the chef Manuel.. I have to mention the service from IgnaciobVazquez,
David blanco and Tomas were excellent and friendly. Thank you for all the attention.

reviews.author: jenniferb_carson
reviews.title: Whoo whoo was awesome
reviews.text: Great trip & Service Wonderful experience staff awesome would come back, Red Lounge was fun enjoyed that ear phone thing never done that before great drinks with premium alcohol used; plenty of room at pool & beach

reviews.author: Anabel G
reviews.title: Exceeded expectations
reviews.text:
This is by far the best resort we have stayed at. The attention we received was unmatched with anyone else. They truly do make you feel like royalty. There is security while entering the premises which is a nice plus.
Check in was easy, the hotel is very well kept. The ambiance is very calm and relaxing. The suites are very clean and the mini bar is fully stocked.. which everything is already included and refilled daily. 
The view from the room is breathtaking. We would definitely go back just to stay in this resort. I cannot say it enough how comfortable everyone made us feel. Not one bad thing to say. The nightlife activity is good, as well as the day activities. The view from the pool is spectacular.

reviews.author: Cynthia F
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: I stayed for 7 nights and there was many restaurants and also many options to choose from the room service menu. Super friendly staff. My favorite two that I will never forget is Chef Eduardo Mukul and Server Edwin Ordoñez. I was celebrating my 31st birthday and they made me feel like royalty. Edwin setup a special table decorated with balloons for the occasion. My experience at Naos Restaurant was the best! I really recommend this hotel. I have three children at our visit their ages were 1, 7, 8 therefore it was really nice to take them to the kids zone and baby club where the staff were friendly and fun, they have multiple activities for the kids it's amazing, the best part is that my kids liked being there giving me and my husband alone time. By far my best stay in Cancun. I've been to Cancun throughout my life 6 times and this was my favorite place to stay in Cancun. Thank you again to Chef Eduardo Mukul and Server Edwin Ordoñez. :)

reviews.author: Ashleykendray34
reviews.title: nice hotel not run well tho
reviews.text:
I've stayed at the la Perla twice before and is my favourite hotel in the world. the service and food quality here let the brand down. 
went back to meet checkin person so they could explain how it all works at the time he said but he never showed up ?
for some reason have to pay to use a cabana at the pool but little to no shade for kids or people who didn't want to sit in sun all day.
chines restaurant was closed for 3 nights and couldn't get into the rest over the weekend booked out. and the buffet average at best for quality had a good range but hot dishes weren't hot and air cons turned off during day time so humid and hot in restaurant
rooms were nice ours had just been renovated so unfortunately had strong smell of thinners for at least couple of days. hot water took about 5 minutes before hot water got to the room so pre plan shower and turn on before you get in.
just a bit dated I think Melia should think about a close on the next off season and fully renovate it. get it up to date. 
al lot of the staff had issues with English I never found this at la Perla  so need some training there to make things easier for us silly tourists.
overall was still a nice place to stay but left our group wanting for more definitely not as good as it should be !
yhi spa was great really good staff

reviews.author: amberleilani
reviews.title: Already wanting to plan my next trip...
reviews.text:
We visited Paradisus for a week and had THE MOST incredibly relaxing vacation. From the moment you arrive you are surrounded by beautiful scenery and decor, but what really stood out about our stay was the insanely friendly, attentive, hardworking staff. Raul was the first smiling face we met at Paradisus, such a kind guy. We have never experienced greater service anywhere and are already recommending Paradisus Cancun to our friends and family for this very reason. We booked a “Royal Service” suite, which I highly recommend. Arturo, our butler for the week, went out of his way to make our honeymoon extra special. He even planned a surprise to have our room decorated with roses one evening while we were at dinner; so sweet!! Arturo checked in with us daily, always with a smile on his face, reserved poolside “Bali Beds” for us each day, and got us dinner reservations at each of the restaurants of our choice. 

Our favorite restaurant was Vento, not just because the food was great, but due to  our server, Carlos Gonzales. We went back a second night to Vento literally because of him!! He really went the extra mile to talk to the kitchen to provide me with vegetarian options, by remembering us by name and our orders from a few nights before, and even by bringing us a special dessert the last night of our stay. Carlos, you rock. 

We ate breakfast and most lunches at La Palapa, and were always impressed with the quality of the food. All of the Royal Service staff were amazing, but Julio, Valeria, Daniel, Cesar, Eddie, and Victor really stood out to us, always making sure we were one hundred percent stuffed with yummy food and beyond hydrated. 

Can’t wait to start planning our next trip to Paradisus and to take our family and friends!

reviews.author: marcelladawson
reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: I would definitely recommend this hotel as the staff were fantastic service amazing food was Great it was just perfect. Thank you to the paradisus hotel and their amazing staff for such a great holiday definitely will return again in the future

reviews.author: M_Lobato7
reviews.title: Relaxing Honeymoon
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed in the royal wing of the resort and it was incredible. Our butler, Hector was so attentive and went above and beyond for us. The entire staff is so friendly and accommodating.  We took advantage of some of the activities offered at the resort, and really enjoyed the mixology workshop that we did. We were so relaxed, and it was the perfect getaway! We would highly recommend this, and would love to go back.

reviews.author: Nathan K
reviews.title: Amazing resort, fantastic staff
reviews.text: We stayed here for 6 days, and absolutely loved it. did a lot of activities that the resort offered, but most importantly - Alberto Diaz at NAOS restaurant made our trip 10000 times more enjoyable! Super genuine person that will take care of you! Definitely recommend this place!

reviews.author: andregmera
reviews.title: Relaxing family vacation
reviews.text:
We loved our stayed at the hotel, staff was very friendly, the food at the booked restaurants was really good. 
My two year old girl really enjoyed the pool, the pool is so well design for kids and also thought for parents to keep an eye on them, it is spacious and allow the little ones to feel some freedom and independence.

reviews.author: Kenn L
reviews.title: Awesome trip
reviews.text: Good hotel with good service.Was worth every cent of it. I got the royal service and it was awesome. the only bad thing is the food. The food is the only thing tat need improvement. other than that, all is good and worth the time and money.

reviews.author: evelyni84
reviews.title: Family vacation !
reviews.text: We had a great time! Every year we take a family vacation and this is the third year we been staying at a Melia hotel and again it was a great time! I will definitely be back! The hotel is beautiful and staff very friendly!

reviews.author: j m
reviews.title: They made my dream come true!
reviews.text: I used to be a flight attendant and this hotel has been my home for 5 beautiful years (20 years ago!), at the time the name was GRAND MELIA'...It was just one pyramid and I saw building the other ones :) I spent the last 8 years talking to my husband about this place and I really wanted to take him and the kids there to show them a piece of my life, I couldn't be happier when I saw the deal for a dream vacation on Expedia. Let me start by telling  you we have been treated like ROYALTIES! Since the moment we checked in to our check out everything was just perfect, they really made my dream come true, my husband and both my little kids were incredibly happy about the whole experience. A great thank you to our server Omar Garcia who works at Naos, he has been such an amazing person to talk to that we requested him every night! We also want to thank his manager Gulliermo Lopez who made our nights just PERFECT, they did everything possible to make sure we were experiencing our vacation at best. Everything you need is here, the entire hotel is beyond clean, I would say spotless. We had our room done in the morning and in the evening, the kids club is wonderful if you have kids, mine had a blast. I never ever saw so much kindness and welcoming attitude and I did travelled the world. I work in the customer service business now and I am so happy this vacation gave me the chance to learn something great that I will cherish forever and use in my business too, only so much to learn from this amazing staff. Thank you for making my family happy, it really meant a lot to me. Thank you for not disappointing me after years of dreaming about coming back here. We are already talking about our next vacation there next year! We will definitely see you soon. Thanks again.

reviews.author: Brian S
reviews.title: Best place to stay in Cancun
reviews.text: We have stayed at a few hotels in Cancun but this will now be the place we will always go to when visiting. It is truly a five star experience. We wanted to change rooms and thought it might be difficult but they were more than happy to accommodate us. We were a little skeptical of going back to Mexico with the State Dept warning but there were no issues whatsoever. The food in the buffet was delicious. Each night was something a little different, from scallops, squid, mani mahi to steak, it was all so good. The restaurants were also fantastic and the service was top notch. We enjoyed our stay so much we will be going back soon!

reviews.author: P5500BOrafaelr
reviews.title: Inconsistent
reviews.text: Not a bad place but I signed up for Royal Service and did not receive the attention that was promised, saw the butler the first day but he was off the next two days called for services but was ignored. The rest of the service staff was very good attentive and friendly, but because of the inconsistency, I would not stay there again.

reviews.author: Alex Bolanos
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel and Fantastic Service
reviews.text: We stayed 5 nights at the Paradisus, and all Incan sway is that the place is fantastic! The hotel is incredible, with great restaurants, gorgeous front beach, nice and clean rooms, and the staff is great!

reviews.author: Sharif K
reviews.title: 2nd Visit
reviews.text:
It was a terrible from the get go. We reserved a ocean view suite and was told suite didn't mean a 2nd living area as we are used to in the US and like we had the first time. I said I would pay for an upgrade but they only available room they could give us didn't have ocean view but the view of a pool (first floor). Anyway upon entering the room my wife goes into the bathroom and finds a lizard, screams and locks the door. I call front door someone comes after an hour and sprays something I don't know but then I go into the bathroom find the lizard again. I put a towel over it and stomp it to death. Took me a while but I got it. 

Maria the our royal service attendant was nice but the rest of the crew that I initially dealt with was flat out rude. Anyway We went back to this place because the first time around was fantastic but 2nd time around was a bust. Obviously won't return there are plenty of other resorts.

reviews.author: KIM W
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation
reviews.text: The best vacation ever!! Never been to Cancun. Went here in trip advisor and loved what I saw.  It was such an incredible place.  The room was unbelievable, food incredible and service. The most perfect blue water and white beaches. 5stars

reviews.author: Jerry
reviews.title: Really Good, even Great at times, but not Excellent
reviews.text:
If you are going for your first time to an all inclusive resort then this hotel will probably knock your socks off. If you are a more experienced traveler, then you might want to know some of the short-comings.

First and foremost (or my husband will kill me) is the lack of good AC in the common area restaurants. I was okay mostly, while my hubby continuously had to ask staff to point a fan in his direction. Nice thing is that all the restaurants allows shorts to be worn. While I'm on the topic of the restaurants, not all of them are open every day. So while you may think when you get there that your choices are limitless, that really is not the case. We upgraded to Royal Service (I'll explain more later) so reservations was not an issue for us. The food was for us Vegans was best at Mole and, believe it or not, the Market Grill steak restaurant (if you don't mind slabs of meat being brought to your table, since we were vacationing with carnivores). The food at Mole was just yummy yummy, and Market Grill had a lot of grilled veggies to choose from. In general though, our special meal restrictions (as they referred to them) were often lost in translation between the server and the kitchen. The server would repeat exactly what we wanted, but then would come out with something else. This happened several times at different restaurants on the property.

Also the coffee and gelato bars were RARELY open. None of us could figure out the hours or days and the coffee bar was really bad. No blender or any specialty drinks really. No almond milk or other choices, basically if you could find it open you could get the same cup of coffee you could get in the buffet.

The design of the hotel itself was also lacking function. It was difficult to get places, not all floors connect to other wings and to go to the pool we would first have to pass by it then go down a floor and then we could go back in the direction of it.

The rooms in Pyramid 4 were nice but kind of standard, Pyramid 1 was old and dingy. The step up into the bathtub shower combination was a doozie and we are both tall. I can't imagine how difficult it would have been for my mother. And the housekeeping service would not take dishes away from your room, that was for a different staff member I guess. And the smoke detector over the bed was like Close Encounters of the Third Kind. Blinking a secret message to you while you try to sleep.

The upgrade to Royal Service was worth every penny. We wanted a more Adults Only experience and got this with the upgrade. Plus, our butler Mari (Maria) was the best thing about our trip. She was on top of everything and a real pleasant person. But even the 'Royal' treatment lacked in areas. In the Royal Service section on the beach they would let beach vendors come and take a siesta right there under a palapa. Some smoked weed there, and 2 got in a full on fists out fight over a potential customer. While I realize these folks have a hard job walking the beach all day, it did not feel very royal having them share your restricted area.

And while I'm on the subject of vendors, they even have an onsite tour company poolside. So every time you walk by that area (which is hard to avoid) you get the same unwanted attention you would walking down the street or in a shopping mall, except you're in the supposed safe space of your hotel. HEY AMIGOS WHAT ARE YOUR PLANS TODAY?

Another not so Royal thing that happened at the Adults Royal Service pool is that they let one of the guests play music loud on his speakers. There was already resort music playing. While the guest is just as much at fault for this, any one of the staff could have asked him nicely to use headphones.

We had also called a week before we arrived for restaurant and spa reservations. We were given the restaurant reservation for the first night (since we arrived on my birthday). The spa they told us no need for reservations and confirmed they had both male and female massage therapist. However, there were no male therapists when we got there.

Lastly I want to discuss the Resort Credit.  I usually don’t care much about this, but this one really rubbed me the wrong way.  It is a coupon book worth absolutely nothing.  Most coupons require such a high dollar value to use, you would never use it.  Basically almost every service in there you can find a better deal just by asking or negotiating.  And you can only use them on regular price services so don’t think you’re going to double dip with a deal here.  If you want a true resort credit, do your research, there are other hotels very close in vicinity that offer REAL resort credits that you can use on tours, spa, etc. without spending your money.

Excellent Paradisus service members included:
Mari
Eddie
Octavio
Moises
Jorge
Valeria
Ricardo
Manager of Mole

reviews.author: idzyns
reviews.title: fantastic hotel
reviews.text: rooms are great ( the two room suite) and the staff is fantastic. food is good and always available. get the beach bed and the lobster. you wont regret it. the family butler service will make sure you and your family are taken care of all day and night.

reviews.author: Jill M
reviews.title: Awesome Hotel, Great Staff, Beautiful Ocean views
reviews.text:
We just returned from an excellent and incredibly relaxing week at this hotel with our family of 5 (kids 10,7,4)The whiny reviews are ridiculous. The staff is friendly, hotel is clean, pool is great, ocean was gorgeous. We did the family concierge program, which was a really nice addition. Maria and Gloria were AWESOME and did such cool things for our kids (toys, treats, food to feed the fish, balloons, and more). They loved finding surprises in our room. 

All the staff we met were SO friendly, we got to know the waiters in the buffet and they remembered us which was sweet. 

We had a king size bed, the couch pulled out and they brought a nice sized roll away which was perfect for our family of 5. 

The buffet was better than we expected, breakfast especially was excellent and overall it was very good with a wide variety for all. Best sweets/pastries, even my non sweets eating husband loved them. Omelets were delish and fruit was aplenty. Best restaurant was Enzo by far. The Brazilian Steakhouse was also very good.  

It was very international which was great. My kids made friends from Argentina and Chile and the UK.

Only negative would be the lack of signs so it took us a few days to get our bearings. The only other mildly annoying thing was the frequent extras they tried to sell you (spa, photo ops, etc). But I’m stretching to consider this a real negative. Once we said no a few times they quit asking! 

We barely touched an electronic device and spent 6 full days at the pool and beach. You can’t go wrong here! Book this vacation right now and you will not be disappointed!

reviews.author: audreybanks20
reviews.title: 30th Anniversary
reviews.text: Great service, will recommend to family and friends. The food at all the specialty restaurants was very good. Daniel our butler was above the standard. Drinks were good. Bali beds were nice. The Market Brazilian Steakhouse was awesome. Try the French toast at Lapalapa, you won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: Nortoa
reviews.title: Amazing Staff
reviews.text: I will start this review to say we stayed at the Hyatt Ziva last time so it may not be a fair comparison.  We did the Royal Service and paid more using Booking.com and paid more because it came with $550 in hotel credits.  The hotel credits are anything but. They are coupons to use example $20 off a bottle of wine however drinks are included. The resort is beautiful however music sucked by the pool bring own speaker, need more activities and beware every two seconds we were being upsold on timeshares, Massage’s, etc was hard to relax when constantly getting asked for things. The pool staff on royal side were amazing, they truly made the resort. Food was mediocre at best...

reviews.author: Discover236947
reviews.title: Overview
reviews.text:
Very nice place to stay, have fun and enjoy beautiful sea and beach. This is really something special. Hotel was very good, stuff were very friendly and kind, food delicious. Mexican restaurant Mole offers fantastic dishes. Duck that we tried, was amazing, as well as carrot cake. Only two suggestions that we have are: 
1. Room improvement 
2. Better coffee

reviews.author: Ruslan Ibatullin
reviews.title: Great time! Good hotel
reviews.text:
Gorgeous hotel with great food and great service! It wasn’t cheap but it worth it for sure! 
Beach was nice and Purdy clean. I wouldn’t recommend go in the city, just stay and enjoy beautiful ocean and view in there. 
Thinking to come back in future

reviews.author: Chris H
reviews.title: I've tried to call and email them numerous times and I'm getting no help.
reviews.text: Lack of communication is an issue.  They need to respond to emails and phone calls and make it easier for customers to contact them.  I'm a pretty patient person but when emails go unanswered for over a week that is unacceptable.

reviews.author: Maria S
reviews.title: Family vacation- 2 adults 1 child
reviews.text:
Dates: 9/16-9/23
We arrived and were escorted to what I thought was the Family Concierge lounge. We started the checkin process, and were informed that our room wouldn't be ready for a couple hours. 
A gentleman showed us around the resort and talked us into a time share presentation for the following day (the guy that showed us around was so kind, remembered us by name thought out our stay, he was wonderful). We had lunch and the buffet, went back to check in and still didn't have a room. At this point we'd been there for 4 hours, finally got a room and asked about the Concierge and were told that we didn't have Family Concierge (which we did, I showed them my confirmation) and were in the wrong area. They quickly walked us over to family concierge were we were checked in quickly. 
We were given a Lagoon view room, that was less than desirable, Very outdated. We stayed in it for one night and requested a new room. We were upgraded to an ocean view room, which was beautiful and newly remodeled. 
We were happy with the service we received after check-in/Room was corrected. 

Pool(s)- 
Kids Pool: The size and depth is perfect, kids can play without worry and there's enough space for multiple activities at once. The built-in loungers in the pool are nice. 
Needs to be updated, falling apart in places and is a bit dingy. There's also a tiny round kids pool that looked sketchy, we stayed away. 

Main Pool: size is a great size, with hot tub coves and a swim-up bar. You can swim from the kids pool to the swim up bar. Needs to be updated, falling apart in places and is a bit dingy. 

Side Pool by Restaurants: Most updated pool in the general resort area.

Adults only Pool: Updated, really relaxing, super nice. 

FOOD- 
Grill by pool: Chicken nuggets, fries, nachos basic grill options that are quick. 
Really disappointed with the lack of fresh/light options, I wish they had salad options and fresh fruit/veggie platters, smoothies!!!  I got a salad and it was in a 6oz plastic cup, gave it back. 

Mole: contemporary Mexican 
Stellar Service, delicious from start to finish- Perfect portion sizes, great special spicy margarita, beautiful handcrafted furniture, awesome music

Fuego: Latin/American Fusion 
Amazing service, perfect food, good music 

Naos: Buffet 
Ate breakfast and lunch here daily and dinner our first night
Great service everyday, these servers work hard, high traffic restaurant. 
Good options for children, vegetarians and meat lovers. 

Vento: Mediterranean Tapas 
Great service, Ok food, good house drink. 

Market Grill: Brazilian/Argentinian Grill 
Good Service, meat Ok pretty salty, good side options. 

Enso: Asian 

Blue agave: Mexican Ok service, good food. 

Childcare/playroom: Amazing and caring staff, the room is clean and spacious, could use a little TLC in the baby/Toddler room. My daughter LOVED hanging out in the playroom, definitely a highlight for her! 

Daily children's activities poolside, the beach is well maintained and the beach/Pool servers are wonderful! We WILL be back, hopefully all updates will be done (they seem to be working very quickly.

reviews.author: Jackie K
reviews.title: Awesome for family, not romantic get away
reviews.text: We traveled with a 2 year old so our standards for hotels were quite different from what we would normally book.  Service is AMAZING for kids.  Lots of personal touch, generous toiletries, great on site amenities like play rooms.

reviews.author: lera_161_
reviews.title: Осенний отпуск!
reviews.text: so the time has come to revoke. We rested at the Paradisus Cancun Resort from 14-25 September. The hotel as a whole was satisfied. lived on the floor where the reception. the beauty of vines is fascinating. I think this is the most successful floor. from the minuses I will note that the hotel's terreterium (garden, park) is not, in general there is no 😬😬🤷♀️ and poorly followed the mini-bar. but otherwise everything is positive! Asuncion special thanks. shore and entrance to the sea is also very good, comfortable, clean and beautiful. Sorry for mistakes since my native language is Russian. good rest!

reviews.author: jodylynn302003
reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text: This was the most amazing experience that we have every had. The resort staff was friendly and always willing to answer any questions we had. Karla assisted us with every detail from restaurant reservations to helping us book all of our adventures.  We can not say enough about the kindness that she showed us. The resort, Where do I even begin. It was very well maintained and clean at all times. It was like being in a whole new world. The beach was to die for and there was activities daily. They have photographers that you can schedule to do a photo-shoot on the beach, shops, jewelry store, clothing stores, a doctor on staff if needed . This place is spectacular to say the least!!!! We would certainly recommend this resort to everyone.

reviews.author: Joyce L
reviews.title: wedding anniversary
reviews.text: The room was very nice and quite only thing would have been nice to have English subtitles when watching TV haha. This resort was very lush & tropical we would definably stay here again. Only thing I didn't like which would be anywhere we stayed was pushing to buy into the timeshare

reviews.author: Mary Ellen R
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus
reviews.text: This hotel is definitely 5 star quality. The service, friendliness, respect and courteousness were beyond anything we have ever experiences. Maria, Carlos, Roberto, Victor, Manuel, Joel, Lilianna and many others were wonderful to us. We will never forget you guys.

reviews.author: armando v
reviews.title: Huge complex with lots of choices
reviews.text:
Stayed there at large convention.
The place is huge, many pools, restaurants, bars, very Long Beach, night clubs, activities.
Service was quite good for a place this big.
Food was good, not excellent; but with so many choices one has lots of possibilities; although since it is all inclusive, all the best places fill up very fast and one might end up in a large line to eat.
Rooms are quite big

reviews.author: chriskR4463RO
reviews.title: Best Vacation
reviews.text: My girlfriend and I stayed at Paradisus in royal service for 5 nights. From the moment we walked into the resort, we were treated like royalty. The resort itself is beautiful, all the food was delicious and the service was great as well. Our butler, Eduardo went above and beyond to make us have an amazing time. Orlando was also super cool. He always made sure we were content by the pool. We are counting the days until we come back!

reviews.author: Olympia60
reviews.title: Wonderful time
reviews.text: From the minute we walked into the lobby of the Paradisus we were meet with a wonderful staff of people from the Concierge to check in. The lobby had beautiful flower arrangements that were changed every couple of days and the greenery that hung from each floor was well maintained, Our room was spacious and the mini bar was stocked with cold drinks, beer , water and snacks. The buffet food was delicious and never boring. We use the pool in front of the buffet restaurant and  were never without a cold beverage or any snack thanks to  our waiter Sergio Mescro who took well care of us. The entertainment was great but the  location where they performed could have been somewhere else  were we did not have to sit on the stairs going down to the beach which were hard and uncomfortable, the Michael Jackson impersonator group was fabulous. My friend and I went to the SPA which was a wonderful experience calm and soothing, we spent a couple of hours there and were never rushed to leave by the staff. We truly had a wonderful time recommend Paradisus to our friends family and 1 has already  booked it for December on our recommendation.

reviews.author: Nbas73
reviews.title: 4 Year Anniversary
reviews.text:
This is our second time to Paradisus Cancun,  and we booked the family concierge because the royal service area was out of commission.  The check-in had a couple of hiccups - we had to wait a while to be shown to our room after we were given notification via what's app that it was ready, but not a huge deal.  we had booked the lagoon view with the king bed,  but when we got to our room,  there was a very strong unbearable varnish smell.. instant headache.  Our butler immediately got us another room,  and upgraded us to ocean view,  which we were thrilled with,  but this room only had 2 double beds which we were told would be put together, but it never happened.. a little disappointing bc it was my husband and I's 4th anniversary.  Besides this,  we were very happy with our stay, and we got excellent service from our butlers,  Gabriel and Fernanda.  They both checked in with us daily to let us know when they arrived and offered us help every day,  booked our dinner reservations and made our stay vey special with bottle service,  chocolate covered strawberries and rose petals.  They also helped our friends and my husband plan surprises for me. Our housekeeping was excellent.. there was a lady that came by with a cart almost every day asking if I needed extra towels.  We were very pleased with with the friendly staff all over the resort,  and were always greeted with a Buenos Dias with a hand over the heart.. Our favorite place to eat,  same as last year,  was la palapa.. the food was amazing,  and the staff (Cesar, Eddie, Moises, Jorge, Daniel,  Joel, Ignacio? And others- lady waitress and  the waiter with the gold tooth), went out of their way to make our time enjoyable.  They also served us on the beach and Came up and down the stairs so many times to check on us.. My feet were very swollen from the heat, and they actually brought me bags of ice so I would feel better.  Other restaurants: bana- the sushi restaurant - amazing food and quick service.  Beautiful ambience with the indoor vines and plants.. mole - authentic Mexican restaurant.. the food was very creative. had cappuccino bean soup in a mug and had froth on top so it looked just like a cappuccino.. also had pork with a delicious sauce and sides.  My favorite thing there was the mariachi band. They came up to our table singing.. also excellent were fuego- Latin fusion,  market grill - Brazilian steakhouse, enso- Thai food,  and vento- Mediterranean food. 
We liked to also go over to the coffee stand,  gelato stand, royal service coffee area, and the swim up bar. entertainment was amazing.. we saw the Michael Jackson impersonator,  the performers by the pool dancing,  and the Mayan dancers. Cocos beach bar and the red lounge both had excellent service and friendly staff as well.  I was also very happy to learn that the resort has a full time worker that releases the baby turtles.. I was lucky to be on the beach while one was being released. We also had hydrotherapy included,  and went a couple days.. love the spa,  aromatherapy and the shower jets.. as soon as you are in the vicinity of the spa,  you can smell the citrus incense.. They have an area outside with the hydrotherapy with herbal teas,  drinks,  cucumbers and healthy snacks.  Only complaints besides check-in.. the elevators smelled disgusting.. also,  it is really hard to drink frozen drinks without a straw.. They werent available anywhere on the resort.   Some of the frozen drinks and fruit juices had a very chemically taste,  like there were artificial sweeteners. Overall,  our stay was amazing and all of the staff went above and beyond and we would love to come back.

reviews.author: Omar R
reviews.title: So so vacation
reviews.text: Well the place was nice along with the staff , one of the few downsides is the air conditioner, only your room has air , no ac in the restaurants . The other one is that someone came in my room and stole my money , once I called the security they came to my room asked me questions , they searched my room as well as my luggage making sure my money was not somewhere else in the room . They checked the electronic door mechanism to see who came in my room and and according to them no one but me enter the room ( figures ) . The next day I went and talk to another security staff member to tell them to check on the people that comes in to the hotel and sales you the excursions because they are the only people that have your hotel name of course and your room number so they know how long you will be out of your room , the guy looks at my face and said no that is IMPOSSIBLE , I laughed then as I tell him that it sounds like an inside job he assured me that they have a security system that no one can crack , I laughed some more and went back to my room , then I realized they are sitting on a gold mine , cause here in the US we have one of the best  secured systems and Russia , North Korea and China were able to crack it so I hope they take advantage of this situation LOL ! Little to say I will never go back to that hotel ever again .   PS I know they provide a safe in the rooms and my money was taken from a drawer , still an inside job so be careful  use the safe specially if you are going to an excursion .

reviews.author: Colofox1959
reviews.title: Great!!!
reviews.text: I can’t wait to write this review, last week I was at Paradisus Cancun :AMAZING, beautiful, hotel, the lobby simple but great for me less is more!! , the reception was nice and the gentlemen that made our check in was very courteous, we get there a little early and immediately we were taken into the room : the rooms was very nice we had a lagoon view and the busy boulevard, but the entrance to the lobby was to far from the street that we didn’t hear any noise at all, the little fridge was full of drinks, cookies, chips a little downside, the bed was a little hard for me but I ask them if they can do something and immediately they send the housekeeper to put some soft stuff in the bed and was fine, the toiletries fantastic!!! And there was not that musty smell that sometimes you feel as a soon you enter the room overall great room , the buffet for the breakfast was really good they were changing the menu almost everyday, unfortunately I didn’t get the names of the people working in the restaurant, but everybody was really nice and complacent they go far and beyond to make you feel important, the bathrooms in the common areas as the pool, the lounge and around the hotel ; super, super clean, love the tacos and quesadillas corner , the Mexican restaurant was great, the Japanese, fabulous, but the level 0 of the hotel the best amazing beautiful, my husband and me had a massage OH MY GOD !!! You must have  it !!!! was wonderful !!!! In overall wonderful resort, I will be back as soon as possible I definitely recommend this hotel

reviews.author: mflower275
reviews.title: Time Well Spent and Gone Too Fast!
reviews.text:
When we exited the bus, there were friendly faces awaiting us. We were offered a washcloth which had a lovely aroma. We were assisted with our luggage and upon entering the hotel, noticed how beautiful it was from the distance. 

What I loved:
-A quick and smooth check-in.
-The room was beautiful - picture perfect. 
-We had access to the snacks, soda, water in the refrigerator, 24-hour room service (for a $5 fee), unlimited food and drinks.
- Impeccable customer service.
- There was a number of restaurants on the grounds which served very tasty food.
- Housekeeping was amazing.
- Their efforts to assist us and accommodate such a large party was greatly appreciated.

What I would improve:
- There were limited channels on the TV in which most of them were in Spanish. There were only a few programs in English.
- I didn't enjoy the majority of their alcoholic beverages.

reviews.author: Omara L
reviews.title: Amazing vacation ever
reviews.text:
Let me told you something,  this hostel have a excellent customer services that a never received since we arrive to the total was like a fairly tale every person in the total was so kind and helpful believe me when I said that on the front desk they assign us a person Judith for us she was our referral in everything we wanted, I don't know if she was our counselor , because somebody told me that the person's in the desk for your floor is your counselor but for us she was the best , all the total is amazing I don't care the little things like construction in the pool for kids you what because because the hotel is wonderful that we do not care,
Now
Food amazing you have several options to choose what you want , the main buffet every day  change the menu , my favorite restaurant was naos and ishi 
Pool amazing soooooooooo big 
Room omg comfortable went we arrive, they put flowers on bed and fruit and Champaign 

Then we get a tour in the submarine was the  most wonderful experience that I never have.

Know for me the only bad experience was because went we arrive in the airport there are to many people trying to sale tour for less please don't pay attention to the people listen don't do that , we expend all our day in  other total they force you to buy apartments and is so maddening because you may want to run out of there and return to your wonderful and comfortable hotel and not leave there any more
We went around the city and is beautiful but the people outside is different that the hostel you see the different everything is expensive. 

I invite you go and visit this place is for sure the best option for me was a spectacular

reviews.author: Sabrina A
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: I just want to say the hotel it’s wonderful and don’t leave without taking a walk under the moon and liberate the turtles with Geovani on the beach at night!!! Beautiful experience with the kids and everyone!! 100 % points!!

reviews.author: kimmiechr
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: Great hotel, good service and awesome food. I recommend it. Royal service was great best breakfast at La Palapa restaurant, the market place restaurant is a plus with their quality of meats and fresh. Daniel was very detailed oriented with us and gave us a great service.

reviews.author: BellininLee
reviews.title: First Vacation with Toddler Great Success!!!
reviews.text:
We stayed at Paradisus Cancun with our 1 1/2 year old daughter the first week of October. Let me just say it was... wonderful and as relaxing as you can get with a toddler!!! My husband and I Paradisus lovers!!! We got married at Palma Real in Punta Cana, we had our honeymoon at La Perla in Riviera Maya and now this first family vacation at Cancun. We are used to traveling with Royal service and now with the baby we were not sure how it would go. We decided to do family concierge because of the great reviews and they did not disappoint. 

Family Concierge:

Rodolfo, Maria and Alexander were amazing. They brought gifts for our little one at night and everything is done with a smile on their face. They also brought my husband and I bottles of champagne, wine, a nice tequila, chocolate covered strawberries. You name it they had it...they made us feel special. 
*Communication:
We were there during the week that Tropical storm was going to pass over cancun. Let me say nothing happened but the hotel was great with communicating with us about changes and updating us regarding the storm. Thank goodness we just got rain. We used what’s app to communicate which is very good. We left our daughter one day at the baby zone to enjoy some adult time at the spa. She was hysterical and lasted about 20 min but maria, our butler,contacted us right away via what’s app we were there in a matter of minutes. THANK YOU!!!!  The service was amazing and well worth it so if you have a family it’s a MUST! 

Things happen....it was not always perfect... there was one instance when we wanted to push back a reservation because our daughter went down for a late  nap after the pool but we did not get a response from our butler.We managed to make it to the restaurant 30 minutes late and they did not want to sit us because they only wait 15 minutes for reservations, which is completely understandable. Overall, they sat us and the meal was fabulous at Market Grill (one of the best dinners we had). We just wish our butlers would have responded. If it can’t be done it can’t be done... but a response would have been nice. We also asked for whole white milk be stocked in our mini fridge instead of chocolate milk. Several times it was not there and we either had to call or go pick them up at family cosierge. However,  This did not ruin our trip at all we had a great time and would do this again. Our room was updated, clean and the AC was great. Again, Family concierge  is well worth it... this will be the only way we travel to a Paradisus. 

Pool:
Pool- the adult pools are very deep. I am short and could not enjoy it at all. We either had to stay at the kiddie pool with our daughter or go to jacuzzis like pool within the pool. It would be nice if the pool was not as deep. Also when you get in there is a huge step at the bottom so please be careful I scrapped my knee on it. 

The Kiddie pool was fun for the little ones. We were there most of the time. 

A big thank you to Veronica and Sophania who kept our drinks coming. They were friendly made great suggestions and they wanted us to relax on vacation. Such hard working people... 

****Restaurants: 
This is the only reason we gave this resort a 4. Most of the indoor restaurants are extremely hot... They need to invest in good air conditioning.  

Naos- we ate here for breakfast, lunch and once for dinner food was very good but sometimes cold. One thing my husband and I did not like is that at the omlette station they did not flip the eggs before they add the veggies. We tried both stations numerous times and it was the same. There were always lots of good options at the buffet.

A big thanks to Gaudencio, excellent waiter, who was amazing with our daughter during breakfast and lunch. Also, thanks to Abraham and Arturo very pleasant and honestly just wanted to make sure we we had everything we needed. 

Enso— Just amazing food. They made a special dish for my daughter who eats low sodium. Chicken, white rice and veggies. She ate most of it. The fried rice is amazing and so were the spring rolls. OMG! Still thinking about our dinner there.... Veronica and Ramon were on point with everything. The food was delicious. It is extremely hot in this restaurant which is understandable because it is outdoors. 

Market grill- We had breakfast a couple of times. we did not like it for lunch because the food was cold. You can ask for pizza or other options on the menu which were very good. Dinner was rodizio style was Fantastic!!!! We want to thank Manuel and Jesus for making our experience very special after having a tough night with the baby. We also want to thank Katia at market grill.

Fuego was also amazing!!! The steak was just perfect. We loved our dinner and the waiter  got us spaghetti with Butter for our little one. She loved it! Thank you to our waiter Jorge! Fernando at fuego was also very pleasant and wanted us to feel comfortable.

The only negative is the extreme heat in this restaurant. It is indoors and i just wish there was AC. It makes it uncomfortable to enjoy your delicious meal when you are drenched in sweat. My husband and I loved the food but the heat was unbearable at times. 

Bana- My husband and I do not eat seafood but Bana has great options. The chicken tempura roll was to die for!!! Our waiter, Luis, at this restaurant was also wonderful. Our baby had a special child corn rice and veggie dish which she enjoyed. amazing for dinner. 

Mole- was okay... traditional mexican food... super hot in this restaurant. We asked for fans and the staff accommodated. Our daughter was uncomfortable and we could not enjoy the full experience. A big thank you to Roberto our waiter. 

YHI Spa is great. A big thanks to Sandy who did my massage she was excellent and friendly. 

The Baby zone is for children 1-4 and the Kidzone is for the older kids. We visited  the baby zone and the staff was fabulous. Our daughter kept saying she wanted to go see Lucy. A big thanks to Lucy, Abby, Aurora for their great work. 

One suggestion is that they need to do better with cleaning the baby zone. When our daughter was picked up her feet were filthy. I started to put socks on her when she would visit. 

So if you are looking for a resort for family this is the place... I know people say too many kids everywhere but that’s what it’s about FAMILY... if you would prefer adults only try Royal Service. 

Our visit with our toddler was a Success! However, i want to point out that this wouldn’t have been the case had it not been for the wonderful staff at Paradisus Cancun. They work very very very hard... A bit suggestion is to TIP—Even though every one does their work with a smile... tipping does go a long way. They deserve it!!!

reviews.author: Dimitar B
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text:
We arrived before they were expecting a hurricane to hit Cancún which never happened. Everything about our stay there was impeccable but above all I would like to recognize the very hardworking staff. Always kind and smiling. I’m impressed. Our server at night Mario did a great job. Excellent service. 
I would recommend booking the ocean view even though the lagoon view is nice too. We will be back. Thank you for the great vacation!

reviews.author: Joseph D
reviews.title: Recent Stay
reviews.text: My Fiancé and I recently enjoyed a 5 night/ 6 day stay at Paradisus Cancun (9/23-9/28.) With recommendations from a close friend, we chose to get the Royal Service, and boy we’re we blown away by it. From the second we checked in, our butler Daniel took excellent care of us. He went over all the restaurants with us and made us reservations for the ones we wanted to try for our stay. He reserved our pool side cabana for us everyday, had rose petals and chocolate strawberries and champagne waiting for us back at our room after dinner. Needless to say, this place and the staff went above and beyond our expectations. One of the Royal service staff members, Ricardo, was phenomenal. We are already talking about our next trip down there!

reviews.author: Matthew C
reviews.title: Fun memorable family getaway
reviews.text: All the best to say about the Paradisus: immaculate property, excellent service, so easy and relaxed. Just back from celebrating my mother’s 80th birthday. They accommodated our party of 12 with comfort and panache. Don’t miss Mole & Fuego restaurants...AND the swimup bar. My only criticism is the lack of AC in the common spaces.

reviews.author: 55deel
reviews.title: Very Nice Experience
reviews.text: Originally planned to go to Cabo, but switched last minute to Cancun due to weather situation. So glad we picked this resort! The associates were very friendly and helpful. My family and I stayed in the Family Concierge area. Josue and Fernanda (assigned to our family), were very accommodating and attentive to our needs. Josue was proactive in making sure our stay was a pleasant one. All of the servers, including Hector, Abraham, Santiago, Diego (DD), made our dining experiences great. Some restaurants require reservations, so be sure to make them in advance. The resort also offers childcare during the day in the event you need it.

reviews.author: Carlos C
reviews.title: Awesome, as always!
reviews.text: This is our second time at this resort and they did not disappoint. Their service and attention to detail is insane!  Food options were upgrades from last time and it seems they keep outdoing themselves. We paid extra for the Royal Service. It was absolutely worth it. If you get it, make sure you try their separate pool and restaurant. Impeccable service. Huge shoutout to Maria from Royal Service, Andres at the pool bar and the dynamic duo of Samuel and Oscar at the Avenue Bar. If you plan to travel, try visiting in October. Occupancy is a little low, so you get to enjoy the extra attention!!

reviews.author: Michael L
reviews.title: Average resort to enjoy the climate and beach of Quintana Roo
reviews.text:
This past weekend I had the chance to stay at this resort for work from Monday through Friday. The resort was fairly empty, I would guess around 50% occupancy. Upon arriving the people at that front desk were very nice and helpful, with the customary cooling towel. I was checked in and given my wristband, a sort of colored nylon fabric with a wooden token intertwined with the fabric. 

I was taken to my room with the help of the bellboy. The room was very clean and nice with a King sized bed. The air-conditioner worked very well, which was really helpful as there isn't a ceiling fan, which made me sad. The mini fridge is stocked with water, snacks, and a variety of malt beverages. There are no liquor spirits in the room at all. I am not a fan of this at all, though I didn't consider calling anyone to see if that could be changed. The bathroom is a good size, and is elevated about 4 inches off the room floor, which my big toe repeated found throughout the trip. The shower has great pressure and heat, but is also again elevated a bit off the bathroom floor. If you have arthritis, or bad hips, etc, etc, I would consider finding a different resort as you will have difficulties getting in and out of the tub. 

The property as a whole is a smoke free environment, save for a few designated areas, though I did see quite a few people smoking in various outdoor areas without consequence. The buildings are very pretty inside, but the common areas are either not air conditioned at all, or are so poorly done that they feel as though they aren't. The restaurants were all comfortable except for The Market Grille, which is outside so this makes sense. The restaurants are all next to each other, and in a few instances we were seated in closed restaurants to eat in in a restaurant that was open at the time. This is how close they are to each other, which made for some confusion. I never had the opportunity to make a reservation and eat at a nicer restaurant because I forgot pants and didn't want to break the dress codes. It didn't alter my experience at all I believe. The room service is actually some of the best I have ever had at an all-inclusive resort. It was also delivered about 20 minutes after it was ordered, which is far and away the fastest I have ever had. The gym was nice, A/C'd and a great place to get some exercise in with cable machines, free weights, treadmills, and ellipticals. I was very happy with this amenity.

The Pools are all nice and clean, there aren't any floaties and I didn't see too many people who had brought there own actually. The music was never too loud and a good vibe. The beach is kept very clean and is pretty expansive and deep for Cancun. I did not at all appreciate the bars near the pools closing before the pools close. Not a fan at all.

Overall this was a pretty nice place. If you are in decent enough shape to get in and out of the tub, and love the hot weather, this may be a good option for you.

reviews.author: Christopher L
reviews.title: Piece of heaven on earth!
reviews.text: What can I say: you get what you pay for! Excellent all-inclusive hotel with lots of facilities and many in-house dining. Strongly recommend upgrading to the Family Concierge or Royal Service - totally worth the extra pampering you get. A big thank you goes out to Maria, Alex and Josue who were very attentive and helpful. They made our stay so much more relaxing and comfortable! Also a big shout out to Luis and Orlando, waiters at our favorite eating places. They remembered exactly what we liked and were always helpful and patient with our questions. Look forward to returning again! PS: there is a turtle conservation program that is run by the hotel! We had the privilege of participating in the release of hatchlings into the sea! It was a great family moment! Thank you to our concierge for inviting us!

reviews.author: mmolmik
reviews.title: Some Changes Made
reviews.text: After returning 2nd year in a row we noticed these differences, all the restaurants were not open,buffet had limited choices during lunch and dinner,nightly entertainment was sporadic and could have been more organized.Last year all restaurants were open,plenty of choices at buffet,and nightly entertainment very well organized every night.

reviews.author: Nazila T
reviews.title: Summer vacation
reviews.text:
Overall had an amazing time with family. The view and the beach took my breath away. Most beautiful lobby I’ve ever seen. Location can not be better. I had a full time butler that would make reservations for us and kinda follow us around to make anything possible! So yes to family concierge since it was me and my 3 teenage boys. Can’t wait to go back. ❤️
Ps any picture you see on the website, it looks exactly the same or even better.

reviews.author: John D
reviews.title: Very relaxing vacation!
reviews.text: My family and I stayed in a lagoon front room with two queen sized beds. We are a family of 4, my wife, 6 year old daughter and 7 month old baby-boy. We were worried about how the baby was going to react but everything went great from the moment we checked in, (which was rather quick) until we left. The staff is very professional and very well trained on customer service. The first day, there is a person that will try to sell you the melia club package.

reviews.author: Flor Dalisa Q
reviews.title: GREAT BUT did not reimbursed my money...CHARGED ME TWICE.
reviews.text:
The hotel is great, breath taking. The services is excellent. The food, OMG, the food. 

However, THEY CHARGED MY RESERVATION TWICE. I forgot to bring the credit card with which I paid (booked online) and they didn't honored it even when the reservation was already charged and money was withdrawn from the credit card. Because I didn't show the plastic credit card at check in, they asked for another payment method promising they would reimburse the money from the original credit card. It's been almost two weeks since then and I am still waiting for the reimbursement. I even had to request a dispute with my credit card company to get my money back.

reviews.author: Judy M
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: My husband had a wonderful visit and appreciated the attentiveness of staff.  They were so kind, hard working and efficient.  The best service we have ever experienced.  Staff felt like family by the time we were leaving....

reviews.author: Arewa O
reviews.title: Paradise in Mexico!
reviews.text: My fiancee and I stayed in a Lagoon front room for 4 nigths and our only regret was we didn’t stay longer. Clean, beautiful & spacious room. Lots of choice restaurants in the all-inclusive package which i’ll recommend. We had an amazing experience and will definitely go back again!

reviews.author: minjung16
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun 09/2017 waist of money
reviews.text:
We just got back from cancun and stayed 3 nights at paradisus cancun. I do not understand why they get good reviews from others, but my experience was horrible. Do not go there unless you want to ruin your vacation. 

1. service
Person who checked us in was rude with rigid face, did not have any intention to help. She lied us they are out of bracelet pass(they give you a bracelet that can be used as pass to all the restaurant) when we asked to change it because there were ruff spot on metal part. She had bunch of bracelet right next to her.   
After 30 min check in, a lady held us for another 30 min for timeshare presentation. We paid full price to book this resort. I did not expect that coming. After we said multiple times "no" she let us go, next morning she ignores me multiple times when we met in the lobby. 
Asked for house keeping in the morning, they came 8pm after we called 3 more times. 
They do not know what restaurant is open/close because it changes so much.
Kids club was good except they need to change their floor. My feet turned black after staying couple hours there. 
So, we had so much issues, I decide to address this, all they did was saying "I am sorry" without eye contact. 

2. property
No air-conditioning except rooms. Its true I felt like I am in sauna every night at restaurants. very limited restaurant. They rotate restaurants to close diff days, so we ended up eating lunch at the same place for 3 days. Servers they do not know about Menu so you need to keep track what is coming or not. Portion was very small but often times they eliminate couple orders themselves and then say "it was not in order." last night we stayed, I figured I should wrote down my own order and kept track if everything is there. Sure enough, they missed couple dishes, I showed my writing, only thing they do is "sorry" and move on. 
Pool area was under construction.(Close to kids swimming pool). They sprayed paint around the pool while people are swimming right next to.     

3. management 
Best part was I felt like no one was listening. I addressed issues, but all they could do was saying " I am very sorry." It was less than two star hotel service. 

I really hoping someone see this type of review serious and apply on their upcoming trip because they are overrated for sure as of now.

reviews.author: jamesfE4253ZI
reviews.title: Very relaxing atmosphere!
reviews.text: My husband and I had a great week here. The food was good, the hotel was beautiful, just a little warm in the hotel. I don't think there was AC inside the building, except in our room. Overall, a beautiful paradise!

reviews.author: Lauren L
reviews.title: Loved this hotel
reviews.text:
This hotel was excellent! We went for a wedding and were not sure what to expect and it was awesome. The location is perfect because it has a huge beach and it right on the bus route to town ($1 each way) if you wanted to leave the hotel. The food at Tempo was an extra charge but it was the best tasting menu we have ever tried. The margaritas at Blue Agave were really good and the food at Vento (tapas style) was yummy. We stayed in the Royal Service 1 bedroom ocean view suite and it was amazing. 2 balconies, 2 bathrooms, room to hang with friends and family and we really like the Royal Service bar at the bottom of the pyramid and the extra restaurant for breakfast and lunch. 

The Royal Service pool was nice and quiet and the service was excellent.  The hotel carries a nice selection of high end alcohol so you can easily find something you like. The one downside to the resort is how long it is. We had some elderly people traveling with us for the wedding and  it was hard for them to walk from one end to the other but most of the services and restaurants are right in the middle.

We will defiantly be returning to the hotel in the future!!

reviews.author: Susie C
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: We enjoyed the hotel and all that it offered. Delicious food, entertainment, wonderful hard working staff. We never had a reason to leave the resort all was available to us. Looking forward to returning.

reviews.author: spmarkmann
reviews.title: AMAZING HOTEL AND STAFF!!!!
reviews.text: Trip to Paradisus Cancun in October 2016 was amazing! I would recommend this place to everyone. Hotel was beautiful and hotel staff was very attentive. They have many great restaurants on sight and if you eat at Naos, you must make sure to sit in Alberto's area for breakfast which is outside on patio and see Victor May for dinner or dessert. Both were the best waiters I've ever had.  Both of them took care of everything and always remembered what we liked to drink. The Blue Agave's tacos were the bomb. It was very hard to stop eating them. Amazing pools with swim up bar (ask for the top shelf alcohol though). Beach was beautiful with white sand.  We can't wait to return to this resort.

reviews.author: Angie O
reviews.title: The Staff Make This Place Amazing!  We had a Great Trip!
reviews.text:
We stayed at this hotel the last week of October and had a wonderful time in the Royal Service.  There were a few areas that could use improvement but overall it was a wonderful vacation.

Check-In/Arrival - Upon arrival we were whisked away to the Royal Service check-in area where we immediately received cold towels and champagne while going over the resort and our ammenities through the royal service.
