Our butler was Antonio and he was wonderful, more about that later.  Check-In took maybe 10 minutes.  Our room wasn't quite ready yet (we arrived around 1pm), so we were taken to the Royal Service pool bar to eat lunch.  By the time we were finished eating our room was ready.

Room - The hotel itself is definitely older but the room was very nice and very clean.  The bathroom is spacious and had a large tub and rain shower.  The bed was OK, it felt comfortable overall but both my husband and I had trouble sleeping on it.  Every day the cleaners did a great job cleaning it up and we had turn down service every night with chocolate on our pillows.  The minibar was constantly stocked.  Upon arrival we also had a bottle of champagne waiting for us and rose petals on the bed (I had told them we were celebrating our anniversary).

Pool - The pool in the Royal Service is wonderful.  The cabana beds are amazing.  You are guaranteed 2 days in a cabana bed with the Royal Service, but since it was October and very slow we were able to get one every day we were there.  We moved around and never had the same one, and were able to enjoy some amazing views of the beach & pool.  We had excellent service at the pool thanks to Eddie & Edier who served us endless drinks and snacks.  Daniel assisted with getting us cabana beds and towels everyday and he was awesome as well.

Beach - We didn't spend a lot of time on the beach because it was very windy but it is a beautiful beach and the water is crystal clear.  It was just a bit too rough for us.  We did book a wave runner through Aqua World and had to walk down the beach.  They warned us it would be rough but we decided to go anyway.  I would recommend doing a wave runner on the Lagoon.  The ocean side was very rough and while we had fun, we probably would have had more fun on the lagoon side b/c we could have gone faster.  We also booked the Jungle Tour through Aqua World which was really fun and a nice local 2-3 hour activity (ask for Pablo!).

Food - We had reservations each night.  Our favorites were Mole (amazing mexican!!!) and Fuego (Latin).  Bana (Asian/Sushi Bar) was also very good with some unique sushi options which was fun.  I would avoid The Market Grill and Vento.  Vento the food was just gross, it was not up to par with the rest of the resort and I think we would have rather ate in the buffet that night.  It all sounded delicious looking at the menu but overall was just unappetizing.  Market Grill is a Brazilian steak house in the evening and while it was OK, the meat was dry and it just wasn't for us.  We ate breakfast at the buffet one day and it was OK as well but nothing special.  The rest of our breakfasts were at La Palapa, the Royal Service pool restaurant and it was excellent every time.  We ate most of our lunches in a cabana bed at the Royal Service pool where you could order a selection of "snack" type foods.  We loved the chips & guacamole, wings, tuna skewers and nachos the best but we tried everything at some point and liked it all.  

Entertainment/Bars - We were on vacation mostly just to relax so we did not spend a lot of time in the evening out late, but we did go to the nightly shows and they were very entertaining.  WE loved the beds in the bar that we could relax on and have a drink.  My one complaint would be that the area where they do the shows is very very small.  You had to get there really early if you wanted a seat where you could see.  It was so crowded you couldn't even stand and see on some nights.  And this was in the middle of October when they are at their lowest season so I can't imagine if it were busy how crowded it would have been.  Overall it was fine though and good entertainment.

Service - The Service was AMAZING.  Everyone that took care of us was great.  Antonio was our butler and he made sure we had dinner reservations each night, he took care of cabana rentals for us and checked in with us multiple times a day to make sure we didn't need anything.  He brought us different beer for our mini fridge upon request and left us champagne and other treats each afternoon in our room.  He was great and a super nice guy.  We also loved Edie & Edier at the pool as well as Daniel.  Everyone else we encountered was very friendly and did anything we asked, the people really make this hotel great.

Spa - We did a couples massage and the actual massage was great but their lounge and waiting area could use some work.  It was very crowded and there was no where to sit and relax after the massage, we were taken right back to the locker room.  The massage was great though.

Royal Service - A lot of people say they didn't need it or didn't do it and had a great time.  I think that you probably would, but I am so so glad we did the Royal service.  Every need was taken care of, we really felt like royalty.  The people in the royal service were amazingly helpful and friendly, they truly made our trip great.  They are remodeling the Royal Service area right now so the Royal Service bar/lounge was set up in the basement of one of the buildings temporarily.  Except no one told us it was temporary so it seemed very odd to us and not very "royal".  I think the second or third day we figured out that the usual royal lounge is HUGE and in a great spot.  We wish we could see it operating where it normally does, it would be much more elegant.  But, it was still very nice and accomodating.  

Tips: We got the best drinks from the Royal Service lounge.  October is a great month to go if you want to feel secluded and not deal with crowds!  Avoid Vento if you can!

Overall our vacation was wonderful and this hotel is great.  The food was pretty good overall, but keep an open mind. The hotel is definitely older, but the people make this place what it is, they seem like they really care about taking good care of their guests.  We would definitely return here in the future!

reviews.author: ruddyorti
reviews.title: Best vacations, Best bartender, best food
reviews.text: we stayed here October 25-29, everything was amazing! from the food to the drinks. The entire staff was accommodating and nice, always trying to please every request. Our favorite bartender was Reymundo (W Yandel! lol), who works at the Bana bar; he has a great attitude, always happy to work and surprise you with amazing drinks. The Market Grill is highly recommended for reservations, Blue Agave was also amazing.

reviews.author: David P
reviews.title: Best breakfast server
reviews.text: Martin Arzeta is a great waiter at Naos restaurant breakfast buffet.  He is very outgoing and makes you feel very special.  He is always up beat and happy!!!  Great service.  Always remembers your drink selections.

reviews.author: Darren M
reviews.title: Darren Marshall
reviews.text:
Outstanding service from start to finish
Food excellent throughout
Staff friendly ,this hotel is best I have stayed we will return very soon
Location excellent cannot fault this trip
Vento restaurant and banos restaurants simply wonderful 
The staff go the extra mile in everything they do to make your stay special
Thanks to all staff

reviews.author: cefraga
reviews.title: Amazing resort, in my view one of the best worldwide
reviews.text:
Crew is amazing making this resort perfect. Kind and happy people attending gests with joy, professionalism and Excellency. From zero to ten, eleven!!!!
Special thanks to Eddie C Rafa, Eulices, Ricardo Balaim, Eduardo Ramo, Ramon Zapot, Valeria, Vitor and Edier. A few names among several extraordinary people.

reviews.author: 184colbyb
reviews.title: Great staff, Amazing food and overall good family vacation
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our family vacation at Paradisus Cancun.  The waiters were excellent and very attentive to our family.  My 12 year old daughter raved about the staff everyday and wanted to go back to each restaurant, because they made her feel so special.  Erik at the sushi restaurant was amazing and really made our experience unbelievable.  Martin at the Naos restaurant for breakfast was a highlight for our family.  He treated us like we were the only ones at the restaurant.  We truly felt like "Norm" from Cheers when we came in each morning.  Our only issue was our room.  The motel was overbooked, so we ended up with only a king bed, so our girls had to sleep on cots.  We had several issues with the cots throughout the week, but the staff were there within minutes to resolve our problems.  My last suggestion is to make sure you eat the blue agave for lunch - the tacos and quesadillas were amazing!

reviews.author: Kmed14
reviews.title: Amazing place !!
reviews.text:
Wow, this hotel did not disappoint ! We had a room over looking the lagoon, it was lovely & cleaned daily! The views when you walked out to the pool were just amazing. The bar in the middle of the hotel does the most amazing cocktails, you can literally ask for anything and they will make it for you ( all the drinks were international brands too ) we ate at the buffet for breakfast which gave us plenty of choice. Our favourite evening meal was enso ( big thanks to Nathanael & Jose for making us feel so special every time we went, the desert was out of this world ) ! The pool & beach were lovely, waiter service at both. 
A bit of feedback that could be used to improve was the fact the restaurants were advertised as open from a certain time but they didn't open until late! Mainly the Mexican restaurant, it said 12 but didn't open until 4. The pool food got a bit repetitive every day ( burgers, chips, chicken etc ) I think this may have been because the hotel was quiet, so perhaps it wasn't worth opening. But we paid for a week all inclusive, so it would have been great to get what was advertised. 
Also the other problem we had was trying to get a towel in the afternoon, it's next to impossible ! I sat for 40 minutes waiting and the member of staff dealing with it was quite rude, it's a shame as he was the only one who was out of everyone in the hotel! They need a better policy in place, someone next to us had 4 towels for 2 adults, no wonder they ran out. Think going forward it would be helpful to keep track of who's had them from the room number. 

Even with them little points I would definitely go back & recommend this hotel to anyone. The staff really couldn't do enough for you. Only 5/10 mins in a bus away from shops & nightlife !

reviews.author: Maria C
reviews.title: Best vacations ever
reviews.text:
the best vacations ever, excellent customer service, delicious food, is too clean and organized, definitely if I return to Cancun is in this hotel. I apreciates the service of carlos ( concierge) , Daniel , irving ,and angel from Mole restaurant, I really recommended this restaurant and ask for "el momento guau" its an little demo of  a kind mexican food. 
Eddie from the pool He was really helpful he gave us everytime food and drinks without ask him.

reviews.author: MiltIV
reviews.title: Impressive rooms, amazing restaurants, indifferent beach
reviews.text: Having visited the very impressive Paradisus in Punta Cana I was expecting a little more from this hotel. Rooms were pretty excellent, the restaurants were very good except Mole. Common space and the beach were not so impressive though... However I guess if you are in Cancun, just take the chance to go around, there are so many perfect beaches and things to see/do in Yucatan.

reviews.author: D S
reviews.title: Top shelf destination
reviews.text:
Took a 4 day trip to the Paradisus with the wifey in August and this place lived up to its namesake. We stayed in Cancun a few years back at another "all inclusive" which turned out to be a toilet. During that trip, we got day passes to the Paradisus in exchange for sitting thru their timeshare presentation. They gave us the 3 night comp stay for that as well, and we used the voucher for this trip.

The Paradisus is fantastic! We were given the "Royal" treatment, which is an upgraded room and a separate pool for the fancy people. We had our own bar, food service, and pool. We used it once and spent the majority of the time at the other main pool, as we wanted to meet other people.

Wherever you stay in this hotel, you will be impressed. Plenty of staff to assist you, everybody was friendly, the rooms were nice, the pool is fantastic, and the beach is top notch. The food at all the restaurants is excellent. You can have fine dining or nachos and burgers by the pool, or both. We enjoyed every minute and will be back.

Tips: take an outing, which can be booked thru the concierge. Plenty of awesome day trips to the pyramids, caves, water parks, etc. Also, when you are drinking at the pool, tips will speed up your service. They are not required, but a 20 spot to the bartender will make you the rockstar and your cup will runners over all day. It's Mexico, grease the skids and you will be rewarded.

I could go on and on, but the bottom line is this place is awesome, customer service is top notch, and it's worth it! Even the rainy season isn't bad; it's warm and you will probably be in the pool anyway.

reviews.author: feleciag338
reviews.title: OMG
reviews.text: First time in Mexico! Special thanks to Joshua the bartender, and waiter who was very attentive at all times! I recommend he become a butler. Everyone is very welcoming, the food at the buffet NAOS was always great. The resort is beautiful inside and out! I definitely recommend going here because everyone is very friendly and will direct you during your stay.

reviews.author: marselastringa
reviews.title: excellent customer service *********
reviews.text:
excellent customer service we love the service.
every morning we went to eat breakfast at the Naos Restaurant and one of the waitress Jaime he was taking care of us for the time that we stay there..
we love it

reviews.author: Val Walker
reviews.title: Epic hotel
reviews.text: This hotel is amazing. First class service and great location! Very happy with our stay. One downside..hotel is doing construction in bldg 5. Had to put in a request to move because of construction noise.  We took pictures  through the hotels photography service "outdoors photo" and our photographer Parvi did a great job. We loved everything about this place and will def come back.

reviews.author: barbarasX5718TZ
reviews.title: Best
reviews.text: We had a great time, the room was great from the mini bar to the ocean view. Everyone that work there was very help full. The royal service was great from Rode our butler to MOISE and the crew at the La Palapa. The crew at the cabana/bali was very help full.

reviews.author: Mercedes C
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: My husband and I just got back from this resort 3 ago celebrating our one year anniversary and we had an amazing stay!! We had an ocean front view with also an amazing view of the main pool. First time in Mexico and we are already looking for flights to go back and to the same resort! The food was great!, everyone is very welcoming, the food at the buffet NAOS was always great. We had a waiter, Alejandro Blanco who was very attentive at all times!! The resort is beautiful inside and out!! I definitely recommend going here specially if it's your fisrt time because everyone is very friendly and will direct you during your stay.

reviews.author: StanDonna
reviews.title: Amazing for the 6th time!
reviews.text: Once again our experience at the Paradisus was amazing. The best part is the phenomenal service as well as the Royal Service accommodations, ambience and cuisine. We have to mention the Royal Service Manager Lazaro Asencion who has continuously provided exceptional assistance in room selection and overall service. Also, we thank Sergio, our butler, Richert at the Naos breakfast buffet, Chef Marcos at Bana for the special dinner he prepared for us and Carlos and Angel at Our favorite restaurant Enso. Outstanding service and friendly attitudes by these staff members. We give our highest recommendation for this outstanding resort especially in Royal Service where there is no better friendlier service compared to other resorts we have visited. We love the Paradisus and consider the staff our friends. In Royal Service you get great adult only accommodations, a personal butler, a private swimming pool with a no extra cost cabana/bali bed.....fantazimo.

reviews.author: landonterry
reviews.title: The Perfect Resort
reviews.text: I stayed here for 4 days and had a fantastic time. The room was decorated well and had a spectacular view. The food was great and the service was always top notch. I would like to especially thank our waitress Asuncion for making our time on the beach absolutely perfect. We called her Susie because we couldn't pronounce her name. Asuncion was very personable and brought us anything we needed. She has been working at the resort for 24 years! I will most certainly be back and would recommend Paradisus as well as Cancun Mexico for an ultimate vacation.

reviews.author: lenkastrnadka
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun is a must to stay if you go to Cancun . Beautiful  resort , breathtaking beach , very nice and friendly stuff , I hope I will have a chance to go back and enjoy Paradisus Cancun again!

reviews.author: mwebb12
reviews.title: Incredible hotel, customer service and experience
reviews.text: My mother and I took a trip to the Paradisus Cancun in early October for a week. We had an absolutely incredible stay from start to finish. The customer service at the hotel was impeccable. Every staff member we came in contact with went above and beyond to accommodate us. The hotel and room was stunning. The grounds were very well kept and every restaurant and dining experience we had was delicious. Out of all the all-inclusive resorts I have stayed at, the food here was by far the best I have had. The beach was beautiful, the chairs were comfortable and the beverage service on the beach was great. We never had to wait long at all for a drink- Luis was amazing! We had the family concierge and it made the experience all the more special for us. We will definitely be returning to Paradisus and are looking forward to being able to do so. I would highly recommend this hotel for families, friends or couples.

reviews.author: 296ginaz
reviews.title: Best place to stay in Cancun
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing place, and staff. Always smiling and very friendly. Place was spotless, people were always making sure it looked great. I will definitely be returning. The pools were very clean and not very full, and the nightlife was so much fun

reviews.author: naakhr
reviews.title: paradise
reviews.text: Kk don’t know where to start from because Paradisus Cancun is a heaven on earth. One of the most amazing places me and my hubby have visited. Starting from their security, restaurants are amazing. Literally stayed there for 7 days and wish I could stay lifetime. Their staff is so amazing wish I can remember everyone’s name to mention.  Anna was our rep in the hotel who helped us with providing information.  Then our apple vacation rep that helped us choose the most amazing activates for 5 days straight was Naos was the spot we always went. The waiters were so friendly; we didn’t want to leave them.  I wish I could remember each and one of their names, but I all the workers working through the 7th to the 14th of October have been the best ever.

reviews.author: Carbob3
reviews.title: Royal Service
reviews.text:
My husband and I, along with my brother-in-law who traveled solo, stayed in the Royal Service, adult section of the Paradisus Cancun.  We rented (2) one-bedroom suites with a Lagoon View - the rooms and the view were beautiful.
The Royal Service offers a quieter, adults-only section of the resort with regards to your room, pool and Bali Beds, and restaurant.  There are many other areas and restaurants in the resort that Royal Service guests have access to whenever you want. However, if you are into relaxing poolside or on the clean, white sandy beach with absolutely gorgeous turquoise waters, Royal Service is the way to go!  
We thought the entire resort was beautiful and well kept.  The food and beverages were delicious and abundant, whether we ate at a sit-down restaurant, the main buffet, or by the pool or beach.  There is something for everyone, and, if you couldn't find it, simply ask and it's yours.
It did take the first day to overcome a few glitches; however, once we communicated our needs and wants to our Butler, Rode, Pool Concierge, Daniel, and wait staff including Rafael, Eddie, Moises, Ricardo, Jorje, and Valeria, they treated us like royalty!
We have visited many resorts and always do our research, and, at the Paradisus Cancun, Royal Service, our expectations were met in every way possible. The resort sits in the middle of the Hotel Zone and is only 15 minutes from the airport...however, once you are there, you feel like you're in your own private, turquoise paradise.
I would like to say a special "thank you" to our Pool Concierge, Daniel, who, after telling him that the lens fell out of my prescription glasses, took it upon himself to bring them to an eyeglass center on his way home from work, thus returning them to me fully repaired by the very next day! Now that is Royal Service!

reviews.author: Britton E
reviews.title: Awesome hotel
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel and amazing staff!!!!  We loved every minute.  Food is wonderful and a real service was absolutely amazing. Everyone at the Royal Service pool was unbelievable. The service is second to none.

reviews.author: LKG
reviews.title: Enjoy it, we did
reviews.text:
Just returned from our 7 night stay at Paradisus, and it was a darn good time.  

The service was great everywhere we went within the resort, without exception.

The room was cleaned and re-stocked daily, stayed nice and cool, the lagoon view we opted for was beautiful, and the location was perfect for reaching the main areas of the resort (building 3, the main building).  

Food was good.  Buffet had a lot to offer all of the healthy and not-so-healthy palates of our decent-sized group.  Reservations at the restaurants were pretty easy and plentiful, IF you got to making them by noon (mole, bana, market girll, fuego were all good; vento, meh).  

My partner-in-crime for the week and I hit the gym a few times.  The earlier, the more crowded, naturally, but never so much that what we needed/wanted wasn't available to us.  One of the nicer gyms I've seen in an all-inclusive setting.  The adjacent spa was decent, as were its ammenities, although we're a bit spoiled coming from Vegas.  

Heavy pours on some good liquors in the bars.  The "nightclub" left something to be desired, and we did hit it almost nightly for lack of anything else to do, but we were able to enjoy dancing with ourselves to mash-ups of Phil Collins and Bruno Mars.

May or may not matter, but there weren't a whole lot of children around, or that we saw at least, so no issues with that.  And no one seemed to have any trouble with relationships of any combination.

reviews.author: CGMTL
reviews.title: Paradise Found
reviews.text:
I've just returned from a 7 night stay. What more to say except Paradise on earth. The beach, pools and Restaurants were fabulous.  The quality and variety of food was incredible, not to mention the service from the staf received at all of the restaurants. A special thank-you goes out to the staff at the baby club especially to Alma & Adriana. My son and daughter enjoyed their time there and their attention to the kids was wonderful.
I would definetly recommend the Tempo restaurant (additional $) but an experience like non other. The food service were world class.
The room attendants were great too.  They always went out of their way to service the room when it was convenient for us...paying attention to the little details and leaving goodies for the kids (lotions and chocolate).
The only downside is the initial room we were booked in... It was right above the lounge area where the night club is located (3rd floor).  It was very loud with music blarring until 2am...made for a sleepless first night.  The good news is that the minute I mentioned it to the front desk...they changed our room and the rest of the vacation was wonderful.  If you have small children I recommend asking the front desk at checkin to make sure you are away from the night club area.
The YHI spa is also wonderful.  The staff Ismail Reynolds professional andd the facial and massage received ft were amazing.
A big thank-you to all of your staff at the hotel.  You are all very professional and extremely hard working. We are looking forward to visiting your hotel again soon.

reviews.author: leethomag
reviews.title: Fabulous experience! Loved every minute
reviews.text: We all loved the Paradisus. It was a fabulous venue for fun and our business meetings. The meetings spontaneously and joyously continued in the salt water and around the pool in a very relaxed atmosphere. The night life shows were engaging.

reviews.author: Dorota J
reviews.title: Best Beach in Cancun
reviews.text: Beautiful swimming pools! and amazing beach with white sand and clear water! Good selection of restaurants to choose from. Upgrading to Royal Treatment is worth it! Especially if you are looking for more peaceful and tranquil stay. There is a separate swimming pool area and pool side restaurant that is only available to the Royal Treatment. You can have fabulous breakfast without a crowd and with perfect view and ocean breeze.

reviews.author: 558annetta
reviews.title: Second time and still was great
reviews.text: Second time here and was better than the first, we knew where everything was so we wasted no time. We reserved dinner every night. The restaurants and staff are very nice. Great drink selection at all there bars. Loved it just as much as the first.

reviews.author: Joy j
reviews.title: Birthday Celebration
reviews.text:
Hubby and I were there in July to celebrate our birthdays.  We had a great time.  This is also our first time to experience the Butler Service which was excellent.  Our butler CAESAR did a fantastic job. We had fruit and champagne already waiting for us in our room when we arrived.  Each day he had something special in our room.  At night our beds were turned down and our pillows were sprayed with a fragrance.  He made dinner reservations for us each night at a different restaurants on the facility.  Also had Bali beds set up for us  about three times that week.  I was sick the last night. He even offered to leave the hotel to go out and get meds for me.  How special was that?  Anything we wanted or needed he made sure that he was able to get it for us or let us know how to get it on our own.  He definitely provided the Royal Service.
The grounds are beautiful with plenty of things to do.  If you want to leave the premises there is a buses on the street right in front of the building that come within seconds.  My only complaint was too many steps as someone mentioned before.  If you like walking around but have bad knees or feet this might not be the place for you because of the steps.  Otherwise I'm sure he will have a great time.

reviews.author: 547jennifer
reviews.title: A Wonderful Vacation at Paradisus!
reviews.text:
I have been in hospitality/event management in Boston for 20 years.  I CAN NOT express how amazing the staff is here.  TOP NOTCH.   The resort is not perfect... there are pockets where things can be improved.. but this amazing team of hospitality professionals makes any and all issues melt away.  I have never had better service.

My friend and I stayed (2 years in a row) in the Royal Service which I would highly recommend.  Last year, we were upgraded to an ocean view.  It was so nice to wake up and feel the energy of the ocean and to see the blue waters. This year, the Ocean View upgrade was not available, but they did upgrade us to a lagoon view suite.  Having our own bathrooms was a nice luxury just the same.  Both were valuable in their own way. 

We had Galdino as our butler.  Galdino was extremely professional and truly did everything in his power to make our stay enjoyable.  He graciously made reservations, answered all of our questions, and made recommendations as needed.  This year we opted for the "butler cell phone" which I would recommend. I am not sure how, but he always answered the phone on the first ring.  Even when I mistakenly called on his day off.  (Sorry Galdino!) 

It's easy to make new "friends' with the staff here. You will look forward to seeing the people from day to day because they truly make you feel like they care and want for you to have the best trip possible. 
Daniel, who I believe is the Cabana area manager, recognized me from last year.  The cabana for me is my #1 priority on a relaxing vacation and Daniel did his best to secure me a wonderful cabana every day.  (both years!)   Daniel is THE BEST.  Truly!  Ricardo was our fav server @ the cabanas. They all are excellent and work very hard.  Please tip the staff because it is well deserved! 

For the most part the restaurants are good.  There are hits and misses in this department.  
The breakfast/lunch buffet is very good. Tons to choose from.  Great omelets! 
Bana serves Sushi which is good. I am in the "business" and a bit of a foodie.  I will say the food at the other restaurants is fine..  but you do get to order lots, try fun things, and get dressed up for a night out.  They do their best and for all inclusive I think it is good. 

Tempo on the other hand.. WOW.  What an amazing experience.  If you are a foodie 100% you need to have the tasting menu w/wine pairings.  World Class.  Rudy our server and Carlos made sure all was perfect. 

I will be back ASAP! Thank you!

reviews.author: rickjaramillo
reviews.title: wonderful place to stay in Cancun with family
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay and would highly recommend Paradisus Cancun to anyone.  The staff is outstanding!  They're very hard working and sincere.  Gabrielle our butler (family concierge service package) was very kind & attentive.  Miguel who is one of the servers on the beach was amazing! He worked so hard to take care of everyone on the beach and make sure they had drinks/bottled water etc.  He brought me a virgin blended mojito without me asking and it was delicious!  I thought that was so kind and thoughtful of him. This became my favorite drink and I of course added alcohol from then on.  Richer was one of the servers at the morning buffet and he has worked at this location 26 of the 27 years it has been open.  He took excellent care of us and kept us laughing the entire time.  We asked to be at one of his tables each morning.  We had a professional photo session done with the photography company that is in the hotel.  Parvi was our photographer and we couldn't have been happier.  We had a blast with her!  She was so sweet and honestly a very talented photographer.  Our photos turned out beautiful and we purchased a photo album that we can look back on for years to come.  Carlos works for the photography company and he was very patient and helpful when we sat down to look through our photos and select which ones we wanted.  We loved so many of them it was hard to narrow down! The style of photos they take are artistic and mostly candid shots which I love and the reason we decided to do a photo session. 

Room Info - We had a room with two double beds which was small for the 4 of us.  My husband and I are both 5'8" and normal weight and our kids are small 11 & 9 year olds.  We each slept with a kid which helped but I would have slept better on a larger bed.  In the future I'll be booking the room with one king and the option to bring in a bed (real, not a cot) for my kids.  I stayed away from this room when I booked because I was worried the kids would be uncomfortable on the sofa sleeper.  I learned when we were there that they'll bring in a real bed if you don't want to use the sofa sleeper.  Also, if you have little ones that go to bed early and you prefer a quite room I suggest you don't stay in the main pyramid.  It's very loud at night with the shows they put on. Although they're over at 10pm.  It's convenient since everything is located there but if you prefer quite I think a little extra walk would be worth it

reviews.author: Steven E
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text: We had an incredible time the hotel and staff were over the top responsive and incredibly nice everywhere. Food was very good and the beaches and pool areas really nice. They had music everywhere all the time. There was not one person I met who wasn't as nice as could be. I cannot say enough about the staff in every dept. special thanks to Manual and Rafael at Enso restaurant they were so wonderful and the service they provided makes me want to go back just to see them again. The hotel was lush and tropical all over and there were plenty of quiet or noisey places too. We would go back in a heartbeat. Aquaworld across the street was also incredible any activity you want they have, we went fishing they opened the restaurant in the back just for us and cooked all the fish we caught just terrific people there. There were a few issues to be aware of some the hotel can fix some they cannot. First the entire hotel was pretty hot and many people in our group were uncomfortable. Second lots and lots of steps slightly dangerous after a few drinks and at night. They didn't have a good steakhouse or seafood restaurant on site which would have been nice. Other then this it was in my top 5 places I have ever been too. We would all go back again. Thank you Paradiscus mgmt for knowing what you are doing and a special thanks to the entire staff who worked very hard to get me anything I asked for with a smile!

reviews.author: Melissa B
reviews.title: Overwhelmingly amazing resort
reviews.text: I was recommended to this resort by a friend. Royal Service at Paradisus was just that, our butler Susana took great care of us. We were not on a honeymoon but she made it feel that way! The resort is overwhelming gorgeous, the staff was always friendly. We were upgraded complementary to a better suite and it was a beautiful oven view. The room was always spotless and we received turn down service every night. Our AC was always on blast and the bed was extremely comfortable, two things we have not had luck wth in past stays at other resorts in Cancun. Every restaurant was 5 stars, we are not picky eaters and enjoyed trying new foods from the amazing 6 different restaurants we went to and the buffet which served lobster/seafood on Wednesday nights. Our favorite part of our vacation was the opportunity we received to have our engagement photos taken by the talented Parvi of Outdoors Photo located right on the resort. She captured our love and vacation experience with true passion and desire to give us the most incredible pictures :) The pools were always warm and clean and Daniel at the Royal Service Pool conceir always remembered us and was very nice. My two comments for improvement would be the hallways and resort are not fully air conditioned so some fans would go a long way in some areas. Also Coco's Beach bar is closed after 7 unless you smoke cigars or buy bottles of champagne... it was too bad because we really enjoyed the atmosphere and were asked to leave which just made us feel very unwelcome, suggest communicating that before people go in so they are not surprised at 7. No biggie though that won't stop us from going back and recommending it to friends and family!!!

reviews.author: giuliana
reviews.title: Very nice stay
reviews.text:
My sister and I spent such a wonderful time at the hotel, everybody was really friendly and we enjoyed every moment. 
The only complaint is the breakfast buffet, the food wasn't good and the personnel wasn't as friendly and attentive as the rest of the hotel. Besides that, everything was perfect, so I would definitely come back to the Hotel.

reviews.author: shorneruk
reviews.title: Paradisus is paradise
reviews.text: From the moment we arrived stress free luggage was taken booked in with the Royal service staff if you can upgrade to Royal Service then definitely do so worth it.Exclusive adult only beach and pool areas with waiter service Bali beds available excellant staff good food in all the restaurants varied choice, our favourite was Vento. The butler service is also fantastic leaving you to enjoy your holiday they book your restaurants and any requests you have it's done promptly and efficiently. Beach area was beautiful white soft sand and perfect coloured Caribbean Sea. We will be going back.

reviews.author: kmyerseers
reviews.title: Great all-inclusive resort
reviews.text: Love this hotel. Staff is great,friendly and so helpful. All inclusive is great because all of the restaurants are delicious. The walk to beach is short and plenty of Chickie's on beach to choose from. The pools are huge do plenty of room to move around.

reviews.author: cjones1644
reviews.title: Great first visit
reviews.text: My husband & I visited Paradisus for the 1st time ever in Cancun for our 23rd anniversary. We had a great time. The entire staff was so friendly, welcoming & helpful. We plan to definitely return. Special shout out to Efrain, Manuel, Armando & Melvin at Market Grill! These guys are exceptional!! Thank you, thank you!!

reviews.author: Cooki
reviews.title: My favorite resort!
reviews.text:
I'm waaaaay late with this review. Actually stayed at Paradisus 
a year ago (Oct. 2015) to celebrate my mother's birthday. This was my 5th stay at Paradisus Cancun within a two year period... Can you tell I love this place? We stayed in the royal service section, which is always worth the extra $$$. And as usual I requested Sergio to be our Butler. He is THE BEST! As soon as he saw me in the lobby during check-in he immediately booked Bali beds by the pool for everyday of our stay. So when I started to ask him if he would do that for us he stopped me mid sentence, it was already handled. Just during friendly chit chat with him I mentioned we were there for my mother's birthday, not expecting anything extra. However, everyday of our stay Sergio arranged a surprise in our room to make her feel special, without being asked to do so. One day there were fruits and chocolates, next day flowers and a lovely note. The day of her birthday after we returned from an excursion, there were balloons and confetti everywhere, along with cake and champagne. He really out did himself and that's why I request Sergio everytime I visit. He's very attentive, dependable and just a sweet guy.

reviews.author: Brian B
reviews.title: Great hotel, great food, great service
reviews.text:
Holy crap it's muggy in Cancun.  Got to the hotel about 8:00pm and had a very quick and smooth check-in.  Had a lagoon view jr. suite.  A little small but great view and nice balcony. BRING A POWER STRIP IF YOU HAVE ELECTRONICS, not near enough outlets.  Went to Naos buffet.  It was good although my son didn't find too much he liked.  I suspect the buffet will change daily however.
We were here during the slow season (Sept. thru November) and I would recommend anyone coming to Cancun do the same.  I would not want to be here during spring break...yikes.
The hotel restaurants are a couple notches above the buffet although the buffet is definitely worthy.  Again great service.  Tip your servers please as they do an incredible job.  Tips go a long way too.  :). 
We were here for 12 days and the things that stand out are the great food, and great service.  The nightly entertainment is kinda hokey but family friendly.  Our room was always clean with fresh towels.  Sometimes the pool ran out of towels but not for long.  The beach is awesome.  One thing that I noticed is that the sand doesn't get hot.  You could lay buck naked in the heat of the day and it would be fine.
They burn incense at night which I didn't care for.
My kids enjoyed the kid zone which worked out great when the wife and I wanted to try a new restaurant or something.

reviews.author: Ladiebird
reviews.title: Amazing Family Vacation
reviews.text:
We visited the Paradisus Cancun from Sept 23-30th. We loved our visit! The hotel is beautiful. The staff is amazing. We stayed in an ocean view family concierge with 2 full beds. We have never shared a room with our 8 yr old, since she was born we have always stayed in a condo or a hotel with separate bedroom, so we were a little nervous and worried that we wouldn't be able to relax together after she went to bed or that we would all keep each other up. Well, there was nothing to worry about! She was so tired each night that she passed out and we enjoyed a drink or just chatted outside on our porch. The kids club was amazing - they had various activities all day long and our daughter made some friends. We could drop her off and gave dinner or lunch together (it was open until 9pm). 

Overall the food was great. The buffet was alright. Breakfast was decent if you got a fresh omelette. But overall the food was cold and I was hesitant to eat any of meats that had been sitting out. We only had the fresh fruit, soups, desserts and fresh cooked foods from the buffet. For lunch Market Grill was delicious. The Sunset Grill by the pool was ok - it tended to be cold as well unless you grabbed it when the food was just cooked. For dinner Market Grill, Enzo (you have to try the pinapple dessert!) and Mole were amazing. Blue Agave had delicious tacos. Vento was horrible, we had to go eat at Blue Agave because the food was just not edible. We didn't try the other restaurants so can't comment. 

The pool was beautiful and kept very clean. We were always able to find a chair and someone to get us a drink. 

The entire hotel was spotless. They were always cleaning it. The staff was so amazing, very helpful and friendly. 

My daughter loved the family concierge with the little gifts each night, small bathrobe and slippers. 

We didn't do many excursions but did go to the Museo de Mayo about 5 mins walk down the road. Really nice museum and only about $3 each, our daughter was free. We also took the ferry to Isla Mujeres and rented a golf cart. The turtle sanctuary is worth a visit and the shopping for souvenirs is better than in Cancun.

Overall I highly recommend the Paradisus and if we ever go back to Cancun, will stay there again!

reviews.author: RW_PW2013
reviews.title: BIG, Good All Inclusive Value
reviews.text: We recently stayed at Paradisus Cancun where my son and daughter-in-law were married.  Their services for the wedding package were very nice and well provided.  The resort is very large-I think they said there were 1800 people there-and has many places to eat and drink.  It's like being on a cruise ship.  There are many reviews for this resort and while overall we were pleased and thought we got a good value, there are a few things that I felt they came up short on.  First the smell.  When you walk in the door, front or back, the incense or odorizers will almost knock you over.  Get past the entries and you're ok.  Second, there is no air movement in the hotel.  You can sweat just standing in the lobby.  Same goes for the rooms.  Some have ceiling fans and others don't.  Be sure you get one.  and stairs.  Steps everywhere inside and out.  And not many handrails.  One of the ladies in our party fell and she probably would not have if there had been a handrail.  Dining reservations for dinner in almost every dining area, and they really don't open until 8 PM.  Great breakfast and lunches.  Beach food service is great.  Cabana beds on the beach were great.  $70 all day and they throw in a bottle of booze!  Activity tours were very convenient around the pools.

reviews.author: jodisheltiemom
reviews.title: My honest thoughts about this hotel...
reviews.text:
I stayed at Paradisus for 5 nights, 6 days.  I arrived at noon so during the check in process, I asked if I could get a room earlier than 3pm and also if I could upgrade to an ocean view.  There were no ocean views available I was told but they did give me a room in the Royal Service adults only pyramid (room 5407) free of charge.  It was nice to get in to our room early especially after we were hot and drained.  We received Royal Service bracelets, but no butler.  We were able to enjoy the other Royal Service amenities.

The inside of this hotel is beautiful but it's older.  It's rather warm in the common areas and I wonder if it is because there are plants EVERYWHERE.  It's very clean.  I was happy with my upgraded room because it was basically an apartment.  Even though I did not have a view, I had two balconies, two bathrooms, numerous closets, a bedroom, a living room area.  The showers are good.  The mini fridge works well and has enough variety.  The worst part was the air conditioning in our room.  It worked just fine in the main room, but in the bedroom, nothing would come out of the vents.  We had it on the highest setting the entire time and kept the bathroom doors shut plus curtains shut which seemed to help.  The maintenance guy did come but there wasn't a fix.  After a few days, it was a lot better but to me, as I'm picky because I'm always hot, it could have been a lot better.  

The people who work at Paradisus are very genuine, helpful, and friendly.  Better than in Cabo and better than in the Dominican.

My favorite thing was the bali bed.  I had a bali bed on the beach for 3 hours (it's INCLUDED with Royal Service btw) and it was so nice!  You need to reserve one of these.  They are taken up by reservations so make sure to get out and take care of reserving one in the morning.  The beach was awesome!  I actually was able to swim.  I am a scaredy cat when it comes to the ocean and I went out to shoulder deep.  For some reason, the waves weren't as bad as described online.  I wouldn't let my little kid in there but really, it was not bad.  It was so pretty.

My favorite restaurants were the Fuego and Market Grill.  Market Grill for dinner, you will sweat a lot since it's outside, but the food was amazing!  Make sure you leave a lot of room to eat there because there are 11 types of meat and many, many sides.  Fuego was good, I had the frying pan sirloin with mushroom risotto and coconut creme brulee.  Blue Agave was good too.  I was not a big fan of Naos.  I didn't think there was enough variety and their warm dishes weren't very good.  I was hoping for more meats and pastries.  There was plenty of bread and fresh fruit.  I did not like Mole.  I did not try Enso.  Vento wasn't too bad either but I still think it was average.  There's nowhere to get a coffee in the morning before 10am unless you use the machine or have a cup with breakfast.  Room service was not bad.  I tried the spaghetti, hamburgers, and desserts (try the 4 leches cake).

I didn't do the spa.  We almost took pictures but canceled that.  Maybe next time.

Moral of the story...
If you want something, ask!  They will help you or go out of their room to make it work.

reviews.author: Kelly M
reviews.title: Anniversary trip 2016
reviews.text: This was our first time in Cancun! So glad we stayed at the Paradisus! This resort is Beautiful and very clean! Everyone is so nice and helpful! One of our best meals was at the Market Grill! Our servers were awesome! Alfredo, Jamie, Melvin, Ana and head waiter Sonia!! They took the time to explain everything to us and because of my dairy allergy they made my vegetables separate! They are great! We also had our first couples massage today! Highly recommended!  Veronica and Urie at the Yhi spa were fabulous!

reviews.author: Paola R
reviews.title: SUPER FANTASTICO
reviews.text:
El hotel es excelente, la atencion que te brindan es maravillosa desde el momento en que ingresas. La habitacion es excelente, incluso tuvieron un detalle de bienvenida, con globos y serpentinas pues mi hija se encontraba de cumpleaños. El hotel cuenta con todas las comodidades y puedo dar fe de la honradez del personal de mucamas, piramide 2, hab 2303. Deje la caja fuerte abierta dos veces, con tarjetas y dinero y nunca falto nada.
El hotel esta siempre limpio, no es verdad que le falta mantencion, todo impecable. 
Los shows a diario muy variados, me encanto un show de las Super girls, tipo las Vegas y otro de musica y baile  mexicano.
Los restaurants de hotel son muy buenos, Naos es muy variado su buffet, todos los dias varian platillos, tanto de internacional como comida mexicana. Reponen los alimentos antes de que se terminen.
El plazo para reservar en Restaurant es hasta las 18, pero si vas directo a los restaurantes a preguntar, lo mas probable es que te den un cupo. no tienes que levantarte a las 7 am como otros resorts para reservar.
Recomiendo especialmente el Restaurant Fuego, comida fusion peruana, mis felicitaciones al chef Alex, excelente todo, gracias a Gabriel por su amable atencion a la Srta de recepcion, que nos brindo un cupo sin reserva previa.
Todo el personal de mozos, muy amables, con una sola excepcion en Naos.
Todo en mi habitacion funcionaba perfecto, solo la llave se desprogramo pero rapidamente personal de seguridad lo soluciono.
El snack de la pIscina, exquisito todo. Bar de la piscina,excelentes Margaritas.
Volvere sin dudarlo a este hotel, quedamos encantadas.Es realmente 5 estrellas.
Solo debes preguntar o pedir lo que necesitas para tu estancia, seguramente te lo daran.
The hotel is excellent care and all that they give to  You is wonderful from the moment you enter at Hotel Paradisus. The room is excellent, even had a special welcome , with balloons and streamers for my daughter's birthday when us arrived. The hotel has all the amenities and I can testify for the honesty of house keeping staff, Pyramid 2 hab 2303. Let the safe open twice, with my credit cards and money and never miss anything.
The hotel is always clean, not really missing mantention all is impeccable clean and funtional.
Shows a varied daily, I love a show of Super girls, like Las Vegas and other types of shows with music and Mexican dance.
The hotel's restaurants are very good, Naos is varied its buffet, all day dishes differents from both kinds , international and Mexican food. Restock food before they are completed.
The deadline for booking Restaurant is until 6 pm, but if you go directly to any restaurant to ask, they give You a chance are  You get a reservation. You do not have to get up at 7 am as other resorts for booking.
I especially recommend the Restaurant Fuego, Peruvian fusion food, my compliments to the chef Alex, excellent all ,thanks to Gabriel and all the staff,  for your kind attention, specially  to the Reception's Miss for the kindess , which gave us a quota without prior reservation.
All staff of waiters, very friendly, with one only exception in Naos. He don't know how is a coffee milk...
Everything in my room worked perfect, just the key was deprogrammed twice ,but security staff quickly fixed that, also gave me a new pair.
The snack's from pool, exquisite everything. Pool bar, excellent too,tasty Margaritas, the best bartenders of Hotel.
I will back to Paradisus without hesitation, if You ask...they will give You.

reviews.author: RICKDallas
reviews.title: Not Luxury, just ok.
reviews.text:
Well this resort is listed as a luxury resort and I really don't agree. If you are American and used to staying at luxury resorts I would move on. 
There were some good things about our stay, but also bad.
The main problem we experienced is the lack of air conditioning. IT IS SUPER HOT!
Our room would get to about 77 at night and then 80 degrees in the day. We asked to move rooms , but were told NO. The maintenance man came and tried to work on the air, but it really could not keep up. They did bring us a fan to try and keep us happy, but it was pretty miserable. 
Common areas , like restaurants and night club get really hot. Be prepared to sweat. 
Was almost unbearable. 
The food was actually good for a Mexico resort and many choices of restaurants. 
The one thing I found really strange is the lunch situation. 
The have a pool snack bar that is soooo BAD!!
They have other options for lunch, a buffet and Mexican food restaurant. BUT!! You can't go in in those if you are in the pool. You have to go change clothes and then eat and then go back and change clothes again if you are swimming at the beach or pool. Really was irritating. 
They have nice out door restaurant, Enzo's , but they don't open that for lunch. WHY??
I was starving one afternoon when going back up to the room from the pool. Put on my shorts and shoes with my board shorts,. Dried off and all. Was totally presentable. 
I attempted to get a plate of food from the buffet to take to the room.
Was rudely told NO and thrown out. Told you can't bring food up to your room. 
How can this be you have room service. How can you not bring food up to your room?
We were told NO! a lot. 
Am I the guest or a pest?
Another big point! Yes, they have room service, but do not serve any alcohol with room service. No champagne in the morning on vacation? WHAT?
Was told NO again. 
Wanted a taxi one night to go out to dinner. They acted like the did not know what a taxi was. Told to walk to the bus stop. NO!
I did not want to take a bus. 
Over all we still had fun, but it was strange and would never go back. 
The entertainment was fairly good. They just surprise you from time to time with a performance. 
Kind of cool. Opera singing pool guy one afternoon. 
Dance numbers by the pool.
Belly dancing in the lobby by the bar. 
Mayan show by the pool one afternoon.
Liked that part. I give the entertainers props. 
One ting I do want o mention. If you want to go out to dinner one nightt out of the hotel there is a place called Crab House right down the street you can walk to. It is tremendous. Definitely recommend it for a nice dinner over looking the bay.
To sum it up. I think there are many nicer hotels than this in Cancun.
I travel quite a bit so I have experience in this. 
Did meet lots of nice people from all around the world and enjoyed that.
Was also my 53rd birthday while there.  They knew about it, but did nothing. 
Shop around. 
Paradisus, just so you know. Americans need air conditioning!
You need to do something about it and get rid of the horrible snack bar!
STOP TELLING YOUR GUESTS NO!
WE PAID FOR A VACATION.
One more thing to make known. If you have any walking problems do not go here. It is thousands of steps. You get a leg work out for sure. Tons of places you can have serious wipe out. By the towel are there is 4 foot drop off with no railing. Not good for people having cocktails. 
Rick and Lisa from Dallas, Texas.

reviews.author: matthewbV7864DP
reviews.title: Honeymooners
reviews.text: The amenities were wonderful.  The staff were always willing to help. I cannot express how much the staff improved our stay. They were always helpful and wanted to help any way they could and always with a smile on their face. They made u feel so welcomed!!  Thank you   The staff should be praised at the job they do

reviews.author: Leisha C
reviews.title: Amazing Hotel for our honeymoon!
reviews.text: This is probably the best hotel I have ever stayed at. The hotel and grounds were beautiful. The pools were amazing. Their beach is one of the better ones I saw compared to the hotels around us in the fact it was larger than most. We went during a slower season so there were always chairs or bali beds available if you wanted to pay a little extra for those. The service in this hotel is top notch. Everyone was helpful and beyond friendly. The food in each of their restaurants was amazing. Our favorites were Blue Agave and Mole though. Our server at Blue Agave the first night we were there was beyond amazing. His name was Irving so definitely check for him if you eat there. Our server at Mole was Leonardo and he was amazing as well. The servers at these two restaurants work at both so you may find them flip flopping. There are not enough good things I can say about our experience here. The only thing I wish there was less of was the sales pitches every time you turned around. We will definitely be back though and are already planning our next trip to bring our daughter!

reviews.author: Joanne K
reviews.title: Sister time
reviews.text: This was the best ever definetely coming back. So much fun I am bringing back my daughters and grandson.  So relaxing the name does do it justice totally the best trip ever wheat her you just wanna get away for relaxation or a romantic get away. You will be extremely happy. Paradise at its best 😘😘😘😘😘😘😘😘😘

reviews.author: nani662015
reviews.title: BEST VACATION DESTINATION.
reviews.text: It was a great vacation and one to remember. As a couple we could not have had a better vacation. The room, the food and the service were all perfect. One of the best properties we have visited in recent years.

reviews.author: HollywoodCouple
reviews.title: Mixed Emotions
reviews.text:
Stayed in April 2016, took me so long to review because how upset i was from my departure experience i wanted to cool down before i reviewed so it would be fair.  Unfortunately did not get the name but the young looking short stocky Spanish guy at the front desk with dark hair with a DA type haircut, short on the sides and combed back with gel on the top. So rude and really left a bad taste in my mouth and for that i gave a 3 even after my cool down.  Took long to write but he was very rude and unhelpful upon check out even going as far as being combative with me not a great experience.  
Pros: Nice property stayed in the Punta Cana one and similar features which i really love. Great beach, good food which is important to me. Rooms decent favorite features were big balcony with great ocean views, bade, and big soaking tub.  Disco on site which was nice with live DJ. Nice spa with hydro therapy pool.

Cons: Service is hit or miss with the staff.

Overall had a nice time i will be honest what really impacted my 3 star instead of 1 was Kauil he was an amazing experience.  He was a waiter at the buffet and he is truly amazing, energetic, professional, i can go on.  I would have give 5 star just because of him had it not been for the front desk agent upon check out.  I cannot say it enough KAUIL is the best at what he does.  Thank you!!

reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text:

reviews.author: sandy_hodges
reviews.title: Breath taking
reviews.text: The property was always being cleaned and manicured...the staff was always doing their job but never to busy to help a guest with information or to excort you to wherever you were trying get to,.. .,,,

reviews.author: Karlene S
reviews.title: From Karlene Haase & Taphia Hogarth
reviews.text: I would recommend  Paradisus Cancun a 100% to all my family and friends. The service was excellent and the staff were very nice, they made you feel welcome with a upscale home feeling. The food was also good!  U will also need to try Eeso & Market Grill Restaurant that at this  hotel!!!

reviews.author: miguel_trujillo95
reviews.title: THE PERFECT PLACE
reviews.text:
The hotel and the service are out of this world, extremely satisfied. I did not get to eat at all of the restaurants that they have in the hotel but I had some issues with two places, the sushi and the breakfast. 
The sushi was simply BAD! very bad quality, gas station quality, and regarding the breakfast it was a buffet style which is great, but the food was cold!! Only two things I complained about, but everything else is just excellent!

reviews.author: redline144
reviews.title: Best Hotel in 12 Visits
reviews.text: I've been to Cancun 12 times, staying in various hotels.  This is by far the best hotel I've ever stayed in.  The staff was top notch from the second we arrived.  They went above and beyond to exceed our expectations.   I've never seen a cleaner hotel in my life.  The entire property was spotless.  All the restaurants we ate at were incredible.  There was a lot of entertainment and things to do around the resort.  I can't wait to back next year.

reviews.author: 120stalin
reviews.title: the best
reviews.text: excellent on every aspect. rooms were clean, people were great. and please tip the people the deserved, i will go back with no problem, i like the experience i would recommend all my friends. we had a great time.

reviews.author: Can’t Think of Cute Name
reviews.title: Exceeded our expectations
reviews.text: This resort exceeded our expectations. We booked a family suite which was great. Lots of room for our family. The room and grounds are extremely clean. The staff  was very attentive and food was good. We have decided when we go back to Cancun we will stay at the same location.

reviews.author: nrvie1
reviews.title: Great place to relax
reviews.text: We've had the most enjoyable vacation. There was great variety of restaurants and food and the staff was very friendly. We didn't feel pressed or pushed to do any of the activities. I really recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Nadine T
reviews.title: Paradise on earth !
reviews.text: My wife and I, along with four other couples had the time of our lives in  Paradisus Cancun. It is by far the best resort in Mexico, the best service, the most luxurious facilities and the delicious food is exquisite. Our experience was made complete by one special person name Ernesto, who's shown us such a great time. His charisma and energy was contagious; we had a great time playing beach volley! Best five day ever!

reviews.author: Phillucoe
reviews.title: Best trip!
reviews.text: We had an amazing stay at the Paradisus Hotel! The hotel, food, service and atmosphere was outstanding. Everything was always very clean, the employees are all very helpful and friendly. Ernesto is the bomb! We had an amazing time hanging out with him. We cannot wait to plan our return trip!

reviews.author: garsanath
reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text:
If you want comfort and fun, this is the place to stay.  

The beach has very many chairs, cabanas and you do not have to wait long for a waiter or waitress to refill your drinks.  Food is not allowed on the beach, but there are places to eat inside throughout the day and night.

reviews.author: yguzman2016
reviews.title: BEST HOTEL EVER!!
reviews.text: Sep 2016 best hotel I have ever been to. travel a lot but this was the best. hotel is gorgeous, clean and the staff is amazing, specially staff in all the restaurants. will be back next year! no need to stay at another hotel. four days was not enough days to visit all the restaurants in this hotel. pool and beach are a dream. no need to leave the hotel for any reason

reviews.author: Tania S
reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.text:
This resort exceeds expectations. I traveled with three  girlfriends to celebrate my 40th Birthday. We were looking to just RELAX, as we are all moms just needing a little break.  It might not be as new or as large as some other  local ones, but the staff and cleanliness are impressive.  We had the Adult Royal Service.  Our butler, Antonio, was so nice and VERY good. (I have stayed at Paradisus Punta Cana and our butler there was terrible.)  I would suggest asking for him, you won't be disappointed!  Our experience at the Royal Service adult pool was so relaxing and fun.  Moises is just the BEST server and was so friendly and funny.  He is by far, the most attentive and catering person I have ever encountered at ANY resort.  He anticipated every need and I would return just to see him again.
The spa was wonderful and it was amazing that the steam room and pool were complimentary.  We all got massages and they were very good as well.   The food was just perfect from the buffet to all the restaurants .  If you are truly looking to disconnect from reality for a few days- This resort will NOT disappoint!

reviews.author: bfranks
reviews.title: Great Food/Staff/Pool/Ambiance/etc.
reviews.text:
I hope you enjoy my review. I really enjoyed Paradisus Cancun and am once again a fan of Melia Resorts. This is my second Melia stay this year.

Pros:
White sand beach
Great food at multiple restaurants (all-inclusive is worth it!)
YHI Spa (included with Royal Service)

Cons:
Ocean current fairly strong at times
Not much to do you if you like to explore a lot (far from city, not a lot in walking distance)
Aroma machines around the buildings are strong, may be an issue if you have allergies 
Occasional sewer smell in restroom, not major, just noticeable. 

--FOOD –
All the restaurants were delicious, even the buffet.
NAOS is the buffet. I love breakfast and you can get an omelet, waffles, meats, fruit, juices, chilaquiles, and so much more. There are easily over 60 options with all the toppings,
BANA was by far my favorite restaurant. I had the pecking duck which was cooked to perfection. You can only order a single item with the all-inclusive so choose wisely. 
MOLE was very good and has a great yellow glow ambiance. The food had a great presentation and there was a mariachi playing. 
BLUE AGAVE has some really delicious tacos and quesadillas. The lengua taco’s and chicken quesadilla are some of the best I’ve ever had. 
MARKET GRILL was probably my least favorite restaurant. The buffet was actually better quality. I ordered a flank steak but it was small and tough. 
SWIM UP BAR is so convenient. You can literally stay in the pool for hours. I’ve stayed at other Melia resorts where the swim up bar is not included, but luckily, not here. 
COCO’s BAR is a great outdoor hangout bar at night. You can purchase a hookah or Cuban cigars and hangout on a couch. 

--EXCURSIONS –
We took a hotel taxi to downtown shopping (not near the Coco Bongo, a more rural flea market style to get the authentic shopping experience). The shop owners do haggle so if you are not one who likes to say ‘no gracias’ repeatedly, then go to the commercial shopping area and spend 5x as much. We visited HOOTERS and Senior Frogs and returned. If we stayed longer we would have visited coco bongo. 
We did the XCARET day trip. It leaves the hotel at 730am, its about $140 pp and takes an hour to get to the destination. We were picked up in an tour bus and you can nap on the way. Check out the brochures, I highly recommend this trip, the park is so well kept and there is a lot to do! You will be gone all day and can return at either 6pm or 11pm. 
I also wanted to do the fishing trip from the hotel $140 /person on a 6 man boat for 6 hours. That didn’t sound bad to me but I found out on the last day. 

--WEDDING – 
We did observe a wedding while there. It was very beautiful with outdoor chandeliers, DJ, food, etc. I guess the party goers were either drunk or bored because the entire party jumped into the pool, it was hilarious.

--ROOM – 
I opted for the lagoon view as me and my wife spend most of the time out of our room on the beach. Our view actually faced building 4 so there was literally no view, but that did not matter to us. Our friends had the ocean view and it was nice. 

--STAFF—
All of the staff were amazing and nice. Do yourself a favor and bring some small bills to tip, you will feel bad if you don’t. Room service is nice and fairly quick … but the food did not taste as good to me. There are limited options in the evening.

--ROYAL SERVICE—
The private butler feature of the royal service is the most beneficial thing. He will book your reservations, trips, taxis, and bring you a bottle of the alcohol of your choice. A Day bed was included which was pretty amazing. I would only recommend the Royal Service if you’re going during a busy season, plan on eating a lot, and want day bed use (normally $100 per day).

reviews.author: Natalie1818
reviews.title: Best Resort in Mexico!
reviews.text: Every person we encountered from check in until check out went above and beyond to make our vacation unforgettable and amazing! Best spa treatments and therapists we have ever had, amazing food, beaches were pristine. Perfect vacation and already planning our return! Only place we will stay in Cancun!

reviews.author: Cass30tr
reviews.title: 1 week all inclusive
reviews.text:
Had a great time at this resort. Bar service was good. Not over crowded. Restaurants were very accommodating for the large group of 10 I had went with. 

All staff was wonderful! Very polite and friendly. Special thanks to Ernesto who  took care of us while there! 

I would recommend this resort and will likely return!

reviews.author: arben d
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text:
Great place to be visited. 
Good food, good rooms, great service.
I do recommend it to all my friends. It's my third time in Cancun and the second time here at this resort. I'm impressed with the service this year, especially with Royal service.

reviews.author: Adrian C
reviews.title: Held corporate event, most staff were exceptional
reviews.text: We held a corporate incentive trip at Paradisus Cancun. Out main event contact Apolo was exceptional, superb attention to detail, made my entire trip as the head organizer extremely at ease. I had previously read many of the negative reviews prior to giving the hotel a chance. I'm glad we did. It appears many visitor came to this hotel expecting a to get a lot for as little as possible. You're not going to get superb service if you book the cheapest available option. This is a superb hotel if you are willing to spend a few bucks for complete relaxation. Our group booked royal service, and the service was exceptional. We took over a dozen room for the week, and not a single complaint from our travelers.

reviews.author: Brad M
reviews.title: An amazing trip made exceptional
reviews.text:
I just got back from a week spend at this amazing place. The variety of food, always helpful staff, cold drinks and spotlessly clean common areas as well as rooms made this location one of the best I've had the opportunity to visit.

From check-in to check-out, there wasn't a single reason to complain!

What made this trip truly exceptional was one of the activity directors Ernesto.  His happy and helpful attitude brought tons of smiles and laughter to the experience.

I'd highly recommend staying at this resort to anyone looking for somewhere warm, clean and friendly!

reviews.author: Terra G
reviews.title: Amazing!!!
reviews.text: We had an amazing vacation at the Paradisus Cancun Resort! From the time of arrival to the day we left the service was over the top. The staff was so friendly and helpful, the food was amazing, and the entertainment was fantastic. I have to give credit to one person in particular who worked there, Ernesto! He was so friendly, got everyone involved in either water aerobics, Zumba, beach volleyball etc. We travelled with 4 other couples and he remembered each one of our names!! He made a point everyday to come say hello, just made us feel very welcome. I would travel back to Cancun again and for sure stay at the Paradisus.

reviews.author: alexgalivan
reviews.title: AMAZING!!!!
reviews.text:
We just returned from a group getaway trip to Paradisus to celebrate my 30th birthday. The hotel is beautiful, the food is amazing, the service is unbeatable.
On the entertainment team, Ernesto made our stay so enjoyable with his lively personality. He always kept us engaged in water aerobics, Zumba ,beach volleyball and all of the other entertaining events and shows happening throughout the day.
He was so personable, always remembered all of our names! We had an amazing time hanging out with him!
All of the service staff members are so friendly especially Andres at the Espresso hut. I always enjoyed getting my coffee and talking with him throughout the day!

I had an amazing holiday and I truly cannot wait to back !

reviews.author: Bill H
reviews.title: Paradisus is our new home when in Cancun
reviews.text: We had a fantastic vacation at the Paradisus Canun Resort!! From the minute we checked in it was five star service and five star friendly at a great value. Food is excellent and grounds and room was very well maintained. We highly recommend this very well managed resort.

reviews.author: atashab2016
reviews.title: Looooooooooove Paradisus
reviews.text: I enjoyed every bit of my time here. I would really like to go back. My favorite restaurant was The Market Grill. The employeesale look very nice in their uniform. I loved the smell upon 1st entry at the door.

reviews.author: pamelamO4663ZZ
reviews.title: Over all a good experience.
reviews.text: Credits each day are really small discounts on extra services, store and upgraded wine or liquor. Charged for a late check out. Nice variety of restaurants and food.  The Michelin Resturant is an extra $89 a person or $120 with wine tasting.

reviews.author: Eleonora C
reviews.title: Paradise ! We will go back !
reviews.text: This was a 5 Star experience. Highly Recommend. Just Gorgeous. The customer service was superb. The food was over the top. We don't have one complaint. It was a convenient shuttle service from the airport and back. The bus system is great. It stopped every few minutes in front of the hotel to take us anywhere in the city. Excursions were readily available for purchase in the hotel. Every detail was taken care of.

reviews.author: Sara W
reviews.title: Loved it
reviews.text: We are just returning from 5 days at this fantastic resort. The staff are super attentive. The upgrade to the Royal Service is well worth the money for the upgraded room, private butler service, exclusive adults only areas and lots of extras. We just wish we could have stayed longer. Special thanks to Cesar, Eddie and Octavio in royal service and Jorge at the Mole restaurant.

reviews.author: Shawn T
reviews.title: Splendid resort
reviews.text:
I had an amazing time at the resort.  Excellent service.  Beautiful resort.  Stayed in Royal Service section. Staff pampered me from the time I arrived until I departed.  Food and libation was great and abundant.  I highly recommend this resort Royal Service. You get personal care and superb treatment.  Thank you Rossana my wonderful female butler. I appreciate the awesome support I received from Royal Service Concierge thanks (Samatha, Letica and the whole concierge staff). My favorite place to enjoy cocktails and food with a serene ambience was La Palapa  of Royal Service. The staff provided me with warm friendly outstanding service. Thanks Guadalupe, Jorge, & the entire staff for the treatment you gave me.  I would also recommend the Sunset grill on the beach.  The staff was attentive and eagered  to serve.  I look forward to returning to Paradisus Resort in the near future.  My only regret is that I didn't stay longer! 
Shawn T

reviews.author: SteveO1234567892015
reviews.title: Overall experience
reviews.text: Samuel at the Beach was exceptional, his service far exceeded our expectations. We rented 2 days from him and those were the best days of our vacation. Lobster delivered to you at the beach doesn't get much better.  Thank you Samuel!!!!!   Victor was great answered all questions and provided information.    The 90 minute tour for vacation ownership  was fine but on the way home we got to thinking about the promise we were made if we attended  we would receive 3 days free on our next trip?????  we did not receive the promise

reviews.author: cvorrias1
reviews.title: Excellent resort for the price
reviews.text: We stayed in the royal service section. We were pampered everyday and our personal butler helped us at all times. This is a huge resort with tons of all inclusive amenities. We could not even try all the restaurants. Needless to say we will be back.

reviews.author: Barbara H
reviews.title: Will Return
reviews.text:
Overall the all-inclusive package at this hotel is a definite recommend.  A few pros and cons follow.

Pros:
-	Beach is clean and expansive.  Any seaweed that is present is cleaned every morning.
-	Restaurants, food selections and preparations are one of the best of any all-inclusive.
-	The restaurant reservation system is excellent.  Just a quick phone call.  Specify date and time.  
-	Lobby has outdoor feel and is gorgeous.  
-	Staff service is above and beyond.  This includes room service, cleaning and general attention.
-	There is a nightly music and dance period that never felt long enough.  Do not miss the band Quantico.  Professional talent at its best.  

Cons: 
-	The general construction of the hotel interior and exterior consists of levels and steps.    While beautiful, may be an issue for those that have limited in walking abilities.  There are elevators. 
-	There is only one bar open during the day and that is by the pool.  
-	Main entertainment consists of a small show in the upstairs lounge.  
-	The pool is large but 5 foot deep everywhere except for the immediate area around the pool bar.  There is a children’s pool.          

Preparation Hint: The pharmacy / gift store has hours from 7 am to 10 pm.  Very convenient but you need to pay with pesos.  There is an exchange at the front desk.  Have your passport in hand. 

Special Mention:  Jared at the front desk was so patient helping me through an issue with transportation.  Much appreciated.  Alejandro at the Mole offered a brief education on the area, humor when I dropped my silverware and overall excellent service.  Marco at Naos breakfast always helped me with my Spanish and was so attentive each and every morning.

reviews.author: Katherine K
reviews.title: Fantastic Resort
reviews.text:
My husband and I just returned from an anniversary trip to the Paradisus Cancun.  The property was beautiful...beach fantastic with great waiters and lots of palapas!  Victor and Guadalupe from Royal Service waited on us and they were so good!  Royal Service Pool Concierge Omar one of the best and very friendly!  Lots of bali beds around the pool and lounge chairs.  

Our butler Galdino was so very helpful with any needs we had.  He was so great!

Food was very good and wait staff so friendly and efficient.  In Naos Ricardo waited on us every morning and at lunch and seemed to be waiting to greet us each time!

Tempo was amazing!  We have eaten at most of the Martin Berasategui restaurants at the Paradisus resorts and this was one of the best so far!  Our waiter Samuel, Hostess Sandra and Sommelier Iran were so attentive and friendly with 5 star service!  The chef Ismael even came out to greet us which we were happy to rave about his culinary skills!

Also not to be missed were Josue, Ivan and Javier at La Palapa.  All those that we encountered were smiling, friendly and willing to help in any way.

I would recommend this hotel highly and can't wait to go back.  One thing to note...they have transformed this property into a Paradisus from the Gran Melia and the upgrades are very nice.  They are still working on a couple of the sections but it did not disturb us or keep up from enjoying this trip.

reviews.author: ladyfish574
reviews.title: gorgeous view average hotel
reviews.text:
Although this Hotel has a great view and the staff is superb, this Hotel is starting to show its age. Because of a high Atrium and long hanging vines the humidity in the central area is high and this creates a mold smell which the Hotel tries to cover up with strong flower scents. In the evening it gets really warm in that area and in the morning the couch cushions are wet.
Food is average except for the Friday night buffet which is not advertised well but is awesome. Unlimited lobster, stone crabs, snow crabs mussels shrimp and octopus. Don't miss Friday night buffet.
