The shows are in a small area in the atrium and you have to stand mostly to see it if it is crowded. I would take out the desk in the center that holds the light and sound controls and open the entire area up so it is fully visible from the bar.
The pools are nice. If you are short watch out because they are 5' 5 all around with no shallow end. The cabanas are a nice touch but it is a shame after paying for all inclusive you have to pay for Royal service and cabanas to enjoy the amenities. 
Our room was clean and well attended, however, we could hear the beat of the Disco on the 3rd floor. I would rate this Hotel average.

reviews.author: lcruzg7
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: Stayed for 7 nights and I found this place wonderful. Excellent service.  Excellent staff. The beach was beautiful and we all had a great time. I would absolutely want to come back to this hotel and to enjoy Cancun again.

reviews.author: 646dustind
reviews.title: Poor service and overpriced.
reviews.text: Overbooked, problems with check-in, staff seemed indifferent to anyone who complained.  Service was great from a select few people and terrible from the rest, with the bar staff topping the list of ignoring people and moving slowly at all times.  Also, this is the only all-inclusive I've stayed at where it just seemed like they were trying to get me to always spend more money on either service, products, or the staff making me feel like I have to tip at all times with tip jars out.  I've had better stays at half the price in other resorts.

reviews.author: Heeva A
reviews.title: Average hotel overall
reviews.text:
Stayed here for 5 nights in late October and enjoyed our stay. I've stayed at better all-inclusives in Cancun (Excellence Playa Mujeres), but this hotel did a good job. The pool is nothing special, but it's very clean. The staff was very nice (for the most part), but the most disappointing aspect of this hotel was the food. The food was pretty awful actually. I only truly enjoyed one meal and that was at the Market Grill for dinner (Brazilian BBQ). The staff and food were amazing. Our server (Efratin) was super helpful and accommodating. 

Now let me tell you about our rooms. At first, we were given rooms in building 4 (which is quite a far walk to the main building where all the food and activities are). We were there for a couple days until my wife (she's 7 months pregnant) noticed they were applying paint thinner and other chemicals to all the floors in our building. I immediately asked to be moved due to the tremendous health hazard (esp for someone pregnant) and I was moved 3 hrs later. They apparently only had 1 room available, which I highly doubt since they were only at 40% capacity. That was annoying (not having more options) and we lost our ocean view since there were no other rooms available (or so they said).

I wouldn't come back, but wouldn't also say it was so terrible that I would deter people from going. I would simply suggest a different all-inclusive.

reviews.author: AAA1129
reviews.title: 6 wonderful days in paradise
reviews.text:
We definitely would recommend Royal Service,   From Rode our butter to the pool staff were amazing, I like to name some of the staff that  treated us amazingly well.  Octavio, Victor, Valeria, Lupita etc.  always making sure we didn't lack anything.  Loved the Bali beds!  Royal service has premium liquor, descent wines as well.  We also enjoyed the Royal lounge entertainment every evening before going to dinner.  Very nice touch.
We also enjoyed the restaurants, but "Bana"was our favorite.  Had dinner twice there, the service was fantastic!  Daniel and Erick made sure we had a wonderful experience, the sushi was great!
This is our second stay at a Paradisus Resort, cancun and Costa Rica.  Great Properties.
We would love to make a suggestion, have an  adults only restaurant for dinner.  We love children, but a nice romantic quieter restaurant, would be a nice addition.
We will return to Paradisus.

reviews.author: Debbie H
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Absolutely loved Paradisus Cancun!  Beautiful property and beautiful beach!  The staff was excellent and would like to recognize 2 of the best.  Laura and Leticia waiting on us on the beach and they were the best waitresses than any other trip that I have ever taken.   They were very attentive and always smiling!  Hope they are there again on a next trip because they went out of their way to wait on us timely.  If we were gone walking, our bucket would be filled with drinks and ice upon our return!!!

reviews.author: Lisa F.
reviews.title: Easter at Paradisus
reviews.text:
We had an oceanfront room and it was amazing!  Huge balcony that looked down at the entire pool area as well as the beach as far as you could see in either direction.  Food was excellent, lots of variety, great service in the restaurants.  Super clean and close to La Isla by taxi.  We would not return only because the main pool does not have a shallow end and we travel with a child.  He was a bit big for the kids pool and even if he was smaller, the kids pool is removed from the main area so not for us. 

Entertainment at night happens in a small space so get there early if you like to see the shows.  Unlike some resorts, this hotel does not have an open lobby area where you can sit around at night, have a drink and people watch.  We missed having "somewhere to go" after dinner.  Because we travelled with a child we did not to go the disco.

The week we travelled the waves and undertow at the beach was quite rough - nothing to do with the hotel and sometimes is calm, sometimes it's not.  Every day we witnessed people who were not careful and were pulled out by the current.  The lifeguards are amazing and quickly returned them to shore however visitors should be careful, it's very dangerous and you are not stronger than the current!

Can't forget the AWESOME bali beds by the pool, we rented them two days and LOVED having such a beautiful place to lounge out of the sun and have our lunch.
Overall a great spot, super clean, good food, good location close to the mall and the airport.  More of a couples resort in my view.

reviews.author: Rounsie
reviews.title: I think I got the bad room
reviews.text:
I'd love to score this higher. The staff were beautiful. Nothing too much trouble, I hope they are well looked after. 
The food was really good. Considering the volumes they did an amazing job. The individual restaurants were faultless. 
Now my room! Above the disco you can't get to sleep. Friday night was the worst, but here for a conference and it was exhausting. The room thumped all night. Wireless internet was useless in the room, we had to go into the lobby to get it. The shower didn't have enough pressure or hot water to be comfortable or efficient. On the last day we decided to watch a movie after dinner to find the tv didn't work. There is a gap across the top of the door, and we're adjacent to the lifts, so the noise is straight in. We certainly didn't sleep well. So yes, love to give a better rating, and I think it was just our room, but not at all good.

reviews.author: Kym S
reviews.title: Please Stay away from this hotel... Employee Thief
reviews.text:
STAY AWAY FROM THIS HOTEL...  HOTEL THIEF

We stayed at Paradius Cancun from September 29th to October 4th, 2015.  Since it was our Anniversary, we decided to upgrade to Royal Service were we were given our own Personal Buter.  Although the hotel is absolutely beautiful, our experience was horrible.

Our personal Butler, Juan, broke into our room while we were at the Spa and stole money from our safe.  We had a confirmed reservation for massages at the Spa, and while we were at the Spa the Butler broke into our room.   

I came back to the room to get money for a tip, and I actually walked in on the Butler in the middle of the act.  I was scared out of my mind. He was standing in the darkened bathroom when I walked in.  All I could do was grab my purse and my personal belongings and run out the room as fast as I could. 

The butler took all of of our clothes out my suitcase, and hid my wallet in the suitcase.   Our safe was opened when I walked in.  After a thorough investigation, Security reports showed that the Butler entered our room 3 times that day without permission while we were at the Spa and at the pool.

To make matters worse, after I reported the incident to the Royal Service Manager, Lazaro Asencio, and to the head of Security, and they did nothing!  They kept asking us not the share our experience with any of the other guests or employees.

After hotel Security verified that the thief took place at the hotel, they did nothing.  They promised that they would terminate the Butler, but he is still working there.

In addition, the Security team and Management promised to email us a formal report about the incident which we never received.

Please be careful if you choose to stay at Paradius Cancun.  The hotel Butler who we trusted when we checked into the hotel could have panicked when I walked in on him in our room, and he could have killed me in that room.  Please, please, please be careful if you decide to stay at Paradius Cancun in Mexico.

reviews.author: 845betsyc
reviews.title: Great experience day #2
reviews.text: So just wanted to take a minute and acknowledge the great service so far we have received. From our butler Gerardo to our pool concierge experience has been great. So first with the bad we came and out bathroom was dirty toilet had rim around that was gross. We called and room service came and cleaned but still looked moldy I called ROYAL service concierge they offered change of room but nothing much for our inconvenience. But then Gerardo came and saved the day he made it better knowing we would get moved to a new room and he would accompany us to view the room. So impressed and grateful for out butler Gerardo. He made sure we had our Bali beds and all our reservations. OK now for pool experience all inhave to say us Victor Perez is beyond the best waiter pool concierge we experience he is such hard worker he brought us the best food n drinks always with smile n so energetic. Rodrigo with pool concierge was great very nice and always willing to help I am not strong swimmer but my boyfriend is so he went out of his way and got me a floatie so that I could stay in deep parts of pool. Thank u Rodrigo for ur thoughtfulness. Thank u Paradisus look forward to rest of my experience ..

reviews.author: Hope D
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun...in one word...AWESOME!!
reviews.text: I'm reporting to you live, from a Royal Service poolside bali bed! Many thanks to Victor Perez, our magnificent pool server, who keeps our cold drinks flowing & literally goes out of his way to get you whatever you would like to eat & drink. Also, special thanks to our butler, Galdino, who made all our wishes come true.  We have 3 more days at this beautiful island paradise, then back to reality. It'll be so sad to leave.

reviews.author: seanp286
reviews.title: Awesome experience
reviews.text: Had a great time.   Jim was very helpful and treated us great he made us feel like family what a great guy.  Food was excellent drinks where top shelf.  Overall great experience. Had a bit of rainy weather towards the end but still managed to have a good time. Definitely will be back.

reviews.author: David L
reviews.title: Amazing Trip
reviews.text:
2 words to describe this place ----ABSOLUTELY AMAZING!!!!!  From the moment we were greeted w/champagne @ check in until our final breakfast..... the service made us feel like royalty.
    Our Royal Service (RS) concierges Samantha & Leticia were super helpful w/ lots of hints & tidbits about the resort.  Our butler Cesar went above & beyond all our expectations.  From champagne & strawberries in our room, nightly dinner reservations, rose petals strewn on our bed and in the bath he was amazing.  I mentioned I like wine before dinner.... that night when we got back from the it was waiting for us in our room.
     The RS pool was our personal paradise.  Our pool concierge Daniel was super polite, helpful & very accommodating.  Each day he had our requested Bali bed all set up and ice water waiting for our arrival.  Our waiters Eddie and Ricardo were so on point that our drinks were refilled or refreshed before we even thought to ask.  The first day @ the pool we requested something for lunch not on the menu and Ricardo handled it quickly and hassle free.  The next day even though he was working inside at a different area of the resort Ricardo came out to make sure the Chef had us taken care of.  So thoughtful and unnecessary.  
     Eddie and Ricardo were also servers in the RS lounge where we ate breakfast every morning.  They were as good inside when we had them as they were out side.  One morning the hard boiled eggs that we requested for room service never arrived (only happened once during the week) and we weren't worried about it but Gustavo was very concerned and ran to the main restaurant and got us hard boiled eggs.  It was very thoughtful and the kind of service we received the entire week.  By the 3rd  day since we ate in the RS lounge every morning Gustavo, Eddie, Ricardo and the other servers had our drinks at the table before we had a chance to ask for them. The RS lounge was breathtaking day & night to look at.
     All the restaurants were absolutely delectable & servers were awesome.  We like Mole and were lucky enough to have Leonardo both times.  He was so attentive , we didn't want to leave when we were seated in in his section the 2nd night, he remembered our drink orders from the first night (which was 4 days before).  Great friendly service, food was top notch.  We went to Bana twice as well and loved the food as well as the atmosphere.  Our maitre'd Daniel and Alberto our server made our last night @ Paradisus one we won't soon forget.  
     We felt like the Royal Service did exactly that......made us feel like royalty.  The candlelight, koi ponds, tropical plants and the incense were breathtaking.  This was one trip we will be repeating.

reviews.author: Ivan P
reviews.title: Amazing vacation
reviews.text:
Just came back from Paradisus Cancun and I miss it already!! Such an amazing vacation. It's our 2nd time in Cancun, last time we stayed at Live Aqua, but this year decided to try Paradisus and we will definitely be back! 
Perfect beach, clean hotel, lobby is very unique and relaxing. Food is great, plenty of restaurants to choose from. Our favorite was Market Grill, amazing steak! You have to make reservation, we made it in the morning for the next 2 days, so it's not too bad. 
They have shows every night, really good drinks. Reymund at the Avenue Bar provided EXCEPTIONAL service, he's the best barman we've met! Melvin at the Market grill was amazing, made sure our meat was well done everytime. 
Very happy with overall service, food, and hotel in general, will be back for sure!

reviews.author: Sushma B
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun service excellent Kauil from Naus restaurant and Victor Pool server
reviews.text:
Paradisus, Cancun was such a great escape. Everyone was great. and a special
THank you to Kauil from Restaurant Naos and Victor Chale - pool server.. you both were excellent, your time and service was much appreciated from the Bachan and Rambharose Family. Kauil and Victor Chale really were very nice and genuine.  Thanks for taking such great care of us.

reviews.author: coloradotrav
reviews.title: Always a PLEASURE
reviews.text:
My family and I have been traveling to Cancun and staying at what was originally the Gran Melia and is now the  Paradisus Cancun for the last 15 years. The resort just gets better every year and not just because of upgrades but because of the fantastic staff. We have had the pleasure of being pampered by Luis Cortez at the pool and beach. Rody , Sonia and Angel at Mole restaurant. These are just some of the many fine people working and tending to the needs of guests. 

For the last  3 years we have gone for our wedding anniversary and find the room ready with champagne, chocolates and rose petals every where. The beach as always is beautiful, even this year with all the seaweed the staff at the Paradisus found away to make everything enjoyable.

This year we also went for the 16th of September independence celebration. It was a total joy to be with the people of Mexico and help celebrate their independence day. The Paradisus not only had a great party but respected the culture and history of Mexico.

If you are traveling to Cancun and want to be sure of a great experience stay at the Paradisus, if you going to Playa del Carmen stay at the Paradisus Playa del Carmen. Thee you will receive the same exceptional service.

reviews.author: LaurenAnne25
reviews.title: Pool Bar
reviews.text: I have been coming to the  Paradisus Cancun for 20 years.  I want to recommend one of the waitresses at the pool bar.  Her name is Asuncion.  She has waited on me during each of my trips.  She is so friendly and is an excellent waitress.  Please ask for her when you are here.

reviews.author: naya32
reviews.title: Paradisus is a gem!!!
reviews.text:
Great location & some of the friendliest people!!!!
I can't thank enough for the services & friendly interaction with Miguel at Naos, Erick Cruz at the pool bar, and those who filled in-room mini bar & maids who cleaned up the room at least a couple of times everyday.   Thanks again!!!

reviews.author: Larry S
reviews.title: Wonderful Mexican Getaway!
reviews.text: Great food, great service and the rooms are fabulous with great views.  Many rooms have a hot tub on the roomy patio!  They treat you like a king in the restaurants.  Ask fior Jeremius, Bonilla or Dorwin, Chorono at the restaurant Ibana, you will not be disappointed!

reviews.author: 139carissaj
reviews.title: Beautiful resort excellent food and drinks
reviews.text: Place was absolutely beautiful but there wasn't a lot of things to do because of the rainy weather. Food was excellent and the drinks were ready good. Very friendly staff. Only problem was the beach had a lot of garbage washed up on shore by the end of the night

reviews.author: Maria P
reviews.title: High quality and family friendly all-inclusive hotel
reviews.text:
I've stayed at several all-inclusive hotels but usually the quality of the food and drinks and food is not the best.  I was impressed of the high quality standards of the food and drinks.  I could not say what restaurant was best.  
Food options are great.  We stayed 8 nights and could try all the restaurant options.
What I loved the most was the kids club for kids from 1 year and up.  Usually kids have to be at least 4 to stay at the kids club.  I was able to have time with my husband and relax while my 2-year and 6-year kids where having fun at the kids club.
Only two things I disliked... if you do not pay for the concierge service then you have to wake up very early (around 5am) to get chairs and a good location at the pool or beach.  And the night activities where at a very small place that did not fit all the guests... we had to arrive at least 30 minutes earlier to maybe get a place to sit and enjoy the show.  Furthermore, after 10pm there was nothing to do at the hotel, we did not have any other option than going back to our room

reviews.author: imventarza
reviews.title: A place to came back with better wheather
reviews.text: The Hotel is very well located and very big. All the staff is very friendly and the try to help you with every details. Rooms are very nice and big. You have everything that you need even the beach towels. The swimming pool is very nice but was very difficult to use because of the weather.  The views are very nice but my room was located very low and I did not have any view( room 5002)

reviews.author: SoCa1l26
reviews.title: A Zen experience, but pools limiting and beach lacking
reviews.text:
My wife and I have stayed many times in the Mayan Riviera, but this was our first time in Cancun. We wanted to compare the experience to other resorts down the coast.

THE RESORT: The resort is a set of nice pyramid shaped buildings and the main building is a large enclosed space with a beautiful atrium and hanging green plants that remind me of some of the cenotes in the area. It is quite beautiful. To add to that, the "theme" of this resort seems to be a spa-Zen type relaxation motif. 

There is a spa-like smell in the main atrium area, there is zen music playing (starts promptly at 7am every morning), and all of the staff are wearing uniforms that are like white martial arts robes with colored belts. It is certainly different and kind of pleasant althoug if I worked there I could imagine it would drive me crazy after a few weeks.

CHECK-IN: Check-in was fast and efficient. A nice lady met us to tell us about the hotel; she also wanted us to come back after checkin to go over what can be done and what services are at the resort. She was very nice and friendly, but in the back of my head I suspected timeshare sales. We did meet with her the next day and she spent a good 20 minutes with us going over area sights, transportation, etc. with no hint of any sales. I was just about to think that I had been too cynical about the timeshare sales thought in the back of my head when the mention of a "vacation club" came up - so I had to cut her off at that point and tell her we were not interested.

I guess some people fall for this or like timeshares, but personally I like to have complete flexibility to travel without monthly payments or annual maintenance fees that you can't get out of or weeks that you must take your vacation. I suppose that it works for some, but I find it kind of offensive that I'm on a limited vacation where I'm spending a lot of money to enjoy myself and then the resorts have sales people trying to comandeer your time for 1-3 hours of a sales presentation. No thanks. We've found this at a variety of resorts but I must say the one place that has never done this to us is Iberostar, fyi. We really like the Iberostar resorts for service and value.

THE ROOM: We had an ocean facing room in the main pyramid and it was quite nice. The AC worked well. The view was a bit limited as there are large side dividers that stick way out due to the architecture of the building, so you can't see sideways very much, only straight ahead. Also, even though the atrium has gorgeous well maintained hanging plants, each room has a large planter on the balcony where the rail would be (there is like 18 inches of planter between your balcony and the drop off) and the planter was just dirt, devoid of plants. So from the outside of the building you see just the building but  in days of yore it probably had hanging or other plants on the outside, too. This seemed kind of cheap to us and is a downside - either maintain the planters or get rid of them!

FOOD: We don't drink and ate only in the buffet, so we can't comment on those aspects of the resort. The buffet was consistently excellent for food and noticeably better than other AI resorts where we have stayed.

BEACH/POOLS: The beach is kind of curious as compared to say, the resorts near Playa del Carmen. I understand that the color of the water is gorgeous in Cancun, and it was that way on some days, but on other days it was kind of ugly brown near shore due to the seaweed/sargassum problems that have been well publicized recently. Certainly not the resort's fault. 

What is weird is that while in PDC you see huge numbers of people on the beach, in Cancun it seems that many more people are at the pools and the beach is relatively deserted. At the Paradisus, there are relatively few loungers and Palapas and they were not even crowded. The water was kind of rough and there was a significant slope along the water which made it hard to walk down the beach.

Now let's talk about the pools. It was hot in September and we wanted shade. So first of all the smaller pool is off limits unless you paid a lot more for the upscale package. So that's 1/3 of the pool space off limits to you. Second, at the larger pool that you can go to, there are huge numbers of Bali Beds that cost like $50/day or some such to reserve. 

The proportion of shaded space with umbrellas that is open to anybody is pretty small. So perhaps 25% of the large pool has publicly accessible shaded space; 25% is public, unshaded, and the other 50% or so is Bali Beds! So if you want shaded space and *didn't* pay even more for the exclusive club, then you have 25% of 2/3 of the pool space (the large pool) to choose from. That is about 16% of the total pool space for anybody who wants shade, didn't pay for the high end club, and doesn't pay for a Bali Bed. 

This is not one of the cheaper resorts but it is an "All Inclusive" that doesn't include most of the pool space that most of the cheaper AI resorts provide to you with shade!

We liked the resort but based upon these issues, probably won't be back.

In summary, the good:
- clean, zen atmosphere, beautiful atrium, comfortable room, good food and service
The bad:
- timeshare sales, limited pool shade, not the best place if you want a good beach

reviews.author: MarieW1015
reviews.title: Excellent Vacation
reviews.text: We had a fantastic trip! The Royal Service was a must-do upgrade. We traveled during the off season, so we were given our choice of reserved boli beds each morning. We enjoyed both the general pool and Royal Service pool, but liked the child-free ambiance of the RS pool. The RS waiters were also fantastic, bringing appetizers and drinks before we even asked for them. The RS pyramid had a fantastic pre-dinner buffet with a chocolate fountain that we enjoyed between swimming and our dinner reservations. The beach was beautiful and, though there was a bit of seaweed, this was naturally-caused and consistent among the beaches of all nearby hotels. We enjoyed our butler, Rossana, who made sure we had dinner reservations at the preferred times and at the exact tables we asked for. We also liked that the waiters and butlers made an effort to converse with us during the day.

reviews.author: Cooper H
reviews.title: Fall Break 15
reviews.text: Beautiful Hotel, pool staff Asunion and Rodrigo were excellent, great drinks, on time, friendly, brought towels and gave excellent Cancun recommendations. Melia Paradisus is 4.5 Stars , food and drinks are very good and reasonable price- 8 th visit , prices have fallen in the last 4 years.  Buffet is amazing, entertainment at night was outstanding .

reviews.author: T603DDcheryls
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation in a beautiful Resort!
reviews.text: I just returned from a week long stay at Paradisus and enjoyed it so much I felt compelled to write my first review. Four friends (women) traveling together and it was very safe!  We arranged an all inclusive package through Funject vacations. The all inclusive is the way to go, there are many different restaurants to choose from - hint, you must have reservations for most of them. They will only let you book two days in advance - we decided which restaurants we wanted to eat at before we left and made sure we called when we got there. All of the food was delicious! The buffet changes themes every day so you aren't eating the same thing for lunch over and over. The service everywhere we went was excellent.  We enjoyed Vento restaurant, with Aurelio, Katia and Jose, and Mole was fabulous!  Everything was very clean, we constantly saw people mopping the floors or cleaning the glass. Be careful because there are stairs/steps all over the place, including one to get into the bathroom of your suite. The beaches are beautiful as is the pool area. Sergio Mesero did a fantastic job keeping our drinks flowing! Even in the rain he kept coming over to make sure we were ok under our cabana and make sure we had enough to drink.  One note about the pool - the depth is 5.1 feet almost everywhere, which makes it challenging for shorter people. My friend is 4'11, so we bought floaties in the gift shop (they will blow them up for you) to make things a bit easier for her.  We arranged an excursion to Chichen Itza, which I highly recommend. It's a long day on a tour bus, and we were a little concerned about the travel to and from, but they take your safety very seriously there. We never had any issues. My friend had her door open a crack while she was grabbing something from the room, and security knocked on her door to make sure she was ok. The only time we left the Resort was on the guided excursion. As someone mentioned, they do start the lobby background music early, but it never bothered us in our rooms. We were on the 4th floor ocean view junior suite. One thing to mention, the entertainment does go till at least 9pm and it's loud - you won't be able to sleep through it if you want to turn in early (unless noise doesn't bother you). From start to finish we received excellent service!  We did not upgrade to Royal Service and didn't feel it was necessary. We had tips included in our package, but we still brought $50 in ones (each person) and tipped our servers. They work hard and deserve it!  I have recommended this resort already to many of my friends, and I would definitely stay at the Paradisus Resort chain again!

reviews.author: SapphireBoston
reviews.title: Nice but Inconsistent
reviews.text:
I stayed here 4 days for a business conference. It's a beautiful hotel in a great location on the beach. It presents itself as a luxury property and in some ways it is but in other ways, it's not.

The pros:
Close to the beach
Great pools and lounge areas
Beautifully designed rooms and common areas
Nice big room layouts and amenities
Really good food at the restaurants especially for an all inclusive. I was very pleasantly surprised by the food. (But room service breakfast was pretty horrible by contrast, rubbery eggs, and the turkey sausage was actually just a gross hot dog.)
Comfy bedding and towels
Room was very clean
Staff is very friendly and tries hard to please
I had a Zumba class with Alfonso and he was a fun instructor
Go to the Passions restaurant - even if you don't stay at this resort. Passions was one of the best dining experiences of my life. The chef there is a genius!

The cons:
Although they are trying hard, they mistake many simple things. For example:
They give you a special card if you have dietary restrictions. Present this card at your meal and they will adjust your entree to accommodate your diet. I did this, the waiter indicated he understood and even talked to the chef. They got half the restrictions right but still put ingredients in my food that are listed on the card as allergies. So I had to pick through the food and take out the problem ingredients. 
The activities they offer are automatically canceled if only one guest shows up. So I came for a workout class by the pool and the instructor was there but he refused to do the class with me because I was the only one.
They have a live Latin band on Saturday nights and offer dancing - but only for one hour. That's hardly enough time for a dance party. It's over as soon as it starts. It's not really appropriate for a vacation resort to only offer a party for one hour on Saturday night.
If your room is near the nightly activities, you'll have to participate or wait until it ends- for example I had to wait out the opera concert before I could go to sleep. (That's also probably why the dance party only lasted one hour).
There were other odd things like each day I got a different combination of towels - sometimes I'd get face cloths sometimes not. Sometimes two bath towels, sometimes one. It was random.
They were working on the power while I was there and although they said it would be off for 2 hours, it was off for much longer. And that meant no air conditioning. People were burning up. I didn't understand why they wouldn't run a generator.
During my September visit, the ocean was doing some weird ecological thing where it dumps massive amounts of sea weed on the shore. The smell was disgusting and of course there's no way you would swim in it. It was so gross I couldn't tolerate a short walk on the beach. I was there for a conference, so someone else made my reservation and it didn't ruin my trip, but I wondered if the regular guests were informed of this before reserving. Someone was having a wedding at the beach and I felt really bad for them.

Overall, it seemed like the staff training and management wasn't up to the level of quality they want to represent. The staff were trying hard but delivery was inconsistent. There were many mishaps. If you can deal with that, it's a beautiful hotel in a great location.

reviews.author: Pierre Archambeau
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: What an amazing resort. The service was outstanding, in particular in the restaurant in the centre of the hotel. We had one of the best waiters we have EVER had (Jesus Canche) so professional and we didn't want for anything. This young man is a credit to your hotel. Food was also amazing, the only fault was that we had no electricity for 18 hours however the BBQ the hotel put on that night was outstanding. Well done Paradisus and thank you "Jesus"

reviews.author: J O
reviews.title: Would have given 4 stars but they stole our credit card information
reviews.text:
Ok, let me be frank.  I have never had any interest in visiting Cancun past sophomore year of college.  If I want tropical there's plenty of other places to go.  That being said, we had a wedding to attend in Cancun and decided since we were going to make a week all-inclusive vacation out of it.  For what I was expecting, I must admit I was pleasantly surprised.  The hotel is beautiful- the pictures from other travelers accurately portray it.  It was built in 1999 we were told and changed over to Paradisus in 2011, so its relatively new.
We learned through other members of our party that that high rates we were offered through expedia and on the Paradisus website for Royal Service, or upgrades, were negotiable.  Other members of our party were able to upgrade for $15/night.  When we arrived we explained we were there for a wedding and asked about an upgrade, which was quoted by Alma for a lagoon view (the cheaper option) for $1k for the week.  When all was said and done, she worked with us and we paid a third of that.  I was very satisfied.
Our room in Royal Service was nice but had no view what so ever. Others has gorgeous views.  This didn't bother us because we planned to spend zero time on a balcony anyway.  Our Butler, which is basically one person you deal with for every need was Rosanna.  She was very kind and accepted calls even when she was home.  I guess it's her job, but it's not a job I would ever accept so I admire that a lot.  Overall she was good.  She did forget to book our bell service to have our bags brought to transportation upon our departure which cut it close.  She also forgot to book one dinner reservation for us, but the restaurant took us anyway.  So again, not deal breakers for me and I was happy.  I learned from another member of our party toward the end of our trip that the hotel does offer nightly shows.  She learned from her Butler.  Rosanna never told us about entertainment on the resort.  But I did google search and learn that they sell hookah on the property, which was nice for me because I enjoy hookah here and there.
I also want to note Miguel from Fuego restaurant who went out of his way to have to chef prepare me two types of rice one evening when I was disappointed to rice is scarce in Paradisus. You rock Miguel.  And Sergio at the pool was a great server.  And Eduardo at the Royal Service pool.  I remember their names because they were very good.
Overall, I felt that everyone at Paradisus were extremely accommodating and the hospitality was exceptional.  I thought I'd give them 5 stars, until...
When it rains, the hotel leaks.  The automatic doors stop, the pool bathrooms flood, water drips in down some walls so there's towels all over the floors, and even one staircase was closed.  But no water came in my room so it wasn't too big of a deal to me.  What did bother me was that all night it was noisy as all hell.  Footsteps, people talking, workers pushing carts, the people above us seemed to move furniture around for hours.  Alllllll...night.....
Then housekeeping kept taking my wash rags, but never replaced them.  So every day I had to call and ask for wash rags so I could shower.  Inconvenient, annoying, but again not a deal breaker.  That's where discretion in tipping comes into play.
The wedding we attended was beautiful. I saw 4-5 during my week and ours was by far the best.  It was held outside on the gazebo and the reception was alllllllll the way across the hotel but on the beach.  All the other ones I saw were indoors next to the buffet and pool, which was undesirable.  During the ceremony, which was lovely, we guests got to smell gasoline and listen to the jet skis that felt it was appropriate to ride directly behind a wedding.  Also on that note, the bride and groom have a child.  So they weren't able to stay in Royal Service.  But for people who paid to hold their wedding at the resort, they were treated as nothing special.  A normal room, no extra care, etc.  The groom and his extremely well behaved daughter came to the Royal Service pool to chat with us for a few moments on a day that the place was empty, and were chased out.  He just paid to get married here...
And one night I was laying on a bali bed on the beach, awake.  I heard a worker come down the stairs, turned my head, watched him approach the entire time, only for him to state to me "these bed's are not for sleeping that's what your room is for."  Did I look like I was sleeping?  I just watched you.  There were more professional ways to address me thanks.
And lastly, when we arrived Alma at the front desk took our credit card to swipe it.  Then she wrote the numbers down.  My boyfriend questioned why she was writing it down and was told that's their policy.  Once we checked in at Royal Service they again took our credit card and wrote the numbers down.  We didn't question this since we were already told it was policy.  But two days later the card was cancelled on us because someone tried to spend $140 at a gas station in Mexico.  So we had no use of that card the entire trip.  And someone or some people working at Paradisus are stealing and scamming customers.  The card was only taken out of it's wallet two times, both times given to Paradisus staff.
That being said, I will never, ever return here.  All the hospitality in the world doesn't mean a thing when it's to distract me from your dirty work.

reviews.author: Grace Gómez-Herrera
reviews.title: An unforgettable experience!!!!!
reviews.text:
A pleasant atmosphere of the entrance, comfortable rooms with breathtaking ocean.
The service and attention are personalized.
Here you find the ideal holiday break.
Romantic and elegant in all areas !

reviews.author: yarden p
reviews.title: We love it
reviews.text:
Beside it was raining all day long we really enjoyed the hotel! Everything was great! The food and especially the bana sushi restaurant!!
The room service was quick but not a lot of options!
We enjoy very much !!

reviews.author: alexvanessa2015
reviews.title: Awesome Experience!!!
reviews.text: My girlfriend and I celebrated my birthday here and let me tell you, it was an awesome experience! The hotel is beautiful!  The all inclusive package was worth every penny.  The staff were very professional, especially three staff members in particular.  Victor Chale (we asked for their full names.. lol) who works as a pool attendant was very attentive to our needs.  We never once had to look around and ask for drinks or food, he was always on top of it.  Also, Carlos Nunez at the Coco's Bar gave us such great service and the VIP treatment!  When it came to dinner, Miguel our waiter from the Bana restaurant was also very courteous, and friendly.  He made us feel right at home.  This hotel is top notch, the views are breathtaking from the moment you step out to the pool area. There are cabanas and day beds galore.  The pools are big and you are never crowded.  Overall, the week we spent here was an amazing experience and we can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: Thefourbatemans
reviews.title: Problems Left and Right
reviews.text:
For how expensive this place was, I was expecting a lot more. The problems started right when we arrived, they didn't have our reservations. The first clerk was extremely rude. We purchased the family concierge package, they were much nicer but nothing was fixed, we arrived late Saturday when they were supposed to go home (sorry), so we were put into a small hotel room the first night, nothing given to us or explained. We spent the first two days just trying to get things fixed and figured out, I was extremely frustrated.

They were very-very accommodating on switching our room, the first room was tiny and most of the electrical fixtures didn't work, it was in the main pyramid, very noisy. They put us in a very nice, first floor room, close to the kids zone, big enough for our family of four, they even showed us three rooms to choose from, we chose the king size bed with two roll away beds, I was very impressed with that service but that's were it ends. Not sure if the concierge was worth the money or not, they definitely seemed to try and help, felt too little too late, and we heard a lot of complaints from other vacationers.

The restaurants were good, and accommodating for younger kids, The wait staff is either great or horrible depending on who you get, sometimes we felt ignored.

The staff around the kids pool is amazing, they were very friendly and always ready to help, drinks and food every time you turn around. 

The room service is convenient but they NEVER get your order right, have to wait 30 minutes to get the rest of your food, two or three times.

The hotel is very nice and kept clean, the rooms can be wonderful or horrible.

Resort credit was misleading, they were coupons, such as $10 off $100 purchase. Many were for wine selection discounts, and little girl spa discounts.

reviews.author: Curtis D
reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed here while attending a friends wedding.  The hotel is absolutely beautiful and the staff is warm, friendly, and always there to help with anything you could need.  We wrapped up our stay with dinner at Bana, the Asian fusion restaurant in the heart of the main pyramid.  Luis, our waiter, took perfect care of us and made sure we knew which menu items were "must haves.". He was helpful friendly and provided for some very enjoyable conversation about the area and his background.  It really made the meal memorable.  I will come back here, no doubt.

reviews.author: Danilo C
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text:
Great friends made , good food ,drinks . The ladies from Naos in the morning and 
Orlando Bello the waiter ( pure charisma)  
 Christian bartender from Red Lounge. True hermanos , and Laura from beach service . Despiste The air conditioning was out of service ,the staff did something to handle. 💪🏼

reviews.author: kimm e
reviews.title: Nice but ....
reviews.text: There are many nice amenities and atmospheric things about Paradisus but there are a few annoying things too. Namely, there is elevator music playing all the time and it's loud. We've asked for them to turn it down (it starts at 7am). Not only is it loud but it's such a constant spa-like, annoying background noise that I find myself actually irritated when indoors. Definitely don't buy their inclusive package as there are fabulous, authentic and very inexpensive restaurants within walking and safe distance. You get the same ole buffet if you do the all inclusive package. There need to be two more pillows on each bed too so that one can be supported while reading or watching tv. The pools are nice and all the staff is friendly and speak perfect English. In fact, it feels like you never left America. The downside.

reviews.author: iceman276
reviews.title: Great Experience!
reviews.text: We definitely recommend the Royal Service Package. Fantastic Service! Great food with premium drink options. It was nice to get away from the loud area and go to the private pool on the royal service side. If you travel in a group of four you should share a cabana so you have one for four days due to only receiving two cabana days per room. Large layout. Great for a big group.

reviews.author: Dmitri K
reviews.title: Thanks to Royal service staff and Food and Beverages people!!
reviews.text:
Hi everyone, just came back from our vacation in Paradisus Cancun. We stayed there many times before and once again had a great time staying in Paradisus Royal Service in room on the 5th floor, 5507. Royal service pyramid is for adults only having nice appetizers section with good selection of drinks located in a beautiful, green and QUIET lobby. Separate Front Desk with nice staff, Angel, Letizia, Sandra, Juan Carlos, all guys nice. This zone is  more for people who like to get away from city buzz and restore energy. The entire hotel has tropical garden with Japanese colorful fish in ponds just in the lobbies with nice coffee spots, bars, armchairs, sofas. If you wanna quietly take a sit in a cool place having wifi time you will definitely find comfy seating area for yourself. 

We had a room overlooking lagoon and golf course with a butler service. Hi, Antonio:)) Thanks a lot man for your service and company. He made for us reservations in a la carte restaurants, confirmed our transfer, arrange luggage, golf booking, bali bed reservation, housekeeping requests, etc.  Nice to have someone taking care of things while we enjoyed sunshine.

During our stay from October 4th to 11th the weather was great, no rain, just a little bit at night, pretty hot after 10 am to 3 pm, but under umbrella it's nice and cool. Beach was clean, no seaweed!!!!!! Just a little bit in the morning on sand not even in the water and they removed it away very very early in the morning. We like Cancun for long beach we walk along every morning as far as we want. Paradisus Beach area is pretty extensive. Nice service provided by beach/pool servers bringing drinks or food. Thanks guys.

We stayed the last year previously and this time food in buffet changed significantly thanks to a new chef, we guess. Everything very very fresh and tasty. 
Restaurant staff are very hard working people, always friendly and nice. 
Lots of thank you words to Oscar Velazques, Edgar from Naos restaurant, Juan de Dios, Ignacio, Moises, Elizabeth (RS team), actually all of F&B staff are doing a great job!!   

Bana sushi restaurant was amazing. Spent the last evening there and it was amazing sitting in a green tropical forest. Sushi are tasty there. Asked our server Miguel to take picture of us and he did a great job, all his photos looked like pro:)) 

And some words about management. French F&B manager Max Mathey is always there checking on staff, service and restaurants, talking to guests, above and beyond on every guest request. Very attentive and professional. Merci beaucoup!

Mr. Lazaro Asencio, Royal Service GM takes care of his guests and staff. It was pleasure meeting him. Great job Sir! Thanks to all of you. Lana and Dmitri

reviews.author: hectorf303
reviews.title: just beautiful
reviews.text: love this place,   u are  treated like royal we stayed at the royal suite ..I truly recommend this place the food is good ,everything its just beautiful .I would defenetly go back ..room service is the best u have ure own buttler  private buttler

reviews.author: U9129VHrickb
reviews.title: great vacation
reviews.text: really great hotel,the employes were very kind and always took care of us in a very kind way.the waiter kauil, victor at the pool monica from the spa made our trip very special.we felt like family.keep up the great job.

reviews.author: Denny2701
reviews.title: Great time in Cancun
reviews.text: Had a great time and fun experience. Beach was nice and vast. Pool was great. Will make sure to make reservations i earlier as this became a bit of a bother if we wanted to try a different place to eat

reviews.author: xStefan78x
reviews.title: OVER THE TOP SERVICE.
reviews.text: This resort far exceeded my expectations. I must stress how impressed I was by the level of service my wife and I received during our 5 day/4 night stay in a Jr. suite Ocean view. We opted to upgrade to Royal service. It's definitely worth the extra money and i strongly recommend this upgrade. Our room was extremely comfortable and accommodating. The view was simply beautiful. We spent time daily admiring the view of white sand and blue/green water from our patio especially in the mornings where a breathtaking sunrise can be viewed. Our personal butler/concierge Galdino was EXCELLENT. He worked tirelessly behind the scenes to ensure that our stay was memorable. He ensured we had reservations at one of the many restaurants on site. We received preferential reservations/seating(another perk of Royal service).  I celebrated my birthday there and the entire staff was aware and all extended birthday well wishes. I received several birthday cakes. The breakfast service at the Royal service was well maintained and provided a certain level of exclusivity and much less "hustle and bustle" than the main breakfast area. They also provided snacks and top shelf liquor all day long. The pool service as well was excellent. All your needs are met by the pool concierge and pool staff. Daniel and Alexander were very good. Loved the cabanas(again another benefit of royal service). I must say Edier aka Eddie provided a level of service that was superior to all. He prides himself in personalizing his interactions. Additionally Rodrigo, Jorge, Moises all seemed genuine and all seemed to love what they did and also provided excellent service. We opted for a couples massage at the spa services on site and was extremely satisfied with our package. (Royal service members also get access to certain spa amenities.) Our package was additional. Veronica and her partner were excellent. They displayed a level of professionalism that eliminated any uncomfortableness and they were simply good at what they did. They incorporated wraps, massages, aroma therapy and body scrubs into the routine. I would definitely recommend people to at least check it out. The nightly shows were fun, interactive and provided variety and diversity.  All in all my wife and I were very impressed with our overall stay here. We will definitely be returning next year and i'll be bringing more family to experience the superior service and first class amenities offered by the Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: Odyssey89578
reviews.title: Fantastic Family Vacation
reviews.text: My family and I just returned from the Paradisus Cancun.  We have a 2 year old son so did Family Concierge.  From the moment our butler Ramon walked us to our room to the moment he walked us to the cab to leave everything was perfect!  My son has been asking to go see him for the past two days!!  Ramon left our son a note and little treat each night which he always looked forward to.  He made sure the restaurants knew his allergies and gave us great recommendations for outside dinners as well.  The hotel room was always clean and stocked with everything that we needed.  The pool staff was there with a new drink before you finished your current one.  All around great trip and look forward to returning !!

reviews.author: MGIson
reviews.title: Huge hotel with staff that could care less about the guests
reviews.text: Overall, this is a huge hotel with lots of options and a beautiful beach.  The staff is the weakest I've ever experienced at a hotel.  From check in, to solving details, to care at the restaurants the only consistent thing is that not a single staff member cared about the guests.  They have lots of staff but no one ever seems to do anything help the customer.  I had a problem with my room key and after 4 visits to the front desk and a "security officer" nothing worked.  I demanded a manager come solve the problem and new keys magically worked.  It should not have taken so much to solve such a simple problem.  Even though the staff saw me back in the welcome lounge, I had to wait until they finished with all the customers.  Every simple problem that was raised by me or any member of the large group here for a meeting, nothing was solved simply.  You have to wait for towels to be told they have run out.  You are told you can't be seated in one of the restaurants without a reservation - but after throwing a fit magically we were seated in a near empty restaurant that always had a free table during our visit.  You have lots of choices in Cancun - my only advice is to pick another hotel!

reviews.author: Campmeg
reviews.title: In a word, UNSURPASSED.
reviews.text:
To say that our trip was amazing would be an understatement, and although I will try my best, my review will certainly not capture all the details that really helped to make our Anniversary trip so special. Just know that you will NOT be disappointed if you splurge for Royal Service (adults only option), which makes me think that anyone else who had a less than stellar vacation was simply a fluke.

I poured through extensive reviews before selecting this hotel for a special occasion, and also my first trip to Mexico. For our 7 night vacation, the hotel service, location, and food were top notch. 

Location

This beach is beautiful, well-kept, and uncrowded. It’s not a private beach, and the hotel does a great job at preventing non-guests from using services they haven’t paid for. The pictures speak for themselves, and we were lucky that every day was bright and shiny, in October no less! 

Rooms

Immaculate. With Royal Service, we were whisked away to a completely separate tower from the rest of the hotel (Pyramid 5), and selected a king size ocean-view room. The cleaning staff did a great job at picking up after the tornado that came through our room every day after a day of drinking at the pool. Rooms come stocked with a full mini-bar (water, beer, snacks) and our Butler in Royal Service even catered our fridge specifically to our tastes and the type of beverages we wanted. Stocked daily. You get a nice beach bag to use during your stay (don’t take it home!), and access to robes and slippers which keep your feet warm and away from sand on the tile floors. They supply the room with top-shelf bottles of liquor too (tequila, vodka, rum, etc). FREE OF CHARGE! And although we didn’t partake, they offer a pillow menu if you want something special with feathers or aromatherapy (again, free of charge).

ROYAL SERVICE! ROYAL SERVICE! ROYAL SERVICE!

I cannot stress enough how WORTH IT the Royal Service option is if you are traveling without kids. It is not that much more expensive to elect, and they really roll out the red carpet for you. They have a separate lounge and Pyramid (you can’t even get into this pyramid without a special bracelet and card). The lounge offers food and drinks until 10 pm, providing different high quality nibbles throughout the day, tailored to the time of day. The Royal Service pyramid is away from all the action, away from the loud Pyramid 3 where all the action is, so you have plenty of time for quiet rest and relaxation. You also can use the hydrotherapy pool and special showers in the Yhi Spa for free anytime. 

You have access to a separate pool, AWAY FROM SCREAMING KIDS, and not even half as crowded as the regular pool. This pool is huge, and has tons of Bali Beds for RS guests to access. Included in the Royal Service, is access to Bali Beds twice during your stay. However, helpful tip, if Bali Beds are unclaimed by 11 am, they are up to grabs for anyone regardless of your reservation. Because of this, we were able to snag a Bali Bed for every day during our stay. They are CLEAN, and perfect if you want a break from the sun to take a nap on a comfy bed with pillows. However I imagine it might be more challenging to get a bed during the busy season so be sure to have your Butler reserve yours sooner than later. Outside of the Royal Service at the main pool, reservations of Bali Beds cost a pretty penny.

GERARDO! This was our butler, or a saint, as we like to call him. You have access to your butler via a cell phone (if you request the phone). Gerardo was always available via phone (even when he wasn’t on property!), and always one step ahead of our needs. The list is endless of how he made our trip extra special…nightly turndown services, warm bubble baths ready to go based on when his knowledge of our dinner reservations, assisted in booking all dinner reservations, excursions, and activities, little notes and flower petals, complimentary bottles of wine and/or champagne, and chocolate covered fruit left for us in our room. On one of the days he noticed we were sunburned by the pool and even left aloe for us in our room! Seriously Gerardo made this trip for us, and this is the mode of operation for any butler in Royal Service.

Gerardo was fantastic, but every. single. person. we came into contact with was simply delightful. These guys are busting their butts every day, in blazing heat, and with a smile on their face. They will always remember your name, and truly love assisting in any way they can. We never passed a single employee who didn’t greet us casually and flash a smile. The other Royal Service staff outside of our butler kept us entertained, hydrated (with many adult beverages ) and fed, every day. Shout-outs to Victor, Jorge, Moses, Ricardo, and Daniel, the pool concierge. These guys will take care of your every need, so PLEASE remember to tip them! A little bit goes a long way.

Food

Try all of it if you can! We were not disappointed with anything, and for an all-inclusive resort, they really go all out on the food and cuisine. We were impressed with the level of detail, décor, and menu items that went into the “feel” of each of the restaurants. They do a great job of creating a different experience for you every time. If we had to pick, our favorites were Fuego and Blue Agave (bomb tacos!), but seriously, the rest were just as good. We didn’t have an opportunity to try Tempo, but plan to when we go back. It’s an additional charge, but if you plan to visit here, make sure you bring appropriate attire! They are strict on dress code with closed toed shoes (no tennis shoes), slacks (no jeans), and button up shirts.

To everyone at Paradisus Cancun, THANK YOU! This was the trip of a lifetime, and we hope we can visit you again in Cancun and elsewhere!

reviews.author: Rona K
reviews.title: FABULOUS
reviews.text: big shout out to staff Letecis,Guildo,Edier,orig Eddie,Valeria,Moises,Victor,Gustavo,Omar,Jojue,Cesar,Juan Carlos,Ricardo,Staff at Rest La Palapa,and Housekeepers! reviews.author: Stephanie T
reviews.title: Such an amazing time!
reviews.text:
My sister and I stayed here for her 30th Birthday weekend and I'm so glad we did!

The hotel itself deserves 4 stars being that the power kept turning off and our security box wasn't working. However, the staff at this hotel truly deserves 5+ stars!  Everyone was so AMAZING super attentive, kind, funny, above and beyond! I wish I knew all the names of everyone who was attentive to my sister and I but those who were exceptional to us were first and foremost Kauil WOW Gracias Kauil por todos!  Eder at the Market Grill for making my sisters birthday so special and Alma at the concierge for being the sweetest upon arrival and departure. I can't wait to come back with the family soon.

reviews.author: jkeish
reviews.title: Service unlike any other.
reviews.text: This property was the very nicest, cleanest and with the best customer service I have honestly ever experienced. First, our pool side Spanish lesson with Erick M. was fun and informative and I have taken Spanish before..that wasn't fun or informative. Then, our Royal service butler, Alma was not only perfect in every way but found out I had a birthday and provided balloons, cake and a bubbling jacuzzi as a surprise. She was amazing. Additionally, our front desk host, Angel in the Royal service area was more than helpful and patient as we checked in and out without a hitch.  I will definitely visit this property again and hope to work with these superior professionals.

reviews.author: Rishma B
reviews.title: AMAZING STAFF.
reviews.text: Our first trip to Mexico with our entire family.  Staff was amazing especially Kauil at restaurant Noas.  As well as Victor Chale our pool server.  Rooms were clean stocked fridge everyday.  Had turned down service.  Excellent stay for first time in Cancun, Mexico.  Thank you Expedia for booking our trip!

reviews.author: MsLyn901
reviews.title: Lacking Attention to Detail
reviews.text:
Overall, the trip was great. The beach is beautiful, there were several great food options, the housekeeping staff did a great job, the Royal Service pool area is beautiful, and the Royal Service outdoor staff is extremely attentive. 

However, there were several issues that I didn't expect to have with Royal Service. I had to call to have the minibar restocked, as it had not been restocked for more than 2 days. The power went out several times - not sure if this is generally an issue in Cancun or just this hotel. Whenever the butler was not at work, the lady answering the request line would say she would call back but never called back. Thus, I ended up having to call multiple times to get simple things done, and some tasks, like reserving a Bali bed, were never done! 

I hate to complain about such little things, but these issues made the trip much less relaxing as I was counting on things to be done that were never done. Plus, I felt like I never received the amenities and extras that were promised to me upon checkin. I definitely question whether Royal Service was worth the extra cost.

reviews.author: Alejandro_Sch
reviews.title: Awesome place!
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay at the Paradisus, the food was amazing! Fuego was our favorite restaurant. The service was excellent at the pool area and restaurants. The beach and pool were great. If you go make sure you make reservations for the restaurants, the buffet is good but the restaurants are so much better.

reviews.author: Arial7777
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel, amazing beach
reviews.text:
We stayed in Paradisus from September 27- October 4 with a group of four adults.
The hotel is breathtaking, check in was fast and easy, rooms are nice and clean with comfortable beds. The pool area and the breach is amazing and clean. During our stay hotel was completely out of power for 3 full days. All restaurants were closed except the Noah buffet during the week due to the power outage. The breakfast at the buffet was very basic and flavorless, we did not enjoy any of our meals there, I'm not sure if it was due to the electrical issues that the hotel was experiencing. The hotel manager Sergio was very nice and accommodating, he offered us 4 complimentary spa certificates. 
The bartenders Salvador and Francisco were very nice and they made us the best drinks every night. Overall, loved the this hotel and would stay there again.

reviews.author: Q S
reviews.title: Best for the Best
reviews.text: No other to place to stay. After 3 vacations to other resorts near by this is the only 4 star vacation. Totally go all inclusive. Just do not stay near the dolphins.  We had the sweetest  concierge lady.  She catered to us and she recommended we listened and had tons of fun. Even a great couples massage.

reviews.author: FarAway592872
reviews.title: Great for family!!!
reviews.text:
We are at paradisus Cancun with our 3 young girls. We arranged the trip with family concierge and was a 
hit!!!! Our mayordomo Ramon was very kind and helpful. Food overal was ok . The pool and beach fantastic. Amenities great and service was excellent. From the pool side like Jose and Asynciin as the room service

reviews.author: Angela M
reviews.title: Love this resort!
reviews.text: I love this resort! The stuff is so nice and helpful. The pools are perfect! Also loved that every night they had awesome shows. The club was great! The restaurants were so delicious and the service was excellent, our waitress Kauil at Naos was outstanding. Everytime we went to Naos for breakfast we always asked that Kauil was our waitress. We are already planning our next trip with our kids. I won't stay any where else but the Paradisus

reviews.author: Dino B
reviews.title: Great Place to stay in Cancun
reviews.text: I love this place so much! Service is awesome. Two places there I would like to recommend is the avenue bar with Raymundo and his crew bar tending you will have a good time. Also Vento Jose and Javier gave us excellent service. Party of 20 👌🏽 and still had no problems. We were there for a family vacation and my cousins quinceañera. Ask raymundo to make you a Singapore Slim and if you want to take a shot ask for the Cerebro congelado!

reviews.author: jacoby361
reviews.title: Second class experience
reviews.text: They have different packages and they don't treat you properly if you are not part of the good ones.  No one offer us those packages or give us any orientation on the premises, services or activities.  No power, AC, WiFi, almost every single day, from 2 hours to 12 hours wish is unacceptable.  First time in my life that something like that happen to me. No one took responsibility of anything.

reviews.author: Davidmaldonado123
reviews.title: Best of the best
reviews.text: This is a resort that should be on your top places to go. The resort is magnificent with a beautiful design. When you walk inside it feels so majestic the vines that drop from the ceiling, the love music in the background. The pools are perfect. There's always something going on at the pools several activities that are very fun. Every night they have awesome shows. There's a club inside that gets very good too. The restaurants were sooooo delicious I loved the vento restaurant. Katia was our host along with Ruben and Jose they served our family better than restaurants back in Houston, and that's because we were a party of about 20 people. The staff were very nice at all times weather it was a host bar tender, room service or house keeping. I recommend the spa the have this very awesome pool with all kinds of different massage jets and the mussuese was excellent. We went to celebrate a quinceneria in their ball rooms and they set everything up perfect for our family. I won't stay any where else but paradises resort when I vacation to cancun. If you can buy into there vacation club you won't be disappointed. See you soon Paradisus

reviews.author: So Youn K
reviews.title: Fantastic stay!
reviews.text:
Staffs are so nice in there. especially Darisnell at fron desk , he's excellent!!!!
love the pool area, beach area overall the place. 
the only one thing- it was temporaly i believe- we did have power problem when i stayed there. otherwise everything else was toatally fine. I would love to go back there.

reviews.author: corazonespinado_b
reviews.title: It was cool
reviews.text: the free room service was cool. I think I spent the whole day with a yard stick margarita in my hand. They will kick you out if you drink to much so be careful. Make sure to make reservations as soon as you can or all you'll be eating is tacos

reviews.author: reallycoolcatty
reviews.title: Seriously Impressed! Would stay again and again.
reviews.text: This trip for us was a dental vacation and we were extremely stressed. Check In was quick (our flight 12 hours late) and extremely professional. The fellow at the front desk knew we were exhausted and did everything quickly as possible to get us to our room. We were so grateful. We were in the main pyramid building, in a standard room that was bright and clean and in amazing condition. Pillows sucked, LOL, but they brought us more when requested. House keeping and room service were exceptional and instant. We were there off season. We asked for a cot for our daughter so none of us would have to share a bed, it came immediately, at not extra cost and was super comfy for her.  The buffet was outstanding, super clean fresh, and different daily. Due to sore teeth and dental appointment we did not feel up to trying the other restaurants this visit. Staff outstanding, eager to help, kind and humorous.  The grounds were beautiful, pool awesome and clean, beach front was great as well. Perfect weather except one thunderstorm we were grateful to get. Due to our circumstance we did not take advantage of any upgrades ect. The only disappointment was the resort credits for example to use 20.00 in the store you had to spend 200.00, I found that rather pointless. However I did find their prices in the gift store reasonable and fair. We would absolutely stay here again and look forward to it in early 2016 A big one for us was Free wifi and good reception.

reviews.author: Sheila T
reviews.title: SKIP THIS RESORT....OLD & HORRIBLe
reviews.text:
Where do I start... I'm sad to write a bad review because I was so excited for this trip.  Came with a group of 6 families from east and west coast, and picked this resort based on tripadvisor reviews. And I still don't understand how it comes close to any good reviews

 1) Family concierge.... HORRIBLE.....They gave us the wrong colored bracelets which would show the staff that we have special services with family concierge. WE discovered this error 1.5 days later, how did the staff not realize that!!!  Not even an apology about it

2)NONE of the amenties were told to us... no offering of a tour to the hotel.... With family concierge we were supposed to get a bottle of liquor (we had to remind them), 550$ of credit for resort (THIS IS CRAP... was a whole bunch of coupons worth 550$) 
Our family concierge was supposed to provide each family with a phone that connected with our butler.... they gave us one phone for 3 families that were in 3 different rooms/buildings. Asked him to get my family one the next day..... never happened.

3)Smell of incenses all over the hotel is so overpowering.... I wonder what smell they are hiding???

4)Rooms... Pyramid 1 was quite and relaxing, close to the pools but far from buffet.  Don't stay in pyramid 3 unless you want your room to sound like the club, I kept thinking our door is open!

5) WIFI service was iffy... had to call 4 times to get someone to come fix it 

6)Food.....I've staying in resorts in Mexico many times with no problems.  Buffet was overwhelming with amount of food, but very little quality food.  Soggy churros, really?  Dinner food was the only thing I looked forward to. My 10 mo baby got vomiting from the food one day  & we all had diarrhea from time to time

7)Pool/Beach.... Beach was fabulous.  Clean, beautiful, easy access.  The main pool was so deep that I couldn't even stand in it???  WTH??  I'm not a short person but I had to tred water the whole time.  With family concierge, they were supposed to come by the pool with fruit/wet towels... etc We got that ONE day out of 6 days!!! ONE!!! We were by the pool the whole day

reviews.author: Vera B
reviews.title: Nice hotel, but would try another hotel
reviews.text: The hotel is nice. I would have preferred for them to have entertainment at night for adults. Also, the food gets a little boring, I would have night themes for dinner. I was there 6 days, same food ah

reviews.author: Dee Z
reviews.title: Great time at the Paradisus with family and friends.
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time at the Paradisus.  We did enjoy the food and ate at most the restaurants and enjoyed them, remember the pace is different here, so it will take a while.  We ended up eating at the buffet a lot especially for breakfast, great meeting place.  We had 11 people.  The people here are wonderful and took great care of us.  We spent a ton of time at the swimup bar.  Only thing at that pool it is 5 foot.  I am little so unless I was close to the bar I was underwater.  LOL  One thing I would change is I would but a foot ledge all around the pool so you could at least stand on the edge with out being underwater (me and children LOL).  Thankfully you could use floats and I did enjoy that. The staff at the pool were again. Terrific and fun to watch with lots of games.  They went out of their way to involve everyone.  Thanks for the great Hospitality!!

reviews.author: סיון ג

reviews.text:
Most recommended!!!
We reserved the all inclusive package and it was worth every penny

The resort is amazing, staff is friendly and welcoming.
Everyone are so nice and smiling all day.
