reviews.author: Maggiecourt C
reviews.title: Best Holiday Ever Ian & Maggie from UK England
reviews.text:
Returned from this amazing  hotel Paradisus Resort Cancun, on Sunday 4th Oct this was a special holiday booked for our 50th Wedding Anniversary which we celebrated on the 2nd Oct.
On our arrival in the main Reception it was breath taking couldn't believe what we were walking into.
Our room was overlooking the ocean it was perfect in every way, the room itself was extremely large and very well furnished..
The care of all the staff was exceptional nothing was too much trouble.
The food was excellent so much choice, we used Naos Restraurant for meals one particular member of staff was Christina who always greeted us with a lovely warm welcome. The waiters also excellent and very attentive. We would certainly like to return to the Paradisus again.

reviews.author: A_G_Pennypacker
reviews.title: Our honest experience at Paradisus
reviews.text:
My family (myself, wife, daughter 3.5, son 1.5) stayed at the Paradisus cancun for 2 weeks in September.  Staying for such a long period of time gave us an opportunity to try all the food outlets and get to know the staff quite well, and gave us a true feel for this resort.  
I will mention that we have been to Mexico several times, staying in all inclusives in Cabo, PV, and all over Riviera Nayarit.  
I'll start with the bad. Both of our children got sick on separate occasions during our stay. We can't say for sure what it was- food/ virus etc but they were throwing up and had diarrhea for a significant chunk of time.  As a parent, this is the kind of thing that I look for on Trip Advisor reviews, and it alters my decision on where to stay.  My wife and I understand that this is a part of staying in a foreign country for a significant amount of time, but it definitely put a bit of a dampener on part of the vacation.  I won't let that dominate my review of Paradisus, so on to the rest.
Food was very good.  We found ourselves eating at the buffet most of the time and it was impressive!  We loved eating dinner at the buffet, they change the theme every night so it never got repetitive for us, and the quality and assortment of food was outstanding.  We went to all the restaurants on the property (except Tempo & Mole) and found them to be very good.  Bana was probably our favourite restaurant, the setting is amazing and the sushi was quite good for an AI resort in Mexico.
Room service was not good.  We ordered several times and were amazed at how much worse the food was than the rest of the resort.  We ordered nachos and were presented with a soup bowl of chips with carrots, beans and a massive amount of liquid cheese.  These were the worst nachos that my wife and I have ever seen (I included a picture).  Also of note was the processed cheese found in our omelette.  I'm not trying to be a pain in the a#@ but at a higher end 5 star resort this was not impressive.    
Our room was average.  We booked a jr suite ocean view, and were placed on the 5th floor between tower 2 and 3 (very good location, not loud at night and high enough to have a great view of the pools and Caribbean). Our room was long and narrow, which we expected due to the architecture, there were 2 chairs with a round table, and a larger sofa chair with a coffee table.  The balcony had 2 lounge chairs and a small metal table which we used plenty.  One side note about the balcony which was a disappointment, is that the light is on an automatic timer and went off at 10pm every night.  This was disappointing because we like to sit outside and play cards while having a cocktail at night, but had to move inside at 10 due to lack of light.  Compared to rooms at Dreams resorts or Riu Palace, our room at the Paradisus was small and outdated.  We had requested a crib and pull out couch twice before we got there, but neither were in our room when we arrived.  They sent a crib up within 90 minutes and a cot followed not long after that. 
The staff were amazing!  Thank you to all the staff that worked while we were visiting, you were all incredible.  Special thanks to Flor, Sergio and Laura on the beach, you went above and beyond and really provided exceptional service to our family, it was so greatly appreciated.  We are very generous when it comes to tipping, and the staff here deserve it.  Our chamber maid was incredible, our room was always cleaned and stocked without us needing to request for it to be done.  We donated some childrens items to our chambermaid the day that we were leaving to show our appreciation for the service she provided us.  Remember these employees work 6 days a week and long hours for very little pay, show your appreciation!  Also worth mentioning is the entertainment staff.  This was without a doubt the most impressive resort entertainment we have ever seen.  These employees were so talented and worked so hard every night to entertain the guests, they should have had a tipping option for the entertainment crew.  I will try to post a video of one of the shows, they truly were incredible.  
The beach was great, seaweed wasn't much of an issue, it was only really bad 2 or 3 days out of 14.  
I hope this helps other families who may be shopping around for the right resort.

reviews.author: Carlos B
reviews.title: Great hospitality
reviews.text: Our experience at the paradisus resort in punta Cana was awesome.  The workers made our stay fabulous.  The pool bar waiters were the best.  They were very attentive and respectful and very professional.  Juan Cruz, argenis de Los santos and Denny Acosta, ay yah yah, Jessie rejos, Luis parra, santos polanco.  These working from the swimming pool bar were the best.  The snack bar and their service was spectacular.  They made us so comfortable so we will defenity come back again.  My fiancé and I will definetly come back again!

reviews.author: Sara V
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
The hotel staff was top notch.  Watch out for the Club Melia people who will try to get you to sign up for a time share presentation.  The will get you right at check-in by asking if you have been to the resort before.  If your reservation states that transportation is provided...do not believe it.

The room we reserved was not ready at 1500 as promised and we were put in a room with two double beds our first night.  No one offered this information and no one offered a pro-rate for the difference of the room.  
The entire hotel leaked like crazy when it rained literally water running down the walls.  The poor staff were constantly mopping, etc.  Our room flooded under the balcony door one night and created a puddle that took four very large beach towels to soak up.
Food was hit or miss.  The best was Market Street and Mole.  Cell phone was stolen at buffet NAOS.
Beach and pools were awesome.  Staff was the best.  I'm not sure if I would stay here again.

reviews.author: kimberlyk51
reviews.title: Great getaway!
reviews.text:
I stayed in Paradisus Cancun this past May with my fiancé and another couple.  Overall we had a great experience and time at Paradisus.  Food and drinks were great! There is a variety of restaurants to choose from and every one we went to over our 5 nights was enjoyable.

We had an AMAZING experience on the beach thanks to the server Luis.  He was extremely attentive, kind and always had a smile on. He would have drinks and water waiting for us every day before we even asked !  He even would walk the drinks down to the ocean for us when we were swimming. We really appreciated what a great server he was to us!
Antonio the waiter at the breakfast buffet was also very friendly and great to us!

The only negative experience we had was at the restaurant Mole on our first night there.  The reservation was accidentally made for two, instead of four.  When we explained to the hostess that there was 4 of us to eat she glared at us and was giving us the impression that this would be an issue, even though the restaurant was no where near crowded.  She reluctantly seated us then she proceeded to hand the 4 of us 2 menus and said she didn't have any more and we had to share. Our much kinder waiter came over not even a minute later then when we were seated and grabbed us two more menus from behind the hostess station where she stated she was out of menus. 
Other than that experience we were very happy with our stay !

reviews.title: Awesome Trip
reviews.text:

My husband and I went together and we stayed an extra few days. It was very romantic and relaxing.  We would recommend this resort to anyone that wants a wonderful, relaxing vacation.

reviews.author: charidd2015
reviews.title: Absolutely perfect
reviews.text: The hotel staff took every measure possible to make sure that we were comfortable and enjoyed our stay.  I would defitely come back to Paradissus. Our first Cancun visit was amazing because of Paradissus!

reviews.author: Rayf1973
reviews.title: INCREDIBLE
reviews.text: Amazing!!!!! Butler service impeccable. Rodrigo an absolute gem. Haven't traveled in 20 years and we will absolutely be back next year. Every detail absolutely attended to.  First class experience from start to finish.

reviews.author: Lorenzo C
reviews.title: Worth the Travel
reviews.text: I usually don't take the time to rate hotels or resorts, however, I was not passing this one by.  Simply put; the service and amenities are top notch.  This is the cleanest hotel I've stayed at: there have been over 50 in my short life time.  Worth the money and time...will book again.

reviews.author: Rodica G
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, best service ever!
reviews.text: Wonderful inside arquitecture, we've never seen seen a jungle inside a building, great!! Harmonious, silent and relaxing atmosphere. The service is excellent! Wonderful restaurants like "Vento", with quick and professional service José and his team, among them Karla and Emmanuel. Excellent service in the little café bar in the Royal Service especially with Valeria, always professionel and friendly. Very friendly recepcionists Leticia, María and Roxana. We will always recomend this hotel!

reviews.author: Kj G
reviews.title: Not what i was hoping for
reviews.text: My wife and i travel to Cancun once a year , this was our first time in this resort . Upon arrival we were informed that due to some maintenance work we may experience some power outrages during our stay , of course we figure it was not a big deal after all this is the slow season in Cancun and lots of resorts take advantage of this to catch up with some stuff that need to be done .We stayed for a week and during this time every single day was a problem with the electric , and i  am not talking about just for an hour or two it will be the whole day and at time during the night as well witch it can really get to you if you are under the sun all day and at night you want to have a good night sleep but there's no AC ! . Also when you think of a tropical vacation you can imagine yourself on a beautiful beach sipping pina coladas , but not here the fact that most of the time there was not electricity  means no frozen drinks at all ,witch will leave you with the option or beer ( that will get warm after a few minutes ) or another mix drink with a hard liquor in it ( not a good idea for a refresh drink unless you are an alcoholic or a college kid who likes to drink to the point of blacking out just because is the cool thing to do ). I can't really say nothing  about the staff  ( this is not a compliment ) you see , through the years we stayed in different all inclusive resorts in Mexico and always after a few days we got to know some of the staff members just because we  frequent the same areas and you always remember  them because they made your stay a bit more personal , but not here i wont go as far as saying that they were rude but there was nobody going out their way for you . Food was not to bad but repetitive , unfortunately some restaurant were not available  when we were ready to try them . The place was fairly clean in the general areas it was only one day that actually for not a reason at all our room was not clean and we had to  call them to do so ( not to be picky but if i am out at the beach the whole day i like to comeback to a clean towel , a bed made and garbage taking out ) .All in all ,in all my years visiting this was the worse experience i had , maybe for some first timer this is a great place all i can say is get out there and try different things but the same price you will find other resorts near by that run circles around this place . I know now that my next visit will not be to this resort , in fact even i talked to the manager on site about some of this issues and he offered me a free stay witch i refused because i have no intentions to set foot in this place ever again .

reviews.author: Ron G
reviews.title: Beautiful and great resort!
reviews.text: We booked a short 4 day vacations for 2 adults and our 3 year old son.The place is very clean and the service is amazing ,they make any other place look like a disaster if you compare.they help you with everything to make your stay smooth, fun and  amazing.the food is very good and  the variety of restaurants and type of food can please the most demanding taste.the pools are very clean and the service around them is good too.the ocean side is beautiful and  very well maintained.they have activities and areas for the little ones and they hotel is perfectly designed for people with limited mobility as well as kids with strollers ...have nothing to criticize about it. their constant fight to keep the place shiny as a jewel is amazing  ..always people painting ,cleaning and polishing glass walls.timeshare talk it's not a problem for me since I know how to get rid of them , anyways lovely people too and not aggressive in any sense

reviews.author: Michael C
reviews.title: Excellent Place
reviews.text: This place is beautiful, the lobby is amazing and the rooms are great. Service is very good. the food is also really good, top shelf liquor available and the bartenders are great. Jesus the waiter at the pool took great care of us.  One of the few issues with this place is the dinner situation. You need to make reservations 24hrs in advance at most of the restaurants and that can get annoying. So if you happen to go out on a excursion or out on the town and forget to call 24hrs in advance then you are S.O.L and have to eat at the buffet (not that eating at the buffet is a bad thing) but due to the whole reservation thing, we didn't get a chance to try most of the restaurants. The also do not take walk ins at the restaurants.  Also WATCH YOUR STEPS walking around the property, plenty of small steps and tripping hazards, very dangerous specially after drinking a few adult cocktails.  Other than that excellent place.

reviews.author: Thanh N
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel and great food
reviews.text:
The jr suit lagoon view was beautiful great for our family of 4.  The resort was so beautiful, the best we'd ever stayed.  We loved Friday seafood buffet at Naos restaurant.  They had lobsters, jumbo shrimp, huge king crab, scallop, and more.  They served cold, but if you bring to the cook at the grill, they'll grill it for you.  Servers were excellent.  We met an excellent waiter, Cesar Prado, at Naos buffet who gave us the best service.  We had great time at the resort.  Thanks to Cheap Caribbean for suggesting
order room service 1 hr before checking out. 

noon for lunch and bring ziplock to go.  Will definitely come back and highly recommend this resort.t it wasuseless.  Resort credit is more like coupon.  You can not combine, for example they give you 2 x $15 bali bed resort credit, you can only use $15 for each bali bed booking of $50/day.  So you end up paying $35+. reviews.author: Harold H
reviews.title: A visit to Cancun
reviews.text:
The hotel was beautiful, clean and easily accessable.  The staff was very friendly, eager to help, courteous and thoughtful.
The food was excellent, service excellent.   The rooms were spacious and well maintained.   I would definately stay again.

reviews.author: zapryan g
reviews.title: Paradise in Paradisus
reviews.text: The hotel and the stuff that works there is fantastic. I am very impressed by one of the servers at the breakfast bar Gaudencio. He was wonderful and made our stay amazing. He is a great example of outstanding customer service.

reviews.author: SeniorSkiier
reviews.title: Something Rotten in Paradise
reviews.text:
First, let me mention the positive points of our extended-family vacation at Paradisus. The hotel is beautiful, our rooms were clean and comfortable (one family said their room was too hot). The food was very good. We ate in just about all the restaurants. My personal favorites were Bana (Asian fusion menu) and Fuego (Latin). And, overall, the staff were very accommodating.
On the flip side, though, was an incident that occurred at the pool outside the Market Grill, early on in our stay . A hotel service worker came to the pool, stood and looked at the pool for awhile and then went away. After a while, this worker returned, together with another service worker who had a pool skimmer. Only then did we look around to see that there was feces floating close to where our group was in the pool. We immediately got out of the pool and told others to do the same. The feces was removed from the pool; and, the original worker threw two handfuls of pellets into the pool. The worker never told us there was feces in the pool, didn't tell anyone to get out of the pool before or after removing the feces, or take water samples after throwing pellets into the pool. 
The incident bothered me so, that the next day I requested to talk to someone from management. I spoke with a front desk manager. I was told that he would review the CCTV video from the day before to identify the employees; and, that they would be interviewed. I was assured by this manager that he would contact me after the review was conducted. 
Needless to say, no one ever contacted me. I was told by another worker that a report was sent to upper management. I sincerely doubt that that happened. For this reason, I cannot give Paradisus an overall favorable review.
A final negative comment concerns the registration process. It was arduous. All of our group had booked lagoon view junior suite rooms. First, I was offered to upgrade to royal service. When I asked how much, I was told it would be $120/day. When I said no to that, I was immediately quoted a $90/day offer. When I said no again, I was asked about an upgrade to an ocean view junior suite at $60/day. I was told that the upgrade couldn't take place until the next day. I initially said yes. The next day I realized it was too much of a hassle to change rooms, so I cancelled the upgrade. 
Since we came home, I've checked the prices at Paradisus numerous times; and, have never seen the difference in room rates to be as large as I was quoted at registration. So, decide what kind of room, and how much you're willing to spend for a room, before you book.

reviews.author: suzette h
reviews.title: Bana Restaurant
reviews.text: Celebrated my bday 9/29/2015 @ the Bana restaurant ,Erik our waiter did an outstanding job ,serving us.The food selections were delightful ,I tried varieties of sushi & calamari for the 1st time.Best restaurant at the Paradisus Resort.👍🏼👌🏼

reviews.author: samuelcharlesw
reviews.title: 1st holiday.
reviews.text: Great overall. Just need more variety for food maybe. Our butler was great. I lost my expensive sunglasses and although we never found then 3 of the staff dove in the ocean for 2 hours searching for them that really impressed me.

reviews.author: Heidi B
reviews.title: Wonderful time, great service and good food
reviews.text:
We recently spent a week at the Paradisus Cancun and had a wonderful experience.  The staff was courteous and polite.  The room was well appointed and the bed was comfortable.  
I have to say that we took full advantage of the all inclusive and enjoyed wonderful food and drinks at all hours of the day and into the night.
We had the same service staff four mornings at breakfast and the second time we had them they remembered our beverage order from the day before and brought it to us without us needing to ask.  Jose Luis Caro, Jorge and David were their names and for someone who is grumpy without her morning coffee they made my mornings.  
We will definitely be staying there again.

reviews.author: Johnny H
reviews.title: My 50th Birthday Celebration
reviews.text: The hotel was so nice and lots of restaurants, the Private restaurant (Michelin star chef) was perfect for my Birthday party!  Our butler was amazing (request hime, Hervik) and our pool waiters Francisco MIcheal and Francisco Terrazas were never far away with non-stop attention everyday we were there (7 days).  The stay was so nice we are thinking about taking a quick weekend trip in the coming 6 months.

reviews.author: Raquel J
reviews.title: Awesome vaction spot to go with friends!
reviews.text: I traveled to Paradisus Cancun a few days ago for a 6 day trip with a group of six couples.  The trip was awesome!  The Paradisus was very welcoming and very helpful in every way.  The Royal Service is the way to go.  It's a little extra but worth it because you get put in an adult only tower which is great for a little quiet in the evenings and there is a private breakfast/ happy hour area.  The bali beds by the Royal Service pool had great waiters. The food on the resort was great and better than expected. The Blue Agave taco restaurant was the best!   Ivan was our butler we were given as part of the Royal Service.  Ivan did a great job!  He even put candies, champagne and chocolate in our rooms :)  I had the best massage at the spa.  It was sooo relaxing.  The hotel was also very clean and waitstaff did a great job at picking everything up quickly. I would definitely go back to the Paradisus!!!!

reviews.author: Tylers D
reviews.title: Royal Service is a dream!
reviews.text:
The overall grade of the hotel is 5*, even though TripAdvisor shows only four!

Me and my wife stayed at the Royal Service pyramid #5 with a wonderful sea view deluxe suit. The staff is friendly and attentive. We had two birthdays and a wedding anniversary to celebrate during our stay. Three days in a row! :) we have got attention to all of these dates and received pleasant surprises for each day!

I would like to mention three people that made our stay especially pleasant:

1. Leticia Patlan Roses (concierge service) for helping me arrange flowers delivery for my wife's birthday 

2. Eric Cordova (butler service) for making pleasant surprises in our room like bottles of sparkling wine, rose-petals on the bed, aromatic pillows and etc. 

3. Omar Hidalgo (pool concierge service) for being attentive to our needs and for a wonderful surprise in our bali -- cake for our anniversary!!!

We are still staying in the hotel at the moment and don't want to leave it! Service, ocean and weather are so fantastic!!!!!

Thank you guys!!!

reviews.author: joanneb102
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
We visited Paradisus Cancun in October 2014 for our 20th anniversary. It was an incredible stay. We chose the Royal Service package which includes butler service, an all adult area of the hotel plus an all adult pool and beach area. It also includes suntan lotion and oil and a buffet all day.  You can also reserve a Bali bed by the pool for free.  The service was so outstanding. Especially Eddie at the pool. The beach was so nice. It was huge. There was free food and drink service at the pool and on the beach. All of the restaurants were wonderful. The only one that was extra was Tempo. It is VERY expensive. However, that being said, the food is top notch. It was worth it four the night of our anniversary.   The resort is 15-20 minutes from the airport and a short bus ride to the malls. 

The only reason we gave this resort four stars is because we experienced a lot of leaks during our stay due to th rain. And the hydrotherapy pool is really old and could use an overhaul.

reviews.author: Eriks S
reviews.title: 12 days in Paradisus, excellent all-inclusive resort, great staff.
reviews.text:
Have been in many similar resorts in Europe, Turkey and Egypt and have to say this is the best experience ever.
Location: Hotel is located right by the ocean. If I am right then about 8 km from the hotel zone centre where all that wild nightlife (Coco Bongo etc) takes place.
Hotel: 5 pyramids we stayed in the 5th where Royal Service guests are placed. This property has been opened more than 20 years ago and of course some renovation has to be done but still it looks gorgeous all the lobbies, bars are beautiful. Some guests complained that hotel lobby is not conditioned well. There is some truth but hotel is designed so it even can't be air conditioned. Higher temperature is price for huge central lobby where restaurants and bars are located like in the jungle  (lots of greens, palms) on the ground floor, on the top you have huge roof made of glass. Beautiful decorations! Swimming pool area layout is superb. Territory is huge and it's planned in very excellent way. Almost from every place you see ocean. Swimming pool flows along all hotel territory, very clean and well maintained.
Rooms: We stayed in Ocean View Junior Suite. Have already said hotel and rooms need some renovation, furniture is outdated..... but room was large, everything worked well, the bed was comfortable. One of the days we had some issues with air conditioner. Called to reception and in couple of hours when came back from dinner it worked. Smooth service. In fact we don't worry much about rooms when we go to the beach resorts. We spend just nights in the room and if we have such breathtaking ocean view and sound of ocean as we had I don't care much about some scratches on the furniture and loose hinges of closet.
Staff: Outstanding people working there. We had been met like royalties smiling lady opened the door and greeted us. Check in process was unbelievable smooth after 21 hours in planes and airports it's nice that there is no rush no worries you just sit having some sparkling wine and then you are escorted to your room. Everyone of the staff is kind, smiling, friendly, helpful and attentive.
Special thanks to our butler Juan. Honestly we didn't disturb him much though he every day came to us and asked how we feel, how we are doing, any help assistance needed. We loved to chat with him about Mexico history about Mayas culture. He also prepared couple of surprises in the room: nicely decorated table on the balcony with bottle of wine, bath with rose petals and after bed all in roses. I guess that butler can help much during high season with restaurant reservations. We also like to say hello to Juan from restaurant Fuego. He didn't bring only food he made a good show and nice presentation of dishes we have ordered. Many thanks to Omar, pool concierge, every morning he met us with a smile, little chat and bali bed reservation process always went smoothly.
Food & Drinks: We have stayed in more expensive hotels in Turkey and Greece. It's not even comparable. Viva La Mexico! If I am correct there are 11 (all inclusive) a la carte restaurants. The food was excellent. Our Top 3 - Fuego (Latinos) Vento (Mediterranean) and Bana (Asia). The lunch all 9 days (3 days we spent for excursions) we had in "La Palapa" specially for Royal Service guests. Drinks? Only premium drinks. You won't  find Mexican cognac, Mexican vodka, Mexican Baileys. Those who has been in Turkey know I am talking about. Cognac - Martell, vodka - Absolut and Belvedere, 15 years Ron, Chivas Regal, Spanish and Chilean wines. We tried the best Margaritas ever. The guys in the bar really knows their work.
Royal Sevice: We would suggest pay more and have Royal Service. Especially during high season when restaurants get booked out early mornings. Butler will help with the reservations. Royal Service is adults only thus atmosphere is more quiet. There is also RS only restaurant La Palapa for the breakfast and lunch. Ocean view breakfasts at 8:00 am were breathtaking and very romantic as sometimes just two of us were sitting there (not many woke up so early), fresh wind from the ocean before heat of the day and what a VIEW!!!! colours of the water white, blue, green, perfect white sand.... We loved it!!!
Weather: We were worried about weather conditions while checking forecasts (Accuweather, Intellicast etc). Raining everyday? We had 1.5 day cloudy and rainy of 12. In fact we had lots of sunshine and warmth though October is one of the most rainy months if to check averages.
Tipping: We were tipping guys in the bars, restaurants and they really deserves that. They are doing hard work for us so we can feel like..... like kings and we really felt absolutely pampered.
Excursions: We visited Chichen Itza, Tulum, Xcaret, XelHa. All those places are worth to visit. Probably Xcaret and XelHa are similar thus you can choose one of those. When you go to archaeological sites take lots of water with you and don't drink too much all inclusive cocktails. Were partying in hotel's nightclub before Chichen itza...... if I had time machine I wouldn't have had those last 3 margaritas.
WiFi: Very good connection in the room. Every day had Skype calls to home with our 12 years old daughter, good quality. Wifi also worked by swimming pool, were able to do Skype calls but right place had to be find. We had WiFi on all inclusive basis. Don't know if it's included if you are not at Royal Service.
Conclusion: Thanks to all kind people who made our stay wonderful in Paradisus Cancun. 100% recommendations to choose this lovely place.

reviews.author: Kenya S
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text:
My wife and I tried the Cocos beach club and it was amazing.. The signature drinks are explosive... Thank you Jorge for letting us try them out... 

Yes we're coming back!!

We were upgraded to the "Royal Service" which was awesome.

Kenia & Jose.

reviews.author: Dane P
reviews.title: Amazing and unique
reviews.text:
We had a hard time picking an all-inclusive resort in Cancun, because there are so many highly-rated options, but in hindsight we are really happy that we chose Paradisus.

The highlights of this resort are the ambience, facilities, and service. The atrium is one-of-a-kind, and the architecture fits into the local environment a lot better than some of the nearby cookie-cutter resorts. The pool area is huge, with plenty of options for lounging  (at various price points- see below). And from the moment you walk through the front door, the staff provide personal attention.

Some of the weaker aspects are the food and noise level. There's nothing in particular wrong with the food- there's a variety of options to choose from, and it's all decent. But after just 4 days, I was pretty tired of. It would have been nice to have some lighter options, and to have a little more flavor.

For vegetarians- of the 6 inclusive restaurants at Paradisus, 4 offer decent vegetarian options (not sure about vegan).

The resort seems to draw a younger and more lively crowd, and can get pretty noisy. If you want some peace and quiet, try to get a room on the higher floors or outside of the main tower. When you go to the pool area, reserve a Bali Bed away from the DJ and poolside bar, or sign up for Royal Service and use the private pool area.

Speaking of which- getting a Bali Bed is DEFINITELY worth the money. You should do it for at least one day if you plan on spending a decent amount of time poolside and want some shade/relaxation.

All in all, we had an amazing experience at this hotel and will definitely return in the future.

reviews.author: Debbie R
reviews.title: We had prescription glasses stolen!
reviews.text:
We stayed for 6 days on October 2014. Hotel was nice, clean, food quality was the best part. However, we had a bad incident which in my opinion was not handled properly. While at the pool restroom, we placed my 10 year old daughter's $300 prescription glasses next to the sink while she changed her clothes in the stall next to it. Guests, employees came in and out within the 10 minutes we were there to find that when we were about to leave the glasses were gone! We turned the bathroom upside down and employees just seemed to make fun of us. I finally contacted the security director who said: we'll let you know if they show up. Seriously? My daughter needs them to see! can you check closely? guests? employees? security cameras? nothing. I asked for the manager to only gethe runaround. 
We were planning on another stay in 2015 but THERE IS NO WAY we will come back to this place. No customer service.

reviews.author: Marie M
reviews.title: Gorgeous Views and amazing service
reviews.text: I stayed at the Paradisus Cancun for 6 days in October 2014. The resort is absolutely gorgeous the views from my room were amazing. From the moment we arrived we were greeted with smiles from  the staff . They are so friendly and attentive, they make sure all your needs are met plus some. The food was good a variety of choices, the buffet is decent but the food tends to get cold. My favorite restaurant was Fuego the food was delicious, the best drinks can be found at Aguave's the margaritas are to die for. We loved all the staff everyone was so kind and went out of their way to accommodate us. One staff member stood out above all others to us, she was so awesome and good to us she made us feel so welcome and took care of all of all requests. So please visit Karina Reyes Ochoa at the Avenue Bar she is fantastic she went above and beyond her job for us. Thank you Karina for making my birthday so special....

reviews.author: none35
reviews.title: Excellent ambiance with a highly responsive staff, great restaurants and central location.
reviews.text: I have been staying at this hotel, which was previously called Grand Melia, every year since 2008. I absolutely love the staff, particularly Lolita. I told them ahead of time that I'd be at the Paradius in September 2014!to celebrate my wedding anniversary and they had my bed decorated with rose petals  and left a bottle of Champagne in the living room. With such royal treatment, I can't help but go back again and again.

reviews.author: Shelly G
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: This trip with my girlfriends was absolutely fabulous. The staff was very accommodating, facilities very nice, food tasted great and had a wide variety, entertainment was wonderful. I couldn't have asked for a better place!

reviews.author: Juliefleis
reviews.title: Royal Service!  The only way to travel!
reviews.text:
What an amazing week!  Such a beautiful resort, and we selected the Royal Service option for our stay since we were traveling sans kids.  What a great choice!  Located in building/pyramid 5 the private area we stayed in was everything we could want and much that we didn't think to ask about!   Get an ocean view room, worth the extra!  Built like a pyramid, the rooms on the lower floors are much bigger than those above.  The all inclusive eating and drinks was fun, our first experience with this.  Yummy Pina Coladas and Blue Hawaiians for me, Oho Rojo's for the hubby.   Plenty of seafood to enjoy, grouper, scallops, mussles, etc...   The meats were kinda tough but that was okay for us, we prefer the fresh seafood anyway.   

Celebrated our Anniversary last week.  Our butler, yes I said butler, took care of everything we needed.  Thanks Ivan!  From dinner reservations, booking cabana beds by the water to making our room special for our anniversary he was the best!  They give you a handy cell phone so you can reach your butler any time you need him.  We had several days of rain but still had a great time, the spa was wonderful we had a great couples massage, very relaxing. 

Had our fancy dinner at Tempo, costs extra, but well worth it!  Reviewed that separately.

Food was good, ambiance the best!

reviews.author: Bravo2013
reviews.title: Amazing Stay
reviews.text:
If you have stayed here and hooted for Royal service, you would have to try hard to have a bad time.  2nd stay here and can't say enough positive things about the staff.  The minute you walk into the hotel you are taken to the private check-in, where you are offered champagne.  Mayte and Natalia at Royal service concierge are fabulous.  Because we were repeat guests and it was slow season, we were upgraded to a 1 bedroom suite.  Our room wasn't ready until 3 pm and I wanted to change clothes so they provided a "hospitality suite" for our use until check in.  Our butler Hervik moved our things to our other room as soon as it was ready and stocked the fridge with our favorite drinks and left a platter of fresh fruit.  We reserved a Bali bed at the pool for each day and our waiter Francisco took care of everything.  Our favorite restaurant is Blue Agave--great taqueria and they were happy to make me a vegetarian meal.  Great margaritas!  We also love the sushi spot, Bana.  I was shocked to find such fresh sushi at an all-inclusive.  The hotel is immaculate and the staff work hard--tip them well!
I have stayed at at least 10 other all- inclusives in Mexico, and Paradisus is the hands-down winner.  We will return again and again and so appreciate the warm, professional service.  Thank you Hervik and all the other staff who made our trip memorable!

reviews.author: Hanna S
reviews.title: Great short break in Cancun
reviews.text:
We are time share owners and were pleasantly surprised by the upgrades and changes to the former melia cancun. Our suite was beautiful and includes lots of amenities , even a nespresso maker in the room. The breakfast buffet restaurant was fantastic and our server Carlos Cadena went out of his way to make sure every morning was perfect.
Our only complaint is the fitness room which has not been upgraded in a long time. It's still functional, but dark and needs new equipment. Also, why no yoga classes?
Anyway-- it's a great place, in a great place. Good location, service, rooms and amenities. We look forward to our next visit.

reviews.author: Janna A
reviews.title: Great place to stay!
reviews.text: I was so impressed with hotel and the staff were very friendly and helpful! Everyone who worked there were very customer oriented. The hotel was so clean and spacious and the view of the ocean from our room was beautiful. The buffet at Naos was so delicious and the hours the bufget was very convenient! The only issue I had was the wifi signal was rather weak from our room. Streaming videos on iPAD or iPhone was a hit or miss and it was usually a miss. Same goes with the internet. I would most definitely return to this hotel!! :)

reviews.author: dallawayfamily
reviews.title: Best place to go in punta cana
reviews.text:
We had remarkable service at the pool bar and on the beach from Ramon Fulgo &
& Francisco cabrera & nelson crema.

The kids have had a great time. And the staff have been wonderful with them. 

The food is great... I love the buffet selections especially for breakfast

reviews.author: Gemma
reviews.title: Nice hotel...but our room flooded!!
reviews.text:
I visited the hotel with my boyfriend in October for 8 nights. First impressions...hotel looks impressive as driving up, nice lobby/check in area. Check in was very smooth and quick as we arrived at 11pm on the evening. Bell boy brought our luggage up swifty. The next morning we had card posted through the door, saying a lady called Rose had missed us on check in and she had a 'free gift' for us and that we were to go and see her. I think this was a timeshare ploy so we just ignored it.

Room: We opted for deluxe lagoon view. We were located in room 3625 - main building, 6th floor. Room was fine, nice comfy bed. We had to sleep with our air-con on every night to drown out the sound from Red Lounge blasting its music out until 2am. Maid visited daily to clean the room and also on an evening for turndown service. There was only 1 sun lounger on the balcony which was strange as it was a room for 2 people...it didnt matter to us as we didnt use the balcony during our stay. Bathroom was a good size, bath plug did not work - we had to stuff a flannel in the plug hole so we could have a soak. On our second to last day a huge storm hit, when we woke up the next morning the rooms floor was totally soaked everywhere, approx 0.5cm high. Our suitcases were soaking!! We caught the maid outside & she quickly cleaned the water up. We heard that it happened to alot of room around the resort. Surely if its a place prone to heavy rainfall they would have better seals on the balcony doors?!

Resturants: In my opinion, there was plenty of choice for everyones taste. Only place open for breakfast & lunch was Naos - an international buffet style resurant, lots of different food choices. Only complaint about this is sometimes dishes would be on the cold side. Our favourate resturant was Bana - a japanese sushi resturant. We ate here twice during our trip. Beautiful surroundings and great food!! On our 1st visit we found our waiter very obliging (think he was called Leo), he explained everything to us. On the second visit we had a different waiter and service was very sloppy, although he only had 3 tables to wait on!! We also ate at Feugo - a Peruvian themed resturant. Service and food were very good. Vento - a tapas resturant. Again, food and service was A+.   Blue Agave - a taco cantina. We chose to eat here before a night out downtown as we didnt want anything too heavy. Good food & service too. The worst resturant we visited was Market Grill. We got sat down and had counters placed on our table - one side green, the other red. We guessed it was similar to a resturant we know in the UK. No-one explained the concept to us. We had to ask one of the waiters for drinks after we had been sat 10mins without anyone noticing us. The waiters then came round with meats, salads, potatoes and veg (approx 5 mins apart for each other). The concept of the resturant is good but it just did not work when we visited. We constantly had an empty plate and was thinking of leaving and going to another resturant. We ate at Mole on our last night - Mexican resturant. Service was fantastic and food was really good too.

Bars: We used the pool bar during the day...Christian, Julian & Efrain were great fun and always ready to make up great tasting cocktails. We used Avenue Bar & Toji Bar on an evening...no complaints, bar staff very polite and accomadating. We didnt use Red Lounge during our stay - it was booming with loud music until 2am every night though.

Pool area: Good sized pool areas. Plenty of sun loungers - make sure youre down before 10ish if you want a lounger with a parasol. People tended to 'claim' sun loungers with their towels before heading for breakfast. Activities were a bit hit & miss. My boyfriend wanted to participate in beach soccer & volleyball...some days they would play as advertised, others they wouldnt play at all. On the 1st day we went to get a towel & the guy asked for towel cards...these were not given to us at check in. It wasnt a problem, he asked for our room number & gave us the towels. Upon return, he gave us 2 towel cards. 

Beach: Lovely beach, no problem getting a sun lounger with a parasol. Waiters on the beach very fast, always asking if you would like more drinks. 

Overall, Paradisus is a nice hotel. Many lovely staff whom are ready to help you. There was just a few issues which had let us down. Next time we return to Cancun i will be trying a different hotel.

reviews.author: Chel1304
reviews.title: A little luxury
reviews.text: Great location, easy from airport & amazing selection of restaurants for every taste. You need to get up early to reserve a sunbed with a umbrella, but we loved it & can't wait to go back. Next time we want to visit more the area has to offer.

reviews.author: Kelly R
reviews.title: Was expecting more
reviews.text:
I really wanted to love this hotel & the Royal Service upgrade which we opted for but I did leave feeling ready to go! We booked our package with Virgin & decided on this hotel purely for the Royal Service, we wanted to feel like everything would be taken care of...sadly it took a complaint to senior management to get the service we expected. 

Firstly upon arrival to the hotel after a 10hr flight from Gatwick we had to wait in reception for 20 mins for our butler & that was after reminding them twice we were there....we were assigned Erick who took us to our room via Royal Service check in, we asked for a mobile so we could contact Erick for anything during our stay. We decided to call Erick on day 2 to ask for details on the Spa & about a couple of other things, he didn't answer so we left a message asking him to call back...he didn't so we rang again & this time he answered & we asked that he could pop down to the pool to visit us...basically he told us to speak to the concierge down at the pool & that he would "pop" a price list for the spa in our room...not the personal touch we thought we would get.  We met a lovely couple around by the pool who were explains about their butler Hector & all the lovely personal touches he had been doing for them like run baths, champagne in the room, meal on the balcony, daily visits to them by the pool.  We suddenly felt short changed so approached management about how we felt & explained the previous phone call situation & the manager totally agreed that this wasn't acceptable....so we then ended up with two butlers! I have to say Hector pulled all the stops out & did make the effort to make our stay lovely & Erick apologised to us & did try & make amends for his lack of effort. 

The pool area was kept clean & if you tipped daily then you'd always get a great service from Javier or Octavier who were lovely. Drinks a plenty & snacks available, also breakfast in the RS area should you wish. 

We always used the buffet for breakfast which was fine & I'd say the food was the best thing about the stay, we tried all restaurants expect the Tempo & the sushi & all were nice, but I'd have to say you were never quite full after eating at any of them so maybe side orders of veg etc could be an option. 

Bali beds.....lovely option around the pool, we had reserved for our last three days, but were told that as new people were arriving we were basically being bumped off! This didn't go down well as you can imagine so a quick word with Hector sorted it, you shouldn't be made to feel that new people were more important- maybe a Bali bed per room would solve it! Clearly can't cater for all RS rooms in that case which is a shame.

The hotel itself is large & spread across 5 blocks, 3 is the restaurants & lobby & 5 is the RS so it always felt like a treck & I'm quite fit physically! One major disappointment for me was how dark the hotel was, literally people were using their phone tourches to read menus, not sure why it's so dark but it def needs to be lighter it made me feel so tired all the time. 

The Avenue Bar puts on a show each night, which is fine a bit of light entertainment by the same group of dancers, I will say the seating is strange as there are a lot of beds in the bar & pillars so the view can be restricted which would be easily solved with TV screens showing the show to those who can't see it. Lovely cocktails in that bar!

Rooms-we had a lagoon view which was fine but I've def stayed in better hotel rooms with out doubt, actually quite basic which surprised me. You got the usual safe, coffee machine, to etc but just felt it lacked that little extra, but I hear if you got an upgrade then your room was massive-seems a select few got this!

We did the Dolphin trip organised by the Virgin rep, was a good day & well worth it, the catamaran ride was good but take motion sickness tablets should you get sick as some poor chap couldn't cope.   

We went to Coco Bongos VIP service, def pay the extra for this or you'll be in the mosh pit & being VIP you get international drinks & a waiter, we got the bus there from outside the hotel the R1 or R2 it's 10 pesos each, each way & if you ask where to get the bus at the end of the night you'll be shown, takes about 15 mins. The show is good & although the same in places as it was a few years ago it has new sections. Give it a go!

Overall I probably wouldn't stay at this hotel again which makes me sad as I really looked forward to it, it just had a few to many things about it which disappointed me & my partner, but Mexico is good.

reviews.author: 1RJP
reviews.title: Make sure you eat at Vento
reviews.text:
The hotel has a number of restaurants all of which are good. Make sure that you visit Vento which is sensational. It is a tapas restaurant that looks quite ordinary from the outside but the food is amazing, We had a wide selection of dishes bit the medallions of beef, the cheese and fruit salad and the duck were divine.

Make sure that Victor serves you as he is a great host and was able to point us towards the best dishes.

We go home in two days but I think we might be returning tomorrow!

reviews.author: Maliav2
reviews.title: Paradisus cancun makes you feel @ paradise !
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun makes it right even when it's wrong ! Exceptional service they tend to all your needs , 24hr. Rm service comes in handy especially when coming back from a tour . Buffet is very good with good variety to choose from . Food could be a lil hotter . Wish they had more premium alcohol for all inclusive ! Would definitely come back for another seven nights !

reviews.author: Andrew G
reviews.title: October Vacation
reviews.text:
The service at this Hotel is the reason why people should choose to stay here. The employees work their tails off to make sure that everything is fine.

The Royal Service is the way to go, hands down. You must have an Ocean View Room.

Our Butler, Hervick, was absolutely incredible and paid extraordinary attention to detail.

Hervick, the Grover's will miss you my friend. Keep up the amazing work and extreme passion that you have for guests.

Javier and Gerardo are amazing at the Royal Service pool. If you have the chance, make sure one of these two take care of you. The drinks are always flowing with these two. 

Samuel and Enrique are absolutely amazing at the Avenue Bar. Please make sure you spend several nights with them. Although the shows are very quick, grab a seat at the bar and order your favorite drink. 

Huge shout out to Pedro at Bana. Pedro, you made my wife and I feel so welcome. Your service is impeccable. May you be promoted to Manager one day my friend.

Now, here is where I have to vent a little. If you stay here for more than a week, the food gets old very quickly.

I wish they had a sub station, steak house, or just something additional to add.

The Restaurants are great, however, there is something missing. 

The entertainment also could use a little pick me up.

Look, if I were you, I'd come spend a Vacation here at least once in your life. You will never regret it.

Paradisus Cancun is pure paradise as the pools are incredible and the ocean amazing.

Thanks for the memories.

reviews.author: Jessica Nicole M
reviews.title: Best Vacation/Honeymoon Ever
reviews.text: The staff was very informative and polite and professional. The experience was awesome. The restaurants and cuisine offered was top notch in taste and presentation. The best service that would rival any other places I've stayed in previously. The whole experience makes want to return and stay here again. The waiter at NAOS Restaurant was a true professional and polite man that extremely informative about the Cancun area. That gentleman deserves some recognition by his superiors.

reviews.author: Danny F
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: The stay here with my family of 20 with friends was fenominal. They catered to our size. The views inside the hotel are spectacular. Many choices to eat at the fine dining restaurants. Two thumbs up and will return.

reviews.author: robert m
reviews.title: Great hotel and staff
reviews.text:
We stayed here when the weather could have been better. We stayed with another family and had a great week. The tooms are modern and the ones facing the sea have great views. On an all inclusive stay you can use nearly all of the restaurants. Ibana a sushi restaurant and the Market Grill stand out. The hotel restaurant Naos has wn incredibly varied and high quality buffet. 

The evening entertainments were variable and were aimed more at a younger audience.

There are several pools all of which overlook the sea and the beach has space for football and volleyball. 

When it rains the windows facing the sea do leak as does the hotel which was clearly built for sunshine. 

We really enjoyed the very well equipped gym.

reviews.author: Paige C
reviews.title: Mexico Wedding Splender
reviews.text: Last Saturday on the 18th of October, 2014 our son got married at this resort. We had over 60 people travel to this resort. To say it was spectacular is an understatement. The planning and attention to detail was amazing. I really want to comment on the staff. Our stay in royal service was second to none. If you have the chance please request Sergio as your butler. He was so kind and professional we felt like we were staying with family. We are planning on returning soon and we will request to have him again. The pool service at the royal service entrance was stellar. The staff were very kind but there were a few stand outs. Michael, Francisco Terrazos made sure our glasses were full and that the ice never melted by the cabana's. It's worth the extra money to stay on the Royal Service side. The attention to detail from packing your clothes and ironing made us feel like we were treated royally. Chocolate covered strawberries were delightful. An aroma therapy bath made us feel like we were in heaven after a long day relaxing at the beach. We loved this place!! The value of what you get will make you want to return. Thank You again Sergio, Michael and Francisco for making us feel at home.

reviews.author: xz
reviews.title: Not for Kids
reviews.text:
The CONS:
I wrote to them ahead of time confirming there was a kids club, the answer was yes.  There is only a kids "lounge" that parents have to stay with their kids (and listen to 20 other kids) and even activities by the pool (not much) you have to sit in that little hut on a mini chair while they paint etc (really all they ever do).  Paid for the concierge, never got our Walkie-talkie (and seemed annoyed when I asked)--our concierge was not accommodating (female, can't remember her name) even though we never asked for anything.  Once we called to have our Bali-bed set up--no one ever came.  Asked the concierge about kids at restaurants, she would not give me a straight answer--but guess what, half the restaurants DO NOT take kids--Asian, and taco restaurants do not accept kids (and the fancy place which is understandable) but that's what we wanted to try--the Asian and taco places.  So we walked past these gorgeous Asian gardens in the lobby and could not eat there (or the other 2 restaurants).  Also paid for kiddie turn down service--they came late at night after kids were sleeping to bring sugary boxes of strawberry or chocolate milk and garbage cookies.  Kids were already in bed.  Frustrating to get around, so many pyramids and only 1 floor actually connects them all (so you have to go up or down and then across and all times).  Also snacks in the lounge (that we paid a premium for with the concierge package) were hot cans of sodas sitting out, booze that you could make yourself a drink, and a few sweets from the buffet (usually empty).  No sandwiches or anything you'd actually want to snack on.

PROS:
Food is great (was only able to go to some of the restaurants)--especially the lunch at the grill on the patio.  Great margaritas (they are strong!) in real glass cups.  Buffet is a buffet (can't say I've ever wowed over a buffet).  And the lobby is beautiful.

Would I stay here again?  No, it is not worth the high price I paid ( especially for the 1bedroom concierge).  Service is lacking, and not a good place for kids (few activities and no real kids club).

reviews.author: Lmala23
reviews.title: We loved it but wouldn't go back
reviews.text: Although I gave this place great reviews (which it really was great) there was really nothing to do there. They didn't have an activities during the day or night. Not even a dj by the pool all day! They only had a dj from like 11-1 which to me is crazy than they played what I like to call spa music. The food was quite terrible as well. Out of a 5 id rate it a 2.5. On the other hand this hotel was breathe taking. Everything about it was beautiful  the workers are the hardest workers I have even seen. They treat you as if you are royalty there (it was awesome). We had a great time though. We spent 3 days doing excursions but if we didn't I think wed go crazy. Sitting by the pool or the beach is only fun for a couple of days. The night life .... We'll there was no night life. Another flaw the hotel had to offer. We left just in time of a tropical storm. I feel very bad for the people just getting there. If your not outside in pool or beach. You will have nothing to do. So like I said. We had a great time but wouldn't go back!

reviews.author: sjykna
reviews.title: Paradisus resorts are not what they used to be.....
reviews.text: My review is not a good one,,,,Dissapointing is all I can say.....The food, the service slow and not impressive at all...I do understand it is all inclusive but I believe they fail in that department...The restaurant choices are poor.....The food is of poor quality......The breakfast was good, fresh fruit, and choice of many items....And I also feel the hotel was not up to par.......The beach however was beautiful........I have stayed at many paradisus prior to this, and I must say they have declined in the past few yrs.............

reviews.author: Gail L
reviews.title: Great resort, minus the timeshare pitch...
reviews.text:
Great resort with a beautiful beach and blue water that I was looking for, I would recommend this place to friends and family but advise to stay away from the timeshare pitch when you check in...it made our check-in experience so terrible, Carmen was our greeter and promised to make our week stay enjoyable.  But once she found out we had spoken to someone at the airport who had pitched us 2 rounds of golf and all-inclusive daypass at another resort in exchange that we watch their timeshare presentation, she became this agressive salesperson wanting to know what we got from the other person and that she would "fix it." She promised us golf at another resort and gave us coupons for jewelry in exchange that we watched the timeshare presentation at Paradisus instead of another resort.  She kept us for over an hour after we checked in and after telling her that we wanted to go to our room and have lunch, she finally let us go but asked us to come back with the paperwork that we received from the airport.  When we did come back, she made it seem like we got scammed and that we wouldn't be getting what we had paid for but with what she was promising to "fix" she still wanted us to pay more money in order to get the golf that we wanted.  We were so disgusted and tired, we ended up not going to any presentation, at Paradisus or the other resort.  We were so turned off that we decided to just enjoy our vacation and deal with the airport people when we return home.  And which we did, there is someone at the airport that you can go to at the Arrivals gate and tell them that you want your money back, and they will refund your money.  So please take this advice, AVOID ALL PEOPLE AT THE AIRPORT & DECLINE ANYTHING AT YOUR RESORT, don't tell them how old you are, or what you do for a living, or what your hobbies are or what excursions you want to do.  Book excursions somewhere else or online. Samba offers a catamaran to Isla de Mujeres for $40 and does a good job (we did this excursion). 

Besides that check-in experience, I LOVED the resort, everything else was great, the food was really good, the buffet never really repeated anything all week and the dine-in restaurants was great.  Beach was beautiful and pool was nice, even had a kids pool for our 1 yr old daughter (2 ft deep). The resort met my expectations and I hope to check out their other locations someday.

reviews.author: Greg S
reviews.title: First Class Place
reviews.text: This is a first class place from the great food,clean rooms, and awesome service. We played the par 3 golf course and was lot's of fun. Beaches clear water and clean sand. The pools are my favorite part to this place. We will be back.

reviews.author: Tsams
reviews.title: Can't believe the negative reviews!
reviews.text: Stayed as a couple in the Royal Service 10/4-10/11.  This was my third trip to the resort but my first since the change from Melia to Paradisus.  I found the facility to be everything I remembered, beautiful with excellent accommodations and wonderfully thorough staff.  Our butler Juan greeted us and checked in with us daily.  We can't say enough about how his efforts made our trip so memorable and warm.  It was my boyfriend's birthday and by the end of his special day he kept saying, "that was the best birthday ever!"  What a day it was!  Juan decorated our room with rose pedals and balloons and had Champagne and Birthday Cake waiting for us after a day at the beach where Juan also arranged an ocean front palapa.  While at the beach, the entire Royal Service Crew brought my boyfriend a slice of birthday cake and sang happy birthday to him!  That was arranged by our beach waiter Efraine.  These folks work so hard to see to it that your every need is met.  They truly are a remarkable group of individuals who take pride in what they do.  That being said, I would encourage all who travel here to drop their preconceived notions and open up to the warmth and inviting culture of this resort.  Above all don't forget to tip everyone (that includes your housekeeping staff and minibar stockers)!  The price is reasonable so why not give back to those who work so hard to make your vacation special.  We believe in taking care of those who take care of us and let me tell you it comes back to you ten fold.  The Paradisus exceeded our every hope.  The food was delicious, especially at Tempo (which isn't part of the AI but I highly recommend the tasting menu - it was unbelievably creative and yummy).  The service was top notch everywhere we went.  The beds are comfortable, the showers were high pressured with endless hot water.  The resort is stunning and we loved the smell of the lavender incense.  I've traveled extensively throughout Mayan Riviera and this is definitely one of my favorite resorts to visit.  On our last day of the trip, Juan paid us a visit in our room to give us a lovely gift and later came to check on us just before our departure in the lobby while we waited for our transport to the airport.  His attention to detail was perfection.  We will definitely be returning and wish all of those we met at the Paradisus well.  Thank you all so much for everything you do!!

reviews.author: Ashley P
reviews.title: Best Vacation for Couples
reviews.text: This was a great trip. The service we received was extraordinary, and I have high standards. Galindo, our Royal Service butler, was professional, courteous, thoughtful and efficient. We will absolutely be back and recommend to friends.

reviews.author: 874Lisa
reviews.title: Just another resort
reviews.text:
PRO's:  Beautiful beach and good location.
CONS:  Didn't get the room we paid for, mini-bar was only stocked if we left a tip, food was fair at best, hotel smelled overly strong like perfume, TV sound didn't always work, alarm clock was wired into the wall, not plugged in, and went off during varies hours of the night.  Only one lounge chair on balcony that they said they would get us another but never did. Bali beds are a joke.  You have to PAY to use them and almost all of them were empty.  The 1500 resort credit is also a scam.  It is not like the Palace resort credit that you can actually use it for activities.  Would definately not recommend this resort except for the beautiful  beach.

reviews.author: Katya K
reviews.title: The best hotel ever
reviews.text:
We enjoyed our stay in this hotel and found it the most beautiful we had ever seen. Stuff is very friendly and helpful, the hotel is very clean. Wonderful plants, huge pool, sophisticated food, a lot of activities for our 5 year old daughter in the Kids Zone (special thanks to experienced ladies working there. They gave so much care and attention to our girl, that she couldn't be happier).
Due to low season we could find any spot we liked around the pool, in the restaurants etc.
Excellent gym was a pleasant addition, special thanks to Aldo, the coach, who is a highly skilled professional.
The only concern was an A/C unit noise.

reviews.author: Vera
reviews.title: Enjoyed Royal Servis
reviews.text: If you are travelling without children, definitely book the royal Servis, it is wort he'd every penny as they say in England. The only minus is a small buffet compare to Riu, no guacamole, but you can get it at the pool or in the restaurants.

reviews.author: salosm
reviews.title: Don't let them fool you
reviews.text: You pay a lot and obviously expext luxury. You won't get it in here. Food and service is not even average. All restaurants except Tempo (not included as All Inclusive plan) serve the same and the food is bad, not enough servers and you have to wait long to eat or drink. If you want to get comfortable in the pool or beach in a bed you have to pay 50 USD a day. If this is your budget there are a lot of better hotels in Cancun

reviews.author: Sam R
reviews.title: So close but so far....
reviews.text:
I think this hotel is fine, but nothing special. For what we paid the service just fell short in almost all areas, for example...
1) wifi and service on beach great but service was slow, quicker to get yourself.
2) great food selection at buffet but food under lamps not hot
3) service in buffet hit and miss and salt and pepper never on the table and sometimes missing a spoon etc
4) rooms pleasant but we were missing towel/ flannels etc
5) room not cleaned on 2 occasions
6) balcony never cleaned
7) mini bar replenished but glasses not cleaned and plastic cup never moved. 
8) best restaurant was vento, but missed out eating there on last night because they all seem to open and close on different days which was not clearly advertised.
9) blueagave was the was meal of my life, left without eating
10) fuego was nic but service was terrible, waiter tried to rush us out together another table in by telling us the kitchen was closing at 10.15 when in fact we had till 11pm

reviews.author: Mbb82
reviews.title: Plus and minus
reviews.text:
We spent 3 nights in an ocean view room on the 4th floor of the main building, pyramid 3.
Plus:  Smiling and helpful personnel in all departments:  reception, bars, restaurants, etc.- Good size room - Very good food and  nice presentation -  Very nice restaurants - Free wifi
Minus:  Even if the hotel is very clean and well maintained,  the building shows its age:  pealing paint, stained glasses,  missing tiles,   stained joints _  Music all over the site,  mainly lounge and techno music,  sometimes pop around the main pool,  going from loud to very loud, we can hear the music of the main pool from the beach.   It is impossible to find  a spot around one of the pool where you just have the sound of the ocean.   For us this was very ennoying and except for this situation,  I would have agreed to 4 points instead of 3.

reviews.author: Moira e
reviews.title: Fantastic Holiday
reviews.text: My partner and I returned last week from a 2 weeks stay along with 2 other couples. We cannot fault the hotel at all, the staff the food the service was all first class. We did not do Royal Service and we found the service to be excellent. The pool waiting staff were just fab.  We had no problems getting tables in the restaurants and we would defiantly recommend this hotel to others

reviews.author: cam12reyes
reviews.title: Nice little vacation
reviews.text:
This was our 6th or 7th trip to Mexico, never stayed in the Cancun hotel zone before, usually go to Playa del Carmen or Riviera Maya, we like quite places. Overall was a very nice little vacation, we did the Royal service that it was very good. Not very happy with the rooms because it was just a regular room with a king size bed, bathroom was very small. The private pool area is very nice and with good service. About 3 years ago went to the Majestic Elegance in Punta Cana, Elegance Club, and that was a really good and a big 2 room suite.
I have to thank the following people who made our trip very enjoyable, Michael, pool, Hector our friend(butler), Andres, The market Grill, I always found a way to get there and get his service and Natalia Acosta, Assistant Manager fro Royal Service,  who helped me with a request.
Best restaurant for us was Vento, great tapas, and then Mole. We did go to Tempo and did the 10 courses and wine pairing dinner, my wife loved it, I only liked 3.

reviews.author: Nour E
reviews.title: Excellence beyond any expectation! Outstanding efficiency on all levels!
reviews.text:
We just came back from a most amazing stay at the Paradisus Cancun.
We were three adults and a four year old granddaughter.
Arriving at the resort, you are greeted by an exotic fragrance that already makes you feel on vacation. Cancun's beauty is a miracle of Nature, and Paradisus is a pearl on Cancun's beach.

We had the Family concierge service and it was beyond anything we could have imagined.
Check-in is at an exclusive reception area, closed from the main lobby, an oasis of freshness and a warm welcome with little goodies for the kids. We got upgraded to ocean view which made the whole experience just like paradise! Andrea checked us in, efficient like everybody that works at the resort.
Veronica, the manager of the Family concierge, made sure we get the room that fitted our needs and prepared the package for us. We stayed in Pyramid 3 on the fifth floor.
We were assigned a personal assistant (I have a dislike for the word Butler) and got a cellphone that connected us to Ramon and the resort at anytime.
Ramon! We don't how to express our gratitude for making our stay so wonderful.
Your dedication and attention, going above and beyond your responsibilities, just turned everything into magic. The daily surprises that you prepared for our granddaughter in the room, the amazing ideas to make a four year old happy, all the notes you left for her and for us truly warmed our hearts. (I kept every single one of them)
The resort is so well managed and maintained, attention to every detail, service beyond anything we had at any other hotel or resort before. 

The room was amazing, and any request is handled within a few minutes. then you get a call to make sure your request was handled immediately.
There are no garbage bins anywhere, the staff makes sure that everything remains picture perfect clean. 
The Bali beds are wonderful, by the kids pool or by the bar. Your own little home during the day.
And the free Wifi, really everywhere you go, as far as the beach.
The hotel is kids friendly, I also noticed that it is 100% handicap accessible.
Bana, Asian fusion and Sushi restaurant, was our preferred spot. The setting, close to the evening shows and the food and service were perfect. Thank you Jesus, we enjoyed your dedication so much! I missed to get the name of Jesus' manager, who on the second time arranged a table for us, which was a challenge as the restaurant is in high demand.
Naos is the open buffet restaurant, and I would like to thank Carlos, for remembering our preferences day after day. 
Rodrigo at the kids pool, what a pleasant company we had looking after our needs!
Salvador at the family concierge, great service!
Abundance of great food, at any time, at any place, in the restaurants, by the pool, everywhere.
The staff comes by sooner than you run out of a drink or food. The attendant that brought us the drinks by the kids pool, went to get the ice-cream (which was not available at the pool restaurant) from Naos, a few minutes walk, just to make our little one happy, wow! We were really stunned when he came back with the ice-cream! 
Outstanding efficiency and service! (Our service in Canada and the US has a lot to learn from Mexico!)

I missed to note all the other names that belong to the beautiful smiles that surrounded us all day.
They sure know how to smile in Mexico, a genuine smile to make you happy and feel welcome.

And last but not least: Urbano, the sales manager of the resort, I know you were behind all the amazing hospitality you lavished us with... but your staff outdid even your expectations, I guess.
Going back as soon as we can.
Thank you Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: Felttam
reviews.title: Dream Vacation
reviews.text: This was the best vacation I have ever had. The staff treats you like royalty. Everything was inclusive so all the drinks and food at the different restaurants were free. The staff went out their way to help me find my bag that was lost at the airport (we got it). Love the decor of fresh plants and fountains throughout the location (3-4 blocks long). I would come back every year. Love it!

reviews.author: Kevin O
reviews.title: Excellent Hotel and a great place.
reviews.text:
The hotel food is geared towards the Spanish, Latin American taste. That said, there is enough variety to cater form everyone.

The hotel staff are excellent and can not do enough for you. The location is great with a beach that is stunning. It is just a short taxi drive (or bus) to all the shopping locations and Cancun town.

we went for the ocean view room which was really good, however, I was told that the Lagoon rooms were also excellent.

reviews.author: DrDetroit68
reviews.title: Fantastic Cancun Getaway
reviews.text: Out stay at the Paradisus Cancun with the Royal Service option was beyond amazing.  The entire resort was first class, from the room, to the staff, the amenities, the restaurants, the constant attention to detail at each and every turn.  We were so pampered with the Royal Service, besides it being Adults Only so we could just relax, having our own Bali Bed each day was like heaven.  Going in the off-season was even better as nothing was over crowded.  Also, for those runners out there, being able to get out in the mornings and run along Hotel Row was fantastic, great morning runs.  We are already ready to go back and this will be our first choice for our next vacation for certain.  While we didn't stay on the Family side of the resort, those offerings also seemed to be top notch and the families were having a great time as well.

reviews.author: gordon c
reviews.title: Great trip, outstanding staff
reviews.text: The Paradisus was good and the staff was great. Their goal to make your stay enjoyable is very evident. Every member of the staff I enteracted with was pleasent and gladly not only met all request, but predicted them as well. The hotel was busy but not crowded, their processes were quick but I never felt rushed. The beach bali beds and the pool were great, as was the pool side service (drink and food). The hotel is large enough to provide outstanding service yet not so large that you don't feel their touch of personal service. Special comments and reviews for Royal Services. Leticia provided great service and if I could, I'd hire her myself.  This assistance recieved by her, as well as Hector did not go without notice. Hector contacted us everyday, at least twice a day to ask if we needed or wanted anything. When we did, he took care of the request at once. If you want to spoil yourself.....try this hotel.

reviews.author: Vesaint
reviews.title: Great getaway!!!!!
reviews.text: The Paradisus was good and the staff was great. Their goal to make your stay enjoyable is very evident. Every member of the staff I enteracted with was pleasent and gladly not only met all request, but predicted them as well.  The hotel was busy but not crowded, their processes were quick but I never felt rushed. The beach bali beds and the pool were great, as was the pool side service (drink and food).  The hotel is large enough to provide outstanding service yet not so large that you don't feel their touch of personal service. If you want to spoil yourself.....try this hotel.

reviews.author: Bobbi E
reviews.title: Excellent all-around!!
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun last weekend and it was phenomenal!! We had the Royal Service in building 5 and it was everything I thought it would be and more. The Royal Service pool was huge and the Bali beds are great. 

The beach was beautiful and extremely clean. Royal Service beach waiter service is great. We had buckets of water, glasses with ice, cold drinks, & food delivered all day long. (I think we had the Mahi Mahi everyday lol.)

The food is great at the Paradisus Cancun, especially the Mexican food at 'Mole' and the Latin food at 'Fuego'. I'm not a huge ceviche fan; however, the grouper was the best I've ever had.

For us the resort's top service came from Jose Luis & Ignacio at 'Naos'. Every morning we were greeted with coffee and a smile!! Its incredible service like theirs that makes me want to return!! Thank you Paradisus Cancun for a great stay, we look forward to returning next year!!

reviews.author: Michael C
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun was just that: a paradise
reviews.text:
Spent 4 days/3 nights in Cancun at the Paradisus. It was beautiful. Steps from that blue, blue water and totally self contained. The room was fabulous (Junior Suite with an Ocean View.) 

The restaurants were each excellent in their own way. Naos was prefect for breakfast and lunch. Add in the excellent service by Darwin Alejandro and it made for a completely enjoyable experience. For dinner, we hit Bana, Vento and Market Grill. Each very well done.. 

As for tequlia and such, we stayed with Coco's Bar. A few steps from the beach and attended to by Christian and Tony, we looked forward to going there every night. Christian is quite the character and kept the fun level high. We also took the YHI spa up on a special they were running. Very good choice. Very relaxing and attentive staff. 

All in all I'd say the hotel may need a bit of a freshening up, but it certainly did not stop us from having a great time. We also read prior complaints about the restaurant levels being extremely warm. That is actually true. I'd suggest shorts and light shorts for all of the bars and restaurant that are open air. And I'd suggest the hotel invest in some industrial strength fans. Not looking to be super cooled, but when you're sweating while eating, its uncomfortable.

That said, we very much look forward to a return trip in the near future.

reviews.author: felice243
reviews.title: Great Family Experience
reviews.text:
We recently spent a week here for a family wedding. Ranging in age from 68 to 7 months, we were all incredibly well-cared for, pampered, feted. No doubt we will all remember this trip for a long time. The hotel itself is amazingly beautiful -- lots of greenery, water features inside the hotel.
