The rooms (we had to lower priced lagoon view) are very nice, not that you want to spend much time in them. The staff was gracious and tried hard to meet our every request. 
A special shout-out to waiter Carlos Cardena in the Naos Restaurant. Besides being very attentive, he seemed to be there whenever we needed anything.
We tried several of the restaurants. I felt the Naos and Market Grill had the best consistency. The food was fine and available whenever. While we never had a bad meal, many were just average. That said, the beach, pools, bars, entertainment, SERVICE made up for any shortcomings. We had a blast! Highly recommended for families.

reviews.author: Marce37
reviews.title: Great Service!!!
reviews.text: Went here for our 1st anniversary . . .  had our room decorated with roses and champagne! Great Service . . .  Very friendly people . . .  the beach is beautiful! We had a great time! The waiters in the pool area were very nice and gave us great service with drinks and snacks . . .  Jesus, Sorfino and Victor!!!! Great job and we hope to see you soon!

reviews.author: Buzzard82
reviews.title: HOLIDAY OF A LIFETIME, INCREDIBLE STAFF!
reviews.text:
Just returned from a week and a half holiday at this hotel.
We decided to opt for Royal Service and were completely wowed by every detail of this establishment! The lobby both in the main pyramid (3) and the royal service pyramid (5) were astounding. Real vines, trees and plants adorn both areas making spectacular viewing. The restaurants are charms scattered around every corner, we were particularly impressed with Vento and Market Grill. The pool areas in both the adults only and normal sections were spotlessly clean and the water was perfect. The beach is beautiful and the water warm although there is quite a bit of seaweed that washes up daily.
Royal service is luxury beyond belief.
We were lucky to have Hector as our butler who's attention to detail and us was exceptional! We could not have asked for more from a personal butler service. There are some other staff that also need mentioning, one is Efrain who is a server around the pool and cocktail area inside the lobby. He is one of the most accommodating and friendly servers I have come across and I can imagine he would also make a fantastic butler! The last and probably most importantly is the manager of Royal Service Lazaro! I cannot stress enough how professional and approachable he is. He is totally dedicated to ensuring every single one of his residents in the Paradisus Royal Service is having the time of their life. If there are any problems which I imagine is a rarity, please please ask to speak to him as I can personally assure you he will do his upmost to resolve. 
Royal Service has the best team of cleaners, concierge, servers, and butlers (particularly Hector) that I have ever had the pleasure of encountering and we are already trying to work out how soon we can return.
This hotel is most certainly a 5* but the service and staff deserve 7*
That is a blinding combination!

reviews.author: LaineyB10
reviews.title: Great holiday
reviews.text:
This was our first time in Cancun and had great expectations having read previous reviews but have to say were a little disappointed.  The staff were extremely friendly and helpful and will give a shout out to Jorge at the Market Grill, Enrique in the Avenue Bar and Marisol on pool service.  

We arrived on the weekend and the service was great - a bit difficult to get a sun bed with shade.  However during the week the poolside service was hit and miss and one day when it was over cast  - non existent.

Whilst we were staying there were several extremely large conferences taking place, which put a strain on service and whilst the staff did their best it affected the service they could offer holiday makers.  On two nights two of the main restaurants were closed which left very little choice for evening meals.  One morning we had to queue for a table for breakfast as the breakfast restaurant was swamped with conference guests.

We went sky riding and snorkeling with Aquaworld which is just across the road from the hotel and both trips were excellent.  Bookable through kiosks around the pool area. 

The towel service was interesting!  You get a card each for one towel.  Whilst I can understand the reason for this service,  one or two of the towel service guys were very officiious - not making it a pleasant experience.

We had a great holiday but would not return to this hotel.

reviews.author: Phil Guana
reviews.title: Wonderful family experience
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus all week and had an amazing time. I will first say that the staff was more than accommodating and professional at every level, from room service, maids to front of the house staff. 

We stayed as part of their Family Concierge package with our two kids, ages 10 and 12. The extra level of service received by this VIP part of the hotel is second to none. We had our own Butler (Fernanda) who was available to us at any moment. I had a Credit Card ATM scare (machine did not return my card), Fernanda and the staff, called the ATM operator and had the machine opened and my card removed within an hour....thank god!

The staff goes above and beyond and if you are traveling with kids and can spare the extra cost, it is WELL worth the extra service and attention. 

The restaurants are all top notch and all facilities are well maintained and the resort is in wonderful condition. Rooms are comfortable, clean and perfect. They provide room cleaning service twice a day, so you always come back to a fresh room. Pools are all crystal clear and spotless. I am a very picky guest usually, but I have nothing bad to say about the property or facilities. You can't go wrong here.

reviews.author: Michael R
reviews.title: Great stay at Paradisus
reviews.text: We were there Oct 3-8 and had such great service I felt I should write it up. Bartenders Raphael and Christian at the swim-up bar and at Coco's Bar on the beach were the best. They were happy to see us every time, very attentive to whatever we need, always remembered us and our drinks and seemed genuinely sad to see us go. The service at this resort is the best I've had and this was my 8th different all-inclusive. The resort is beautiful but it's the people that make it great. Additional kudos go out to all the staff at the Market Grill. I've never seem service so attentive as that. Thanks everyone for a great stay,

reviews.author: brandydeshay
reviews.title: Can't wait to return
reviews.text: We came to celebrate our 15th anniversary not knowing the resort.  We were pleasantly surprised to get the Royal package and Hanne been spoiled rotten. Our butler, Cesar, was so sweet and treated us to special moments frequently. We can't wait to come back to visit!

reviews.author: David S
reviews.title: Royal Service - Wow!
reviews.text:
This was my third visit to this property within the last four years and my first since it has become all-inclusive. Not being an all-inclusive fan, I greeted the news of its conversion with more than a bit of trepidation. My previous two visits had been so exceptional, that I decided to go for a third even as an all-inclusive. I opted, as I had on the previous visits, for Royal Service ( formerly Red Level service). Part of the hotel complex is Time Shares, part a traditional hotel, and part Royal Service...an exclusive hotel within the hotel. It is certainly appropriately named. From the moment you set foot on the property, you are treated royally......a special plush lounge where you meet your personal attendant (Butler) for your stay who accompanies you to the Royal Service pyramid where you check in amid a lush rain forest atmosphere of tranquility and class. The entire Royal Service staff is highly professional, attentive to detail, welcoming, and dedicated to the anticipation of guests every need.

Rooms - whether facing the ocean/pool or the lagoon (sunsets), are superbly appointed. Amenities are abundant and of the highest quality...no corners cut here. TVs are flat screen with a wide variety if channels and movies.Beds are quite comfortable, not the usual Mexican "rock hard" and a pillow menu is offered if desired. The coffee maker and coffee selection was wonderful, the rain shower delightful, the lighting...somewhat perplexing. I was never quite able to figure out how to work all the lights without turning off circuits to unintended things...like the radio alarm clock. In room robes, slippers, beach towels, and a complimentary beach bag were all nice touches.

The pool reserved for Royal Service guests is spectacular! It is huge, surrounded by Bali bed palapas which can be reserved. There is a pool bar/grill and service here is also quite attentive.

Food - Where do I start?  Food and drink is almost always available in the Royal Service lounge area minutes from your room, but within the hotel complex and available to Royal Service guests are an awesome ( I don't use that word often ) selection of 8 unique, varied, full service, superb quality restaurants. As a Royal service guest you get preferred reservations and seating.The best meals of my week in Mexico were had here. 

The Spa - is magnificent! It offers a wide variety of treatments...massages, facials, wraps, and rituals.... in a choice of atmospheres.  There is also a huge hydrotherapy area which normally costs about $30.00/day to use....free to Royal Service guests.

In short, The entire Royal Service experience at the Paradisus is extraordinary...World Class.
Considering the level of service, quality, food, drink, and "extras"...it is well worth every peso. I emphatically recommend it.

reviews.author: malveen
reviews.title: The Great Escape
reviews.text: We spent one week at this fantastic resort--great time, good food and great service.  The staff was very attentive and exceptionally friendly.  One bartender in particular was amazing (Erick De La Cruz) who provided us outstanding service during our several visits to the several bars on the resort.  Excellent young man who provided outstanding service and great conversation.  The hotel was exceptionally clean, beautiful and comfortable.  Would certainly visit again in the future.  Aside from the occasional delicious tequila shots, mixed drink alcohol seemed to be watered down.

reviews.author: MyEscapeVacation
reviews.title: Awesome Resort!
reviews.text: I stayed in the Royal Service building,Adults only and loved it,butler service,champagne in my room everyday,bar in the lobby with top shelf alcohol,you can pour your cocktail or a waiter standing by will mix it for you.It was the royal service.

reviews.author: 345Dansa321
reviews.title: Really enjoyed it
reviews.text:
Just four nights but found the hotel a treat to be in. Food was good all-inclusive food, meaning not great, not bad. Found we preferred the buffet best as you had some control over what looks good.
Royal Service is a must, as is the adult only sections of the hotel

reviews.author: Sue630
reviews.title: Royal Service 9/27-10/8
reviews.text:
Royal Service Staff excellent
Butler Very Good
Ocean front suite outstanding
Adult beverage service outstanding
Royal room treats outstanding 
Royal small bites inside good
Royal pool service outstanding
Royal pool outstanding
Royal ocean front breakfast and dinner very good, always willing to please
Tempo tasting menu: service outstanding, food very good, pricey
Mole very good
Fuego very good
Buffet good
Paradisus location, excellent
Bus safe and timely
Shows at 8:30, superior
Weather 11.5 days of sun out of 12

reviews.author: Honestopp
reviews.title: PARADISUS IS PARADISE ROYAL SERVICE IS HEAVEN!!
reviews.text:
There are not good enough words to describe our experience at this hotel! It is so fabulous I could not even wait to get home before writing it (yes I'm still here)!
Unfortunately today is raining so I decided to write this review whilst biding time before heading of to our private beach side Bali Bed that will have our name displayed and will be pre prepared with a beach bag and towels. This will all have been organised by our angel butler 'HECTOR" who has also done many other luxury and thoughtful things throughout our stay. Like decorate our room with petals, run bubble baths (also sprawled with petals) arranged our favourite tipple in our room. Given me brand new insect repellent when he noticed I had bites. Sorted us with fragranced pillows (AMAZING). Reserved restaurants and had a special romantic table set up for us on our anniversary, the list just goes on and on! There is not a single staff member at the paradisus that has not wowed us with there impeccable service. The location is stunning, the food is of an extremely high standard, the pool area and poolside snacks are outstanding. The rooms in Royal service are luxurious wherever you turn. I haven't seen the rooms in the other part of the hotel but I have no doubt that they are just as wonderful. The lobby and foyers in both the Royal service and the main hotel are just mind blowing. Royal Service (if you can afford it) is absolutely worth every penny as it does what is says on the tin... you are literally treated like royalty, but if not you will certainly not be disappointed with a standard stay at this hotel.
I cannot fault this place (and I usually always find something).
I even went to a 'sort of' timeshare meeting and although I didn't choose to buy due to personal reasons, it was well carried out and actually a fantastic deal! I did in fact enjoy seeing rooms at their sister hotel and was not spoken to once out of turn. Please please do not pay attention to negative remarks as they simply are either not true or an extreme exaggeration. This is the best vacation I have ever had and the loveliest hotel I have stayed at. I have been all around the Caribbean (Jamaica, Barbados, Dominca) and I have not found another hotel that is any comparison to Paradisus - particularly in terms of service.
I will be devastated to leave and will probably end up being escorted out by security kicking and screaming! Fair warning Paradisus ;)
Thank you for giving us a once in a lifetime experience!!

reviews.author: Matthew P
reviews.title: Read many reviews before going, my synopsis
reviews.text:
I did a lot of research before going. We just got back from a 5 day trip and had a great time. I will highlight the areas that I was warned through reviews about.The resort is only 15 minutes from the airport, you are greated and your bags are taken away. Inside it is a massive pyramid with vines hanging from each level. There are Koy ponds and an Asian restaurant called Bana that has it's tables hidden throughout trees and walkways.The smell that everyone speaks of does hit you, but only when you come in from the outside. Around the grounds and in your room, you do not smell it. 

You are then ushered into a lounge where you check in and receive your braclet. They offer the royal treatment and explain about the restaurants. To our suprise, they changed the reservation system, not once did we have to make one. It might just be for off peak season, but it was nice not to have to get up early to make a reservation. There was also little or no pressure for time shares. You see the desks around the lobby, but they don't hound you. The elavators smelled really bad, so bad that we never used them.

The room was nice, nothing amazing. We were in tower 3 and did not hear much outside noise from the lobby at night. AC worked, safe worked, only 1 lounger on the balcony, but never used it.

The pool was great, not very packed, it is deep, 5 feet 9 inches. Never had trouble with chairs, off season helped with that. No much shade, we all got burned bad. Bartenders were great along with walk around servers. Towel system was easy, never had any issues.

The beach is amazing, the huts with lounge chairs are perfect for shade. There is a good amount of seaweed, but they come around and clean it up. The water is nice and blue, waves can be very strong. There are also rip currents that can be very dangerous, life guards were on top of it.

We tried 4 different restaurants not including the buffet. The buffet is amazing for breakfast and lunch. Everything was fresh and the varity was very good. The first night we went to Mole, service was great, food was bland. We sat in the wine room, the funny part is that there were only 2 types of wine. The second night we went to Fuego, the food was great, the service was awful. We arrived at 8:30, seated at 8:45, at 9 we had no menus or water, at 9:05 we poured our own water, at 9:30 we got our drinks and ordered, at 10 we got bread and our apatizers, at 10:45 we got dinner, at 11:15 we got desert and at 11:40 we were told the restraurant closed at 11 and were asked to leave. The third night we went to the market grill. We had already tried it for lunch one day for burgers. At night it is a Brazillian steak house. We had 10 people and from sitting down to walking out, it took 35 minutes. A huge change from the night before, it is a well oiled service machine. They come first with salads, and then potatos and corn. Next the meat comes: chicken, turkey wrapped in bacon, beef, lamb, and sausage. Everything was amazing. The last night, Blueagave was closed and the sushi place didn't apeal to a few of our friends so we went to Tempo? There are two that sound exactly alike, but this was the one by the buffet in tower 4 that you did not have to pay extra for. It is tapas style, with 3 small crustinis to start, then 4 entrees and then 4 deserts. This or Fuego was the best meal as far as taste.

Entertainment was good, we saw the Michael Jackson and the dance show. Both were really good. They also had casino night, which was cool for about 15 minutes. 

Overall, we would easily come back. Compared to other places we have stayed, this was easily the best. I feel off season helped with many of the prior reviewed complaints.

reviews.author: LisaJ002
reviews.title: Abs amazing
reviews.text:
I cannot say ANYTHING bad about this place.Says it in the name Paradise…..went on a girly holiday and paid for Royal Service,gees didn't we feel like Royalty,as soon as ,on arrival you get assigned your butler in the sumptuous surroundings, the smell as soon as you step in the hotel was amazing ,I even asked if I could buy it in an oil or burner!! Our butler was the best…Hector,he was always wanting to help us and gave us first class service ,it was sad to say bye to him and he even gave us a present!
We tried all the restaurants as Hector booked for us and were amazing ,the staff were always professional and helpful.Our fav was definitely Tempo ,which you have to pay a supplement as it is by a Michelin Chef,well it was worth every $,you MUST go ,sadly we went on our last night to make it special but was offered a different menu just for us if we wanted to go again but couldn't as we were leaving ,we are all in the industry and couldn't fault it ,it really was an experience!
I could go on and on about this Hotel,even the tours(booked in the office by reception Expedia,Teresa and Efren(think thats how its spelt)gave us amazing service and a fab deal on diving ,snorkelling and Coco Bongos trips ,so book all trips there and they will discount! Coco Bongos and Senior frogs was amazing night out to,like Vegas in Mexico!
Ok well I can't wait to return and I can't stop telling everyone about how amazing it was,lots of pictures ,couldn't take a bad picture,even my friends say how nice my pictures are!!! 
Miss the place already….they need to bottle that smell….oh go to the Spa (free in RService)sooo releasing if you need to be ANY more relaxed!!

reviews.author: Callie S
reviews.title: Excellent!!
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay! We stayed in the Royal Service. I think that is the way to go my only complaint is that our butler was not that good. Forgot our alcohol that is supposed to be delivered daily. We did not get the cell phone and he didn't really help us. He forgot one night of our dinner reservations. We did however enjoy everyone else! Especially Alfonso, Roger, Michael. I would like to have one of them as my butler they were very attentive , nice, funny, friendly!

reviews.author: naya5579
reviews.title: Amazing Resort!
reviews.text:
4 couples traveld. Had Royal Service rooms. Rooms are nice and all the amendmities like shampoo and conditioners are very nice unlike small tiny ones they give out at other hotels.
bottles of Vodka, tequilla, rum and wisky were given upon request. Beds were so comfy.  Didn't get to ask many things to our butler but had no problem.

Restuarants were nice especially mole.
Buffet, we didn't like tht much but it was not bad.

Pool was so clean inside and outside. water temperature was perfect. foof at the pool was so delicious.

Yhi spa. we had 50 min relaxation massage which was good but felt so short. next time we wanted to go for 80 min. Hydro therapy was nice too. 

Now the bad thing is. since the resort is so huge we had to walk so much to go to restaurant and pool from royal service building. we was little annoing to me.
Pool had so little people and so quiet that there was no activities going on which got little boring but ok to relax.

All in all, we had wonderful time and felt very welcome and royl during our stay.
It was good that there were not many guests while our stay. no reservation was needed for any restaurant.

reviews.author: Dwest858
reviews.title: Very Good Stay!!
reviews.text:
I visited Paradisus Cancun from September 27-Oct 02 and stayed in the Royal Service section.
Pros: Very clean and well kept resort. 
Ample food selection which was also pretty good overall
Top shelf liquors with nice pours all around
Great beach
Cons: Aging resort (although well kept and clean), 
Food was a bit redundant, essentially the same food you can get at their buffet with a different presentation.
Ok, so here are my thoughts, I stayed at RS which I stated before and I am glad I made that choice. While staying in RS you are in a separate building which is at least 10 degrees cooler than the rest of the buildings, its very quiet relaxing and has a lot of ambience. There is also a small area for food and drinks which is not busy at all and allows for quick and easy snacks, drinks, ice and such. In addition, with Rs you get 2 days use of a bali bed which is great, in low season, you can also get additional days if they aren't reserved. I went to the beach and stayed at the papilla's which were also very nice. My room was nice cool and clean. Turn down service every night, never needed to call for anything.  I did not receive a phone from my butler Juan, but as I walked through the lobby each day he always asked "is there anything I can do to make your day special"
Pool Bar was very busy happening place, not my scene so glad I was in RS.
Bana- Decent sushi, good drinks, not my favorite
Vento- Very good food, nice overall experience
Blue agave- good quick snack or meal, margarita of the day made fresh were tasty
La Papala- RS- good for a poolside lunch or snack, limited selection
Naos- This is their buffet, I was super surprised with this one, Probably the best restaurant they offer.. I would recommend a walkthrough prior to eating at the ala cart places, see what they are cooking fresh, likely it will be more fresh and better tasting than the other restaurants with a "not as pretty" presentation 
Oh, and starting the week I was there it was a no reservation needed policy for the specialty restaurants during the remainder of low season. 
To just touch base on a few things I was concerned with prior to visiting..
I was never approached by a timeshare person, although I saw them doing the breakfasts.
There are 58 steps to the front door, but my driver bypassed them and dropped me off at the front door.
No reservations for restaurants
Good AC in my room with a great view
Was warm in the main building but I never found myself very uncomfortable
They will convert from USD to peso at a 12.5 rate with no additional charges
Overall, this is a great resort, with great staff.. Its aging but well kept and none of which effected my stay at the very least. Nicest place Ive stayed within Cancun
Oh and the Main pyramid is pretty awesome at night

reviews.author: John R
reviews.title: royal service!
reviews.text: Hotel was wonderful! Butler Juan was awesome. In my opinion Royal Service is the only way to go. Food great there. However food in common area was bad and we preferred room service to the restaurants outside of Royal Service. Would definitely go again!

reviews.author: Manuel V
reviews.title: Best Vacation!
reviews.text: We got the royal service package and the customer service was extraordinary! We had our own personal butler that arranged many of our activities. I took my girlfriend for her birthday and our butler Erik really made her birthday into a special day. We got our pool side cabana in the morning, reservation for a nice restaurant and when we got back into our suite, the living room was filled with birthday balloons, there was a birthday cake and champagne bottle for us to enjoy as we finished celebrating my girl’s birthday! I highly recommend the Royal Service Package!

reviews.author: Sarah M
reviews.title: Amazing Resort
reviews.text: My husband and I came on our honeymoon and it was our first time in Cancun. This place was amazing from start to finish. Beautiful inside and out. The food was awesome anything you can think of they prob have. Our fav place to eat was Bana which was sushi and my husband was not a sushi eater until there bc it was so amazingly good. The pool is huge and about 6ft deep the whole length. We hung out at the pool bar most of the week during the day if you want to meet other people on vacation that's the spot to go. Always a good time. The bar tenders at the pool bar were awesome! Very nice and friendly they knew us by name just after a few days. Also they play loud music at certain times of the day for activities like Zumba and balloon toss. I have been on a lot of vacations and I can honestly say this is the most AMAZING resort iv ever stayed. I highly recommend picking here. Pulling into Paradisus took our breath away as a first impression not other resort on the block looked as nice. I have never wrote a review before but before I picked this resort I read a lot of basically made my decision from that and that's why I decided to make my own bc it was the best choice we could have made.

reviews.author: Lavidaesuncarnaval
reviews.title: The best hotel I have ever stayed in
reviews.text:
Where to begin.. From the very first step in, we realized that this hotel is special. Amazing interior of the main pyramid with lots of restaurants and bars that are included, nice people and amazing service. Hotel position is perfect, with long, wide and perfect sandy beach, huge pool area facing the ocean, comfortable sunbeds all with shades, everything perfectly clean.

The receptionist was so nice and polite, she explained us everything. We were upgraded to Royal service, which is really Royal. It is placed in 5th pyramid with it`s own restaurant which serves all the main courses, as well as snacks and cocktails during the day. Also, it has it`s own pool zone, which is adults only, along with the best pool bar&restaurant. Besides the normal pool, there is a small, romantic pool (where we spent most of the days looking at the turquoise ocean).  

There are more than 10 restaurants serving dinner and one which is open all night, which we used almost every night after going out. Sushi bar is amazing, as well as The Market-Brasillian and Argentinian grill. I have never had such food quality and choice in an all inclusive resort!

Visiting Cancun was a part of our 25day journey through Mexico and Cuba, and we only stayed here for 5 days. We are definitely coming back for a 2 week Paradisus only vacation!

Once again, I have to mention the service and amazing, lovely, helpful, the nicest staff ever! So happy to have chosen this resort!

reviews.author: Sandy G
reviews.title: paradisus was amazing, unforgettable
reviews.text: I loved paradidus cancun! The staff was so welcoming and was extremely helpful during our stay there. I miss this place and would definitely go back to this resort. The view we had was amazing and or price was good too! Food=excellent

reviews.author: Ashly P
reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.text: This was not my first choice when booking my stay at Cancun but I am glad it worked out this way. Paradisus is a dream, please don't get discouraged by the negative reviews of a few individuals. i am actually happy I wasn't expecting it to be great because it was more than that, it totally blew me away. The hotel is spotless clean, the staff is amazing, and the gift shop seriously does offer better prices than the stores down town which is unusual. When I was looking for a hotel Paradisus ranked #11 but after such an amazing experience it should definitely by at least in the TOP 5. Im only 24 years old and those who say it was "boring" obviously didn't take it upon themselves to interact with people and find out where the places to be were. I definitely encourage everyone to consider Paradisus.

reviews.author: Rick D
reviews.title: One of Cancun's Finest
reviews.text: Whatever your taste, whether it be food, activities or sport, the Paradisus Resort has something for all ages. The pool was absolutely fantastic and included a section for younger families and little children. The rooms were very spacious and comfortable, and the maid service was impeccable. The staff was very accomodating and friendly throughout the resort. The restaurants choices were varied and the food very satisfying. I only wish that they would include bacon on the breakfast bar and include ice cream on the lunch and dinner bars. The location is perfect, unless you want to be able to walk to the night clubs away from the resort. Great value for your money!!! I will definitely stay at this resort again.

reviews.author: Maria D
reviews.title: By far a great hotel..
reviews.text:
My husband and I went to Paradisus from 10/16/2013 to 10/23/13.  It was our first time in Mexico so we learned alot!

We booked our stay through Expedia and paid about $250 per night for the all-inclusive stay.  We then paid $139 for the excursions to Tulum & Xel-ha and $24 per person for shuttle to and from airport.  Total our trip was about $2600.

When we arrived to Cancun, when you exit the terminal there are these guys set up there in ties and you think that they are trying to help you get to your shuttle, when they are NOT.  They will try to get you to go to Moon Palace to go see a presentation.  This guy got us to put $40 to go see a presentation in which he promised 2 free tickets to Xi Chen Itza.  He told us if anyone from our hotel asked us, to not tell them that we did that.

We then exited the airport where there is a place for you to get a taxi or you can look for your shuttle, ours was Best Day.

When we arrived to the hotel, we were amazed by the music and the smell, it totally just took us by surprise.  We then were greeted by a woman who walked with us to check in, then sat us down wanting us to make an appointment to see a presentation-  when we expressed to her that we already had an appointment with Moon Palace, she then matched what the guy at the airport was giving us and got us.

We then got to our room, and it was nice.  The bed was comfortable and the view was nice, however we were right above where the condensors(?) were so it was a bit of an eye sore if you looked over the balcony but from where we were it was nice.

We then went to go eat at the Fuego and the food was amazing.  

The next day we had our presentation and boy was it sales. It is a vacation option through club melia.  We passed however I must say it ate my day and they were high pressure. I did get my $40 back in pesos at a 12.5 xchange rate and 2 tickets to Xichen itza.  

we did just chill most of our time there we ate at every restaurant and the food was excellent. 

In the morning we would have breakfast in the buffet and Orlando, I think that is his name, was so pleasant and always helpful and attentive.  I wish I would have left a comment regarding him before we left, but time just fleeted us.

We were able to catch the bus right in front of the hotel to go to the malls and flea markets.  everything is inflated in Cancun and we found silver and gifts much cheaper when we went to Xichenitza.  Word of advice, with the vendors - price around then go to the cheapest.  We bought something for $24 then 2 booths down it was $10.

The cons of the hotel is that 2 nights in a row around 7-8pm they knocked on our door and proceeded to try to come in and because I was not dressed I yelled out and they asked if I needed towels, this was the same answer both times.  - This was very annoying.  The wireless internet kept going in and out.

Other than that, the staff was very nice and willing to work things out to make them more enjoyable for you.  I would like to come back to cancun, but not necessarily to come back to an all inclusive if I bring the kids.  If you dont drink or eat alot you could probably enjoy it just the same at a cheaper rate.

I would recommend this place, I may stop by again.

reviews.author: Sid D
reviews.title: Unique expérience!!!
reviews.text:
We just got back from à week vacation. We choose a Family Concierge package. We can't  stop talking about our trip. The Kids fall in love site the butlers. From the moment we enter until about Check out, the staff could not do more for us. The made the dining reservations for us for the entire stay. The food was amazing and delicious. Our suite was looking over the ocean, we had a our bed by the pool reserved on a daily basis. The pool concierge always with a smile and providing staff to our kids. The shows were good, even though we were expecting more shows.

We loved it and we will ne back soon.

reviews.author: Odie C
reviews.title: Highly recommend this property
reviews.text:
The property is beautiful and the staff are always going above and beyond to make sure you are enjoying your stay at the hotel. 
The grounds and rooms are very clean and well maintained. 
I highly recommend this property!

reviews.author: Amanda L
reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text: My husband and I just came back from a beautiful vacation at this hotel in the middle of October.  We went for a week to just get away and relax. And we did just that.  We loved our ocean front room that looked over the ocean & pool.  I loved the look of the whole hotel.  The restaurants & bars had such a great look/atmosphere to them.  We loved the Tequila Bar (Blue Agave) and Mole.  We also liked Bana, the Asian restaurant.  I believe we had Miguel there, he was excellent.  The food at the buffet (Naos) for breakfast and lunch were pretty good.  Some days were better than others.  We had Orlando as our waiter pretty much everytime and he was the best.  He took such great care of us.  Overall, the service everywhere was great.  The women trying to sell you into the Club Melia did get annoying but besides that, everyone was great.  The bartenders at the pool bar were a lot of fun too.  We had a waitress in the Avenue Bar that was great too...can't remember her name.  But she was on top of things.  That was a great place to lounge, have some drinks.  We laid in the beds a few times and watched the World Series there.  It was great to have enough to do without having to leave the hotel.  If you do want to leave the hotel, you are a short bus ride from the main club scene (less than 10 minutes)  Take the local bus, much cheaper than a taxi.   We only went out there one night, to the Coco Bongo...which is definitely worth checking out.  I would definitely recommend this to couples and friends. We were very happy with our experience !!

reviews.author: Kaitlin B.
reviews.title: A Wonderful Return to Cancun!
reviews.text: My fiancé and I had the pleasure of returning to Cancun, Mexico for a week on vacation. We stayed at the Paradisus Luxury Resort which we would absolutely recommend and stay again. From the time we arrived to the time we left, we experienced first-class service and felt completely pampered and relaxed. Our hotel room was clean and updated with a beautiful view of the ocean. The restaurants on site were very diverse and delicious for even the most refined pallets. There were many different pools areas for adults and family friendly environments as well. The Royal Service Pool Concierge were extremely friendly and accommodating. We were greeted every day by name with a reserved Bali Bed, fresh towels, sunscreen, and anything else you would need for the pool and the beach. The beaches are breathtaking and the water was very warm, clean and crystal clear blue. We also had the pleasure of making friends with hundreds of baby sea turtles as we helped release them into the ocean one night during our stay. This all part of the hotels effort to preserve the natural wildlife population. What an unforgettable and magical experience! We always felt incredibly safe and comfortable on our trip. Needless to say, that we enjoyed our overall experience and the best part would have to be the people that worked at the hotel to make it all possible. We can't wait to come back!! :)

reviews.author: GregoryD33139
reviews.title: Everything you'll need
reviews.text: Nice, clean, elegant hotel. Food and drinks also amazing. Room are spacious, well equipped. Small detail but well appreciated, the shower products are Thierry Mugler, really nice smell. Overall great stay, great staff

reviews.author: Julie A
reviews.title: Great Hotel!!!
reviews.text:
We visit the hotel resently.  The hotel is beautiful, employees very friendly.
Thanks to Eligio H. and Gerardo Cox for making breakfast and luch so special.   I recoment this hotel to everyone.  Next year we are going to the Paradisus La Perla at Playa del Carmen.  Looking forward to it.  Paradisus - EXCELLENT Hotels.

reviews.author: Johnny9s
reviews.title: Excellent resort that doesn't sell itself well enough!
reviews.text:
This is a first for me however, I felt the need to help promote this hotel - Something I believe it doesn't do itself justice with.

I travelled on 12th October 2013 for 10 nights in a group of 6 friends/couples.
Hotel is ideally located about 15/20 mins from the airport and 10 mins from the main Cancun nightlife. The hotel sits on the main Hotel strip of which a great bus service runs every 5 mins to downtown Cancun for shopping at La Isla or main downtown Cancun where the clubs and bars are located. Bus prices are slightly less the 1 USD but a cab home was never more that 10-15 USD

We were initially a little anxious about this hotel as the hotel grounds pictures were a little unusual and as a result we were unsure how nice it actually was.

I am very glad we stayed at this wonderful hotel as it is spread over a quite wide bit of land unlike the others which can be quite narrow and more deep or high rise. The result of this meant that the pools were very wide and spacious and there is a beautiful wide part of the beach associated to this hotel. (beach is amazing). I appreciate that it was lower season and not packed but I would imagine this to be a huge plus should the hotel fill up in peak season.

We stayed in Pyramid 5 which was for adults Royal Service guests. This is a must upgrade if you can. Within the main part of this Pyramid (they are all connected) you have your own guest services/check in etc along with lovely grounds of bridges and walkways with rest areas to enjoy the open bar/drinks/coffee along with a selection of food/snacks that they keep replenished throughout the day. The walk back from the pool always ended with a lovely coffee and cake prior to returning to our room. 

Rooms numbers are made up of Pyramid-Floor-door number! Ours was 5311 which was the first of the ocean view rooms. The higher numbers 12,14,15,16 etc all have ocean views with 10,09,08 etc having lagoon views.

The hotel itself whilst not brilliantly lit, does have some wonderful scents and water features throughout which make for a very enjoyable experience. The main Pyramid 3 is where most things are located. 

The restaurants and food are top notch. I didn't have a bad experience in any restaurant. Most required a reservation which can be done the day before however at times we reserved same day and were even accommodated without a reservation though again remember the hotel wasn't at full capacity. Without reviewing each restaurant, I can tell you that all food was fantastic and very very fresh. The sushi was out of this world and I'm not a huge sushi fan. If you have any special requests or tastes the staff go out of their way to accommodate you.

With regards to the service within the hotel, this has to be one of its greatest assets. The staff could not do enough for you whether it be replacement drinks, towels on beds, reservations or just a general smile and hello as you walk by. The little extras in royal service included bali beds reserved and made for you before you arrive. fresh cool towels throughout the day to keep you cool. very attentive poolside services for any drinks or snacks that you may want. they even have a great lunchtime menu should you want to eat on your Bali bed. whilst not on the menu, the afternoon ice creams were a lovely little treat and the staff went out of their way to accommodate anything that was required. Sergio was joy to meet during out stay and ensured we had a very smooth and relaxing day by the pool. One of the most friendliest employees I met during our stay. He looked after us well and we thank him again for that.

I'll try not to go on but if you're thinking about booking this hotel, you wont be disappointed. Large spacious grounds/pools with impeccable service. Friendly staff, beautiful beach and prime location for any type of holiday whether it be a relaxing one or a lively one with access to downtown Cancun within 10 minutes by bus.

My only criticism of this hotel would be the lack of entertainment in the evenings. Whilst its nice to sit in Avenue bar (great 80s soundtracks) and have a drink before/after dinner, this was the only real place to do this. They do have Red bar next to this but like most hotel nightclub/bars this was not busy and so didn't attract the guests that were staying here. 
If this hotel employed an entertainment team to put the odd show on each night and had a designated area for this then it would fly up the TripAdvisor ratings. We thought simple changes like utilising its uniqueness and putting on a pyramid light show would be benefitial or maybe a bbq on the beach with music in the evening. My thoughts are that this wouldn't cost a lot but add huge value to guests. Its little improvements like this that can go a long way for enjoyment.
Either way, you have downtown Cancun 10 mins away with an array of bars/clubs that all do open bar for a reasonable price. Congo bar is by far the best there with ticker tape and air randomly sprayed on people as part of its mental atmosphere. 20 USD and you had open bar for as long as you want therefore the lack of evening entertainment wasn't a problem with this on hand.

If anyone would like to know more, please feel free to contact me.

reviews.author: Sue B
reviews.title: Beautiful facility
reviews.text: The resort was absolutely beautiful! The restaurants how ever were not to be desired. The sushi bar area was the only place we enjoyed. The buffet is nothing like it used to be. The rest of them were way to stuffy for the average family. How can you make reservations the day before when you are on vacation? The pool was beautiful and the beach well cared for. My favorite server was Asuncion what a treat she was! We would come again but would go down to the mall and eat on the boardwalk of the bay which is what we did most of our time there.

reviews.author: DarkSparda
reviews.title: Totally worth the price, will definitely come back!
reviews.text: Great service from arrival, specially Sadrac, who gave us excellent upgrade options and advise, the suites are just great and confortable, very clean, and the food is delicious, all restaurants have a gourmet focus and with options for all kind of tastes, the waiters are really kind, specially Miguel, from the oriental restaurant, also Orlando from Naos restaurant and the girl from royal service check-in desk

reviews.author: Ontsarah
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: My husband and I just got back from a 5 night stay here... it was an amazing resort!  Words do not even begin to do justice for HOW beautiful  this resort was.  The food tasted amazing, Vento (the Mediterranean restaurant) was the best meal we've ever had and we highly recommend going there for dinner.  As well the food at the Market Grill was very good.  We booked as Royal Service and upgraded to a one bedroom suite when we got there and WOW... great room!  We Highly Highly recommend (it was only $80 per night to upgrade and it was worth it! Plus we were able to use our $100 room upgrade credit for this too).  With the one bedroom suite we were still part of the Royal Serivce and had two full bathrooms, the bedroom was separate from living room and a ridiculously huge balcony that wrapped around so you had an ocean view and view of the pool.  Sergio was our butler and he was great... always ready to help in any way.  Such a sweet guy!  We went to the other part of the resort to hang at the beach for the day (the beaches are incredible... you can walk them for hours!!! beautiful sand!) Sergio knew we weren't around Royal Service and would be in the sun all day and we came back in the room later to cold towels and aloe vera (which we indeed needed).  Its the little things that they think of here.  The separate pool and beach area for Royal Service is worth the cost of Royal Service alone, you get the bali beds (which is great after a day of being in the sun too much to have some shade) the pool/beach servers were so on top of things and will come and bring you food and drinks all day  wherever you are:) Also the resort white wine was Chardonnay and Im not a fan but they served Savignon Blanc in Royal Service and I was even able to get a bottle sent to my room thanks to Sergio :) There is 24-hour room service which is a must for me when we are away.  The staff are amazing at this place, I wish I remembered the names of more people but I don't need to because everyone at this resort is worth recognising for how friendly and helpful they are.  The gym was decent to get a work out in while away.  Was a great resort and I would definitely go back again.

reviews.author: Anisa P
reviews.title: Amazing resort, wonderful staff, great food & drinks!!!
reviews.text: My husband and I decided to go to Cancun for our three year anniversary. We chose Paradisus since a coworker had been there before and liked it. We had an amazing experience. We had the royal service and we were literally treated like royalty. The smell in Pyramid 5 was heavenly. The ocean view from our room was breathtaking. The food was great. The cabana, private pool and beach were absolutely amazing. We decided to do nothing but relax so we spent most of our time in our cabana, where Francisco Terrazos  took amazing care of us. He was so friendly, funny and attentive . We never lacked for anything. He definitely made our stay even more enjoyable. Paradisus was the perfect resort  and we loved it so much that we are already planning our next trip!!! Thank you Paradisus for such an amazing, relaxing experience :)

reviews.author: Antonio S
reviews.title: Cancun disappointment
reviews.text:
Beautiful hotel, facilities not so good.
Poor restaurants, poor reservation system for the restaurants.
Several pools, but only one with access to a bar.
There were children at the bar area in the lobby running around until late hours.

reviews.author: ANAMARIAGONZO
reviews.title: A Piece of Heaven Amazing Time Amazing Staff
reviews.text: Oh were do I begin!!! Our new travel agent Sean Rudis from Liberty Travel recommended this place and boy we hit the lottery.  My husband and I travel frequently and Mexico was our next adventure.  We arrived at Paradisus a Beautiful hotel with a divine smell in every hallway (yes smells so good weird right? ).  Very friendly lady at reception checked us in and we decided to but the Royal Service adults only side.  We were taken on a gulf cart to a private check in where we met the lovely attentive & courteous Natalia (Royal Service Natalia) she gave us all our stuff for the stay and presented us to Juan our butler.  Natalia answered all our questions and we booked all of our restaurant meals right then and there according to her recommendations and let me tell you she was absolutely right! The grounds are very well kept and the staff superb.  We stayed at Room 5606 of Royal service facing the lagoon, the view was very pretty but the service is whats key.  Juan took such an amazing care of us, always checking on us, they give us a cell phone to call the butler or concierge if we need to and he always answered.  He did a special turn down service and champagne.  He booked our bali beds for the entire stay exactly where we wanted facing the water by the beach.  He listen to us he cared, he was just fantastic!!!!! He even brought me the paper every morning and i read it with my coffee!!! Other fantastic amazing great people were: Francisco Terrazas waiter by the Royal Service pool & beach.  Francisco you are awesome!!!! He worked really hard to get everybody drinks food, excetera he was always smiling and available i was never thirsty!!! He even told us a little bit about Mexico.  Very attentive very polite thank you Juan natalia & Francisco! Oh Thank you Pool Juan & Rogelio also great oh so nice meeting both of you very attentive always on point great service! Antonio, Felipe Gracias! it was a great trip because you guys made it possible we felt like royalty! Food excellent service at all restaurants excellent every person we met aimed to please us and make us happy :) We are easy going people but they went the extra mile to make everything an experience one to remember! My favorite was the BEACH sandy clear waters, restaurants Vento, Market Grill, IBANA & Mole excellent excellent.  Seafood AMAZING and the Steaks to die for! Overall if you looking for a good time relaxing yet an ambiance this is the place, if you like the fine things in life also the place if you want to travel with kids well i didnt experience it cause we went just us, but i did see things for kids to do (not the best to ask for an opinion since i dont have any ) but it seemed like there was something for everyone in this little piece of heaven! Needless to say we will be coming back next year with our friends THANK YOU ALL at ROYAL SERVICE & ENTIRE HOTEL STAFF for a truly awesome time Gracias!

reviews.author: Sally C
reviews.title: Fabulous place to 'just be'!
reviews.text:
I will be back to enjoy your wonderful hospitality and property next year, and I can barely wait till then already!
I spent my birthday week there and had a fantastic restful, enjoyable and fun time. Service is impeccable, I'm recommending Martin and Hector in the restaurant Fuego; and in restaurant Mole are Rigoberto and Carol. I fell in love with at least 3 bartenders for their warmth and great service, they are Israel, Margarito, and Henrique. Also, Salvatore and Flash!
One server asked me why I thought so many people from Fla come to visit Cancun when they have the beaches and similar climate. I said that the service is unparalleled and the cleanliness is so very refreshing. Both of which are so very much to be proud of.
Go with the best at Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: fatiha456
reviews.title: The one and only experience
reviews.text: I had the opportunity to visit this hotel while in business in Mexico City. Then, I flew to Cancun.that was the first time to Mexico since I am from far away. I live in Saudi Arabia and have never traveled there. I must say after being around the world and experiencing the diversity of an exclusive service. I must give the thumps up to this hotel. The staff is amazing, very courteous,very hospitable. They carry a smile at all times. Thank You Paradisus Cancun for this unforgettable experience. We will be back soon and I recommend highly this hotel.

reviews.author: Parnesy
reviews.title: Wonderful Experience in fine service capped with great food and lovely beach.
reviews.text:
This was my first time at Paradisus. I have to say it is an absolutely wonderful resort with friendly staff and lovely atmosphere. The beaches are pristine and the views are 5 star. Guadalupe and Alma at front desk and guest services were wonderful. I work at a Relais and Chateau property and although this was a short stay, I will be back for sure as it is outstanding.

P.S. - Canadians travelling to Mexico please understand that you are forced to deal with HSBC bank as most other banks do not take out Credit Cards. (our security is much higher than here and requires PIN codes that most banks will not ask for).

reviews.author: Bill H
reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text: We visited the resort recently and were blown away by the experience. All of the restaurants were wonderful. Hector our butler in Royal service was amazing!! As was Natalia. We will be returning soon. The bali beds in RS were great! The food was wonderful. We tried Mole, Fuego, Bana and Naos all were out of this world, for an all-inclusive experience I would say this was the best I ever experienced. The beds were comfortable. I didn't like the laundry detergent they used for the towels and napkins smelled a little like that bacteria smell you get from older towles, but nothing is perfect, and this resort was as close as you could get to perfection!! Thanks so much for the wonderful experience!!

reviews.author: Luis L
reviews.title: Amazing Paradisus Vacation
reviews.text: We visited Paradisus Cancun, October 2-6, 2013, as soon as we arrived we were impressed with the amazing entrance and the warm welcome that we received.   We were checked-in to a Lagoon View room; which was perfect. We did see other category rooms that Darisnel at the Front Desk was so kind to allow us to view. The resort has breath taking views of the turquoise color ocean and a immaculately clean coral beach. We had an all inclusive package, which all the outlets were above standard. The very best one was "Vento Restaurante" it is a Tapa & Wine place nestled away in the resort; the service was Excellent. Javier was our anfitrion (Server) at Ventos and his level of service was exquisite, with attention to detail. Javier went above and beyond, he verified guest history and saw that my Birthday was coming up and took it upon himself to make it extra special. Took it upon himself and organized the hostess and the Captain to all come to our table and sang in latin "Las Mananitas" which was moving and so unexpected. I've been to many vacations around the world and this is a place that I'm already planing to return.

reviews.author: cmxc5
reviews.title: Great choice if you find a good deal
reviews.text:
There are many good things about this place and some things that are not that great. 

The rooms definitely need some upgrade: the AC system is really loud, twin beds are small, bathroom needs deep cleaning, bathtub didn't work, coffee machine didn't work, tv remote didn't work...

Now the good side about this hotel is probably when you you step into the lobby and you see the vegetation and the nice atmosphere created, for first timers it is just WOW... staff is friendly but i got the feeling that they expect to be tipped... but let's be honest when travel ALL INCLUSIVE we expect to have everything taken care of....food for breakfast is pretty ordinary, my favorite restaurant was BANA, the sushi there was really good and you can have as much as you want.
I would recommend anyone to stay in this place only and only if they find a good deal, but if the price is high, then you can try to find something else.

reviews.author: Daniel
reviews.title: amazing experience
reviews.text: My wife and I recently had the opportunity to stay at the Paradisus Cancun Resort for our anniversary getaway.  We were thoroughly impressed with the place itself, attention to detail, courtesy of the staff, and timeliness of services.  We couldnt have asked for a better experience.  Raul Lozano greeted us at the entrance, with a huge smile and professional presentation.  Teo Terrazas, Sergio, and Rogelio Romano provided excellent service at the poolside restaurant La Palapa as part of the Royal Service.  Great variety in food and entertainment, along with excellent service and courteous staff.  We can't wait to be back!

reviews.author: Shantall4101
reviews.title: Its the most amazing vacation that i ever had.
reviews.text: The staff its the most important thing and this staff its so kind, helpful, they have the sence of service in every word they said and in every way. Specially some names: Dulce at Naos, Carol at Fuego y Mole. Efrain front desk, Felipe in the Golf car all of them , thank you and i will be back soon. I feel like Family.

reviews.author: Tony B
reviews.title: Paradisus resort: Excellent Management!
reviews.text:
Paradisus resort was a great destination for my birthday. The hotel is beautiful and reflects the pictures. 
Upon your entry in the beautifully scented lobby you are nicely welcomed by the staff.
The check in was at 3pm but the agent checked me in earlier which was great as I was exhausted .

The suite looked great, cleaned everyday and the view was amazing.

I've tried all the restaurants and there is a great selection of food.If you are a big eater , you can literally eat there 24/7...

Finally I 'd like to give a 10+ to the management who was able to solve any issue I would bring to their attention. Fred Boutouba was an amazing interlocutor and made sure my stay exceeded my expectations.

I highly recommend Paradisus Cancun to anyone looking to spend some amazing quality time!

Myriam C.

reviews.author: tcm312
reviews.title: Very disappointing experience
reviews.text: Don't stay at this hotel! The rooms are ridiculously small, the staff is extremely unfriendly & unaccommodating, and the food is mediocre at best.  Our Deluxe Ocean View Junior Suite was anything but "deluxe"..and very "junior". The room is very crowded, minimal storage for clothing (only 3 small drawers), small bathroom....we had to store our suitcases on the balcony. Speaking of balcony... there was only one chair on the balcony. We requested 2 additional chairs and the front desk gave us an attitude about it. The pool side wait staff were very rude & unfriendly. Most of the hotel staff don't speak English. Ultimately, we met with the hotel manager Alberto to express our disappointment & request a larger room that we would pay extra for. Alberto was no help whatsoever, struggled to offer us a larger room (the hotel was only at 22% occupancy rate) & couldn't have cared less about our dissatisfaction with our experience. Needless to say, we will never stay here again. One last note: There are an endless amount of steep steps to get to the pool and beach with no hand rails. Pretty dangerous set up.

reviews.author: Scott F
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation!!!!!
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed from Oct,10-16 at Paradisus.  We chose the Royal Service side of the resort.  Let me just say that is worth the extra money. We were greeted with scented towl to wipe our faces at check in and also had a welocme drinks as we checked in.  Our butlers name was Juan.  He was so nice and would do anything you asked him to do.. He really went out of his way for us.  He always came to check on us.  He made sure our dinner reservations were made.  The day we arrived he asked if this was a special trip for us and it was our 1 year anniversary.  On the day of our anniversay her may a path to pur bed with rose pedals and made a heart on the bed out of rose pedals.  He left us a bottle of tequllia and shot galsses with limes and scented towles.  

The food was really good!  The resurants were like fine dinning.  The portions were a little small but if youwanted more all you had to do was ask.  We tryed most of them.  My wides favorite was the sushi place I dont eat sushi but she said it was some of the best she has ever had.  The buffet was really good and always has something for everyone.  

The alcohol was all top shelf!  They had Grey Goose Absolute Captain Morgan Crown Royal ect...  The beer choices could have been better but with all the top shelf it was not a deal breaker for me.  The drinks kept coming non stop.  The servers at the pool were great. 

The pool for royal service was amazing.  It was so quite and relaxing.  You did not have to deal with screaming kids and the hustle and busltle of the other pools.  The weather was perfect.  We did not have any rain.  We ate lunch by the pool in our bali bed a few times.  If they did not have something on the menu that you wanted all you had to do is ask and they would try to accomidate you with something you did want.  They also have a variety of sun blaock and tanning oils for you to use.  You dont need to bring it with you if you are staying at the royal service side.

The staff was great!  I cant say enough good things about them.  Juan was so sincere about everything.  I feel that I made a friend for life.  He did not expect any tips from you at all.  These people run all day long to make your stay perfect.  We did take care of him at the end of our trip to show how greatful we were of his service.

Sergio was one of the pool guys that took care of us.  He was great as well!!!  Always checking on us to make sure we didnt need anything.  We also took care of him at the end of our trip as well.  He had our bali bed ready everyday for us.  

This place is worth every penny.  I dont have any complaints.  Anyone whos complains about thisplace is crazy!!!!   All you you had to do is let tehm know you did not like something and they would do there best to make it better.  There are always a few things that one does not like but make the best of it. We will be going back to Paradisus again in the near future.

reviews.author: GIDRocks63
reviews.title: Excellent resort!
reviews.text: Best resort for your money. place is beautiful and five star from the moment we arrived and were greeted by Marisol who represents this resort with style and grace. the whole week we were there all the staff treated us like family. Sandra at the NAOS buffet was wonderful always greeting us with a smile and our favorite drink. The mager at Fuego, Hector, went out of his way several times for us and arranged a birthday surprise for me too. Top notch manager. Try all the ala catre restaurants but Mole was great. Our waiter Rigoberto and Veronica were above the best I have ever encountered. we ended the week eating at Tempo with

reviews.author: Stacey B
reviews.title: Even better!~
reviews.text: I have been coming here for 9 years. The change from Gran Melia to Paradisus is wonderful and I just returned from a week there. The service is even more superb than before, the new restaurants are great, and the property is still one of the best around in Cancun. I am a Member and it was the first time I brought other family with me, Nancy in the Club is amazing and helped us with everything. Juan and Marisol at the pool took care of anything we could ever want to eat or drink. The property was immaculate, the changes are not overstated, and the new amenities are a great added touch; no wifi fee for members and no extra room service charge for all inclusive. I'm so happy they got rid of those and we are already set to come back next year. Thank you, it was wonderful!

reviews.author: Mombianna
reviews.title: Incredible
reviews.text: Amazing experience.i tried  Mole restaurant which is a traditional mexican cusine. It was incredible, my hostess Carol and waiter Leonardo were very helpful with everything. Thank you for making my experience so wonderful:)

reviews.author: Sherry S
reviews.title: Perfect way to relax!
reviews.text: This resort was everything I hoped it would be and then some. The staff is top notch. Lots of choices. The resort is set on a spa theme, my goal was to disconnect and relax. With so many Breath taking views and choices totally perfect.

reviews.author: Juan G
reviews.title: 1st. Wedding Anniversary/2nd. Honeymoon
reviews.text:
My wife & I decided to go back to Cancun and celebrate our wedding anniversary. We stayed from Friday September 27th - Friday October 4th 2013. This was our 2nd time visiting Cancun and we were very pleased with our stay at Paradisus. We originally booked a Junior Suite with an Ocean View but somehow there was a mix up at the front desk and we ended up getting "Family Concierge" with a Junior Suite - Ocean View......... We were glad we did. It's like Royal Service but they put you in Tower 1 which is a good 10 minute walk Up and Down stairs/elevators to reach Tower 3 which is where all the restaurants and bars are located in. The rooms were beautiful. Make sure to get the Ocean View Junior Suite!!! The room had it's own outdoor balcony with a Jacuzzi and chairs. We stayed on the 4th floor, excellent view of the pool and Ocean. 

The whole staff made us feel welcomed and attended to our every need....... 

-Our head Concierge MARIA REYES was attentive from the get go. She made sure that of our reservations for restaurants were made. We were welcomed with a bottle of Milagro Tequila, Rose petals laid out on our bed and a Bottle of Champagne. We also had 2 personal butlers hep us out "NANCY" and "KARINA". They were the sweetest and most helpful girls, they would surprise my wife and I with chocolate covered strawberries, snacks, bottles of tequila sent up to our room on random days during our stay. 

PROS:
-Blue Agave: My wife and I fell in love with this restaurant. It's traditional Mexican food "Tacos & Quesadillas" along with a FULLY stocked Tequila & Mezcal bar. We are simple people who love home style cooked meals and this place did not disappoint. Our waiter RIGOBERTO was very attentive, funny and respectful. Always made sure our drinks were topped off and our plates with food. The manager MAURICIO made sure that my wife and I got a great table by the corner with a view of the ocean (seeing that we were celebrating our anniversary) he wanted to make sure that the setting was perfect for us to enjoy our evening.

-Noas (Buffet): The food is limited in selection but enjoyed the taste. Omelette bar, Enchiladas and the Re fried Beans for breakfast were excellent. We had the pleasure of meeting a few of the waiters/waitress that work there. IGNACIO was an easy going guy originally from Alabama I believe that moved to Cancun. He was funny and could relate to everything we threw his way. VALERIA was very humble and down to earth, we were talking about food and she mentioned that the "Tortas de cochinita pibil" were popular in Cancun and offered to bring us a couple to try from a friend who makes them. She kept her word and brought them our last day there. THEY WERE GOOD!!!!!! We also had dinner there one night and BALTAZAR was our waiter. Super cool guy and hooked me up with Double shots of premium Tequila at no charge. Very funny and easy going. He also gave my wife and I a "Coffee cup" of Tequila and dessert to go.

-Mole: Mexican restaurant with flavors from Oaxaca and Nayarit. The Chicken Mole was awesome, the appetizer platter was just GREAT. Our waiter ANGEL was excellent and knew so much about Tequila, he recommended an excellent choice for the evening. The hostess MONTSERRAT was a total sweetheart and made sure that we were seated quickly and sent the waiter right over to help us out. She came around once to make sure we were enjoying our evening. Similar quality of food like Blue Agave. By far these 2 restaurants were our favorite during our stay.

CONS:
Not many but the only things that bothered us was the night of our actual anniversary we made reservations for "Fuego" which is one of the restaurants there. Let's just say that service was SUUUUUUPER SLOOOOOW. Waiter comes over and asks us if we wanted more bread (We have been sitting there for 10 minutes and have not been helped yet) so we were honest and told him that we never got bread. 5 minutes later he brings us waters and asks us if we wanted bread (Ummmmm yeah)....... The courses took too long to arrive. Soup was cold, Appetizers came with our first serving of bread. It took 2 hours for us to receive our Main Course which consisted of a Cold/Under cooked Steak. We were upset and didn't finish our meal & left.

The other thing was the Timeshare presentations and persistent phone calls to your room. We got tracked down by an employee saying "Oh we have a welcome present for you" my wife received a little wicker bag with some lotions which was nice but then BOOM came the hook..... "Are you guys planning any excursions"? To which we knew that we got trapped. He offered a discount to Xcaret 2 for 1 but the only thing was that we had to sit through a 90 minute presentation for Melia Resorts "Tiempo Compartido" which technically means Timeshare even though they denied it and said that it wasn't. We wen't through it and at first didn't receive the 2 for 1. Supposedly it was only a $100 discount. I was upset and complained to the Lady in charge of the timeshare presentation. At the end there was a "Misunderstanding" and went ahead & honored the 2 for 1. 

Overall our trip was memorable and very enjoyable, we wen't during the Off-season so it was kinda slow with maybe 30% occupancy but we made up for it by going on excursions and hitting downtown for a night at the clubs & bars. It rained 2 of the 7 nights we weer there so that was good. I highly recommend you come and stay at Paradisus Cancun. The staff are super cool and helpful & Cancun is just too beautiful to pass up. I will def. be returning soon.

reviews.author: jullian09
reviews.title: Very dated hotel
reviews.text: We where here on august 2013, they just change the name from Melia to paradisus, to start this hotel is very dated except for the name... we had a great room on the 5th floor with the best view but overall for the prices they charge you expect a refurbished and up to date hotel i saw a picture of someone else that did a review on this hotel showing a 30 year old iron board and i laugh about it, guess what happen to me the same problem...(haha) to rename a hotel paradisus you need to at least remove and change your old furniture, had a good time just this minor problems overall nice stay, nice people and good costumer service.

reviews.author: Kenneth W
reviews.title: Most Incredible Experience!!
reviews.text:
WoW, WoW, Wow!! This is one of the most memorable trip my wife and I ever had. We have stayed in 100's of Hotels worldwide but this had to be the best to date!! It did not start out that way.... First night we had to change rooms because i was on crutches and the walk to all the meeting rooms or dining facilities would have been to much. Then we had to change to another room because of minor house keeping issues. Finally we arrived in room 3712. Our rep Natalia for the Royal Service was so helpful and caring, she made us feel like family!! Everyone was so helpful and friendly everywhere in the hotel!! Special thanks to Valeria Gallardo at the Naos restaurant for extra care and service. Guadalupe at the Check out counter and Raul "Paul Newman" our Bell guy, whose service was exemplary!! This was our second trip to Cancun and we do plan to stay at Paradisus the next time we go!! If you want to stay at a place where everyone from check in to check out smiles, says Hi and are incredibly helpful, look no further!! Give our friend Natalia a call and she will give you a Royal welcome!! Thanks Agains Natalia and may God Bless you and your incredible facility!!
Ken and Ratna Wendling  Texas USA!!

reviews.author: Judy G
reviews.title: Thank you, Paradisus Cancun!
reviews.text: Thank you for a wonderful vacation.  We think your hotel is the most beautiful one in the Hotel Zone.  All of your staff are so friendly and helpful.  This is our fourth stay, and Raul has greeted us each time with such sincere friendliness that we feel like old friends.  Sandra in the Restaurant Naos was also especially friendly and helpful.  Walking out the door to the beach and the beautiful pools is a luxury that we look forward to.

reviews.author: HidG
reviews.title: Nice, clean, great service
reviews.text:
We are currently here for 7 days.  This is day 2.  Guadalupe was very helpful in our check in process.  She is aware we are elevating our anniversary.  We are loyal Melia guests, and this is our first time to Paradisus Cancun.
Last night we had a large storm, and the water leaked into our room.  We had a flood.  We are in 3611, so I am not sure if this is the only room with this leaking problem.  They offered to mop it up, but I had already sopped up what I could with towels.  I just let housekeeping clean up.  I guess we will see if the leak persists.

Market Grill is full of amazing staff!  Guillermo, Margarita, Juan, and Rody have made our dinner absolutely delightful.  We will be here every night just to see them.  They went above and beyond what is asked of them!

We are looking forward to visiting Paradisus Resorts in other countries as we travel.  We are loyal!

reviews.author: Min D
reviews.title: Nice All-inclusive place for Cancun trip
reviews.text:
My family stayed in Paradisus for 5 nights and it was mostly a pleasent trip.
The location is great, it is in the middle of the Hotel Zone. 
Beautiful beach and lots of activities on site.
The food and restaurants are great. Can't have enough of it.
All the employees were very friendly and helpful.

There were a few cons. One, the check-in process was kinda slow, took us about 20-30 minutes. Two, the service call from room (like replacing a key card, or refill bottled water) was not responded quickly, took about half an hour. Three, the room we stayed in was above the main hall and the music and noise from the bars below was kinda loud.

reviews.author: Philip F
reviews.title: 4 night stay at resort
reviews.text: Excellent.... Wish the rooms had a jacuzzi in it is the only issue I can see wrong with this resort (we stayed at the hard rock only 4 mths ago & that was great to have). Other than that, the premises are great, restaurants are dope & location on beach was perfect

reviews.author: Vilmaris C
reviews.title: Paradisus a Real Paradise.
reviews.text: After a rough time at the airport because our lauggage did not arrived with us to Cancún, all was forgoten as soon as we arrived to the hotel and we were so warmly received by the hotel staff. They were very helpful and nice. The service was exelent in every corner we stood. The buffet was good but it needed a little nore variety. And in the Mexican Restaurant that was included in our all inclusive package the service was a little poor by the waiter and they serve very but very little portion of food. But that was the only not perfect moment for us. The fresh smell in the hotel and room was great.

reviews.author: Suzel A
reviews.title: Amazing week
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed at the Paradisus Cancun the week of September 1st 
I will try to give a bias review since I am a travel consultant and I was there in September when hotels are not a full capacity.  
Staff is friendly and available to help out whenever needed. 
The hotel is very clean and well maintained, as well as the rooms 
It was very easy to make a la carte reservations.  Personally I found the food amazing and well varied.  The beach is beautiful and easy to find a quiet corner.  Mid week the hotel filled up to about 70% capacity with the world beach tennis tournament and although there were more people the services still remained the same and did not affect regular guest staying at the property. 
The plants and fountains in the lobby and throughout the hotel give this resort a zen and calming atmosphere.  
The only negative point at the resort is the timeshare people that hassle you all week… defiantly the hotel should think of putting them in a closed office and should not allow them to hassle the guests in the hallway. 
I would defiantly return and truly enjoyed my week of reading and relaxation

reviews.author: Sue630
reviews.title: Royal Service, Very Nice!
reviews.text:
Everyone from the Paradisus Manager to the Royal Service Manger aimed to please in every way! No matter how  small or grand the request,  the staff was willing to accommodate. The only liaise faire employee was Samuel the Butler. We asked that he be replaced by Hector and our request was accommodated. Hector was 5 Star!!!!! The Royal Service pool area was outstanding and the food at the Royal Service luncheon area was out of this world! Especially the Mahi-Mahi. The area should be open till 8pm so folks can enjoy ocean front petite dinners!!! We would eat there every night! Our room had a beautiful ocean view. It was cool, however, we always travel with a small fan to ensure maximum air conditioning. The common areas are not air conditioned. They could use fans, especially in the Japanese Restaurant area. As far as cleanliness goes, the entire hotel was sparkling! We are very particular!  The spa treatments were very nice. A few areas need to be updated mechanically like the shower and pool. We never saw anyone selling anything like time share etc in 10 days. the weather was grand, only 1 day of rain in 10. All of the alcohol is top shelf. 
The bloody Mary's are the best anywhere.  All and all we had a fantastic time and look forward to returning next year. They are working furiously to improve every aspect of the property that needs improvement!

reviews.author: esteban t
reviews.title: Good place
reviews.text: Its a nice place, good if traveling with family and kids, they have several things for kids to do, restaurants were good, good location. The only thing they need to work on is getting transportation from lobby entrance to the blvd, its about 1 block walk to the city bus

reviews.author: Jared K
reviews.title: Extremely Great Experience
reviews.text: This was our second visit here to the Paradisus Cancun Resort.  The last time we visited, it was called the Gran Melia and we enjoyed the property very much.  We heard about the revisions and decided to visit here again.  Overall, our experience this time exceeded our experience of the last visit.  Everyone was so wonderfully helpful. There was never a time where we were left to fend for ourselves.  We were always in contact with our Family Concierge or the other Concierge's at the resort and every single one of them were extremely helpful.  We would like to make a special shout out to ALL of the Family Concierge staff, in particular our own Concierge Grace, as well as Reyes and Stephanie who were all extremely helpful in all circumstances.  Others we would like to note are Henvick, who was acting as the pool concierge while the actual person in that role was away.  He was always there for us and made sure we were happy every second by the pool.  Also, our outside waitress Asuncion was always cheerful and ready to bring us whatever we asked for.
