While eating at Bana, Eric and Violeta were very great at assisting us in our Sushi adventures.  While eating breakfast/lunch everyday at Naos, Jesus was excellent and excelled at delivering exceptional customer service to his clients.  Theses were just a few of the MANY, MANY staff members we encountered; however everyone at the resort should be commended for their excellent customer service and their will to make ever persons stay memorable.  Thank you for a great 6 nights here at the Paradisus resort.  We will be back and next time we will be brining more friends!

reviews.author: Marc N
reviews.title: Very nice Property
reviews.text:
Location and resort property is great.  Plenty of amenities. Pools were amazing.  Plenty of chairs and cabanas.  Food was GREAT.  Service was GREAT.  The rooms were basic, beds not comfortable. Shower was a letdown.  I would come back, maybe if we upgraded the room it would have been more comfortable?
The staff was exceptional.  I even misplaced my wallet and it was returned to me within 30 minutes from Veronica in the Melia Club.  She wouldn't accept anything other than man appreciation!  Thank you Veronica!

reviews.author: Mary F
reviews.title: Fantastik !!
reviews.text: We just returned from Cåncun,  This hotel was wonderful...  The ocean view, The decoration, the people, the food, the service everything was a dream!!!! you will have an exclusive service. I are already  making plans to go back  next year :):) GRACIAS a todos.

reviews.author: jarodri1
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text:
This was my 9th business trip to Cancun and my first time in paradisus hotel. I have to admit that the personnel and the quality of my stay far surpassed my expectations. Thank you for the wonderful experience.
John Martin

reviews.author: Luisky69
reviews.title: Spoiled & Pampered in Paradisus
reviews.text: We are really happy with the family concierge service. Karla our family assigned buttler is really helpful and has great attitude. We had an amazing dinner at the Tempo restaurant experiencing a menu with different dishes of Vasque Cuisine a really memorable dinner.

reviews.author: John J
reviews.title: Wonderful Experience!
reviews.text:
My family and I went into a trip to spend a small vacations at Cancun last month. We spend 4 days in one of the most rememberable vacations we'll ever have. With our small kids getting rotten spoiled by the family concierge staff, our only concern was in how to spend the extra "couple time" we weren't expecting, so, we discovered this Coco's Bar at the hotel beach, with a magnificent view of the ocean, were you can lay on your very own private beach bed, and spend all your day just chilling out and enjoying yourself, even they had a butler to bring you what ever you needed. At the end of the day we picked up our kids from the family concierge and went to have dinner at the mexican restaurant near the beach, where we taste some of the most extraordinary mexican cuisine.. Just amazing!! (Definitively two thumbs up!!!), afterwards, we went to our room, and for our own surprised, our beds were folded just for us to get inside and sleep (they make some extra points with the kids by adding a chocolate on top of the pillows!)
I believe, the best part was knowing that our kids were safe and having fun, while we could spend our time as a couple as well. Most say that for the first time in my life, I felt that a hotel wasn't just an industry for passing the night, far beyond that, was a business for creating feelings and memories!
For all the people working in Paradisus Cancun Resort, thank you to all very much!!! Looking forward to come back pretty soon!!!

reviews.author: mrmarkx
reviews.title: More heat then happiness.
reviews.text: Having stayed at other various resorts in Mexico, this place can no way be compared to other 5 star resorts. Rooms that were held together by paint and caulk, lack of air conditioners that properly worked to cool our room, let alone to cool the restaurant's, and a crew of pushy "members only club" sellers, all deemed to work  for a heated time, but not a enjoyable one. The resort had numerous plant boxes and vines for an enchanted view of greenery, yet to grow these, the roofs all have glass panels to let in the sunlight, along with the tremendous heat that comes with it. Thinking the pools will cool you off, well they can a bit until 7pm each night,, since after then the pools are closed for "cleaning and sanitizing", which as a vacationer seemed ridiculous! Even though this resort had over 700 people there the week before, we found that most of the restaurants were closed every other day because this was "slow season". Now the restaurants that we finally did eat in had incredible dishes. I do recommend the food at the restaurants, yet the buffet at lunch time was awful, really awful. As usual in Mexico, the wait(Hector), pool(Rogelo), and bar staff(Karina Reyes) were tremendously courteous, but the room cleaning staff wasn't really up to par, even if it had been for a local run down interstate motel. In the end all I can say is "wont be going back there any time soon, unless its half price and I know the air is on "super high".

reviews.author: Keith H
reviews.title: I'd stay here again
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun proved to be a great place to stay for my business/leisure trip.  There is a nice combination of business people, couples, singles and families so no one feels out of place.  The restaurants are all good with nice presentation.  The staff is friendly and willing to help.  All of the water sports that are included are located in the AquaMarina right across the street on the lagoon side. They only have an agreement with hotel and are not hotel staff, hence there are tip boxes everywhere and they have no qualms about asking for tips either.  They require a waiver form where we would be responsible to pay $40/square inch of damage, so be careful.  I still rented windsurfing equipment and a Hobie Cat and did a little sailing.  There are also kayaks for rental.  I am into fly fishing, so I spent a half day with a guide from CancunTarponFishing.com and it was excellent.
